paper_title: Linked within-host and between-host models and data for infectious diseases: A systematic review
paper_abstract: The observed dynamics of infectious diseases are driven by processes across multiple scales. Here we focus on two: within-host, that is how an infection progresses inside a single individual (for instance viral and immune dynamics), and between-host, that is how the infection is transmitted between multiple individuals of a host population. The dynamics of each of these may be influenced by the other, particularly across evolutionary time. Thus understanding each of these scales, and the links between them, is necessary for a holistic understanding of the spread of infectious diseases. One approach to combining these scales is through mathematical modeling. We conducted a systematic review of the published literature on multi-scale mathematical models of disease transmission (as defined by combining within-host and between-host scales) to determine the extent to which mathematical models are being used to understand across-scale transmission, and the extent to which these models are being confronted with data.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Basic reporting see below Experimental design see below Validity of the findings see below Comments for the Author This is a nice review worth publishing, but I have several concerns that I think should be addressed. My main concern is about the search strategy. I find it too narrow to be a convincing systematic review. First, it seems to me your search terms are not broad enough. For instance I have seen papers that use the term “in-host” instead of “within-host”. Similarly, there might be papers who have a population-level component but might not use the word “between-host”. With your search terms, you seem to be missing those. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We have widened our search terms in several ways to look for: (within-host* OR in-host-model* OR among-host-model* ) AND (between-host* OR nested-model* OR cross-scale-model*) AND (pathogen* OR parasite* ) AND (transmi*) We now include “in-host-model” as well as “within-host.” We chose “in-host-model,” rather than just “in-host” to avoid the large number of out-of-scope papers that are found when the preposition “in” is searched next to “host.” We feel this encompasses all suggested additional terms by both this reviewer and other reviewers. We note that this search accesses the “title,” “abstract,” “author keywords,” and “keywords plus.” If the search terms are not found in these locations, the papers will not be returned from the search. Further, systematic reviews generally search across multiple sources, it is unusual for systematic reviews to only search a single source (despite WoS being more than one database, I consider it essentially a single source). I recommend you re-do your search across multiple sources (e.g. include Scopus or others that you think might be complementary to WoS) and use somewhat more flexible search terms to ensure you get all relevant studies, not only those who explicitly use the term “within-host”. Such a broader search would make me more confident that this was truly systematic/broad. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We believe the “all database” collection of Web of Science is a sufficiently large source for peer-reviewed articles that would meet our criteria. To confirm this, we also considered Scopus but did not find any additional papers. My remaining comments are less substantial, listed in order of appearance: Abstract: calling within-host the 1st scale is a bit arbitrary. One could equally say that within-cell/intracellular is the 1st scale. So I would re-word some to indicate that here you are looking at 2 of the – possibly many – ways one can define scales. Start of introduction is worded better. We thank the reviewer for this point. We have reworded to clarify that we are talking about two possible scales – within-host and between-host, which we no longer label as first and second. Line 25: typo, should be holistic Corrected. Line 87: I’m unclear what ‘out of scope’ refers to. Can you clarify? It seems to me that if it’s not a multi-scale model and/or doesn’t contain data, it is flagged as ‘No’ for those categories. What other ‘out of scope’ evaluation did you perform? Where there some papers that were multi-scale models with data but you ignored them? If so why? Needs some more explanation. We thank the reviewer for this question. `Out-of-scope’ refers to papers that incorporate our search terms but do not use them in a way consistent with the article. For example, as “within” and “between” are prepositions it is possible for an article that is not attempting anything multi-scale to include both in the abstract and, thus, be recovered by our search. Thus, we felt it inappropriate to label this as lacking a model or data at a certain scale, if that was not even in line with the intention of the paper. Additionally, we labeled out-of-scope any articles that were from conferences and, thus, only contained an abstract. Figure 3: since there are only 2 “other” in 3A and 1 in 3B, maybe explicitly state what this ‘other’ is. Especially for infection type, I’m wondering what it could be that’s not one of the listed categories. We thank the reviewer for the suggestion and have adapted the figure to describe “Other”, when possible to succinctly summarize. In short, in the previous manuscript, the “Other” in Figure 3A were both bacteria while the “Other” in Figure 3B referred to plasmids. In our new figures, what “Other” refers to given in the caption when the number is manageable. Otherwise there is description in the text. Additional information can often be found in the extended data files. Figure 4: I find that figure confusing since it looks as if these are mutually exclusive categories when they are not. IBM could be either deterministic (rare) or stochastic (common), any deterministic or stochastic model could be fit to data, which would make it ‘statistical’. The only clear mutually exclusive categories are deterministic vs stochastic. I think you need better terminology for this. I assume what you mean by deterministic is also a mechanistic, compartmental model (i.e. ODE), and stochastic is also a mechanistic compartmental model, while IBM is individual based (and maybe deterministic, maybe stochastic), and what you call statistical I assume by that you mean a non-mechanistic/process/system model? We thank the reviewer for this clarification. We have specified what we mean by each categorization in the text and in the figure caption. See the response to
paper_title_zh: 宿主内和宿主间传染病模型及数据的关联：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 传染病观察到的动态由多个尺度上的过程驱动。本文重点关注两个尺度：宿主体内，即感染在单个个体内部的进展方式（例如病毒和免疫动态），以及宿主间，即感染在宿主种群多个个体之间的传播方式。每个尺度的动态都可能受到另一个尺度的影响，尤其是在进化时间尺度上。因此，理解每个尺度及其之间的联系，对于全面理解传染病的传播是必要的。将这两个尺度结合的一种方法是数学建模。我们对已发表的关于疾病传播的多尺度数学模型（定义为结合宿主体内和宿主间尺度）文献进行了系统综述，以确定数学模型在理解跨尺度传播方面的应用程度，以及这些模型与数据相符的程度。

此外，系统综述通常会在多个来源中进行搜索，仅在一个来源（尽管WoS不止一个数据库，但我认为它本质上是一个单一来源）中搜索是不常见的。我建议你们在多个来源（例如，包括Scopus或你们认为与WoS互补的其他来源）中重新进行搜索，并使用更灵活的搜索词，以确保获取所有相关研究，而不仅仅是那些明确使用“within-host”这一术语的研究。这样更广泛的搜索会让我更有信心，这确实是一个系统/广泛的综述。

我剩下的评论不那么重要，按出现顺序列出：

我们感谢审稿人的这个问题。“Out-of-scope”指的是那些包含我们搜索词但使用方式与文章不一致的论文。例如，由于“within”和“between”是介词，一篇并非试图进行多尺度研究的文章也可能在摘要中包含这两个词，从而被我们的搜索检索到。因此，我们认为将其标记为在某一尺度上缺乏模型或数据是不恰当的，如果这甚至不符合文章的意图。此外，我们将所有来自会议且仅包含摘要的文章标记为“out-of-scope”。

paper_title: Remote sensing techniques for automated marine mammals detection: a review of methods and current challenges
paper_abstract: Marine mammals are under pressure from multiple threats, such as global climate change, bycatch, and vessel collisions. In this context, more frequent and spatially extensive surveys for abundance and distribution studies are necessary to inform conservation efforts. Marine mammal surveys have been performed visually from land, ships, and aircraft. These methods can be costly, logistically challenging in remote locations, dangerous to researchers, and disturbing to the animals. The growing use of imagery from satellite and unoccupied aerial systems (UAS) can help address some of these challenges, complementing crewed surveys and allowing for more frequent and evenly distributed surveys, especially for remote locations. However, manual counts in satellite and UAS imagery remain time and labor intensive, but the automation of image analyses offers promising solutions. Here, we reviewed the literature for automated methods applied to detect marine mammals in satellite and UAS imagery. The performance of studies is quantitatively compared with metrics that evaluate false positives and false negatives from automated detection against manual counts of animals, which allows for a better assessment of the impact of miscounts in conservation contexts. In general, methods that relied solely on statistical differences in the spectral responses of animals and their surroundings performed worse than studies that used convolutional neural networks (CNN). Despite mixed results, CNN showed promise, and its use and evaluation should continue. Overall, while automation can reduce time and labor, more research is needed to improve the accuracy of automated counts. With the current state of knowledge, it is best to use semi-automated approaches that involve user revision of the output. These approaches currently enable the best tradeoff between time effort and detection accuracy.
review_content: Reviewer 2. Some of the metrics were renamed, and the rationale for their use is now better explained (lines 432-523).
paper_title_zh: 遥感技术用于自动探测海洋哺乳动物：方法综述及当前挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 海洋哺乳动物面临着多重威胁，如全球气候变化、副渔获物和船舶碰撞。在此背景下，为了指导保护工作，更频繁且空间范围更广的丰度和分布研究调查是必要的。海洋哺乳动物的调查已通过陆地、船只和飞机进行目视观察。这些方法可能成本高昂，在偏远地区后勤挑战大，对研究人员存在危险，且可能干扰动物。卫星和无人物流系统（UAS）图像的日益使用有助于解决这些挑战，补充有人调查，并允许更频繁且分布更均匀的调查，特别是在偏远地区。然而，卫星和UAS图像中的手动计数仍然费时费力，但图像分析的自动化提供了有前景的解决方案。本文综述了应用于卫星和UAS图像中检测海洋哺乳动物的自动化方法文献。通过定量比较研究性能，使用评估自动化检测与动物手动计数之间假阳性和假阴性的指标，这有助于更好地评估保护背景下误计数的影响。总体而言，仅依赖动物及其周围环境光谱响应统计差异的方法表现不如使用卷积神经网络（CNN）的研究。尽管结果不一，CNN显示出潜力，其使用和评估应继续进行。总体而言，尽管自动化可以减少时间和劳力，但仍需更多研究以提高自动化计数的准确性。根据当前知识水平，最好使用涉及用户修订输出的半自动化方法。这些方法目前能够在时间投入和检测准确性之间实现最佳平衡。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2：部分指标已被重新命名，并且对其使用理由的说明现在更为清晰（第432-523行）。

reasons: Some of the metrics were renamed, and the rationale for their use is now better explained (lines 432-523).

paper_title: Framing and understanding the whole aspect of oral sex from social and health perspectives: a narrative review
paper_abstract:
Historically, oral sex is part of human sexual behaviour even though some consider it taboo, and its expression is deemed inappropriate. Human rights also stand out as technology becomes more sophisticated, leading to its practice disclosure in the 21 st century. The large-scale oral sex discussion in media encourages people to express it, and there is feedback on whether it is right or not. It all depends on each person’s values. We found this sexual behaviour occurs everywhere regardless of religion, culture and race. 
Pop culture influences this behaviour considerably. It can be seen in music, movies and television programmes that allude to oral sex. Numerous motivations underlying this behaviour include sexual pleasure for the sake of psychological well-being. It is undeniable that this behaviour is still controversial. There is a risk of it causing disease, but it reportedly provides many benefits. 
Oral sex is not a new behaviour crossing boundaries, according to our theory. It is an old behaviour that has been highlighted because of the factors that support it. This behaviour, still considered taboo, has its disadvantages, such as sexually transmitted disease and oral cancer, but also has benefits, such as preventing preeclampsia.
review_content:
First, I would like to take this opportunity to say thank you for giving me this chance to review this interesting topic.

In my opinion, I would like to say thank you to the authors who spent time writing this article. However, this is not a review paper, because:
  * There is no rationale for this paper. Why did you do this review? What contexts are you looking for? Are you looking for this in a certain country or globally?
  * Method: what databases did you search for these papers? Time frame? Countries? Etc?
  * The topic of the review is not discussed comprehensively in the context. To me, this paper is very descriptive. It needs more critical thinking.
  * The conclusion is so simple. The authors should restate their aims/objectives and future directions or implications (if needed).

I think this paper should be revised a lot before it can be published. My recommendations are below:

Introduction:
The authors need to clarify: Why are you doing this review? What are your aims/objectives?
Defining oral sex and pop culture
Paragraph No3 (from the top) - page 3/9: The last sentence needs references.
Paragraph No4 (from the top) - page 3/9: The first sentence needs references.

Prevalence of oral sex
I suggest this headline should be The prevalence of oral sex of some countries around the world.
This section is so descriptive. You should say some things such as what is your thinking of these oral sex rates?

Perspectives and motives in oral sex
You should add on the countries where these studies were conducted. Again, what do you think about these studies influencing your aims?

Attitudes in oral sex
Again, which nationalities of these participants in these studies?
Paragraphs No 2&3 should be deleted because they are irrelevant to this section.

Oral sex risk
This section is good.

Benefits obtained due to oral sex
I suggest this headline should be “oral sex benefits”.
Again, which nationalities of these participants in these studies?
paper_title_zh: 从社会和健康视角构建和全面理解口交问题：一项叙事性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
历史上，口交是人类性行为的一部分，尽管有些人认为它是一种禁忌，其表达也被认为是不恰当的。随着技术的日益复杂，人权问题也凸显出来，导致其在21世纪的实践被披露。媒体中的大规模口交讨论鼓励人们表达这一行为，并且存在关于其是否正确的反馈。这一切都取决于每个人的价值观。我们发现这种性行为无处不在，不受宗教、文化和种族的影响。

流行文化对这种行为的影响相当大。在音乐、电影和电视节目中都可以看到对口交的暗示。这种行为背后的众多动机包括为了心理福祉而追求性快感。不可否认，这种行为仍然存在争议。它有引发疾病的风险，但据报道也提供了许多益处。

根据我们的理论，口交并非一种跨越界限的新行为。它是一种古老的行为，由于支持它的因素而被凸显出来。这种仍被视为禁忌的行为有其缺点，如性传播疾病和口腔癌，但也有其益处，如预防先兆子痫。
review_content_zh:

  * 方法：您搜索了哪些数据库来获取这些论文？时间范围？国家？等等？

  * 结论过于简单。作者应该重述他们的目标/目的以及未来的方向或影响（如果需要的话）。

我认为这篇论文在发表前需要大量修订。我的建议如下：

paper_title: The effects of teaching strategies on learning to think critically in primary and secondary schools: an overview of systematic reviews
paper_abstract:
Background 
 We conducted an overview of systematic reviews about the effects of teaching strategies that can be used to teach primary and secondary school students to think critically. Our objective was to inform decisions about what teaching strategies to use in resources that we developed to teach critical thinking about health in secondary schools. 
 
 
 Methods 
 We mapped characteristics of systematic reviews of teaching strategies and summarised findings from the most relevant reviews to teaching students to think critically about health. We included reviews that assessed the effects of teaching strategies that could potentially be used in primary or secondary schools to teach students to think critically, had a Methods section with explicit selection criteria, reported at least one outcome measure of the ability to undertake one of four basic types of cognitive tasks (memory, procedural, comprehension, or opinion), and were published after 1999. 
 
 
 Results 
 We included 326 systematic reviews. The reviews evaluated a wide range of teaching strategies for a variety of purposes. Important limitations of the reviews included not considering adverse effects (99% of the reviews), not assessing the risk of bias for included studies (93% of the reviews), and not assessing the credibility of subgroup effects (100% of the reviews). We summarised the findings for 37 teaching strategies that we considered most relevant. The certainty of the evidence of the effects varied from very low to moderate. We used 12 of the strategies in resources that we developed to teach secondary students to think critically about health. 
 
 
 Conclusions 
 A tremendous amount of work has gone into evaluating the effects of a wide range of teaching strategies. The results of this research can inform decisions about how to teach critical thinking and future research. However, well-designed, up-to-date systematic reviews are still needed for many teaching strategies.
review_content: This an interesting paper with clear objectives and criteria for a systematic review of other reviews on teaching strategies and their effects on learning and critical thinking in education. Despite the lack of some evidence in the reviews that were anaysed, the study contributes to the categorisation of teaching strategies and in summarizing their (possible) effects on learning.
paper_title_zh: "教学策略对中小学批判性思维学习的影响：系统综述概览"
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
我们进行了一项关于教学策略的系统评价概述，这些策略可以用来教授小学生和初中生进行批判性思考。我们的目标是指导我们在开发用于教授中学健康批判性思考的资源时，应使用哪些教学策略。

方法
我们绘制了教学策略系统评价的特征，并总结了与教授学生进行健康批判性思考最相关的评价的发现。我们纳入了评估可能用于小学或中学教授学生进行批判性思考的教学策略的评价，这些评价具有明确选择标准的方法部分，报告了至少一项完成四种基本认知任务（记忆、程序、理解或观点）能力的结果测量，并且发表于1999年之后。

结果
我们纳入了326项系统评价。这些评价评估了多种目的的广泛教学策略。评价的重要局限性包括未考虑不良影响（99%的评价）、未评估纳入研究的偏倚风险（93%的评价）以及未评估亚组效应的可信度（100%的评价）。我们总结了我们认为最相关的37种教学策略的发现。效果证据的确定性从非常低到中等不等。我们在开发的用于教授中学生进行健康批判性思考的资源中使用了其中的12种策略。

结论
大量工作已投入到评估广泛教学策略的效果中。这项研究的结果可以指导如何教授批判性思考以及未来的研究。然而，许多教学策略仍需要设计良好、最新的系统评价。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇有趣的论文，具有明确的目标和标准，对教育中教学策略及其对学习和批判性思维影响的综述进行了系统回顾。尽管在所分析的综述中缺乏一些证据，该研究仍有助于教学策略的分类，并总结了它们（可能的）对学习的影响。

paper_title: Video Diffusion Models - A Survey
paper_abstract: Diffusion generative models have recently shown great potential for video generation and editing tasks. This survey provides a systematic overview over relevant aspects of video diffusion models such as applications, architecture, and temporal dynamics. Developments in the field are outlined through paper summaries. The review concludes with an examination of remaining challenges and an outlook on the future of the field.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey provides a broad overview of recent advances in video diffusion models, organizing related works into relevant subtask categories. The paper covers several important aspects including applications, architectures, temporal dynamics, and evaluation metrics.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Pros: - The paper covers application taxonomy, model architecture, temporal dynamics, Evaluation Metrics, and provides an introduction for readers who want to know the overview of the video diffusion field. - Table1 provides a systematic overview of prior works and figure 2 provides a good taxonomy of video diffusion applications. Cons: - While this survey provides a broad overview of video generation models, community could benefit much more from this paper when additional detailed conclusions and insights are provided. - The datasets and performance comparisons are not discussed in this survey. - In the Temporal Dynamics section (Sec 4), explicitly referencing key papers when describing different techniques would better highlight the most impactful contributions in this field. Additionally, including visual examples of model failures would aid reader comprehension. For example, providing some unwanted object warping illustration for the description “In practice, this method in itself is not sufficient , … This can lead to unwanted object warping across”. - The disadvantages behind training from scratch on video data (Sec 4.4) requires further elaboration to fully justify the training paradigm choice. Specifically, the inconsistent alignments between text and video compared to text and images needs to be explored. - I agree that human evaluations are critical for assessing video generation quality. To emphasize their importance, the paper could compare and contrast human judgments with automated metrics, discussing the advantages and limitations of each. Standard best practices for human studies like detailed experimental design, principles for metric selection, and statistical significance testing should also be covered. - While listing common quantitative metrics is helpful, their discussions lack depth and clear conclusions. For example, the statements on FVD's suitability for different tasks require supporting evidence and analysis. And the overview of optical flow EPE does not provide any meaningful takeaways for the reader. Expanding on these metrics with rigorous comparisons on relevant datasets would strengthen these sections.

**Requested Changes:**
- Involve discussions on datasets and performance comparisons. - Provide illustrations to make the understanding easier. - More detailed analysis, conclusion and insights should be included.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
No

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Revision: Dear reviewer, thank you very much for your time and thoughtful feedback. A version of the updated paper where the main revisions have been marked in blue can be found in the supplementary material. We added tables 1, 2, 4. >While this survey provides a broad overview of video generation models, community could benefit much more from this paper when additional detailed conclusions and insights are provided. >More detailed analysis, conclusion and insights should be included. We have added an overview of benchmarks (Section 5.4, Table 4) on (un)conditional video generation on commonly used data sets. This comparison also includes non-diffusion methods that are discussed in section 6.1.1 and 6.1.2. >The datasets and performance comparisons are not discussed in this survey. >Involve discussions on datasets and performance comparisons. In addition to the benchmarks, we have added a sections on commonly used video (5.1) and image (5.2) training data sets, including tables (1, 2) that summarize their most salient aspects > In the Temporal Dynamics section (Sec 4), explicitly referencing key papers when describing different techniques would better highlight the most impactful contributions in this field. Additionally, including visual examples of model failures would aid reader comprehension. For example, providing some unwanted object warping illustration for the description “In practice, this method in itself is not sufficient , … This can lead to unwanted object warping across”. >Provide illustrations to make the understanding easier. We have added more references to key papers in the temporal dynamics section (4) as the methods part in general. >The disadvantages behind training from scratch on video data (Sec 4.4) requires further elaboration to fully justify the training paradigm choice. Specifically, the inconsistent alignments between text and video compared to text and images needs to be explored. We have expanded the discussion on why training on videos is often augmented with image data sets (Section 5), in addition to new sections that discuss representative video (5.1) and image (5.2) data sets. >I agree that human evaluations are critical for assessing video generation quality. To emphasize their importance, the paper could compare and contrast human judgments with automated metrics, discussing the advantages and limitations of each. Standard best practices for human studies like detailed experimental design, principles for metric selection, and statistical significance testing should also be covered. We agree that discussing methodological aspects of human studies would provide value for prospective readers. Unfortunately, we believe that we lack the necessary expertise in this domain to provide an insightful discussion. >While listing common quantitative metrics is helpful, their discussions lack depth and clear conclusions. For example, the statements on FVD's suitability for different tasks require supporting evidence and analysis. And the overview of optical flow EPE does not provide any meaningful takeaways for the reader. Expanding on these metrics with rigorous comparisons on relevant datasets would strengthen these sections. The sections on (evaluation) data sets and benchmarks hopefully address part of you criticism. We can not provide a deeper discussion of the pros and cons of different evaluation metrics at this time.
paper_title_zh: 视频扩散模型综述
paper_abstract_zh: 扩散生成模型近年来在视频生成和编辑任务中展现出巨大潜力。本综述系统地概述了视频扩散模型的相关方面，如应用、架构和时间动态性。通过论文摘要概述了该领域的发展。综述最后对剩余挑战进行了探讨，并对该领域的未来进行了展望。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本综述提供了视频扩散模型近期进展的广泛概述，将相关研究按相关子任务类别进行组织。论文涵盖了几个重要方面，包括应用、架构、时间动态性和评估指标。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：
- 论文涵盖了应用分类、模型架构、时间动态性、评估指标，并为希望了解视频扩散领域概览的读者提供了引言。
- 表格1系统概述了先前的工作，图2提供了视频扩散应用的良好分类。

缺点：
- 尽管本综述提供了视频生成模型的广泛概述，但若能提供更详细的结论和见解，社区将从中受益更多。
- 本综述未讨论数据集和性能比较。
- 在时间动态性部分（第4节），在描述不同技术时明确引用关键论文，将更好地突出该领域最具影响力的贡献。此外，包含模型失败的视觉示例将有助于读者理解。例如，为描述“在实践中，这种方法本身并不足够，……这可能导致不必要的对象扭曲”提供一些不必要的对象扭曲插图。
- 从头开始训练视频数据（第4.4节）的缺点需要进一步阐述，以充分证明训练范式选择。特别是，文本与视频之间与文本与图像之间的不一致对齐需要探讨。
- 我同意人类评估对于评估视频生成质量至关重要。为了强调其重要性，论文可以比较和对比人类判断与自动化指标，讨论各自的优缺点。还应涵盖人类研究的标准最佳实践，如详细的实验设计、指标选择原则和统计显著性测试。
- 虽然列出常见的定量指标很有帮助，但它们的讨论缺乏深度和明确的结论。例如，关于FVD适用于不同任务的说法需要支持证据和分析。光流EPE的概述未为读者提供任何有意义的收获。在相关数据集上进行严格的比较，扩展这些指标将加强这些部分。

**请求的更改：**
- 涉及数据集和性能比较的讨论。
- 提供插图以简化理解。
- 应包括更详细的分析、结论和见解。

否

paper_title: Tourette syndrome research highlights 2015
paper_abstract: We present selected highlights from research that appeared during 2015 on Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders. Topics include phenomenology, comorbidities, developmental course, genetics, animal models, neuroimaging, electrophysiology, pharmacology, and treatment. We briefly summarize articles whose results we believe may lead to new treatments, additional research or modifications in current models of TS.
review_content: A very comprehensive review of the TS literature in 2015 for which the authors must be thanked. Generally speaking, they provide a brief overview of the main results / points of each paper but do not dwell into interpretations and discussions, which is fine with me; all readers interested can look up the primary article. Also, there are no relevant articles missing from what I can gather as I have a weekly Pubcrawler alert for TS. The choice of papers is subjective, of course, and I was surprised not to find a few of our own group’s contributions, listed below, but I leave it up to the authors to elaborate on them or not.

paper_title: Pulse fortified whole wheat bread: A review on dough rheology, bread quality, and sensory properties
paper_abstract: The increase in the consumption of pulses can perform a key role in preventing protein deficiency among people specifically in developing countries. The fortification of whole wheat bread with pulses is an efficient approach to boost the nutritional profile of bread as protein, starches, dietary fiber, vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, and phytochemicals are all abundant in pulses. The optimum ratio of the pulse to whole wheat flour is necessary to determine for producing bread with good quality, sensory attributes, and handling properties. This review investigated the impact of the pulse addition on the whole wheat dough rheology, bread quality, and sensory characteristics, with a particular focus on dough stability, elasticity, strength, and bread volume. The improvement in the nutritional value as well as the negative impact of pulses on whole-wheat bread was also reviewed. The research gaps in pulse supplemented whole grains bread were identified, and further study directions were recommended. Fortification of whole wheat bread with pulses produced affordable bread with a balanced diet for all classes of people. The addition of a higher level of pulses develops a weak gluten structure, which negatively affects dough stability, strength, elasticity, and handling properties. The volume of bread also decreased, and the off-flavor compound produced at a higher level of pulse fortification. The addition of additives and prior processing of pulses not only promote the nutritional value but also produce bread with better dough stability, bread volume, and sensory score.
review_content:
The paper is scientifically sound but a few changes that could be incorporated for the improvement of the manuscript are as follows:
  * Page number 4 line number 16 and line number 22: 'protein digestibility improved by inactivating ant nutrient compounds; ant nutrients responsible for off flavour.' It should be anti-nutrient compounds or anti-nutrients.
  * Figure 2 represents many parameters like water absorption capacity, dry gluten, protein content, protein recovery, albumin, globulin, glutelin, prolamin, lysine, etc. but few are discussed in the text. Please discuss other parameters.
  * Page no 10 line 26: It was also permissible to replace 10% to >20%. Please indicate a specific range.
paper_title_zh: 脉冲强化全麦面包：面团流变学、面包质量及感官特性的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 豆类消费的增加在预防发展中国家人民蛋白质缺乏方面可以发挥关键作用。将豆类强化到全麦面包中是一种提高面包营养价值的高效方法，因为豆类富含蛋白质、淀粉、膳食纤维、维生素、矿物质、抗氧化剂和植物化学物质。为生产出具有良好品质、感官属性和处理特性的面包，确定豆类与全麦面粉的最佳比例是必要的。本综述研究了豆类添加对全麦面团流变学、面包质量和感官特性的影响，特别关注面团的稳定性、弹性、强度和面包体积。还评述了豆类对全麦面包营养价值的提升以及负面影响。识别了豆类强化全谷物面包的研究空白，并推荐了进一步的研究方向。用豆类强化全麦面包生产出了价格适中且营养均衡的面包，适合各阶层人群。较高水平的豆类添加会形成较弱的麸质结构，这对面团的稳定性、强度、弹性和处理特性产生负面影响。面包体积也会减少，且在较高水平的豆类强化下会产生异味化合物。添加剂的添加和豆类的预处理不仅能提升营养价值，还能生产出面团稳定性更好、面包体积更大、感官评分更高的面包。

paper_title: Avian influenza (H5N1) virus, epidemiology and its effects on backyard poultry in Indonesia: a review
paper_abstract: Avian influenza (AI) is a zoonotic viral endemic disease that affects poultry, swine, and mammals, including humans. Highly pathogenic avian influenza (HPAI) is caused by influenza type A virus subtypes H5, and H7 which are naturally carried by a wild bird and often affect domestic poultry. Avian influenza (AI) is a major problem worldwide that causes significant economic losses in the poultry sector. Since 2003, the widespread H5N1 HPAI in poultry has led to high mortalities resulting in huge economic losses in the poultry sector in Indonesia. Domestic poultry is a key source of income that contributes to economic growth, both directly and indirectly, by reducing poverty among the people living in rural communities. Furthermore, in many developing countries, including Indonesia, rural people meet a portion of their food needs through backyard poultry. Nevertheless, this sector is strongly affected by biosecurity hazards, particularly in Indonesia by HPAI infections. Avian influenza (AI), subtype H5N1 has zoonotic significance, posing major risks to public health and poultry. Due to close interaction between wild migratory birds and ducks, the domestic poultry sector in Indonesia is directly affected by this virus. This virus continues to be ubiquitous in Indonesia as a result of the unpredictable mutations produced by antigenic drift and shift, which can persist from a few days to several years. In this review, the epidemiology and impact, of highly pathogenic avian influenza H5N1 subtype virus infection on backyard poultry in Indonesia were discussed.
review_content:
An interesting review by Rehman et al. However, there are some issues the authors need to address before it could be considered for publication.
  * Section introduction lines 1 and 2, Has instead of Had, its instead of their
  * Line 6, Remove “Still,”
  * Please modify the following sentence, Recommendations for future initiatives and policies to reduce the risk of avian influenza (HPAI and LPAI) in Indonesian backyard poultry.
  * Please define LBMs at the first mention.
  * The mutation was very similar to the variant of H5N1 found at almost the same time in West and East Java, Bali, and Nusa Tenggara Barat (NTB). paper_title_zh: 禽流感（H5N1）病毒、流行病学及其对印度尼西亚后院家禽的影响：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 禽流感（AI）是一种影响家禽、猪和包括人类在内的哺乳动物的动物源性病毒性地方病。高致病性禽流感（HPAI）由A型流感病毒的H5和H7亚型引起，这些病毒自然携带于野生鸟类中，并常影响家禽。禽流感（AI）是全球性问题，给家禽业造成显著经济损失。自2003年以来，广泛传播的H5N1 HPAI在家禽中导致高死亡率，给印度尼西亚家禽业带来巨大经济损失。家禽是农村社区居民减少贫困、促进经济增长的关键收入来源，这种贡献是直接和间接的。此外，在包括印度尼西亚在内的许多发展中国家，农村居民通过后院家禽满足部分食物需求。然而，这一领域受到生物安全风险的严重影响，特别是在印度尼西亚，受HPAI感染的影响。禽流感（AI），特别是H5N1亚型，具有人畜共患意义，对公共卫生和家禽构成重大风险。由于野生迁徙鸟类和鸭子的密切互动，印度尼西亚的家禽业直接受到该病毒的影响。由于抗原漂移和抗原转变产生的不可预测的突变，该病毒在印度尼西亚持续存在，持续时间从几天到几年不等。在本综述中，讨论了高致病性禽流感H5N1亚型病毒感染对印度尼西亚后院家禽的流行病学和影响。
review_content_zh:
由Rehman等人撰写的一篇有趣的综述。然而，在考虑发表之前，作者需要解决一些问题。
  * 引言部分第1和第2行，将“Had”改为“Has”，将“their”改为“its”
  * 第6行，删除“Still,”
  * 请修改以下句子：关于减少印度尼西亚后院家禽中禽流感（HPAI和LPAI）风险的未来倡议和政策建议。
  * 请在首次提及时定义LBMs。
  * 该突变与几乎同时在西爪哇、东爪哇、巴厘岛和西努沙登加拉（NTB）发现的H5N1变体非常相似。而不是“它们有一个突变，与几乎同时在西爪哇、东爪哇、巴厘岛和西努沙登加拉（NTB）发现的H5N1变体非常相似。”
  * 在流行病学和生命周期部分，第2段中，作者提到“FAO在全球范围内识别了四个家禽生产部门”，但作者未能描述其他三个家禽生产部门。
  * 在文本中首次提及DPSR时进行定义。
  * 在文本中首次提及PDS时进行定义。
  * 作者表示流感病毒具有多步骤的繁殖过程。我建议作者首先定义所有病毒蛋白，然后描述它们在病毒生命周期中的作用。事实上，病毒生命周期段落由于混合了参与复制周期的各种病毒蛋白而显得混乱。建议作者按病毒进入至释放的顺序撰写该段落。
  * 流行病学和生命周期的最后一段应移至该部分的开头。
  * 请按以下方式修改图1：作者提到了去壳过程，但图中未显示。受体在进入细胞质后仍附着在病毒上。转录阶段发生在细胞核中，但图中未显示，包装步骤也未显示。请在图例中提供一些图的细节。

paper_title: The Hertfordshire Cohort Study: an overview
paper_abstract: The Hertfordshire Cohort Study is a nationally unique study of men and women born in the English county of Hertfordshire in the early part of the 20 th century. Records that detail their health in infancy and childhood have been preserved, their sociodemographic, lifestyle, medical and biological attributes have been characterised in later life, and routinely collected data on their hospital use and mortality have been acquired. This paper provides an overview of the study since its inception in the 1980s, including its methods, findings, and plans for its future.
review_content:
This report provides an overview of the Hertfordshire Cohort Study, one of the most influential of epidemiological studies which provided ground-breaking evidence of early life influences on the development of adult chronic disease and laid the foundation for a huge corpus of scientific work on the developmental origins of health and disease hypothesis. The original retrospective cohort study was established by linking contemporary health outcome data to health visitor records collected between 1911-1930 in the English county of Hertfordshire.

The paper concentrates on the highly innovative strategy of further follow-up examinations and data collection in the younger cohort of 3000 men and women who were born between 1931 and 1939. The objective was to evaluate interactions between intra-uterine and early postnatal environment, adult diet and lifestyle, genetics in the aetiology of chronic disorders of ageing including osteoporosis. A comprehensive battery of social, biological and health status variables was collected and the summary of studies carried out between 1998-2018 is summarised in Figure 2. A further highly original development is the inter-generational follow-up now planned and in train. To date more than 1000 members have provided contact details for their children and grandchildren, which will make this one of very few prospective studies with three generation follow-up. There is also detailed linkage to routine health records and administrative datasets, mortality and hospital episodes statistics.

The review provides a comprehensive summary of key publications in the areas of osteoporosis, osteoarthritis and diet and this study has greatly added to our understanding of the aetiology and natural history of these outcomes. There are also a number of detailed tables which summarise the wealth of data collected at different stages of the study.

My comments are all minor and primarily to do with presentation of the data in the report. Firstly, as a suggestion, I think the report would flow better if the sections on diet, routinely collected data, genetics and epigenetics and possibly National and International collaborations (currently pages 15-16) were moved back earlier to precede the outcome sections, focusing particularly on Osteoporosis, Osteoarthritis, Sarcopenia and Diet (currently pages 4-15). It might make the scope of the study clearer to the general reader. Also, the tables provide considerable detail and if the variables were sequenced in the same order and as appropriate sub-categorised, it would be easier to cross-reference what was collected and when.
paper_title_zh: 赫特福德郡队列研究：概述
paper_abstract_zh: 赫特福德郡队列研究是一项全国独特的研究，研究对象为20世纪初出生于英格兰赫特福德郡的男性和女性。他们的婴儿期和儿童期健康记录得以保存，其社会人口学、生活方式、医学和生物学特征在成年后进行了表征，并且获取了他们医院使用和死亡率的常规收集数据。本文概述了自20世纪80年代启动以来该研究的情况，包括其方法、发现以及未来的计划。
review_content_zh:
本报告概述了赫特福德郡队列研究，这是最具影响力的流行病学研究之一，提供了关于早期生活对成人慢性病发展影响的突破性证据，并为大量关于健康与疾病发展起源假说的科学工作奠定了基础。最初的回顾性队列研究通过将当代健康结果数据与1911-1930年间在英格兰赫特福德郡收集的健康访视记录相链接而建立。

论文重点介绍了对1931年至1939年间出生的3000名男性和女性年轻队列进行进一步随访检查和数据收集的高度创新策略。其目标是评估宫内和早期产后环境、成人饮食和生活方式、遗传因素在包括骨质疏松症在内的老年慢性病病因学中的相互作用。收集了全面的社会、生物和健康状态变量，并在图2中总结了1998-2018年间进行的研究。另一个极具原创性的发展是现在计划并进行中的跨代随访。迄今为止，已有超过1000名成员提供了他们子女和孙子女的联系方式，这将使本研究成为少数具有三代随访的前瞻性研究之一。此外，还有与常规健康记录和行政数据集、死亡率和医院事件统计的详细链接。

该综述全面总结了骨质疏松症、骨关节炎和饮食领域的关键出版物，本研究大大增进了我们对这些结果病因学和自然史的理解。还有一些详细的表格总结了研究不同阶段收集的大量数据。

我的评论都是次要的，主要涉及报告中数据的呈现。首先，作为一个建议，我认为如果将关于饮食、常规收集数据、遗传学和表观遗传学以及可能的国家和国际合作部分（目前在第15-16页）提前到结果部分之前，特别是重点关注骨质疏松症、骨关节炎、肌肉减少症和饮食（目前在第4-15页），报告的流畅性会更好。这可能会使研究范围对普通读者更清晰。此外，表格提供了大量细节，如果变量按相同顺序排列并适当细分，将更容易交叉参考所收集的内容和时间。

paper_title: Systematic review of the application of Machine Learning in the detection and classification of transposable elements
paper_abstract: Background. Transposable elements (TEs) constitute the most common repeated sequences in eukaryotic genomes. Recent studies demonstrated their deep impact on species diversity, adaptation to the environment, and diseases. Although there are many conventional bioinformatic algorithms for detecting and classifying TEs, none have achieved reliable results on different types of TEs. Machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) techniques can automatically extract hidden patterns and novel information from labeled or non-labeled data and have been applied to solving several scientific problems.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting This manuscript seems to be a report, not a review article. The authors should carefully reconsider and revise the structure of the manuscript. For example, the chapters "Search strategy" and "Selection of articles" are lengthily but contain few information. It is not difficult to shorten them without losing any information. Thank you for recommendation. We revised the structure and we mixed and shorten the sections “Search strategy" and "Selection of articles", following the methodology proposed in “Guidelines for performing Systematic Literature Reviews in Software Engineering”. Experimental design no comment Validity of the findings no comment Comments for the Author Orozco-Arias et al. reported a systematic review of 35 papers/reports that detected and classified transposable elements (TEs) in genomes by applying machine learning (ML) approaches. For each study, the authors summarized addressing the following 4 points: 1. Are ML approaches for TE analyses advantageous compared to bioinformatics approaches? 2. Which ML techniques are currently used to detect and classify TEs or similar data? 3. What are the best parameters and most used metrics in algorithms and architectures to detect and classify TEs? 4. What are the most used DNA coding schemes in ML tasks? The manuscript contains something informative to the current studies of TE identifications; however, it is not well organized and insufficient as a review article. First of all, point #1 raised by the authors seems to be the most important part in the review, but it not well answered in this review. I would like to know how ML (and DL) approaches improve the identification and classification of TEs in various species compared to the conventional (i.e. homology-based) approaches. How much species have been analyzed yet, and are there any species that are in particular suitable for ML-based search? How did they distinguish whether the search results were true-positives or false-positives? In addition to that, please consider the following comments as well. We fully agree with this recommendation. We add a few paragraphs at the end of the Q1 section arguing how ML and DL can overcome conventional approaches. All the questions you have asked here have been taken into account in the added paragraphs. Comment #1 In the title, the word “deep learning” should be deleted because as shown in the Figure 6 and Table 3, many (almost all) papers mentioned in the review is not based on a deep learning approach. Or if the authors include it in the title, DL-based approaches should be mentioned more in this manuscript. Thank you for your opinion. We agree with you and considering that very few publications were found in which DL was applied in the detection and classification of TEs, we removed "Deep Learning" from the title. Comment #2 In the Introduction, Figure 1 shows a detail classification of TEs; however, no explanations were not provided. Due to the diversity of TEs, the identification and classification of TEs are difficult. Therefore, to understand the importance of this review, the more detailed explanations of TEs are essential. This comment was very useful to us. In the introduction we have added additional information about the classification and why it is important to analyze and annotate the TEs in the genomes (second and third paragraphs). Comment #3 Figures are not easy to read. In particular, now many researchers including me believe pie charts should be avoided (please see https://www.data-to-viz.com/caveat/pie.html, for example). Thank you for your recommendation. We agree with it and we replace all pie charts by bar charts. Comment #4 In the Table 3, data source is not clear. For example, what is “RNA” or “DNA”? What is the differences between “k-mer frequencies” and “oligomer frequencies”? Thank you. In Table 3 we revised all fields in data source columns and we adjusted them when necessary. Comment #5 References should be carefully revised. Thank you, we used the Peerj Style (in Mendeley) for formatting references.
paper_title_zh: 机器学习在转座元件检测与分类中应用的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。转座元件（TEs）是真核生物基因组中最常见的重复序列。近期研究表明，它们对物种多样性、环境适应性和疾病有着深远的影响。尽管存在许多用于检测和分类TEs的传统生物信息学算法，但没有任何一种算法能在不同类型的TEs上取得可靠的结果。机器学习（ML）和深度学习（DL）技术能够自动从标记或未标记的数据中提取隐藏模式和新型信息，并已被应用于解决多个科学问题。
review_content_zh:
### 审稿人1（匿名）的基本报告

这篇手稿似乎是一篇报告，而不是综述文章。作者应仔细重新考虑并修订手稿的结构。例如，“搜索策略”和“文章选择”这两章篇幅较长但信息量较少。缩短它们而不丢失任何信息并不困难。感谢您的建议。我们修订了结构，并按照“软件工程系统文献综述指南”中提出的方法，合并并缩短了“搜索策略”和“文章选择”部分。

#### 实验设计
无评论

#### 研究发现的可靠性
无评论

#### 对作者的评论

Orozco-Arias等人报告了对35篇论文/报告的系统综述，这些论文/报告通过应用机器学习（ML）方法检测和分类基因组中的转座元件（TEs）。对于每项研究，作者总结了以下四个要点：
1. 与生物信息学方法相比，ML方法在TE分析中有优势吗？
2. 目前用于检测和分类TEs或类似数据的ML技术有哪些？
3. 在检测和分类TEs的算法和架构中，最佳参数和最常用指标是什么？
4. 在ML任务中最常用的DNA编码方案是什么？

手稿包含了对当前TE识别研究的一些有用信息；然而，它组织得不够好，作为综述文章内容不足。首先，作者提出的第1点似乎是综述中最重要的部分，但在本综述中并未得到充分回答。我想知道ML（和DL）方法如何在不同物种中改进TE的识别和分类，与传统的（即基于同源性的）方法相比。已经分析了多少物种，是否有特别适合基于ML搜索的物种？他们是如何区分搜索结果是真阳性还是假阳性的？除此之外，也请考虑以下评论。

我们完全同意这一建议。我们在Q1部分末尾添加了几段，论证了ML和DL如何克服传统方法。您在这里提出的所有问题在添加的段落中都已考虑。

#### 评论#1

在标题中，应删除“深度学习”一词，因为如图6和表3所示，综述中提到的许多（几乎全部）论文并非基于深度学习方法。或者，如果作者要在标题中包含它，手稿中应更多地提及基于DL的方法。

感谢您的意见。我们同意您的观点，考虑到很少有出版物涉及DL在TE检测和分类中的应用，我们从标题中删除了“深度学习”。

#### 评论#2

在引言中，图1展示了TE的详细分类；然而，没有提供解释。由于TE的多样性，TE的识别和分类是困难的。因此，为了理解这篇综述的重要性，更详细的TE解释是必要的。

这条评论对我们非常有用。我们在引言中添加了关于分类的额外信息，以及为什么分析和对基因组中的TE进行注释很重要（第二和第三段）。

#### 评论#3

图表不易阅读。特别是，现在许多研究人员（包括我）认为应避免使用饼图（请参阅https://www.data-to-viz.com/caveat/pie.html，例如）。

感谢您的建议。我们同意这一点，并将所有饼图替换为条形图。

#### 评论#4

在表3中，数据来源不明确。例如，“RNA”或“DNA”是什么？ “k-mer频率”和“寡核苷酸频率”之间的区别是什么？

感谢指正。在表3中，我们修订了数据来源列的所有字段，并在必要时进行了调整。

#### 评论#5

参考文献应仔细修订。

感谢，我们使用了Peerj样式（在Mendeley中）来格式化参考文献。

paper_title: Recent insights into the implications of metabolism in plasmacytoid dendritic cell innate functions: Potential ways to control these functions
paper_abstract: There are more and more data concerning the role of cellular metabolism in innate immune cells, such as macrophages or conventional dendritic cells. However, few data are available currently concerning plasmacytoid dendritic cells (PDC), another type of innate immune cells. These cells are the main type I interferon (IFN) producing cells, but they also secrete other pro-inflammatory cytokines (e.g., tumor necrosis factor or interleukin [IL]-6) or immunomodulatory factors (e.g., IL-10 or transforming growth factor-β). Through these functions, PDC participate in antimicrobial responses or maintenance of immune tolerance, and have been implicated in the pathophysiology of several autoimmune diseases, as well as in tumor immune escape mechanisms. Recent data support the idea that the glycolytic pathway (or glycolysis), as well as lipid metabolism (including both cholesterol and fatty acid metabolism) may impact some innate immune functions of PDC or may be involved in these functions after Toll-like receptor (TLR) 7/9 triggering. The kinetics of glycolysis after TLR7/9 triggering may differ between human and murine PDC. In mouse PDC, metabolism changes promoted by TLR7/9 activation may depend on an autocrine/paracrine loop, implicating type I IFN and its receptor IFNAR. This could explain a delayed glycolysis in mouse PDC. Moreover, PDC functions can be modulated by the metabolism of cholesterol and fatty acids. This may occur via the production of lipid ligands that activate nuclear receptors (e.g., liver X receptor [LXR]) in PDC or through limiting intracellular cholesterol pool size (by statin or LXR agonist treatment) in these cells. Finally, lipid-activated nuclear receptors (i.e., LXR or peroxisome proliferator activated receptor) may also directly interact with pro-inflammatory transcription factors, such as NF-κB. Here, we discuss how glycolysis and lipid metabolism may modulate PDC functions and how this may be harnessed in pathological situations where PDC play a detrimental role.
review_content:
This review provides a balanced and comprehensive overview of the latest discoveries about the role of metabolism in plasmacytoid dendritic cell innate functions. This is a very original topic based on recent data supporting the idea that the glycolytic pathway as well as lipid metabolism may modulate the production of type I IFN by pDC or may be involved in this function after TLR7/9 triggering. In addition, this review provides new clues on how these metabolic pathways may be harnessed in pathophysiological contexts where pDC play a detrimental role.

This review has a comprehensive view of all relevant literature in the field and summarized very well the fundamental concepts, but there are some minor concerns that need to be addressed as below.
 1. Abstract is clearly written, but the text could be reduced by omitting the section about the differences related to the origin of pDC.
 2. Page 3: PRR stands for Pattern (but not Pathogen) Recognition Receptors
 3. Page 3: I would suggest to add that i) human pDC are usually identified as CD4+ CD303+ CD123high and CD11cnegative (to highlight the difference with mouse pDC that are CD11clow), ii) irf7 is also a master genes that is shared between human and mouse pDC, iii) CD317 (known as BST2, PDCA1).
 4. Page 5: the list of references related to the regulatory functions of pDC is too short. Some major articles should be added (Ochando 2006, Goubier 2008, Hadeiba 2008, Irla 2010, etc…).
 5. Page 5 paragraph 2.4: when the authors discuss the role of pDC in diseases, they focus on autoimmune disorders, GVHD, atherosclerosis, and chronic viral infections but cancer was omitted. This needs to be discussed.

paper_title_zh: 近期对代谢在浆细胞样树突状细胞固有功能中影响的见解：控制这些功能的潜在途径
paper_abstract_zh: 关于细胞代谢在固有免疫细胞（如巨噬细胞或常规树突状细胞）中的作用，已有越来越多的数据。然而，目前关于浆细胞样树突状细胞（PDC）这一类固有免疫细胞的数据却很少。这些细胞是主要的I型干扰素（IFN）产生细胞，但它们也分泌其他促炎细胞因子（例如，肿瘤坏死因子或白细胞介素[IL]-6）或免疫调节因子（例如，IL-10或转化生长因子-β）。通过这些功能，PDC参与抗菌反应或免疫耐受的维持，并且已被牵涉到几种自身免疫性疾病的病理生理学中，以及肿瘤免疫逃逸机制中。近期数据支持这样的观点：糖酵解途径（或糖酵解），以及脂质代谢（包括胆固醇和脂肪酸代谢）可能影响PDC的一些固有免疫功能，或者可能在Toll样受体（TLR）7/9触发后参与这些功能。TLR7/9触发后的糖酵解动力学在人类和小鼠PDC之间可能存在差异。在小鼠PDC中，由TLR7/9激活促进的代谢变化可能依赖于一个自分泌/旁分泌环路，涉及I型IFN及其受体IFNAR。这可以解释小鼠PDC中糖酵解的延迟。此外，PDC功能可以通过胆固醇和脂肪酸的代谢进行调节。这可能通过产生激活PDC中核受体的脂质配体（例如，肝X受体[LXR]）或通过限制这些细胞内胆固醇池的大小（通过他汀类药物或LXR激动剂治疗）来实现。最后，脂质激活的核受体（即LXR或过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体）也可能直接与促炎转录因子（如NF-κB）相互作用。在此，我们讨论了糖酵解和脂质代谢如何调节PDC功能，以及这在PDC发挥有害作用的病理情况下如何被利用。
review_content_zh:
本综述提供了一个平衡且全面的概述，介绍了关于浆细胞样树突状细胞（pDC）固有功能中代谢作用的最新发现。这是一个非常原创的主题，基于近期数据支持的观点，即糖酵解途径以及脂质代谢可能调节pDC产生I型干扰素（IFN），或在TLR7/9触发后参与此功能。此外，本综述还提供了新的线索，说明这些代谢途径如何在pDC发挥有害作用的病理生理背景下被利用。

本综述全面涵盖了该领域的所有相关文献，并很好地总结了基本概念，但存在一些需要解决的次要问题，如下：
1. 摘要写得清楚，但可以通过省略关于pDC起源差异的部分来缩减文本。
2. 第3页：PRR代表模式（而非病原体）识别受体。
3. 第3页：建议补充以下内容：i）人类pDC通常被识别为CD4+ CD303+ CD123高表达和CD11c阴性（以突出与小鼠pDC的CD11c低表达的差异），ii）irf7也是人类和小鼠pDC共享的主控基因，iii）CD317（已知为BST2, PDCA1）。
4. 第5页：与pDC调节功能相关的参考文献列表太短。应添加一些重要文章（Ochando 2006, Goubier 2008, Hadeiba 2008, Irla 2010等）。
5. 第5页第2.4段：当作者讨论pDC在疾病中的作用时，他们聚焦于自身免疫性疾病、GVHD、动脉粥样硬化和慢性病毒感染，但遗漏了癌症。然而，在癌症背景下，代谢途径发生了深刻变化，我假设pDC的固有功能会受到肿瘤微环境中代谢变化的调节。这一点需要讨论。
6. 第7页：当作者讨论糖酵解在TLR7触发后对pDC功能的作用时，不清楚这是对转录的全面调控，还是仅针对与I型IFN途径相关的基因的特定调控。
7. 第10页：虽然不太有趣，但我不清楚细胞内胆固醇含量的大幅减少是如何与STING/cGAS途径的激活相连接，从而导致巨噬细胞自发产生I型IFN的。这一点需要澄清。
8. 图表很好地支持和说明了综述的主要内容。尽管如此，我建议添加一个表格，总结每种代谢途径对pDC生物学的主要影响，通过比较人类与小鼠以及TLR7与TLR9刺激的差异。

paper_title: Discovery of continental-scale travelling waves and lagged synchrony in geometrid moth outbreaks prompt a re-evaluation of mountain birch/geometrid studies
paper_abstract: The spatio-temporal dynamics of populations of two 9-10 year cyclic-outbreaking geometrids, Operophtera brumata and Epirrita autumnata in mountain birch forests in northern Fennoscandia, have been studied since the 1970´s by a Swedish-Norwegian research team and, during the last decade, by Norwegian and Finnish research teams. Some of the early results have been challenged by the Norwegian team. To examine the base for disagreements, five of the papers published by the Norwegian team (2004-2011) are reviewed. It is found that conclusions in these papers are questionable or data could not be interpreted fully because two decisive traits in the spatio-temporal behaviour of outbreaks of the two species were not considered.
review_content:
Population cycles of two species of forest caterpillars, winter moth Operophtera brumata and the autumnal moth Epirrita autumnata have been studied extensively over both spatial and temporal scales in Norway, Sweden and Finland by a number of workers. Two major findings are that the outbreaks of winter moth tend to lag those of autumnal moth by one to two years, and waves of population outbreaks of both species occur from east to west across Fennoscandia with a ten-year periodicity (Tenow 2013). Over the years there has been much interest in the synchronous population dynamics of cyclic species and whether this is associated with some environmental cue, wide ranging dispersal, or the movement of natural enemies among populations. The lag in outbreaks of winter moth and autumnal moth and the waves of outbreaks suggest that a single environmental cue is unlikely to explain the outbreak dynamics.

Here Tenow reinterprets the results of 5 publications of population outbreaks of winter moth and autumnal moth in Norway to show how interpretations could be different if the lag between the two species and the waves of outbreaks were considered. The descriptions are complex and the paper would be clearer if the figures from the original papers were included so that it was evident what the population trends were that were being discussed. Given the extensive amount of work on this system it is useful to reevaluate earlier studies in light of more recent findings as is done here.

Remaining interesting questions are
1. What factors determine the geographical waves of outbreaks? And
2. Why does this apparently consistent lag occur in outbreaks of two species feeding on the same host trees?
paper_title_zh: 大陆尺度迁徙波和滞后同步现象在尺蛾爆发中的发现促使重新评估山地桦树/尺蛾研究
paper_abstract_zh: 自20世纪70年代以来，瑞典-挪威研究团队对北芬诺斯坎迪亚山区桦树林中两种9-10年周期性爆发的尺蛾——Operophtera brumata和Epirrita autumnata的时空动态进行了研究，而在过去十年中，这一研究由挪威和芬兰的研究团队继续进行。挪威团队对一些早期结果提出了质疑。为了检验分歧的基础，本文回顾了挪威团队在2004-2011年间发表的五篇论文。发现这些论文中的结论存在问题，或者数据无法完全解释，因为未考虑到这两种物种爆发时空行为的两个决定性特征。
review_content_zh:
两种森林毛虫——冬季尺蠖Operophtera brumata和秋季尺蠖Epirrita autumnata的种群周期在挪威、瑞典和芬兰已被众多研究者广泛地研究，涵盖了空间和时间尺度。两个主要发现是：冬季尺蠖的爆发倾向于比秋季尺蠖滞后一到两年，且两种物种的种群爆发波从东到西跨越芬诺斯坎底亚，具有十年周期性（Tenow 2013）。多年来，人们一直对周期性物种的同步种群动态及其是否与某些环境线索、广泛范围的扩散或天敌在种群间的移动有关深感兴趣。冬季尺蠖和秋季尺蠖爆发的时间滞后以及爆发波表明，单一环境线索不太可能解释爆发动态。

在此，Tenow重新解读了挪威冬季尺蠖和秋季尺蠖种群爆发的5篇出版物结果，展示了如果考虑两种物种之间的时间滞后和爆发波，解释可能会有所不同。描述较为复杂，如果包含原始论文中的图表，本文将更为清晰，以便明确所讨论的种群趋势。鉴于对该系统的大量研究，按照本文所做的那样，以更近期的研究成果重新评估早期研究是有益的。

仍待解决的有意思的问题是：
1. 什么因素决定了爆发地理波？
2. 为什么在以相同寄主树为食的两个物种爆发中会出现这种明显一致的时间滞后？

paper_title: The expanding regulatory universe of p53 in gastrointestinal cancer
paper_abstract: Tumor suppresser gene TP53 is one of the most frequently deleted or mutated genes in gastrointestinal cancers. As a transcription factor, p53 regulates a number of important protein coding genes to control cell cycle, cell death, DNA damage/repair, stemness, differentiation and other key cellular functions. In addition, p53 is also able to activate the expression of a number of small non-coding microRNAs (miRNAs) through direct binding to the promoter region of these miRNAs.  Many miRNAs have been identified to be potential tumor suppressors by regulating key effecter target mRNAs. Our understanding of the regulatory network of p53 has recently expanded to include long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs). Like miRNA, lncRNAs have been found to play important roles in cancer biology.  With our increased understanding of the important functions of these non-coding RNAs and their relationship with p53, we are gaining exciting new insights into the biology and function of cells in response to various growth environment changes. In this review we summarize the current understanding of the ever expanding involvement of non-coding RNAs in the p53 regulatory network and its implications for our understanding of gastrointestinal cancer.
review_content:
This article by Fesler et al. is a timely summary of the state of the art of P53 related regulatory mechanisms with specific emphasis on colon cancer. P53 is certainly the most critical node of oncogenesis and progression. With the rapidly advancing information about the importance of non-coding RNA in the field of cancer biology it is critical to establish an integrated picture that allows us to make working models for regulation. The review has done a perfect job towards this by providing two well designed figures. Overall it is a very timely review of this ever evolving field. It is really appreciated that the authors have provided a bit of introduction on what are miRNAs and what are Lnc RNAs. It will make it easy for readers that are new to this field to appreciate the review.

It is intriguing that the authors have provided a glimpse of future directions for the field. Overall I do not have any major or necessary suggestions. However I do have a curious request. Authors may wish to provide insight on if there is any way to integrate the miRNA based pathways to mRNA based pathways and if that has been done for P53 field.
paper_title_zh: p53在胃肠道癌中的扩展调控领域
paper_abstract_zh: 肿瘤抑制基因TP53是胃肠道癌症中最常被删除或突变的基因之一。作为转录因子，p53调控多种重要的蛋白质编码基因，以控制细胞周期、细胞死亡、DNA损伤/修复、干细胞特性、分化等关键细胞功能。此外，p53还能通过直接结合到这些miRNA的启动子区域，激活多种小非编码microRNA（miRNA）的表达。许多miRNA已被鉴定为通过调控关键效应靶mRNA而具有潜在肿瘤抑制功能。我们对p53调控网络的理解最近扩展到包括长非编码RNA（lncRNA）。与miRNA类似，lncRNA被发现 在癌症生物学中发挥重要作用。随着我们对这些非编码RNA的重要功能及其与p53关系的深入理解，我们正在获得关于细胞在应对各种生长环境变化时的生物学和功能的新颖见解。在这篇综述中，我们总结了目前对非编码RNA在p53调控网络中不断扩展的参与及其对我们理解胃肠道癌症的启示。
review_content_zh:
Fesler等人撰写的这篇文章及时总结了P53相关调控机制的研究现状，特别强调了其在结肠癌中的重要性。P53无疑是致癌和进展过程中最关键的节点。随着关于非编码RNA在癌症生物学领域重要性的信息迅速发展，建立一个综合图景以构建调控工作模型至关重要。该综述通过提供两个精心设计的图表，在这方面做得非常出色。总体而言，这是一篇非常及时的关于这一不断演变领域的综述。作者对miRNA和Lnc RNA进行了简要介绍，这一点非常值得赞赏，它将使新接触该领域的读者更容易理解这篇综述。

令人感兴趣的是，作者还展望了该领域的未来方向。总体上，我没有任何重大或必要的建议。然而，我有一个好奇的请求。作者或许可以提供一些见解，探讨是否有方法将基于miRNA的通路与基于mRNA的通路整合起来，以及这在P53领域是否已经实现。

paper_title: Proliferative nephritis in childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus: current therapeutic approaches and future perspectives
paper_abstract: Renal involvement occurs in 50-75% of children with childhood-onset systemic lupus erythematosus (cSLE). Proliferative lupus nephritis (LN) represents the most common pattern of renal involvement in cSLE. Despite aggressive treatment, progression to end stage renal disease can occur in up to 5-10% of children. Over the last 2 decades, tremendous advancements have been made in the treatment of pediatric LN. Special considerations in children need to address the impact of disease and therapy on both physical and psychological growth and development. This review will focus on pivotal clinical trials in the treatment of proliferative LN, with a focus on pediatric data when available.
review_content:

paper_title_zh: 儿童期发病系统性红斑狼疮中的增殖性肾炎：当前治疗策略与未来展望

paper_title: A comprehensive review of deep learning-based single image super-resolution
paper_abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) is one of the vital image processing methods that improve the resolution of an image in the field of computer vision. In the last two decades, significant progress has been made in the field of super-resolution, especially by utilizing deep learning methods. This survey is an effort to provide a detailed survey of recent progress in single-image super-resolution in the perspective of deep learning while also informing about the initial classical methods used for image super-resolution. The survey classifies the image SR methods into four categories, i.e., classical methods, supervised learningbased methods, unsupervised learning-based methods, and domain-specific SR methods. We also introduce the problem of SR to provide intuition about image quality metrics, available reference datasets, and SR challenges. Deep learning-based approaches of SR are evaluated using a reference dataset. Some of the reviewed state-of-the-art image SR methods include enhanced deep SR network (EDSR), cycle-in-cycle GAN (CinCGAN), multiscale residual network (MSRN), meta residual dense network (Meta-RDN), recurrent back-projection network (RBPN), second-order attention network (SAN), SR feedback network (SRFBN) and wavelet-based residual attention network (WRAN). Finally, this survey is concluded with future directions and trends in SR and open problems in SR to be addressed by the researchers.

paper_title_zh: 基于深度学习的单图像超分辨率综合综述
paper_abstract_zh: 图像超分辨率（SR）是计算机视觉领域中提升图像分辨率的重要图像处理方法之一。在过去的二十年里，超分辨率领域取得了显著进展，尤其是通过利用深度学习方法。本综述旨在详细梳理近年来基于深度学习的单图像超分辨率研究进展，同时介绍最初用于图像超分辨率的经典方法。该综述将图像SR方法分为四类，即经典方法、基于监督学习的方法、基于无监督学习的方法和特定领域的SR方法。我们还引入了SR问题，以提供关于图像质量指标、可用参考数据集和SR挑战的直观理解。基于深度学习的SR方法通过参考数据集进行评估。一些被评述的先进图像SR方法包括增强型深度SR网络（EDSR）、循环中的循环GAN（CinCGAN）、多尺度残差网络（MSRN）、元残差密集网络（Meta-RDN）、递归反投影网络（RBPN）、二阶注意力网络（SAN）、SR反馈网络（SRFBN）和小波基残差注意力网络（WRAN）。最后，本综述总结了SR的未来方向和趋势，以及研究人员需要解决的SR开放性问题。

paper_title: Tale of Two Cities: narrative review of oxygen
paper_abstract: The human brain contributes 2% of the body weight yet receives 15% of cardiac output and demands a constant supply of oxygen (O 2 ) and nutrients to meet its metabolic needs. Cerebral autoregulation is responsible for maintaining a constant cerebral blood flow that provides the supply of oxygen and maintains the energy storage capacity. We selected oxygen administration-related studies published between 1975–2021 that included meta-analysis, original research, commentaries, editorial, and review articles. In the present narrative review, several important aspects of the oxygen effects on brain tissues and cerebral autoregulation are discussed, as well the role of exogenous O 2 administration in patients with chronic ischemic cerebrovascular disease: We aimed to revisit the utility of O 2 administration in pathophysiological situations whether or not being advantageous. Indeed, a compelling clinical and experimental body of evidence questions the utility of routine oxygen administration in acute and post-recovery brain ischemia, as evident by studies in neurophysiology imaging. While O 2 is still part of common clinical practice, it remains unclear whether its routine use is safe.
review_content:
The authors should be commended for the nice, well written review. Here are a few small suggestions:

Page 5 - Without O2, the ETC would not have a final electron acceptor and the production of ATP would become much less efficient - Here I would briefly mentioned the Pasteur point where the cell metabolism switches from aerobic to anaerobic leading to lower ATP production. Oxidative metabolism of each glucose molecule results in production of 38 ATP. When the level of oxygen in mitochondria falls to around 1–2 mm Hg (Pasteur point), anaerobic metabolism of glucose results in synthesis of lactic acid with a consequent generation of 2 ATP per glucose only.
 3. Page 5 – Change HIPV to (HPIV).
 4. Page 5 - Intriguingly, while ROS mediates neuronal damage during the early phase of ischemia, in later phases it mediates vascular endothelial growth factor –You might want to add “synthesis” after endothelial growth factor.
 5. Beginning of Page 6 – Change “and thereby lead to” to “and thereby leads to” or “and thereby leading to”.
 6. Page 6 – Change “In a 28 patients” to “In 28 patients”.
 7. Page 6 – FiO2 1.0 - Since in this case 1 represents a fraction and there is no number greater than 1, I would eliminate the ".0" – I would also do the same for the rest of the review.
 8. Page 6 – change “did not underwent” to “did not undergo”.
 9. Page 6 - (neurons, interneurons, astrocytes, smooth muscle cells, pericytes, endothelial cells) – I would add Microglia to this list.
10. Page 7- HIF1a – I would spell the alpha here and write HIF1-alpha.
paper_title_zh: 双城记：氧气叙事综述
paper_abstract_zh: 人脑仅占体重的2%，却接收了15%的心输出量，并且需要持续供应氧气（O₂）和营养物质以满足其代谢需求。脑自动调节负责维持恒定的脑血流，从而提供氧气供应并保持能量储存能力。我们选取了1975年至2021年间发表的与氧气治疗相关的研究，包括荟萃分析、原创研究、评论、社论和综述文章。在本次叙述性综述中，讨论了氧气对脑组织和脑自动调节的几个重要影响，以及外源性O₂治疗在慢性缺血性脑血管疾病患者中的作用：我们旨在重新审视在病理生理情况下O₂治疗的实用性，无论其是否具有优势。事实上，大量临床和实验证据对急性及恢复期脑缺血中常规氧气治疗的实用性提出了质疑，这一点在神经生理学影像研究中尤为明显。尽管O₂仍是常见临床实践的一部分，但其常规使用的安全性仍不明确。

10. 第7页——HIF1a——我会在这里拼写出alpha，写作HIF1-alpha。

paper_title: A short review on the potential of coffee husk gasification for sustainable energy in Uganda
paper_abstract: Agricultural biomass is widely recognized as a clean and renewable energy source, with increasing potential to replace conventional fossil fuels in the energy market. Uganda, like other developing countries, has a high dependency (91%) on wood fuel, leading to environmental degradation. With a coffee production of 233 Metric Tonnes per annum, relating to 46.6 Mega Tonnes of coffee husks from processing, transforming these husks into syngas through gasification can contribute to resolving the existing energy challenges. The objective of this article is to briefly review the energy potential of coffee husks through gasification, and how the gasification process could increase energy recoveries for coffee farmers. Previous  findings indicate that the 46.6 Mega Tonnes per year of coffee husks generated in Uganda, with a heating value of 18.34 MJ/kg, is capable of generating 24 GWh of energy. This will address a 0.7% portion of the energy situation in Uganda, while protecting the environment.
review_content:
The review is relevant considering the current energy situation i.e. dwindling of fossil fuel resources and the impact of the same to climate change. Use of sustainable renewable resource which are considered to be carbon neutral is very important.

However, the current generation of coffee husks (only meeting 0.7% of energy demand) does not provide comfort for sustainable energy supply. Although the paper discusses the intention of Uganda to increase acreage of coffee plantation, it does not discuss to what extent this will be done to meet even 20% of Uganda’s energy supply.

Specific Comments
Abstract
 1. Line 4, the Authors are stating that Uganda is producing 233 Metric Tonnes of coffee, which produce 46.6 Mega Tonnes. These numbers do not make sense. Unless 233 are in Mega Tonnes
 2. Line 5, insert “per year” between “husks” and “from”
 3. Line 13, 0.7% of total energy from coffee husks do not tally with the use of “sustainable energy” – probably instead the Authors should use contribute to energy mix

Introduction
 1. Line 5, the Authors imply other pollutants contribute to greenhouse gases, they should be specific by mentioning which ones, otherwise they should change the statement
 2. Second paragraph, second line, last word “efficiencies” is misspelled

The Energy Situation in Uganda
Fossil Fuels
 1. Line 3, the Authors are making reference to use of Natural Gas. My understanding is that Uganda is not using NG, probably they wanted to mean “Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG)”

Biomass Energy on page 4
 1. Second paragraph, line 5, Authors should change “Should” to “could”

Status of gasification in Uganda
 1. Line 21 “ replace the word “electrical” with “electricity”

Gasification potential of coffee husks (page 5)
 1. Line 2 the Authors states that the coffee yield 22% of its weight as coffee husks. When you consider that Uganda produces 233 Mega Tonnes, then the coffee husks do not compute to 46.6 Mega Tonnes
 2. The statement ” The annual generation of coffee husks in Uganda is estimated to be 46.6 M tons per annum, rising from 172 M tons per annum reported in 2004” does not seem correct. 172 Mega Tonnes is larger than 46.6 Mega Tonnes
Conclusion
 1. Line 8, use of statement “the heavy reliance of wood for fuel will be curbed” is a heavy statement without qualification particularly when you consider that the coffee husks contribute only 0.7% of energy in Uganda
 2. Line 12, insert the word “source” between “a” and “clean”

paper_abstract_zh: 农业生物质被广泛认为是清洁且可再生的能源，其在能源市场替代传统化石燃料的潜力日益增加。乌干达与其他发展中国家一样，对木燃料的依赖度高达91%，导致环境退化。乌干达每年的咖啡产量为233公吨，相应地产生46.6兆吨的咖啡壳。通过气化将这些咖啡壳转化为合成气，有助于解决现有的能源挑战。本文旨在简要回顾通过气化咖啡壳的能源潜力，以及气化过程如何提高咖啡种植者的能源回收率。先前的研究表明，乌干达每年产生的46.6兆吨咖啡壳，其热值为18.34兆焦耳/千克，能够产生24吉瓦时的能量。这将解决乌干达0.7%的能源问题，同时保护环境。
review_content_zh:
该评论考虑到当前的能源状况，即化石燃料资源的枯竭及其对气候变化的影响，具有重要意义。使用被认为是碳中和的可持续可再生能源非常重要。

然而，当前咖啡壳的产量（仅满足0.7%的能源需求）并不能为可持续能源供应提供保障。尽管论文讨论了乌干达增加咖啡种植面积的计划，但并未讨论这一计划将如何实施以满足乌干达至少20%的能源供应。

paper_title: CircRNA: purification, identification, and disease marker potential
paper_abstract: Circular RNA (CircRNA) is an endogenous noncoding RNA with covalently closed cyclic structure. It is divided into exonic circRNA, intronic circRNA and exon-intron circRNA, based on their components. CircRNAs are well conserved in sequence and abundantly expressed in a tissue specific manner. They have a high stability due to resistance to exonuclease. Depends on their sequence, they perform many biological function including microRNA sponging activity, modulation of alternative splicing or transcription, interaction with RNA binding proteins, rolling translation and derivative of pseudogenes. They are involved in the development of a variety pathological condition including cardiovascular disease, diabetes, neurological diseases and cancer. Emerging evidences show that circRNA are likely to be potential targets for new clinical diagnostic markers or treatment of many diseases. In this review, we have described the potential relationship between circRNA and disease progression, methods and databases of cyclic RNA.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting The manuscript contains many typographic and drafting errors. English must be considerably improved. The manuscript includes sufficient background. It shows clearly the context. The structure of the article is according to the required format by PeerJ. Figures are very illustrative, appropriately labelled and described. Experimental design The review is organized logically into coherent subsections. However, the “CircRNA in disease development and progression” section is poorly developed. The only paragraph in this section is difficult to understand and contains poor information. Validity of the findings No comment. Comments for the author The review entitled “CircRNA: as a disease marker potential and research strategy” by Xu et al. addresses a very interesting and novel topic. In this review, authors explain relevant topics about CircRNAs including biogenesis, properties and functions. In general, these topics were correctly written and illustrated with appropriately described images. The “CircRNA in disease development and progression” section is not according to previous sections, this one is very poor. I consider that, since title is about CircRNAs and diseases, this section must be more extensive and complete. The “Methods of CircRNA detection and characterization” section is basically focused on methods of purification and identification of CircRNAs. This one is a small part that I consider to be a research strategy (as included in the title). Authors must discuss more about these topics and include Why CircRNA could be a disease marker potential? I think that, if the authors address the previous comments and the following minor comments, the manuscript could be considered for publication. Thank you for your suggestions. The first, originally considering the influence of the number of words, I showed the “CircRNA in disease development and progression” section in the form of a table. Although this form is simple but it also lost some important information, I have changed “CircRNA in disease development and progression” to “CircRNA as a disease marker in disease progression”. In addition to the detailed description, I also updated the latest research results(“1 Introduction”、“5.3.4 Hepatocellular Carcinoma”、“5.5 Other disease” etc. ). The relationship between these diseases and circRNA can give the reader a clear understanding and explain why circRNA could be a disease marker potential (“5.6 CircRNA as a disease marker potential”). Second, the research method in the title contains a very wide range of content, but the examples listed in the article are not enough to reflect all the research methods. In order to better reflect the themes and research content of the full text, the title of the article has been changed to “CircRNA: Purification, Identification, and Disease Marker Potential” Minor comment: Section 7 is loss. paper_title_zh: 环状RNA：纯化、鉴定及疾病标志物潜力
paper_abstract_zh: 环状RNA（CircRNA）是一种具有共价闭合环状结构的内源性非编码RNA。根据其组成成分，可分为外显子环状RNA、内含子环状RNA和外显子-内含子环状RNA。环状RNA在序列上高度保守，并以组织特异性的方式丰富表达。由于其对核酸外切酶的抵抗性，具有较高的稳定性。根据其序列，环状RNA执行多种生物学功能，包括微小RNA海绵活性、调控可变剪接或转录、与RNA结合蛋白相互作用、滚动翻译和假基因衍生物。它们参与多种病理条件的发展，包括心血管疾病、糖尿病、神经疾病和癌症。越来越多的证据表明，环状RNA可能成为新的临床诊断标志物或多种疾病治疗的潜在靶点。在本综述中，我们描述了环状RNA与疾病进展之间的潜在关系，以及环状RNA的方法和数据库。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2

基本报告
手稿中存在许多排版和起草错误。英语水平必须显著提高。手稿包含了足够的背景信息，清晰地展示了研究背景。文章结构符合PeerJ所要求的格式。图表非常具有说明性，标签和描述恰当。

实验设计
综述逻辑性地组织成连贯的子节。然而，“环状RNA在疾病发展和进展中的作用”部分发展不足。该部分唯一的段落难以理解，且信息质量差。

结果的有效性

对作者的评论
