paper_title: Linked within-host and between-host models and data for infectious diseases: A systematic review
paper_abstract: The observed dynamics of infectious diseases are driven by processes across multiple scales. Here we focus on two: within-host, that is how an infection progresses inside a single individual (for instance viral and immune dynamics), and between-host, that is how the infection is transmitted between multiple individuals of a host population. The dynamics of each of these may be influenced by the other, particularly across evolutionary time. Thus understanding each of these scales, and the links between them, is necessary for a holistic understanding of the spread of infectious diseases. One approach to combining these scales is through mathematical modeling. We conducted a systematic review of the published literature on multi-scale mathematical models of disease transmission (as defined by combining within-host and between-host scales) to determine the extent to which mathematical models are being used to understand across-scale transmission, and the extent to which these models are being confronted with data.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Winston Garira) Basic reporting The manuscript is well written. However, there is no sufficient field background/context provided. The article does not include sufficient introduction to demonstrate how multiscale models which integrate within-host and between-host scale fit into the broader field of multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems. Infectious disease systems have many levels of organization apart from the host level. The authors should have a more general introduction that discusses multiscale modelling at the various levels of organization (cell level, tissue level, host level, etc.) and then indicate why they chose multiscale modelling at host level. We thank the reviewer for this comment and agree with the assessment. Within-host and between-host scales are just two of several to be considered. We have reformulated our manuscript to specify that we focus on within-host and between-host scales, of the wider range of multi-scale models. We have added to the introduction a brief discussion and some references about the selection of within-host and between-host as the scales considered. As the details of the many types of multi-scale models have been elegantly reviewed elsewhere (Garira, 2017), we do not delve deeply into the specifics here. Experimental design This is a review paper. The research objectives are well defined, relevant & meaningful. The paper is within the aims and scope of the journal. The study design is described in sufficient detail. Validity of the findings The findings of this study are clear. the conclusion are well stated, linked to original research question. However, the authors should justify the conclusion that host immunity can be considered as an alternative linking mechanism in multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We have extended our description (including references) of the possibility of host immune response as a linking mechanism in the discussion. Comments for the Author More general comments are in the pdf file attached. Note: We have replicated the authors comments in the attached pdf here to address point by point. Summary: The authors conducted a systematic review of the published literature on multiscale mathematical models of infectious disease dynamics to determine the extent to which mathematical models are being used to understand across-scale dynamics at host level, and the extent to which these models are being confronted with data. They followed PRISMA guidelines for systematic reviews. The focus was on multiscale models that integrate the within-host and between-host scales. The review identified 19 of 139 qualifying papers across 30 years that include both linked within-host and between-host sub-models. They analyzed traits of the19 papers focusing on which species are modeled, which pathogens are modeled, which types of models are used, how the within-host and between-host dynamics are linked, and at what level data has been used. The main findings are that it was most common for these multiscale models to describe a human population, to model a viral disease, to use a deterministic modeling at either scale, to link the pathogen load at the within-host scale, to link the transmission rate at the between-host scale, and to use data at the within-host scale. General comments: 1. The title of paper and even the way the whole manuscript is written seems to imply that multiscale modelling of infectious diseases means developing multiscale models only at host level of organization of an infectious disease system, that is, only integrating within-host scale and between-host scale. That is not true. There are also other levels of organization of an infectious disease system at which multiscale models can be developed to describe disease dynamics (see [3] below for other levels of organization of an infectious disease system at which multiscale models can be developed). If the authors would like to keep the title of the paper as it is, they should acknowledge the existence of other levels of organization of an infectious disease system at which multiscale models can be developed and indicate why they chose the host level if the objective was to establish the state of multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems in general as implied by the title and the writing of throughout the paper. We thank the reviewer for important point. We have changed our title to “Linked within- and between-host models and data for infectious diseases: A systematic review” 2. The authors indicate that in their search for papers on multiscale models of infectious disease dynamics, they identified papers which were of review nature which they excluded in the analysis. However, since their paper is also of review nature, they should indicate how those other review papers are different from their current review paper. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We have now included more evaluation of the other review papers that our search terms returned within the introduction. Briefly, several review papers are very relevant in their comparison to our own (e.g. Mideo, 2008; Handel, 2015; Dorratoltaj, 2017; Theys 2018). These papers indicated the need for additional data and integration of scales. Some focused on more particular components of multi-scale models (e.g. Lavine, 2008 on heterogeneity). Others (e.g. Dolan, 2018; Forrester, 2016; Pimenoff, 2018; Wilks, 2012) focused more on reviewing specific biological components or more methodological components (e.g. Kao, 2010; Willem, 2017). Note that all mentioned references are now included in the main text so we do not reproduce them here. 3. In the manuscript, the submodels used in the multiscale were categorized into four groups (i.e. types of modeling framework): deterministic, statistical, individual-based, and stochastic for purposes of analysis. The authors did not give the criteria used to make this grouping of submodels in the multiscale models. The problem is that there is conflicting literature on what is an individual based model as some authors do not make distinction between individual-based models, stochastic models and statistical models (see for example [4] below which treats any model which does not describe disease variables as averaged quantities as individual-based model). Based on this criteria some individual based models can be statistical models, while some stochastic models can be individual based models. Therefore, the authors should clarify their grouping of the types of submodels into the four groups (deterministic, statistical, individual-based, and stochastic). We thank the reviewer for this clarification. We have specified what we mean by each categorization in the text and in the figure caption. Specifically, we added the following within the main body of the text: In all cases, our categorization is based on the process/mechanism portion of the model being considered. Deterministic models included any mechanistic/process based model that did not include stochasticity in the process. For example, this may include ODE/compartmental models. These models may have been fit assuming a stochastic observation model overlaid on the dynamics. Stochastic models include any model that includes stochasticity in the description of the mechanism/process. Examples of this would include stochastic SIR models, or stochastic differential equations, but not IBMs. Here, IBMs include any models in which individuals or agents were modeled separately from each other and allowed to interact within a simulated environment. This is in contrast to models that include data collected on individuals and where these are used to parameterize models (we would refer to these as ``trait based''). IBS as defined here may contain both deterministic and stochastic components. These models are typically much more difficult to analyze and fit to data than either of the other two flavors of mechanistic models, hence why we considered them separately. Finally, statistical models are those that seeks to fit a function to data without the function having an explicit link to a mechanism for what produces a pattern. This would include all flavors of regression, and many machine-learning approaches. 4. The authors identified two linking mechanisms which they categorized either as a state or a trait. Integrating the scales is one of the main scientific challenges in multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems. The authors identified that most of the submodels were linked through the pathogen load while pathogen growth rate was the second most used trait to link submodels. In general, the scales of an infectious disease system are linked through disease processes (see [3] below for a detailed discussion of some of the linkages between scales through disease processes). However, the challenge is to convert an actual disease processes that represents exchange of information between scales (e.g. exchange of pathogen between within-host scale and between-host scale) into a mathematical linking mechanism. But is there any scientific/biological basis to support the existence of the linkage of scales through any of the following traits: pathogen death rate, pathogen growth rate, host death rate, host recovery rate, pathogen frequency, pathogen virulence. The authors should explain how these traits represent exchange of information between scales of an infectious disease system and which scales exchange information through these traits. Otherwise such linkages are unrealistic and may not be representing any linkage of scales in an actual disease system. Equally, it is not clear how host immune response at the site of infection can be thought of constituting a linking mechanism between scales of an infectious disease. What is clear is that the immune response system at the site of infection is a complex system, with its own scales as explained in [2] and its own multiscale modelling approaches [1]. An infectious disease system is also another complex system made up of three components (host, pathogen, environment) , with its own scales and its own multiscale modelling approaches (Garira, 2017). The two different complex systems (infectious disease system and immune response system at the site of infection) are linked during infection. The authors should explain how immune response system at the site of infection represent exchange of information between scales of an infectious disease system. There is possibility of confusion if this aspect is not explained and scientifically justified. One possible source of confusion is that models of infectious disease dynamics which are single scale in representing infectious disease dynamics (e.g. within-host scale model alone), but which are multiscale in modelling immune response at the site of infection (e.g. those integrating molecular scale and cellular scale of immune response) may end up being considered as multiscale models of infectious disease systems. Yet they are not multiscale models of infectious disease. The reviewer brings up a very important and interesting point here. However, the intention of our paper is not to evaluate whether or not the choice of linking mechanisms used by other authors is the most relevant choice to describe an infectious disease system, but to report on the state of the field. We chose the suite of potential linking mechanisms based on preliminary readings of relevant literature where we identified the need for this review. 5. The way the authors presented the results of the traits of the 19 papers does not allow for easy independent verification of the results by readers. Since the papers are few (only 19), the authors should indicate which papers or give some examples of papers that have specific traits as presented in the analysis in the results section to allow for easy independent verification of the results by readers. For example, the authors indicated that pathogen growth rate was the second most used trait to link the within- to between-host model (4/19 papers). It would be better if the authors could give examples of papers with such a trait. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We have extended our search as suggested by the reviewers, resulting in 195 papers, of which 24 were included in our full evaluation. As the number remains small, we have added specific discussion of some of the results. We also note that the answers to all questions for each paper are included in the supplemental data files. Specific comments/typos: 1. Page 1, lines 40-41. The authors indicated that biological systems do not exhibit clear separation of temporal or spatial scales. Its not clear what the authors want to say. It appears as if they want to say there are no clear boundaries between scales. If that is the case I do not think its true. The authors need to clarify what exactly do they mean by ``… do not exhibit clear separation of temporal or spatial scale, ….”. We thank the reviewer of this question. We have clarified to indicate that this is not always the case but often the case. From a mathematical standpoint, what we mean by “ … do not exhibit clear separation of temporal or spatial scales …” is that it is not accurate in the case of time to represent one scale as slow and one scale as fast. The time scales are often very similar and cannot be assumed to be qualitatively different. 2. Page 4, Figure 2. In the caption of this figure it appears as if the meaning of gray colour and blue colour are exchanged. We thank the reviewer for pointing this out. It has been corrected. 3. Page 5, line 160. The author wrote: In a multi-scale model, the within-host component and between-host component are both modeled explicitly. First, this statement seems to imply that every multiscale of an infectious disease system integrates within-host scale and between-host. This is not true. Some multiscale model integrate within-cell and between-cell scales while others may integrate within-tissue and between-tissue scales (see [3] below). Second, it is not always the case that in a multiscale model that integrates the within-host scale and the between-host scale both scales are modelled explicitly. Some individual-based multiscale models (Garira, 2017) do not have explicit representation of both scales. I also think that the survey identified such papers, but excluded them from the analysis. We agree with the reviewer for multi-scale models in general that explicit within-host and between-host models are not required. However, we have only considered papers here that explicitly included a within-host model and explicitly included a between-host model. We have modified this sentence to clarify this is for our study. 4. Page 5, line 170. The Figure is not correctly specified. We have edited this section such that this is no longer included. 5. Page 7, lines 208 – 217. The authors should replace the word level with the word scale throughout this paragraph. In multiscale modelling of complex systems the these words often have different meanings and may not be used interchangeably. We have taken the reviewer’s suggestion and revised this paragraph accordingly. 6. Page 7, line 245. Unless the authors can present some justification of how host immunity represents exchange of information between scales of an infectious disease system, they should not propose it as an alternative linking mechanism of scales of an infectious disease system. The point is that before we start talking about mathematical linking mechanism, we should first talk about a biological or disease process linking mechanism. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We have included in the discussion section some justification for immune response as a linking function. It has also been discussed at length in two previous reviews (Hawley, 2011; Graham 2007). References [1.] Cappuccio, A., Tieri, P., & Castiglione, F. (2015). Multiscale modelling in immunology: a review. Briefings in bioinformatics, 17(3), 408-418. [2.] Eftimie, R., Gillard, J. J., & Cantrell, D. A. (2016). Mathematical models for immunology: current state of the art and future research directions. Bulletin of mathematical biology, 78(10), 2091-2134.. [3.] Garira, W. (2018). A primer on multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems. Infectious Disease Modelling, 3, 176-191. [4.] Tian, Y., & Osgood, N. (2011). Comparison between Individual-based and Aggregate Models in the context of Tuberculosis Transmission. In Proceedings, the 29th International Conference of the System Dynamics Society (pp. 1-29).
paper_title_zh: 宿主内和宿主间传染病模型及数据的关联：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 传染病观察到的动态由多个尺度上的过程驱动。本文重点关注两个尺度：宿主体内，即感染在单个个体内部的进展方式（例如病毒和免疫动态），以及宿主间，即感染在宿主种群多个个体之间的传播方式。每个尺度的动态都可能受到另一个尺度的影响，尤其是在进化时间尺度上。因此，理解每个尺度及其之间的联系，对于全面理解传染病的传播是必要的。将这两个尺度结合的一种方法是数学建模。我们对已发表的多尺度疾病传播数学模型文献（定义为结合宿主体内和宿主间尺度）进行了系统综述，以确定数学模型在理解跨尺度传播方面的应用程度，以及这些模型与数据相符的程度。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（温斯顿·加里拉）基本报告
手稿撰写良好。然而，提供的领域背景/上下文不足。文章没有包含足够的引言来展示整合宿主体内和宿主间尺度的多尺度模型如何融入更广泛传染病系统的多尺度建模领域。传染病系统除了宿主水平外还有许多组织层次。作者应该有一个更普遍的引言，讨论各个组织层次（细胞水平、组织水平、宿主水平等）的多尺度建模，然后说明为什么选择在宿主水平进行多尺度建模。我们感谢审稿人的这一评论，并同意其评估。宿主体内和宿主间尺度只是需要考虑的几个尺度中的两个。我们已经重新撰写了手稿，明确指出我们关注的是宿主体内和宿主间尺度，属于更广泛的多尺度模型范围。我们在引言中增加了一段简短讨论和一些关于选择宿主体内和宿主间作为考虑尺度的参考文献。由于多种多尺度模型的细节已在其他文献中优雅地综述（加里拉，2017），我们在此不深入探讨具体细节。

实验设计
这是一篇综述文章。研究目标明确、相关且有意义。论文符合期刊的目标和范围。研究设计描述足够详细。

结果的有效性
本研究的结果清晰。结论陈述得当，与原始研究问题相联系。然而，作者应证明宿主免疫可以作为传染病系统多尺度建模中的替代连接机制的结论。我们感谢审稿人的这一建议。我们已在讨论中扩展了对宿主免疫反应作为连接机制可能性的描述（包括参考文献）。

对作者的评论
更一般的评论见附件中的pdf文件。注：我们将作者在附件pdf中的评论复制于此，以便逐点回应。

摘要：作者对已发表的关于传染病动态多尺度数学模型的文献进行了系统综述，以确定数学模型在理解宿主水平跨尺度动态方面的使用程度，以及这些模型与数据对比的程度。他们遵循了系统综述的PRISMA指南。重点在于整合宿主体内和宿主间尺度的多尺度模型。综述在30年间识别出139篇符合资格的论文中有19篇包含链接的宿主体内和宿主间子模型。 他们对19篇论文的特征进行了分析，重点关注了建模的物种、建模的病原体、使用的模型类型、宿主体内和宿主间动态如何关联，以及使用了哪个层次的数据。主要发现是，这些多尺度模型最常见的是描述人类群体、建模病毒性疾病、在任一尺度上使用确定性建模、在宿主体内尺度上关联病原体负荷、在宿主间尺度上关联传播率，以及使用宿主体内尺度的数据。

一般性评论：
1. 论文的标题甚至整篇手稿的写作方式似乎暗示，传染病的多尺度建模仅指在传染病系统的宿主水平上开发多尺度模型，即仅整合宿主体内尺度和宿主间尺度。这是不正确的。传染病系统的其他组织水平也可以开发多尺度模型来描述疾病动态（参见下文[3]，了解传染病系统其他组织水平上可以开发多尺度模型的情况）。如果作者希望保持论文标题不变，他们应该承认传染病系统的其他组织水平也可以开发多尺度模型，并说明为什么他们选择宿主水平，如果目标是建立如标题和整篇论文所暗示的传染病系统多尺度建模的总体状况。我们感谢审稿人提出的重要观点。我们已经将标题改为“传染病宿主体内和宿主间模型的关联及数据：系统综述”。
2. 作者指出，在他们搜索关于传染病动态多尺度模型的论文时，他们发现了综述性质的论文，这些论文在分析中被排除。然而，由于他们的论文也是综述性质的，他们应该说明那些其他综述论文与当前综述论文的不同之处。我们感谢审稿人的这一建议。我们现在已经在引言中更多地评估了我们的搜索词返回的其他综述论文。简而言之，几篇综述论文在与其自身的比较中非常相关（例如，Mideo, 2008; Handel, 2015; Dorratoltaj, 2017; Theys 2018）。这些论文指出了需要额外的数据和尺度的整合。一些论文更关注多尺度模型的特定组成部分（例如，Lavine, 2008关于异质性）。其他论文（例如，Dolan, 2018; Forrester, 2016; Pimenoff, 2018; Wilks, 2012）更侧重于回顾特定的生物学组成部分或更多方法学组成部分（例如，Kao, 2010; Willem, 2017）。请注意，所有提到的参考文献现在都已包含在正文主体中，因此我们在此不再重复。3. 在文稿中，用于多尺度模型的子模型被分为四类（即建模框架的类型）：确定性、统计性、基于个体和随机性，以便进行分析。作者并未给出用于将多尺度模型中的子模型进行这种分类的标准。问题在于，关于什么是基于个体的模型存在相互矛盾的文献，因为一些作者并未区分基于个体的模型、随机模型和统计模型（例如，参见下文[4]，该文献将任何不将疾病变量描述为平均量的模型视为基于个体的模型）。根据这一标准，一些基于个体的模型可以是统计模型，而一些随机模型也可以是基于个体的模型。因此，作者应澄清他们将子模型类型分为四类（确定性、统计性、基于个体和随机性）的依据。我们感谢审稿人对此的澄清。我们已在文本和图注中明确了我们所说的每一类别的含义。具体而言，我们在文本主体中添加了以下内容：在所有情况下，我们的分类基于所考虑模型的进程/机制部分。确定性模型包括任何基于机制/进程的模型，但不包括进程中的随机性。例如，这可能包括ODE/分区模型。这些模型可能通过假设在动态上叠加一个随机观测模型来进行拟合。随机模型包括任何在机制/进程描述中包含随机性的模型。这方面的例子包括随机SIR模型或随机微分方程，但不包括IBM。在这里，IBM包括任何将个体或代理单独建模并允许其在模拟环境中相互作用的模型。这与那些包含个体数据收集并用这些数据来参数化模型的模型形成对比（我们将这些模型称为“基于特征”的模型）。此处定义的IBS可能包含确定性和随机性成分。这些模型通常比其他两种机制的模型更难分析和拟合数据，因此我们将其单独考虑。最后，统计模型是指那些试图将函数拟合到数据中，而该函数与产生模式的机制没有明确联系的模型。这包括所有类型的回归和许多机器学习方法。4. 作者确定了两种连接机制，并将其归类为状态或特征。整合尺度是传染病系统多尺度建模的主要科学挑战之一。作者发现，大多数子模型是通过病原体负荷连接的，而病原体生长率是连接子模型的第二大常用特征。 一般来说，传染病系统的各个尺度通过疾病过程相互关联（详见下文[3]中对通过疾病过程连接各尺度的详细讨论）。然而，挑战在于将实际疾病过程中代表尺度间信息交换的部分（例如，宿主体内尺度与宿主间尺度之间的病原体交换）转化为数学连接机制。但是，是否有科学/生物学基础支持通过以下特征存在尺度间的连接：病原体死亡率、病原体生长率、宿主死亡率、宿主恢复率、病原体频率、病原体毒力。作者应解释这些特征如何代表传染病系统各尺度间的信息交换，以及哪些尺度通过这些特征交换信息。否则，这样的连接是不现实的，可能并不代表实际疾病系统中任何尺度的连接。同样，感染部位的宿主免疫反应如何构成传染病各尺度间的连接机制也不清楚。明确的是，感染部位的免疫反应系统是一个复杂的系统，有其自身的尺度（如[2]中所述）及其多尺度建模方法[1]。传染病系统也是一个由三个组成部分（宿主、病原体、环境）构成的复杂系统，有其自身的尺度和多尺度建模方法（Garira, 2017）。在感染过程中，这两个不同的复杂系统（传染病系统和感染部位的免疫反应系统）相互连接。作者应解释感染部位的免疫反应系统如何代表传染病系统各尺度间的信息交换。如果不解释并从科学上加以论证，可能会引起混淆。一个可能的混淆来源是，那些在表示传染病动态时是单一尺度的模型（例如，仅宿主体内尺度模型），但在模拟感染部位免疫反应时是多尺度的模型（例如，那些整合了免疫反应的分子尺度和细胞尺度的模型），可能会被误认为是传染病系统的多尺度模型。然而，它们并不是传染病的多尺度模型。审稿人提出了一个非常重要且有趣的观点。然而，我们论文的意图并不是评估其他作者所使用的连接机制是否是描述传染病系统的最相关选择，而是报告该领域的现状。我们根据相关文献的初步阅读选择了这套潜在的连接机制，因为我们识别到了进行这一综述的需求。5. 作者呈现19篇论文特征结果的方式，使得读者难以独立验证这些结果。由于论文数量较少（仅19篇），作者应在结果部分指出哪些论文或给出一些具有特定特征的论文示例，以便读者能够轻松独立验证结果。例如，作者指出病原体生长率是用于连接宿主体内到宿主间模型的第二常用特征（4/19篇论文）。如果作者能给出具有此类特征的论文示例会更好。我们感谢审稿人的这一建议。我们已按照审稿人的建议扩展了搜索范围，结果找到了195篇论文，其中24篇被纳入我们的全面评估。由于数量仍然较少，我们已对一些结果进行了具体讨论。我们也注意到，每篇论文对所有问题的答案都包含在补充数据文件中。

具体意见/错别字：
1. 第1页，第40-41行。作者指出生物系统在时间或空间尺度上没有明显的分离。不清楚作者想表达什么。看起来他们似乎想说尺度之间没有明确的边界。如果是这样，我认为这不正确。作者需要澄清“……没有明显的时间或空间尺度分离……”的确切含义。我们感谢审稿人提出这一问题。我们已澄清，这并非总是如此，但常常如此。从数学角度来看，“……没有明显的时间或空间尺度分离……”意味着在时间上，将一个尺度视为慢速，另一个尺度视为快速是不准确的。时间尺度通常非常相似，不能假定它们在质上有所不同。
2. 第4页，图2。该图标题中，灰色和蓝色的含义似乎被交换了。我们感谢审稿人指出这一点。已进行更正。
3. 第5页，第160行。作者写道：在多尺度模型中，宿主体内成分和宿主间成分都被明确建模。首先，这一陈述似乎暗示每个传染病系统的多尺度都整合了宿主体内尺度和宿主间尺度。这是不正确的。一些多尺度模型整合了细胞内和细胞间的尺度，而其他模型可能整合了组织内和组织间的尺度（见下文[3]）。其次，在整合宿主体内尺度和宿主间尺度的多尺度模型中，并非总是两种尺度都被明确建模。一些基于个体的多尺度模型（Garira, 2017）并没有明确表示两种尺度。我也认为调查发现了此类论文，但将其排除在分析之外。 我们同意审稿人对于多尺度模型的一般看法，即不需要显式的宿主体内和宿主间模型。然而，我们在此仅考虑了明确包含宿主体内模型和明确包含宿主间模型的论文。我们已修改这句话以澄清这是针对我们的研究。4. 第5页，第170行。图示未正确指定。我们已编辑此部分，使其不再包含在内。5. 第7页，第208-217行。作者应将此段落中的“水平”一词替换为“尺度”一词。在复杂系统的多尺度建模中，这些词通常具有不同的含义，不能互换使用。我们已采纳审稿人的建议并相应地修订了此段落。6. 第7页，第245行。除非作者能提供一些证据说明宿主免疫如何代表传染病系统各尺度间的信息交换，否则不应将其作为传染病系统各尺度间的替代连接机制。关键在于，在我们开始讨论数学连接机制之前，应首先讨论生物学或疾病过程的连接机制。我们感谢审稿人的这一建议。我们在讨论部分中包含了一些将免疫反应作为连接功能的证据。这一点也在之前的两篇综述中进行了详细讨论（Hawley, 2011; Graham 2007）。参考文献[1.] Cappuccio, A., Tieri, P., & Castiglione, F. (2015). Multiscale modelling in immunology: a review. Briefings in bioinformatics, 17(3), 408-418. [2.] Eftimie, R., Gillard, J. J., & Cantrell, D. A. (2016). Mathematical models for immunology: current state of the art and future research directions. Bulletin of mathematical biology, 78(10), 2091-2134. [3.] Garira, W. (2018). A primer on multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems. Infectious Disease Modelling, 3, 176-191. [4.] Tian, Y., & Osgood, N. (2011). Comparison between Individual-based and Aggregate Models in the context of Tuberculosis Transmission. In Proceedings, the 29th International Conference of the System Dynamics Society (pp. 1-29).

Page 5, line 170. The Figure is not correctly specified.
Page 7, lines 208 – 217. The authors should replace the word level with the word scale throughout this paragraph.

However, there is no sufficient field background/context provided. The article does not include sufficient introduction to demonstrate how multiscale models which integrate within-host and between-host scale fit into the broader field of multiscale modelling of infectious disease systems.
It would be better if the authors could give examples of papers with such a trait.

paper_title: The rise of pathogen genomics in Africa
paper_abstract: The routine genomic surveillance of pathogens in diverse geographical settings and equitable data sharing are critical to inform effective infection control and therapeutic development. The coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic highlighted the importance of routine genomic surveillance of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) to detect emerging variants of concern. However, the majority of high-income countries sequenced >0.5% of their COVID-19 cases, unlike low- and middle-income countries. By the end of 2022, many countries around the world had managed to establish capacity for pathogen genomic surveillance. Notably, Beta and Omicron; 2 of the 5 current SARS-CoV-2 variants of concern were first discovered in Africa through an aggressive sequencing campaign led by African scientists. To sustain such infrastructure and expertise beyond this pandemic, other endemic pathogens should leverage this investment. Therefore, countries are establishing multi-pathogen genomic surveillance strategies. Here we provide a catalog of the current landscape of sequenced and publicly shared pathogens in different countries in Africa. Drawing upon our collective knowledge and expertise, we review the ever-evolving challenges and propose innovative recommendations.
review_content:
The opinion article, "The rise of pathogen genomics in Africa" by Gerald Mboowa and colleagues provides an detailed overview of the sequencing capacities and the efforts taken to further establish molecular pathogen surveillance in Africa during the COVID-19 pandemic.

The article provides a brief introduction to genomic pathogen surveillance and why it is so important to build capacity for the necessary sequencing equipment and bioinformatics. Mboowa and colleagues show very nicely what has happened in this area during the COVID-19 pandemic and how this considerable progress has led to important contributions in and from Africa. There is no question that these competences should continue to be maintained and expanded, as this benefits not only Africa but all of us as a global scientific community - as very well demonstrated on the example of SARS-CoV-2 in the publication. One of the major factors in this area, as the article argues, will definitely be to offer comprehensive bioinformatics expertise and training - the initiatives mentioned in the article can serve as a starting point for the interested reader. The article is definitely an important contribution and provides a great overview of progress and problems in pathogen surveillance in Africa, although a few small changes could further improve readability and impact.
  * In the abstract: „ However, the majority of high-income countries sequenced >0.5% of their COVID-19 cases, unlike low- and middle-income countries.”. I would add a number here, what is the difference to low and middle income countries.
    Of note, also for the paragraph in the text: I am not convinced that the percentage of sequenced COVID cases is a good estimator. It depends on which COVID tests were used and how extensively they are used. Furthermore, one could argue that waste water surveillance also provides a very good overview and is very cost-efficient.
  * In my view, the publication would benefit from including examples of what genomic surveillance has already achieved in Africa. It is very well elaborated what capacities exist and what needs to be established on a larger scale, but what is the benefit when all goals are achieved? This would emphasize the importance of the topic in my opinion, e.g. extend on the link between NGS and vaccine adaptations.
  * In general, the article is very "COVID-heavy". Based on the title, I would have expected a somewhat broader scope here. Could other initiatives for other pathogens perhaps be mentioned here?
    In this context. The authors mention: ‘The continent still has several pathogens of epidemic and pandemic potential that require near real-time tracking’, a brief overview of which pathogens are meant or what ‘near real-time tracking’ is used for would be useful here. It is not entirely clear which time period is meant.
  * Table 1 is pretty big and it’s certainly important for networking purposes so it should not be excluded. However, I might suggest to move the country list with the specific NGS equipment to the supplementary.
  * The key applications in Table 1 are a bit misleading in my opinion, e.g. one could easily run 12-20 bacterial WGS samples on a minion (or even more on a MiSq). It all depends on the number of samples and the amount of data required for the analysis. It may be better to have two tables here. One that gives information about the devices and their output and a second one with applications and their requirements? Depending on the number of samples one can then look for the right device here.
  * The information on the MinION is not consistent, in Table 1 an output of 50Gb is specified, on page 9, however, 15-20Gb are stated. Further note: The read length for ONT devices is limited mostly by the DNA Prep, the maximum read length is questionable here (especially since different maximum read lengths were specified for different ONT devices). The longest read ever was over 4Mb until recently.
  * The search term “Pathogen [All Fields] AND Country [All Fields]” on the SRA webpage (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/) as describe on page 9 delivers pathogens from all countries, not just Africa?
  * The paragraphs under “Major emerging challenges” are a bit redundant and I’d generally suggest to shorten them a bit. In my view, the key messages are sometimes a little lost. The authors could further comment critically here that with cloud platforms, to a certain extent, one also gives the data out of ones hands and makes oneself dependent on certain providers again.
  * The paragraph „ Challenges of integrating ethics and law in international collaborations” might also be shorten a bit.
In my view, the points above would emphasize the intentions of the article a little more and increase the flow of reading. Nevertheless, it is already an excellent and above all important article.
paper_title_zh: 病原体基因组学在非洲的兴起
paper_abstract_zh: 在多样化地理环境中对病原体进行常规基因组监测以及公平的数据共享对于指导有效的感染控制和治疗开发至关重要。2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）大流行凸显了常规基因组监测严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）以检测新兴关注变异株的重要性。然而，大多数高收入国家对超过0.5%的COVID-19病例进行了测序，而低收入和中等收入国家则不然。到2022年底，世界上许多国家已设法建立了病原体基因组监测能力。值得注意的是，当前5个SARS-CoV-2关注变异株中的2个——Beta和Omicron，是通过非洲科学家领导的积极测序活动首先在非洲发现的。为了在此大流行之外维持此类基础设施和专业知识，其他地方性病原体应利用这一投资。因此，各国正在建立多病原体基因组监测策略。本文提供了非洲不同国家目前已测序和公开共享的病原体的当前概况目录。基于我们的集体知识和专长，我们回顾了不断演变的挑战，并提出了创新性建议。
review_content_zh:
**评论内容翻译：**

由Gerald Mboowa及其同事撰写的观点文章《病原体基因组学在非洲的兴起》详细概述了在COVID-19大流行期间，非洲的测序能力和为建立分子病原体监测所付出的努力。

文章简要介绍了基因组病原体监测及其为何对建立必要的测序设备和生物信息学能力至关重要。Mboowa及其同事很好地展示了这一领域在COVID-19大流行期间的发展情况，以及这一显著进步如何为非洲及从非洲出发的重要贡献。毫无疑问，这些能力应继续得到维护和扩展，因为这不仅造福非洲，也造福我们作为全球科学共同体的所有人——正如文章中SARS-CoV-2的例子所充分展示的。正如文章所论述的，这一领域的主要因素之一无疑是提供全面的生物信息学专业知识和培训——文章中提到的倡议可以作为有兴趣读者的起点。尽管一些小的改动可以进一步提高可读性和影响力，但该文章无疑是一项重要贡献，提供了非洲病原体监测进展和问题的全面概述。

* 在摘要中：“然而，大多数高收入国家对超过0.5%的COVID-19病例进行了测序，而低收入和中等收入国家则不然。”我会在这里添加一个数字，说明与低收入和中等收入国家的差异。
  值得注意的是，对于正文中的段落：我不太相信测序的COVID病例百分比是一个好的估计值。这取决于使用了哪些COVID检测方法以及它们的广泛使用程度。此外，有人可能会认为废水监测也提供了非常好的概览，并且非常经济高效。
* 在我看来，文章如果能包括基因组监测在非洲已经取得的成果示例，将受益匪浅。文章很好地阐述了现有的能力以及需要在大规模上建立的内容，但如果所有目标都实现了，好处是什么？这将强调该主题的重要性，例如扩展NGS与疫苗适应之间的联系。
* 总的来说，文章非常“侧重于COVID”。基于标题，我本来期望这里会有更广泛的范围。是否可以在这里提及针对其他病原体的其他倡议？
  在此背景下，作者提到：“非洲大陆仍有几种具有流行和 pandemic 潜力的病原体，需要近乎实时的追踪”，在这里简要概述指的是哪些病原体或“近乎实时追踪”用于什么目的将很有用。这里并不完全清楚指的是哪个时间段。
* 表格1相当大，对于网络建设目的来说确实很重要，因此不应排除。不过，我建议将具体NGS设备的国家列表移至补充材料。
* 我认为表1中的关键应用有些误导，例如，一个人可以很容易地在minion上运行12-20个细菌WGS样本（在MiSq上甚至更多）。这完全取决于样本数量和分析所需的数据量。也许在这里有两个表格会更好。一个提供设备及其输出的信息，另一个提供应用及其需求的信息？根据样本数量，可以在这里查找合适的设备。
* MinION的信息不一致，表1中指定了50Gb的输出，然而在第9页上却提到了15-20Gb。另请注意：ONT设备的读长主要受DNA制备的限制，最大读长在这里是有问题的（尤其是由于不同的ONT设备指定了不同的最大读长）。直到最近，最长的读长超过4Mb。
* 在SRA网页（https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/sra/）上搜索“Pathogen [All Fields] AND Country [All Fields]”如第9页所描述，会检索到来自所有国家的病原体，而不仅仅是非洲？
* “主要新兴挑战”下的段落有些冗余，我建议稍微缩短一些。在我看来，关键信息有时有点丢失。作者可以在这里进一步批判性地评论，使用云平台在一定程度上也是将数据交到他人手中，并使自己再次依赖于某些提供商。
* “国际合作中整合伦理和法律挑战”的段落也可以稍微缩短一些。

在我看来，上述要点将稍微强调文章的意图，并提高阅读流畅性。尽管如此，这已经是一篇优秀且非常重要的文章。

paper_title: Occupational therapy productions in times of pandemic: a systematic review of occupational therapeutic actions against the new coronavirus (COVID-19) epidemic
paper_abstract:
Background: In March 2020, the World Health Organization classified infection and contagion of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) as a worldwide pandemic. Since then, health professionals have been tirelessly researching the symptoms and consequences of this disease in people's daily lives. Occupational therapists have also been mobilized to implement effective actions in order to guarantee the functionality and quality of life of individuals and groups. The aim of this article was to investigate what available resources there are regarding occupational therapy during the pandemic, and thus support and enrich professional practice during this time. 
 Methods: A search for was carried out for materials such as technical notes, guidelines for working with COVID-19 patients, clinical trials, and reflections and debates on occupational therapeutic practice during the COVID-19 pandemic. Articles in English, Portuguese and Spanish were included. The search was carried out in the Virtual Health Library (VHL), Google Scholar, Latin American & Caribbean Health Sciences Literature (LILACS), Scientific Electronic Library Online (SCIELO) databases, Medical Literature Analysis and Retrieval System Online (MEDLINE), Pubmed, and the websites of occupational therapy entities and organizations. 
 Results: A total of 44 materials were found and categorised into performance guides, technical notes and scientific articles. The materials dealt with different themes, with a predominance of guidelines for hospital practices. However, there was also a significant amount of notes on the positioning of representative bodies in the preparation of intervention guides in wards, intensive care units, and outpatient and patient homes to support these professionals. 
 Conclusions: The results demonstrate the quick response of authors in the field of occupational therapy, to combat the challenges and barriers of the COVID-19 pandemic. The texts promote scientifically-based strategies to provide the best assistance to patients during the pandemic period.
review_content:
I applaud for the authors' efforts in conducting such an important topic regarding the effectiveness of occupational therapy during the era of COVID-19 pandemic. In general, the systematic review is well written and followed by the standard (i.e., the PRISMA guideline). The Results section is meaningful and have clear information that demonstrates the synthesized results. However, I believe that the systematic review can be improved with three minor comments from my side:
 1. In the Introduction, I would like the authors to mention that occupational therapy can be applied to different aspects of human daily livings, including their sleep (Fan & Drumheller, 20211). This can strengthen the rationale of conducting this meaningful systematic review.
 2. I would suggest changing the title from "the new coronavirus (COVID-19) epidemic" to "COVID-19 pandemic". Given that the COVID-19 is spread over the world, epidemic cannot reflect the true situation of the severity of COVID-19.
 3. I would like to see a clear PICO in the present systematic review, especially I would like to see the outcomes in the authors' mind. It seems that the authors have several outcomes and quality of life is the most important one that the authors want to assess. However, this is not clearly stated in the systematic review.
paper_title_zh: 大流行时期的职业治疗实践：针对新型冠状病毒（COVID-19）疫情的职业治疗行动的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：2020年3月，世界卫生组织将2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）的感染和传播归类为全球大流行。自那时起，卫生专业人员一直在不懈地研究这种疾病对人们日常生活的症状和后果。职业治疗师也被动员起来，实施有效行动，以确保个人和群体的功能性和生活质量。本文旨在调查大流行期间职业治疗的可利用资源，从而支持和丰富这一时期的职业实践。

方法：对技术说明、与COVID-19患者工作的指南、临床试验以及关于COVID-19大流行期间职业治疗实践的反思和辩论等材料进行了搜索。纳入了英文、葡萄牙文和西班牙文的文章。搜索在虚拟健康图书馆（VHL）、谷歌学术、拉丁美洲和加勒比健康科学文献（LILACS）、科学电子图书馆在线（SCIELO）数据库、医学文献分析和检索系统在线（MEDLINE）、Pubmed以及职业治疗实体和组织网站上进行。

结果：共找到44份材料，分为绩效指南、技术说明和科学文章。这些材料涉及不同主题，以医院实践指南为主。然而，也有大量关于代表性机构在病房、重症监护室、门诊和患者家中准备干预指南的定位说明，以支持这些专业人员。

结论：结果表明，职业治疗领域的作者对应对COVID-19大流行的挑战和障碍做出了快速反应。这些文本推广了基于科学的策略，以在大流行期间为患者提供最佳援助。
review_content_zh:
我对作者在COVID-19大流行期间进行关于职业治疗有效性的这一重要主题的研究努力表示赞赏。总体而言，这篇系统综述写得很好，遵循了标准（即PRISMA指南）。结果部分内容丰富，信息清晰，展示了综合结果。然而，我认为这篇系统综述可以通过我提出的三个小建议进行改进：
1. 在引言部分，我希望作者能提到职业治疗可以应用于人类日常生活的不同方面，包括他们的睡眠（Fan & Drumheller, 20211）。这可以加强进行这项有意义的系统综述的合理性。
2. 我建议将标题从“新冠病毒（COVID-19）流行”改为“COVID-19大流行”。鉴于COVID-19已在全球范围内传播，流行一词无法反映COVID-19严重程度的真实情况。
3. 我希望在目前的系统综述中看到一个清晰的PICO，尤其是我想了解作者心中的结果。似乎作者有几个结果，而生活质量是作者最想评估的最重要的一个。然而，这在系统综述中并未明确说明。

paper_title: I drink for my liver, Doc: emerging evidence that coffee prevents cirrhosis
paper_abstract: Evidence demonstrating that regular ingestion of coffee has salutary effects on patients with chronic liver disease is accumulating rapidly. Specifically, it appears that coffee ingestion can slow the progression of liver fibrosis, preventing cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This should excite clinicians and scientists alike, since these observations, if true, would create effective, testable hypotheses that should lead to improved understanding on fibrosis pathogenesis and thus may generate novel pharmacologic treatments of patients with chronic liver disease. This review is designed to examine the relevant clinical and epidemiological data in critical fashion and to examine the putative pharmacological effects of coffee relevant to the pathogenesis of liver fibrosis and cirrhosis. We hope that this will inspire relevant critical analyses, especially among “coffee skeptics”. Of note, one major assumption made by this review is that the bulk of the effects of coffee consumption are mediated by caffeine, rather than by other chemical constituents of coffee. Our rationales for this assumption are threefold: first, caffeine’s effects on adenosinergic signaling provide testable hypotheses; second, although there are  myriad chemical constituents of coffee, they are present in very low concentrations, and perhaps more importantly, vary greatly between coffee products and production methods (it is important to note that we do not dismiss the “botanical” hypothesis here; rather, we do not emphasize it at present due to the limitations of the studies examined); lastly, some (but not all) observational studies have examined both coffee and non-coffee caffeine consumption and found consistent effects, and when examined, no benefit to decaffeinated coffee has been observed. Further, in the interval since we examined this phenomenon last, further evidence has accumulated supporting caffeine as the effector molecule for coffee’s salutary effects.
review_content:
This is an excellent review covering recent findings on beneficial effects of coffee on liver cirrhosis. The authors reviewed the relevant clinical and epidemiological data and suggested an inhibitory role of caffeine on adenosinergic signaling in hepatic stellate cells.
 1. Caffeine inhibits adenosine receptors. Contrary to this notion, the authors mentioned that antagonists for the receptors inhibit the protective effect of caffeine on portal hypertension-related complications on page 6. Please check whether antagonists for adenosine receptors inhibit the beneficial effects of caffeine in the liver.
 2. Are there papers showing adenosine receptor signaling in hepatic stellate cells? Does the inhibition the receptor suppress activation of hepatic stellate cells or induce their cell death?
 3. Caffeine has been shown to induce autophagy in hepatocytes. Is it possible that activation of autophagy in hepatocytes indirectly mediates the activation state of hepatic stellate cells in the liver?

paper_title_zh: "我为了肝脏而饮酒，医生：咖啡预防肝硬化的新证据"
paper_abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，定期饮用咖啡对慢性肝病患者具有有益影响。具体而言，咖啡摄入似乎可以减缓肝纤维化的进展，预防肝硬化和肝细胞癌（HCC）。这应该会让临床医生和科学家都感到兴奋，因为这些观察结果如果属实，将产生有效且可测试的假设，从而有助于更好地理解纤维化病理机制，并可能为慢性肝病患者开发新的药物治疗方法。本综述旨在以批判性的方式审视相关临床和流行病学数据，并探讨咖啡对肝纤维化和肝硬化病理机制的可能药理作用。我们希望这能激发相关批判性分析，尤其是对于那些“咖啡怀疑论者”。值得注意的是，本综述的一个主要假设是，咖啡摄入的大部分效应是由咖啡因介导的，而非咖啡中的其他化学成分。我们这一假设的依据有三点：首先，咖啡因对腺苷能信号传导的影响提供了可测试的假设；其次，尽管咖啡中存在多种化学成分，但它们的浓度非常低，更重要的是，在不同咖啡产品和生产方法之间差异很大（需要指出的是，我们并未在此否定“植物学”假设；而是由于所审查研究的局限性，目前不强调它）；最后，一些（但并非所有）观察性研究已经考察了咖啡和非咖啡类咖啡因摄入，并发现了一致的效果，并且在考察时，未发现脱咖啡因咖啡的益处。此外，自我们上次审视这一现象以来，进一步积累的证据支持咖啡因作为咖啡有益效应的作用分子。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇优秀的综述，涵盖了近期关于咖啡对肝硬化的有益作用的研究发现。作者回顾了相关的临床和流行病学数据，并提出了咖啡因在肝星状细胞中通过抑制腺苷能信号传导发挥作用的观点。
1. 咖啡因抑制腺苷受体。与此观点相反，作者在第6页提到，腺苷受体的拮抗剂抑制了咖啡因对门脉高压相关并发症的保护作用。请核实腺苷受体的拮抗剂是否抑制咖啡因在肝脏中的有益作用。
2. 是否有文献显示肝星状细胞中存在腺苷受体信号传导？抑制该受体是否能抑制肝星状细胞的激活或诱导其细胞死亡？
3. 研究表明咖啡因能诱导肝细胞自噬。是否有可能肝细胞自噬的激活间接介导了肝脏中肝星状细胞的激活状态？
4. 请在文中标注表1。

paper_title: Pollen report:Quantitative review of pollen crude protein concentrations offered by beepollinated flowers in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes
paper_abstract: To ease nutritional stress on managed as well as native bee populations in agricultural habitats, agro-environmental protection schemes aim to provide alternative nutritional resources for bee populations during times of need. However, such efforts have so far focused on quantity (supply of flowering plants) and timing (flower-scarce periods) while ignoring the quality of the two main bee relevant flower-derived resources (pollen and nectar). As a first step to address this issue we have compiled a geographically explicit dataset focusing on pollen crude protein concentration, one measurement traditionally associated with pollen quality for bees. We attempt to provide a robust baseline for protein levels bees can collect in-(crop and weed species) and off-field (wild) in agricultural habitats around the globe. Using this dataset we identify crops which provide sub-optimal pollen resources in terms of crude protein concentration for bees and suggest potential plant genera that could serve as alternative resources for protein. This information could be used by scientists, regulators, bee keepers, NGOs and farmers to compare the pollen quality currently offered in alternative foraging habitats and identify opportunities to improve them. In the long run we hope that additional markers of pollen quality will be added to the database in order to get a more complete picture of flower resources offered to bees and foster a data-informed discussion about pollinator conservation in modern agricultural landscape
review_content: Reviewer 2 for his critical reading of the manuscript and we have incorporated most of the suggestions to the best of our abilities. In case of the figures we have included the actual data points to figure two only. After looking at Figure 1 in more detail we felt that the overall quality distribution was well covered by the simple box plot presentation as outliers have a smaller impact in these cases. Experimental design At its core this is a valid compilation and re-analysis of an interesting global dataset of pollen protein contents. Provided that the authors can address the statistical issues outlined in the general comments section, any findings supported by those corrected analyses will be sound. Validity of the findings Despite the strengths detailed above, I believe that in their current state the statistical analyses need revision and are not sufficient to support the authors’ conclusions. I have detailed the issues in the general comments section of my review. We have drastically changed the analytical approach see below. Comments for the author This manuscript provides a valuable analysis of pollen protein content in agricultural and wild landscapes. The authors gathered data from eight previous publications on the protein contents of crop, weed, and wild plants and use these data to conclude that wild plants produce higher protein pollen than crop or weed plants on a global scale. This pattern is largely driven by plants in the new world, but there is a non-significant trend towards a similar pattern in Europe. Though these findings are potentially very interesting, there are some serious issues with the statistical analyses that need to be fixed before the authors conclusions are fully supported. I have organized my comments into Major Issues that I feel need to be addressed in order for the data, analyses, and conclusions to be sound and Minor Comments that deal primarily with the presentation and communication of the findings. Further I have directly addressed the PeerJ editorial criteria at the end of this review. We would like to thank the reviewer for the overall positive evaluation and we hope we were able to address the valid concerns raised concerns. Major Issues • I am very concerned about the authors’ analytical methods regarding whether or not crops, weeds, or wild plants have higher pollen protein content. Based on the sample sizes presented in figure 1, it appears that they are treating each observation in their data as independent despite ~85 of their observations being within species replicates. It is not clear in the description of their statistical models (lines 183-189) whether or not the authors accounted for this in their models, but figure 1 suggests they did not. If the authors did not account for this repeated measurement, they need to. Otherwise if they did somehow account for the non-independence of repeated measures on a single species they need to describe how they did this. Based on this valid criticism, we have decided to change the analytical approach for this paper. The original intention of the paper was to 1) aggregate the available data on crude protein concentration in bee visited flowers, 2) to make it accessible in an easy to use electronic format and 3) present the broad geographic, taxonomic and community patterns. Staying true to these aims, we have decided to drop hypothesis driven analytics from the paper and instead describe the broad patterns we observe in the data using summary statistics and basic graphical representation. We now stress that for an in-depth analysis of the potential drivers of crude protein concentration in pollen a phylogenetically controlled analytical approach is called for. We believe that this approach, although a bit unorthodox, is true to the intention of the paper and in line with the current discussion about statistical approaches in biological science. We hope that this decision is acceptable for both the reviewers and the editor. Following this change we have adjusted the relevant parts of the MS (mostly results & discussion). • Similarly there are two issues with the authors analysis of genus level variation. First, at line 173, the authors say they only included genera that had more than three species level records in this analysis, but they did not do this. They have included some genera that have three or more repeated measure of a single species but not three different species in the genus (e.g. Lupinus, Zea, Hypochoeris). Secondly, these data seem to call for a phylogenetically corrected model, and the authors should attempt to apply some sort of phylogenetic correction or explain why it would be inappropriate to do so. We agree with the reviewer that a phylogenetically controlled analysis would be a promising future research direction. However, the goal of this paper was to aggregate the available data on pollen quality in bee visited flowers and present the overall patterns. We believe that in addition to phylogeny habitat/growing conditions will influence resource quality. As all factors will contribute the pollen quality bees can encounter in agricultural habitats we consider observation (unique species habitat observations) as the most relevant measurement in this context. We now clarify this in the materials and method section and have corrected the relevant annotations in the figures. • The authors use two schema for categorizing plants in their dataset: 1) domestication and weediness status, and 2) genus. At various points in the manuscript they refer to genera of plants as either crop, wild, or weed (e.g. line 207), but not all members of every genus in the dataset are entirely agricultural or wild. This is especially true for members of Solanum which the authors refer to as a “crop genus” despite only 4 of the 18 species in the authors’ database being crop plants. The authors should be careful regarding this point throughout the manuscript. The reviewer is correct. Our intention was to mark genera containing crop. However, we now realize that this has caused confusion for both reviewers and we have consequently decided to remove this feature from Figure 2. In addition, we now clarified this important aspect in all relevant sections of the MS. A within genus comparison in such mixed genera would be particularly interesting to see if domestication has influenced resource quality. Minor Comments • L64-67: The authors should move the citations after the final word of this sentence to increase readability. removed • L76 and elsewhere: Throughout the work there is an issue with the Roulston, Cane, and Buchmann 2000 citation. First, T.Roulston’s name is spelled incorrectly in the supplemental data file (currently written as Roulstone in the, but the correct surname is Roulston). Secondly in all of the in-text citations the authors have used T.Roulston’s first name instead of his surname (e.g. line 76 should read “Roulston, Cane et al. 2000”). Corrected • L84: The authors should consider including lipid content here (as they do at line 158 and 253). Done • L279-280: There is a missing line here, and I believe the authors may have inadvertently deleted some text. The last paragraph was restructured • Works Cited: as written the works cited section is extremely difficult to read, and its formatting should be revised for clarity. changed • Figures 1 and 2: The authors should add raw data as points overlaid over these box plots (to provide readers with a better sense of the distribution of the data) as long as it does not make the plots overly complicated. As an example, I have produced the an example figure (an attached version of figure 2 that both corrects for the issues mentioned above regarding the inclusion of genera that do not have 3 species, and which also includes raw data). I will include the code to generate this plot with my review. done for Fig. 2. After looking at Figure 1 in more detail we felt that the overall quality distribution was well covered by the simple box plot presentation as outliers have a smaller impact in these cases. • Figure 2: It appears that the authors have color coded the genera, but the logic behind this color coding is not clear in the figure description. Perhaps red genera are crops, and black genera are wild plants. If this is the case the authors should consider how they might color code genera that contain crops, weeds, and wild plants (e.g. Solanum). We have removed this aspect to avoid confusion • Supplementary data file: The data are uploaded as a comma separated values file (.csv), but are semi-colon delimited. This may cause issues for some readers who open the file in common spreadsheet software (e.g. Microsoft Excel). The authors should either change the file type to .txt or change the delimiter to a coma. Thank you for spotting it we have now uploaded an updated raw data sheet in .txt format. We hope this fixes the issue. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.8174627.v1
paper_title_zh: 花粉报告：农业和非农业景观中蜜蜂授粉花朵提供的花粉粗蛋白浓度的定量综述
paper_abstract_zh: 为了缓解农业生境中人工饲养和野生蜜蜂种群的营养压力，农业环境保护计划旨在在蜜蜂需求时期为其提供替代性营养资源。然而，此类努力迄今为止主要集中在数量（开花植物供应）和时机（花朵稀缺期）上，而忽略了两种主要与蜜蜂相关的花源性资源（花粉和花蜜）的质量。作为解决这一问题的第一步，我们编制了一个地理明确的数据库，重点关注花粉粗蛋白浓度，这是传统上与蜜蜂花粉质量相关的一项测量指标。我们试图为蜜蜂在全球农业生境中田间（作物和杂草种类）和田间外（野生）可收集的蛋白质水平提供一个稳健的基线。利用这一数据集，我们识别出在粗蛋白浓度方面为蜜蜂提供次优花粉资源的作物，并建议潜在的植物属作为蛋白质的替代资源。这些信息可供科学家、监管机构、养蜂人、非政府组织和农民使用，以比较目前替代觅食生境中提供的花粉质量，并识别改进的机会。从长远来看，我们希望数据库中能增加更多花粉质量指标，以便更全面地了解提供给蜜蜂的花朵资源，并促进在现代农业景观中基于数据的传粉者保护讨论。
review_content_zh:
感谢审稿人2对稿件的批判性阅读，我们已经尽最大努力采纳了大部分建议。在图件方面，我们仅在图二中包含了实际数据点。在更详细地查看图1后，我们觉得简单箱线图已经很好地覆盖了整体质量分布，因为在这种情况下异常值的影响较小。

实验设计
从根本上说，这是一份对全球花粉蛋白含量有趣数据集的有效汇编和再分析。只要作者能够解决一般评论部分中概述的统计问题，任何由这些修正分析支持的发现都将是有根据的。

发现的合理性
尽管有上述优点，但我认为目前的统计分析需要修订，尚不足以支持作者的结论。我在评审的一般评论部分详细说明了这些问题。我们已经大幅改变了分析方法，见下文。

对作者的意见
这篇手稿对农业和野生景观中花粉蛋白含量进行了宝贵的分析。作者收集了八篇先前关于作物、杂草和野生植物蛋白含量的出版物数据，并使用这些数据得出结论，认为在全球范围内，野生植物产生的花粉蛋白含量高于作物或杂草植物。这一模式主要由新世界的植物驱动，但在欧洲也存在一个不显著的类似趋势。尽管这些发现可能非常有趣，但在作者的结论得到充分支持之前，统计分析中存在一些严重问题需要解决。我将我的评论分为主要问题，这些问题需要解决以确保数据、分析和结论的可靠性，以及次要评论，主要涉及发现的呈现和传达。此外，我在评审末尾直接回应了PeerJ的编辑标准。我们感谢审稿人的总体积极评价，并希望我们能够解决提出的有效关切。

主要问题
• 我对作者的分析方法非常担忧，尤其是关于作物、杂草或野生植物是否具有更高花粉蛋白含量的问题。根据图1中呈现的样本量，他们似乎将数据中的每个观测值视为独立，尽管约有85个观测值是物种内的重复。在统计模型描述（第183-189行）中，不清楚作者是否在模型中考虑了这一点，但图1表明他们没有。如果作者没有考虑到这种重复测量，他们需要这样做。否则，如果他们以某种方式考虑了单个物种上重复测量的非独立性，他们需要描述是如何做到的。 基于这一合理的批评，我们决定更改本文的分析方法。本文的初衷是：1）汇总蜜蜂访问花朵中粗蛋白浓度的可用数据，2）将其以易于使用的电子格式呈现，3）展示广泛的地理、分类和群落模式。为了忠实于这些目标，我们决定从论文中删除基于假设的驱动分析，转而使用汇总统计和基本的图形表示来描述我们在数据中观察到的广泛模式。我们现在强调，对于花粉中粗蛋白浓度潜在驱动因素的深入分析，需要采用系统发育控制的分析方法。我们认为，尽管这种方法有些非正统，但它忠实于论文的初衷，并与当前关于生物科学统计方法的讨论相一致。我们希望这一决定能够得到审稿人和编辑的认可。根据这一变化，我们调整了手稿的相关部分（主要是结果与讨论）。

同样，作者对属级变异的分析存在两个问题。首先，在第173行，作者表示他们只包括在此分析中有超过三个物种级记录的属，但他们并未这样做。他们包括了一些属，这些属有三个或更多同一物种的重复测量，但不是三个不同的物种（例如Lupinus、Zea、Hypochoeris）。其次，这些数据似乎需要一种系统发育校正模型，作者应尝试应用某种系统发育校正，或解释为何这样做不合适。我们同意审稿人的观点，认为系统发育控制的分析是一个有前景的未来研究方向。然而，本文的目标是汇总蜜蜂访问花朵中花粉质量的可用数据，并展示总体模式。我们认为，除了系统发育外，栖息地/生长条件也会影响资源质量。由于所有因素都会影响蜜蜂在农业栖息地中遇到的花粉质量，我们认为观察（独特物种栖息地观察）是这一背景下最相关的测量方法。我们现在在材料与方法部分对此进行了澄清，并已更正了图中的相关注释。

作者在数据集中使用了两种植物分类方案：1）驯化和杂草状态，以及2）属。在手稿的多个地方，他们将植物属称为作物、野生或杂草（例如第207行），但并非数据集中每个属的所有成员都是完全农业或野生的。这对于Solanum属的成员尤其如此，尽管作者将其称为“作物属”，但作者数据库中的18个物种中只有4个是作物植物。作者应在整篇手稿中对此点保持谨慎。 审稿人是对的。我们的意图是标记包含作物的属。然而，我们现在意识到这给两位审稿人造成了困惑，因此我们决定从图2中删除这一特征。此外，我们现在在论文的相关部分中澄清了这一重要方面。在混合属中进行属内比较，特别有趣的是看驯化是否影响了资源质量。

次要意见：
• 第64-67行：作者应将引文移至该句最后一个词之后，以提高可读性。已移除。
• 第76行及其他地方：全文中存在关于Roulston, Cane, 和 Buchmann 2000引文的问题。首先，T.Roulston的名字在补充数据文件中拼写错误（目前写作Roulstone，但正确的姓氏是Roulston）。其次，在所有正文引文中，作者使用了T.Roulston的名字而非姓氏（例如，第76行应读作“Roulston, Cane等人2000”）。已更正。
• 第84行：作者应考虑在此处包含脂质含量（如他们在第158行和第253行所做的那样）。已完成。
• 第279-280行：此处缺少一行，我认为作者可能无意中删除了一些文本。最后一段已重新组织。
• 引用作品：目前的引用作品部分非常难以阅读，其格式应进行修订以增强清晰度。已更改。
• 图1和图2：作者应在这些箱线图上叠加原始数据点（以便读者更好地了解数据的分布），只要这样做不会使图表过于复杂。例如，我制作了一个示例图（一个附带的图2版本，既纠正了上述关于包含不足3个物种的属的问题，也包含了原始数据）。我将包括生成此图表的代码在我的审稿意见中。图2已完成。在更详细地查看图1后，我们觉得简单的箱线图展示已很好地覆盖了整体质量分布，因为这些情况下异常值的影响较小。
• 图2：看来作者对属进行了颜色编码，但图例描述中并未明确这种颜色编码的逻辑。也许红色属是作物，黑色属是野生植物。如果是这样，作者应考虑如何对包含作物、杂草和野生植物的属进行颜色编码（例如Solanum）。我们已删除这一方面以避免混淆。
• 补充数据文件：数据以上传为逗号分隔值文件（.csv），但实际上是以分号分隔的。这可能会给一些使用常见电子表格软件（如Microsoft Excel）打开文件的读者造成问题。作者应将文件类型改为.txt或将分隔符改为逗号。感谢指出，我们现在已上传了更新后的原始数据表为.txt格式。我们希望这能解决问题。 由于您提供的链接指向的是一个具体的学术资源，而不是直接的文本内容，我无法直接进行翻译。如果您能提供具体的文本内容，我将能够根据您的要求进行翻译。请复制并粘贴您希望翻译的英文学术文本，以便我为您提供准确的中文翻译。

paper_title: Tourette Syndrome research highlights 2014
paper_abstract: About 200 journal articles reported research on Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders in 2014. Here we briefly summarize a few of the reports that seemed most important or interesting, ranging from animal models to human studies. Readers can comment on our choices or provide their own favorites using the tools on the online article.
review_content:
The authors summarize papers, which they felt were notable or might inspire further research.
Strengths of the manuscript: the paper provides a well-written, informative and succinct summary of progress in a wide range of research areas concerning TS.

Weaknesses: the paper reports on research highlights 2014 and it should therefore be clearly stated in every section why this particular work is important for the field, this is not always the case (see comments below). I feel that not all sections are entirely clear without having read the original article; I therefore have a few minor suggestions (see below).

General comment: some papers that were published prior to 2014 are cited (e.g. the histidine findings), others are not (e.g. enhanced cognitive control).

Specific comments:
A genetic clue:
It would be interesting to include a) how precise the prediction of the diagnosis was, b) which SNP survived correction for multiple tests and c) possibly the authors main thoughts on the role of the nearby genes in TS.

Pathophysiology:
How large is the family (N)? Were dopamine receptor binding and prepulse inhibition altered in the same direction in humans and mice? What are the implications of the results for TS in general or possibly for a sub-group, i.e. why are they so important for the field?

Other animal models:
What are the implications of the McCairn paper, especially regarding vocal tics?

Neuroimaging studies:
“Cortical structure BOLD signal clearly preceded signal in subcortical structures“ - It may be interesting to point out that the temporal pattern of activation differs from animal models (Bronfeld et al., 2013).

The paragraph about interhemispheric balance and role of SMA is very interesting and it would be nice to give a few more details regarding the model. The reference regarding induced echophenomena is missing.

GABA in SMA study: the findings are very complex and not easy to follow. It is unclear what sort of task the fMRI BOLD response refers to. It may also be useful to point out that fractional anisotropy in the corpus callosum was measured in fibers connected to the SMA and to point out why altered FA in CC might be related to increased motor tic severity and at the same time increased GABA in the SMA.
References for enhanced volitional control are missing.

CBIT study
Please include the behavioral findings.

The urge made me do it
The section has a very informative introductory sentence. However, the negative reinforcement model is explained in the third paragraph, after research on the model has already been presented. It might be useful to explain it in the introductory sentence.

PUTS
The presented results do not explain how the paper arrived at the conclusion that the PUTS has acceptable reliability and validity.

Results concerning MOVES associations with PUTS in the third study seem to contradict results found in the first study. Is there an explanation as to why that might be the case? Are there noteworthy results found in the second study or do the results in the last paragraph refer to the second AND third study?

I have two more suggestions for Box 1:

Muller-Vahl, K. R., Riemann, L., & Bokemeyer, S. (2014). Tourette patients' misbelief of a tic rebound is due to overall difficulties in reliable tic rating. J Psychosom Res, 76, 472-476.

Gharatya, A., Stern, J., Man, C., Williams, D., Simmons, H., & Robertson, M. (2014). Suicidality in patients with tourette's syndrome. J Neurol Neurosurg Psychiatry, 85, e3.
paper_title_zh: 2014年图雷特综合征研究亮点
paper_abstract_zh: 2014年，约有200篇期刊文章报道了关于图雷特综合症和其他抽动障碍的研究。在此，我们简要总结了几篇看似最重要或最有趣的报告，内容涵盖从动物模型到人类研究的各个方面。读者可以通过在线文章的工具对我们的选择进行评论或提供他们自己的偏好。
review_content_zh:
### 翻译内容

**作者总结了他们认为值得注意或可能激发进一步研究的论文。**

**手稿的优点：** 该论文对涉及TS的广泛研究领域中的进展提供了文笔流畅、信息丰富且简洁的总结。

**缺点：** 该论文报告了2014年的研究亮点，因此应在每个部分明确说明为何这项特定工作对领域重要，但并非总是如此（见下述评论）。我觉得在没有阅读原文的情况下，并非所有部分都完全清晰；因此，我有几点小建议（见下述）。

**总体评论：** 一些在2014年之前发表的论文被引用了（例如组氨酸发现），而其他一些则没有（例如增强的认知控制）。

**具体评论：**

**遗传线索：**
a) 包含对诊断预测的精确度如何，b) 哪个SNP在多重测试校正后仍然显著，c) 可能还包括作者对附近基因在TS中作用的主要看法，将会很有趣。

**病理生理学：**
家族规模有多大（N）？在人类和小鼠中，多巴胺受体结合和前脉冲抑制是否在同一方向上改变？这些结果对TS总体或可能对亚组有何影响，即为何它们对领域如此重要？

**其他动物模型：**
McCairn论文的启示是什么，特别是关于发声抽动？

**神经影像学研究：**
“皮质结构BOLD信号明显先于皮下结构信号”——指出激活的时间模式与动物模型不同（Bronfeld等，2013）可能很有趣。

关于半球间平衡和SMA作用的段落非常有趣，如果能提供更多关于模型的细节就更好了。关于诱导模仿现象的参考文献缺失。

**SMA中的GABA研究：** 研究发现非常复杂，不易理解。不清楚fMRI BOLD响应指的是哪种任务。指出胼胝体中与SMA相连的纤维测量了各向异性分数，并指出为何CC中改变的FA可能与运动抽动严重度增加以及SMA中GABA增加相关，可能也有用。关于增强意志控制的参考文献缺失。

paper_title: Play and dance therapy: a review of theories, techniques and didactic methodologies for the motor recovery of children with disabilities
paper_abstract:
Background: This research is aimed at analysing the effectiveness of play activities and dance-therapy programmes in improving the psycho-physical condition and increasing the well-being of individuals with disabilities. 
 Methods: Online search engines (e.g., EBSCOhost, PubMed, the American Journal of Dance) were consulted using parameters such as "physical disabilities" or "dance with music" or "childhood" and excluding protocols published before 2010. Eleven intervention protocols were analysed. These concerned play and dance-therapy courses targeted at disabled subjects under 14 years of age. 
 Results: It was found that at the end of the play sessions, higher muscular activation and improvement of quality of communication exchanges with the family members was found. With regard to the dance-therapy protocols, improvement was reported in general coordination, balance ability and a decrease in maladaptive behaviour in children with disabilities. 
 Conclusions: With the improvement in physical performance, an increase in the subjects' state of well-being is also noted, underlining a strong body-mind connection. For future studies, it is recommended that the number of participants in individual studies should be larger and to include a control group to make the results generalisable on a large scale.
review_content:
This manuscript is a systematic review on the effects of play and dance therapy on psycho-physical condition and well-being in children with disabilities. While reviewing the manuscript, several areas where improvements could enhance the overall quality and impact of the work were noted:
 1. The rationale for conducting a systematic review in this area could be made clearer. It would be helpful to discuss any previous reviews on this subject to contextualize your contribution.
 2. Consider structuring your research question in a PICO format and provide clear operational definitions for terms such as "living conditions" to enhance clarity and precision. Clearly delineate your population of interest as part of the research question.
 3. Present a comprehensive search strategy to ensure transparency and replicability in your literature review process. Could be presented as an appendix.
 4. Adherence to PRISMA guidelines is essential for systematic reviews. Ensure that your manuscript explicitly references these guidelines and follows them in both its methodology and reporting.
 5. Revise the flow chart to align with PRISMA standards, providing a clear visual representation of the study selection process.
 6. Consider utilizing two raters for the search and data extraction processes to enhance reliability and mitigate bias.
 7. It is essential to assess the quality of the studies included in a systematic review. Incorporating a quality assessment tool and reporting its findings would strengthen the rigor of your analysis.
 8. Enhance the comprehensiveness of your data extraction process to ensure that all relevant information is captured accurately.
 9. While not always feasible, conducting a meta-analysis can provide valuable insights by quantitatively synthesizing data from included studies. Consider whether this approach is appropriate given the available data.
10. Strengthen the discussion section by contextualizing your findings within the existing literature and acknowledging the limitations of your study. Providing insights into future research directions can also enrich the discussion.
Overall, addressing these areas will contribute to the robustness and impact of your manuscript, enhancing its value to the scientific community."
paper_title_zh: 儿童残疾运动康复的玩耍与舞蹈治疗：理论、技术和教学方法的综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：本研究旨在分析游戏活动和舞蹈治疗项目在改善残疾人身心状况和提升其福祉方面的有效性。
方法：通过在线搜索引擎（如EBSCOhost、PubMed、《美国舞蹈杂志》）使用“身体残疾”、“音乐舞蹈”或“儿童”等参数进行搜索，并排除2010年之前发表的协议。分析了11项干预协议。这些协议涉及针对14岁以下残疾主体的游戏和舞蹈治疗课程。
结果：研究发现，在游戏活动结束时，肌肉激活度提高，与家庭成员的沟通质量也有所改善。在舞蹈治疗协议方面，报告显示，在残疾儿童中，一般协调性、平衡能力得到改善，不良行为减少。
结论：随着身体表现的提高，受试者的福祉状态也得到提升，这强调了身心之间的紧密联系。对于未来的研究，建议在个体研究中增加参与者的数量，并包括对照组，以便使结果在大规模上具有可推广性。
review_content_zh:
这篇手稿是对游戏和舞蹈治疗对残疾儿童心理生理状况和福祉影响的研究系统综述。在审阅手稿时，发现了一些可以改进的方面，以提升工作的整体质量和影响力：
1. 对开展这一领域系统综述的依据可以阐述得更清晰。讨论此主题的任何先前综述将有助于界定你的贡献。
2. 考虑以PICO格式构建你的研究问题，并为诸如“生活环境”等术语提供明确的操作定义，以增强清晰度和精确性。在研究问题中明确界定你的目标人群。
3. 提供一个全面的搜索策略，以确保文献综述过程的透明度和可重复性。这可以作为一个附录呈现。
4. 遵循PRISMA指南对于系统综述至关重要。确保你的手稿明确引用这些指南，并在其方法和报告中遵循它们。
5. 修订流程图以符合PRISMA标准，提供研究选择过程的清晰视觉表示。
6. 考虑在搜索和数据提取过程中使用两位评审员，以提高可靠性和减少偏差。
7. 评估系统综述中包含的研究质量至关重要。结合质量评估工具并报告其结果将加强你分析的科学性。
8. 增强数据提取过程的全面性，确保准确捕捉所有相关信息。
9. 虽然并非总是可行，但进行荟萃分析可以通过定量综合纳入研究的资料提供有价值的见解。考虑根据现有数据，此方法是否适当。
10. 通过将你的发现置于现有文献的背景下，并承认你研究的局限性来加强讨论部分。提供对未来研究方向的认识也能丰富讨论。
总体而言，解决这些领域将有助于增强你手稿的稳健性和影响力，提升其在科学界的价值。

paper_title: How beavers affect riverine aquatic macroinvertebrates: A review
paper_abstract: Background. As ecosystem engineers, the construction of dams by beavers alters stream habitat physically and biologically, making them a species of interest for habitat restoration. Beaver-created habitat changes affect a wide range of aquatic invertebrate species. However, despite numerous studies of how beaver-induced changes affect aquatic macroinvertebrate assemblages, there has been no evaluation of the consensus of these effects across studies.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Petri Nummi) Richness and other biodiversity Here you could consider mentioning an experimental study from Finland (Nummi 1989) which shows the shift in invertebrate community in a creek section upon a damming imitating beaver, both in the littoral and creek bed as well as showing the change in number of emerging insects. It also demonstrates the substantial flow of organic terrestrial matter to the water in the from tree leaves in the early phase of inundation. While this study is interesting, we are not including instances where beaver dam analogues were installed. There have been very few studies comparing analogue dams to natural beaver dams, and none of them involving aquatic invertebrates (only hydrology, water temp, sediment dynamics, and plants). When there is more data on these beaver simulations, then there will be room to discuss them. However, because simulations are relevant to the restoration potential, we have altered lines 349-352 [in the Research Gaps section] to include analogue dams: “Having numerous examples of how beavers (and humans simulating the effects of beavers, such as with beaver dam analogues) change stream macroinvertebrate communities under a range of conditions will both improve scientific knowledge and aid support for the role of ecosystem engineers more generally in mitigating the freshwater biodiversity crisis.” Maybe here you could mention also the considerable within patch heterogeneity, including deep water behind the dam, flooded swamps, shallow marshes etc., noted by e.g. Bush & Wissinger 2016 and Willby et al. 2018. This also related to the discussion later, in lines 356-363, about “low-gradient streams may be turned into large wetland complexes”. We have altered line 127 to include this level of detail: “... due to increased habitat heterogeneity (e.g. adding various lentic areas to lotic systems, increasing woody debris patches, constructing shallow canals) as well as within-patch heterogeneity (e.g. depths and inundation extent).” l. 150-151. Missing a word? These types of changes will cause shifts IN aquatic macroinvertebrate density and biomass. We have addressed this typo, thanks! Feeding groups In the discussion of the abundance of different feeding groups it could be relevant to shortly deal with effect succession on these; e.g. shredders may be abundant in new beaver ponds where there is plenty of dead coarse organic matter in the form of dying plants, or predatory inverts might be abundant in new flowages because of little competition/predation from fishes. We are greatly interested in this possibility, especially considering there is currently no data to support or describe succession for feeding groups. We added a sentence to address the one publication addressing succession in the community composition response section: “Only one study involved beaver pond successional stages within a stream system, reporting differences in the taxa present within beaver ponds of different ages (Bush et al., 2019).” We have also added your above point about shredders. Research Gaps Ecosystem processes l. 313. Along with birds, maybe bats as a group, or e.g. near threatened species Myotis dasycneme could be mentioned here. Thanks for the suggestion. We have added the threatened component and specified the bat example in the sentence, which now reads: “For example, data on how endangered or threatened riparian species are affected by changes in insect emergence within beaver impoundments can aid in conservation efforts, such as for the Southwestern Willow Flycatcher (Empidonax traillii extimus; Finch & Stoleson, 2000) and European pond bat (Myotis dasycneme; Nummi et al., 2011).” Aquatic insect quantification Here it was interesting to note the high number of predators in spite of the fact that quite much e.g. corers were used which hardly trap many of the very mobile predatory insects. I m not sure if this needs any comment. This is indeed an interesting point! Freshwater biodiversity crisis l. 341. Maybe Bush &Wissinger 2016 could be added as reference here. Done! l. 347-349. Here, in the connection of the mere structural things, you might consider mentioning dead trees, especially trunks fallen to the water. Great point! The Hering 2001 comparative review supports this comment and would work well in this paragraph. We have added the following sentence: “The wood of the dams and other beaver-associated woody debris (e.g. trunks) create highly-structured lentic zones within streams, sometimes greatly amplifying the faunal effects a natural debris pile would have or creating vastly different conditions that support different taxa (Hering et al., 2001).” Please notify us if you have other recommendations for citations about woody debris and structure.
paper_title_zh: 海狸对河流水生大型无脊椎动物的影响：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。作为生态系统工程师，海狸通过建造水坝在物理和生物上改变了溪流生境，使其成为生境恢复中感兴趣的种类。海狸创造的生境变化影响广泛的淡水无脊椎动物种类。然而，尽管已有众多研究探讨了海狸引发的变化如何影响淡水大型无脊椎动物群落，但尚未对这些研究效应的共识进行评估。
review_content_zh:
### 审稿人1（Petri Nummi）的评论

**丰富度及其他生物多样性**

在此处，您可以考虑提及芬兰的一项实验研究（Nummi 1989），该研究展示了在模拟海狸筑坝的情况下，溪流段的无脊椎动物群落在沿岸和溪床上的变化，以及羽化昆虫数量的变化。该研究还展示了在淹没初期，大量有机陆地物质（如树叶）流入水中的情况。尽管这项研究很有趣，但我们并未包括安装海狸坝模拟物的实例。很少有研究比较模拟坝与自然海狸坝，且这些研究均未涉及水生无脊椎动物（仅涉及水文学、水温、沉积物动态和植物）。当有更多关于这些海狸模拟的数据时，再进行讨论。然而，由于模拟与恢复潜力相关，我们已修改第349-352行（研究空白部分），以包括模拟坝：“拥有众多实例，展示海狸（以及人类模拟海狸效应，例如使用海狸坝模拟物）在不同条件下如何改变溪流大型无脊椎动物群落，将既提升科学知识，又支持生态系统工程师在缓解淡水生物多样性危机中的更广泛角色。”也许在此处，您还可以提及斑块内显著的异质性，包括坝后深水区、淹没的沼泽、浅滩等，如Bush & Wissinger 2016和Willby et al. 2018所指出的。这也与后文第356-363行关于“低梯度溪流可能转变为大型湿地复合体”的讨论相关。我们已修改第127行，以包括这一细节：“...由于栖息地异质性的增加（例如，在流动系统中增加各种静水区域，增加木质残骸斑块，构建浅水渠道）以及斑块内异质性（例如，深度和淹没范围）。”

**第150-151行。缺少一个词？**

这类变化将导致水生大型无脊椎动物密度和生物量的变化。我们已更正此错别字，谢谢！

**食性群体**

在讨论不同食性群体丰度时，简要处理演替对这些群体的影响可能相关；例如，在新海狸池塘中，由于有大量死亡的粗有机物质（如枯死植物），撕食者可能很丰富；或者在新形成的滞流区，由于鱼类竞争/捕食较少，捕食性无脊椎动物可能很丰富。我们对此可能性非常感兴趣，尤其是考虑到目前尚无数据支持或描述食性群体的演替。我们在群落组成响应部分添加了一句话，以提及唯一一篇涉及演替的研究：“只有一项研究涉及溪流系统中海狸池塘的演替阶段，报告了不同年龄海狸池塘中存在的类群差异（Bush et al., 2019）。”我们还添加了您关于撕食者的观点。

**研究空白**

**生态系统过程**

第313行。除了鸟类，也许可以提及蝙蝠作为一个群体，或者例如近危物种Myotis dasycneme。感谢您的建议。我们已添加受威胁成分，并在句子中具体说明了蝙蝠示例，现在该句 reads：“例如，关于受威胁或濒危河岸物种如何受海狸围堰内昆虫羽化变化影响的数据，可以有助于保护工作，如针对西南柳莺（Empidonax traillii extimus; Finch & Stoleson, 2000）和欧洲池蝠（Myotis dasycneme; Nummi et al., 2011）。”

**水生昆虫量化**

在此处注意到捕食者数量很高，尽管使用了相当多的例如钻芯采样器，这些采样器很难捕获许多非常活动的捕食性昆虫。我不确定这是否需要评论。这确实是一个有趣的点！

**淡水生物多样性危机**

第341行。也许可以添加Bush & Wissinger 2016作为参考文献。已添加！

第347-349行。在此处，联系到纯粹的结构性事物，您可以考虑提及死树，尤其是倒在水中的树干。很好的观点！Hering 2001的比较综述支持这一评论，并且很适合在此段落中使用。我们已添加以下句子：“海狸坝的木材和其他与海狸相关的木质残骸（例如树干）在溪流中创造了高度结构化的静水区域，有时极大地放大了天然残骸堆的动物效应，或创造了截然不同的条件，支持不同的类群（Hering et al., 2001）。”如果您有关于木质残骸和结构的其他引用建议，请告知我们。
