paper_title: How to Reuse and Compose Knowledge for a Lifetime of Tasks: A Survey on Continual Learning and Functional Composition
paper_abstract: A major goal of artificial intelligence (AI) is to create an agent capable of acquiring a general understanding of the world. Such an agent would require the ability to continually accumulate and build upon its knowledge as it encounters new experiences. Lifelong or continual learning addresses this setting, whereby an agent faces a continual stream of problems and must strive to capture the knowledge necessary for solving each new task it encounters. If the agent is capable of accumulating knowledge in some form of compositional representation, it could then selectively reuse and combine relevant pieces of knowledge to construct novel solutions. Despite the intuitive appeal of this simple idea, the literatures on lifelong learning and compositional learning have proceeded largely separately. In an effort to promote developments that bridge between the two fields, this article surveys their respective research landscapes and discusses existing and future connections between them.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper is a survey of recent works (focussing mainly on the most recent five years) of life-long learning and continual learning, including all forms of machine learning where these are relevant - (un)supervised and reinforcement learning. The paper provides a careful categorization of these methods - in terms of the framing such as task-based and task agnostic, in terms of algortihmic and data approach, and to some extent (esp. in the RL section) in terms of how an application domain becomes decomposed, etc. To the extent that this is mainly a survey of past work, the innovation is in the interpretation of the methods in order to extract the shared structures.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
The primary strength of this paper is that it is suitably comprehensive, as a survey should be, in covering the the relevant literature. I like the following elements: - useful categorization in terms of types of machine learning methods, types of algorithmic approach and data assumptions, task decomposition, etc. - This is chiefly but not exclusively in terms of the six axes of variation, which are well chosen - the writing is clear and the use of visualizations is helpful in bringing out and supporting the structures being addressed - to the best of my knowledge the coverage of the papers is also adequate The primary weaknesses of this paper are as follows: - The different sections addressing lifelong and compositional learning, supervised and reinforcement learning, etc. are indeed distinct from each other. While within each section, there is an appropriate form of analysis and categorization, I do not get a higher level understanding of principles that cut across the top level categories. So, for instance, if one asks how the compositional templates (such as chaining or aggregation, or even graphs) relate to, say, similar questions in the RL section then the paper does not quite explain this. Of course, there are indeed connections, e.g. there is graph structuring in both, but both the structuring of the sections and the ways of writing do not expose any such connections. This is important because the introduction explicitly starts by making the case for how the many different types of learning - lifelong, continual and compositional, multi-task, etc. are all essentially related and should be studied as such - A second major point is that the focus on just papers from 2017 seems a bit odd for subject matter that has indeed been thought about since quite a bit earlier. To be fair to the authors, they do mention key early works (such as Thrun) and the recent explosion of ML literature would make it hard to be entirely comprehensive over a much longer period. However, this has the effect that many other forms of decomposition of tasks and analysis of stucture are left out unless featured in the deep learning literature of the recent couple of years - There is a distinct lack of consideration of methods that approach representations in other ways, e.g. there is not much discussion of things like options or sub-task discovery in the RL setting, neuro-symbolic representations and algorithms that make use of symbolic structuring or reasoning in any way, etc. - There is a distinct lack of specific domain examples - from vision, language and so on, and much of the discussion is in terms of machine learning models alone. This makes the paper rather dry. That said, the examples in the RL section are quite useful (e.g. fig 8) and more such examples in the earlier sections would have been very welcome

**Requested Changes:**
Having said that this is a well written and clear paper that makes a timely contribution, the survey would be stronger if the authors find ways to address weaknesses outlined in the previous section. I will not reiterate the list here, but each weakness might require further thought about how best to organise and explain the works.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
This is a survey paper on existing work, so as such this paper does not raise any new concerns about broader impact. The paper does a nice job of synthesizing the work from the past five years and of explaining how different strands of work relate to each other.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to review by 4YsP: 1. **Sections are distinct/disjoint:** This is an excellent point to raise. With such a broad-reaching survey, there were certainly major efforts employed towards structuring the article in a way the exposed the connections across "top level categories". In particular, the main thread that we used to examine those connections was the six-axis categorization of Figure 4. Note that we applied the categorization to _all_ the major references, as summarized in the Appendix. We did attempt to highlight these interconnections in text. For example, we mention how several RL approaches relate to the compositional structures in terms of aggregation/chaining/graph. However, we do recognize that these cross-cutting discussions could be better highlighted and explained, which we will address in the revised manuscript per your suggestion. 2. **Chronological scope:** As stated in Section 1.1, our survey indeed focuses on works published on 2017 or later. While there is certainly relevant earlier literature, attempting to cover _all_ relevant literature from the past would unfortunately be intractable. In particular, earlier _lifelong learning_ literature is quite sparse, and we did include the most relevant references we know of from those earlier years, including Sebastian Thrun's seminal work (as the reviewer rightly points out) and Ruvolo et al.'s ELLA paper. Earlier _compositional learning_ literature is on the contrary quite substantial and broad. Consequently, we focused on the compositional works that have been adapted to the deep learning landscape. While there is of course opportunity to investigate alternative approaches that _haven't_ been adapted to deep learning, we contend that it falls outside of the scope of this survey to find those connections, which would each likely constitute an algorithmic paper on its own right. That being said, if the reviewer has specific suggestions for literature that we have missed that would aid in providing context or insight in the scope of the submission, we would be more than glad to incorporate it. 3. **Alternative compositional representations:** - Options/sub-task decomposition in RL. Please note that the focus of our survey is on _functional_ composition, and as such option discovery is only described for context and _not as a standalone survey of hierarchical RL_. We had stated this briefly towards the bottom of page 24 ("With this in mind, note that the discussion of works on skill discovery, which is a vast literature on its own, is by no means comprehensive") and have will expand the disclaimer and point to relevant surveys in that space. - Neuro-symbolic / reasoning approaches. This is an excellent point. Our original submission included multiple references from symbolic programming and other forms of reasoning-based approaches, but we had not explicitly stated this distinction. We will add a separate paragraph highlighting this point. 4. **Examples from vision, language, and others:** Thank you for pointing this out. We will add examples in earlier sections, starting from the introduction, that we can carry throughout in similar vein to the RL section.
paper_title_zh: 如何终身复用与组合知识：持续学习与功能组合综述
paper_abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）的主要目标之一是创建一个能够获得对世界普遍理解的智能体。这样的智能体需要具备在不断遇到新经验时持续积累和构建知识的能力。终身学习或持续学习针对的是这种情境，即智能体面临持续不断的问题流，必须努力捕捉解决每个新任务所需的知识。如果智能体能够以某种组合表示形式积累知识，那么它就可以有选择地重用和组合相关知识片段，以构建新颖的解决方案。尽管这个简单想法直观上很有吸引力，但关于终身学习和组合学习的文献在很大程度上是独立发展的。为了促进这两个领域之间的桥梁建设，本文综述了它们各自的研究现状，并讨论了它们之间现有的和未来的联系。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了近年来（主要集中在前五年）的终身学习和持续学习研究，涵盖了所有相关形式的机器学习——包括（非）监督学习和强化学习。文章对这些方法进行了细致的分类——从框架角度，如基于任务和任务无关；从算法和数据方法角度；以及在一定程度上（特别是在强化学习部分）从应用领域如何分解等角度。鉴于本文主要是一篇综述性文章，其创新之处在于对方法的解读，以提取共享结构。

**优点和缺点：**
本文的主要优点在于其作为综述文章应有的全面性，涵盖了相关文献。我喜欢以下元素：- 按机器学习方法类型、算法方法类型和数据假设、任务分解等进行的有用分类。- 这主要但不完全基于六个变异轴，这些轴选择得当。- 文章清晰，可视化工具的使用有助于突出和支持所讨论的结构。- 据我所知，文献覆盖面也足够。本文的主要缺点如下：- 关于终身学习和组合学习、监督学习和强化学习等不同部分确实彼此独立。尽管在每个部分内都有适当的形式分析和分类，但我未能获得跨越顶层类别的原则性理解。例如，如果有人问组合模板（如链式或聚合，甚至图结构）与强化学习部分中的类似问题有何关联，文章并未完全解释这一点。当然，确实存在关联，例如两者都有图结构，但部分结构和写作方式并未揭示这些关联。这一点很重要，因为引言部分明确指出，多种不同类型的学习——终身学习、持续学习和组合学习、多任务学习等——本质上都是相关的，应作为整体进行研究。- 第二个主要问题是，仅关注2017年以来的论文，对于早已被思考的主题而言显得有些奇怪。公平地说，作者确实提到了早期关键工作（如Thrun），而近年来机器学习文献的爆炸性增长使得全面覆盖更长时间段变得困难。然而，这导致许多其他任务分解和分析结构的形式被忽略，除非它们出现在近几年的深度学习文献中。- 明显缺乏对其他表示方法的考虑，例如在强化学习环境中对选项或子任务发现的讨论不多，神经符号表示和利用符号结构或推理的算法等。- 明显缺乏具体领域示例——如视觉、语言等，大部分讨论仅限于机器学习模型本身。这使得文章较为枯燥。尽管如此，强化学习部分的示例非常有用（如图8），早期部分若有更多此类示例将非常受欢迎。

**请求的修改：**
尽管这是一篇写得很好且清晰的论文，及时贡献了相关内容，但如果作者能找到解决前述部分所列缺点的方法，综述将更加强大。在此不再赘述列表，但每个缺点可能都需要进一步思考如何最佳组织和解释这些工作。

**更广泛影响关切：**
这是一篇关于现有工作的综述文章，因此本身并未引发任何新的更广泛影响关切。文章很好地综合了过去五年的工作，并解释了不同线索工作之间的关联。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳评论：**
对4YsP评审的回应：1. **部分独立/分离：** 这是一个极好的观点。对于如此广泛覆盖的综述，确实投入了大量努力来构建文章结构，以揭示“顶层类别”之间的联系。特别是，我们用来检查这些联系的主要线索是图4中的六轴分类。请注意，我们将该分类应用于所有主要参考文献，如附录所总结。我们确实试图在文本中突出这些相互联系。例如，我们提到几种强化学习方法如何与组合结构中的聚合/链式/图相关联。然而，我们确实认识到这些跨领域的讨论可以更好地突出和解释，我们将在修订稿中按照您的建议进行处理。2. **时间范围：** 如第1.1节所述，我们的综述确实聚焦于2017年或之后发表的工作。尽管确实存在相关的早期文献，但试图覆盖过去所有相关文献将不幸变得不可行。特别是，早期的终身学习文献相当稀少，我们确实包括了我们所知的那些早期年份中最相关的参考文献，包括Sebastian Thrun的开创性工作（正如评审所指出的）和Ruvolo等人的ELLA论文。早期的组合学习文献相反非常丰富和广泛。因此，我们专注于适应深度学习格局的组合工作。尽管当然有机会研究尚未适应深度学习的替代方法，但我们认为这超出了本综述的范围，每个都可能构成一篇独立的算法论文。话虽如此，如果评审有具体建议的我们遗漏的文献，能够在本投稿范围内提供背景或洞见，我们将非常乐意纳入。3. **替代组合表示：** - 强化学习中的选项/子任务分解。请注意，我们综述的重点是功能组合，因此选项发现仅用于提供背景，而非作为层次强化学习的独立综述。我们在第24页底部简要提到这一点（“请注意，对技能发现工作的讨论，本身就是一个庞大的文献领域，绝非全面”）并将扩展免责声明并指向该领域的相关综述。- 神经符号/推理方法。这是一个极好的观点。我们的原始投稿包括多个来自符号编程和其他基于推理方法的参考文献，但我们并未明确指出这一区别。我们将添加一个单独段落突出这一点。4. **视觉、语言等领域的示例：** 感谢指出这一点。我们将在早期部分，从引言开始添加示例，并以类似强化学习部分的方式贯穿全文。

paper_title: How beavers affect riverine aquatic macroinvertebrates: A review
paper_abstract: Background. As ecosystem engineers, the construction of dams by beavers alters stream habitat physically and biologically, making them a species of interest for habitat restoration. Beaver-created habitat changes affect a wide range of aquatic invertebrate species. However, despite numerous studies of how beaver-induced changes affect aquatic macroinvertebrate assemblages, there has been no evaluation of the consensus of these effects across studies.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Title: Instead of "A synthesis of global data", just "A review" (it is more adequate). Thanks for this suggestion, it was something we debated and changed last-minute. We have reverted to ‘a review.’ Abstract: Headings in a structured abstract would increase its clarity. Please remember, that headings in structured abstracts (i.e., Background. Methodology. Results. Conclusions) should be bold and followed by a period. We agree with this suggestion. We originally debated this also and removed the headers, but have now replaced them with the correct formatting. Introduction: In general, the Introduction doesn’t really summarise the whole manuscript. I would recommend that the authors re-design to succinctly describe in more detail the work that they set out to do. Some important references are missing. Thank you for this comment. We feel that the introduction should provide a foundation for the paper, not a summary (that is the role of the abstract). In an effort to increase clarity of the introduction and better describe the direction of our review, we have revised the introduction in the following ways: • Reorganized information order within paragraphs • Deleted unnecessary sentences • Re-worked the objectives as per the subsequent comment about lines 81-85 We applied these changes to the abstract as well. Line 46-47. ‘...becoming increasingly interested in how beaver engineering activities alter stream ecosystems within a modern landscape context’ - see Brazier et al., 2021 Thank you for pointing us to Brazier et al. 2021. We have included it as a citation in this sentence, but did the reviewer wish for us to expand on this point using that citation? Line 48. ‘…can improve salmonid fish habitat’ - see also Kukuła & Bylak, 2011 We have altered this sentence to include the works of Kukuła & Bylak and include all fish (not just salmonids). Line 69. ‘…can support different aquatic macroinvertebrate taxa’ – see also Bylak et al., 2021 - support for endangered mussels. Thank you for pointing us to this important study. We have altered the sentence to include mussels by changing ‘macroinvertebrates’ to ‘invertebrates’ and citing the recommended paper. Research aims. Line 81-85 - Point 1 and 2: These are the objectives of the research paper, not the review paper. My recommendation is to revise/clarify the research questions. For example, the second research question presented is: “Determine if the aquatic macroinvertebrate communities differ in composition between beaver ponds and lotic stream segments” I could not see how this research questions was addressed by the analyses conducted. Three research questions stand out (based on the data collected): (1) What is the state of knowledge in understanding of taxonomic and functional changes in benthic macroinvertebrate assemblages of the beaver-altered streams? How has the field of knowledge evolved over time? (2) Which types of associations between beaver activity and aquatic invertebrate taxa have been described to date? What are the most relevant trends or patterns? (3) Knowledge gaps (which are good as they are). Please also modify the Abstract section accordingly. If we understand correctly, the objection to the research aims is that they are worded in a way that suggests that we did this research instead of collating existing research. We have reworded the first two objectives into one multi-pronged objective: 1. Determine if the current literature suggests there are generalizable differences in aquatic macroinvertebrate ◦ taxa richness ◦ density ◦ biomass ◦ functional feeding groups between beaver ponds and nearby lotic stream segments and describe these differences. These changes are reflected in the abstract. RICHNESS AND OTHER ... Line 139 – ‘a metacommunity effect’ – metacommunities in the beaver dam-and-pond complexes have been previously described in detail in fish populations - see Bylak & Kukuła, 2018. Thank you for bringing this metacommunity work to our attention. While it is important, we do not want to add a tangent to line 139 that will detract focus from invertebrate evidence. Instead, we have included this citation in line 48. INVERTEBRATES OF BEAVER-ALTERED LAKES AND WETLANDS Line 383-397 - Is this whole paragraph really needed ??? (see - Title and Survey methodology) Thanks for this question. We wanted to be cognizant of the other beaver-influenced aquatic macroinvertebrate work that has occurred outside of streams, especially considering this is a review. While we couldn’t include those studies in our analysis, we felt they were still relevant, especially because the same research gaps that occur in streams likely occur in wetlands. References. Following, you will find some new related references which should be added to literature set: -Brazier et al. 2021. Beaver: Nature's ecosystem engineers. doi: 10.1002/wat2.1494 -Bylak et al., 2021. Potential use of beaver Castor fiber L., 1758 dams by the thick-shelled river mussel Unio crassus Philipsson, 1788. doi:10.1080/13235818.2019.1664371 -Bylak & Kukuła, 2018. Living with an engineer: Fish metacommunities in dynamic patchy environments. doi:10.1071/MF17255 -Kukuła & Bylak, 2011. Ichthyofauna of a mountain stream dammed by beaver. doi: 10.2478/v10086-010-0004-1 Thank you for these. We have ensured they are all cited. Figures. A flowchart should be added to the article to show the research methodology. While a flowchart would certainly be helpful, we feel it is not necessary and may distract readers from the trends we present. Please also increase the font size of numbers in Figure 1. Great suggestion, we have altered the figure accordingly.
paper_title_zh: 海狸如何影响河流水生大型无脊椎动物：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。作为生态系统工程师，海狸通过建造水坝在物理和生物上改变了溪流生境，使其成为生境恢复中感兴趣的种类。海狸创造的生境变化影响了一系列的水生无脊椎动物种类。然而，尽管已有众多研究探讨了海狸引发的变化如何影响水生大型无脊椎动物群落，但尚未对这些研究中的影响共识进行评估。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2（匿名）标题：建议将“全球数据的综合”改为“综述”（更为恰当）。感谢这一建议，这是我们辩论后最后一刻更改的内容。我们已经改回为“综述”。摘要：结构化摘要中的标题能增加其清晰度。请记住，结构化摘要中的标题（即背景、方法、结果、结论）应加粗并后接句点。我们同意这一建议。我们最初也对此进行过辩论，并移除了标题，但现在已按照正确格式重新添加。引言：总体而言，引言并未真正总结整篇手稿。建议作者重新设计，更详细地简洁描述他们计划进行的工作。一些重要的参考文献缺失。感谢这一评论。我们认为引言应为论文提供基础，而非总结（那是摘要的作用）。为了增加引言的清晰度并更好地描述我们综述的方向，我们已对引言进行如下修订：• 重新组织段落内的信息顺序• 删除不必要的句子• 根据后续关于第81-85行的评论重新撰写目标我们也将这些更改应用于摘要。第46-47行：“……越来越关注海狸工程活动如何在现代景观背景下改变溪流生态系统”——参见Brazier等人，2021年感谢指出Brazier等人2021年的研究。我们已将其作为引用添加到该句中，但审稿人是否希望我们利用该引用进一步展开这一点？第48行：“……可以改善鲑科鱼类栖息地”——也参见Kukuła & Bylak，2011年我们已修改该句，纳入Kukuła & Bylak的研究，并将范围扩展到所有鱼类（不仅限于鲑科鱼类）。第69行：“……可以支持不同的水生大型无脊椎动物类群”——也参见Bylak等人，2021年——对濒危贻贝的支持。感谢指出这一重要研究。我们已修改该句，将“大型无脊椎动物”改为“无脊椎动物”，并引用了推荐的论文。研究目标。第81-85行——点1和点2：这些是研究论文的目标，而非综述论文的目标。建议修订/澄清研究问题。例如，提出的第二个研究问题是：“确定水生大型无脊椎动物群落在海狸池塘和河流段之间的组成是否存在差异”我无法看出这一研究问题是如何通过所进行的分析来解决的。基于收集的数据，三个研究问题显得突出：（1）对海狸改造溪流中底栖大型无脊椎动物类群的分类和功能变化的了解现状如何？知识领域是如何随时间演变的？（2）迄今为止已描述的海狸活动与水生无脊椎动物类群之间的关联类型有哪些？最相关的趋势或模式是什么？（3）知识空白（目前表述良好）。请相应修改摘要部分。如果我们理解正确，对研究目标的异议在于其措辞方式暗示我们进行了这项研究，而非汇总现有研究。我们将前两个目标重新措辞为一个多方面的目标：1. 确定当前文献是否表明海狸池塘和附近河流段之间在水生无脊椎动物◦ 类群丰富度◦ 密度◦ 生物量◦ 功能摄食群方面存在可概括的差异，并描述这些差异。这些更改在摘要中有所体现。丰富度及其他……第139行——“一个群落效应”——在海狸坝和池塘复合体中的群落效应已在鱼类种群中详细描述——参见Bylak & Kukuła，2018年。感谢指出这一群落效应研究。尽管其很重要，但我们不希望在139行添加会分散对无脊椎动物证据关注的旁支。相反，我们已在第48行中引用了该文献。海狸改造湖泊和湿地的无脊椎动物第383-397行——这一整段真的必要吗？（参见——标题和调查方法）感谢这一问题。我们希望注意到在溪流之外发生的其他受海狸影响的水生大型无脊椎动物研究，特别是考虑到这是一篇综述。尽管我们无法将这些研究纳入我们的分析，但我们认为它们仍然相关，尤其是因为在溪流中出现的同一研究空白很可能也出现在湿地上。参考文献。以下是一些新的相关参考文献，应添加到文献集中：-Brazier等人，2021年。海狸：自然的生态系统工程师。doi: 10.1002/wat2.1494-Bylak等人，2021年。海狸Castor fiber L.，1758坝对厚壳河蚌Unio crassus Philipsson，1788的潜在利用。doi:10.1080/13235818.2019.1664371-Bylak & Kukuła，2018年。与工程师共存：动态斑块环境中的鱼类群落。doi:10.1071/MF17255-Kukuła & Bylak，2011年。受海狸筑坝的山溪鱼类。doi: 10.2478/v10086-010-0004-1感谢这些文献。我们已确保全部引用。图表。文章中应添加流程图以展示研究方法。尽管流程图确实会有所帮助，但我们认为其并非必要，且可能会分散读者对我们呈现趋势的注意力。请也将图1中的数字字体大小增大。非常好的建议，我们已相应修改图表。

paper_title: Investigating colistin drug resistance: The role of high-throughput sequencing and bioinformatics
paper_abstract: Bacterial infections involving antibiotic-resistant gram-negative bacteria continue to increase and represent a major global public health concern. Resistance to antibiotics in these bacteria is mediated by chromosomal and/or acquired resistance mechanisms, these give rise to multi-drug resistant (MDR), extensive-drug resistant (XDR) or pan-drug resistant (PDR) bacterial strains. Most recently, plasmid-mediated resistance to colistin, an antibiotic that had been set apart as the last resort antibiotic in the treatment of infections involving MDR, XDR and PDR gram-negative bacteria has been reported. Plasmid-mediated colistin resistant gram-negative bacteria have been described to be PDR, implying a state devoid of alternative antibiotic therapeutic options. This review concisely describes the evolution of antibiotic resistance to plasmid-mediated colistin resistance and discusses the potential role of high-throughput sequencing technologies, genomics, and bioinformatics towards improving antibiotic resistance surveillance, the search for novel drug targets and precision antibiotic therapy focused at combating colistin resistance, and antibiotic resistance as a whole.
review_content:
In this review, the authors describe the biology behind the evolution of antimicrobial resistance, with a focus on the resistance against colistin, one of the "last-resort" antibiotics. An alarming development was reported in 2016, where a form of resistance was discovered that could be readily transferred to other bacteria. Researchers first discovered this resistance in China, quickly followed by findings of similar resistance patterns in other countries. These discoveries relied in part on the use of high throughput sequencing.

The review is very short and it is understandable that, within these four pages, the authors can't expand these themes in too many details. Still, I have a few minor and a few major comments about the current version of the article.

Minor comments:
  * The flow of the different sections of the review is a bit off in my opinion:
a) The section "Colistin resistance trends in Africa" describes the observed burden of colistin resistance in this continent
b) the section "Evolution to plasmid mediated colistin resistance …" describes the biology and mechanism of colistin resistance, from chromosomal to plasmid-mediated.
c) the section "Pan-drug resistance and characteristics…" describes, generally, the phenomena that gives rise to AMR.
It would make more sense, to me, to rework these sections in the order c), b) then a).
  * The sentence "Furthermore, phenomena such as genome plasticity and pan genomes that have the ability to influence bacterial resistome can only effectively be investigated using HTS and bioinformatics analyses." needs to be better explained and referenced. Also, pan genomes are not, in my opinion, "phenomena".
  * The section "Evolution to plasmid mediated colistin resistance..." explains the mechanisms of action of chromosome-mediated resistance, then simply lists the genes involved in plasmid-mediated resistance, with no indication about modes of action of these genes, and whether it is different from the ones described previously.
  * I noticed at least one incomplete sentence ("Plasmid transfer of the colistin resistance mobile genes, mcr-1, mcr-2, and also mcr-3.")
Major comments:
  * The section on Africa needs to be reworked. First, the Figure says "Adapted from Xavier et al. under a CC-BY 4.0 license". I don't know about the license and rights, but I didn't notice any difference with the original figure, so a more appropriate phrasing would be "Reproduced from…" (or, if I missed it, a better indication on how it was adapted).
  * Second, I don't see how the figure supports the statement "The limited available literature from African settings has reported the mcr-1 gene mediated colistin resistance to be most prevalent in Africa, largely in South Africa, and this covers the largest portion of Africa according to the global map"; according to the figure, detection in Africa does not look more prevalent compared to other continents.
  * Finally, the text mentions detection in South Africa, Algeria, Rwanda and Uganda, while the maps shows South Africa, Algeria, Tunisia and Egypt.
  * The last section, "The role of high-throughput sequencing …" is very generic, and barely addresses how this applied to colistin resistance, as the tile of the review suggests. It contain very general statements about the possibilities of HTS for AMR detection, that have been reviewed in more details in a few recent publications. The authors should take the opportunity of assessing how HTS led to the rapid detection of the spread of the newly identified colistin resistance risk, in a way that was not possible before. Relevant studies should include, among others, the following:
Hasman, H., Hammerum, A.M., Hansen, F., Hendriksen, R.S., Olesen, B., Agersø, Y.,
Zankari, E., Leekitcharoenphon, P., Stegger, M., Kaas, R.S., et al. (2015). Detection of
mcr-1 encoding plasmid-mediated colistin-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from human
bloodstream infection and imported chicken meat1.
Kluytmans–van den Bergh, M.F., Huizinga, P., M. J. Bonten, M. Bos, K. De Bruyne, A. W. Friedrich, J. W. Rossen, P. H. Savelkoul, and J. A. Kluytmans. (2009) Presence of mcr-1-positive Enterobacteriaceae in retail chicken meat but not in humans in the Netherlands since 20092.
Yu, C. Y., Ang, G. Y., Chong, T. M., Chin, P. S., Ngeow, Y. F., Yin, W. F., & Chan, K. G. (2016). Complete genome sequencing revealed novel genetic contexts of the mcr-1 gene in Escherichia coli strains3.
paper_title_zh: 调查粘菌素耐药性：高通量测序与生物信息学的角色
paper_abstract_zh: 涉及抗生素耐药性革兰氏阴性菌的细菌感染持续增加，成为全球公共卫生的主要关切。这些细菌对抗生素的耐药性通过染色体和/或获得的耐药机制介导，导致出现多重耐药（MDR）、广泛耐药（XDR）或泛耐药（PDR）的菌株。最近，有报道称质粒介导的耐药性对粘菌素产生了耐药，而粘菌素曾被作为治疗涉及MDR、XDR和PDR革兰氏阴性菌感染的最后一道防线抗生素。质粒介导的粘菌素耐药革兰氏阴性菌被描述为PDR，意味着处于无其他抗生素治疗选择的状态。本文综述了抗生素耐药性向质粒介导的粘菌素耐药性演变的历程，并讨论了高通量测序技术、基因组学和生物信息学在改善抗生素耐药性监测、寻找新型药物靶标以及针对粘菌素耐药性和整体抗生素耐药性的精准抗生素治疗中的潜在作用。
review_content_zh:
在这篇综述中，作者描述了抗菌药物耐药性演化的生物学背景，重点关注了对粘菌素这一“最后防线”抗生素的耐药性。2016年报道了一项令人担忧的发展，发现了一种可以轻易传播给其他细菌的耐药形式。研究人员首先在中国发现了这种耐药性，随后在其他国家也发现了类似的耐药模式。这些发现部分依赖于高通量测序技术的使用。

这篇综述非常简短，可以理解的是，在这四页的篇幅内，作者无法过多地展开这些主题。尽管如此，我对当前版本的文章有一些小意见和一些大意见。

小意见：
* 在我看来，综述不同部分的流畅性有些问题：
a) “非洲粘菌素耐药趋势”部分描述了非洲大陆观察到的粘菌素耐药负担
b) “向质粒介导的粘菌素耐药的演化…”部分描述了粘菌素耐药的生物学和机制，从染色体介导到质粒介导
c) “泛耐药及其特征…”部分一般性地描述了导致抗菌药物耐药性（AMR）的现象
在我看来，将这些部分按c)、b)然后a)的顺序重新编排会更合理。
* 句子“此外，基因组可塑性和泛基因组等能够影响细菌耐药组的现象，只能通过高通量测序（HTS）和生物信息学分析有效地进行研究。”需要更好的解释和引用。此外，泛基因组在我看来并不是“现象”。
* “向质粒介导的粘菌素耐药的演化…”部分解释了染色体介导耐药的作用机制，然后简单地列出了涉及质粒介导耐药的基因，没有说明这些基因的作用模式，以及它们是否与之前描述的不同。
* 我注意到至少有一个不完整的句子（“粘菌素耐药移动基因mcr-1、mcr-2以及mcr-3的质粒转移。”）

大意见：
* 关于非洲的部分需要重写。首先，图注说“改编自Xavier等人，根据CC-BY 4.0许可”。我不了解该许可和权利，但我没有注意到原图有任何不同，所以更合适的措辞应该是“复制自…”（或者，如果我有疏忽，应有更好的说明是如何改编的）。
* 其次，我不明白这幅图如何支持“非洲有限的可文献表明，mcr-1基因介导的粘菌素耐药在非洲最为普遍，主要在南非，且根据全球地图，这覆盖了非洲的最大部分”这一说法；根据图示，非洲的检测并不比其他大陆更普遍。
* 最后，文本中提到在南非、阿尔及利亚、卢旺达和乌干达的检测，而地图显示的是南非、阿尔及利亚、突尼斯和埃及。
* 最后一部分“高通量测序的作用…”非常泛泛，几乎没有涉及如何应用于粘菌素耐药性，这与综述的标题不符。它包含了一些关于HTS用于AMR检测可能性的非常一般性的陈述，这些已经在一些最近的出版物中详细综述过了。作者应该抓住机会评估HTS如何导致新识别的粘菌素耐药风险的快速检测，这在以前是不可能的。相关研究应包括但不限于以下几项：
Hasman, H., Hammerum, A.M., Hansen, F., Hendriksen, R.S., Olesen, B., Agersø, Y., Zankari, E., Leekitcharoenphon, P., Stegger, M., Kaas, R.S., et al. (2015). Detection of mcr-1 encoding plasmid-mediated colistin-resistant Escherichia coli isolates from human bloodstream infection and imported chicken meat1.
Kluytmans–van den Bergh, M.F., Huizinga, P., M. J. Bonten, M. Bos, K. De Bruyne, A. W. Friedrich, J. W. Rossen, P. H. Savelkoul, and J. A. Kluytmans. (2009) Presence of mcr-1-positive Enterobacteriaceae in retail chicken meat but not in humans in the Netherlands since 20092.

paper_title: Tourette syndrome research highlights from 2021
paper_abstract: We summarize selected research reports from 2021 relevant to Tourette syndrome that the authors consider most important or interesting. The authors welcome article suggestions and thoughtful feedback from readers.
review_content:
The authors provide a good overview of the current literature. This annual summary of the current scientific literature is an important milestone for people active in Tourette's research and treatment to keep themselves informed.

The selection of literature is presented clearly and understandably. Perhaps the categories into which the selected literature is placed could also be presented in an overview at the beginning. Such a list would make reading even more straightforward. The authors mention that they have also integrated congress contributions. A list of the selected congresses would be desirable.

There is an interesting graph at the end of the review about the increasing number of annual publications in the field. Probably the number of publications is still too small; if not, a map from which countries how many publications come, and from which countries how many publications are taken into account (e.g., by the size and color of dots on a map) would be an interesting, but not necessary information for the publication.

The present manuscript is a very successful work that merits indexing in this form.
paper_title_zh: 2021年图雷特综合征研究亮点
paper_abstract_zh: 我们总结了2021年与图雷特综合症相关的研究报告，这些报告是作者认为最重要或最有趣的。作者欢迎读者提出文章建议和深思熟虑的反馈。
review_content_zh:
作者对当前文献进行了良好的概述。这份对当前科学文献的年度总结，对于活跃在图雷特综合症研究和治疗领域的人们来说，是一个重要的里程碑，有助于他们保持信息更新。

文献的选择清晰易懂地呈现出来。或许，被选文献所归入的类别也可以在开头部分以概览形式呈现。这样的列表会使阅读更加直接明了。作者提到他们也整合了会议贡献内容。一份所选会议的列表将是令人期待的。

在综述末尾有一张关于该领域年度出版物数量增加的有趣图表。可能出版物的数量仍然偏少；如果不是这样，一张显示各国出版物数量以及各国被考虑的出版物数量（例如，通过地图上点的尺寸和颜色）的地图，将是一个有趣但非必要的信息补充。

当前手稿是一项非常成功的工作，值得以这种形式进行索引。

paper_title: Big data clustering techniques based on Spark: a literature review
paper_abstract: A popular unsupervised learning method, known as clustering, is extensively used in data mining, machine learning and pattern recognition. The procedure involves grouping of single and distinct points in a group in such a way that they are either similar to each other or dissimilar to points of other clusters. Traditional clustering methods are greatly challenged by the recent massive growth of data. Therefore, several research works proposed novel designs for clustering methods that leverage the benefits of Big Data platforms, such as Apache Spark, which is designed for fast and distributed massive data processing. However, Spark-based clustering research is still in its early days. In this systematic survey, we investigate the existing Spark-based clustering methods in terms of their support to the characteristics Big Data. Moreover, we propose a new taxonomy for the Spark-based clustering methods. . To the best of our knowledge, no survey has been conducted on Spark-based clustering of Big Data. Therefore, this survey aims to present a comprehensive summary of the previous studies in the field of Big Data clustering using Apache Spark during the span of 2010-2020. This survey also highlights the new research directions in the field of clustering massive data.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Anonymous) Basic reporting Comment#1. The English Language should be improved to avoid typographical errors. Some examples of typographical errors include lines 69, 143, 181, 232, 257, 325, 340, 447, 470 and 539. Reply to Comment#1: We have revised the paper and all typographical errors were corrected. Comment#2. The introduction is detailed and well referenced. Reply to Comment#2: Thank you. Comment#3. The structure of the paper needs improvement. For instance, the abstract did not provide a summary of what the systematic review is all about. There was too many background information in the abstract. The abstract is expected to give a little background briefly, then the problem, methods, results, and significance. Besides, I think the background section should come before the literature review section. Moreover, the discussion section should deliberate on the findings/results, but the authors used this section for another literature review or related work. Reply to Comment#3: • We have re-written the abstract to reduce the background information and emphasize the contribution of this systematic survey. • We moved the Background section before the literature as per the reviewer suggestion. • We have re-written Section VI to emphasize the future research directions. These modifications, particularly, highlight three new directions: ◦ utilize AI tools in clustering data while leveraging the benefits of Big Data platforms such as Spark. ◦ clustering methods to support the characteristics of variety and velocity of Big data. Additionally, support new aspects of clustering such as concept drift, scalability, integration, fault-tolerance, consistency, timeliness, load balancing, privacy, and incompleteness, etc. ◦ Design clustering methods to utilize Spark as it is an efficient Big Data platform. paper_title_zh: 基于Spark的大数据聚类技术：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 一种流行的无监督学习方法，即聚类，被广泛应用于数据挖掘、机器学习和模式识别中。该过程涉及将单个且独特的点分组到一个组中，使得它们要么彼此相似，要么与其他簇的点不相似。传统的聚类方法因近年来数据的巨大增长而面临重大挑战。因此，一些研究工作提出了利用大数据平台（如Apache Spark）优势的新型聚类方法设计，Apache Spark旨在进行快速且分布式的海量数据处理。然而，基于Spark的聚类研究仍处于早期阶段。在这项系统综述中，我们从支持大数据特性的角度调查了现有的基于Spark的聚类方法。此外，我们提出了一个新的基于Spark的聚类方法分类法。据我们所知，尚未有关于大数据基于Spark的聚类的研究综述。因此，本综述旨在全面总结2010年至2020年间使用Apache Spark进行大数据聚类领域的前人研究。本综述还突出了大规模数据聚类领域的新研究方向。
review_content_zh:
### 审稿人3（匿名）的基本评审意见

**评论#1**：英语语言应改进以避免排版错误。一些排版错误的例子包括第69、143、181、232、257、325、340、447、470和539行。

**回复**：我们已经修订了论文，所有排版错误均已更正。

**评论#2**：引言部分详细且参考文献丰富。

**回复**：谢谢。

**评论#3**：论文结构需要改进。例如，摘要没有提供系统综述的概要。摘要中背景信息过多。摘要应简要提供少量背景信息，然后是问题、方法、结果和意义。此外，我认为背景部分应在文献综述部分之前。而且，讨论部分应详细讨论发现/结果，但作者将这部分用于另一文献综述或相关工作。

**回复**：
- 我们已重写摘要，减少了背景信息，强调了本次系统调查的贡献。
- 我们按照审稿人的建议，将背景部分移至文献综述之前。
- 我们重写了第VI节，强调未来的研究方向。这些修改特别突出了三个新方向：
  - 利用AI工具在聚类数据时，同时利用大数据平台（如Spark）的优势。
  - 支持大数据的多样性和速度特性的聚类方法。此外，支持聚类的新方面，如概念漂移、可扩展性、集成、容错性、一致性、及时性、负载平衡、隐私和不完整性等。
  - 设计利用Spark的聚类方法，因为Spark是一个高效的大数据平台。

**评论#4**：尽管已有关于大数据分析的文献或系统综述，但作者专门探讨了使用Apache Spark进行大数据聚类分析，这一点值得称赞。

**回复**：谢谢。

**评论#5**：主题内容介绍得当。

**回复**：谢谢。

### 实验设计

**评论#6**：本文是一篇系统文献综述，适用于其他领域，尤其是在处理大规模数据的领域。符合期刊范围。

**回复**：谢谢。

**评论#7**：背景部分需要改进，特别是在聚类大数据的挑战方面。作者只关注了一个方向，即V’s。如果作者也能考虑其他挑战，如概念漂移、可扩展性、集成、容错性、一致性、及时性、负载平衡、隐私和不完整性等，将更为全面。

**回复**：我们同意审稿人认为这些挑战很重要且值得研究，但由于基于Spark的聚类方法尚处于初期阶段，这些挑战尚未被纳入Spark-based聚类的设计中。因此，我们将这一评论作为未来研究方向纳入，供该领域的研究者探讨（见第VI节）。

### 研究结果的可靠性

**评论#8**：尽管论文试图探讨使用Apache Spark进行大数据聚类，但仍有一些内容缺失。作者声称要解决五个问题，但只回答了前两个。人们期望作者能逐一明确地提出问题，并从选定的91篇论文中提供答案。即使是已回答的前两个问题也是隐含的。

**回复**：我们修改了结论，纳入了更多关于未来研究方向的研究发现，以填补Spark-based聚类方法中的现有空白。

### 给作者的评论

**评论#10**：应在表格中总结最终选定的91篇论文。这应反映出从每个使用的来源（数据库）中最终选定的论文数量。

**回复**：我们添加了一个新表（表2），展示我们从哪些数据源获取了论文。

**回复**：分裂层次聚类和聚合层次聚类的定义已正确放置（见第V.B节）。

**评论#12**：引用格式不一致。有些以作者的姓氏开头，有些以首字母开头。

**回复**：我们已修改了参考文献部分，使所有参考文献的格式一致。

**评论#13**：第156-161行。应替换为更好的Spark架构图。所提到的组件，驱动器、执行器和RDD在图中未反映。

**回复**：我们已重绘图1，以反映Spark核心的不同组件。

paper_title: A Survey on Compositional Learning of AI Models: Theoretical and Experimental Practices
paper_abstract: Compositional learning, mastering the ability to combine basic concepts and construct more intricate ones, is crucial for human cognition, especially in human language comprehension and visual perception. This notion is tightly connected to generalization over unobserved situations. Despite its integral role in intelligence, there is a lack of systematic theoretical and experimental research methodologies, making it difficult to analyze the compositional learning abilities of computational models. In this paper, we survey the literature on compositional learning of AI models and the connections made to cognitive studies. We identify abstract concepts of compositionality in cognitive and linguistic studies and connect these to the computational challenges faced by language and vision models in compositional reasoning. We overview the formal definitions, tasks, evaluation benchmarks, various computational models, and theoretical findings. Our primary focus is on linguistic benchmarks and combining language and vision, though there is a large amount of research on compositional concept learning in the computer vision community alone. We cover modern studies on large language models to provide a deeper understanding of the cutting-edge compositional capabilities exhibited by state-of-the-art AI models and pinpoint important directions for future research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper surveys compositional learning of AI models, covering the 5 key concepts behind compositionally based on Dankers et al. (2021), important benchmarks for these concepts, popular machine learning approaches studied for compositionally, including classic neural networks, transformers (large language models) and neural-symbolic methods, as well as theoretical findings on these models. It is motivated to provide "systematic, theoretical and experimental research methodologies" to help "analyze the compositional learning abilities of computational models".

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
# Strengths - The problem that this survey paper is trying to address is important and having a systematic way to develop compositional AI methods would benefit the community. # Weaknesses - The survey is not comprehensive and seems to be opinionated. For example, section 2 is mainly based on a single paper. - The writing of the paper has a lot of space to improve - see **Requested Changes**.

**Requested Changes:**
- `\citep` and `\citet` are used wrongly in the entire draft. Please fix them. - There are a lot of inconsistent capitalization in the draft. For example, in the last paragraph of section 1, there are "For cognitive aspects", "For Evaluation" and "For Models", where only the first one keeps lowercase. - Section 2 is heavily dependent on Dankers et al. (2021) - Why it is chosen? Are those the only defined or widely accepted metrics of compositionally? - Figure 1 should be well explained in its caption, e.g. more descriptions are needed to explain the colors, boxes, arrows, etc. Consider converting the second paragraph of section 6 into a compact version as the caption. - Section 2.1, 2.2 and 2.3: Perhaps works that test those metrics should be listed there. - Section 2.4: Unlike the end of 2.3, there is no comments on if this is well-tested or not. - Section 2.5 - "A well-known example of this is the past-tense debate": What is the debate? - "Another example of this task is translating idioms": Can you give an example? - Unlike the end of 2.3, there is no comments on if this is well-tested or not. - Section 2.6: This section should not be at the same level of 2.1-2.5 otherwise it may look like the 6th metric. Perhaps 2.1-2.5 should be put under the same section, considering each of their length is relative short. - Section 3.3: "PCFG SET Hupkes et al. (2020) is the only benchmark" -> Consider making it softer by "To the best of our knowledge, " - Table 1: Consider making the 2nd and 4th vertical bars double to make it clear that those are distinct sections (`Name || Text or Multi || 5 metrics`) - Section 4: The OpenAI citation on GPT-4 has the wrong date, which should be 2023. - Section 4.1: Perhaps which datasets are used for which method should be listed here. - Section 4.2: Why some of the tasks here in the second paragraph are not included in Table 1? - Section 4.3 - Inconsistent spelling - VisProg v.s. Visprog - neurosymbolic v.s. neuro-symbolic - Missing related work: HOUDINI [1] is an earlier work that combines individual neural networks as sub-modules and learn to solve complex tasks. [1] Valkov, Lazar, Dipak Chaudhari, Akash Srivastava, Charles Sutton, and Swarat Chaudhuri. "Houdini: Lifelong learning as program synthesis." Advances in neural information processing systems 31 (2018).

paper_title_zh: AI模型组合学习的综述：理论与实验实践
paper_abstract_zh: 组合学习，即掌握将基本概念组合并构建更复杂概念的能力，对人类认知至关重要，尤其在人类语言理解和视觉感知方面。这一概念与对未观察情境的泛化能力紧密相关。尽管它在智能中扮演着不可或缺的角色，但缺乏系统的理论和实验研究方法，使得分析计算模型的组合学习能力变得困难。在本文中，我们综述了人工智能模型组合学习的文献及其与认知研究的联系。我们识别了认知和语言研究中组合性的抽象概念，并将其与语言和视觉模型在组合推理中面临的计算挑战相联系。我们概述了形式化定义、任务、评估基准、各种计算模型和理论发现。我们的主要关注点是语言基准以及语言和视觉的结合，尽管仅在计算机视觉社区中就有大量关于组合概念学习的研究。我们涵盖了关于大型语言模型的现代研究，以深入理解最先进人工智能模型所展现的前沿组合能力，并指出未来研究的重要方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了人工智能模型的组合学习，涵盖了基于Dankers等人（2021）的组合学习的5个关键概念，这些概念的重要基准，以及针对组合学习研究的流行机器学习方法，包括经典神经网络、变压器（大型语言模型）和神经符号方法，以及这些模型的理论发现。其动机是提供“系统、理论和实验研究方法”，以帮助“分析计算模型的组合学习能力”。

**优点和缺点：**
# 优点 - 这篇综述论文试图解决的问题很重要，并且有一种系统的方法来开发组合AI方法将使社区受益。 # 缺点 - 该综述不全面，似乎带有主观性。例如，第2节主要基于一篇论文。 - 论文的写作有很大的改进空间 - 见**请求的更改**。

**请求的更改：**
- 整个草稿中`\citep`和`\citet`使用错误。请修正。 - 草稿中有许多不一致的大写。例如，在第1节的最后一段中，有“For cognitive aspects”、“For Evaluation”和“For Models”，其中只有第一个保持小写。 - 第2节严重依赖Dankers等人（2021） - 为什么选择它？这些是唯一定义的或广泛接受的组合性指标吗？ - 图1的标题应详细解释，例如需要更多描述来解释颜色、框、箭头等。考虑将第6节的第二段转换为紧凑版本作为标题。 - 第2.1、2.2和2.3节：也许应该列出测试这些指标的工作。 - 第2.4节：与2.3节末尾不同，没有评论这是否经过充分测试。 - 第2.5节 - “一个众所周知的例子是过去时态辩论”：什么是辩论？ - “这个任务的另一个例子是翻译习语”：你能举个例子吗？ - 与2.3节末尾不同，没有评论这是否经过充分测试。 - 第2.6节：这一节不应与2.1-2.5处于同一级别，否则可能看起来像第六个指标。也许2.1-2.5应放在同一节下，考虑到它们的长度相对较短。 - 第3.3节：“PCFG SET Hupkes等人（2020）是唯一基准” -> 考虑改为“据我们所知，” - 表1：考虑将第2和第4个垂直栏改为双线，以清楚表明这些是不同部分（`名称 || 文本或多 || 5个指标`） - 第4节：关于GPT-4的OpenAI引用日期错误，应为2023年。 - 第4.1节：也许应该列出哪些数据集用于哪种方法。 - 第4.2节：为什么第二段中的一些任务没有包含在表1中？ - 第4.3节 - 拼写不一致 - VisProg v.s. paper_title: Marsupial and monotreme milk -A review of its nutrient and immune properties
paper_abstract: All mammals are characterized by the ability of females to produce milk. Marsupial (metatherian) and monotreme (prototherian) young are born in a highly altricial state and rely on their mother's milk for the first part of their life. Here we review the role and importance of milk in marsupial and monotreme development. Milk is the primary source of sustenance for young marsupials and monotremes and its composition varies at different stages of development. We applied nutritional geometry techniques to a limited number of species with values available to analyze changes in macronutrient composition of milk at different stages. Macronutrient energy composition of marsupial milk varies between species and changes concentration during the course of lactation. As well as nourishment, marsupial and monotreme milk supplies growth and immune factors.
review_content: Reviewer 2: The lengthy descriptive nature impeded an understanding of the importance of milk components, especially during the early stages of development. For example section 4.3. “Carbohydrates” – Why do carbohydrates change? This was explained well for iron and maternal nutrition. Without substantially increasing the manuscript, some interpretation of the biological significance of the milk components as different stages would be beneficial. We have made this change Section 11 Conclusions. This was the weakest link in this manuscript. Rather than conclusions, it was more of an abbreviated review. Statements such as “Further research is needed to assess changes in macronutrient composition of monotreme milk.” need to be justified and explained why more research is needed. Is it simply for the sake of knowledge or does it have conservation issues? We have made this change A suggestion would be to restructure the conclusions away from description to interpretation and significance. This could be linked to conservation and artificial milk formulations. There are almost 200 references, but “further research is needed” is often stated. It would be beneficial to indicate why. Is the research invalid, wrong species, wrong nutrients etc.? We have made this change Referencing used an incorrect format as PeerJ uses the 'Name. Year' style with an alphabetized reference list, not numbered as used in this review. The reference section was also incorrect. paper_abstract_zh: 所有哺乳动物的特征在于雌性能够产生乳汁。有袋类（后兽亚纲）和单孔类（原兽亚纲）幼崽出生时处于高度未成熟状态，在生命初期依赖母亲的乳汁。本文综述了乳汁在有袋类和单孔类发育中的作用和重要性。乳汁是幼年有袋类和单孔类的主要营养来源，其成分在不同发育阶段有所变化。我们应用营养几何技术对有限数量的具有可用数据的物种进行分析，以研究不同阶段乳汁宏量营养素成分的变化。有袋类乳汁的宏量营养素能量组成在不同物种间存在差异，并在哺乳过程中浓度发生变化。除了提供营养外，有袋类和单孔类乳汁还提供生长和免疫因子。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2：冗长的描述性内容阻碍了对牛奶成分重要性的理解，尤其是在发育的早期阶段。例如，第4.3节“碳水化合物”——为什么碳水化合物会发生变化？这一点在对铁和母体营养的解释中做得很好。在不显著增加文稿篇幅的情况下，对牛奶成分在不同阶段的生物学意义进行一些解释将是有益的。我们已在第11节“结论”中进行了这一修改。这是本文稿中最薄弱的环节。与其说是结论，不如说更像是一个简短的综述。诸如“需要进一步研究以评估单孔类动物牛奶宏量营养素组成的变化”之类的陈述需要加以论证，并解释为何需要更多研究。仅仅是为了获取知识，还是涉及保护问题？我们已对此进行了修改。建议将结论部分从描述转向解释和意义，这可以与保护和人工牛奶配方联系起来。虽然有近200篇参考文献，但“需要进一步研究”的说法经常出现。指出原因将是有益的。是研究无效、物种错误、营养素错误等吗？我们已对此进行了修改。参考文献使用了不正确的格式，因为PeerJ采用“姓名.年份”风格并附带按字母顺序排列的参考文献列表，而不是本文中所使用的编号格式。参考文献部分也不正确。我们已将文本中的参考文献和参考文献列表改为PeerJ格式。一些评论已直接添加到pdf文档中。我们已在pdf中进行了所有建议的修改。

paper_title: A scoping review protocol on food handlers’ knowledge, attitude, and practices towards food hygiene and safety in low and middle-income countries
paper_abstract:
Background: Food safety and hygiene has emerged as the foremost cause of concern in recent time, especially post-pandemic and has changed the eating out behaviour of the consumers. Consumers often consider food safety and hygiene as one of the most prominent factors and hence it is important for food handlers to have adequate knowledge and the right attitude towards food safety and food hygiene. The review will summarise the evidence on food handlers’ behaviours towards food safety and hygiene and associated factors that inhibit positive behaviour towards following food safety protocols and standards. 
Methods:   This scoping review protocol is guided by updated methodology from Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI). The search will be conducted on Medline (PubMed), Scopus and Web of Science. Google Scholar will be used to locate pertinent grey literature. A citation search will also be employed for identifying additional relevant studies. Quantitative and qualitative studies published from 2011- present will be included. Two reviewers will independently screen and extract the data. A third reviewer will be involved in resolving disagreements between reviewers. A two-stage screening including title/abstract and full-text will be conducted. Data extraction will be done using a pilot-tested data extraction form. The data extracted from included studies will be organised and presented using narrative synthesis.  The review will also attempt  to identify the unaddressed gaps in the literature with the available evidence. 
Ethics and dissemination: An ethical clearance is not required for this scoping review as findings from existing published literature will be summarised. The review findings will be disseminated through conference presentations and journal publications.
review_content:
Thank you for the opportunity to review this paper focusing on a very important topic. As a scoping review, the methodology is transparent and robust and makes reference to existing guidelines which is always good practice.

I have a few minor suggestions:
  * Can the authors provide a justification for the time frame for the searches? Why focus on that range?
  * I also recommend including the LMIC countries in the search strategy.
  * Also, the paper will benefit from a final proofread. A few points include consistency in some words: e.g. amongst/among... Authors should not mix British with American English.
  * Finally, can authors check the in-text citation for consistency as well.
paper_title_zh: 低收入和中等收入国家食品处理者对食品卫生和安全的知识、态度和实践范围的综述协议
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：食品安全和卫生在近年来，尤其是后疫情时代，已成为人们最为关注的问题，并改变了消费者的外出就餐行为。消费者通常将食品安全和卫生视为最重要的因素之一，因此，食品处理者具备足够的知识和正确的态度对待食品安全和食品卫生至关重要。本综述将总结食品处理者对食品安全和卫生的行为及其相关因素，这些因素阻碍了积极遵循食品安全协议和标准的做法。

方法：本范围综述协议遵循乔安娜·布里格斯研究所（JBI）的更新方法学。检索将在Medline（PubMed）、Scopus和Web of Science上进行。Google Scholar将用于定位相关的灰色文献。还将采用引文检索以识别其他相关研究。将包括2011年至今发表的定量和定性研究。两名评审员将独立筛选和提取数据。第三名评审员将参与解决评审员之间的分歧。将进行包括标题/摘要和全文的两阶段筛选。数据提取将使用经过试测的数据提取表进行。从纳入研究中提取的数据将进行组织和呈现，采用叙述性综合方法。本综述还将尝试识别现有文献中未解决的空白。

伦理和传播：由于本范围综述是对现有已发表文献的总结，因此不需要伦理审查。综述结果将通过会议报告和期刊发表进行传播。
review_content_zh:
感谢有机会审阅这篇聚焦于非常重要主题的论文。作为一篇范围综述，其方法论透明且稳健，并参考了现有指南，这始终是良好的实践。

我有几点小建议：
  * 作者能否提供搜索时间范围的合理性解释？为何聚焦于该范围？

  * 最后，作者能否也检查文中引用的一致性。

paper_title: Contextual dimensions for cache replacement schemes in information-centric networks: a systematic review
paper_abstract: In recent years, Information-centric networks (ICNs) have gained attention from the research and industry communities as an efficient and reliable content distribution network paradigm, especially to address content-centric and bandwidth-needed applications together with the heterogeneous requirements of emergent networks, such as the Internet of Things (IoT), Vehicular Ad-hoc NETwork (VANET) and Mobile Edge Computing (MEC). Innetwork caching is an essential part of ICN architecture design, and the performance of the overall network relies on caching policy efficiency. Therefore, a large number of cache replacement strategies have been proposed to suit the needs of different networks. The literature extensively presents studies on the performance of the replacement schemes in different contexts. The evaluations may present different variations of context characteristics leading to different impacts on the performance of the policies or different results of most suitable policies. Conversely, there is a lack of research efforts to understand how the context characteristics influence policy performance. In this direction, we conducted an extensive study of the ICN literature through a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) process to map reported evidence of different aspects of context regarding the cache replacement schemes. Our main findings contribute to the understanding of what is a context from the perspective of cache replacement policies and the context characteristics that influence cache behavior. We also provide a helpful classification of policies based on context dimensions used to determine the relevance of contents.
review_content: Reviewer 2 R2C1: The basic reporting norms are met. This paper presents a survey of various caching strategies/policies used in Information Centric Networks (ICN). There have been other survey papers on ICNs and caching; this paper specifically considers the awareness of context characteristics that can affect the behaviour of such caching policies AR2C1: As the reviewer highlighted, this survey contributes to current ICN's literature since it discusses the multiple aspects involving context characteristics and their impacts on caching performance. Besides that, it provides a taxonomy in the field to help the development of future adaptive caching schemes in various networking scenarios. R2C2: The contents on the impact of various context elements such as Node-Location, Node-Cache Size etc. presents a listing of some of the techniques used and key results from the various papers. However, what is lacking is a description of the different techniques. A researcher working in this field would be even more interested in the techniques themselves, than merely policy names and results. AR2C2: Due to this Reviewer's comment, we included a new table (Table 7) in Subsection "​RQ4 - Effects of context variation" that provides a description of the different techniques discussed in the subsection. We hope to have addressed this issue through this update. R2C3: Further, the results in a paper will be influenced significantly by the underlying system parameters and hence, presenting only the results may not be very beneficial. AR2C3: Systems' parameters were described through Table 7 of the first version of the manuscript (current Table 8), in Section "​RQ4 - Effects of context variation".​ In any event, we have updated and improved the description associated with the now Table 8 due to the Reviewer's comment. We updated the text in lines 409 and 507, and we included a reference to Table 8 in line 616 (it was missing in this part of the text). The new text is: “Table 8 summarizes the reported underlying system parameters. Those are the context characteristics that supported the analyses. ” R2C4: The survey's taxonomy and research questions (RQ1-RQ4) are valid, scientifically relevant and seem to cover essential questions to be considered. The section on "RESEARCH DIRECTIONS" can be quite useful to researchers who plan to work in this domain. AR2C4: As remarked by the Reviewer, the taxonomy and research questions were designed to support future networking applications, in particular those highlighted in the "Research directions" section. R2C5: [​Introduction section]​ It does not adequately describe what ICNs are; it does not present the state-of-the-art of ICNs in terms of their adaptation. A better motivation for studying ICNs and caching schemes is needed. AR2C5: Due to this comment, we changed the introduction to better present the ICN description and motivations to study ICN and caching schemes (lines 32-58). Regarding the ​“state-of-the-art of ICNs in terms of their adaptation”​, we struggled to comprehend what the Reviewer meant by ​their adaptation.​ Even so, we chose to interpret it as the adoption of real-world ICN deployments, and we extended the Section "​Background - Information-Centric Network", lines 148-157, to include such a discussion. We hope to have addressed these issues through these updates. R2C6: [​Introduction section]​ There is no description of where caching occurs, and why it is needed in ICNs. There is a serious gap in this regard. Hence, the lead-in to lines 49-60 is missing context​. AR2C6: Due to this comment, we updated the introduction to better describe the relation of ICN and caching. The updates are merged with those previously mentioned at AR2C5. Particularly, the lines 51 to 58 put in context where caching occurs and the need to choose appropriate caching schemes. We hope to have addressed this issue through this update. R2C7: [​Introduction section]​ A proper definition of "scenarios" and "contexts" is also needed in this section. AR2C7: We agree with the reviewer. We updated the manuscript to address this issue accordingly. Both terms were often confusing in their meaning. This way, since our work focuses on contexts, we defined the term “network context” in lines 60-64 of the Introduction, and we removed the word scenario from all the work to avoid misunderstanding. The attached marked version shows the changes we have carried out.
paper_title_zh: 信息中心网络缓存替换策略的情境维度：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 近年来，信息中心网络（ICNs）作为高效可靠的内容分发网络范式，引起了研究界和工业界的关注，特别是在应对以内容为中心和带宽需求型应用以及新兴网络（如物联网（IoT）、车载自组织网络（VANET）和移动边缘计算（MEC））的异构需求方面。网络内缓存是ICN架构设计的重要组成部分，整体网络的性能依赖于缓存策略的效率。因此，为满足不同网络的需求，已提出了大量缓存替换策略。文献广泛研究了不同情境下替换方案的性能。评估可能呈现情境特征的不同变化，导致对策略性能的不同影响或最适用策略的不同结果。相反，缺乏研究努力来理解情境特征如何影响策略性能。在此方向上，我们通过系统文献综述（SLR）过程对ICN文献进行了广泛研究，以映射关于缓存替换方案的不同情境方面的报告证据。我们的主要发现有助于理解从缓存替换策略的角度什么是情境以及影响缓存行为的情境特征。我们还提供了一个基于用于确定内容相关性的情境维度的策略分类，这对理解情境具有重要帮助。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2 R2C1：基本报告规范得到了满足。本文对信息中心网络（ICN）中使用的各种缓存策略/政策进行了综述。已有其他关于ICN和缓存的综述论文；本文特别考虑了可能影响此类缓存策略行为的上下文特征意识。AR2C1：正如审稿人所强调的，这篇综述对当前ICN文献做出了贡献，因为它讨论了涉及上下文特征及其对缓存性能影响的多个方面。此外，它在该领域提供了一个分类法，以帮助在各种网络场景中开发未来的自适应缓存方案。R2C2：关于节点位置、节点缓存大小等不同上下文元素影响的内容，列出了一些使用的技术和各篇论文的关键结果。然而，缺乏对不同技术的描述。从事该领域研究的研究人员可能对技术本身更感兴趣，而不仅仅是政策名称和结果。AR2C2：由于这位审稿人的评论，我们在“RQ4 - 上下文变化的影响”小节中新增了一个表格（表7），提供了该小节中讨论的不同技术的描述。我们希望通过这一更新解决这一问题。R2C3：此外，论文中的结果将受到底层系统参数的显著影响，因此仅呈现结果可能并不非常有益。AR2C3：系统参数已在第一版手稿的表7（现表8）中进行了描述，位于“RQ4 - 上下文变化的影响”部分。无论如何，我们根据审稿人的评论更新并改进了与现表8相关的描述。我们更新了第409和507行的文本，并在第616行增加了对表8的引用（这部分文本中缺失）。新文本为：“表8总结了报告的底层系统参数。这些是支持分析的上下文特征。” R2C4：综述的分类法和研究问题（RQ1-RQ4）是有效的、科学相关的，并且似乎涵盖了需要考虑的基本问题。“研究方向”部分对计划在此领域工作的研究人员可能非常有用。AR2C4：正如审稿人所指出的，分类法和研究问题旨在支持未来的网络应用，特别是那些在“研究方向”部分中强调的应用。R2C5：[引言部分] 它没有充分描述ICN是什么；没有呈现ICN在适应性方面的最新研究状态。需要更好的研究ICN和缓存方案的动力。AR2C5：由于这一评论，我们修改了引言，以更好地呈现ICN的描述和研究ICN及缓存方案的动力（第32-58行）。关于“ICN在适应性方面的最新研究状态”，我们难以理解审稿人所说的“它们的适应性”是什么意思。即便如此，我们选择将其解释为现实世界中ICN部署的采用，并扩展了“背景 - 信息中心网络”部分，第148-157行，以包括这一讨论。我们希望通过这些更新解决这些问题。R2C6：[引言部分] 没有描述缓存发生在哪里，以及为什么ICN中需要缓存。在这方面存在严重缺口。因此，第49-60行的引言缺乏上下文。AR2C6：由于这一评论，我们更新了引言，以更好地描述ICN与缓存的关系。这些更新与之前AR2C5中提到的更新合并。特别是，第51至58行将缓存发生的位置和选择适当缓存方案的需要置于上下文中。我们希望通过这一更新解决这一问题。R2C7：[引言部分] 在这一部分也需要对“场景”和“上下文”进行适当的定义。AR2C7：我们同意审稿人的意见。我们相应地更新了手稿以解决这一问题。这两个术语在意义上常常令人困惑。由于我们的工作聚焦于上下文，我们在引言的第60-64行定义了“网络上下文”这一术语，并从整篇工作中删除了“场景”一词以避免误解。附带的标记版本显示了我们所做的更改。

paper_title: A systematic review and critical analysis of cost-effectiveness studies for coronary artery disease treatment
paper_abstract:
Background : Cardiovascular disease remains the primary cause of death among Australians, despite dramatic improvements in overall cardiovascular health since the 1980s. Treating cardiovascular disease continues to place a significant economic strain on the Australian health care system, with direct healthcare costs exceeding those of any other disease. Coronary artery disease accounts for nearly one third of these costs and spending continues to rise. 
A range of treatments is available for coronary artery disease yet evidence of cost-effectiveness is missing, particularly for the Australian context. Cost-effectiveness evidence can signal waste and inefficiency and so is essential for an efficient allocation of healthcare resources. 
 Methods: We used systematic review methods to search the literature across several electronic databases for economic evaluations of treatments for stable coronary artery disease.  We critically appraised the literature found in searches, both against the CHEERS statement for quality reporting of economic evaluations and in terms of its usefulness for policy and decision-makers. 
 Results: We retrieved a total of 308 references, 229 once duplicates were removed. Of these, 26 were excluded as they were not full papers (letters, editorials etc.), 55 were review papers, 50 were not cost-effectiveness analyses and 93 related to a highly specific patient sub-group or did not consider all treatment options.  This left five papers to be reviewed in full. 
 Conclusions: The current cost-effectiveness evidence does not support the increased use of PCI that has been seen in Australia and internationally. Due to problems with accessibility, clarity and relevance to policy and decision-makers, some otherwise very scientifically rigorous analyses have failed to generate any policy changes.
review_content:
This paper presents a valuable critical analysis of cost-effectiveness studies and highlights serious issues in relation to potential inefficiencies in funding for Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) treatment. As identified by the authors, heart disease is a significant area of expenditure for health in Australia and this paper contributes important information for policy consideration.
The paper is well-written and raises a number of recommendations useful for general presentation of cost-effectiveness analyses in the literature. In particular, these recommendations are useful in terms of the quality of life measurement and the application of the CHEERS checklist.
One interesting issue raised here – which could potentially be further explored - is in terms of high-level policy changes. All new procedures presented for listing on Medicare or the PBS necessarily undergo a rigorous process of evaluation, including assessment of cost-effectiveness evidence, which often includes commissioned modelling studies to apply international clinical findings for Australian scenarios. The economic evaluation requires comparison of the new technology or drug with the status quo (or best current alternative) to appraise the incremental cost-effectiveness for the specific population group defined in the submission. However the point raised here is an important one – that incremental benefits and costs in cost-effectiveness may not reflect the bigger picture if the underlying comparator is flawed. Nonetheless it is a much greater undertaking to address wider policy ramifications, particularly where evidence continues to accrue. (Notably the current MBS taskforce is endeavouring to address such challenges.)
One major criticism however is that it is not made clear to the reader that the analysis specifically targets stable angina, which is a subgroup of CAD patients. In particular, the abstract suggests that the results apply to treatment of all CAD patients and hence the results are potentially misleading when considered across all patients with CAD. It is important to know what proportion of CAD patients present with stable disease (and hence are eligible for all three treatments (CABG, PCI, MT). The information is implicit since it is clear from the population group of each of the included trials that patients with acute disease have been excluded. The fairly recent RCT which provides the most enlightening data, has quite strict exclusion criteria, which lists a number of presentations. The conclusions of the review are valid, but the subgroup requires transparency.
This leads to a second point, which questions the importance of the clinical diagnosis. NICE clinical guidelines recommend drug treatment for stable angina unless symptoms are not satisfactorily controlled, in which case interventional procedures should be considered. This suggests a value judgement in selecting patients for interventional care. Does this potentially present a continuum that has shifted over time? It is important to assess what proportion of the cited 57% increase in PCI has been for the treatment of stable CAD. A related query is whether the non-RCT studies were subject to possible selection bias.
A fundamental question then arises as to whether the cost-effectiveness studies should stand apart from the clinical data. That is, if the clinical evidence is changing (and clearly the controversy around interventional procedures for stable disease reflects the growing evidence) – it may be most useful for the cost-effectiveness to be presented for the specific sub groups that are most controversial – for example based on the differential burden of ischaemia.
Queries and comments:
· Reviews were excluded from consideration – were they considered for comparison of findings and were they scrutinised for potentially missed references?
· ‘..most of the .. papers did not examine medical therapy.’ Was this because they pertained to acute presentations or was medical therapy overlooked for stable presentation?



I disagree with some of the statements made around usefulness for policy. For example the statement that presenting clinical complexities ‘does nothing to assist those wanting to make higher level resource allocation decisions’. Complexity may limit relevance in some cases, but if cost-effectiveness varies according to clinical diagnosis (and evidence supports this), then the heterogeneity may be an important consideration. Also, the statement referring to publications that consider only 2 treatments as not being useful to policy – if the policy decision relates to critical cases such as myocardial infarction or if it relates to a minor change to policy already in existence, then comparison of more than 2 options may not be relevant. Thirdly, non-Australian evidence may be appropriate if the clinical findings are relevant to an Australian population and Australian cost data can be applied.
It may be in the wording of some of these statements, given the separation of higher level allocation decisions and those relating to small changes in resource allocation. However most policy decisions assess a well-defined intervention, compared to a current alternative, for a clearly defined patient group (which is necessary to prevent leakage), so commonly the detailed breakdown of cost-effectiveness provides critical information for those decisions.
The paper provides an interesting supplement to the current clinical literature on the controversy around treatment of stable coronary artery disease. The discussion of the importance of policy-relevant evidence will inform future cost-effectiveness analyses of trials currently in progress.
paper_title_zh: 冠状动脉疾病治疗成本效益研究的系统综述与批判性分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：尽管自20世纪80年代以来澳大利亚整体心血管健康状况显著改善，心血管疾病仍然是澳大利亚人的主要死因。治疗心血管疾病继续对澳大利亚医疗系统造成显著的经济压力，其直接医疗成本超过任何其他疾病。冠状动脉疾病占这些成本的近三分之一，且支出持续上升。针对冠状动脉疾病有多种治疗方法，但缺乏成本效益的证据，特别是在澳大利亚背景下。成本效益证据可以揭示浪费和低效，因此对于高效分配医疗资源至关重要。

方法：我们使用系统综述方法，在多个电子数据库中搜索关于稳定型冠状动脉疾病治疗的经济评估文献。我们批判性地评估了搜索到的文献，既依据CHEERS声明对经济评估质量报告的标准，也考虑其对政策和决策者的实用性。

结果：我们共检索到308篇参考文献，去除重复后为229篇。其中，26篇因不是完整论文（如信件、社论等）而被排除，55篇为综述论文，50篇不是成本效益分析，93篇涉及高度特定的患者亚组或未考虑所有治疗选项。最终剩下5篇论文进行全文审查。

结论：目前的成本效益证据不支持在澳大利亚及国际上所见到的PCI使用增加。由于在可访问性、清晰度和对政策和决策者相关性方面存在问题，一些在科学上非常严谨的分析未能引发任何政策变化。
review_content_zh:
本文对成本效益研究进行了宝贵的批判性分析，并强调了与冠状动脉疾病（CAD）治疗资金潜在低效相关的严重问题。正如作者所指出的，心脏病是澳大利亚卫生支出的重要领域，本文为政策考虑提供了重要信息。

文章写得很好，并提出了一些建议，这些建议对于文献中成本效益分析的一般呈现非常有用。特别是，这些建议在生活质量测量和CHEERS清单的应用方面非常有价值。

本文提出的一个有趣问题——可能进一步探讨的——是高级政策变化方面。所有新程序在列入Medicare或PBS之前，都必须经过严格的评估过程，包括成本效益证据的评估，这通常包括委托建模研究，以将国际临床发现应用于澳大利亚情景。经济评估需要将新技术或药物与现状（或最佳当前替代方案）进行比较，以评估特定人群组定义的增量成本效益。然而，这里提出的观点是非常重要的——如果潜在的参照物存在缺陷，成本效益中的增量收益和成本可能无法反映更大的图景。尽管如此，解决更广泛的政策影响是一项更为艰巨的任务，尤其是在证据不断积累的情况下。（值得注意的是，当前的MBS工作组正在努力应对这些挑战。）

然而，一个主要的批评是，文章没有向读者明确说明分析专门针对的是稳定型心绞痛，这是CAD患者的一个亚组。特别是，摘要表明结果适用于所有CAD患者的治疗，因此当考虑到所有CAD患者时，结果可能具有误导性。了解有多大比例的CAD患者表现为稳定型疾病（因此有资格接受所有三种治疗（CABG、PCI、MT））是很重要的。这些信息是隐含的，因为从每个纳入试验的人群组中可以清楚地看出，急性疾病患者已被排除。最近的一项RCT提供了最具启发性的数据，其排除标准非常严格，列出了多种表现。综述的结论是有效的，但亚组需要透明。

这引出了第二个问题，即临床诊断的重要性。NICE临床指南建议对稳定型心绞痛进行药物治疗，除非症状没有得到满意控制，在这种情况下应考虑介入治疗。这表明在选择患者进行介入治疗时存在价值判断。这是否可能呈现一个随时间推移而变化的连续体？评估所引用的PCI增加57%中有多少用于治疗稳定型CAD是很重要的。一个相关的问题是，非RCT研究是否可能存在选择偏倚。

一个基本问题随之而来，即成本效益研究是否应与临床数据分开。也就是说，如果临床证据在变化（显然，围绕稳定型疾病介入治疗的争议反映了越来越多的证据）——那么将成本效益呈现给最具争议的特定亚组可能最有用——例如基于缺血负担的差异。

疑问和评论：
· 综述被排除在考虑之外——它们是否被用于比较发现，并且是否被仔细审查以发现可能遗漏的参考文献？
· “..大多数..论文没有考察药物治疗。”是因为它们涉及急性表现，还是因为稳定表现忽视了药物治疗？

我不同意一些关于政策有用性的陈述。例如，关于呈现临床复杂性“对那些希望做出更高层次资源分配决策的人毫无帮助”的陈述。复杂性在某些情况下可能限制了相关性，但如果成本效益根据临床诊断而变化（且有证据支持这一点），那么异质性可能是一个重要的考虑因素。此外，关于仅考虑两种治疗的出版物对政策无用的陈述——如果政策决策涉及心肌梗死等关键情况，或者涉及对已存在政策的微小更改，那么比较超过两个选项可能不相关。第三，如果临床发现适用于澳大利亚人群并且可以应用澳大利亚成本数据，那么非澳大利亚证据可能是合适的。

这可能在于某些陈述的措辞，鉴于高层次分配决策与涉及资源分配微小变化的决策之间的分离。然而，大多数政策决策评估的是一个明确定义的干预措施，与当前替代方案相比，针对一个明确定义的患者群体（这是防止泄漏所必需的），因此通常详细的成本效益分解为这些决策提供了关键信息。

本文为当前关于稳定型冠状动脉疾病治疗争议的临床文献提供了一个有趣的补充。关于政策相关证据重要性的讨论将为目前正在进行的试验的未来成本效益分析提供信息。

reasons: · Reviews were excluded from consideration – were they considered for comparison of findings and were they scrutinised for potentially missed references?
· ‘..most of the .. papers did not examine medical therapy.’ Was this because they pertained to acute presentations or was medical therapy overlooked for stable presentation?
Thirdly, non-Australian evidence may be appropriate if the clinical findings are relevant to an Australian population and Australian cost data can be applied.
I disagree with some of the statements made around usefulness for policy.
The paper is well-written and raises a number of recommendations useful for general presentation of cost-effectiveness analyses in the literature.
One major criticism however is that it is not made clear to the reader that the analysis specifically targets stable angina, which is a subgroup of CAD patients.
In particular, the abstract suggests that the results apply to treatment of all CAD patients and hence the results are potentially misleading when considered across all patients with CAD.
The conclusions of the review are valid, but the subgroup requires transparency.
It may be in the wording of some of these statements, given the separation of higher level allocation decisions and those relating to small changes in resource allocation.

paper_title: Making science public: a review of journalists’ use of Open Access research
paper_abstract: Science journalists are uniquely positioned to increase the societal impact of open research outputs by contextualizing and communicating findings in ways that highlight their relevance and implications for non-specialist audiences. Yet, it is unclear to what degree journalists use open research outputs, such as open access publications or preprints, in their reporting; what factors motivate or constrain this use; and how the recent surge in openly available research seen during the COVID-19 pandemic has affected this. This article examines these questions through a review of relevant literature published from 2018 onwards—particularly literature relating to the COVID-19 pandemic—as well as seminal articles outside the search dates. We find that research that explicitly examines journalists’ engagement with open access publications or preprints is scarce, with existing literature mostly addressing the topic tangentially or as a secondary concern, rather than a primary focus. Still, the limited body of evidence points to several factors that may hamper journalists’ use of these outputs and thus warrant further exploration. These include an overreliance on traditional criteria for evaluating scientific quality; concerns about the trustworthiness of open research outputs; and challenges using and verifying the findings. We also find that, while the COVID-19 pandemic encouraged journalists to explore open research outputs such as preprints, the extent to which these explorations will become established journalistic practices remains unclear. Furthermore, we note that current research is overwhelmingly authored and focused on the Global North, and the United States specifically. We conclude with recommendations for future research that attend to issues of equity and diversity, and more explicitly examine the intersections of open access and science journalism.
review_content:
This is a timely and important review of the relationship between open access and dissemination practices and science journalism during the COVID-19 pandemic. It is particularly valuable in identifying gaps in the literature with respect to preprints, journalism and their risks and benefits.

My expertise is not in studies of science journalism so additional expertise may be required to ensure the comprehensive coverage of the review. From the perspective of open science practices the review covers the core aspects of importance. I would find it helpful to have a table or dataset that categorizes or lists the identified outputs as well as the relevant search terms but this is a minor issue.

Minor point: Introduction paragraph 4 "...a review of a review of..." is presumably a duplication? If not then maybe rephrasing will help.
paper_title_zh: 《让科学公开：记者使用开放获取研究的综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 科学记者在通过背景化和传播研究结果方面具有独特优势，能够突出其对非专业受众的相关性和影响，从而增加开放研究产出的社会影响。然而，目前尚不清楚记者在报道中多大程度上使用开放研究产出，如开放获取出版物或预印本；哪些因素促进或限制这种使用；以及COVID-19大流行期间公开研究激增对此有何影响。本文通过回顾2018年及以后发表的相关文献——尤其是与COVID-19大流行相关的文献——以及搜索日期之外的经典文章，探讨这些问题。我们发现，明确研究记者与开放获取出版物或预印本互动的研究较为稀缺，现有文献大多只是间接或作为次要关注点而非主要焦点来探讨这一话题。尽管如此，有限的证据指向几个可能阻碍记者使用这些产出的因素，值得进一步探索。这些因素包括过度依赖传统科学质量评估标准；对开放研究产出可信度的担忧；以及使用和验证研究结果的挑战。我们还发现，尽管COVID-19大流行促使记者探索开放研究产出如预印本，但这些探索是否会成为确立的记者实践尚不清楚。此外，我们注意到当前研究绝大多数由全球北方国家，尤其是美国作者撰写并聚焦于此。我们以对未来研究的建议作为结论，这些建议关注公平和多样性问题，并更明确地探讨开放获取与科学新闻业的交叉点。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇及时且重要的综述，探讨了在COVID-19大流行期间开放获取与传播实践和科学新闻业之间的关系。特别是在识别与预印本、新闻业及其风险和收益相关的文献空白方面，该综述尤为有价值。

我的专长不在科学新闻业研究，因此可能需要额外的专业知识以确保综述的全面覆盖。从开放科学实践的角度来看，该综述涵盖了重要的核心方面。如果能有一个表格或数据集，对已识别的成果进行分类或列表，并提供相关的搜索术语，我将觉得非常有帮助，但这只是一个次要问题。

小问题：引言第4段中的“...a review of a review of...”可能是重复？如果不是，那么或许重新措辞会有所帮助。
