paper_title: A Unified Survey on Anomaly, Novelty, Open-Set, and Out of-Distribution Detection: Solutions and Future Challenges
paper_abstract: Machine learning models often encounter samples that are diverged from the training distribution. Failure to recognize an out-of-distribution (OOD) sample, and consequently assign that sample to an in-class label, significantly compromises the reliability of a model. The problem has gained significant attention due to its importance for safety deploying models in open-world settings. Detecting OOD samples is challenging due to the intractability of modeling all possible unknown distributions. To date, several research domains tackle the problem of detecting unfamiliar samples, including anomaly detection, novelty detection, one-class learning, open set recognition, and out-of-distribution detection. Despite having similar and shared concepts, out-of-distribution, open-set, and anomaly detection have been investigated independently. Accordingly, these research avenues have not crosspollinated, creating research barriers. While some surveys intend to provide an overview of these approaches, they seem to only focus on a specific domain without examining the relationship between different domains. This survey aims to provide a cross-domain and comprehensive review of numerous eminent works in respective areas while identifying their commonalities. Researchers can benefit from the overview of research advances in different fields and develop future methodology synergistically. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, while there are surveys in anomaly detection or one-class learning, there is no comprehensive or up-to-date survey on out-of-distribution detection, which this survey covers extensively. Finally, having a unified cross-domain perspective, this study discusses and sheds light on future lines of research, intending to bring these fields closer together.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper provides a review the related work in Anomaly Detection (AD), Novelty Detection (ND), out of distribution detection (OOD) and Open Set Recognition (OSR), aiming to provide a unified view of these problems in machine learning. The paper provides an extensive review of different state-of-the-art methods in these areas as well as an empirical evaluation on different synthetic and real datasets.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: + The idea of providing a unified survey including AD, ND, OOD, and OSR can be of interest and useful to a broad audience in the machine learning community. + The authors included an extensive set of techniques across the different problems. + The paper includes an empirical evaluation comparing the methods explained in the survey. Weaknesses: - The paper does not really deliver the unified view of the different learning tasks considered, as stated in the introduction. The paper mostly focuses on the brief description of an extensive number of methods in the related work. - Some of the descriptions of the algorithms included in the survey are very brief and includes equations that are not really explained (e.g. equations (1) and (2)). It gives the impression that the paper prioritizes quantity (of the methods included in the survey) than quality, which really limits the usefulness of the paper. - The different subsections in Section 9 looks rather disconnected and the storyline is not clear. - The writing quality of the paper can be significantly improved (typos, grammar, etc.). - The paper includes many figures that are not original from the authors, but taken from other papers without making the reference explicit. This can create problems related to copyright infringement and plagiarism.

**Requested Changes:**
I have read the comments and requested changes in the previous version of the paper and briefly checked the changes in the paper with respect to the previous version. I fully agree with the changes suggested by the action editors and I think that the authors have not really addressed them for this revised version of the manuscript. In this sense, my main concern is that the paper mostly focuses on the short description (in some cases insufficient) of a large number of papers rather than providing that unified view promised in the introduction. For instance, the authors mention differences between novelty and anomaly detection tasks (depending on the degree of supervision). But then, in Section 3 both anomaly and novelty detection methods are treated a bit arbitrarily. For example, OC-SVM is defined as a novelty detection method, but the authors include it in a section for anomaly detection methods. The authors have done a good job on gathering a very good number of relevant methods for the different tasks, but the survey needs a significant amount of work in relating them to provide that unified view, which is the objective of the survey. The description of some of the methods needs to be revised and improved: in some cases, these are too brief and includes equations or algorithms that are not really explained. Section 9 seems too disconnected. Some of the ideas can be of use, but the discussions sometimes are shallow and the different aspects considered in the different subsections are not well connected. As mentioned by other reviewers and the action editors in the previous version of the manuscript, the writing quality of the paper can be significantly improved and the paper should be proofread carefully before submission. In this sense, I don’t see significant improvements with respect to the previous version. There is no relevant final discussion or conclusion in the paper. Section 10 is too short. I think this can also be significantly improved.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
Many figures and algorithms have been taken from the original papers, but the authors in this paper do not include any explicit reference to the original source. I don’t think that the authors have done this maliciously, but this can be a source of problems in terms of copyright infringement and plagiarism.

**Rebuttal Comments:**
The new version has been uploaded.: The authors kindly ask you to check out the new version. For your first concern, please refer to our previous responses. For the last concern, we have added Section 8 and tried our best to make the explanation of the methods self-contained. Also, as Reviewer "8zi1" mentioned, we tried our best to polish the paper and make it clear; however, we applied one further polishing to remove probable few typos. | Insufficient Description of Equations and The Explanations of Section 9: Insufficient Description of Equations : Please note that the methods should be explained based on their practicality according to the current advances in the field; otherwise, the paper could end up being very long, which from the author's point of view, is not useful for anyone. OC-SVM is fairly old and mainly based on SVM, a famous method in the field. Therefore, we think there is no need to re-explain the algorithm; instead, we have explained the philosophy behind manipulating SVM for one-class learning applications and addressed how it was further improved. Furthermore, as other reviewers also mentioned, I would refer you to the explanations of deep-learning based methods that are carefully selected and discussed sufficiently to satisfy the needs of either newcomers or experts in the field. The Explanations of Section 9 : The title of this section is "Future works", and future works, by definition, could be elaborated even independently. We have done our best to not only give intuitions about the future areas but also provide empirical evidence to support our claims as you also mentioned in the strengths. Besides, we also made some cross-bridges between the future works wherever it was possible; for instance, we shed light on the abilities of adversarial attacks (with a large perturbation noise) as a data augmentation technique to generate fake abnormal samples to improve the performance of AD methods, which is totally different from their common functionality in the field. Also, I would refer you to "open-world recognition", which discusses the practical challenges of implementing out-of-distribution detection, anomaly detection, and open-set recognition methods. Finally, we addressed the commonalities of different approaches in the corresponding explanations of each method. For instance, take a look at the description of (4.13), which discusses the similarity of GOAD with GT and DSVDD. Also, it is explained that several works that are considered different techniques in AD and OOD, implicitly have introduced the same technique, "outlier exposure", such as 6.6 and 4.10. There are also many other similarities that are addressed in the explanations. | unified perspective, AD+ND, missing citations: Thank you for the comments. About a unified perspective: Please be advised the unified review here means that how these tasks, i.e., OSR, ND, AD, and ODD are related/connected (As main our contribution? Please let us know if another paper addresses this crucial issue in the field which comprehensively discuss this). And what is the main difference between these tasks. We do not tend to provide a unifying perspective on the previously proposed methods (There are a lot of survey papers about this). In this way, we explained and showed how these tasks are connected. Please see Fig 1 and 2, Tab 1, and the introduction and evaluation protocol section. We have just explained the notable previous methods for each task to make the paper more beneficial for the readers. All in all, we can emphasize that the message of this paper is providing a unified overlooking of these correlated tasks( not the methods). We suggest the reviewer again read the paper completely (without skipping any section) to get the paper's central message. About ND and AD: I guess you miss some parts of the papers. We have clarified /explained that ND and AD are two different approaches. However, the community considers both the same in most papers. We follow the community when we have explained methods, while we have provided more explanations about this in other sections. A survey aims not to deliver the technical novelty of each of the previous methods; the duty is to provide a complete review of the most notable previous methods where you can see we have done that. About the reference to the original papers of the photos: We do not agree with you; in each part where we explain a method (paper), we cite the original paper, which shows that all materials from that part are borrowed from that paper. Please read the text carefully, if you do not change your mind, we can cite the original paper in the caption of each figure.
paper_title_zh: 统一调查：异常、新奇、开放集及分布外检测——解决方案与未来挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 机器学习模型经常遇到偏离训练分布的样本。未能识别出分布外（OOD）样本，并因此将该样本分配到类内标签，会显著降低模型的可靠性。由于在开放世界环境中安全部署模型的重要性，这一问题已引起广泛关注。由于建模所有可能的未知分布的不可处理性，检测OOD样本具有挑战性。迄今为止，多个研究领域都在解决检测不熟悉样本的问题，包括异常检测、新颖性检测、单类学习、开放集识别和分布外检测。尽管分布外、开放集和异常检测具有相似和共享的概念，但它们一直是独立研究的。因此，这些研究途径未能交叉融合，形成了研究壁垒。虽然一些综述旨在提供这些方法的概述，但它们似乎只关注特定领域，而未考察不同领域之间的关系。本综述旨在提供跨领域且全面的综述，涵盖各领域内的众多杰出工作，同时识别它们的共同点。研究人员可以从不同领域研究进展的概述中受益，并协同开发未来的方法。此外，据我们所知，尽管存在关于异常检测或单类学习的综述，但尚无全面或最新的关于分布外检测的综述，而本综述对此进行了广泛覆盖。最后，通过统一的跨领域视角，本研究讨论并阐明了未来的研究方向，旨在将这些领域更紧密地结合起来。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了异常检测（AD）、新颖性检测（ND）、分布外检测（OOD）和开放集识别（OSR）的相关工作，旨在为机器学习中的这些问题提供一个统一的视角。文章对上述领域中的不同先进方法进行了广泛的综述，并在不同的合成和真实数据集上进行了实证评估。

**优点与不足：**
优点：
+ 提供一个包括AD、ND、OOD和OSR的统一综述，对机器学习社区的广泛受众具有兴趣和实用价值。
+ 作者涵盖了一系列跨不同问题的技术。

不足：
- 文章并未真正实现引言中所提到的对不同学习任务的统一视角。文章主要侧重于对相关工作中的大量方法进行简要描述。
- 综述中包含的一些算法描述非常简短，并且包含未充分解释的公式（例如公式(1)和(2)）。这给人一种印象，即文章更注重方法的数量而非质量，这大大限制了文章的实用性。
- 第9节中的不同小节看起来较为脱节，故事线索不清晰。
- 文章的写作质量有待显著提高（如错别字、语法等）。
- 文章包含许多非原创图表，而是直接从其他论文中引用，且未明确标注出处。这可能引发版权侵犯和抄袭问题。

**请求的修改：**
我已阅读了前一版论文中的评论和请求的修改，并简要检查了与前一版相比的改动。我完全同意执行编辑提出的修改建议，并且我认为作者并未真正针对修订版手稿进行这些修改。在这方面，我主要担心的是，文章主要侧重于对大量论文的简短描述（在某些情况下是不充分的），而不是提供引言中承诺的统一视角。例如，作者提到了新颖性检测和异常检测任务之间的差异（取决于监督程度）。但在第3节中，异常检测和新颖性检测方法被 somewhat arbitrarily 处理。例如，OC-SVM被定义为一种新颖性检测方法，但作者将其包含在异常检测方法的章节中。作者在收集不同任务的相关方法方面做得很好，但综述需要大量工作来关联这些方法，以提供统一的视角，这也是综述的目标。某些方法的描述需要修订和改进：在某些情况下，这些描述过于简短，并且包含未充分解释的公式或算法。第9节显得过于脱节。其中一些想法可能有用，但讨论有时较为浅显，不同小节中考虑的不同方面未能很好地连接。正如其他评审者和执行编辑在前一版手稿中所提到的，文章的写作质量有待显著提高，并且在提交前应仔细校对。在这方面，我认为与前一版相比没有显著改进。文章没有相关的最终讨论或结论。第10节过于简短。我认为这也需要显著改进。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
许多图表和算法直接从原始论文中引用，但本文作者未明确标注原始出处。我认为作者并非有意为之，但这可能成为版权侵犯和抄袭问题的来源。

**反驳意见：**
新版本已上传：作者恳请您查看新版本。关于您的第一个关切，请参考我们之前的回应。关于最后一个关切，我们已添加第8节，并尽力使方法的解释自洽。此外，正如评审者“8zi1”所提到的，我们尽力润色文章并使其清晰；然而，我们进一步进行了润色以去除可能的少量错别字。| 公式和第9节解释不足：公式解释不足：请注意，方法的解释应基于其在当前领域进展中的实用性；否则，文章可能会变得非常长，从作者的角度来看，这对任何人都没有帮助。OC-SVM较为陈旧，主要基于支持向量机（SVM），这是该领域的一种著名方法。因此，我们认为没有必要重新解释该算法；相反，我们解释了将SVM用于单类学习应用的哲学思想，并讨论了其进一步的改进。此外，正如其他评审者所提到的，我会请您参考对深度学习方法进行的精心选择和充分讨论，以满足领域新手或专家的需求。第9节的解释：本节的标题为“未来工作”，而未来工作，从定义上讲，可以独立展开。我们尽力不仅提供对未来领域的直觉，还提供实证证据来支持我们的主张，正如您在优点中所提到的。此外，我们也在可能的情况下在不同未来工作之间建立了联系；例如，我们揭示了对抗攻击（具有大扰动噪声）作为数据增强技术生成虚假异常样本以改进AD方法性能的能力，这与它们在领域中的常见功能完全不同。此外，我会请您参考“开放世界识别”，它讨论了实施分布外检测、异常检测和开放集识别方法的实际挑战。最后，我们在每种方法的相应解释中讨论了不同方法的共同点。例如，查看(4.13)的描述，它讨论了GOAD与GT和DSVDD的相似性。还解释了在AD和OOD中被视为不同技术的几项工作，隐含地引入了相同的技术“异常暴露”，如6.6和4.10。还有许多其他相似之处在解释中得到了讨论。| 统一视角，AD+ND，缺失引用：感谢您的评论。关于统一视角：请知悉，这里的统一综述是指这些任务，即OSR、ND、AD和ODD是如何相关/连接的（作为我们的主要贡献？如果您知道有另一篇论文全面讨论该领域的这一关键问题，请告知我们）。以及这些任务的主要区别。我们并不倾向于提供对先前提出方法的统一视角（关于这方面已有许多综述论文）。通过这种方式，我们解释并展示了这些任务是如何连接的。请参见图1和2，表1，以及引言和评估协议部分。我们只是解释了每个任务的重要先前方法，以使文章对读者更有益。总之，我们可以强调，本文的信息是提供对这些相关任务的统一概览（而非方法）。我们建议评审者再次完整阅读文章（不跳过任何部分）以获取文章的中心信息。关于ND和AD：我猜您遗漏了论文的某些部分。我们已澄清/解释了ND和AD是两种不同的方法。然而，大多数论文中社区将两者视为相同。我们在解释方法时遵循了社区的做法，同时在其他部分提供了更多解释。综述的目的不是提供先前方法的 technical novelty，而是对最显著的前期方法进行全面回顾，您可以看到我们已做到了这一点。关于图片原始论文的引用：我们不同意您的观点；在解释方法（论文）的每个部分，我们都引用了原始论文，这表明该部分的所有材料都借用了该论文。请仔细阅读文本，如果您仍不改变主意，我们可以在每个图表的标题中引用原始论文。

paper_title: The Hertfordshire Cohort Study: an overview
paper_abstract: The Hertfordshire Cohort Study is a nationally unique study of men and women born in the English county of Hertfordshire in the early part of the 20 th century. Records that detail their health in infancy and childhood have been preserved, their sociodemographic, lifestyle, medical and biological attributes have been characterised in later life, and routinely collected data on their hospital use and mortality have been acquired. This paper provides an overview of the study since its inception in the 1980s, including its methods, findings, and plans for its future.
review_content: This is a clearly written overview of the Hertfordshire Cohort Study. The manuscript presents the background leading to the start of the Cohort and then logically describes the study phases and methods with clear summary tables of the variables collected. The manuscript reports key outcomes in some of the major areas of research that have been conducted using the Cohort, particularly in relation to bone and musculoskeletal health and diet. Details of linkage to routinely collected data, contribution to genetic and epigenetic studies and key collaborators are listed. Plans for the future directions of the cohort, including recruitment to an intergenerational study are described. Overall, the manuscript provides a very useful reference tool and resource for parties interested in collaborating with the Southampton team. My only suggestion for improvement of the manuscript would be to add a paragraph on the limitations of the Cohort e.g. whether there are variables that are not available or with missing data, and whether the lack of these data means that there are certain study questions that cannot be readily addressed using the Cohort. For example, it does not appear that pregnancy-related variables are available in the original cohort, but I presume some may be available in the new intergenerational cohort?
paper_title_zh: 赫特福德郡队列研究：概览
paper_abstract_zh: 赫特福德郡队列研究是一项全国独一无二的研究，研究对象为20世纪初出生于英格兰赫特福德郡的男性和女性。他们的婴儿期和儿童期健康记录得以保存，其社会人口学、生活方式、医学和生物学特征在晚年得到了表征，并且获取了他们医院使用和死亡率的常规收集数据。本文自20世纪80年代研究开始以来，对其方法、发现以及未来的计划进行了概述。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇关于赫特福德郡队列研究的清晰概述。该手稿介绍了启动队列研究的背景，然后逻辑性地描述了研究阶段和方法，并附有清晰总结所收集变量的表格。手稿报告了使用该队列进行的一些主要研究领域的关键结果，尤其是与骨骼和肌肉骨骼健康以及饮食相关的研究。列出了与常规收集数据的链接细节、对遗传和表观遗传学研究的贡献以及主要合作者。描述了队列未来方向的计划，包括招募参与代际研究。总体而言，该手稿为有兴趣与南安普顿团队合作的一方提供了非常有用的参考工具和资源。我对改进手稿的唯一建议是增加一段关于队列局限性的内容，例如是否存在不可用或缺失数据的变量，以及这些数据的缺失是否意味着某些研究问题无法轻易使用该队列来解决。例如，原始队列中似乎没有提供与怀孕相关的变量，但我推测在新一代际队列中可能会有一些可用？

paper_title: Prevalence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease at high altitude: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: Background and Objective: Recently, several studies have investigated the prevalence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) at high altitude (＞1500m). However, much remains to be understood about the correlation between altitude and COPD. We aimed to summarize the prevalence of COPD at high-altitudes and find out if altitude could be a risk factor for COPD.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting The study “Prevalence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease at high altitude: a systematic review and meta-analysis” is a well-written article that identifies an important gap. However, to make this paper publishable, the author needs to respond to the following points. Abstract. 1. Include the objective of the study. Thanks for your suggestion. We have added the objective of the study in abstract and marked it with yellow. 2. If the objective was to analyze previous studies to conduct a meta-analysis and summarize the prevalence of COPD at high-altitudes and explore whether altitude is an independent risk factor affecting the prevalence of COPD; Why is the conclusion in terms of incidence? Thanks for your suggestion. We have replaced incidence with prevalence in the conclusion. The revised parts were marked with yellow. Experimental design Methods. The study "Prevalence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease at high altitude: a systematic review and meta-analysis" is original and there are new data. Methods were described in detail, but there are some points that must be addressed: 1. The bibliographic search in four databases (PubMed/Medline, Cochrane Library, WoS, and Embase) is very limited. They should include other databases (SCOPUS, OVID, ScieLO, and LiLacs). Thanks for your suggestion. We have added the data of SCOPUS, OVID and Chinese Biomedical Literature Database (CBM) databases in our study. Studies in other two databases (ScieLO and LiLacs) were regional electronic bibliographic databases. Cochrane Handbook 5.2 recommended to use CBM in China (Page 6.6-Box 6.2.a), so we searched CBM instead of the other two databases (ScieLO and LiLacs). The revised parts were highlighted with yellow in our manuscript and Figure 1. 2. What was the definition of high altitude? Thanks for your suggestion. We defined high altitude as >1500 meters above sea level. The definition of high altitude was added in our manuscript and marked with yellow. 3. Was high altitude defined as >1500 m above sea level? Thanks for your suggestion. Our definition for high altitude was >1500 m above sea level. Validity of the findings Results: 1. The analyses are robust, and statistically sound. Thanks for your appraisal. 2. If the authors included cross-sectional (prevalence) studies. Why were determined the results and the conclusion in terms of incidence? Thanks for your suggestion. We have replaced “incidence” with “prevalence”. The revised parts were highlighted with yellow. 3. I suggest including Mexico in Table 1 study of Ana Maria Menezes/Country “Americas”. Thanks for your suggestion. We have added Mexico to the study of Ana Maria Menezes/Country “Americas”. Revised part was marked with yellow in Table 1. 4. For a better understanding of the readers, in the Forest plot (Figures 2, 3 and 4) include the prevalence rates (values) of COPD. Thanks for your suggestion. We have replaced ES with prevalence rate in Figure 2,3. Figure 4 is a forest for assessing whether altitude is a risk factor for developing COPD, there is necessary to use Odds Ratio (OR). 5. For in study of Andre´s Caballero (Colombia), how they have synthesized the prevalence rates for COPD in Medellin and Bogotá, (height 1538 and 2640 m, respectively). Thanks for your suggestion. We have separated the two data and analyzed the prevalence rate respectively. The revised parts were showed in Figure 2 and Figure 3. Discussion: 1. Revise. Line 175. “...incidence of COPD at high altitude…” in results is as prevalence. Thanks for your suggestion. We have revised it and marked it with yellow. 2. The conclusions should be appropriately stated in terms of prevalence (not incidence). Thanks for your suggestion. We have replaced incidence with prevalence in conclusions. The revised parts were marked with yellow. Comments for the author The manuscript is clearly written. If there are comments as I have noted above, which should be improved upon before Acceptance.
paper_title_zh: 高海拔地区慢性阻塞性肺疾病的患病率：系统综述与Meta分析
paper_abstract_zh: 背景与目的：近期，多项研究调查了高海拔（＞1500米）地区慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的患病率。然而，关于海拔与COPD之间的相关性仍有许多待解之谜。我们旨在总结高海拔地区COPD的患病率，并探讨海拔是否为COPD的风险因素。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2 基本报告

该研究“高海拔地区慢性阻塞性肺疾病的患病率：系统综述与荟萃分析”是一篇写得很好的文章，指出了一个重要空白。然而，为了让这篇文章能够发表，作者需要回应以下要点。

摘要：
1. 包含研究目标。感谢您的建议。我们已在摘要中添加了研究目标，并用黄色标记。
2. 如果目标是分析以往研究以进行荟萃分析，并总结高海拔地区慢性阻塞性肺疾病（COPD）的患病率，并探讨海拔是否是影响COPD患病率的独立风险因素；为什么结论是用发病率来表述的？感谢您的建议。我们已将结论中的“发病率”替换为“患病率”。修订部分已用黄色标记。

实验设计 方法：
该研究“高海拔地区慢性阻塞性肺疾病的患病率：系统综述与荟萃分析”具有原创性，并且有新数据。方法描述详细，但有些要点必须解决：
1. 在四个数据库（PubMed/Medline、Cochrane Library、WoS和Embase）中的文献检索非常有限。应包括其他数据库（SCOPUS、OVID、ScieLO和LiLacs）。感谢您的建议。我们已在研究中添加了SCOPUS、OVID和中国生物医学文献数据库（CBM）的数据。其他两个数据库（ScieLO和LiLacs）是区域性电子文献数据库。Cochrane手册5.2建议在中国使用CBM（第6.6页-框6.2.a），因此我们搜索了CBM而不是其他两个数据库（ScieLO和LiLacs）。修订部分在我们的手稿和图1中用黄色突出显示。
2. 高海拔的定义是什么？感谢您的建议。我们将高海拔定义为海拔超过1500米。高海拔的定义已添加到我们的手稿中，并用黄色标记。
3. 高海拔是否定义为海拔超过1500米？感谢您的建议。我们对高海拔的定义是海拔超过1500米。

研究结果的有效性 结果：
1. 分析稳健，统计合理。感谢您的评价。
2. 如果作者包括了横断面（患病率）研究，为什么结果和结论是用发病率来确定的？感谢您的建议。我们已将“发病率”替换为“患病率”。修订部分已用黄色突出显示。
3. 我建议在表1的Ana Maria Menezes/Country“美洲”研究中包括墨西哥。感谢您的建议。我们已将墨西哥添加到Ana Maria Menezes/Country“美洲”研究中。修订部分在表1中用黄色标记。
4. 为了让读者更好地理解，在森林图（图2、3和4）中包括COPD的患病率（数值）。感谢您的建议。我们已在图2、3中用患病率替换了ES。图4是用于评估海拔是否是COPD发展风险因素的森林图，有必要使用比值比（OR）。
5. 在Andrés Caballero（哥伦比亚）的研究中，他们是如何综合麦德林和波哥大（海拔分别为1538米和2640米）的COPD患病率的？感谢您的建议。我们将两个数据分开，并分别分析了患病率。修订部分显示在图2和图3中。

讨论：
1. 修订。第175行。“...高海拔地区COPD的发病率...”在结果中应为患病率。感谢您的建议。我们已进行修订并用黄色标记。
2. 结论应适当用患病率（而非发病率）来表述。感谢您的建议。我们已在结论中将发病率替换为患病率。修订部分已用黄色标记。

对作者的意见：
手稿书写清晰。如果按照我上述所提的意见进行改进，则可接受发表。

paper_title: Intrathecal Drug Delivery (ITDD) systems for cancer pain
paper_abstract: Intrathecal drug delivery is an effective pain management option for patients with chronic and cancer pain. The delivery of drugs into the intrathecal space provides superior analgesia with smaller doses of analgesics to minimize side effects while significantly improving quality of life. This article aims to provide a general overview of the use of intrathecal drug delivery to manage pain, dosing recommendations, potential risks and complications, and growing trends in the field.
review_content:
This is an informative review (written with the general practitioner in mind) that provides the basic information and rationale for using ITDD for the treatment of cancer pain.

I have one major reservation and a few suggestions:

1. Cancer pain can be managed by a variety of practitioners; in the majority of situations it will fall under the purview of the patient’s primary oncologist or a primary care physician, who typically are unfamiliar with ITDDs. It would be very helpful, in my view, to add a paragraph that would outline in more detail when one should start thinking about referring a patient for consideration of ITDD? What criteria does the patient need to meet? E.g. life expectancy? Whom such patients should be referred to? Who will manage the pump after the implantation? How is it going to affect further treatment such as chemotherapy or radiation? What kind of treatment break one can expect? This kind of information is crucial for the treating oncologist. Some of this information is already in the text, however it would be very useful to organize it better and add some more specific and practical information. Perhaps in a form of a table?

A few clarifications may be needed:

Table 2:
- Is Meperidine still used as an opioid in ITDD? Its clinical use, especially in cancer pain, has been basically eliminated.
- NMDA receptor – consider adding Methadone. Methadone is an opioid but also has NMDA activity

Page 7:
- In the US, the commonly used term is “cancer pain”, instead of “carcinoma pain”


Marcin Chwistek, MD FAAHPM

paper_title: Current state of knowledge on Wolbachia infection among Coleoptera: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. Despite great progress in studies on Wolbachia infection in insects, the knowledge about its relations with beetle species, populations and individuals, and the effects of bacteria on these hosts is still unsatisfactory. In this review we summarize the current state of knowledge about Wolbachia occurrence and interactions with Coleopteran hosts. Methods. An intensive search of the available literature resulted in the selection of 81 publications that describe the relevant details about Wolbachia presence among beetles. These publications were then examined with respect to the distribution and taxonomy of infected hosts and diversity of Wolbachia found in beetles. Sequences of Wolbachia genes (16S rDNA, wsp and ftsZ) were used for the phylogenetic analyses.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting - language ok, but many typos and orthographic errors Experimental design - interesting topic - severe doubts on completeness of data source - table S1 incomplete Validity of the findings - review article, no essentially new findings Comments for the Author Kajtoch and Kotásková present a review about Wolbachia infections in Coleoptera. Similar reviews have, in the last years, been published for other insect species and, while not adding many new facts to the body of literature, they are usually helpful tools for further research. Until now, such a review was missing for beetles. My main concern here is the integrity of the original dataset. The authors used Google Scholar for literature search. This uncurated, crawler-based search engine is without any doubts extremely valuable for everyday literature recherché, but has some notable limitations: It is notoriously missing important papers, especially if published in the pre-digital era, and, at the same time, adding doubtful or obviously non-scientific sources to the search results. The latter issue may be overcome by careful manual inspection of the search results, the former one not. For these reasons, Web of Science (WoS) has remained the gold standard for scientific literature research. This database has its limitations, too, and is furthermore prohibitively expensive for smaller research institutions, but it is manually curated and covering all SCI journals since more than 100 years. The authors mention that they retrieved 113 hits by searching for “Wolbachia” AND “Coleoptera”, “Wolbachia” AND, “beetles”, and “Wolbachia” AND “[names of all beetle families, separately]”. It is slightly disturbing that these hits also contain work not found in the database but added by the authors based on not further defined "expert knowledge", and that this material contains non-citable publications like unpublished articles and conference talks. I did a small experiment and searched WoS (retrieved 26 November 2017) for the first two terms the authors have used. "Wolbachia AND coleoptera" gave 164 hits, "Wolbachia AND beetles" 157 hits, and the merging of both lists resulted in 232 papers. While several of these hits would be lost in the manual verification step, I am still sure that the data source used here is highly incomplete. > We are very grateful for this highly important remark. We repeated our literature search and indeed we found that google.scholar missed many papers, including 24 publications which must be included in our review. There are much more publications which were found in both databases and also many which refer to more general studies without any new and/or relevant data from beetles, and many also which refer to earlier publications but without any novel findings. After exclusions of all these publications we used 81 records. This also increase number of Wolbachia infected beetles to 197 taxa. I have also one important technical remark on the data source as given in Supplementary Table S1: The citations are worthless when no biographic information (year, journal name, volume, page numbers) is provided. This essential information must be added, otherwise the work is unpublishable. > All these references were and are included in list of references listed in the manuscript as this is the most important part where all references should be included. To be precise, we have also add all references cited in suppl. table 1 to this file (below the table). Minor remarks: - l156: "Maximum likelihood trees were inferred using Maximum likelihood" – well, this does not come as a surprise. > Sorry for this obvious error - corrected. - l159: "substation model" ? > Should be: substitution – corrected. - l343: Is this a "tree", or is it a "network"? Only one can apply. > Again, thank you for noticed this – corrected as “tree” - l409: Please do not begin sentences with words like "But". > Right, corrected. - l411f: NGS is currently revolutionizing molecular ecology and will have its merits in many Wolbachia-related projects yet to come. Anyway, I do not agree that NGS is mandatory to understand Wolbachia diversity. The majority if insect species, and thus Wolbachia strains, is located in countries that, for simple economical reasons, cannot afford NGS in the near to middle future. In contrast, universities in low developed countries are capable of PCR and Sanger techniques, and they sit at the source of large parts of Earth's biodiversity. We should rather encourage such institutions to assess the local biodiversity with simple but efficient techniques like MLST, not discourage them with the NGS overkill. > We agree with this conclusion and this fragment has been rewritten to highlight that MLST is sufficient for understanding Wolbachia diversity, whereas NGS could be helpful for some more detailed studies. - l453: Wolbachia gene transfer into the nucleus has been firstly described ten years ago (Dunning Hotopp et al., 2007), and that only two examples are known today is simply not true. Koutsovoulos, Makepeace, Tanya, & Blaxter (2014) and Funkhouser-Jones et al. (2015) are two quite recent examples out of several others. It is shameful when a literature review article misses a broad body of published research. > This sentence, as the whole review, refers only to studies on beetles, and far we know, there are only 2 papers which report such cases in Coleoptera. However, to not left any ambiguities, we modified this fragment. - Finally, the paper contains a lot of typos, false uses of the comma, missing or additional spaces, and some orthographic errors. It should be copy-edited carefully. > The manuscript has been again checked by native-speaker (EnglishPad company). References Dunning Hotopp, J. C., Clark, M. E., Oliveira, D. C. S. G., Foster, J. paper_title_zh: 鞘翅目昆虫沃尔巴克氏菌感染的现有知识状况：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。尽管在昆虫沃尔巴克氏菌感染研究方面取得了巨大进展，但关于其与甲虫种类、种群和个体的关系，以及细菌对这些宿主的影响的知识仍然不尽如人意。在这篇综述中，我们总结了目前关于沃尔巴克氏菌在鞘翅目宿主中的发生及其相互作用的认知现状。方法。通过对现有文献的深入检索，筛选出81篇描述沃尔巴克氏菌在甲虫中存在相关细节的出版物。这些出版物随后被用于分析感染宿主的分布和分类学，以及甲虫中发现的沃尔巴克氏菌的多样性。沃尔巴克氏菌基因序列（16S rDNA、wsp和ftsZ）被用于系统发育分析。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）
基本报告 - 语言尚可，但存在许多错别字和拼写错误
实验设计 - 主题有趣 - 对数据源的完整性有严重怀疑 - 表格S1不完整
研究结果的有效性 - 综述文章，无本质上新的发现
对作者的评论
Kajtoch和Kotásková撰写了一篇关于鞘翅目昆虫沃尔巴克氏菌感染的综述。近年来，类似的综述已针对其他昆虫物种发表，尽管没有为文献体系增添太多新事实，但它们通常是进一步研究的有用工具。迄今为止，甲虫类尚缺乏此类综述。我主要关注的是原始数据集的完整性。作者使用Google Scholar进行文献检索。这个未经筛选、基于爬虫的搜索引擎无疑对日常文献检索极具价值，但也有一些显著的局限性：它通常会遗漏重要论文，尤其是那些在数字化时代之前发表的论文，同时还会将可疑或明显非科学的来源添加到搜索结果中。后一个问题可以通过仔细的人工检查搜索结果来克服，但前一个问题则无法解决。因此，Web of Science（WoS）一直是科学文献研究的黄金标准。该数据库也有其局限性，并且对于较小的研究机构来说价格昂贵，但它是由人工筛选的，并且涵盖了100多年来所有的SCI期刊。作者提到，他们通过搜索“Wolbachia” AND “Coleoptera”、“Wolbachia” AND “beetles”以及“Wolbachia” AND “[所有甲虫科名称，分别]”检索到113条结果。令人稍感不安的是，这些结果中也包含了一些未在数据库中找到但基于未进一步定义的“专业知识”由作者添加的工作，并且这些材料包含未发表的文章和会议报告等不可引用的出版物。我做了一个小实验，在WoS（检索日期为2017年11月26日）中搜索了作者使用的头两个术语。“Wolbachia AND coleoptera”得到164条结果，“Wolbachia AND beetles”得到157条结果，合并两个列表后共有232篇论文。尽管在人工验证步骤中会丢失一些结果，但我仍然确信这里使用的数据源高度不完整。
> 我们非常感谢这一极为重要的意见。我们重新进行了文献检索，确实发现google.scholar遗漏了许多论文，包括24篇必须纳入我们综述的出版物。还有更多在两个数据库中都找到的出版物，以及许多涉及更普遍研究但未提供任何新的和/或与甲虫相关数据的出版物，还有许多引用早期出版物但无新发现的论文。在排除所有这些出版物后，我们使用了81条记录。这也使得感染沃尔巴克氏菌的甲虫种类增加到197个分类群。 我对补充表S1中给出的数据源还有一个重要的技术性评论：如果没有提供传记信息（年份、期刊名称、卷号、页码），引用就毫无价值。必须添加这些基本信息，否则该作品无法发表。> 所有这些参考文献都已包含在稿件的参考文献列表中，因为这是所有参考文献应该包含的最重要部分。准确地说，我们还将补充表1中引用的所有参考文献添加到了该文件中（表下方）。次要评论：- l156：“最大似然树是通过最大似然法推断的”——这并不令人意外。> 为此明显错误道歉——已更正。- l159：“substation模型”？> 应为：substitution——已更正。- l343：这是“树”还是“网络”？只能选其一。> 再次感谢您的指出——已更正为“树”。- l409：请不要以“但是”之类的词开始句子。> 对，已更正。- l411f：NGS目前正在革新分子生态学，并将对许多即将进行的沃尔巴克氏体相关项目有所贡献。然而，我不同意NGS是理解沃尔巴克氏体多样性的必要条件。大多数昆虫物种，以及相应的沃尔巴克氏体菌株，位于那些由于简单经济原因在近期到中期内无法负担NGS的国家。相反，欠发达国家的大学能够进行PCR和桑格技术，它们位于地球大部分生物多样性的源头。我们应鼓励这些机构使用简单但高效的MLST技术评估当地生物多样性，而不是用NGS过度打击它们。> 我们同意这一结论，并已重写该片段，强调MLST足以理解沃尔巴克氏体多样性，而NGS可能对某些更详细的研究有所帮助。- l453：沃尔巴克氏体基因转移到细胞核中的情况在十年前首次被描述（Dunning Hotopp等人，2007年），而目前仅知道两个例子这一说法并不准确。Koutsovoulos、Makepeace、Tanya和Blaxter（2014年）以及Funkhouser-Jones等人（2015年）是除其他几个例子之外的最近两个例子。一篇文献综述文章遗漏了大量已发表的研究是可耻的。> 该句子，以及整篇综述，仅涉及对甲虫的研究，据我们所知，在鞘翅目中只有两篇论文报告了此类案例。然而，为了避免任何歧义，我们已修改该片段。- 最后，论文中存在大量错别字、逗号误用、缺失或多余的空格以及一些拼写错误。应仔细进行校对。> 手稿已再次由母语者（EnglishPad公司）检查。参考文献 Dunning Hotopp, J. C., Clark, M. E., Oliveira, D. C. S. G., Foster, J. M., Fischer, P., Muñoz Torres, M. C., … Werren, J. H. (2007). 广泛从细胞内细菌到多细胞真核生物的横向基因转移。《科学》（纽约，N.Y.），317(5845)，1753–1756。doi:10.1126/science.1142490 Funkhouser-Jones, L. J., Sehnert, S. R., Martínez-Rodríguez, P., Toribio-Fernández, R., Pita, M., Bella, J. L., & Bordenstein, S. R. (2015)。沃尔巴克氏菌在杂交区的共感染：发现来自两个沃尔巴克氏菌超群的横向基因转移进入动物基因组。《PeerJ》，3，e1479。doi:10.7717/peerj.1479 Koutsovoulos, G., Makepeace, B., Tanya, V. N., & Blaxter, M. (2014)。通过在强鞭虫纲线虫中的沃尔巴克氏菌基因组化石揭示的古共生。《PLOS遗传学》，10(6)，e1004397。doi:10.1371/journal.pgen.1004397

paper_title: Functional genomic approaches to improve crop plant heat stress tolerance
paper_abstract: Heat stress as a yield limiting issue has become a major threat for food security as global warming progresses. Being sessile, plants cannot avoid heat stress. They respond to heat stress by activating complex molecular networks, such as signal transduction, metabolite production and expressions of heat stress-associated genes. Some plants have developed an intricate signalling network to respond and adapt it. Heat stress tolerance is a polygenic trait, which is regulated by various genes, transcriptional factors, proteins and hormones. Therefore, to improve heat stress tolerance, a sound knowledge of various mechanisms involved in the response to heat stress is required. The classical breeding methods employed to enhance heat stress tolerance has had limited success. In this era of genomics, next generation sequencing techniques, availability of genome sequences and advanced biotechnological tools open several windows of opportunities to improve heat stress tolerance in crop plants. This review discusses the potential of various functional genomic approaches, such as genome wide association studies, microarray, and suppression subtractive hybridization, in the process of discovering novel genes related to heat stress, and their functional validation using both reverse and forward genetic approaches. This review also discusses how these functionally validated genes can be used to improve heat stress tolerance through plant breeding, transgenics and genome editing approaches.
review_content:

  * The conclusion need to be ameliorate because it is very brief.
The review discussed very well and comprehensively the context of current literature.

All statements are correct and author can refer to others citations to make the paper more supported.

The review is written with good English and it did not need any improvement.

  * Cushman J.C., Bohnert H.J. 2000. Genomic approaches to plant stress tolerance. Genome studies and molecular genetics, 3:117–1242.
In general, this review can be accepted with minor revision.
paper_title_zh: 功能基因组学方法提高作物植物耐热性
paper_abstract_zh: 热应激作为限制产量的因素，随着全球变暖的加剧，已成为粮食安全的主要威胁。由于植物是固着的，无法避免热应激。它们通过激活复杂的分子网络来响应热应激，例如信号转导、代谢物产生和热应激相关基因的表达。一些植物已发展出复杂的信号网络来响应和适应热应激。热应激耐受性是一个多基因性状，受多种基因、转录因子、蛋白质和激素的调控。因此，为了提高热应激耐受性，需要对参与热应激响应的各种机制有深入的了解。传统的育种方法在增强热应激耐受性方面取得了有限的成效。在基因组学时代，下一代测序技术、基因组序列的可用性和先进的生物技术工具为提高作物植物的热应激耐受性提供了多个机遇窗口。本文综述了各种功能基因组学方法（如全基因组关联研究、微阵列和抑制性消减杂交）在发现与热应激相关的新基因及其通过正反向遗传学方法进行功能验证的潜力。本文还讨论了如何利用这些经过功能验证的基因，通过植物育种、转基因和基因组编辑方法来提高热应激耐受性。

paper_title: Autophagy and airway fibrosis: Is there a link?
paper_abstract: In the past decade, an emerging process named “autophagy” has generated intense interest in many chronic lung diseases. Tissue remodeling and fibrosis is a common feature of many airway diseases, and current therapies do not prevent or reverse these structural changes. Autophagy has evolved as a conserved process for bulk degradation and recycling of cytoplasmic components to maintain basal cellular homeostasis and healthy organelle populations in the cell. Furthermore, autophagy serves as a cell survival mechanism and can also be induced by chemical and physical stress to the cell. Accumulating evidence demonstrates that autophagy plays an essential role in vital cellular processes, including tissue remodeling. This review will discuss some of the recent advancements made in understanding the role of this fundamental process in airway fibrosis with emphasis on airway remodeling, and how autophagy can be exploited as a target for airway remodeling in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
review_content:
Summary statement
Kota et al. present an interesting and challenging subject for review – the interrelationship between autophagy in the context of airway diseases that exhibit airway remodelling as a major pathological feature. Challenging because we still have a lot to learn about both airway remodelling, and indeed the diseases such as asthma and COPD that potentiate fibrotic airway changes, and further still the contribution of increased or blocked autophagy as a driver, or parallel phenomena in this scenario. Overall they provide a needed and good start to the discussion, that will no doubt pioneer further debate in these areas off airway pathobiology. Hence, one leaves this review thinking about the link between fibrosis and autophagy, but also, wondering what insight they gained to direct new lines of inquiry.

Major comments
As stated, this is by no means an easy literature review to compose. At first one would think this is due to limited publication of such studies. However, a PubMed search using “Fibrosis[Title] and Autophagy[Title]”, show there are 83 hits for this query. While the vast majority are not respiratory in nature, it would be beneficial if Kota et al. could use mechanistic insights from other diseases to draw hypothetical parallels with the situation that may be occurring in the airways, which they elude to in paragraph 2 under the heading “Autophagy and fibrotic airway remodelling”, but little supposition is made in regards to this thereafter. Indeed, this paragraph is possibly the only one which directly address the subject matter stated by the title. Refreshingly however, they generously state new unpublished finding (on three occasions) from their laboratory which provides insight for the reader and which have the potential to direct further lines if understanding.

A current question for autophagy is: is it a block in autophagic flux leading to (or contributing to) the cellular dyshomeostasis, or is autophagy increased because it is unable to manage the protracted/chronic disease stressors? While Kota et al. touch upon this question for COPD, and correctly state that there is significant conjecture with regards to this, subsequent discussion mainly lent to the increased autophagy scenario, with an extended discussion with regards to cilia (ciliophagy). Indeed, we now know the relationship between cilia and autophagy is a complex dual interaction whereby they foster each other’s activity/generation rather than a one way situation where increased autophagy leads to the degradation of cilia (Pampliega et al., 2016). Hence, some new insights/thoughts which could weigh into the autophagic flux vs. increased autophagy debate would be welcomed.

Further, airway fibrosis occurs as a result of the chronic inflammation (in addition to e.g. altered smooth muscle-epithelia interactions, between themselves and the inflammatory cells), while autophagy is known to be an anti-inflammatory mechanism. Hence, beyond TGFβ, some insights into how the dysregulation of autophagy leads to fibrosis driven by complex inflammatory changes at the airways would have been informative.

Hence, while this review most certainly warrants publication, and marks yet another achievement for the Oliver laboratory, the informed reader may ask for more than the start of the dialogue presented in this particular review.


Minor comments
The manner of composition on occasions lacks maturity. For example, “ATG5 encodes a protein of 276 amino acids”, is not needed in a review article. The chronological presentation of concepts/studies, should be forfeited to a style of writing that groups and discusses processes to illustrate a pattern of phenomena that helps orient/inform the reader. Avoid using definite statements such as “clearly indicates”, particularly in a review, and especially in areas where we have so much more to learn such as is the case for chronic lung disease and autophagy. Finally, approximately one third of the 55 references are review articles.
paper_title_zh: 自噬与气道纤维化：是否存在关联？
paper_abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，一种名为“自噬”的新兴过程在许多慢性肺部疾病中引起了强烈兴趣。组织重塑和纤维化是许多气道疾病的共同特征，而当前的治疗方法并不能预防或逆转这些结构变化。自噬已演变为一种保守的过程，用于大量降解和回收细胞质成分，以维持基础细胞稳态和细胞内健康细胞器的数量。此外，自噬作为一种细胞生存机制，也可以由化学和物理应激诱导。越来越多的证据表明，自噬在重要的细胞过程中发挥着关键作用，包括组织重塑。本综述将讨论一些在理解这一基本过程在气道纤维化中的作用方面的最新进展，重点讨论气道重塑，以及如何将自噬作为哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺疾病中气道重塑的靶点。
review_content_zh:
**总结陈述**
Kota等人提出了一个有趣且具有挑战性的综述主题——在以气道重塑为主要病理特征的气道疾病背景下，自噬与这些疾病之间的相互关系。之所以具有挑战性，是因为我们对气道重塑以及诸如哮喘和COPD等促进纤维化气道改变的疾病仍有许多需要了解的地方，此外，还需进一步探讨增加或受阻的自噬作为驱动因素或在这一情景中的平行现象的贡献。总体而言，他们为这一讨论提供了必要且良好的开端，无疑将开创这些气道病理生物学领域的进一步辩论。因此，读者在读完这篇综述后，会思考纤维化与自噬之间的联系，同时也会好奇他们获得了哪些见解以指导新的研究方向。

**主要评论**
如前所述，这绝非一篇容易撰写的文献综述。起初，人们可能会认为这是因为此类研究的发表有限。然而，通过PubMed搜索“Fibrosis[标题]和Autophagy[标题]”，发现共有83篇相关文献。尽管绝大多数文献并非呼吸系统疾病相关，但如果Kota等人能利用其他疾病的机制见解，与可能发生在气道中的情况进行假设性类比，将是有益的，他们在“自噬与纤维化气道重塑”标题下的第二段中提到了这一点，但此后几乎没有进行更多推测。实际上，这一段可能是唯一直接论述标题所述主题的部分。然而，令人耳目一新的是，他们慷慨地介绍了实验室中三项未发表的新发现，为读者提供了见解，并有可能指导进一步的理解方向。

当前关于自噬的一个问题是：是自噬通量的阻断导致了（或促成了）细胞内稳态失衡，还是因为自噬无法应对持续/慢性疾病应激而增加？尽管Kota等人触及了COPD的这一问题，并正确指出对此存在显著争议，但随后的讨论主要倾向于自噬增加的情况，特别是对纤毛（纤毛自噬）的扩展讨论。实际上，我们现在知道纤毛与自噬之间的关系是复杂的双向互动，它们相互促进彼此的活动/生成，而不是单方面的自噬增加导致纤毛降解（Pampliega等人，2016年）。因此，一些新的见解/思考，如果能加入自噬通量与自噬增加的辩论中将是非常受欢迎的。

此外，气道纤维化是慢性炎症的结果（除了例如平滑肌-上皮相互作用改变，以及它们与炎症细胞之间的相互作用），而自噬被认为是一种抗炎机制。因此，除了TGFβ之外，如果能提供一些关于自噬失调如何导致由气道复杂炎症变化驱动的纤维化的见解，将是有益的。

因此，尽管这篇综述绝对值得发表，并标志着Oliver实验室的又一成就，但见多识广的读者可能会要求比这篇综述所呈现的对话开端更多的内容。

**次要评论**
文章的撰写方式在某些情况下显得不够成熟。例如，“ATG5编码一种含有276个氨基酸的蛋白质”，这在综述文章中是不必要的。概念的/研究的年代顺序呈现，应放弃转而采用一种将过程分组并讨论的写作风格，以展示有助于引导/告知读者的现象模式。避免使用诸如“明确表明”之类的绝对陈述，特别是在综述中，尤其是在我们还有许多需要了解的领域，如慢性肺病和自噬。最后，大约三分之一的55篇参考文献是综述文章。

paper_title: Measurement properties of the translations of instruments evaluating the subjective effects of tobacco- and nicotine-containing products:  a systematic review of the literature
paper_abstract:
Background: Several instruments are widely used for assessing dependence, craving, withdrawal symptoms, and reinforcing effects in users of tobacco- and nicotine-containing products (TNP), including the Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence (FTND), Questionnaire of Smoking Urges, original (QSU) and brief (QSU-b) versions; Minnesota Nicotine Withdrawal Scale, original (MNWS) and revised (MNWS-R) versions; and Cigarette Evaluation Questionnaire, original (CEQ) and modified (mCEQ) versions. Although these instruments have been translated extensively, their translations and corresponding measurement properties have not been systematically assessed. This study aimed to (1) identify the translations of these instruments for which psychometric properties have been published, (2) describe the methods used for translation, and (3) describe the measurement properties and the context in which these translations were evaluated (e.g., target population and TNP used). 
 Methods: Embase and MEDLINE databases were systematically searched. 
 Results: While no information could be found for the CEQ/mCEQ, several translations were available for the remaining instruments: FTND, 25; QSU and QSU-b, 4 each; QSU (12-item version), 1; MNWS, 4; and MNWS-R, 1. Cigarette smokers represented the main target population in which the validation studies were conducted. Information about the translation process was reported for 25 translations. In most cases, the properties of the translations mirrored those of the originals. Differential item functioning was explored in only one case. 
 Conclusions: There are few publications describing the measurement properties of the translations of the FTND, QSU/QSU-b, and MNWS/MNWS-R. None of these translations have been validated for TNPs other than cigarettes, which suggests the need for greater development and validation of instruments in this area.
review_content:
The authors did a considerable effort in tracing and summarizing scientific articles related to the use of instruments for the assessment of nicotine dependence in languages different from the one in which they were originally created.

Despite this effort, I find the review quite difficult to follow because it is lacking a definite focus, ultimately resulting in point-by point description of what was or was not done in different studies. Indeed, the discussion of the results leads to rather general statements, some of which could be anticipated: not standardized processes translation/adaptation; heterogeneity of populations assessed; deficit of analysis of differential item functioning (DIF); lack of cross-cultural validation.

I suggest that the authors re-organize and summarize their valuable material along one (or both) of the following themes:
 1. Compare the procedures and the analyses done for the several language-specific versions of the scales with pre-defined gold-standards (as described in the methods section), for instance how should a sound translation be conducted and reported; how should content, construct validity, predictive validity, etc. be minimally investigated. As a result of this summary the reader will be informed on how many of the x-language versions of the y-instrument meet these criteria.
 2. Compare the psychometric properties of the different language-specific translations of a given instrument with the original one(s) analyzing the possible reasons for discrepancies, above all the characteristics of the involved samples. This work would be of crucial importance, since smoking populations are increasingly diversifying across different countries, with the emergence of both low-frequency smokers and heavy smokers with psychiatric co-morbidity. Suggested comparisons: population vs. clinical samples; heavy smokers vs light/moderate smokers.

Apart from these overarching considerations I have two additional points:
 1. Title: would be better to rephrase it so that it would be clear that “subjective effects” refer to symptoms of dependence (even dizziness after smoking is a subjective effect).
 2. I wonder why the Cigarette Dependence Scale (Etter et al., 20031) was not included in the search/results. I am aware of at least one study (Rydell et al., 20162) dealing with both translation of the original instrument and its adaptation to smokeless tobacco use.
paper_title_zh: 评估烟草和含尼古丁产品主观效应的工具翻译版本的测量属性：文献的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：多种工具被广泛用于评估烟草和含尼古丁产品（TNP）使用者的依赖性、渴望、戒断症状和强化效应，包括法格斯特伦尼古丁依赖测试（FTND）、吸烟渴望问卷（QSU）及其原始和简短版本（QSU-b）、明尼苏达尼古丁戒断量表（MNWS）及其原始和修订版本（MNWS-R）、以及香烟评估问卷（CEQ）及其原始和修改版本（mCEQ）。尽管这些工具已被广泛翻译，但其翻译及相应的测量属性尚未得到系统评估。本研究旨在（1）识别已发表心理测量属性的这些工具的翻译版本，（2）描述翻译所使用的方法，（3）描述这些翻译的测量属性及评估的背景（例如，目标人群和使用的TNP）。

方法：系统检索Embase和MEDLINE数据库。

结果：尽管未找到CEQ/mCEQ的相关信息，但其余工具存在多个翻译版本：FTND有25个；QSU和QSU-b各有4个；QSU（12项版本）有1个；MNWS有4个；MNWS-R有1个。验证研究的主要目标人群为香烟吸烟者。25个翻译版本报告了翻译过程的信息。在大多数情况下，翻译版本的属性与原始版本相似。仅在一例中探讨了差异项功能。

结论：描述FTND、QSU/QSU-b和MNWS/MNWS-R翻译版本测量属性的出版物较少。这些翻译版本均未针对除香烟以外的TNP进行验证，这表明在该领域需要进一步开发和验证相关工具。
review_content_zh:
作者在追踪和总结与使用非原始语言创建的尼古丁依赖评估工具相关的科学文章方面做出了相当大的努力。

尽管如此，我发现这篇综述相当难以理解，因为它缺乏明确的焦点，最终导致对各个研究中做了什么或没做什么的点对点描述。实际上，对结果的讨论导致了相当普遍的陈述，其中一些是可以预见的：未标准化的翻译/适应过程；评估人群的异质性；差异项目功能（DIF）分析的不足；缺乏跨文化验证。

我建议作者按照以下一个（或两个）主题重新组织和总结他们宝贵的材料：
1. 比较几种语言特定版本的量表的程序和分析与预定义的金标准（如方法部分所述），例如应该如何进行和报告可靠的翻译；应该如何最小化调查内容效度、结构效度、预测效度等。通过这种总结，读者将了解有多少x语言版本的y工具符合这些标准。
2. 比较给定工具的不同语言特定翻译版本与原始版本的心理测量属性，分析差异的可能原因，尤其是涉及样本的特征。这项工作至关重要，因为吸烟人群在不同国家日益多样化，出现了低频吸烟者和伴有精神共病的重度吸烟者。建议比较：普通人群与临床样本；重度吸烟者与轻度/中度吸烟者。

除了这些总体考虑之外，我还有两点补充：
1. 标题：最好重新措辞，以便清楚“主观效应”是指依赖症状（即使是吸烟后的头晕也是一种主观效应）。
2. 我想知道为什么未将香烟依赖量表（Etter等人，20031）纳入搜索/结果中。我至少知道有一项研究（Rydell等人，20162）涉及原始工具的翻译及其对无烟烟草使用的适应。

paper_title: Unifying the Perspectives of NLP and Software Engineering: A Survey on Language Models for Code
paper_abstract: In this work we systematically review the recent advancements in software engineering with language models, covering 70+ models, 40+ evaluation tasks, 180+ datasets, and 900 related works. Unlike previous works, we integrate software engineering (SE) with natural language processing (NLP) by discussing the perspectives of both sides: SE applies language models for development automation, while NLP adopts SE tasks for language model evaluation. We break down code processing models into general language models represented by the GPT family and specialized models that are specifically pretrained on code, often with tailored objectives. We discuss the relations and differences between these models, and highlight the historical transition of code modeling from statistical models and RNNs to pretrained Transformers and LLMs, which is exactly the same course that had been taken by NLP. We also go beyond programming and review LLMs' application in other software engineering activities including requirement engineering, testing, deployment, and operations in an endeavor to provide a global view of NLP in SE, and identify key challenges and potential future directions in this domain.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a survey of code processing methods using large language models. The paper explores related work in this field by surveying a range of models, datasets and tasks. As opposed to previous surveys, the paper proposes to bridge the gap between tasks coming from NLP and tasks proposed from a software engineering perspective, and surveys tasks and approaches from both perspectives. First, it surveys tasks coming from software engineering (sections 2.1.1 - 2.1.5). Then, it surveys tasks in NLP (section 2.1.6). In sections 4 and 5, the paper surveys general and specialized language models for coding. In section 6 the paper surveys some additional features added to language models for coding tasks. Finally, in section 7 the paper surveys advances of large language models in the software engineering process. Along these sections, the paper presents analyses of existing datasets, metrics and performance of state-of-the-art models for coding.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: - The paper presents an interesting survey that aims at closing a gap between efforts to use/evaluate language models from a software engineering perspective and the same efforts from an NLP/modelling perspective. The tasks surveyed in section 2 provide a useful framework to analyse language models from a perspective that could be more useful to software engineering. - The paper examines a vast amount of research from the two perspectives, which is according to what's expected for a survey, and adds experimental results to at least one of these perspectives which helps strenghten the contribution. Weaknesses: - Although I appreciate how systematically the paper presents existing work, and the effort on trying to bridge the gap between SE and NLP perspectives on language models for coding, the organization of the paper seems a bit disconnected from this intention. It seems like most of the content is related to the NLP/modelling perspective, while the SE perspective is only tangentially touched in section 2 by listing methods that perform each of these tasks. I would have expected that, after each perspective is presented (as in section 2), the existing language models would be analysed to the lens of both perspectives (in sections 4 and 5). Or, at least, a more clear "unifying perspective", as claimed in the title of the paper. - Related to the previous item: considering the thorough analyses regarding the performance of general and specialized language models presented in sections 4 and 5, which I assume cover the NLP/modelling perspective, it feels incomplete that the same type of experimental results are not presented for section 2, where specific types of tasks coming from the SE are mentioned. It would be useful to see actual experimental results for at least some of these SE tasks. - A minor point: readability of figures in section 2.1.1 - 2.1.5 could be improved by adding titles to the list of references presented in the last three columns of these diagrams.

**Requested Changes:**
Critical changes that would impact recommendation for acceptance: 1. Add experimental results for all or some of the SE tasks presented in 2.1.1 - 2.1.5, or clarify which of the experiments presented in sections 4 and 5 would cover these. Changes that would strengthen the work: 1. Make the 'unifying perspective' of SE and NLP/modelling perspectives of language models for coding clearer. 2. Improve readability of figures in sections 2.1.1 - 2.1.5.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No broader impact concerns.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 统一自然语言处理与软件工程视角：代码语言模型综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们系统地回顾了语言模型在软件工程中的最新进展，涵盖了70多个模型、40多项评估任务、180多个数据集以及900篇相关研究。与以往工作不同，我们将软件工程（SE）与自然语言处理（NLP）相结合，讨论了双方的视角：SE应用语言模型以实现开发自动化，而NLP则采用SE任务来评估语言模型。我们将代码处理模型分为以GPT家族为代表的一般语言模型和专门在代码上进行预训练的专用模型，这些专用模型通常具有定制化的目标。我们讨论了这些模型之间的关系和差异，并强调了代码建模的历史性转变，即从统计模型和RNN转向预训练的Transformer和大型语言模型（LLM），这一过程与NLP所经历的完全相同。我们还超越了编程领域，回顾了LLM在其他软件工程活动中的应用，包括需求工程、测试、部署和运维，旨在提供一个NLP在SE中的全局视角，并识别该领域的关键挑战和潜在的未来方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对使用大型语言模型的代码处理方法进行了综述。文章通过调查一系列模型、数据集和任务，探讨了该领域的相关工作。与之前的综述不同，本文旨在弥合来自自然语言处理（NLP）任务和从软件工程角度提出的任务之间的差距，并从这两个角度对任务和方法进行了综述。首先，综述了来自软件工程的任务（第2.1.1节至第2.1.5节）。然后，综述了NLP中的任务（第2.1.6节）。在第4节和第5节中，文章综述了用于编码的通用和专用语言模型。第6节综述了为编码任务添加到语言模型中的一些附加功能。最后，在第7节中，文章综述了大型语言模型在软件工程过程中的进展。在这些章节中，文章对现有数据集、指标和编码领域最先进模型的性能进行了分析。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：

paper_title: Role of RAS signaling in ovarian cancer
paper_abstract: The RAS family of proteins is among the most frequently mutated genes in human malignancies. In ovarian cancer (OC), the most lethal gynecological malignancy, RAS , especially KRAS mutational status at codons 12, 13, and 61, ranges from 6–65% spanning different histo-types. Normally RAS regulates several signaling pathways involved in a myriad of cellular signaling cascades mediating numerous cellular processes like cell proliferation, differentiation, invasion, and death. Aberrant activation of RAS leads to uncontrolled induction of several downstream signaling pathways such as RAF-1/MAPK (mitogen-activated protein kinase), PI3K phosphoinositide-3 kinase (PI3K)/AKT, RalGEFs, Rac/Rho, BRAF (v-Raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B), MEK1 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1), ERK (extracellular signal-regulated kinase), PKB (protein kinase B) and PKC (protein kinase C) involved in cell proliferation as well as maintenance pathways thereby driving tumorigenesis and cancer cell propagation. KRAS mutation is also known to be a biomarker for poor outcome and chemoresistance in OC. As a malignancy with several histotypes showing varying histopathological characteristics, we focus on reviewing recent literature showcasing the involvement of oncogenic RAS in mediating carcinogenesis and chemoresistance in OC and its subtypes.
review_content:
In this article the authors have highlighted the role of the RAS family of proteins in the pathogenesis of ovarian cancers. The article has covered a wide range of functional aspects of RAS including mutational aspects of RAS and its association with various signaling pathways such as RAF-1/MAPK (mitogen-activated protein kinase), PI3K phosphoinositide-3 kinase (PI3K)/AKT, RalGEFs, Rac/Rho, BRAF (v-Raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B), MEK1 (mitogen-activated protein kinase kinase 1), ERK (extracellular signal-regulated kinase), PKB (protein kinase B), and PKC (protein kinase C) involved in cell proliferation as well as maintenance pathways thereby driving tumorigenesis and cancer cell propagation.

It is an important addition to the current state of literature and a very timely one too. The manuscript is well written, and literature extensively reviewed. There are just a few minor issues to take care of before possible indexing:

paper_title: In-context Learning with Retrieved Demonstrations for Language Models: A Survey
paper_abstract: Large language models have demonstrated remarkable few-shot in-context learning (ICL) capabilities, adapting to new tasks with few-shots demonstrations. However, the efficacy of ICL is highly dependent on the selection of these demonstrations. Recent developments have introduced retrieval-based in-context learning (RetICL), which dynamically retrieves demonstrations tailored to each input query. This approach leverages existing databases and retrieval systems, enhancing efficiency and scalability while mitigating biases inherent in manual example selection. Given the promising results and growing interest in RetICL, we present a comprehensive survey of this field. Our review encompasses: design choices for ICL demonstration retrieval models, retrieval training procedures, inference strategies and current applications of RetICL. In the end, we explore future directions for this emerging technology.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey focuses on retrieval-augmented in-context learning (ICL) in large language models, where demonstrations are retrieved from some existing dataset in order to improve the ICL process. The survey categorizes and describes a number of related work along axes such as choice of retrieval dataset or choice of retriever. It then makes some suggestions for future work in the RetICL area.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
## Strengths: - ICL is a fast-growing topic, so this survey is quite timely. - The categorization is clear, with works cited falling along the lines drawn by the paper. ## Weaknesses: I will go into detail in the points below. At a high level I believe that this survey makes a number of claims throughout the text that are not well-substantiated by citations, which makes it a less than ideal entry point to the field. In addition I'm not totally certain why it makes sense to focus on such a specific topic as RetICL, though this isn't major to my review as the TMLR guidelines suggest against judging significance. **Missing citations:** often, I feel that many claims are stated either without justification, or justified much later in the text far from the original claim. Examples: - "Furthermore, ICL avoids common issues with fine-tuning, such as overfitting" as far as I understand the works cited after this claim just say that fine-tuning has a tendency to overfit, not that ICL fixes the issue - "The effectiveness of such demonstrations is influenced by factors such as the quality, quantity, and ordering of the demonstrations" this is definitely discussed later, but I believe something should be cited at this point - "This method has not only consistently outshined approaches relying on... influencing factors" same as above this should probably have citations given it is such a strong claim and we the readers do not yet know much about the RetICL subfield - In the beginning of Section 2, "Language models (LMs)" could probably have more references, I think the goal is to be comprehensive, but I am willing to accept another perspective here - "Early LMs, which were mostly based on N-gram models... recent context" to cite only one object here, which is a survey chapter itself, doesn't seem right to me. I know that this topic is somewhat tangential to the main topic of the survey, but it seems like the history of the development is missing. - Similar to the above, after "neural approaches to language modeling gained more popularity" there are again only two citations for architectures separated by 20 years. There was a lot of development during that time and it seems a bit wrong for the text to ignore that. - "Few-shot learning is a remarkable capability... not trained on such data" I believe this really is a claim, and as such should be substantiated, though it is difficult to do so without looking at the entire dataset. The reason I disagree with this point is that it's possible that there are significant portions of the internet devoted to these repetitive demonstrations (for example math word problems), so in particular if an LLM is tested on math word problems then the capability is in-domain. I would think rather the power of few-shot learning is not that it is out of distribution per se, but rather that it applies quite generally. - "While the size of the context has been increasing over time with newer LLMS" it would be nice to have a citation here. - "Similarity involves selecting demonstrations... language similarity... structural aspects... or other criteria" these are described in detail later, but to be comprehensive it would be good to include the citations here. - the "Iterative Retrieval" heading relies entirely on Scarlatos and Lan, 2023, are there no other citations that the text might reference? - "To achieve... demonstration retrievers." cite here - "between candidate demonstration embeddings... demonstrations" cite here - "initial research efforts focused on a heuristic... for this task" cite here - "Due to its sole reliance on term frequency... certain instances" citations needed - "A rich collection... in the literature." citations needed here - "Text generation tasks that benefit... Data-to-Text." citations needed here to say that RetICL actually helps, beyond just citations for the tasks. The entire point of this survey is to promote and explain RetICL, so there should be ample evidence for that. - "There are some hypotheses... implicit gradient descent" this requires citations for the hypotheses and specific papers. **Missing analysis:** There also seems to be a missed opportunity to make a more specific analysis in many cases: - "While there might be other differences... training set" I think this is a little vague, it would be nice if the text exposed the actual differences between the two works and then attempted to make a more specific suggestion - Under "Mix-Domain": "In the mix domain setting... from other tasks" the text does not present any analysis as to whether this mix-domain retrieval helps or hurts. It would be useful if such discussion were included. - "Cross-domain": similar to above, the end of the paragraph does not discuss whether the referenced methods are helpful or hurtful, or what specific drawbacks/benefits are, it just mentions their existence. - "Free Form Corpus": similar to the above two points, it would be nice to have some discussion on the tradeoffs between settings that are seen in the actual cited works. It's unclear what the effect of these different settings are, and the survey should expose some specific points. - I believe the discussions in Section 7 make suggestions that are much too general. In particular "Is there a potential... tasks?" seems very straightforward to answer no for the simple reason that one might write rules for very closed domains. I would hope that there would be more insight on how the retriever might need to be designed specifically around *demonstrations* rather than raw text. - Similar to above, "Examining and improving the ICL capabilities... direction to explore" does not have any suggestions or opinions on what is missing, which I might hope that such a survey would convey. - "Such tasks are usually accompanied by CoT... reasoning task." This makes it seem like it is hard to disambiguate the effect of retrieval, if so what conclusion can we really draw from the importance of RetICL? - At the end of the paragraph labeled "Pretrained Dual Encoder" it would be nice again to include discussion on the practical benefits/drawbacks of these specific encoders for RetICL, or something closer to the eventual setting. - In the "Diversity of Demonstrations" heading, the methods are presented without discussion as to the benefit or drawback of the approaches, so I don't understand if this is a line worth pursuing or not. **Other points:** - Table 1 takes up more than a page, but I don't really understand how it is helpful for distilling the information. It presents a categorization, but because the organization is chronological it's not really clear what should be compared between methods. One option would be to carve up this table into the sections that are later described in the text, another might be to have separate tables for separate subsections. It would be nice if the caption were to highlight any specific trends we the readers are supposed to take. - "One-hoc Retrieval" this is a strange way to phrase? Perhaps "One-step" or "Independent" might describe what the paper is aiming for? In addition, this heading contains no references, it might just be nice to have a few for comparison with later headings - "Naik et al. 2023 propose... solving the problem" I do not understand what this particular line means. It would be helpful to rewrite somehow, though as I don't understand the intention I'm not sure what I can say constructively. - In Section 2.1 it would be nice to number the centered demonstrations of prompt techniques. Then the 3rd set can reference the 2nd directly. It would also be helpful to bold "[Task Instructions]." I missed it initially on first glance and did not understand why both were included.

**Requested Changes:**
Please see Weaknesses above for specific comments. The most critical points for acceptance are the additional citations to fill in many parts of the writing, as well as additional analysis, especially in the final section.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
I don't have any particular concerns.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes

In the new revision I almost missed the "[Task Instructions]" prompt (which is just a reference to the previous version). | Response to Missing Analysis points: - 2: I still find this a bit unsatisfying, but it is now more clear. - 3: Thanks for the clarification, I think the addition is helpful. - 4: Minor, but "pusedo" -> "pseudo". - 5: I don't think this makes any more specific claims/suggestions/recommendations than the previous version, and some speculation here would be welcome (or pointers to active lines of research). How would one design a retriever around instructional content? What specifically is different? - 7: Perhaps it might be worth being more explicit: RetICL improves "on top of" CoT? | Response to points 1-10: Thank you for your detailed read and clarifications and changes. I really do think they aid the reader for such a survey that will serve as a pointer to those new to the area. I'm happy with almost all the changes except the lingering ones below. 6. While there might be other differences (e.g. the number of the demonstrations and the templates being used to do the inference) between the two setups that may affect the final performance, this comparison implies that retrieving from a carefully selected subset might have comparable results to retrieving from the entire training set 2. In the mix-domain setting (Wang et al., 2023a), the retrieval corpus is constructed from the combination of all tasks. At the inference time, given a question, the retriever will retrieve demonstrations from this mixed corpus; the demonstrations can come from the same domain as the test question or from other tasks. However, the authors have not discussed whether the mix-domain approach is more beneficial than the single-domain approach. Li et al. (2023b) propose a unified retriever trained on a mixture of 40 tasks. This unified retriever can be used for different tasks during inference. The authors have compared the unified retriever with the single-domain retriever (Rubin et al., 2022) and demonstrated improved performance. It’s worth noting that while the unified retriever is trained on mix-domain data, the actual selection of demonstrations during inference depends on the specific implementation. 3. We have added this sentence in the end to highlight the benefits of cross-domain setting, “The main benefit of this setting is to address low-resource training data issues or situations where no training data are available.” The two works we mentioned do not compare with in-domain or mix-domain since the datasets that they study do not have training data available. 4. Similarity involves selecting demonstrations most akin to the query and can be based on language similarity (term matching (Luo et al., 2023; Rubin et al., 2022; Agrawal et al., 2022; Ye et al., 2023a; Dalvi et al., 2022) or semantic matching (Rubin et al., 2022; Li & Qiu, 2023b; Wang et al., 2023a; Liu et al., 2022)), structural aspects (sentence structure (Poesia et al., 2021; Levy et al., 2022; Drozdov et al., 2022), reasoning structure (Fu et al., 2022)). 9. The earlier retrieval strategies acquire each demonstration independently. However, in iterative retrieval, a retriever selects demonstrations based on both the query and previously retrieved demonstrations Khattab et al. (2022); Levy et al. (2022); Drozdov et al. (2022); Ye et al. (2023a); Scarlatos & Lan (2023). 10. To achieve the retrieval objectives outlined above, researchers have explored various types of demonstration retrievers Robertson et al. (2009); Reimers & Gurevych (2019a); Liu et al. (2019); Yang et al. (2019); Ni et al. (2021); Santhanam et al. (2021).
paper_title_zh: 基于检索示例的上下文学习在语言模型中的应用：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 大型语言模型已展现出卓越的少样本上下文学习（ICL）能力，能够通过少量示例适应新任务。然而，ICL的效能高度依赖于这些示例的选择。近期发展引入了基于检索的上下文学习（RetICL），该方法动态检索针对每个输入查询定制的示例。这种方法利用现有数据库和检索系统，提升了效率和可扩展性，同时减轻了手动示例选择中固有的偏见。鉴于RetICL的显著成果和日益增长的兴趣，我们对该领域进行了全面综述。我们的回顾包括：ICL示例检索模型的设计选择、检索训练流程、推理策略以及RetICL的当前应用。最后，我们探讨了这一新兴技术的未来发展方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本综述重点关注大型语言模型中的检索增强式上下文学习（ICL），其中通过从现有数据集中检索演示来改进ICL过程。综述对相关工作的分类和描述沿着诸如检索数据集选择或检索器选择等轴线进行。随后，对RetICL领域的未来工作提出了一些建议。

**优点与缺点：**
## 优点：
- ICL是一个快速发展的主题，因此本综述非常及时。
- 分类清晰，引用的工作符合论文所划定的线条。

## 缺点：
我将在下述要点中详细说明。总体而言，我认为本综述在文本中提出了许多未通过引用充分证实的论断，这使得它作为该领域的入门点不够理想。此外，我不完全确定为何要专注于如此特定的主题如RetICL，尽管根据TMLR指南建议不评判重要性，这对我评审的影响不大。

**缺失的引用：**
通常，我觉得许多论断要么没有给出理由，要么在文本的后面部分才给出理由，且离原论断较远。例如：
- “此外，ICL避免了微调的常见问题，如过拟合”，据我所知，引用的工作只是说微调有过度拟合的倾向，并未表明ICL解决了这一问题。
- “此类演示的有效性受诸如质量、数量和演示顺序等因素的影响”，这确实在后面有所讨论，但我认为在此处应有引用。
- “这种方法不仅一贯优于依赖……影响因素的方法”，同样，此处应有引用，因为这是一个强烈的论断，而读者对RetICL子领域尚不了解。
- 在第2节开头，“语言模型（LMs）”可能需要更多参考文献，我认为目标是全面的，但我也愿意接受其他观点。
- “早期的LMs，大多基于N-gram模型……近期上下文”，仅引用一个对象，而这个对象本身是一个综述章节，在我看来不太合适。我知道这个主题与综述的主要主题有些偏离，但似乎缺少了发展历史。
- 类似地，在“神经方法在语言建模中变得更受欢迎”之后，仅引用了相隔20年的两种架构。在这段时间内有大量的发展，文本忽略这些似乎不太妥当。
- “少样本学习是一种显著的能力……未在这些数据上训练”，我认为这确实是一个论断，因此应该有依据，尽管不查看整个数据集很难做到这一点。 我不同意这一点的理由是，互联网上可能存在大量专门用于这些重复性演示（例如数学应用题）的区域，因此，特别是如果一个大语言模型（LLM）在数学应用题上进行测试，那么这种能力就是领域内的。我认为，少样本学习的力量并不在于它本身是分布外的，而在于它具有相当普遍的适用性。- “随着新一代LLM的出现，上下文的大小一直在增加”在这里引用一个文献会更好。- “相似性涉及选择演示……语言相似性……结构方面……或其他标准”这些在后面有详细描述，但为了全面性，在这里引用文献会更好。- “迭代检索”这一节完全依赖于Scarlatos和Lan，2023年的研究，难道没有其他可以引用的文献吗？- “为了实现……演示检索器。”在这里引用文献。- “在候选演示嵌入之间……演示”在这里引用文献。- “最初的研究努力集中在启发式……来完成这项任务”在这里引用文献。- “由于其完全依赖于词频……某些实例”需要引用文献。- “丰富的集合……在文献中。”在这里需要引用文献。- “受益于……数据到文本的文本生成任务。”需要引用文献来说明RetICL确实有帮助，而不仅仅是任务的引用。这篇综述的整个目的是推广和解释RetICL，因此应该有充分的证据。- “有一些假设……隐式梯度下降”这需要引用假设和相关具体论文的文献。**缺失的分析：**在许多情况下，似乎错过了一个进行更具体分析的机会：- “虽然可能存在其他差异……训练集”我认为这有点模糊，如果文本能揭示两项工作之间的实际差异，并尝试提出更具体的建议会更好。- 在“混合领域”下：“在混合领域设置中……来自其他任务”文本没有分析这种混合领域检索是有帮助还是有害。如果包含此类讨论会很有用。- “跨领域”：与上述类似，段落的结尾没有讨论所引用的方法是有帮助还是有害，或者具体的缺点/优点是什么，只是提到了它们的存在。- “自由形式语料库”：与上述两点类似，如果能讨论实际引用工作中的设置之间的权衡会更好。这些不同设置的影响尚不清楚，综述应该揭示一些具体的点。- 我认为第7节的讨论提出的建议过于泛泛。特别是“是否存在潜在的……任务？”这个问题似乎很容易回答“否”，原因很简单，因为在非常封闭的领域中，人们可能会编写规则。 我希望能够有更多关于如何围绕“演示”而非原始文本来专门设计检索器的洞见。与上文类似，“审视和改进ICL能力……探索方向”并没有对缺失内容提出任何建议或意见，我期望这样的综述能够传达这些信息。“此类任务通常伴随CoT……推理任务。”这让人觉得很难区分检索效果，如果是这样，我们究竟能从RetICL的重要性中得出什么结论？在标有“预训练双编码器”的段落末尾，再次包含对这些特定编码器在RetICL中的实际优缺点的讨论，或者更接近最终设置的内容会更好。在“演示的多样性”标题下，方法被提出，但没有讨论这些方法的优缺点，因此我不明白这是否是一条值得追求的路线。

**其他要点：**
- 表格1占用了超过一页的篇幅，但我不太明白它对提炼信息有何帮助。它呈现了一种分类，但由于组织是按时间顺序的，因此并不清楚方法之间应该比较什么。一种选择是将这个表格按文本中后续描述的章节进行划分，另一种可能是为不同的子章节设置单独的表格。如果标题能够突出读者应该注意的特定趋势会更好。
- “One-hoc检索”这种表述方式很奇怪？或许“单步”或“独立”更能描述论文的目标？此外，这个标题没有引用，可能只是为了与后面的标题进行比较。
- “Naik等人2023年提出……解决问题”我不明白这一特定行文字的意思。如果能重写会很有帮助，但由于我不理解其意图，我不确定能提出什么建设性的意见。
- 在第2.1节中，最好对居中的提示技术演示进行编号。然后第三组可以直接引用第二组。此外，加粗“[任务指令]”也会很有帮助。我一开始没注意到，不明白为什么两者都包含在内。

**请求的更改：**
请参阅上述“弱点”部分的具体评论。接受的最关键点是补充许多写作部分的引用，以及在最后部分增加额外的分析。

**更广泛的影响担忧：**
我没有特别的担忧。

**主张和证据：**
无

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：** 对审稿人针对第1-10点回复的后续回应：感谢您的建议：我们在修订版本中进一步进行了修改，具体而言，少样本学习是大型语言模型（LLMs）的一个显著能力，展示了它们在明确指令下快速适应广泛任务的一般化能力。| 对其他点的回应：- 1：我仍然对这张表的重要性感到犹豫，但并不是特别执着于它。或许对于非常熟悉的读者来说，作为参考可能会有用。- 3：现在更清晰了，谢谢。- 4：我会保留之前版本的间距，并且保留两个提示示例以保持冗余，但我只会将“[任务指令]”加粗，并按现在的版本编号。在新修订版中，我差点错过了“[任务指令]”提示（这只是对前一个版本的引用）。| 对缺失分析点的回应：- 2：我仍然觉得这有点不令人满意，但现在更清晰了。- 3：感谢澄清，我认为添加的内容很有帮助。- 4：小问题，"pusedo" 应为 "pseudo"。- 5：我认为这并没有比前一个版本提出更具体的声明/建议/推荐，这里的一些推测将是受欢迎的（或者指向活跃的研究线索）。如何围绕指令内容设计检索器？具体有何不同？- 7：或许更明确一点会更好：RetICL是在CoT的基础上进行改进的？| 对第1-10点的回应：感谢您详细的阅读、澄清和修改。我确实认为这些对读者很有帮助，尤其是对于这样一个将作为新手指南的综述。我对几乎所有修改都很满意，除了下面遗留的几个问题。6. 很小的问题，但少样本提示是明确的指令，我更愿意强调相同的方法广泛适用。| 对审稿人m6ZC（缺失分析）的回应：以下是对缺失分析部分的评论的回应。1. 尽管两个设置之间可能存在其他差异（例如，用于推理的演示数量和模板），但这一比较表明，从精心选择的子集中检索可能与从整个训练集检索具有相当的结果。2. 在混合领域设置（Wang et al., 2023a）中，检索语料库是由所有任务的组合构建的。在推理时，给定一个问题，检索器将从这个混合语料库中检索演示；演示可以来自与测试问题相同的领域，也可以来自其他任务。然而，作者并未讨论混合领域方法是否比单一领域方法更有益。Li et al. (2023b) 提出了一种在40个任务混合上训练的统一检索器。这个统一检索器可以在推理时用于不同任务。 作者将统一检索器与单一领域检索器（Rubin等人，2022年）进行了比较，并展示了性能的提升。值得注意的是，尽管统一检索器是在混合领域数据上进行训练的，但在推理过程中实际选择演示的依据取决于具体的实现。3. 我们在文末添加了这句话以突出跨领域设置的优势：“这种设置的主要好处是解决低资源训练数据问题或没有训练数据可用的情况。” 我们提到的两项工作并未与领域内或混合领域进行比较，因为它们研究的数据库没有可用的训练数据。4. 处理类似任务中缺乏人工标注数据的另一种方法是从未结构化文本中创建伪演示。为了实现这一目标，Lyu等人（2022年）利用了Demix数据集（Gururangan等人，2022年），该数据集并非针对任何特定任务定制。为了生成伪演示，检索器从数据集中选择最相关的top-k句子。随后，为每个句子附加任意标签以形成示例。与零样本设置相比，这种伪演示是有益的。使用任意标签的动机来自Min等人（2022b），他们发现用随机标签替换黄金标签只会轻微影响性能，这表明输入-输出格式是关键。Li等人（2022年）提出了一种合成问答生成方法，使用大型语言模型（LLM）生成的合成段落来创建问答对。作者还将合成的数据与训练数据作为演示进行了比较，发现性能与使用训练集相当，而无需大量人工劳动来收集训练数据。5. 演示检索器设计：当前的演示检索器架构与用于原始文本的架构没有显著差异，大多数努力集中在构建下游训练数据上。一个悬而未决的问题是：“如何专门为演示而非原始文本设计检索器？” 演示通常需要检索器考虑指导性内容和任务理解，这可能需要更复杂和定制化的方法。6. 为小型语言模型检索演示：大多数现有工作集中在参数超过1000亿的大型语言模型（LLM）上，这些模型通常作为现成模型使用，而不适应下游任务。相比之下，小型LM不仅具有推理效率的优势，而且比LLM更容易进行微调。这为同时优化检索器和LM提供了机会，类似于端到端的检索增强生成训练方法（Guu等人，2020年；Lewis等人，2020年）。 通过定制检索器以生成与小规模语言模型（LM）能力紧密对齐的演示，并对这些小规模LM进行微调以适应上下文学习任务，我们有可能提升它们在特定任务上的表现。7. 这些任务通常伴随着CoT技术。Luo等人（2023）证明，检索到的演示可以与CoT技术结合，以进一步提升数学推理任务的表现。8. 添加以下句子：预训练模型即使在没有针对下游任务进行微调的情况下，也能作为强大的演示检索器。此外，预训练权重可以用于微调演示检索器，与预训练阶段相比，显著减少了所需的训练数据量，我们将在§5中展示这一点。9. 在本段末尾添加了一句话：这些研究已经表明，演示的多样性对于实现更好的上下文学习（ICL）表现至关重要。| 对审稿人m6ZC的回应（缺失引用部分2）：11. 典型的演示检索器将检索语料库中的示例和查询编码成某种向量表示，然后计算候选演示嵌入和查询嵌入之间的相似度度量（例如余弦相似度），以定位最相关的演示（Rubin等人，2022；Li & Qiu，2023b；Wang等人，2023a）。12. 由于对检索到的演示如何提升大规模语言模型（LLM）表现的根本机制理解有限，最初的研究努力集中在对手头可用的检索器进行启发式评估（Liu等人，2022；Zhang等人，2022b）。后续的研究努力探索了专门为检索演示而定制的学习型检索器的设计和开发（Luo等人，2023；Cheng等人，2023；Li等人，2023b）。13. 我们对原句进行了少许改写，并添加了关于BM25局限性的引用。由于其严重依赖词频和文档长度，这种方法可能会忽略语义意义和句子结构等关键方面。因此，BM25可能无法检索到与输入查询在语义上相似但缺乏确切词项匹配的实例（Guo等人，2016；Xiong等人，2017；Mitra等人，2018）。14. 文献中存在丰富的句子嵌入方法（Reimers & Gurevych，2019；Yang等人，2019；Xue等人，2020；Wang等人，2022b）。15. 文本生成任务，如代码生成（CodeGen）（Zelle &
