reasons: Lines 367-369: Tingley et al. is not a paper on the intentional trade of herpetofauna that is being discussed here.
Lines 73-74: I disagree with the statement that the predictive ability of models is unsatisfactory.
It would be good that the authors define ‘alien’ and ‘invasive’ early on in the introduction, the first time they are mentioned.
Line 70: considering recent research (Allen et al., 2017; García-Díaz et al., 2016; Mahoney et al., 2014), I would say that it is not only early maturity but fast-paced life histories in general.

More generally, I think that the manuscript will benefit from a clearer objective and purpose and, concomitantly, from a better linkage between the research presented and the conclusions and management recommendations.
In summary, I suggest that the conclusions presented in the manuscript will benefit from setting the context in which the recommendations would be applicable.
Perhaps it could be interesting to evaluate the implications of the results in the context of the different stages of the invasion pathway and different transport pathways.

I have read the manuscript a couple of time, and I think the methodological procedures are sound, but I suggest that the authors describe their expectations more explicitly – that will certainly help to understand their results and to showcase current knowledge gaps.
Why not, for example, partition the results explicitly by stage of the invasion pathway?
It would be good that the authors define ‘alien’ and ‘invasive’ early on in the introduction, the first time they are mentioned.
Currently, these terms are defined for the first time in the methods section, and the introduction makes it sound as if they are interchangeable.

paper_title: Towards achieving lightweight intrusion detection systems in Internet of Things, the role of incremental machine learning: A systematic literature review
paper_abstract:
While the benefits of IoT cannot be overstated, its computational constraints make it challenging to deploy security methodologies that have been deployed in traditional computing systems. The benefits and computational constraints have made IoT systems attractive to cyber-attacks. One way to mitigate these attacks is to detect them. In this study, a Systematic Literature Review (SLR) has been conducted to analyze 
the role of incremental machine learning in achieving lightweight intrusion detection for IoT systems. The study analyzed existing incremental machine learning approaches used in designing intrusion detection systems for IoT ecosystems, emphasizing the incremental methods used in detecting intrusions, the datasets used to evaluate these methods, and how the method achieves lightweight status. The SLR outlined the contributions of each study, focusing on their strengths and gaps, the datasets used, and the incremental machine learning model used. This study revealed that incremental learning approaches in detecting intrusion in IoT systems are in their infant stage. Over 12 years, from 2010 to 2022, a total of twenty-one (21) studies were carried out in IDSs using incremental machine learning, with eight (8) studies carried out in IoT systems. In addition to reviewing the literature, we offer suggestions for improving existing solutions and achieving lightweight IDS for IoT systems. We also discussed some problems with making lightweight IDS for IoT systems and areas where 
more research could be done in the future.
review_content:
The authors conducted a review for the lightweight purpose of IoT-based introduction detection systems. It is interesting, but the following concerns have to be addressed.
  * Many typos are found.
  * In the abstract, you mentioned that your review is based on the 21 IDS research works. It is not enough to review a specific work. There are many related works in recent years. More references are necessary.

    In Table-5, the authors listed the sources/publishers of their references. Many lightweight IoT-IDS could be easily found by exploring these publishers' web sources. E.g., the authors can explore many articles in their sources, like MDPI, ACM Digital Library, and so on.

    In Table-6, why can “only zero article in ACM” be considered as your quality assessment criteria?
  * According to the title and abstract, you focus on the lightweight purpose in the detection systems, but you mentioned only 7 lightweight models.

    Also, you have to check them again, are these really lightweight systems? The authors organized some lightweight models in Table 8, even if the referenced works are not deeply checked, the question arises, how could some of them be lightweight? E.g., in Table 8, in the reference [30], how it would be lightweight with computational complexity? And also, the reference [28], is it lightweight with memory consumption?
  * According to your abstract, you mentioned that you analyzed the systems regarding 4 kinds of criteria. But your research questions almost did not reflect them. In addition, these are not also correct. In the abstract, the authors described "The study analyzed 1) existing incremental machine learning approaches used in designing intrusion detection systems for IoT ecosystems, 2) emphasizing the incremental methods used in detecting intrusions, 3) the datasets used to evaluate these methods, and 4) how the method achieves lightweight status.

    In the "Research questions" section, the authors generated 4-questions, such as RQ1: What is the primary contribution of the paper? RQ2: What incremental or online machine learning algorithm was used in this study? RQ3: How does the proposed method handle data, feature, or concept drift? RQ4: How does the proposed IDS handle the computational constraints of IoT systems?

    Is there any relation between these two parts? More importantly, even showing these facts in these parts, there is no significant explanation in this review, especially on the lightweight purpose. If so, why did the authors put the important concern in IoT-IDS, "lightweight/handling the computational constraints" in these parts, such as the title, abstract, and research questions?
  * According to your references list, you put many published reviews and survey works. It would be better if you study them again how to arrange the contents in the review works.
  * The citation styles are also different. E.g., the reference numbers 7 and 8. Other references are also facing the same issue. In addition, the reference indexing style in tables is confusing.
  * In the conclusion, you describe that you analyzed comprehensively ML-based intrusion detection systems. However, in the current version, the manuscript seems just a report that you have studied.
The overall comment is that you have to improve your manuscript significantly, to be following the style of review works, to be focusing on the facts in the title and abstract, and be arranged as a well-structured manuscript.
paper_title_zh: "迈向物联网轻量级入侵检测系统：增量机器学习的角色——系统文献综述"
paper_abstract_zh: 物联网（IoT）的益处不言而喻，但其计算限制使得在传统计算系统中部署的安全方法难以应用。这些益处和计算限制使得IoT系统容易受到网络攻击。缓解这些攻击的一种方法是进行检测。在本研究中，通过系统文献综述（SLR）分析了增量机器学习在实现IoT系统轻量级入侵检测中的作用。研究分析了现有用于设计IoT生态系统入侵检测系统的增量机器学习方法，重点探讨了用于检测入侵的增量方法、评估这些方法的数据集以及方法如何实现轻量级状态。SLR概述了每项研究的贡献，重点关注其优势和不足、使用的数据集以及所采用的增量机器学习模型。研究表明，在IoT系统中检测入侵的增量学习方法仍处于初级阶段。在2010年至2022年的12年间，共有二十一（21）项研究在采用增量机器学习的入侵检测系统（IDSs）中进行，其中有八（8）项研究在IoT系统中进行。除了文献综述外，我们还提出了改进现有解决方案和实现IoT系统轻量级IDS的建议。我们还讨论了在为IoT系统构建轻量级IDS时遇到的一些问题，以及未来可以进一步研究的领域。
review_content_zh:
作者对基于物联网的入侵检测系统的轻量化目的进行了综述。这很有趣，但以下问题需要解决：
  * 发现许多错别字。
  * 在摘要中，你提到你的综述基于21项IDS研究工作。这对于综述特定工作来说是不够的。近年来有许多相关研究。需要更多的参考文献。

    在表5中，作者列出了他们参考文献的来源/出版商。通过探索这些出版商的网络资源，可以轻易找到许多轻量级物联网-IDS。例如，作者可以在他们的来源中探索许多文章，如MDPI、ACM数字图书馆等。

    在表6中，为什么“ACM中只有零篇文章”可以作为你的质量评估标准？
  * 根据标题和摘要，你关注的是检测系统中的轻量化目的，但你只提到了7个轻量级模型。

    此外，你还需要再次检查，这些真的是轻量级系统吗？作者在表8中组织了一些轻量级模型，即使未深入检查引用的工作，也会产生疑问，其中一些怎么可能是轻量级的？例如，在表8中，引用[30]的计算复杂度如何能算轻量级？还有引用[28]，其内存消耗算轻量级吗？
  * 根据你的摘要，你提到你根据4种标准分析了系统。但你的研究问题几乎未反映这些标准。此外，这些标准也不正确。在摘要中，作者描述了“研究分析了1）在物联网生态系统中设计入侵检测系统所使用的现有增量机器学习方法，2）强调用于检测入侵的增量方法，3）用于评估这些方法的数据库，以及4）该方法如何实现轻量化状态。

    在“研究问题”部分，作者提出了4个问题，如RQ1：本文的主要贡献是什么？RQ2：本研究使用了哪种增量或在线机器学习算法？RQ3：所提方法如何处理数据、特征或概念漂移？RQ4：所提议的IDS如何处理物联网系统的计算约束？

    这两部分之间有任何关联吗？更重要的是，即使在这些部分展示了这些事实，综述中也没有对这些轻量化目的进行显著解释。如果是这样，为什么作者将物联网-IDS中的重要关注点“轻量化/处理计算约束”放在这些部分，如标题、摘要和研究问题中？
  * 根据你的参考文献列表，你放入了许多已发表的综述和调查工作。如果你再次研究它们如何安排综述内容会更好。
  * 引用格式也不一致。例如，参考文献编号7和8。其他参考文献也存在同样的问题。此外，表格中的参考文献索引风格令人困惑。
  * 在结论中，你描述了你全面分析了基于机器学习的入侵检测系统。然而，在当前版本中，手稿似乎只是你已研究的报告。
总体评论是，你必须显著改进你的手稿，以符合综述作品的风格，聚焦标题和摘要中的事实，并安排成结构良好的手稿。

paper_title: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus in Nepal from 2000 to 2020: A systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: Aims:  To evaluate the prevalence and risk factors of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) from 2000-2020 in various parts of Nepal.  Methods:  PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Google Scholar were searched using the appropriate keywords. All Nepalese studies mentioning the prevalence of T2DM and/or details such as risk factors were included. Studies were screened using Covidence. Two reviewers independently selected studies based on the inclusion criteria. Meta-analysis was conducted using Comprehensive Meta-Analysis Software v.3.  Results:  A total of 15 studies met the inclusion criteria. The prevalence of T2DM, pre-diabetes, and impaired glucose tolerance in Nepal in the last two decades was 10% (CI, 7.1%- 13.9%), 19.4% (CI, 11.2%- 31.3%), and 11.0% (CI, 4.3%- 25.4%) respectively. The prevalence of T2DM in the year 2010-15 was 7.75% (CI, 3.67-15.61), and it increased to 11.24% between 2015-2020 (CI, 7.89-15.77). There were 2.19 times higher odds of having T2DM if the body mass index was ≥24.9 kg/m 2 . Analysis showed normal waist circumference, normal blood pressure, and no history of T2DM in a family has 64.1%, 62.1%, and 67.3% lower odds of having T2DM, respectively.  Conclusion:  The prevalence of T2DM, pre-diabetes, and impaired glucose tolerance in Nepal was estimated to be 10%, 19.4%, and 11% respectively.
review_content:
Background:
 1. In the introduction, more information about the prevalence and risk factors of diabetes should be presented and reorganized for easy reading. The research problem and hypothesis also need to be clearly articulated.
 2. The rationale for the review was also not clearly described in the context of what is already known. As there have been few studies in Nepal, it was not a good reason for conducting meta-analysis. Doing a meta-analysis using a small number of studies might cause bias.
Methods:
 1. Study methods were poorly described and hard to read (see a good example study by Miller et al.1). To help readers replicate the study, the authors should provide more detailed information on electronic search strategy, methods of results synthesis, and sensitivity analysis.
 2. Using only the global search engine, e.g. PubMed, Embase, Scopus, and Google Scholar might cause publication bias if there were some researches papers published locally or in other databases. In point had not been mention in the study limitation.
Results:
 1. Results were inadequately described. In the qualitative summary, the authors should talk about the important features of the information in Table 1. In quantitative synthesis, information on how the pooled prevalence was calculated is also needed. In every figure, the total events should be indicated, and the figure legend should contain more information.
Discussion:
 1. In the Discussion, more information should be provided and reorganized for an easy read.
 2. In the study limitation, the authors mention T2DM diagnostic criteria and demographic data as a problem. However, the authors did not mention how the problems affect the results and how the study handled them.
 3. The statement: “Our finds highlight the importance of exercise and a healthy diet to prevent the increased morbidity among individuals with T2DM in this country”, needs more justification. Was the information from the results of this study or from the literature?
 4. In an attempt to identify diabetes risk factors, the study limited only those studies from Nepal. How this will affect the study results?

Conclusion:
 1. In the conclusion statement, only obesity was claimed to cause diabetes. This conclusion might need more justification since obesity and other risk factors were not extensively discussed. This result was also in contrast to that observed by Jayawardena et al.2, a similar study using data from all countries in South Asia. In that study, family history, urban residency, age, higher BMI, sedentary lifestyle, hypertension, and waist-hip ratio were found to be associated with an increased risk of diabetes.
 2. The conclusion statement should also provide study limitations and recommendations for public health use.
paper_title_zh: 尼泊尔2000年至2020年2型糖尿病的系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh:
目的：评估2000-2020年尼泊尔各地区2型糖尿病（T2DM）的患病率及其风险因素。

方法：使用适当的关键词在PubMed、Embase、Scopus和Google Scholar进行检索。纳入所有提及T2DM患病率及/或风险因素等详细信息的尼泊尔研究。使用Covidence进行文献筛选。两名评审员根据纳入标准独立选择研究。使用Comprehensive Meta-Analysis Software v.3进行荟萃分析。

结果：共有15项研究符合纳入标准。过去二十年中，尼泊尔T2DM、前糖尿病和糖耐量受损的患病率分别为10%（CI，7.1%-13.9%）、19.4%（CI，11.2%-31.3%）和11.0%（CI，4.3%-25.4%）。2010-15年T2DM的患病率为7.75%（CI，3.67-15.61），而在2015-2020年间增至11.24%（CI，7.89-15.77）。若体质指数≥24.9 kg/m²，患T2DM的几率高出2.19倍。分析显示，正常腰围、正常血压和无T2DM家族史分别使患T2DM的几率降低64.1%、62.1%和67.3%。

结论：尼泊尔T2DM、前糖尿病和糖耐量受损的患病率估计分别为10%、19.4%和11%。
review_content_zh:
背景：
1. 在引言部分，应提供更多关于糖尿病患病率和风险因素的信息，并进行重新组织以便于阅读。研究问题和假设也需要清晰地阐述。
2. 在已知研究背景下，综述的合理性未得到清晰描述。由于尼泊尔的研究较少，这并不是进行元分析的充分理由。使用少量研究进行元分析可能会导致偏倚。

方法：
1. 研究方法描述不充分且难以理解（参见Miller等人1的研究示例）。为帮助读者复制研究，作者应提供更多关于电子检索策略、结果综合方法和敏感性分析的详细信息。
2. 仅使用全球搜索引擎，如PubMed、Embase、Scopus和Google Scholar，可能会导致发表偏倚，如果有些研究论文仅在本地或其他数据库发表。这一点在研究局限性中未提及。

结果：
1. 结果描述不充分。在定性总结中，作者应讨论表1中信息的重要特征。在定量综合中，也需要提供如何计算合并患病率的信息。在每个图表中，应标明总事件数，图例应包含更多信息。

讨论：
1. 在讨论部分，应提供更多信息并进行重新组织以便于阅读。
2. 在研究局限性中，作者提到2型糖尿病（T2DM）诊断标准及人口统计数据存在问题。然而，作者未说明这些问题如何影响结果以及研究如何处理这些问题。
3. 声明：“我们的发现强调了运动和健康饮食在预防该国T2DM患者增加的发病率中的重要性”，需要更多佐证。该信息是来自本研究结果还是文献？
4. 在试图识别糖尿病风险因素时，研究仅限于尼泊尔的研究。这将如何影响研究结果？

结论：
1. 在结论声明中，仅声称肥胖导致糖尿病。这一结论可能需要更多佐证，因为肥胖和其他风险因素并未得到广泛讨论。这一结果也与Jayawardena等人2的研究结果相悖，该研究使用南亚所有国家的数据，发现家族史、城市居住、年龄、较高BMI、久坐生活方式、高血压和腰臀比与糖尿病风险增加相关。
2. 结论声明还应提供研究局限性和对公共卫生应用的推荐。

paper_title: The academic, economic and societal impacts of Open Access: an evidence-based review
paper_abstract: Ongoing debates surrounding Open Access to the scholarly literature are multifaceted and complicated by disparate and often polarised viewpoints from engaged stakeholders. At the current stage, Open Access has become such a global issue that it is critical for all involved in scholarly publishing, including policymakers, publishers, research funders, governments, learned societies, librarians, and academic communities, to be well-informed on the history, benefits, and pitfalls of Open Access. In spite of this, there is a general lack of consensus regarding the potential pros and cons of Open Access at multiple levels. This review aims to be a resource for current knowledge on the impacts of Open Access by synthesizing important research in three major areas: academic, economic and societal. While there is clearly much scope for additional research, several key trends are identified, including a broad citation advantage for researchers who publish openly, as well as additional benefits to the non-academic dissemination of their work. The economic impact of Open Access is less well-understood, although it is clear that access to the research literature is key for innovative enterprises, and a range of governmental and non-governmental services. Furthermore, Open Access has the potential to save both publishers and research funders considerable amounts of financial resources, and can provide some economic benefits to traditionally subscription-based journals. The societal impact of Open Access is strong, in particular for advancing citizen science initiatives, and leveling the playing field for researchers in developing countries. Open Access supersedes all potential alternative modes of access to the scholarly literature through enabling unrestricted re-use, and long-term stability independent of financial constraints of traditional publishers that impede knowledge sharing. However, Open Access has the potential to become unsustainable for research communities if high-cost options are allowed to continue to prevail in a widely unregulated scholarly publishing market. Open Access remains only one of the multiple challenges that the scholarly publishing system is currently facing. Yet, it provides one foundation for increasing engagement with researchers regarding ethical standards of publishing and the broader implications of 'Open Research'.
review_content:
This is an interesting and timely review of the issue of open access to scientific literature.

The two other reviewers have highlighted specific issues that should be addressed in the revision of this article, and I agree with these issues. I've added other notes below. I think this review article would benefit from a re-write to correct potentially biased language in support of open access and to round out the review with further evidence of open access impacts on citation rates, altmetrics, scientific literacy / public engagement and research quality.

Notes:

The authors cite “fostering a culture of greater scientific literacy” as a benefit of open access. While this is theoretically a benefit, has more or less open access in particular scientific fields been tied to greater or lesser scientific literacy in those areas? Is this potential benefit supported by research literature? The authors should be clear on what the evidence-based benefits of open access are, and also what the potential drawbacks are. References to related research should be provided on this topic.

The structure the authors use for laying out their evidence and the language they use (e.g. “[the] case for Open Access”) appear to lean more toward the positive impacts / benefits of open access from the outset. The authors should be very careful to review the evidence first before making value-based statements or arguments about open access, even if the evidence-based benefits outweigh any potential drawbacks, or lack of significant benefits, in the end.

Correct the typo in the following sentence: “[In] A longitudinal study Eysenbach (2006) compared…”

The authors write: “One alternative explanation for the citation advantage could be that researchers choose to publish OA when a finding is more impactful, but empirical evidence contradicts this selection effect. Gargouri et al. (2010) compared citation counts within a cohort of OA articles that had either been self-selected as OA or mandated as OA (e.g., by funders). The study concluded that both were cited significantly more than non-OA articles. As such, these findings rule out a selection bias from authors as the cause for the citation advantage (Gargouri et al., 2010).” However, couldn’t funded research also have a tendency to be considered “more impactful,” because it was chosen in the first place to be funded and mandated as OA? The authors should discuss this, and whether there is any research that experimentally investigates whether open access provides a citation advantage. This could perhaps be suggested as future research. The authors should also discuss how/why some studies have found no citation advantage for OA papers.

Related to social media mentions of research papers and citation counts, the authors might also consider citing Liang, X., Su, L. Y. F., Yeo, S. K., Scheufele, D. A., Brossard, D., Xenos, M., ... & Corley, E. A. (2014). Building Buzz (Scientists) Communicating Science in New Media Environments. Journalism & Mass Communication Quarterly, 1077699014550092. [PDF]

In discussing the economics of OA, the authors should also discuss any evidence of potential drawbacks for various stakeholders, such as where funds for pay-to-publish fees will come from and how these fees may affect individual researchers. Pay-to-publish models of OA may also burden early career researchers and researchers working in fields where research grants are more difficult to obtain.

The authors do not discuss the potential impact of OA on research quality or reproducibility (reproducibility is only mentioned in the context of open data). As this has been a controversial issue in the past (e.g. the mentioned 'sting' operations) the authors should discuss any research that has investigated the impact of open access on the rigor of peer reviews, research quality, presence of replication studies / reproducibility, etc. There has also been some discussion of whether open peer review (like that used by F1000Research) affects the quality of reviews, e.g. (Rooyen et al. 1999). The authors should mention this and/or subsequent literature when addressing open peer review.

There have also been studies on scientists' / journal article authors' perceptions and attitudes toward open access, e.g. Schroter and Tite (2005; 2006). The authors might considering summarizing some of this research, as it gives context to some of the existing barriers to open access and perceived drawbacks among researchers.

Summary:

In summary, the topic of this review is important and timely. However, this paper falls short of what I would expect from a systematic review in terms of systematically summarizing previous research findings related to the impact of open access on scientific publishing, public engagement with science, science literacy and altmetrics. The authors should be careful to hold back value judgements / arguments related to the case for open access until having systemically reviewed the evidence-based benefits, drawbacks, and/or lack of significant benefits. The authors should also provide some discussion of how we might objectively weigh any evidence-based benefits with potential drawbacks for various stakeholders including researchers and especially early career researchers. The authors should avoid summarizing mostly the findings of previous studies that find positive impacts of open access on the various domains of potential impact they consider in their paper. The evidence already presented in the paper is rigorous and detailed. However, I would recommend a revision that rounds this review out with more systematic evidence.
paper_title_zh: 开放获取的学术、经济和社会影响：基于证据的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 围绕学术文献开放获取的持续辩论是多方面的，并且由于参与各方的不同且往往两极分化的观点而变得复杂。在当前阶段，开放获取已成为一个全球性问题，对于所有参与学术出版的人员，包括政策制定者、出版商、研究资助者、政府、学术团体、图书馆员和学术社区，了解开放获取的历史、益处和陷阱至关重要。尽管如此，在多个层面上，关于开放获取潜在利弊的共识普遍缺乏。本综述旨在通过综合三个主要领域——学术、经济和社会——的重要研究，成为当前关于开放获取影响的知识的资源。虽然显然还有很大的额外研究空间，但已识别出一些关键趋势，包括公开出版的研究人员享有广泛的引用优势，以及其作品在非学术传播中的额外益处。开放获取的经济影响尚不完全清楚，但很明显，获取研究文献对于创新企业和一系列政府及非政府服务至关重要。此外，开放获取有可能为出版商和研究资助者节省大量财务资源，并为传统订阅型期刊提供一些经济益处。开放获取的社会影响显著，特别是在推进公民科学倡议和为发展中国家研究人员提供公平竞争环境方面。开放获取通过允许无限制再利用，超越了所有潜在的学术文献获取替代模式，并提供了独立于传统出版商财务约束的长期稳定性，这些财务约束阻碍了知识共享。然而，如果高成本选项被允许在广泛不受监管的学术出版市场中继续盛行，开放获取有可能变得对研究社区不可持续。开放获取仍然是当前学术出版系统面临的多重挑战之一。然而，它为增加研究人员对出版伦理标准及“开放研究”更广泛影响的参与提供了一个基础。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于科学文献开放获取问题的有趣且及时的综述。

其他两位审稿人已经指出了在修订本文时应解决的具体问题，我同意这些观点。我在下方补充了其他意见。我认为这篇综述文章可以通过重写来纠正支持开放获取的潜在偏见性语言，并通过进一步提供开放获取对引用率、替代计量学、科学素养/公众参与和研究质量影响的证据来完善综述。

意见：

作者将“促进更高科学素养的文化”作为开放获取的一个益处。虽然这在理论上是一个益处，但在特定科学领域中，更多或更少的开放获取是否与这些领域的更高或更低的科学素养相关联？这一潜在益处是否有研究文献支持？作者应明确开放获取的证据基础上的益处和潜在弊端。应提供相关研究的参考文献。

作者在呈现证据的结构和使用的语言（例如“开放获取的案例”）似乎从一开始就更倾向于开放获取的积极影响/益处。作者应非常谨慎地在做出基于价值的陈述或论证之前先审查证据，即使最终证据基础上的益处超过了任何潜在弊端或缺乏显著益处。

请更正以下句子中的错别字：“[In] A longitudinal study Eysenbach (2006) compared…”

作者写道：“引用优势的另一种解释可能是，研究人员在发现更具影响力时选择以开放获取方式发表，但实证证据与这种选择效应相矛盾。Gargouri等人（2010年）比较了同一批开放获取文章的引用次数，这些文章要么是自行选择为开放获取，要么是强制为开放获取（例如，由资助者要求）。研究得出结论，这两种文章的引用次数都显著高于非开放获取文章。因此，这些发现排除了作者选择偏倚作为引用优势原因的可能性（Gargouri等人，2010年）。”然而，资助研究是否也可能因为首先被选中资助并强制为开放获取而被认为“更具影响力”？作者应讨论这一点，以及是否有任何实验性研究探讨了开放获取是否提供了引用优势。这或许可以建议作为未来的研究方向。作者还应讨论为何有些研究发现开放获取论文没有引用优势。

关于研究论文在社交媒体上的提及和引用次数，作者也可以考虑引用Liang, X., Su, L. Y. F., Yeo, S. K., Scheufele, D. A., Brossard, D., Xenos, M., ... & Corley, E. A. (2014). Building Buzz (Scientists) Communicating Science in New Media Environments. Journalism & Mass Communication Quarterly, 1077699014550092. [PDF]

在讨论开放获取的经济问题时，作者还应讨论对各种利益相关者的潜在弊端证据，例如支付出版费用的资金来源以及这些费用可能如何影响个别研究人员。开放获取的付费出版模式也可能给早期职业研究人员和在难以获得研究资助的领域工作的研究人员带来负担。

作者没有讨论开放获取对研究质量或可重复性的潜在影响（可重复性仅在开放数据的背景下提及）。由于这是一个过去有争议的问题（例如提到的“ sting”操作），作者应讨论任何研究了开放获取对同行评审严谨性、研究质量、复制研究/可重复性等影响的研究。也有关于开放同行评审（如F1000Research所使用的）是否影响评审质量的讨论，例如（Rooyen等人，1999年）。作者在讨论开放同行评审时应提及这一点和/或后续文献。

还有关于科学家/期刊文章作者对开放获取的看法和态度的研究，例如Schroter和Tite（2005年；2006年）。作者可以考虑总结一些这类研究，因为它为现有开放获取障碍和研究人员的感知弊端提供了背景。

总结：

总的来说，这篇综述的主题重要且及时。然而，本文在系统总结与开放获取对科学出版、公众参与科学、科学素养和替代计量学影响相关的前人研究方面，未能达到我对系统综述的期望。作者应谨慎地在系统审查证据基础上的益处、弊端和/或缺乏显著益处之前，避免做出与开放获取案例相关的价值判断/论证。作者还应讨论我们如何客观权衡对各种利益相关者（包括研究人员，尤其是早期职业研究人员）的证据基础上的益处与潜在弊端。作者应避免仅总结前人研究中发现开放获取对他们在论文中考虑的各种潜在影响领域的积极影响。本文已呈现的证据是严谨且详细的。然而，我建议进行修订，以更系统的证据完善这篇综述。

reasons: The authors cite “fostering a culture of greater scientific literacy” as a benefit of open access.
While this is theoretically a benefit, has more or less open access in particular scientific fields been tied to greater or lesser scientific literacy in those areas?
Is this potential benefit supported by research literature?
The authors should be clear on what the evidence-based benefits of open access are, and also what the potential drawbacks are.
References to related research should be provided on this topic.

Related to social media mentions of research papers and citation counts, the authors might also consider citing Liang, X., Su, L. Y. F., Yeo, S. K., Scheufele, D. A., Brossard, D., Xenos, M., ... & Corley, E. A. (2014).
There has also been some discussion of whether open peer review (like that used by F1000Research) affects the quality of reviews, e.g. (Rooyen et al. 1999).
The authors should mention this and/or subsequent literature when addressing open peer review.

As this has been a controversial issue in the past (e.g. the mentioned 'sting' operations) the authors should discuss any research that has investigated the impact of open access on the rigor of peer reviews, research quality, presence of replication studies / reproducibility, etc.

However, this paper falls short of what I would expect from a systematic review in terms of systematically summarizing previous research findings related to the impact of open access on scientific publishing, public engagement with science, science literacy and altmetrics.

I think this review article would benefit from a re-write to correct potentially biased language in support of open access and to round out the review with further evidence of open access impacts on citation rates, altmetrics, scientific literacy / public engagement and research quality.
Correct the typo in the following sentence: “[In] A longitudinal study Eysenbach (2006) compared…”

The structure the authors use for laying out their evidence and the language they use (e.g. “[the] case for Open Access”) appear to lean more toward the positive impacts / benefits of open access from the outset.

The authors should be very careful to review the evidence first before making value-based statements or arguments about open access, even if the evidence-based benefits outweigh any potential drawbacks, or lack of significant benefits, in the end.

However, this paper falls short of what I would expect from a systematic review in terms of systematically summarizing previous research findings related to the impact of open access on scientific publishing, public engagement with science, science literacy and altmetrics.
However, I would recommend a revision that rounds this review out with more systematic evidence.

paper_title: Economic evaluations of peritoneal dialysis and hemodialysis: 2004-2012
paper_abstract: Background : End-stage renal disease (ESRD) is a debilitating condition resulting in death unless treated. Treatment options include conservative care, transplantation, and dialysis. Major alternative dialysis modalities include peritoneal dialysis (PD) and in-center hemodialysis (ICHD), which have been shown to produce similar outcomes and survival. The need to provide dialysis treatment for patients with ESRD represents a significant financial challenge for global health care systems. Changes in clinically-appropriate dialysis delivery leading to more efficient use of resources would increase health systems’ ability to meet that challenge. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate the economic literature of PD and ICHD within the context of continued economic uncertainty and pressure on healthcare resource use. Methods: A systematic literature search was conducted for studies published between 2004 and 2012.  Articles are included if they were original research studies in English which reported costs and/or cost effectiveness associated with PD and ICHD. Results: Twenty-four articles are included in our review, six of which are cost effectiveness studies comparing PD and ICHD. Conclusions: Our findings echo those of prior published reviews, showing that PD is significantly cost-saving compared to ICHD therapy in most developed countries and some developing countries. Increasing the use of clinically-appropriate PD would substantially reduce healthcare costs.
review_content:
The authors have conducted a systematic review of the cost of provision of peritoneal dialysis versus hemodialysis. They have considered a more recent era than previous reviews, evaluating studies published between 2004 and 2012. Using a well described search strategy and inclusion and exclusion criteria, they provided a narrative review of the 24 cost and cost-effectiveness studies. In tabular format they provided a brief description of each study, and for costing studies provided a ratio of the costs of hemodialysis versus PD. The results of each country were categorized by national income status.

The results of the 24 studies are congruent with previous reviews suggesting that compared to in center hemodialysis, peritoneal dialysis is less costly to provide. The limitations of the studies including differences in perspective, cost categories, and quality are well described. This is a generally well-written and well conducted study and is an important addition to the literature as healthcare systems strive for economic sustainability.

There is a conflict of interest as Baxter is a major supplier of PD equipment and supplies, and many of the author are or were employees / stockholders. This however is clearly outlined in the competing interests section. There does not appear to be any major discernible bias imparted by this.

I have some suggestions to improve clarity and organization of the paper:

Major comments
  * In several places including the abstract and final conclusion it is stated that increase in the use of clinically appropriate PD would reduce healthcare costs. More precise language should be used to indicate that PD should be used instead of hemodialysis (technical efficiency). This is simply to highlight the fact that some health care systems may not provide dialysis therapy at all, or provide dialysis for only a small proportion of the population. This analysis does not compare the cost cost-effectiveness of PD versus conservative management. It might be prudent to make this explicit at some point in the paper, perhaps the discussion.
  * There are several sentences or paragraphs in the results section which I think would be better suited to the methods section. First is the discussion of how income status of each of the countries included in the review were determined. This is in the first paragraph of the results section. The first paragraph of column 2 on page 4 discusses how the ratio of HD to PD costs are determined and I would suggest they should also be in the method section.
  * There are also several sections in the results paragraphs that are more of an interpretation of the results than simply stating the results of their systematic review. For example page 4 first column third paragraph describe the challenges of cross-country comparison but these first few sentences do not describe any results. This would be better suited to the discussion section. I would suggest that the authors go through the results section and move interpretive statements to the discussion. Further, statements around limitations would also be better suited to the discussion.
  * While I agree with the conclusion that increasing the proportion of patients treated with dialysis therapy to PD would lower health care costs, the feasible proportion of patients suitable for peritoneal analysis is controversial. However it is clear that at least in several jurisdictions such as Canada and United States, there are segments of the patient population that would not be suitable for PD, recognizing that PD is generally thought to be significantly underutilized. Exploration of this in the discussion would be useful to place the results in context.

Other comments
  * Page 3 column 2 methods section: The prior literature synthesis from 1996 to 2006 should be referenced.
  * Page 7 column 1 discusses “reimbursement incentives”. Reimbursement implies payment for delivery of a service versus actual cost. These are two different concepts. As this article is looking at cost rather than the effect of reimbursement practices or incentives, I would suggest that this terminology be removed.
  * A recent paper has been published that attempts to look at reasons why PD costs may be higher in some low or middle income countries. This paper suggested that lack of local manufacturing of PD supplies, a low number of PD patients, and high import tariffs may make PD less attractive compared to hemodialysis. It may be worthwhile to incorporate this into the discussion (Karopadi et al., 2013).
paper_title_zh: 腹膜透析与血液透析的经济评估：2004-2012
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：终末期肾病（ESRD）是一种致残性疾病，若不治疗将导致死亡。治疗选项包括保守治疗、移植和透析。主要的替代透析方式包括腹膜透析（PD）和中心血液透析（ICHD），研究表明这两种方式在疗效和生存率上相似。为ESRD患者提供透析治疗对全球卫生保健系统构成了显著的财政挑战。改变临床适宜的透析方式，以更高效地利用资源，将增强卫生系统应对这一挑战的能力。本文旨在评估在持续经济不确定性和医疗资源使用压力背景下，PD和ICHD的经济文献。

方法：对2004年至2012年间发表的研究进行了系统文献检索。纳入标准为以英文发表的原创研究，报告了与PD和ICHD相关的成本和/或成本效益。

结果：共有24篇文章纳入我们的综述，其中6篇为比较PD和ICHD的成本效益研究。

结论：我们的发现与先前发表的综述一致，显示在大多数发达国家和一些发展中国家，PD相比ICHD治疗显著节省成本。增加临床适宜的PD使用将大幅降低医疗保健成本。
review_content_zh:
作者对提供腹膜透析与血液透析的成本进行了系统综述。他们考虑了比以往综述更新的时期，评估了2004年至2012年间发表的研究。通过使用详尽描述的搜索策略以及纳入和排除标准，他们对24项成本和成本效益研究进行了叙述性综述。以表格形式简要描述了每项研究，并为成本研究提供了血液透析与腹膜透析成本的比率。每个国家的研究结果按国民收入状况进行分类。

这24项研究的结果与以往综述一致，表明与中心血液透析相比，提供腹膜透析的成本更低。研究的局限性，包括视角、成本类别和质量上的差异，均有详细描述。这是一篇总体上写得很好且执行得很好的研究，对于力求经济可持续性的医疗系统而言，是文献的重要补充。

存在利益冲突，因为百特公司是腹膜透析设备和用品的主要供应商，且许多作者目前或曾是该公司员工/股东。然而，这一点在竞争利益部分已明确列出。似乎并未因此产生任何明显的偏见。

我有一些建议以改进论文的清晰度和组织结构：

主要意见
  * 在包括摘要和最终结论在内的几处地方提到，增加临床适宜的腹膜透析使用将降低医疗成本。应使用更精确的语言来表明腹膜透析应替代血液透析（技术效率）。这只是为了强调一个事实，即某些医疗系统可能根本不提供透析治疗，或仅为一小部分人口提供透析。这一分析并未比较腹膜透析与保守管理的成本效益。在论文的某个部分，或许是讨论部分，明确指出这一点可能是明智的。
  * 结果部分有几句话或段落我认为更适合放在方法部分。首先是关于如何确定综述中包含的每个国家的收入状况的讨论。这在结果部分的第一段中。第4页第2栏第1段讨论了如何确定血液透析与腹膜透析成本的比率，我也建议将其放在方法部分。
  * 结果段落中也有一些部分更多是对结果的解释，而不仅仅是陈述系统综述的结果。例如，第4页第1栏第3段描述了跨国比较的挑战，但前几句话并未描述任何结果。这更适合放在讨论部分。我建议作者通读结果部分，将解释性陈述移至讨论部分。此外，关于局限性的陈述也更适合放在讨论部分。
  * 虽然我同意增加接受透析治疗的患者中腹膜透析比例会降低医疗成本的结论，但适合腹膜透析的患者比例的可行性是有争议的。然而，至少在加拿大和美国等几个司法管辖区，显然有部分患者不适合腹膜透析，尽管普遍认为腹膜透析利用率显著不足。在讨论中探讨这一点将有助于将结果置于相关背景中。

其他意见
  * 第3页第2栏方法部分：应引用1996年至2006年的先前文献综述。
  * 第7页第1栏讨论了“报销激励”。报销意味着为提供服务而支付的费用，与实际成本是两个不同的概念。由于本文关注的是成本而非报销实践或激励的影响，我建议删除这一术语。
  * 最近发表的一篇论文试图探讨为何在某些低收入或中等收入国家腹膜透析成本可能更高。该论文指出，缺乏本地生产腹膜透析用品、腹膜透析患者数量少以及高进口关税可能使腹膜透析相对于血液透析吸引力较低。将其纳入讨论可能是有价值的（Karopadi等人，2013）。

paper_title: Impact of Climate Change on Human Lactation: Biological, Socioeconomic, and Public Health Implications
paper_abstract: Global climate change poses significant challenges to human health and nutrition, particularly affecting lactating individuals and their infants. This review examines the impact of climate change on lactation, focusing on physiological, socioeconomic, and public health implications. Rising temperatures and heat stress can reduce milk production and alter milk composition, while malnutrition and water scarcity exacerbate these effects. Vulnerable populations face heightened risks, emphasizing the need for targeted mitigation strategies. Recommendations include enhancing nutritional support, securing water supplies, reducing environmental toxin exposure, and integrating lactation considerations into climate policies. Employing a social-ecological lens, this review underscores the necessity of a holistic approach to support lactating individuals in a warming world. Future research should explore the complex interactions between climate stressors and lactation to develop effective public health interventions.
review_content:
I appreciate the opportunity to review this manuscript on an important topic. The main challenge is that I am not quite seeing how this review contributes to the literature in light of other similar recent work on climate change and breastfeeding that has conceptualized the field. For instance, we have had a recent review in JHL by Cerceo et al 2023 that summarizes key areas of this work, as well as recent reviews on heat and infant feeding (Edney et al), food insecurity and breastfeeding (Frontiers in Public Health 2024), water security and child feeding (Schuster et al), just to mention a few. Additionally, the analysis of the review lacks some of the broader considerations that others have already addressed (see below) and would be expected here.
If this paper is further revised, I suggest the following:
 1. Condense the background to a brief overview with updated citations on breastfeeding. The 2023 Lancet Breastfeeding Series does a nice job providing this overview, including structural barriers that prevent many women from achieving their breastfeeding goals – this is a hugely significant issue that the authors don’t reckon with in their analysis. This is very problematic since the paper aims to frame the review in the context of the social ecological model and rightfully emphasizes health inequities. This goal cannot be achieved without considering the landscape of breastfeeding in a broader context. Additionally, there is no consideration of how these structural barriers result in formula feeding, which makes infants particularly vulnerable to any situation without power or safe water (common conditions globally that are becoming particularly common with climate-driven disasters). In a review focused on climate change and breastfeeding, this is absolutely a critical issue to consider. There is wealth of literature on these issues that is not cited here. Nor is there any mention of the climate impacts of formula production (lots from Smith and colleagues on this).
 2. Cut the section on the physiology of breastfeeding – as this not necessary and is part of most textbooks on lactation
 3. Methods – more details on the screening process and the analysis of the results should be included. A PRISMA diagram would be helpful and expected in a review. A summary table of the results should also be presented with brief details on the studies discussed.
 4. Each section of the results needs more detail on the actual studies that are included, their methods, and populations under consideration. Gaps in the literature should be discussed in each section as well.
 5. The discussion section would need to be revisited after the above conceptual and methodological issues are addressed.
paper_title_zh: 气候变化对人类哺乳的影响：生物学、社会经济和公共卫生意义
paper_abstract_zh: 全球气候变化对人类健康和营养构成了重大挑战，尤其是对哺乳期个体及其婴儿的影响。本文综述了气候变化对哺乳的影响，重点关注生理、社会经济和公共卫生方面的含义。气温上升和热应激可以减少乳汁产量并改变乳汁成分，而营养不良和水资源短缺则加剧了这些影响。脆弱人群面临更高的风险，突显了制定针对性缓解策略的必要性。建议包括加强营养支持、保障水资源供应、减少环境毒素暴露，并将哺乳考虑纳入气候政策。采用社会-生态学视角，本文强调在变暖的世界中支持哺乳期个体的整体方法的重要性。未来研究应探讨气候压力源与哺乳之间的复杂相互作用，以制定有效的公共卫生干预措施。
review_content_zh:
我感谢有机会审阅这篇关于重要主题的手稿。主要挑战在于，考虑到近期关于气候变化和母乳喂养的其他类似工作已经对这一领域进行了概念化，我不太清楚这篇综述如何为文献做出贡献。例如，我们在《JHL》杂志上刚刚发表了由Cerceo等人于2023年撰写的一篇综述，总结了这一工作的关键领域，还有关于高温和婴儿喂养（Edney等人）、食物不安全性和母乳喂养（《公共卫生前沿》2024年）、水安全性和儿童喂养（Schuster等人）的近期综述，仅举几例。此外，这篇综述的分析缺乏其他人已经探讨的一些更广泛的考虑（见下文），而这些本应在此处有所体现。

如果这篇论文进一步修订，我建议如下：
1. 将背景部分浓缩为简短的概述，并更新关于母乳喂养的引用。2023年《柳叶刀》母乳喂养系列很好地提供了这一概述，包括阻碍许多妇女实现母乳喂养目标的结构性障碍——这是一个极其重要的问题，作者在分析中并未涉及。这非常成问题，因为论文旨在将综述置于社会生态模型的背景下，并正确地强调了健康不平等。如果不考虑更广泛背景下的母乳喂养现状，这一目标无法实现。此外，没有考虑到这些结构性障碍如何导致配方奶喂养，这使得婴儿在无电力或安全水源的情况下特别脆弱（这是全球常见的状况，尤其在气候驱动灾害中尤为常见）。在一篇聚焦于气候变化和母乳喂养的综述中，这绝对是一个关键问题。关于这些问题的文献非常丰富，但此处并未引用。也没有提及配方奶生产的气候影响（Smith及其同事对此有大量研究）。
2. 删除关于母乳喂养生理学的部分——因为这并非必要，且大多数关于哺乳的教科书已有涉及。
3. 方法——应包括更多关于筛选过程和结果分析的细节。PRISMA图将有助于综述，并且是预期中的内容。还应呈现一个结果汇总表，简要列出所讨论研究的详细信息。
4. 结果的每个部分都需要更详细地介绍所包含的实际研究、其方法和考虑的群体。每个部分也应讨论文献中的空白。
5. 在解决上述概念和方法问题后，讨论部分需要重新审视。

reasons: For instance, we have had a recent review in JHL by Cerceo et al 2023 that summarizes key areas of this work, as well as recent reviews on heat and infant feeding (Edney et al), food insecurity and breastfeeding (Frontiers in Public Health 2024), water security and child feeding (Schuster et al), just to mention a few.

The 2023 Lancet Breastfeeding Series does a nice job providing this overview, including structural barriers that prevent many women from achieving their breastfeeding goals – this is a hugely significant issue that the authors don’t reckon with in their analysis.

Additionally, there is no consideration of how these structural barriers result in formula feeding, which makes infants particularly vulnerable to any situation without power or safe water (common conditions globally that are becoming particularly common with climate-driven disasters).
There is wealth of literature on these issues that is not cited here.
Nor is there any mention of the climate impacts of formula production (lots from Smith and colleagues on this).

The main challenge is that I am not quite seeing how this review contributes to the literature in light of other similar recent work on climate change and breastfeeding that has conceptualized the field.
Additionally, the analysis of the review lacks some of the broader considerations that others have already addressed (see below) and would be expected here.
This is very problematic since the paper aims to frame the review in the context of the social ecological model and rightfully emphasizes health inequities.
This goal cannot be achieved without considering the landscape of breastfeeding in a broader context.
1. Condense the background to a brief overview with updated citations on breastfeeding.
2. Cut the section on the physiology of breastfeeding – as this not necessary and is part of most textbooks on lactation
3. Methods – more details on the screening process and the analysis of the results should be included.
A PRISMA diagram would be helpful and expected in a review.
A summary table of the results should also be presented with brief details on the studies discussed.
4. Each section of the results needs more detail on the actual studies that are included, their methods, and populations under consideration.
Gaps in the literature should be discussed in each section as well.
5. The discussion section would need to be revisited after the above conceptual and methodological issues are addressed.

paper_title: Digital sensors (non-invasive) for early detection of risk factors for recurrent stroke: A systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Improving awareness in patients with stroke to detect risk factors of recurrent stroke has recently become a major challenge for all health professionals in preventing recurrence among stroke survivors. Utilization of advanced technology, such as digital sensors, (a non-invasive device) is among the breakthroughs in detecting the risk of disease and promotes more effective prevention and improves quality of care. This study aims to conduct a systematic review on studies addressing early detection of the risk factors of recurrent stroke through the utilization of digital sensors. 
  
  
    Methods 
    A literature search was carried out on articles published between 2011 - 2018 on EBSCO, Elsevier, Science Direct, ProQuest, Springer link, PubMed, MEDLINE, PLoS, and the Journal of Community Nursing. The search identified quantitative research studies on the utilization of digital sensors in cases of hypertension, diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and cardiac disorders that contributed to stroke recurrence. Each study’s bias was assessed using Review Manager 5. 
  
  
    Results 
    Ten articles were analyzed through data extraction. Robust assessment of independent risk factors which provoke recurrent stroke such as hypertension, diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and heart diseases could lead to conservation of health resources. It is very important to monitor these factors. With the development of technology, the potential use of non-invasive monitoring for hypertension, diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and heart diseases as risk factors for recurrent stroke events is considered effective because it is easy, simple, low cost, sensitive, and does not cause additional suffering for patients. 
  
  
    Conclusion 
    A practical and non-invasive method for early detection and monitoring of risk factors may reduce the risk of stroke recurrence among stroke survivors.
review_content:
1. How to define “early detection of the risk factors” when conceptualizing the paper.
 2. The “proper practice guidelines” were listed as part of the objective, however, it hasn't been discussed and described thoroughly in the manuscript.
 3. The year of publication was limited to 2011-2018. There are couples of new studies 2019-2020, why such studies were not included?
 4. The literatures searching were performed through a combination of indexing databases and journal databases, with majority of the searching were done through journal databases. Why was such a searching done? It is advisable to the author to search through the indexing databases rather than the journal databases. By which, the results obtained through the searching on these limited numbers of journal databases is incomplete.
 5. The search term is quite diversified, ‘risk factor of stroke’, ‘post-stroke’, ‘recurrent stroke’, ‘stroke prevention’, ‘detection’, ‘digital sensor’, ‘non-invasive’, and ‘nursing’.” Not sure why nursing was used as part of the search term. Whilst the title involves quality of care, and such term was not included as part of the search term?
 6. The article would be much more comprehensive if the author can include the risk factors such as “hypertension”, “diabetes”, etc. as part of the search term.
 7. Figure 1 shows the process of screening. It is advisable that the author should include the items that have been excluded in Figure 1. It has no meaning to input the number as n=43, without telling the reader why it is excluded.
 8. I found these sentences very confusing “The search process resulted in 92 articles which matched the keywords. These articles were then filtered according to full text and publication year between 2011 – 2018 which resulted in 49 articles. These 49 articles were then reviewed based on titles matching the use of digital sensors (non-invasive) for early detection of risk factors for recurrent stroke and resulted in 16 articles. Finally, these 16 articles were filtered based on inclusion and exclusion criteria, (see below) and resulted in 10 articles. The search process on the databases is shown in Figure 1.” If there are 92 articles that matched the keywords, shouldn’t all the 92 articles being screen through the inclusion/exclusion criteria? Why the author needs to review the title that matched with digital sensors, then screen the title based in the inclusion/exclusion criteria?
 9. The inclusion criteria of study design: Randomized Controlled Trial, meta-analysis, cohort study, survey and case report. However, “experimental” has been used in Table 1. Thus, it is not sure whether experimental work is referring to survey/case report/ any other types of study design.
10. To increase the transparency of the quality assessments, the information of Critical Appraisal Skills Program (CSAP) should be appended as supplementary files.
11. Please elaborate more on “Ten articles were analyzed through data extraction.”
12. The meta-analysis has been used as the inclusion criteria for the study. How many meta-analysis papers have been included in the analysis so far? Shouldn’t the meta-analysis paper being excluded from the analysis?
13. Nursing intervention has been used as the exclusion criteria for the study, but the search term “nursing” has been used in the literature searching. It is contradicting.
14. Are digital sensors the same as digital devices? Are they interchangeable? Any differences between them? As illustrated by the author, blood pressure measurement device has been used to monitor their hypertension status. Such deficiencies have led to the development of a blood pressure measurement device that utilizes automatic measurement features. …..It is easy to use, only requiring a finger tap and the sensor will automatically measure the blood pressure with a sensitivity matching the user’s condition. Measurement of blood pressure through such a digital sensor also offers advantage that it enables the patient to monitor his own blood pressure at any time18. The author is describing only the digital sensors/digital device for BP monitoring?
15. Please elaborate more on “Therefore, a device to detect cholesterol levels through a digital sensor which is pain-free with rapid and accurate results is currently being developed15.”
16. As for the biosensors, have they been verified clinically? Or they are still in the stages of clinical trials?
17. It would be of great interest for the clinicians and researchers, if the author could include the biosensors which have been verified clinically. Otherwise, the findings of this systematic review need to be analyzed with caution.
paper_title_zh: 数字传感器（非侵入性）用于复发性卒中风险因素的早期检测：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
提高卒中患者对复发性卒中风险因素的认知，已成为所有医疗专业人员预防卒中幸存者复发的主要挑战。利用先进技术，如数字传感器（一种非侵入性设备），是检测疾病风险的突破之一，并促进更有效的预防，提高护理质量。本研究旨在对通过使用数字传感器进行复发性卒中风险因素早期检测的研究进行系统综述。

方法
在EBSCO、Elsevier、Science Direct、ProQuest、Springer link、PubMed、MEDLINE、PLoS和《社区护理杂志》上，对2011年至2018年间发表的文章进行了文献检索。检索确定了关于在高血压、糖尿病、高胆固醇血症和心脏疾病中使用数字传感器的定量研究，这些疾病对卒中复发有贡献。使用Review Manager 5评估每项研究的偏倚。

结果
通过数据提取分析了十篇文章。对高血压、糖尿病、高胆固醇血症和心脏病等独立风险因素的稳健评估，可能导致卫生资源的节约。监测这些因素非常重要。随着技术的发展，将非侵入性监测用于高血压、糖尿病、高胆固醇血症和心脏病作为复发性卒中事件的风险因素被认为是有效的，因为其简便、成本低、敏感，且不会给患者带来额外痛苦。

结论
一种实用且非侵入性的方法用于早期检测和监测风险因素，可能会降低卒中幸存者卒中复发的风险。
review_content_zh:
1. 在构思论文时，如何定义“早期检测风险因素”。
2. “适当的实践指南”被列为目标的一部分，然而在稿件中并未进行充分讨论和描述。
3. 发表年份限定在2011-2018年。2019-2020年有几项新研究，为何未将这些研究纳入？
4. 文献检索通过索引数据库和期刊数据库的组合进行，大部分检索是通过期刊数据库完成的。为何进行这样的检索？建议作者通过索引数据库而非期刊数据库进行检索。通过这些有限的期刊数据库检索得到的结果是不完整的。
5. 检索词较为多样化，包括“中风风险因素”、“中风后”、“复发性中风”、“中风预防”、“检测”、“数字传感器”、“非侵入性”和“护理”。不确定为何将“护理”作为检索词的一部分。虽然标题涉及护理质量，但该词并未作为检索词的一部分？
6. 如果作者能将“高血压”、“糖尿病”等风险因素作为检索词的一部分，文章将更为全面。
7. 图1展示了筛选过程。建议作者在图1中包含被排除的项目。仅输入n=43而没有告知读者为何被排除是没有意义的。
8. 发现这些句子非常令人困惑：“检索过程共得到92篇与关键词匹配的文章。这些文章随后根据全文和2011-2018年的发表年份进行筛选，结果为49篇文章。这49篇文章再根据标题与使用数字传感器（非侵入性）进行复发性中风风险因素早期检测的匹配进行审查，结果为16篇文章。最后，这16篇文章根据纳入和排除标准（见下文）进行筛选，结果为10篇文章。数据库的检索过程如图1所示。”如果有92篇文章与关键词匹配，难道不应该对所有92篇文章进行纳入/排除标准的筛选吗？为何作者需要先审查与数字传感器匹配的标题，然后再根据纳入/排除标准进行筛选？
9. 研究设计的纳入标准：随机对照试验、meta分析、队列研究、调查和病例报告。然而，表1中使用了“实验性”。因此，不确定实验性工作是指调查/病例报告/还是其他类型的研究设计。
10. 为提高质量评估的透明度，应将关键评估技能程序（CSAP）的信息作为补充文件附上。
11. 请进一步阐述“十篇文章通过数据提取进行分析”。
12. meta分析已被用作研究的纳入标准。到目前为止，有多少篇meta分析文章被纳入分析？难道meta分析文章不应该被排除在分析之外吗？
13. 护理干预被用作研究的排除标准，但检索词“护理”在文献检索中被使用。这是矛盾的。
14. 数字传感器与数字设备是否相同？它们是否可互换？它们之间有何区别？如作者所述，血压测量设备被用于监测高血压状况。这些缺陷导致了利用自动测量功能的血压测量设备的开发……它易于使用，只需轻触手指，传感器将自动测量血压，灵敏度与用户状况相匹配。通过这种数字传感器测量血压还具有使患者能够随时监测自己血压的优势18。作者是否仅描述了用于血压监测的数字传感器/数字设备？
15. 请进一步阐述“因此，目前正在开发一种通过数字传感器检测胆固醇水平的设备，该设备无痛且结果快速准确15。”
16. 就生物传感器而言，它们是否已经过临床验证？还是仍处于临床试验阶段？
17. 如果作者能包括已经过临床验证的生物传感器，将对临床医生和研究人员具有极大兴趣。否则，本系统综述的发现需要谨慎分析。

paper_title: State-of-the-art optimization methods for short-term mine planning
paper_abstract:
Maintaining short-term planning aligned with the ultimate long-term plan is challenging. This requires many details to be modelled on a daily or weekly basis to reach this target. Short-term planning is more challenging than medium- and long-term planning because it deals with daily challenges with block model changes, mining cut polygons variation, which increases the gap between medium- and long-term plans for each material to be mined. Short-term mine planning teams are expected to identify and manage potential risks to mitigate them, and eventually achieve the long-term objective of maximizing the Net Present Value (NPV). Very few studies have identified the problems that exist in short-term mine planning and provided technical solutions to overcome them for open-pit mines. One of the complexities associated with short-term planning is the creation of polygons or mining cuts by clustering before optimizing and scheduling the plan to reduce the computational expense of mine planning models. 
 The primary objective of this study is to review the latest papers describing short-term mine planning challenges and technical solutions proposed to optimize mine planning for open-pit mines.
review_content:
1. The authors list a number of papers that have provided an review of short-term or long-term planning. What is the significance of this review for the author? What is the difference from previous studies? I suggest adding the specific differences in Table 1.

2. Please add explanations and differences between short-term, medium-term as well as long-term plans. Is there a quantitative range that distinguishes these three terms?

3. Please spell out the abbreviations when they first appear. For example, RM and UG.

4. The research gap is not clear to me. Can you clarify your research gap of this review paper? Not the research gap of computational techniques.

5. Please explain why this review paper focuses on the two aspects of short-term planning.

6. Authors need to summarize previous research and offer constructive comments or ideas. For example, the author overviews the application of clustering methods. The authors simply read the relevant literature and methods without making some summarizing conclusions and recommendations. This problem also applies to other parts of the review.
paper_title_zh: 短期矿山规划的前沿优化方法
paper_abstract_zh:
保持短期规划与最终长期规划的一致性是一项挑战。这需要在每日或每周的基础上对许多细节进行建模，以实现这一目标。短期规划比中、长期规划更具挑战性，因为它需要应对日常挑战，如块模型变化、采矿切割多边形的变化，这增加了每种待开采材料的中、长期规划之间的差距。短期矿山规划团队需要识别并管理潜在风险以减轻它们，最终实现最大化净现值（NPV）的长期目标。很少有研究识别出短期矿山规划中存在的问题，并为露天矿山提供技术解决方案。与短期规划相关的一个复杂性是在优化和规划排程之前，通过聚类创建多边形或采矿切割，以减少矿山规划模型的计算成本。
本研究的主要目标是回顾最新文献，描述短期矿山规划的挑战以及为优化露天矿山规划所提出的技术解决方案。
review_content_zh:
1. 作者列举了一系列提供了短期或长期规划综述的论文。这一综述对作者的意义何在？与以往研究的区别是什么？建议在表1中添加具体差异。

2. 请添加短期、中期以及长期计划之间的解释和区别。是否有区分这三个术语的定量范围？

3. 请在缩写首次出现时拼写全称。例如，RM和UG。

4. 我不清楚研究空白。能否阐明这篇综述论文的研究空白？而不是计算技术的研究空白。

5. 请解释为什么这篇综述论文聚焦于短期规划的两个方面。

6. 作者需要总结以往研究并提出建设性的评论或想法。例如，作者概述了聚类方法的应用。作者只是阅读了相关文献和方法，而没有做出一些总结性的结论和建议。这一问题也适用于综述的其他部分。

paper_title: Transfection types, methods, and strategies: A technical review
paper_abstract: Transfection is a modern and powerful method used to insert foreign nucleic acids into eukaryotic cells. The ability to modify host cells' genetic content enables the broad application of this process in studying normal cellular processes, disease molecular mechanism, and gene therapeutic effect. In this review, we summarized and compared the findings from various reported literature on the characteristics, strengths, and limitations of various transfection methods, type of transfected nucleic acids, transfection controls, and approaches to assess transfection efficiency. With the vast choices of approaches available, we hope that this review will help researchers, especially those new to the field, in their decision making over the transfection protocol or strategy appropriate for their experimental aims.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anna Shmakova) Basic reporting The review by Chong et al. has improved significantly from the previous version. The idea of the review is clear, the material is quite well organized and easy to read. Sufficient background is provided. Probably, for a person unfamiliar with the field of transfection, this review will serve as a good help to dive into this topic. The Introduction adequately introduce the subject. paper_title: Harmful effects of microplastic pollution on health of animals. A Literature Review
paper_abstract: Background.Environmental pollution by microplastics is a global problem that has arisen from the extensive production and use of plastics. Small particles of different types plastic with a diameter of less than 5 mm are found around the globe in water, air, soil, and various living organisms. An individual constantly absorbs microplastics with water and food, inhales with air. Therefore, an important issue of microplastic environmental pollution is whether it poses a risk to human health. Objectives:Experimental studies of the potential health risks of microplastic are now under the undoubted scientific interest.

文章包含了足够的背景资料，并附有适当的参考文献，为这篇文献综述提供了依据。作为小修改，请检查第62条参考文献（第605行）：在“2021”后缺少一个句号。- 已检查参考文献格式，错误已更正。

尽管改进对纳米塑料的描述可能超出了本文的范围，但我建议在第61行首次提到“nanoplastics”时添加NP缩写，以便在文本中明确引用（第263、264、266、328行及表1中）。- 已添加NP缩写。

paper_title: A comprehensive review of deep learning-based single image super-resolution
paper_abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) is one of the vital image processing methods that improve the resolution of an image in the field of computer vision. In the last two decades, significant progress has been made in the field of super-resolution, especially utilizing deep learning methods. This survey is an effort to provide a detailed survey of recent progress in singleimage super-resolution in the perspective of deep learning while also informing about the initial classical methods used for image super-resolution. The survey classifies the image SR methods into four categories, i.e., classical methods, supervised learning-based methods, unsupervised learning-based methods, and domain-specific SR methods. We also introduce the problem of SR to provide intuition about image quality metrics, available reference datasets, and SR challenges. Deep learning-based approaches of SR are evaluated using a reference dataset. Some of the reviewed state-of-the-art image SR methods include enhanced deep SR network (EDSR), cycle-in-cycle GAN (CinCGAN), multiscale residual network (MSRN), meta residual dense network (Meta-RDN), recurrent back-projection network (RBPN), second-order attention network (SAN), SR feedback network (SRFBN) and wavelet-based residual attention network (WRAN). Finally, this survey is concluded with future directions and trends in SR and open problems in SR to be addressed by the researchers.

paper_title_zh: 基于深度学习的单图像超分辨率综合综述
paper_abstract_zh: 图像超分辨率（SR）是计算机视觉领域中提高图像分辨率的关键图像处理方法之一。在过去二十年里，超分辨率领域取得了显著进展，尤其是在深度学习方法的应用上。本综述旨在从深度学习的视角对单图像超分辨率领域的最新进展进行详细梳理，同时介绍用于图像超分辨率的基本经典方法。综述将图像SR方法分为四类，即经典方法、基于监督学习的方 法、基于无监督学习的方法和特定领域SR方法。我们还介绍了SR问题，以提供对图像质量指标、可用参考数据集和SR挑战的直观理解。使用参考数据集评估了基于深度学习的SR方法。一些被审查的最先进图像SR方法包括增强型深度SR网络（EDSR）、循环循环GAN（CinCGAN）、多尺度残差网络（MSRN）、元残差密集网络（Meta-RDN）、循环反向投影网络（RBPN）、二阶注意力网络（SAN）、SR反馈网络（SRFBN）和基于小波的多尺度残差注意力网络（WRAN）。最后，本综述总结了SR的未来方向和趋势，以及研究人员需要解决的超分辨率开放性问题。

paper_title: Ethiopia's Potato Seed System: Regulatory Challenges, Quality Assurance Issues, and Pathways for Improvement ─ A mini review
paper_abstract:
Background 
 Ethiopia’s potato seed system is currently hindered by a disjointed regulatory framework, insufficient quality assurance processes, and a lack of collaboration among stakeholders, which collectively impede agricultural productivity and food security. The regulatory environment is characterized by inconsistent seed certification practices and a dependence on informal seed sources, negatively affecting the quality of potato seeds available to farmers. Although potatoes play a crucial role in global food security by providing high yields compared to other staple crops, the sector grapples with significant challenges due to bureaucratic inefficiencies, limited technical expertise, and the widespread presence of counterfeit seeds throughout the value chain. 
 
 
 Methods 
 To tackle these challenges, this mini-review outlines potential improvements, stressing the necessity for a unified regulatory framework tailored to the unique issues of vegetatively propagated crops. For this reason, we have used different literature source from web of science, Pubmed, Google Scholar, ResearchGate and other scientific websites. We have documented the most relevant information focusing on potato seed system, regulatory frameworks, quality assurance bottlenecks and pathways for improvement across the seed value chain. 
 
 
 Results 
 our paper highlights key recommendations that includes enhancing training for regulatory staff, investing in research for disease-resistant varieties, and bolstering public-private partnerships to encourage innovation and resource sharing. Furthermore, improving traceability in the seed supply chain is essential for maintaining seed quality and integrity. 
 
 
 Conclusions 
 This review calls for a comprehensive strategy that fosters stakeholder engagement and promotes sustainable practices to rejuvenate Ethiopia’s potato seed system, thereby supporting the livelihoods of millions of smallholder farmers and strengthening national food security through integrated seed sector development and capacity improvement of the seed regulatory body as well as smallholder farmers.
review_content:
The Review article gave insight into the Ethiopian Seed System and highlighted the challenges facing the sector and the consequences of these on the Potato production industry in particular. The authors also made good, significant suggestions to tackle these challenges to establish a viable potato seed production system that would enhance the yield and productivity of potato in Ethiopia.

However, it will be appropriate for the authors to maintain a definite pattern of citing references throughout the article; provide the full meaning of VPC where it was mentioned; give an explanation on COC licences because of audience who are not based or familiar with Ethiopia; and reflect the National Seed Regulatory authority mentioned on the Organizational diagram as mentioned in the text.

Also, the conclusion that "The interplay between various regulatory bodies can create confusion, resulting in overlapping mandates and insufficient support for stakeholders at different levels" was not clearly reflected in the main text.

paper_abstract_zh:
背景
埃塞俄比亚的土豆种子系统目前受到不连贯的监管框架、不足的质量保证流程以及各利益相关方之间缺乏合作的阻碍，这些因素共同妨碍了农业生产力和粮食安全。监管环境的特点是种子认证实践不一致且依赖非正式的种子来源，这负面影响了农民可获得的土豆种子质量。尽管土豆通过与其他主食作物相比的高产量在全球粮食安全中扮演着关键角色，但该行业因官僚低效、技术专业知识有限以及整个价值链中普遍存在的假冒种子而面临重大挑战。

方法
为应对这些挑战，这篇小综述概述了潜在的改进措施，强调需要建立一个针对无性繁殖作物独特问题的统一监管框架。为此，我们使用了来自Web of Science、PubMed、Google Scholar、ResearchGate和其他科学网站的不同文献来源。我们记录了最相关信息，重点关注土豆种子系统、监管框架、质量保证瓶颈以及种子价值链中的改进途径。

结果
我们的论文提出了关键建议，包括加强监管人员的培训、投资于抗病品种的研究以及加强公私合作伙伴关系以鼓励创新和资源共享。此外，改善种子供应链的可追溯性对于维持种子质量和完整性至关重要。

结论
这篇综述呼吁制定一项全面战略，促进利益相关方参与并推广可持续做法，以重振埃塞俄比亚的土豆种子系统，从而支持数百万小农的生计，并通过综合种子部门发展和种子监管机构以及小农的能力提升来加强国家粮食安全。
review_content_zh:
综述文章深入探讨了埃塞俄比亚种子系统，并突出了该领域面临的挑战及其对马铃薯生产业的特定影响。作者还提出了切实可行且重要的建议，以应对这些挑战，建立可行的马铃薯种子生产系统，从而提高埃塞俄比亚马铃薯的产量和生产力。

然而，建议作者在整篇文章中保持一致的引用格式；在提及VPC时提供其完整含义；由于读者可能不熟悉或不基于埃塞俄比亚，应对COC许可证进行解释；并在组织结构图中反映文中提到的国家种子监管机构。

此外，结论中“各监管机构之间的相互作用可能导致混乱，造成职责重叠和对不同层级利益相关者支持不足”的观点在正文部分并未清晰体现。

reasons: The Review article gave insight into the Ethiopian Seed System and highlighted the challenges facing the sector and the consequences of these on the Potato production industry in particular.
The authors also made good, significant suggestions to tackle these challenges to establish a viable potato seed production system that would enhance the yield and productivity of potato in Ethiopia.

Also, the conclusion that "The interplay between various regulatory bodies can create confusion, resulting in overlapping mandates and insufficient support for stakeholders at different levels" was not clearly reflected in the main text.

However, it will be appropriate for the authors to maintain a definite pattern of citing references throughout the article; provide the full meaning of VPC where it was mentioned; give an explanation on COC licences because of audience who are not based or familiar with Ethiopia; and reflect the National Seed Regulatory authority mentioned on the Organizational diagram as mentioned in the text.

Also, the conclusion that "The interplay between various regulatory bodies can create confusion, resulting in overlapping mandates and insufficient support for stakeholders at different levels" was not clearly reflected in the main text.

paper_title: Tourette syndrome research highlights from 2018
paper_abstract: This is the fifth yearly article in the Tourette Syndrome Research Highlights series, summarizing research from 2018 relevant to Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders. The authors briefly summarize reports they consider most important or interesting. The  highlights from 2019 article  is being drafted on the Authorea online authoring platform, and readers are encouraged to add references or give feedback on our selections using the comments feature on that page. After the calendar year ends, the article is submitted as the annual update for the  Tics collection on F1000Research .
review_content:
This is a well selected review that covers most of the essential 2018 works on Tourette syndrome.
One area that will probably have a big impact in the future, is the ability to predict which neurocognitive variables represents good predictors of clinical evolution in TS. Electrophysiological measures were useful to predict outcome, following a psychological intervention, in other psychiatric disorders, such as anxiety disorders, depression and obsessive-compulsory disorder (Krause et al., 2015; Burkhouse et al., 2016)1,2, but has yet to be tested in TS. One article did just that last year. I suggest to add an article by Morand-Beaulieu and colleagues (2018)3 that suggest that electrophysiological markers could offers new predictors for therapeutic outcome in TS and CTD patients with its high temporal precision to follow the stream of fast cognitive and motor processes. Morand-Beaulieu et al (2018) suggested that motor-related and slow cortical potentials could constitute electrophysiological markers of TS.
These measures are related to SMA and basal ganglia functioning which is pretty consistent with neuroimaging and electrophysiological studies already reported in the current manuscript. I believe that this article could fit well in the ‘’clinical and neuropsychological studies’’ section or perhaps in the ‘psychological intervention’ section if you decide to integrate it.

paper_title: Pharmaceutical policy and innovation for rare diseases: A narrative review
paper_abstract:
This article aims to synthesize the existing literature on the implementation of public policies to incentivize the development of treatments for rare diseases, (diseases with very low prevalence and therefore with low commercial interest) otherwise known as orphan drugs. The implementation of these incentives in the United States (US), Japan, and in the European Union (EU) seems to be related to a substantial increase in treatments for these diseases, and has influenced the way the pharmaceutical research & development (R&D) system operates beyond this policy area. Despite the success of the Orphan Drug model, the academic literature also highlights the negative implications that these public policies have on affordability and access to orphan drugs, as well as on the prioritization of certain disease rare areas over others. 
  The synthesis focuses mostly on the United States’ Orphan Drug Act (ODA) as a model for subsequent policies in other regions and countries. It starts with a historical overview of the creation of the term “rare diseases”, continues with a summary of the evidence available on the US ODA’s positive and negative impacts, and provides a summary of the different proposals to reform these incentives in light of the negative outcomes described. Finally, it describes some key aspects of the Japanese and European policies, as well as some of the challenges captured in the literature related to their impact in Low- and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs).
review_content:
This literature review is handy on how the market rationale captured the orphan drug R&D policies and became them in a business strategy to take advantage of both public financing and extending market exclusivity. The US, European, and Japanese orphan drug R&D policies are well described in the paper, as well as its affordability and sustainability failures. Also, the article provides evidence about the undesirable outcomes of the current R&D model and some recommendations to fix it.

On the other hand, as the authors explain, given the few articles they find on Low- and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs), it is hard to extrapolate the findings. In the same line, and given the definition of orphan drugs is far from neglected diseases, the authors could consider removing the phrase "these policies have not helped address other areas, such as neglected diseases that affect vulnerable populations, mostly in LMICs."

Finally, because of few papers found on R&D policies in LMIC, the authors could suggest another research question around the negative impact of the orphan drug business strategy on the drug regulatory systems and access to orphan drugs in these countries, carrying direct interviews, grey reviews, etc.
paper_title_zh: 罕见病药物政策与创新：叙事性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
本文旨在综合现有文献，探讨实施公共政策以激励罕见病（即患病率极低、商业利益较小的疾病）治疗方法开发的现状，这些治疗方法通常被称为孤儿药。在美国、日本和欧盟实施这些激励措施似乎与这些疾病治疗方法的显著增加相关，并影响了制药研发系统在此政策领域之外的操作方式。尽管孤儿药模式取得了成功，但学术文献也强调了这些公共政策对孤儿药的可负担性和可及性以及优先考虑某些罕见病领域而非其他领域的负面含义。

本文综合分析主要聚焦于美国的孤儿药法案（ODA）作为其他地区和国家后续政策的典范。文章首先回顾了“罕见病”一词的创立历史，接着概述了有关美国ODA积极和消极影响的现有证据，并针对所述负面结果，总结了改革这些激励措施的不同提案。最后，描述了日本和欧洲政策的一些关键方面，以及文献中捕捉到的与这些政策对低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）影响的若干挑战。
review_content_zh:
这篇文献综述详细探讨了市场逻辑如何捕获孤儿药研发政策，并将其转变为一种商业策略，以利用公共融资和延长市场独占权。文中对美国、欧洲和日本的孤儿药研发政策进行了详尽描述，同时也指出了其在可负担性和可持续性方面的失败。此外，文章还提供了当前研发模式不良后果的证据，并提出了一些建议以进行改进。

另一方面，正如作者所言，鉴于他们发现的关于低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的文章较少，很难推广这些发现。同样，由于孤儿药的定义与被忽视疾病相去甚远，作者可以考虑删除“这些政策并未帮助解决其他领域的问题，例如主要影响LMICs中脆弱人群的被忽视疾病”这一表述。

最后，由于关于LMICs研发政策的文献较少，作者可以提出另一个研究问题，围绕孤儿药商业策略对这些国家药品监管系统和孤儿药获取的负面影响，通过直接访谈、灰色文献综述等方式进行研究。

paper_title: Nanoparticles in traumatic spinal cord injury: therapy and diagnosis
paper_abstract: Nanotechnology has been previously employed for constructing drug delivery vehicles, biosensors , solar cells, lubricants and as antimicrobial agents. The advancement in synthesis procedure makes it possible to formulate nanoparticles (NPs) with precise control over physico-chemical and optical properties that are desired for specific clinical or biological applications. The surface modification technology has further added impetus to the specific applications of NPs by providing them with desirable characteristics. Hence, nanotechnology is of paramount importance in numerous biomedical and industrial applications due to their biocompatibility and stability even in harsh environments. Traumatic spinal cord injuries (TSCIs) are one of the major traumatic injuries that are commonly associated with severe consequences to the patient that may reach to the point of paralysis. Several processes occurring at a biochemical level which exacerbate the injury may be targeted using nanotechnology. This review discusses possible nanotechnology-based approaches for the diagnosis and therapy of TSCI, which have a bright future in clinical practice.
review_content:
The article does a great job summarizing many relevant experiments and investigations done regarding various nanoparticle applications to SCI. Where it falls short for the reviewer is the lack of an overarching theme or main point.

After summarizing the relevant data from various experiments, the paper fails to bring it together to talk about the relevance (why this is important) or specific pros and cons of each nanoparticle type discussed. The authors just simply summarized the many previous studies using NPs. What are the underlying mechanisms of NPs for SCI? How are they taken up by cells? Are they employed as a drug delivery vehicle? Or Immunomodulatory factors? What are the effects of physicochemical properties for each of the polymeric NPs on SCI (i.e., size, surface charge, and molecular weight - If the author could provide the table for this it would be helpful)?. The authors mentioned only chitosan and chitosan-related NPs in the natural polymeric NPs section. Is this the only natural polymeric NPs for SCI (one or two additional natural polymeric NP would be helpful)? What are the pros and cons of utilizing natural polymeric NPs and polymeric NPs for SCI treatments?

If the paper could bring all the information together after each section and in the conclusion to talk more about why these developments are innovative or how they could lead to a new SCI treatment, the reviewer would have no reservations.
paper_title_zh: 创伤性脊髓损伤中的纳米粒子：治疗与诊断
paper_abstract_zh: 纳米技术已被先前用于构建药物递送载体、生物传感器、太阳能电池、润滑剂以及作为抗菌剂。合成工艺的进步使得能够精确控制纳米粒子（NPs）的理化性质和光学性质，以满足特定临床或生物应用的需求。表面改性技术进一步推动了NPs在特定应用中的发展，通过赋予其理想特性。因此，由于纳米粒子在恶劣环境中的生物相容性和稳定性，纳米技术在众多生物医学和工业应用中具有至关重要的作用。创伤性脊髓损伤（TSCIs）是常见的主要创伤之一，通常会对患者造成严重后果，甚至可能导致瘫痪。纳米技术可以针对发生在生化水平上的多个加剧损伤的过程进行干预。本综述讨论了基于纳米技术的创伤性脊髓损伤的诊断和治疗可能方法，这些方法在临床实践中具有光明前景。
review_content_zh:
该文章在总结关于各种纳米粒子在SCI（脊髓损伤）应用方面的许多相关实验和调查方面做得非常出色。然而，对于审稿人来说，其不足之处在于缺乏一个总体主题或主要观点。

在总结了各种实验的相关数据后，论文未能将这些数据整合起来讨论其相关性（为何重要）或所讨论的每种纳米粒子类型的具体优缺点。作者只是简单地总结了众多使用纳米粒子（NPs）的先前研究。纳米粒子对SCI的潜在机制是什么？它们是如何被细胞摄取的？它们是作为药物递送载体还是免疫调节因子？每种聚合物纳米粒子的理化性质（如尺寸、表面电荷和分子量）对SCI有何影响（如果作者能提供相关表格将会有所帮助）？在天然聚合物纳米粒子部分，作者仅提到了壳聚糖及其相关纳米粒子。这是SCI的唯一天然聚合物纳米粒子吗（增加一两种天然聚合物纳米粒子将会有所帮助）？利用天然聚合物纳米粒子和聚合物纳米粒子进行SCI治疗的优缺点是什么？

paper_title: Assessment of activities of daily living in patients post COVID-19: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background: Coronavirus disease has provoked much discussion since its first appearance. Despite it being widely studied all over the world, little is known about the impact of the disease on functional ability related to performing activities of daily living (ADL) in patients post COVID-19 infection.
