paper_title: Recent advances in biochar application for water and wastewater treatment: A review
paper_abstract: In the past decade, researchers have carried out a massive amount of research on the application of biochar for contaminants removal from aqueous solutions. As an emerging sorbent with great potential, biochar has shown significant advantages such as the broad sources of feedstocks, easy preparation process, and favorable surface and structural properties. This review provides an overview of recent advances in biochar application in water and wastewater treatment, including a brief discussion of the involved sorption mechanisms of contaminants removal, as well as the biochar modification methods.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting no comment Experimental design no comment Validity of the findings The Conclusions section should include the main aspects of biochar modification. Thank you for your suggestion. We have rewritten the Conclusions section to make it better reflect the main aspects of biochar modification (lines 800-803): Based on the mechanisms, attention has been paid on biochar modification to improve its performance, which aims to increase the surface area, porosity, or surface sorption sites of the biochar. Exciting frontiers of magnetic biochar and biochar-biofilm combination are also presented. Comments for the author This manuscript reviews the recent advances in biochar applications in water and wastewater treatment. A brief discussion is also conducted on the sorption mechanisms of mainly certain organic pollutants. Finally, a brief discussion of various biochar modification and their effect on the structure, surface properties, and sorption efficiency is presented. The manuscript is well written and scientifically well organized. It is potentially interesting for the readers of the Journal and could be considered for publication after changes. Thank you very much for your comments. We have revised the manuscript point-by-point based on your specific comments. Specific comments 1) Since a number of referenced papers concern the use of biochar for the removal of contaminants from water or aqueous solutions, the title of the article should be changed to: “Recent advances in the application of biochar for water and wastewater treatment: A review.” Thank you for your suggestion. We have changed the title to “Recent advances in biochar application for water and wastewater treatment: A review.” Besides, we have revised all the corresponding parts in the text using the expression of “water and wastewater treatment.” 2) The effect of pyrolysis temperature on biochar surface and sorption capacity on metals and PAHs as well basic modification of biochar should be benefited by referring to relevant literature on this topic such as: a) Preparation and Characterization of Biochar Sorbents Produced from Malt Spent Rootlets. Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research, 54(39), 9577-9584. 2015. b) Effect of Chloride and Nitrate Salts on Hg(II) Sorption by Raw and Pyrolyzed Malt Spent Rootlets. Journal of Chemical Technology and Biotechnology, 92(8), 1912-1918. 2017. c) Phenanthrene Removal from Aqueous Solutions Using Well-Characterized, Raw, Chemically Treated, and Charred Malt Spent Rootlets. Journal of Environmental Management, 128, 252-258. 2013. Thanks. We have added these references: a) Reports have shown that the physicochemical properties of biochar such as surface area, porosity, acid-base behavior, surface functional groups, and element composition depend on pyrolysis temperatures and feedstock types (Ahmad et al., 2014; Uchimiya et al., 2013; Nachenius et al., 2013; Manariotis et al., 2015). (lines 85-88) Their later study showed that the Hg sorption capacity by MSR biochars increased by a maximum factor of 6 for high-temperature (750-900℃) biochars compared to the raw material (Manariotis et al., 2015). (lines 256-258) b) Hg(II) sorption onto both materials carried on mainly through neutral species (Boutsika et al., 2017). (lines 258-259) c) Valili et al. (2013) reported that the MSR biochar pyrolyzed at a higher temperature of 800°C gained a much higher PHE sorption capacity, two orders of magnitude higher compared to the raw material. (lines 281-283) 3) In the section of inorganic ions, a brief discussion on the mechanisms for nitrogen and phosphorus removal should be useful for the reader. Thank you for your suggestion. We have added these parts to the text. For nitrogen removal (lines 377-387): Potential mechanisms for NH4+ sorption was further studied by Hu et al. (2020). They reported that pH influenced the NH4+ sorption capacity by changing the surface charge of biochar. Negatively charged biochar in higher pH (pH > pHPZC) solutions easily sorbed NH4+ due to electrostatic attraction. FT-IR patterns showed that the -OH and -C=O groups weakened after the sorption, indicating that the NH4+ acted with these functional groups through surface complexation. In addition, ion exchange between NH4+ and the negatively charged functional groups such as -OH and -COOH also led to the NH4+ sorption. For NO3-, the sorption mechanisms are governed by multiple interactions, primarily electrostatic attraction, and ionic bonds with exchangeable cations from the biochar, based on the sorption study of NO3- by bamboo biochar (Viglašová et al., 2018). For phosphorus removal (lines 392-398): Ajmal et al. (2020) compared the removal efficiency of PO43- from wastewater by biochars before and after magnetic modification. Results showed that the sorption ability of magnetic biochar was twice (25-28 mg·g-1) than that of the unmodified biochar (12-15 mg·g-1). The PO43- sorption on magnetic biochar is dominated by simultaneous mechanisms including electrostatic attraction, surface precipitation, and complexation, while for the original biochar, the sorption mainly depends on electrostatic attraction. 4) Line 463. Please clarify what watershed treatment means? Thank you for your question. The "watershed treatment" referred to the treatment of surface runoff and soil erosion problems in a river basin by using biochar. We have changed “watershed” to the more appropriate phrase “river basin” (lines 434-437): Surface runoff and soil erosion in the river basin, especially in some degraded fields with high precipitation, could cause certain contamination to the water environment. Several studies have proved that biochar has the potential to reduce surface runoff and soil erosion (Razzaghi et al., 2020; Głąb et al., 2020; Bayabil et al., 2015; Tanure et al., 2019; Gholami et al., 2019). 5) Lines 469-472. Please explain how the addition of biochar into soil reduces runoff and increases runoff time. We have rewritten this paragraph with the explanation for your above question (lines 437-447): Biochar particles can bond with soil mineral surface through phenolic and carboxylic functional groups, thus improve the stability of soil aggregation and structure (Soinne et al., 2014). Besides, the exchangeable divalent cations with high charge density (e.g., Ca2+, Mg2+) on biochar surface can replace the monovalent cations (e.g., Na+, K+) on exchange sites of clay particles, which enhances clay flocculation and thereby improves macropores size and network in the soil (Rao & Mathew, 1995), eventually increases the infiltration capacity. Therefore, it is concluded that the biochar amendment can improve soil physical properties, which in turn reduces runoff, erosion, and waterlogging (Bayabil et al., 2015). Moreover, biochar with large water-storing property spreading on soil surface could absorb the force of raindrops, thus increases the runoff time (Gholami et al., 2019). 6) Modification of biochar. The authors discuss in detail the various methods for biochar modification. In my opinion, a comparative discussion is needed at the end of the section on how to select the appropriate modification method according to the target contaminant(s). Which are the future directions for biochar modification? Thank you for your suggestion. We have added this discussion part at the end of the “Biochar modification” section (lines 706-723): All in all, the selection of modification methods should base on the property and removal mechanism of the target contaminant. Generally, gas, steam, acid, and alkaline modifications increase the porosity of biochar, suitable for the contaminant whose sorption is dominant by pore-filling. Both acids and oxidants agents enrich the surface oxygen-containing groups of biochar with high cation exchangeability, which facilitates the sorption governed by ion exchange, such as heavy metal ions and NH4+. The alkaline modification provides high aromaticity of the biochar, promoting the π-π EDA interaction and sorption for some organic contaminants such as dyes and antibiotics. Notably, it also leads to a lower O/C ratio, which strengthens the hydrophobic nature of biochar (Wang & Wang, 2019), conducive to the sorption of hydrophobic organic contaminants. For negatively charged oxyanions such as NO3-, PO43-, and AsO43-, positively charged metal oxides embedding into the biochar facilitates this type of sorption. Moreover, metal oxides increase the active sites in biochar, which is related to the catalytic action of the composite material. Incorporated nitrogen by amino-rich agents also acts as active sites and is linked with such catalytic ability (Duan et al., 2018). Especially, transition metal salts increase the magnetism of biochar to meet the separation needs; biochar combining with biofilm is applicable for degradation of some toxic organic contaminants to reduce the toxicity. 7) The Conclusions section should include the main aspects of biochar modification. Thank you for your suggestion. We have rewritten the Conclusions section to make it better reflect the main aspects of biochar modification (lines 800-803): Based on the mechanisms, attention has been paid on biochar modification to improve its performance, which aims to increase the surface area, porosity, or surface sorption sites of the biochar. Exciting frontiers of magnetic biochar and biochar-biofilm combination are also presented.
paper_title_zh: 生物炭在水与废水处理中应用的最新进展：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，研究人员对生物炭在水溶液中去除污染物的应用进行了大量研究。作为一种具有巨大潜力的新兴吸附剂，生物炭展现出诸多显著优势，如原料来源广泛、制备过程简便以及优良的表面和结构特性。本综述概述了生物炭在水和废水处理中应用的最新进展，包括对污染物去除涉及的吸附机制的简要讨论，以及生物炭改性方法。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1 基本报告 无评论 实验设计 无评论 研究结果的可靠性 结论部分应包括生物炭改性的主要方面。感谢您的建议。我们已经重写了结论部分，使其更好地反映生物炭改性的主要方面（第800-803行）：基于机制，已关注生物炭改性以提升其性能，旨在增加生物炭的表面积、孔隙度或表面吸附位点。还介绍了磁性生物炭和生物炭-生物膜组合的激动人心的前沿领域。对作者的意见 本手稿综述了生物炭在水和废水处理中应用的最新进展。还简要讨论了主要某些有机污染物的吸附机制。最后，简要讨论了各种生物炭改性及其对结构、表面性质和吸附效率的影响。手稿写作良好，科学组织严谨。对期刊读者可能具有潜在兴趣，可在修改后考虑发表。非常感谢您的意见。我们已根据您的具体意见逐点修订了手稿。具体意见 1) 由于许多参考文献涉及使用生物炭从水或水溶液中去除污染物，文章标题应改为：“Recent advances in the application of biochar for water and wastewater treatment: A review.” 感谢您的建议。我们将标题改为“Recent advances in biochar application for water and wastewater treatment: A review.” 此外，我们已使用“水和废水处理”的表达修订了文本中的所有相应部分。 2) 热解温度对生物炭表面及其对金属和PAHs的吸附能力的影响，以及生物炭的基本改性，应通过参考相关文献而受益，例如：a) Preparation and Characterization of Biochar Sorbents Produced from Malt Spent Rootlets. Industrial & Engineering Chemistry Research, 54(39), 9577-9584. 2015. b) Effect of Chloride and Nitrate Salts on Hg(II) Sorption by Raw and Pyrolyzed Malt Spent Rootlets. Journal of Chemical Technology and Biotechnology, 92(8), 1912-1918. 2017. c) Phenanthrene Removal from Aqueous Solutions Using Well-Characterized, Raw, Chemically Treated, and Charred Malt Spent Rootlets. Journal of Environmental Management, 128, 252-258. 2013. 谢谢。我们已经添加了这些参考文献：a) 报告显示，生物炭的物理化学性质，如表面积、孔隙度、酸碱行为、表面官能团和元素组成，取决于热解温度和原料类型（Ahmad et al., 2014; Uchimiya et al., 2013; Nachenius et al., 2013; Manariotis et al., 2015）。 （第85-88行）他们后续的研究表明，与原材料相比，高温（750-900℃）生物炭的MSR生物炭对Hg的吸附能力最大增加了6倍（Manariotis等人，2015年）。（第256-258行）b) Hg(II)在两种材料上的吸附主要通过中性物种进行（Boutsika等人，2017年）。（第258-259行）c) Valili等人（2013年）报道，在800°C较高温度下热解的MSR生物炭获得了更高的PHE吸附能力，比原材料高出两个数量级。（第281-283行）3) 在无机离子部分，对氮和磷去除机制的简要讨论对读者应有所帮助。感谢您的建议。我们已将这些内容添加到文本中。关于氮去除（第377-387行）：Hu等人（2020年）进一步研究了NH4+吸附的潜在机制。他们报告称，pH通过改变生物炭的表面电荷来影响NH4+的吸附能力。在较高pH（pH > pHPZC）溶液中，带负电荷的生物炭由于静电吸引而易吸附NH4+。FT-IR图谱显示，吸附后-OH和-C=O基团减弱，表明NH4+通过表面络合与这些官能团作用。此外，NH4+与带负电荷的官能团（如-OH和-COOH）之间的离子交换也导致了NH4+的吸附。对于NO3-，吸附机制由多种相互作用主导，主要是静电吸引和与生物炭中可交换阳离子的离子键，基于竹生物炭对NO3-的吸附研究（Viglašová等人，2018年）。关于磷去除（第392-398行）：Ajmal等人（2020年）比较了磁性改性前后生物炭对废水中PO43-的去除效率。结果显示，磁性生物炭的吸附能力是未改性生物炭的两倍（25-28 mg·g-1），而未改性生物炭为（12-15 mg·g-1）。磁性生物炭上PO43-的吸附主要由静电吸引、表面沉淀和络合的协同机制主导，而原始生物炭的吸附主要依赖于静电吸引。4) 第463行。请澄清“流域处理”的含义？感谢您的提问。“流域处理”指的是通过使用生物炭处理河流流域的表面径流和土壤侵蚀问题。我们将“流域”改为更合适的短语“河流流域”（第434-437行）：河流流域的表面径流和土壤侵蚀，特别是在一些高降水量的退化田地中，可能会对水环境造成一定污染。多项研究已证明，生物炭具有减少表面径流和土壤侵蚀的潜力（Razzaghi等人，2020年；Głąb等人，2020年；Bayabil等人，2015年；Tanure等人，2019年；Gholami等人，2019年）。5) 第469-472行。 生物炭颗粒可以通过酚类和羧酸官能团与土壤矿物表面结合，从而改善土壤团聚体和结构的稳定性（Soinne等，2014）。此外，生物炭表面具有高电荷密度的可交换二价阳离子（例如，Ca2+、Mg2+）可以替换粘土颗粒交换位点上的单价阳离子（例如，Na+、K+），这增强了粘土絮凝，从而改善了土壤中的大孔隙尺寸和网络（Rao & Mathew，1995），最终增加了渗透能力。因此，可以得出结论，生物炭改良可以改善土壤物理性质，进而减少径流、侵蚀和水涝（Bayabil等，2015）。此外，具有大储水性能的生物炭分布在土壤表面可以吸收雨滴的冲击力，从而增加径流时间（Gholami等，2019）。

关于生物炭的改性。作者详细讨论了生物炭改性的各种方法。在我看来，在“生物炭改性”部分的最后需要进行比较讨论，以说明如何根据目标污染物选择适当的改性方法。生物炭改性的未来方向是什么？感谢您的建议。我们已在“生物炭改性”部分的最后添加了这一讨论内容（第706-723行）：总的来说，改性方法的选择应基于目标污染物的性质和去除机制。通常，气体、蒸汽、酸和碱性改性会增加生物炭的孔隙率，适用于主要通过孔隙填充吸附的污染物。酸和氧化剂均能丰富生物炭表面的含氧官能团，具有高阳离子交换性，这有助于通过离子交换控制的吸附，例如重金属离子和NH4+。碱性改性提供了生物炭的高芳香性，促进了π-π EDA相互作用，有利于某些有机污染物如染料和抗生素的吸附。值得注意的是，它还导致较低的O/C比，增强了生物炭的疏水性（Wang & Wang，2019），有利于疏水性有机污染物的吸附。对于NO3-、PO43-和AsO43-等带负电的氧阴离子，将带正电的金属氧化物嵌入生物炭中促进了这类吸附。此外，金属氧化物增加了生物炭中的活性位点，这与复合材料的催化作用有关。通过富含氨基的试剂引入的氮也作为活性位点，并与这种催化能力相关（Duan等，2018）。特别是，过渡金属盐增加了生物炭的磁性，以满足分离需求； 生物炭与生物膜结合适用于降解某些有毒有机污染物，以降低其毒性。7）结论部分应包括生物炭改性的主要方面。感谢您的建议。我们已经重写了结论部分，使其更好地反映了生物炭改性的主要方面（第800-803行）：基于这些机制，已经关注到生物炭改性以提升其性能，旨在增加生物炭的表面积、孔隙度或表面吸附位点。同时，还介绍了磁性生物炭和生物炭-生物膜结合的令人兴奋的前沿领域。

paper_title: Pharmaceutical policy and innovation for rare diseases: A narrative review
paper_abstract:
This article aims to synthesize the existing literature on the implementation of public policies to incentivize the development of treatments for rare diseases, (diseases with very low prevalence and therefore with low commercial interest) otherwise known as orphan drugs. The implementation of these incentives in the United States (US), Japan, and in the European Union (EU) seems to be related to a substantial increase in treatments for these diseases, and has influenced the way the pharmaceutical research & development (R&D) system operates beyond this policy area. Despite the success of the Orphan Drug model, the academic literature also highlights the negative implications that these public policies have on affordability and access to orphan drugs, as well as on the prioritization of certain disease rare areas over others. 
  The synthesis focuses mostly on the United States’ Orphan Drug Act (ODA) as a model for subsequent policies in other regions and countries. It starts with a historical overview of the creation of the term “rare diseases”, continues with a summary of the evidence available on the US ODA’s positive and negative impacts, and provides a summary of the different proposals to reform these incentives in light of the negative outcomes described. Finally, it describes some key aspects of the Japanese and European policies, as well as some of the challenges captured in the literature related to their impact in Low- and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs).
review_content:
Thank you for the chance to review this update to the review. Overall, I found your literature review very interesting, timely, and well-written.
However, there are a few issues you might want to consider, which I suggest below:
  * On a general note, hyperlinking is inconsistent throughout the document. Sometimes, you hyperlink the reference when in-text, while sometimes you only do it when within brackets.

Section 1
  * In this section, you might want to discuss some ongoing initiatives to address the lack of burden of disease data in the rare disease space for further context. For example, in 2023, the European Burden of Disease Network launched the Task Force on Rare Diseases to address this gap by researching the health impact of rare conditions in Europe ( see: [ref 1] )
  * Here, you could discuss the concept of medical plausibility used by the EMA which, to some extent, limit the salami slicing practice ( see: [ref 2] )
  * Finally, you could discuss the differential probability of success across disease types (rare vs non-rare) earlier in the introductory section as it seems relevant for statements you have later in the text (see [ref 3])

Section 2
  * You seem to contrapose the claims that the ODA affected positively the innovation rate in the rare disease space with the fact that many drugs are financed by the public sector, especially at initial R&D stages. While I agree with this, I am unclear about the link between the two concepts. As far as I am aware, we do not have evidence to suggest that publicly-funded research groups/companies were immune to incentives by the ODA? Rather, I would emphasise the fact that there are many confounding factors, such as improvements in basic science (see the first DNA sequence happening around the same time) and in genomics, which are likely to have affected rare diseases, which are mostly genetic in nature, disproportionately.
Section 2.2
  * It would be useful to add reference to the following statement "First, the market exclusivity clause has been portrayed as the major contributor to the success of the ODA, but also as a major driver of unaffordable prices, as the monopolies allow companies to set high prices without competition."
  * You discuss EU-related issues in this section, which should focus solely on the negative consequences of the ODA. I would suggest moving this elsewhere, possibly in the next section.
  * You frame your review as innovation in the rare disease space, but you specifically look at legal frameworks and do not look at - for example - policies beyond orphan regulations such as R&D investments and pricing and reimbursement frameworks. I wonder if the title is appropriate?

Section 2.3
  * It does not look like the ones you suggest can be defined solely as changes to the ODA specifically, but broader change to the incentive system in the US, e.g. repurposing. I suggest you change the title of the section or move the content elsewhere in the paper.
  * You could justify better the primary relevance of the US regulation, considering the current set-up of the pharmaceutical system (i.e., the US making up the majority of sales etc.).

Section 3
  * In this section, you might want to reference Gentilini & Miraldo 2023 ( see [ref 4] ), which specifically looks at the role and impact of patient groups in innovation in the rare disease R&D space.
  * Your last sentence discussing the risk of conflicts of interest between patient groups focusing on rare disease and industry is currently missing a reference. In this context, Gentilini & Parvanova 2023 ( see [ref 5] ) might be relevant, as it is the only paper discussing the share of industry funding directed to patient groups focusing on rare diseases specifically.
Section 4.2
  * When discussing European incentives, you could mention the changes suggested as part of the revision to the orphan regulation (see inception impact assessment here: [ ref 6 ]), which proposes market exclusivities of different lengths depending on the type of development (innovative products; re-purposed products; second/multiple indications).
  * While you hint at it in your second bullet point, you could explicitly say that the profitability clause has never been implemented (i.e., de facto orphan designation can only be granted based on the prevalence criterion).
  * Please provide a reference for the following statement: "On the regulatory side, the Regulation provides protocol assistance and fee waivers (100% waiver for protocol assistance and 50% for all regulatory fees), which is highlighted as a strong incentive for small- and medium-sized enterprises. Protocol assistance can relate to the support for regulatory requirements such as product quality, preclinical studies, clinical trial design, etc."
  * You mention 29 EU member states, but there are only 27? If you are including the UK and Switzerland please add them separately as Norway and Iceland.

Section 4.3
  * In the LMICs section, you could explicitly refer to the willingness to pay issues between different regions, which inevitably translates into different degrees of attractiveness to for-profit companies.
  * I think that competition in rare diseases would deserve mention. For example, many orphan drugs will be coming off-patent in the next years, which is expected to increase competition and lower prices. However, there is evidence that competition in rare diseases is low and mostly occurs in conditions that are more prevalent or have a higher willingness-to-pay, such as cancer or cystic fibrosis (see [ ref 7 ] ). The question then is, how will these drugs be affordable in LMICs? Joint procurement? Price discrimination based on GDP?
  * It might be worth mentioning that both China and India have made progress in their rare disease policy. For example, China set up its first rare diseases registry in 2020 (see [ ref 8 ]), while India published its National Rare Diseases Policy India in 2021 (see [ ref 9 ])

Limitations
  * You might also mention as a limitation the fact that you did not consider governmental documents and legislations but only peer-reviewed literature, which might have overlooked some issues and initiatives.
paper_title_zh: 罕见病药物政策与创新：叙事性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
本文旨在综合现有文献，探讨实施公共政策以激励罕见病（即患病率极低、商业利益较小的疾病）治疗方法开发的现状，这些治疗方法通常被称为孤儿药。在美国、日本和欧盟实施这些激励措施似乎与这些疾病治疗方法的显著增加相关，并影响了制药研发系统在此政策领域之外的操作方式。尽管孤儿药模式取得了成功，但学术文献也指出了这些公共政策对孤儿药的可负担性和可及性以及优先考虑某些罕见病领域而非其他领域的负面含义。

本文综合研究主要聚焦于美国的孤儿药法案（ODA）作为其他地区和国家后续政策的模型。首先从“罕见病”一词的创立历史概述入手，接着总结有关美国ODA积极和消极影响的相关证据，并提供针对所述负面结果改革这些激励措施的不同建议的概述。最后，描述了日本和欧洲政策的一些关键方面，以及文献中捕捉到的与这些政策对低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）影响的若干挑战。
review_content_zh:
感谢您给我机会审阅这篇综述的更新。总体而言，我发现您的文献综述非常有趣、及时且文笔流畅。

然而，有几个问题您可能需要考虑，我在下面提出建议：

* **总体而言**，文档中的超链接不一致。有时，您在正文中超链接了参考文献，而有时仅在括号内进行超链接。

**第一部分**
* 在这一部分，您可能需要讨论一些正在进行中的倡议，以解决罕见病领域疾病负担数据缺乏的问题，以便提供更多背景信息。例如，2023年，欧洲疾病负担网络启动了罕见病特别工作组，通过研究欧洲罕见疾病的健康影响来填补这一空白（参见：[ref 1]）。
* 在这里，您可以讨论EMA使用的医学合理性概念，这在一定程度上限制了“切片式”做法（参见：[ref 2]）。
* 最后，您可以在引言部分更早地讨论不同疾病类型（罕见病与非罕见病）的成功概率差异，因为这似乎与您在文中后部分所陈述的内容相关（参见：[ref 3]）。

**第二部分**
* 您似乎将ODA对罕见病领域创新率的积极影响与许多药物由公共部门资助的事实相对立，尤其是在初始研发阶段。虽然我同意这一点，但我不清楚这两个概念之间的联系。据我所知，我们没有证据表明公共资助的研究小组/公司对ODA的激励免疫？相反，我会强调有许多混杂因素，如基础科学的进步（参见第一个DNA序列大约在同一时间发生）和基因组学，这些因素很可能对大多是遗传性质的罕见病产生不成比例的影响。

**第二部分第2.2节**
* 添加以下声明的参考文献将很有用：“首先，市场独占条款被描绘为ODA成功的主要贡献者，但也被视为导致价格高昂的主要驱动因素，因为垄断允许公司在没有竞争的情况下设定高价格。”
* 在这一部分，您讨论了与欧盟相关的问题，这部分应仅关注ODA的负面后果。我建议将其移至其他部分，可能在下一部分。
* 您将综述定位为罕见病领域的创新，但您具体关注的是法律框架，并未涉及例如孤儿法规之外的政策，如研发投资和定价及报销框架。我怀疑标题是否合适？

**第二部分第2.3节**
* 您所提到的似乎并不仅仅是对ODA的具体修改，而是对美国激励系统的更广泛改变，例如药物再利用。我建议您更改该节的标题或将内容移至论文的其他部分。
* 您可以更好地论证美国法规的主要相关性，考虑到当前制药系统的设置（即美国占销售的大部分等）。

**第三部分**
* 在这一部分，您可能需要引用Gentilini & Miraldo 2023（参见[ref 4]），该文献专门探讨了患者群体在罕见病研发创新中的作用和影响。
* 您在讨论罕见病患者群体与行业之间利益冲突风险的最后一句目前缺少参考文献。在这种情况下，Gentilini & Parvanova 2023（参见[ref 5]）可能相关，因为它是唯一一篇讨论行业资金投向专门关注罕见病的患者群体的论文。

**第四部分第4.2节**
* 在讨论欧洲激励措施时，您可以提及作为孤儿法规修订一部分的变更建议（参见此处的影响评估初稿：[ref 6]），该建议提出根据开发类型（创新产品；再利用产品；第二/多个适应症）设定不同长度的市场独占期。
* 虽然您在第二点中有所暗示，但您可以明确指出盈利条款从未实施（即，事实上孤儿认定只能基于患病率标准）。
* 请为以下声明提供参考文献：“在监管方面，该法规提供了协议援助和费用减免（协议援助100%减免，所有监管费用50%减免），这被强调为对中小企业的强有力激励。协议援助可以涉及对监管要求的支持，如产品质量、临床前研究、临床试验设计等。”
* 您提到29个欧盟成员国，但实际上只有27个？如果您包括英国和瑞士，请分别添加，并与挪威和冰岛分开。

**第四部分第4.3节**
* 在LMICs部分，您可以明确提及不同地区之间的支付意愿问题，这不可避免地转化为对营利性公司的不同吸引力程度。
* 我认为罕见病领域的竞争值得提及。例如，许多孤儿药物将在未来几年内专利到期，预计这将增加竞争并降低价格。然而，有证据表明罕见病领域的竞争较低，且主要发生在患病率较高或支付意愿较高的疾病中，如癌症或囊性纤维化（参见[ref 7]）。那么问题来了，这些药物在LMICs中如何负担得起？联合采购？基于GDP的价格歧视？
* 提及中国和印度在罕见病政策方面取得的进展可能是有价值的。例如，中国于2020年建立了首个罕见病登记处（参见[ref 8]），而印度于2021年发布了其国家罕见病政策（参见[ref 9]）。

**局限性**
* 您还可以提及一个局限性，即您未考虑政府文件和立法，而仅考虑了同行评审的文献，这可能忽略了一些问题和倡议。

paper_title: The rule-based insensitivity effect: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. Adherence to inaccurate rules has been viewed as a characteristic of human rule-following (i.e., the rule-based insensitivity effect; RBIE) and has been thought to be exacerbated in individuals suffering from clinical conditions. This review intended to systematically examine these claims in adult populations.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Introduction C18: L49-52 ‘Under such circumstances…instructions’ Why is ‘you’ (i.e., the reader) referenced here? Instead of talking about what ‘you’ might do, the authors should continue to refer only to the groups of pts in the example. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We initially wrote “you” because we instructed the reader to imagine that (s)he was participating in the task. paper_title: Unleashing the Power of Data Tsunami: A Comprehensive Survey on Data Assessment and Selection for Instruction Tuning of Language Models
paper_abstract: Instruction tuning plays a critical role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. Despite the vast amount of open instruction datasets, naively training a LLM on all existing instructions may not be optimal and practical. To pinpoint the most beneficial datapoints, data assessment and selection methods have been proposed in the fields of natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning. However, under the context of instruction tuning, there still exists a gap in knowledge on what kind of data evaluation metrics can be employed and how they can be integrated into the selection mechanism. To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive review on existing literature of data assessment and selection especially for instruction tuning of LLMs. We systematically categorize all applicable methods into quality-based, diversity-based, and importance-based ones where a unified, fine-grained taxonomy is structured. For each category, representative methods are elaborated to describe the landscape of relevant research. In addition, comparison between latest methods is conducted on their officially reported results to provide in-depth discussions on their limitations. Finally, we summarize the open challenges and propose the promosing avenues for future studies. All related contents are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/instruction_tuning_data_survey-B307.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a thorough survey on data assessment and selection methods in the instruction tuning of large language models (LLMs). It systematically categorizes the existing approaches into three key dimensions: quality, diversity, and importance. The paper provides a detailed comparison and analysis of these methods, contributing valuable new insights and perspectives on optimizing LLMs performance through effective data selection. Furthermore, it addresses the challenges faced in practical applications and proposes potential directions for future research.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths:** 1. The paper offers profound insights and a comprehensive analysis of data assessment and selection methods aimed at enhancing LLMs performance. The innovative approach of categorizing existing methods into three dimensions is noteworthy. 2. The inclusion of a detailed link to related content, which categorizes the corresponding papers and provides summaries, significantly enhances the paper's impact within the LLMs community. 3. The survey is both thorough and well-organized, with figures and structure that facilitate easy comprehension for readers. **Weaknesses:** 1. Beyond the three main categories, there are algorithms that are hybrids of two categories, such as LIST, FL, DEITA, and QBIT. It would be beneficial for the authors to discuss these hybrid algorithms and their corresponding categories in a dedicated section. 2. The paper should clarify the distinctions and relationships between the methods in these three categories. 3. In the "Survey Scope" section, the authors claim that previous studies overlook the measurement of data quality. It is recommended that the authors more explicitly differentiate this survey from previous ones and emphasize the novelty of their work.

**Requested Changes:**
Please refer to the Weaknesses.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 释放数据海啸的力量：语言模型指令调优中数据评估与选择的全面综述

paper_title: It’s the network, stupid: a population’s sexual network connectivity determines its STI prevalence
paper_abstract: There is little consensus as to why sexually transmitted infections (STIs), including HIV and bacterial vaginosis (BV) are more prevalent in some populations than others. Using a broad definition of sexual network connectivity that includes both structural and conductivity-related factors, we argue that the available evidence suggests that high prevalence of traditional STIs, HIV and BV can be parsimoniously explained by these populations having more connected sexual networks. Positive feedback, whereby BV and various STIs enhance the spread of other STIs, then further accentuates the spread of BV, HIV and other STIs. We review evidence that support this hypothesis and end by suggesting study designs that could further evaluate the hypothesis, as well as implications of this hypothesis for the prevention and management of STIs.
review_content:
This is a well referenced, very interesting paper which attempts and in large part succeeds, in critically examining, and in many cases rejecting common “risk factors/ determinants” of high STI (sexually transmitted infection) rates. The authors have traced a long history in mathematical modelling of primarily HIV and summarised the most common and consistently found explanations of “peak HIV” rates at an ecological level.

I think this article is thought provoking and even if one is not entirely convinced by it, it adds much deeper and more critical thought to assumptions of mathematical modellers and epidemiologists about the immediate causes of HIV than I have ever seen. I am glad it is published.

I think the paper could be improved in general by addressing two major areas. First, some mention of the empirical study of sexual networks should be made.There are examples from all over the world which the authors may use to strengthen their ultimate hypothesis; that sexual interactions between sexual network members in which some people are infected with STI are the primary and necessary conditions for STI to transmit 1,2. This will help define for their readers very clearly the fact that because ecological findings focus on whole systems, whether national or regional, these studies are more indicative of large networks and should not be regarded as “weaker” evidence as they are in epidemiology. The authors can also argue that the ultimate risk factor on an individual level for acquiring gonorrhoea for example is having unprotected sex with another person with gonorrhea; that is it and that is all. Other factors are moderators of that plain risk; such as use of condoms, cumulative frequency of intercourse, etc. Concurrency or number of sex partners are indirect indicators of the risk itself; because transmission of STI is an interaction which occurs between at minimum two people, the other “factors” are reduced to characteristics or behaviors of individuals within the population, which again are proxies, though more proximal than age, sex, ethnic background or income.

The second thing I would be very clear on is the part played by ethnic group. This is again just a proxy for sexual interactions and cultural norms, and may not be a consistent nor accurate marker. However, it is very easy in the discussion of HIV in Africa to “racialize” the epidemic and/or behavior. For example, the effect of the labour policies under apartheid South Africa, where black labourers were forced into a pattern of migrant labor for a year at a time from their rural homes to large urban or mining compounds did much to accelerate sexual interactions which in turn exacerbated HIV spread. Likewise, sexual violence in some parts of Africa is extremely high, and while it is not mentioned here specifically, certainly does contribute to transmission. However, this also is linked to harsh colonial conditions and the authors could make it very clear that this should not be interpreted as being a intrinsically ethnic or cultural characteristic. The successful Ugandan educational intervention is a great demonstration of that. One of the best network explanations of different STI rates in people of different ethnic backgrounds can be found in 3, pages 689-697.

More minor comments follow;

Page 2 - I love Figure 1.

Page 3, 2nd paragraph - better give credit where credit is due 4.

Page 3, 3rd paragraph - so concurrency may be a marker of connectivity; or a determinant, but one may equally pose that if one has many sex partners the only way to fit them all in is to have concurrent ones.. and that may have an effect also on frequency of intercourse with each partner. Lots of food for thought!

Page 4 - wonderful summary! I would love to see a systematic review which includes an exhaustive list with negative findings. Again, one could look for only proximal causes of transmission rather than secondary or structural determinants.

Page 5 - you state that “Peak high prevalence HIV is based generally of high quality longitudinal data”. Please justify and provide references.

Page 5 - the statements on poverty and socioeconomic status, gender inequality which are not consistently associated with HIV are great; this is because these determinants are only distally linked to transmission.

Page 5, paragraph 8 - to describe numbers of partners more accurately I would use the median, range or IQR as the mean implies these distributions are Gaussian, but they are not. The devil is literally in "de tail" Also one may have to look at the penile anal penetration risk of transmission which is not exactly comparable to penile vaginal sex. But I agree in principle.

Page 7, paragraph 1 - I would be more accurate here, HSV is certainly treatable, but not as easily diagnosed or treated as the bacterial STI.

Page 7, Table 2 - you may find the discussion of ethnic homophily and heterogeneity in networks interesting in 1,2.

Great paper, good thinking, and great to challenge convention!
paper_title_zh: “关键在于网络，傻瓜：人群的性网络连通性决定了其性传播感染的发生率”
paper_abstract_zh: 关于为何包括HIV和细菌性阴道病（BV）在内的性传播感染（STIs）在某些人群中比其他人群更为普遍，目前尚无广泛共识。采用一个广义的性网络连通性定义，该定义包括结构和导电性相关因素，我们认为现有证据表明，传统STIs、HIV和BV的高流行可以通过这些人群拥有更连通的性网络来简洁解释。正反馈机制，即BV和各种STIs增强其他STIs的传播，进一步加剧了BV、HIV和其他STIs的扩散。我们回顾了支持这一假设的证据，并在最后提出了可以进一步验证该假设的研究设计，以及这一假设对STIs预防和管理的启示。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇参考文献丰富、非常有趣的论文，它试图并且在很大程度上成功地批判性地审视了，并在许多情况下否定了高性传播感染（STI）率的常见“风险因素/决定因素”。作者追溯了数学建模中主要是HIV的悠久历史，并总结了在生态层面上最常见且一致发现的“HIV高峰”率的解释。

我认为这篇文章发人深省，即使有人不完全信服，它也比我所见过的任何文章都更深入、更批判性地思考了数学建模者和流行病学家关于HIV直接原因的假设。我很高兴它被发表了。

我认为这篇论文可以通过解决两个主要领域来改进。首先，应该提及性网络的实证研究。世界各地都有例子，作者可以用这些例子来加强他们的最终假设；即性网络成员之间的性互动，其中一些人感染了STI，是STI传播的主要和必要条件1,2。这将帮助读者非常清楚地定义一个事实，即由于生态发现关注的是整个系统，无论是国家还是地区，这些研究更能指示大型网络，不应被视为流行病学中的“较弱”证据。作者还可以论证，例如在个体层面上感染淋病的最终风险因素是与另一个淋病患者进行无保护性行为；仅此而已。其他因素是这一 plain 风险的调节因素；例如使用避孕套、性交的累积频率等。并发性或性伴侣数量是风险本身的间接指标；因为STI的传播是至少两个人之间发生的互动，其他“因素”被简化为人群内个体的特征或行为，这些虽然是代理变量，但比年龄、性别、种族背景或收入更接近。

第二点我要非常明确的是种族群体所扮演的角色。这仅仅是性互动和文化规范的代理变量，可能不是一个一致且准确的标记。然而，在讨论非洲的HIV时，很容易将这种流行病和/或行为“种族化”。例如，在种族隔离时期的南非劳动政策下，黑人劳工被迫从农村家园迁移到大型城市或矿区，为期一年，这种模式极大地加速了性互动，进而加剧了HIV的传播。同样，非洲某些地区的性暴力非常高，尽管这里没有具体提到，但肯定有助于传播。然而，这也与严酷的殖民条件有关，作者可以非常明确地指出，这不应当被解释为内在的种族或文化特征。乌干达成功的教育干预就是一个很好的证明。关于不同种族背景人群不同STI率的最佳网络解释可以在3的第689-697页找到。

更多次要评论如下：

第2页 - 我喜欢图1。

第3页，第2段 - 更好地给予应得的赞誉4。

第3页，第3段 - 所以并发性可能是连接性的一个标志；或是一个决定因素，但同样可以提出，如果一个人有很多性伴侣，唯一能容纳他们的方式就是有并发的伴侣..这也可能对与每个伴侣的性交频率产生影响。很多值得思考的地方！

第4页 - 精彩的总结！我很想看到一个包括所有阴性发现的系统性综述。同样，可以只寻找传播的近端原因，而不是次要或结构决定因素。

第5页 - 你指出“高峰高流行HIV通常基于高质量纵向数据”。请提供依据和参考文献。

第5页 - 关于贫困和社会经济地位、性别不平等这些与HIV不一致相关的陈述很棒；这是因为这些决定因素只是与传播有远端联系。

第5页，第8段 - 为了更准确地描述伴侣数量，我会使用中位数、范围或IQR，因为均值暗示这些分布是高斯分布，但它们不是。细节中确实有魔鬼。另外，可能还需要考虑阴茎肛交的传播风险，这与阴茎阴道性交不完全可比。但我原则上同意。

第7页，第1段 - 我会在这里更准确一些，HSV当然是可以治疗的，但不像细菌性STI那样容易诊断或治疗。

第7页，表2 - 你可能会在1,2中找到关于网络中种族同质性和异质性的讨论很有趣。

伟大的论文，良好的思考，挑战传统真是太好了！

paper_title: Causal Reinforcement Learning: A Survey
paper_abstract: Reinforcement learning is an essential paradigm for solving sequential decision problems under uncertainty. Despite many remarkable achievements in recent decades, applying reinforcement learning methods in the real world remains challenging. One of the main obstacles is that reinforcement learning agents lack a fundamental understanding of the world and must therefore learn from scratch through numerous trial-and-error interactions. They may also face challenges in providing explanations for their decisions and generalizing the acquired knowledge. Causality, however, offers notable advantages by formalizing knowledge in a systematic manner and harnessing invariance for effective knowledge transfer. This has led to the emergence of causal reinforcement learning, a subfield of reinforcement learning that seeks to enhance existing algorithms by incorporating causal relationships into the learning process. In this survey, we provide a comprehensive review of the literature in this domain. We begin by introducing basic concepts in causality and reinforcement learning, and then explain how causality can help address key challenges faced by traditional reinforcement learning. We categorize and systematically evaluate existing causal reinforcement learning approaches, with a focus on their ability to enhance sample efficiency, advance generalizability, facilitate knowledge transfer, mitigate spurious correlations, and promote explainability, fairness, and safety. Lastly, we outline the limitations of current research and shed light on future directions in this rapidly evolving field.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper provides a comprehensive summary of recent developments in an emerging discipline of causa reinforcement learning (CRL). In other words, CRL studies applying causal inference theory to reinforcement learning algorithms, incorporating prior knowledge about the underlying causal mechanisms. This allows the AI systems/agents to address various challenges and biases arising from the underlying data-generating processes, including the presence of unobserved confounding, selection bias, and generalizability of policies to new environments where external validity does not hold. The authors provide a catalog of CRL algorithms addressing these challenges. More specifically, Section 3 discusses methods to improve the sample efficiency of existing RL algorithms by exploiting underlying sparse state representation; Section 4 describes CRL algorithms to generalize the effects of candidate policies to different environments and tasks; Section 5 studies the challenges of spurious correlations to existing RL algorithms, including unobserved confounding and selection bias. Finally, Section 6 discusses related topics beyond policy optimization, including explainability and algorithmic fairness.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
This paper attempts to provide a catalog of existing algorithms in the field of causal reinforcement learning. This is quite an undertaking since CRL is undergoing rapid development, and a common solution pattern is still emerging. The authors managed to identify some key challenges facing standard RL, which could be addressed using causal inference techniques. A comprehensive list of related work is provided. Still, there are some questions and confusion regarding the authors' proposed categorization. Some RL researchers and practitioners might find this paper a bit abstract and confusing. The presentation and organization of the manuscript could be improved. More specifically, I summarize my concerns below. - The need to adopt causal inference techniques in reinforcement learning tasks could be better motivated. It is unclear how existing RL algorithms are unable to address the challenges described in this paper and how causal inference allows one to overcome these challenges. I would recommend the authors starting by describing basic models (e.g., MDPs) and algorithms for RL and providing simple examples, one for each, demonstrating how these RL algorithms do not lead to satisfactory performance when some critical assumptions are violated, e.g., the presence of unobserved confounding, selection bias, and generalizability to new environments. - The categorization within each section could be confusing. For instance, the "Category" column in Table 2 seems a bit arbitrary, and some concepts are unclear. What does the "Mixed" category mean here, and how does it differ from "Dynamics" and "Tasks"? Also, there are overlaps between the second row, "MDP: OPE" and the third-row, "POMDP." The backdoor/frontdoor adjustment could be seen as a form of off-policy policy evaluation by adjustment. How do they differ, for instance, from the bounding approach in (Namkoong et al., 2020)? Overall, this paper could be most improved by consistently categorizing algorithms across sections. I recommend organizing algorithms according to their problem settings, e.g., off-policy (offline) learning, online learning, offline-to-online (transfer) learning, and imitation learning. The authors could then further categorize algorithms according to their techniques and assumptions. - Discussions in Section 3 could be improved. It is unclear what type of sample efficiency the authors are referring to. Is it about minimizing the regret in online learning? Or is it about "zero-shot generalization ability and require only a small number of training samples to converge in new environments?" As for the latter case, how does it differ from Section 4? Are some of these discussions in Section 4 redundant? There exist methods exploiting the sparsity of the underlying causal relationships to accelerate online learning processes. Overall, I found those algorithms similar to algorithms for factored MDPs in the RL literature. The ability to exploit the underlying independence in the interventional distributions is not unique to causal inference but also exists in other disciplines, such as hierarchical RL and influence diagrams. Due to these reasons, I suggest moving Section 3 to later parts of the manuscript, e.g., Section 6.

**Requested Changes:**
- [C1] Add simple examples demonstrating the challenges of unobserved confounding, selection bias, and generalizability to new environments. - [C2] Organize algorithms in each section according to their problem settings, such as off-policy, online, offline-to-online (transfer), and imitation learning. - [C3] Further clarify the meaning of "sample efficiency" in Section 3. Is it referring to online or offline learning? If it is offline, how does it differ from the discussion in Sections 4 and 5? - [C4] Generalizability of policies to new environments has been studied in the causal inference literature under the rubrics of transportability. Several conditions and algorithmic procedures have been introduced. The authors should include a few paragraphs discussing related works. See (Bareinboim & Pearl, PNAS-16) for a detailed survey. Minor comments: - [C5] The authors could be more gentle when introducing the causal Markov factorization in Eq. (1). It relies on Markovianity. It does not necessarily hold when unobserved confounders exist in the underlying causal model. I recommend starting with a general factorization, including the exogenous parents $U_i$, and then deriving the Markov factorization when Markovianity holds.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
This paper provides a comprehensive survey of existing algorithms and methods exploring the intersection between causal inference and reinforcement learning. No new algorithm is proposed. Its longterm societal impact is unclear to see.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer 6Lf7: Thank you very much for your thorough review and insightful feedback on our manuscript! We have carefully addressed each of your points and made necessary revisions, as outlined below: > (C1) Add simple examples demonstrating the motivations. To better illustrate the motivation of causal RL, we have replaced the scurvy example with real-world applications more closely related to reinforcement learning (robot manipulation, medical treatment, and autonomous driving). We have included a new figure (figure 1 on page 2) and enhanced the discussion in Section 1 to better analyze the limitations inherent in traditional reinforcement learning (the second paragraph on page 2). > (C2) Organize algorithms according to their problem settings. Thanks for the thoughtful advice! In the revised manuscript, we have labeled the problem setting of each paper in Tables 1-4, including offline, online, offline-to-online, and imitation learning. In cases where an approach employs online training augmented by offline datasets, it is labeled as online$^*$. We have also changed the category "Mixed" in Table 1 into "Dynamics and Tasks" for improved clarity. As for the difference between backdoor/frontdoor adjustment and the bounding approach in (Namkoong et al. 2020), the key is whether the causal effect is identifiable. When the causal effect is identifiable, we can employ methods such as backdoor/frontdoor adjustment. In cases where the causal effect is unidentifiable, we can resort to set identification (partial identification), deriving its upper and lower bounds, which allows us to assess the robustness of our estimates against unobserved confounding. > (C3) Moving Section 3 to later parts of the manuscript. In the revised manuscript, Section 3 has been relocated to Section 5. We have highlighted that the literature discussed in this section is not limited to minimizing regret, but also includes papers related to knowledge transfer (the second paragraph on page 19). The ability to reuse knowledge contributes to both generalization and sample efficiency. For papers that study generalization, sample efficiency improvements on target domains often appear as a byproduct. In our literature review, we emphasize the different motivations and present the methods with a targeted discussion to avoid meaningless repetitions in the two sections. We agree that part of the work presented in this section is closely related to Factored MDPs. Indeed, if the edges of the dynamic Bayesian networks implied by Factored MDPs represent causal relationships, then these MDPs essentially serve as causal models. In addition, we also agree that the ability to exploit the underlying independence in the interventional distributions is not unique to causal inference. Causal inference provides a language for formally describing the problems of interest, but it is not the only way to solve these problems. > (C4) Discussion of transportability. Thanks for bringing up the topic of transportability! This is a very interesting but rarely studied topic in reinforcement learning, closely related to generalization ability. We have added a brief introduction to this topic and the related literature in the last paragraph of Section 3 (page 13). > (C5) A gentle introduction of the causal Markov factorization. Thank you for your kind advice! In the revised manuscript, we have provided a gentler introduction to the causal Markov factorization following your suggestion (the last paragraph on page 4). We would like to express our gratitude once again for your valuable insights, which have unquestionably contributed to the improvement of our research.
paper_title_zh: 因果强化学习：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 强化学习是解决不确定性环境下序贯决策问题的重要范式。尽管近几十年来取得了许多显著成就，但将强化学习方法应用于现实世界仍然具有挑战性。主要障碍之一是强化学习代理缺乏对世界的基本理解，因此必须通过大量的试错交互从头开始学习。它们还可能面临为其决策提供解释和将所学知识泛化的挑战。然而，因果关系通过系统化地形式化知识并利用不变性实现有效知识转移，提供了显著优势。这导致了因果强化学习的出现，它是强化学习的一个子领域，旨在通过将因果关系融入学习过程来增强现有算法。在本综述中，我们对这一领域的文献进行了全面回顾。我们首先介绍了因果关系和强化学习的基本概念，然后解释了因果关系如何帮助解决传统强化学习面临的关键挑战。我们对现有的因果强化学习方法进行了分类和系统评估，重点关注它们在提高样本效率、增强泛化能力、促进知识转移、减少虚假关联以及提升可解释性、公平性和安全性方面的能力。最后，我们概述了当前研究的局限性，并展望了这一快速演变领域的未来方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对因果强化学习（CRL）这一新兴学科的近期发展进行了全面总结。换言之，CRL研究将因果推断理论应用于强化学习算法，并结合关于底层因果机制的先验知识。这使得人工智能系统/代理能够应对由底层数据生成过程引起的各种挑战和偏差，包括未观测混杂因素的存在、选择偏差以及政策对新环境的泛化性，其中外部有效性不成立。作者提供了一系列应对这些挑战的CRL算法。具体而言，第3节讨论了通过利用底层稀疏状态表示来提高现有RL算法样本效率的方法；第4节描述了将候选政策的效果泛化到不同环境和任务的CRL算法；第5节研究了现有RL算法面临的虚假相关性挑战，包括未观测混杂因素和选择偏差。最后，第6节讨论了与政策优化相关的其他主题，包括可解释性和算法公平性。

**优点和缺点：**
本文试图提供因果强化学习领域现有算法的目录。这是一项艰巨的任务，因为CRL正在迅速发展，且常见的解决方案模式仍在形成中。作者成功识别了标准RL面临的一些关键挑战，这些挑战可以通过因果推断技术来解决。提供了相关工作的全面列表。然而，关于作者提出的分类方法仍存在一些疑问和混淆。一些RL研究人员和从业者可能会觉得本文有些抽象和令人困惑。手稿的呈现和组织可以改进。具体而言，我在下方总结了我的担忧。- 在强化学习任务中采用因果推断技术的必要性可以更好地说明。现有RL算法为何无法应对本文描述的挑战，以及因果推断如何帮助克服这些挑战，尚不清楚。我建议作者从描述RL的基本模型（例如，MDP）和算法开始，并提供简单示例，每个示例演示当某些关键假设被违反时（例如，未观测混杂因素的存在、选择偏差以及对新环境的泛化性），这些RL算法未能达到满意性能的情况。- 每节内的分类可能令人困惑。例如，表2中的“类别”列似乎有些随意，且某些概念不明确。“混合”类别在这里意味着什么，它与“动态”和“任务”有何不同？此外，第二行“MDP: OPE”和第三行“POMDP”之间存在重叠。后门/前门调整可以被视为通过调整进行的离线政策评估形式。例如，它们与（Namkoong et al., 2020）中的边界方法有何不同？总体而言，本文可以通过在各节中一致地分类算法来最大程度地改进。我建议根据问题设置组织算法，例如离线（offline）学习、在线学习、离线到在线（转移）学习和模仿学习。然后，作者可以根据技术和假设进一步分类算法。- 第3节的讨论可以改进。作者所指的样本效率类型不明确。是指在线学习中的最小化遗憾吗？还是指“零样本泛化能力，并且在新环境中只需少量训练样本即可收敛”？对于后一种情况，它与第4节有何不同？第4节中的一些讨论是否冗余？存在利用底层因果关系稀疏性来加速在线学习过程的方法。总体而言，我发现这些算法与RL文献中针对因子MDP的算法相似。利用干预分布底层独立性的能力并非因果推断独有，也存在于其他学科，如分层RL和影响图。由于这些原因，我建议将第3节移至手稿的后部分，例如第6节。

**请求的更改：**
- [C1] 添加简单示例，演示未观测混杂因素、选择偏差和对新环境泛化性的挑战。- [C2] 根据问题设置（如离线、在线、离线到在线（转移）和模仿学习）组织每节中的算法。- [C3] 进一步澄清第3节中“样本效率”的含义。是指在线学习还是离线学习？如果是离线，它与第4节和第5节的讨论有何不同？- [C4] 在因果推断文献中，政策对新环境的泛化性已在可迁移性（transportability）的框架下进行研究。已引入了若干条件和算法程序。作者应包括几段讨论相关工作的内容。参见（Bareinboim & Pearl, PNAS-16）的详细综述。次要评论：- [C5] 作者在引入第（1）式中的因果马尔可夫分解时可以更温和。它依赖于马尔可夫性。当底层因果模型中存在未观测混杂因素时，它不一定成立。我建议从包括外生父母$U_i$的广义分解开始，然后在马尔可夫性成立时推导出马尔可夫分解。

**更广泛的影响担忧：**
本文对探索因果推断与强化学习交叉点的现有算法和方法进行了全面综述。未提出新算法。其长期社会影响尚不清楚。

**声明和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳评论：**
回应审稿人6Lf7：非常感谢您对我们手稿的详尽审查和富有洞察力的反馈！我们已仔细考虑了您的每一点意见，并进行了必要的修订，如下所述：>（C1）添加示例说明动机。为了更好地说明因果RL的动机，我们已将坏血病示例替换为与强化学习更密切相关的现实应用（机器人操作、医疗治疗和自动驾驶）。我们新增了一幅图（第2页的图1），并增强了第1节的讨论，以更好地分析传统强化学习固有的局限性（第2页第二段）。>（C2）根据问题设置组织算法。感谢您的深思熟虑的建议！在修订的手稿中，我们已在表1-4中标注了每篇论文的问题设置，包括离线、在线、离线到在线和模仿学习。在方法采用在线训练并辅以离线数据集的情况下，标记为在线$^*$。我们还把表1中的“混合”类别改为“动态和任务”以提高清晰度。至于后门/前门调整与（Namkoong et al. 2020）中边界方法的区别，关键在于因果效应是否可识别。当因果效应可识别时，我们可以采用后门/前门调整等方法。在因果效应不可识别的情况下，我们可以求助于集合识别（部分识别），推导其上限和下限，这使我们能够评估估计对未观测混杂因素的稳健性。>（C3）将第3节移至手稿后部分。在修订的手稿中，第3节已移至第5节。我们强调本节讨论的文献不仅限于最小化遗憾，还包括与知识转移相关的论文（第19页第二段）。知识重用的能力有助于泛化和样本效率。对于研究泛化的论文，目标域上的样本效率改进通常作为副产品出现。在我们的文献综述中，我们强调不同的动机，并有针对性地介绍方法，以避免两节中的无意义重复。我们同意本节部分工作与因子MDP密切相关。实际上，如果因子MDP隐含的动态贝叶斯网络的边代表因果关系，那么这些MDP本质上就是因果模型。此外，我们也同意利用干预分布底层独立性的能力并非因果推断独有。因果推断为正式描述感兴趣的问题提供了一种语言，但它不是解决这些问题的唯一方法。>（C4）讨论可迁移性。感谢您提出可迁移性话题！这是一个非常有趣但在强化学习中很少研究的主题，与泛化能力密切相关。我们已在第3节最后一段（第13页）添加了关于这一主题和相关文献的简要介绍。>（C5）温和引入因果马尔可夫分解。感谢您的善意建议！在修订的手稿中，我们已按照您的建议提供了对因果马尔可夫分解的更温和介绍（第4页最后一段）。我们再次感谢您宝贵的见解，这无疑为我们的研究改进做出了贡献。

paper_title: A Pharmacist Perspective on Optimizing Pharmacotherapy among Older Adults – A Review
paper_abstract: Multimorbidity and the associated consumption of multiple medications are common among the older population, posing a significant health concern. This leads to an increased incidence of side effects, adverse drug reactions, and higher healthcare costs for the individual, their family, and the country’s overall healthcare expenditure. Older adults experience complications due to the natural aging process and polypharmacy. The pharmacokinetic and pharmacodynamic variables of medications play a crucial role in their recovery and overall health. While many studies have highlighted the rising incidence of multimorbidity among older adults, they often overlook the importance of optimizing medication therapy to reduce complications, side effects, adverse drug reactions, falls, and improve medication adherence. This narrative review focuses on the impact of polypharmacy on older adults, age-related pharmacokinetic changes, pharmacodynamics in this population, and various methods to optimize pharmacotherapy. The findings of this review aim to provide healthcare providers with a better understanding of how to optimize pharmacotherapies and reduce drug-related complications in older adults.
review_content:
I believe this paper is important as it reviews the key considerations for optimizing drug therapy in the older adults. However, I have several concerns and would like to propose the following revisions:
 1. Novelty and Differentiation: While the paper provides a comprehensive review, it would benefit from a clearer emphasis on what makes it unique compared to other similar reviews. Highlight specific angles or methods that distinguish this paper from the existing literature.
 2. Focus on True Health Outcomes: While the paper acknowledges the benefits of medication optimization in reducing the number of drugs, PIMs, and anticholinergic load, it should go further by discussing outcomes directly affecting the elderly's quality of life. It would be useful to include data on physical function, ADL (activities of daily living), quality of life, and mortality in elderly populations. Studies like the one in reference(PMID: 35633757) that show the impact of medication reviews on optimizing therapy and health outcomes could be cited.
 3. Insufficient Citations: The paper lacks references in critical sections, such as the one on "Promote patient autonomy & shared decision-making." Adding recent systematic reviews and relevant research will strengthen the paper's academic depth. Consider citing the latest studies that discuss optimizing drug therapy outcomes in the elderly, particularly those focused on shared decision-making models.
paper_title_zh: 《药师视角下优化老年人药物治疗——综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 多重疾病及其伴随的多药使用在老年人群中普遍存在，构成显著的卫生问题。这导致副作用、药物不良反应的发生率增加，以及个人、家庭和国家整体医疗支出的提高。老年人因自然衰老过程和多药并用而经历并发症。药物的药代动力学和药效动力学变量在其康复和整体健康中起着至关重要的作用。尽管许多研究强调了老年人多重疾病发生率上升的问题，但它们往往忽视了优化药物治疗以减少并发症、副作用、药物不良反应、跌倒和改善药物依从性的重要性。这篇叙述性综述重点关注多药并用对老年人的影响、与年龄相关的药代动力学变化、该人群的药效动力学以及优化药物治疗的多种方法。本综述的发现旨在为医疗保健提供者提供更深入的理解，以优化药物治疗并减少老年人的药物相关并发症。
review_content_zh:
我相信这篇论文很重要，因为它综述了优化老年人药物治疗的关键考虑因素。然而，我有几个担忧，并提出以下修改建议：
1. 新颖性和差异化：虽然论文提供了全面的综述，但应更清晰地强调其与其他类似综述的不同之处。突出具体的角度或方法，使本文区别于现有文献。
2. 关注真实健康结果：虽然论文承认药物优化在减少药物数量、潜在不适当药物（PIMs）和抗胆碱能负荷方面的益处，但应进一步讨论直接影响老年人生活质量的结果。包括有关老年人群体身体功能、日常生活活动（ADL）、生活质量和死亡率的数据将很有用。可以引用如参考文献（PMID: 35633757）中显示药物审查对优化治疗和健康结果影响的研究。
3. 引用不足：论文在关键部分（如“促进患者自主性和共同决策”）缺乏参考文献。添加最近的系统综述和相关研究将增强论文的学术深度。考虑引用最新讨论优化老年人药物治疗结果的研究，特别是那些专注于共同决策模型的研究。

paper_title: A scoping review of determinants of performance in dressage
paper_abstract: As a first step in achieving an evidence-based classification system for the sport of Para Dressage, there is a clear need to define elite dressage performance. Previous studies have attempted to quantify performance with able-bodied riders using scientific methods, however definitive measures have yet to be established for the horse and/or the rider. This may be, in part, due to the variety of movements and gaits that are found within a dressage test and also due to the complexity of the horse-rider partnership. The aim of this review is therefore to identify objective measurements of horse performance in dressage and the functional abilities of the rider that may influence them to achieve higher scores.

paper_title: Prevalence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease at high altitude: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: Background and Objective: Recently, several studies have investigated the prevalence of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) at high altitude (＞1500m). However, much remains to be understood about the correlation between altitude and COPD. We aimed to summarize the prevalence of COPD at high-altitudes and find out if altitude could be a risk factor for COPD.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting Basic reporting adequate, including components of the manuscript, professional structure, short manuscript. Experimental design Design is adequate, question clearly defined, impact of altitude in COPD prevalence is relevant from the scientific point of view and also from a practical point of view as there is a substantial proportion of individuals living at high altitude especially in some countries. 1. Limitation of the analysis derives from a limited number of original studies analyzing the question, although adding to a large number of individuals. Thanks for your suggestion. Our study included 10 original studies, which contained population from all over the word. So we think the results of our study is convincing and could provide evidence for further studies. Certainly, limited number of original studies resulted in limited data analysis. Therefore, we call for more further studies to detect the relationship between altitude and the prevalence of COPD. 2. Methods are well described although not enough detail on obtaining adjusted OR in each study, and what variables were adjusted, what is important for the summary adjusted OR. Thanks for your suggestion. We obtained adjusted OR from original studies. Variables we extracted for adjusted OR are household air pollution, age, gender, educational level, pack years, exposure to gas or dust, history of tuberculosis and body mass index. We have explained in our manuscript and highlighted with yellow mark. The summary of adjusted OR could eliminate the biases in our results from factors other than altitude. Moreover, our results could be more accurate under the analyze of adjusted OR. Validity of the findings 3. The summary analysis is correct (except previous observation on adjusted OR´s with unclear variables adjusted for). Thanks for your suggestion. Variables we extracted for adjusted OR are household air pollution, age, gender, educational level, pack years, exposure to gas or dust, history of tuberculosis and body mass index. We have explained in our manuscript and highlighted with yellow mark. Comments for the author Interesting review on the impact of altitude on prevalence of COPD, analyzing crude and adjusted OR. Study well described and including all important items. 1. Crude OR suggests altitude is a risk factor, but adjusted OR did not, as there was confusing factors better explaining it. Not clear what variables were adjusted for in the individual studies (should be clarified) The crude OR suggests that altitude is a risk factor, while adjusted OR does not. paper_title: Primary Salivary Gland Malignancy: A Review on Post-Operative Follow-Up Duration and Radiological Modalities
paper_abstract: Salivary gland cancers (SGC) are rare neoplasms that exhibit a wide array of histological heterogeneities. Most patients presenting with SGCs are asymptomatic, as they are typically slow-growing and localized. Primary surgical resection is the cornerstone treatment for SGCs and radiotherapy is performed in selected cases. There is no consensus on concrete standard post-operative guidelines. Patients are followed-up for years, however an agreed duration of follow-up is less elucidated in the literature present on the subject. Distant metastases are the primary cause of treatment failure. Post-operative diagnostic evidence of disease recurrence or distant metastases is heavily guided by radiological examinations. Patients with SGCs have better outcomes with a well-structured and lengthy follow-up plan. This review aims to suggest an appropriate follow-up duration and radiological modalities used post-operatively for SGC patients.
review_content:
1. Methodology and Article Selection

-PRISMA Flow Diagram: Although the review clearly states the article selection criteria and keywords used, the process should be transparently depicted. It is recommended that the authors include a PRISMA flow diagram to illustrate the identification, screening, eligibility, and inclusion of studies.
-Definition of the Clinical Question: The review does not clearly define the clinical question guiding the literature search. The authors should explicitly state the research question or objective, which is essential for understanding the scope of the review.
-Search Strategy Clarity: It remains unclear whether the multiple keywords were combined using “AND” or “OR” operators. The search strategy section should clarify the logical combination of keywords to ensure reproducibility and transparency.

2. Data Presentation and Analysis

-Survival Data Stratification: Table 1 summarizes disease-free survival (DFS) and overall survival (OS) across studies. However, because these outcomes can be influenced by factors such as pathological subtype, the review should also analyze or discuss whether DFS and OS differ among various histopathological types.
-Avoiding Redundancy: If DFS is defined once in the manuscript, subsequent repetitions of the definition should be removed to avoid redundancy and maintain clarity.

3. Referencing and Evidence Support

- Supporting Key Statements: Several claims in the review require proper citation. For example:
The statement regarding the Korean study—“...the presence of local metastases to regional lymph nodes and distant metastases at presentation were significant indicators of poor survival”—should be supported with an appropriate reference.
Similarly, the reported times for locoregional recurrence and distant metastases from the studies by Shabani et al. (approximately 5 and 11 years, respectively) and Mimica et al. (a median time of 20 months) need to include their corresponding citations.

4. Content and Discussion Enhancements

- Anatomical Variations: The incidence of specific tumor types may vary by anatomical location. For instance, differences in the incidence of mucoepidermoid carcinoma between the parotid and submandibular glands should be discussed, as these variations could have clinical relevance.
- Perineural Invasion: Perineural invasion is a critical prognostic factor in certain salivary gland carcinomas, yet it is not addressed in the current review. Including a discussion on the prevalence and prognostic impact of perineural invasion would add depth to the analysis.

5. Structure and Organization

- Ordering of Sections: The section dedicated to radiological modalities is primarily diagnostic in nature. It might be more logical to position this section before the treatment and prognosis discussion to better reflect the flow from diagnosis to follow-up management.
- Conclusions and Novelty: The review’s conclusion appears to reiterate established findings without highlighting any new insights. To improve the impact, the conclusion should acknowledge the limitations of previous reviews and clearly state the novel contributions of this work based on recent publications.

6. Overall Assessment

While the review addresses an important and timely topic, enhancing the clarity of the methodology, supporting key claims with appropriate references, and reorganizing the content would significantly improve the scientific rigor and readability of the article. Addressing these points will help ensure that the review not only summarizes the current state of knowledge but also contributes novel insights to the field.
paper_title_zh: 原发性唾液腺恶性肿瘤：术后随访时长及放射学检查手段综述
paper_abstract_zh: 唾液腺癌（SGC）是一种罕见的肿瘤，表现出广泛的组织学异质性。大多数SGC患者无症状，因为它们通常生长缓慢且局限。原发性手术切除是SGC治疗的基础，放疗在选定的病例中进行。关于具体的术后标准指南尚未达成共识。患者需进行多年随访，然而在现有文献中，关于随访的同意时长尚未明确阐明。远处转移是治疗失败的主要原因。术后疾病复发或远处转移的诊断证据主要依赖于放射学检查。SGC患者通过结构良好且长期的随访计划可获得更好的预后。本综述旨在建议适当的随访时长及术后用于SGC患者的放射学检查方式。
review_content_zh:
1. 方法学和文章选择

-PRISMA流程图：尽管综述明确说明了文章选择标准和使用的关键词，但该过程应透明地展示。建议作者包括一个PRISMA流程图，以说明研究的识别、筛选、合格性和纳入情况。
-临床问题的定义：综述未明确界定指导文献检索的临床问题。作者应明确陈述研究问题或目标，这对于理解综述的范围至关重要。
-检索策略的清晰度：目前尚不清楚多个关键词是否通过“AND”或“OR”运算符组合。检索策略部分应澄清关键词的逻辑组合，以确保可重复性和透明度。

2. 数据呈现和分析

-生存数据分层：表1总结了各研究的无病生存期（DFS）和总生存期（OS）。然而，由于这些结果可能受病理亚型等因素的影响，综述还应分析或讨论DFS和OS在不同组织病理学类型之间是否存在差异。
-避免冗余：如果DFS在文稿中已定义一次，后续重复的定义应删除，以避免冗余并保持清晰。

3. 参考文献和证据支持

-支持关键陈述：综述中的几项主张需要适当的引用。例如：
关于韩国研究的陈述——“...局部转移至区域淋巴结和远处转移的出现是预后不良的显著指标”——应提供适当的参考文献支持。
同样，Shabani等人研究中报告的局部区域复发和远处转移的时间（分别约为5年和11年）以及Mimica等人报告的中位时间（20个月）也需要包括相应的引用。

4. 内容和讨论的增强

-解剖变异：特定肿瘤类型的发病率可能因解剖位置而异。例如，应讨论腮腺和下颌下腺之间黏液表皮样癌发病率的差异，因为这些变异可能具有临床相关性。
-神经周围浸润：神经周围浸润是某些唾液腺癌的关键预后因素，但在当前综述中未涉及。包括对神经周围浸润的流行率和预后影响的讨论将增加分析的深度。

5. 结构和组织

-章节顺序：专门讨论放射学模式的章节主要是诊断性的。将该章节置于治疗和预后讨论之前可能更符合逻辑，以更好地反映从诊断到随访管理的流程。
-结论和新颖性：综述的结论似乎重申了已确立的发现，而没有突出任何新见解。为提高影响力，结论应承认以往综述的局限性，并基于近期出版物明确陈述本工作的创新贡献。

6. 总体评价

尽管综述涉及一个重要且及时的主题，但增强方法学的清晰度、用适当参考文献支持关键主张以及重新组织内容将显著提高文章的科学严谨性和可读性。解决这些要点将有助于确保综述不仅总结当前知识状态，还为该领域贡献新见解。

paper_title: Theranostics-enabling high-tech centers: the value of centralizing resources in countries in development
paper_abstract: Theranostics is a rapidly advancing field that is driving significant advancements in the healthcare industry by providing individualized medical solutions. Demand for theranostics is increasing over time and has led to the creation of theranostics-enabling high-tech technological centers. This review investigated the potential advantages and drawbacks of consolidating theranostics resources within technologically advanced facilities, particularly in developing nations, and led to three main observations: 1) The centralization of theranostics resources can lead to improved research, cost efficiency, and quality of healthcare services; 2) Developing countries may encounter hurdles such as resource allocation, infrastructure development, and skill acquisition, but these risks can be mitigated; 3) High-tech centers can play a major role in fostering innovation and advancing theranostics industry in these countries. In conclusion, this paper provides insights into the potential of high-tech centers as a pivotal point in the evolution of healthcare in developing countries. It calls for more funding support, in-depth research and collaborative efforts to overcome the challenges and harness the full potential of theranostics, as it has already occurred in some countries.
review_content:
This work centers the topic of Theranostics-enabling high-tech centers in developing countries. This topic is interesting to both scientific communities related and also the policy makers. Theranostics is an important emerging trend in current medical research, not only because the combination of two most important aspects of diagnosis and therapy, but also the merits in revolutionizing our way and ability to treat diseases. Delineating the demands and the gaps on the development of theranostics-enabling high-tech centers in developing countries is certainly helpful to the global spread of science. I have several points on this manuscript:
 1. The following literature are recommended to include in the discussion of the term of Theranostics, e.g., Theranostics 2011; 1: 1-2. Chen XS (2011 [Ref - 1]); Nature Reviews Materials 2 (7), 1-18 Chen H et al. (2017 [Ref - 2]).
 2. When talking about ‘theranostics’, one of the most important and elegant approaches of achieving theranostics is nuclear medicine, which matches well with the aim of theranostics. This part should be elaborated.
 3. The authors believes that “Theranostics…., allows to tailor treatments for individual patients based on their unique biological characteristics, paving the way for personalized medicine”. I do not doubt about the goal of ‘personalized medicine’, however, it is somewhat far from the current understanding of ‘Theranostics’.
paper_title_zh: 诊疗一体化赋能的高科技中心：发展中国家资源集中的价值
paper_abstract_zh: 诊疗一体化是一个快速发展的领域，通过提供个性化医疗解决方案，正在推动医疗行业的重大进步。对诊疗一体化的需求随着时间的推移不断增加，并促成了诊疗一体化高科技技术中心的建立。本综述研究了在技术先进设施内整合诊疗一体化资源的潜在优势和劣势，特别是在发展中国家，并得出了三个主要观察结果：1）诊疗一体化资源的集中可以提升研究水平、成本效益和医疗服务的质量；2）发展中国家可能会遇到资源分配、基础设施建设和技能获取等障碍，但这些风险是可以缓解的；3）高科技中心可以在促进创新和推动这些国家诊疗一体化产业发展中发挥重要作用。总之，本文深入探讨了高科技中心作为发展中国家医疗演变关键点的潜力。它呼吁更多的资金支持、深入研究以及合作努力，以克服挑战并充分发挥诊疗一体化的潜力，正如一些国家已经实现的那样。
review_content_zh:
本文聚焦于发展中国家的高科技中心赋能诊疗一体化（Theranostics）这一主题。这一主题不仅对相关科学界具有吸引力，也对政策制定者具有重要意义。诊疗一体化是当前医学研究的一个重要新兴趋势，这不仅因为它结合了诊断和治疗这两个最重要的方面，还因为它在革新我们治疗疾病的方式和能力上的优势。明确发展中国家在发展诊疗一体化高科技中心的需求和差距，无疑有助于科学的全球传播。我对这篇手稿有几点建议：
1. 建议在讨论“诊疗一体化”这一术语时，包含以下文献，例如：Theranostics 2011; 1: 1-2. Chen XS (2011 [Ref - 1]); Nature Reviews Materials 2 (7), 1-18 Chen H et al. (2017 [Ref - 2])。
2. 在谈论“诊疗一体化”时，核医学是实现诊疗一体化的最重要且最优雅的方法之一，这与诊疗一体化的目标非常契合。这一部分应详细阐述。
3. 作者认为“诊疗一体化……，可以根据患者的独特生物特征定制治疗方案，为个性化医疗铺平道路”。我对“个性化医疗”的目标没有疑问，然而，这与当前对“诊疗一体化”的理解有些距离。

paper_title: Automated human chromosome segmentation and feature extraction: Current trends and prospects
paper_abstract: Automated human chromosome segmentation and feature extraction aim to improve the overall quality of genetic disorder diagnosis by addressing the limitations of tedious manual processes such as expertise dependence, time-inefficiency, observer variability and fatigue errors. Nevertheless, significant differences caused by staining methods, chromosome damage which may occur during imaging, cell and staining debris, inhomogeneity, weak boundaries, morphological variations, premature sister chromatid separation, as well as the presence of overlapping, touching, di-centric and bent chromosomes pose challenges in automated human chromosome segmentation and feature extraction. This review paper extensively discusses how the approaches presented in literature have addressed these challenges, and their strengths and limitations. Human chromosome segmentation algorithms are presented under four broad categories; thresholding, clustering, active contours and convex-concave points-based methods. Chromosome feature extraction methods are discussed under two main categories based on banding-pattern and geometry. In addition, new insights for the improvement of fully automated karyotyping are provided.
review_content:
This research paper presents human chromosome segmentation algorithms under four broad categories; thresholding, clustering, active contours and convex-concave points-based methods. Chromosome feature extraction methods are discussed under two main categories based on banding-pattern and geometry. The research paper presents new insights for the improvement of fully automated karyotyping are provided.

A few suggestions/comments to further enhance the quality of the manuscript:
 1. The reviews of the previous work presented in the manuscript presents are fairly brief, and they focus on the outcomes and limitations rather than the algorithms used. Some deeper technical discussion of the previous work most related to this study may be included.
 2. The comparison tables in the manuscript list the methods used. It is imperative to present an exhaustive review comparing the advantages / limitations / weakness / strengths of the methods.
 3. Various publicly available datasets (LK1, BioLab etc) with the varying complexities in segmentation and subsequent feature extraction may be discussed to highlight the choices of the algorithms, research challenges addressed, contribution of the researches.
 4. Various performance parameters to measure the success of the segmentation algorithms are popularly reported. Please consider including a discussion on the performance of the reported algorithms in terms of the various performance parameters.
 5. Few researchers have successfully addressed extrication of touching and overlapping chromosomes (up to seven overlaps) using novel approaches. Please include a discussion on the same in the manuscript. See Munot, Jayanta & Joshi (2013).1
 6. Manuscript mentions use of pre-trained network for chromosome segmentation. A few recent references and their findings may also be considered in the manuscript, such as Sun et al. (2021), and Kanimozhi, Balasubramani, & Anuradha (2021).[ref-1,2]
 7. Role of deep learning approaches and other aspects or considerations like Transfer learning, regularization hyper parameter tuning may be considered.

paper_title_zh: 自动化人类染色体分割与特征提取：当前趋势与展望
paper_abstract_zh: 自动人类染色体分割和特征提取旨在通过解决繁琐的手工流程的局限性，如专业知识依赖、时间低效、观察者变异性和疲劳错误，来提高遗传疾病诊断的整体质量。然而，染色方法引起的显著差异、成像过程中可能发生的染色体损伤、细胞和染色碎片、不均匀性、弱边界、形态学变异、姐妹染色单体过早分离，以及重叠、接触、双着丝粒和弯曲染色体的存在，对自动人类染色体分割和特征提取构成了挑战。这篇综述文章广泛讨论了文献中提出的方法如何应对这些挑战，以及它们的优点和局限性。人类染色体分割算法被分为四大类：阈值法、聚类法、主动轮廓法和基于凸凹点的 methods。染色体特征提取方法根据带型和解剖学特征被分为两大类。此外，还提供了关于改进全自动化核型分析的新的见解。
review_content_zh:
该研究论文介绍了四大类人类染色体分割算法：阈值法、聚类法、活动轮廓法和基于凸凹点的分割方法。染色体特征提取方法基于带型图案和几何形状分为两大类进行讨论。研究论文提供了关于改进全自动核型分析的新的见解。

为进一步提升手稿质量，提出以下建议/评论：
1. 手稿中呈现的先前工作综述较为简略，主要关注结果和局限性，而非所用算法。可以包含与本研究最相关的先前工作的更深入技术讨论。
2. 手稿中的比较表格列出了所用方法。必须提供一个详尽的综述，比较这些方法的优点、局限性、弱点和强项。
3. 可以讨论各种公开可用的数据集（如LK1、BioLab等），这些数据集在分割和后续特征提取方面具有不同的复杂性，以突出算法选择、解决的研究挑战和研究的贡献。
4. 通常会报告各种性能参数来衡量分割算法的成功。请考虑包含关于所报告算法在各种性能参数方面的表现的讨论。
5. 一些研究者已成功采用新颖方法解决了接触和重叠染色体（多达七重重叠）的分离问题。请在手稿中包含相关讨论。参见Munot, Jayanta & Joshi (2013)。

7. 可以考虑深度学习方法的作用以及其他方面或考虑因素，如迁移学习、正则化超参数调整。
8. 文献报告了使用背景校正和其他预处理技术来提高分割准确性的方法。如MFISH。可以纳入类似方法的讨论。
9. 讨论部分必须专门列出并总结所设计方法的重大发现、方法的强项、所报告算法失败或表现优异的关键案例、解决的研究空白、从实际部署角度的主要考虑以及临床环境的影响。

paper_title: A comprehensive review of deep learning-based single image super-resolution
paper_abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) is one of the vital image processing methods that improve the resolution of an image in the field of computer vision. In the last two decades, significant progress has been made in the field of super-resolution, especially by utilizing deep learning methods. This survey is an effort to provide a detailed survey of recent progress in single-image super-resolution in the perspective of deep learning while also informing about the initial classical methods used for image super-resolution. The survey classifies the image SR methods into four categories, i.e., classical methods, supervised learningbased methods, unsupervised learning-based methods, and domain-specific SR methods. We also introduce the problem of SR to provide intuition about image quality metrics, available reference datasets, and SR challenges. Deep learning-based approaches of SR are evaluated using a reference dataset. Some of the reviewed state-of-the-art image SR methods include enhanced deep SR network (EDSR), cycle-in-cycle GAN (CinCGAN), multiscale residual network (MSRN), meta residual dense network (Meta-RDN), recurrent back-projection network (RBPN), second-order attention network (SAN), SR feedback network (SRFBN) and wavelet-based residual attention network (WRAN). Finally, this survey is concluded with future directions and trends in SR and open problems in SR to be addressed by the researchers.

paper_title: Advanced and Conventional Magnetic Resonance Imaging in Neuropsychiatric Lupus
paper_abstract: Neuropsychiatric lupus is a major diagnostic challenge, and a main cause of morbidity and mortality in patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE). Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is, by far, the main tool for assessing the brain in this disease. Conventional and advanced MRI techniques are used to help establishing the diagnosis, to rule out alternative diagnoses, and recently, to monitor the evolution of the disease. This review explores the neuroimaging findings in SLE, including the recent advances in new MRI methods.

paper_title: The Responsible Foundation Model Development Cheatsheet: A Review of Tools & Resources
paper_abstract: Foundation model development attracts a rapidly expanding body of contributors, scientists, and applications. To help shape responsible development practices, we introduce the Foundation Model Development Cheatsheet: a growing collection of 250+ tools and resources spanning text, vision, and speech modalities. We draw on a large body of prior work to survey resources (e.g. software, documentation, frameworks, guides, and practical tools) that support informed data selection, processing, and understanding, precise and limitation-aware artifact documentation, efficient model training, advance awareness of the environmental impact from training, careful model evaluation of capabilities, risks, and claims, as well as responsible model release, licensing and deployment practices. We hope this curated collection of resources helps guide more responsible development. The process of curating this list, enabled us to review the AI development ecosystem, revealing what tools are critically missing, misused, or over-used in existing practices. We find that (i) tools for data sourcing, model evaluation, and monitoring are critically under-serving ethical and real-world needs, (ii) evaluations for model safety, capabilities, and environmental impact all lack reproducibility and transparency, (iii) text and particularly English-centric analyses continue to dominate over multilingual and multi-modal analyses, and (iv) evaluation of systems, rather than just models, is needed so that capabilities and impact are assessed in context.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The rise of foundation models has attracted enormous attention in many scenarios and applications. To facilitate the development of foundation models in practical applications, this paper introduces a cheatsheet about foundation models. It surveys many resources including software, documentations, frameworks, guides, practical tools and other topics. Based on this list, it could help the community to understand the development of foundation models.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** 1. This paper formulates the pipeline of model development and survey resources of each stage that requires. 2. This paper has provided a comprehensive survey to cover many topics that are involved in foundation model building. **Weaknesses** The motivation of this paper is good but lacks some in-depth insights about each part in building foundation models. Some conclusions are concrete. For example, some practices in data preparation are common, while how to well deploy these operations could be more important.

**Requested Changes:**
1. It will be better to define the scope of tools and resources. Both "tool" and "resource" are quite common words that will make some misunderstanding. Some research topics like AI Agent also introduce tool learning while is a different direction. To make a better understanding, I suggest authors first define the scope of tools and resources used in this paper first. 2. Besides, it would be better to add some sections to describe the applications of current models.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
This paper does not require broader impact concerns.

Yes

paper_title_zh: 《负责任的基础模型开发速查手册：工具与资源综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 基础模型开发吸引了迅速增加的贡献者、科学家和应用程序。为了帮助塑造负责任的开发实践，我们介绍了基础模型开发速查表：这是一个涵盖文本、视觉和语音模态的250多种工具和资源的不断增长的集合。我们借鉴了大量前期工作，调研了支持知情数据选择、处理和理解、精确且有局限意识的人工制品文档、高效模型训练、提前了解训练对环境影响、谨慎评估模型能力、风险和声明，以及负责任的模型发布、许可和部署实践的资源（例如软件、文档、框架、指南和实用工具）。我们希望这一精心挑选的资源集合能帮助指导更负责任的开发。整理这份清单的过程使我们能够回顾人工智能开发生态系统，揭示现有实践中哪些工具严重缺失、误用或过度使用。我们发现：（一）数据来源、模型评估和监控工具在满足伦理和现实需求方面严重不足；（二）模型安全性、能力和环境影响的评估都缺乏可重复性和透明度；（三）文本尤其是以英语为中心的分析继续主导，而多语言和多模态分析则相对不足；（四）需要评估系统而不仅仅是模型，以便在具体情境中评估能力和影响。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
基础模型的兴起在许多场景和应用中吸引了极大的关注。为了促进基础模型在实际应用中的发展，本文介绍了一份关于基础模型的速查表。它调研了包括软件、文档、框架、指南、实用工具和其他主题在内的众多资源。基于这份清单，它可以帮助社区理解基础模型的发展。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点** 1. 本文制定了模型开发的流程，并调研了每个阶段所需的资源。2. 本文提供了全面的调研，涵盖了基础模型构建涉及的许多主题。
**缺点** 本文的动机是好的，但缺乏对基础模型构建各部分的一些深入见解。一些结论较为具体。例如，数据准备中的一些实践是常见的，而如何良好地部署这些操作可能更为重要。
