paper_title: Effects of exercise training with blood flow restriction on vascular function in adults: a systematic review and metaanalysis Elisio A Pereira-Neto
paper_abstract: Background. Blood flow restricted exercise (BFRE) improves physical fitness, with theorized positive effects on vascular function. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to report 1) the effects of BFRE on vascular function in adults with or without chronic health conditions, and 2) adverse events and adherence reported for BFRE.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Comments for the author The authors of this manuscript performed a very comprehensive systematic review and metaanalysis on the effects of BFRE on vascular structure and function along with relevant secondary outcomes (adherence/negative side effects). The authors should be commended at the level of data synthesis performed in this review and the clear reporting in the tables/figures. 1) Ln 162-3 – Smart et al needs to be referenced appropriately Author response: This reference has now been corrected. 2) Ln 164 – “Studies were not excluded based on score for methodological quality.” One sentence to elaborate on why this was the case could help further clarify for the reader. Was this to increase study inclusion to be able to perform a MA? Author response: We prospectively planned to include all eligible studies irrespective of methodological quality score. A number of studies and guidelines advise against excluding studies based on methodological quality due to the impact on precision (decreases) and increased bias for meta-analysis findings. For example: 23. Stone J, Gurunathan U, Glass K, Munn Z, Tugwell P, Doi SAR. Stratification by qualityinduced selection bias in a meta-analysis of clinical trials. J Clin Epidemiol 2019; 107:51–9. 24. Higgins JPT, Altman DG, Gøtzsche PC, Jüni P, Moher D, Oxman AD, et al. The Cochrane Collaboration’s tool for assessing risk of bias in randomised trials. BMJ 2011; 343:1–9. We have included the following clarifying sentence ‘Studies were not excluded based on methodological quality score as this has been shown to reduce precision and increase bias in meta-analysis results [23,24].’ 3) Ln 196-7 – I2 needs to be superscripted x 2 Author response: This has now been corrected as suggested. 4) Ln 216 – extra space between “reported” and “on” Author response: This has now been corrected as suggested. 5) Ln 238 – What does (%) mean? Is there a number that should precede the %? Author response: This was an error, and the number 58 should precede the % as it indicates the percentage of studies that evaluated BFRE versus one other group, which is equivalent to 15 studies out of the total 26 included. We have amended the line to ‘There were 15 (58%) studies […]’. 6) Ln 269 – extra % in (46%%) needs removing Author response: The extra % has now been removed as suggested. 7) Ln 357 – Figure 3 appears to be referenced incorrectly and should be Figure 2. Author response. We have now amended the reference from ‘Figure 3’ to ‘Figure 2’. 8) Ln 372 – Figure 2 appears to be referenced incorrectly and should be Figure 3 Author response: We have now amended the reference from ‘Figure 2’ to ‘Figure 3’. 9) Ln 387 – “meta regression” should be “meta-regression” or some consistent term Author response: The term “meta regression” has been changed to the term ‘meta-regression’ consistently throughout the manuscript. 10) Ln 427-429- “A single study reported an initial sensation of leg numbness when one participant commenced BFRE, which did not persist beyond the first minute of exercise [39] (2 out of 16 hypertensive older women).” – would suggest changing wording to two participants since the study reported two adverse events in 16 participants, not just one participant. Author response: We have corrected the information for two participants instead of one. The line is now worded as ‘A single study reported an initial sensation of leg numbness in two participants after commencing BFRE […]’. 11) Ln 452 – extra space present between “favored” and “dynamic” Author response: We have now removed the extra space as suggested. 12) Ln 466 – remove “the” before both Author response: We have now removed the word ‘the’ as suggested. 13) Ln 485 – needs period at the end Author response: We have now included period at the end as suggested. 14) Ln 504 – need space between “40] and” Author response: We have now included the space as suggested. 15) Ln 506 – Wilvebrand spelled wrong Author response: We have now corrected the spelling to Willebrand. 16) Ln 514-524 – I appreciated this section in addressing the significant limitations in the literature and how that reflected in your analysis. Author response: No amendment required. 17) Ln 534 – Principals -> principles Author response: We have now corrected the word used changing from ‘principals’ to ‘principles’. 18) Ln 545 – The article (Patterson, 2019) is now not referred to as a position stand, so this should be reflected in the manuscript Author response: Thank you for the suggestion. The reference is now referred to as a recent review of BFRE methodology, application and safety. 19) Ln 546 – space needs removing between recommending and BFR Author response: We have now removed the extra space as suggested. 20) Ln 555 – The article (Patterson, 2019) is now not referred to as a position stand, so this should be reflected in the manuscript Author response: The reference is now referred to as a recent review of BFRE methodology, application and safety. 21) Ln 557 – needs a number before the percentage to inform reader of the exact % not using LOP as a standardization approach (also – you have used AOP prior – thoughts on sticking to one term throughout the manuscript?) Author response: We have now included the percentage of studies that did not use LOP as a standardisation approach (92%). We have made the decision to use LOP in the manuscript as this is becoming the most common term used, and we searched the entire paper to ensure consistency in the term used, including in Table 2 (which was resubmitted in tracked changes and clean versions). 22) Ln 575-76 – additional spacing needs to be deleted, along with the comma between review and excluded Author response: We have now removed the extra space and comma as suggested. We would also like to note that on Ln 579 there was also an extra space between the words ‘as’ and ‘peripheral’ that we also removed. 23) Ln 578 – stick with one variation of the word – comorbidities or co-morbidities and keep consistent. This has comorbidities but on 575 its co-morbidities. Author response: We have now searched the whole manuscript to ensure that we used the term ‘comorbidities’ consistently throughout the paper. 24) May be good to mention https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC5374335/ even though there was no exercise control, it was RCO design and illustrates some of what you are talking about with respect to the at-risk populations (and was excluded from analysis based on your inclusion criteria) and shows some potentially negative changes in both the trained and untrained limb following 3 weeks of training in overweight individuals. Author response: We have reviewed the suggested reference and do not think it is appropriate in the paragraph specified by the reviewer as a) the paragraph is related to older people living with chronic conditions, but the reference concerns young normotensive, non-smoking people who were not taking any medication; b) while the reference indicates the participants were overweight, no criteria/threshold for classifying weight status were reported; and c) this is a pilot study (n=8). We have included this reference in the Introduction section, in support of this sentence (Ln 8687) ‘Studies that have investigated the effects of BFRE on VF have reported heterogenous results, with both beneficial and deleterious [16-18] effects reported for VF’. 25) Ln 583 – “side” should have another word attached – ie “side events” if removing the preposition still doesn’t make sense. Author response: We have removed the term ‘side’ and the sentence now reads as ‘Whereas in Hughes et al (2017)’s review of BFRE [3] and our review, 50% and 69% of studies (respectively) made no mention of adverse events’. 26) Ln 610 – The article (Patterson, 2019) is now not referred to as a position stand, so this should be reflected in the manuscript; along with spacing between “tolerability” and “and” Author response: The reference is now referred to as a recent review of BFRE methodology, application and safety. We have also adjusted the spacing between the words ‘tolerability’ and ‘and’.
paper_title_zh: "血流限制运动训练对成人血管功能的影响：系统综述与荟萃分析 Elisio A Pereira-Neto"
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。血流限制性运动（BFRE）能改善体能，理论上对血管功能有积极影响。本系统综述和荟萃分析旨在报告1）BFRE对有或无慢性健康问题的成年人血管功能的影响，以及2）BFRE报告的不良事件和依从性。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2对作者的评论

本文作者对BFRE对血管结构和功能的影响以及相关次要结局（依从性/负面副作用）进行了非常全面的系统综述和荟萃分析。作者在本次综述中数据合成的水平以及表格/图表中的清晰报告值得称赞。

1) 第162-3行 – Smart等人需要被正确引用
作者回应：此引用现已更正。

2) 第164行 – “研究未根据方法学质量评分被排除。”增加一句话来进一步阐明原因对读者会有帮助。这是为了增加研究纳入以进行荟萃分析吗？
作者回应：我们前瞻性地计划纳入所有符合条件的研究，不论其方法学质量评分。许多研究和指南建议不要根据方法学质量排除研究，因为这会降低精确度并增加荟萃分析结果的偏倚。例如：
23. Stone J, Gurunathan U, Glass K, Munn Z, Tugwell P, Doi SAR. Stratification by quality-induced selection bias in a meta-analysis of clinical trials. J Clin Epidemiol 2019; 107:51–9.
24. Higgins JPT, Altman DG, Gøtzsche PC, Jüni P, Moher D, Oxman AD, et al. The Cochrane Collaboration’s tool for assessing risk of bias in randomised trials. BMJ 2011; 343:1–9.
我们已增加以下澄清句子：“研究未根据方法学质量评分被排除，因为这已被证明会降低荟萃分析结果的精确度并增加偏倚[23,24]。”

3) 第196-7行 – I2需要上标两次
作者回应：已按建议更正。

4) 第216行 – “reported”和“on”之间多了一个空格
作者回应：已按建议更正。

5) 第238行 – “(%)”是什么意思？是否应该有一个数字在%之前？
作者回应：这是一个错误，数字58应该在%之前，因为它表示评估BFRE与另一组对比的研究百分比，相当于26项研究中的15项。我们已将句子修改为“有15项（58%）研究[…]”。

6) 第269行 – “(46%%)”中的额外%需要删除
作者回应：已按建议删除额外%。

7) 第357行 – 图3似乎被错误引用，应该是图2
作者回应：我们已将引用从“图3”更正为“图2”。

8) 第372行 – 图2似乎被错误引用，应该是图3
作者回应：我们已将引用从“图2”更正为“图3”。

9) 第387行 – “meta regression”应为“meta-regression”或使用一致的术语
作者回应：已将“meta regression”一词在整个手稿中统一更改为“meta-regression”。 10) 第427-429行——“一项研究报告称，一名参与者在开始BFRE时出现了腿部麻木的初始感觉，这种感觉在运动开始后第一分钟内并未持续[39]（16名高血压老年女性中有2人）。”——建议将措辞改为两名参与者，因为该研究报告了16名参与者中的两起不良事件，而不仅仅是一名参与者。作者回应：我们已将信息更正为两名参与者而非一名。该行现在措辞为‘一项研究报告称，两名参与者在开始BFRE后出现了腿部麻木的初始感觉[…]’。11) 第452行——“favored”和“dynamic”之间多了一个空格。作者回应：我们已按建议删除了多余的空格。12) 第466行——删除“both”前的“the”。作者回应：我们已按建议删除了“the”一词。13) 第485行——句末需要加句号。作者回应：我们已按建议在句末加上了句号。14) 第504行——“40] and”之间需要空格。作者回应：我们已按建议加上了空格。15) 第506行——Wilvebrand拼写错误。作者回应：我们已将拼写更正为Willebrand。16) 第514-524行——我赞赏这一部分在指出文献中的重大局限性以及这在你们分析中的反映。作者回应：无需修改。17) 第534行——Principals应改为principles。作者回应：我们已将用词从‘principals’更正为‘principles’。18) paper_title: Autophagy and airway fibrosis: Is there a link?
paper_abstract: In the past decade, an emerging process named “autophagy” has generated intense interest in many chronic lung diseases. Tissue remodeling and fibrosis is a common feature of many airway diseases, and current therapies do not prevent or reverse these structural changes. Autophagy has evolved as a conserved process for bulk degradation and recycling of cytoplasmic components to maintain basal cellular homeostasis and healthy organelle populations in the cell. Furthermore, autophagy serves as a cell survival mechanism and can also be induced by chemical and physical stress to the cell. Accumulating evidence demonstrates that autophagy plays an essential role in vital cellular processes, including tissue remodeling. This review will discuss some of the recent advancements made in understanding the role of this fundamental process in airway fibrosis with emphasis on airway remodeling, and how autophagy can be exploited as a target for airway remodeling in asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease.
review_content:
Summary:

This review clearly demonstrates the need for more studies investigating the role of autophagy in respiratory disease. It is good that the authors added some unpublished data into the review article as support of evidence.


Major comments:
 1. Figure 2 can be improved. Eg: at the arrow between Autophagy and Cell Growth/ECM release, the authors can add the words increase energy resource so the readers understand the association between Autophagy and Cell Growth/ECM release. Authors should consider adding ‘Genetics’ into the figure. The authors could add ‘circadian rhythm’ into the figure with a ‘?’ to show that it is a factor for further investigation.
 2. For the collectively structural changes of airway remodeling, please include smooth muscle hyperplasia (James et al. 2012; Am J Respir Crit Care Med).
 3. In the autophagy and fibrotic airway remodelling section, the paragraphs could be rearranged. Eg do not split TGFb1 between the paragraphs. The section about circadian rhythm seems to be a better fit in the Therapeutic strategies: Novel autophagy modulators section, as it is something to further evaluate as a potential target.
 4. Are there any genetic component as evidence of autophagy in COPD? For example: Chen et al. 2015; J Formos Med Assoc.
 5. Should have a reference for the sentence regarding TGFb1 leads to accumulation of ECM. ECM could be abbreviate earlier in the article.
paper_title_zh: 自噬与气道纤维化：是否存在关联？
paper_abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，一种名为“自噬”的新兴过程在许多慢性肺部疾病中引起了强烈兴趣。组织重塑和纤维化是许多气道疾病的共同特征，而当前的治疗方法并不能预防或逆转这些结构变化。自噬已经演变为一种保守的过程，用于大量降解和回收细胞质成分，以维持细胞基础稳态和细胞内健康细胞器的数量。此外，自噬作为一种细胞生存机制，也可以由化学和物理应激诱导。越来越多的证据表明，自噬在重要的细胞过程中发挥着关键作用，包括组织重塑。本综述将讨论一些在理解这一基本过程在气道纤维化中的作用方面的最新进展，重点讨论气道重塑，以及如何将自噬作为哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺疾病中气道重塑的靶点。
review_content_zh:

本综述清楚地表明了需要更多研究来探讨自噬在呼吸系统疾病中的作用。值得肯定的是，作者将一些未发表的数据纳入综述文章中，作为证据支持。

paper_title: Machine learning algorithms: their applications in plant omics and agronomic traits’ improvement
paper_abstract: Agronomic traits of plants especially those of economic or aesthetic importance are threatened by climatic and environmental factors such as climate change, biotic, and abiotic stresses. These threats are now being mitigated through the analyses of omics data like genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and phenomics. The emergence of high-throughput omics technology has led to an avalanche of plant omics data. Plant research demands novel analytical paradigms to extract and harness large plant omics data for plant improvement effectively and efficiently. Machine learning algorithms are well-suited analytical and computational approaches for the integrative analysis of large unstructured, heterogeneous datasets. This study presents an overview of omics approaches to improve plant agronomic traits and crucial curated plant genomic data sources. Furthermore, we summarize machine learning algorithms and software tools/programming packages used in plant omics research. Lastly, we discuss advancements in machine learning algorithms' applications in improving agronomic traits of economically important plants. Extensive application of machine learning would advance plant omics studies. These advancements would consequently help agricultural scientists improve economically important plants’ quality, yield, and tolerance against abiotic and biotic stresses and other plant health-threatening issues.
review_content:
A variety of reviews on omics data analysis and machine learning (ML) in the fields of plant science and plant breeding have recently been published. It is unclear where exactly this manuscript positions itself with respect to these existing reviews. In particular, the title seems to indicate a strong focus on ML; however, the introduction makes clear that there is a broader view, including review on data sources, “bioinformatics software, tools and packages”, in addition to reviewing the application of ML. This seems like a very broad topic to review, and maybe as a result, various sections of the manuscript are not satisfactory in my opinion:
 1. The description of genomic information in 1.1. seems limited as well as somewhat confusing (“cis-elements, gene expression data, protein interactome, transcriptional and post-transcriptional data“). How can protein interactome be described as “genomic information”?
 2. On the other hand, how about e.g. DNA methylation, histone modifications, transcription factor binding sites etc?
 3. Similarly, the information in Table 1 seems unorganized as well as incomplete. It would help to provide some sub-division with headers of subsections; moreover, it is unclear what criteria are used to include/exclude databases. E.g. what about https://bar.utoronto.ca/thalemine/begin.do, http://plantismash.secondarymetabolites.org/, http://cisbp.ccbr.utoronto.ca/, protein interaction databases, the jaspar database, and various others. Also note that when I tested urls from the table, not all seemed reachable (e.g. chromdb.org, http://mips.gsf.de/).
 4. Sometimes very arbitrary examples are chosen to refer to; e.g. for QTL mapping ref 41 – why would that one specifically be relevant, there would be numerous other QTL mapping studies that could be mentioned?
 5. Figure 2, does not add much compared to figure 1 – it could well be removed or provided as a (SI) table
 6. Some sections in the part on ML are quite disappointing. For example, Table 2 is very brief – there are definitely more examples of ML tools for plant omics data analysis and in fact even some tools mentioned in the manuscript itself (e.g. apoplastp) are not mentioned in the table.
 7. The explanation on ML in section 3.1 is not always to the point. E.g. the sentence “Machine learning algorithms are generally classified into the following categories; supervised, semi-supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement, and deep learning” suggests that deep learning is an alternative type of ML compared to supervised, semi-supervised learning etc, which is not correct. Also the statement “Unsupervised learning is a learning approach focused on statistics…” is unclear. Similarly, Reinforcement Learning is not well explained.
 8. Some of the examples mentioned in the text on ML are also not to the point. For example, ref 93 seems like a randomly chosen example of genomic prediction – there would be many studies that could be mentioned, why would this one be mentioned specifically as ML? Similarly for ref 67, this seems just like a straightforward analysis of omics data – it is again not clear why this is ML?
 9. Relevant other examples of application of ML are missing, including e.g. https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.1814551116, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25893-w, https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/tpj.13979
10. Various statements in the text are not clear (sometimes too strong worded), e.g.:
  * In the abstract “These threats are now being mitigated through the analyses of omics data like genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, and phenomics. “ – I don’t think threats are mitigated by data analysis itself.
  * Section 2.1 “Genome sequence availability has paved the way for identifying all genes and genetic variants associated with agronomics traits” – that seems too simple, just having genome sequence does not mean we known which genes/variatns are associated with traits of interest
  * Section 3.6: “Finally, a comprehensive plant database must be constructed to facilitate comparative studies” – not clear what this would mean and why this has to be done.
paper_title_zh: 机器学习算法：在植物组学和农艺性状改良中的应用
paper_abstract_zh: 植物的农艺性状，尤其是那些具有经济或美学重要性的性状，正受到气候变化、生物和非生物胁迫等气候和环境因素的影响。这些威胁目前正在通过基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和表型组学等组学数据的分析来缓解。高通量组学技术的出现导致了植物组学数据的激增。植物研究需要新颖的分析范式，以高效且有效地提取和利用大量植物组学数据，用于植物改良。机器学习算法非常适合于对大型非结构化、异质数据集进行综合分析和计算。本研究概述了用于改善植物农艺性状的组学方法以及关键的精选植物基因组数据来源。此外，我们总结了在植物组学研究中所使用的机器学习算法和软件工具/编程包。最后，我们讨论了机器学习算法在改善经济重要植物农艺性状方面的应用进展。广泛应用机器学习将推进植物组学研究。这些进展将有助于农业科学家改善经济重要植物的质量、产量以及对非生物和生物胁迫及其他植物健康威胁问题的耐受性。
review_content_zh:
近期发表了许多关于植物科学和植物育种领域中组学数据分析与机器学习（ML）的综述。尚不清楚该手稿相对于这些现有综述的具体定位。特别是，标题似乎表明对ML有强烈关注；然而，引言中明确指出，其视角更为广泛，包括对数据来源、“生物信息学软件、工具和包”的综述，以及对ML应用的回顾。这似乎是一个极为广泛的主题，或许因此，手稿的多个部分在我看来并不令人满意：
1. 1.1节中对基因组信息的描述似乎有限且有些混淆（“顺式元件、基因表达数据、蛋白质互作组、转录和转录后数据”）。蛋白质互作组如何被描述为“基因组信息”？
2. 另一方面，例如DNA甲基化、组蛋白修饰、转录因子结合位点等如何？
3. 同样，表1中的信息似乎组织不力且不完整。提供带有小节标题的细分会有所帮助；此外，包含/排除数据库的标准不明确。例如，https://bar.utoronto.ca/thalemine/begin.do、http://plantismash.secondarymetabolites.org/、http://cisbp.ccbr.utoronto.ca/、蛋白质互作数据库、jaspar数据库等如何？还需注意，当我测试表中的URL时，并非所有URL均可访问（例如chromdb.org、http://mips.gsf.de/）。
4. 有时选择的例子非常随意，例如QTL映射引用41——为何特别提及这一研究，还有许多其他QTL映射研究可以提及？
5. 图2相较于图1并未增加太多信息——可以删除或作为（SI）表格提供。
6. ML部分的某些章节相当令人失望。例如，表2非常简短——肯定有更多用于植物组学数据分析的ML工具，实际上手稿中提到的某些工具（例如apoplastp）在表中并未提及。
7. 3.1节中对ML的解释并不总是切中要害。例如，“机器学习算法通常分为以下类别：监督学习、半监督学习、无监督学习、强化学习和深度学习”这句话暗示深度学习是与监督学习、半监督学习等并列的ML类型，这是不正确的。此外，“无监督学习是一种专注于统计的学习方法……”这一表述也不清晰。同样，强化学习的解释也不充分。
8. 文中提到的某些ML例子也不切题。例如，引用93似乎是随机选择的一个基因组预测例子——有许多研究可以提及，为何特别提及这一研究作为ML？同样，引用67似乎只是一个直接的组学数据分析——同样不清楚为何这是ML？
9. 缺少相关ML应用的其他例子，包括例如https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.1814551116、https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-021-25893-w、https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/full/10.1111/tpj.13979。
10. 文中的某些陈述不清晰（有时措辞过于强烈），例如：
   * 摘要中“这些威胁正通过基因组学、转录组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学和表型组学等组学数据的分析得到缓解。”——我认为威胁并非通过数据分析本身得到缓解。
   * 2.1节“基因组序列的可用性为识别与农艺性状相关的所有基因和遗传变异铺平了道路”——这似乎过于简单，仅拥有基因组序列并不意味着我们了解哪些基因/变异与感兴趣性状相关。

paper_title: Latest developments and scope of Health Technology Assessment in India: Tapping into the future
paper_abstract:
Health Technology Assessment (HTA) is a multifaceted approach for informing policy by considering social, medical, economic and ethical aspects in a systematic and transparent manner . HTA is an important tool for decision-making, priority-setting and for resource allocation, leading to Universal Health Coverage (UHC). The importance of HTA becomes more pronounced in developing countries such as India. In this review, we have summarised the status and future scope of HTA in India after referring to the scientific literature available in the form of journal articles and government reports. 
HTA supports prioritisation of healthcare services to be included in UHC and the provision of affordable and quality healthcare services in India. India established ‘HTA in India’ (HTAIn) in January 2017 as a starting point in HTA activities and this centre conducts HTA studies of various methodologies upon receiving requests from the different central and state departments. HTA in India is a relatively new concept and the processes are not streamlined compared to countries where HTA is established. Although an HTA manual is present for guiding the HTA process in India, there is lack of clarity on the HTA information considered for translating evidence into policy or practice. Additionally, there is a dearth of individual capacity to undertake high quality HTA in the country.   HTAIn initiative showcases India’s political commitment towards achieving UHC and for HTA. However, there is an imminent need to expand the role of the technical partners and regional resource hubs in capacity building in HTA by involving the private sector in HTA processes.
review_content:
This paper is a narrative review looking at the status of HTA in India. It draws on existing English language literature (published and grey) to document the importance of HTA for India, the structure of HTAIn (the government funded body responsible for HTA at the national level), the studies conducted and the challenges faced for a successful HTA programme.

I suggest that the methods for the narrative review are provided in more detail and some restructuring of the paper would help strengthen it. Specific suggestions are provided below:

Abstract:
  * Sentence 2: HTA doesn’t “….leading to Universal Health Coverage” per se. Change this to something along the lines of “… in the journey to UHC”.
  * Line3/4 - please add something to explain why it becomes more pronounced; e.g. because the health budget is so constrained.
  * 6th sentence (line 6) – Please explain that this is what HTA in India proposes to do rather than make it a statement of fact.
  * Last line – regional resource hubs needs to be explained for the abstract; perhaps re-phrase this as regional government funded HTA resource centres.

Introduction:
  * 1st para, line 6/7 – please refer to the 13th five year plan (i.e. the current one).
  * 1st para, last line – do we really know that this is true? India has one of the lowest healthcare spends in the world relative to GDP. Optimal utilisation will help but healthcare for all is not necessarily affordable within current spending patterns. I suggest re-phrasing to reflect this.
  * 3rd para line 6 – your objective is to carry out a narrative review to summarise the status of HTA in India. Can you expand on what you mean by status e.g. institutional development; capacity development; methods development; research produced; decisions made?
Resources for the review (should this be called Methods?):
  * You provide a very brief summary of the literature search methods. Can you explain your methods in more detail? What search terms did you use – what concepts were you looking for in this search? And what time period did you cover? Did you also rely on expert advice/prior knowledge/ reference lists of papers identified? And finally, what information/topics did you look for in your review of the literature. Did you have any exclusion criteria (eg. Non English language). It would also be useful to state what a narrative review is (as opposed to a systematic review).
Importance of the Indian healthcare system:
  * 1st para - This section is good background but does not really tell us about the status of HTA in India. I recommend shifting this to the background.
  * 2nd para – this seems to be a summary of the reasons/ rationale/proposals behind the introduction of HTA in India and the plans for it as laid out at the start. Please explain that this is the case. In addition, do you have a source for figure 1 or was this developed by the author team; please can you also explain if these are proposed users and producers or current users and producers.
Administrative structure of HTAIn:
  * 1st para – Please add the sources for all these statements.
  * 2nd para, last sentence – please add a summary sentence relating to the functions of each of these bodies.

Methods used for conducting HTAs:
  * This section provides an overview of the procedural steps for the conducting HTA but does not provide detail on the actual methods followed; some discussion of the HTAIn reference case for Economic evaluation would be a useful reference here and some discussion of the non-economic aspects of HTA and whether these are included in the processes.

HTA analysis studies conducted:
  * Please can you give some detail on what topics have been covered in the policy documents? It is not clear why the review focuses in on the results of two studies. It would be more useful to map out the topic areas covered across the HTAIn policy documents as well as these two studies; also there are some systematic reviews of economic evaluation in India which would help make this section complete (https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26449485/; https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8525785/).1,2 Is there any documentary evidence of the analysis results being taken up in decision-making? Also, can you add some reflections on how topics have been chosen and why?
  * Your discussion makes some strong points. Perhaps this section should be titled: Current challenges to HTA in India
paper_title_zh: 印度健康技术评估的最新进展与范围：探索未来
paper_abstract_zh:
健康技术评估（HTA）是一种多方面的方法，通过系统化和透明化的方式考虑社会、医疗、经济和伦理方面来为政策提供信息。HTA是决策、优先级设定和资源分配的重要工具，有助于实现全民健康覆盖（UHC）。在印度等发展中国家，HTA的重要性更为突出。在这篇综述中，我们参考了期刊文章和政府报告等科学文献，总结了HTA在印度的现状和未来前景。

HTA支持优先考虑纳入UHC的医疗服务，并在印度提供负担得起且高质量的医疗服务。印度于2017年1月成立了“印度HTA”（HTAIn），作为HTA活动的起点，该中心在接到中央和各州部门的不同请求后，进行各种方法学的HTA研究。HTA在印度是一个相对较新的概念，其流程与已建立HTA的国家相比尚未规范化。尽管印度有一本HTA手册用于指导HTA流程，但对于将证据转化为政策或实践所考虑的HTA信息缺乏明确性。此外，该国缺乏进行高质量HTA的个体能力。

HTAIn倡议展示了印度在实现UHC和HTA方面的政治承诺。然而，迫切需要通过将私营部门纳入HTA流程，扩大技术合作伙伴和区域资源中心在HTA能力建设中的作用。
review_content_zh:
本文是一篇叙述性综述，探讨了印度卫生技术评估（HTA）的现状。它基于现有的英文文献（已发表和灰色文献），记录了HTA对印度的重要性、HTAIn（负责国家级HTA的政府资助机构）的结构、所进行的研究以及成功实施HTA项目所面临的挑战。

我建议提供更详细的叙述性综述方法，并对论文进行一些结构调整以增强其力度。具体建议如下：

摘要：
  * 第二句：HTA并非“……导致全民健康覆盖”。应改为“……在实现UHC的旅程中”。
  * 第三/四行：请添加解释为何变得更加显著的内容，例如因为卫生预算非常有限。
  * 第六句（第六行）：请解释这是印度HTA的提议，而不是将其作为事实陈述。
  * 最后一行：需要对摘要中的区域资源中心进行解释；或许可以重新表述为区域政府资助的HTA资源中心。

引言：
  * 第一段，第六/七行：请参考当前的“十三五”规划。
  * 第一段，最后一行：我们真的知道这是真的吗？相对于GDP，印度是世界上卫生支出最低的国家之一。优化利用会有所帮助，但在当前支出模式下，全民医疗并不一定负担得起。我建议重新表述以反映这一点。
  * 第三段，第六行：你的目标是进行叙述性综述，总结印度HTA的现状。你能扩展一下你所指的现状吗？例如机构发展、能力发展、方法发展、研究成果、决策制定。

综述资源（这部分应该称为方法吗？）：
  * 你提供了非常简短的文献检索方法摘要。你能更详细地解释你的方法吗？你使用了哪些搜索术语——你在这次搜索中寻找哪些概念？你覆盖了哪个时间段？你是否还依赖专家建议/先前知识/已识别论文的参考文献列表？最后，你在文献综述中寻找哪些信息/主题？你有任何排除标准吗（例如非英语文献）？此外，说明叙述性综述是什么（与系统性综述相对）也会很有用。

印度卫生系统的重要性：
  * 第一段：这部分是很好的背景，但并没有真正告诉我们印度HTA的现状。我建议将其移至背景部分。
  * 第二段：这似乎是对引入HTA背后的原因/依据/提议以及最初计划的总结。请解释情况确实如此。此外，图1的来源是什么，是作者团队开发的吗？请解释这些是拟议的用户和生产者还是当前的用户和生产者。

HTAIn的行政结构：
  * 第一段：请为所有这些陈述添加来源。
  * 第二段，最后一句：请添加一句总结句，说明这些机构的职能。

进行HTA的方法：
  * 这部分提供了进行HTA的程序步骤概述，但没有提供实际遵循方法的细节；在此处引用HTAIn的经济评估参考案例会很有用，并讨论HTA的非经济方面以及这些是否包含在流程中。

进行的HTA分析研究：
  * 请详细说明政策文件中涵盖了哪些主题？不清楚为何综述仅关注两项研究的结果。更有用的是概述HTAIn政策文件以及这两项研究涵盖的主题领域；还有一些关于印度经济评估的系统性综述，这将有助于完善本部分（https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/26449485/；https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC8525785/）。1,2 是否有文献证据表明分析结果被纳入决策？此外，你能添加一些关于如何选择主题以及为何选择这些主题的反思吗？
  * 你的讨论提出了一些有力的观点。或许这部分应标题为：印度HTA当前面临的挑战。

paper_title: Open peer review at four STEM journals: an observational overview
paper_abstract: Open peer review, peer review where authors' and reviewers' identities are disclosed to one another, is a growing trend in scholarly publishing. Through observation of four journals in STEM disciplines, PLOS One , Atmospheric Chemistry & Physics , PeerJ , and F1000Research , an observational overview is conducted. The overview relies on defined characteristics of open peer review. Results show that despite differing open peer review implementations, each journal retains editorial involvement in scholarly publishing. Further, the analysis shows that only one of these implementations is fully transparent in its peer review and decision making process. Finally, the overview contends that journals should clearly outline peer review and editorial processes in order to allow for open peer review to be better understood and adopted by authors, reviewers, editors, and readers of science communications.
review_content:
Thanks to the author for an interesting perspective article on open peer review. Following an invitation to review this article, I would like to request a couple of specific corrections and add a general comment and suggestion.
 1. Correction of Erroneous Statement: "Although ACP views its peer review process as completely transparent (Pöschl, 2004), it is not."

    Neither the cited reference nor the ACP journal web pages claim that the peer review process of ACP would be "completely transparent". There are good reasons to maintain an option for referees to remain anonymous, and this is also very clearly specified on the journal web pages as well as in the referenced article and in a more comprehensive review article (Pöschl, 2012 as referenced and linked below). Thus, it would indeed be wrong to claim “complete transparency” for the open peer review process for ACP, but it is also wrong to insinuate that ACP or the cited article would have raised this claim. Please discard or correct the erroneous statement accordingly. Moreover, please complement or replace the reference to Pöschl 2004 by a reference to Pöschl 2012, because the latter is more comprehensive and up-to.date:

    Pöschl U (2012) Multi-stage open peer review: scientific evaluation integrating the strengths of traditional peer review with the virtues of transparency and self-regulation. Front. Comput. Neurosci. 6:33. doi: 10.3389/fncom.2012.00033
    http://journal.frontiersin.org/article/10.3389/fncom.2012.00033/abstract
 2. Correction of Erroneous Statement: “It could be argued that synchronous review occurs, yet ACP does not consider papers posted at ACPD to be “published.” Because these papers are not considered published, their review is not synchronous.”

    Neither the ACP journal web pages nor the articles providing an authoritative description of the ACP open peer review (Pöschl, 2004 & 2012) have ever indicated that the papers posted in the ACP discussion forum, ACPD, would not be “published”. Well on the contrary, all relevant journal web pages emphasize explicitly that the discussion papers posted and reviewed/discussed in ACPD are publications with permanent public accessibility, archiving and citability. Also my articles explaining the concepts of interactive open access publishing and multi-stage open peer review (Pöschl, 2004 and 2014) specify and emphasize that the discussion papers published in ACPD - as well as in the fifteen interactive open access sister journals of the European Geosciences Union (EGU) - are indeed publications. Thus, it is inappropriate to insinuate the opposite. Please discard or correct the erroneous statement accordingly.
    http://www.egu.eu/about/statements/position-statement-on-the-status-of-discussion-papers-published-in-egu-interactive-open-access-journals/
    http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/general_information/publication_policy.html
    http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/review/review_process_and_interactive_public_discussion.html
    http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/general_information/faq.html
    http://www.ingentaconnect.com/content/alpsp/lp/2004/00000017/00000002/art00005
    http://journal.frontiersin.org/article/10.3389/fncom.2012.00033/abstract
 3. General Comment and Suggestion:

    I understand and respect that the author prefers a fully transparent form of open peer review as implemented by F1000Research. However, F1000Research is a relatively recent follow-up on a series of earlier initiatives that have been pursuing open peer review and are reaching back into the last century. For example, see the British Medical Journal (BMJ), the Electronic Transactions on Artificial Intelligence (ETAI), the Journal of Interactive Media in Education (JIME) and other journals with open peer review as referenced in the recent “research topic” (special issue) on open evaluation (including open peer review) in the open access journal Frontiers in Computational Neuroscience:

    http://journal.frontiersin.org/researchtopic/137

    As detailed in my contribution to that collection of articles (Pöschl 2012) and confirmed by independent studies referenced/linked below, ACP and its sister journals are by most standards of scientific publishing more successful and more efficient than comparable journals with traditional or alternative forms of peer review:

    http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/pr_acp_is_interactive_open_access_publishing_able_to_identify_high_impact_submissions.pdf

    http://www.biomedcentral.com/1471-2288/13/74

    Overall, I see no well-founded basis for the claim that the particular form open peer review practiced by F1000Research would deserve the attribute “gold standard of open peer review”, and I would suggest to substantiate or drop this postulate.
paper_title_zh: 四份STEM期刊的开放同行评审：观察性概述
paper_abstract_zh: 公开同行评审，即作者和评审者彼此公开身份的同行评审，是学术出版中日益增长的趋势。通过对四个STEM学科期刊——PLOS One、Atmospheric Chemistry & Physics、PeerJ和F1000Research的观察，进行了一项观察性概述。该概述依赖于公开同行评审的明确定义特征。结果显示，尽管各期刊的公开同行评审实施方式不同，但每个期刊在学术出版中都保留了编辑参与。此外，分析表明，这些实施方式中只有一种在其同行评审和决策过程中是完全透明的。最后，概述认为，期刊应明确概述同行评审和编辑流程，以便作者、评审者、编辑和科学传播的读者更好地理解和采纳公开同行评审。
review_content_zh:
感谢作者撰写了一篇关于开放同行评审的有趣视角文章。在受邀评审这篇文章后，我想请求对几个具体错误进行更正，并添加一条一般性评论和建议。

1. 错误陈述的更正：“尽管ACP认为其同行评审过程是完全透明的（Pöschl，2004），但实际上并非如此。”

引用的参考文献和ACP期刊网页均未声称ACP的同行评审过程是“完全透明的”。有充分的理由保留审稿人保持匿名的选项，这一点在期刊网页以及引用的文章和一篇更全面的综述文章（Pöschl，2012，见下文引用及链接）中均有明确说明。因此，确实不应声称ACP的开放同行评审过程具有“完全透明性”，但暗示ACP或引用的文章提出了这一主张也是错误的。请相应地删除或更正这一错误陈述。此外，请补充或替换对Pöschl 2004的引用，改为引用Pöschl 2012，因为后者更为全面和最新：

Pöschl U (2012) 多阶段开放同行评审：整合传统同行评审优势与透明度和自我调节美德的科学评估。Front. Comput. Neurosci. 6:33. doi: 10.3389/fncom.2012.00033
http://journal.frontiersin.org/article/10.3389/fncom.2012.00033/abstract

2. 错误陈述的更正：“可以认为同步评审是存在的，但ACP并不认为在ACPD上发表的论文是‘已发表’的。因为这些论文不被视为已发表，所以它们的评审不是同步的。”

无论是ACP期刊网页还是提供ACP开放同行评审权威描述的文章（Pöschl，2004 & 2012）均未指出在ACP讨论论坛ACPD上发表的论文不是“已发表”的。恰恰相反，所有相关的期刊网页都明确强调，在ACPD上发表和评审/讨论的讨论论文是具有永久公开访问性、存档和可引用性的出版物。我的文章解释了互动开放获取出版和多阶段开放同行评审的概念（Pöschl，2004和2014），明确并强调在ACPD——以及欧洲地球科学联盟（EGU）的十五个互动开放获取姊妹期刊——上发表的讨论论文确实是出版物。因此，暗示相反的情况是不恰当的。请相应地删除或更正这一错误陈述。
http://www.egu.eu/about/statements/position-statement-on-the-status-of-discussion-papers-published-in-egu-interactive-open-access-journals/
http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/general_information/publication_policy.html
http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/review/review_process_and_interactive_public_discussion.html
http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/general_information/faq.html
http://www.ingentaconnect.com/content/alpsp/lp/2004/00000017/00000002/art00005
http://journal.frontiersin.org/article/10.3389/fncom.2012.00033/abstract

3. 一般性评论和建议：

我理解并尊重作者偏好F1000Research所实施的完全透明的开放同行评审形式。然而，F1000Research是相对较新的后续举措，之前已有一系列早期倡议追求开放同行评审，并可追溯到上世纪。例如，参见英国医学杂志（BMJ）、人工智能电子交易（ETAI）、教育互动媒体杂志（JIME）以及其他实施开放同行评审的期刊，如近期在开放获取期刊《计算神经科学前沿》的“研究主题”（特刊）中关于开放评估（包括开放同行评审）的引用：

http://journal.frontiersin.org/researchtopic/137

正如我在该文章集的贡献中所详述的（Pöschl 2012），并经独立研究确认/链接如下，ACP及其姊妹期刊在大多数科学出版标准上比采用传统或替代同行评审形式的类似期刊更为成功和高效：

http://www.atmospheric-chemistry-and-physics.net/pr_acp_is_interactive_open_access_publishing_able_to_identify_high_impact_submissions.pdf

http://www.biomedcentral.com/1471-2288/13/74

总体而言，我认为没有充分依据声称F1000Research所实践的特定形式的开放同行评审应被赋予“开放同行评审的黄金标准”这一属性，我建议对这一假设进行论证或放弃。

paper_title: Weed science research achievements on maize in Ethiopia: a review
paper_abstract: Recent research into assessing and combatting maize weeds was reviewed based on scientific and working reports from the year 2011 onwards in Ethiopia. This review paper covered two main topics: assessment of major weed types and their impacts, and research results of weed management in the maize cropping system of the country. More than 80 major weed floras dominated by broad leaved weeds were found infesting maize fields in different localities. By competing, toxifying and/or parasitizing maize plants, they reduce the crop germination, growth and productivity. Several experiments indicated that maize yield loss due to uncontrolled weed growth varied from 35 to 87.5%, indicating that weed management is a critical factor for maize production in the country. Hoeing, hand weeding and pre-emergence herbicides application have been the most frequently used weed control practices to minimize the competition effect of weeds. So far, there has been no effective and sustainable individual weed control method for maize fields. Thus, future research should focus on developing integrated weed management that effectively reduce weed infestation and associated impacts, and improve productivity of the crop considering socio-economic condition of a specific maize producing agro-ecology of the country.
review_content:
The article entitled "Weed Science Research Achievements on Maize in Ethiopia: A Review" authored by Negewo et al., offers a comprehensive assessment of weed management in maize production in Ethiopia. The authors emphasized the significance of maize in Ethiopian agriculture, highlighted the primary weed species affecting maize crops, and explored the consequences of these weed infestations on maize production. Furthermore, they delved into various weed management practices and evaluated their effectiveness in controlling weed proliferation. This study provides informative insights into the critical facets of agriculture in Ethiopia.

Some general and specific assessments and recommendations for the author are as follows:

Clarity and Structure: This article maintains a generally sound structure with a lucid introduction and well-defined section headings. However, there is room for improvement in terms of clarity and structure. One suggestion is to introduce more concise and structured summaries or introductions at the outset of each section. This will enable readers to swiftly grasp the key points without requiring a full reading of the section.

Additional Data and Analysis: This article provides a good introduction to the main weed species and their effects on maize. However, it would be useful to include more data and conduct a more detailed analysis. Adding statistics or case studies to support claims would enhance an article's informative value and credibility.

Address Research Gaps and Future Directions: While this article briefly touches upon research gaps and future directions, it is advisable to expound on these aspects. A comprehensive elaboration of the research required to bridge these gaps and its practical implementation would be beneficial.
Visual Aids: Enhancing the article with visual aids such as charts or graphs to depict data and trends related to weed infestations and management practices could make the content more engaging and comprehensible.

Language and Editing: The manuscript would benefit from additional proofreading and editing. Addressing minor grammatical issues and refining awkward sentence structures will enhance readability.

Symbol Definitions: The author should consider including a legend or explanation for the symbols and abbreviations used in the tables, particularly in Tables 2 and 3. This will contribute to the clarity of the data presentation.

Citations and References: It is essential to ensure that all statements and information presented in an article are substantiated by relevant and recent references. Comprehensive and accurate citations are fundamental for establishing the credibility of information.

Bibliographic Research Methodology: A brief description of the bibliographic research methodology employed, including the keywords used and databases targeted, should be included. This will aid readers in understanding how pertinent literature has been gathered.

Comprehensive Citation of Studies: The author should verify that the article thoroughly cites and references all pertinent studies on weed management in corn crops in Ethiopia to ensure the comprehensiveness and academic rigor of the review.

Inclusion of a Summary Table: To align with the article's title, the author is encouraged to incorporate a summary table that offers an overview of diverse studies conducted in Ethiopia concerning weed management in corn. This table should encompass details, such as research objectives, primary findings, key weed species, crop type, study areas, and proper citations for each study.

Recommendations for Agriculture: An imperative addition would be a section within the article outlining recommendations for agricultural practices, based on the findings of the review. Such recommendations would underscore the practical relevance of this review and elucidate its potential contribution to the development of agriculture in Ethiopia.

Incorporating these suggestions will not only enhance the article's quality and completeness but also render it more informative and valuable to its readers.

We hope that the authors find this review report to be helpful.

Best regards,
Dr. Abdellatif Boutagayout
paper_title_zh: 埃塞俄比亚玉米杂草科学研究进展：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 基于2011年以来在埃塞俄比亚的科学和工作报告，回顾了评估和防治玉米杂草的近期研究。这篇综述论文涵盖了两个主要议题：主要杂草类型的评估及其影响，以及该国玉米种植系统中杂草管理的研究结果。在 不同地区，发现超过80种主要杂草植物，以阔叶杂草为主，侵染玉米田。通过竞争、毒害和/或寄生玉米植株，它们降低了作物的发芽、生长和生产力。多项实验表明，由于未控制的杂草生长，玉米产量损失从35%到87.5%不等，这表明杂草管理是该国玉米生产的关键因素。锄草、手工除草和芽前除草剂应用是最常使用的杂草控制措施，以最小化杂草的竞争效应。迄今为止，尚未有针对玉米田的有效且可持续的单一杂草控制方法。因此，未来的研究应侧重于开发综合杂草管理，有效减少杂草侵染及其相关影响，并考虑特定玉米生产农业生态区的社会经济条件，提高作物生产力。
review_content_zh:
标题为“埃塞俄比亚玉米杂草科学研究成就综述”的文章由Negewo等人撰写，对埃塞俄比亚玉米生产中的杂草管理进行了全面评估。作者强调了玉米在埃塞俄比亚农业中的重要性，突出了影响玉米作物的主要杂草种类，并探讨了这些杂草侵染对玉米生产的后果。此外，他们深入研究了各种杂草管理实践，并评估了其在控制杂草蔓延方面的有效性。这项研究为埃塞俄比亚农业的关键方面提供了有见地的信息。

对作者的一些总体和具体评估及建议如下：

清晰度和结构：本文结构总体合理，引言清晰，各部分标题明确。然而，在清晰度和结构方面仍有改进空间。建议在每个部分的开头引入更简洁、更有条理的摘要或引言。这将使读者能够迅速抓住要点，而无需通读整个部分。

额外数据和分析：本文对主要杂草种类及其对玉米的影响进行了良好介绍。然而，增加更多数据并进行更详细的分析将是有益的。添加统计数据或案例研究以支持论点，将提升文章的信息价值和可信度。

填补研究空白和未来方向：虽然本文简要提及了研究空白和未来方向，但建议对这些方面进行详细阐述。全面阐述填补这些空白所需的研究及其实际应用将是有益的。

视觉辅助：通过图表等视觉辅助工具展示与杂草侵染和管理实践相关的数据和趋势，可以使内容更具吸引力和可理解性。

语言和编辑：手稿将受益于额外的校对和编辑。解决轻微的语法问题并改进不自然的句子结构将提升可读性。

符号定义：作者应考虑在表格中，尤其是表2和表3中，包含符号和缩写的图例或解释。这将有助于数据展示的清晰度。

引用和参考文献：确保文章中所有陈述和信息都有相关且最新的参考文献支持是至关重要的。全面且准确的引用是建立信息可信度的根本。

文献研究方法：应包括对所采用的文献研究方法的简要描述，包括使用的关键词和目标数据库。这将帮助读者理解相关文献是如何收集的。

全面引用研究：作者应核实文章是否全面引用和参考了所有关于埃塞俄比亚玉米作物杂草管理的相关研究，以确保综述的全面性和学术严谨性。

包含摘要表格：为了与文章标题相符，建议作者纳入一个摘要表格，概述在埃塞俄比亚进行的关于玉米杂草管理的多样化研究。该表格应包括研究目标、主要发现、关键杂草种类、作物类型、研究区域以及每个研究的适当引用等细节。

农业建议：一个重要的补充是在文章中包含一个基于综述发现的农业实践建议部分。这些建议将强调本综述的实际相关性，并阐明其对埃塞俄比亚农业发展的潜在贡献。

采纳这些建议不仅将提升文章的质量和完整性，也将使其对读者更具信息价值和实用性。

希望作者认为这份评审报告有所帮助。

此致，
Abdellatif Boutagayout博士

paper_title: Enteropathogenic E. coli: breaking the intestinal tight junction barrier
paper_abstract: Enteropathogenic E. coli (EPEC) causes acute intestinal infections in infants in the developing world. Infection typically spreads through contaminated food and water and leads to severe, watery diarrhea. EPEC attaches to the intestinal epithelial cells and directly injects virulence factors which modulate multiple signaling pathways leading to host cell dysfunction. However, the molecular mechanisms that regulate the onset of diarrhea are poorly defined. A major target of EPEC is the host cell tight junction complex which acts as a barrier and regulates the passage of water and solutes through the paracellular space. In this review, we focus on the EPEC effectors that target the epithelial barrier, alter its functions and contribute to leakage through the tight junctions.
review_content: This is an interesting review, and I think it makes a positive review to the current knowledge about the effects of EPEC on the tight junctions. However, it will be interesting to note the observations posted by the first reviewer (Dr. Dudeja).
paper_title_zh: 肠道致病性大肠杆菌：破坏肠道紧密连接屏障
paper_abstract_zh: 肠致病性大肠杆菌（EPEC）在发展中国家引起婴儿急性肠道感染。感染通常通过被污染的食物和水传播，导致严重的水样腹泻。EPEC附着在肠道上皮细胞上，并直接注入毒力因子，这些因子调控多种信号通路，导致宿主细胞功能障碍。然而，调节腹泻发生的分子机制尚不明确。EPEC的主要靶点是宿主细胞的紧密连接复合体，该复合体作为屏障，调控水和溶质通过细胞旁空间的通道。在本综述中，我们重点关注EPEC效应蛋白，这些蛋白靶向上皮屏障，改变其功能，并导致通过紧密连接的泄漏。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇有趣的综述，我认为它对当前关于肠致病性大肠杆菌（EPEC）对紧密连接影响的知识进行了积极的评价。然而，值得注意的是第一位审稿人（Dudeja博士）提出的观察意见。

reasons: This is an interesting review, and I think it makes a positive review to the current knowledge about the effects of EPEC on the tight junctions.

paper_title: Effectiveness of contact tracing apps for SARS-CoV-2: an updated systematic review
paper_abstract:
Objective – To systematically review evidence on effectiveness of contact tracing apps (CTAs) for SARS-CoV-2 on epidemiological and clinical outcomes 
 Design – Update of a systematic review ( https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjopen-2021-050519 ) 
 Data sources - EMBASE (OVID), MEDLINE (PubMed), BioRxiv, and MedRxiv were searched up to June 9 th 2021 
 Study selection – Studies, empirical or model-based, assessing effect of CTAs for SARS-CoV-2 on quarantine rate, reproduction number (R), total number of infections, hospitalization, mortality, and other epidemiologically and clinically relevant outcomes, were eligible for inclusion. 
 Data extraction – Empirical and model-based studies were both critically appraised based on dedicated quality and risk of bias assessment checklists. Data on type of study (i.e., empirical or model-based), sample size, (simulated) time horizon, study population, CTA type (and associated interventions), comparator, and outcomes assessed, were extracted. Key findings were extracted and narratively summarized. Specifically for model-based studies, characteristics and values of important model parameters were collected. 
 Results – 5123 studies were identified, of which 27 studies (five empirical, 22 model-based studies) were eligible and included in this review. All empirical studies were observational (non-randomized) studies and either at unclear or high risk of bias, mostly due to uncontrolled confounding. Risk of bias of model-based studies was considered high for 7 of 22 studies. Most studies demonstrated beneficial effects of CTAs on R, total number of infections, hospitalization, and mortality. Effect size was dependent on other model parameter values (e.g., proportion of asymptomatic individuals, testing delays), but in general a beneficial effect was observed at CTA adoption rates of 20% and over. 
 Conclusions – CTAs are potentially effective at reducing SARS-CoV-2 related epidemiological and clinical outcomes, though effect size depends on other model parameter values. Methodologically sound comparative empirical studies on effectiveness of CTAs are lacking and would be desirable to confirm findings from model-based studies.
review_content:
I want to thank the authors for their article and work, which collates some of the literature on digital contact tracing during COVID-19. The article and tables could be a good starting point for colleagues for further reading.

The article doesn’t however provide much critical evaluation of the possible reasons for the large discrepancies between estimates for DPT effectiveness between studies, and more specifically, the reasons why empirical evaluations of DPT were so much less favourable than many of the modelling studies. For example, Menges et al 2021 (cited in the text) estimated that DPT could increase the number of detected cases only by a few percentages even with decent uptake. I don’t however think this is absolutely required for this work to be of use to the scientific community, and do support publication in f1000 research with some minor revisions.

Some specific comments in sections in the text that could be of interest to the authors to have another look at:
  * “Research that has not yet undergone peer-review is often published by authors through so-called preprint databases. However, identifying these articles, extracting data, and drawing conclusions can be a challenge, as this requires knowledge on epidemiology, mathematical modelling, systematically appraising evidence, and summarizing that evidence.” While I agree that some or all of this background is required for critical appraisal, this applies to peer-reviewed research as well as other data sources, so I’d leave out the specific reference to preprint manuscripts.
  * “Forward tracing CTAs can only detect the ‘offspring’, i.e., individuals the index case has infected, of an infected individual. Bidirectional tracing CTAs also detect the ‘parents’, i.e., the individual that infected the index case of an infected individual. Models were considered to use bidirectional (as opposed to forward) tracing when, after the index case is detected and registered, all contacts within a period of at least the incubation time are identified, such that the parent of the index case could be found.” I would advise to specify that forward contact tracing to detect the offspring, while bidirectional contact tracing to also identify the parent (and subsequently sibling) cases, as the direction of transmission is not known during contact tracing.
  * “Within 8 months, cumulative incidence of SARS-CoV-2 can be reduced to 13-24% at CTA adoption of 27%, 17-35% at CTA adoption of 40%, 36-59% at CTA adoption of 61%, and 47-76% at CTA adoption of 80%.” I think you mean “can be reduced ”?
  * “1 in 10.9 persons who uploaded a code in the CTA tested positive for SARS-CoV-2”. Actually, Menges et al report that “For every 10.9 (95% SI, 7.6-15.6) upload authorization codes entered in the app, 1 contact had positive test results for SARS-CoV-2 after app notification.” While the first statement seems to point at test positivity rate, which cannot be correct because only infected individuals can upload a code, the second states that for every 10.9 individuals, a single infected contact is detected (which is not a lot in the context of COVID-19’s R0).
  * “and f is the combination of other factors that affect effectiveness of notification by the CTA. Such factors include, but are not limited to, delay between CTA notification and testing, delay between testing and test result, delay between reception of test result and entry of that result in the CTA, compliance to interventions (e.g.,self quarantine), and the proportion of infections that occur pre-or asymptomatically.” I realise that this is not an exhaustive list, and thus leave it to the authors to consider my suggestion, but I’d advise to either evaluate in these studies, or at least discuss the limitations of the accuracy with which these apps are able to detect exposure events using BLE SSRI. But again I leave it to the authors to integrate this point or not.

    Examples of studies that looked at this:

    Ballouz, T. et al. Individual-Level Evaluation of the Exposure Notification Cascade in the SwissCovid Digital Proximity Tracing App: Observational Study. JMIR Public Health Surveill 8, (2022);

    Vogt, F., Haire, B., Selvey, L., Katelaris, A. L. & Kaldor, J. Effectiveness evaluation of digital contact tracing for COVID-19 in New South Wales, Australia. Lancet Public Health 7, e250–e258 (2022).;

    Leith, D. J. & Farrell, S. Measurement-based evaluation of Google/Apple Exposure Notification API for proximity detection in a light-rail tram. PLoS One 15, e0239943 (2020).
  * “the results of the empirical studies were in accordance with the (in general high quality) included model-based studies assessing effectiveness of CTAs.” Actually, I think empirical studies (especially the individual bases studies from Zurich: https://publichealth.jmir.org/2021/12/e30004, https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2779376, https://smw.ch/index.php/smw/article/view/2931/4822, but also https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lanpub/article/PIIS2468-2667(22)00010-X/fulltext) are not in accordance with the generally very positive evaluations in modelling studies.
  * “Although this seems trivial’. While it is understandable to set a cutoff for study inclusion, I would leave out the trivial comment, since including more recent literature could have provided a more complete picture.
I would like to thank the authors again for the work that went into this article, and the editors for inviting me to review.
paper_title_zh: "SARS-CoV-2接触者追踪应用程序的有效性：一项更新的系统综述"
paper_abstract_zh:
**目的**——系统回顾接触者追踪应用（CTAs）对SARS-CoV-2流行病学和临床结局有效性的证据。

**设计**——对一项系统回顾的更新（https://doi.org/10.1136/bmjopen-2021-050519）。

**数据来源**——检索了截至2021年6月9日的EMBASE（OVID）、MEDLINE（PubMed）、BioRxiv和MedRxiv数据库。

**研究选择**——纳入评估CTAs对SARS-CoV-2的隔离率、再生数（R）、总感染人数、住院率、死亡率以及其他流行病学和临床相关结局影响的实证或基于模型的研究。

**数据提取**——基于专用的质量和偏倚风险评估清单，对实证和基于模型的研究进行批判性评估。提取了研究类型（即实证或基于模型）、样本量、（模拟）时间范围、研究人群、CTA类型（及相关干预措施）、比较组和评估的结局数据。提取并叙述性总结了关键发现。特别是对于基于模型的研究，收集了重要模型参数的特征和值。

**结果**——共识别5123项研究，其中27项研究（5项实证研究，22项基于模型的研究）符合条件并纳入本回顾。所有实证研究均为观察性（非随机）研究，且大多因未控制的混杂因素而存在不明确或高偏倚风险。22项基于模型的研究中有7项被认为偏倚风险高。大多数研究表明CTAs对R、总感染人数、住院率和死亡率有有益影响。效应大小取决于其他模型参数值（例如，无症状个体比例、检测延迟），但总体而言，在CTA采用率达到20%及以上时观察到有益效应。

**结论**——CTAs在减少SARS-CoV-2相关的流行病学和临床结局方面具有潜在有效性，尽管效应大小取决于其他模型参数值。缺乏方法学上严谨的关于CTAs有效性的比较实证研究，此类研究对于确认基于模型研究的发现是可取的。
review_content_zh:
我要感谢作者们的文章和所做的工作，该文章汇总了有关COVID-19期间数字接触追踪的一些文献。文章和表格可以为同事们进一步阅读提供一个良好的起点。

然而，文章并未对研究之间DPT（数字接触追踪）有效性估计存在巨大差异的可能原因进行太多批判性评估，更具体地说，实证评估DPT的结果为何远不如许多建模研究那么乐观。例如，Menges等人2021年（文中引用）估计，即使DPT的接受度不错，也只能将检测到的病例数增加几个百分点。不过，我认为这并不是这项工作对科学社区有用的绝对必要条件，并且支持在f1000研究上发表，只需进行一些小修订。

以下是一些文本中可能值得作者再次审视的具体评论：
* “尚未经过同行评审的研究通常由作者通过所谓的预印本数据库发表。然而，识别这些文章、提取数据并得出结论可能是一个挑战，因为这需要流行病学、数学建模、系统评估证据以及总结证据的知识。”虽然我同意进行批判性评估需要部分或全部这些背景知识，但这同样适用于经过同行评审的研究以及其他数据来源，因此我会省略对预印本手稿的具体引用。
* “前向追踪CTA只能检测‘后代’，即被索引病例感染的个体。双向追踪CTA还能检测‘父母’，即感染索引病例的个体。当索引病例被检测和登记后，如果在至少一个潜伏期内识别所有接触者，以便找到索引病例的父母，模型被认为使用了双向（而非前向）追踪。”我建议明确指出，前向接触追踪用于检测后代，而双向接触追踪用于识别父母（以及随后的兄弟姐妹）病例，因为在接触追踪期间传播方向是未知的。
* “在8个月内，CTA采用率为27%时，SARS-CoV-2的累积发病率可降至13-24%，采用率为40%时降至17-35%，采用率为61%时降至36-59%，采用率为80%时降至47-76%。”我想您是指“可以降低”？
* “在CTA中上传代码的每10.9人中就有1人SARS-CoV-2检测呈阳性。”实际上，Menges等人报告称，“每输入10.9（95% SI，7.6-15.6）个上传授权代码，就有1名接触者在应用通知后SARS-CoV-2检测结果呈阳性。”第一个陈述似乎指向检测阳性率，这不可能正确，因为只有感染个体才能上传代码，而第二个陈述则是说每10.9人中检测到1名感染的接触者（在COVID-19的R0背景下这并不多）。
* “f是影响CTA通知有效性的其他因素的综合。这些因素包括但不限于，CTA通知与检测之间的延迟，检测与检测结果之间的延迟，接收检测结果与将该结果输入CTA之间的延迟，对干预措施的依从性（例如，自我隔离），以及感染发生前或无症状感染的比例。”我意识到这不是一个详尽的列表，因此留给作者考虑我的建议，但我建议要么在这些研究中评估这些因素，要么至少讨论这些应用使用BLE SSRI检测暴露事件的准确性限制。不过，我还是留给作者决定是否整合这一点。

以下是一些研究示例：

Ballouz, T.等人。瑞士Covid数字近距离追踪应用中接触通知级联的个体水平评估：观察性研究。JMIR公共卫生监测8，（2022）；

Vogt, F.，Haire, B.，Selvey, L.，Katelaris, A. L. & Kaldor, J. 澳大利亚新南威尔士州COVID-19数字接触追踪的有效性评估。柳叶刀公共卫生7，e250–e258（2022）；

Leith, D. J. & Farrell, S. 基于测量的谷歌/苹果接触通知API在轻轨电车中近距离检测的评估。PLOS One 15, e0239943（2020）。
* “实证研究的结果与（通常高质量的）评估CTA有效性的模型研究相符。”实际上，我认为实证研究（特别是苏黎世的个体基础研究：https://publichealth.jmir.org/2021/12/e30004, https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jamanetworkopen/fullarticle/2779376, https://smw.ch/index.php/smw/article/view/2931/4822，还有https://www.thelancet.com/journals/lanpub/article/PIIS2468-2667(22)00010-X/fulltext）与建模研究中普遍非常积极的评估并不相符。

paper_title: The use of guest speakers in higher education and implications for pharmaceutical teaching: a systematic review of literature
paper_abstract:
Background 
     The purpose of this paper was to systematically review the current literature on the use of guest speakers in higher education teaching and evaluate the implications of the findings for teaching in pharmaceutical teaching. 
   
   
     Methods 
     A comprehensive search of different academic databases for literature on the use of guest speakers in higher education teaching was conducted and articles meeting the inclusion criteria were included in the analysis. A total of 15 articles were used in this systematic review. 
   
   
     Results 
     The use of guest speakers has critical benefits including promoting better learning, good career preparedness, positive learning outcomes, and creating an environment where learners have the opportunity to perceive real-world scenarios from the experiences of the guest speakers and thus be better prepared for the job market. With the increasing importance of the role of guest speakers in higher education learning, researchers have been engaging in coming up with standards and best practices for enhancing the effectiveness of the use of guest speakers in learning. The use of guest speakers in the teaching of pharmacy can enhance positive health outcomes by allowing students to have a better view of the situations they will deal with in their careers. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     The use of guest speakers can have major positive outcomes in promoting effectiveness in learning among students of pharmacy. Professors teaching pharmacy courses have the opportunity to benefit from various tools and resources that academic researchers have developed for guiding the process of the use of guest speakers in pharmacy teaching.
review_content:
The content of the paper is relevant in the context of higher education teaching and learning, with particular reference to the provision of guest lecturer. However, unless major revision is made, the current version of the paper has limitations as outlined in more detail below:

1) The current version of the paper has lack of international relevance as it does not provide wider and deeper discussion with other relevant studies worldwide;
2) The paper has shown the importance of guest speaker in the 'Introduction' section, but it failed to address the gaps in the current existing literature and accordingly, the paper has no clear contribution to the current knowledge development.
3) The paper has a good method for writing the SLR by using PRISMA. However, it needs more detailed elaboration of the bibliometric results of analysis. It requires further in-depth explanations.
4) On the basis of this SLR, it needs to provide future research direction. This important aspect is absent in the paper, both at the discussion section and conclusion.
5) The conclusion need to be further develop in order to provide convincing concluding remarks on the basis of the results.

I am more than happy to provide further review after the major revision of this SLR paper.

本文旨在系统回顾当前关于在高等教育教学中使用嘉宾演讲者的文献，并评估这些发现对药学教学的启示。

方法
对多个学术数据库进行了全面搜索，查找关于在高等教育教学中使用嘉宾演讲者的文献，符合纳入标准的文章被纳入分析。本次系统综述共使用了15篇文章。

使用嘉宾演讲者具有关键益处，包括促进更好的学习、良好的职业准备、积极的学习成果，以及创造一个使学习者有机会通过嘉宾演讲者的经验感知真实世界情景的环境，从而更好地为就业市场做好准备。随着嘉宾演讲者在高等教育学习中的角色日益重要，研究人员一直在致力于制定标准和最佳实践，以提高嘉宾演讲者在学习中的使用效果。在药学教学中使用嘉宾演讲者可以通过让学生更好地了解他们将面临的职业情景，从而提升积极的健康成果。

使用嘉宾演讲者可以在促进药学学生的学习效果方面产生重大积极成果。教授药学课程的教授有机会从学术研究人员为引导药学教学中使用嘉宾演讲者的过程而开发的多种工具和资源中受益。

paper_title: BioHackathon series in 2013 and 2014: improvements of semantic interoperability in life science data and services
paper_abstract: Publishing databases in the Resource Description Framework (RDF) model is becoming widely accepted to maximize the syntactic and semantic interoperability of open data in life sciences. Here we report advancements made in the 6th and 7th annual BioHackathons which were held in Tokyo and Miyagi respectively. This review consists of two major sections covering: 1) improvement and utilization of RDF data in various domains of the life sciences and 2) meta-data about these RDF data, the resources that store them, and the service quality of SPARQL Protocol and RDF Query Language (SPARQL) endpoints. The first section describes how we developed RDF data, ontologies and tools in genomics, proteomics, metabolomics, glycomics and by literature text mining. The second section describes how we defined descriptions of datasets, the provenance of data, and quality assessment of services and service discovery. By enhancing the harmonization of these two layers of machine-readable data and knowledge, we improve the way community wide resources are developed and published.  Moreover, we outline best practices for the future, and prepare ourselves for an exciting and unanticipatable variety of real world applications in coming years.
review_content:
The paper presents an overview about experiences and produced work related to RDF from the 6th and 7th annual BioHackathons (2013 and 2014).

The paper is structured in two major sections about (1) RDF data management in life sciences; and (2) meta-data about the RDF datasets with emphasis on SPARQL endpoint resources.
The paper provides an important contribution to the state-of-art in the context of RDF resources development and publication for life sciences, also presenting some discussion about good practices in these topics.

The paper is quite relevant and is well written, but there are some issues:
  * My main concern regards how current (actual) the content presented is, since the paper describes the editions of 2013 and 2014, and 7 editions occurred after these. I know that many advances/improvements happened in these last editions, including for example the use of ontologies like the Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI), the Semanticscience Integrated Ontology (SIO), the HCLS ontology profile, the SPAR ontologies (particularly FaBiO), FHIR, among others, in different use cases and with more recent technologies (e.g., ShEx, SHACL, RDF*, GraphDB, JSON-LD, etc).
  * Ideally, this survey should also incorporate these more recent BioHackathons (2015-2019) or at least provide a discussion about the main points where the most important advances/improvements happened. The current (recent) literature has many works produced in these last 7 editions.
  * I missed a paragraph (or some sentences in the end of Introduction) explaining why the authors choose to structure the paper in these 2 major categories: (1) Improvement and utilization of RDF data in life sciences; and (2) Metadata about RDF data resources.
  * The reasoning behind the paper structure is not so clear. For example, it is difficult to understand why the sub-sections of "Provenance of Data" were organized in Nanopublication, Bio2RDF2SADI and Quality assessment. The 2 first categories refer to specific approaches, while the later refers to a generic data management activity. Similar issue happens on the other sections.
  * The discussion on best practices, outlined in the abstract as a contribution of this paper, is quite difficult to track. One can find some recommendations spread in the text, but, in my point of view, it would be better to have a section only for Discussion and Recommendations. So, I suggest to create this section before the conclusions, moving all good practices' discussion to it.
  * Furthermore, it would be valuable to have in this new section a summary of the main open issues regarding the 2 major categories, highlighting which of the presented approaches faced these issues, giving directions to solve them.
  * In the Provenance of data section, I missed the reference to W3C PROV, which btw is used by the nanopublication approach and is a fundamental standard for reasoning over the data provenance.
  * The Conclusion section can be improved by making explicit what were the main lessons learned, the main contributions of the paper and a summary of the open issues identified.
paper_title_zh: 2013和2014年BioHackathon系列活动：生命科学数据和服务语义互操作性的改进
paper_abstract_zh: 在资源描述框架（RDF）模型中发布数据库正逐渐被广泛接受，以最大化生命科学中开放数据的语法和语义互操作性。本文报道了在东京和宫城分别举办的第六届和第七届年度BioHackathon中所取得的进展。本综述包括两个主要部分：1）在生命科学各个领域中RDF数据的改进和利用，以及2）关于这些RDF数据的元数据、存储它们的资源以及SPARQL协议和RDF查询语言（SPARQL）端点的服务质量。第一部分描述了我们在基因组学、蛋白质组学、代谢组学、糖组学以及通过文献文本挖掘中如何开发RDF数据、本体和工具。第二部分描述了我们是怎样定义数据集的描述、数据的来源以及服务和服务发现的质评估。通过增强这两层机器可读数据和知识的协调一致，我们改进了社区范围内资源开发和发布的方式。此外，我们概述了未来的最佳实践，并为未来几年激动人心且不可预见的多样化现实世界应用做好了准备。
review_content_zh:
本文概述了在第六届和第七届年度BioHackathon（2013年和2014年）中与RDF相关的经验和产出工作。

文章结构分为两大主要部分：(1) 生命科学中的RDF数据管理；以及 (2) 关于RDF数据集的元数据，重点介绍SPARQL端点资源。
本文为生命科学领域RDF资源开发和发布的现状提供了重要贡献，并就这些主题的良好实践进行了讨论。

文章相当相关且撰写良好，但存在一些问题：
  * 我主要关注的是所呈现内容的时效性，因为文章描述的是2013年和2014年的版本，而在此之后已经举办了7届。我知道在这些后续版本中发生了许多进展和改进，例如使用了诸如生物医学调查本体（OBI）、语义科学集成本体（SIO）、HCLS本体配置文件、SPAR本体（特别是FaBiO）、FHIR等，在不同的用例中使用了更先进的技术（例如，ShEx、SHACL、RDF*、GraphDB、JSON-LD等）。
  * 理想情况下，这篇综述也应包含这些较近期的BioHackathon（2015-2019年）的内容，或至少讨论最重要的进展和改进的主要点。近期文献中有许多在这些最后7届中产生的工作。
  * 我觉得缺少一个段落（或在引言末尾的几句话），解释作者为何选择将文章结构分为这两大类别：(1) 生命科学中RDF数据的改进和利用；以及 (2) 关于RDF数据资源的元数据。
  * 文章结构的逻辑不够清晰。例如，很难理解为何“数据来源”的子部分被组织为Nanopublication、Bio2RDF2SADI和质量评估。前两个类别指的是特定方法，而后者指的是一个通用的数据管理活动。其他部分也存在类似问题。

  * 在“数据来源”部分，我遗漏了W3C PROV的引用，该标准被nanopublication方法使用，是推理数据来源的基本标准。
  * 结论部分可以通过明确主要经验教训、文章的主要贡献和开放性问题的总结来改进。

paper_title: A scoping review of determinants of performance in dressage
paper_abstract: As a first step in achieving an evidence-based classification system for the sport of Para Dressage, there is a clear need to define elite dressage performance. Previous studies have attempted to quantify performance with able-bodied riders using scientific methods, however definitive measures have yet to be established for the horse and/or the rider. This may be, in part, due to the variety of movements and gaits that are found within a dressage test and also due to the complexity of the horse-rider partnership. The aim of this review is therefore to identify objective measurements of horse performance in dressage and the functional abilities of the rider that may influence them to achieve higher scores.

paper_title: The emergence of a modern paradigm for urban health
paper_abstract: The importance of urban health in achieving global and planetary health goals is increasingly recognized. Cities offer important opportunities to improve health while also presenting significant challenges. As our understanding of and evidence for the importance of determinants of health beyond health care have grown, the need for urban health policies and actions that transcend disciplinary and sectoral boundaries and involve multiple stakeholders in urban decision-making has become clearer. Current urban health practice builds on decades of conceptual and operational work. This paper traces the evolution of the urban health paradigm through research, policy and practice in recent decades. We suggest that, despite the proven utility of urban health as a paradigm and its conceptual and practical evolution for effective urban health governance, significant challenges remain, especially related to implementing the systems approaches needed to improve health amidst the complexity of urban dynamics.
review_content:
This article robustly traces the evolution of the urban health paradigm that highlights key past frameworks like the Health in All Policies (HiAP), the Ottawa Charter, and Healthy Public Policy. It also references systems thinking, equity, and complexity as core theoretical lenses for understanding urban health dynamics and a bold recommendation to move away from older frameworks to newer paradigms and emerging issues in Urban Health . These provide a strong foundation, but there are a few gaps that could be addressed in the remit of this article.
  * Strengths:
      + The focus on the settings-based approach and systemic determinants of health is comprehensive.
      + Incorporation of complexity science to frame urban health challenges is forward-thinking.
      + Historical references to the Alma Ata Declaration and WHO initiatives contextualize the paradigm's evolution.
  * Gaps:
      + The frameworks largely neglect the integration of digital health transformation in urban health , which is rapidly reshaping urban health systems. The article could incorporate frameworks like digital ecosystems and their potential to address urban health inequities through data analytics, telemedicine, and AI-driven decision-making.
      + The private health sector's role is also underemphasized who is often a key play in urban health systems in emerging economies with mixed health systems. A pragmatic discussion of mixed health systems and private sector dynamics could strengthen the conceptual framing, especially regarding regulatory frameworks, financing models, and partnerships.
2. Digital Health Transformation
The omission of digital health as a transformative tool is a significant gap, given its increasing relevance in urban health:
  * Suggested Additions:
      + Include a discussion on the role of digital platforms in improving access to urban health services, particularly for underserved populations.
      + Explore frameworks like the Digital Health Ecosystem Model, emphasizing the interplay between governance, technology, and stakeholders in urban settings.
      + Highlight innovations such as mobile health (mHealth), eHealth tools, and AI applications in predictive urban health surveillance.
  * Rationale: Digital health can bridge gaps in healthcare access and quality in urban areas, where infrastructure is often unevenly distributed. Including this dimension would make the article more relevant to contemporary challenges and opportunities.
3. Role of the Private Health Sector
The private health sector is critical in urban settings, especially in low- and middle-income countries, where it often fills service delivery gaps:
  * Suggestions for Inclusion:
      + Discuss how private providers can complement public health efforts through partnerships, performance-based contracting, or shared accountability models.
      + Examine innovative financing mechanisms (e.g., social impact bonds) and their role in incentivizing private sector participation in urban health initiatives.
      + Incorporate case studies that illustrate successful integration of private sector solutions in urban health systems (e.g., public-private partnerships in urban clinics or insurance schemes tailored to urban populations).
  * Theoretical Contribution: The article could introduce theories of market dynamics and public-private synergies, focusing on balancing equity, efficiency, and accessibility in urban health.
4. Suggestions would be useful in the scope of this forward thinking article if
  * The authors should explicitly recognize the transformative potential of digital health and private sector partnerships as key drivers of the next phase of the urban health paradigm.
  * A section dedicated to exploring how these two elements can operationalize the theoretical concepts of systems thinking and equity would enrich the discussion.
paper_title_zh: 现代城市健康范式的兴起
paper_abstract_zh: 城市健康在实现全球和行星健康目标中的重要性日益得到认可。城市提供了改善健康的重要机会，同时也带来了显著挑战。随着我们对医疗保健之外健康决定因素重要性的理解和证据的不断增长，跨学科和部门界限并涉及多个城市决策利益相关者的城市健康政策和行动的需求变得更加明确。当前的城市健康实践建立在数十年的概念和操作性工作之上。本文通过近年来的研究、政策和实践，追溯了城市健康范式的演变。我们认为，尽管城市健康作为一个范式已被证明具有实用价值，并在概念和实践上为有效的城市健康治理不断演变，但仍存在重大挑战，尤其是与在复杂城市动态中实施改善健康所需的系统方法相关的问题。
review_content_zh:
本文有力地追溯了城市健康范式的演变，突出了关键的历史框架，如“所有政策中的健康”（HiAP）、《渥太华宪章》和健康公共政策。文章还引用了系统思维、公平性和复杂性作为理解城市健康动态的核心理论视角，并大胆建议从旧框架转向新范式和城市健康中的新兴问题。这些内容为文章奠定了坚实的基础，但仍有一些空白可以在本文范围内加以解决。
  * 优点：
      + 对基于环境的方法和健康系统性决定因素的探讨是全面的。
      + 结合复杂性科学来框定城市健康挑战具有前瞻性。
      + 对《阿拉木图宣言》和世界卫生组织倡议的历史引用为范式演变提供了背景。
  * 缺陷：
      + 这些框架在很大程度上忽视了数字健康转型在城市健康中的整合，而数字健康正在迅速重塑城市健康系统。文章可以纳入数字生态系统等框架，及其通过数据分析、远程医疗和人工智能驱动的决策来解决城市健康不平等问题的潜力。
      + 私人卫生部门的作用也被低估，而私人部门在新兴经济体混合健康系统中的城市健康系统中往往扮演关键角色。对混合健康系统和私人部门动态的务实讨论可以加强概念框架，特别是在监管框架、融资模式和合作伙伴关系方面。
2. 数字健康转型
鉴于数字健康在城市健康中的日益重要性，将其作为变革工具的遗漏是一个重大缺陷：
  * 建议补充：
      + 讨论数字平台在改善城市健康服务可及性方面的作用，特别是对服务不足人群的影响。
      + 探讨如数字健康生态系统模型等框架，强调城市环境中治理、技术和利益相关者之间的相互作用。
      + 突出移动健康（mHealth）、电子健康工具和人工智能在预测性城市健康监测中的创新应用。
  * 理由：数字健康可以弥合城市地区医疗保健可及性和质量方面的差距，这些地区的 infrastructure 往往分布不均。包括这一维度将使文章更贴近当代的挑战和机遇。
3. 私人卫生部门的作用
私人卫生部门在城市环境中至关重要，特别是在低收入和中等收入国家，它常常填补服务交付的空白：
  * 建议纳入内容：
      + 讨论私人提供者如何通过合作伙伴关系、基于绩效的合同或共享责任模型来补充公共卫生工作。
      + 考察创新融资机制（如社会影响债券）及其在激励私人部门参与城市健康倡议中的作用。
      + 纳入案例研究，说明私人部门解决方案在城市健康系统中的成功整合（如城市诊所的公私合作伙伴关系或针对城市人口定制的保险方案）。
  * 理论贡献：文章可以引入市场动态和公私协同的理论，重点平衡城市健康中的公平性、效率和可及性。
4. 在这篇具有前瞻性文章的范围内，以下建议将是有益的：
  * 作者应明确认识到数字健康和私人部门合作伙伴关系的变革潜力，作为推动下一阶段城市健康范式的关键驱动力。
  * 设立专门章节探讨这两要素如何将系统思维和公平性的理论概念付诸实践，将丰富讨论内容。

paper_title: Youth athletes and wearable technology
paper_abstract: Wearable sensors have become integral tools for monitoring biomechanical and physiologic aspects of athletic training and performance. A prominent trend in fitness technology, wearable devices now measure a variety of health characteristics, including movement and posture, physiologic measures (eg, heart rate and energy expenditure), and fluid and electrolyte losses, to understand an athlete’s physiologic responses during activity. Sleep has proven integral to athletic performance, and sleep monitoring wearable devices (eg, watches, rings, and headbands) use various measures, such as actigraphy and pulse oximetry, to analyze sleep quality. Young athletes benefit from wearable devices during training sessions, where multimodal data are collected and analyzed to assess performance. Wearable devices are also useful for resistance training, biofeedback, and electrical muscle stimulation, providing athletes with tools to optimize their training regimens. Moreover, these devices play a crucial role in athlete safety by monitoring cardiac physiology, head impacts, and muscle rehabilitation after injury. We provide a comprehensive review of current wearable technology and its application in youth athletics, describe where and how these sensors are used to help enhance physiologic, biomechanical, and performance parameters, and discuss future directions for wearable devices to advance sports science and athlete management.
review_content:
The authors are to be commended for conducting a thorough review of the literature around wearable technology, however it feels that the focus of the review could be rethought, with the link back to the practitioner and why they should consider measuring these things using wearable technology allowing them to compare to the laboratory measures of the same outcomes.

There is also limited linking back to youth athletes, with the focus very much on the technology. This is therefore, not reflected in the title of the work.

There is also detail here on devices work (e.g. accelerometers and MEMSs). Is that vital information for the understanding of the data collected? This links back to the question about what is the aim of this piece. Currently does not feel that it is achieving the aim.

See below some specific comments on various sections
What wearable technology can do:

L1 – wearable tech does not need to be worn on the skin, could be worn close to it so would suggest amending this.

L9 list with lots of ands in. This could do with revision.

Ref 24 - This is an undergraduate thesis. Is this the most appropriate source for this information? Also would suggest that this part needs clarification due to the use of distance covered. Does this mean the distance covered by the ball or by the golfer walking the course? I would suggest clarifying this and providing a more appropriate (preferably peer reviewed) source for this information.

HR/HRV – Not sure of the relevance of the athlete heart here. How does this relate to sensor wearing? This can’t be determined using wearable technology, again seems to be outside of the focus on wearable technology in youth athletes.

How much variation is there between wrist based vs chest worn HR straps? How would this change the determination of which is more important the athlete comfort v data quality. What recommendations would you make?

Energy Expenditure
Same point re HR. How do the wearable estimates of EE compare to lab based measures? This is key information for people trying to understand the data that they might collect using these devices.

Training monitoring and assessment
Kalman filter- what is the relevance of this? How does it impact the data that is collected/reported by the device?
paper_title_zh: 青年运动员与可穿戴技术
paper_abstract_zh: 可穿戴传感器已成为监测运动员训练和表现的生物力学和生理学方面的重要工具。作为健身技术的一个显著趋势，可穿戴设备现在可以测量多种健康特征，包括运动和姿势、生理指标（例如，心率和能量消耗）以及液体和电解质流失，以了解运动员在活动中的生理反应。睡眠已被证明对运动员表现至关重要，睡眠监测可穿戴设备（例如，手表、戒指和头带）使用多种测量方法，如活动记录法和脉搏血氧仪，来分析睡眠质量。年轻运动员在训练期间从可穿戴设备中受益，其中收集和分析多模态数据以评估表现。可穿戴设备还适用于抗阻训练、生物反馈和电肌肉刺激，为运动员提供优化训练方案的工具。此外，这些设备通过监测心脏生理学、头部撞击和受伤后的肌肉康复，在运动员安全方面发挥着至关重要的作用。我们全面回顾了当前可穿戴技术及其在青少年运动中的应用，描述了这些传感器在何处以及如何用于帮助提升生理学、生物力学和表现参数，并讨论了可穿戴设备在未来推进运动科学和运动员管理的发展方向。
review_content_zh:
作者对可穿戴技术相关文献进行了全面回顾，值得称赞。然而，综述的重点似乎需要重新思考，特别是将其与从业者联系起来，探讨他们为何应考虑使用可穿戴技术来测量这些指标，并与实验室测量的相同结果进行比较。

此外，文章在将内容与青少年运动员联系起来方面较为有限，重点过多放在技术上。这一点在文章标题中并未体现。

文中还详细介绍了设备工作原理（如加速度计和MEMS）。这是否是理解所收集数据的关键信息？这又回到了本文目的的问题上。目前看来，文章并未达到其目标。

以下是对各部分的具体评论：
可穿戴技术能做什么：

L1 – 可穿戴技术不必贴身佩戴，可以是靠近皮肤，建议修改此点。

L9 列举了大量“和”的用法，需要修订。

Ref 24 - 这是一篇本科论文。这是否是该信息的最佳来源？此外，建议澄清“距离覆盖”的使用，是指球覆盖的距离还是高尔夫球手走完球场的距离？建议明确这一点，并提供更合适的（最好是同行评审的）信息来源。

心率/心率变异性（HR/HRV） - 不确定运动员心脏的相关性。这与传感器佩戴有何关系？这无法通过可穿戴技术确定，似乎超出了对青少年运动员可穿戴技术的关注范围。

手腕佩戴与胸部佩戴的心率带之间有多大差异？这会如何影响对运动员舒适度与数据质量哪个更重要的判断？你会给出什么建议？

能量消耗
与HR相同的问题。可穿戴设备对能量消耗的估计与实验室测量相比如何？这对试图理解使用这些设备可能收集到的数据的人来说是关键信息。

训练监测与评估
卡尔曼滤波器 - 其相关性何在？它如何影响设备收集/报告的数据？
