作者回应：讨论了碳的种类并提供了支持性表格（第143-174行）（见表1）。

研究结果的有效性：无。

对作者的意见

作者回应：删除了重复词。

作者回应：已提供句号。

4. 作者应在底物吸收率方法和底物浓度变化方法部分添加引用。

paper_title: A Survey on Large Language Models for Critical Societal Domains: Finance, Healthcare, and Law
paper_abstract: In the fast-evolving domain of artificial intelligence, large language models (LLMs) such as GPT-3 and GPT-4 are revolutionizing the landscapes of finance, healthcare, and law: domains characterized by their reliance on professional expertise, challenging data acquisition, high-stakes, and stringent regulatory compliance. This survey offers a detailed exploration of the methodologies, applications, challenges, and forward-looking opportunities of LLMs within these high-stakes sectors. We highlight the instrumental role of LLMs in enhancing diagnostic and treatment methodologies in healthcare, innovating financial analytics, and refining legal interpretation and compliance strategies. Moreover, we critically examine the ethics for LLM applications in these fields, pointing out the existing ethical concerns and the need for transparent, fair, and robust AI systems that respect regulatory norms. By presenting a thorough review of current literature and practical applications, we showcase the transformative impact of LLMs, and outline the imperative for interdisciplinary cooperation, methodological advancements, and ethical vigilance. Through this lens, we aim to spark dialogue and inspire future research dedicated to maximizing the benefits of LLMs while mitigating their risks in these precision-dependent sectors. To facilitate future research on LLMs in these critical societal domains, we also initiate a reading list that tracks the latest advancements under this topic, which will be released and continually updated.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey paper summarizes the state of domain-specific LLMs in finance, medicine, and law, draws shared connections across these settings for ethnical condiderations and desirdata for real-world use (e.g. "explainability"). The paper summarizes existing domain-specific LLMs, their pretraining datasets, tasks, and evaluation techniques. This work contributes to a growing body of surveys covering LLMs in domain-specific settings. I focus most of my comments on the medical LLM section.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** - Covers the wide range of recent medical LLMs - Captures general NLP categories across the 3 discussed LLM domains - Outlines some ethnical connections across domains to expand the survey **Weaknesses** - The manuscript covers a lof of material, 3+ deep topics on finance, medicine, law use cases of LLMs and corresponding ethical implications. The manuscript almost feels like 2 papers combined: a survey of current work on domain-specific LLMs and a paper on the shared ethical principles (Figure 6) of high-stakes AI. I do feel this paper tries to cover too much material at the cost of focusing on clearer story for the reader. - As the authors note, there are many such recent LLM surveys covering these areas. The manuscript makes arguments for the unique contributions and need for this work. > "Our work encompasses a broader spectrum, surveying various applications in both the pure NLP domain and multimodal scenarios. We also discuss recent novel tasks such as medical instruction following and medical imaging classification via natural language." However, I feel there have been a number of recent surveys, especially in the medical and digital medicine literature, that provide a broader view than just the classic NLP (infoextract, sentence classification, QA) and vision-language model spaces in medicine as covered here. The survey would be enriched by bringing in more domain-focused discussions of LLM use in medicine. Some example recent survey papers and perspectives worth including. - Bedi et al. 2024. [A Systematic Review of Testing and Evaluation of Healthcare Applications of Large Language Models (LLMs)](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.04.15.24305869v4) Preprint. - Omiye et al. 2024. [Large Language Models in Medicine: The Potentials and Pitfalls: A Narrative Review](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/full/10.7326/M23-2772?casa_token=EyotCeeolAYAAAAA:qdUVM6EJ-V1kD50n87vzUAZk2a15R0ZHT8WPbzCanz9E3j8Wl-TvoC83zn0cZj7AtpeF2dYpeUlR) Annals of Internal Medcine. - Peng et al 2023. [A study of generative large language model for medical research and healthcare](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00958-w). npj Digital Medicine - Shah et al 2023. [Creation and Adoption of Large Language Models in Medicine](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/article-abstract/2808296). JAMA. > 4.4 Medical Report Generation - There is work demonstrating how lexical measures of text generation (e.g., BLEU, ROUGE-L, METEOR) and info-extract-style evaluations of generated text (where some set of concepts are labeled in generated text) don't correlate well with expert judgement of generation quality (Xie et al 2024). Given this, I'm curious as the motivation and take-aways for Table 5. - Xie et al 2024. [DocLens: Multi-aspect Fine-grained Evaluation for Medical Text Generation](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.39/) ACL 2024. > 4.5 Medical Free-form Instruction Evaluation - The MedAlign dataset (Fleming et al 2024), 303 instructions written by clinicians for tasks defined over longitudinal EHRs, is also worth citing as a medical instruction benchmark targeting real-world medical applications. - Fleming et al 2024. [MedAlign: A Clinician-Generated Dataset for Instruction Following with Electronic Medical Records](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/30205). AAAI 2024. > "As a novel task proposed recently, existing LMs may not readily include Under review as submission to TMLR such a task into its pre-training stage. Therefore, evaluation of this task allows us to investigate how language models perform for unseen tasks." - I'm not really sold on the merits of the Table 4 experiment results, showing how fine-tuned smaller BERT style models work better for sentence classification (abnormality / ambiguity classes) vs. zero and few shot autoregressive LLMs. Ignore missing experimental details (how many shots?) the take-away "there is still a gap between finetuned LMs and prompted LLMs" is well-established in the literature. > "The evaluation of LLMs, such as ChatGPT, on medical exams, including US Medical Exams (Kung et al., 2023) and Otolaryngology–Head and Neck Surgery Certification Examinations (Long et al., 2023), indicates that they achieve scores close to or at the passing threshold. This suggests the potential of LLMs to support real-world medical usages such as medical education and clinical decision-making" - There is a strong argument that passing medical exams is viewed as a very weak, at least one that lacks ecological validity. While curated medical vignettes and other exam-style assessments of LLMs provide some insight into knowledge skills (either from weight memory or via retrieval abilities) it is far removed from the majority of tasks involved with the practice of medicine.

**Requested Changes:**
- Comment on space of LLMs trained and evaluated on electronic health record (EHR) data. This is mentioned in passing in section "Future Prospects" but there are prior survey papers for LLMs that explore this topic in more depth and the gaps therein. - Wornow et al 2023. "[The shaky foundations of large language models and foundation models for electronic health records](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00879-8)" - Include more surveys outside the purely technical realm to better characterize how the medical domain is framing and thinking about the challenges of deploying generative AI more broadly. - Include specific citations outlined in the weaknesses above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No concerns.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer LqKo: ## Q: paper covering too much material A: Thank you for comment, we understand the concern. However, we would like to clarify our intent and the cohesive structure of the paper: Combination of LLM+FHL and ethics: The intrinsic connection between the technical aspects of LLM and ethical considerations in the finance, health, and law (FHL) sectors necessitates their combined discussion. Ethics is not merely an adjunct topic but a fundamental component that must be addressed in tandem with technological advancements. Distinct focus on domain-related ethics: Unlike general ethical surveys, the ethical discussion in our manuscript deliberately narrows its focus to domain-related concerns. This target allows us to delve deeper into the unique ethical dilemmas and considerations directly within FHL sectors, and we do not overextend the scope but rather intensify the discourse within a clearly defined boundary. ## Q: Include more citations in medicine-related LLM. A: Thanks for your suggestion, we will include the citations as mentioned in the review and discuss them in the revision. ## Q: Metrics and Take-aways for Table-5 A: The evaluation of text generation has long been an active research topic. Though n-gram metrics are not the best metrics in terms of high agreements with medical experts, they still have a level of correlation to represent the quality of generated text. We include them as they are commonly reported in previous papers. We also report clinical efficacy to measure the clinical accuracy of the generated reports. ## Q: Table 4 experiment results A: The few-shot results are evaluated with 5-shots. We will clarify in the paper. As for the overall interpretation of the results, one argument is “prompted LLMs perform worse on novel tasks (tasks that are most likely unseen during pre-training)”. ## Q: While curated medical vignettes and other exam-style assessments of LLMs provide some insight into knowledge skills, it is far removed from the majority of tasks involved with the practice of medicine. A: We acknowledge this argument. Passing medical exams does not mean LLMs are ready to be deployed for medical education or clinical decision-making. We will add this comment into the paper. On the other hand, though these medical exams are not fully capturing real-world practice, as of today, they may still be useful for assessing foundational medical knowledge and reasoning skills in LLMs. ## Q: Comment on the space of LLMs trained and evaluated on EHR data. A: Thank you for your valuable suggestion. We will include a dedicated subsection on LLMs for EHR in the revised version and reference the suggested survey paper. Below is a brief summary of current work on LLMs in this area: Several LLMs in healthcare have been further fine-tuned on electronic health record (EHR) data to improve clinical outcomes, such as predicting 30-day readmission, mortality, and extended lengths of stay on clinical notes, or multimodal data such as time series and text [1]. For instance, Gema et al. [2] performed parameter-efficient fine-tuning of the LLama model on clinical notes from MIMIC-IV to enhance clinical knowledge injection. Additionally, Fleming et al. [3] introduced MedAlign, an EHR-based instructional dataset, to promote the development of LLMs for healthcare applications. Despite these advancements, the use of LLMs on EHR data remains limited due to high costs and constrained data availability [4]. We will provide a detailed description of the work in this subdomain in the revised manuscript. [1] Zhang et al. (2023). Improving Medical Predictions by Irregular Multimodal Electronic Health Records Modeling. [2] Gema et al. (2023). Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning LLaMA for the Clinical Domain. [3] Fleming et al. (2024). MedAlign: A Clinician-Generated Dataset for Instruction Following with Electronic Medical Records. [4] Johnson et al. (2023). MIMIC-IV, a Freely Accessible Electronic Health Record Dataset. ## Q: Include more surveys outside the purely technical realm about how the medical domain is thinking about and deploying generative AI. A: Thanks for your suggestion! We will cite more surveys outside the purely technical realm. If you have any specific papers in mind, feel free to let us know.
paper_title_zh: 关于关键社会领域大型语言模型的综述：金融、医疗保健与法律
paper_abstract_zh: 在快速发展的人工智能领域，大型语言模型（LLMs）如GPT-3和GPT-4正在彻底改变金融、医疗和法律等领域的格局：这些领域以依赖专业 expertise、数据获取困难、风险高以及严格的监管合规为特征。本综述详细探讨了LLMs在这些高风险领域的方法论、应用、挑战及前瞻性机遇。我们强调了LLMs在提升医疗诊断和治疗方法、创新金融分析以及完善法律解释和合规策略中的关键作用。此外，我们批判性地审视了LLMs在这些领域应用的伦理问题，指出现有的伦理关切以及对透明、公平、健壮且尊重监管规范的AI系统的需求。通过全面回顾当前文献和实际应用，我们展示了LLMs的变革性影响，并概述了跨学科合作、方法论进步和伦理警觉的必要性。通过这一视角，我们旨在引发对话并激励未来研究，致力于最大化LLMs在这些精确依赖型领域的益处，同时降低其风险。为了促进在这些关键社会领域对LLMs的未来研究，我们还启动了一份阅读清单，追踪该主题的最新进展，并将发布并持续更新。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了金融、医学和法律领域特定的大型语言模型（LLM）的现状，探讨了这些领域在伦理考量方面的共同联系以及实际应用中的需求（例如“可解释性”）。文章总结了现有的领域特定LLM、其预训练数据集、任务和评估技术。这项工作为涵盖领域特定设置中LLM的日益增长的综述文献做出了贡献。我的评论主要集中在医学LLM部分。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点** - 涵盖了广泛的近期医学LLM - 捕捉了三个讨论的LLM领域中的一般NLP类别 - 概述了跨领域的某些伦理联系，以扩展综述 **缺点** - 手稿涵盖了大量材料，涉及金融、医学、法律中LLM的3+个深度主题及其相应的伦理影响。手稿几乎像是两篇论文的组合：一篇关于领域特定LLM当前工作的综述，以及一篇关于高风险AI共享伦理原则（图6）的论文。我确实觉得这篇论文试图涵盖过多材料，以至于牺牲了对读者更清晰的故事线。 - 如作者所言，近期已有许多类似的LLM综述涵盖这些领域。手稿论证了这项工作的独特贡献和必要性。 > “我们的工作涵盖了更广泛的光谱，综述了纯NLP领域和多模态场景中的各种应用。我们还讨论了近期的新颖任务，如医疗指令跟随和通过自然语言进行医学影像分类。” 然而，我觉得近期已有许多综述，特别是在医学和数字医学文献中，提供了比这里所涵盖的经典NLP（信息提取、句子分类、问答）和视觉-语言模型空间更广阔的视角。通过引入更多关于医学中LLM使用的领域聚焦讨论，可以使综述更加丰富。一些值得包括的近期综述论文和观点示例。 - Bedi等人，2024年。[大型语言模型（LLM）在医疗应用中的测试和评估的系统综述](https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2024.04.15.24305869v4) 预印本。 - Omiye等人，2024年。[大型语言模型在医学中的潜力与陷阱：叙述性综述](https://www.acpjournals.org/doi/full/10.7326/M23-2772?casa_token=EyotCeeolAYAAAAA:qdUVM6EJ-V1kD50n87vzUAZk2a15R0ZHT8WPbzCanz9E3j8Wl-TvoC83zn0cZj7AtpeF2dYpeUlR) 内科年鉴。 - Peng等人，2023年。[生成式大型语言模型在医学研究和医疗保健中的研究](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00958-w)。npj数字医学 - Shah等人，2023年。[大型语言模型在医学中的创建和采纳](https://jamanetwork.com/journals/jama/article-abstract/2808296)。JAMA。 > 4.4 医疗报告生成 - 有研究表明，文本生成的词汇度量（例如，BLEU、ROUGE-L、METEOR）以及生成文本的信息提取式评估（在生成文本中标记某些概念集）与专家对生成质量的判断并不密切相关（Xie等，2024）。鉴于此，我对表5的动机和结论感到好奇。- Xie等，2024。[DocLens：医疗文本生成的多方面细粒度评估](https://aclanthology.org/2024.acl-long.39/) ACL 2024。> 4.5 医疗自由形式指令评估 - MedAlign数据集（Fleming等，2024），包含由临床医生编写的303条针对纵向电子健康记录（EHR）定义任务的指令，也值得引用，作为针对现实世界医疗应用的医疗指令基准。- Fleming等，2024。[MedAlign：一个用于遵循电子医疗记录指令的临床医生生成数据集](https://ojs.aaai.org/index.php/AAAI/article/view/30205)。AAAI 2024。> “作为最近提出的新任务，现有的语言模型可能不会轻易将此类任务纳入其预训练阶段。因此，对此任务的评估使我们能够研究语言模型在未见任务上的表现。” - 我对表4实验结果的优点并不完全信服，该结果显示微调后的较小BERT风格模型在句子分类（异常/模糊类别）上比零样本和少样本自回归大型语言模型（LLM）表现更好。忽略缺失的实验细节（多少次样本？），“微调语言模型与提示语言模型之间仍存在差距”这一结论在文献中已得到充分确立。> “对ChatGPT等大型语言模型在医疗考试中的评估，包括美国医学考试（Kung等，2023）和耳鼻喉-头颈外科认证考试（Long等，2023），表明它们的成绩接近或达到及格线。这表明大型语言模型有潜力支持现实世界的医疗应用，如医学教育和临床决策。” - 有强有力的论据认为，通过医疗考试被视为一个非常弱的指标，至少缺乏生态效度。虽然经过筛选的医疗案例和其他考试风格的评估提供了一些对知识技能的洞察（无论是来自权重记忆还是通过检索能力），但这与医学实践中的大多数任务相去甚远。

**请求的更改：**
- 评论在电子健康记录（EHR）数据上训练和评估的大型语言模型（LLM）的空间。这在“未来前景”部分中有所提及，但已有关于大型语言模型的先前综述论文深入探讨了这一主题及其中的差距。- Wornow等，2023。 "[大型语言模型和电子健康记录基础模型的摇摇欲坠的基础](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41746-023-00879-8)" - 在纯粹技术领域之外进行更多调查，以更好地刻画医疗领域是如何框架化和思考更广泛部署生成式AI的挑战。 - 包含上述弱点中概述的具体引文。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
无关切。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳评论：**
对审稿人LqKo的回应：## Q: 论文涵盖材料过多 A: 感谢您的评论，我们理解您的关切。然而，我们想澄清我们的意图和论文的连贯结构：LLM+FHL与伦理的结合：大型语言模型（LLM）的技术方面与金融、健康和法律（FHL）领域的伦理考量之间的内在联系，需要将它们结合起来讨论。伦理不仅仅是附加话题，而是必须与技术进步同步解决的基本组成部分。专注于领域相关伦理的明确焦点：与一般伦理调查不同，我们手稿中的伦理讨论故意缩小焦点到领域相关的关切。这一目标使我们能够更深入地探讨FHL领域内独特的伦理困境和考量，我们没有扩大范围，而是在明确界定的边界内加强讨论。## Q: 在医学相关LLM中包含更多引文。 A: 感谢您的建议，我们将按照评审意见包含这些引文，并在修订中讨论它们。## Q: 表格5的指标和要点 A: 文本生成的评估一直是活跃的研究课题。尽管n-gram指标在高度同意医学专家方面不是最佳指标，但它们仍有一定程度的关联性，可以代表生成文本的质量。我们包含它们是因为它们在之前的论文中常见报道。我们还报告临床效用以衡量生成报告的临床准确性。## Q: 表格4实验结果 A: 少样本结果是用5个样本评估的。我们将在论文中澄清。至于结果的总体解释，一个论点是“提示型LLM在新任务（最可能在预训练中未见过的任务）上表现较差”。## Q: 虽然经过精心挑选的医学案例和其他考试风格的LLM评估提供了一些关于知识技能的见解，但这与医学实践中的大多数任务相去甚远。 A: 我们承认这一论点。通过医学考试并不意味着LLM已准备好用于医学教育或临床决策。我们将在论文中加入这一评论。另一方面，尽管这些医学考试并未完全捕捉到现实世界的实践，但截至目前，它们可能仍有助于评估LLM中的基础医学知识和推理技能。 ## Q: 评论在EHR数据上训练和评估的LLM的空间。A: 感谢您的宝贵建议。我们将在修订版本中包含一个专门关于EHR的LLM的子节，并引用所建议的综述论文。以下是当前该领域LLM工作的简要总结：医疗领域的几个LLM已经进一步在电子健康记录（EHR）数据上进行微调，以改善临床结果，例如预测30天再入院率、死亡率以及临床记录上的延长住院时间，或如时间序列和文本等多模态数据[1]。例如，Gema等人[2]对LLama模型在MIMIC-IV的临床记录上进行了参数高效的微调，以增强临床知识的注入。此外，Fleming等人[3]介绍了MedAlign，一个基于EHR的指导性数据集，以促进医疗应用中LLM的发展。尽管取得了这些进展，但由于高成本和受限的数据可用性，LLM在EHR数据上的应用仍然有限[4]。我们将在修订的手稿中详细描述这一子领域的工作。[1] 张等人（2023）。通过不规则多模态电子健康记录建模改进医疗预测。[2] Gema等人（2023）。参数高效微调LLaMA用于临床领域。[3] Fleming等人（2024）。MedAlign：一个由临床医生生成的用于遵循电子医疗记录指令的数据集。[4] Johnson等人（2023）。MIMIC-IV，一个可自由访问的电子健康记录数据集。## Q: 包含更多关于医疗领域如何思考和部署生成式AI的非纯技术领域的综述。A: 谢谢您的建议！我们将引用更多非纯技术领域的综述。如果您有任何具体的论文建议，请随时告知。

paper_title: Measuring language lateralisation with different language tasks: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Language lateralisation refers to the phenomenon in which one hemisphere (typically the left) shows greater involvement in language functions than the other. Measurement of laterality is of interest both to researchers investigating the neural organisation of the language system and to clinicians needing to establish an individual's hemispheric dominance for language prior to surgery, as in patients with intractable epilepsy. Recently, there has been increasing awareness of the possibility that different language processes may develop hemispheric lateralisation independently, and to varying degrees. However, it is not always clear whether differences in laterality across language tasks with fMRI are reflective of meaningful variation in hemispheric lateralisation, or simply of trivial methodological differences between paradigms. This systematic review aims to assess different language tasks in terms of the strength, reliability and robustness of the laterality measurements they yield with fMRI, to look at variability that is both dependent and independent of aspects of study design, such as the baseline task, region of interest, and modality of the stimuli. Recommendations are made that can be used to guide task design; however, this review predominantly highlights that the current high level of methodological variability in language paradigms prevents conclusions as to how different language functions may lateralise independently. We conclude with suggestions for future research using tasks that engage distinct aspects of language functioning, whilst being closely matched on non-linguistic aspects of task design (e.g. stimuli, task timings etc); such research could produce more reliable and conclusive insights into language lateralisation. This systematic review was registered as a protocol on Open Science Framework: https://osf.io/5vmpt/.
review_content: Reviewer 3: Sebastian Ocklenburg • Suggested change: The reviewer asked that we work on having a clearer hypothesis for the article. ◦ Our aim in conducting this systematic review was to look at the laterality measured by different paradigms in order to try to extract some principles that could be used to guide development of robust laterality paradigms. In this way, we were not primarily hypothesis driven. However, we did go into the review with two more general ‘hypotheses’: 1) that different language tasks will demonstrate different levels of lateralisation and 2) that parameters such as the region of interest and baseline task used will have effects on laterality measurement that may be task-specific. We have therefore added these to the end of the introduction (lines 96-99), and refer back to them at the start of the discussion (lines 590-592). In revising the manuscript for resubmission, we have also taken the opportunity to make some minor wording changes to increase readability; these have been included as tracked changes in the revised manuscript. Kind regards, Abigail Bradshaw (on behalf of the co-authors)
paper_title_zh: 使用不同语言任务测量语言侧化：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 语言侧化是指一个半球（通常是左半球）在语言功能上的参与程度大于另一个半球的现象。侧化测量对于研究语言系统神经组织的研究人员以及需要在手术前确定个体语言半球优势的临床医生（如难治性癫痫患者）都具有重要意义。近年来，人们越来越意识到不同的语言过程可能独立地发展出半球侧化，并且程度各不相同。然而，使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）在不同语言任务中观察到的侧化差异，并不总是清楚这些差异是否反映了半球侧化的有意义变化，还是仅仅是不同范式之间的琐碎方法学差异。本系统综述旨在评估不同语言任务在使用fMRI进行侧化测量时的强度、可靠性和鲁棒性，考察依赖于研究设计方面的变异（如基线任务、感兴趣区域和刺激模态）以及独立于这些方面的变异。提出了可用于指导任务设计的建议；然而，本综述主要强调当前语言范式中的高方法学变异性，阻碍了对不同语言功能如何独立侧化的结论。我们以对未来研究的建议作为总结，建议使用涉及语言功能不同方面的任务，同时在任务设计的非语言方面（如刺激、任务时间等）保持紧密匹配；此类研究可能产生更可靠和更有说服力的关于语言侧化的见解。本系统综述已在开放科学框架上注册为协议：https://osf.io/5vmpt/。
review_content_zh: 审稿人3：塞巴斯蒂安·奥克伦堡 • 建议修改：审稿人要求我们为文章提供一个更清晰的假设。◦ 我们进行这项系统性综述的目的是考察不同范式测量的侧化现象，以尝试提取一些可用于指导开发稳健侧化范式的原则。因此，我们并非主要受假设驱动。然而，我们在进行综述时确实有两个更普遍的“假设”：1）不同的语言任务将表现出不同水平的侧化；2）诸如感兴趣区域和基线任务等参数将对侧化测量产生影响，且这种影响可能是任务特定的。因此，我们已将这些内容添加到引言的末尾（第96-99行），并在讨论的开头再次提及（第590-592行）。在修订稿件以重新提交时，我们还借此机会对一些措辞进行了微调，以提高可读性；这些修改已作为跟踪更改包含在修订后的稿件中。此致，阿比盖尔·布拉德肖（代表共同作者）

paper_title: Unleashing the Power of Data Tsunami: A Comprehensive Survey on Data Assessment and Selection for Instruction Tuning of Language Models
paper_abstract: Instruction tuning plays a critical role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. Despite the vast amount of open instruction datasets, naively training a LLM on all existing instructions may not be optimal and practical. To pinpoint the most beneficial datapoints, data assessment and selection methods have been proposed in the fields of natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning. However, under the context of instruction tuning, there still exists a gap in knowledge on what kind of data evaluation metrics can be employed and how they can be integrated into the selection mechanism. To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive review on existing literature of data assessment and selection especially for instruction tuning of LLMs. We systematically categorize all applicable methods into quality-based, diversity-based, and importance-based ones where a unified, fine-grained taxonomy is structured. For each category, representative methods are elaborated to describe the landscape of relevant research. In addition, comparison between latest methods is conducted on their officially reported results to provide in-depth discussions on their limitations. Finally, we summarize the open challenges and propose the promosing avenues for future studies. All related contents are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/instruction_tuning_data_survey-B307.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
In this paper, the authors present a survey on data assessment and selection methods for instruction tuning of LLMs. This is an important topic with a possibility of significant impact on future research. The authors systematically categorize the literature into three main perspectives: quality, diversity, and importance. Next, for each category, representative methods from both model-based and hand-based indicators are elaborated. The survey also includes an empirical comparison between different approaches. After introducing related works, the paper proposed a number of open questions for the research community to consider.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: 1. The paper does a good and detailed survey of an important topic. Each approach has been explained with clarity. 2. The empirical results and discussions in section 6 covering different approaches, LLMs, and test datasets can be really helpful to the community. 3. Summarized and proposed a list of open research questions for future research. Weaknesses: I did not find any major concern with this survey. 1. There are some formatting issues with quotation marks throughout the paper. 2. Some algorithms could benefit from bit more detailed descriptions for easy understanding by a reader without any background in this field. In general, I appreciate the author's work. Overall, this is a very comprehensive survey analyzing an important field.

**Requested Changes:**
1. Fix the formatting inconsistencies with quotation marks throughout the paper. 2. I request the authors to provide more detailed descriptions of the algorithms for easier understanding. Although it is optional.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
There are no concerns about the broader impact of the work.

Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 释放数据海啸的力量：语言模型指令调优中数据评估与选择的全面综述

paper_title: Holistic approaches to living well with endometriosis
paper_abstract:
Endometriosis is a common chronic non curable neuro-inflammatory condition, which can cause endometriosis-related pelvic pain (ERPP). Sufferers may struggle with side effects and/or risks from conventional medical and surgical treatments, or not get pain relief. Increasing numbers of endometriosis patients wish to explore holistic management with fewer side effects, however it is important that medical professionals maintain an evidence-based practice for recommended treatments. We present up-to-date evidence of holistic strategies used for managing ERPP including nutrition, body and mind therapies, acupuncture, traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) and the use of adjunct devices such as phallus length reducers and transcutaneous electrical nerve stimulation (TENS). 
   
     Recent findings: 
     
       Nutrition: Gluten-free, low-nickel and high intake of omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids diets improve ERPP. Low FODMAP (fermentable oligo-, di-, monosaccharides and polyols), plant-based diet and antioxidant vitamin supplementation is helpful including those with concurrent irritable bowel syndrome. 
     
       Body and Mind: Cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT) is beneficial in postoperative pain reduction, whilst mindfulness has been shown to reduce pain scores and dyschezia. Progressive muscle relaxation therapy and regular yoga sessions improve ERPP and Quality of life. 
     
       Acupuncture: Acupuncture and moxibustion show improved pain scores compared to conventional therapies alone. 
     
       Adjunct devices: TENS improves deep dyspareunia and reduces the number of days pain is experienced. 
   
   
     Summary: 
     Holistic management strategies for ERPP should be incorporated into routine counselling when discussing conservative, medical and or surgical treatments for endometriosis. The growing evidence presented for the use of holistic management strategies gives hope to those patients who cannot have, or don’t respond to conventional approaches and as an adjunct alongside standard treatments. These findings should be incorporated into the routine counselling when seeing patients in the gynaecology outpatient setting presenting with chronic pelvic pain.
review_content:
Endometriosis is an incurable disorder and as the authors correctly state patients are often keen to try non-medical approaches to manage symptoms including chronic pain, bloating and fatigue. Some approaches including physiotherapy are often included in multidisciplinary care and information on patient websites includes a wide range of complementary therapies some of which are discussed in this review [https://www.endometriosis-uk.org/].

The authors are to be commended on bringing together information about a very wide range of potential interventions and their assessment that many individuals with symptomatic endometriosis are keen to explore self management and alternative therapies as part of their care plan is something increasingly reported by health care professionals.
The section entitled ‘Recent findings’ makes some dogmatic statements and it was not clear they were backed up by the latest data – this was particularly true of nutrition which is a fast moving field.

Given the importance of the topic it is of concern that there appears to be an overall lack of ‘balance’ in the paper with a lot of emphasis in the first section placed on a systematic reviews – REFs 1-5, 8,9,12.
In some parts of the text it is hard to know if the results discussed relate to individuals with CPP or those with CPP/Endo so careful re-reading and clarification of is advised (examples include yoga, TENS, mindfulness). [table of mind and body therapies?]

It is recommended that the authors assemble information from relevant high quality original information from trials in tables – this would be more useful to the reader than simple text. Authors are referred to a number of recent reviews related to the impact of diet, inflammation and the gut brain axis as sources of information.
Additional References
Esprit2 trial has a published protocol [Ref -1].
Reference 6 is to a protocol – the trial has been completed and the correct reference is
[Ref -2]
In section on nutrition it would be useful to mention GWAS and other data that support patient experience of IBS-like symptoms in association with endometriosis (includes abdominal bloating [Ref-3], diarrhoea etc).
Recent paper [Ref-3]
No mention of botox for treatment of pelvic floor pain although there are reports it is effective · [Ref -4]
The section on cannabinoids is very brief which seems at odds with the widespread use of CBD in management of chronic pain, in some countries they are prescribed and there are several trials for endometriosis CPP underway – add more references. [Ref 5-7]

paper_title_zh: "全面方法：与子宫内膜异位症和谐共处"
paper_abstract_zh:
子宫内膜异位症是一种常见的慢性不可治愈的神经炎症性疾病，可导致子宫内膜异位症相关盆腔疼痛（ERPP）。患者可能因传统药物和手术治疗带来的副作用和/或风险而困扰，或未能获得疼痛缓解。越来越多的子宫内膜异位症患者希望探索副作用较小的整体管理方法，然而，医疗专业人员维持基于证据的实践以推荐治疗至关重要。我们提供了最新的整体策略证据，用于管理ERPP，包括营养、身心疗法、针灸、传统中医（TCM）以及辅助设备的使用，如阴茎长度缩减器和经皮神经电刺激（TENS）。

最新发现：

营养：无麸质、低镍和高摄入ω-3多不饱和脂肪酸的饮食改善ERPP。低FODMAP（可发酵的低聚糖、双糖、单糖和多元醇）、植物性饮食和抗氧化维生素补充有助于改善症状，包括那些同时患有肠易激综合征的患者。

身心疗法：认知行为疗法（CBT）在术后疼痛减少中有益，而正念已被证明可以降低疼痛评分和排便困难。渐进性肌肉放松疗法和定期瑜伽课程改善ERPP和生活质量。

针灸：针灸和艾灸在改善疼痛评分方面优于单独的传统疗法。

辅助设备：TENS改善深部性交痛并减少疼痛天数。

总结：

在讨论子宫内膜异位症的保守、药物和/或手术治疗时，应将ERPP的整体管理策略纳入常规咨询。越来越多的证据支持使用整体管理策略，为那些无法接受或对传统方法无反应的患者带来了希望，并可作为标准治疗的辅助手段。这些发现应纳入妇科门诊慢性盆腔疼痛患者的常规咨询中。

paper_title: Shifting paradigm of maternal and perinatal death review system in Bangladesh: A real time approach to address sustainable developmental goal 3 by 2030
paper_abstract:
Recently, Bangladesh has made remarkable progress in reducing maternal and neonatal morality, even though the millennium developmental goal to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality was not achieved. Sustainable Developmental Goal (SDG) 3 has already been set for a new target to reduce maternal and neonatal deaths by 2030. The country takes this timely initiative to introduce a maternal and perinatal death review system. This review will discuss the shifting paradigm of the maternal and perinatal death review system in Bangladesh and its challenges in reaching the SDG on time. This review uses existing literature on the maternal and perinatal death review system in Bangladesh, and other systems in similar settings, as well as reports, case studies, news, government letters and meeting minutes. 
Bangladesh introduced the maternal and perinatal death review system in 2010. Prior to this there was no such comprehensive death review system practiced in Bangladesh. The system was established within the government health system and has brought about positive effects and outcomes. Therefore, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare of Bangladesh gradually scaled up the maternal and perinatal death review system nationwide in 2016 within the government health system. The present death review system highlighted real-time data use, using the district health information software(DHIS-2). Health mangers are able to take remedial action plans and implement strategies based on findings in DHIS-2. Therefore, effective utilization of data can play a pivotal role in the reduction of maternal and perinatal deaths in Bangladesh. 
Overall, the maternal and perinatal death review system provides a great opportunity to achieve the SDG 3 on time. However, the system needs continuous monitoring at different levels to ensure its quality and validity of information, as well as effective utilization of findings for planning and implementation under a measureable accountability framework.
review_content:
This is a well-written review article and highlights an intervention for a very important public health problem - maternal deaths in low and middle income countries. The article is a very fine contribution to the literature.

It could be further strengthened by providing specific recommendations on the way forward regarding maternal death notification, review and response in Bangladesh based on findings from other countries - perhaps, these recommendations could be presented in a table highlighting identified challenges and potential solutions. Similarly, a box or panel highlighting the essential components of the perinatal and maternal death review system in Bangladesh will also be useful for readers.

The abstract could be rewritten as a summary of the literature review (highlighting the reason for the literature review, and briefly summarizing each segment of the paper). The abstract and paper could use further editing for typos.
paper_title_zh: 孟加拉国母婴及围产期死亡审查系统范式转变：实时方法应对2030年可持续发展目标3
paper_abstract_zh:
近年来，孟加拉国在降低孕产妇和新生儿死亡率方面取得了显著进展，尽管未能实现千年发展目标中降低孕产妇和新生儿死亡率的目标。可持续发展目标（SDG）3已设定新的目标，即到2030年减少孕产妇和新生儿死亡。该国及时采取行动，引入孕产妇和围产期死亡审查系统。本文将讨论孟加拉国孕产妇和围产期死亡审查系统的范式转变及其在按时实现SDG目标中面临的挑战。本文综述了孟加拉国孕产妇和围产期死亡审查系统的现有文献，以及其他类似环境中的系统，还包括报告、案例研究、新闻、政府信函和会议记录。

孟加拉国于2010年引入孕产妇和围产期死亡审查系统。在此之前，孟加拉国没有实施过如此全面的死亡审查系统。该系统在政府卫生系统内建立，并已带来积极的效果和成果。因此，孟加拉国卫生和家庭福利部于2016年在政府卫生系统内逐步将孕产妇和围产期死亡审查系统推广至全国。当前的死亡审查系统强调实时数据使用，采用区级卫生信息软件（DHIS-2）。卫生管理人员能够根据DHIS-2中的发现制定补救行动计划并实施策略。因此，有效利用数据在减少孟加拉国孕产妇和围产期死亡中可发挥关键作用。

总体而言，孕产妇和围产期死亡审查系统为实现SDG 3目标提供了巨大机会。然而，该系统需要在不同层面进行持续监控，以确保其信息质量和有效性，以及在一个可衡量的问责框架下对发现的有效利用，以进行规划和实施。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇写得很好的综述文章，突出了一种针对非常重要公共卫生问题的干预措施——低收入和中收入国家的孕产妇死亡。该文章对文献做出了非常宝贵的贡献。

通过基于其他国家的发现，提供关于孟加拉国孕产妇死亡通知、审查和响应的具体建议，可以进一步强化文章——或许，这些建议可以以表格形式呈现，突出已识别的挑战和潜在解决方案。同样，一个突出孟加拉国围产期和孕产妇死亡审查系统基本组成部分的框或面板，对读者也将非常有用。

摘要可以重写为文献综述的总结（突出文献综述的原因，并简要概述文章的每个部分）。摘要和论文可以进一步编辑以纠正错别字。

reasons: This is a well-written review article and highlights an intervention for a very important public health problem - maternal deaths in low and middle income countries.
The article is a very fine contribution to the literature.
The abstract could be rewritten as a summary of the literature review (highlighting the reason for the literature review, and briefly summarizing each segment of the paper).
The abstract and paper could use further editing for typos.

It could be further strengthened by providing specific recommendations on the way forward regarding maternal death notification, review and response in Bangladesh based on findings from other countries - perhaps, these recommendations could be presented in a table highlighting identified challenges and potential solutions.
Similarly, a box or panel highlighting the essential components of the perinatal and maternal death review system in Bangladesh will also be useful for readers.
The abstract could be rewritten as a summary of the literature review (highlighting the reason for the literature review, and briefly summarizing each segment of the paper).

paper_title: Improving
paper_abstract: On the 26th January 2023, a free to attend, ‘improving in vivo snake venom research: a community discussion’ meeting was held virtually. This webinar brought together researchers from around the world to discuss current neutralisation of venom lethality mouse assays that are used globally to assess the efficacy of therapies for snakebite envenoming. The assay’s strengths and weaknesses were highlighted, and we discussed what improvements could be made to refine and reduce animal testing, whilst supporting preclinical antivenom and drug discovery for snakebite envenoming. This report summarises the issues highlighted, the discussions held, with additional commentary on key perspectives provided by the authors.
review_content:
This opinion article describes the topics presented and discussed at the meeting “Improving in vivo snake venom research” (2023), organized by the Center for Snakebite Research and Interventions of Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine (UK).

In the manuscript, the use of the murine model to determine the lethality of snake venoms and its neutralization by antivenoms was discussed, as well as suggestions for refining the model, with the aim of meeting the 3Rs principle in the use of animals. The authors also gather references that support the discussion of the topic and the proposed adaptations/modifications. This is a topic of great relevance not only for those directly involved in the area, but for the scientific community in general.

Major points:
The authors describe the standardized murine model for neutralization of venom lethality and comment on the advantages of the assay that led to its success/widespread use. However, the manuscript focuses on discussing the limitations of the model, especially regarding its ethical issues and scientific validity. Refinements to the standard neutralization of lethality assay were described, as well as a modified version with reduced number of mice required. Importantly, the need and the challenges of the implementation of humane endpoints are discussed.

Minor points:
The authors give an historical overview of the development and standardization of the murine model for accessing the snake venom lethality and its neutralization.
Additionally, authors give examples of alternatives to lethality model considering the pathophysiology of the envenomation caused by genera Echis, Bothrops, Naja and Daboia.

I only suggest a review by the authors to amend some writing/typing mistakes.
paper_title_zh: 改进
paper_abstract_zh: 2023年1月26日，举办了一场免费参加的线上会议——“改善体内蛇毒研究：社区讨论”。此次网络研讨会汇聚了来自世界各地的研究人员，共同讨论了目前全球用于评估蛇咬伤中毒疗法有效性的小鼠毒液致死性中和试验。会议突出了该试验的优势和劣势，并探讨了如何改进以精简和减少动物试验，同时支持蛇咬伤中毒的 preclinical 抗毒液和药物发现。本报告总结了所突出的问题、所进行的讨论，并附上了作者对关键观点的额外评论。
review_content_zh:
这篇评论文章描述了在利物浦热带医学院（英国）的蛇伤研究与干预中心组织的“改善体内蛇毒研究”会议（2023年）上呈现和讨论的主题。

在文稿中，讨论了使用小鼠模型来确定蛇毒的致死性及其通过抗蛇毒血清的中和作用，以及为满足动物使用中的3Rs原则而对该模型进行改进的建议。作者还收集了支持该主题讨论和所提议的调整/修改的参考文献。这一主题不仅对直接参与该领域的人员具有重要意义，对整个科学界也是如此。

主要观点：
作者描述了用于中和蛇毒致死性的标准化小鼠模型，并评论了导致其成功/广泛使用的试验优势。然而，文稿重点讨论了该模型的局限性，尤其是其伦理问题和科学有效性。描述了对标准致死性中和试验的改进，以及一种减少所需小鼠数量的修改版本。重要的是，讨论了实施人道终点的必要性和挑战。

次要观点：
作者对用于评估蛇毒致死性及其中和作用的小鼠模型的发展和历史标准化进行了概述。
此外，作者还举例说明了考虑到由埃希斯属、波托斯属、纳贾属和达博亚属引起的毒血症病理生理学的致死性模型的替代方法。

我只建议作者对一些写作/打字错误进行修订。

paper_title: Shifting paradigm of maternal and perinatal death review system in Bangladesh: A real time approach to address sustainable developmental goal 3 by 2030
paper_abstract:
Recently, Bangladesh has made remarkable progress in reducing maternal and neonatal morality, even though the millennium developmental goal to reduce maternal and neonatal mortality was not achieved. Sustainable Developmental Goal (SDG) 3 has already been set for a new target to reduce maternal and neonatal deaths by 2030. The country takes this timely initiative to introduce a maternal and perinatal death review system. This review will discuss the shifting paradigm of the maternal and perinatal death review system in Bangladesh and its challenges in reaching the SDG on time. This review uses existing literature on the maternal and perinatal death review system in Bangladesh, and other systems in similar settings, as well as reports, case studies, news, government letters and meeting minutes. 
Bangladesh introduced the maternal and perinatal death review system in 2010. Prior to this there was no such comprehensive death review system practiced in Bangladesh. The system was established within the government health system and has brought about positive effects and outcomes. Therefore, the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare of Bangladesh gradually scaled up the maternal and perinatal death review system nationwide in 2016 within the government health system. The present death review system highlighted real-time data use, using the district health information software(DHIS-2). Health mangers are able to take remedial action plans and implement strategies based on findings in DHIS-2. Therefore, effective utilization of data can play a pivotal role in the reduction of maternal and perinatal deaths in Bangladesh. 
Overall, the maternal and perinatal death review system provides a great opportunity to achieve the SDG 3 on time. However, the system needs continuous monitoring at different levels to ensure its quality and validity of information, as well as effective utilization of findings for planning and implementation under a measureable accountability framework.

paper_title: The effects of hip-and ankle-focused exercise intervention on dynamic knee valgus: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. A range of non-contact injuries such as anterior cruciate ligament tear, patellar displacement and patellofemoral pain syndrome are caused by disordered knee joint loading from excessive dynamic knee valgus (DKV). Previous systematic reviews showed that DKV could be modified through the influence of hip strength and ankle range of motion. There was also a narrative review that investigated hip-focused neuromuscular exercise intervention on DKV. Therefore, the purpose of this systematic review was to examine the effects of exercise intervention which involved either top-down or bottom-up kinetic chains on minimizing DKV in male and female adults and adolescents, with and without existing knee pain . Methodology. Electronic searches were conducted in SAGE, Science Direct, SCOPUS, and Pubmed. The search strategy consisted of the medical subject headings and the free-text search keywords, synonyms and variations of 'exercise intervention,' 'knee alignment,' 'dynamic knee valgus', 'knee abduction' that were merged via the Boolean operator 'AND' and 'OR'. The search was conducted on full-text journals that documented the impact of the exercise intervention program involving either the bottom-up or top-down DKV mechanism on the knee kinematics. Furthermore, exercise intervention in this review should last at least one week which included two or three sessions per week. This review also considered both men and women of all ages with a healthy or symptomatic knee problem. The risk of bias of the included studies was assessed by Cochrane risk assessment tool. The protocol of this review was registered at PROSPERO (registration number: CRD42021219121). Results.Ten studies with a total of 289 participants (male= 122, female= 321; adults= 230, adolescents= 142; pre-adolescent= 51) met the inclusion criteria were included in this review. Seven studies showed the significant effects of the exercise intervention program (range from two weeks to ten weeks) on reducing DKV. The exercise training in these seven studies focused on muscle groups directly attached to the knee joint such as hamstrings and gastrocnemius.

However, there is no discussion by the authors on their perspective of if a top-down or bottom-up approach is more appropriate when using exercise interventions to improve DKV. Since this emphasis was made in the Introduction, a few sentences to acknowledge and discuss this should be added to the Discussion or Conclusion section. This would greatly strengthen the systematic review. Thank you for your feedback. We have included sentences about the kinetic chains in the Discussion and Conclusion sections. Discussion: 1st paragraph: Previous systematic reviews revealed the association of increased ankle dorsiflexion ROM (i.e., bottom-up kinetic chain) and hip strength (i.e., top-down kinetic chain) in reducing DKV (Lima et al., 2018; Dix et al., 2018). Additionally, a narrative review found that neuromuscular exercises targeting hip musculature strength may alter the DKV (Ford et al., 2015). However, to date, there is no systematic review investigating the impact of exercise intervention based on top-down and bottom-up kinetic chains on DKV. 2nd paragraph: . The experimental group performed functional weight bearing exercises aimed at reducing knee valgus angle and open and closed kinetic chain exercises to promote hip muscle activation. Thus, the exercises training involved a top-down kinetic chain that emphasized hip muscle to reduce knee valgus. 3rd paragraph: The exercises in the NMT group included a combination of top-down and bottom-up kinetic chain exercises that were focused on enhancing hamstrings muscular strength and ankle motion control to alter knee mechanics. 4th paragraph: A new study is included following the inclusion of ‘knee abduction’ search term. 5th paragraph: The intervention program was comprised of hip- and ankle-focused muscle strengthening and ankle flexibility exercises for two to three weeks. Therefore, the intervention program used a combination of top-down and bottom-up kinetic chain to reduce knee valgus. 6th paragraph: Baldon et al., (2014) found that functional stabilization training (FST) consisted of hip muscle strengthening, lower limb and trunk movement control exercises (i.e., a combination of top-down and bottom-up kinetic chain exercises), modified the knee kinematics in the frontal plane during single leg squat (SLS). 7th paragraph: A new study is included following the inclusion of ‘knee abduction’ search term. 8th paragraph: Saad et al., (2018) reported that eight weeks of hip and quadriceps exercises (i.e., top-down kinetic chain) significantly reduced knee valgus angle during step tasks. 9th paragraph: Czasche et al. (2017) reported a change in the medial/lateral loading of the knee following eight weeks of lower limb strength training (i.e., top-down kinetic chain) despite a small non-statistically significant difference in the kinematics and GRF during drop landing. 10th paragraph: A new study is included following the inclusion of ‘knee abduction’ search term. 11th paragraph: Araújo et al. (2017) reported no significant differences in transverse plane knee kinematics during step-down task among women with DKV. The five exercises in the experimental group comprised hip and trunk (i.e., top-down kinetic chain) muscle strengthening exercises for three sessions per week. To the best of our knowledge, this study represented one of the negative findings about top-down kinetic chain exercises on DKV. Conclusion (L360-375): In this review, we investigated the effects of exercise interventions, based on either top-down or bottom-up kinetic chains, on minimizing DKV during specific tasks. As DKV is one of the main factors that could increase the risk of lower limb injury, findings from this review highlighted the importance of prescribing exercise training program to improve DKV. Four studies (Barendrecht et al., 2011; Bell et al., 2013; Baldon et al., 2014; Thompson-Kolesar et al., 2017) found significant changes in knee valgus following a training program that combined both top-down and bottom-up kinetic chain exercises. Three studies (Sheerin, Hume, and Whattman, 2012; Saad et al., 2018; Jeong et al., 2021) discovered that top-down kinetic chain exercise intervention programs were also effective in reducing knee valgus. However, McCurdy et al., (2012), Czasche et al., (2017) and Araújo et al., (2017) did not detect any significant effects of the exercise intervention in minimizing DKV. Therefore, we concluded that a combination hip- and ankle- focused exercises and hip-focused (top-down kinetic chain) exercises only are more favorable than exercise program consisted of ankle-focused (bottom-up kinetic chain) exercises only. Apart from focusing on the load and volume of prescribed exercises, the specificity of exercises should also be emphasized. These findings might help the athletes and coaches to design appropriate exercise programs in reducing DKV.
paper_title_zh: 髋关节和踝关节聚焦运动干预对动态膝外翻的影响：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。一系列非接触性损伤，如前交叉韧带撕裂、髌骨位移和髌股疼痛综合征，是由过度的动态膝外翻（DKV）引起的膝关节负荷紊乱所致。之前的系统综述显示，DKV可以通过髋部力量和踝关节活动范围的影响进行改善。还有一篇叙述性综述研究了针对髋部的神经肌肉锻炼干预对DKV的影响。因此，本系统综述的目的是考察涉及自上而下或自下而上动力链的锻炼干预在减少男性和女性成年人及青少年（无论是否存在现有膝痛）DKV方面的效果。方法学。在SAGE、Science Direct、SCOPUS和Pubmed数据库中进行电子检索。检索策略包括医学主题词和自由文本搜索关键词、同义词及“锻炼干预”、“膝关节对齐”、“动态膝外翻”、“膝关节外展”的变体，通过布尔运算符“AND”和“OR”进行合并。检索对象为全文期刊，记录了涉及自下而上或自上而下DKV机制的锻炼干预计划对膝关节运动学的影响。此外，本综述中的锻炼干预应至少持续一周，包括每周两到三次的锻炼。本综述还考虑了所有年龄段的男性和女性，无论其膝关节是否健康或有症状。纳入研究的偏倚风险通过Cochrane风险评估工具进行评估。本综述的方案在PROSPERO注册（注册号：CRD42021219121）。结果。共有10项研究，总计289名参与者（男性=122，女性=321；成年人=230，青少年=142；前青春期=51）符合纳入标准，被纳入本综述。其中7项研究表明，锻炼干预计划（持续时间为两周至十周）在减少DKV方面具有显著效果。这些研究的锻炼训练重点针对直接附着于膝关节的肌肉群，如腘绳肌和小腿三头肌。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2的评论已按如下方式处理：

第35行
审稿人评论：我想知道为什么你没有在“膝关节对齐”和“动态膝外翻”之外使用“膝关节外展”这一搜索词。在指代膝关节塌陷动作时，该动作常导致在着陆和变向等任务中受伤，“膝关节外展”一词通常与“膝关节外翻”交替使用。我觉得这可能是一个错失的机会，可能错过了符合你搜索标准的一些其他研究。

回应：谢谢，我们已经加入了“膝关节外展”这一术语并重新进行了搜索。我们找到了3篇额外的符合条件的研究论文。搜索策略包括医学主题词和自由文本搜索关键词，'运动干预'、'膝关节对齐'、'动态膝外翻'、'膝关节外展'的同义词和变体，通过布尔运算符'AND'和'OR'进行合并。

第38行
审稿人评论：从短语“…DKV机制对膝关节运动学的影响”中删除“the”。这样可以为你节省一个字数。

回应：我们已经删除了。搜索是在全文期刊中进行的，这些期刊记录了涉及自下而上或自上而下DKV机制的锻炼干预计划对膝关节运动学的影响。

第39-40行
审稿人评论：考虑修改这个句子，它读起来像是一个不完整的思想。

回应：我们已经修改了句子。此外，本综述中的运动干预应至少持续一周，包括每周两到三次的锻炼。

第45行
审稿人评论：从短语“…符合纳入标准的…”中删除“which”。

回应：我们已经删除了。共有10项研究，总计289名参与者（男性=122，女性=321；成人=230，青少年=142；前青少年=51）符合纳入标准，被纳入本综述。

第53行
审稿人评论：你在摘要中没有讨论训练量或负荷的先前影响，所以这个结论有点偏离主题。你在摘要中唯一提到的是，专注于直接跨越膝关节的肌肉的干预比专注于躯干肌肉的干预更成功。请修改。

回应：我们已经删除了该句子，并修改了关于跨越膝关节肌肉的前一句话。结论：针对特定膝关节肌肉的锻炼，无论是自上而下还是自下而上的动力链，都可能减少DKV的形成。专注于特定膝关节肌肉的锻炼干预可能减少DKV，而不是训练负荷和量。

第53行
审稿人评论：将“这些结果…”改为“这些结果…”。

回应：我们已经修改了。这些结果可能帮助运动员和教练制定有效的锻炼计划，以最小化DKV，并最终预防下肢受伤。

第54行
审稿人评论：从短语“…可以最小化膝关节外翻…”中删除“the”。

回应：我们已经删除了。这些结果可能帮助运动员和教练制定有效的锻炼计划，以最小化DKV，并最终预防下肢受伤。 61 已从短语“…DKV可由髋关节外展肌无力引起…”中删除“the”。已删除。DKV可由导致髋关节内旋、膝关节过度前向对齐或胫骨旋转角度以及对侧骨盆下降的髋关节外展肌无力引起（Powers, 2010）。

66 修改为“两种类型的动力链在…中起作用”。已修改。两种类型的动力链在DKV机制中起主要作用，即自上而下（近端起源）和自下而上（远端起源）的动力链（Jamaludin等，2020）。

76 从短语“过度DKV和内部关节负荷”中删除“the”。已删除。先前研究旨在寻找过度DKV和膝关节内部负荷的来源，以预防如ACL拉伤等下肢损伤（Nessler, Denney & Sampley, 2017）。

76 当你说“内部关节负荷”时，你指的是什么？你是指特定的ACL负荷吗？软骨负荷？请澄清。已改为“膝关节负荷”。先前研究旨在寻找过度DKV和膝关节内部负荷的来源，以预防如ACL拉伤等下肢损伤（Nessler, Denney & Sampley, 2017）。

86 请澄清“无症状女性”的含义。是指她们没有受伤？还是没有膝关节疼痛？我们定义为无任何损伤。无症状（即无任何损伤）女性的DKV。

89：这一对叙事综述的批评是针对所有叙事综述的吗？还是特指Ford等人撰写的综述？请修改以明确。已修改为“…Ford等人（2015）的叙事综述…”。然而，Ford等人（2015）的叙事综述排除了深入和系统的文献搜索方法，因此可能遗漏了若干相关论文。

93-95 将“锻炼训练计划”改为“锻炼训练方案”。已修改。该综述将阐明进一步研究锻炼训练方案如何改善膝关节损伤机制至关重要。膝关节力学。

93-95 我认为研究锻炼训练方案如何改善膝关节力学机制并不关键，关键在于理解这些锻炼训练方案如何改善膝关节损伤背后的机制。请修改。已将句子修改为：该综述将阐明进一步研究锻炼训练方案如何改善膝关节损伤机制至关重要。膝关节力学。

109 再次，我认为这里需要一些关于为什么“膝关节外展”没有被用作搜索术语的背景信息。这可以是对审稿人的回应。但我想知道为什么没有使用，以及你认为这是否会影响到你的系统综述的结论？我们已包括术语“膝关节外展”并重新进行搜索。 三个短语通过布尔运算符“AND”和“OR”合并用于搜索数据库：即“运动干预”、“训练”、“膝关节对齐”、“动态膝外翻”、“膝关节外展”。表1 您认为将一项针对肥胖儿童的研究（Horsak等人，2019年）作为综述中包含的8项研究之一是否合适？我之所以这样问，是因为肥胖是一个特殊人群，肥胖因素是导致DKV的主要驱动因素之一。将针对肥胖儿童进行的干预与其他7项针对平均体重、休闲活动的成年人的研究进行比较，可能并不合适。感谢您的反馈。我们已删除该研究（Horsak等人，2019年）。175 句子“…用于视觉确认膝外翻的存在”令人困惑。请修改以澄清。句子已修改为：同时，Bell等人（2013年）在双腿深蹲（DLS）过程中视觉确认膝外翻的存在 193 从短语“…可能改变DKV…”中删除“the”。该词已被删除。此外，一篇叙述性综述发现，针对髋部肌肉力量的神经肌肉训练可能改变DKV（Ford等人，2015年）。216-218 这是一个不完整的句子，请修改。句子已修改。实验组进行了旨在减少膝外翻角度的功能性负重训练以及开放和闭合动力链训练，以促进髋部肌肉激活。因此，训练涉及自上而下的动力链，强调髋部肌肉以减少膝外翻 272-276 这个句子读起来有些混乱。请修改以澄清。句子已修改。然而，必须强调的是，本研究中参与者的体力活动水平未进行评估或控制，这可能影响了结果。然而，需要注意的是，本研究中参与者的体力活动水平未进行评估或控制，因此可能会影响结果。283-284 我建议重新检查这一发现。仅加强股四头肌应影响膝关节伸肌，而不是膝关节屈肌。该句子已被删除。讨论与结论 在引言的L94-96中提到，尚未有系统综述专注于从自上而下或自下而上的角度研究运动干预。在讨论中，综述中使用的8项研究被识别为自上而下或自下而上。然而，作者未讨论在采用运动干预改善DKV时，自上而下或自下而上的方法哪种更合适。由于引言中强调了这一点，应在讨论或结论部分添加几句话来承认和讨论这一点。这将大大加强系统综述。感谢您的反馈。 我们在讨论和结论部分中包含了关于动力链的句子。

讨论：
第一段：之前的系统综述揭示了增加踝关节背屈活动范围（即自下而上的动力链）和髋部力量（即自上而下的动力链）在减少DKV中的关联（Lima等，2018；Dix等，2018）。此外，一篇叙述性综述发现，针对髋部肌肉力量的神经肌肉训练可能会改变DKV（Ford等，2015）。然而，迄今为止，尚无系统综述研究基于自上而下和自下而上动力链的锻炼干预对DKV的影响。

第二段：实验组进行了旨在减少膝关节外翻角的功能性负重练习以及开放和闭合动力链练习，以促进髋部肌肉激活。因此，训练中的练习涉及自上而下的动力链，强调髋部肌肉以减少膝关节外翻。

第三段：NMT组的练习包括自上而下和自下而上动力链练习的组合，重点在于增强腘绳肌力量和踝关节运动控制，以改变膝关节力学。

第四段：在纳入“膝关节外展”搜索词后，包含了一项新研究。

第五段：干预项目包括为期两到三周的髋部和踝部肌肉强化以及踝关节灵活性练习。因此，干预项目使用了自上而下和自下而上动力链的组合来减少膝关节外翻。

第六段：Baldon等（2014）发现，功能性稳定训练（FST）包括髋部肌肉强化、下肢和躯干运动控制练习（即自上而下和自下而上动力链练习的组合），在单腿深蹲（SLS）期间改变了膝关节在额状面的运动学。

第七段：在纳入“膝关节外展”搜索词后，包含了一项新研究。

第八段：Saad等（2018）报告称，八周的髋部和股四头肌练习（即自上而下的动力链）显著减少了步态任务中的膝关节外翻角。

第九段：Czasche等（2017）报告称，八周的下肢力量训练（即自上而下的动力链）后，膝关节的内侧/外侧负荷发生了变化，尽管在落地时的运动学和地面反作用力（GRF）上存在小的非统计学显著差异。

第十段：在纳入“膝关节外展”搜索词后，包含了一项新研究。

第十一段：Araújo等（2017）报告称，在步降任务中，DKV女性的膝关节横断面运动学无显著差异。实验组的五项练习包括每周三次的髋部和躯干（即自上而下的动力链）肌肉强化练习。据我们所知，这项研究是关于自上而下动力链练习对DKV负面影响的少数研究之一。 结论（L360-375）：在本综述中，我们研究了基于自上而下或自下而上动力链的运动干预对在特定任务中减少动态膝外翻（DKV）的影响。由于DKV是增加下肢受伤风险的主要因素之一，本综述的发现强调了制定运动训练计划以改善DKV的重要性。四项研究（Barendrecht等，2011年；Bell等，2013年；Baldon等，2014年；Thompson-Kolesar等，2017年）发现，结合自上而下和自下而上动力链练习的训练计划显著改变了膝外翻。三项研究（Sheerin, Hume和Whattman，2012年；Saad等，2018年；Jeong等，2021年）发现，自上而下动力链运动干预计划在减少膝外翻方面也有效。然而，McCurdy等（2012年）、Czasche等（2017年）和Araújo等（2017年）未检测到运动干预在减少DKV方面的任何显著效果。因此，我们得出结论，结合髋部和踝部聚焦练习以及仅髋部聚焦（自上而下动力链）练习的运动计划，比仅由踝部聚焦（自下而上动力链）练习组成的运动计划更有利。除了关注规定练习的负荷和量之外，还应强调练习的特异性。这些发现可能有助于运动员和教练设计适当的运动计划以减少DKV。

paper_title: Therapeutic implications of statins in heart failure with reduced ejection fraction and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction: a review of current literature
paper_abstract: Statins are one of the standard treatments to prevent cardiovascular events such as coronary artery disease and heart failure (HF). However, data on the use of statins to improve clinical outcomes in patients with established HF remains controversial. We summarized available clinical studies which investigated the effects of statins on clinical outcomes in patients with HF with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF) and HF with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF). Statins possess many pleiotropic effects in addition to lipid-lowering properties that positively affect the pathophysiology of HF. In HFrEF, data from two large randomized placebo-controlled trials did not show benefits of statins on mortality of patients with HFrEF. However, more recent prospective cohort studies and meta-analyses have shown decreased risk of mortality as well as cardiovascular hospitalization with statins treatment. In HFpEF, most prospective and retrospective cohort studies as well as meta analyses have consistently reported positive effects of statins, including reducing mortality and improving other clinical outcomes. Current evidence also suggests better outcomes with lipophilic statins in patients with HF. In summary, statins might be effective in improving survival and other clinical outcomes in patients with HF, especially for patients with HFpEF. Lipophilic statins might also be more beneficial for HF patients. Based on current evidence, statins did not cause harm and should be continued in HF patients who are already taking the medication. Further randomized controlled trials are needed to clarify the benefits of statins in HF patients.
review_content:
This is a comprehensive review on the role of statins in heart failure both with reduced and preserved ejection fraction. The paper is well-written, informative and easy to read. The authors reported the most important studies and the meta-analysis on the topic in a very exhaustive manner.

Although some data are not analyzed in-depth the manuscript deserves indexing because it is very educational and useful.
paper_title_zh: 他汀类药物在射血分数降低型心力衰竭和射血分数保留型心力衰竭中的治疗意义：当前文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 他汀类药物是预防心血管事件（如冠状动脉疾病和心力衰竭（HF））的标准治疗方法之一。然而，关于使用他汀类药物改善已确诊HF患者临床结局的数据仍存在争议。我们总结了探讨他汀类药物对射血分数降低的HF（HFrEF）和射血分数保留的HF（HFpEF）患者临床结局影响的现有临床研究。除了降脂特性外，他汀类药物还具有许多多效性作用，这些作用对HF的病理生理学有积极影响。在HFrEF中，两项大型随机安慰剂对照试验的数据并未显示他汀类药物对HFrEF患者死亡率的有益影响。然而，更近期的前瞻性队列研究和荟萃分析显示，他汀类药物治疗可降低死亡风险及心血管住院风险。在HFpEF中，大多数前瞻性和回顾性队列研究以及荟萃分析一致报告了他汀类药物的积极效果，包括降低死亡率和改善其他临床结局。当前证据还表明，脂溶性他汀类药物在HF患者中可能具有更好的结局。总之，他汀类药物可能有效改善HF患者的生存率和其他临床结局，尤其是对HFpEF患者。脂溶性他汀类药物也可能对HF患者更有益。基于当前证据，他汀类药物未造成伤害，应继续用于已服用该药物的HF患者。需要进一步随机对照试验以明确他汀类药物在HF患者中的益处。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于他汀类药物在射血分数降低和保留的心力衰竭中作用的全面综述。该论文文笔流畅、信息丰富且易于阅读。作者以非常详尽的方式报告了该领域最重要的研究和元分析。

尽管某些数据未进行深入分析，但该手稿仍值得索引，因为它具有很高的教育性和实用性。

reasons: This is a comprehensive review on the role of statins in heart failure both with reduced and preserved ejection fraction.
The authors reported the most important studies and the meta-analysis on the topic in a very exhaustive manner.
Although some data are not analyzed in-depth the manuscript deserves indexing because it is very educational and useful.
The paper is well-written, informative and easy to read.

paper_title: Pollen report:Quantitative review of pollen crude protein concentrations offered by beepollinated flowers in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes
paper_abstract: To ease nutritional stress on managed as well as native bee populations in agricultural habitats, agro-environmental protection schemes aim to provide alternative nutritional resources for bee populations during times of need. However, such efforts have so far focused on quantity (supply of flowering plants) and timing (flower-scarce periods) while ignoring the quality of the two main bee relevant flower-derived resources (pollen and nectar). As a first step to address this issue we have compiled a geographically explicit dataset focusing on pollen crude protein concentration, one measurement traditionally associated with pollen quality for bees. We attempt to provide a robust baseline for protein levels bees can collect in-(crop and weed species) and off-field (wild) in agricultural habitats around the globe. Using this dataset we identify crops which provide sub-optimal pollen resources in terms of crude protein concentration for bees and suggest potential plant genera that could serve as alternative resources for protein. This information could be used by scientists, regulators, bee keepers, NGOs and farmers to compare the pollen quality currently offered in alternative foraging habitats and identify opportunities to improve them. In the long run we hope that additional markers of pollen quality will be added to the database in order to get a more complete picture of flower resources offered to bees and foster a data-informed discussion about pollinator conservation in modern agricultural landscape

paper_title_zh: 花粉报告：农业和非农业景观中蜜蜂授粉花朵提供的花粉粗蛋白浓度的定量综述
paper_abstract_zh: 为了缓解农业生境中人工饲养和野生蜜蜂种群的营养压力，农业环境保护计划旨在在蜜蜂需求时期为其提供替代性营养资源。然而，迄今为止此类努力主要集中在数量（开花植物供应）和时机（花朵稀缺期）上，而忽略了两种主要与蜜蜂相关的花源性资源（花粉和花蜜）的质量。作为解决这一问题的第一步，我们编制了一个地理明确的数据库，重点关注花粉粗蛋白浓度，这一传统上与蜜蜂花粉质量相关的测量指标。我们试图为全球农业生境中蜜蜂在田间（作物和杂草种类）和田间外（野生）可收集的蛋白质水平提供一个稳健的基线。利用这一数据集，我们识别出在粗蛋白浓度方面为蜜蜂提供次优花粉资源的作物，并建议潜在的植物属作为蛋白质的替代资源。这些信息可供科学家、监管机构、养蜂人、非政府组织和农民使用，以比较目前替代觅食生境中提供的花粉质量，并识别改善这些生境的机会。从长远来看，我们希望数据库中能增加更多花粉质量指标，以便更全面地了解提供给蜜蜂的花朵资源，并促进在现代农业景观中基于数据的传粉者保护讨论。

paper_title: The rise of testicular germ cell tumours: the search for causes, risk factors and novel therapeutic targets
paper_abstract: Since the beginning of the 20th century there has been a decline in the reproductive vitality of men within the Western world. The declining sperm quantity and quality has been associated with increased overt disorders of sexual development including hypospadias, undescended testes and type II testicular germ cell tumours (TGCTs). The increase in TGCTs cannot be accounted for by genetic changes in the population. Therefore exposure to environmental toxicants appears to be a major contributor to the aetiology of TGCTs and men with a genetic predisposition are particularly vulnerable. In particular, Type II TGCTs have been identified to arise from a precursor lesion Carcinoma in situ (CIS), identified as a dysfunctional gonocyte; however, the exact triggers for CIS development are currently unknown. Therefore the transition from gonocytes into spermatogonia is key to those studying TGCTs. Recently we have identified seven miRNA molecules (including members of the miR-290 family and miR-136, 463* and 743a) to be significantly changed over this transition period. These miRNA molecules are predicted to have targets within the CXCR4, PTEN, DHH, RAC and PDGF pathways, all of which have important roles in germ cell migration, proliferation and homing to the spermatogonial stem cell niche. Given the plethora of potential targets affected by each miRNA molecule, subtle changes in miRNA expression could have significant consequences e.g. tumourigenesis. The role of non-traditional oncogenes and tumour suppressors such as miRNA in TGCT is highlighted by the fact that the majority of these tumours express wild type p53, a pivotal tumour suppressor usually inactivated in cancer. While treatment of TGCTs is highly successful, the impact of these treatments on fertility means that identification of exact triggers, earlier diagnosis and alternate treatments are essential. This review examines the genetic factors and possible triggers of type II TGCT to highlight target areas for potential new treatments.
review_content: This article is a review discussing testicular germ cell tumours and how they may be triggered with an emphasis on miRNA expression. There are a few minor grammatical and spelling errors throughout this review but these do not impact on the quality of the manuscript. I would like to point out however that my area of expertise is primarily miRNA biology and I do not have a great background in TGCT.
paper_title_zh: 睾丸生殖细胞肿瘤的兴起：病因、风险因素及新型治疗靶点的探索
paper_abstract_zh: 自20世纪初以来，西方世界中男性的生殖活力出现了下降。精子数量和质量的下降与性发育显性障碍的增加有关，包括尿道下裂、隐睾和II型睾丸生殖细胞肿瘤（TGCTs）。TGCTs的增加不能仅通过人群中的遗传变化来解释。因此，暴露于环境毒物似乎是TGCTs病因的主要因素，具有遗传倾向的男性尤为易感。特别是，II型TGCTs被认为起源于前驱病变——原位癌（CIS），其被识别为功能失调的生殖母细胞；然而，CIS发展的确切触发因素目前尚不清楚。因此，生殖母细胞向精原细胞的转变是研究TGCTs的关键。最近，我们鉴定出七个miRNA分子（包括miR-290家族成员以及miR-136、463*和743a）在这一转变期间发生了显著变化。这些miRNA分子预测靶向CXCR4、PTEN、DHH、RAC和PDGF通路，这些通路在生殖细胞迁移、增殖和归巢至精原干细胞微环境中均发挥重要作用。鉴于每个miRNA分子影响的潜在靶点众多，miRNA表达的微小变化可能导致显著后果，例如肿瘤发生。miRNA等非传统致癌基因和肿瘤抑制因子在TGCT中的角色，通过大多数此类肿瘤表达野生型p53这一事实得以凸显，p53是一种关键的肿瘤抑制因子，通常在癌症中被失活。尽管TGCTs的治疗非常成功，但这些治疗对生育能力的影响意味着确定确切触发因素、早期诊断和替代治疗至关重要。本综述探讨了II型TGCT的遗传因素和可能的触发因素，以突出潜在新治疗的目标领域。
review_content_zh: 本文是一篇综述，讨论了睾丸生殖细胞肿瘤及其可能的触发机制，特别强调了miRNA表达的作用。在这篇综述中存在一些轻微的语法和拼写错误，但这些并不影响稿件的质量。然而，我想指出的是，我的专业领域主要是miRNA生物学，对TGCT的了解并不深入。

reasons: There are a few minor grammatical and spelling errors throughout this review but these do not impact on the quality of the manuscript.

paper_title: Making sense of the cause of Crohn’s – a new look at an old disease
paper_abstract: The cause of Crohn’s disease (CD) has posed a conundrum for at least a century. A large body of work coupled with recent technological advances in genome research have at last started to provide some of the answers. Initially this review seeks to explain and to differentiate between bowel inflammation in the primary immunodeficiencies that generally lead to very early onset diffuse bowel inflammation in humans and in animal models, and the real syndrome of CD. In the latter, a trigger, almost certainly enteric infection by one of a multitude of organisms, allows the faeces access to the tissues, at which stage the response of individuals predisposed to CD is abnormal. Direct investigation of patients’ inflammatory response together with genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and DNA sequencing indicate that in CD the failure of acute inflammation and the clearance of bacteria from the tissues, and from within cells, is defective. The retained faecal products result in the characteristic chronic granulomatous inflammation and adaptive immune response. In this review I will examine the contemporary evidence that has led to this understanding, and look for explanations for the recent dramatic increase in the incidence of this disease.
review_content: This is a very comprehensive review of the pathogenesis of Crohn's disease (CD). The paper thoroughly covers all relevant aspects, including epidemiology, microbiology, immunology, and genetics. In that regard, it is both holistic and reductionist -- a very rare combination nowadays. It is beautifully written and presents a fair account of the current state of knowledge. Importantly, it is not biased: it does not resemble any of the too many reviews on CD that provide more beliefs and opinions than facts. This is in my view the very best review ever written on CD. This is clearly a must-read for anyone interested in this condition.
paper_title_zh: 理解克罗恩病的原因——对一种古老疾病的新视角
paper_abstract_zh: 克罗恩病（CD）的病因至少在一个世纪以来一直是一个谜。大量研究工作结合基因组研究领域的最新技术进步，终于开始提供一些答案。本文首先试图解释并区分原发性免疫缺陷导致的肠道炎症，这种炎症通常在人类和动物模型中导致非常早期的弥漫性肠道炎症，与真正的克罗恩病综合征之间的区别。在后一种情况下，一个触发因素，几乎肯定是多种微生物之一引起的肠道感染，使得粪便能够接触到组织，在这一阶段，易患克罗恩病的个体的反应是异常的。直接研究患者的炎症反应，结合全基因组关联研究（GWAS）和DNA测序表明，在克罗恩病中，急性炎症的失败以及从组织和细胞内清除细菌的功能是缺陷的。残留的粪便产物导致特征性的慢性肉芽肿性炎症和适应性免疫反应。在本文中，我将审视导致这一理解的当代证据，并寻找解释近年来该病发病率急剧增加的原因。
review_content_zh: 这是一篇关于克罗恩病（CD）发病机制的非常全面的综述。该论文全面涵盖了所有相关方面，包括流行病学、微生物学、免疫学和遗传学。在这方面，它既具有整体性又具有还原性——这在当今是非常罕见的组合。文章写得非常优美，并公正地呈现了当前的知识状态。重要的是，它没有偏见：它不像许多关于CD的综述那样，提供更多的是信念和观点而非事实。在我看来，这是迄今为止关于CD写得最好的综述。对于任何对此病症感兴趣的人来说，这显然是必读之作。

The paper thoroughly covers all relevant aspects, including epidemiology, microbiology, immunology, and genetics.
This is clearly a must-read for anyone interested in this condition.
It is beautifully written and presents a fair account of the current state of knowledge.

paper_title: Emergency contraception from historical myth to modern reality: a historical timeline and updated interpretation
paper_abstract:
Introduction: Emergency contraception is the use of a birth control method after coitus has taken place and there is a fear that it may lead to a pregnancy. Historical attempts were more likely to be harmful rather than effective. Oral estrogens, progestins, anti-progesterone, and partial agonist/antagonists of progesterone have all been used with varying degrees of efficacy. Currently ethinyl estradiol/levonorgestrel combinations, levonorgestrel alone, ulipristal acetate, and mifepristone are the usual oral methods depending on availability. Copper carrying and more recently levonorgestrel releasing intrauterine devices have also been used successfully. The intrauterine devices appear to be more effective than the oral methods and are also regular contraceptive methods and in addition have therapeutic properties. 
 
 Background: The evolution from longer duration oral treatments with side effects to the current single tablet of levonorgestrel, ulipristal acetate, or mifepristone with low side effects and reasonable efficacy is described. The role of the highly effective copper intrauterine device and now also the levonorgestrel intrauterine device for emergency contraception is examined. 
 
 Conclusion: Oral emergency contraception is a short term solution. Expanding emergency contraception to include the levonorgestrel releasing intrauterine device may provide long term contraception and health benefits as well as providing emergency contraception.
review_content:
Thank you for the invitation to peer review this manuscript.

Overall, emergency contraception (EC) is indeed relevant and has evolved over decades with quite a few ‘backs and forths’. So its history would be interesting educational reading to both clinical and non-clinical audiences. This manuscript provides sufficient detail with over 100 references cited, hence warranting extra care with clarity and flow. It could also be improved significantly by more focus on facts and figures and excluding several digressions.

To ensure comprehensiveness, every new aspect of history reported needs to state the occurrence time in a manner that engages the reader without sounding repetitive - the year, or how soon before or after an incident or event that has been mentioned, etc. This has so far been partly done and should be improved upon please. For example, under the section "The copper bearing IUD" and subsection "Clinical evaluation of the emergency copper IUD", the first sentence "Lippes and colleagues published the first studies of the emergency copper IUD.69,70" is inadequate for this reason. Although the sentence has been referenced, a reader expects to see/learn what year this was in the text. Similarly inadequate appears the sentence in the same paragraph "The publication of the larger Yuzpe study71 rapidly dampened enthusiasm for the emergency IUD" - why... what year was this? There should be no need to sift through references to determine this.

For clarity and flow, the subheadings/sections/subsections created support the reading of this history and enable signposting. I believe this manuscript could benefit further by refining these to achieve more simplicity for the manuscript structure e.g. under each of the types of oral / intrauterine EC subheadings, have only history and evaluation (to include efficacy and future research) as further subsections, and discuss everything in paragraphs under these, and then summarise the structure in the introduction to guide audience. Other non-EC history issues discussed in the manuscript could be given a shorter section, e.g. within the introduction or prior to the conclusion, for mentions of EC IUDs as LARC and the argument about EC being an abortifacient. The current sections on these are quite long and probably even digress into issues that may be considered irrelevant to EC history or more of personal opinion e.g. that EC should be provided "... irrespective of day of cycle..." on page 11.

Extra revision of the manuscript could also improve clarity and flow throughout with these suggestions - ensuring the history detail is in sequences (1920s prior to 1960s); specifying the year, or number of years over which, a product was introduced or phased out; avoiding repetition especially in the introduction section; avoiding digression e.g. the sentence on page 4 "In order to use this method with modern oral contraceptives the tablets must be juggled around..." appears out of place and should be removed; several sentences could be split or shortened; sections should focus on their purpose e.g. introduction narrating some background and what the manuscript will discuss, while conclusion summarising EC history and potential future; the current conclusion seems to introduce new issues that are irrelevant to the topic and even cited a new reference that possibly belongs somewhere else - where did 'hook-up culture' and 'Tinder' come from and how are they relevant to EC history?

Unable to quickly find any better examples, kindly find here some links to articles that discuss contraception history to show use of specific times, shorter sentences and avoiding digression:

https://www.pandiahealth.com/resources/birth-control-throughout-history/

https://www.ellaone.co.uk/magazine/features/the-brief-history-of-contraception

https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/History_of_birth_control

"History of contraception": https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1744187006000874


With best wishes
paper_title_zh: 紧急避孕：从历史神话到现代现实——历史时间线与最新解读
paper_abstract_zh:
引言：紧急避孕是指在性行为发生后，因担心可能导致怀孕而采取的避孕方法。历史上的尝试往往更有害而非有效。口服雌激素、孕激素、抗孕激素以及孕激素的部分激动剂/拮抗剂都曾被使用，效果各异。目前，根据可获得性，常用的口服方法包括炔雌醇/左炔诺孕酮组合、单独的左炔诺孕酮、醋酸乌利司他以及米非司酮。含铜的和最近开发的左炔诺孕酮释放宫内节育器也已被成功使用。宫内节育器似乎比口服方法更有效，并且也是常规避孕方法，此外还具有治疗特性。

背景：本文描述了从具有副作用的长效口服治疗到目前副作用低且效果合理的单片左炔诺孕酮、醋酸乌利司他或米非司酮的演变过程。探讨了高效含铜宫内节育器以及现在也包括左炔诺孕酮宫内节育器在紧急避孕中的作用。

结论：口服紧急避孕是一种短期解决方案。将紧急避孕扩展到包括左炔诺孕酮释放宫内节育器，可能不仅提供长期避孕和健康益处，还能提供紧急避孕。
review_content_zh:
感谢您邀请我进行同行评审这篇手稿。

总体而言，紧急避孕（EC）确实是一个相关话题，并且经过数十年的发展，经历了不少“反复”。因此，其历史对于临床和非临床读者来说都是有趣的教育性读物。这篇手稿引用了100多篇参考文献，提供了足够的细节，因此需要特别关注清晰度和流畅性。通过更专注于事实和数据，并排除一些离题内容，可以显著提升文章质量。

为确保全面性，报告中每一个新的历史方面都需要以吸引读者的方式陈述发生时间，避免重复——例如年份，或在已提及事件之前或之后多久等。目前这一点部分已做到，但请进一步改进。例如，在“含铜宫内节育器”部分和“紧急含铜宫内节育器的临床评估”小节中，第一句“Lippes及其同事发表了关于紧急含铜宫内节育器的首批研究。69,70”因缺乏年份信息而不充分。尽管该句已有引用，但读者期望在文本中看到/了解具体年份。同样不充分的是同段落中的句子“较大规模的Yuzpe研究71的发表迅速抑制了对紧急宫内节育器的热情”——为何……这是哪一年？读者不应需要翻阅参考文献来确定这一点。

为了清晰和流畅，所创建的副标题/部分/小节支持对这一历史的阅读，并便于指引。我认为这篇手稿可以通过进一步精简这些结构以获得更多益处，例如在每个口服/宫内EC类型的副标题下，仅设历史和评估（包括有效性和未来研究）作为进一步的小节，并在这些小节下用段落讨论所有内容，然后在引言中总结结构以引导读者。手稿中讨论的其他非EC历史问题可以放在较短的章节中，例如在引言或结论之前，提及EC宫内节育器作为长效可逆避孕方法（LARC）和关于EC作为堕胎药的争论。目前关于这些内容的章节较长，甚至可能涉及与EC历史无关或更多个人观点的问题，例如第11页提到的EC应“……不论周期哪一天……”提供。

进一步修订手稿也可以通过这些建议提升全篇的清晰度和流畅性——确保历史细节按顺序排列（20世纪20年代先于60年代）；明确产品引入或淘汰的具体年份或年数；避免重复，尤其是在引言部分；避免离题，例如第4页的句子“为了与现代口服避孕药一起使用这种方法，必须对这些药片进行调配……”显得不合适，应删除；多个句子可以拆分或缩短；各部分应聚焦其目的，例如引言叙述背景和手稿将讨论的内容，而结论总结EC历史和潜在未来；目前的结论似乎引入了与主题无关的新问题，甚至引用了可能属于其他位置的新参考文献——‘勾搭文化’和‘Tinder’从何而来，它们与EC历史有何相关性？

未能迅速找到更好的示例，以下是一些讨论避孕历史的文章链接，展示了具体时间的使用、短句和避免离题：

paper_title: Current state of knowledge on Wolbachia infection among Coleoptera: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. Despite great progress in studies on Wolbachia infection in insects, the knowledge about its relations with beetle species, populations and individuals, and the effects of bacteria on these hosts is still unsatisfactory. In this review we summarize the current state of knowledge about Wolbachia occurrence and interactions with Coleopteran hosts. Methods. An intensive search of the available literature resulted in the selection of 81 publications that describe the relevant details about Wolbachia presence among beetles. These publications were then examined with respect to the distribution and taxonomy of infected hosts and diversity of Wolbachia found in beetles. Sequences of Wolbachia genes (16S rDNA, wsp and ftsZ) were used for the phylogenetic analyses.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) Basic reporting see below Experimental design see below Validity of the findings see below Comments for the Author Review for Peerj-21704 The paper by Kajtoch & Kotásková is a nice summary of current knowledge on Wolbachia in beetles. Wolbachia is arguably the most common, and may be the most important endosymbiont of arthropods. There are a lot of studies on Wolbachia in many host taxa, and especially for people new to this field, the large number of studies may be overwhelming. Reviews on endosymbionts of particular host taxa such as the one presented here are therefore very helpful and represent valuable resources for the community. I want to commend the authors for the effort put into compiling this dataset, which is mostly clearly presented and illustrated. The only major issue I see with this manuscript is the lack of any synthesis that goes beyond summarizing the findings of previous studies. It would be interesting to know if, in the authors opinion, beetles are peculiar Wolbachia hosts in any respect, or if there is something especially noteworthy that only seems to apply to beetles and not any other Wolbachia hosts. Furthermore, everything that is mentioned in the “outlook” section of the manuscript applies to Wolbachia studies in general and is not specific to Wolbachia-beetle interactions. > In our opinion, such systematic review paper should be focused on summary of current state of knowledge and this should as much objective as it is possible, so any personal opinion should be avoided. However, we followed recommendation of the Reviewer and short “opinion” chapter has been added (but please note that our opinions about need for future studies are already mentioned in “outlook” section). It is true that “outlook” section is not specific for beetles, but it could not be as there is no special science “Wolbachia in beetles” – this is and need to be a part of overall research on Wolbachia infection. However, in this section we tried to refer to specific papers on beetles and to issues which are still poorly known for beetle hosts (but sometimes much better studied for other hosts). In our opinion, such section is important as it shows which are missing issues in studies on Wolbachia in beetles. There are other -mostly minor- issues that should be addressed in a revision. Please find details on these below, hopefully constructive. Line 81ff: As potential addition to this list, there are reviews on mites (Chaisiri et al. 2015) and ants (Russell 2012) as well. The latter one also compares Wolbachia incidence between many different arthropod groups, and might be worth having a look for inspiration. > We have completed this list of publications by referring to above mentioned articles. Line 88: “[beetles] are the most species rich organisms on earth […]” – One often finds similar statements, but they do not make sense at all. Insects are even more species rich than beetles, and arthropods are more species rich than insects. This is just to illustrate that all phylogenetic ranks (except maybe species) are artificial, and therefore those statements should be avoided. > It is true, therefore we modified this description. L109–112: I don’t know of any study showing that Wolbachia is “responsible” for speciation, if the authors claim this here, it should be referenced with an example. > Again, we agree, that there are no studies which directly show that Wolbachia induced speciation of its hosts. Sentence has been rewritten to be more specific. L120–121: As far as I know, google searches always use the boolean “AND”, regardless if it is typed in the search field. > Yes, but we left this description as it is now valid in respect to WoS. L126: I searched my personal literature database and found a number of papers about Wolbachia in beetles that are not mentioned in your manuscript (Pankewitz et al. 2007; Chafee et al. 2010; Kageyama et al. 2010; Toju & Fukatsu 2010; Xue et al. 2011; Toju et al. 2013; Iwase et al. 2015). I am unsure whether this is due to these things not showing up in your search because the papers used are not listed anywhere separately. I would suggest to provide a list of all the papers used and, should you have missed the papers mentioned above, re-design your search strategy to accomodate potential shortcomings that have led to the oversight of these. Another way to discover potentially overlooked Wolbachia-beetle associations would be to check the NCBI nucleotide database for Wolbachia sequences from beetles. Maybe also worthwhile is to search the databases used by previous meta-analyses investigating global Wolbachia incidences (Weinert et al. 2007; Hilgenboecker et al. 2008; Russell 2012). > We are grateful for all these remarks. As
paper_title_zh: 鞘翅目昆虫沃尔巴克氏菌感染研究现状：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。尽管在昆虫沃尔巴克氏菌感染研究方面取得了巨大进展，但关于其与甲虫种类、种群和个体的关系，以及细菌对这些宿主的影响的知识仍然不尽如人意。在这篇综述中，我们总结了目前关于沃尔巴克氏菌在鞘翅目宿主中的发生及其相互作用的认知现状。方法。通过对现有文献的深入检索，筛选出81篇描述沃尔巴克氏菌在甲虫中存在的相关细节的出版物。这些出版物随后被用于分析感染宿主的分布和分类学，以及甲虫中发现的沃尔巴克氏菌的多样性。沃尔巴克氏菌基因序列（16S rDNA、wsp和ftsZ）被用于系统发育分析。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）

基本报告：见下文

实验设计：见下文

研究结果的有效性：见下文

对作者的评论：

对Peerj-21704的评审

Kajtoch和Kotásková的论文是对当前关于甲虫中沃尔巴克氏体（Wolbachia）知识的良好总结。沃尔巴克氏体可以说是节肢动物中最常见的内共生体，也可能是最重要的内共生体。关于沃尔巴克氏体在许多宿主类群中的研究有很多，尤其是对于刚进入这一领域的人来说，大量的研究可能会让人感到不知所措。因此，像本文所呈现的关于特定宿主类群内共生体的综述非常有帮助，并为学术界提供了宝贵的资源。我要赞扬作者在汇编这一数据集时所付出的努力，该数据集大多呈现清晰并配有插图。我认为这篇手稿的唯一主要问题是缺乏对前人研究发现的总结之外的任何综合分析。了解作者是否认为甲虫在某种意义上是特殊的沃尔巴克氏体宿主，或者是否存在某些特别值得注意的仅适用于甲虫而不适用于其他沃尔巴克氏体宿主的情况，将是非常有趣的。此外，手稿中“展望”部分提到的所有内容都适用于一般的沃尔巴克氏体研究，并非特定于沃尔巴克氏体与甲虫的相互作用。

> 在我们看来，这样的系统综述论文应专注于对当前知识状态的总结，并且应尽可能客观，因此应避免任何个人意见。然而，我们遵循了审稿人的建议，并添加了一个简短的“观点”章节（但请注意，我们对未来研究需求的观点已经在“展望”部分提及）。确实，“展望”部分并非特定于甲虫，但也不可能是，因为并不存在专门的“甲虫中的沃尔巴克氏体”科学——这必须是沃尔巴克氏体感染整体研究的一部分。然而，在这一部分中，我们试图引用关于甲虫的具体论文，并提及对甲虫宿主仍知之甚少的问题（但对其他宿主的研究可能更为深入）。我们认为，这样的部分很重要，因为它展示了甲虫中沃尔巴克氏体研究的缺失问题。

还有一些其他的主要是次要的问题需要在修订中解决。请在下文中找到这些问题的详细说明，希望这些意见具有建设性。

第81行及以下：作为对该列表的潜在补充，还有关于螨类（Chaisiri等人，2015年）和蚂蚁（Russell，2012年）的综述。后一篇综述还比较了沃尔巴克氏体在不同节肢动物类群中的发生率，可能值得一看以获取灵感。

> 我们已通过引用上述文章完善了这一出版物列表。

第88行：“[甲虫]是地球上物种最丰富的生物……”——人们经常看到类似的陈述，但它们根本没有任何意义。昆虫的物种比甲虫更丰富，而节肢动物的物种比昆虫更丰富。这只是说明所有系统发育等级（除了可能是物种）都是人为的，因此应避免这些陈述。

> 这是事实，因此我们修改了这一描述。

第109-112行：我不知道有任何研究表明沃尔巴克氏体“负责”物种形成，如果作者在此处提出这一观点，应引用具体例子。

> 我们再次同意，没有研究直接显示沃尔巴克氏体诱导其宿主的物种形成。句子已重写以更具体。

第120-121行：据我所知，谷歌搜索总是使用布尔运算符“AND”，无论是否在搜索字段中输入。

> 是的，但我们保留了这一描述，因为现在它对WoS是有效的。

第126行：我搜索了我的个人文献数据库，发现了一些关于甲虫中沃尔巴克氏体的论文，这些论文在您的手稿中未提及（Pankewitz等人，2007年；Chafee等人，2010年；Kageyama等人，2010年；Toju和Fukatsu，2010年；Xue等人，2011年；Toju等人，2013年；Iwase等人，2015年）。我不确定这是否因为这些论文在任何地方都没有单独列出，所以没有出现在您的搜索中。我建议提供所有使用的论文列表，并且如果您遗漏了上述论文，请重新设计您的搜索策略，以弥补导致这些疏忽的潜在不足。另一种发现可能被忽视的沃尔巴克氏体与甲虫关联的方法是检查NCBI核苷酸数据库中来自甲虫的沃尔巴克氏体序列。也许还值得搜索以前用于研究全球沃尔巴克氏体发生率的元分析所使用的数据库（Weinert等人，2007年；Hilgenboecker等人，2008年；Russell，2012年）。

> 我们对所有这些意见表示感谢。

The latter one also compares Wolbachia incidence between many different arthropod groups, and might be worth having a look for inspiration.
