paper_title: The nectar report: Quantitative review of nectar sugar concentrations offered by bee visited flowers in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes
paper_abstract: There is growing concern that some bee populations are in decline, potentially threatening pollination security in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes. Among the numerous causes associated with this trend, nutritional stress resulting from a mismatch between bee nutritional needs and plant community provisioning has been suggested as one potential driver. To ease nutritional stress on bee populations in agricultural habitats, agrienvironmental protection schemes aim to provide alternative nutritional resources for bee populations during times of need. However, such efforts have focused mainly on quantity (providing flowering plants) and timing (flower-scarce periods), while largely ignoring the quality of the offered flower resources. In a first step to start addressing this information gap, we have used literature data to compile a comprehensive geographically explicit dataset on nectar quality (i.e. total sugar concentration), offered to bees both within fields (crop and weed species) as well as off field (wild) around the globe. In particular social bees are sensitive to nectar sugar concentrations, which directly impact calorie influx into the colony and consequently their fitness. We find that the total nectar sugar concentrations in general do not differ between the three plant communities studied. In contrast we find increased quality variability in the wild plant community compared to crop and weed community, which is likely explained by the increased phylogenetic diversity in this category of plants. In a second step we explore the influence of local habitat on nectar quality and its variability utilizing a detailed sunflower (Helianthus annuus L.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting Pamminger et al present an extensive dataset on nectar concentrations in 322 species of wild, cultivated and weedy plant species from across the major world continents. The paper is well structured and well written throughout, with only a few areas that need to have their phrasing polished up which I detail below. We would like to thank the reviewer for the overall positive evaluation of the manuscript. The results are interesting (a very consistent average nectar concentration found in insect pollinated plants across all regions) and highlight particular crop genera that may benefiine: from additional nectar sources in the surrounding landscape to benefit bee populations. The figures and tables are clear and the statistical techniques used are well described. The literature is reasonably well covered, but I would like more discussion of the evidence base as to why the sugar concentration in nectar is important, and which species of bee this evidence is drawn from (predominantly social bees). I go into this point in more detail in section 3. Experimental design The research question is well defined (the importance of sugar concentrations in nectar) but as detailed in the next section I would like some more discussion of whether or not this is valid to apply to all bees. See below Validity of the findings I have a few more major comments that I would like to see addressed. The major point is that the manuscript talks about the importance of nectar to 'bees', but almost all the evidence we have that nectar concentrations are important comes from social bees (Bombus, Apis, etc). I think the data presented is really interesting, but I find it hard to argue that nectar concentrations are quite so important for solitary bee species (the vast majority of bee species) that have mainly had their fitness linked to the type and quantity of pollen available to them. I think a slight rewrite that shifts the focus (and justification for choosing nectar as the response variable) onto social bees would make the manuscript more representative of our current understanding of how important nectar is to bees, given the substantial knowledge deficit that exists for solitary bee species. We agree with the reviewer that most of the direct evidence linking nectar sugar concentrations to fitness stem from social bees and we have made this more clear in all parts of the MS. However, we believe that quality interventions will, at least to some degree, support wild bees as well. We no make these distinctions more clear in all relevant sections of the MS. Line 22-24, 85-90, 339-343, 573-577 L69-71. I would argue strongly that maintaining a diverse bee community has not been the focus of agri-environment schemes targeted at bees. Early work in the UK focused strongly on bumble bees and their foraging requirements Carvell et al 2004; 2006; 2007 leading to currently incarnations of flower-rich field margins containing predominantly bumble bee food plants (e.g. Trifolium, Centaurea, Vicia and so on). Until recently, few pollinator-focused schemes were appraised for their ability to provide resources to a wide variety of wild bee species e.g. Scheper et al 2015 JAE We thank the reviewer for this clarification and we have adapted the paragraph accordingly and have included the reference as well. Line: 79-84 L72-75. I think you need to be careful here. Most of the work that has be conducted on floral resource quality (especially nectar) has been on social bees. Next to nothing is known about how nectar quality affects solitary bee fitness, and if it even does at all. Pollen quality has been more extensively studied, but still predominantly on social bees (Vaudo, recent work on polyfloral/monofloral pollen diets for B. terrestris colonies from the Michez lab). For solitary bees, the limited amount of work suggests that it is the quality of the landscape (i.e. density of floral resources) that determines bee fitness e.g Persson et al 2018 Ecology and Evolution. I would lay out a couple of these issues in a little more detail in the introduction to highlight that most of the nectar work comes from social bees, which are of course very important as pollinators due to their abundance in most ecosystems. We absolutely agree with the reviewer that the ecological needs of solitary bees are very different from social bees. We have consequently reworded this section to better reflect these differences. In addition, we now emphasize the need to collect pollen quality markers as well as an important next step. Despite these fundamental differences we believe that sugar concentration (admittedly understudied) is likely also an important quality marker for solitary bees. This is due to three main reasons: 1. The higher caloric value of nectar will decrease time investment to fulfill the adult and larval nutritional requirements and will consequently benefit wild bees. 2. The argument of Kim et al 2011 is based on the physiology and physics of food uptake which holds for solitary bees as well. 3. By suggesting complementary food resources within agricultural landscapes plant diversity would be increased, which in turn likely helps solitary bees as well at least to some degree. We now make our argumentation clearer in the relevant sections of the MS. Line 22-24, 85-90, 339-343, 573-577 L152. This dataset from Kim et al 2011 is restricted to a narrow selection of bees in Apinae, e.g. Bombus, Apis, Meliponini and Euglossini, all but the Euglossines being social bees. These bees, whilst capturing a lot of the social diversity, are not necessarily representative of the other 19,000+ bee species and so statements such as “However, all evidence suggests that bees avoid foraging on nectar sources below 20% sugar concentration, likely because the caloric intake cannot support sustained foraging activity with potentially detrimental effects for the bee colony” are not necessarily true for solitary species. An earlier discussion of the ecological differences between social and solitary bees seems warranted. If the paper was to state that the focus on nectar was to better inform management for social bees (as is implied by the focus on nectar and references to colony health) this would resolve many of these issues. As it is currently written, the paper refers to ‘bees’ but focuses mostly on social bee examples and on a problem (nectar concentration) that has not empirically been demonstrated to be an issue in solitary species. The main argument of Kim et al is focused on the physiological and physical effects of nectar sugar concentrations on food uptake. Their argument revolves around optimal viscosity and caloric uptake. While we agree that the ecological parameters are very important we believe that the basic augment likely holds for the majority of bees. We have emphasized the important differences between solitary and social bees throughout the MS including the materials and method section. See above L326-327. I was interested to read this reference to see what evidence the authors present, but it is incomplete and gives only the title of the book without publisher information. Looking it up online, the subtitle is ‘the most important food sources for the honey bee’. As written, the current sentence “While it is well-known that pears (Pyrus) are not considered attractive to bees due to their low nectar (Fig.3) quality (Maurizio and Grafl 1980)” is misleading, since the evidence is for honey bees only, and pear is known to have attractive pollen for spring-flying wild bees, particularly Andrena (Chambers 1946 J Animal Ecology; Westrich 1989 Die Wildbienen Baden-Württembergs). Focusing the manuscript more explicitly on honey bees, bees known to be sensitive to nectar concentrations, would seem more appropriate. We agree with the reviewer and have reworded this section to emphasis it’s important to social bees in this context. Line 560-565 Comments for the Author Formatting of references – I have not seen the first and second author et al citation structure before. Please check against PeerJ standards L11. “some bee populations are in decline,” add comma Done L14. “associated with this trend, nutritional stress resulting from a mismatch between bee nutritional needs and plant community provisioning has been suggested as one potential driver.” change placement of commas Done L19. “this information gap,” add comma Done L42. Are in decline, or seem to be declining Done L44. rephrase to ‘are declining in only a few geographic regions and over certain time periods’ Done L48. correct to “intensification, habitat loss- or fragmentation and emerging pathogens” check use of Done L60. cornucopia – perhaps a more scientific and slightly less flowery word? (no pun intended) Changed to plethora L61. Discreet – perhaps change to relatively short? Changed L65. I’m not quite sure what you mean by ‘selective’ in this context. Is it the habitat that is selective, or the criteria used to determine the kind of habitat type that is selective? ‘Specific’ may be a more appropriate word choice if you intend the latter meaning Changed L82-83. Add comma ‘developing bees, sugar concentration’ Done L86. Check second quality Done L126-133. Check formatting e.g. double parentheses, underlining etc Done L147-149. Repetition of ‘for bees’ Done L213. Check capitalisation of genus Done L223. Check PeerJ formatting for Tab. or Table 1 Done L248. Check spelling of variety Done L249. Check spelling of hybrid Done L254. Difference singular Done L273. Check spelling of Pyrus Done L308. Repetition of findings, consider rephrasing Done L331-335. Repetition of high-quality, consider rewriting. In fact, both sentences could be rewritten for clarity. Done L347. Check capitalizations Done Figure 2. Check spelling of Wilcoxon Changed Figure 3 legend. Check spelling of border Changed Figure 3. Hoffmannseggia and Hoffmanseggia seems to be listed twice, are these different genera? We thank the reviewer for pointing out this error. It turned out to be caused by a coding error in the raw data. We have corrected this mistake updated the associated statistics. All other results were unaffected. ________________________________________
paper_title_zh: 花蜜报告：农业和非农业景观中蜜蜂访问花朵提供花蜜糖浓度的定量综述
paper_abstract_zh: 日益增长的担忧表明，一些蜜蜂种群正在衰退，这可能威胁到农业和非农业景观中的授粉安全。在与此趋势相关的众多原因中，蜜蜂营养需求与植物群落供给之间的不匹配所导致的营养压力，被认为是其中一个潜在驱动因素。为了缓解农业栖息地中蜜蜂种群的这种营养压力，农业环境保护计划旨在在蜜蜂需要时为其提供替代性营养资源。然而，这些努力主要集中在数量（提供开花植物）和时机（花朵稀缺期）上，而很大程度上忽视了所提供花朵资源质量。为了开始填补这一信息空白，我们首先利用文献数据编制了一个关于全球范围内蜜蜂可获得花蜜质量（即总糖浓度）的综合地理明确数据集，包括田间（作物和杂草种类）以及田外（野生）的花蜜。特别是社会性蜜蜂对花蜜糖浓度非常敏感，这直接影响热量流入蜂群，进而影响其适应性。我们发现，所研究的三个植物群落之间的花蜜总糖浓度总体上没有差异。相比之下，我们发现野生植物群落的质量变异性比作物和杂草群落更高，这很可能是由该类植物系统发育多样性的增加所解释的。在第二步中，我们利用详细的向日葵（Helianthus annuus L.）数据，探讨了当地栖息地对花蜜质量及其变异性的影响。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）基本报告
Pamminger等人提供了一个关于322种野生、栽培和杂草植物物种花蜜浓度的广泛数据集，这些物种来自世界各大洲。论文结构良好，通篇写作出色，只有少数地方需要润色，具体如下。我们感谢审稿人对稿件的总体积极评价。结果很有趣（在所有地区昆虫授粉植物中发现了非常一致的平均花蜜浓度），并突出了某些作物属，这些作物属可能受益于周围景观中额外的花蜜来源，以利于蜜蜂种群。图表清晰，所使用的统计技术描述得当。文献覆盖较为全面，但我希望更多地讨论花蜜中糖浓度为何重要，以及这一证据来自哪些蜜蜂物种（主要是社会性蜜蜂）。我在第3部分中更详细地讨论了这一点。

实验设计
研究问题定义明确（花蜜中糖浓度的重要性），但正如下一部分所详述，我希望更多地讨论这是否适用于所有蜜蜂。见下文

研究结果的有效性
我有几条更重要的评论希望得到解决。主要问题是，稿件讨论了花蜜对“蜜蜂”的重要性，但我们几乎所有关于花蜜浓度重要的证据都来自社会性蜜蜂（如Bombus、Apis等）。我认为所呈现的数据非常有趣，但我很难认同花蜜浓度对独居蜜蜂物种（占蜜蜂物种的绝大多数）同样重要，这些物种的适应性主要与可获取的花粉类型和数量相关。我认为稍作改写，将焦点（以及选择花蜜作为响应变量的理由）转移到社会性蜜蜂上，会使稿件更能代表我们目前对花蜜对蜜蜂重要性的理解，鉴于独居蜜蜂物种存在较大的知识缺口。我们同意审稿人的观点，即大多数直接将花蜜糖浓度与适应性联系起来的证据来自社会性蜜蜂，我们已在稿件的各个部分中对此进行了更清晰的说明。然而，我们相信高质量的干预措施至少在一定程度上也会支持野生蜜蜂。我们已在稿件的相应部分更清晰地做出了这些区分。第22-24行、85-90行、339-343行、573-577行
L69-71。我强烈认为，维持多样化的蜜蜂群落并不是针对蜜蜂的农业环境计划的重点。英国早期的工作强烈关注大黄蜂及其觅食需求（Carvell等人，2004年；2006年；） 2007年，导致目前富含花卉的田边地带主要包含大黄蜂食物植物（例如三叶草、矢车菊、巢菜等）。直到最近，很少有以传粉者为重点的计划被评估其能否为多种野生蜜蜂物种提供资源，例如Scheper等人2015年在JAE上的研究。我们感谢审稿人对此的澄清，并已相应地修改了段落，并添加了参考文献。行：79-84，L72-75。我认为这里需要谨慎。大多数关于花蜜资源质量（尤其是花蜜）的研究都是在社会性蜜蜂上进行的。关于花蜜质量如何影响独居蜜蜂适应性以及是否真的有影响，几乎一无所知。花粉质量的研究较为广泛，但仍然主要集中在社会性蜜蜂上（Vaudo，Michez实验室最近关于多花/单花花粉饮食对B. terrestris蜂群的研究）。对于独居蜜蜂，有限的研究表明，决定蜜蜂适应性的是景观质量（即花资源的密度），例如Persson等人2018年在Ecology and Evolution上的研究。我建议在引言中更详细地阐述这些问题，以突出大多数花蜜研究来自社会性蜜蜂，这些蜜蜂当然非常重要，因为它们在大多数生态系统中数量丰富。我们完全同意审稿人关于独居蜜蜂的生态需求与社会性蜜蜂非常不同的观点。因此，我们已重新措辞这一部分，以更好地反映这些差异。此外，我们现在强调收集花粉质量标记也是一个重要的下一步。尽管存在这些根本差异，我们认为糖浓度（诚然研究不足）可能也是独居蜜蜂的一个重要质量标记。这主要基于三个原因：1. 花蜜的高卡路里价值将减少满足成虫和幼虫营养需求的时间投入，从而有利于野生蜜蜂。2. paper_title: COVID-19 associated spontaneous barotrauma: a literature review
paper_abstract:
Reports of spontaneous pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum as a complication of coronavirus disease (COVID-19) have been increasing. COVID-19 causes inflammatory disease mainly affecting the respiratory system. Severity varies from asymptomatic pulmonary findings on imaging to acute respiratory distress syndrome along with pleural effusions, consolidations and spontaneous pneumomediastinum and pneumothorax. 
 
The aim of this paper was to review the literature to explore the association between pneumomediastinum/pneumothorax and COVID-19 respiratory disease, both in patients on ventilators and without ventilators, on a spontaneous basis. To this end, we conducted a comprehensive online literature search using PubMed for articles published with the key words of ‘spontaneous pneumothorax’, ‘pneumomediastinum’ and ‘COVID-19’. Further references were obtained through cross-referencing the bibliographies cited in each publication. 
We found that  spontaneous barotrauma is one of the complications associated with COVID-19 infection and has been observed in patients with and without mechanical ventilation. The process of pneumomediastinum and pneumothorax development is not well understood, especially in patients without underlying lung disease or on mechanical ventilation. We identified various factors that predispose to barotrauma. First, the direct infection of the Type I and Type II pneumocytes by the virus. Second, the pressure gradient between the alveoli and the pulmonary interstitium. Finally, barotrauma can occur secondary to the severe inflammatory response from the COVID-19-related cytokine storm. These conditions are all associated with severe alveolar damage and rupture of the alveolar wall that can produce pneumomediastinum and pneumothorax, both in mechanically ventilated patients and non-ventilated patients. 
COVID-19 is associated complications result in prolonged mechanical ventilation and length of stay, as well as overall increase in morbidity and mortality. Spontaneous pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum are two serious complications. Education regarding the adjustment of ventilation settlings in the ventilator-dependent COVID-19 patient may perhaps offset the iatrogenic component of barotrauma seen in some such patients.
review_content:
In this manuscript, Dr. Arias-Morales and colleagues present a narrative review of COVID-19 spontaneous barotrauma. As we are now facing the fourth wave of the COVID-19 pandemic in several countries, this remains an "up-to-date" topic relevant to current practice.

Overall, while the review provides a general cover of most of the relevant aspects related to barotrauma, all topics could be discussed in greater detail. Furthermore, a brief paragraph describing the management of COVID-19-related barotrauma could be useful.
  * Few lines comparing the rate of barotrauma in COVID-19 vs non-COVID-19 respiratory failure and ARDS might be useful, as there is a general belief of a higher rate of barotrauma in COVID-19 ARDS. In this view, the authors may wish to discuss a recent systematic review on barotrauma in COVID-19 patients (see Belletti et al., 20211).
  * As a related point, the prognostic impact and risk factors for barotrauma in COVID-19 patients may be worth a discussion in a separate paragraph. Several authors now report higher mortality rates (>60%) for COVID-19 patients who developed barotrauma.
  * The authors may also wish to discuss tracheal damage and tracheomalacia associated with COVID-19, which is being increasingly reported and associated with the development of pneumomediastinum (see Guarnieri et al., 20212; Fiacchini et al., 20213; Rosati et al., 20214).
  * Some authors recently described the CT finding of the Macklin-like effect as a potential predictor of barotrauma in COVID-19 patients (see Palumbo et al., 20215. I believe that these findings could be discussed in the paragraph on possible causes of barotrauma.
  * It might be useful to add one or more tables summarizing findings of major published studies on barotrauma rate and outcome in spontaneous breathing vs non-invasively ventilated vs invasively ventilated COVID-19 patients.
  * It might also be useful to add a table summarizing identified risk and predisposing factors for barotrauma development in COVID-19 ARDS patients.
  * A separate paragraph on Methods, describing how the search strategy was performed (last update, keywords, number of reviewers screening articles, etc.) might also be useful.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19相关自发性气压伤：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
关于新型冠状病毒肺炎（COVID-19）并发症自发气胸和纵隔气肿的报道日益增多。COVID-19主要引起影响呼吸系统的炎症性疾病，其严重程度从影像学上的无症状肺部表现到急性呼吸窘迫综合征，伴随胸腔积液、实变以及自发纵隔气肿和气胸。

本文旨在通过文献综述探讨自发纵隔气肿/气胸与COVID-19呼吸系统疾病之间的关联，包括有创呼吸机和无创呼吸机患者的自发情况。为此，我们使用PubMed进行了全面的在线文献检索，关键词包括“自发气胸”、“纵隔气肿”和“COVID-19”。通过交叉引用每篇出版物中引用的参考文献，进一步获取了相关资料。

我们发现，自发气压伤是COVID-19感染的并发症之一，在有创和无创机械通气患者中均有观察到。纵隔气肿和气胸的发生机制尚不明确，特别是在无基础肺疾病或接受机械通气的患者中。我们识别了多种易导致气压伤的因素：首先，病毒直接感染I型和II型肺泡上皮细胞；其次，肺泡与肺间质之间的压力梯度；最后，气压伤可能继发于COVID-19相关细胞因子风暴引起的严重炎症反应。这些条件均与严重肺泡损伤和肺泡壁破裂相关，可能导致纵隔气肿和气胸，无论在机械通气患者还是非通气患者中。

COVID-19相关并发症会导致机械通气时间延长、住院时间增加，以及总体发病率和死亡率的上升。自发气胸和纵隔气肿是两种严重的并发症。对依赖呼吸机的COVID-19患者进行通气参数调整的教育，可能在一定程度上抵消部分患者中出现的医源性气压伤。
review_content_zh:
在这篇手稿中，Arias-Morales博士及其同事对COVID-19自发性气压伤进行了叙述性综述。鉴于我们目前在多个国家正面临COVID-19大流行的第四波，这一话题仍然是与当前实践相关的“最新”议题。

总体而言，尽管该综述涵盖了与气压伤相关的大部分重要方面，但所有主题都可以进行更详细的讨论。此外，简要段落描述COVID-19相关气压伤的管理可能会很有用。
  * 比较COVID-19与非COVID-19呼吸衰竭和ARDS中气压伤发生率的几行文字可能有用，因为普遍认为COVID-19 ARDS中气压伤的发生率更高。就此观点，作者可能希望讨论一篇关于COVID-19患者气压伤的最新系统性综述（参见Belletti等人，20211）。
  * 作为相关点，COVID-19患者气压伤的预后影响和风险因素可能在单独段落中进行讨论。多位作者现在报告，发生气压伤的COVID-19患者死亡率较高（>60%）。
  * 作者也可能希望讨论与COVID-19相关的气管损伤和气管软化，这种情况被越来越多地报告，并与纵隔气肿的发展相关（参见Guarnieri等人，20212；Fiacchini等人，20213；Rosati等人，20214）。
  * 一些作者最近描述了Macklin样效应的CT表现，作为COVID-19患者气压伤的潜在预测指标（参见Palumbo等人，20215）。我认为这些发现可以在关于气压伤可能原因的段落中进行讨论。
  * 添加一个或多个表格，总结已发表的主要研究中关于自发性呼吸、非侵入性通气与侵入性通气COVID-19患者气压伤发生率和预后的发现，可能有用。
  * 添加一个表格，总结已识别的COVID-19 ARDS患者气压伤发展的风险和易感因素，也可能有用。
  * 单独段落描述方法，说明搜索策略是如何执行的（最后更新、关键词、审阅文章的评审员数量等），也可能有用。

paper_title: Automated language essay scoring systems: A Literature Review
paper_abstract: Background.Writing composition is a significant factor for measuring test-takers' ability in any language exam. However, the assessment (scoring) of these writing compositions or essays is a very challenging process in terms of reliability and time. The need for objective and quick scores has raised the need for a computer system that can automatically grade essay questions targeting specific prompts. Automated Essay Scoring (AES) systems are used to overcome the challenges of scoring writing tasks by using Natural Language Processing (NLP) and machine learning techniques. The purpose of this paper is to review the literature for the AES systems used for grading the essay questions.Methodology.We have reviewed the existing literature using Google Scholar, EBSCO and ERIC to search for the terms "AES", "Automated Essay Scoring", "Automated Essay Grading", or "Automatic Essay" for essays written in English language. Two categories have been identified: handcrafted features and automatically featured AES systems. The systems of the former category are closely bonded to the quality of the designed features. On the other hand, the systems of the latter category are based on the automatic learning of the features and relations between an essay and its score without any handcrafted features. We reviewed the systems of the two categories in terms of system primary focus, technique(s) used in the system, the need for training data, instructional application (feedback system), and the correlation between e-scores and human scores. The paper includes three main sections.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting The topic of the article is important, and the evaluation of the different approaches/systems is required in the presence of huge use of AES systems especially in English Language Assessment and standardized exam all over the world. The article has a good introduction and background to demonstrate the importance of the work and how it fits into the field of knowledge. Also, the structure of the article is logical and in an acceptable format. In general, the language of the article is clear and the ideas are well organized. Yet, there are few English mistakes (See below). I suggest reviewing the article by a native speaker. The tables and figures are clear and useful as well.
paper_title_zh: 自动化语言作文评分系统：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景。写作能力是衡量任何语言考试考生能力的重要因素。然而，这些写作作品或作文的评估（评分）在可靠性和时间方面是一个非常具有挑战性的过程。对客观和快速评分的需求引发了对一个计算机系统的需求，该系统能够自动评分针对特定提示的作文题目。自动作文评分（AES）系统通过使用自然语言处理（NLP）和机器学习技术来克服评分写作任务的挑战。本文的目的是回顾用于评分作文题目的AES系统的文献。

方法。我们通过使用Google Scholar、EBSCO和ERIC检索了现有的文献，搜索术语包括“AES”、“Automated Essay Scoring”、“Automated Essay Grading”或“Automatic Essay”，针对用英语撰写的作文。我们确定了两个类别：手工特征和自动特征AES系统。前一类系统与设计特征的质量紧密相关。另一方面，后一类系统基于特征的自动学习和作文与其分数之间的关系，而不需要任何手工特征。我们从系统主要关注点、系统使用的技术、对训练数据的需求、教学应用（反馈系统）以及电子评分与人工评分之间的相关性等方面对这两类系统进行了回顾。本文包括三个主要部分。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2 基本报告

文章的主题很重要，特别是在AES系统广泛应用于英语语言评估和全球标准化考试的背景下，对不同方法/系统的评估是必要的。文章有良好的引言和背景，展示了工作的重要性及其在知识领域的定位。此外，文章的结构逻辑清晰，格式可接受。总体而言，文章的语言清晰，观点组织得当。然而，仍有少量英语错误（见下文）。建议由母语者审阅文章。表格和图表也清晰且有用。

reasons: The topic of the article is important, and the evaluation of the different approaches/systems is required in the presence of huge use of AES systems especially in English Language Assessment and standardized exam all over the world.
In general, the language of the article is clear and the ideas are well organized.
Yet, there are few English mistakes (See below).
I suggest reviewing the article by a native speaker.
The tables and figures are clear and useful as well.
In general, the language of the article is clear and the ideas are well organized.
The tables and figures are clear and useful as well.

paper_title: The long reads ahead: de novo genome assembly using the MinION
paper_abstract: Nanopore technology provides a novel approach to DNA sequencing that yields long, label-free reads of constant quality. The first commercial implementation of this approach, the MinION, has shown promise in various sequencing applications. This review gives an up-to-date overview of the MinION's utility as a de novo  sequencing device. It is argued that the MinION may allow for portable and affordable de novo sequencing of even complex genomes in the near future, despite the currently error-prone nature of its reads. Through continuous updates to the MinION hardware and the development of new assembly pipelines, both sequencing accuracy and assembly quality have already risen rapidly. However, this fast pace of development has also lead to a lack of overview of the expanding landscape of analysis tools, as performance evaluations are outdated quickly. As the MinION is approaching a state of maturity, its user community would benefit from a thorough comparative benchmarking effort of de novo assembly pipelines in the near future. An earlier version of this article can be found on  bioRxiv .
review_content:
Carlos de Lannoy, Dick de Ridder, and Judith Risse have written a technical review paper of MinION sequencing. This is a challenging task due to the high rate of MinION consumable obsolescence, and the breadth of use cases. Unfortunately I feel that this challenge has not been met in their paper, which appears to be a scattered mixture of discussions of differing recency with no cohesive story threading them together. I think it is especially important that a review paper of MinION technology is as current as possible, because it has the potential to be used extensively by others as an indication of the quality of sequencing at a particular point in time.

I should perhaps point out that the main thing I found the most frustrating to read was a reference to R9 as current technology, and my other comments are likely coloured by me spotting this in my first scan through the article.

Here are some additional comments about the content of the paper. This is not a comprehensive review, and should only be used as a guide to the areas of concern I have with the content:
  * Title: "Coming of age" -- overlaps with Sara Goodwin's Nature Reviews Genetics paper [doi:10.1038/nrg.2016.49], which is also a review paper on sequencing technology (including nanopore). See, for example, this image:

    [https://www.nature.com/nrg/journal/v17/n6/fig_tab/nrg.2016.49_F5.html]

    A search for "coming of age" and nanopore returns another paper:

    [http://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2007/mb/b702845h]
  * The paper talks about "current" nanopore technology as R9, which was discontinued last year in preference to R9.4. Shortly before this, the paper discusses solid state nanopores for a review paper, when there is no commercially-available product. This is despite mentioning the introduction of 1D² technology in May 2017, which was introduced after R9.4 pores.
  * The paper references internal nanopore community technical documentation, which is unlikely to be available to general readers of the article (and particularly not those who are considering its use).
  * "The exact start and end of the hairpin is not always clear from the signal" -- I disagree with this. While current software may have difficulty interpreting the start/end, the location is obvious when looking at the raw signal. It is surprising to see this shortly before referencing our chimeric reads paper, where we give visual examples of the raw signal where the characteristic harpins are annotated.
  * Figure 5: I like the idea of this figure. It's uncommon for people to give a visual indication of multiple pores and the MUX switching. However, some changes (and/or different annotation) are warranted. Using colours for both the mux type and the QC error is distracting; I would recommend using a hatch pattern to indicate failed pores. The pores are much larger than their actual size relative to the well size; this should be stated in the legend. Pores can also fail QC due to the membrane breaking, due to blocked pores, and presumably other reasons; the QC check is not only counting pores.
  * Figure 6: There is enough event-annotated nanopore data available that mock data should not be necessary. Spikes and within-event signal variation that I am used to seeing in raw signal data are not present in this figure.
  * "Any comparison in this chapter" -- might want to change that 'chapter' to a 'paper'.
  * Canu is now published in Genome Research:

    [dx.doi.org/10.1101/gr.215087.116]
  * The nanopolish algorithm has now been improved such that it takes substantially less time for v0.7:

    [http://simpsonlab.github.io/2017/06/30/nanopolish-v0.7.0/]
  * The paper makes many statements around the accuracy of base-calling and assembly solutions which [mostly] ignores post-transducer base-calling. I would like to see a review paper that (if possible) concentrates on post-transducer software, which would probably mean discarding discussion on HMM-based callers.
paper_title_zh: 长读长技术展望：使用MinION进行从头基因组组装
paper_abstract_zh: 纳米孔技术为DNA测序提供了一种新颖的方法，该方法产生长且质量恒定的无标记读数。这种方法的首次商业化实现——MinION，已在各种测序应用中展现出潜力。本文综述了MinION作为从头测序装置的当前效用。有观点认为，尽管MinION的读数目前存在错误，但它可能允许在不久的将来便携且经济地从头测序甚至复杂的基因组。通过不断更新MinION硬件和开发新的组装流程，测序准确性和组装质量已经迅速提高。然而，这种快速发展也导致了对分析工具不断扩大的领域的概述不足，因为性能评估很快就会过时。随着MinION逐渐成熟，其用户社区将受益于在不久的将来对从头组装流程进行彻底的比较基准测试。本文的早期版本可在bioRxiv上找到。
review_content_zh:
卡洛斯·德·拉诺伊、迪克·德·里德和朱迪思·里斯撰写了一篇关于MinION测序的技术综述论文。由于MinION消耗品的快速过时和广泛的应用案例，这是一项具有挑战性的任务。不幸的是，我认为他们的论文并未克服这一挑战，它似乎是一系列不同时效性的讨论的散乱混合，没有连贯的故事线索将它们串联起来。我认为，MinION技术的综述论文尽可能地保持最新是非常重要的，因为它有可能被其他人广泛用作特定时间点测序质量的指示。

我或许应该指出，我最感到沮丧的是阅读时发现将R9称为当前技术，我的其他评论可能也受到了我在第一次浏览文章时发现这一点的影响。

以下是关于论文内容的额外评论。这并不是一个全面的评论，而应仅用作我对内容关注领域的指南：
* 标题：“成年” —— 与萨拉·古德温的《自然综述遗传学》论文[doi:10.1038/nrg.2016.49]重叠，后者也是一篇关于测序技术（包括纳米孔）的综述论文。例如，参见以下图片：

    [https://www.nature.com/nrg/journal/v17/n6/fig_tab/nrg.2016.49_F5.html]

    搜索“成年”和纳米孔会返回另一篇论文：

    [http://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2007/mb/b702845h]
* 论文讨论了“当前”的纳米孔技术R9，去年已停产，转而使用R9.4。在此之前，论文讨论了用于综述论文的固态纳米孔，尽管目前没有商业产品。尽管提到了2017年5月引入的1D²技术，该技术是在R9.4孔之后引入的。
* 论文引用了内部纳米孔社区的技术文档，这些文档可能无法提供给文章的一般读者（尤其是那些考虑使用它的人）。
* “从信号中无法始终清楚地确定发夹的确切起始和结束位置” —— 我不同意这一点。虽然当前软件可能难以解释起始/结束位置，但从原始信号中可以清楚地看到位置。在参考我们的嵌合读数论文之前看到这一点令人惊讶，我们在该论文中给出了原始信号的视觉示例，其中特征发夹被标注出来。
* 图5：我喜欢这个图的想法。人们很少给出多个孔和MUX切换的视觉指示。然而，一些变化（和/或不同的标注）是必要的。使用颜色表示MUX类型和QC错误会分散注意力；我建议使用网纹图案来指示失败的孔。孔相对于井的大小要大得多；应在图例中说明这一点。孔也可能因膜破裂、孔堵塞等原因而无法通过QC检查；QC检查不仅仅是计数孔。
* 图6：有足够的事件标注纳米孔数据可用，因此不需要模拟数据。我习惯在原始信号数据中看到的尖峰和事件内信号变化在此图中不存在。
* “本章中的任何比较” —— 可能需要将“章节”改为“论文”。
* Canu现在发表在《基因组研究》上：

    [dx.doi.org/10.1101/gr.215087.116]
* 现在nanopolish算法已经改进，v0.7版本所需时间大大减少：

    [http://simpsonlab.github.io/2017/06/30/nanopolish-v0.7.0/]
* 论文在关于基调用和组装解决方案的准确性方面做出了许多陈述，[主要]忽略了后传感器基调用。我希望看到一篇综述论文，如果可能的话，专注于后传感器软件，这可能会意味着放弃对基于HMM的调用器的讨论。

paper_title: Comprehensive classification of the plant non-specific lipid transfer protein superfamily towards its Sequence -Structure -Function analysis
paper_abstract: Background. Non-specific Lipid Transfer Proteins (nsLTPs)  are widely distributed in the plant kingdom and constitute a superfamily of related proteins. Several hundreds of different nsLTP sequences -and counting -have been characterized so far, but their biological functions remain unclear. It has been clear for years that they present a certain interest for agronomic and nutritional issues. Deciphering their functions means collecting and analyzing a variety of data from gene sequence to protein structure, from cellular localization to the physiological role. As a huge and growing number of new protein sequences are available nowadays, extracting meaningful knowledge from sequence-structure-function relationships calls for the development of new tools and approaches. As nsLTPs show high evolutionary divergence, but a conserved common right handed superhelix structural fold, and as they are involved in a large number of key roles in plant development and defense, they are a stimulating case study for validating such an approach.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Anonymous) Basic reporting Authors have tried to decipher the functions of nsLTP(s) by collating and analyzing protein sequences, structures and some reported physiological functions. On the basis of homology modelling of different types, they have classified nsLPTs into two main sub-types and developed two bioinformatics tools for analysis of the dataset. It is a good bioinformatics study and I would recommend for publication if the issues raised in general comments are addressed. Experimental design The work is carried out using established computational methods. Validity of the findings Findings are validated within the limitations of bioinformatics approaches. It would of course be best if they are experimentally validated. However that would not be in the scope of this article. We thank you for your interest and your relevant comments. Comments for the Author 1. Line 116-118: The cited reference for the identification of residues involved in their antifungal activity through SDM has not been carried out in original article Ge et al., 2003. Indeed, there has been a confusion between two articles written by Ge and collaborators in 2003. The reference we actually wish to cite is: Ge, X., Chen, J., Sun, C., Cao, K. (2003). Preliminary study on the structural basis of the antifungal activity of a rice lipid transfer protein. Protein Eng. 6, 387–390. We replaced the reference line 874. 2. Line 308 and 311: In many places the authors have written 797 number of sequences was analyzed and at some place 798. This was a mistake indeed. It has been corrected and it is now 797 everywhere in the text. 3. Line 326-335: Explanation for Figure1-A2 and B2, very confusing and not clear. In this paragraph we discuss how to align type I and type II nsLTP cysteine residues correctly, by comparing the structural projection of each sequence alignment. To clarify our explanation we suggest to rewrite it as follows: “To determine which of these two alignments better aligned nsLTP type I and II CXC patterns, we used ViTO program to compare the effects on the 3D structures of both sequence alignments. The 3D projection of MUSCLE sequence alignment (Figure 1A2) showed that the attempt to spatially superimpose Cys5 and Cys6 of type I nsLTPs with Cys5’ and Cys6’ of type II nsLTPs respectively, was very expensive in term of Cys C-alpha RMSD value (7.32 Ǻ). On the contrary, according to the 3D projection of MAFFT sequence alignment (Figure 1B2), type I Cys5 could be well superimposed with type II Cys6’, with a Cys C-alpha RMSD value dropping to 2.15 Å. Furthermore, type I hydrophylic X residue was exposed to the solvent, whereas type II apolar X residue was orientated toward the core of the protein, increasing the stability of the proteins. For these reasons we think that the sequence alignment calculated by MAFFT is more relevant.“ 4. Line 458-471: The cited reference article Cheng et al., 2008, did not carried out SDM of the residues 54 and 63 in their original article, as claimed by the authors. Actually, the numbers 54 and 63 refer to the alignment positions displayed on Figure 3 of our manuscript, not to residue numbers. Residue number correspondences can be inferred by comparing our alignment on Figure 3 with the sequences on Figure 1A of Cheng's article : positions 54 and 63 in our Figure 3 respectively correspond to residues 36 and 45 in Cheng's figure 1A. The comments made in the lines 458-471 (now 477-489) of our article refer to this sentence in the Cheng's paper : "The alpha-helical content was significantly lower for L8A, F36A, and V49A (6, 9, and 8%, respectively), indicating that L8, F36, and V49 are structurally important residues and that alanine substitution at these positions is sufficient to disrupt the secondary structure." ... and also to this other sentence : "As for Y45A, it had a lower percent competition (20.6%) in competitive binding assay, even though this mutant has a similar tertiary structure and exposed hydrophobic surface area to wild-type protein." We modified our manuscript as follows to be less ambiguous : "It was shown by site-directed mutagenesis that the replacement of this intermediate residue by an alanine residue perturbed folding, ligand binding and lipid transfer activity in type II nsLTPs (Cheng et al., 2008). The position 54 in our alignment corresponds to residue 36 in Cheng's article." and "The mutation to alanine of the residue at position 63 (residue 45 in Cheng's article) was also shown experimentally to destabilize ligand binding in type II nsLTPs (Cheng et al., 2008)." 5. Line: 573-578: Without any SDM data available on antifungal activity, it is very unlikely to suggest any potential residues involved in antifungal activity by doing sequence analysis only. Actually, one aim of this work is to point some residues out that can be good candidates to experimental analysis. Using both sequence and structure analysis we find that these residues show a good conservation in their subfamily and that they don’t have a structural implication. That is why we can suspect that they are involved in the protein activity. Of course, the hypothesis has to be experimentally investigated to be confirmed. We will clarify this point as follows: “By investigating structural similarities between the 31 identified defense nsLTPs in our annotated dataset, we attempted to identify key amino acid residues that would be good candidates for SDM experiments as they may bestow their functional properties on these proteins.” 6. Data for 797/798 sequences extracted, analyzed from different plant sources should also be provided in supplementary file, as mentioned in Boutrot et al., 2008. The dataset containing the 797 sequences used for this study will be made available on the CIRAD Dataverse (doi:10.18167/DVN1/UNKLA6). The Dataset will be made available as soon as the article will be accepted. Data analysis and annotation of the 797 sequences can be accessed through InTreeGreat interface (http://phylogeny.southgreen.fr/treedisplay/index.php?data=msdmind).
paper_title_zh: 植物非特异性脂质转移蛋白超家族的综合分类及其序列-结构-功能分析
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。非特异性脂质转移蛋白（nsLTPs）在植物界中广泛分布，构成一个相关蛋白的超家族。迄今为止，已鉴定出数百种不同的nsLTP序列，并且数量还在增加，但它们的生物学功能仍不清楚。多年来，它们在农业和营养问题上的重要性已显而易见。解析其功能意味着从基因序列到蛋白质结构、从细胞定位到生理作用的各类数据的收集和分析。鉴于目前有大量且不断增加的新蛋白序列可供使用，从序列-结构-功能关系中提取有意义的知识需要开发新的工具和方法。由于nsLTPs表现出高度进化分歧，但保留了保守的右手超螺旋结构折叠，并且它们在植物发育和防御中扮演众多关键角色，因此它们是验证此类方法的激励性案例研究。
review_content_zh:
### 审稿人3（匿名）的基本报告

作者通过收集和分析蛋白质序列、结构以及一些已报道的生理功能，试图解析nsLTP(s)的功能。基于不同类型的同源建模，他们将nsLTPs分为两个主要亚型，并开发了两个生物信息学工具用于数据集的分析。这是一项良好的生物信息学研究，如果解决了总体评论中提出的问题，我建议予以发表。

### 实验设计

该工作使用了已建立的计算方法进行。

### 研究发现的可靠性

研究发现在生物信息学方法的局限性内得到了验证。当然，如果能够通过实验验证则最佳，但这超出了本文的范围。

我们感谢您的兴趣和相关的评论。

### 给作者的评论

1. 第116-118行：引用的关于通过SDM识别参与抗真菌活性的残基的参考文献在Ge等人2003年的原始文章中并未进行。实际上，在Ge及其合作者2003年撰写的两篇文章之间存在混淆。我们实际希望引用的参考文献是：Ge, X., Chen, J., Sun, C., Cao, K. (2003). Preliminary study on the structural basis of the antifungal activity of a rice lipid transfer protein. Protein Eng. 6, 387–390。我们在第874行替换了参考文献。

2. 第308和311行：在许多地方，作者写道分析了797个序列，而在某些地方写的是798个。这确实是一个错误。已经进行了更正，现在全文中均为797个序列。

3. 第326-335行：对图1-A2和B2的解释非常混乱且不清晰。在这段中，我们讨论了如何通过比较每个序列对齐的结构投影，正确对齐I型和II型nsLTP半胱氨酸残基。为了澄清我们的解释，我们建议重写如下：“为了确定这两种对齐方式中哪一种更好地对齐了nsLTP I型和II型的CXC模式，我们使用ViTO程序比较了这两种序列对齐对3D结构的影响。MUSCLE序列对齐的3D投影（图1A2）显示，尝试将I型nsLTPs的Cys5和Cys6分别与II型nsLTPs的Cys5’和Cys6’空间叠加，其Cys C-alpha RMSD值非常高（7.32 Å）。相反，根据MAFFT序列对齐的3D投影（图1B2），I型Cys5可以很好地与II型Cys6’叠加，Cys C-alpha RMSD值降至2.15 Å。此外，I型亲水性X残基暴露于溶剂中，而II型非极性X残基朝向蛋白质核心，增加了蛋白质的稳定性。因此，我们认为MAFFT计算的序列对齐更为相关。”

4. 第458-471行：引用的Cheng等人2008年的文章并未在其原始文章中进行54和63位残基的SDM，如作者所声称的。实际上，54和63是指我们手稿图3中对齐位置显示的数字，而不是残基编号。通过将我们的图3对齐与Cheng文章图1A中的序列进行比较，可以推断出残基编号的对应关系：我们图3中的位置54和63分别对应于Cheng图1A中的残基36和45。我们文章第458-471行（现为477-489行）的评论是指Cheng论文中的这句话：“α-螺旋含量在L8A、F36A和V49A（分别为6%、9%和8%）中显著降低，表明L8、F36和V49是结构上重要的残基，并且在这些位置用丙氨酸替代足以破坏二级结构。”……以及另一句话：“至于Y45A，其在竞争结合测定中的竞争百分比较低（20.6%），尽管该突变体与野生型蛋白具有相似的三级结构和暴露的疏水表面积。”我们修改了手稿以减少歧义：“通过定点突变显示，用丙氨酸残基替换这个中间残基会扰乱II型nsLTPs的折叠、配体结合和脂质转移活性（Cheng等人，2008年）。我们排列中的位置54对应于Cheng文章中的残基36。”以及“在位置63（Cheng文章中的残基45）处将残基突变为丙氨酸也通过实验显示会破坏II型nsLTPs中的配体结合（Cheng等人，2008年）。”

5. 第573-578行：在没有关于抗真菌活性的SDM数据的情况下，仅通过序列分析就提出可能参与抗真菌活性的潜在残基是非常不合理的。实际上，这项工作的一个目标是指出一些可以作为实验分析良好候选者的残基。通过结合序列和结构分析，我们发现这些残基在其亚家族中表现出良好的保守性，并且没有结构上的影响。这就是为什么我们怀疑它们参与了蛋白质活性。当然，这一假设需要通过实验研究来确认。我们将如下澄清这一点：“通过研究我们注释数据集中识别的31个防御nsLTPs之间的结构相似性，我们试图识别一些关键氨基酸残基，这些残基是SDM实验的良好候选者，因为它们可能赋予这些蛋白质其功能特性。”

6. 如Boutrot等人2008年所述，从不同植物来源提取并分析的797/798个序列的数据也应提供在补充文件中。用于本研究的包含797个序列的数据集将在CIRAD Dataverse上提供（doi:10.18167/DVN1/UNKLA6）。数据集将在文章被接受后立即提供。可以通过InTreeGreat界面访问797个序列的数据分析和注释（http://phylogeny.southgreen.fr/treedisplay/index.php?data=msdmind）。

paper_title: How to Reuse and Compose Knowledge for a Lifetime of Tasks: A Survey on Continual Learning and Functional Composition
paper_abstract: A major goal of artificial intelligence (AI) is to create an agent capable of acquiring a general understanding of the world. Such an agent would require the ability to continually accumulate and build upon its knowledge as it encounters new experiences. Lifelong or continual learning addresses this setting, whereby an agent faces a continual stream of problems and must strive to capture the knowledge necessary for solving each new task it encounters. If the agent is capable of accumulating knowledge in some form of compositional representation, it could then selectively reuse and combine relevant pieces of knowledge to construct novel solutions. Despite the intuitive appeal of this simple idea, the literatures on lifelong learning and compositional learning have proceeded largely separately. In an effort to promote developments that bridge between the two fields, this article surveys their respective research landscapes and discusses existing and future connections between them.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper’s contributions are as follows: 1. A survey of lifelong learning, including a categorization of the problem statements within lifelong learning as well as a categorization of potential approaches to these in language, vision, and robotics domains. 2. A survey of compositional learning, including a delineation between temporal and functional composition. 3. A call for research to investigate the use of compositional methods in lifelong learning.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
The paper presents a quite thorough analysis of the problem settings within the scope of lifelong and compositional ML. Many relevant prior works are discussed and categorized across multiple axes. The cross section of lifelong learning and compositionality is an interesting area to explore. A strength of the paper is in its detailed categorization of prior works in this area, in terms of problem setting, type of supervision, algorithmic approach, and architectural approach. The difference between temporal and functional composition is especially good to have written down as these concepts are often discussed interchangeably. The figures in the paper are well designed (except for Figure 4) The paper concludes with a nice list of further work to be done in the field. —— One weakness of the survey is a lack of criticism of the standard lifelong learning (LL) problem statement, especially in regards to the feasibility of learning compositional agents in an LL setting. As described in the paper, the standard LL problem setting is to maximize performance on all tasks while only being able to train on each task once, in sequence. The artificialness of this definition is discussed in the final paragraph before 2.2.1, which explains exactly why the standard LL problem doesn’t actually address a realistic setting, as it would be impossible to continually learn new tasks, and never forget ones that are never seen again, with a finite memory. However, the standard LL problem statement is particularly adversarial to compositional methods, as learning how to best decompose multiple tasks into reusable components is easiest when you can train on multiple tasks simultaneously, even if the overall distribution across tasks changes over time consistent with the broader LL motivation. The work would also benefit from a more specific discussion of what is generally assumed when LL or compositional approaches are used. For example, a task-agnostic setting where always the same input is mapped to different outputs depending on the (hidden) task is an arbitrarily difficult LL problem. Past tasks can only accelerate future learning if they are in some way related. Compositional structures can lead to worse performance if they don’t match the underlying structure of the environment, as they are a form of bias onto the final model. The paper successfully describes the width of prior work across LL and compositional learning, but it could include a bit more discussion on which LL methods are most promising for composition, and vice versa. An early paper on functional compositional learning in robotics that the authors may want to include: “Learning modular neural network policies for multi-task and multi-robot transfer” (Devin 2017)

**Requested Changes:**
I suggest adding some discussion to the points above. —————————— There are a few statements in the paper that are incorrect or insufficiently supported. “AI systems in the real world will not have access to batches of simultaneous tasks, but instead will face them in sequence in a lifelong setting”. -> An agent in the real world will likely be simultaneously parsing sound into text, predicting future video input, detecting object, estimating human poses, etc. There is no reason it would have to learn only one task at a time in sequence and then never see data for that task again. “In order for knowledge to be maximally reusable, it must capture a self-contained unit that can be composed with similar pieces of knowledge” -> This statement can be either viewed as a strong claim that needs significantly more evidence to say, or as vague philosophizing that doesn’t really say anything at all. “A service robot that has learned to both search-and-retrieve objets and navigate across a university building should be able to quickly learn to put these together to deliver a stapler to Rosie’s office. Instead, typical methods […]” -> This is how most hierarchical policy learning works already, which is common and old enough to be considered a typical method. —————————— In Figure 4, the supervised vs unsupervised delineation may not be necessary. Unsupervised learning is usually algorithmically equivalent to supervised, it just denotes whether the supervision is from a human or from a non-human (such as physics, time, etc). At the same time, there are only 2 papers that fall in the unsupervised bucket. This figure could also be transposed to have application domain as rows, and supervised vs RL as the marker-fill, which would be easier to read.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
Compositional and lifelong learning approaches will output different agents than unstructured, iid learning. How do they improve or worsen issues of bias and fairness?

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to review from ebXm: 1. **Lack of criticism to standard lifelong setting:** While we agree with the reviwer that the prevalent lifelong learning paradigms studied in the literature are to varying extents artificial, we strongly believe that the strictly sequential nature of the problem is not a weakness of the formulation. Learning compositional structures is certainly complicated by this strictly sequential setting, but that difficulty lies at the core of the lifelong compositional learning problem. For example, a home assistant robot may be deployed for a long time before it ever faces a task that requires opening a door. It is unreasonable to expect the robot to learn this new "component" by re-learning how to solve all previous tasks that require no door opening. We view this type of sequential decomposition as precisely the crux of the matter. Of course, specific applications of the problem may relax this constraint in a way that suits the concrete domain (e.g., maybe robots can train some initial decomposition in a set of pre-training tasks before being deployed for lifelong training). 2. **Discussion of lifelong and compositional assumptions:** * The approaches of various forms of lifelong learning methods are delineated in Section 2.1. The point the reviewer raises, regarding the arbitrary difficulty of mapping equivalent inputs to different outputs given hidden task information, is absolutely on point, and yet the literature mostly fails to discuss this explicitly. Our submission explicitly addresses this point in Section 4.2.5. * The various compositional assumptions are also discussed extensively in Section 2.2. We will expand our discussion to clarify that this form of bias may be detrimental if the _problem_ doesn't match the _method's_ assumptions (as the reviewer points out). 3. **Discussion about promising lifelong approaches for composition and vice versa:** This survey seeks to make the case that explicitly modular and compositional models are promising candidates for addressing the lifelong learning problem. While we largely refrain from making value judgments in order to offer a balanced review of the state of the field, we do state this claim in Sections 5 and 7 alongside the respective methods, and reiterate it more explicitly in Section 8. 4. **Cite to Devin et al. 2017:** Our original submission discussed Devin et al.'s work as an initial method in functionally compositional RL (page 26, bottom half). 5. **Suggested edits/revisions:** * "AI systems in the real world..." -- This is a good point. We meant to convey that the agent will be solving a single objective at a time (e.g., set the table, load the dishwasher...). But, as the reviewer rightly points out, there is no need for these higher-level objectives to match one-to-one with the agent's learning tasks. We will address this case in the revised manuscript. * "In order for knowledge..." -- As stated in the clause immediately preceding the quoted text, this is merely an intuition and not a formal statement. * "A service robot that has..." -- While indeed hierarchical RL approaches have existed for a while, 1) they are by no means the "typical" method used today, and 2) they are exceedingly rarely used in the lifelong setting, which is what the paragraph in question refers to. 6. **Figure 4:** We took the reviewer's suggestion to unify the supervised and unsupervised rows in Figure 4, and have drafted a revision. We do agree it makes the illustration much clearer (thanks!), and will include it in the revised manuscript. We will still maintain the distinction in the Appendix for completeness and precision.
paper_title_zh: 如何终身复用与组合知识：持续学习与功能组合综述
paper_abstract_zh: 人工智能（AI）的主要目标之一是创建一个能够获得对世界普遍理解的智能体。这样的智能体需要具备在不断遇到新经验时持续积累和构建其知识的能力。终身学习或持续学习针对的是这种情境，即智能体面临持续不断的问题流，并必须努力捕捉解决每个新任务所需的知识。如果智能体能够以某种组合表示形式积累知识，它就可以有选择地重用和组合相关知识片段，以构建新的解决方案。尽管这个简单想法直观上很有吸引力，但终身学习和组合学习领域的文献在很大程度上是独立发展的。为了促进这两个领域之间的桥梁建设，本文综述了它们各自的研究现状，并讨论了它们之间现有的和未来的联系。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文的贡献如下：1. 对终身学习进行了综述，包括对终身学习问题陈述的分类，以及对语言、视觉和机器人领域潜在方法的分类。2. 对组合学习进行了综述，包括对时间组合和功能组合的区分。3. 呼吁研究使用组合方法在终身学习中的应用。

**优点和缺点：**
本文对终身学习和组合机器学习范围内的问题设置进行了相当全面的分析。讨论并分类了许多相关的前期工作，跨越多个维度。终身学习和组合性的交叉是一个有趣的探索领域。本文的优点在于其对这一领域前期工作的详细分类，包括问题设置、监督类型、算法方法和架构方法。时间组合和功能组合之间的区别特别值得写下来，因为这些概念经常被交替讨论。本文中的图表设计得很好（图4除外）。本文以一份未来工作清单作为结尾，非常不错。——该综述的一个缺点是对标准终身学习（LL）问题陈述缺乏批评，尤其是在关于在LL设置中学习组合代理的可行性方面。正如文中所述，标准LL问题设置是在所有任务上最大化性能，而只能按顺序在每个任务上训练一次。这种定义的人工性在2.2.1之前的最后一段中进行了讨论，解释了为什么标准LL问题实际上并没有解决一个现实设置，因为不可能不断学习新任务，并且永远不会忘记那些再也不会看到的任务，尤其是在有限内存的情况下。然而，标准LL问题陈述对组合方法特别不利，因为当可以同时训练多个任务时，学习如何将多个任务分解为可重用组件是最容易的，即使任务的整体分布随时间变化，也符合更广泛的LL动机。本文还将受益于对使用LL或组合方法时通常假设的更具体讨论。例如，在一个任务无关的设置中，总是将相同的输入映射到不同的输出，这取决于（隐藏的）任务，这是一个任意困难的LL问题。过去的任务只有与未来任务相关时才能加速学习。如果组合结构不符合环境的底层结构，它们可能会导致性能下降，因为它们是对最终模型的一种偏见。本文成功描述了LL和组合学习的前期工作的广度，但可以包括更多关于哪些LL方法对组合最有前景，反之亦然的讨论。一篇关于机器人功能组合学习的早期论文，作者可能希望包括：“学习模块化神经网络策略以进行多任务和多机器人迁移”（Devin 2017）。

**建议的修改：**
我建议增加对上述观点的讨论。——本文中有一些陈述是不正确或支持不足的。“现实世界中的AI系统将无法访问同时进行的任务批次，而只能在终身设置中按顺序面对它们”。-> 现实世界中的代理可能会同时将声音解析为文本，预测未来视频输入，检测对象，估计人体姿态等。没有理由它必须一次只学习一个任务，然后永远不再看到该任务的数据。“为了使知识最大化可重用，它必须捕获一个自包含单元，可以与类似的知识片段组合”。-> 这句话可以被视为一个需要更多证据支持的强有力主张，或者被视为一种模糊的哲学化，实际上并没有说什么。“一个学会了搜索和检索对象以及穿越大学建筑导航的服务机器人应该能够快速学会将这些结合起来，将订书机送到Rosie的办公室。相反，典型的方法[…]”-> 这正是大多数分层策略学习已经做到的，这很常见且足够古老，可以被视为一种典型方法。——在图4中，监督与非监督的区分可能不必要。非监督学习通常在算法上等同于监督学习，它只是表示监督是来自人类还是非人类（如物理、时间等）。同时，只有2篇论文属于非监督类别。这个图也可以转置，以应用领域为行，监督与RL为标记填充，这样更容易阅读。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
组合和终身学习方法将输出与无结构、独立同分布学习不同的代理。它们如何改善或加剧偏见和公平性问题？

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳评论：**
对ebXm评论的回应：1. **对标准终身设置缺乏批评：** 虽然我们同意评审员的观点，即文献中研究的普遍终身学习范式在某种程度上是人为的，但我们坚信严格的顺序性质并不是公式化的弱点。学习组合结构确实因这种严格的顺序设置而变得复杂，但这一难度正是终身组合学习问题的核心。例如，一个家庭助理机器人在面对需要开门的任务之前可能已经部署了很长时间。期望机器人通过重新学习如何解决所有不需要开门的先前任务来学习这个新的“组件”是不合理的。我们认为这种类型的顺序分解正是问题的症结所在。当然，具体应用问题可能会以适合具体领域的方式放宽这一约束（例如，机器人在部署终身训练之前可能在一组预训练任务中训练一些初始分解）。2. **对终身和组合假设的讨论：** * 各种形式的终身学习方法在2.1节中进行了阐述。评审员提出的关于在给定隐藏任务信息的情况下将等效输入映射到不同输出的任意难度问题绝对是正确的，然而文献大多未能明确讨论这一点。我们的投稿在4.2.5节中明确指出了这一点。* 各种组合假设在2.2节中也进行了广泛讨论。我们将扩展我们的讨论，以澄清这种形式的偏见如果问题的假设与方法的不匹配（正如评审员指出的那样），可能会是有害的。3. **关于终身方法对组合的潜力以及反之亦然的讨论：** 本综述旨在论证显式模块化和组合模型是解决终身学习问题的有前景的候选者。虽然我们大多避免做出价值判断，以提供对领域现状的平衡回顾，但我们在5节和7节中以及相应的方法中提出了这一主张，并在8节中更明确地重申了这一点。4. **引用Devin等人2017年的工作：** 我们的原投稿将Devin等人的工作讨论为功能组合RL的初始方法（第26页，下半部分）。5. **建议的编辑/修订：** * “现实世界中的AI系统…”——这是一个好观点。我们本意是传达代理将一次解决一个目标（例如，摆桌子，装洗碗机…）。但是，正如评审员正确指出的那样，这些更高级别的目标没有必要与代理的学习任务一一对应。我们将在修订稿中讨论这种情况。* “为了使知识…”——正如引用文本前一句所述，这仅仅是一种直觉，而不是正式声明。* “一个服务机器人…”——虽然确实存在分层RL方法已经有一段时间了，但1）它们绝不是今天使用的“典型”方法，并且2）它们在终身设置中极少使用，这正是问题段落所指的内容。6. **图4：** 我们采纳了评审员的建议，将图4中的监督和非监督行统一，并草拟了修订稿。我们确实认为这使插图更加清晰（谢谢！），并将其包含在修订稿中。我们仍将在附录中保留这一区分，以保持完整性和精确性。

paper_title: Measurement properties of the translations of instruments evaluating the subjective effects of tobacco- and nicotine-containing products:  a systematic review of the literature
paper_abstract:
Background: Several instruments are widely used for assessing dependence, craving, withdrawal symptoms, and reinforcing effects in users of tobacco- and nicotine-containing products (TNP), including the Fagerström Test for Nicotine Dependence (FTND), Questionnaire of Smoking Urges, original (QSU) and brief (QSU-b) versions; Minnesota Nicotine Withdrawal Scale, original (MNWS) and revised (MNWS-R) versions; and Cigarette Evaluation Questionnaire, original (CEQ) and modified (mCEQ) versions. Although these instruments have been translated extensively, their translations and corresponding measurement properties have not been systematically assessed. This study aimed to (1) identify the translations of these instruments for which psychometric properties have been published, (2) describe the methods used for translation, and (3) describe the measurement properties and the context in which these translations were evaluated (e.g., target population and TNP used). 
 Methods: Embase and MEDLINE databases were systematically searched. 
 Results: While no information could be found for the CEQ/mCEQ, several translations were available for the remaining instruments: FTND, 25; QSU and QSU-b, 4 each; QSU (12-item version), 1; MNWS, 4; and MNWS-R, 1. Cigarette smokers represented the main target population in which the validation studies were conducted. Information about the translation process was reported for 25 translations. In most cases, the properties of the translations mirrored those of the originals. Differential item functioning was explored in only one case. 
 Conclusions: There are few publications describing the measurement properties of the translations of the FTND, QSU/QSU-b, and MNWS/MNWS-R. None of these translations have been validated for TNPs other than cigarettes, which suggests the need for greater development and validation of instruments in this area.
review_content:
This manuscript reports on a comprehensive review of the psychometric properties of the translated versions of some frequently used nicotine dependence (ND) assessments. The range of psychometric properties used to test equivalence of the translated ND measures was as rigorous as possible, given that there was considerable variability in the translation process and reporting of psychometric properties across the studies.

The review found a surprising lack of rigorous assessment of measurement invariance (differential item functioning) for translated versions compared to the original English language versions. This is mentioned in the Discussion, but it seems important to more strongly emphasize that the psychometric properties examined in this study can evaluate measurement equivalence, but not measurement invariance. Although factor structure, reliability, and validity appeared similar for most of the translations, it is possible that the meaning of the ND measure was different for the translated versions compared to the English version. This potential lack of measurement invariance might be a reason for the psychometric differences that were found. Without testing for measurement invariance, the possibility of unaccounted noninvariance remains a potential confounder in subsequent statistical analyses using the translated ND measures, and may be an important factor in frequent failure to replicate findings across studies using the same measures.

In the Introduction, the authors indicate that it is crucial to ensure “cross-cultural equivalence between the original versions and their translations”. This suggests that observed translation differences in the ND measures are related to cultural differences. However, the reasons for the differences are indeterminate. The differences may be attributed to cultural differences, but also they could be due to changes in the wording in the translated measures, study design, or a myriad number of other factors. This should be clarified.

The drawback of such a comprehensive review is that it is very difficult to keep track of all the psychometric differences, and there is no clear way to determine when the identified differences may be considered significant or meaningful and when they may be insignificant or inconsequential. In addition, the supplemental tables provide more information, but they were not easy to locate. Perhaps there could be more detailed instructions for accessing those tables.
paper_title_zh: 烟草和含尼古丁产品主观效应评估工具翻译版本的测量属性：文献的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：多种工具被广泛用于评估烟草和含尼古丁产品（TNP）使用者的依赖性、渴望、戒断症状和强化效应，包括法格斯特罗姆尼古丁依赖测试（FTND）、吸烟渴望问卷（QSU）及其原始和简短版本（QSU-b）、明尼苏达尼古丁戒断量表（MNWS）及其原始和修订版本（MNWS-R）、以及香烟评估问卷（CEQ）及其原始和修改版本（mCEQ）。尽管这些工具已被广泛翻译，但其翻译及相应的测量属性尚未得到系统评估。本研究旨在（1）识别已发表心理测量属性的这些工具的翻译版本，（2）描述翻译所使用的方法，以及（3）描述这些翻译的测量属性及其评估的背景（例如，目标人群和使用的TNP）。

方法：系统检索Embase和MEDLINE数据库。

结果：尽管未找到CEQ/mCEQ的相关信息，但其余工具存在多个翻译版本：FTND有25个；QSU和QSU-b各有4个；QSU（12项版本）有1个；MNWS有4个；MNWS-R有1个。香烟吸烟者是验证研究的主要目标人群。25个翻译版本报告了翻译过程的信息。在大多数情况下，翻译版本的属性与原始版本相似。仅在一例中探讨了差异项功能。

结论：描述FTND、QSU/QSU-b和MNWS/MNWS-R翻译版本测量属性的出版物较少。这些翻译版本均未针对除香烟以外的TNP进行验证，这表明在该领域需要进一步开发和验证相关工具。
review_content_zh:
本文稿对一些常用尼古丁依赖（ND）评估工具的翻译版本的心理测量特性进行了全面综述。鉴于翻译过程和各研究中心理测量特性的报告存在相当大的变异性，用于测试翻译ND测量工具等效性的心理测量特性范围尽可能严格。

综述发现，与原始英语版本相比，翻译版本在测量不变性（差异项目功能）的严格评估方面存在令人惊讶的不足。这一点在讨论中有所提及，但似乎有必要更加强调，本研究中考察的心理测量特性可以评估测量等效性，但不能评估测量不变性。尽管大多数翻译的因子结构、可靠性和有效性看起来相似，但与英语版本相比，翻译版本的ND测量意义可能不同。这种潜在的测量不变性缺乏可能是发现的心理测量差异的原因。如果不进行测量不变性测试，使用翻译ND测量工具的后续统计分析中，未解释的非不变性仍可能是一个潜在的混杂因素，并且可能是使用相同测量工具的各研究间频繁未能复制发现的重要因素。

在引言中，作者指出确保“原始版本与其翻译之间的跨文化等效性”至关重要。这表明观察到的ND测量中的翻译差异与文化差异有关。然而，差异的原因尚不确定。这些差异可能归因于文化差异，但也可能是由于翻译测量工具中的措辞变化、研究设计或众多其他因素。这一点应予以澄清。

此类全面综述的缺点是，很难追踪所有心理测量差异，并且没有明确的方法来确定何时发现的差异可被视为显著或有意义，何时可能无关紧要或无足轻重。此外，补充表格提供了更多信息，但它们不易找到。或许可以提供更详细的说明以便访问这些表格。

The range of psychometric properties used to test equivalence of the translated ND measures was as rigorous as possible, given that there was considerable variability in the translation process and reporting of psychometric properties across the studies.

The drawback of such a comprehensive review is that it is very difficult to keep track of all the psychometric differences, and there is no clear way to determine when the identified differences may be considered significant or meaningful and when they may be insignificant or inconsequential.
However, the reasons for the differences are indeterminate.
The differences may be attributed to cultural differences, but also they could be due to changes in the wording in the translated measures, study design, or a myriad number of other factors.
This should be clarified.
In addition, the supplemental tables provide more information, but they were not easy to locate.
Perhaps there could be more detailed instructions for accessing those tables.

paper_title: Open science approaches to COVID-19
paper_abstract: In only a matter of months, the coronavirus disease of 2019 (COVID-19) has spread around the world. The global impact of the disease has caused significant and repeated calls for quick action towards new medicines and vaccines. In response, researchers have adopted open science methods to begin to combat this disease via global collaborative efforts. We summarise here some of those initiatives, and have created an updateable list to which others may be added. Though open science has previously been shown as an accelerator of biomedical research, the COVID-19 crisis has made openness seem the logical choice. Will openness persist in the discovery of new medicines, after the crisis has receded?
review_content:
This is a very timely, excellent manuscript that both highlights and supports open drug discovery research especially for COVID-19 and possible future pandemics. The authors provide a nice overview of different types of open research activities related to the research response to COVID-19.

There has been indeed an unprecedented level of sharing data and resources since the beginning of the pandemic and it is difficult to cover all of these developments in a short review. I would nevertheless suggest a few additions. Thus, I recommend adding a statement on the availability of computational resources besides Folding@home such as COVID-19 HPC consortium (https://www.xsede.org/covid19-hpc-consortium).

I would also suggest a broader acknowledgment of multiple journals and publishers that agreed to provide open access to all papers on the topic of COVID-19. A possibly complete list is available from the Wellcome Trust (https://wellcome.org/press-release/publishers-make-coronavirus-covid-19-content-freely-available-and-reusable).

Finally, I would recommend that the authors expand on the important issue of the quality of research publications. The authors mention that even preprint servers stopped accepting manuscripts with countless purely computationally repurposed drugs against the disease with no experimental confirmation. It would be prudent to cite a recent publication in Nature Biotechnology on the need for automated peer review of the publications tsunami (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-020-0686-x)1 and perhaps, emphasize the importance of rigor, experimental support, and reproducibility of research findings reported in both preprint servers and peer-reviewed publications.
paper_title_zh: 开放科学方法应对COVID-19
paper_abstract_zh: 在短短几个月内，2019年冠状病毒病（COVID-19）已在全球范围内传播。该疾病的全球影响引发了对于新药物和疫苗快速行动的显著且反复的呼吁。作为回应，研究人员采用了开放科学方法，通过全球协作努力开始对抗这一疾病。我们在本文中总结了其中一些倡议，并创建了一个可更新的清单，以便添加更多内容。尽管开放科学已被证明是生物医学研究的加速器，但COVID-19危机使开放性显得成为逻辑上的选择。在危机消退后，开放性是否会在新药物的发现中持续存在？
review_content_zh:
这是一篇非常及时、优秀的稿件，既突出了又支持了开放药物发现研究，尤其是针对COVID-19和可能出现的未来大流行病。作者对与COVID-19研究响应相关的不同类型的开放研究活动进行了很好的概述。

自大流行病开始以来，确实出现了前所未有的数据共享和资源共享水平，在一篇简短的综述中很难涵盖所有这些进展。尽管如此，我还是建议做一些补充。因此，我建议除了 Folding@home 之外，增加关于计算资源可用性的声明，例如 COVID-19 HPC 联盟（https://www.xsede.org/covid19-hpc-consortium）。

我还建议更广泛地认可多家期刊和出版商同意提供对COVID-19主题所有论文的开放获取。Wellcome Trust提供了一个可能的完整列表（https://wellcome.org/press-release/publishers-make-coronavirus-covid-19-content-freely-available-and-reusable）。

最后，我建议作者扩展关于研究出版物质量的重要问题。作者提到，即使是预印本服务器也停止接受无数纯粹通过计算重新定位的药物稿件，这些药物没有实验验证。引用《自然·生物技术》上最近一篇关于出版物海啸需要自动化同行评审的文章（https://www.nature.com/articles/s41587-020-0686-x）1，并强调在预印本服务器和同行评审出版物中报告的研究成果的严谨性、实验支持和可重复性的重要性，将是明智的。

paper_title: Recent advances in biochar application for water and wastewater treatment: A review
paper_abstract: In the past decade, researchers have carried out a massive amount of research on the application of biochar for contaminants removal from aqueous solutions. As an emerging sorbent with great potential, biochar has shown significant advantages such as the broad sources of feedstocks, easy preparation process, and favorable surface and structural properties. This review provides an overview of recent advances in biochar application in water and wastewater treatment, including a brief discussion of the involved sorption mechanisms of contaminants removal, as well as the biochar modification methods.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Hrissi Karapanagioti) Basic reporting The manuscript is well-written with minor editing mistakes, but the use of the terminology related to sorption can be further improved. Please see suggestions in the annotated pdf file. Thank you very much for your time, and we appreciate a lot for your elaborative review of our manuscript. We have corrected the use of terminology related to sorption and changed them to “sorption” or “removal”, “sorb”, “sorbent”, and “sorbate” according to your annotation in the annotated pdf file. Besides, we have revised all the piecemeal mistakes according to your annotation: 1) Corrected citation mistakes throughout the text 2) Deleted article “the” (line 204) 3) Added the word “polar” (line 212) 4) Corrected the word “environmentally” (line 274) 5) Erased the repeated unit “℃” (line 299) 6) Accuracy (line 391). Also, we have improved the accuracy throughout the text by using integer or one decimal place. 7) Corrected the word “selected” (line 476) 8) Deleted the phrase “by 1.3 times” (line 514) Sufficient references are used, but some key references are missing, and suggestions are provided in the annotated pdf file. a) Manariotis et al. (2017). “In Focus: Novel Sorbents for Environmental Remediation” Journal of Chemical Technology and Biotechnology, V. 92, No. 8. Editorial and papers by Deliyanni, Werner, Boutsika, etc. b) Boutsika et al. (2014). “Aqueous Mercury Sorption by Biochar from Malt Spent Rootlets” Water, Air & Soil Pollution 225 (1), Article 1805. c) Manariotis et al. (2015). “Preparation and characterization of biochar sorbents produced from malt spent rootlets” Industrial and Engineering Chemistry Research, V. 54, 9577-9584. d) Boutsika et al. (2017). “Effect of chloride and nitrate salts on Hg(II) sorption by raw and pyrolyzed malt spent rootlets” Journal of Chemical Technology and Biotechnology, V. 92, No. 8, p. 1912-1918. Thank you. We have added these key references: a) and papers published on “Journal of Chemical Technology and Biotechnology,” which were presented in the 2017 European Geosciences Union session “Novel Sorbents for Environmental Remediation” (Sanroman et al., 2017b; Manariotis et al., 2017). (lines 115-117) b) Boutsika et al. (2014) employed biochar produced from malt spent rootlets (MSR) to remove Hg(II) from pure aqueous solutions. The removal efficiency was up to 100% after a 24 h contact time at biochar concentrations of 1 g·L-1, with the maximum Hg(II) sorption capacity of 103 mg·g-1. (lines 253-256) c) Reports have shown that the physicochemical properties of biochar such as surface area, porosity, acid-base behavior, surface functional groups, and element composition depend on pyrolysis temperatures and feedstock types (Ahmad et al., 2014; Uchimiya et al., 2013; Nachenius et al., 2013; Manariotis et al., 2015). (lines 85-88) Their later study showed that the Hg sorption capacity by MSR biochars increased by a maximum factor of 6 for high-temperature (750-900℃) biochars compared to the raw material (Manariotis et al., 2015). (lines 256-258) d) Hg(II) sorption onto both materials carried on mainly through neutral species (Boutsika et al., 2017). (lines 258-259) The article is well-structured, the figures are useful, and another figure is proposed to organize the last section that is on concerns and future suggestions. Thank you for your suggestion. We have added this figure (Figure 3. Environmental concerns and future research directions of biochar application) that organized the last section of the manuscript. Experimental design Manuscript content is within the Aims and Scope of the journal. Rigorous investigation was performed, but still some key references are missing. See the annotated pdf file. Revised accordingly. Thank you. The structure of the review is well-prepared. However, some points need to be better highlighted and should be on new separate subsections. See the annotated pdf file. Thank you very much for your suggestion. We have re-constructed the relevant parts and set three new subsections according to your annotation. Please refer to the line numbers in the revised manuscript: 1) Indicator organisms and pathogens (lines 342-366) 2) Magnetization (lines 642-678) 3) Biofilm formation (lines 680-704) Besides, we have made revisions in Figure 2 (Figure 2. Modification methods of biochar according to different emphases) to make it consistent with the revised text. Validity of the findings The information is well-presented and well-discussed with future concerns and suggestions provided at the end of the manuscript. The current use of biochar or similar material in wastewater facilities is not sufficiently described. Thank you very much for your comment and suggestion. We have added this part as a subsection, describing the current application of biochar in wastewater treatment facilities. Please refer to lines 449-471 in the revised manuscript. Comments for the author The use of the sorption terminology requires attention and should be carefully used throughout the manuscript. Revised accordingly. Thank you. Specific comments 1) Line 33. “Numerous" and only one reference is cited? Thank you. We have added more references here (lines 57-59): Numerous researches have shown the interests of biochar in improving soil properties and increasing crop yield (Windeatt et al., 2014; Agegnehu et al., 2017; Awad et al., 2017; ÖZ, 2018; Yu et al., 2019). 2) Lines 54-55. “making biochar an easy-to-get and renewable adsorbent and appropriate for low-income communities” Not true in all cases, since high surface area materials require high-temperature pyrolysis. Thank you. We have reworded this expression to “providing more options to produce such renewable sorbents, which benefits the low-income communities to some extent.” (lines 78-79) 3) Line 62. “smaller size of biochar particles” Not true because it depends on the size of the raw material. In both cases, it can be fixed in any shape and size. Thank you for your comment. For the sake of the logicality and smoothness of the manuscript, we have decreased the paragraph where the above expression was located and combined it with the previous paragraph. The revised paragraph is as follows (lines 67-82): Water and wastewater treatment is one of the emerging subsets of biochar application. Due to the properties of large surface area and pore volume, rich organic carbon content and mineral components, abundant and diverse functional groups, biochar displays prominent sorption ability for both inorganic and organic contaminants in aqueous solutions (Ahmad et al., 2014). Traditional techniques for contaminants removal from the aqueous phase, for example, ion exchange, membrane separation, chemical precipitation, and sorption using activated carbon, have disadvantages such as high cost and inevitable generation of a large number of chemical residues with no economic value (Oliveira et al., 2017). In contrast, biochar can be produced from green wastes, mainly agricultural biomass and solid wastes such as woodchips, straws, shells, bagasse, and manure (Ahmad et al., 2014; Nanda et al., 2016; Thornley et al., 2009). The resources of feedstocks are among the wealthiest renewable resources in the ecosystem (Yao et al., 2012; Xu et al., 2013), providing more options to produce such renewable sorbents, which benefits the low-income communities to some extent. Moreira et al. (2017) compared the global environmental impacts between the production process of biochar and activated carbon. The production process of biochar showed fewer carbon emissions. Biochar as a sorption material is an environmentally friendly alternative to activated carbon. 4) Lines 71-73. “Positive values imply damaging burdens, and negative ones indicate environmental credits, which partly counteract the environmental impacts” Explain it. Thank you. We have reworded it in a more easy-to-understand expression (lines 79-82): Moreira et al. (2017) compared the global environmental impacts between the production process of biochar and activated carbon. The main findings encouraged biochar to be an environmentally friendly alternative to activated carbon, mainly reflected by net mitigation of carbon emissions in the biochar production process. 5) Line 196. “influence the surface charge of the uptake rate of a compound” Reword or explain. It is not clear. We have reworded it in lines 189-191: Chen et al. (2012) revealed that the biochar’s surface area is influenced by the pyrolysis temperature, affecting the uptake rate of naphthalene (NAP) in solutions. 6) Lines 292-294. “It was found that the biochar prepared at 700℃ has a better adsorption effect for naphthalene, while the biochar made at 200℃ has a better adsorption effect for naphthol.” This is very interesting! It is worthwhile to elaborate more on the mechanisms involved in the two different materials and sorbates. Thank you very much for your interest and suggestion. We have elaborated on the involved mechanisms in lines 285-291: For biochars pyrolyzed at lower temperatures, their polar surface due to the presence of water molecules has additional polar interactions (e.g., hydrogen bonds) with 1-naphthol, resulting in higher sorption capacity than NAP. Meanwhile, the partition is favored as the sorbate concentration increases, but adsorption rapidly reaches saturation (Chen et al., 2008). OP200 had the maximal sorption capacity for 1-naphthol with high concentration due to polar interactions and high partition. However, OP700 exhibited an optimum sorption capacity for NAP because of its highest surface area and low surface polarity, which facilitated the NAP sorption. 7) Lines 337-348. This paragraph is out of the scope of the manuscript. Decrease and combine with the paragraph below. Thank you. We have decreased this paragraph and combined it with the paragraph below and set a new subsection “Antibiotics” for it, with additional references. Please refer to lines 321-340 in the revised manuscript. 8) Lines 381-386. This paragraph is out of the scope of the manuscript. Decrease and combine with the paragraph below. Thank you. We have deleted this paragraph and written a new little paragraph to lead the “Inorganic ions” subsection (lines 369-372): In virtue of the convenience and little generation of secondary contamination (Yang et al., 2018; Yin et al., 2017), biochar are popular in inorganic ions removal, which targets at the removal of nutrient elements N and P that exist in the form of inorganic ions in wastewater, and F- in drinking water. 9) Line 712. “including the sub-Saharan African countries” In Africa, they have this technology for water filtration, but they call the material bonechar instead of biochar since it is produced from bone charing. Thank you very much for your comment and technical help. We have reworded this part in lines 729-732: In this case, arduous research work needs to be carried out to solve the potential environmental problems and provide the developing countries with exercisable research directions to expand the application of biochar.X
paper_title_zh: 生物炭在水及废水处理中应用的最新进展：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在过去十年中，研究人员对生物炭在水溶液中去除污染物的应用进行了大量研究。作为一种具有巨大潜力的新兴吸附剂，生物炭展现出诸多显著优势，如原料来源广泛、制备过程简便以及优良的表面和结构特性。本综述概述了生物炭在水和废水处理中应用的最新进展，包括对污染物去除涉及的吸附机制的简要讨论，以及生物炭改性方法。
review_content_zh:
