paper_title_zh: 《开源软件期刊（JOSS）：设计与首年回顾》
paper_abstract_zh: 本文描述了《开源软件期刊》（Journal of Open Source Software, JOSS）的动机、设计和进展。JOSS是一个免费且开放获取的期刊，发表描述研究软件的文章。它具有双重目标：提高提交软件的质量，并为研究软件开发者提供获得认可的机制。虽然设计上符合当前科学界的评价体系，但JOSS解决了科学贡献中以软件形式做出的关键贡献缺乏奖励的问题。JOSS发表的文章封装了软件本身所包含的学术成果，其严格的同行评审针对软件组件：功能性、文档、测试、持续集成和许可证。一篇JOSS文章包含描述软件目的和功能的摘要、参考文献以及指向软件存档的链接。文章是JOSS提交的入口点，涵盖了一整套软件制品。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1。此外，请见以下几点。一个反复出现的担忧是大多数作品只有一个审稿人。这需要解释。如何识别和处理利益冲突？如何确保审稿人具备知识和技能？如果任何人都可以自愿审稿且这是唯一的检查方式，如何确保质量？在这种情况下如何评估正确性？是否有其他人审查过所接受作品的质量？我们已经根据许多审稿人的意见进行了修改，具体如本文档其余部分所述。关于审稿人数的问题，我们已经回应了审稿人#1和#2的意见。我们相信，我们在审稿人选择和审稿方面的努力达到了（在某些情况下甚至超过了）大多数其他期刊的水平，因为整个过程是公开和透明的。此外，我们为审稿增加了结构，认为这有助于确保我们的投稿质量标准得到满足。一些编辑确实会定期分配两名审稿人，其他编辑几乎以审稿人的身份参与审稿，以帮助确保质量（特别是如果审稿过程非常快）。我们也有一项利益冲突政策，审稿人必须同意；这比大多数其他期刊更进一步，尽管我们通常信任审稿人——审稿过程的公开性和审稿人身份的透明性有助于确保遵守利益冲突政策。第1页，共10页。

另一个担忧是对读者的支持。这似乎是一个弱点，应该讨论，并明确计划如何解决。了解谁阅读JOSS作品、他们之后做什么、是否有引用统计、是否有重复投稿、新投稿是否引用旧投稿等会很有帮助。我们已经澄清，该期刊主要旨在为作者/软件开发者服务。然而，我们确实计划增加更好的搜索功能，包括基于语言和领域的标签，这将使查找软件/文章更容易。然而，JOSS的设计并不是为了像典型期刊那样阅读，其主要重点是创建可引用的软件实体。由于这个原因，我们没有关于读者群的任何信息。我们在结论中添加了一些初步（且不完整）的引用统计信息，以及两篇引用旧版本文章的证据。

另一个担忧是关于开放科学、以美国为中心、学术界和行业晋升/发展优先事项的必要变化、目标受众等背景问题。我们已经对这些话题的评论进行了回应。另一个担忧是关于JOSS的新颖性、相关努力的文献综述，以及理解JOSS作品如何融入更广泛的基础设施。例如，请参见下文关于Calgo的讨论。此外，它如何融入教育领域（投稿是否被教师或学生使用）或软件工程？ 我们在第3.4节中增加了一些关于Calgo和其他领域特定期刊的讨论。关于教育方面，JOSS特别关注具有研究应用价值的软件（参见投稿要求http://joss.theoj.org/about#submission_requirements），因此针对教育应用的软件不在其范围内。然而，一些JOSS编辑已经启动了一个新的姊妹期刊，《开源教育杂志》，该期刊将接受教育软件和材料。另一个问题是依赖GitHub和假设环境中的其他部分。大多数投稿为Python或R的事实表明，应该对扩大投稿来源的多样性进行一些讨论。例如，随着当前对Jupyter笔记本的兴趣增加，是否有与之相关的投稿？我们在第13页增加了一些关于GitHub通知相关问题的讨论。我们认为，Python和R的高比例反映了这些语言在现代科学计算中的流行以及与开源研究软件社区的紧密联系。此外，与rOpenSci的合作也导致了大量R语言的投稿。我们在第5节中增加了一些讨论。我们已经讨论了将笔记本作为投稿类型，但目前不接受独立的笔记本。请参阅附上的手稿副本中的标记。关于“Calgo”的注释，请参见http://calgo.acm.org/和http://toms.acm.org/algorithms-policy.cfm。似乎有必要对这一长期运行的算法平台进行一些讨论。第2页，共10页。我们已经根据标记的手稿进行了推荐的编辑，并在第3.4节中提到了CALGO。

审稿人#1：可能有必要包含一些关于如何识别和/或选择JOSS投稿审稿人的信息。这似乎是一个相当开放的评审系统，我想知道编辑们是否有协议来处理多个未经邀请的审稿人跳入投稿的评审GitHub问题，可能会出现意见冲突或经验偏见的情况。我们在第4.1节的第2点中增加了一些关于审稿人选择的额外细节。我们尚未看到许多未经邀请的审稿人加入投稿评审的情况，尽管出现的少数未经邀请的评论在性质上是建设性的。任何出现的问题——或违反JOSS行为准则的情况——将由投稿的编辑处理。鉴于JOSS评审完全通过GitHub问题进行，且大多数审稿人通常在GitHub上处理自己的项目，JOSS编辑是否利用了任何特殊的定制或添加功能，以帮助JOSS评审评论从审稿人可能接触到的GitHub通知的“噪音”中脱颖而出？或者编辑们是否有其他想法，以确保JOSS评审通知不会被错过，正如简要提到的导致一些评审延迟的原因。 我们在第13页增加了一些关于GitHub通知相关问题的讨论。审稿人#2

本文描述了《开源软件期刊》（Journal of Open Source Software）的设计，并介绍了自其创立以来的第一年的经验。首先，我想提到我完全支持将开源软件发表在描述软件并评审一些质量指标的文章中，这使软件能够在科学文献中被引用，并给予作者适当的认可。我也欣赏这一过程的开放性，并祝贺本文的作者们在JOSS迄今为止所取得的成功。像这样的论文几乎不可能因科学价值而被拒绝，因为它描述了一个过程，我的评论大多是一种建议，有时是个人意见，很少是纠正。

第1节

首先，目标读者并不完全清楚。文章中有相当多的软件开发技术术语。我认为这些术语与科研软件工程师社区相关，可能范围更广（包括本审稿人）。在更广泛的学术背景下，将软件发表在文章中、使其可引用以及为科研软件工程师建立奖励和认可系统的主题确实没有得到足够的重视。本文不会直接回应这一讨论，因此我建议在开头明确指出，目标社区是已经专业化的科研软件社区以及可能向本期刊投稿的读者，而不是更广泛的学术社区。我们在第2页第一段中增加了一句话，以明确目标读者：“我们预计本文将对以下两个核心读者群体感兴趣：(1) 开发软件并可能将他们的工作提交给JOSS的研究人员，(2) 对推进学术交流感兴趣并可能欣赏JOSS期刊框架技术细节的社区成员，以及(3) 对在其自己的研究出版物中引用软件的可能性感兴趣的读者。”

与上述相关，更广泛地讨论开放科学方面的内容将受到欢迎（仍在本文的范围内）。我支持与开放科学相关的开源软件运动，但也存在缺点和批评。在你们的设置中，哪些方面是你们明确不解决的？作者在开头提到了开源的伦理问题，并在最后描述了软件开发的问题，但没有涉及开放性部分。这本期刊如何促进更广泛的开放科学实践的发展（显然包括开放获取，但不仅仅是开放数据到开源软件）？ 这是一个在引言中可以稍作更多描述的主题，而不是想当然地认为开源软件是开放科学的核心原则，JOSS通过提供遵循最佳实践的激励措施，鼓励开源软件的共享。事实上，我们认为JOSS主要在这一领域做出贡献，而不是开放获取（尽管我们的文章是开放获取的）。我们在第2页引言的末尾添加了一句话来反映这一点：“JOSS还通过鼓励研究人员公开分享他们的软件并遵循其开发的最佳实践，支持更广泛的开放科学运动。”我们意识到关于开源的挑战和机遇的讨论仍在进行中。这些已在其他地方进行了广泛而深入的讨论，超出了本文的范围。本期刊旨在支持那些决定将他们的软件开源并鼓励在开源软件工作中遵循良好实践的人。类似的期刊确实存在，也有保持讨论论文开放的期刊（摘要暗示这是第一个此类期刊），例如欧洲地球物理联盟的期刊，包括软件和数据期刊如GMD。突出JOSS在这些具有相似目标的领域期刊中的独特定位会很有帮助。也可能有必要参考和讨论具有相似目标的仪器期刊。它们不发表新的科学成果，而是描述仪器、校准等。我们在第3.4节中扩展了对其他软件期刊的讨论，包括一些领域特定的期刊，并与JOSS进行比较和对比。一个评论是，该期刊似乎非常以美国为中心，有一些例外，这在文章投稿中如何体现？是否有策略来拓宽这一点？我们添加了新的图8，展示了第一年发表论文的所有作者的国家，并在第15页添加了讨论段落。目前，在我们的19位编辑中，有6.5位位于美国以外（0.5来自我们一位编辑的双重隶属关系）。我们相信，扩大编辑委员会将帮助我们接触到那些尚未充分代表的国家的作者，期刊的自然增长和认可也将如此。第4页共10页第1节结束时没有总结期刊包含的内容。它进一步描述了。它是关于发布软件的，但没有说明它在多大程度上涉及（是否包括代码、文档、测试，还是仅仅是描述？）。读者需要一份总结。 我们在第1节的最后一段中添加了一个总结JOSS文章的句子：“文章从高层描述了软件，而软件本身包括源代码以及相关的工件，如测试、文档和示例。” 第2节 虽然我同意这一节，但有一些评论：作者提到实际的学术成就是完整的软件环境，产生数据的代码。这是对科学和学术研究的非常狭隘的看法。这是一种仅从技术角度看待科学研究的方法，它暗示了整个研究创造过程都在软件开发中。此外，它只采取了纯粹的学术观点，而21世纪的研究与社会的、经济的和生态的挑战有着紧密的联系，这在代码中并未体现。我强烈不同意这一说法，并建议措辞要更加谨慎。这是个人意见。我们在纯技术背景下讨论计算研究，并同意一般研究涉及的远不止软件。然而，对于涉及软件的研究，我们的观点是学术成就包括软件，因此这方面的努力应得到充分认可。这本期刊的动机不应是研究软件工程师的职业生涯。它应该是良好的科学实践。作为一个副作用，它可能有助于职业发展，但这个问题更多地与许多学术机构中现有的奖励和评价体系有关。拥有这本期刊可能解决了一个方面，但并非科学社区中软件工程师缺乏职业前景的实际原因。这需要在学术体系中，特别是其领导层中解决。开发者回避发表可引用的论文并不是一个有力的论点。他们应该这样做，因为这是良好科学实践的一部分，它包含了独立的同行评审质量检查、时间戳，并允许引用。论文也是一种时间戳，认可作者对科学过程的原始贡献，这一点也可以更清楚地说明。请注意，有一些领域特定的期刊不要求新的科学成果。根据我个人的经验，作为其中之一的编辑，这更多的是一个文化问题。审稿人非常关注科学成果，很难仅基于方法和工具来评审论文。与科学文化（在许多领域）相关的挑战有很多：如何认可数字产品、出处和可重复性，以及许多社会问题，包括对出版物外个人的认可、多样性等。JOSS并不是试图直接解决这个完整的问题，而是专注于一个小部分：认可软件和软件贡献者。如果我们在这部分取得成功，这将影响整个科学文化。 第3节“装扮成……”听起来有点弱。第5页（共10页）

我们已替换了第4页上的短语：“JOSS为开发者提供了一个发布其完整研究软件的场所，这些软件被装扮成软件文章，并包裹在相对较短的高水平文章中，从而使其工作能够获得引用信用。”不清楚JOSS是否也检查软件的原创性，即它是否没有重新发明轮子。科学论文同行评审的一个目标就是作者是第一个发现结果并在其上打上时间戳的人（见上文）。该期刊是否允许任何研究软件，还是它有助于避免重新发明轮子？我缺少关于原创性的这一方面（也见第4节关于评审标准，其中似乎隐藏在需求声明中）。正如我们所澄清的，JOSS的主要目标是通过对可引用文章的发布，为研究软件的开发者提供信用。因此，我们通常不选择/评审原创性或潜在影响，而是评审软件是否符合我们的标准。这一节在目标上有点不清楚。一方面它只是“广告”，另一方面它提到了详细的代码评审。如果只评审高水平的功能，那么在JOSS中实际上有什么可评审的？如何定义质量和原创性？那么，如何像科学论文的同行评审那样确定影响和质量？代码评审是否承担这一角色？这是否包括编码标准、基准测试、检查科学结果的正确性（除了代码测试之外）？JOSS中同行评审的目标不是评判投稿的接受或拒绝，而是将投稿提升到可接受的标准。任何符合我们标准的投稿都应被接受，因为我们不基于潜在影响或质量（超出符合我们标准所隐含的）进行筛选。同行评审包括代码、软件功能、测试以及任何相关的工件（文档、示例等）。我们在第5页添加了一句话，澄清了同行评审的目标。

第3.4节仅与通用研究软件期刊进行比较。最好也与一些领域期刊进行比较。我们在第8页添加了对一些领域期刊的讨论（Collected Algorithms, Computer Physics Communications, 和 Geoscientific Model Development），并链接到了一个发布软件/软件文章的期刊列表（包括领域特定和更广泛的期刊）。

第4/5节我认为至少一名评审员实在太少。这样做的依据是什么？最初创建JOSS的主编（Arfon Smith）有天体物理学的背景，在该领域单名评审员是标准做法。然而，我们认识到这对许多研究领域来说并不正常。 二次评审是可能的，一些编辑在处理JOSS投稿时通常会征求多方评审，尤其是当编辑对自己在相关领域、软件及评审方面的理解不够自信时。我们计划在我们的基础设施中建立对多方评审的一流支持。我们也想指出，评审的目标是将论文提升到可接受的标准，而不仅仅是判断其是否被接受或拒绝。既然如此，是否需要超过一位评审员来提供帮助和反馈并不明确，特别是如果我们可以说编辑密切参与了检查评审员的工作。第6页（共10页）

鉴于评审标准，JOSS的范围远不止于广告。然而，对于研究应用所需的程度尚不明确。它似乎主要关注软件方面，而不是研究应用以及软件对研究的适用性。这可能是一个有意的选择，因为更专业的领域期刊会涉及这一点，但应明确说明。我们不要求作者在研究中使用该软件，也不要求包括使用该软件的研究结果（除了作为示例）；我们是一家软件期刊，而不是研究期刊。一个入选标准是论文是否可能被引用，这意味着软件可能会在已发表的研究中使用。我们还要求作者在文章和存储库中解释软件可能被使用的场景。我们在第9页第4.2节的开头添加了一句话以澄清这一点：“我们不要求作者在研究项目中使用他们的软件，或在文章中包含研究结果，除非作为示例；专注于结果而非软件的投稿应提交给研究期刊。”此外，对投稿适宜性有疑问的作者可以提交预审查询；我们在第9页添加了对此的描述。

我对两个额外的统计数据感兴趣：第一作者的所属国家（是否以美国为中心？）和研究应用领域的分布。我们添加了新的图8，展示了所有作者的所属国家，并在第15页用一段文字描述了这些数据。目前，47%的作者来自美国，40%来自欧洲。我们尚未跟踪研究领域，手动根据领域分类文章会相当耗时。未来，我们计划开始要求对新文章进行标签化，包括编程语言和关键词，以帮助标记领域。

第6节 最后一段很长，有些不清楚，且结尾不尽如人意。是否有预见的流程来处理JOSS的这一问题？ 我们对段落进行了轻微的压缩，并修订了最后一句：“编辑委员会将接受每个主要版本甚至次要版本的新JOSS文章，如果编辑和审稿人认为变化足够显著，但我们不知道这是否能满足开发者和用户（分别对应JOSS的作者和读者）的需求。”第7节第一段提到了RSE的职业视角，但这不能成为设立JOSS的理由。设立JOSS是因为软件是研究过程的重要组成部分，因此应进行适当的评估和发表，使其可查找，并具有质量和原创性的衡量标准。虽然我们同意软件是研究的重要组成部分，因此应进行评估和发表，但在信用问题上我们有不同意见。我们创建JOSS的主要动机实际上是向开发软件的研究人员（包括RSE，但不仅限于此）提供信用。因此，JOSS与传统期刊不同，后者评估原创性和/或影响力，尽管我们也审查质量标准。第7页（共10页）此外，由于JOSS并非设计为阅读型期刊，我们并不主要将其作为查找软件的机制。（尽管我们确实计划在一定程度上改进搜索和标签功能。）我在结论部分缺少了开放科学的视角。我们在第17页第一段中添加了一句总结JOSS对开放科学主要贡献的句子：“通过鼓励研究人员按照最佳实践开发软件，并公开分享和发表，JOSS支持更广泛的开放科学运动。”总之，我对论文有一些意见，但我强烈支持JOSS，因为发表研究软件并对开放科学做出贡献是至关重要的。我希望它在不久的将来能进一步发展！谢谢！审稿人#3基本报告英语出色，清晰且无歧义。文献引用提供了适当的背景和上下文。文章自成一格，使用了专业的文章结构。数据可从figshare文章中获得。第2节有些重复（最后一段），因为为软件获取信用的理由已经阐述得很充分了。实验设计本文的目的——即介绍一种新期刊的设计，该期刊以轻量级方式为软件提供“代理”论文，并回顾其第一年的运营情况——表述清晰且呈现得当。设立此类期刊的理由令人信服。第3.1节（目标和原则）清晰地呈现了原则和理由，期刊投稿系统和工作流程的机制在第3.2节和第4.1节中有较为详细的描述。然而，从读者体验的角度来看，设计几乎完全缺失。 期刊拥有作者、编辑/审稿人和读者，但似乎对读者体验的设计被忽视了。例如，期刊似乎没有搜索功能，而在访问时已有超过246篇文章，没有标签或分类的列表难以导航。第6节（下一年）重点在于投稿流程的自动化，包括处理先前投稿的版本，但在为读者提供的功能方面却鲜有涉及。似乎重点在于为软件分配标记，而非为寻找软件文章的期刊。如果这是明确的设计决策，应当予以说明。文章将其设计决策集中在编辑和审稿的易用性上。如果能有一些关于作者和读者体验的反馈将是有益的。正如你所指出的，JOSS主要设计用于作者/软件开发者，而非读者——主要服务是提供机制让作者为其软件获得认可，并通过同行评审提高这些研究软件的质量。我们已在第3.1节的第4页添加了以下句子以明确这一点：“与大多数期刊不同，后者便于发现新的研究和发现，JOSS主要作为软件开发者/作者改进和发布其研究软件的机制。因此，软件发现是次要功能。”关于作者体验，我们已在第18页（参考文献38和39）添加了指向作者（正面）博客文章的链接，但没有更多关于作者体验的反馈。

2. 审稿过程主要使用1名审稿人——如何确信这是足够的？如果审稿过程主要是基于清单（看似如此）且少有判断，这可能足够。创建JOSS的编辑-in-chief（Arfon Smith）有天体物理学的背景，在该领域单名审稿人是标准做法。然而，我们认识到这在许多研究领域并不常见。二次审稿是可能的，一些编辑在处理他们负责的JOSS投稿时，尤其是当编辑对自己对领域、软件和审稿的理解不够自信时，会定期征求多方审稿。我们计划在我们的基础设施中建立对多名审稿人的一流支持。我们还想指出，审稿的目标是将论文提升至可接受的标准，而不仅仅是评判其接受或拒绝。既然如此，不清楚是否需要超过一名审稿人来提供这种帮助和反馈，尤其是如果我们可以说编辑密切参与了检查审稿人的工作。

研究发现的合理性
提交和发表的文章数量清晰地表明了期刊的合理性和价值及其在生态系统中的地位。所呈现的数据是稳健的。与OSI和NumFOCUS的合作是鼓舞人心的。 第一年的回顾提供了有用的信息。以下是一些可以改进论文的要点：

1. 所提供的统计数据是从编辑团队的角度出发的。更有趣的应该是分析第一年的投稿情况，包括文章主题、服务社区、地理分布（是侧重美国还是欧洲？）等等。从http://joss.theoj.org/papers的用户界面很难看出这些信息。我们已经在第15页添加了新的图8和一段描述作者地理分布的段落；在第一年，大约48%的作者来自美国，40%来自欧洲。然而，按社区/主题分类投稿更具挑战性，因为我们目前还没有建立标签系统。我们计划支持按领域/研究主题和编程语言对文章进行标签化，并基于这些标签实现更便捷的搜索。

2. 如评审部分2所述，对读者体验的讨论较少。例如，我无法轻易找到Whedon RubyGem库是否有自己的文章。最近我们一直在努力改善读者体验，例如通过更易读、信息更丰富的文章网页，以及前述的标签/搜索功能。Whedon RubyGem库没有自己的文章，因为我们认为研究人员不会引用此类文章。换句话说，Whedon不是研究软件，不符合JOSS的范畴。

3. 除了对版本的思考外，期刊是否已制定关于软件分叉的策略，特别是由不同开发团队对原始开发者的分叉？我们在第17页添加了一段简短的内容，描述我们如何处理软件分叉的投稿。最终，我们倾向于将作者决定权留给开发者，尽管这对于分叉可能会变得复杂。

paper_title: Unleashing frugal innovation in private higher education institutions via intellectual capital and Information technology capability: a systematic literature review
paper_abstract:
Background: Given the persistent challenges to the higher education business model, private higher education institutions (PHEIs) are exploring myriad ways to increase enrolment and income, while aggressively managing spending. Many PHEIs are facing financial distress and struggling because of decreasing budgets and declining revenue. Thus, carving unique strategies that direct the institution to focus on its core competencies, making additional budget cuts without compromising quality, developing new revenue streams, embracing new technology, and offering affordable programs, will ultimately lead to financial success. Frugal innovation (FI) can shed light on these challenges. 
 Methods: This paper presents a systematic literature review to investigate and analyse prior research that focused on FI within the sphere of intellectual capital (IC) and information technology capabilities (ITC) research, and their relationships in PHEIs. Transfield’s five phases were employed to extract journal articles published over a thirty-year period (1990 to 2020) from major online databases using keyword searches. Although an initial search generated 76,025 papers, the search for IC and FI yielded 41 papers, and finally only two papers were selected as they clearly related IC with FI. 
 Results : There was a research gap in the literature published from 1990 to 2020 regarding IC applications to achieve FI. This work revealed that IC and ITC research for FI in PHEI remain insufficiently explored.   
 Conclusions: Further research is required on the evaluation model of IC, ITC and FI, methodologies, empirical analysis, and the development of measurement metrics. A limitation to this study is the number of keywords selected.
review_content:
1. General:
    In general, this research is very interesting. The author has reviewed the literature extensively to produce this paper. However, there are some things that need to be improved so that this paper is more valuable for indexing.
 2. Title:
    The title is incomplete because the author did not include information technology capabilities (ITC) variables.
 3. Introduction:
    The research problem is not sharp to portray the issues. In fact, the argument is also not clear on why the author uses three variables in this study.
 4. Method:
    What is the reason for the authors making statistics in Figures 4, 5, 6, and 7? In my opinion, the data is not related to the research objectives, because this research is a just systematic literature review, not investigational research.
 5. Results and discussion:
    The discussion is very shallow; the authors have reviewed a lot of literature, but the discussion of the results is less in-depth.
    The intended research gap (in table 5) is not clear. Need to write down the author's analysis.
 6. Summary:
    I think the authors failed to conclude significant findings as to the new theory in this study
What is the reason the authors concluded the frugal innovation, intellectual capital, and ITC insufficient? Need justification on the matters.
paper_title_zh: 通过智力资本和信息技术能力在私立高等教育机构中释放节俭创新：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：鉴于高等教育商业模式面临的持续挑战，私立高等教育机构（PHEIs）正在探索多种方式以增加招生和收入，同时积极管理开支。许多PHEIs因预算减少和收入下降而面临财务困境，挣扎求生。因此，制定独特策略，引导机构专注于其核心竞争力，在不牺牲质量的前提下进行额外预算削减，开发新的收入来源，拥抱新技术，并提供负担得起的课程，最终将带来财务成功。节俭创新（FI）可以为这些挑战提供启示。

方法：本文通过系统文献综述，调查和分析先前聚焦于节俭创新（FI）在智力资本（IC）和信息科技能力（ITC）研究领域的相关研究，以及它们在私立高等教育机构中的关系。采用Transfield的五阶段法，通过关键词搜索从主要在线数据库中提取了三十年间（1990年至2020年）发表的期刊文章。尽管初步搜索生成了76,025篇论文，但关于IC和FI的搜索仅得到41篇论文，最终仅选取了两篇明确将IC与FI相关联的论文。

结果：在1990年至2020年间发表的文献中，关于应用智力资本（IC）实现节俭创新（FI）的研究存在空白。这项工作揭示了在私立高等教育机构中，针对节俭创新的智力资本和信息科技能力研究仍探索不足。

结论：需要对智力资本、信息科技能力和节俭创新的评估模型、方法论、实证分析以及测量指标的开发进行进一步研究。本研究的局限性在于所选关键词的数量。

4. 方法：

    意图中的研究空白（见表5）不明确。需要写下作者的分析。

    作者为何认为节俭创新、智力资本和ITC不足？需要对这些事项进行论证。

paper_title: Open peer review at four STEM journals: an observational overview
paper_abstract: Open peer review, peer review where authors' and reviewers' identities are disclosed to one another, is a growing trend in scholarly publishing. Through observation of four journals in STEM disciplines, PLOS One , Atmospheric Chemistry & Physics , PeerJ , and F1000Research , an observational overview is conducted. The overview relies on defined characteristics of open peer review. Results show that despite differing open peer review implementations, each journal retains editorial involvement in scholarly publishing. Further, the analysis shows that only one of these implementations is fully transparent in its peer review and decision making process. Finally, the overview contends that journals should clearly outline peer review and editorial processes in order to allow for open peer review to be better understood and adopted by authors, reviewers, editors, and readers of science communications.
review_content:
Thank you for this interesting observation article and for the invitation to contribute my open peer review.

In the beginning, the article tries to disambiguate different “flavours" or implementations of open peer review (OPR) by identifying a number of OPR characteristics. Regarding this effort I would like to note the following issues that I think should be somehow addressed in a future version of the article:
  * As already noted by Peter Binfield, the definition offered is limited to only one of the identified OPR characteristics, namely whether the reviews are signed or not.
  * It is not clear what is the difference between reviews “signed when the author receives them” and disclosed reviews. It seems that in both cases the names of authors and reviewers are disclosed from the beginning of the review process.
  * Is disclosure of the reviewer’s identity necessary to initiate a discussion between authors and reviewers? Perhaps what you refer to here is an infrastructure to allow multiple iterations during the review process, as provided for example by Frontiers. This is different from simply revealing the name of the reviewer.
  * There is a clear distinction between an unsolicited comment on an article and a formal review process by expert peers that receive a review invitation either by an experienced editor or the authors themselves.
  * What is the alternative to editor mediation in peer review, if we consider that unsolicited commentaries do not constitute formal peer reviews? Is there another model where formal peer review is not editor-mediated? I know we proposed such model that we called author-guided peer review in Perakakis, P., Taylor, M., Mazza, M., Trachana, V. (2010). Natural selection of academic papers. Scientometrics, 85 (2), pp. 553–559, but I am not aware of any implementations. I repeat that I do not think we should consider crowd-sourced comments as equal to formal peer reviews.
And some other comments to consider:
  * PLOS ONE clearly does not qualify as an OPR journal by any standards. Instead, I would be more interested to see a discussion on the implementation of OPR by Frontiers.
  * I suspect there is a misunderstanding around the terms double-blind and single-blind review. The standard in most journals and disciplines is single-blind review where authors are blind to the name of the reviewer, but reviewers know the name of the authors. Double-blind refers to the process where neither authors nor reviewers are aware about the identity of each other.
  * It is not entirely correct that PLOS ONE “waives publishing fees for unfunded research”. What they do is ask for proofs that authors cannot cover the APCs even from their own budget, sometimes even asking for personal financial records, which by the way I find unacceptable. Proving that there is no formal funding to publish the particular research is not enough to waive APCs.
  * I definitely agree that a comparison table is needed.
  * I detected that the references to the articles by Lawrence are missing. Please double check that all references are included.
Thank you again for the opportunity to participate in this process that is very close to my ideal model of OPR and I will be looking forward to a revised version of your manuscript.
paper_title_zh: 四个STEM期刊的开放同行评审：观察性概览
paper_abstract_zh: 公开同行评审，即作者和评审者彼此公开身份的评审方式，在学术出版中正成为一种日益增长的趋势。通过对四个STEM学科期刊——PLOS One、Atmospheric Chemistry & Physics、PeerJ和F1000Research的观察，进行了观察性概述。该概述依赖于公开同行评审的明确定义特征。结果显示，尽管各期刊的公开同行评审实施方式不同，但每个期刊在学术出版中都保留了编辑参与。此外，分析表明，这些实施方式中只有一种在其同行评审和决策过程中是完全透明的。最后，概述认为，期刊应明确概述同行评审和编辑流程，以便作者、评审者、编辑和科学传播的读者更好地理解和采纳公开同行评审。
review_content_zh:
感谢您这篇有趣的观察性文章，以及邀请我进行开放同行评审。

文章开头试图通过识别一系列开放同行评审（OPR）的特征来消除不同“类型”或OPR实施方式的歧义。关于这一努力，我想指出以下问题，我认为这些问题应在文章的未来版本中有所体现：
* 如Peter Binfield所指出的，所提供的定义仅限于已识别的OPR特征之一，即评审是否署名。
* 不清楚“作者收到评审时署名”与公开评审之间的区别。似乎在这两种情况下，作者和评审者的姓名在评审过程一开始就被公开了。
* 评审者身份的公开是否是启动作者与评审者之间讨论的必要条件？或许您所指的 here 是一种允许在评审过程中进行多次迭代的基础设施，例如Frontiers所提供的。这与简单地公开评审者的姓名是不同的。
* 对文章的非应邀评论与由经验丰富的编辑或作者本人邀请的专家同行进行的正式评审过程之间存在明显区别。
* 如果我们认为非应邀评论不构成正式同行评审，那么同行评审中编辑调解的替代方案是什么？是否存在另一种不由编辑调解的正式同行评审模式？我知道我们在Perakakis, P., Taylor, M., Mazza, M., Trachana, V. (2010). Natural selection of academic papers. Scientometrics, 85 (2), pp. 553–559中提出了一个称为作者引导同行评审的模式，但我不知道有任何实施案例。我重申，我认为我们不应将众包评论等同于正式同行评审。

还有一些其他评论需要考虑：
* PLOS ONE显然不符合任何标准的OPR期刊。相反，我更感兴趣的是看到关于Frontiers实施OPR的讨论。
* 我怀疑对双盲和单盲评审术语存在误解。大多数期刊和学科的标准是单盲评审，即作者不知道评审者的姓名，但评审者知道作者的姓名。双盲指的是作者和评审者彼此都不知道对方身份的过程。
* 说PLOS ONE“为无资助研究免除出版费用”并不完全正确。他们所做的是要求证明作者即使从自己的预算中也无力支付APC，有时甚至要求提供个人财务记录，顺便说一下，我认为这是不可接受的。仅证明没有正式资金来发表特定研究是不够的，无法免除APC。
* 我绝对同意需要一个比较表格。
* 我发现引用Lawrence的文章缺失了。请仔细检查是否包含所有参考文献。

再次感谢有机会参与这一与我理想的OPR模式非常接近的过程，我期待着您稿件的修订版本。

paper_title: Making science public: a review of journalists’ use of Open Access research
paper_abstract: Science journalists are uniquely positioned to increase the societal impact of open research outputs by contextualizing and communicating findings in ways that highlight their relevance and implications for non-specialist audiences. Yet, it is unclear to what degree journalists use open research outputs, such as open access publications or preprints, in their reporting; what factors motivate or constrain this use; and how the recent surge in openly available research seen during the COVID-19 pandemic has affected this. This article examines these questions through a review of relevant literature published from 2018 onwards—particularly literature relating to the COVID-19 pandemic—as well as seminal articles outside the search dates. We find that research that explicitly examines journalists’ engagement with open access publications or preprints is scarce, with existing literature mostly addressing the topic tangentially or as a secondary concern, rather than a primary focus. Still, the limited body of evidence points to several factors that may hamper journalists’ use of these outputs and thus warrant further exploration. These include an overreliance on traditional criteria for evaluating scientific quality; concerns about the trustworthiness of open research outputs; and challenges using and verifying the findings. We also find that, while the COVID-19 pandemic encouraged journalists to explore open research outputs such as preprints, the extent to which these explorations will become established journalistic practices remains unclear. Furthermore, we note that current research is overwhelmingly authored and focused on the Global North, and the United States specifically. We conclude with recommendations for future research that attend to issues of equity and diversity, and more explicitly examine the intersections of open access and science journalism.
review_content:
This article examines the intersection of open scholarship and science journalism. The authors suggest that this is an understudied area, despite the critical importance of open access research to journalism and vice versa. They provide a thorough literature review of the research that is available on science journalists’ use of open access research. Notably, the authors dig into the actual usage of preprints by science journalists during the COVID-19 pandemic, which had become a hot button topic for those working in the field.

I would be interested to see one of the arguments of this article fleshed out slightly; that is, for the authors to interrogate the value of specialist language more deeply. It is a truism of academic research that it is obscure and opaque to anyone outside a specific discipline (and sometimes sub-discipline). Indeed, this is one of the areas where science journalists and other knowledge brokers come into play: as translators for a broader, more generalized readership. But it is important, too, to not lose sight of the value of shorthand. As Laura Mandell writes in Breaking the Book: Print Humanities in the Digital Age, shorthand allows for an expedited exchange of ideas between specialists without having to include all of the detailed context and history of each theory or concept being explored and built upon. Translation and comprehension are necessary, of course; but there is value to the complexity and detail of research, too. How does this tension affect the production, circulation, and uptake of open access research?

I also found the point about science journalists relying on prestige markers such as the Impact Factor an angle that would be well worth digging more deeply into. Prestige and open access publishing are often critiqued within the context of hiring, review, or tenure and promotion. What does it mean that science journalists and hiring and promotion committees are depending on the same arbitrary and easily gamed metrics?

Overall, this article provides an important summation of the current state of play regarding science journalism and open scholarship. It highlights that for open access research to reach its full impact, it must be findable, legible, and reusable; science journalism is one of the mechanisms to reach such a goal. The article closes with recommendations for future work, all of which would be well worth pursuing. I will look forward to reading more from the lead author and her co-authors on the subject.
paper_title_zh: 《让科学公开：记者使用开放获取研究的综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 科学记者在将开放研究成果的社会影响最大化方面具有独特的优势，他们通过将研究发现置于背景中并进行传播，突出其对非专业受众的相关性和影响。然而，目前尚不清楚记者在报道中多大程度上使用了开放研究成果，如开放获取出版物或预印本；哪些因素促成了或限制了这种使用；以及新冠疫情期间公开可获取研究激增对此产生了何种影响。本文通过回顾2018年及以后发表的相关文献——尤其是与新冠疫情相关的文献——以及搜索日期之外的经典文章，探讨了这些问题。我们发现，明确研究记者与开放获取出版物或预印本互动的文献较为稀缺，现有文献大多只是附带或作为次要问题而非主要焦点来讨论这一话题。尽管如此，有限的证据指向了几个可能阻碍记者使用这些成果的因素，值得进一步探讨。这些因素包括过度依赖传统科学质量评估标准；对开放研究成果可信度的担忧；以及使用和验证研究发现的挑战。我们还发现，尽管新冠疫情促使记者探索开放研究成果如预印本，但这些探索将在多大程度上成为确立的 journalistic practices 仍不清楚。此外，我们注意到当前研究绝大多数由全球北方国家，尤其是美国的作者撰写并聚焦于此。我们以对未来研究的建议作为结论，这些建议关注公平性和多样性问题，并更明确地探讨开放获取与科学新闻业的交叉点。
review_content_zh:
本文探讨了开放学术与科学新闻界的交叉领域。作者指出，尽管开放获取研究对新闻界至关重要，反之亦然，但这一领域的研究却相对不足。他们对科学记者使用开放获取研究的相关文献进行了全面的综述。值得注意的是，作者深入探讨了科学记者在COVID-19大流行期间对预印本的实际使用情况，这一话题在当时成为了该领域工作者关注的焦点。

我感兴趣的是，本文的一个论点可以进一步展开，即作者应更深入地探讨专业语言的价值。学术研究的一个普遍现象是，对于特定学科（甚至子学科）之外的人来说，它往往是晦涩难懂的。实际上，这正是科学记者和其他知识中介发挥作用的地方：作为面向更广泛、更普通读者的翻译者。但同样重要的是，不要忽视简写语的价值。正如劳拉·曼德尔在《打破书籍：数字时代的人文印刷》中所写，简写语允许专家之间快速交换思想，而无需包含每个正在探讨和构建的理论或概念的详细背景和历史。翻译和理解当然是必要的；但研究的复杂性和细节也有其价值。这种张力如何影响开放获取研究的生产、传播和采纳？

我还发现，关于科学记者依赖诸如影响因子等声望标志的观点，是一个值得深入挖掘的角度。声望和开放获取出版常常在招聘、评审或终身教职和晋升的背景下受到批评。科学记者和招聘及晋升委员会依赖同一套武断且容易被操纵的指标，这意味着什么？

总体而言，本文对科学新闻界与开放学术的现状进行了重要的总结。它强调，要使开放获取研究发挥其全部影响力，必须使其可查找、可读和可重用；科学新闻界是实现这一目标的一种机制。文章以对未来工作的建议作为结尾，所有这些建议都值得进一步追求。我期待阅读该主要作者及其合著者在这一主题上的更多作品。

Overall, this article provides an important summation of the current state of play regarding science journalism and open scholarship.
The authors suggest that this is an understudied area, despite the critical importance of open access research to journalism and vice versa
But it is important, too, to not lose sight of the value of shorthand.

paper_title: Review of the Genus Loimia Malmgren, 1866 (Annelida, Terebellidae) from China seas with recognition of two new species based on integrative taxonomy
paper_abstract: Specimens of the genus Loimia (Annelida, Terebellidae) deposited in the Marine Biological Museum of the Chinese Academy of Sciences (MBMCAS) together with materials newly collected from China seas were examined. Based on morphological comparisons and molecular analysis, some specimens collected from the coasts of Shandong province and Guangxi province were confirmed as two new Loimia species respectively (Loimia borealis sp. n. and Loimia macrobranchia sp. n.). Morphologically, L. borealis sp. n. is distinguished from previously known species of this genus by having seven equal sized ventral shields, with length five times the width; this species was retrieved as sister to the clades of Loimia arborea <ref type="bibr" target="#b32">Moore, 1903 and</ref> Loimia bandera Hutchings, 1990  in the phylogenetic tree, which was reconstructed based on mitochondrial COI gene. Loimia macrobranchia sp. n. differs from congeners by the large size of its first pair of branchiae with a thick main stem and about 18 dendritic branches arranged in two levels. A key to identifying Loimia species found in Chinese seas is given.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Basic reporting 1)The language is overall clear and unambiguous but some spelling and structural issues that are highlighted in the General Comments section. I would further advise to replace "huge" and "enormous" with more toned synonyms. Agreed. We have replaced “huge” and “enormous” with “large”. 2) The introduction should mention how Loimia is identified compared to other Terebellidae (uncini, branchiae, lobes), so that it is clear how material was assigned to this group. Agreed. We have added the identification characters of Loimia in introduction. 3) There are further some nomenclature inconsistencies because some of the species in Chinese seas were not originally placed in Loimia and the author name and publication year should therefore be enclosed in parentheses to follow nomenclatural rules. This applies to 3 species (L.76-77), Loimia ingens (Grube, 1878), Loimia medusa (Savigny, 1818), Loimia montagui (Grube, 1878). Agreed. We have corrected these nomenclature inconsistencies. Experimental design 4) A main issue is that not all available sequence data is being used. While sequences for two other terebellids are included as outgroups from published data, available sequences for the species under investigation are not considered. Genbank has COI, 16S and one 18S for species of Loimia (Loimia ramzega, Loimia medusa, Loimia arborea, Loimia ingens) that were not used here. If there is evidence that these sequences should not be used (e.g. suspected misidentifications of the species) that would be valid but it should be justified why publicly available data is not being used here to gain the most insight into Loimia species. The phylogenetic analyses are carefully performed but I would encourage to add a maximum likelihood analysis of the data. The analysis should involve selecting the best fit model for each data partition (COI, 16S, 18S) rather than estimating a substitution model across all three partitions because these genes are from different genomic compartments (mitochondrial, nuclear genome) and have different rates and patterns of substitution. The partitioned dataset can then be used in a maximum likelihood framework with bootstrap supports. RAxML or IQTREE can be used for these purposes and both approaches have free-to-use servers that can be used with small datasets like this one. IQTREE even performs model selection with Modelfinder as part of the analysis. Our analysis included COI, 16S rRNA and 18S rRNA gene at the same time for every mentioned species while Genbank only have one or two kinds of sequences for each species (e.g. COI and 16S rRNA sequences for Loimia ramzega; COI and 18S rRNA sequences for Loimia medusa; Loimia arborea and Loimia ingens only have COI sequences), which means sequences from Genbank cannot be used in our analysis. But as you suggested, we think it is better to use available sequences from Genbank to gain the most insight into Loimia species. As a result, we decided not to use the former phylogenetic analyses and recovered phylogenetic trees with COI sequences of Loimia species from both Genbank and our study. We also downloaded COI sequences of two species Pista cristata and Terebella lapidaria from Genbank as outgroup. The combined phylogenetic trees were reconstructed from the maximum likelihood analyses and bayesian inference analyses (see Figure 10). 5) I discourage the use of "basal" when describing phylogenetic relationships among species (albeit this term being very commonly used in the literature). Krell & Cranston 2004 Systematic Entomology describe the problem clearly: "Every branching in a (phylogenetic) tree is rotatable (see Fig. 1). Of course, the tree has a base, and there is a most basal branching and a next most basal branching, but there is no such thing as the most basal clade. Because branchings are rotatable, there are always two most basal clades (if the most basal branching is completely resolved, Fig. 1) or even more most basal clades (if the most basal branching is not completely resolved, e.g. in Polyneoptera in Fig. 1). Both branches originating from a node (i.e. the two sister groups) are of equal age and have undergone equivalent evolutionary change. Whether a group has branched off early (basal) or later in the phylogeny contains no information about this particular group, but information about both this group and its sister group, because both branched off at the same time." I encourage the authors to describe the phylogenetic relationships among Loimia species using descriptions about sister groups. This applies to the Abstract and the paragraph L.388-394, L.456-462. Agreed. I have rewritten the discussion of phylogenetic relationships among our species. When we describe phylogenetic relationships among species, the use of “basal” was avoided. Validity of the findings no comment Comments for the author Thank you for a carefully conducted and easy to follow study. Minor comments on language and structure: Abstract 6) Add Annelida, Terebellidae after first mention of Loimia Corrected. 7) "collected from the coasts of Shandong..." Corrected. 8) Remove point after "respectively: Loimia." Corrected. 9) 2 spaces missing: "COI, 16S rRNA and 18S rRNA" This part was changed: “the phylogenetic tree which is reconstructed based on mitochondrial COI gene” 10) small case on "phylogenetic tree" Corrected. 11) upper case on "identifying Loimia species" Corrected. 12) "China seas" could be better as Chinese seas Corrected. 13) Abstract, L.264, L.266, L.363, L.460, L.468: I believe it is uncommon to start sentences with an abbreviation (of Loimia to L.) Corrected. 14) L.70: add space after Malmgren, 1865 Corrected. 15) L.75: capitalize China Corrected. 16) L.102: maybe better "from coastal areas of Corrected. 17) L.114: "using the primer pairs: Corrected. 18) L.142-143: repeated reference to Gblocks compared to L.136 Since molecular data and method of phylogenetic analysis changed, this part was deleted. 19) L.180: maybe "convoluted" or "complicated taxonomic history" rather than "confused" “Loimia has a confused taxonomic history with several mistaken taxa records around the world.” was cited from Carrerette & Nogueira (2015). Since it is confusing (pointed out by reviewer 2), we have deleted this sentence. 20) L.181: remove dot before reference Corrected. 21) L.181: "occur in tropcial areas" or "are distributed in tropical areas" Agreed. I replaced “distribute” with “occur”. 22) L.183: Add "The most useful character" Corrected. 23) L.196: Add space after August 21, Corrected. 24) L.216: remove ")" L.217: Add space after October 22, Since materials we listed here are not type materials, we have deleted this “Additional material examined for comparison” part. 25) L.219: lower case specimens Corrected. 26) L.252: replace "and" with "," in Figure reference Corrected. 27) L.277: Add "." at end of sentence. Corrected. 28) L.281: remove ")" Corrected. 29) L.286: remove ")", add space after April 21, L.291: add space after August 21, L.304: remove ")" Since materials we listed here are not type materials, we have deleted this “Additional material examined for comparison” part. 39) L.376-394: all occcurrences of L. arborea and L. bandera misspelled Corrected. 40) L.396: maybe better "reidentified" than rechecked Agreed. I replaced “rechecked” with “reidentified" 41) L.397: remove "out" after finding, remove "very" Corrected. 42) L.398: "new to science" Corrected. 43) L.400: add space segment 3 Corrected. 44) L.409: misformatted reference Corrected. 45) L.411: "does not dwell in Chinese seas" Corrected. 46) L.411-413: sentence is difficult to understand and the last references seem misformatted. “L. montagui, believed to be homonym currently, was identified as Terebella montagui by Grube (1878) from Philippine Island as unreplaced primary homonym to Terebella montagui Quatrefages, 1865, then it was recombined with Loimia by Hartman (1959) (Holthe, 1986).” Holthe (1986) mentioned that: Loimia grubei, new name, replacing Terebella montagui Grube, 1878 (primary homonym of Terebella montagui Quatrefages, 1865 and secondary homonym in combination with Loimia (by Hartman 1959)). Type locality: Philippine Islands. Carrerette & Nogueira (2015) mentioned that: This species was originally described as Terebella montagui by Grube (1878) and was posteriorly transferred to L. grubei by Holthe (1986a), replacing Terebella montagui Grube, 1878, primary homonym of Terebella montagui Quatrefages, 1865, and secondary homonym in combination with Loimia by Hartman (1959) (Holthe 1986a). We have revamped the sentence: According to Carrerette & Nogueira (2015), Loimia montagui was firstly identified as Terebella montagui by Grube (1878) from Philippine Island, then it was recombined with Loimia by Hartman (1959). Later Terebella montagui Grube, 1878 was transferred to Loimia grubei by Holthe (1986) and Loimia montagui (Grube, 1878) now is a name of uncertain taxonomic significance in WoRMS (http://www.marinespecies.org). 47) L.414: remove . after Loimia Corrected. 48) L.416: we referred to the description" Corrected. 49) L.438: "where notopodia end" Corrected. 50) L.446: "species that have been deposited" Corrected. 51) L.460: lower case phylogenetic Corrected. 52) L.467: suggest to remove "independent" because COI and 16S are not independent because they get inherited together on the mitochndrial genome. Could be stronger to say " from three mitochondrial and nuclear molecular markers" The former sentence was changed since we only used COI sequences for molecular analysis. 53) L.473: why "preliminary", remove? Agreed. 54) L.477: add "pairs" after third to be consistent with L.479-480 Corrected. 55) L.496: remove "extremely" Corrected. 56) Table 4: add space L. arborea and before Japan Corrected. 57) Table 5: misspelled arborea and bandera, inconsistent spacing sp.nov. Corrected.
paper_title_zh: 《中国海域Loimia Malmgren, 1866属（环节动物门，缨鳃虫科）的综述及基于整合分类学识别的两个新种》
paper_abstract_zh: 中国科学院海洋生物博物馆（MBMCAS）保存的Loimia属（环节动物门，缨鳃虫科）标本以及新近从中国海域采集的材料进行了研究。基于形态学比较和分子分析，确认从山东省和广西省海岸采集的一些标本分别为两个新的Loimia物种（Loimia borealis sp. n. 和 Loimia macrobranchia sp. n.）。形态学上，L. borealis sp. n. 通过具有七个大小相等的腹盾，长度为宽度的五倍，与该属已知物种区分开来；该物种在基于线粒体COI基因重建的系统发育树中，被检索为Loimia arborea <ref type="bibr" target="#b32">Moore, 1903</ref> 和 Loimia bandera Hutchings, 1990 的姐妹群。Loimia macrobranchia sp. n. 通过其第一对鳃的大型特征，具有粗壮的主干和约18个分两层排列的树状分支，与同属物种相区别。提供了识别中国海域Loimia物种的鉴定关键。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1 基本报告
1) 总体而言，语言清晰且无歧义，但在“一般评论”部分中指出了某些拼写和结构问题。我进一步建议用更为温和的同义词替换“huge”和“enormous”。同意。我们已将“huge”和“enormous”替换为“large”。
2) 引言部分应提及如何将Loimia与其他Terebellidae（如uncini、branchiae、lobes）区分开来，以便清楚地说明材料是如何被归入这一类群的。同意。我们已在引言中添加了Loimia的识别特征。
3) 还存在一些命名不一致的问题，因为中国海域中的一些物种最初并未被归入Loimia，因此作者姓名和出版年份应括在括号内，以符合命名规则。这适用于3个物种（L.76-77），Loimia ingens (Grube, 1878)，Loimia medusa (Savigny, 1818)，Loimia montagui (Grube, 1878)。同意。我们已纠正这些命名不一致的问题。

实验设计
4) 主要问题是并未使用所有可用的序列数据。虽然从已发表的数据中包含了两个其他terebellids作为外群序列，但未考虑所研究物种的可用序列。Genbank中有Loimia物种（Loimia ramzega, Loimia medusa, Loimia arborea, Loimia ingens）的COI、16S和一个18S序列，这些序列在此未被使用。如果有证据表明这些序列不应被使用（例如，物种的疑似误鉴定），那是有效的，但应说明为何不使用这些公开数据以获得对Loimia物种的最多洞察。系统发育分析做得非常仔细，但我建议添加数据的最大似然分析。分析应包括为每个数据分区（COI、16S、18S）选择最佳拟合模型，而不是跨所有三个分区估计替代模型，因为这些基因来自不同的基因组部分（线粒体、核基因组），并且具有不同的替代速率和模式。分区的数据集然后可以在最大似然框架中使用，并带有自举支持。RAxML或IQTREE可用于这些目的，并且这两种方法都有免费使用的服务器，可以用于像这样的小数据集。IQTREE甚至在进行分析时使用Modelfinder进行模型选择。我们的分析包括每个提及物种的COI、16S rRNA和18S rRNA基因，而Genbank中每个物种只有一种或两种序列（例如，Loimia ramzega的COI和16S rRNA序列；Loimia medusa的COI和18S rRNA序列；Loimia arborea和Loimia ingens只有COI序列），这意味着Genbank中的序列不能用于我们的分析。但正如您所建议的，我们认为最好使用Genbank中的可用序列以获得对Loimia物种的最多洞察。 因此，我们决定不使用之前的系统发育分析，而是从Genbank和我们研究中获得的Loimia物种的COI序列来重建系统发育树。我们还从Genbank下载了两种物种Pista cristata和Terebella lapidaria的COI序列作为外群。综合系统发育树通过最大似然分析和贝叶斯推理分析重建（见图10）。5）我不建议在描述物种间的系统发育关系时使用“基部的”一词（尽管这个术语在文献中非常常见）。Krell和Cranston在2004年的《系统昆虫学》中清楚地描述了这个问题：“（系统发育）树中的每一个分支都是可旋转的（见图1）。当然，树有一个基部，并且有一个最基部的分支和下一个最基部的分支，但没有所谓的最基部分支。因为分支是可旋转的，所以总是有两个最基部分支（如果最基部分支完全解析，见图1），或者甚至更多最基部分支（如果最基部分支未完全解析，例如图1中的Polyneoptera）。从一个节点起源的两个分支（即两个姐妹群）具有相同的年龄并经历了等效的进化变化。一个群体在系统发育中早期（基部）分支还是后期分支，并不包含关于该特定群体的信息，而是包含关于该群体及其姐妹群体的信息，因为它们是在同一时间分支的。”我鼓励作者使用关于姐妹群的描述来描述Loimia物种间的系统发育关系。这适用于摘要以及第L.388-394、L.456-462段。同意。我已经重写了我们物种间系统发育关系的讨论。在描述物种间系统发育关系时，避免了使用“基部的”。对研究结果的有效性无评论对作者的评论感谢您进行的一项细致且易于跟进的研究。关于语言和结构的少量评论：摘要6）在首次提及Loimia后添加Annelida, Terebellidae已纠正。7）“collected from the coasts of Shandong...”已纠正。8）删除“respectively: Loimia.”后的句点已纠正。9）缺少两个空格：“COI, 16S rRNA and 18S rRNA”这部分已更改：“基于线粒体COI基因重建的系统发育树”10）“phylogenetic tree”小写已纠正。11）“identifying Loimia species”大写已纠正。12）“China seas”改为Chinese seas更好已纠正。13）摘要，L.264，L.266，L.363，L.460，L.468：我认为句子以缩写（Loimia缩写为L.）开头并不常见已纠正。14）L.70：在Malmgren, 1865后添加空格已纠正。15）L.75：China大写已纠正。16）L.102：也许改为“from coastal areas of”更好已纠正。17）L.114：“using the primer pairs:”已纠正。 18) L.142-143：重复提及Gblocks，与L.136相比。由于分子数据及系统发育分析方法已改变，此部分已删除。19) paper_title: Marsupial and monotreme milk -A review of its nutrient and immune properties
paper_abstract: All mammals are characterized by the ability of females to produce milk. Marsupial (metatherian) and monotreme (prototherian) young are born in a highly altricial state and rely on their mother's milk for the first part of their life. Here we review the role and importance of milk in marsupial and monotreme development. Milk is the primary source of sustenance for young marsupials and monotremes and its composition varies at different stages of development. We applied nutritional geometry techniques to a limited number of species with values available to analyze changes in macronutrient composition of milk at different stages. Macronutrient energy composition of marsupial milk varies between species and changes concentration during the course of lactation. As well as nourishment, marsupial and monotreme milk supplies growth and immune factors.

paper_title: A survey on modeling dynamic business processes
paper_abstract: Dynamic and flexible systems offer huge advantages for businesses in addressing dynamic uncertain factors and implementing dynamic business processes (DBP). However, DBP remains a challenge from the perspectives of modeling, simulation, and implementation because of a nontrivial understanding of "What is a dynamic business process?". A variety of approaches for DBP modeling and implementation have been proposed over the past years, yet few comprehensive studies analyzing DBP from different particular perspectives (e.g., business process (BP) variability, aspect oriented BP, service compositions, etc.) and research questions that lay the foundation for the development of a meaning of a DBP have been reported. The motivation behind this review is to examine DBP meaning from a global perspective and, consequently, answer the previously presented research question. Therefore, in this paper, we present a systematic literature review (SLR) comprised of 67 papers from five respective digital libraries, which index Computer Science (CS), Information Systems (IS), and Software Engineering (SE) journals and conference proceedings. Two points of view are analyzed in the selected papers. First, we observe the similarities and differences between the proposed approaches to DBP modeling and implementation. From these observations, we define six main requirements for DBP (DBPR). In addition, the comparison of the selected papers according to DBPR shows that most of the approaches analyzed limit BP dynamicity, since they use partially predefined BP models. Secondly, we analyze the papers based on a visualization perspective that shows the less explored areas as follows: more flexible process modeling approach and its implementation in IS should be developed; usage of historic data should be extended; domain knowledge usage, like goal-orientation, multi-criteria optimization, domain knowledge, artificial intelligence, etc., should be included and extended to ensure BP dynamicity. As such, this study makes important contributions and serves as a useful resource for future DBP studies and practice. Moreover, we expect that our results could inspire researchers and practitioners towards further work aimed at bringing forward the field of DBP modeling and implementation.

paper_title_zh: 动态业务流程建模综述
paper_abstract_zh: 动态和灵活的系统在应对动态不确定因素和实施动态业务流程（DBP）方面为商业提供了巨大优势。然而，由于对“什么是动态业务流程？”这一问题的理解并非易事，DBP在建模、仿真和实施方面仍然是一个挑战。过去几年中，已经提出了多种DBP建模和实施方法，但很少有全面的研究从不同特定视角（例如，业务流程（BP）的可变性、面向方面的BP、服务组合等）分析DBP，并探讨为DBP意义发展奠定基础的研究问题。本综述的动机是从全局视角审视DBP的意义，并由此回答之前提出的研究问题。因此，在本文中，我们呈现了一项系统文献综述（SLR），涵盖来自五个相关数字图书馆的67篇论文，这些图书馆索引了计算机科学（CS）、信息系统（IS）和软件工程（SE）的期刊和会议论文集。选定的论文中分析了两个观点。首先，我们观察了提出的DBP建模和实施方法之间的相似性和差异性。基于这些观察，我们定义了DBP的六个主要需求（DBPR）。此外，根据DBPR对选定论文的比较显示，大多数分析的方法限制了BP的动态性，因为它们使用了部分预定义的BP模型。其次，我们从可视化视角分析论文，揭示了较少探索的领域：应开发更灵活的流程建模方法及其在IS中的实施；应扩展历史数据的使用；应包括并扩展领域知识的使用，如目标导向、多标准优化、领域知识、人工智能等，以确保BP的动态性。因此，本研究做出了重要贡献，并为未来的DBP研究和实践提供了有用资源。此外，我们期望我们的结果能够激励研究人员和从业者进一步开展旨在推进DBP建模和实施领域的工作。

paper_title: Defining and conceptualizing patient-centered family planning counseling: A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Family planning counseling has long been dominated by the tiered-effectiveness model, which discusses contraceptive methods in order of effectiveness. However, there is growing recognition that patients may prioritize factors other than method effectiveness. This scoping review identifies how patient-centered family planning care has been defined and conceptualized, and discusses the implications for measurement. 
   
   
     Methods 
     We systematically searched PubMed and SCOPUS for documents on “patient-centered family planning counseling or support” published between 2013 and 2022. Eligibility criteria included discussion of 1) strategies for providing patient-centered care, 2) interventions using a patient-centered approach, or 3) the impact of patient-centered approaches. We describe the definitions and domains of patient-centered family planning counseling addressed in the literature. 
   
   
     Results 
     Our scoping review is based on 33 documents. Only 18 documents clearly defined patient-centered family planning counseling or discussed what it entails. We identified important differences in how patient-centered family planning care was defined. However, most studies emphasized patients’ needs and preferences, respect for the patient, and informed decision-making and can be mapped against the McCormack’s framework for patient-centered communication. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     It is important for studies to more clearly state how they define or conceptualize patient-centered family planning. Inconsistent use of indicators makes it difficult, if not impossible, to make generalized conclusions about the effectiveness of the patient-centered approach relative to the tiered-effectiveness approach. Consistent use of comparable indicators of key domains of patient-centered care is needed to address the gap in evidence about the effectiveness of patient-centered family planning counseling on various family planning outcomes, and to support future interventions. Wider use of existing scales to measure patient-centered family planning care may help standardize the definition of patient-centered care and strengthen the evidence base.
review_content:
This scoping review aimed to identify definitions of patient-centered counseling and the implications for lack of an agreed definition. The background was well written. My one question is whether client-centered and patient-centered are interchangeably used within the contraceptive care context. I would provide evidence to support this conclusion and count how many articles within the review have either term within the Results section. The search strategy used was minimal but causes me to wonder why the search was not expanded. An expanded search would have resulted in many more hits to include within the review as is implied within the limitations. Results drawn from the articles look to be sound. The discussion and conclusion do not have the same ideas. The conclusion states, "Inconsistent use of indicators makes it difficult, if not impossible, to make generalized conclusions about the effectiveness of the approach relative to the tiered-effectiveness approach." This is not proven within the discussion section of from your results.

Changes to make:
- Show proof of client-centered and patient-centered being used interchangeably within contraceptive care.
- Subsequently provide counts for both terms within the results section of the manuscript.
- Provide a clearer explanation of the choice of indices for searching articles. Maybe the smaller search is attributed to a rapid review style?
- Make sure the discussion and conclusion have a consensus on the conclusions drawn (see quote listed above).
paper_title_zh: 定义和概念化以患者为中心的家庭计划生育咨询：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
计划生育咨询长期以来一直由分层有效性模型主导，该模型按有效性顺序讨论避孕方法。然而，越来越多的人认识到，患者可能会优先考虑除方法有效性之外的其他因素。本范围综述确定了以患者为中心的计划生育护理是如何被定义和概念化的，并讨论了其对测量的影响。

方法
我们系统地检索了PubMed和SCOPUS数据库中2013年至2022年间发表的关于“以患者为中心的计划生育咨询或支持”的文献。纳入标准包括讨论1）提供以患者为中心的护理策略，2）使用以患者为中心的方法的干预措施，或3）以患者为中心的方法的影响。我们描述了文献中涉及的以患者为中心的计划生育咨询的定义和领域。

结果
我们的范围综述基于33篇文献。仅有18篇文献明确定义了以患者为中心的计划生育咨询或讨论了其内涵。我们发现了在定义以患者为中心的计划生育护理方面的重要差异。然而，大多数研究强调患者的需求和偏好、尊重患者以及知情决策，并且可以与McCormack的患者中心沟通框架相对应。

结论
研究更清晰地说明其如何定义或概念化以患者为中心的计划生育非常重要。指标使用的不一致使得难以，甚至不可能，对以患者为中心的方法相对于分层有效性方法的有效性做出普遍性结论。需要一致使用患者中心护理关键领域的可比指标，以填补关于以患者为中心的计划生育咨询对各种计划生育结果有效性的证据空白，并支持未来的干预措施。更广泛地使用现有量表来测量以患者为中心的计划生育护理，可能有助于标准化患者中心护理的定义并加强证据基础。

paper_title: Evidence of mitochondria origin of SARS-CoV-2 double-membrane vesicles: a review.
paper_abstract:
Coronavirus Disease-19 (COVID-19) pandemic is caused by SARS-CoV-2 that has infected more than 600 million people and killed more than 6 million people worldwide. This infection affects mainly certain groups of people that have high susceptibility to present severe COVID-19 due to comorbidities. Moreover, the long-COVID-19 comprises a series of symptoms that may remain in some patients for months after infection that further compromises their health. Thus, since this pandemic is profoundly affecting health, economy, and social life of societies, a deeper understanding of viral replication cycle could help to envisage novel therapeutic alternatives that limit or stop COVID-19. 
  Several findings have unexpectedly discovered that mitochondria play a critical role in SARS-CoV-2 cell infection. Indeed, it has been suggested that this organelle could be the origin of its replication niches, the double membrane vesicles (DMV). In this regard, mitochondria derived vesicles (MDV), involved in mitochondria quality control, discovered almost 15 years ago, comprise a subpopulation characterized by a double membrane. MDV shedding is induced by mitochondrial stress, and it has a fast assembly dynamic, reason that perhaps has precluded their identification in electron microscopy or tomography studies. These and other features of MDV together with recent SARS-CoV-2 protein interactome and other findings link SARS-CoV-2 to mitochondria and support that these vesicles are the precursors of SARS-CoV-2 induced DMV. In this work, the morphological, biochemical, molecular, and cellular evidence that supports this hypothesis is reviewed and integrated into the current model of SARS-CoV-2 cell infection. In this scheme, some relevant questions are raised as pending topics for research that would help in the near future to test this hypothesis. The intention of this work is to provide a novel framework that could open new possibilities to tackle SARS-CoV-2 pandemic through mitochondria and DMV targeted therapies.
review_content:
The manuscript presents an intriguing exploration of the role of mitochondria-derived vesicles (MDVs) in the viral replication cycle, particularly emphasizing the formation of double membrane vesicles. The author has adeptly synthesized a substantial body of research to elucidate this complex process. However, there appears to be an oversight in the literature review, as some pivotal studies that could further enrich the discussion have been omitted. I recommend the inclusion of the following two articles to bridge this gap and enhance the comprehensiveness of the review:

 2. Zimmermann L et al, 2023 [Ref 2]
Regarding the graphical elements, the quality of Figure 1 could be significantly improved to better support the narrative. Additionally, the figure legend is currently too extensive and could be streamlined for clarity. Portions of the legend that provide general information could be integrated into the main text to maintain focus on the key findings depicted in the figure.
While the selection of Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) images effectively demonstrates MDV shedding post-viral RNA infection, the visual impact of the paper would benefit from the inclusion of color confocal microscopy images (if any). These images could provide a more vivid and informative representation of the phenomena described, thereby reinforcing the author’s statements with visual evidence.
paper_title_zh: "SARS-CoV-2 双膜囊泡线粒体起源的证据：综述。"
paper_abstract_zh:
新冠病毒病-19（COVID-19）大流行由SARS-CoV-2引起，已在全球感染超过6亿人，并导致超过600万人死亡。该感染主要影响某些易感人群，由于合并症，这些人群更容易发展为重症COVID-19。此外，长期COVID-19包括一系列症状，这些症状可能在某些患者感染后持续数月，进一步损害其健康。因此，由于这场大流行深刻影响着社会的健康、经济和社交生活，深入理解病毒复制周期可能有助于设想新的治疗替代方案，以限制或阻止COVID-19。

多项研究发现，线粒体在SARS-CoV-2细胞感染中发挥着关键作用。确实，有研究表明，这一细胞器可能是其复制生态位——双层膜囊泡（DMV）的起源。在这方面，几乎在15年前发现的参与线粒体质量控制过程的线粒体衍生囊泡（MDV），是一个以双层膜为特征的亚群。MDV的脱落由线粒体应激诱导，并且具有快速的组装动态，这可能是其在电子显微镜或断层扫描研究中未被识别的原因。MDV的这些及其他特征，结合最近的SARS-CoV-2蛋白互作组和其他发现，将SARS-CoV-2与线粒体联系起来，支持这些囊泡是SARS-CoV-2诱导的DMV的前体。在本研究中，回顾并整合了支持这一假设的形态学、生化、分子和细胞证据，并将其纳入当前的SARS-CoV-2细胞感染模型。在这一框架中，提出了一些有待研究的相关问题，这些问题的解决将有助于在不久的将来验证这一假设。本研究的目的是提供一个新框架，通过针对线粒体和DMV的疗法，开辟应对SARS-CoV-2大流行的新可能性。

关于图形元素，图1的质量可以显著提升以更好地支持叙述。此外，图例目前过于冗长，可以简化以提高清晰度。图例中提供一般信息的部分可以整合到正文之中，以保持对图中展示的关键发现的关注。

paper_title: Enter the Matrix: Fibroblast-immune cell interactions shape extracellular matrix deposition in health and disease.
paper_abstract: Fibroblasts, non-hematopoietic cells of mesenchymal origin, are tissue architects which regulate the topography of tissues, dictate tissue resident cell types, and drive fibrotic disease. Fibroblasts regulate the composition of the extracellular matrix (ECM), a 3-dimensional network of macromolecules that comprise the acellular milieu of tissues. Fibroblasts can directly and indirectly regulate immune responses by secreting ECM and ECM-bound molecules to shape tissue structure and influence organ function. In this review, we will highlight recent studies which elucidate the mechanisms by which fibroblast-derived ECM factors (e.g., collagens, fibrillar proteins) regulate ECM architecture and subsequent immune responses, with a focus on macrophages. As examples of fibroblast-derived ECM proteins, we examine Collagen Triple Helix Repeat Containing 1 (CTHRC1) and Transforming Growth Factor-β-inducible protein (TGFBI), also known as BIGH3. We address the need for investigation into how diverse fibroblast populations coordinate immune responses by modulating ECM, including the fibroblast-ECM-immune axis and the precise molecular mediators and pathways which regulate these processes. Finally, we will outline how novel research identifying key regulators of ECM deposition is critical for therapeutic development for fibrotic diseases and cancer.
review_content:
I find this review timely and well written. It summarizes the latest findings on fibroblast biology and fibroblast-derived molecules offering an insight on potential therapeutic options to target fibroblast-mediated diseases such as fibrosis where therapeutic treatments are lacking. This is a hot topic at the moment. See detailed report below.

This review from Altieri et al. recapitulates the most recent findings in the field of fibroblasts. In addition, the authors discuss how fibroblasts coordinate immune responses, especially macrophages’ functions, by modulating ECM, and outline the molecular mediators such as CTHRC1 and TGFB and pathways regulating these processes. This is a very well written and timely review.
Minor points:
Add and discuss the following references:
Fibroblasts orchestrate ECM deposition in steady state and disease: I would add few more words on fibroblasts heterogeneity here. Some key references below:
Gauthier V,et.al., 2023 [Ref 1], Korsunsky I, et.al.,2022 [Ref 2], Muhl L, et.al., 2020 [3]

Fibroblast derived cytokines and chemokines decorate the ECM to influence fibroblast-macrophage interactions: please add and discuss the following references which focus on fibroblast/macrophage interactions. Ng MTH, et.al.,2024 [Ref 5],Zhou X, et.al.,2022 [Ref 6], Meizlish ML, et.al., 2024 [Ref 7]
Recent evidence has demonstrated that metabolic intermediates can also fuel stromal cell responses and ECM deposition and can regulate cellular crosstalk. Kay EJ, et.al., 2022 [Ref 8], Schwörer S,et.al.,2021 [Ref 9], Pucino V, et.al., 2023 [Ref 10]

paper_title_zh: 进入矩阵：成纤维细胞-免疫细胞相互作用塑造健康与疾病中的细胞外基质沉积
paper_abstract_zh: 成纤维细胞是起源于间充质的非造血细胞，作为组织架构师，它们调控组织的地形结构，决定组织驻留细胞类型，并驱动纤维化疾病的发生。成纤维细胞调节细胞外基质（ECM）的组成，ECM是由大分子构成的三维网络，形成了组织的非细胞环境。成纤维细胞通过分泌ECM及ECM结合分子，直接和间接地调控免疫反应，从而塑造组织结构并影响器官功能。在本综述中，我们将重点介绍近期研究，阐明成纤维细胞来源的ECM因子（如胶原蛋白、纤维蛋白）如何调节ECM架构及后续免疫反应的机制，重点关注巨噬细胞。作为成纤维细胞来源的ECM蛋白的例子，我们探讨了含有三螺旋重复序列的胶原蛋白1（CTHRC1）和转化生长因子-β诱导蛋白（TGFBI），也称为BIGH3。我们提出了对多种成纤维细胞群体如何通过调节ECM协调免疫反应进行研究的必要性，包括成纤维细胞-ECM-免疫轴以及精确调控这些过程的分子介质和通路。最后，我们将概述识别ECM沉积关键调节因子的新研究对于纤维化疾病和癌症治疗开发的重要性。
review_content_zh:
我发现这篇综述及时且写得很好。它总结了成纤维细胞生物学和成纤维细胞衍生分子的最新发现，提供了针对成纤维细胞介导的疾病（如缺乏治疗手段的纤维化）的潜在治疗选择的见解。目前这是一个热门话题。详见下方的详细报告。

Altieri等人撰写的这篇综述概括了成纤维细胞领域的最新发现。此外，作者讨论了成纤维细胞如何通过调节细胞外基质（ECM）协调免疫反应，特别是巨噬细胞的功能，并概述了调控这些过程的分子介质，如CTHRC1和TGFB及其相关通路。这是一篇写得非常好且及时的综述。

次要问题：
请添加并讨论以下参考文献：
成纤维细胞在稳态和疾病中协调ECM沉积：在此处应增加一些关于成纤维细胞异质性的描述。以下是一些关键参考文献：
Gauthier V等人，2023 [Ref 1]，Korsunsky I等人，2022 [Ref 2]，Muhl L等人，2020 [Ref 3]

paper_title: The history of mesowear: A review Nicole L Ackermans
paper_abstract: publications, 707 species, 1396 data points). Mesowear is a widely applied tooth wear technique that can be used to infer a herbivore's diet by scoring the height and sharpness of molar tooth cusps with the naked eye. Established as a fast and efficient tool for paleodiet reconstruction, the technique has seen multiple adaptations, simplifications, and extensions since its establishment, which have become complex to follow. The present study reviews all successive changes and adaptations to the mesowear technique in detail, providing a template for the application of each technique to the research question at hand. In addition, the array of species to which mesowear has been applied, along with the equivalent recorded diets have been compiled here in a large dataset. This review provides an insight into the metrics related to mesowear publication since its establishment. The large dataset overviews whether the species to which the various techniques of mesowear are applied are extant or extinct, their phylogenetic classification, their assigned diets and diet stability between studies, as a resource for future research on the topic.
review_content: Reviewer 2: This manuscript is a welcome review on mesowear analysis. As rightly stressed by the author, there are now currently many variations of the original method and it is difficult to get a good overview of the pros, cons and field(s) of application of each variation. This manuscript does just that, in a clear and concise manner. The manuscript is well-written: the structure is logical and the wording is clear. The intro and the background do explain the relevance of the study, and reference to previous work adequately. However, two topics have been excluded from this review, and I believe they deserve some space: - Mesowear as an environmental proxy - there have been quite a lot of discussion and debate around the signal provided by mesowear: is it a dietary or an environmental proxy? I do not think this debate is closed, but in any case, this topic must be addressed in the introduction. - The author does not provide enough background and clarity regarding the different scales of wear analyses and how they relate to each other: how microwear affects mesowear and how both affect hypsodonty? Are the different methods just about different dietary signal durations, or are the wear agents and processes different at different scales? There is a lot at play here, and the few sentences on this topic (lines 40-45 and 230-232) are too vague and are mixing many concepts in an ambiguous manner. Please expand on this topic, in the introduction and discussion, potentially linking it to my previous comment. Raw data are shared as appendices. paper_title: Animal Venoms as Potential Source of Anticonvulsants
paper_abstract:
Abstract* 
   Epilepsy affects millions of people worldwide, and there is an urgent need to develop safe and effective therapeutic agents. Animal venoms contain diverse bioactive compounds like proteins, peptides, and small molecules, which may possess medicinal properties against epilepsy. In recent years, research has shown that venoms from various organisms such as spiders, ants, bees, wasps, and conus snails have anticonvulsant and antiepileptic effects by targeting specific receptors and ion channels. This review underscores the significance of purified proteins and toxins from these sources as potential therapeutic agents for epilepsy. In conclusion, this review emphasizes the valuable role of animal venoms as a natural resource for further exploration in epilepsy treatment research.
review_content:
A review entitled Animal venoms as a potential source of anticonvulsants by Zainal Abidin and colleagues is very exciting and informative. Considering the challenges and stereotypes associated with the sufferers of epilepsy, there is a need to explore natural sources including venom from organisms for potential therapeutic solutions. The authors demonstrated that venom components from selected venomous organisms interact with receptors, channels, and transporters and induce anticonvulsant activities. Furthermore, venom components could stimulate GABA concentration, and modulation of L-glutamate and glycine uptake by interfering with NMDA and GABAergic transporter making them possible anticonvulsant agents.
It would have been more interesting if the authors had presented a Figure summarising possible mechanisms of action of these venom toxins in inducing anticonvulsant activities. Thus, proposing the interactions of these venom toxins with receptors, channels, transporters and downstream responses to the perturbation.

The review will be beneficial to both researchers in the field of venomics, pharmacology, physicians, and ordinary people. However, there are some changes I would suggest to improve the manuscript.

Abstract
Add scorpion venom in the abstract since there is a sub-heading (2.2) about it and highlights about the roles in voltage-gated sodium ion channels, as a potent anticonvulsant agent.

Introduction
Page 3, Paragraph 1: Reference to back up the definition of epilepsy by the Task Force of the International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE).
Page 3, Paragraph 2: Ca2+, 2+ should be in superscript
Page 3, Paragraph 3: The first sentence could be supported with reference especially “diet changes as methods to treat epilepsy”
Page 3, Paragraph 3: Cl-, - should be in superscript
Page 3, Paragraph 5: I would suggest venom and venom toxins with potential effects against epilepsy since there were no approved venom-based drugs available to treat epilepsy.
Section 2.1 sub-heading: I suggest removing (Table 1)
Page 4, Paragraph 1: If “Subjects” was used to refer to “rats”, I suggest using the latter throughout
Page 4, Paragraph 2: “A’ of Aminobutyric should be written with lowercase font
Table 2: Voltage-gated?
Table 3: Could be moved to sub-section 2.3.
Page 5, Paragraph 1: in vivo?
Page 5, Paragraph last: Apis mellifera should be in italics

The authors’ “Future directions” to explore the venoms of snakes and sea anemones is interesting, considering the role of neurotoxins (three-finger toxins) in snakebite envenoming victims. The interaction of this toxin at the neuromuscular junction inhibits presynaptic voltage-gated calcium channels by so doing causes paralysis of the snakebite victims.
paper_title_zh: 动物毒液作为潜在的抗惊厥药物来源
paper_abstract_zh:
摘要*
癫痫影响全球数百万人口，迫切需要开发安全有效的治疗药物。动物毒液中包含多种生物活性化合物，如蛋白质、肽类和小分子，这些化合物可能具有对抗癫痫的药用特性。近年来，研究表明来自蜘蛛、蚂蚁、蜜蜂、黄蜂和锥形蜗牛等不同生物的毒液通过靶向特定受体和离子通道，具有抗惊厥和抗癫痫作用。本综述强调了从这些来源中纯化的蛋白质和毒素作为癫痫潜在治疗药物的重要性。总之，本综述强调了动物毒液作为癫痫治疗研究进一步探索的宝贵天然资源的价值。
review_content_zh:

如果作者能提供一张总结这些毒液毒素诱导抗惊厥活性的可能机制的图，将会更有趣。因此，提出这些毒液毒素与受体、通道、转运蛋白的相互作用及其对扰动的下游反应。

paper_title: Factors contributing to persistent shoulder pain after arthroscopic rotator cuff repair: Protocol for a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Introduction 
 Rotator cuff (RC) tears are the most common and disabling musculoskeletal ailments among patients with shoulder pain. Although most individuals show improvement in function and pain following arthroscopic rotator cuff repair (ARCR), a subgroup of patients continue to suffer from persistent shoulder pain following the surgical procedure. Identifying these factors is important in planning preoperative management to improve patient outcomes. 
 
 
 Objective 
 This scoping review aims to identify biological factors, psychological factors, and social determinants of health contributing to the development of persistent pain in individuals after the ARCR procedure. 
 
 
 Inclusion criteria 
 All prospective and retrospective longitudinal studies reporting the risk factors contributing to persistent pain three months or longer after the ARCR surgery will be considered for this scoping review. 
 
 
 Methods 
 Our review will adhere to the Joanna Briggs Institute (JBI) scoping review methodology. Four electronic databases PubMed, CINAHL, Embase, and Scopus will be searched for studies in the English language. Additional studies can be found by conducting a citation analysis of the included studies. Title and abstract screening will be performed by two independent reviewers following the inclusion criteria, a third reviewer will be consulted about any differences. Next, full-text screening will be conducted, and the remaining search results will be reviewed to extract data, as well as to synthesize findings from all research. An overview of findings will be depicted in tabular format accompanied by a narrative summary of various factors contributing to persistent pain.

paper_title: A comprehensive review of energy efficient routing protocols for query driven wireless sensor networks
paper_abstract: In this current era of communications and networking, The Internet of things plays the main role in the making of smart communication and networking. In this article, we have focused on the literature survey on wireless sensor networks which are energy efficient. Various standard protocols are reviewed along with some enhanced protocols which makes the network energy efficient. The comparison of the standard and enhanced protocols with respect to various applications in wireless sensor networks is thoroughly done in this article. The outcomes of the enhanced protocols are also briefly discussed. For easier analysis to future researchers, a comparative table which lists the enhanced protocols which are compared with standard counterparts along with the factors for energy efficiency of the protocols. This article also comments on the issues and challenges of the protocols which can be further analyzed for making the wireless sensor network more energy efficient.
review_content:
While the article comments on issues and challenges, expanding this discussion to include potential solutions or ongoing research efforts that address these challenges could greatly enhance the practical relevance of the review. Additionally, discussing the trade-offs between energy efficiency and other performance metrics like latency or reliability could provide a more balanced view.

paper_title: The effects of hip-and ankle-focused exercise intervention on dynamic knee valgus: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. A range of non-contact injuries such as anterior cruciate ligament tear, patellar displacement and patellofemoral pain syndrome are caused by disordered knee joint loading from excessive dynamic knee valgus (DKV). Previous systematic reviews showed that DKV could be modified through the influence of hip strength and ankle range of motion. There was also a narrative review that investigated hip-focused neuromuscular exercise intervention on DKV. Therefore, the purpose of this systematic review was to examine the effects of exercise intervention which involved either top-down or bottom-up kinetic chains on minimizing DKV in male and female adults and adolescents, with and without existing knee pain . Methodology. Electronic searches were conducted in SAGE, Science Direct, SCOPUS, and Pubmed. The search strategy consisted of the medical subject headings and the free-text search keywords, synonyms and variations of 'exercise intervention,' 'knee alignment,' 'dynamic knee valgus', 'knee abduction' that were merged via the Boolean operator 'AND' and 'OR'. The search was conducted on full-text journals that documented the impact of the exercise intervention program involving either the bottom-up or top-down DKV mechanism on the knee kinematics. Furthermore, exercise intervention in this review should last at least one week which included two or three sessions per week. This review also considered both men and women of all ages with a healthy or symptomatic knee problem. The risk of bias of the included studies was assessed by Cochrane risk assessment tool. The protocol of this review was registered at PROSPERO (registration number: CRD42021219121). Results.Ten studies with a total of 289 participants (male= 122, female= 321; adults= 230, adolescents= 142; pre-adolescent= 51) met the inclusion criteria were included in this review. Seven studies showed the significant effects of the exercise intervention program (range from two weeks to ten weeks) on reducing DKV. The exercise training in these seven studies focused on muscle groups directly attached to the knee joint such as hamstrings and gastrocnemius.

paper_title: A systematic review of the case findings, testing and management of COVID-19
paper_abstract:
Background: Mass testing and adequate management are essential to terminate the spread of coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19). This testing is due to the possibility of unidentified cases, especially ones without COVID-19 related symptoms. This review aimed to examine the outcome of the existing studies on the ways of identifying COVID-19 cases, and determine the populations at risk, symptom and diagnostic test management of  COVID-19. 
 Methods: The articles reviewed were scientific publications on the PubMed, Science Direct, ProQuest, and Scopus databases. The keywords used to obtain the data were COVID-19, severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) and case detection, case management or diagnostic test. We applied the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) and Population, Intervention, Control and Outcomes (PICO) approaches. 
 Results: A total of 21 articles from 13 countries met the inclusion criteria and were further analyzed qualitatively. However, 62% of the articles used a rapid antibody test for screening rather than a rapid antigen test. According to the rapid antigen test, 51.3% were positive, with men aged above 50 years recording the highest number of cases. Furthermore, 57.1% of patients were symptomatic, while diagnostic tests' sensitivity and specificity increased to 100% in 14 days after the onset. 
 Conclusion s :  Real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR)  is recommended by the World Health Organization for detection of COVID-19. Suppose it is unavailable, the rapid antigen test is used as an alternative rather than the rapid antibody test. Diagnosis is expected to be confirmed using the PCR and serological assay to achieve an early diagnosis of COVID-19, according to disease progression, gradual rapid tests can be used, such as rapid antigen in an earlier week and antibody tests confirmed by RT–PCR and serological assay in the second week of COVID-19.
review_content:
I have read the paper entitled “ A systematic review of the case findings, testing, and management of COVID-19”. This paper is good and clear and beneficial for public health. The literature search for journal articles and Systematic Review stages is in accordance with standards.

There are comments from me that do not affect the quality of this paper as written below:
 1. At the end of the methods, it is written that the category of article quality assessment in percent is divided into bad (0-30%), satisfactory (34-67%), good (68-100%), there is a missing range, namely 31%, 32%, and 33% should be included in which category?
 2. In the results section, it states that "The reactive results of patients examined by the rapid tests showed that 42.9% were asymptomatic or lacked available data". This needs attention because it is very dangerous for public health. COVID-19 patients are asymptomatic and can transmit COVID-19 to other people in their various activities.
 3. "According to Table 3, showing the screening tests used in the study, 62% of the articles (13/21) adopted a rapid antibody and antigen test, for most of the men over 50 years of age" - what is the possible reason this test is less used at younger ages? This needs further research.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19病例发现、检测和管理的系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：大规模检测和充分管理对于终止2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）的传播至关重要。这种检测是由于存在未识别病例的可能性，尤其是那些没有COVID-19相关症状的病例。本综述旨在考察现有研究关于识别COVID-19病例的方法，并确定高风险人群、症状及COVID-19的诊断测试管理。

方法：所回顾的文章来自PubMed、Science Direct、ProQuest和Scopus数据库的科学出版物。用于获取数据的关键词包括COVID-19、严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV-2）、病例检测、病例管理或诊断测试。我们应用了系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目（PRISMA）以及人群、干预、对照和结果（PICO）方法。

结果：共有来自13个国家的21篇文章符合纳入标准，并进行了定性分析。然而，62%的文章使用快速抗体检测进行筛查，而不是快速抗原检测。根据快速抗原检测，51.3%的病例为阳性，其中50岁以上男性记录的病例数最高。此外，57.1%的患者有症状，而诊断测试的敏感性和特异性在发病后14天增加到100%。

结论：世界卫生组织推荐实时聚合酶链反应（RT-PCR）用于检测COVID-19。如果不可用，则使用快速抗原检测作为替代，而不是快速抗体检测。根据疾病进展，预期通过PCR和血清学检测确认诊断，以实现COVID-19的早期诊断，逐步可以使用快速检测，如在早期使用快速抗原检测，并在COVID-19的第二周通过RT-PCR和血清学检测确认抗体检测。

paper_title: Assessing toxicological risk of nanoplastics contaminants in food and feed from ingestion pathway to human diseases
paper_abstract: The extensive use of plastic without an effective management system is linked to significant environmental pollution issues. The fragmentation of various types of plastic waste leads to the formation of microplastics (MPs) and nanoplastics (NPs). NPs, measuring less than 0.1 μm pose a latent danger to the human food chain caused by the ability to traverse biological membranes than MPs, potentially leading to various chronic diseases. The widespread distribution of NPs across diverse environmental matrices and their subsequent infiltration into food and feed chains precipitates various emerging health concerns. NPs contaminate food production systems and leach from plastic packaging, infiltrating organisms at various trophic levels. Seafood, processed foods, and drinking water serve as vectors for absorption and accumulation in human tissues. The pervasive contamination pathway poses substantial risks to human health through multiple exposure routes, primarily ingestion. It can lead to cytotoxicity, inflammation, genotoxicity, and apoptosis. This review summarizes the implications of NPs exposure that triggers various diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), kidney dysfunction, liver disease, heart problems, brain disorders, reproductive issues, and cancer. Currently, no established method exists to treat NPs that humans may have already ingested. Hence, it is urgent to mitigate the harmful effects of NPs through the development and implementation of innovative, efficient, and sustainable environmental decontamination strategies. This discussion highlights several advanced remediation techniques that can effectively reduce the toxicity of NPs in environmental systems, thus mitigating their associated risks.
review_content:
This a review paper on the risk of nanoplastics from food and feed ingestion to humans.
The paper contains updated literature review and it is useful to the general public and scientists who want to learn more about this subject. Overall it is acceptable after major revision but I have few comments that need to be addressed before indexing.


1. The title indicate nanoplastics, particle size between 1-100 nm. We know that this is extremely difficult to achieve due to lack of instruments in the laboratories and there is still a lot of data lacking in the literature. The authors of this review have mixed microplastics, size between 100 nm to 5 mm and NPs. Juts read the literature. I would suggest to change the title and and micro and nanoplastics (MNPs) instead on nanoplastics.

2. The authors have listed papers on the levels of MNPs in the environment but I did not see any comment on the analytical part. The authors need to introduce a bullet point about the difficulties to determine MNPs in the environment and human samples . In addition there is lack of data on NPs still today- because of the analytical methods/instruments. Additionally there are also problems to compare data between different laboratories- due to the fact that there is not yet a standard analytical method and there are many different polymers- with different densities and abundances as well sizes, types and colour that need to be measured. One of the weak points is to measure MPs at levels of 100-1000 nm since micro-FTR instruments are needed and not many laboratories upgraded their FTIR instruments..
4.Table 1. Densities of the polymers need to be added- there is a broad range of densities, from levels < 1 g/cm3 like PE , PP till level < 1,35-1.7 g/cm3 like PET 1.35 or PVA. This will make a big difference in the atmospheric environmentt- low density ones can fly longer distances, as well in the aquatic environment, in water we will have the low density ones PP, LDPE and in sediments and sludge of wastewater the high density one are present. See paper recommended reading
5. Effects in different organs like renal or reproduction. Another point to be considered for the toxicity are the sorbed contaminants in the surface of the MNPs, Perfluorinated chemicals , PAHs and many pharmaceutical are sorbed into the plastic surface and can affect as well human health. Another bullet point on this topic need to be added.
6. Remediation techniques. Discuss as well the kinetics not only the efficiency of the technologies. For instance microorganisms can degrade MNPs but it will take several months to do this job, . But when using advanced oxidation techniques like Fenton degradation can occur within hours.
7.Conclusions need to be further elaborated and discussed indicating some perspective on this topic. For instance the need of better and comparable analytical techniques and much more epidemiological studies with larger population involved together with hospitals and research institutes at global scale.
paper_title_zh: 评估食品和饲料中纳米塑料污染物通过摄入途径对人类疾病的毒理学风险
paper_abstract_zh: 塑料的广泛使用缺乏有效的管理系统，与严重的环境污染问题密切相关。各种类型塑料废物的碎片化导致微塑料（MPs）和纳米塑料（NPs）的形成。尺寸小于0.1微米的NPs因其能够穿越生物膜，相较于MPs对人类食物链构成潜在危险，可能导致各种慢性疾病。NPs在多种环境基质中的广泛分布及其随后对食品和饲料链的渗透，引发了诸多新兴健康问题。NPs污染食品生产系统，并从塑料包装中渗出，渗透到不同营养级的生物体中。海产品、加工食品和饮用水作为载体，促进其在人体组织的吸收和积累。这种普遍的污染途径通过多种暴露途径，尤其是摄入，对人类健康构成重大风险，可能导致细胞毒性、炎症、基因毒性和细胞凋亡。本文综述了NPs暴露引发的各类疾病影响，如炎症性肠病（IBD）、肾脏功能障碍、肝脏疾病、心脏问题、脑部疾病、生殖问题和癌症。目前，尚无确立的方法治疗人类可能已摄入的NPs。因此，迫切需要通过开发和实施创新、高效和可持续的环境净化策略，减轻NPs的有害影响。本文讨论了若干先进修复技术，这些技术能够有效降低环境系统中NPs的毒性，从而减轻其相关风险。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于人类通过食物和饲料摄入纳米塑料风险的综述文章。
该文章包含最新的文献综述，对希望了解更多该主题的公众和科学家都很有用。总体而言，经过重大修订后是可以接受的，但我有一些在索引前需要解决的问题。

1. 标题中提到的纳米塑料，其粒径范围在1-100纳米之间。我们知道，由于实验室缺乏相关仪器，这极难实现，且文献中仍缺乏大量数据。该综述的作者将微塑料（粒径在100纳米至5毫米之间）和纳米塑料（NPs）混为一谈。只需阅读文献即可发现。我建议将标题改为“微纳米塑料（MNPs）”而非“纳米塑料”。

2. 作者列出了关于环境中MNPs水平的论文，但我未看到对分析部分的任何评论。作者需要引入一个关于在环境和人类样本中确定MNPs困难的要点。此外，由于分析方法/仪器的限制，至今仍缺乏关于NPs的数据。此外，由于尚未有标准的分析方法，且存在许多不同密度、丰度、大小、类型和颜色的聚合物，不同实验室之间的数据比较也存在问题。其中一个弱点是测量100-1000纳米水平的微塑料（MPs），因为这需要微-FTIR仪器，而许多实验室尚未升级其FTIR仪器。

4. 表1。需要添加聚合物的密度信息——密度范围很广，从低于1 g/cm³的PE、PP到低于1.35-1.7 g/cm³的PET 1.35或PVA。这在大气环境中会有很大差异——低密度塑料可以飞得更远，在水生环境中，水中会有低密度的PP、LDPE，而在废水污泥和沉积物中则存在高密度塑料。参见推荐阅读的论文。

5. 不同器官如肾脏或生殖系统的影响。毒性考虑的另一个要点是MNPs表面吸附的污染物，如全氟化合物、多环芳烃和许多药物，这些物质吸附在塑料表面，也可能影响人类健康。需要在此话题上增加一个要点。

6. 治理技术。不仅要讨论技术的效率，还要讨论其动力学。例如，微生物可以降解MNPs，但这需要几个月的时间。而使用高级氧化技术如Fenton降解，则可以在几小时内完成。

paper_title: A comprehensive review of circRNA: from purification and identification to disease marker potential
paper_abstract: Circular RNA (circRNA) is an endogenous noncoding RNA with a covalently closed cyclic structure. Based on their components, circRNAs are divided into exonic circRNAs, intronic circRNAs and exon-intron circRNAs. CircRNAs have well-conserved sequences and often have high stability due to their resistance to exonucleases. Depending on their sequence, circRNAs are involved in different biological functions, including microRNA sponge activity, modulation of alternative splicing or transcription, interaction with RNA-binding proteins, and rolling translation, and are a derivative of pseudogenes. CircRNAs are involved in the development of a variety of pathological conditions, such as cardiovascular diseases, diabetes, neurological diseases and cancer. Emerging evidence has shown that circRNAs are likely to be new potential clinical diagnostic markers or treatments for many diseases.
