paper_title: Post-operative rehabilitation and nutrition in osteoarthritis
paper_abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative process involving the progressive loss of articular cartilage, synovial inflammation and structural changes in subchondral bone that lead to loss of synovial joint structural features and functionality of articular cartilage. OA represents one of the most common causes of physical disability in the world. Different OA treatments are usually considered in relation to the stage of the disease. In the early stages, it is possible to recommend physical activity programs that can maintain joint health and keep the patient mobile, as recommended by OA Research Society International (OARSI) and European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR). In the most severe and advanced cases of OA, surgical intervention is necessary. After, in early postoperative stages, it is essential to include a rehabilitation exercise program in order to restore the full function of the involved joint. Physical therapy is crucial for the success of any surgical procedure and can promote recovery of muscle strength, range of motion, coordinated walking, proprioception and mitigate joint pain. Furthermore, after discharge from the hospital, patients should continue the rehabilitation exercise program at home associated to an appropriate diet. In this review, we analyze manuscripts from the most recent literature and provide a balanced and comprehensive overview of the latest developments on the effect of physical exercise on postoperative rehabilitation in OA. The literature search was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar, using the keywords ‘osteoarthritis’, ‘rehabilitation’, ‘exercise’ and ‘nutrition’. The available data suggest that physical exercise is an effective, economical and accessible to everyone practice, and it is one of the most important components of postoperative rehabilitation for OA.
review_content:
The review article by Musumeci et al. under the title "Post-operative rehabilitation and nutrition in osteoarthritis" is well written, with appropriate title and abstract. The article largely accomplishes to underline importance of exercise, combined with an appropriate daily diet, in postoperative rehabilitation for osteoarthritis (OA) patients. However, I have several comments which I hope will help the authors to bring across this important message even more efficiently.

Major points:
  * It is not very clear how the selection of articles was performed. The authors state: "The literature search was conducted from in March 2014 to April 2015 on PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar using appropriate keywords (osteoarthritis, rehabilitation, exercise and nutrition). Of approximately 160 papers (original articles, systematic and meta-analysis reviews) only 67 have been chosen and considered appropriate for the purpose of the review. The other papers, have not been considered as they resulted outside the scope of the research." However, out of these 67, only 7 are from 2014 and 3 from 2015. The rest range from 1995-2013 (References). The authors should clarify the selection criteria and perhaps include more of the more recent papers.

    Suggestions of the papers to include:
      + OARSI Clinical Trials Recommendations: Design and conduct of clinical trials of lifestyle diet and exercise interventions for osteoarthritis
      + Knee osteoarthritis: Clinical connections to articular cartilage structure and function
      + Exercise for osteoarthritis of the knee
      + Regular Exercises in Knee and Hip Osteoarthritis
      + Exercise, nutrition and managing hip fracture in older persons

  * The authors state: "OA is a degenerative process involving the progressive loss of structural features and functionality of the articular cartilage caused by an imbalance between anabolic and catabolic processes in the cartilage tissue, so that cartilage degradation exceeds reparative processes and OA progresses" - this is not sufficiently precise, since the subchondral bone is also involved in pathogenesis of OA. The authors should also mention this and further on, comment on the effects of weight loss/gain and exercise training on bone mineral density in OA patients.

    Suggested paper: The independent and combined effects of intensive weight loss and exercise training on bone mineral density in overweight and obese older adults with osteoarthritis.
Minor points:
  * "Cartilage is a slow adapting tissue, indeed it undergoes 75% adaptation in approximately 2 years." - Reference for this statement?
  * The paragraph under title “Second step post-operative rehabilitation in OA” - the whole paragraph is very repetitive, with the same kind of information provided in the table as well. Can be shortened.
  * It would be good to give short overview of the available surgical procedures to treat OA. The authors mention “Arthroscopic procedures, such as chondroplasty or microfracture, may resolve faster than osteochondral autograph transplantation (OATS) or autologous chondrocyte implantation (ACI) that involve larger incisions, requiring a slower exercise rehabilitation program”, but it would be better if they gave a short description of each procedure (not more than a sentence long).
paper_title_zh: 术后康复与营养在骨关节炎中的应用
paper_abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种退行性过程，涉及关节软骨的逐渐丧失、滑膜炎症和软骨下骨的结构变化，导致滑膜关节结构特征和关节软骨功能丧失。OA是全球导致身体残疾的最常见原因之一。不同的OA治疗方法通常与疾病的阶段相关。在早期阶段，可以推荐物理活动计划，以维持关节健康并保持患者活动能力，正如骨关节炎研究学会国际（OARSI）和欧洲抗风湿病联盟（EULAR）所推荐的。在OA最严重和晚期病例中，需要进行手术干预。术后早期阶段，必须包括康复锻炼计划，以恢复受累关节的完全功能。物理治疗对任何手术的成功至关重要，可以促进肌肉力量、活动范围、协调行走、本体感觉的恢复，并减轻关节疼痛。此外，出院后，患者应继续在家进行康复锻炼计划，并结合适当的饮食。在本综述中，我们分析了最新文献中的手稿，并提供了关于物理锻炼对OA术后康复影响的最新发展的平衡且全面的概述。文献检索使用了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar，关键词为“骨关节炎”、“康复”、“锻炼”和“营养”。现有数据表明，物理锻炼是一种有效、经济且人人可及的实践，是OA术后康复最重要的组成部分之一。
review_content_zh:
Musumeci等人撰写的综述文章《术后康复与营养在骨关节炎中的重要性》文笔流畅，标题和摘要恰当。该文章在很大程度上强调了锻炼结合适当的日常饮食在骨关节炎（OA）患者术后康复中的重要性。然而，我有几点意见，希望有助于作者更有效地传达这一重要信息。

主要问题：
  * 文章选择的标准不够明确。作者指出：“文献检索于2014年3月至2015年4月在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar上进行，使用适当的关键词（骨关节炎、康复、锻炼和营养）。在约160篇论文（原创文章、系统综述和荟萃分析）中，仅选择了67篇被认为适合综述目的的文章。其余文章因超出研究范围而未被考虑。”然而，在这67篇文章中，只有7篇来自2014年，3篇来自2015年，其余的从1995年至2013年（参考文献）。作者应澄清选择标准，并可能包括更多近期论文。

    建议纳入的论文：
      + OARSI临床试验建议：生活方式饮食和锻炼干预骨关节炎的临床试验设计与实施
      + 膝关节骨关节炎：与关节软骨结构和功能的临床联系
      + 膝关节骨关节炎的锻炼

paper_title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Models: A Comprehensive Survey
paper_abstract: Large models represent a groundbreaking advancement in multiple application fields, enabling remarkable achievements across various tasks. However, their unprecedented scale comes with significant computational costs. These models, often consisting of billions of parameters, require vast amounts of computational resources for execution. Especially, the expansive scale and computational demands pose considerable challenges when customizing them for particular downstream tasks, particularly over the hardware platforms constrained by computational capabilities. Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provides a practical solution by efficiently adjusting the large models over the various downstream tasks. In particular, PEFT refers to the process of adjusting the parameters of a pre-trained large model to adapt it to a specific task or domain while minimizing the number of additional parameters introduced or computational resources required. This approach is particularly important when dealing with large-scale language models with high parameter counts, as fine-tuning these models from scratch can be computationally expensive and resource-intensive, posing considerable challenges in the supporting system platform design. In this survey, we present comprehensive studies of various PEFT algorithms, examining their performance and computational overhead. Moreover, we provide an overview of applications developed using different PEFT algorithms and discuss common techniques employed to mitigate PEFT computation costs. In addition to providing an extensive survey from an algorithmic standpoint, we also examine various real-world system designs to investigate the implementation costs associated with different PEFT approaches. This survey serves as a valuable resource for researchers aiming to understand both the PEFT algorithm and its system implementation, offering detailed insights into recent advancements and practical applications.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This manuscript provides a literature review of parameter efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods, with a focus on fine tuning large language models (LLMs). It provides an ontology of PEFT methods, summarizes the considerations of PEFT design, provides example applications of PEFT outside of LLMs, summarizes considerations for implementing PEFT in systems, and proposes directions of future research.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: - Organization makes sense. - Ontology makes sense. - Figures are clear and helpful. - This is an extremely active area of research, and this manuscript provides a useful high-level overview of the field. Weaknesses: - Grammar is poor. - The word choice is poor in some parts. Some sentences are vague. - The review skims a lot of papers, and does a reasonable job in organizing the work, but there isn't much in the way of synthesis.

**Requested Changes:**
1. Run a grammar checker to fix grammar problems. 2. In abstract, avoid hyperbole: "This survey serves as an indispensable resource" 3. Section 3.1.2: "researchers directly append" --> "researchers directly prepend" 4. Section 4.1: "When we look at autoregressive characteristic, it becomes a major challenge in designing an inference system." This is unclear.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 大型模型的参数高效微调：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 大型模型在多个应用领域代表了突破性的进展，使各种任务取得了显著成就。然而，其前所未有的规模带来了显著的计算成本。这些通常包含数十亿参数的模型，需要大量的计算资源来执行。特别是，庞大的规模和计算需求在为特定下游任务进行定制时带来了相当大的挑战，尤其是在受计算能力限制的硬件平台上。参数高效微调（PEFT）通过高效调整大型模型以适应各种下游任务，提供了一种实用解决方案。具体而言，PEFT指的是调整预训练大型模型的参数以适应特定任务或领域，同时最小化引入的额外参数数量或所需的计算资源。这种方法在处理高参数数量的大型语言模型时尤为重要，因为从头开始微调这些模型可能会非常昂贵且资源密集，对支持系统平台设计构成相当大的挑战。在这篇综述中，我们全面研究了各种PEFT算法，考察了它们的性能和计算开销。此外，我们概述了使用不同PEFT算法开发的应用，并讨论了常用的减轻PEFT计算成本的技术。除了从算法角度提供广泛的综述外，我们还考察了各种现实世界的系统设计，以研究不同PEFT方法的实现成本。本综述为旨在理解PEFT算法及其系统实现的研究人员提供了宝贵资源，提供了对最新进展和实际应用的详细见解。

paper_title: Investigating the efficacy of hyaluronic acid in minimizing black triangles: A comprehensive analysis
paper_abstract:
In the anterior area of the mouth, the interdental papilla is important for dental hygiene and appearance. When it disappears, unpleasant “black triangles” form, which affects patients’ self-confidence in their smiles and makes oral hygiene more difficult. The loss of interdental papilla is caused by several variables such as tooth shape, periodontal disease, and aging. Although surgical treatments have been utilized to restore or retain missing papilla, their predictability remains unknown. In response, researchers have investigated non-invasive procedures, such as the use of fillers such as hyaluronic acid (HA). 
 Owing to its capacity to increase tissue volume and bind water, HA, a naturally occurring polysaccharide with special rheological qualities, has become a popular choice for use as a dermal filler. It shows promise when used to cure interdental papilla loss; the effects usually last for six–12 months. This review article explores the development and history of papilla rebuilding methods, emphasizing hyaluronic acid as a cutting-edge and successful method for regaining both periodontal health and aesthetics.
review_content:
This article Investigating the efficacy of hyaluronic acid in minimizing black triangles: A comprehensive analysis, explores the development and history of papilla rebuilding methods, with special emphasis on hyaluronic acid as a cutting-edge and successful method for achieving both periodontal health and aesthetics. The background , history and timelines are clearly highlighted. The importance of having a interdental papilla in esthetics and function and the factors influencing it are explained. The various surgical techniques for the management currently available are also highlighted.
The advantages of the use of hyaluronic acid and its potential future role are highlighted.

paper_title_zh: 探究透明质酸在减少黑三角中的有效性：一项综合性分析
paper_abstract_zh:
在口腔前部，牙间乳头对牙齿卫生和外貌至关重要。当其消失时，会形成不雅的“黑三角”，影响患者对微笑的自信，并使口腔卫生维护更加困难。牙间乳头的丧失由多种因素引起，如牙齿形状、牙周病和衰老。尽管已采用手术治疗以恢复或保留缺失的乳头，但其可预测性仍未知。为此，研究人员探讨了非侵入性方法，例如使用如透明质酸（HA）的填充剂。

由于透明质酸是一种具有特殊流变性质的天然多糖，能够增加组织体积和结合水分，已成为真皮填充剂的流行选择。在治疗牙间乳头丧失方面显示出良好前景；效果通常可持续6至12个月。本文综述了乳头重建方法的发展和历史，重点介绍了透明质酸作为恢复牙周健康和美观的前沿且有效方法。

paper_title: A review of ultrasound contrast media
paper_abstract: Efforts have been made over the last five decades to create effective ultrasonic contrast media (UCM) for cardiac and noncardiac applications. The initial UCM was established in the 1980s, following publications from the 1960s that detailed the discovery of ultrasonic contrast enhancement using small gaseous bubbles in echocardiographic examinations. An optimal contrast agent for echography should possess the following characteristics: non-toxicity, suitability for intravenous injection, ability to traverse pulmonary, cardiac, and capillary circulations, and stability for recirculation. Definity, Optison, Sonazoid, and SonoVue are examples of current commercial contrast media. These contrast media have shown potential for various clinical reasons, both on-label and off-label. Several possible UCMs have been developed or are in progress. Advancements in comprehending the physical, chemical, and biological characteristics of microbubbles have significantly improved the visualization of tumor blood vessels, the identification of areas with reduced blood supply, and the enhanced detection of narrowed blood vessels. Innovative advances are expected to enhance future applications such as ultrasonic molecular imaging and therapeutic utilization of microbubbles.
review_content:
This review shows An ideal contrast medium for echography should be nontoxic, capable of being injected intravenously, able to travel through pulmonary, cardiac, and capillary circulations, and stable for recirculation

Examples of current commercial contrast media include Definity, Optison, Sonazoid, and SonoVue, which have demonstrated potential for various clinical purposes, both on- and off-label.

paper_title: Using citation tracking for systematic literature searching - study protocol for a scoping review of methodological studies and a Delphi study
paper_abstract:
Background: Up-to-date guidance on comprehensive study identification for systematic reviews is crucial. According to current recommendations, systematic searching should combine electronic database searching with supplementary search methods. One such supplementary search method is citation tracking. It aims at collecting directly and/or indirectly cited and citing references from "seed references". Tailored and evidence-guided recommendations concerning the use of citation tracking are strongly needed. 
 Objective: We intend to develop recommendations for the use of citation tracking in systematic literature searching for health-related topics. Our study will be guided by the following research questions: What is the benefit of citation tracking for systematic literature searching for health-related topics? Which methods, citation indexes, and other tools are used for citation tracking? What terminology is used for citation tracking methods? 
 Methods: Our study will have two parts: a scoping review and a Delphi study. The scoping review aims at identifying methodological studies on the benefit and use of citation tracking in systematic literature searching for health-related topics with no restrictions on study design, language, and publication date. We will perform database searching in MEDLINE (Ovid), CINAHL (EBSCOhost), Web of Science Core Collection, two information science databases, web searching, and contact experts in the field. Two reviewers will independently perform study selection. We will conduct direct backward and forward citation tracking on included articles. Data from included studies will be extracted using a prespecified extraction sheet and presented in both tabular and narrative form. The results of the scoping review will inform the subsequent Delphi study through which we aim to derive consensus recommendations for the future practice and research of citation tracking.
review_content:
The authors propose to conduct a scoping review of the use of citation tracking techniques to identify research evidence to inform systematic reviews and also to survey experts on their use of citation tracking.

My suggestions for action on the proposal are as follows:
 1. Introduction: 'These references are usually eligible for inclusion into the review and known at the start of the citation search10–12.' I think this could be reworded for clarity along the following lines:
    'These references are usually eligible for inclusion into the review and some may be known at the beginning of the review and others may emerge as eligible records following the main database searches10–12.'
    Then perhaps you may not need the sentence that follows the one I am commenting on.
 2. Introduction: 'The taxonomy used to describe the…'. I think it might be better to use a word such as 'terminology' rather than 'taxonomy'.
 3. Figure 1. The figure would be more helpful if it could show the relationships of the indirect citation tracking in the Figure 1b perhaps by colour coding. Please check diagrams in the following references which incorporate chronology into the citation picture as well as showing the indirect citation tracking clearly.
    Belter CW. A relevance ranking method for citation-based search results. Scientometrics. 2017;112(2):731-46.1
    Janssens A, Gwinn M, Brockman JE, Powell K, Goodman M. Novel citation-based search method for scientific literature: a validation study. BMC Med Res Methodol. 2020;20(1):25.2
 4. Introduction: 'However, recent guidance suggests that combining several citation tracking methods (e.g. screening cited, citing, co-cited and co-citing references) may be the most effective way to use citation tracking for systematic reviewing. ' Please cite the guidance.
 5. Introduction: ' It rather depends on a variety of factors. For instance, citation tracking may be especially beneficial in case of (i) complex searches (e.g. for reviews on public health topics), (ii) searching for health outcome measurement instruments, or (iii) research areas without consistent taxonomy, with vocabulary overlaps with other fields, or with a lack of index terms in databases (e.g. methodological topics)'. These are all important issues and each deserves a bit more description so that readers can understand the differences. Again I think the word 'taxonomy' should be replaced with 'terminology'.
 6. Introduction: current 'topical reviews' - suggest replacing with 'recent reviews on this topic'. Then please add in more citations so that 'reviews' can be supported with more than one reference.
 7. Introduction: 'health-related systematic literature searching'. This occurs three times and for each occurrence I suggest rewording as follows for clarity: 'literature searching for systematic reviews of health and health-related topics'.
 8. Eligibility criteria. 'evidence retrieval method'. Suggest that 'method' is not needed as the sentence has 'means'.
 9. 'Eligible studies need to have a health-related context. Studies without an explicitly specified research context are also eligible. ' This seems contradictory. Why are studies in education topics for example not useful if they are looking at the methods rather than the topic? Just including papers where the topic is not clear seems arbitrary when there may be much to learn from a paper even if it has an engineering topic, say. Perhaps reword along the lines of 'although studies undertaken in the context of health-related topics are the main focus, studies of citation tracking in other literatures will also be eligible where the focus is on exploring the methods rather than the subject topic'.
10. Table 1. Publication Type cannot be 'Any' when there are publication types listed as ineligible. The authors should list eligible study types or use some sort of exception wording.
11. Information sources. I am not sure 'free web searching via Google Scholar' is a helpful description, perhaps just say 'searches of Google Scholar' here and further down where it is mentioned again.
12. 'For citation tracking, we will use Scopus, as this database seems to cover the largest number of relevant citations for the purpose of our review30. ' There is quite a lot of research that reports that other resources such as Google Scholar or Microsoft Academic provide wider coverage - the authors may wish to consider searching some of the free resources as well (since Scopus alone is not going to find the largest number of results) or finding other reasons for the use of a Scopus only approach.
13. 'MEDBIB-L' - I think there may be a typo here and it is MEDLIB-L? I think it may also need to be corrected in the Dissemination section.
14. My understanding of the purpose of a protocol is that it should list what will happen and therefore the resources to be searched should be listed and there should be no examples which imply that other things may be added. So there should be no' e.g.'.
15. 'text mining approach' - the chapter describes many approaches - which one was used in this case?
16. 'parts of our textwords' - suggest 'some of our textwords'?
17. Box 1 - there is harmless redundancy in the search. For example co-citation is searched alone and in combination with other terms - it only needs to be searched alone.
18. Box 1 - with the focus on searching in the titles, the use of such close adjacency does not seem warranted - it would be more sensitive to use AND for title searching.
19. Box 1 - it might be helpful in the absence of subject headings and the focus on searching mainly in titles to also search the author keywords field.
20. Data charting process: I realise it is difficult to know what will happen but the authors description is not very clear about their plans 'We aim for an iterative data extraction process, but in the final publication, we will provide a detailed overview of extracted data items.' What is an 'iterative data extraction process' - what might it look like and what does it involve?
21. Data collection 'preferred taxonomy' - again, I suggest the word you mean is 'terminology' not 'taxonomy'.
22. Data analysis. 'To analyse the survey data, we will apply descriptive statistics based on frequencies, percentages, and cross tables.' I think it may be 'cross tabulations' rather than 'cross tables'?
23. Dissemination of results - it might be useful to also to try to present results at conferences of systematic review experts - Cochrane Colloquium and the Health Technology Assessment International (HTAi) conferences. These organisations also have active information retrieval special interest groups.
24. Conclusions: 'Depending on the available study landscape' - this seems rather vague to me - it would help the reader if the authors could be more explicit about what they mean.
25. 'consequently, on the quality of clinical care' - I think it might not only be clinical care that could be impacted - it might be any aspect of health care depending on what is being reviewed e.g. a service, a policy, a new method of organising staff etc.
26. 'in a health-related context may prove relevant also for other academic fields such as social or environmental sciences' - I think that much of what you find may be generalisable to other disciplines, so I suggest that you state this earlier as a possibility.
paper_title_zh: 使用引文追踪进行系统文献检索——方法论研究范围综述和德尔菲研究方案
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：对于系统评价的综合研究识别，最新的指导至关重要。根据当前的建议，系统检索应结合电子数据库检索与补充检索方法。引文追踪是其中一种补充检索方法，旨在从“种子参考文献”中直接和/或间接收集被引用和引用的参考文献。针对引文追踪的使用，亟需定制化和循证指导建议。

目的：我们旨在为健康相关主题的系统文献检索中引文追踪的使用开发建议。我们的研究将围绕以下研究问题进行指导：引文追踪对健康相关主题系统文献检索的益处是什么？哪些方法、引文索引和其他工具用于引文追踪？引文追踪方法使用哪些术语？

方法：我们的研究将分为两部分：范围综述和德尔菲研究。范围综述旨在识别关于引文追踪在健康相关主题系统文献检索中的益处和使用的方法学研究，不限制研究设计、语言和发表日期。我们将在MEDLINE（Ovid）、CINAHL（EBSCOhost）、Web of Science核心合集、两个信息科学数据库中进行数据库检索，进行网络搜索，并联系领域专家。两名评审员将独立进行文献筛选。我们将对纳入的文章进行直接的前向和后向引文追踪。使用预先指定的提取表从纳入研究中提取数据，并以表格和叙述形式呈现。范围综述的结果将为后续的德尔菲研究提供信息，通过该研究我们旨在推导出对未来引文追踪实践和研究的共识建议。
review_content_zh:
作者们提议进行一项范围审查，探讨引用追踪技术用于识别研究证据以指导系统综述，并对专家们使用引用追踪的情况进行调查。

我对该提案的改进建议如下：

1. 引言部分：“这些参考文献通常符合纳入综述的条件，并在引文搜索开始时已知10–12。”我认为可以重新措辞以更清晰地表达：
   “这些参考文献通常符合纳入综述的条件，其中一些可能在综述开始时已知，而其他一些可能在主要数据库搜索后作为符合条件记录出现10–12。”
   这样或许可以省去我评论的句子后面的那句话。

2. 引言部分：“用于描述……的分类法”。我认为使用“术语”一词可能比“分类法”更合适。

3. 图1。如果图1b能通过颜色编码显示间接引用追踪的关系，该图将更有帮助。请参考以下文献中的图表，这些图表将时间顺序纳入引文图，并清晰地展示了间接引用追踪。
   Belter CW. A relevance ranking method for citation-based search results. Scientometrics. 2017;112(2):731-46.1
   Janssens A, Gwinn M, Brockman JE, Powell K, Goodman M. Novel citation-based search method for scientific literature: a validation study. BMC Med Res Methodol. 2020;20(1):25.2

4. 引言部分：“然而，最近的指南建议，结合多种引用追踪方法（例如，筛查被引用、引用、共被引用和共引用参考文献）可能是使用引用追踪进行系统综述的最有效方式。”请引用该指南。

5. 引言部分：“这更多地取决于多种因素。例如，引用追踪在以下情况下可能特别有益：（一）复杂搜索（例如，公共卫生主题的综述），（二）搜索健康结果测量工具，或（三）研究领域缺乏一致的术语、与其他领域的词汇重叠，或数据库中缺乏索引术语（例如，方法学主题）。”这些都是重要问题，每个问题都应稍作详细描述，以便读者理解差异。再次建议将“术语”替换“分类法”。

6. 引言部分：当前的“专题综述”——建议替换为“近期关于该主题的综述”。然后请增加更多引用，以便“综述”能有多个参考文献支持。

7. 引言部分：“健康相关系统文献检索”。这出现了三次，每次我都建议重新措辞以更清晰表达：“为健康及健康相关主题的系统综述进行的文献检索”。

8. 纳入标准。“证据检索方法”。建议删除“方法”，因为句子中已有“手段”。

9. “符合条件的研究需具有健康相关背景。未明确指定研究背景的研究也符合条件。”这似乎自相矛盾。例如，如果教育主题的研究关注的是方法而非主题，为什么没有用？仅包括主题不明确的论文似乎武断，因为即使论文是工程主题，也可能有很多值得学习的地方。或许可以重新措辞为：“尽管以健康相关主题为背景的研究是主要关注点，但在其他文献中进行的引用追踪研究也将符合条件，只要其重点在于探索方法而非主题。”

10. 表1。出版物类型不能是“任何”，当列出了不符合条件的出版物类型时。作者应列出符合条件的研究类型或使用某种例外措辞。

11. 信息来源。我不确定“通过Google Scholar进行免费网络搜索”是否是一个有帮助的描述，或许在这里和后面再次提到的地方直接说“搜索Google Scholar”即可。

12. “对于引用追踪，我们将使用Scopus，因为这个数据库似乎覆盖了我们综述目的相关引用的最大数量30。”有相当多的研究报道，其他资源如Google Scholar或Microsoft Academic提供更广泛的覆盖范围——作者可能希望考虑搜索一些免费资源（因为仅Scopus不会找到最大数量的结果），或找到仅使用Scopus的其他理由。

13. “MEDBIB-L”——我认为这里可能有打字错误，应该是MEDLIB-L？我认为在传播部分也应进行更正。

14. 我对协议目的的理解是，它应列出将要发生的事情，因此应列出将要搜索的资源，且不应有暗示可能添加其他内容的例子。所以不应有“例如”。

15. “文本挖掘方法”——该章节描述了许多方法——这里使用的是哪一种？

16. “我们部分文本词”——建议改为“我们一些文本词”？

17. 盒子1——搜索中存在无害的冗余。例如，共引用单独搜索并与其他术语组合搜索——只需单独搜索即可。

18. 盒子1——由于重点在标题搜索，如此紧密的邻接似乎不合理——使用AND进行标题搜索会更敏感。

19. 盒子1——在没有主题标题且主要关注标题搜索的情况下，也可能有助于搜索作者关键词字段。

20. 数据图表过程：我意识到很难知道会发生什么，但作者的描述关于他们的计划并不十分清晰：“我们旨在进行迭代数据提取过程，但在最终出版物中，我们将提供提取数据项的详细概述。”什么是“迭代数据提取过程”——它可能是什么样子，涉及什么？

21. 数据收集“首选分类法”——再次建议，你指的词是“术语”而非“分类法”。

22. 数据分析。“为了分析调查数据，我们将应用基于频率、百分比和交叉表的描述性统计。”我认为可能是“交叉表”而非“交叉表”？

23. 结果传播——也可能有助于在系统综述专家的会议上展示结果——Cochrane Colloquium和健康技术评估国际（HTAi）会议。这些组织也有活跃的信息检索特别兴趣小组。

24. 结论：“取决于可用的研究景观”——这对我来说似乎相当模糊——如果作者能更明确地说明他们的意思，将有助于读者。

25. “因此，对临床护理质量的影响”——我认为可能不仅临床护理会受到影响——根据所审查的内容，可能是健康的任何方面，例如服务、政策、新的员工组织方法等。

26. “在健康相关背景下可能也适用于其他学术领域，如社会或环境科学”——我认为你发现的很多东西可能适用于其他学科，所以建议你早点提出这种可能性。

'Eligible studies need to have a health-related context. Studies without an explicitly specified research context are also eligible. ' This seems contradictory.

My understanding of the purpose of a protocol is that it should list what will happen and therefore the resources to be searched should be listed and there should be no examples which imply that other things may be added. So there should be no' e.g.'.

paper_title: Automated human chromosome segmentation and feature extraction: Current trends and prospects
paper_abstract: Automated human chromosome segmentation and feature extraction aim to improve the overall quality of genetic disorder diagnosis by addressing the limitations of tedious manual processes such as expertise dependence, time-inefficiency, observer variability and fatigue errors. Nevertheless, significant differences caused by staining methods, chromosome damage which may occur during imaging, cell and staining debris, inhomogeneity, weak boundaries, morphological variations, premature sister chromatid separation, as well as the presence of overlapping, touching, di-centric and bent chromosomes pose challenges in automated human chromosome segmentation and feature extraction. This review paper extensively discusses how the approaches presented in literature have addressed these challenges, and their strengths and limitations. Human chromosome segmentation algorithms are presented under four broad categories; thresholding, clustering, active contours and convex-concave points-based methods. Chromosome feature extraction methods are discussed under two main categories based on banding-pattern and geometry. In addition, new insights for the improvement of fully automated karyotyping are provided.
review_content:
This review paper addresses automated human chromosome segmentation and. four categories of chromosome segmentation: thresholding, clustering, active contours and convex-concave points-based methods are presented. two feature extraction categories are introduced: based on banding-pattern and geometry.

My comments are:
  * The author need to clearly identify the paper contributions in the Introduction section.
  * Missing sections and subsection numbering. Better to mention the section number instead of “below” or “next” for ex. Page 6: “A detailed review on thresholding-based chromosome segmentation is presented below”
  * All figure sources need to be cited, and all figures need more elaboration.
  * Suggest to add a section that review all the existing datasets and its specifications.
  * Suggest to restructure the methods under each section to “hand crafted methods” and “deep learning methods”
  * Summary tables as table1 need to be added for the other categories.
  * More information need to be mentioned for each work like the dataset used, its specifications, the used evaluation metrics and their values compared to other works, limitations, and advantages of each work.
  * Table 3 does not reflect the segmentation and feature extraction categories in the papers. It even does not specify if the mentioned method is for segmentation and/or feature extraction.
  * The preprocessing stage and the last stage (karyotyping) are so important, better to be reviewed in the paper to give a complete review about the process.
paper_title_zh: 自动化人类染色体分割与特征提取：当前趋势与展望
paper_abstract_zh: 自动化人类染色体分割和特征提取旨在通过解决繁琐手工流程的局限性，如依赖专业知识、时间效率低下、观察者变异性和疲劳误差，来提高遗传疾病诊断的整体质量。然而，染色方法引起的显著差异、成像过程中可能发生的染色体损伤、细胞和染色碎片、不均匀性、弱边界、形态学变异、姐妹染色单体过早分离，以及重叠、接触、双着丝粒和弯曲染色体的存在，为自动化人类染色体分割和特征提取带来了挑战。本文综述了文献中提出的方法如何应对这些挑战，以及它们的优点和局限性。人类染色体分割算法被分为四大类：阈值法、聚类法、主动轮廓法和基于凸凹点的分割方法。染色体特征提取方法根据带型和解剖学特征分为两大类进行讨论。此外，还提供了关于改进全自动化核型分析的新的见解。
review_content_zh:
本综述论文探讨了自动化人类染色体分割，并介绍了四类染色体分割方法：阈值法、聚类法、活动轮廓法和基于凸凹点的分割法。此外，还引入了两种特征提取类别：基于带型特征和几何特征。

我的评论如下：
  * 作者需要在引言部分明确指出论文的贡献。
  * 缺少章节和小节编号。建议提及章节编号，而不是使用“如下”或“接下来”等表述，例如第6页：“如下将详细介绍基于阈值的染色体分割综述”。
  * 所有图源需要引用，所有图表需要更详细的说明。
  * 建议增加一个综述现有数据集及其规格的章节。
  * 建议将各章节下的方法重新组织为“手工方法”和“深度学习方法”。
  * 需要为其他类别添加类似表1的总结表格。
  * 对于每项工作，需要提及更多信息，如使用的数据集及其规格、所用的评估指标及其与其他工作的对比值、每项工作的局限性和优势。
  * 表3未能反映论文中的分割和特征提取类别，甚至未指明所提方法是用于分割还是特征提取。
  * 预处理阶段和最后阶段（核型分析）非常重要，建议在论文中进行综述，以提供关于该过程的完整评述。

paper_title: CD4 count and tuberculosis risk in HIV-positive adults not on ART: A systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: Background : CD4 cell count in adults with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection (PLHIV) not receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART) influences tuberculosis (TB) risk. Despite widespread use in models informing resource allocation, this relationship has not been systematically reviewed.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The paper is well written, but can be improved with minor copy-editing. Thank you. We have proof-read our article again and made a number of changes. Experimental design The study objective and rationale for this study and study design methods are well stated. Validity of the findings The analysis is sound, but the findings have to specifically stated that they are applicable only to HIV positive adults (>= 15 years of age) not on ART, rather than generally to all people living with HIV not on ART, since this can be misunderstood to mean both children and adults. Thank you for pointing this out. We have made changes to the Title, Abstract, Introduction and Discussion to stress that we are talking about adults defined as >= 15 years old (see track changes). Comments for the Author The authors have conducted a systematic review and meta-analysis to quantify the risk between CD4+ T cell count and tuberculosis among HIV-positive adults (>= 15 years of age) who are not on antiretroviral therapy. This is a valuable study that quantifies this risk in a systematic manner, and adds the the current evidence illustrating the exponential increase in TB incidence with declining CD4+ T cell count. Here are my specific comments: 1. Lines 1-2 -- Title: Change the “people” in title to “adults”, since this study is specific to HIV-positive adults (>= 15 years of age). You can change the title to “CD4 count and tuberculosis risk in HIV-positive adults not on ART: A systematic review and meta-analysis” Thanks, yes. We have done this. 2. Line 4 -- Short title: Change short title to “CD4 count and TB risk in HIV-positive adults not on ART” Unfortunately, this is substantially over the stringent character system that the submission system imposes. We have been unable to formulate a better short title than our original version, but hope that the other clarifications (and change to the main title) will head off any potential confusion. 3. Lines 30-32: Add “among HIV-positive adults (>= 15 years of age) not on ART” to the end of the sentence, (i.e), change sentence to “Our meta-analysis estimated a 1.43 (95% credible interval: 1.16 – 1.88)-fold increase in TB incidence per 100 cells per mm3 decrease in CD4 cell count among HIV-positive adults (>= 15 years of age) not on ART” Done. 4. Line 33-35: Add “among HIV-positive adults (>= 15 years of age) not on ART”, (i.e), change sentence to “Our analysis confirms previous estimates of exponential increase in TB incidence with declining CD4 cell count among HIV-positive adults (>= 15 years of age) not on ART, emphasizing the importance of early ART initiation to reduce TB risk. Mindful for the abstract character limit, we have inserted ‘in adults’ but not duplicated the definition of this term appearing the Abstract:Methods. 5. Similar to comments 1-4, please change any reference throughout the paper from people to make it specific to adults. Thereby, the analysis and findings in this paper will not be misunderstood to be applicable to all people, including children and adults. Thanks, yes. We have done this. 6. Line 43-45: Be clear there are a total of 1.8 million deaths from TB, of which 1.4 million deaths are among HIV- people and 0.4 million deaths among HIV+ people. We have changed this to read: “an estimated 1.4 million deaths from TB (excluding those with HIV) and 0.4 million deaths in those with HIV and TB in 2015.” 7. Line 154-156 and Figure 4: Why is the upper CD4 T cell count of 1000 cells/mm3 used? Can’t the curve be projected/extrapolated using the available data? This would be extrapolating substantially beyond the typical range of the data. There is heterogeneity between individuals and populations in the CD4 count among HIV-negative persons, which likely reflects in the CD4 dynamics of comparable HIV-positive groups.(Williams et al. 2010; Williams et al. 2006) The significance of this heterogeneity remains controversial. For us the key result is the relative increase in TB risk for each decrement in CD4 cell count. The choice of 1000 cells/mm3 as a baseline is typical in the modelling literature, e.g. (Williams & Dye 2003; Williams et al. 2010), because it tallies with models of CD4 dynamics and also because this starting point reproduces observed TB risk levels in late stage untreated HIV infections. 8. Line 293-294: Add “except for one study (Wolday et al. 2003)”, (i.e), modify the sentence to “BCG vaccination status was not reported except for one study (Wolday et al. 2003), and may itself have confounded results, either through variation in coverage or variation in efficacy.” Thanks. We have done this. 9. Figure 1: Update the box “Studies included in qualitative synthesis (n=7)” to “Studies included in qualitative and quantitative synthesis (n=7)”. Thanks. We have done this. 10. Figure 2 legend: Change “people” to “adults (>= 15 years of age)”. We have made these changes to all the Figure legends. 11. Figure 3: Try the plot with X axis in linear scale instead of log scale for “Increase in TB incidence per 100 CD4 cells/mm3 decrease” -- This is likely to represent this data better for understanding. If the current plot (log scale) is a better visualization of this result, than leave it as is; if not replace it with the linear scale plot. Here we do believe the log scale is a better representation of the result. First, it is more closely related to what is being estimated, and to the data as presented in Figure 2. Secondly, plotting on a linear scale would require us to switch to talking about IRRs, since the background TB rates in each study are different (this drops out on a log scale when dealing with differences). Finally, the large uncertainty associated with Wolday et al, would be difficult to represent on a linear scale while still being able to visualize the different study results. 12. Table 1: Split the “Study description” column to “Study description” and “Conclusion”. That is, add a separate column for “Conclusion”, and move this corresponding text from the “Study description” column. We have done this. 13. Table 1: Monge, 2014 study -- age range is > 13 years. Is the overall systematic review representative of >=15 years of age or >=14 years of age? Fair point. Neither this publication, nor other publications on the CoRIS cohort state what proportion of person time was in persons aged 14. However, given the stated characteristics of this cohort (58% MSM), and the nature of the HIV epidemic in Spain generally (UNAIDS estimate nearly 80% of PLHIV are male and fewer than 100 persons aged 14 or younger infected with HIV in Spain currently), this is not likely to be a serious issue. We have added the following sentence to the limitations in the Discussion: “It is possible that a small number of individuals may have contributed person-time at age 14 to the cohort in (Monge et a. 2014).” 14. Table 1: Nicholas, 2011 study -- Name all the 6 countries in the “Country” column. We have done this.
paper_title_zh: HIV阳性未接受抗逆转录病毒治疗的成人CD4计数与结核病风险：系统综述与Meta分析
paper_abstract_zh: 背景：未接受抗逆转录病毒治疗（ART）的成人人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）感染者（PLHIV）的CD4细胞计数影响结核病（TB）风险。尽管这一关系在指导资源分配的模型中广泛应用，但尚未进行系统综述。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）
基本报告
论文写得很好，但可以通过轻微的校对编辑进行改进。谢谢。我们已经再次校对文章并做了一些修改。
实验设计
研究目标和本研究的研究设计方法的合理性陈述得很好。
研究结果的有效性
分析是合理的，但研究结果必须明确指出仅适用于未接受抗逆转录病毒治疗的HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁），而不是普遍适用于所有未接受ART的HIV感染者，因为这样可能会被误解为包括儿童和成人。谢谢您指出这一点。我们已经对标题、摘要、引言和讨论部分进行了修改，以强调我们讨论的是定义为>= 15岁的成人（见跟踪更改）。
对作者的意见
作者进行了一项系统综述和荟萃分析，以量化未接受抗逆转录病毒治疗的HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁）中CD4+ T细胞计数与结核病之间的风险。这是一项有价值的研究，系统地量化了这一风险，并增加了当前证据，说明随着CD4+ T细胞计数的下降，结核病发病率的指数增长。以下是我的具体意见：
1. 第1-2行 -- 标题：将标题中的“people”改为“adults”，因为这项研究特定于HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁）。你可以将标题改为“CD4计数与未接受ART的HIV阳性成人结核病风险：一项系统综述和荟萃分析”
谢谢，是的。我们已经这样做了。
2. 第4行 -- 简短标题：将简短标题改为“CD4计数与未接受ART的HIV阳性成人TB风险”
不幸的是，这大大超出了投稿系统严格规定的字符限制。我们未能制定出比原版本更好的简短标题，但希望其他澄清（以及对主标题的更改）能够避免任何潜在的混淆。
3. 第30-32行：在句末添加“在未接受ART的HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁）中”，（即），将句子改为“我们的荟萃分析估计，每100个细胞每mm3的CD4细胞计数下降，在未接受ART的HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁）中，TB发病率增加1.43倍（95%可信区间：1.16 – 1.88）”
已完成。
4. 第33-35行：添加“在未接受ART的HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁）中”，（即），将句子改为“我们的分析证实了之前关于随着CD4细胞计数下降，在未接受ART的HIV阳性成人（>= 15岁）中TB发病率呈指数增长的估计，强调了早期启动ART以降低TB风险的重要性。”考虑到摘要字符限制，我们插入了“在成人中”，但没有重复摘要：方法中出现的该术语的定义。
5. 类似于意见1-4，请将论文中任何提及“people”的地方改为特指“adults”。 因此，本文的分析和发现不应被误解为适用于所有人，包括儿童和成人。谢谢，是的。我们已经做了这一点。6. 第43-45行：明确指出共有180万人死于结核病，其中140万人为HIV阴性人群，40万人为HIV阳性人群。我们已将其修改为：“2015年估计有140万人死于结核病（不包括HIV感染者）和40万人死于HIV和结核病双重感染者。”7. 第154-156行及图4：为什么使用1000个细胞/mm³作为CD4 T细胞计数的上限？难道不能利用现有数据对曲线进行投影/外推吗？这将大大超出数据的典型范围。HIV阴性人群中的CD4计数存在个体和群体间的异质性，这可能在可比HIV阳性群体的CD4动态中有所反映（Williams等人，2010；Williams等人，2006）。这种异质性的意义仍存在争议。对我们而言，关键结果是CD4细胞计数每减少一个单位，结核病风险的相对增加。选择1000个细胞/mm³作为基线在建模文献中是典型的，例如（Williams & Dye 2003；Williams等人，2010），因为这符合CD4动态模型，并且这一起点再现了晚期未治疗HIV感染中观察到的结核病风险水平。8. 第293-294行：添加“除了一项研究（Wolday等人，2003）”，即修改句子为“BCG疫苗接种状况未报告，除了一项研究（Wolday等人，2003），并且其本身可能通过覆盖范围的变异或效力的变异而混淆结果。”谢谢。我们已经做了这一点。9. 图1：将框“纳入定性综合的研究（n=7）”更新为“纳入定性和定量综合的研究（n=7）”。谢谢。我们已经做了这一点。10. 图2图例：将“人”改为“成人（>= 15岁）”。我们已经对所有图例进行了这些修改。11. 图3：尝试使用线性尺度而不是对数尺度绘制“每减少100个CD4细胞/mm³结核病发病率的增加”——这可能更有助于理解这些数据。如果当前图（对数尺度）更好地展示了这一结果，则保持不变；如果不是，则替换为线性尺度图。我们确实认为对数尺度是这一结果的更好表示。首先，它与所估计的内容以及图2中呈现的数据更为接近。其次，在线性尺度上绘图将要求我们转而讨论IRR，因为各研究中的背景结核病率不同（在对数尺度上处理差异时，这一点会消失）。最后，Wolday等人研究中的巨大不确定性在线性尺度上难以表示，同时还能可视化不同研究结果。12. 表1：将“研究描述”列拆分为“研究描述”和“结论”。也就是说，添加一个单独的“结论”列，并将相应的文本从“研究描述”列移至新列。我们已经完成此操作。13. 表1：Monge, 2014研究——年龄范围为>13岁。整体系统评价是代表>=15岁还是>=14岁？这是一个合理的观点。无论是这篇出版物，还是其他关于CoRIS队列的出版物，都没有说明14岁人群中的人时比例。然而，鉴于该队列的已知特征（58%为男男性行为者），以及西班牙HIV疫情的一般情况（联合国艾滋病规划署估计，近80%的HIV感染者为男性，目前西班牙14岁及以下感染HIV的人数不足100人），这不太可能成为一个严重问题。我们已在讨论部分的局限性中添加了以下句子：“可能有一小部分个体在14岁时对Monge等人（2014）研究的队列贡献了人时。” 14. 表1：Nicholas, 2011研究——在“国家”列中列出所有6个国家。我们已经完成此操作。

paper_title: Medicinal properties of
paper_abstract:
Background: The objective of this review was to evaluate the medicinal potential of Morus alba leaves on the control of type 2 diabetes mellitus (DM2). The research question was: what is the therapeutic potential of Morus alba leaves for the control of DM2? 
 Methods: This systematic review was based on the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) guidelines. The included studies were extracted from Scopus, Pubmed, ScienceDirect, Scielo, and Google Scholar; January 2015 to July 2021. Key search terms were MeSH and DeCS: Morus alba , mulberry, hypoglycemic agent. The inclusion criteria were: studies in rats administered Morus alba leaf extracts; studies that included the dimensions of lipidemia and glycemia; studies that included indicators such as fasting glucose, postprandial glucose, glycosylated hemoglobin, triglycerides, low-density lipoproteins, total cholesterol, and insulin resistance. Exclusion criteria: studies in which Morus alba leaves were administered with other plants; studies with other parts of the Morus alba plant; proteomic studies, cancer, duplicate studies, in vitro studies, and evaluation of included studies. All included investigations were evaluated for biases. 
 Results: Of 253 studies found, 29 were included. The extracts of Morus alba leaves at the phytochemical level improve glucose uptake. Chlorogenic acid, isoquercitrin, and quercitrin, present in the leaves of Morus alba , have hypoglycemic properties and an ameliorating effect on diabetic nephropathy. This leaf has pharmacological effects such as glucose absorption, insulin secretion production, antioxidant and anti-inflammatory agent, antihyperglycemic and antihyperlipidemic activities, and obesity management. 
 Conclusions:  Morus alba leaves have pharmacological effects on DM2 that include glucose absorption, production of insulin secretion, antioxidant agent, antihyperglycemic and antihyperlipidemic activities, and obesity control. Beyond these results, there is a lack of studies on the potential and synergistic effects of Morus alba leaves' components, limiting the possibility of a more effective therapy using the plant's leaves.
review_content:
The article belongs to the research line of Biomedical Sciences, specifically phytochemistry and pharmacognosy in medicinal plants, addressing the evidence of the activity of a plant on Diabetes Mellitus 2. It is a relevant and current topic in the medical specialty; the study developed a careful screening based on the various sources of articles consulted and included in the study.

Some recommendations:
 1. In the abstract –methodology section–, the wording should be improved so that it is clearly understood which studies were found, and of the total, which ones were included.
 2. Review the publication “Declaración PRISMA 2020: una guía actualizada para la publicación de revisiones sistemáticas;” especially figure 1, page 795 1 compare it with figure 1 of the manuscript under review (Flow diagram of the identification, screening, eligibility and included articles), and make the appropriate adjustments.
 3. Synthesize the conclusion, focusing mainly on the study's main findings and their impact on the therapeutic potential of Morus alba leaves in the control of the disease addressed in the present study.
paper_title_zh: 药用特性
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：本综述的目的是评估桑叶在控制2型糖尿病（DM2）中的药用潜力。研究问题是：桑叶对DM2控制的疗效潜力是什么？
方法：本系统综述基于系统综述和荟萃分析的首选报告项目（PRISMA）指南。纳入的研究来自Scopus、Pubmed、ScienceDirect、Scielo和Google Scholar；时间范围为2015年1月至2021年7月。关键词为MeSH和DeCS：Morus alba、mulberry、hypoglycemic agent。纳入标准包括：在大鼠中给予桑叶提取物的研究；包含脂血症和血糖维度的研究；包含空腹血糖、餐后血糖、糖化血红蛋白、甘油三酯、低密度脂蛋白、总胆固醇和胰岛素抵抗等指标的研究。排除标准：桑叶与其他植物共同给药的研究；使用桑树其他部位的研究；蛋白质组学研究、癌症研究、重复研究、体外研究和对纳入研究的评估。所有纳入的研究均进行了偏倚评估。
结果：在找到的253项研究中，有29项被纳入。在植物化学水平上，桑叶提取物能改善葡萄糖摄取。桑叶中含有的绿原酸、异槲皮苷和槲皮苷具有降血糖特性，并对糖尿病肾病有改善作用。桑叶具有药理作用，如葡萄糖吸收、胰岛素分泌产生、抗氧化和抗炎作用、抗高血糖和抗高血脂活性以及肥胖管理。
结论：桑叶对DM2具有药理作用，包括葡萄糖吸收、胰岛素分泌产生、抗氧化作用、抗高血糖和抗高血脂活性以及肥胖控制。除了这些结果外，关于桑叶成分的潜在和协同效应的研究不足，限制了利用该植物叶子进行更有效治疗的可能性。
review_content_zh:
文章属于生物医学科学领域的研究，具体涉及药用植物的植物化学和生药学，探讨了某种植物对2型糖尿病活性的证据。这是一个在医学专业中相关且当前的热门话题；研究基于所查阅和纳入研究的各类文章来源，进行了细致的筛选。

一些建议：
1. 在摘要的“方法学”部分，应改进措辞，以便清晰地理解发现了哪些研究，以及在这些研究中哪些被纳入。
2. 审阅出版物“Declaración PRISMA 2020: una guía actualizada para la publicación de revisiones sistemáticas;”特别是第795页的图1，将其与所审稿件中的图1（文章识别、筛选、合格及纳入的流程图）进行比较，并进行适当的调整。

paper_title: A Survey of Lottery Ticket Hypothesis
paper_abstract: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH) states that a dense neural network model contains a highly sparse subnetwork (i.e., winning tickets) that can achieve even better performance than the original model when trained in isolation. While LTH has been proved both empirically and theoretically in many works, there still are some open issues, such as efficiency and scalability, to be addressed. Also, the lack of open-source frameworks and consensual experimental setting poses a challenge to future research on LTH. For the first time, we examine previous research and studies on LTH from different perspectives. We also discuss issues in existing works and list potential directions for further exploration. This survey provides an in-depth look at the state of LTH.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
As clearly stated upfront, the manuscript surveys the research on the lottery ticket hypothesis. To organize the survey, it is organized into eight different topic areas.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: - The manuscript delivers on what the title promises. As far as I know, this kind of summary does not exist, and it will likely be useful to anyone looking for a survey of papers in the field. - The proposed topic areas mostly make sense for organizing the existing literature. Weaknesses: - This is not a good introduction to the LTH for researchers outside the field (e.g. graduate students). - The manuscript fails to synthesize any new understanding. - Descriptions of the papers is shallow and uncritical. - Some papers are summarized to the point that it is difficult or impossible to understand what the paper is about. - There are some grammatical errors. - The relation to research on building sparse neural networks is never explained.

**Requested Changes:**
- The LTH hypothesis is mainly interesting because the phenomenon seems to tell us something about how a neural network (NN) learns during training. For practitioners who want to build effecient NN models, there is a whole literature on sparsity, of which LTH is just a subset. This is never addressed in the manuscript. I believe it should be. - For example, are the methods proposed for finding sparse subnetworks useful within the larger context of building sparse, resource efficient NNs? Or are these methods only for the sake of our theoretical understanding? - The abstract describes the LTH as that a DNN contains a subnetwork "that can achieve even better performance than the original model". This contradicts the definition given on page 3, which says "can reach similar accuracy". - There are various grammatical problems throughout. In Section 5.3: "pruning is known to have an inability for real hardware acceleration." Section 7: "we conclude these connections." The spelling "re-training" is used. - Descriptions are unclear. In Section 1: "Unstructured pruning results in sparse individual parameters without pre-defining the positions of zeros." In Section 6.3: "These tickets can be directly reused across various tasks without the need for retraining." What kind of retraining? I couldn't understand from the context. In Section 6.2: "This subset accurately mirrors the performance disparities observed under various training frameworks, hyperparameters, and other conditions." Also, the description of sparsifying image patches at the end of Section 6.2 requires more explanation. Description of the dual lottery ticket hypothesis in Section 6.4 was unclear. - I thought the authors' could have used their expertise in this field to help synthesize some of these results.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
None.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 彩票假设综述
paper_abstract_zh: 彩票假说（LTH）指出，一个稠密的神经网络模型包含一个高度稀疏的子网络（即中奖彩票），当单独训练时，该子网络能够实现比原始模型更好的性能。尽管LTH已在许多工作中通过实证和理论得到证明，但仍存在一些待解决的问题，如效率和可扩展性。此外，缺乏开源框架和共识性实验设置对LTH的未来研究构成了挑战。我们首次从不同角度审视了以往关于LTH的研究和探讨，并讨论了现有工作中的问题，列出了进一步探索的潜在方向。本综述深入探讨了LTH的现状。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
如前所述，该手稿综述了关于彩票假说（lottery ticket hypothesis）的研究。为了组织综述，将其划分为八个不同的主题领域。

**优点与缺点：**
优点：
- 手稿实现了标题所承诺的内容。据我所知，这种类型的总结尚不存在，对于寻找该领域论文综述的人来说可能非常有用。
- 所提议的主题领域大多对于组织现有文献是合理的。

缺点：
- 对于领域外的研究者（例如研究生）来说，这不是一个好的LTH入门介绍。
- 手稿未能综合出任何新的理解。
- 对论文的描述浅显且缺乏批判性。
- 一些论文被总结到难以或无法理解其内容的程度。
- 存在一些语法错误。
- 未解释与构建稀疏神经网络研究的关系。

**请求的修改：**
- LTH假说主要有趣之处在于，该现象似乎告诉我们关于神经网络（NN）在训练过程中如何学习的信息。对于希望构建高效NN模型的实践者来说，存在一个关于稀疏性的完整文献体系，而LTH只是其中的一部分。手稿中从未提及这一点，我认为应该加以讨论。
- 例如，提出用于寻找稀疏子网络的方法在构建稀疏、资源高效NN的更大背景下是否有用？还是这些方法仅为了我们的理论理解？
- 摘要中将LTH描述为深度神经网络（DNN）包含一个“能够实现甚至优于原始模型性能”的子网络，这与第3页给出的定义“能达到相似精度”相矛盾。
- 全文存在各种语法问题。在第5.3节：“剪枝被认为无法实现真正的硬件加速。”第7节：“我们总结这些联系。”使用了“re-training”的拼写。描述不清楚。在第1节：“非结构化剪枝导致稀疏的个别参数，而不预先定义零的位置。”在第6.3节：“这些彩票可以直接在各种任务中重复使用，而无需重新训练。”是什么样的重新训练？从上下文中无法理解。在第6.2节：“这一子集准确反映了在不同训练框架、超参数和其他条件下观察到的性能差异。”此外，第6.2节末尾对稀疏化图像块的描述需要更多解释。第6.4节中对双彩票假说的描述不清楚。
- 我认为作者本可以利用他们在该领域的专业知识来帮助综合这些结果。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
无。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

paper_title: Immunopathology of galectin-3: an increasingly promising target in COVID-19
paper_abstract: The pandemic brought on by the outbreak of severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV2) has become a global health crisis, with over 22 million confirmed cases and 777,000 fatalities due to coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) reported worldwide. The major cause of fatality in infected patients, now referred to as the “Cytokine Storm Syndrome” (CSS), is a direct result of aberrant immune activation following SARS-CoV2 infection and results in excess release of inflammatory cytokines, such as interleukin (IL)-1, tumor necrosis factor α (TNF-α), and IL-6, by macrophages, monocytes, and dendritic cells. Single cell analysis has also shown significantly elevated levels of galectin 3 (Gal-3) in macrophages, monocytes, and dendritic cells in patients with severe COVID-19 as compared to mild disease. Inhibition of Gal-3 reduces the release of IL-1, IL-6, and TNF-α from macrophages in vitro , and as such may hold promise in reducing the incidence of CSS. In addition, Gal-3 inhibition shows promise in reducing transforming growth factor ß (TGF-ß) mediated pulmonary fibrosis, likely to be a major consequence in survivors of severe COVID-19. Finally, a key domain in the spike protein of SARS-CoV2 has been shown to bind N- acetylneuraminic acid (Neu5Ac), a process that may be essential to cell entry by the virus. This Neu5Ac-binding domain shares striking morphological, sequence, and functional similarities with human Gal-3. Here we provide an updated review of the literature linking Gal-3 to COVID-19 pathogenesis. Dually targeting galectins and the Neu5Ac-binding domain of SARS-CoV2 shows tentative promise in several stages of the disease: preventing viral entry, modulating the host immune response, and reducing the post-infectious incidence of pulmonary fibrosis.

* The review article is clear, concise, and well structured.

paper_title_zh: 半乳糖凝集素-3的免疫病理学：COVID-19中日益有前景的靶点
paper_abstract_zh: 由严重急性呼吸综合征冠状病毒2（SARS-CoV2）爆发引发的大流行已成为全球卫生危机，全球报告的2019冠状病毒病（COVID-19）确诊病例超过2200万例，死亡777,000例。感染患者的主要死因，现称为“细胞因子风暴综合征”（CSS），是SARS-CoV2感染后异常免疫激活的直接结果，导致巨噬细胞、单核细胞和树突状细胞过量释放炎症细胞因子，如白细胞介素（IL）-1、肿瘤坏死因子α（TNF-α）和IL-6。单细胞分析还显示，与轻度疾病患者相比，重症COVID-19患者的巨噬细胞、单核细胞和树突状细胞中半乳糖凝集素3（Gal-3）水平显著升高。体外抑制Gal-3可减少巨噬细胞释放IL-1、IL-6和TNF-α，因此可能在降低CSS发生率方面具有前景。此外，Gal-3抑制在减少转化生长因子β（TGF-β）介导的肺纤维化方面显示出前景，这可能是重症COVID-19幸存者的主要后果。最后，SARS-CoV2刺突蛋白中的一个关键结构域已被证明可结合N-乙酰神经氨酸（Neu5Ac），这一过程可能是病毒进入细胞的关键。这一Neu5Ac结合结构域在形态、序列和功能上与人类Gal-3具有显著相似性。本文提供了关于Gal-3与COVID-19发病机制相关性的最新文献综述。双重靶向半乳糖凝集素和SARS-CoV2的Neu5Ac结合结构域在疾病的多个阶段显示出初步前景：预防病毒进入、调节宿主免疫反应以及减少感染后肺纤维化的发生率。
review_content_zh:
* 该综述文章清晰、简洁且结构良好。
  * 文章通过将COVID-19的致病机制与Gal-3的免疫病理学效应联系起来，突出了新的发现。使用Gal-3抑制剂双重靶向SARS-CoV2的Neu5Ac结合域和半乳糖凝集素-3，可能是减少病毒传播、细胞因子风暴和感染后肺纤维化的非常有效的方法。
  * 文章中的图表质量良好，清晰地解释了所讨论的概念。
  * 请求作者解决以下具体意见：
    1) 作者提到Gal-3抑制剂可以靶向Neu5Ac结合域，从而减少病毒进入宿主细胞。由于ACE2受体是SARS-CoV2的主要进入机制，Gal-3抑制剂单独使用能在多大程度上提供缓解效果？此外，ACE2抑制剂能否与Gal-3抑制剂联合使用作为佐剂？可能性如何？这些问题需要解释。

    2) 建议作者在他们的手稿中引用Garcia-Revilla, J.等人于2020年发表的文章。该文章讨论了与作者当前综述中提到的类似概念。因此，引用它可以为作者的观点提供更多支持。
  * 总的来说，该文章写得很好，一旦解决了这些小修正，建议予以发表。

paper_title: Current state of knowledge on Wolbachia infection among Coleoptera: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. Despite great progress in studies on Wolbachia infection in insects, the knowledge about its relations with beetle species, populations and individuals, and the effects of bacteria on these hosts is still unsatisfactory. In this review we summarize the current state of knowledge about Wolbachia occurrence and interactions with Coleopteran hosts. Methods. An intensive search of the available literature resulted in the selection of 81 publications that describe the relevant details about Wolbachia presence among beetles. These publications were then examined with respect to the distribution and taxonomy of infected hosts and diversity of Wolbachia found in beetles. Sequences of Wolbachia genes (16S rDNA, wsp and ftsZ) were used for the phylogenetic analyses.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The review on Wolbachia in Coleoptera summarizes the data obtained from a thorough literature search and nicely illustrates the basic results by pie charts. As such the paper is a very nice resource for future studies. I am somewhat concerned, however, that the authors are not always sufficiently careful not to overstretch the conclusions of the original papers. To give two examples: I reread two of the heavily quoted papers, Mazur et al. 2016 and Jäckel et al. 2013, and don't agree that Mazur et al. unambigiously demonstrated that Wolbachia induced or reinforced parthenogenesis in Eusomus ovulum (l. 311 - 313) - it could also be that Wolbachia infected the beetles when they were already parthenogenetic. The Jäckel paper on the other hand talks about the possible connection between CI and selective sweeps, but does not unambigiously demonstrate that this was the case in the Altica beetles as the authors claim (l. 294-295). Especially since people tend to quote from reviews, the authors need to be extremely careful to correctly quote the results. > Thank you for highlighting these uncertain data in our review. Maybe, we have not pointed clearly that some effects were not really supported in original papers, but in suppl. table 1, which summarize all knowledge about Wolbachia in beetles, all such cases were and are mentioned as “possible” or with “?”. Now, we highlighted these uncertainties in text of the review. While the structure of the paper is mostly straight forward I feel that the introduction should be restructured. The general information on Wolbachia effects given in l. 95-l. 113 should be moved further up and substantiated with the best quotes across all insects, not just with those from the beetle literature. The aim of the study, i.e. compiling the data for beetles l. 81-94, should be the last part of the introduction. > Thank you for these helpful suggestions. We have rearranged order of paragraphs in introduction following your recommendations. Although, we left references restricted to beetles as already this paper has very long of references and we would avoid adding more. Examples on beetles are as good as these from other Wolbachia hosts. When the authors come back to the idea of splitting Wolbachia into several species (l. 440-442), they should discuss at least roughly in how far their phlylogenetic analyses agree or do not with the proposed distinctions. > We have added such discussion to our paper, however due to limitations of data collected from beetles, our discussion could not be conclusive for taxonomy of Wolbachia. The English would benefit from editing by a native speaker, e.g. l. 233 and all pie charts - replace 'share' by 'proportion' > Corrected l. 236 and 243 replace 'verified' by 'investigated' > Corrected l. 244 replace 'members' by 'of the species' > Corrected l. 256 rearrange to 'supergroups A and B' and l. 259 to 'supergroup F' > Corrected l. 270 replace 'within' by 'represented by' > Corrected and many more instances where an English correction would help. > English quality has been verified and corrected by native-speaker with experience in scientific journals proofreading (EnglishPad company). Experimental design o.k. Validity of the findings see above
paper_title_zh: 鞘翅目昆虫沃尔巴克氏体感染的现有知识状况：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。尽管在昆虫沃尔巴克氏菌感染研究方面取得了巨大进展，但关于其与甲虫种类、种群和个体的关系，以及细菌对这些宿主的影响的知识仍然不令人满意。在这篇综述中，我们总结了目前关于沃尔巴克氏菌在鞘翅目宿主中的发生及其相互作用的认知现状。方法。通过对现有文献的深入检索，选出了81篇描述沃尔巴克氏菌在甲虫中存在相关细节的出版物。这些出版物随后被审查，以了解感染宿主的分布和分类学以及甲虫中发现的沃尔巴克氏菌的多样性。沃尔巴克氏菌基因序列（16S rDNA、wsp和ftsZ）被用于系统发育分析。
review_content_zh:
审稿人3（匿名）基本报告

这篇关于鞘翅目昆虫沃尔巴克氏体的综述总结了通过彻底文献检索获得的数据，并通过饼图很好地展示了基本结果。因此，该论文是未来研究的宝贵资源。然而，我有些担心作者在得出原始论文结论时并不总是足够谨慎，以免过度解读。举两个例子：我重新阅读了两篇被大量引用的论文，Mazur等人2016年和Jäckel等人2013年的论文，我不同意Mazur等人明确证明了沃尔巴克氏体诱导或强化了Eusomus ovulum的孤雌生殖（第311-313行）——也有可能是沃尔巴克氏体在甲虫已经孤雌生殖时感染了它们。另一方面，Jäckel的论文讨论了CI与选择性清除之间可能的联系，但并没有明确证明在Altica甲虫中确实如此，正如作者所声称的（第294-295行）。特别是由于人们倾向于引用综述，作者需要极其小心地正确引用结果。

> 感谢您指出我们综述中这些不确定的数据。也许，我们并没有明确指出某些效应在原始论文中并未真正得到支持，但在补充表1中，总结了关于甲虫中沃尔巴克氏体的所有知识，所有此类情况都被提及为“可能的”或带有“？”。现在，我们在综述的文本中突出了这些不确定性。

虽然论文的结构大多直截了当，但我感觉引言部分需要重新组织。第95-113行中给出的关于沃尔巴克氏体效应的一般信息应提前，并用所有昆虫的最佳引文加以佐证，而不仅仅是甲虫文献中的引文。研究的目的是汇编甲虫的数据（第81-94行），这应该是引言的最后部分。

> 感谢这些有益的建议。我们已按照您的建议重新排列了引言中的段落顺序。尽管如此，我们仍将参考文献限制在甲虫范围内，因为这篇论文的参考文献已经非常长，我们希望避免增加更多。甲虫的例子与其他沃尔巴克氏体宿主的例子一样好。

当作者回到将沃尔巴克氏体分为几个物种的想法时（第440-442行），他们至少应该大致讨论他们的系统发育分析在多大程度上同意或不同意所提出的区分。

> 我们已在论文中添加了此类讨论，但由于从甲虫收集的数据有限，我们的讨论无法对沃尔巴克氏体的分类学得出结论。

paper_title: Automated Design of Metaheuristic Algorithms: A Survey
paper_abstract: Metaheuristics have gained great success in academia and practice because their search logic can be applied to any problem with available solution representation, solution quality evaluation, and certain notions of locality. Manually designing metaheuristic algorithms for solving a target problem is criticized for being laborious, error-prone, and requiring intensive specialized knowledge. This gives rise to increasing interest in automated design of metaheuristic algorithms. With computing power to fully explore potential design choices, the automated design could reach and even surpass human-level design and could make high-performance algorithms accessible to a much wider range of researchers and practitioners. This paper presents a broad picture of automated design of metaheuristic algorithms, by conducting a survey on the common grounds and representative techniques in terms of design space, design strategies, performance evaluation strategies, and target problems in this field.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper provides a survey of the automated design of metaheuristic algorithms (black-box optimizers). As automatically designed algorithms can reach and sometimes surpass manually designed ones, a lot of methods have been investigated so far. This paper presents the representative techniques from four aspects: design space, design strategies, performance evaluation strategies, and target problems. The contribution of this paper is to survey and provide the existing techniques for four aspects.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
[Strengths] - The broad picture for the automated design of metaheuristic algorithms is provided, which is useful for people who want to start the research on this topic. - Surveying the automated design methods in terms of four modules, including design space, design strategies, performance evaluation strategies, and target problems, is somewhat novel. [Weaknesses] - Some state-of-the-art works are missing. Please see Requested Changes. - Learning-based design strategies might be the most interesting approach in the machine learning community. However, the contents regarding them are limited (only in 7.2).

**Requested Changes:**
- Some state-of-the-art works are missing. It would be better to include the recent approaches, especially a (meta)-learning-based approach, for the automated design of black-box optimization algorithms. For example, the following papers should be considered to be included in this survey. paper_title_zh: 元启发式算法的自动化设计：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 元启发式算法在学术界和实践中取得了巨大成功，因为其搜索逻辑可以应用于任何具有可用解表示、解质量评估和一定局部性概念的问题。手动设计用于解决目标问题的元启发式算法被批评为费力、易出错且需要密集的专业知识。这引发了人们对元启发式算法自动设计的日益关注。凭借计算能力来全面探索潜在的设计选择，自动设计可以达到甚至超越人类水平的设计，并可以使高性能算法被更广泛的研究人员和从业者所使用。本文通过调查该领域的设计空间、设计策略、性能评估策略和目标问题的共同基础和代表性技术，呈现了元启发式算法自动设计的广阔图景。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对元启发式算法（黑盒优化器）的自动化设计进行了综述。由于自动设计的算法可以达到甚至超越手动设计的算法，因此迄今为止已经研究了大量方法。本文从四个方面介绍了代表性技术：设计空间、设计策略、性能评估策略和目标问题。本文的贡献在于综述并提供了这四个方面的现有技术。

**优点和缺点：**
[优点] - 提供了元启发式算法自动化设计的广泛图景，这对想要开始该领域研究的人员非常有用。 - 从设计空间、设计策略、性能评估策略和目标问题四个模块综述自动化设计方法，具有一定的创新性。
[缺点] - 缺少一些最新的研究成果。请参阅“请求的更改”。 - 在机器学习社区中，基于学习的设计策略可能是最有趣的方法。然而，相关内容有限（仅在第7.2节中提及）。
