paper_title: Mechanisms Behind the Pharmacological Application of Biochanin-A: A review
paper_abstract: This review was aimed at summarizing the cellular and molecular mechanisms behind the various pharmacological actions of biochanin-A. Many studies have been reported claiming its application in cancers, metabolic disorders, airway hyperresponsiveness, cardiac disorders, neurological disorders, etc. With regard to hormone-dependent cancers like breast, prostate, and other malignancies like pancreatic, colon, lung, osteosarcoma, glioma that has limited treatment options, biochanin-A revealed agreeable results in arresting cancer development. Biochanin-A has also shown therapeutic benefits when administered for neurological disorders, diabetes, hyperlipidaemia, and other chronic diseases/disorders. Isoflavones are considered phenomenal due to their high efficiency in modifying the physiological functions of the human body. Biochanin-A is one among the prominent isoflavones found in soy (glycine max), red clover (Trifolium pratense), and alfalfa sprouts, etc., with proven potency in modulating vital cellular mechanisms in various diseases. It has been popular for ages among menopausal women in controlling symptoms. In view of the multi-targeted functions of biochanin-A, it is essential to summarize it's mechanism of action in various disorders. The safety and efficacy of biochanin-A needs to be established in clinical trials involving human subjects. Biochanin-A might be able to modify various systems of the human body like the cardiovascular system, CNS, respiratory system, etc. It has shown a remarkable effect on hormonal cancers and other cancers. Many types of research on biochanin-A, particularly in breast, lung, colon, prostate, and pancreatic cancers, have shown a positive impact. Through modulating oxidative stress, SIRT-1 expression, PPAR gamma receptors, and other multiple mechanisms biochanin-A produces anti-diabetic action. The diverse molecular mechanistic pathways involved in the pharmacological ability of biochanin-A indicate that it is a very promising molecule and can play a major impact in modifying several physiological functions.
review_content:
The paper entitled “Mechanisms behind the pharmacological application of biochanin-A: a review by Anuranjana PV et al. gives an interesting perspective on the field. However, there are some minor comments which should be addressed before it is suitable for publication.
 1. The title of the Manuscript needs to be updated, all the first letters should have been kept in Upper case letters as Mechanisms Behind the Pharmacological Application of Biochanin-A: A review
 2. The abstract need to be reframed, you must start with your abstract by giving a brief introduction of natural products and its current role in drug discovery.
 3. The first two lines of the abstract should be kept at the end of abstract
 4. The Introduction part needs to be begin with natural products and the current drugs from natural products in the market, and then a brief introduction to isoflavones
 5. The term potency at line No. 3 in the introduction section is specific for drugs only and biochanin-A is not a drug, so replace this term.
 6. The term efficacy in the section 2.1 does not fit with this compound, so replace it with some relevant term and other places as well. This term is specific for the marketed drugs only
 7. Biochanin-A is not written properly at all places, Check the correct way of writing. i.e with or without hyphen
 8. In section 2.9 i.e Antimicrobial activity, you have mentioned only antibacterial activity only, if it is so then change the title as antibacterial activity.
 9. There is no need to write in the conclusion (Last line) biochanin-A can play a major impact in modifying several physiological functions. Remove this sentence.
10. I recommend the authors to check and update bibliography and include the most recently published papers in the field.
paper_title_zh: "生物chanin-A药理应用的机制：综述"
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述旨在总结生物chanin-A各种药理作用背后的细胞和分子机制。许多研究报道了其在癌症、代谢紊乱、气道高反应性、心脏疾病、神经系统疾病等中的应用。对于激素依赖性癌症如乳腺癌、前列腺癌以及其他恶性肿瘤如胰腺癌、结肠癌、肺癌、骨肉瘤、胶质瘤等治疗选择有限的疾病，生物chanin-A在抑制癌症发展方面显示出令人满意的结果。生物chanin-A在治疗神经系统疾病、糖尿病、高脂血症和其他慢性疾病/紊乱中也显示出治疗益处。异黄酮因其高效调节人体生理功能而被认为是非凡的。生物chanin-A是存在于大豆（Glycine max）、红三叶草（Trifolium pratense）和苜蓿芽等中的主要异黄酮之一，已被证明在调节多种疾病中的关键细胞机制方面具有显著效力。长期以来，它一直被用于控制更年期妇女的症状。鉴于生物chanin-A的多靶向功能，总结其在各种疾病中的作用机制至关重要。生物chanin-A的安全性和有效性需要在涉及人类受试者的临床试验中加以确立。生物chanin-A可能能够修饰人体的多种系统，如心血管系统、中枢神经系统、呼吸系统等。它对激素依赖性癌症和其他癌症显示出显著效果。许多关于生物chanin-A的研究，特别是在乳腺癌、肺癌、结肠癌、前列腺癌和胰腺癌中，均显示出积极影响。通过调节氧化应激、SIRT-1表达、PPARγ受体和其他多种机制，生物chanin-A产生抗糖尿病作用。生物chanin-A药理能力涉及的多样化分子机制途径表明，它是一个非常具有前景的分子，可以在修饰多种生理功能中发挥重大影响。
review_content_zh:
标题为“生物chanin-A药理应用的机制：Anuranjana PV等人的综述”的论文对该领域提供了一个有趣的视角。然而，在适合发表之前，有一些小意见需要解决。
1. 手稿的标题需要更新，所有首字母应保持大写，即“Mechanisms Behind the Pharmacological Application of Biochanin-A: A Review”。
2. 摘要需要重新组织，必须从简要介绍天然产物及其在药物发现中的当前作用开始。
3. 摘要的前两行应放在摘要的末尾。
4. 引言部分应从天然产物和市场上的天然产物药物开始，然后简要介绍异黄酮。
5. 引言部分第3行的“效力”一词仅适用于药物，而biochanin-A不是药物，因此应替换该术语。
6. 第2.1节中的“疗效”一词不适用于该化合物，因此应替换为相关术语，其他地方也应如此。该术语仅适用于已上市药物。
7. Biochanin-A在所有地方的书写不正确，检查正确的书写方式，即带或不带连字符。
8. 在第2.9节即抗菌活性中，你只提到了抗菌活性，如果是这样，则应将标题改为抗菌活性。
9. 结论部分（最后一行）无需写“biochanin-A可以在修饰多种生理功能方面发挥重大影响”。删除这句话。
10. 我建议作者检查并更新参考文献，并包括该领域最近发表的论文。

reasons: I recommend the authors to check and update bibliography and include the most recently published papers in the field.
The paper entitled “Mechanisms behind the pharmacological application of biochanin-A: a review by Anuranjana PV et al. gives an interesting perspective on the field.
In section 2.9 i.e Antimicrobial activity, you have mentioned only antibacterial activity only, if it is so then change the title as antibacterial activity.
There is no need to write in the conclusion (Last line) biochanin-A can play a major impact in modifying several physiological functions. Remove this sentence.
The abstract need to be reframed, you must start with your abstract by giving a brief introduction of natural products and its current role in drug discovery.

paper_title: Systematic review of COVID-19 vaccine acceptance and hesitancy: global perspectives and implications.
paper_abstract: The acceptance rate towards COVID-19 vaccination among the global population could be higher due to the need for more education or awareness of prevention strategies to control the COVID-19 outbreak. Thus, there is a dire need to reduce the population’s reluctance towards COVID-19 vaccination across the globe, which will ultimately lead to the implementation of prevention and control strategies against the COVID-19 virus and improving health outcomes across the globe. The following study intends to conduct a systematic review of the literature to evaluate the relationship between COVID-19 vaccination and the current trends related to COVID-19 vaccination faced by the global population. The methodology employed in this study primarily focused on assessing secondary data by conducting a systematic literature review. Internet and electronic databases were used to select research articles to obtain secondary sources. Six articles were selected from ScienceDirect and Google Scholar for a systematic literature review. The keywords used for the selection of articles were “COVID-19,” “Global trends,” Reluctance, “and “vaccination.” The selected articles that were most suitable for the topic consisted of global trends related to COVID-19 vaccination. Six articles relevant to the topic were selected and reviewed. The selected articles showed data collection results from different research journals. The findings of the six research articles depicted common themes, such as each vaccine having a different level of access attitude towards the regional existence, which primarily depends on the variability to determine the vaccine’s effectiveness. Further studies are required to evaluate the factors and strategies that help healthcare organizations and governments reduce the reluctance to use the COVID-19 vaccine among populations worldwide.
review_content:
I would like to thank the editor for providing an opportunity to review this paper. It is well written. However, the following are some of my suggestions:-

In the second paragraph of the introduction, the statement "To date, 12.13 billion vaccine doses have been administered worldwide. " is better to mention the time period instead of ‘to date’.

Check for grammatical errors.

Even though, the " Articles published before the COVID-19 pandemic were not included in the study." this statement has been mentioned, it is better to mention the from and to date of searching the articles, in the methodology.

In the PRISMA flowchart, add the reasons for excluding articles during the second screening.

The table can also have a separate column that highlights the acceptance and hesitancy towards vaccines.

I feel the conclusion can be briefed to include only the core points of the paper.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19疫苗接种接受度与犹豫的系统综述：全球视角及其启示。
paper_abstract_zh: 全球人口对COVID-19疫苗接种的接受率可能会因需要更多教育或提高对预防策略的认识以控制COVID-19疫情而提高。因此，迫切需要在全球范围内减少人口对COVID-19疫苗接种的抵触情绪，这将最终导致实施针对COVID-19病毒的预防和控制策略，并改善全球健康状况。本研究旨在对文献进行系统综述，以评估COVID-19疫苗接种与全球人口当前面临的COVID-19疫苗接种趋势之间的关系。本研究采用的方法主要侧重于通过系统文献综述评估二手数据。互联网和电子数据库被用于选择研究文章以获取二手资料。从ScienceDirect和Google Scholar中选取了六篇文章进行系统文献综述。用于选择文章的关键词包括“COVID-19”、“全球趋势”、“抵触”和“疫苗接种”。所选文章中最适合主题的包括与COVID-19疫苗接种相关的全球趋势。选取并综述了六篇与主题相关的文章。所选文章展示了来自不同研究期刊的数据收集结果。六篇研究文章的发现描绘了共同主题，例如每种疫苗在不同地区存在的接受态度水平不同，这主要取决于疫苗有效性的变异性。需要进一步研究以评估帮助卫生组织和政府减少全球人口对使用COVID-19疫苗抵触情绪的因素和策略。
review_content_zh:
感谢编辑提供机会审阅本文。文章写得很好。然而，以下是我的一些建议：

在引言的第二段中，"迄今为止，全球已接种121.3亿剂疫苗。"这一说法最好提及具体时间段，而不是用"迄今为止"。

检查语法错误。

尽管已提到"在COVID-19大流行之前发表的文章未包含在研究中。"这一说法，但在方法部分最好还是提及搜索文章的起止日期。

在PRISMA流程图中，添加第二次筛选时排除文章的原因。

表格也可以有一个单独的列，突出显示对疫苗的接受和犹豫态度。

我认为结论可以简化，只包含文章的核心要点。

reasons: Even though, the " Articles published before the COVID-19 pandemic were not included in the study." this statement has been mentioned, it is better to mention the from and to date of searching the articles, in the methodology.
In the PRISMA flowchart, add the reasons for excluding articles during the second screening.
The table can also have a separate column that highlights the acceptance and hesitancy towards vaccines.
I feel the conclusion can be briefed to include only the core points of the paper.

paper_title: Effects of exercise training and dietary supplement on fat free mass and bone mass density during weight loss – a systematic review and meta-analysis.
paper_abstract:
Background : After a diet- or surgery induced weight loss almost 1/3 of lost weight consists of fat free mass (FFM) if carried out without additional therapy. Exercise training and a sufficient supply of protein, calcium and vitamin D is recommended to reduce the loss of FFM. 
 Objective : To investigate the effect of exercise training, protein, calcium, and vitamin D supplementation on the preservation of FFM during non-surgical and surgical weight loss and of the combination of all interventions together in adults with obesity. 
 Methods : A systematic review was performed with a pairwise meta-analysis and an exploratory network meta-analysis according to the PRISMA statement. 
 Results : Thirty studies were included in the quantitative analysis. The pairwise meta-analysis showed for Exercise Training + High Protein vs. High Protein a moderate and statistically significant effect size (SMD 0.45; 95% CI 0.04 to 0.86), for Exercise Training + High Protein vs. Exercise Training a high but statistically not significant effect size (SMD 0.91; 95% CI -0.59 to 2.41) and for Exercise Training alone vs. Control a moderate but statistically not significant effect size (SMD 0.67; 95% CI -0.25 to 1.60). In the exploratory network meta-analysis three interventions showed statistically significant effect sizes compared to Control and all of them included the treatment Exercise Training. 
 Conclusions : Results underline the importance of exercise training and a sufficient protein intake to preserve FFM during weight loss in adults with obesity. The effect of calcium and vitamin D supplementation remains controversial and further research are needed.
review_content:
In this systematic review and meta-analysis, Roth et al. examined the effect of exercise training, protein, calcium, and vitamin D supplementation on the preservation of fat-free mass during non-surgical and surgical weight loss and of the combination of all interventions together in adults with obesity. This manuscript deals with an interesting topic. However, there are several points to be addressed. The language needs editing. Furthermore, the process should be thoroughly described. Generally, the paper is well written and the topic is highly relevant. Nevertheless, there are some limitations in this piece of work that could be improved.
  * The method of the search strategy is faced with limitations. First, the search query is not designed properly, so it could not find all relevant papers, especially the papers that have reported “fat free mass” and “bone mass density” as secondary outcomes. Second, some important databases such as PubMed, Scopus, and Embase have been not searched.
  * Statistical analysis: The authors stated, “To have equal scales, outcome data reported in percentages were proportionally converted into Kilograms”. So, why did the authors use the SMD? SMD is usually used when studies have reported the outcome variables using different scales and scales cannot be converted to each other.
  * Eligibility criteria: Did you include also non-randomized studies? Regarding the inclusion of non-RCTs, I highly suggest that the authors include only RCTs or perform subgroup analysis based on randomization.
  * The section of eligibility criteria lacks any description/definition of high protein. Please describe high protein thoroughly.
  * From Figure 1, I do not understand what is meant by “inadequate patient population” and “inadequate setting”. Please rephrase this to improve clarity.
  * Certainty of evidence assessment needs to be performed with the GRADE approach and findings to be included in the results section and conclusion section of the abstract.
  * Please provide information regarding the gender of participants in the table of characteristics of studies.
  * The manuscript must be also revised with regard to the English language.
paper_title_zh: 运动训练和膳食补充对减重期间瘦体重和骨密度的影响——系统综述与荟萃分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：在通过饮食或手术诱导的减重后，如果没有额外治疗，几乎有1/3的减重部分是无脂质量（FFM）。建议通过运动训练和充足的蛋白质、钙和维生素D供应来减少FFM的损失。
目的：研究运动训练、蛋白质、钙和维生素D补充对非手术和手术减重期间FFM保留的影响，以及所有干预措施联合应用对肥胖成人FFM保留的影响。
方法：根据PRISMA声明，进行了一项系统综述，包括成对meta分析和探索性网络meta分析。
结果：共有30项研究纳入定量分析。成对meta分析显示，运动训练+高蛋白与高蛋白相比，具有中等且统计学上显著的效果大小（SMD 0.45；95% CI 0.04至0.86）；运动训练+高蛋白与运动训练相比，效果大小高但统计学上不显著（SMD 0.91；95% CI -0.59至2.41）；单独运动训练与对照相比，效果大小中等但统计学上不显著（SMD 0.67；95% CI -0.25至1.60）。在探索性网络meta分析中，有三项干预措施与对照相比显示出统计学上显著的效果大小，且所有这些干预措施均包括运动训练。
结论：结果表明，运动训练和充足的蛋白质摄入对肥胖成人在减重期间保留FFM的重要性。钙和维生素D补充的效果仍存在争议，需要进一步研究。
review_content_zh:
在这篇系统综述和荟萃分析中，Roth等人研究了运动训练、蛋白质、钙和维生素D补充对非手术和手术减重期间无脂质量保存的影响，以及所有干预措施联合使用对肥胖成年人的影响。该手稿涉及一个有趣的主题。然而，有几个问题需要解决。语言需要编辑。此外，过程应详细描述。总体而言，论文写得很好，主题高度相关。尽管如此，这项工作中仍有一些局限性可以改进。
* 搜索策略的方法存在局限性。首先，搜索查询设计不当，因此可能无法找到所有相关论文，尤其是将“无脂质量”和“骨密度”作为次要结果的论文。其次，一些重要的数据库如PubMed、Scopus和Embase尚未被检索。
* 统计分析：作者指出，“为了使量表相等，以百分比报告的结果数据被按比例转换为千克”。那么，为什么作者使用标准化均数差（SMD）？SMD通常用于当研究使用不同量表报告结果变量且量表之间无法转换时。
* 纳入标准：是否也包括非随机研究？关于纳入非随机对照试验（非RCT），我强烈建议作者仅纳入RCT或基于随机化进行亚组分析。
* 纳入标准部分缺乏对高蛋白的描述/定义。请详细描述高蛋白。
* 从图1中，我不明白“患者人群不足”和“设置不足”是什么意思。请重新措辞以提高清晰度。
* 证据确定性的评估需要使用GRADE方法进行，并将结果包含在摘要的结果部分和结论部分。
* 请在研究特征表格中提供有关参与者性别信息。
* 手稿还必须针对英语语言进行修订。

reasons: The method of the search strategy is faced with limitations.
First, the search query is not designed properly, so it could not find all relevant papers, especially the papers that have reported “fat free mass” and “bone mass density” as secondary outcomes.
Second, some important databases such as PubMed, Scopus, and Embase have been not searched.
This manuscript deals with an interesting topic.
So, why did the authors use the SMD? SMD is usually used when studies have reported the outcome variables using different scales and scales cannot be converted to each other.
Did you include also non-randomized studies? Regarding the inclusion of non-RCTs, I highly suggest that the authors include only RCTs or perform subgroup analysis based on randomization.
The language needs editing.
From Figure 1, I do not understand what is meant by “inadequate patient population” and “inadequate setting”.
Please rephrase this to improve clarity.
The manuscript must be also revised with regard to the English language.
Generally, the paper is well written and the topic is highly relevant.
Furthermore, the process should be thoroughly described.
Eligibility criteria: Did you include also non-randomized studies?
Regarding the inclusion of non-RCTs, I highly suggest that the authors include only RCTs or perform subgroup analysis based on randomization.
The section of eligibility criteria lacks any description/definition of high protein.
Certainty of evidence assessment needs to be performed with the GRADE approach and findings to be included in the results section and conclusion section of the abstract.
Please provide information regarding the gender of participants in the table of characteristics of studies.

paper_title: Tourette Syndrome research highlights 2014
paper_abstract: About 200 journal articles reported research on Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders in 2014. Here we briefly summarize a few of the reports that seemed most important or interesting, ranging from animal models to human studies. Readers can comment on our choices or provide their own favorites using the tools on the online article.
review_content:
I enjoyed reading this useful and well written contribution.

I have a few comments:
 1. In the subsection of Results entitled “Other animal models”, the reader might benefit from a brief explanation of the model presented by McCairn et al: did this use a GABA antagonist like bicuculline?
 2. In the subsection entitled “A look inside: neuroimaging studies”, I personally found interesting a paper which is not cited and evaluates the potential of deep repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (deep rTMS) to the supplementary motor area (Bloch et al.,2014)
 3. In respect to neurobiofeedback, as commented on in page 4, another useful paper on ADHD and tic disorders is Gevensleben et al. (2009). Moreover, a 2015 citation focusing on neurofeedback is this useful review: Farkas et al. (2015).
 4. My main criticism is that there is no citation at all about deep brain stimulation, which is an area currently avidly investigated in Tourette syndrome. It is possible that the authors felt that none of the articles published in 2014 on DBS in Tourette syndrome is sufficiently interesting, but I would at least discuss this in the article and add the following citation in Box 2: Schrock et al., (2015).
 5. Additional 2014 publications of interest:

    Chao TK, Hu J and Pringsheim T: Prenatal risk factors for Tourette syndrome: a systematic review. BMC Pregnancy and Childbirth. 2014; 14(53).

    Gilbert DL, Budman CL, Singer HS, et al:, A D1 receptor antagonist, ecopipam, for treatment in Tourette syndrome. Clin Neuropharmacol. 2014; 37(1): 26-30.

    Wijemanne S, Wu LJ and Jankovic J: Long-term efficacy and safety of fluphenazine in patients with Tourette syndrome. Mov Disord. 2014; 29(1):126-130.
paper_title_zh: 2014年图雷特综合征研究亮点
paper_abstract_zh: 2014年，约有200篇期刊文章报道了关于图雷特综合症和其他抽动障碍的研究。在此，我们简要总结了几篇看似最重要或最有趣的报告，内容涵盖从动物模型到人类研究的各个方面。读者可以通过在线文章的工具对我们的选择进行评论或提供他们自己的偏好。
review_content_zh:
我享受阅读这篇实用且文笔出色的贡献。

我有几点评论：
1. 在“结果”部分的子节“其他动物模型”中，读者可能会从对McCairn等人提出的模型的简要解释中受益：这个模型是否使用了像比库林（bicuculline）这样的GABA拮抗剂？
2. 在“内部观察：神经影像学研究”这一子节中，我个人发现一篇未引用的论文很有趣，该论文评估了深度重复经颅磁刺激（deep rTMS）对辅助运动区的潜力（Bloch等人，2014年）。
3. 关于神经生物反馈，如第4页所述，另一篇关于注意力缺陷多动障碍和抽动障碍的有用论文是Gevensleben等人（2009年）。此外，一篇2015年专注于神经反馈的有用综述是Farkas等人（2015年）。
4. 我的主要批评是，文章中完全没有引用关于深脑刺激的内容，而这是目前在图雷特综合征中积极研究的领域。作者可能认为2014年发表的关于图雷特综合征中DBS的文章都不够有趣，但至少应在文章中讨论这一点，并在框2中添加以下引用：Schrock等人（2015年）。
5. 其他2014年值得关注的相关出版物：

    Chao TK, Hu J和Pringsheim T：图雷特综合征的产前风险因素：系统综述。BMC Pregnancy and Childbirth. 2014; 14(53)。

    Gilbert DL, Budman CL, Singer HS等人：D1受体拮抗剂，ecopipam，用于图雷特综合征的治疗。Clin Neuropharmacol. 2014; 37(1): 26-30。

    Wijemanne S, Wu LJ和Jankovic J：氟奋乃静在图雷特综合征患者中的长期疗效和安全性。Mov Disord. 2014; 29(1):126-130。

reasons: Additional 2014 publications of interest:
I enjoyed reading this useful and well written contribution.

paper_title: Voltage-gated sodium channel as a target for metastatic risk reduction with re-purposed drugs
paper_abstract: Objective: To determine the exact role of sodium channel proteins in migration, invasion and metastasis and understand the possible anti-invasion and anti-metastatic activity of repurposed drugs with voltage gated sodium channel blocking properties. Material and methods: A review of the published medical literature was performed searching for pharmaceuticals used in daily practice, with inhibitory activity on voltage gated sodium channels. For every drug found, the literature was reviewed in order to define if it may act against cancer cells as an anti-invasion and anti-metastatic agent and if it was tested with this purpose in the experimental and clinical settings. Results: The following pharmaceuticals that fulfill the above mentioned effects, were found: phenytoin, carbamazepine, valproate, lamotrigine, ranolazine, resveratrol, ropivacaine, lidocaine, mexiletine, flunarizine, and riluzole. Each of them are independently described and analyzed. Conclusions: The above mentioned pharmaceuticals have shown anti-metastatic and anti-invasion activity and many of them deserve to be tested in well-planned clinical trials as adjunct therapies for solid tumors and as anti-metastatic agents. Antiepileptic drugs like phenytoin, carbamazepine and valproate and the vasodilator flunarizine emerged as particularly useful for anti-metastatic purposes.
review_content:
This article focuses attention on sodium channels as potential therapeutic targets for metastatic disease. Much work needs to be done to determine whether agents that act on sodium channels will blunt metastatic activity in a clinically meaningful manner, but a spectrum of sodium channel blockers with only minimal side-effects are already used clinically. This novel approach thus merits careful study.

While at first glance it may seem surprising that voltage-gated sodium channels are proposed as molecular targets within (presumably) non-excitable cells, there are many precedents for a role of these channels in controlling effector actions in multiple types of cells that have traditionally been considered non-excitable1. One example is provided by astrocytes, which express multiple types of sodium channels that are functional within the cell membrane2. These astrocytic sodium channels provide a return pathway for Na ions that facilitates operation of the Na-K/ATPase in these cells3. Notably, expression of sodium channels within astrocytes is highly dynamic, a phenomenon that is strikingly seen in scarring astrocytes in disorders such as multiple sclerosis (MS) and its models where expression of Nav1.5 is up-regulated 4. Recent evidence indicates that these glial sodium channels participate in the astrocytic response to injury, via a cascade that involves Na influx that activates reverse (Ca-importing) Na/Ca exchange5. Given the large number of traditionally non-excitable cell-types (including microglia, macrophages, and multiple other cell-types) where expression of voltage-gated sodium channels and a functional role for these channels has been documented (reviewed in Black and Waxman, 20131), sodium channels may emerge as therapeutic targets in multiple disorders.
paper_title_zh: 电压门控钠通道作为降低转移风险的药物再利用靶点
paper_abstract_zh:
**目的**：确定钠通道蛋白在迁移、侵袭和转移中的确切作用，并了解具有电压门控钠通道阻断特性的药物再利用的抗侵袭和抗转移活性。

**材料与方法**：对已发表的医学文献进行回顾，寻找日常实践中使用的、对电压门控钠通道具有抑制活性的药物。对于找到的每种药物，回顾文献以确定其是否可作为抗侵袭和抗转移剂对抗癌细胞，以及是否在实验和临床环境中进行了相关测试。

**结果**：发现了以下符合上述效应的药物：苯妥英、卡马西平、丙戊酸、拉莫三嗪、雷诺嗪、白藜芦醇、罗哌卡因、利多卡因、美西律、氟桂利嗪和利鲁唑。每种药物均独立描述和分析。

**结论**：上述药物显示出抗转移和抗侵袭活性，其中许多药物值得在精心设计的临床试验中作为实体瘤的辅助治疗和抗转移剂进行测试。抗癫痫药物如苯妥英、卡马西平和丙戊酸以及血管扩张剂氟桂利嗪在抗转移方面尤为有用。
review_content_zh:
本文将注意力集中在钠通道作为转移性疾病潜在治疗靶点的研究上。尽管需要大量工作来确定作用于钠通道的药物是否能在临床上显著抑制转移活性，但已有多种副作用极小的钠通道阻滞剂在临床中使用。因此，这一新颖方法值得仔细研究。

虽然乍一看，电压门控钠通道被提议作为（假定）非兴奋性细胞内的分子靶点似乎令人惊讶，但已有许多先例表明这些通道在控制传统上被认为是非兴奋性的多种类型细胞的效应器作用中发挥作用1。一个例子是星形胶质细胞，它们表达多种类型的钠通道，这些通道在细胞膜内具有功能性2。这些星形胶质细胞钠通道为Na离子提供了返回途径，促进了这些细胞中Na-K/ATPase的运作3。值得注意的是，星形胶质细胞内钠通道的表达高度动态，这一现象在多发性硬化症（MS）及其模型中的瘢痕形成星形胶质细胞中尤为明显，其中Nav1.5的表达上调4。最近的研究表明，这些胶质细胞钠通道通过涉及Na内流激活反向（Ca导入）Na/Ca交换的级联反应，参与星形胶质细胞对损伤的反应5。鉴于在大量传统非兴奋性细胞类型（包括小胶质细胞、巨噬细胞和多种其他细胞类型）中，电压门控钠通道的表达及其功能性作用已有文献记载（见Black和Waxman, 20131的综述），钠通道可能成为多种疾病的治疗靶点。

paper_title: Heavy Metal Contamination: Sources, Health Impacts, and Sustainable Mitigation Strategies with Insights from Nigerian Case Studies
paper_abstract: Heavy metal contamination has gradually become a highly significant global issue due to its continual existence in the environment and bioaccumulation in the ecosystems, posing deleterious risks to human health. This review aims to investigate the sources, pathways, and toxicological impacts of heavy metals such as cadmium, lead, mercury, and arsenic, elucidating their health consequences and plausible mitigation strategies. Furthermore, the review explores the dual origins of heavy metal contamination; natural geological processes and anthropogenic activities such as industrial emissions, mining, and agricultural practices. These heavy metals seep into soil, water, and food chains, leading to bioaccumulation, bio-magnification and causing significant health risks, including cardiovascular diseases, neurological disorders, and reproductive toxicity. Additionally, the addition of indigenous case studies from Nigeria, such as lead poisoning in Zamfara State and contamination in the Great Kwa River of Cross Rivers State underscores the disproportionate impact of heavy metal pollution in developing nations. These case studies reveal the socio-economic and environmental dimensions of the issue, providing a contextual understanding of region-specific vulnerabilities and health outcomes. To address these problems, the review evaluates already existing mitigation strategies, including chelation therapy and phytoremediation, while proposing sustainable, cost-effective solutions for reducing exposure and mitigating impacts. It emphasizes the importance of integrative approaches involving policy, community engagement, and technological innovations to fight heavy metal contamination effectively. In conclusion, this seminar contributes to the understanding of heavy metal toxicity, giving and showcasing very much important insights into the sources and health implications of contamination. By integrating theoretical perspectives with practical solutions, this review provides a robust framework for informing policy makers and advancing sustainable environmental management practices.

paper_title_zh: 重金属污染：来源、健康影响及基于尼日利亚案例研究的可持续缓解策略
paper_abstract_zh: 重金属污染由于其持续存在于环境中并在生态系统中生物累积，已逐渐成为一个高度重要的全球性问题，对人类健康构成有害风险。本综述旨在调查镉、铅、汞和砷等重金属的来源、途径和毒理学影响，阐明其健康后果和可能的缓解策略。此外，综述探讨了重金属污染的双重起源：自然地质过程和人为活动，如工业排放、采矿和农业实践。这些重金属渗入土壤、水和食物链，导致生物累积和生物放大，造成显著的健康风险，包括心血管疾病、神经系统疾病和生殖毒性。此外，通过纳入尼日利亚的本土案例研究，如赞法拉州的铅中毒和十字河州大克瓦河的污染，强调了重金属污染在发展中国家不成比例的影响。这些案例研究揭示了问题的社会经济和环境维度，为理解区域特定脆弱性和健康结果提供了背景。为解决这些问题，综述评估了现有的缓解策略，包括螯合疗法和植物修复，同时提出了可持续、成本效益高的解决方案以减少暴露和减轻影响。它强调了综合方法的重要性，涉及政策、社区参与和技术创新，以有效应对重金属污染。总之，本次研讨会有助于理解重金属毒性，提供了关于污染来源和健康影响的极为重要的见解。通过将理论视角与实践解决方案相结合，本综述为政策制定者提供了强有力的框架，并推进了可持续环境管理实践。

paper_title: The nectar report: Quantitative review of nectar sugar concentrations offered by bee visited flowers in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes
paper_abstract: There is growing concern that some bee populations are in decline, potentially threatening pollination security in agricultural and non-agricultural landscapes. Among the numerous causes associated with this trend, nutritional stress resulting from a mismatch between bee nutritional needs and plant community provisioning has been suggested as one potential driver. To ease nutritional stress on bee populations in agricultural habitats, agrienvironmental protection schemes aim to provide alternative nutritional resources for bee populations during times of need. However, such efforts have focused mainly on quantity (providing flowering plants) and timing (during flower-scarce periods), while largely ignoring the quality of the offered flower resources. In a first step to start addressing this information gap, we have used literature data to compile a comprehensive geographically explicit dataset on nectar quality (i.e. total sugar concentration), offered to bees both within fields (crop and weed species) as well as outside fields (wild species) around the globe. Social bees are particularly sensitive to nectar sugar concentrations, which directly impact calorie influx into the colony and consequently their fitness making it an important resource quality marker. We find that the total nectar sugar concentrations in general do not differ between the three plant communities studied. In contrast we find increased variability in nectar quality in the wild plant community compared to crop and weed community, which is likely explained by the increased phylogenetic diversity in this category of plants. In a second step we explore the influence of local habitat on nectar

paper_abstract_zh: 日益增长的担忧表明，一些蜜蜂种群正在衰退，这可能威胁到农业和非农业景观中的授粉安全。在与此趋势相关的众多原因中，蜜蜂营养需求与植物群落供给之间的不匹配所导致的营养压力，被认为是潜在的驱动因素之一。为了缓解农业栖息地中蜜蜂种群的这种营养压力，农业环境保护计划旨在在蜜蜂需要时为其提供替代性营养资源。然而，此类努力主要集中在数量（提供开花植物）和时机（在花稀少的时期）上，而很大程度上忽视了所提供花资源质量。为了开始填补这一信息空白，我们首先利用文献数据编制了一个关于全球范围内田间（作物和杂草种类）以及田间外（野生种类）提供给蜜蜂的花蜜质量（即总糖浓度）的全面且地理明确的数据库。社会性蜜蜂对花蜜糖浓度特别敏感，这直接影响热量流入蜂群，进而影响其适应性，使其成为重要的资源质量标志。我们发现，所研究的三个植物群落之间的花蜜总糖浓度总体上没有差异。相反，我们发现与作物和杂草群落相比，野生植物群落中的花蜜质量变异性增加，这很可能是由该类植物系统发育多样性的增加所解释的。在第二步中，我们探讨了当地栖息地对花蜜的影响。

paper_title: Enter the Matrix: Fibroblast-immune cell interactions shape extracellular matrix deposition in health and disease.
paper_abstract: Fibroblasts, non-hematopoietic cells of mesenchymal origin, are tissue architects which regulate the topography of tissues, dictate tissue resident cell types, and drive fibrotic disease. Fibroblasts regulate the composition of the extracellular matrix (ECM), a 3-dimensional network of macromolecules that comprise the acellular milieu of tissues. Fibroblasts can directly and indirectly regulate immune responses by secreting ECM and ECM-bound molecules to shape tissue structure and influence organ function. In this review, we will highlight recent studies which elucidate the mechanisms by which fibroblast-derived ECM factors (e.g., collagens, fibrillar proteins) regulate ECM architecture and subsequent immune responses, with a focus on macrophages. As examples of fibroblast-derived ECM proteins, we examine Collagen Triple Helix Repeat Containing 1 (CTHRC1) and Transforming Growth Factor-β-inducible protein (TGFBI), also known as BIGH3. We address the need for investigation into how diverse fibroblast populations coordinate immune responses by modulating ECM, including the fibroblast-ECM-immune axis and the precise molecular mediators and pathways which regulate these processes. Finally, we will outline how novel research identifying key regulators of ECM deposition is critical for therapeutic development for fibrotic diseases and cancer.
review_content:
In this review article, the authors describe the functions of fibroblasts in the context of ECM remodeling and their interaction with macrophages, and make the claim that CTHRC1 and TGFBI are important modulators of this axis. Overall, the manuscript is well-written. However, the manuscript is uneven in how it presents information. As I outline below, some sections of the manuscript are overly superficial in their discussion of important concepts and rely on citing review articles rather than primary research papers. Meanwhile, some of the other sections of the manuscript simply list findings from primary research studies without providing a proper context for the reader to understand the findings. The two main themes of fibroblast-macrophage interactions and CTHRC1/TGFBI functions read like two separate narratives, and the connection between the two needs to made much more clear by the authors.

The following are a few suggestions to improve the manuscript:
1. The title should be changed to reflect the rather narrow focus on either fibroblast-macrophage interactions and/or the roles of CTHRC1 and TGFBI.
2. In general, the manuscript cites too many other reviews, especially when referring to specific facts/findings that should really be citing the original research papers that originated these findings.
3. Intro, paragraphs 2-4, and section on "fibroblast heterogeneity dictates ECM deposition": the discussion about fibroblasts' heterogeneity and their myriad functions during wound repair and fibrosis is overly simplistic, as is the depiction in Figure 2. In addition to the discussed ref. 34, there are several other recent primary research papers that should be cited and discussed here that directly address fibroblast heterogeneity and its effects on ECM composition during wound repair; see for example references Guerrero-Juarez CF et.al., 2019 (Ref 1), Gay Det.al., 2020 (Ref 2), Foster DSet.al.,2021 (Ref 3), Wietecha MS et.al., 2023 (Ref 4), Phan QM et.al., 2021 (Ref 5), Hu KH et.al., 2023 (Ref 6) below. Many of these papers also mention fibroblast-macrophage interactions and list CTHRC1 and TGFBI as genes of interest, but this requires a deeper dive that may better set the stage for the more focused discussion about TGF-beta signaling, CTHRC1 and BIGH3.
4. The sections on CTHRC1 and BIGH3 are a list of facts about their function in fibroblasts in various model systems and have very little to do with macrophages or fibroblast-macrophage interactions dictating ECM composition in disease states. Besides a couple sentences stating that both CTHRC1 and BIGH3 may also be produced by macrophages, how does this fit within the larger narrative the authors have established thus far? Are macrophages even the primary producers of these cofactors in disease states, or are fibroblasts? Indeed, the "proposed model for cofactor-mediated ECM deposition in fibroblasts" (Fig 4) does not show macrophages as producers of CTHRC1/BIGH3.
5. The statement "This gene is also a paralog of periostin (POSTN)" lacks context and explanation.
paper_title_zh: 进入矩阵：成纤维细胞-免疫细胞相互作用塑造健康与疾病中的细胞外基质沉积
paper_abstract_zh: 成纤维细胞是起源于间充质的非造血细胞，作为组织架构师，它们调控组织的地形结构，决定组织驻留细胞类型，并驱动纤维化疾病的发生。成纤维细胞调控细胞外基质（ECM）的组成，ECM是由大分子构成的三维网络，形成了组织的非细胞环境。成纤维细胞通过分泌ECM和ECM结合分子，直接和间接地调控免疫反应，塑造组织结构并影响器官功能。在这篇综述中，我们将重点介绍近期研究，阐明成纤维细胞来源的ECM因子（如胶原蛋白、纤维蛋白）如何调控ECM架构及后续免疫反应的机制，重点关注巨噬细胞。作为成纤维细胞来源的ECM蛋白的例子，我们探讨了含有三螺旋重复序列的胶原蛋白1（CTHRC1）和转化生长因子-β诱导蛋白（TGFBI），也称为BIGH3。我们提出了对多种成纤维细胞群体如何通过调节ECM协调免疫反应进行研究的必要性，包括成纤维细胞-ECM-免疫轴以及精确调控这些过程的分子介质和通路。最后，我们将概述识别ECM沉积关键调节因子的新研究对于纤维化疾病和癌症治疗开发的重要性。
review_content_zh:
在这篇综述文章中，作者描述了成纤维细胞在细胞外基质（ECM）重塑中的功能及其与巨噬细胞的相互作用，并声称CTHRC1和TGFBI是该轴的重要调节因子。总体而言，手稿写得很好。然而，手稿在信息呈现上存在不均衡的问题。正如我在下面所概述的，手稿中某些部分在讨论重要概念时过于肤浅，依赖于引用综述文章而非原始研究论文。同时，手稿的其他部分只是简单地列举了来自原始研究的结果，而没有为读者提供理解这些发现的适当背景。成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞相互作用和CTHRC1/TGFBI功能这两个主要主题读起来像是两个独立的叙述，作者需要更清晰地阐明两者之间的联系。

以下是改进手稿的一些建议：
1. 标题应更改，以反映对成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞相互作用和/或CTHRC1和TGFBI作用的相对狭窄的关注。

4. 关于CTHRC1和BIGH3的部分列举了它们在各种模型系统中成纤维细胞功能的事实，与巨噬细胞或成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞相互作用决定疾病状态下ECM组成的关系非常小。除了几句话提到CTHRC1和BIGH3也可能由巨噬细胞产生外，这与作者迄今为止建立的大叙述如何契合？在疾病状态下，巨噬细胞是否是这些辅因子的主要生产者，还是成纤维细胞？实际上，“成纤维细胞中辅因子介导的ECM沉积的假设模型”（图4）并未显示巨噬细胞作为CTHRC1/BIGH3的生产者。
5. “该基因也是骨膜蛋白（POSTN）的旁系同源物”这一陈述缺乏背景和解释。

paper_title: Life of Pi: Exploring functions of Pi16+ fibroblasts
paper_abstract: Fibroblasts are mesenchymal cells that are responsible for creating and maintaining tissue architecture through the production of extracellular matrix. These cells also play critical roles in processes such as wound repair and immune modulation in normal tissues and various disease states including fibrosis, autoimmunity, and cancer. Fibroblasts have a complex repertoire of functions that vary by organ, inflammatory state, and the developmental stage of an organism. How fibroblasts manage so many functions in such a context-dependent manner represents a gap in our understanding of these cells. One possibility is that a tissue-resident precursor cell state exists that provides the fibroblast lineage with flexibility during growth, inflammation, or other contexts that require dynamic tissue changes. Recent work has suggested that a precursor fibroblast cell state is marked by expression of Peptidase inhibitor 16 ( Pi16 ). This review aims to concatenate and compare studies on fibroblasts that express Pi16 to clarify the roles of this cell state in fibroblast lineage development and other functions.
review_content:
Buechler and colleagues have prepared a comprehensive review of the many tissue settings and experimental models in which Pi16+ cells (or their transcriptionally similar counterparts) are demonstrated to respond to biological perturbation. There are minor comments that would be recommended to increase the clarity between lineage and non-lineage functions of Pi16+ fibroblasts.

In section 2., the authors describe experiments in which Pi16+ fibroblasts or their counterparts have been shown to serve as progenitors for more specialized fibroblastic cell types in vitro or using lineage-tracing models. Collectively the cited literature discusses the role for Pi16+ fibroblasts to give rise to adipocytes or to ECM-producing or contractile fibroblasts (in epicardial fibrosis or as myofibroblastic cancer associated fibroblasts in tumors). However, some of the studies quoted in the non-lineage functions of Pi16+ fibroblasts section appear to reflect a progenitor phenotype of Pi16+ or Pi16+-like cells. This includes the cited work by Rinkevich and colleagues, as well as pro-fibrotic function of fate-mapped 'mural chaser' cells in the adipose tissue. If one assumes that fibroblasts that give rise to CAFs with an ECM-enriched gene signature represent a progenitor-progeny relationship, is this not also the case for fibroblasts that differentiate to produce ECM and cover a scar in a tissue injury model?

What appears to stand out are Pi16+ cells in lymphoid organs. Unlike the perivascular progenitors that receive Lymphotoxin signals to differentiate into fibroblastic reticular cells (Cheng HW et al., 2019 Nat. Comm. (Ref 1 )and Prados A. et al., 2022, Nat. Imm (Ref 2)), Pi16+ reticular cells do not appear to be FRC progenitors (Pezoldt et al. 2018 Nat. Comm) [Ref4]. Nevertheless, these cells are expanded in inflammation, and encode a stemness gene signature, as shown in chronically-inflamed tonsils (De Martin et al., 2023 Nat. Immunol. (Ref 3)). Perhaps, it is the case that they are either more inflammatory, as the authors have discussed, or respond according to the nature of the tissue injury.

Considering the above mentioned points, the authors may consider to reorganize these sections, and order the sections reflecting the graphical representation in Figure 1.

Figure 1 may be clarified. Fibroblasts activated by inflammation or injury may be those that recruit or activate immune cells (as in lymphoid organs) or exhibit an ECM-depositing phenotype (wounding or CAFs), respectively.

Minor comments:

Figure 1: It would be helpful to cite the relevant references related to the 4 feature of Pi16+ function.

The authors may consider discussing mural cells as fibroblasts. At present there is a discrepancy between non-fibroblastic mural cells – relating to reference 20 and adipocyte progenitors and Pi16+ fibroblasts derived from Pdgfrb+ mural cells – relating to reference 29. Are vascular smooth muscle cells and pericytes fundamentally not a fibroblastic cell type? After all, adipocytes are included as specialized fibroblasts.

Reference 16 is mis-cited.

In reference 27 – it is not clear which CD34+ exhibits the Pi16+ phenotype

It is likely that the reticulated interstitium, like the fascia, is highly vascularized. Thus, although not mural cells, Pi16+ cells in these tissues may also be considered in proximity to the vasculature.

Small grammatical typos:

Section 1, Paragraph 1 of the introduction: 'fibroblasts that arise during inflammation are seeded from local, in situ local precursors …'

Section 1, Paragraph 4: 'Pi16+ fibroblasts have been identified near the vasculature in numerous tissues...'
paper_title_zh: 《生命之π：探索Pi16+成纤维细胞的功能》
paper_abstract_zh: 成纤维细胞是间充质细胞，负责通过产生细胞外基质来创建和维护组织结构。这些细胞在正常组织和各种疾病状态（包括纤维化、自身免疫和癌症）中的伤口修复和免疫调节等过程中也发挥着关键作用。成纤维细胞具有复杂的功能谱，这些功能因器官、炎症状态和生物体的发育阶段而异。成纤维细胞如何在如此依赖上下文的模式下管理如此多功能，代表了我们对其理解的空白。一种可能性是存在一种组织驻留的前体细胞状态，该状态为成纤维细胞谱系在生长、炎症或其他需要动态组织变化的情境中提供了灵活性。近期研究表明，前体成纤维细胞状态的特征是表达肽酶抑制剂16（Pi16）。本综述旨在整合和比较表达Pi16的成纤维细胞的研究，以阐明这一细胞状态在成纤维细胞谱系发育和其他功能中的作用。
review_content_zh:

在第2节中，作者描述了实验，其中Pi16+成纤维细胞或其对应细胞被证明可以作为更专业化成纤维细胞类型的祖细胞，在体外或使用谱系追踪模型中。总体而言，引用的文献讨论了Pi16+成纤维细胞分化为脂肪细胞或产生细胞外基质（ECM）的成纤维细胞或收缩性成纤维细胞（在心外膜纤维化中或作为肿瘤中肌成纤维细胞相关的成纤维细胞）的角色。然而，在Pi16+成纤维细胞非谱系功能部分引用的一些研究似乎反映了Pi16+或Pi16+样细胞的祖细胞表型。这包括Rinkevich及其同事引用的工作，以及脂肪组织中命运映射的“ mural chaser”细胞的促纤维化功能。如果假设产生具有ECM富集基因特征的CAF的成纤维细胞代表祖细胞-后代关系，那么在组织损伤模型中分化产生ECM并覆盖疤痕的成纤维细胞是否也是如此？

尤为突出的是淋巴器官中的Pi16+细胞。与接受淋巴毒素信号分化为成纤维网状细胞的血管周围祖细胞不同（Cheng HW等人，2019 Nat. Comm.（参考文献1）和Prados A.等人，2022，Nat. Imm（参考文献2）），Pi16+网状细胞似乎不是FRC祖细胞（Pezoldt等人，2018 Nat. Comm）[参考文献4]。尽管如此，这些细胞在炎症中扩张，并编码干细胞基因特征，如慢性炎症扁桃体所示（De Martin等人，2023 Nat. Immunol.（参考文献3））。或许，正如作者所讨论的，它们要么更具炎症性，要么根据组织损伤的性质作出反应。

考虑到上述观点，作者可以考虑重新组织这些部分，并按照图1中的图形表示顺序排列各部分。

图1可能需要澄清。由炎症或损伤激活的成纤维细胞可能是那些招募或激活免疫细胞的细胞（如在淋巴器官中），或分别表现出ECM沉积表型（伤口或CAF）。

图1：引用与Pi16+功能4个特征相关的参考文献将有所帮助。

作者可以考虑将 mural 细胞作为成纤维细胞进行讨论。目前，非成纤维细胞的 mural 细胞（与参考文献20相关）和脂肪祖细胞与来自Pdgfrb+ mural细胞的Pi16+成纤维细胞（与参考文献29相关）之间存在差异。毕竟，血管平滑肌细胞和周细胞基本上不是成纤维细胞类型吗？毕竟，脂肪细胞被包括在专业化成纤维细胞中。

paper_title: Growth regulators promote soybean productivity: a review
paper_abstract: Soybean [Glycine max (L.) Merrill] is a predominant edible plant and a major supply of plant protein worldwide. Global demand for soybean keeps increasing as its seeds provide essential proteins, oil, and nutraceuticals. In a quest to meet heightened demands for soybean, it has become essential to introduce agro-technical methods that promote adaptability to complex environments, improve soybean resistance to abiotic stress, and increase productivity. Plant growth regulators are mainly exploited to achieve this due to their crucial roles in plant growth and development. Increasing research suggests the influence of plant growth regulators on soybean growth and development, yield, quality, and abiotic stress responses. In an attempt to expatiate on the topic, current knowledge, and possible applications of plant growth regulators that improve growth and yield have been reviewed and discussed. Notably, the application of plant growth regulators in their appropriate concentrations at suitable growth periods relieves abiotic stress which increases the yield and yield components of soybean. Moreover, the regulation effects of the different growth regulators on the morphology, physiology, and yield quality of soybean are discoursed in detail.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Prasad Parchuri) Basic reporting The manuscript submitted by Dede et al., is an interesting article. In this regard, the authors present an updated vision regarding the different investigations that demonstrate the effect of growth regulators on Soybean productivity. I believe that the manuscript will be of interest to researchers in the field. Experimental design Although, the manuscript is reasonably well written and has an adequate structure, the content in some sections looks superficial and lacks the critical insights that would make it a useful addition to the field. Validity of the findings No comment Comments for the Author Major comments: 1. Section 2.0, describes the role of major growth regulators on plant growth and development. The section is lengthy and just lists the general functions of plant growth regulators and whether they add anything to the article needs to be considered carefully. This section needs to be shortened substantially by highlighting the role of plant growth regulators in improving the Soybean productivity. Further, authors should include information about the synthetic or chemical growth regulators, which also play a major role in Soybean growth.
paper_title_zh: 生长调节剂促进大豆生产力：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 大豆[Glycine max (L.) Merrill]是一种主要的食用植物，也是全球植物蛋白的主要来源。随着大豆种子提供必需蛋白质、油脂和营养保健品，全球对大豆的需求持续增加。为了满足对大豆日益增长的需求，引入促进适应复杂环境、提高大豆对非生物胁迫的抗性以及增加产量的农业技术方法变得至关重要。植物生长调节剂因其对植物生长和发育的关键作用而被主要利用。越来越多的研究表明，植物生长调节剂对大豆的生长发育、产量、品质和非生物胁迫反应有影响。为了详细阐述这一主题，本文综述和讨论了当前关于植物生长调节剂的知识及其在提高生长和产量方面的可能应用。值得注意的是，在适宜的生长时期以适当浓度应用植物生长调节剂可以缓解非生物胁迫，从而增加大豆的产量和产量构成因素。此外，本文还详细讨论了不同生长调节剂对大豆形态、生理和产量品质的调节效应。

paper_title: Prior and Posterior Networks: A Survey on Evidential Deep Learning Methods For Uncertainty Estimation
paper_abstract: Popular approaches for quantifying predictive uncertainty in deep neural networks often involve multiple sets of weights or models, for instance, via ensembling or Monte Carlo dropout. These techniques usually incur overhead by having to train multiple model instances or do not produce very diverse predictions. This survey aims to familiarize the reader with an alternative class of models based on the concept of Evidential Deep Learning: For unfamiliar data, they admit “what they don’t know” and fall back onto a prior belief. Furthermore, they allow uncertainty estimation in a single model and forward pass by parameterizing distributions over distributions. This survey recapitulates existing works, focusing on the implementation in a classification setting, before surveying the application of the same paradigm to regression. We also reflect on the strengths and weaknesses compared to each other as well as to more established methods and provide the most central theoretical results using a unified notation in order to aid future research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey paper looks at Evidential Deep Learning methods, mentioning and relating many different papers, as summarised in Figure 1 and Tables 1, 2 and 3. This includes methods for classification and regression, as well as prior-based and posterior-based methods.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths 1. The paper covers many different papers / methods. 2. Sections 1, 2, 3.1 and 3.2 are well-written, and easy to follow. I also thought the Discussion brought up some nice points. Weaknesses 1. I found the explanations of the methods very brief and terse in Sections 3.3, 3.4 and 4. There was typically a couple of sentences assigned to each paper, and I was not able to follow how each method was different. This starts at the top of page 7. It seems like the authors assume that the reader is familiar with the papers, and this is just a brief summary of the methods like what would be in a space-pressured 'Related Works' section in a paper. As someone who does not know most of the recent works discussed in this survey paper, I was unable to follow most of the explanations. 2. The authors claim they compare Evidential Deep Learning approaches to established methods (as said at the top of page 2). Where was this done? Was this Section 5, and if so, I did not find this to be much of a discussion (it is just a few quick sentences on other approaches without much insight). 3. The authors say they provide the "most central theoretical results using a unified notation" (Abstract). This was not clear to me in the main paper at all. Most methods are mentioned but I am unsure what the most central results are and where in the paper they are. Most of the equations appear in the background section, and I believe most surveyed papers would already describe Dirichlet distributions. 4. The discussion on Model uncertainty in Section 3.2 was a bit weird to me. The authors previously argued that we lost epistemic uncertainty by using a single estimate of neural network weights, but now say that the uncertainty is still available. I think the authors should change some of the writing around Equation 4 so this does not seem so out-of-place / contradictory. 5. Figure 2 is not explained in much detail. I was often confused as to how each of the subplots in Figure 2 represents what the authors say it represents, and nowhere is this explained to the reader (instead, the authors just assume knowledge of eg how Fig 2d represents model uncertainty while 2c represents data uncertainty). Ideally, in my opinion, the authors should have a detailed caption (or detail in Section 2) explaining each of the subplots and comparing them to each other.

**Requested Changes:**
Many of my requested changes are detailed in the Weaknesses section above. 1. My biggest problem with the paper was my inability to follow the brief explanations of methods from Section 3.3 onwards. As a survey paper, I think the authors should have better writing so that I can follow each method and understand the big picture view of how they differ from each other. [See Weakness 1] 2. The authors claim they compare approaches to established methods, and also critically reflect on their advantages and shortcomings. Similar to point 1 above, I did not think this was done in a readable way or in sufficient detail. [Also see weakness 2] 3. [See Weakness 3] I did not follow what the most central theoretical results are. Could the authors make this more obvious and/or argue to me why this is a useful contribution. (Note that I have not read most of the surveyed papers, so am willing to be convinced that they are unaware of each other or use significantly different notation. But if this is the case, then perhaps the authors should make this clearer in the writing.) 4. See Weakness 4 and suggested change. 5. See Weakness 5 and suggested change. 6. I thought the Discussion brought up some valid problems with methods, but again, this was mentioned briefly and only at the end of the paper. Could some of these ideas be put in during the rest of the paper and in significantly more detail, so the methods are critically discussed throughout? Minor typos: (a) 'i.e.' should be 'e.g.' bottom of page 2. (b) "probability *of* success" (bottom of page 2). (c) "a more complex teacher network" [no 's'] (top of page 7). (d) Greek letter 'nu' instead of 'v' in $\mathcal{N}(\gamma, \sigma^2 v^{-1})$ bottom of page 9? (e) "quanitified" -> "quantified" top of page 10.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No Broader Impact Statement provided, and I do not think one is required.

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Reponse to Reviewer 6GHq: We would like to thank the anonymous reviewer for their tremendously useful feedback to our work. We corrected the caught typos and implemented a lot of the suggestions to further improve the paper. We address a few more of the raised points here: - Based on the feedback of the other reviewers, we welcome the idea of further discussing the showcased approaches in sections 3 and 4, which so far happened in an abridged version to stay within the 12 page limit. - We changed the wording of comparing EDL approaches to established methods in order not to imply new empirical results, which might have been misleading. The comparison indeed takes place within the discussion, and we will take this point along with the concerns of reviewer jdKi to extend the discussion of this point in the main text. - Addressing weakness 4 as well as a point raised by reviewer jdKi, we will add an additional section discussion the ways epistemic uncertainty are obtained within the EDL framework and how this compares to other UQ approaches such as ensembling.
paper_title_zh: 先验与后验网络：证据深度学习方法在不确定性估计中的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 流行的方法在量化深度神经网络中的预测不确定性时，通常涉及多组权重或模型，例如通过集成或蒙特卡洛dropout。这些技术通常需要训练多个模型实例而产生额外开销，或者无法产生非常多样化的预测。本综述旨在使读者熟悉基于证据深度学习概念的另一类模型：对于不熟悉的数据，它们承认“它们不知道的”，并回退到先验信念。此外，它们通过参数化分布之上的分布，允许在单个模型和前向传播中进行不确定性估计。本综述回顾了现有工作，重点关注分类设置中的实现，然后调查同一范式在回归中的应用。我们还反思了彼此之间以及与更成熟方法的优缺点，并使用统一的符号提供了最核心的理论结果，以助力未来的研究。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这篇综述论文探讨了证据深度学习方法，提及并关联了许多不同的论文，如图1和表1、2、3所示。这包括分类和回归方法，以及基于先验和后验的方法。

**优点与不足：**
优点：
1. 论文涵盖了许多不同的论文/方法。
2. 第1、2、3.1和3.2节写得很好，易于理解。我也认为讨论部分提出了一些很好的观点。

不足：
1. 我发现第3.3、3.4和4节对方法的解释非常简略和晦涩。通常每篇论文只有几句话的描述，我无法理解每种方法的不同之处。这种情况从第7页顶部开始。作者似乎假定读者熟悉这些论文，而这只是一个类似论文中“相关工作”部分因篇幅限制而简略的方法总结。作为一个对这篇综述论文中讨论的大部分近期工作不甚了解的人，我无法理解大部分的解释。
2. 作者声称他们比较了证据深度学习方法与已建立的方法（如第2页顶部所述）。这在何处进行了？是在第5节吗？如果是，我没有发现这里有太多的讨论（只是对其他方法进行了几句简短的描述，没有太多洞见）。
3. 作者说他们提供了“使用统一符号的最核心的理论结果”（摘要）。我在正文中完全不清楚这一点。大多数方法都被提及，但我不确定最核心的结果是什么，以及它们在论文的哪个部分。大多数方程出现在背景部分，我相信大多数被调查的论文已经描述了狄利克雷分布。
4. 第3.2节关于模型不确定性的讨论在我看来有些奇怪。作者之前认为通过使用单一神经网络权重的估计，我们失去了认识不确定性，但现在又说这种不确定性仍然存在。我认为作者应该在方程4周围的文字做一些修改，以免显得如此不合时宜/矛盾。
5. 图2没有详细解释。我经常困惑于图2中的每个子图如何代表作者所说的内容，而且文中没有对此进行解释（相反，作者只是假定读者知道例如图2d代表模型不确定性而2c代表数据不确定性）。在我看来，理想情况下，作者应该有一个详细的图注（或在第2节中详细说明），解释每个子图并将它们相互比较。

**请求的修改：**
我请求的许多修改已在上述不足部分详细说明。
1. 我对这篇论文最大的问题是，从第3.3节开始，我无法理解对方法的简略解释。作为一篇综述论文，我认为作者应该有更好的写作，以便我能理解每种方法并了解它们之间差异的全貌。[参见不足1]
2. 作者声称他们比较了方法与已建立的方法，并对其优缺点进行了批判性反思。与上述第1点类似，我认为这一点没有以可读的方式或足够的细节进行。[也参见不足2]
3. [参见不足3] 我不清楚最核心的理论结果是什么。作者能否使其更明显，并/或向我论证为什么这是一个有用的贡献。（请注意，我没有阅读大部分被调查的论文，所以愿意被说服它们彼此不了解或使用显著不同的符号。但如果是这样，那么作者或许应该在写作中更清楚地说明这一点。）
4. 参见不足4和建议的修改。
5. 参见不足5和建议的修改。
6. 我认为讨论部分提出了一些方法的有效问题，但同样，这只是简略提及并在论文末尾。能否将其中一些观点在论文其余部分以更详细的篇幅提出，以便对方法进行批判性讨论？

小错误：
(a) 第2页底部的“i.e.”应为“e.g.”。
(b) 第2页底部的“probability *of* success”。
(c) 第7页顶部的“a more complex teacher network” [无需's']。
(d) 第9页底部的$\mathcal{N}(\gamma, \sigma^2 v^{-1})$中的希腊字母'nu'是否应为'v'？
(e) 第10页顶部的“quanitified” -> “quantified”。

**更广泛影响关注：**
未提供更广泛影响声明，我认为也不需要。

**反驳意见：**
对评审员6GHq的回应：我们感谢匿名评审员对我们工作的极其有用的反馈。我们纠正了发现的错误，并实施了许多建议以进一步改进论文。我们在此再回应一些提出的观点：
- 基于其他评审员的反馈，我们欢迎在3和4节进一步讨论所展示的方法，这在之前因限于12页篇幅而进行了简略处理。
- 我们修改了将EDL方法与已建立方法进行比较的措辞，以免误导读者认为有新的实证结果。比较确实在讨论中进行，我们将结合评审员jdKi的关注点，在正文中扩展这一点的讨论。

paper_title: Use of botulinum toxin in musculoskeletal pain
paper_abstract: Chronic musculoskeletal pain is a common cause of chronic pain, which is associated with a total cost of $635 billion per year in the U.S. Emerging evidence suggests an anti-nociceptive action of botulinum toxin, independent of its muscle paralyzing action. This review provides a summary of data from both non-randomized and randomized clinical studies of botulinum toxin in back pain and various osteoarticular conditions, including osteoarthritis, tennis elbow, low back pain and hand pain. Three randomized controlled trials (RCTs) of small sizes provide evidence of short-term efficacy of a single intra-articular injection of 100 units of botulinum toxin A (BoNT/A) for the relief of pain and the improvement of both function and quality of life in patients with chronic joint pain due to arthritis. Three RCTs studied intramuscular BoNT/A for tennis elbow with one showing a significant improvement in pain relief compared with placebo, another one showing no difference from placebo, and the third finding that pain and function improvement with BoNT/A injection were similar to those obtained with surgical release. One RCT of intramuscular BoNT/A for low back pain found improvement in pain and function compared to placebo. Single RCTs using local injections of BoNT in patients with either temporomandibular joint (TMJ) pain or plantar fasciitis found superior efficacy compared to placebo. One RCT of intramuscular BoNT/B in patients with hand pain and carpal tunnel syndrome found improvement in pain in both BoNT/B and placebo groups, but no significant difference between groups. Most evidence is based on small studies, but the use of BoNT is supported by a single, and sometimes up to three, RCTs for several chronic musculoskeletal pain conditions. This indicates that botulinum toxin may be a promising potential new treatment for chronic refractory musculoskeletal pain. Well-designed large clinical trials are needed.
review_content:
The manuscript is a decent, very detailed, and almost complete review. The title and abstract are appropriate for the content of the article and the conclusions are sensible and justified.

However, I do have two significant reservations. Unfortunately, for a complete review of the published data concerning the topic 'botulinum toxin and pain' we found two RCTs missing: Lin YC (2010) Am J Phys Med Rehabil, Placzek R (2007) JBJS Am.

Furthermore, there have been at least 3 review articles with the same topic in 2012 (Hameed F (2012), Cheng OT (2012), Sim WS (2011)), hence by reading this manuscript, little information may be new to the informed reader.
paper_title_zh: 肉毒毒素在肌肉骨骼疼痛中的应用
paper_abstract_zh: 慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛是慢性疼痛的常见原因，与美国每年总计6350亿美元的费用相关。新出现的证据表明，肉毒毒素具有抗伤害感受作用，独立于其肌肉麻痹作用。本综述总结了肉毒毒素在背痛和各种骨关节疾病（包括骨关节炎、网球肘、腰背痛和手部疼痛）中的非随机和随机临床研究数据。三项小规模的随机对照试验（RCTs）提供了证据，表明单次关节内注射100单位肉毒毒素A（BoNT/A）在短期内对缓解关节炎引起的慢性关节疼痛、改善功能和提高生活质量有效。三项RCT研究了肌肉内注射BoNT/A治疗网球肘，其中一项显示与安慰剂相比疼痛缓解显著改善，另一项显示与安慰剂无差异，第三项发现BoNT/A注射在疼痛和功能改善方面与手术松解相似。一项肌肉内注射BoNT/A治疗腰背痛的RCT发现，与安慰剂相比，疼痛和功能有所改善。使用局部注射BoNT治疗颞下颌关节（TMJ）疼痛或足底筋膜炎的单项RCT发现，其疗效优于安慰剂。一项肌肉内注射BoNT/B治疗手部疼痛和腕管综合征的RCT发现，BoNT/B和安慰剂组在疼痛改善方面均有改善，但两组间无显著差异。大多数证据基于小规模研究，但使用BoNT在几种慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛条件下的单一或最多三项RCT中得到了支持。这表明肉毒毒素可能是治疗慢性难治性肌肉骨骼疼痛的有前景的新疗法。需要设计良好的大型临床试验。
review_content_zh:
该手稿是一篇体面、非常详细且几乎完整的综述。标题和摘要适合文章内容，结论合理且有据。

然而，我确实有两个重要的保留意见。不幸的是，在关于“肉毒毒素与疼痛”这一主题的已发表数据的完整综述中，我们发现缺少了两项随机对照试验：Lin YC (2010) Am J Phys Med Rehabil, Placzek R (2007) JBJS Am。

此外，2012年至少已有3篇同主题的综述文章（Hameed F (2012), Cheng OT (2012), Sim WS (2011)），因此，阅读这篇手稿，对知情读者而言，可能鲜有新信息。

Furthermore, there have been at least 3 review articles with the same topic in 2012 (Hameed F (2012), Cheng OT (2012), Sim WS (2011)), hence by reading this manuscript, little information may be new to the informed reader.

paper_title: I drink for my liver, Doc: emerging evidence that coffee prevents cirrhosis
paper_abstract: Evidence demonstrating that regular ingestion of coffee has salutary effects on patients with chronic liver disease is accumulating rapidly. Specifically, it appears that coffee ingestion can slow the progression of liver fibrosis, preventing cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). This should excite clinicians and scientists alike, since these observations, if true, would create effective, testable hypotheses that should lead to improved understanding on fibrosis pathogenesis and thus may generate novel pharmacologic treatments of patients with chronic liver disease. This review is designed to examine the relevant clinical and epidemiological data in critical fashion and to examine the putative pharmacological effects of coffee relevant to the pathogenesis of liver fibrosis and cirrhosis. We hope that this will inspire relevant critical analyses, especially among “coffee skeptics”. Of note, one major assumption made by this review is that the bulk of the effects of coffee consumption are mediated by caffeine, rather than by other chemical constituents of coffee. Our rationales for this assumption are threefold: first, caffeine’s effects on adenosinergic signaling provide testable hypotheses; second, although there are  myriad chemical constituents of coffee, they are present in very low concentrations, and perhaps more importantly, vary greatly between coffee products and production methods (it is important to note that we do not dismiss the “botanical” hypothesis here; rather, we do not emphasize it at present due to the limitations of the studies examined); lastly, some (but not all) observational studies have examined both coffee and non-coffee caffeine consumption and found consistent effects, and when examined, no benefit to decaffeinated coffee has been observed. Further, in the interval since we examined this phenomenon last, further evidence has accumulated supporting caffeine as the effector molecule for coffee’s salutary effects.
review_content:
This is a well-written review about beneficial effects of coffee on fibrogenesis and liver injury encompassing both lab and clinical studies. A couple points warrant the authors’ attention:
 1. Caffeine also regulates phosphodiesterases. Could this be a contributory factor for beneficial effects?
 2. Carbonated beverages also have significant levels of caffeine. Not aware of their benefits for fibrosis though. Any literature about this in context of fibrosis to support or refute the concept of caffeine as the antifibrotic component of coffee?
paper_title_zh: “我为我的肝脏而饮，医生：咖啡预防肝硬化的新证据”
paper_abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，定期饮用咖啡对慢性肝病患者具有有益作用。具体而言，咖啡摄入似乎可以减缓肝纤维化的进展，预防肝硬化和肝细胞癌（HCC）。这应该会让临床医生和科学家都感到兴奋，因为这些观察结果如果属实，将产生有效且可测试的假设，从而有助于更好地理解纤维化病理机制，并可能为慢性肝病患者生成新的药物治疗方法。本综述旨在以批判性的方式审视相关的临床和流行病学数据，并探讨咖啡对肝纤维化和肝硬化病理机制的可能药理作用。我们希望这能激发相关的重要分析，尤其是对于那些“咖啡怀疑者”。值得注意的是，本综述的一个主要假设是，咖啡摄入的大部分效应是由咖啡因介导的，而不是由咖啡的其他化学成分介导的。我们这一假设的理由有三：首先，咖啡因对腺苷能信号传导的影响提供了可测试的假设；其次，尽管咖啡含有多种化学成分，但它们的浓度非常低，更重要的是，这些成分在不同咖啡产品和生产方法之间差异很大（需要指出的是，我们在此并未摒弃“植物学”假设；而是由于所审查研究的局限性，目前不强调它）；最后，一些（但并非所有）观察性研究已经考察了咖啡和非咖啡类咖啡因摄入，并发现了 consistent effects，并且在考察时，未发现脱咖啡因咖啡的益处。此外，自我们上次考察这一现象以来，进一步积累的证据支持咖啡因作为咖啡有益效应的作用分子。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于咖啡对纤维生成和肝损伤有益影响的综述，文笔流畅，涵盖了实验室和临床研究。有几点值得作者注意：
1. 咖啡因还调节磷酸二酯酶。这可能是其有益影响的一个促成因素吗？
2. 碳酸饮料也含有显著水平的咖啡因。尽管不清楚它们对纤维化的益处。是否有关于纤维化背景下支持或反驳咖啡因作为咖啡抗纤维化成分的文献？

reasons: Not aware of their benefits for fibrosis though.
Any literature about this in context of fibrosis to support or refute the concept of caffeine as the antifibrotic component of coffee?
This is a well-written review about beneficial effects of coffee on fibrogenesis and liver injury encompassing both lab and clinical studies.

paper_title: Discipline-specific open access publishing practices and barriers to change: an evidence-based review
paper_abstract:
Background: Many of the discussions surrounding Open Access (OA) revolve around how it affects publishing practices across different academic disciplines. It was a long-held view that it would be only a matter of time before all disciplines fully and relatively homogeneously implemented OA. Recent large-scale bibliometric studies show, however, that the uptake of OA differs substantially across disciplines. We aimed to answer two questions: First, how do different disciplines adopt and shape OA publishing practices? Second, what discipline-specific barriers to and potentials for OA can be identified? 
 Methods: In a first step, we identified and synthesized relevant bibliometric studies that assessed OA prevalence and publishing patterns across disciplines. In a second step, and adopting a social shaping of technology perspective, we studied evidence on the socio-technical forces that shape OA publishing practices. We examined a variety of data sources, including, but not limited to, publisher policies and guidelines, OA mandates and policies and author surveys. 
 Results: Over the last three decades, scholarly publishing has experienced a shift from “closed” access to OA as the proportion of scholarly literature that is openly accessible has increased continuously. Estimated OA levels for publication years after 2010 varied between 29.4% and 66%. The shift towards OA is uneven across disciplines in two respects: first, the growth of OA has been uneven across disciplines, which manifests itself in varying OA prevalence levels. Second, disciplines use different OA publishing channels to make research outputs OA. 
 Conclusions: We conclude that historically rooted publishing practices differ in terms of their compatibility with OA, which is the reason why OA can be assumed to be a natural continuation of publishing cultures in some disciplines, whereas in other disciplines, the implementation of OA faces major barriers and would require a change of research culture.
review_content:
I’m sorry that I haven’t been slow with reviewing this study, but the increasing length of studies, which generally I think necessary, makes peer review even more onerous.

Importance:
  * The study asks two important questions - what is the variation in use of open access by discipline, and what might be the reasons for the differences? And it provides answers that are generally convincing, although hard to digest.

Originality:
  * Individual studies provide some answers to these questions, but this review brings them together. That is useful.

Methods and presentation:
  * Although the study is described as a meta-synthesis, it seems to me that it’s essentially a descriptive study. The authors find the studies and then largely describe what they report. There isn’t much synthesis, and I, as a reader, would appreciate more.
  * There is huge heterogeneity in the studies of proportions of articles that are open access, but readers are left to look through a table that is four pages long - and largely to wonder for themselves about the reasons for the big variations. I know that all the data are there, but how is it that a study of 12m article from 2018 finds that 66% of articles are open access, whereas another equally large study from the same year finds that 29% are open access? Clearly they must be using different definitions of open access, and the authors don’t themselves define open access or its subsets (gold, green, hybrid, and bronze). They should. I’d like to see a summary table that has the following columns: Year of study, number of articles in the study, definition of open access, proportion of articles that were open access.
  * There should be another summary table that shows the variation by discipline in overall open access rates and in the subsets of open access.
  * Another useful addition would be a figure that showed how proportions of articles that are open access by discipline have varied over time.
  * The authors might also give a table that shows the association between their “analytical dimension” and the different disciplines. At the moment readers can get this information only by ploughing through pages of text that describe the variations by discipline.
  * As this is essentially a descriptive study I don’t have great criticisms of the methods and conclusions, although I recognise the weakness of surveys, which give us data on what people say about their behaviour than what really drives their behaviour.
  * My biggest criticisms are about presentation. I’d like to see not only more tables and a figure but also a much shorter paper backed up by supplementary material if necessary. That would, I judge, make for a much more readable and useful paper and dramatically increase the number of readers.

Minor points:
  * There is at the moment a great deal of repetition. The discussion is mostly a repetition of the results.
  * I’d like to see some data in the abstract.
  * I believe that abbreviations are a plague in medical writing, and I’d avoid them, including OA for open access.
  * I’d drop “evidence-based” in the title.
  * It would be good to have the search strategy as a table.
  * Much of what’s in the results should ideally be in the discussion.
  * There are a fair few typos.
paper_title_zh: 学科特定的开放获取出版实践及变革障碍：基于证据的综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：围绕开放获取（OA）的许多讨论都集中在它如何影响不同学术领域的出版实践上。长期以来，人们普遍认为，所有学科全面且相对同质性地实施OA只是时间问题。然而，近期的大规模文献计量研究表明，OA的采用在不同学科之间存在显著差异。我们旨在回答两个问题：首先，不同学科如何采纳和塑造OA出版实践？其次，可以识别出哪些学科特定的OA障碍和潜力？

方法：首先，我们识别并综合了评估各学科OA普及率和出版模式的相关文献计量研究。其次，采用技术社会塑造视角，我们研究了塑造OA出版实践的社会技术力量的证据。我们审查了多种数据来源，包括但不限于出版商政策和指南、OA指令和政策以及作者调查。

结果：在过去三十年中，学术出版经历了从“封闭”获取到OA的转变，因为公开可获取的学术文献比例持续增加。2010年以后的出版年份估计OA水平介于29.4%至66%之间。向OA的转变在学科间不均衡，体现在两个方面：首先，OA的增长在不同学科间不均衡，表现为不同的OA普及率水平。其次，学科使用不同的OA出版渠道来使研究成果开放获取。

结论：我们认为，历史上根深蒂固的出版实践在与其与OA的兼容性方面存在差异，这就是为什么可以假设OA是一些学科出版文化的自然延续，而在其他学科中，OA的实施面临重大障碍，并需要改变研究文化的原因。
review_content_zh:
很抱歉我并未拖延评审这项研究，但研究篇幅的不断增加（我认为这通常是必要的）使得同行评审变得更加繁重。

重要性：
  * 该研究提出了两个重要问题——各学科在开放获取使用上的差异是什么，以及这些差异可能的原因是什么？它提供的答案总体上是令人信服的，尽管难以消化。

原创性：
  * 单个研究对这些问题提供了一些答案，但这项综述将它们整合在一起。这是有用的。

方法和呈现：
  * 尽管该研究被描述为元综合，但在我看来，它本质上是一项描述性研究。作者找到这些研究，然后主要描述了它们报告的内容。综合的部分并不多，作为读者，我希望看到更多。
  * 在开放获取文章比例的研究中存在巨大的异质性，但读者需要浏览一个长达四页的表格——并且主要靠自己揣摩这些巨大差异的原因。我知道所有数据都在那里，但一项关于2018年1200万篇文章的研究发现66%的文章是开放获取的，而同年另一项同样规模的研究却发现29%的文章是开放获取的。显然，它们必须使用了不同的开放获取定义，而作者们自己并未定义开放获取及其子集（金色、绿色、混合和青铜）。他们应该这样做。我希望看到一个包含以下列的总结表格：研究年份、研究中的文章数量、开放获取的定义、开放获取文章的比例。
  * 应该有另一个总结表格，展示各学科在总体开放获取率和开放获取子集方面的差异。
  * 另一个有用的补充是一张图，展示各学科开放获取文章比例随时间的变化。
  * 作者们还可以提供一个表格，展示他们的“分析维度”与不同学科之间的关联。目前，读者只能通过翻阅描述各学科差异的文本页面来获取这些信息。
  * 由于这本质上是一项描述性研究，我对方法和结论没有大的批评，尽管我认识到调查的弱点，它们提供的是关于人们对其行为的说法，而非真正驱动其行为的数据。
  * 我最大的批评在于呈现方式。我希望看到的不仅是有更多的表格和图表，而且是一篇更短的论文，如有必要，辅以补充材料。我认为这将使论文更加易读和有用，并显著增加读者数量。

次要问题：
  * 目前存在大量重复。讨论部分大多是结果的重复。
  * 我希望摘要中能看到一些数据。
  * 我认为缩写在医学写作中是一种祸害，我会避免使用它们，包括用OA表示开放获取。
  * 我会去掉标题中的“基于证据的”。
  * 将搜索策略以表格形式呈现会更好。
  * 结果中的许多内容理想情况下应该放在讨论部分。
  * 有相当多的错别字。

paper_title: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on self-harm and suicidal behaviour: update of living systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused considerable morbidity, mortality and disruption to people’s lives around the world. There are concerns that rates of suicide and suicidal behaviour may rise during and in its aftermath. Our living systematic review synthesises findings from emerging literature on incidence and prevalence of suicidal behaviour as well as suicide prevention efforts in relation to COVID-19, with this iteration synthesising relevant evidence up to 19 th October 2020. 
 Method:  Automated daily searches feed into a web-based database with screening and data extraction functionalities. Eligibility criteria include incidence/prevalence of suicidal behaviour, exposure-outcome relationships and effects of interventions in relation to the COVID-19 pandemic. Outcomes of interest are suicide, self-harm or attempted suicide and suicidal thoughts. No restrictions are placed on language or study type, except for single-person case reports. We exclude one-off cross-sectional studies without either pre-pandemic measures or comparisons of COVID-19 positive vs. unaffected individuals. 
 Results: Searches identified 6,226 articles. Seventy-eight articles met our inclusion criteria. We identified a further 64 relevant cross-sectional studies that did not meet our revised inclusion criteria. Thirty-four articles were not peer-reviewed (e.g. research letters, pre-prints). All articles were based on observational studies. 
There was no consistent evidence of a rise in suicide but many studies noted adverse economic effects were evolving. There was evidence of a rise in community distress, fall in hospital presentation for suicidal behaviour and early evidence of an increased frequency of suicidal thoughts in those who had become infected with COVID-19. 
 Conclusions:   Research evidence of the impact of COVID-19 on suicidal behaviour is accumulating rapidly. This living review provides a regular synthesis of the most up-to-date research evidence to guide public health and clinical policy to mitigate the impact of COVID-19 on suicide risk as the longer term impacts of the pandemic on suicide risk are researched.
review_content:
This article provides a review of empirical studies on suicide ideation, behavior, and deaths as related to the COVID-19 pandemic (up to June 2020). Given prior data linking disasters and crises more generally, and pandemics specifically, to changes in suicide rates, describing any changes in suicide rates (as well as suicide ideation and non-fatal behavior) due to the COVID-19 pandemic could contribute to suicide prevention science and promote public health efforts to save lives. A key strength of this paper is its design as a ‘living review’ that will be updated every six months as more data is available. Another strength is the transparent reporting on search methods and strategies.

A limitation of the paper is inadequate attention to study quality in the analysis and interpretation of findings. I will give several examples. First, the authors report that they used a formal tool to assess the risk of bias for epidemiological or clinical trial design studies, but do not report findings from these assessments; given that many papers included in the review were not peer reviewed, it seems especially useful for the authors to use such assessments of study quality to guide their review and to ‘weight’ findings from these studies in their analysis. Second, the degree of methodological rigor could be assessed for all studies, not just those with epidemiology/clinical trial designs and the authors should consider doing so. Third, the authors indicate in the primary table that letters to the editor were ‘probably not peer reviewed.’ Given that this information could be verified by contacting the journals, this would be a useful strategy to bolster findings from this review. Fourth, when the authors describe the findings, they do not differentiate between findings that appear methodologically-sound versus those that may not be, thus negating one of the most useful features of review papers for readers.

Another limitation of the paper is that it provides relatively little synthesis or conclusions, which is a key function of review papers, as opposed to a database that contains a listing of available studies. The discussion section includes more of a summary of what studies examined (and did not examine) as opposed to a synthesis of findings. The authors do not provide a nuanced discussion of the fact that these studies come from numerous countries around the world and what addressing this issue could potentially tell us about possible variability in suicide rates around the world. They do not discuss limitations with sampling that appeared across studies (e.g., generalizability of online platforms like M-Turk). In the discussion section, the authors conclude that “a marked improvement in the quality of design, methods, and reporting in future studies is needed.” This may be accurate, but I do not think it is an especially useful statement to guide the field. A more useful set of statements might involve a synthesis of methodological strengths and weaknesses as well as a discussion on strategies that can be taken going forward to address these weaknesses. The authors do not posit further implications; this may be accurate—that nothing else can be concluded right now—but in that case, perhaps the paper is premature.

The authors should provide additional details on the methods used for the review process to construct Tables 1-4. In particular, for the column labeled ‘Conclusions,’ presumably, this refers to conclusions made by the authors of the original papers? This should be stated explicitly. Did the authors of this review include all conclusions made by the authors of the original studies in the table or did they select ones deemed most useful? How did the authors of this review select the limitations and comments included in the final column? Some of the comments included in that final column appear opinion-based and are not supported by data from the papers (e.g., prevalence is “surprisingly low” or these data “cannot be interpreted” and “usefully”).

For future updates, the authors should consider providing dates for data collection in their tables given that the timing of when studies are conducted may moderate findings, given the variability in length of physical distancing, amount of economic disruption, and the number of deaths due to COVID-19.
paper_title_zh: 新冠疫情对自伤和自杀行为的影响：实时系统综述更新
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：COVID-19大流行已在全球范围内造成显著的发病率和死亡率，并对人们的生活造成了严重干扰。有担忧认为，在疫情期间及其后续影响中，自杀和自杀行为的比率可能会上升。我们的实时系统综述综合了关于COVID-19相关自杀行为的发生率和流行率以及自杀预防努力的最新文献，本次迭代综合了截至2020年10月19日的相关证据。

方法：自动每日搜索结果输入到一个具有筛选和数据提取功能的基于网络的数据库中。纳入标准包括与COVID-19大流行相关的自杀行为的发生率/流行率、暴露-结局关系和干预效果。感兴趣的结果包括自杀、自伤或自杀未遂以及自杀想法。除单人案例报告外，不对语言或研究类型设限。我们排除了既无大流行前测量也无COVID-19阳性与未受影响个体比较的一次性横断面研究。

结果：搜索识别出6,226篇文章。78篇文章符合我们的纳入标准。我们进一步识别出64项相关的横断面研究，但不符合我们修订后的纳入标准。34篇文章未经同行评审（如研究简报、预印本）。所有文章均基于观察性研究。

没有一致证据表明自杀率上升，但许多研究指出不利的经济影响正在演变。有证据显示社区痛苦增加，因自杀行为而就诊医院的人数下降，以及早期证据表明感染COVID-19的人群中自杀想法的频率增加。

结论：关于COVID-19对自杀行为影响的研究证据正在迅速积累。这一实时综述提供了最新研究证据的定期综合，以指导公共卫生和临床政策，减轻COVID-19对自杀风险的长期影响，同时继续研究大流行对自杀风险的长期影响。
review_content_zh:
本文回顾了截至2020年6月与COVID-19大流行相关的自杀意念、行为和死亡的实证研究。鉴于先前数据将灾害和危机（尤其是大流行）与自杀率的变化联系起来，描述因COVID-19大流行导致的自杀率变化（以及自杀意念和非致命行为）可能有助于自杀预防科学并促进公共卫生努力以挽救生命。本文的一个关键优势是其设计为“动态综述”，将每六个月更新一次，以纳入更多数据。另一个优势是透明地报告了搜索方法和策略。

本文的局限性在于在分析和解释研究结果时对研究质量的关注不足。我将举几个例子。首先，作者报告称他们使用了一种正式工具来评估流行病学或临床试验设计研究的偏倚风险，但没有报告这些评估的结果；鉴于许多纳入综述的论文未经同行评审，作者使用这些研究质量评估来指导综述并在分析中“加权”这些研究的发现似乎尤为重要。其次，所有研究的方法严谨度都可以被评估，而不仅仅是那些具有流行病学/临床试验设计的研究，作者应考虑这样做。第三，作者在主表中指出，给编辑的信“可能未经同行评审”。鉴于这一信息可以通过联系期刊来验证，这将是一个加强本综述发现的实用策略。第四，当作者描述研究结果时，他们没有区分方法上可靠的发现与可能不可靠的发现，从而否定了综述论文对读者最有用的特点之一。

本文的另一个局限性是提供的综合或结论相对较少，这是综述论文的一个关键功能，与仅包含可用研究列表的数据库不同。讨论部分更多地总结了研究考察了什么（以及未考察什么），而不是对发现的综合。作者没有细致讨论这些研究来自世界各地的事实，以及解决这一问题可能对我们了解全球自杀率的可能变异性有何启示。他们没有讨论各研究中出现的抽样局限性（例如，M-Turk等在线平台的普适性）。在讨论部分，作者得出结论：“未来研究在设计的质量、方法和报告方面需要显著改进。”这可能是准确的，但我认为这对指导该领域并不是一个特别有用的陈述。更有用的一组陈述可能包括对方法优势与劣势的综合，以及关于未来如何解决这些劣势的策略讨论。作者没有提出进一步的启示；这可能准确——目前无法得出其他结论——但如果是这样，或许这篇论文还为时过早。

作者应提供更多关于用于构建表1-4的综述过程方法的细节。特别是，对于标有“结论”的列，假设这指的是原论文作者的结论？这应明确说明。本综述的作者是否在表中包括了原研究作者的所有结论，还是仅选择了他们认为最有用的结论？本综述的作者如何选择最终列中包含的局限性和评论？最终列中的一些评论似乎基于个人意见，且没有论文数据支持（例如，患病率“出奇地低”或这些数据“无法解释”且“不具参考价值”）。

对于未来的更新，作者应考虑在表中提供数据收集的日期，因为考虑到物理距离的长度、经济中断的程度以及因COVID-19导致的死亡人数的变异性，研究的进行时间可能会调节发现。
