“知情的健康选择”（IHC）是一项重要的倡议，旨在提升科学和健康素养。为了保持其有效性，作者积极更新IHC至关重要。他们选择的方法，即结合优先考虑系统评价的文献检索并纳入专家反馈，值得称赞。这一策略确保了IHC的持续维护和相关性。

在引言中，作者为IHC倡议提供了合理性论证，指出“许多人发现很难就治疗或健康行动该相信什么或做什么做出决定。”通常，个人依赖其医生代为做出这些判断。人们常常认为，对治疗或健康行动做出决定不是他们的责任。作者在引言中 address 这一观点，可能有助于缓解读者可能存在的任何担忧。

在表1中，第1.4项提出的概念指出，“仅基于信息来源的信任可能具有误导性。”然而，这一概念带来了一些挑战。考虑到各领域的专业知识极为广泛，任何人都不可能批判性地评估每一个重要声明的有效性。例如，我个人发现很难评估与气候变化相关的声明，而是依赖对某些来源的信任。鉴于此，IHC倡议或许可以提供指导，帮助个人辨别哪些信息来源更可靠，而不是强调不应仅基于信息来源建立信任。

paper_title: Natural disaster and medication preparedness among elderly: a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Introduction 
 The increasing number of older people and their vulnerability to disaster and medication preparedness as the primary elements of disaster mitigation are necessary to reduce the impact of a disaster. Nevertheless, research on natural disasters and medication preparedness in the elderly population is still lacking. This review aimed to explore all reported research and publications related to natural disasters and medication preparedness among the elderly. 
 
 
 Methods 
 A scoping review was performed using the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analysis Extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR). A literature search was conducted using the following four databases: Scopus, PubMed, Sage, and Google Scholar. Screening was conducted using the following criteria: articles written in English, open access, and published between 2020 and 2024. Articles must discuss natural disasters and medication preparedness. In the data search, we input several keywords that include “elderly,” “natural disaster,” “preparedness,” and “medication.” Snowballing was then conducted to find articles on preparedness interventions. Data extraction and analysis were then performed. 
 
 
 Results and conclusion 
 The findings from this literature review are the majority of studies showing that most elderly people are not well prepared in facing disasters; however, through various programs that have been implemented by either the government or community, the elderly show more preparation when they encounter any natural disaster.
review_content:
Thank you for the opportunity to review this manuscript. In this paper, the authors conducted a scoping review of disaster preparedness as it relates to elderly people. I think there is some interesting information in here, and some careful re-editing and re-organization of the text could hopefully make it stronger.

General comment:

The overall quality of written English needs improvement, with many grammatical errors and overly-long descriptions in the text.

As a specific example, the opening three sentences of the main text could be re-written as “The global population of elderly people, defined as those 60 years of age or greater, is large and increasing. There were an estimated 1 billion elderly people alive in 2024, a group that is projected to grow to 1.4 billion in 2030 and 2.1 billion by 2050.” An explanation of how becoming elderly is a function of aging is not needed.

Specific comments:

Abstract – the results and conclusions are too brief; while the necessary brevity of an abstract constrains out ability to discuss results in enormous detail, some mention of the actual results of the review should be included.

Introduction – It is not necessary to mention what ministries of health are, although it is useful to mention that disaster preparedness may fail to meet the needs of older people.

Results – 5 papers out of 20 is not “most” (in reference to the number of papers that were written in the US). It is not necessary to list the journals of origin in the main text; this can be included in Table 3 and in the references.

Results – The results section does not include any actual results, just a list of papers that met their inclusion criteria. Much of this information is included in the discussion but would be properly considered part of the results. The basic organization of preparedness categories in the discussion (mobility assistance, social support, etc.) is a reasonable one, however.
paper_title_zh: 自然灾害与老年人药物准备情况：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
引言
随着老年人口数量的增加及其在灾害和药物准备方面的脆弱性，作为灾害减缓的主要要素，减少灾害影响是必要的。然而，关于老年人口在自然灾害和药物准备方面的研究仍然不足。本综述旨在探讨所有已报道的与老年人自然灾害和药物准备相关的研究和出版物。

方法
采用系统综述和荟萃分析扩展范围综述的首选报告项目（PRISMA-ScR）进行范围综述。通过以下四个数据库进行文献检索：Scopus、PubMed、Sage和Google Scholar。筛选标准如下：英文撰写、开放获取、2020年至2024年发表的文章，且必须讨论自然灾害和药物准备。在数据搜索中，我们输入了包括“老年人”、“自然灾害”、“准备”和“药物”在内的多个关键词。随后进行滚雪球法以查找有关准备干预的文章。然后进行数据提取和分析。

结果与结论
本次文献综述的发现是，大多数研究表明，大多数老年人在面对灾害时准备不足；然而，通过政府或社区实施的各种项目，老年人在遭遇任何自然灾害时表现出更多的准备。
review_content_zh:
感谢有机会审阅这篇手稿。在这篇论文中，作者对与老年人相关的灾害准备进行了范围审查。我认为这里有一些有趣的信息，经过仔细的重新编辑和文本重组，有望使其更具说服力。

总体评论：

书面英语的整体质量需要提高，文本中存在许多语法错误和过于冗长的描述。

举一个具体的例子，正文开头的三句话可以改写为：“全球老年人口，定义为60岁及以上的人群，数量庞大且在增加。据估计，2024年有10亿老年人，预计到2030年将增长到14亿，到2050年将达到21亿。”关于变老是如何衰老的一个功能解释是不必要的。

具体评论：

摘要——结果和结论过于简短；尽管摘要的必要简洁性限制了我们对结果进行详尽讨论的能力，但应提及审查的实际结果。

引言——没有必要提及卫生部门是什么，尽管提到灾害准备可能无法满足老年人的需求是有用的。

结果——20篇论文中有5篇并不代表“大多数”（指在美国撰写的论文数量）。没有必要在正文中列出期刊来源；这可以包括在表3和参考文献中。

结果——结果部分没有包含任何实际结果，只是列出了符合纳入标准的论文。许多信息包含在讨论中，但应被视为结果的一部分。然而，讨论中准备类别的基本组织（如行动辅助、社会支持等）是合理的。

Much of this information is included in the discussion but would be properly considered part of the results.

Much of this information is included in the discussion but would be properly considered part of the results.
The basic organization of preparedness categories in the discussion (mobility assistance, social support, etc.) is a reasonable one, however.

paper_title: Advancing the activity cliff concept
paper_abstract: The activity cliff concept has experienced increasing interest in medicinal chemistry and chemoinformatics. Activity cliffs have originally been defined as pairs of structurally similar compounds that are active against the same target but have a large difference in potency. Activity cliffs are relevant for structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis and compound optimization because small chemical modifications can be deduced from cliffs that result in large-magnitude changes in potency. In addition to studying activity cliffs on the basis of individual compounds series, they can be systematically identified through mining of compound activity data. This commentary aims to provide a concise yet detailed picture of our current understanding of activity cliffs. It is also meant to introduce the further refined activity cliff concept to a general audience in drug development.
review_content:
This paper provides an overview of the concept of activity cliffs in structure-activity relationships and provides a number of examples of how the technique can be applied in a drug discovery setting. Activity cliffs can provide a means of better understanding the relationships between chemical structure and biological activity, as well as identifying regions of a molecule that are critical to activity. The review is directed toward the non-expert and should provide an adequate background for those unfamiliar with the topic. Those familiar with activity cliffs may want to consult more specialized reviews written by the same authors. This review is well-written, easy to follow, and provides many key references for those who would like to learn more about the topic.

The authors’ breakdown of the activity cliff concept into components will be helpful for those unfamiliar with the topic. It may be useful to point out that utilizing log differences in activity can make activity cliff scores more intuitive to chemists and biologists. Those with a limited knowledge of chemoinformatics will appreciate the discussion of fingerprint similarity. However, a figure might make these concepts even more clear. The authors' point out that "calculated fingerprint Tc values are often difficult to interpret from a medicinal chemistry point of view". In my experience, Tanimoto similarity typically makes sense, this sentence might be better as "calculated fingerprint Tc values are *sometimes* difficult to interpret". The authors mention matched molecular pairs (MMP) as a means of expressing molecular similarity.

In addition to references 12 and 13, it would be useful to include what I consider to be the seminal paper on matched molecular pairs.
Leach, A. G.; Jones, H. D.; Cosgrove, D. A.; Kenny, P. W.; Ruston,L.; MacFaul, P.; Wood, M.; Colclough, N.; Law, L. Matched Molecular Pairs as a Guide in the Optimization of Pharmaceutical Properties; A Study of Aqueous Solubility, Plasma Protein Binding and Oral Exposure. J. Med. Chem. 2006, 49, 6672–6682.

As chemists and biologists pursue more complex targets, it is necessary to increase the sophistication of our SAR analysis. I appreciate the fact that the authors point out how activity cliffs can also be used to examine multi-target activity relationships and links between sometimes-distant functional groups.

I agree with the authors' assessment that the activity cliff concept is underutilized in medicinal chemistry. Hopefully with the introduction of robust commercial software tools for the identification and exploitation of activity cliffs, the technique will be more widely used.

This review provides and excellent introduction to activity cliffs for those unfamiliar with the method. The paper is well referenced and will hopefully inspire a new group of users to continue to advance the method.
paper_title_zh: 推进活性悬崖概念
paper_abstract_zh: 活性悬崖概念在药物化学和化学信息学中引起了越来越多的关注。活性悬崖最初被定义为结构相似但针对同一靶标活性存在显著差异的化合物对。活性悬崖对于构效关系（SAR）分析和化合物优化具有重要意义，因为从悬崖中可以推断出小的化学修饰，这些修饰会导致活性发生大幅度的变化。除了基于单个化合物系列研究活性悬崖外，还可以通过挖掘化合物活性数据系统地识别它们。本文旨在提供一个简洁而详细的当前对活性悬崖理解的全貌。同时，也旨在向药物开发领域的普通读者介绍进一步细化的活性悬崖概念。
review_content_zh:
本文概述了结构-活性关系中活性悬崖的概念，并提供了一些在药物发现环境中应用该技术的实例。活性悬崖可以提供一种更好地理解化学结构与生物活性之间关系的方法，同时识别分子中对活性至关重要的区域。该综述面向非专家读者，应为不熟悉该主题的人提供足够的背景知识。熟悉活性悬崖的读者可能希望参考同一作者撰写的更专业的综述。这篇综述文笔流畅，易于理解，并为希望深入了解该主题的读者提供了许多关键参考文献。

作者将活性悬崖概念分解为各个组成部分，这对不熟悉该主题的读者将有所帮助。指出利用活性对数的差异可以使活性悬崖分数对化学家和生物学家更加直观，这可能是有益的。对化学信息学知识有限的读者将欣赏关于指纹相似性的讨论。然而，一幅图可能会使这些概念更加清晰。作者指出“计算的指纹Tc值通常难以从药物化学的角度解释”。根据我的经验，Tanimoto相似性通常是有意义的，这句话可能改为“计算的指纹Tc值*有时*难以解释”更为合适。作者提到匹配分子对（MMP）作为表达分子相似性的一种手段。

除了参考文献12和13外，还应包括我认为关于匹配分子对的奠基性论文。
Leach, A. G.; Jones, H. D.; Cosgrove, D. A.; Kenny, P. W.; Ruston, L.; MacFaul, P.; Wood, M.; Colclough, N.; Law, L. 匹配分子对作为优化药物性质的指南；水溶性、血浆蛋白结合和口服暴露的研究。J. Med. Chem. 2006, 49, 6672–6682.

随着化学家和生物学家追求更复杂的目标，有必要提高我们SAR分析的复杂性。我赞赏作者指出活性悬崖还可以用于研究多靶点活性关系以及有时相距较远的官能团之间的联系。

我同意作者的评估，即活性悬崖概念在药物化学中未被充分利用。希望随着用于识别和利用活性悬崖的强大商业软件工具的引入，该技术将得到更广泛的应用。

这篇综述为不熟悉该方法的读者提供了关于活性悬崖的出色介绍。该论文参考文献丰富，有望激励新一组用户继续推进该方法。

paper_title: A survey on modeling dynamic business processes
paper_abstract: Dynamic and flexible systems offer huge advantages for businesses in addressing dynamic uncertain factors and implementing dynamic business processes (DBP). However, DBP remains a challenge from the perspectives of modeling, simulation, and implementation because of a nontrivial understanding of "What is a dynamic business process?". A variety of approaches for DBP modeling and implementation have been proposed over the past years, yet few comprehensive studies analyzing DBP from different particular perspectives (e.g., business process (BP) variability, aspect oriented BP, service compositions, etc.) and research questions that lay the foundation for the development of a meaning of a DBP have been reported. The motivation behind this review is to examine DBP meaning from a global perspective and, consequently, answer the previously presented research question. Therefore, in this paper, we present a systematic literature review (SLR) comprised of 67 papers from five respective digital libraries, which index Computer Science (CS), Information Systems (IS), and Software Engineering (SE) journals and conference proceedings. Two points of view are analyzed in the selected papers. First, we observe the similarities and differences between the proposed approaches to DBP modeling and implementation. From these observations, we define six main requirements for DBP (DBPR). In addition, the comparison of the selected papers according to DBPR shows that most of the approaches analyzed limit BP dynamicity, since they use partially predefined BP models. Secondly, we analyze the papers based on a visualization perspective that shows the less explored areas as follows: more flexible process modeling approach and its implementation in IS should be developed; usage of historic data should be extended; domain knowledge usage, like goal-orientation, multi-criteria optimization, domain knowledge, artificial intelligence, etc., should be included and extended to ensure BP dynamicity. As such, this study makes important contributions and serves as a useful resource for future DBP studies and practice. Moreover, we expect that our results could inspire researchers and practitioners towards further work aimed at bringing forward the field of DBP modeling and implementation.
review_content: Reviewer 1 Thank you for your comments that significantly help us to improve our review. No. Reviewer‘s comments Authors‘ answers 1. Why the format of References’ citation differ? For example (Pesic & van der Aalst, 2006; Heinl et al., 1999) in Line 2020 and (2016b) in Line 203. We have improved all citations in text, as recommended in PeerJ Reference format style (https://peerj.com/about/author-instructions/cs). 2. Authors mention that ‘Due to technical limitations only free access sources were chosen’. Did the authors sent some requests to some authors of non-free access papers to obtain some interesting papers fruitful to the survey? Some requests were send. However, we have not get any answer. Some papers were found, but after detailed reading were not included into the review. The survey based mainly on the free accessed papers and papers accessed using our university account. 3. Authors mention that one of the main results obtained during the survey of the selected papers consists of analysis of tools for DBP modeling and simulation. Why the authors did not go in depth for this point to deal with modeling languages and standards that cover the DBP? This was not the main aim of the current study. Moreover, techniques are reviewed, like in (Ayora et al., 2015), instruments, mechanisms and languages, like in (Cognini et al., 2016). However, it is a good suggestion for the future works, since this study is large enough according to the existing resources limitations. 4. In Line 398, authors mention that they deal with surveys examining BP dynamicity from different perspectives. I am asking if these survey papers should be analysed different from non-survey papers? Or the same manner should be adopted? We have adopted the survey method proposed in (Ivarsson & Gorschek, 2011; Kitchenham, 2007; Kitchenham et al., 2009). The sentence “they deal with surveys examining BP dynamicity from different perspectives” means that different authors analyze BP dynamicity from various viewpoints, like variability (Rosa et al., 2017; Ayora et al., 2015); aspect-oriented (Pourshahid et al., 2012); service compositions (Kapuruge, Han & Colman, 2010); flexibility (Cognini et al., 2014; 2018); and declarative (Goedertier, Vanthienen & Caron, 2015). This survey tends to be more general study in the domain of BP dynamicity. Moreover, in this study, we are not going to compete with existing studies but to supplement them in terms of both time and the scale of their scope. 5. Authors mention briefly ‘process ontology’ but they do not compare proposed ontologies (richness and coverage). In the other hands, authors include context in the definition of DBP but do not enumerate how studied works deal with BP context (i.e, how they model and manage these contexts? Maybe by ontologies or other models?) In this survey, for us it was interesting to determine whether the studies described in the analyzed papers use an ontology and/or context to define DBP. However, we did not perform an analysis of whether context is expressed through an ontology, and what is the interdependence of context and ontology. In our view, a separate study is needed to address this issue. It is a good suggestion for the future works. 6. Same remarks applies for ‘rules’ We have not perform an interdependence analysis among the defined questions. Statistical analysis methods are not applied here as well. This question should be addressed in a separate review. 7. Also in the definition of DBP, authors mention that ‘changes can be implemented with minimal delay’. Did the authors focus on this issue when analyzing and/or comparing existing works? Our previous studies allow us to formulate the requirements of DBP (Vasilecas, O., Kalibatiene, D., & Lavbič, D. (2016). Rule-and context-based dynamic business process modelling and simulation. Journal of Systems and Software, 122, 1—15. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jss.2016.08.048), which include that “changes can be implemented with minimal delay”. However, in our study, we have not focused on this issue. Moreover, as we can say, the authors in the analyzed papers do not mention the delay at all. Thank you for the valuable comments and questions. However, if we delved so deeply into the questions asked, such a study would reflect a different approach and pursue a different aim, and such a study would require some more resources.
paper_title_zh: 动态业务流程建模综述
paper_abstract_zh: 动态和灵活的系统在应对动态不确定因素和实施动态业务流程（DBP）方面为商业提供了巨大优势。然而，由于对“什么是动态业务流程？”这一问题的理解并非简单，DBP在建模、仿真和实施方面仍然是一个挑战。过去几年中，已经提出了多种DBP建模和实施方法，但很少有综合研究从不同特定视角（例如，业务流程（BP）的可变性、面向方面的BP、服务组合等）分析DBP，以及为DBP意义发展奠定基础的研究问题。本次综述的动机是从全局视角审视DBP的意义，并由此回答之前提出的研究问题。因此，在本文中，我们呈现了一项系统文献综述（SLR），包含来自五个相关数字图书馆的67篇论文，这些图书馆索引了计算机科学（CS）、信息系统（IS）和软件工程（SE）的期刊和会议论文集。选定的论文中分析了两个观点。首先，我们观察了提出的DBP建模和实施方法之间的相似性和差异性。基于这些观察，我们定义了DBP的六个主要需求（DBPR）。此外，根据DBPR对选定论文的比较显示，大多数分析的方法限制了BP的动态性，因为它们使用了部分预定义的BP模型。其次，我们从可视化视角分析论文，揭示了较少探索的领域：应开发更灵活的流程建模方法及其在IS中的实施；应扩展历史数据的使用；应包括并扩展领域知识的使用，如目标导向、多标准优化、领域知识、人工智能等，以确保BP的动态性。因此，本研究做出了重要贡献，并为未来的DBP研究和实践提供了有用资源。此外，我们期望我们的结果能够激励研究人员和从业者进一步开展工作，以推进DBP建模和实施领域的发展。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1：感谢您的评论，这对我们改进综述非常有帮助。

序号 | 审稿人意见 | 作者回复
--- | --- | ---
1. | 为什么参考文献的引用格式不同？例如，第2020行的（Pesic & van der Aalst, 2006; Heinl et al., 1999）和第203行的（2016b）。 | 我们已根据PeerJ参考文献格式风格（https://peerj.com/about/author-instructions/cs）的建议，改进了所有文本中的引用。
2. | 作者提到“由于技术限制，只选择了免费访问的来源”。作者是否向非免费访问论文的作者发送了一些请求，以获取对综述有益的有趣论文？ | 我们确实发送了一些请求。然而，我们没有收到任何回复。虽然找到了一些论文，但在详细阅读后并未纳入综述。本综述主要基于免费访问的论文和通过我们大学账户访问的论文。
3. | 作者提到，综述所选论文的主要成果之一是对DBP建模和仿真工具的分析。为什么作者没有深入探讨这一点，涉及涵盖DBP的建模语言和标准？ | 这不是当前研究的主要目标。此外，我们综述了技术，如（Ayora et al., 2015）中的工具、机制和语言，如（Cognini et al., 2016）。然而，这是一个对未来工作的好建议，因为根据现有资源限制，这项研究已经足够庞大。
4. | 在第398行，作者提到他们处理从不同角度审视BP动态性的综述。我想问这些综述论文是否应该与非综述论文有不同的分析方法？还是应该采用相同的方法？ | 我们采用了（Ivarsson & Gorschek, 2011; Kitchenham, 2007; Kitchenham et al., 2009）中提出的综述方法。句子“他们处理从不同角度审视BP动态性的综述”意味着不同作者从各种视角分析BP动态性，如可变性（Rosa et al., 2017; Ayora et al., 2015）；面向方面（Pourshahid et al., 2012）；服务组合（Kapuruge, Han & Colman, 2010）；灵活性（Cognini et al., 2014; 2018）；以及声明式（Goedertier, Vanthienen & Caron, 2015）。本综述倾向于在BP动态性领域进行更普遍的研究。此外，在本次研究中，我们并非要与现有研究竞争，而是要在时间和范围尺度上补充它们。
5. | 作者简要提到“过程本体”，但没有比较所提出本体的丰富性和覆盖范围。另一方面，作者在DBP的定义中包含上下文，但没有列举所研究工作如何处理BP上下文（即，他们如何建模和管理这些上下文？也许通过本体或其他模型？） | 在本综述中，我们感兴趣的是确定所分析论文中描述的研究是否使用本体和/或上下文来定义DBP。然而，我们没有分析上下文是否通过本体表达，以及上下文和本体的相互依赖关系。我们认为需要单独的研究来解决这个问题。这是一个对未来工作的好建议。
6. | 同样的评论也适用于“规则”。 | 我们没有对定义的问题进行相互依赖分析。这里也没有应用统计分析方法。这个问题应在单独的综述中解决。
7. | 在DBP的定义中，作者提到“变化可以以最小延迟实施”。作者在分析和/或比较现有工作时是否关注了这一点？ | 我们之前的研究使我们能够制定DBP的要求（Vasilecas, O., Kalibatiene, D., & Lavbič, D. (2016). Rule-and context-based dynamic business process modelling and simulation. Journal of Systems and Software, 122, 1—15. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jss.2016.08.048），其中包括“变化可以以最小延迟实施”。然而，在本次研究中，我们没有关注这一点。此外，正如我们所说，所分析论文的作者根本没有提到延迟。

感谢您宝贵的评论和问题。然而，如果我们深入探讨所提出的问题，这样的研究将反映不同的方法和追求不同的目标，并且需要更多的资源。

paper_title: Exploring Sample Size Determination in Educational Research: A Comprehensive Review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     By conducting an in-depth study of the publications, a review was conducted with the goal of evaluating the sample size in educational research. The sample size, represented by the letter “n,” is a key factor in this research because it specifies the number of participants who represent the target population. Although various studies have been published in the literature defining the processes for calculating sample sizes, there is still much uncertainty. It is vital to understand that there is no single all-encompassing method for determining sample sizes for different study designs. Instead, different study designs call for different approaches to determine sample numbers. 
   
   
     Methods 
     Information was retrieved from the databases in accordance with updated PRISMA recommendations. The keywords used for the retrieval of the relevant articles from two databases (Google Scholar and PubMed). The articles were selected by thorough scrutiny and application of inclusion and exclusion criteria. 
   
   
     Results 
     Seven articles were selected and the comparison was made among the studies in the relation to methods, objective, and outcome from the enrolled studies. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     The evaluation of the seven studies as a whole concluded that the sample size for testing any novel approach essentially required 24.24 participants in each group. The median sample size for the simulation-based educational research was 30. Further research is required to determine the proper sample size based on a single universal formula for all types of designs.
review_content:
The general impression is that this paper is a collection of sentences about sample size calculations taken from different sources, assembled without a clear structure.
The authors stated at the end of the introduction that "the study was conducted with the aim of assessing the sample size in educational research". However, after carefully reading the paper the goal of this study remains unclear. Was the purpose to describe the best practices in sample size calculations for educational research and compare the current practices in the literature? If that was the goal, the authors should have first provided a clear and accessible description of how to determine the sample size (under the most relevant study designs) in educational research according to well-established statistical literature, and then made a comparison with the seven papers retrieved from the systematic review. However, the recommendations given in the conclusion are so general and vague to be of no practical use. For instance, the authors claimed that "Studies involving cluster randomization require a larger sample size and a complex method for calculations." So, how the sample size should be computed in randomized trials, a reader could ask? Another recommendation is "The sample size for conducting any new method basically required 24.24 members in each group.", which seems in contradiction with the statement given a few lines before "the sample [size] needed for a study is determined by a variety of variables, including the feasibility of the study, its power, the accuracy of the calculated value, its analytical relevance and confidence level, its ability to detect a clinically significant difference, and other factors, such as financial support, workforce, subject availability, and time."

Furthermore, the authors correctly stated in the introduction that "It is crucial to realize that there is no single universal formula for calculating the sample sizes for all study designs. Instead, different study designs require different methods to calculate sample sizes.", and then contradicted this statement in the conclusion, where they claimed that "Further, more research is needed for the appropriate sample size and universal single formula based on every study design.".

For these reasons, I cannot recommend this paper for approval. Furthermore, I kindly invite the authors to read the following references that provide useful guidelines on how to determine the sample size in the social sciences.
paper_title_zh: 探索教育研究中样本量确定的综合综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
通过对出版物进行深入研究，进行了一项旨在评估教育研究中样本量的综述。样本量，用字母“n”表示，是这项研究的关键因素，因为它指定了代表目标人群的参与者数量。尽管文献中已经发表了各种定义样本量计算过程的研究，但仍然存在许多不确定性。重要的是要理解，对于不同的研究设计，并没有一个单一的、全面的方法来确定样本量。相反，不同的研究设计需要不同的方法来确定样本数量。

方法
根据更新的PRISMA建议，从数据库中检索信息。使用关键词从两个数据库（Google Scholar和PubMed）检索相关文章。通过仔细审查和应用纳入和排除标准来选择文章。

结果
选择了七篇文章，并对入选研究的方法、目标和结果进行了比较。

结论
对这七项研究的整体评估得出结论，测试任何新方法所需的样本量在每个组中本质上需要24.24名参与者。基于模拟的教育研究中位样本量为30。需要进一步研究以确定基于单一通用公式适用于所有类型设计的适当样本量。
review_content_zh:
总体印象是，这篇论文是从不同来源摘录的关于样本量计算的句子集合，汇编时缺乏清晰的结构。

作者在引言末尾指出，“该研究的目的是评估教育研究中的样本量”。然而，仔细阅读论文后，该研究的目标仍然不明确。目的是描述教育研究中样本量计算的最佳实践并比较文献中的当前实践吗？如果是这样，作者首先应根据已确立的统计文献，清晰且易于理解地描述如何在教育研究中最相关的研究设计下确定样本量，然后再与从系统综述中检索到的七篇论文进行比较。然而，结论中给出的建议过于笼统和模糊，以至于没有实际用途。例如，作者声称“涉及聚类随机化的研究需要更大的样本量和复杂的计算方法。”那么，随机试验中样本量应如何计算，读者可能会问？另一条建议是“进行任何新方法的样本量基本上每组需要24.24名成员”，这似乎与几行前的陈述相矛盾：“研究的样本量[大小]由多种变量决定，包括研究的可行性、其效力、计算值的准确性、其分析相关性和置信水平、其检测临床显著差异的能力，以及其他因素，如财务支持、劳动力、受试者可用性和时间。”

此外，作者在引言中正确地指出：“至关重要的是要认识到，没有单一的通用公式可以计算所有研究设计的样本量。相反，不同的研究设计需要不同的方法来计算样本量。”然而，在结论中，他们又自相矛盾地声称：“此外，需要更多研究来确定适当的样本量和基于每种研究设计的通用单一公式。”

基于这些原因，我不能推荐这篇论文获得批准。此外，我诚挚地邀请作者阅读以下参考文献，这些文献提供了关于如何在社会科学中确定样本量的有用指南。

paper_title: Review of the nutritional composition, medicinal, phytochemical and pharmacological properties of Citrus reticulata Blanco (Rutaceae)
paper_abstract: Citrus reticulata Blanco is a moderately-sized fruit tree widely used as herbal medicine worldwide. The nutritional composition, medicinal uses, phytochemistry and pharmacological properties of C. reticulata were critically reviewed in the current study. The literature linked to C. reticulata properties was obtained from multiple internet sources including Elsevier, Google Scholar, SciFinder, Web of Science, Pubmed, BMC, Science Direct, and Scopus. Ethnopharmacological research identified antioxidants such as vitamin C, carotenoids and phenolic compounds, also a source of sugars, organic acids, amino acids, pectins, minerals and volatile organic compounds as components of C. reticulata . As a medicinal plant, C. reticulata is used for the treatment of dyspepsia, gastro-intestinal distension, cough with profuse phlegm, hiccup and vomiting. The crude extracts of C. reticulata fruits have depicted anti-inflammatory, anticholesterolemic, analgesic, antiasthmatic, antiscorbutic, antiseptic, antitussive, carminative, expectorant, stomachic. With more people becoming nutrition-conscious, there has been an increase in the demand for the use of citrus fruits and their by-products as traditional medicines for conventional healthcare in developing countries.
review_content:
The article is well written for the purpose intended. All the subject matter namely nutritional composition, medicinal, phytochemical and pharmacological properties as highlighted in the title of this article has been adequately reviewed and cited.

Secondary metabolites in plants are of major interest and are often taught in plant biochemistry courses. The content of secondary metabolites differ in different plant species and the use of such plant phytochemical for various purposes such as antibacterial, antimicrobial, anti cancer, anti-inflammatory etc, also differ among the plant species. This paper provides a comprehensive outlook and will be a good specimen to demonstrate the types of secondary metabolites present and its bioactive compounds in relation to pharmacological activities. The article can be a one stop reference on the properties of Citrus reticulata up to 2020.

Just a few minor typos are present, which are highlighted here.

paper_title: From Identifiable Causal Representations to Controllable Counterfactual Generation: A Survey on Causal Generative Modeling
paper_abstract: Deep generative models have shown tremendous capability in data density estimation and data generation from finite samples. While these models have shown impressive performance by learning correlations among features in the data, some fundamental shortcomings are their lack of explainability, tendency to induce spurious correlations, and poor out-of-distribution extrapolation. To remedy such challenges, recent work has proposed a shift toward causal generative models. Causal models offer several beneficial properties to deep generative models, such as distribution shift robustness, fairness, and interpretability. Structural causal models (SCMs) describe data-generating processes and model complex causal relationships and mechanisms among variables in a system. Thus, SCMs can naturally be combined with deep generative models. We provide a technical survey on causal generative modeling categorized into causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation methods. We focus on fundamental theory, methodology, drawbacks, datasets, and metrics. Then, we cover applications of causal generative models in fairness, privacy, out-of-distribution generalization, precision medicine, and biological sciences. Lastly, we discuss open problems and fruitful research directions for future work in the field.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper provides a thorough and insightful technical survey on causal generative modeling, specifically focusing on causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation methods. The contributions are as follows: 1. The author categorizes causal generative modeling into identifiable causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation tasks. A detailed classification of causal representation learning methods based on Pearl's Causal Hierarchy is provided, along with a breakdown of controllable generation approaches by the type of generative model used. 2. This paper discusses evaluation metrics, benchmark datasets, and results for causal generative models.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: 1. The author effectively categorizes causal generative modeling, offering clarity on identifiable causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation. 2. The paper demonstrates a strong understanding of causal representation learning by organizing methods and providing a comprehensive discussion on evaluation metrics, datasets, and results. Weaknesses: 1. The authors did not list the existing datasets in full. Many of the referenced papers include some datasets. Including these datasets in the paper would make the survey more comprehensive. 2. Causal generative modeling is also employed to address issues related to learning causal relationships among observed variables, why do the authors only focus on the causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation? Moreover, it would be better to provide the relationship between causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation. 3. There are also some works on using generative models to address causal representation learning that have not been included in the paper, such as LEAP[1], TDRL[2], and so on. [1] Yao, Weiran, et al. "Learning Temporally Causal Latent Processes from General Temporal Data." International Conference on Learning Representations. 2021. [2] Yao, Weiran, Guangyi Chen, and Kun Zhang. "Temporally disentangled representation learning." Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems 35 (2022): 26492-26503. 4. Although a symbol table is provided in the paper, there is some inconsistency in the use of symbols. For instance, in Figure 7, "A" is used to represent a variable, while in Equation 34, "A" is used to denote the causal adjacency matrix. This could lead to confusion in understanding.

**Requested Changes:**
See the weaknesses above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
Not applicable.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer A2sk: We thank the reviewer for the detailed feedback in the weakness section to improve our survey. We have incorporated your feedback and requested changes with $\textbf{color code red}$ in the revised version. We answer your concerns in the order listed in the Weaknesses section: 1. We have now included more datasets from the papers for completeness and have included a table showing which methods experiment on each dataset $\textbf{(Table 4)}$. We have also split the datasets into synthetic image, real-world image, temporal video, and biological/medical categories $\textbf{(Section 6)}$. We also mention a synthetic non-visual dataset generated from sampled random graphs (Erdos-Renyi random graph model) often used for CRL experiments. 2. In this survey, we focus our attention on causal representation learning and counterfactual generation due to recent research focusing on modeling underlying data-generating processes of high dimensional data. We do not focus on causal structure learning as it is a parallel effort. Other surveys thoroughly cover the landscape of causal discovery, including those methods that utilize generative models (Vowels et al, 2021). Regarding the relationship between causal representation learning and controllable counterfactual generation, we have added a paragraph describing their similarities and differences in the introduction. 3. We thank the reviewer for pointing out the temporal disentanglement works in the observational setting. We have now included these in the observational CRL section of our survey $\textbf{(Section 3.3)}$. Further, we have also included some more recent work in the observational and interventional paradigms of causal representation learning for completeness (please see global comment for full list). $\textbf{Table 1}$ has been updated accordingly. 4. We have revised our manuscript to ensure consistency of notation as much as possible. (Vowels et al, 2021) Matthew J Vowels, Necati Cihan Camgoz, and Richard Bowden. D’ya like dags? a survey on structure learning and causal discovery. arXiv preprint arXiv:2103.02582, 2021.
paper_title_zh: 从可识别的因果表示到可控的反事实生成：因果生成建模综述
paper_abstract_zh: 深度生成模型在数据密度估计和从有限样本中进行数据生成方面展现了巨大的能力。尽管这些模型通过学习数据中特征之间的相关性表现出令人印象深刻的性能，但它们存在一些根本性的不足，如缺乏可解释性、倾向于诱导虚假相关性以及较差的分布外外推能力。为了解决这些挑战，近期的研究提出了向因果生成模型的转变。因果模型为深度生成模型提供了多种有益属性，例如分布偏移鲁棒性、公平性和可解释性。结构因果模型（SCMs）描述了数据生成过程，并模拟了系统中变量之间的复杂因果关系和机制。因此，SCMs可以自然地与深度生成模型结合。我们提供了一份关于因果生成建模的技术综述，将其分类为因果表示学习和可控反事实生成方法。我们重点关注基本理论、方法论、缺点、数据集和指标。然后，我们涵盖了因果生成模型在公平性、隐私、分布外泛化、精准医疗和生物科学中的应用。最后，我们讨论了该领域未来工作的开放问题和富有成效的研究方向。

paper_title: Remote sensing techniques for automated marine mammals detection: a review of methods and current challenges
paper_abstract: Marine mammals are under pressure from multiple threats, such as global climate change, bycatch, and vessel collisions. In this context, more frequent and spatially extensive surveys for abundance and distribution studies are necessary to inform conservation efforts. Marine mammal surveys have been performed visually from land, ships, and aircraft. These methods can be costly, logistically challenging in remote locations, dangerous to researchers, and disturbing to the animals. The growing use of imagery from satellite and unoccupied aerial systems (UAS) can help address some of these challenges, complementing crewed surveys and allowing for more frequent and evenly distributed surveys, especially for remote locations. However, manual counts in satellite and UAS imagery remain time and labor intensive, but the automation of image analyses offers promising solutions. Here, we reviewed the literature for automated methods applied to detect marine mammals in satellite and UAS imagery. The performance of studies is quantitatively compared with metrics that evaluate false positives and false negatives from automated detection against manual counts of animals, which allows for a better assessment of the impact of miscounts in conservation contexts. In general, methods that relied solely on statistical differences in the spectral responses of animals and their surroundings performed worse than studies that used convolutional neural networks (CNN). Despite mixed results, CNN showed promise, and its use and evaluation should continue. Overall, while automation can reduce time and labor, more research is needed to improve the accuracy of automated counts. With the current state of knowledge, it is best to use semi-automated approaches that involve user revision of the output. These approaches currently enable the best tradeoff between time effort and detection accuracy.

paper_abstract_zh: 海洋哺乳动物正面临多重威胁，如全球气候变化、副渔获物和船只碰撞。在这种情况下，为支持保护工作，更频繁且空间范围更广的丰度和分布研究调查是必要的。海洋哺乳动物的调查通常通过陆地、船只和飞机进行目视观察。这些方法可能成本高昂，在偏远地区后勤困难，对研究人员存在危险，且可能干扰动物。卫星和无人物理系统（UAS）图像的日益使用有助于解决这些挑战，补充有人参与的调查，并允许更频繁且均匀分布的调查，尤其是在偏远地区。然而，卫星和UAS图像中的手动计数仍然耗时且费力，但图像分析的自动化提供了有前景的解决方案。本文综述了应用于检测卫星和UAS图像中海洋哺乳动物的自动化方法文献。通过定量比较研究性能，使用评估自动化检测与动物手动计数之间的假阳性和假阴性的指标，这有助于更好地评估误计数在保护背景下的影响。总体而言，仅依赖动物及其周围环境光谱响应统计差异的方法表现不如使用卷积神经网络（CNN）的研究。尽管结果不一，CNN显示出潜力，其使用和评估应继续进行。总体而言，虽然自动化可以减少时间和劳力，但仍需更多研究以提高自动化计数的准确性。根据当前的知识水平，最佳做法是使用涉及用户修订输出的半自动化方法。这些方法目前能够在时间投入和检测准确性之间实现最佳平衡。

paper_title: Neurocognitive endophenotypes in CGG KI and Fmr1 KO mouse models of Fragile X-Associated disorders: an analysis of the state of the field
paper_abstract: It has become increasingly important that the field of behavioral genetics identifies not only the gross behavioral phenotypes associated with a given mutation, but also the behavioral endophenotypes that scale with the dosage of the particular mutation being studied. Over the past few years, studies evaluating the effects of the polymorphic CGG trinucleotide repeat on the FMR1 gene underlying Fragile X-Associated Disorders have reported preliminary evidence for a behavioral endophenotype in human Fragile X Premutation carrier populations as well as the CGG knock-in (KI) mouse model. More recently, the behavioral experiments used to test the CGG KI mouse model have been extended to the Fmr1 knock-out (KO) mouse model. When combined, these data provide compelling evidence for a clear neurocognitive endophenotype in the mouse models of Fragile X-Associated Disorders such that behavioral deficits scale predictably with genetic dosage. Similarly, it appears that the CGG KI mouse effectively models the histopathology in Fragile X-Associated Disorders across CGG repeats well into the full mutation range, resulting in a reliable histopathological endophenotype. These endophenotypes may influence future research directions into treatment strategies for not only Fragile X Syndrome, but also the Fragile X Premutation and Fragile X-Associated Tremor/Ataxia Syndrome (FXTAS).
review_content:
This is a well written review on an important topic. Fmr1 knock-out mice have been used as a best approximation of a genetically accurate model of fragile X syndrome, despite the fact that the patients have a tandem repeat expansion rather than a null mutation. The systematic comparison of knock-in and knock-out Fmr1 mice is important not just for our understanding of fragile X syndrome, FXTAS and related disorders, but also for the role of this fascinating tandem repeat polymorphism in healthy brain development and cognitive function. Whilst the maintenance of very long tandem repeat mutations in mouse lines has been a technical challenge (particularly for fragile X syndrome), this can no doubt be overcome so that such tandem repeat disorders are modeled with optimal genetic construct validity.

The article summarises and integrates a large body of data. The integration of cognitive endophenotypes with information on cellular and molecular mechanisms is informative. I think it is a useful addition to the literature on tandem repeat polymorphisms and associated disorders, and their effects on the healthy and diseased brain.
paper_title_zh: 脆性X相关障碍的CGG KI和Fmr1 KO小鼠模型中的神经认知内表型：领域现状分析
paper_abstract_zh: 行为遗传学领域越来越需要识别的不仅是与特定突变相关的大体行为表型，还包括与所研究突变剂量成比例的行为内表型。在过去的几年里，评估多态性CGG三核苷酸重复对脆性X相关障碍中FMR1基因影响的研究报告了初步证据，表明在人类脆性X前突变携带者群体以及CGG敲入（KI）小鼠模型中存在行为内表型。最近，用于测试CGG KI小鼠模型的行为实验已扩展到Fmr1敲除（KO）小鼠模型。综合这些数据，为脆性X相关障碍小鼠模型中存在明确的神经认知内表型提供了有力证据，即行为缺陷与基因剂量成可预测的比例。同样，CGG KI小鼠似乎有效模拟了脆性X相关障碍中跨越CGG重复直至完全突变范围的病理组织学，从而形成了一个可靠的病理组织学内表型。这些内表型可能会影响未来对脆性X综合征、脆性X前突变以及脆性X相关震颤/共济失调综合征（FXTAS）治疗策略的研究方向。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于重要主题的写得很好的综述。尽管患者具有串联重复扩展而非无效突变，Fmr1基因敲除小鼠仍被用作脆性X综合征遗传学准确模型的最佳近似。系统地比较Fmr1基因敲入和敲除小鼠，不仅对我们理解脆性X综合征、FXTAS及相关疾病至关重要，而且对于这一引人注目的串联重复多态性在健康脑发育和认知功能中的作用也具有重要意义。尽管在鼠系中维持非常长的串联重复突变一直是一个技术挑战（尤其是对于脆性X综合征），但这无疑是可以克服的，以便以最佳的遗传结构效度模拟此类串联重复疾病。

文章总结并整合了大量数据。将认知内表型与细胞和分子机制的信息相结合，具有启发性。我认为这是对串联重复多态性及相关疾病文献的有益补充，以及它们对健康和疾病大脑的影响。

The integration of cognitive endophenotypes with information on cellular and molecular mechanisms is informative.
I think it is a useful addition to the literature on tandem repeat polymorphisms and associated disorders, and their effects on the healthy and diseased brain.

Whilst the maintenance of very long tandem repeat mutations in mouse lines has been a technical challenge (particularly for fragile X syndrome), this can no doubt be overcome so that such tandem repeat disorders are modeled with optimal genetic construct validity.
I think it is a useful addition to the literature on tandem repeat polymorphisms and associated disorders, and their effects on the healthy and diseased brain.
This is a well written review on an important topic.

paper_title: Risk factors for premature coronary artery disease (PCAD) in adults: a systematic review protocol
paper_abstract:
PCAD possesses a public health challenge resulting in years of productive life lost and an escalating burden on health systems. Objective of this review is to compare modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors for PCAD compared to those without PCAD. This review will include all comparative observational studies conducted in adults aged > 18 years with confirmed diagnosis of PCAD (on angiography) compared to those without PCAD. Databases to be searched include; PubMed, CINAHL, Embase, Web of Science, and grey literature (Google Scholar). All identified studies will be screened for title and abstract and full-text against the inclusion criteria on Covidence software. Data relevant to exposures and outcomes will be extracted from all included studies. All studies selected for data extraction will be critically appraised for methodological quality. Meta-analysis using random-effects model will be performed using Review Manager 5.3. Effect sizes for categorical risk factors will be expressed as odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals. For risk factors measured in continuous form, mean difference (if units are consistent) otherwise standardized mean difference (if units are different across studies) will be reported. Heterogeneity between 
studies will be assessed using I 2 test statistics. GRADE will be used to assess the certainty of the findings. 
 
 Systematic review registration number:  PROSPERO Registration # CRD42020173216
review_content:
Summary:
It is a study protocol of a systematic review to assess the risk factors for premature coronary artery disease (PCAD) in adults. Understanding modifiable and non-modifiable risk factors is critical for preventing morbidity and mortality from PCAD. All major risk factors, both modifiable and non-modifiable, have not been thoroughly investigated in previous systematic reviews among patients with PCAD. They either included specific risk factors for PCAD, targeted specific subgroups, or were limited to a single country. There has been no comprehensive appraisal of the evidence to date, despite the fact that there have been a number of published observational studies on PCAD risk factors, a comprehensive systematic review of the evidence is lacking. The findings of this systematic review will contribute to existing scientific knowledge and inform current clinical practice guidelines.

Comments:
Data Synthesis:
1. The authors have mentioned that for dichotomous variables odds ratio will be reported, however odds ratio may not be applicable for cohort studies and cross sectional studies for which the appropriate measures of association are relative risk and prevalence ratio respectively.
2. The authors have mentioned in the title that it will be a systematic review, however in the methodology they have mentioned they will perform meta-analysis. Please make it consistent with the title.
paper_title_zh: 成年人早发性冠状动脉疾病（PCAD）的危险因素：系统综述方案
paper_abstract_zh:
PCAD构成一项公共卫生挑战，导致生产性寿命年数的损失，并对卫生系统造成日益加重的负担。本综述的目的是比较PCAD患者与无PCAD人群的可修改和不可修改风险因素。本综述将包括所有在年龄大于18岁的成年人中进行的比较性观察研究，这些研究对象经血管造影确诊为PCAD，并与无PCAD人群进行比较。将检索的数据库包括：PubMed、CINAHL、Embase、Web of Science以及灰色文献（Google Scholar）。所有识别出的研究将通过Covidence软件进行标题和摘要的筛选，以及全文对照纳入标准进行筛选。将从所有纳入的研究中提取与暴露和结果相关的数据。所有选入数据提取的研究将对其方法学质量进行严格评估。使用Review Manager 5.3进行随机效应模型的Meta分析。分类风险因素的效应大小将以优势比及其95%置信区间表示。对于以连续形式测量的风险因素，若单位一致则报告均值差，若单位在不同研究间不一致则报告标准化均值差。研究间的异质性将通过I²检验统计量进行评估。将使用GRADE评估研究结果的确定性。

系统综述注册号：PROSPERO注册号# CRD42020173216
review_content_zh:
摘要：
这是一项系统评价的研究方案，旨在评估成人早发性冠状动脉疾病（PCAD）的风险因素。了解可修改和不可修改的风险因素对于预防PCAD引起的发病率和死亡率至关重要。在以往针对PCAD患者的系统评价中，所有主要风险因素（包括可修改和不可修改的）尚未得到彻底研究。它们要么仅包括特定风险因素，要么针对特定亚组，或仅限于单一国家。尽管已有大量关于PCAD风险因素的观察性研究发表，但至今仍缺乏对证据的全面评估。这项系统评价的发现将有助于现有科学知识的积累，并为当前的临床实践指南提供信息。

评论：
数据合成：
1. 作者提到对于二元变量将报告优势比，然而优势比可能不适用于队列研究和横断面研究，对于这些研究，适当的关联度量分别是相对风险和患病率比。
2. 作者在标题中提到这将是一项系统评价，然而在方法学部分他们提到将进行Meta分析。请与标题保持一致。

Please make it consistent with the title.

Please make it consistent with the title.

paper_title:
Post-sphincterotomy
bleeding: fully-covered metal stents for hemostasis
paper_abstract:
Background/objectives : In endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography,
post-sphincterotomy bleeding (PSB) is a common complication of biliary
sphincterotomy. Recently, the temporary placement of fully-covered metal stents
(FCMS) into the biliary tree in order to achieve a tamponade effect has been
described as an additional therapeutic option for PSB. The aim of this article
is to review the literature on FCMS for hemostasis in PSB and update the
treatment algorithm for this complication.  Methods : A PubMed literature search
was conducted using the search terms post-sphincterotomy, bleeding, and stent. 33
articles were reviewed, along with their references, and four were found to
describe the use of FCMS for hemostasis in PSB.  Results : A total of 21 patient cases
were described in the four articles. All patients received FCMS for PSB
hemostasis following the application and subsequent failure of traditional
therapies (conventional pharmacologic injection, thermal or electrocoagulation,
and mechanical therapy (balloon tamponade or endoclip)). Successful hemostasis was
achieved in all patients through FCMS placement. No major complications were
observed.    Conclusion : These 21 cases demonstrate
that FCMS are a viable therapeutic option for PSB.  It is reasonable to consider stent placement for
patients in which traditional interventions fail in order to avoid the need for
angiographic or surgical hemostasis.
review_content: The article provides a precise review of a "salvage" technique for refractory post-sphincterotomy bleeding, the discussion underlines the pro and cons of the technique, and the article can be useful for the endoscopic community.
paper_title_zh: 括约肌切开术后出血：全覆膜金属支架用于止血
paper_abstract_zh: 背景/目的：在内镜逆行胰胆管造影中，括约肌切开术后出血（PSB）是胆道括约肌切开的常见并发症。近期，将全覆膜金属支架（FCMS）临时置入胆道以实现止血效果的描述已成为PSB的额外治疗选择。本文旨在回顾关于FCMS在PSB止血中的文献，并更新这一并发症的治疗算法。方法：通过PubMed数据库使用关键词“括约肌切开术后”、“出血”和“支架”进行文献检索。共回顾了33篇文章及其参考文献，其中有4篇描述了FCMS在PSB止血中的应用。结果：四篇文章中共描述了21例患者的病例。所有患者在传统治疗（常规药物注射、热或电凝以及机械治疗（球囊压迫或内镜夹））应用并失败后，接受了FCMS进行PSB止血。通过FCMS置入，所有患者均成功止血，未观察到重大并发症。结论：这21例病例表明，FCMS是PSB的一种可行治疗选择。对于传统干预失败的患者，考虑支架置入是合理的，以避免需要血管造影或手术止血。
review_content_zh: 该文章对一种治疗难治性括约肌切开术后出血的“挽救”技术进行了精确的综述，讨论突出了该技术的优缺点，对内镜学领域具有实用价值。

reasons: The article provides a precise review of a "salvage" technique for refractory post-sphincterotomy bleeding, the discussion underlines the pro and cons of the technique, and the article can be useful for the endoscopic community.

paper_title: Prevalence of stress and its relevance on psychological well-being of the teaching profession:  A scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Well-being among teachers contributes toward quality work and better student support. Teachers’ well-being persists to be a concern in school settings; there is a lacuna in understanding the concept of well-being among them. This scoping review identifies the stress factors and map their association with the psychological well-being of teachers employed in schools. Additionally, to identify the methodology and the interventions used in reducing teachers’ stress and their relevance on their psychological well-being. 
  
  
    Methods 
    First, Pubmed, Web of Science, and Scopus databases were searched for eligible studies with MeSH terms for stress factors, well-being, and teachers from 2010 to 2022. Identified studies were screened thoroughly and excluded or included based on prior established criteria. Data from the included studies were extracted and summarized according to the study protocol. 
  
  
    Results 
    Among the 60 studies that met our inclusion criteria, the majority were quantitative, with cross-sectional studies. Several studies focused on emotional exhaustion, depersonalization, and diminished personal accomplishment aspect among teachers. Almost half of the included studies focused on organizational and social pressures such as administration workload, classroom management issues, lack of supervisor and team support, students’ behaviour, and pressure from parents. The most used interventions to overcome stress were coping strategies and mindfulness training intervention tools. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    The findings from the current scoping review will reveal the different stressors which impact psychological well-being. Focus on the most used interventions to overcome stress among schoolteachers. This will also provide recommendations to regulators and management to identify the factors causing stress among teachers and their relevance to their psychological well-being, overcome employee turnover and absenteeism issues. Also, different alternatives available to reduce the stress may benefit the stakeholders and policymakers to confirm a suitable intervention that will benefit the teaching profession.
review_content:
Review for the paper:
Prevalence of stress and its relevance on the psychological well-being of the teaching profession: A scoping review
  * The review covers the period between 2010 to 2022.
  * Although the title implies all the teaching professions, the study sample includes only school teachers.
  * The study scope is well-defined, identifying the stress factors and the interventions/measures followed to overcome the stress in the teaching profession.
  * The criteria for selecting the sample and the exclusion was well defined.
  * I believe the topic of the study is significant as it takes the school teachers as a sample, and the procedures used are suitable for this kind of study.
  * The statistics and layout of the results clarify the scope of the study.
  * The discussion includes increased research in the field (from three countries), theoretical perspective and stress intervention.
  * The authors clearly clarify the limitations of the study.
  * The conclusion: The paper identifies the benefit of higher psychological well-being of the teachers' profession. Also, they stress that the study results help managers working in consultancies and organisations think and apply the intervention better to harmonise our real drivers of the education sector.
  * It seems that the English language may need revision.
  * Finally, this paper is critical and worth for approving, as it touches on an essential societal profession. The scientific procedure followed in this study is well-defined and appropriate for such a study.
paper_title_zh: 压力的普遍性及其对教师职业心理健康的相关性：范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
教师福祉有助于高质量工作和对学生的更好支持。教师的福祉在学校环境中持续受到关注；对教师福祉概念的理解存在空白。本范围综述识别了学校教师的压力因素，并绘制了这些因素与教师心理福祉之间关联的图谱。此外，旨在识别用于减轻教师压力的方法论和干预措施，以及这些措施对教师心理福祉的相关性。

方法
首先，在PubMed、Web of Science和Scopus数据库中搜索2010年至2022年间符合条件的研究，使用MeSH术语检索压力因素、福祉和教师相关研究。识别出的研究经过彻底筛选，根据预先设定的标准进行排除或纳入。从纳入的研究中提取数据，并根据研究方案进行总结。

结果
在符合我们纳入标准的60项研究中，大多数为定量研究，以横断面研究为主。几项研究关注教师的情感耗竭、去人格化和个人成就感降低方面。几乎一半的纳入研究关注组织和社交压力，如行政工作负担、课堂管理问题、缺乏上级和团队支持、学生行为以及来自家长的压力。最常用于克服压力的干预措施是应对策略和正念训练干预工具。

结论
当前范围综述的发现将揭示影响心理福祉的不同压力源。重点关注学校教师中最常用于克服压力的干预措施。这还将为监管者和管理层提供建议，以识别导致教师压力的因素及其与心理福祉的相关性，克服员工流失和缺勤问题。此外，减少压力的不同替代方案可能使利益相关者和政策制定者受益，以确定适合教学职业的干预措施。

paper_title: Rates and predictors of data and code sharing in the medical and health sciences: Protocol for a systematic review and individual participant data meta-analysis.
paper_abstract: Numerous studies have demonstrated low but increasing rates of data and code sharing within medical and health research disciplines. However, it remains unclear how commonly data and code are shared across all fields of medical and health research, as well as whether sharing rates are positively associated with implementation of progressive policies by publishers and funders, or growing expectations from the medical and health research community at large. Therefore this systematic review aims to synthesise the findings of medical and health science studies that have empirically investigated the prevalence of data or code sharing, or both. Objectives include the investigation of: (i) the prevalence of public sharing of research data and code alongside published articles (including preprints), (ii) the prevalence of private sharing of research data and code in response to reasonable requests, and (iii) factors associated with the sharing of either research output (e.g., the year published, the publisher’s policy on sharing, the presence of a data or code availability statement). It is hoped that the results will provide some insight into how often research data and code are shared publicly and privately, how this has changed over time, and how effective some measures such as the institution of data sharing policies and data availability statements have been in motivating researchers to share their underlying data and code.
review_content:
This proposal describes a meta-analysis of studies of data and code sharing in medical and health sciences.
  * There is a vast difference in the utility of available data uploaded via scanned pdf and available data in a csv file (or other software-neutral format), I would argue that csv data “available upon request” is more accessible than publicly available scanned pdfs containing data that will likely have to be re-entered by hand in order to be used. The authors might consider/measure data accessibility in addition to availability.
  * Is there a reason for not confirming private availability in the same/similar way to public availability?
  * Given the variety of search terms that could be used and non-standardized ways that journals operate and format manuscripts, would a secondary search strategy employing humans potentially capture additional candidate studies?
  * How will the authors handle data accessibility if the accessible data are synthetic? (E.g. when data cannot be made public due to private health info, some authors may choose to mimic important data features by providing synthetic data that will result in similar research results as the primary data)
  * Will any attention be given to whether code that is available is in a format that can be read by open source software (e.g. Python, R) vs. making code available that can only be read with purchased software (e.g. SAS, SPSS)? Is code that someone needs to buy software to use really “open”?
  * The secondary outcomes are all for the data sharing and not for the code sharing; would similar secondary outcome measures for code sharing be useful as well? Journals are unlikely to have code sharing policy (in my experience) but perhaps sharing of code increases with an open data policy. It seems logical that researchers who share data might be more inclined to share code as well.
  * We found that researchers are more likely to share data and code when funders and employers require these things in public health (Harris et al. (20181)). The authors are collecting funder policy on data (typo in data collection form lists “date” instead of “data”) but not employer. Adding employer may provide some additional insight into why certain papers have available data/code.
paper_title_zh: 医学与健康科学中数据与代码共享的比率及预测因素：系统综述与个体参与者数据元分析的方案
paper_abstract_zh: 众多研究已证明在医学和健康研究领域，数据和代码共享的比例虽低但呈上升趋势。然而，尚不清楚在所有医学和健康研究领域中，数据和代码共享的普遍程度，以及共享比例是否与出版商和资助者实施的渐进政策，或医学和健康研究界日益增长的期望呈正相关。因此，本系统综述旨在综合医学和健康科学研究中实证调查数据和代码共享普遍性的发现。研究目标包括调查：(一) 在已发表文章（包括预印本）旁公开共享研究数据和代码的普遍性，(二) 在合理请求下私下共享研究数据和代码的普遍性，以及(三) 与共享任一研究产出相关的因素（例如，发表年份、出版商的共享政策、数据或代码可用性声明的存在）。希望研究结果能提供一些见解，了解研究数据和代码公开和私下共享的频率、随时间的变化情况，以及诸如实施数据共享政策和数据可用性声明等措施在激励研究人员共享其基础数据和代码方面的有效性。
review_content_zh:
该提案描述了对医学和健康科学领域中数据和代码共享研究的元分析。
  * 通过扫描的pdf上传的可用数据与csv文件（或其他软件中性格式）中的可用数据在实用性上有巨大差异，我认为“可应要求提供”的csv数据比公开可用的包含数据的扫描pdf更易获取。作者可能需要考虑/衡量数据的可获取性，而不仅仅是可用性。
  * 是否有理由不确认私人可用性与公共可用性以相同/相似的方式进行？
  * 考虑到可能使用的搜索术语的多样性以及期刊操作和格式化手稿的非标准化方式，采用人类参与的二次搜索策略是否可能捕获额外的候选研究？
  * 如果可获取的数据是合成的，作者将如何处理数据可获取性？（例如，当数据因包含私人健康信息而不能公开时，一些作者可能选择通过提供合成数据来模拟重要数据特征，从而得出与原始数据相似的研究结果）
  * 是否会关注可用代码的格式是否可由开源软件（如Python、R）读取，而不是仅能通过购买软件（如SAS、SPSS）读取的代码？需要购买软件才能使用的代码是否真的“开放”？
  * 次要结果都是针对数据共享而非代码共享；类似的针对代码共享的次要结果测量是否也有用？据我的经验，期刊不太可能有代码共享政策，但或许随着开放数据政策的实施，代码共享也会增加。逻辑上，共享数据的研究者可能也更倾向于共享代码。
  * 我们发现，当资助者和雇主在公共卫生领域要求这些事项时，研究者更可能共享数据和代码（Harris等人，20181）。作者正在收集资助者对数据（数据收集表中的错别字将“data”列为了“date”）的政策，但不包括雇主。增加雇主信息可能为某些论文具有可用数据和代码的原因提供额外见解。

reasons: Given the variety of search terms that could be used and non-standardized ways that journals operate and format manuscripts, would a secondary search strategy employing humans potentially capture additional candidate studies?

There is a vast difference in the utility of available data uploaded via scanned pdf and available data in a csv file (or other software-neutral format), I would argue that csv data “available upon request” is more accessible than publicly available scanned pdfs containing data that will likely have to be re-entered by hand in order to be used.
The authors might consider/measure data accessibility in addition to availability.
Is there a reason for not confirming private availability in the same/similar way to public availability?

Given the variety of search terms that could be used and non-standardized ways that journals operate and format manuscripts, would a secondary search strategy employing humans potentially capture additional candidate studies?
How will the authors handle data accessibility if the accessible data are synthetic?

Will any attention be given to whether code that is available is in a format that can be read by open source software (e.g. Python, R) vs. making code available that can only be read with purchased software (e.g. SAS, SPSS)?
Is code that someone needs to buy software to use really “open”?

Adding employer may provide some additional insight into why certain papers have available data/code.

paper_title: The product science of electrically heated tobacco products: a narrative review of the scientific literature
paper_abstract:
Heated tobacco products represent a novel category of tobacco products in which a tobacco consumable is heated to a temperature that releases nicotine from the tobacco leaf but not to a temperature sufficient to cause combustion. Heated tobacco products may therefore have the potential to be a less harmful alternative for adult smokers that would otherwise continue to smoke conventional cigarettes. Given the rapid development of this product category, the aim of this review was to examine the available peer-reviewed scientific evidence related to heated tobacco products and highlight any research gaps. 
In recent years, manufacturers of heated tobacco products have published a number of studies on their respective heated tobacco products. Whilst there is limited research that is independent of commercial interests, the available scientific evidence indicates that heated tobacco products produce a much simpler aerosol than conventional cigarette smoke, with fewer and substantially lower levels of harmful toxicants. Toxicology assessments indicate these reductions in aerosol toxicants translate to reduced biological effects. Biomarker and clinical data from studies in which product use is controlled within a clinical setting, indicate changes in biomarker levels and clinical end-points similar to observations in cessation studies, indicating the potential for reduced harm. The scientific evidence also indicates that exposure of non-users to emissions from heated tobacco products in indoor environments is significantly reduced compared to exposure resulting from smoking conventional cigarettes. 
Overall, the available scientific evidence indicates that heated tobacco products hold promise as a less harmful alternative to conventional cigarettes, but more independent data is required to validate industry findings. As a growing product category, epidemiological studies and independent population modelling studies are outstanding, and empirical data on how dual tobacco product category use by consumers affects their risk profile is lacking.
review_content:
The current review is a very comprehensive review of the toxicological and risk assessment of electronically heated tobacco products. The authors have done a commendable job in putting together all the existing literature comparing the toxicology and health effects of aHTPs with conventional cigarettes. However this reviewer feels that the length of this review with so many different aspects being discussed makes it a tough read.

Here are a few suggestions to improve upon this manuscript:
 1. The way the review is structured it might as well be structured as a systematic review. Authors must check the guidelines and restructure the manuscript accordingly.
 2. The manuscript will benefit much with some serious editing. Repetitions and redundant statements and studies can be removed from discussion and key ideas should be focused on in terms of the public health risk.
 3. The quality of Tables could be improved.
paper_title_zh: 电加热烟草产品产品科学：科学文献的叙述性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
加热烟草产品代表了一类新型烟草产品，其中烟草可消费品被加热到释放烟草叶中尼古丁的温度，但不足以引起燃烧的温度。因此，加热烟草产品可能成为继续吸传统香烟的成年吸烟者的较无害替代品。鉴于该产品类别的快速发展，本综述的目的是审查有关加热烟草产品的现有同行评审科学证据，并突出任何研究空白。

近年来，加热烟草产品的制造商们发表了大量关于其各自加热烟草产品的研究。尽管独立于商业利益的研究有限，但现有科学证据表明，加热烟草产品产生的气溶胶比传统香烟烟雾简单得多，有害毒物的种类和水平都显著降低。毒理学评估显示，这些气溶胶毒物的减少转化为生物效应的降低。在临床环境中控制产品使用的生物标志物和临床数据显示，生物标志物水平和临床终点的变化与戒烟研究中的观察结果相似，表明具有减少危害的潜力。科学证据还表明，非用户在室内环境中接触加热烟草产品排放物的暴露量显著低于吸传统香烟的暴露量。

总体而言，现有科学证据表明，加热烟草产品作为传统香烟的较无害替代品具有前景，但需要更多独立数据来验证行业发现。作为一个不断增长的产品类别，流行病学研究以及独立的群体建模研究尚待进行，且缺乏关于消费者双重使用烟草产品类别如何影响其风险状况的实证数据。
review_content_zh:
当前综述是对电子加热烟草产品的毒理学和风险评估的非常全面的回顾。作者在汇总所有现有文献，比较加热烟草制品（aHTPs）与传统香烟的毒理学和健康影响方面做得值得称赞。然而，本审稿人认为，这篇综述篇幅较长，讨论了众多不同方面，使得阅读较为困难。

以下是几条改进该手稿的建议：
1. 综述的结构方式完全可以按照系统综述来构建。作者必须查阅相关指南并相应地重新组织手稿。
2. 手稿将大大受益于一些认真的编辑工作。可以从讨论中删除重复和冗余的陈述及研究，并应重点关注公共卫生风险的关键观点。
3. 表格的质量可以提升。

However this reviewer feels that the length of this review with so many different aspects being discussed makes it a tough read.

paper_title: Oral squamous cell carcinoma: metastasis, potentially associated malignant disorders, etiology and recent advancements in diagnosis
paper_abstract: Oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) is a commonly occurring head and neck cancer. It has a high prevalence in certain parts of the world, and is associated with a high mortality rate. In this review, we describe metastasis related to OSCC, and disorders that could lead to OSCC with common etiological factors. In addition, a brief account of the diagnosis of OSCC and role of salivary biomarkers in its early detection has also been highlighted. Google Scholar and PubMed search engines were searched with keywords including “oral squamous cell carcinoma”, “OSCC”, “oral cancer”, “potentially malignant disorders in oral cavity”, “etiological factors of OSCC”,  “diagnosis of OSCC”, and “salivary biomarkers and OSCC” to gather the literature for this review. The review concludes that OSCC has the potential for regional as well as distant metastasis, and many potentially malignant diseases can transform into OSCC with the help of various etiological factors. Diagnosis of OSCC involves traditional biopsy, but salivary biomarkers could also be utilized for early recognition.
review_content:
1. In etiology section: it has been mentioned that there is a various etiological factors that cause OSCC, most of the articles that have been cited are based on epidemiological statistics. So I think it is better to specify that these are based on epidemiological statistics.
 2. It has been mentioned that early detection of cancer using certain techniques like salivary bio markers will lead to successful prognosis and treatment, are there any studies showing that there is improved prognosis after early detection? If not then this would be a good way to mention this as a suggestion and future trend to establish studies to show the essential role of early diagnosis.
 3. Suggestions to add diagnostic criteria for early detection of OSCC.

paper_title: Circadian clock regulation of skeletal muscle growth and repair
paper_abstract: Accumulating evidence indicates that the circadian clock, a transcriptional/translational feedback circuit that generates ~24-hour oscillations in behavior and physiology, is a key temporal regulatory mechanism involved in many important aspects of muscle physiology. Given the clock as an evolutionarily-conserved time-keeping mechanism that synchronizes internal physiology to environmental cues, locomotor activities initiated by skeletal muscle enable entrainment to the light-dark cycles on earth, thus ensuring organismal survival and fitness. Despite the current understanding of the role of molecular clock in preventing age-related sarcopenia, investigations into the underlying molecular pathways that transmit clock signals to the maintenance of skeletal muscle growth and function are only emerging. In the current review, the importance of the muscle clock in maintaining muscle mass during development, repair and aging, together with its contribution to muscle metabolism, will be discussed. Based on our current understandings of how tissue-intrinsic muscle clock functions in the key aspects muscle physiology, interventions targeting the myogenic-modulatory activities of the clock circuit may offer new avenues for prevention and treatment of muscular diseases. Studies of mechanisms underlying circadian clock function and regulation in skeletal muscle warrant continued efforts.
review_content:
This is an interesting review paper summarising the current knowledge about the role of the circadian clock in skeletal muscle development and function.

I have few comments which might help to improve the paper:
 1. Intro: last two sentences are difficult to understand. "As locomotor activity..." this is not a complete sentence / "It is therefore possible..." - consider shortening. Is your main point to say that there is still a lot to do?
 2. Chapter "The tissue-intrinsic circadian clock in skeletal muscle"

    - Daily oscillations are not GOVERNED by outside rhythms; consider ENTRAINED

    - Peripheral clocks are not DRIVEN by the SCN; consider COORDINATED/RESET.
 3. Carefully check spelling of genes and proteins, in particular capitalisations
 4. Consider discussing the role of metabolic feedback on SM clock regulation and function.

paper_title: Key concepts for informed health choices: Where’s the evidence?
paper_abstract:
Background 
    The Informed Health Choices (IHC) Key Concepts is a framework that provides a basis for developing educational resources and evaluating people’s ability to think critically about health actions. We developed the original Key Concepts framework by reviewing texts and checklists for the public, journalists, and health professionals and collecting structured feedback from an international advisory group. We revised the original 2015 framework yearly from 2016 to 2018 based on feedback and experience using the framework. The objectives of this paper are to describe the development of the framework since 2018 and summarise their basis. 
  
  
    Methods 
    For the 2019 version, we responded to feedback on the 2018 version. For the current 2022 version, in addition to responding to feedback on the 2019 version, we reviewed the evidence base for each of the concepts. Whenever possible, we referenced systematic reviews that provide a basis for a concept. We screened all Cochrane methodology reviews and searched Epistemonikos, PubMed, and Google Scholar for methodology reviews and meta-epidemiological studies. 
  
  
    Results 
    The original framework included 32 concepts in six groups. The 2019 version and the current 2022 version include 49 concepts in the same three main groups that we have used since 2016. There are now 10 subgroups or higher-level concepts. For each concept, there is an explanation including one or more examples, the basis for the concept, and implications. Over 600 references are cited that support the concepts, and over half of the references are systematic reviews. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    There is a large body of evidence that supports the IHC key concepts and we have received few suggestions for changes since 2019.
review_content:
In general, the paper is easy to follow and well-structured. The objectives are clear, and methods and results are reported in a precise and sound manner. The high degree of transparency is especially notable. Here are a few minor suggestions for clarification:
  * a more substantive description (overview) of the key concepts would be helpful
  * p3, 2nd paragraph: use “competences” instead of “abilities” for consistent use of language and describe both briefly, as they are integral parts of the framework
  * p3, 3rd paragraph: “A major new challenge […]” – to what?
  * p4: If all of p4 refers to prior revisions, the suggestion is to include the time frame in the heading, e.g.: “Development of the Informed Health Choices Key Concepts from 2013-2018”
  * These two points created confusion:
      + p4, 2nd paragraph: the cited works from colleagues were published after 2018 (Aronson et al., 2019 and Stewart et al., 2022)
      + p4, 3rd paragraph: the given reference was published in 2020
  * p5, 1st paragraph: refer to the supplemental material for underlying data within the text
  * p6, table 2: include a description of the added competences and disposition in the table (like was done for the added concepts); or provide an explanation why they are not listed; or add reference to where they may be found
  * p7, table 3: “[…] many other factors affect outcomes […]” – this wording sparks curiosity about those other factors and weakens the importance of critical thinking
  * p8, 2nd paragraph: provide an example (within the text) of a suggestion that was incorporated in the explanations for concepts
  * p8, 4th paragraph: “It has proven to be useful for this.” – missing citation
  * Rethink repetitions: “We received little feedback […]” (p8, 1st paragraph); “There have been few suggestions for change […]” (p8, 3rd paragraph); “We have received few suggestions […]” (p9, 2nd paragraph)
  * p9, data availability: The suggestion is to add the following to the 2nd sentence: The project contains the following underlying data “in two different formats (pdf, docx)”. As the files have different names, the addition makes it clearer that they contain the same information.
paper_title_zh: 知情健康选择的关键概念：证据何在？
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
知情健康选择（IHC）关键概念框架为开发教育资源及评估人们批判性思考健康行为的能力提供了基础。我们通过审查面向公众、记者和健康专业人士的文本和清单，并收集来自国际咨询小组的结构化反馈，开发了最初的关键概念框架。基于反馈和使用框架的经验，我们从2016年至2018年每年对2015年的原始框架进行修订。本文的目标是描述自2018年以来框架的发展并总结其基础。

方法
对于2019年版，我们回应了针对2018年版的反馈。对于当前的2022年版，除了回应2019年版的反馈外，我们还审查了每个概念的证据基础。在可能的情况下，我们引用了为概念提供基础的系统评价。我们筛选了所有Cochrane方法学评价，并在Epistemonikos、PubMed和Google Scholar上搜索了方法学评价和元流行病学研究。

结果
原始框架包括六个组中的32个概念。2019年版和当前的2022年版包括自2016年以来我们一直使用的三个主要组中的49个概念。现在有10个亚组或更高级别的概念。每个概念都包括一个或多个例子的解释、概念的基础和影响。引用了超过600条支持这些概念的参考文献，其中超过一半是系统评价。

结论
有大量证据支持IHC关键概念，并且自2019年以来我们收到的修改建议很少。
review_content_zh:
总体而言，该论文易于理解且结构良好。目标明确，方法和结果报告得精确且可靠。高度的透明度尤其值得注意。以下是一些澄清的微小建议：
  * 更为实质性的关键概念描述（概述）将有所帮助
  * 第3页，第2段：为保持语言的一致性，使用“能力”代替“技能”，并简要描述两者，因为它们是框架的组成部分
  * 第3页，第3段：“一个主要的新挑战[…]” —— 指的是什么？
  * 第4页：如果第4页全部涉及之前的修订，建议在标题中包含时间范围，例如：“2013-2018年知情健康选择关键概念的发展”
  * 这两点造成了混淆：
      + 第4页，第2段：引用的同事作品发表于2018年之后（Aronson等人，2019年和Stewart等人，2022年）
      + 第4页，第3段：所给参考文献发表于2020年
  * 第5页，第1段：在文本中提及补充材料以获取底层数据
  * 第6页，表2：在表格中包含对新增能力和倾向的描述（如同对新增概念的描述一样）；或解释为何未列出；或添加引用说明其位置

paper_title: Research on emotional intelligence among Indian teachers: A Systematic Review and meta-analysis of its correlation with health parameters and impact of gender
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Emotional intelligence is the self-perception related to identification and regulation of emotions. Several studies have been done among Indian teachers evaluating emotional intelligence in relation to demographic, professional and various psychological parameters, but the variety of scales, teacher types, and conflicting results makes it difficult to draw any meaningful conclusions from this heterogeneous data. 
     The present work aims to synthesize the available data by both qualitative and quantitative analysis and is the first such attempt to include only Indian studies in this field. The main objectives were to determine the correlation of emotional intelligence with teachers’ health parameters and to study the gender difference in emotional intelligence. 
   
   
     Methods 
     After a thorough literature search in Google, Google scholar, Scopus, Web of science and Pubmed, fifty-five Indian studies were selected which empirically examined teachers’ emotional intelligence, either alone or in association with another parameter evaluating teachers’ psychological health and performance. After qualitative assessment of major findings, quantitative analysis was performed. Three separate meta-analysis were carried out. The first one with fifteen effect sizes among 3291 participants evaluated correlation with personal health parameters. The second with nineteen effect sizes in 4165 participants evaluated correlation with professional health parameters. The third with twenty-six studies involving 6005 participants assessed effect of gender. 
   
   
     Results 
     The results show that almost all studies have used a trait measure, teachers’ emotional intelligence is positively correlated with both personal and professional health parameters and gender has no effect on emotional intelligence. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     Major limitations are a very high degree of heterogeneity of the data, incomplete description of the scales, inadequate randomization and small sample sizes in many studies. The results indicate the importance of emotional intelligence in both personal and professional life of teachers and no effect of gender preparing a solid base for future research.
review_content:
This paper is a good attempt to explore the status of research on emotional intelligence in India. The following are some points suggested to the author-

1. The paper is too long in comparison to the normal length of the research paper.
2. The rationale behind choosing the Indian research only, needs a more logical background.
3. Methodology is sufficient and clear for a layman.
4. I am unable to understand why researchers used two different methods in a single paper i.e. meta-analysis and survey.
5. References are relevant to the present study.
paper_title_zh: 印度教师情绪智力的研究：与健康参数相关性的系统综述与元分析及性别影响
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
情绪智力是指与情绪识别和调节相关的自我感知。已有若干研究针对印度教师评估情绪智力与人口统计学、职业及各种心理参数之间的关系，但由于量表种类、教师类型及结果冲突的多样性，使得从这些异质数据中得出任何有意义的结论变得困难。当前研究旨在通过定性和定量分析综合现有数据，并且是首次仅包含该领域印度研究的尝试。主要目标是确定情绪智力与教师健康参数之间的相关性，并研究情绪智力中的性别差异。

方法
在谷歌、谷歌学术、Scopus、Web of Science和PubMed进行彻底的文献检索后，选取了五十五项印度研究，这些研究实证考察了教师的情绪智力，无论是单独考察还是与评估教师心理健康和绩效的其他参数相结合。在对主要发现进行定性评估后，进行了定量分析。进行了三项独立的元分析。第一项涉及3291名参与者的十五个效应量，评估与个人健康参数的相关性。第二项涉及4165名参与者的十九个效应量，评估与职业健康参数的相关性。第三项涉及二十六项研究，包括6005名参与者，评估性别的影响。

结果
结果显示，几乎所有研究都使用了特质测量，教师的情绪智力与个人和职业健康参数均呈正相关，且性别对情绪智力无影响。

结论
主要局限性在于数据的高度异质性、量表描述不完整、随机化不足以及许多研究中样本量较小。结果表明情绪智力在教师个人和职业生活中的重要性，且性别无影响，为未来研究奠定了坚实基础。
review_content_zh:
本文是探讨印度情绪智力研究现状的一次良好尝试。以下是对作者的一些建议：

4. 我无法理解为何研究人员在同一篇论文中使用了两种不同的方法，即元分析和调查。
5. 参考文献与当前研究相关。

paper_title: Food supplements to complement brain functioning: the benefits of a combination of magnesium, folic acid, omega-3 fatty acids and vitamin E
paper_abstract: Diet and nutrition play a fundamental role not only in human body composition and in physiology, but have also relevant effects on mood, mental well-being and cognitive performance. In particular, the preservation of mental well-being through a healthy lifestyle, including a well-balanced diet and, in case, through the intake of specific food supplements, is of particular relevance in the perspective of global human ageing, as the brain is affected significantly by a persistent presence of stress factors. Due to the increasing burden of mental and neurological disorders and to the universality of food as a modifiable risk factor, even limited improvements in nutritional habits may translate to a considerable rise of well-being and mental health in the global population. Moreover, the use of targeted, well-balanced food supplements aiming to support the mental health and well-being will probably represent a relevant tool in future decades, together with an increased awareness of the importance of nutrition, also considering the COVID-19 pandemic and the related stressful events and limitations we are still experiencing at global level. The aim of this review is to summarize the experimental and clinical data reported in the literature concerning the beneficial effects of a subset of micro- and macronutrients contained both in food and in supplements, namely magnesium, folic acid, docosahexaenoic acid, eicosapentaenoic acid, and alpha-tocopherol, on a series of disorders, including stress, anxiety, low sleep quality, and low cognitive performance.
review_content:
This is an interesting, well written and timely article focused on the fundamental role of diet/nutrition on brain function. The importance of improved nutritional habits is also discussed, specifically the beneficial effects of micro- and macronutrients in food and supplements.

Some clarifications on the following would improve the manuscript.
  * Please add rationale for the focus only on magnesium, folic acid, docosahexaenoic acid (DHA), eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), and alpha-tocopherol.
  * A short discussion on the impact of the gut microbiome on brain metabolome would be interesting.
  * Is there any evidence that other free fatty acids besides omega 3 influence brain function and well being?
  * Is magnesium the only ion known to impact cognitive responses?
paper_title_zh: 补充食品以促进大脑功能：镁、叶酸、ω-3脂肪酸和维生素E组合的益处
paper_abstract_zh: 饮食和营养不仅在人体组成和生理学中起着基础性作用，而且对情绪、心理健康和认知表现也有显著影响。特别是，通过健康生活方式，包括均衡饮食以及必要时通过摄入特定食物补充剂来维持心理健康，在全球人口老龄化的背景下尤为重要，因为大脑会显著受到持续压力因素的影响。鉴于精神和神经系统疾病的负担日益加重，以及食物作为可修改风险因素的普遍性，即使是营养习惯的有限改善也可能转化为全球人口福祉和心理健康的显著提升。此外，使用针对性强、均衡的食物补充剂以支持心理健康和福祉，可能在未来几十年内成为一个重要工具，同时提高对营养重要性的认识，也考虑到我们仍在全球范围内经历的COVID-19大流行及其相关的压力事件和限制。本综述的目的是总结文献中报道的实验和临床数据，涉及食物和补充剂中含有的部分微量和宏量营养素，即镁、叶酸、二十二碳六烯酸、二十碳五烯酸和α-生育酚，对一系列疾病（包括压力、焦虑、低睡眠质量和低认知表现）的益处。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇有趣、文笔流畅且适时的文章，专注于饮食/营养对大脑功能的基本作用。文章还讨论了改善营养习惯的重要性，特别是食物和补充剂中微量营养素和宏量营养素的益处。

对以下几点进行澄清将提升稿件质量：
  * 请补充仅关注镁、叶酸、二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）、二十碳五烯酸（EPA）和α-生育酚的理由。
  * 简要讨论肠道微生物群对大脑代谢组的影响将是有趣的。
  * 是否有证据表明除ω-3以外的其他游离脂肪酸会影响大脑功能和健康？
  * 镁是唯一已知影响认知反应的离子吗？
