paper_title: A Survey on Graph Construction for Geometric Deep Learning in Medicine: Methods and Recommendations
paper_abstract: Graph neural networks are powerful tools that enable deep learning on non-Euclidean data structures like graphs, point clouds, and meshes. They leverage the connectivity of data points and can even benefit learning tasks on data, which is not naturally graph-structured -like point clouds. In these cases, the graph structure needs to be determined from the dataset, which adds a significant challenge to the learning process. This opens up a multitude of design choices for creating suitable graph structures, which have a substantial impact on the success of the graph learning task. However, so far no concrete guidance for choosing the most appropriate graph construction is available, not only due to the large variety of methods out there but also because of its strong connection to the dataset at hand. In medicine, for example, a large variety of different data types complicates the selection of graph construction methods even more. We therefore summarise the current state-of-the-art graph construction methods, especially for medical data. In this work, we introduce a categorisation scheme for graph types and graph construction methods. We identify two main strands of graph construction: static and adaptive methods, discuss their advantages and disadvantages, and formulate recommendations for choosing a suitable graph construction method. We furthermore discuss how a created graph structure can be assessed and to what degree it supports graph learning. We hope to support medical research with graph deep learning with this work by elucidating the wide variety of graph construction methods.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This is a survey paper that reviews graph construction for geometric deep learning in medicine. The authors overview many relevant papers and discuss different types of tasks (graph level, node level, predicting relations), static and adaptive graph construction, and discuss current challenges and future research directions.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
First, I should note that I am not an expert in ML for medicine, thus I cannot assess the completeness and correctness of some parts of the submission. Strengths: - The paper covers a wide range of related papers - The paper is well written Weaknesses: - My main concerns relate to the sections devoted to homophily/heterophily (Section 2.3 and Section 5.3). This subject is covered in this survey since homophily measures can be used to evaluate the usefulness of the constructed graph. However, most of the homophily measures are designed for node-level tasks and it can be non-trivial to apply them to graph-level tasks or to knowledge graphs. This subject is not covered in the text. - Also, in [1] it was shown that popular homophily measures have certain drawbacks and thus cannot be used to compare homophily levels of different datasets. Moreover, it was shown that homophily is not a good measure to predict the performance of a graph neural network on a given dataset, and an alternative measure is proposed. [1] Platonov O. et al. Characterizing Graph Datasets for Node Classification: Homophily–Heterophily Dichotomy and Beyond. arXiv preprint arXiv:2209.06177, 2022. - The graph types are divided into Population graphs, Subject-level graphs, Knowledge graphs, and Real-world structures. The last category is not clear. For instance, can molecular graphs belong not to this category, but to subject-level?

**Requested Changes:**
1. Please, provide a deeper discussion of homophily/heterophily measures, their drawbacks, and how they can be applied to different types of problems. 2. More explanation about the types of graphs considered in the paper would be helpful (see the comment above). 3. The paper is overall well-written, but there are some minor writing issues that I noticed: - Abstract: footnotes are usually placed after punctuation marks; - Section 2.1: "The Graph" -> "A graph"; - Citations can be used via \citet{}, e.g., in Section 3.3 this can fix "Cheng et al. (Cheng et al., 2021a)" (more examples in the text); - Section 7.4: "ADNI dataset ," (extra whitespace).

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
Broader Impact is not discussed in the paper.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Review: We thank the reviewer for their remarks and input. We applied the mentioned changes regarding writing, typos, and citations. We specifically thank the reviewer for pointing us towards this relevant reference [1]. We added the additional metrics to the graph assessment metric section (5.2) and discussed them in more detail. We also use this work as a basis for more details about heterophilic graph structures and extended the summary of graph assessment metrics by the work from Luan et al. “When Do Graph Neural Networks Help with Node Classification Investigating the Homophily Principle on Node Distinguishability” and Hou et al. “Measuring and improving the use of graph information in graph neural networks.” We mention some of the shortcomings of homophily where we introduce the metric and refer to Section 5.2 for more details in Section 2: “Homophily is only one metric to assess a graph structure and still holds some drawbacks regarding comparability between datasets and the direct impact on the performance of the downstream model (Platonov et al., 2022). More details about homophily and further graph assessment metrics can be found in Section 5.2.” Additions to Section 5.2: “Heterophilic graphs can have very different structures, containing either highly informative neighbourhoods or uninformative ones. These different notions of heterophily can be captured by other metrics, such as label informativeness (Platonov et al., 2022) or cross-class neighbourhood similarity (CCNS) (Ma et al., 2022). For that reason, a more general term node distinguishability (ND) has been used (Luan et al., 2023), which quantifies the difference in neighbourhoods more generally than heterophily/homophily.” We added another paragraph to Section 5.2 discussing graph assessment metrics beyond node classification tasks. Given the limited utilisation of such metrics in broader application areas, we believe this to be an important area for future work. “Graph assessment beyond supervised node classification. While graph assessment metrics have mostly been applied for node-level classification tasks and under supervised training, they are not limited to these settings since they represent general graph properties and can equally be applied to graph-level or edge-level predictions. Homophily has initially been introduced for classification tasks and discrete adjacency matrices, but has recently been extended to the notion of node homophily in regression tasks and continuous adjacency matrices, which are required for some adaptive graph learning methods (Mueller et al., 2023a). Furthermore, some metrics have been specifically used for link prediction and unsupervised learning tasks. Li et al. (2022) discuss unsupervised learning for node and edge classification tasks and link prediction, as well as the utilisation of edge labels for edge label assortativity. They observe that edge classification tasks rely more on features of paired nodes having signals with different frequencies. We notice a lack of more detailed and specific graph assessment metrics for tasks beyond node-level classification and identify this as an open and important research area.” Based on the reviewers’ comments, we changed the categorisation of the graph types in our work, aiming to make the distinction between them more clear. We added an additional distinction between graph types (population-level, subject-level, and generic graph structures) and structure types (concept-based and spatial). We therefore adapted Figure 2, added Figure 3 to the manuscript, and adapted Figure 4 to match the new categorisation. We discuss the graph types and structure types the following way: Section 3: “Medical research and data often contain patient data that defines the structure of the dataset. We identify three distinct graph types that are used in medical applications: (1) population-level graphs, where typically individuals of a cohort are connected in a large graph, (2) subject-level graphs, where each subject is represented by an individual graph –leading to a multi-graph dataset–, and (3) subject-independent graphs, which represent more general structures, such as knowledge graphs, molecules or maps. Each graph type comes with individual challenges and utilises different methods for graph creation. In this section, we give an overview of those three graph types, which are visualised in Figure 2. We furthermore distinguish between two types of structures: (a) relationship-based and (b) spatial structures. Relationship-based structures use concepts and relationships to determine the graph structure and spatial structures use spatial information, for example, image key-points in Euclidean space. All graph types can be combined with all structure types. We summarise the combinations of graph types and structure types with examples in Figure 3.”
paper_title_zh: 医学中几何深度学习的图构建综述：方法与建议
paper_abstract_zh: 图神经网络是强大的工具，能够在非欧几里得数据结构（如图、点云和网格）上进行深度学习。它们利用数据点的连通性，甚至可以受益于非自然图结构化数据（如点云）的学习任务。在这些情况下，图结构需要从数据集中确定，这给学习过程增加了显著的挑战。这为创建合适的图结构开辟了多种设计选择，这对图学习任务的成功有着重大影响。然而，到目前为止，还没有具体指导来选择最合适的图构造方法，这不仅因为存在大量不同的方法，还因为它与手头数据集的紧密联系。例如，在医学领域，多种不同数据类型的多样性使得图构造方法的选择更加复杂。因此，我们总结了当前最先进的图构造方法，尤其是针对医学数据。在这项工作中，我们引入了图类型和图构造方法的分类方案。我们确定了两种主要的图构造方法：静态和自适应方法，讨论了它们的优缺点，并提出了选择合适图构造方法的建议。此外，我们还讨论了如何评估创建的图结构以及它在多大程度上支持图学习。我们希望通过阐明多种图构造方法，支持医学研究中使用图深度学习。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这是一篇综述论文，回顾了医学中几何深度学习的图构建方法。作者概述了许多相关论文，并讨论了不同类型的任务（图级别、节点级别、预测关系）、静态和自适应图构建，以及当前挑战和未来研究方向。

**优点和缺点：**
首先，我应该指出，我不是医学机器学习的专家，因此无法评估投稿中某些部分的完整性和正确性。优点：- 论文涵盖了广泛的相关文献 - 论文写作质量高缺点：- 我的主要担忧与同质性/异质性相关的部分（第2.3节和第5.3节）。这一主题在该综述中被涵盖，因为同质性度量可以用来评估所构建图的有用性。然而，大多数同质性度量是为节点级别任务设计的，将其应用于图级别任务或知识图可能并非易事。本文未涉及这一主题。- 此外，[1]中显示，流行的同质性度量存在某些缺点，因此不能用来比较不同数据集的同质性水平。此外，还显示同质性不是预测图神经网络在给定数据集上性能的良好度量，并提出了一种替代度量。[1] Platonov O.等人。表征节点分类的图数据集：同质性-异质性二分法及其超越。arXiv预印本arXiv:2209.06177，2022。- 图类型被分为人口图、主体级别图、知识图和现实世界结构。最后一类不明确。例如，分子图是否属于这一类，而不是主体级别图？

**请求的更改：**
1. 请提供对同质性/异质性度量的更深入讨论，它们的缺点以及如何应用于不同类型的问题。2. 对论文中考虑的图类型进行更多解释将有所帮助（见上述评论）。3. 论文总体上写得很好，但我注意到一些小的写作问题：- 摘要：脚注通常放在标点符号之后；- 第2.1节：“The Graph” -> “A graph”；- 引用可以通过\citet{}使用，例如，在第3.3节中，这可以修正“Cheng et al. (Cheng et al., 2021a)”（文本中有更多例子）；- 第7.4节：“ADNI dataset ,”（多余的空格）。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
论文中未讨论更广泛的影响。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**

**反驳评论：**

paper_title: A review of the biologic and pharmacologic role of docosapentaenoic acid n-3
paper_abstract: Fish oil contains a complex mixture of omega-3 fatty acids, of which eicosapentaenoic acid (EPA), docosapentaenoic acid (DPA), and docosahexaenoic acid (DHA) are the three predominant forms. There has been a plethora of previous research on the effects and associations of fish oil supplementation with various clinical manifestations. While the majority of this work was focused on EPA and DHA as the active compounds, emerging research has begun to elucidate the specific role that DPA plays in these physiological processes and its differences with the other omega-3 fatty acids. The purpose of this review is to focus on the new studies undertaken with DPA. This review summarizes the biochemical mechanisms involved in the biosynthesis and metabolism of DPA before focusing on its effects in cardiovascular disease, immune function, and psychiatric and cognitive health. The limited studies point toward a positive role that DPA supplementation can play in these processes and that is separate and distinct from traditional supplementation with DHA and EPA.
review_content: In general this article does make a good point that DPA may well be an important omega 3 fatty acid and provides references from in vitro studies, animal studies, and some human epidemiologic studies that DPA may have some unique, beneficial properties. However many of the studies quoted for support in cardiovascular disease confuse association with causation, and this should be noted. Moreover there is still some controversy about the extent of the effectiveness of very long chain omega 3 fatty acids in the improvement of cardiovascular health according to different health authorities. That said the article does provide a useful review that should promote more research into this potentially important fatty acid. As an additional comment there are some misstatements which are presumably typographic on the first page. The retroconversion is DPA to EPA rather than the reverse. Also there is only one elongase necessary to convert EPA to DHA.
paper_title_zh: n-3 二十二碳五烯酸生物学和药理学作用的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 鱼油含有一种复杂的ω-3脂肪酸混合物，其中二十碳五烯酸（EPA）、二十二碳五烯酸（DPA）和二十二碳六烯酸（DHA）是三种主要形式。先前已有大量研究探讨了鱼油补充剂与各种临床表现的影响和关联。尽管大部分研究集中于EPA和DHA作为活性化合物，但新兴研究已开始阐明DPA在这些生理过程中的特定作用及其与其他ω-3脂肪酸的差异。本综述的目的是聚焦于DPA的新研究。本综述首先总结了DPA生物合成和代谢中涉及的生化机制，然后重点探讨其在心血管疾病、免疫功能以及精神和认知健康方面的作用。有限的研究表明，DPA补充剂在这些过程中可以发挥积极的作用，且这一作用与传统的DHA和EPA补充剂是独立且不同的。

paper_title: Analysis of environmental migrants and their mental health in strengthening health systems
paper_abstract:
Background: It is predicted that by 2050 more than 250 million people will have to relocate as a result of climate-related change to their home environment. The existential threat posed by anthropogenic phenomena such as forest fires, floods, sea level rise, drought, and intensified weather events (e.g. tropical storms) has caused a new type of migrant to emerge. Within academic literature, these migrants are referred to as climate migrants, environmental migrants, or eco migrants, among other terms. These individuals’ migration journey and this journey’s impact on their mental health is currently an understudied research area. This paper summarizes the mental health challenges climate migrants face via a narrative review. 
 Methods: Google Scholar was used as the main search database throughout May, 2020 until authors determined data saturation had been reached. Grey literature was also included. Sources were included if they focused directly on evaluating environmental migrants and their mental health experiences. Academic sources must have been peer-reviewed and published within the past 10 years. Information was coded and evaluated according to the three migration journey stages of before, after, and during relocation. 
 Results: Main findings include that the slow or sudden degradation of one’s surroundings can cause the onset of mental health disorders that are later exacerbated by challenges faced when migrating, such as lack of access to health services. Mental health challenges faced upon reaching destination communities consist mainly of social marginalization and disruption of social ties. Lastly, action items for health systems are outlined and the need for more research on the mental wellbeing of climate migrants throughout their migration journey is stressed.  
 Conclusions: This review is an urgent call to policymakers, health professionals, and researchers to strengthen health systems by making them more climate resilient and inclusive towards environmental migrants.
review_content:
The author tried to highlight a very important issue regarding the eco-migrants mental health which should have been emphasized a long before the era. Definitely the health system of the country where this type of environmental or climate change impacts are prominent should have a specific intervention strategy at the policy level to address the mental health needs of the migrants.

But regrding methodology, I would like to mention that the author should include a flow chart with the reviewed literature serching pattern and numbers with and without inclusion criteria (before and after), so that the readers have a clear idea about the literature searching process. At present, the method is clumsy and review process is not understandable.

Also need a clear visualization of the findings analysed from the reviewed literature. So the author is requested to add a table with highlighting the summary of findings obtained from the literature with reference list.

Conclusion is too big, I suggest to concise the conclusion with including a part of recommendations from the obtained findings form the review.
paper_title_zh: 环境移民及其心理健康在加强卫生系统中的分析
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：预计到2050年，将有超过2.5亿人因气候变化对其居住环境的直接影响而不得不迁移。由人为现象如森林火灾、洪水、海平面上升、干旱以及加剧的天气事件（例如热带风暴）构成的生存威胁，导致了一种新型移民的出现。在学术文献中，这些移民被称为气候移民、环境移民或生态移民等。这些个体的迁移过程及其对心理健康的影响目前是一个研究不足的领域。本文通过叙述性综述总结了气候移民面临的心理健康挑战。

方法：2020年5月期间，使用谷歌学术作为主要搜索数据库，直至作者确定数据饱和。灰色文献也包括在内。所选来源必须直接关注评估环境移民及其心理健康经历。学术来源必须经过同行评审并在过去10年内发表。信息根据迁移过程的前、中、后三个阶段进行编码和评估。

结果：主要发现包括，个人周围环境的缓慢或突然恶化可能导致心理健康障碍的发生，而这些障碍在迁移过程中因面临如缺乏医疗服务等挑战而进一步加剧。到达目的地社区后面临的主要心理健康挑战包括社会边缘化和社会联系的断裂。最后，概述了卫生系统的行动要点，并强调了在整个迁移过程中对气候移民心理健康进行更多研究的必要性。

结论：本综述是对政策制定者、卫生专业人员和研究人员的紧急呼吁，要求通过增强卫生系统对气候的适应能力和对环境移民的包容性来加强卫生系统。
review_content_zh:
作者试图强调一个非常重要的议题，即生态移民的心理健康问题，这一议题早在该时代之前就应该得到重视。毫无疑问，在那些受环境或气候变化影响显著的国家，其卫生系统应该在政策层面制定具体的干预策略，以应对移民的心理健康需求。

但在方法论方面，我想指出作者应该包含一个流程图，展示所审查文献的搜索模式和数量（包括和不包括纳入标准之前和之后的），以便读者对文献搜索过程有一个清晰的了解。目前，该方法显得杂乱，审查过程也不易理解。

此外，还需要对从所审查文献中分析出的发现进行清晰的视觉呈现。因此，建议作者添加一个表格，突出显示从文献中获得的发现摘要，并附上参考文献列表。

结论部分过于冗长，我建议精简结论，并包含从审查中获得的部分建议。

paper_title: Post-operative rehabilitation and nutrition in osteoarthritis
paper_abstract: Osteoarthritis (OA) is a degenerative process involving the progressive loss of articular cartilage, synovial inflammation and structural changes in subchondral bone that lead to loss of synovial joint structural features and functionality of articular cartilage. OA represents one of the most common causes of physical disability in the world. Different OA treatments are usually considered in relation to the stage of the disease. In the early stages, it is possible to recommend physical activity programs that can maintain joint health and keep the patient mobile, as recommended by OA Research Society International (OARSI) and European League Against Rheumatism (EULAR). In the most severe and advanced cases of OA, surgical intervention is necessary. After, in early postoperative stages, it is essential to include a rehabilitation exercise program in order to restore the full function of the involved joint. Physical therapy is crucial for the success of any surgical procedure and can promote recovery of muscle strength, range of motion, coordinated walking, proprioception and mitigate joint pain. Furthermore, after discharge from the hospital, patients should continue the rehabilitation exercise program at home associated to an appropriate diet. In this review, we analyze manuscripts from the most recent literature and provide a balanced and comprehensive overview of the latest developments on the effect of physical exercise on postoperative rehabilitation in OA. The literature search was conducted using PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar, using the keywords ‘osteoarthritis’, ‘rehabilitation’, ‘exercise’ and ‘nutrition’. The available data suggest that physical exercise is an effective, economical and accessible to everyone practice, and it is one of the most important components of postoperative rehabilitation for OA.
review_content:
It is an well-written and informative paper on the topic. The paper underlines the importance of physical expertise on the treatment of OA, combined with an appropriate diet in post-operative situations. Nevertheless I have serious comments on the scientific basis of the review.

The review is not performed in line with a scientific accepted methodology regarding systematic reviews. The search terms only are focused on the topic OA and not on methodological terms. There are no in-and exclusion criteria for the papers formulated. Also, there is no quality assessment of the papers regarding methodological quality or a systematically presented evidence synthesis. Therefore the presentation of the results, discussion and the conclusion is difficult to interpret.
paper_title_zh: 术后康复与营养在骨关节炎中的应用
paper_abstract_zh: 骨关节炎（OA）是一种退行性过程，涉及关节软骨的逐渐丧失、滑膜炎症和软骨下骨的结构变化，导致滑膜关节结构特征和关节软骨功能丧失。OA是全球导致身体残疾的最常见原因之一。不同的OA治疗方法通常与疾病的阶段相关。在早期阶段，可以推荐物理活动计划，以维持关节健康并保持患者活动能力，正如骨关节炎研究学会国际（OARSI）和欧洲抗风湿病联盟（EULAR）所推荐的。在OA最严重和晚期病例中，需要进行手术干预。术后早期阶段，必须包括康复锻炼计划，以恢复受累关节的完全功能。物理治疗对任何手术的成功至关重要，可以促进肌肉力量、活动范围、协调行走、本体感觉的恢复，并减轻关节疼痛。此外，患者出院后应继续在家进行康复锻炼计划，并结合适当的饮食。在本综述中，我们分析了最新文献中的手稿，并提供了关于物理锻炼对OA术后康复影响的最新发展的平衡且全面的概述。文献检索使用了PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar，关键词为“骨关节炎”、“康复”、“锻炼”和“营养”。现有数据表明，物理锻炼是一种有效、经济且人人可及的实践，是OA术后康复中最重要的组成部分之一。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于该主题写得很好且信息丰富的论文。论文强调了物理专业知识在治疗骨关节炎中的重要性，并结合了术后适当饮食的必要性。然而，我对这篇综述的科学基础有严重的意见。

该综述未按照科学接受的系统综述方法进行。搜索术语仅集中在骨关节炎这一主题上，而未涉及方法学术语。对于论文没有制定纳入和排除标准。此外，也没有对论文的方法学质量进行质量评估，或系统地呈现证据综合。因此，结果的呈现、讨论和结论难以解释。

paper_title: Cardiovascular, carcinogenic and reproductive effects of nicotine exposure: A narrative review of the scientific literature
review_content:
In the section on cardiovascular outcomes, I think it is important to address the fact that most of the studies looking at the effects of nicotine have been done in adults. The effects of nicotine on these same outcomes in adolescents and youth is not well known and may in fact be different.

It is somewhat surprising that there is no section describing birth outcomes in animal studies as there have been a number of rodent studies done with nicotine alone and more recently studies looking at the effects of ENDS use during pregnancy in rodent models. Many of these studies have described pregnancy outcomes including birthweight and live birth index (a surrogate for stillbirth).
paper_title_zh: 心血管、致癌及生殖系统受尼古丁暴露影响：科学文献的叙述性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
新型烟草加热产品和电子尼古丁递送系统（ENDS）的出现正在改变人类接触尼古丁的方式。本叙述性综述的目的是提供关于尼古丁对三个关键健康相关领域影响的已发表科学文献的广泛概述：1）心血管风险，2）致癌作用和3）生殖结果。这些领域已知对香烟烟雾的影响特别敏感，此外，尼古丁被认为在疾病发病机制中发挥作用。急性毒性也将被讨论。

截至2019年2月的文献表明，在没有潜在心血管病理的消费者中，尼古丁暴露并未增加心血管风险。科学共识认为尼古丁不是直接的或完全的致癌物，然而，尚需确定它是否在人类癌症的传播和转移中起某种作用。这些癌症进展途径已在体外模型和转基因啮齿动物体内模型中提出，但尚未在人类癌症病例中得到证实。

需要进一步研究以确定尼古丁是否与人类生育能力下降有关。动物研究结果表明，尼古丁在胎儿发育过程中具有通过多种机制发挥作用的可能性。需要更多研究来解决关于人类尼古丁暴露的问题，这可能导致对进入市场的新型ENDS的额外指导。
review_content_zh:
在心血管结局部分，我认为有必要指出，大多数研究尼古丁影响的研究都是在成年人中进行的。尼古丁对这些相同结局在青少年和年轻人中的影响尚不明确，实际上可能有所不同。

令人有些惊讶的是，没有部分描述动物研究中的出生结局，因为已经进行了许多仅使用尼古丁的大鼠研究，以及最近在鼠类模型中研究电子烟使用对妊娠的影响。许多这些研究已经描述了妊娠结局，包括出生体重和活产指数（作为死产的替代指标）。

reasons: Many of these studies have described pregnancy outcomes including birthweight and live birth index (a surrogate for stillbirth).
The effects of nicotine on these same outcomes in adolescents and youth is not well known and may in fact be different.

It is somewhat surprising that there is no section describing birth outcomes in animal studies as there have been a number of rodent studies done with nicotine alone and more recently studies looking at the effects of ENDS use during pregnancy in rodent models.

paper_title: On permutation-invariant neural networks: A survey
paper_abstract: Conventional machine learning algorithms have traditionally been designed under the assumption that input data follows a vector-based format, with an emphasis on vector-centric paradigms. However, as the demand for tasks involving set-based inputs has grown, there has been a paradigm shift in the research community towards addressing these challenges. In recent years, the emergence of neural network architectures such as Deep Sets and Transformers has presented a significant advancement in the treatment of set-based data. These architectures are specifically engineered to naturally accommodate sets as input, enabling more effective representation and processing of set structures. Consequently, there has been a surge of research endeavors dedicated to exploring and harnessing the capabilities of these architectures for various tasks involving the approximation of set functions. This comprehensive survey aims to provide an overview of the diverse problem settings and ongoing research efforts pertaining to neural networks that approximate set functions. By delving into the intricacies of these approaches and elucidating the associated challenges, the survey aims to equip readers with a comprehensive understanding of the field. Through this comprehensive perspective, we hope that researchers can gain valuable insights into the potential applications, inherent limitations, and future directions of set-based neural networks. Indeed, from this survey we gain two insights: i) Deep Sets and its variants can be generalized by differences in the aggregation function, and ii) the behavior of Deep Sets is sensitive to the choice of the aggregation function. From these observations, we show that Deep Sets, one of the well-known permutation-invariant neural networks, can be generalized in the sense of a quasi-arithmetic mean.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper provides a survey of various deep learning methods associated with the task of learning permutation invariant functions on sets. The task is motivated by providing applications where learning set functions is more useful than conventional vector-based neural networks. A broad range of architectures are discussed with their respective use-cases and limitations. The paper also describes theoretical works focused on showing universal approximation properties of popular architectures. Additionally, it also lists datasets that can be useful for training networks on different tasks.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths:** - The problem of learning set functions is motivated well and in general the paper is easy to follow. - As someone from outside this area, I really appreciate the broad overview of the different techniques, tasks and datasets associated with this problem. **Weaknesses:** - In my opinion, while the paper describes various useful techniques, it lacks in an effective synthesis of the surveyed works beyond what it is known already. I think the value of the paper can increase significantly if the authors add some generalizable insights on these methods. Some examples could include (but not limited to) shedding light on some key current challenges in the area or perhaps some previously unseen connections between the different approaches that could help with future research. - Definition 2.2 appears to have a small technical error. Section 2 defines $\mathcal{V}$ as a set of integers whereas $\mathcal{S}$ is a set of d-dimensional vectors $\phi(s_i) \in \mathbb{R}^d$. With that $\mathcal{S}$ should not be a subset of $\mathcal{V}$. - A very minor issue but I think the writing of the paper is at times a bit verbose and might benefit from some polishing.

**Requested Changes:**
Please refer to my comments in the weaknesses section. I am willing to improve my recommendation if the authors could provide appropriate additions to the manuscript.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
No

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response from the authors.: We appreciate your very helpful comments. > Adding some generalizable insights Based on the survey, we suggested that Deep Sets and its variants can be generalized using a quasi-arithmetic mean, and conducted implementation and experiments in Section 7. We have also added a future perspectives on the field in Section 8. > Modification of Definition To avoid confusion, we have clarified the definitions and the descriptions before and after the definitions. > Writing of the paper is at times a bit verbose We have refined the redundant descriptions.
paper_title_zh: 关于置换不变神经网络：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 传统的机器学习算法通常在假设输入数据遵循向量格式的前提下进行设计，强调以向量为中心的范式。然而，随着涉及集合输入的任务需求不断增长，研究社区中出现了一种范式转变，以应对这些挑战。近年来，诸如Deep Sets和Transformers等神经网络架构的出现，在处理基于集合的数据方面取得了显著进展。这些架构专门设计以自然地适应集合作为输入，从而更有效地表示和处理集合结构。因此，涌现了大量研究工作，致力于探索和利用这些架构在涉及近似集合函数的各种任务中的能力。这篇综合性综述旨在概述与近似集合函数的神经网络相关的多样化问题设置和正在进行的研究努力。通过深入探讨这些方法的复杂性并阐明相关挑战，综述旨在为读者提供对该领域的全面理解。通过这一全面视角，我们希望研究人员能够获得关于基于集合的神经网络的潜在应用、固有局限性和未来方向的有价值见解。事实上，从这篇综述中我们获得了两点洞察：i）Deep Sets及其变体可以通过聚合函数的差异进行泛化；ii）Deep Sets的行为对聚合函数的选择敏感。基于这些观察，我们展示了Deep Sets，这一著名的置换不变神经网络，可以在准算术平均值的意义上进行泛化。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文综述了与在集合上学习排列不变函数任务相关的各种深度学习方法。该任务通过提供应用场景来激发兴趣，在这些场景中，学习集合函数比传统的基于向量的神经网络更有用。讨论了广泛的架构及其相应的用例和局限性。论文还描述了专注于展示流行架构的通用逼近性质的理论工作。此外，还列出了可用于在不同任务上训练网络的数据集。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点：** - 学习集合函数的问题得到了很好的阐述，总体上论文易于理解。 - 作为该领域之外的人，我非常感谢对与该问题相关的不同技术、任务和数据集的广泛概述。 **缺点：** -在我看来，尽管论文描述了多种有用的技术，但在对已调研工作的有效综合方面有所欠缺，未能超出已知内容。我认为，如果作者能添加一些关于这些方法的可推广见解，论文的价值将显著提升。例如（但不限于）揭示该领域当前的一些关键挑战，或者不同方法之间一些先前未见的联系，这些可能有助于未来的研究。 - 定义2.2似乎存在一个小技术错误。第2节将$\mathcal{V}$定义为整数集，而$\mathcal{S}$是d维向量集$\phi(s_i) \in \mathbb{R}^d$。因此，$\mathcal{S}$不应是$\mathcal{V}$的子集。 - 一个非常小的问题，但我认为论文的写作有时略显冗长，可能需要一些润色。

**请求的修改：**
请参考我在缺点部分的评论。如果作者能对稿件进行适当的补充，我愿意提高我的推荐等级。

**主张和证据：**

paper_title: Melatonin: The potential avenues in dentistry
paper_abstract:
Melatonin, the “sleep hormone,” shows significant promise in dentistry owing to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory properties. It is beneficial for treating periodontal disorders and aiding osseointegration of dental implants. Additionally, melatonin helps to manage dental anxiety, offering an alternative to traditional sedatives. 
  Periodontal disease is orchestrated by bacterial plaques along with an exaggerated immune-inflammatory host response. Treatment of periodontitis not only involves the removal of plaque, but also aims to minimize the cytokine load and control the reactive oxygen species burden in the tissues, which would re-establish a healthy periodontium and a balanced bone metabolism. 
  Melatonin is known to exert beneficial effects, such as regulation of circadian rhythm, bone remodeling, and antimicrobial effects. 
  Recent studies have demonstrated the successful use of melatonin as an adjunct to mechanical debridement for the treatment of periodontal disease. Its various uses include systemic administration of melatonin after one-stage full-mouth Non-Surgical Periodontal Therapy in healthy subjects as well as patients. 
  This article provides a summary of the various clinical applications of melatonin, describing its mechanism of action, uses, and potential avenues for future research in dentistry.
review_content: It is very well written review article on Melatonin - the potential avenues in dentistry. author has done extensive search on previous literature and very well compiled its finding in the present article. limitation of previous studies to identify the standard Therapeutic dosage in periodontal therapy, recommendation regarding one time or multiple administration in pocket (local drug delivery) , long term evaluation of clinical results can be incorporated in discussion part. overall its a well compiled review in my opinion.
paper_title_zh: 褪黑素：牙科中的潜在应用途径
paper_abstract_zh:
褪黑素，即“睡眠激素”，因其抗氧化、抗炎和免疫调节特性，在牙科领域展现出显著的应用前景。它有助于治疗牙周疾病并促进牙科植入物的骨整合。此外，褪黑素还能帮助管理牙科焦虑，为传统镇静剂提供了替代方案。
牙周病是由细菌菌斑以及过度的宿主免疫炎症反应共同引发的。治疗牙周炎不仅涉及去除菌斑，还旨在减少组织中的细胞因子负荷和控制活性氧负担，从而重建健康的牙周组织和平衡的骨代谢。
褪黑素已知具有多种有益效应，如调节昼夜节律、骨重塑和抗菌作用。
近期研究表明，褪黑素作为机械清创术的辅助手段，在治疗牙周病中取得了成功。其多种用途包括在健康受试者和患者接受单阶段全口非手术牙周治疗后，进行褪黑素的系统性给药。
本文总结了褪黑素在临床上的各种应用，描述了其作用机制、用途以及未来在牙科领域研究的潜在方向。

paper_title: Open science interventions proposed or implemented to assess researcher impact: a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Several open science-promoting initiatives have been proposed to improve the quality of biomedical research, including initiatives for assessing researchers’ open science behaviour as criteria for promotion or tenure. Yet there is limited evidence to judge whether the interventions are effective. This review aimed to summarise the literature, identifying open science practices related to researcher assessment, and map the extent of evidence of existing interventions implemented to assess researchers and research impact. 
   
   
     Methods 
     A scoping review using the Joanna Briggs Institute Scoping Review Methodology was conducted. We included all study types that described any open science practice-promoting initiatives proposed or implemented to assess researchers and research impact, in health sciences, biomedicine, psychology, and economics. Data synthesis was quantitative and descriptive. 
   
   
     Results 
     Among 18,020 identified documents, 27 articles were selectedfor analysis. Most of the publications were in the field of health sciences (n = 10), and were indicated as research culture, perspective, commentary, essay, proceedings of a workshop, research article, world view, opinion, research note, editorial, report, and research policy articles (n = 22). The majority of studies proposed recommendations to address problems regarding threats to research rigour and reproducibility that were multi-modal (n = 20), targeting several open science practices. Some of the studies based their proposed recommendations on further evaluation or extension of previous initiatives. Most of the articles (n = 20) did not discuss implementation of their proposed intervention. Of the 27 included articles, 10 were cited in policy documents, with The Leiden Manifesto being the most cited (104 citations). 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     This review provides an overview of proposals to integrate open science into researcher assessment. The more promising ones need evaluation and, where appropriate, implementation. 
   
   
     Study registration 
     
      https://osf.io/ty9m7
review_content:
This articles aims to review “any open science practice-promoting initiatives proposed or implemented to assess researchers and research impact, in health sciences, biomedicine, psychology, and economics.”

Let me start by sharing that I am not familiar with the scoping review, following PRISMA, that appears to originate in the evidence synthesis in the health science and which. I work in the fields of research evaluation and scientometrics, which are embedded in social sciences working with mixed-methods – and thus my comments may reflect a disciplinary clash with the methods and framing of the authors, who are based in health sciences and medicine.

My overall impression is that the authors want to apply a reviewing methodology that may work in terms of finding evidence for issues where there are hard facts, but that is problematic for issues that are not well-defined. In our case, we are dealing with studies dealing with ‘initiatives’ that assess researchers and research impact while fostering Open Science in relation to transparency, integrity and data sharing. We should realise that Open Science is defined in different ways (the UNESCO definition mentioned in the text is very broad and includes values and principles), and that evaluation and impact assessment are also carried out in many ways under different names.

It appears that 27 publications found in relevant in the review include generic proposals such the San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA), The Leiden Manifesto for research metrics, The Metric Tide, and the Hong Kong Principles for Assessing Researchers, but also include general opinion pieces (Schmid, 2017)) and specific proposals for indicators that would favour open science (Bradshaw et al., 2021).

As I said, I don’t understand the scoping review methodology (and the exclusion of so many papers), but given the papers included above, I can think of many, many more publications which dealt with similar and related issues proposals for improvement. Just taking the journals ‘Research Evaluation’, ‘Scientometrics’, ‘Research Policy’ and ‘Quantitative Science Studies’ one can find dozens of articles dealing with the topics of researcher assessment, with direct implications in terms of integrity, transparency, reproducibility, collaborations, gender-bias, topic breadth or bias (e.g. due to the problems with use of narrow and proprietary databases (Singh et al., 2021)) or societal impact assessment (an issue highly discussed in the last 10 years (Smit & Hessels, 2021) that does not seem to appear in the 27 papers). Most of these proposals are not sector specific.

In short, I have the impression that this scoping review does not capture the breadth of literature that is making studies on research assessment and proposals about it which are directly relevant to Open Science, although possibly not mentioning OS. It captures publications of different types (a proposal on indicators, an opinion piece, the key documents like DORA), with gaps and unclear logics on why some are included and some not.

While I support the motivations of the authors in seeking better ways for assessing research to foster OS, I am worried about the apparent large gaps in the review.

Specific issues:
  * Title: in reading the title, I had expected it would focus on research impact assessment, meaning the assessment of the societal contribution of researchers (possibly because I am familiar with the UK evaluation system, where impact is assumed to be about society). However, I see that is is about assessing the contributions of researchers, with a focus on sharing and reproducibility. I would suggest making the title more specific to avoid mis-interpretation. Notice that this is a subset of the OS activities as defined by UNESCO. Pilars 3 and 4 of the UNESCO OS definition include participatory processes and dialogue with other knowledge systems. Therefore, I understand that the assessments of impacts in terms of interaction between researchers and beneficiaries should also concern OS.
  * Field selection: The authors state that “We included studies from the health sciences, biomedicine, psychology, and economics fields, as our impression is that open science developments are more prevalent in these disciplines, which are also closest to our knowledge and experience.”. These are fields that deal with complex problems with quantitative techniques and may have more practices on data sharing, or integrity in methods. However, some aspects of OS (as defined by UNESCO) such as participatory research may be more prevalent in other disciplines such as sociology or applied social sciences.
  * Search strategy: The search strategy, as reported in https://osf.io/trfq8 is so complicated that it is very difficult to follow. For an issue such as Open Science that is contested and there are plural understandings (Fecher & Friesike, 2014), this is very problematic, as it is important to convey to the reader what the authors are actually looking at.
  * Screening strategy: I am not familiar with the Continuous Active Learning® (CAL®) tool. I am quite surprised that after screening you ended up with only 208 publications out of the 18,000 – and then only 27 are found relevant. Could you give examples in the text of why so many where excluded?
  * Supplementary materials: Tables 3 and 4 in the underlying data are mentioned, but I could not find them in the supplementary files at https://osf.io/gxy5z.

Examples of missing literature:
  * Adam, P., Ovseiko, P.V., Grant, J. et al. ISRIA statement: ten-point guidelines for an effective process of research impact assessment. Health Res Policy Sys 16, 8 (2018). https://doi-org.ezproxy.leidenuniv.nl/10.1186/s12961-018-0281-5
  * Dahler-Larsen, P. (2018). Making citations of publications in languages other than English visible: On the feasibility of a PLOTE-index. Research Evaluation, 27(3), 212–221.
  * Hormia-Poutanen, Kristiina, Enst Kristiansen, Rebecca Lawrence, Sabina Leonelli, Natalia Manola, Eva Méndez, Christopher Rossel, Michela Vignoli, and Marta Dias Agostinho. 2017. “Recommendations of the OSPP on Next-Generation Metrics.” Almetrics Workng Group of the Open Science Policy Platform.
  * Larivière, V., Kiermer, V., MacCallum, C. J., McNutt, M., Patterson, M., Pulverer, B., ... & Curry, S. (2016). A simple proposal for the publication of journal citation distributions. BioRxiv, 062109.
  * Wilsdon, James, Judit Bar-ilan, Robert Frodeman, Elisabeth Lex, Isabella Peters, and Paul Wouters. 2017. Next-Generation Metrics: Reponsible Metrics and Evaluation for Open Science. Brussels, Belgium: European Commission. https://doi.org/10.2777/337729.
  * Wouters, P., Ràfols, I., Oancea, A., Kamerlin, L., Holbrook, B., & Jacob, M. (2019). Indicator frameworks for fostering open knowledge practices in science and scholarship. European Commission. https://doi.org/10.2777/445286
References
  * Bradshaw, C. J. A., Chalker, J. M., Crabtree, S. A., Eijkelkamp, B. A., Long, J. A., Smith, J. R., Trinajstic, K., & Weisbecker, V. (2021). A fairer way to compare researchers at any career stage and in any discipline using open-access citation data. PLOS ONE, 16(9), e0257141. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0257141
  * Fecher, B., & Friesike, S. (2014). Open Science: One term, five schools of thought. In S. Bartling & S. Friesike (Eds.), Opening Science. Springer International Publishing. https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-319-00026-8
  * Schmid, S. L. (2017). Five years post-DORA: Promoting best practices for research assessment. Molecular Biology of the Cell, 28(22), 2941–2944. https://doi.org/10.1091/mbc.e17-08-0534
  * Singh, V. K., Singh, P., Karmakar, M., Leta, J., & Mayr, P. (2021). The journal coverage of Web of Science, Scopus and Dimensions: A comparative analysis. Scientometrics, 126(6), 5113–5142. https://doi.org/10.1007/s11192-021-03948-5

paper_title_zh: 开放科学干预措施：旨在评估研究者影响力的提议或实施情况——一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
为提高生物医学研究的质量，已提出多项促进开放科学的倡议，包括将研究人员的开放科学行为作为晋升或终身教职评估标准的倡议。然而，关于这些干预措施是否有效的证据有限。本综述旨在总结文献，识别与研究评估相关的开放科学实践，并绘制现有用于评估研究人员和研究影响的干预措施的证据范围。

方法
采用乔安娜·布里格斯研究所范围综述方法进行范围综述。我们纳入了描述在健康科学、生物医学、心理学和经济学领域提出或实施的任何促进开放科学实践倡议以评估研究人员和研究影响的所有研究类型。数据综合是定量和描述性的。

结果
在18,020份识别的文档中，选取了27篇文章进行分析。大多数出版物属于健康科学领域（n = 10），并被标记为研究文化、视角、评论、散文、研讨会会议记录、研究文章、世界观、观点、研究简报、社论、报告和研究政策文章（n = 22）。大多数研究提出了多模态（n = 20）的建议，以解决威胁研究严谨性和可重复性的问题，针对多种开放科学实践。一些研究基于对先前倡议的进一步评估或扩展提出了建议。大多数文章（n = 20）未讨论其提出干预措施的实施情况。在27篇纳入的文章中，有10篇被政策文件引用，其中《莱顿宣言》被引用次数最多（104次）。

结论
本综述提供了将开放科学纳入研究人员评估的提案概览。更有前景的提案需要评估，并在适当的情况下实施。

研究注册
https://osf.io/ty9m7
review_content_zh:
本文旨在回顾“在健康科学、生物医学、心理学和经济学领域，提出的或实施的任何旨在促进开放科学实践、评估研究人员和研究影响的倡议”。

首先，我需要说明我对遵循PRISMA的范畴审查并不熟悉，这种审查似乎起源于健康科学领域的证据综合。我工作于研究评估和科学计量学领域，这些领域嵌入社会科学，采用混合方法——因此我的评论可能反映了与基于健康科学和医学的作者们在方法和框架上的学科冲突。

我的总体印象是，作者们希望应用一种审查方法，这种方法在寻找有确凿事实的问题证据时可能有效，但对于定义不明确的问题则存在问题。在我们的案例中，我们正在处理的是评估研究人员和研究影响的同时促进开放科学（涉及透明度、诚信和数据共享）的“倡议”研究。我们应该意识到，开放科学的定义多种多样（文中提到的联合国教科文组织的定义非常宽泛，包括价值观和原则），评估和影响评估也在许多不同的名称下以多种方式进行。

在审查中发现的27篇相关出版物包括一些通用提案，如《旧金山研究评估宣言》（DORA）、《莱顿研究指标宣言》、《指标潮》和《香港评估研究人员原则》，但也包括一般性观点文章（Schmid, 2017）和有利于开放科学的具体指标提案（Bradshaw等人，2021）。

正如我所说，我不理解范畴审查方法（以及排除如此多论文的原因），但鉴于上述包含的论文，我可以想到许多更多处理类似和相关问题及改进提案的出版物。仅以《研究评估》、《科学计量学》、《研究政策》和《定量科学研究》等期刊为例，可以找到数十篇涉及研究人员评估主题的文章，这些文章直接涉及诚信、透明度、可重复性、合作、性别偏见、主题广度或偏见（例如，由于使用狭窄和专有数据库的问题（Singh等人，2021））或社会影响评估（这是过去10年高度讨论的问题（Smit & Hessels, 2021），似乎并未出现在这27篇论文中）。这些提案大多不是特定于某个领域的。

简而言之，我有这样的印象：尽管这些研究可能未提及开放科学，但这次范畴审查并未捕捉到与研究评估及其提案相关的广泛文献，而这些文献直接与开放科学相关。 它涵盖了不同类型的出版物（如关于指标的提案、观点文章、关键文件如DORA），其中存在一些空白和不清晰的逻辑，解释了为什么有些被包含而有些没有。

虽然我支持作者寻求更好评估研究以促进开放科学（OS）的动机，但我对综述中明显存在的较大空白感到担忧。

具体问题：
  * 标题：在阅读标题时，我本以为它会专注于研究影响评估，即评估研究人员对社会的贡献（可能是因为我熟悉英国的评估体系，其中影响被认为是关于社会的）。然而，我发现它是关于评估研究人员的贡献，重点在于分享和可重复性。我建议使标题更加具体，以避免误解。请注意，这仅是联合国教科文组织定义的开放科学活动的一个子集。联合国教科文组织开放科学定义的第3和第4支柱包括参与性过程和其他知识系统的对话。因此，我理解在研究人员和受益者之间互动方面的影响评估也应关注开放科学。
  * 领域选择：作者指出“我们纳入了来自健康科学、生物医学、心理学和经济学的 studies，因为我们的印象是开放科学的发展在这些学科中更为普遍，这些学科也最接近我们的知识和经验。”这些领域涉及使用定量技术解决复杂问题，可能在大数据共享或方法完整性方面有更多实践。然而，开放科学的一些方面（如联合国教科文组织所定义的）如参与性研究可能在其他学科如社会学或应用社会科学中更为普遍。
  * 搜索策略：如 https://osf.io/trfq8 所报告的搜索策略非常复杂，以至于很难跟随。对于开放科学这样一个存在争议且有多重理解的问题（Fecher & Friesike, 2014），这是非常有问题的，因为向读者传达作者实际在关注什么是很重要的。
  * 筛选策略：我不熟悉连续主动学习®（CAL®）工具。我非常惊讶，在筛选后，你们从18,000篇出版物中只选出了208篇——然后只有27篇被认为是相关的。你们能在文本中举例说明为什么排除了这么多吗？
  * 补充材料：在基础数据中的表3和表4被提及，但我无法在 https://osf.io/gxy5z 的补充文件中找到它们。

paper_title: A comprehensive review of deep learning-based single image super-resolution
paper_abstract: Image super-resolution (SR) is one of the vital image processing methods that improve the resolution of an image in the field of computer vision. In the last two decades, significant progress has been made in the field of super-resolution, especially by utilizing deep learning methods. This survey is an effort to provide a detailed survey of recent progress in single-image super-resolution in the perspective of deep learning while also informing about the initial classical methods used for image super-resolution. The survey classifies the image SR methods into four categories, i.e., classical methods, supervised learningbased methods, unsupervised learning-based methods, and domain-specific SR methods. We also introduce the problem of SR to provide intuition about image quality metrics, available reference datasets, and SR challenges. Deep learning-based approaches of SR are evaluated using a reference dataset. Some of the reviewed state-of-the-art image SR methods include enhanced deep SR network (EDSR), cycle-in-cycle GAN (CinCGAN), multiscale residual network (MSRN), meta residual dense network (Meta-RDN), recurrent back-projection network (RBPN), second-order attention network (SAN), SR feedback network (SRFBN) and wavelet-based residual attention network (WRAN). Finally, this survey is concluded with future directions and trends in SR and open problems in SR to be addressed by the researchers.

paper_title_zh: 基于深度学习的单图像超分辨率综合综述
paper_abstract_zh: 图像超分辨率（SR）是计算机视觉领域中提升图像分辨率的重要图像处理方法之一。在过去的二十年里，超分辨率领域取得了显著进展，尤其是通过利用深度学习方法。本综述旨在详细梳理近年来基于深度学习的单图像超分辨率技术的最新进展，同时介绍最初用于图像超分辨率的经典方法。该综述将图像SR方法分为四类，即经典方法、基于监督学习的方法、基于无监督学习的方法和特定领域的SR方法。我们还引入了SR问题，以提供关于图像质量指标、可用参考数据集和SR挑战的直观理解。基于深度学习的SR方法通过参考数据集进行评估。一些被评述的先进图像SR方法包括增强型深度SR网络（EDSR）、循环中的循环GAN（CinCGAN）、多尺度残差网络（MSRN）、元残差密集网络（Meta-RDN）、递归反投影网络（RBPN）、二阶注意力网络（SAN）、SR反馈网络（SRFBN）和小波基残差注意力网络（WRAN）。最后，本综述总结了SR的未来方向和趋势，以及研究人员需要解决的SR开放性问题。

paper_title: Smokeless tobacco use and reproductive outcomes among women: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background : Both smoked and smokeless tobacco use have deleterious effects on most major organ systems including the 
reproductive system. We conducted a systematic review on smokeless tobacco (SLT) use and 
reproductive outcomes among women. 
 Methods : We searched Pubmed, ProQuest, Cochrane, Wiley and Emerald databases for studies 
involving smokeless tobacco use in women with any or a combination of three conditions: 
infertility, menstrual disorders and pelvic inflammatory disease (PID). Eligibility criteria included 
English language publications from 1st January 1990 - 31st October 2020. CADIMA software 
used for filtering the studies and modified SIGN checklist for the quality assessment. The findings 
are reported as per the PRISMA guidelines. The AXIS and ROBIN E tool were used for assessment of risk of bias. 
 Results : In total, three studies addressed our research question. Two studies addressed infertility 
(prospective cohort: n=501, cross sectional: n=192) of which, the cross-sectional study compared 
the mean cotinine levels between those with infertility, menstrual disorders and PID. This study 
also explored the association between SLT and PID. PID was the most common gynecological 
complaint. Women with PID had significantly higher urinary cotinine levels = 24.95±12.259) ng/ 
ml (p=0.0144). Mean urinary cotinine in women with menstrual complaints was 19.32±10.29 ng/ml.  
The other study used population-based sampling of 501 couples who attempted pregnancy (enrolled in the LIFE Study).  
Results showed that 9% and 2% (n=28) of men used snuff and chewed tobacco respectively. and  few of the women used smokeless tobacco.  
Time to pregnancy was shorter among smokeless tobacco users relative to smokers. 
 Conclusions : Available studies exploring associations between SLT and reproductive outcomes 
are inconclusive due to limitations in the study methodologies. More studies with robust study 
designs are required from low- and middle-income countries with high prevalence of SLT use.
review_content:
The authors use the term reproductive outcomes in the title and then use the terms “reproductive outcomes” and “reproductive health” interchangeably throughout the review. It may be beneficial to use standardized definitions in the review. Rationale also needs to be provided why these 3 particular outcomes namely infertility, menstrual disorders, and pelvic inflammatory disease have been the focus of the review rather than the more commonly reported reproductive outcomes low birth weight, stillbirth, spontaneous abortion, preterm birth and so on in studies related to smokeless tobacco.

In two of the studies, included in the review, the women participants were not consuming smokeless tobacco which is the focus of the review. So the authors need to clarify whether these studies fulfilled their inclusion and exclusion criteria.

All the above points have a bearing on the conclusions drawn from the review and hence need to be addressed.

The discussion also focuses more on smoking rather than smokeless tobacco.
paper_title_zh: 无烟烟草使用与女性生殖结局：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：吸烟和无烟烟草使用对大多数主要器官系统，包括生殖系统，都有有害影响。我们对女性无烟烟草（SLT）使用与生殖结果进行了系统综述。
方法：我们在Pubmed、ProQuest、Cochrane、Wiley和Emerald数据库中搜索了涉及女性无烟烟草使用的研究，研究对象为具有以下任一或组合条件者：不孕、月经失调和盆腔炎性疾病（PID）。纳入标准包括1990年1月1日至2020年10月31日的英文出版物。使用CADIMA软件筛选研究，并采用修改后的SIGN清单进行质量评估。根据PRISMA指南报告研究结果。使用AXIS和ROBIN E工具评估偏倚风险。
结果：共有三项研究符合我们的研究问题。两项研究涉及不孕（前瞻性队列：n=501，横断面：n=192），其中横断面研究比较了不孕、月经失调和PID患者的平均可替宁水平。该研究还探讨了SLT与PID之间的关联。PID是最常见的妇科主诉。患有PID的女性尿可替宁水平显著较高（24.95±12.259 ng/ml，p=0.0144）。月经投诉女性的平均尿可替宁水平为19.32±10.29 ng/ml。另一项研究使用了基于人群的抽样，涉及501对尝试怀孕的夫妇（参与LIFE研究）。结果显示，9%和2%（n=28）的男性分别使用鼻烟和咀嚼烟草，少数女性使用无烟烟草。与吸烟者相比，无烟烟草使用者的怀孕时间更短。
结论：由于研究方法上的局限性，现有探讨SLT与生殖结果之间关联的研究尚无定论。需要来自无烟烟草使用高流行的低收入和中等收入国家更多具有稳健研究设计的研究。
review_content_zh:
作者在标题中使用了“生殖结果”这一术语，并在综述中交替使用了“生殖结果”和“生殖健康”这两个术语。在综述中使用标准化定义可能是有益的。还需要提供理由，说明为什么选择不孕、月经失调和盆腔炎这三种特定的结果作为综述的重点，而不是在涉及无烟烟草的研究中更常报告的生殖结果，如低出生体重、死产、自然流产、早产等。

在综述中包含的两项研究中，女性参与者并未使用作为综述重点的无烟烟草。因此，作者需要澄清这些研究是否符合他们的纳入和排除标准。

以上所有观点都对从综述中得出的结论有影响，因此需要加以解决。

讨论部分也更侧重于吸烟而非无烟烟草。

paper_title: A Survey on Fairness Without Demographics
paper_abstract: The issue of bias in Machine Learning (ML) models is a significant challenge for the machine learning community. Real-world biases can be embedded in the data used to train models, and prior studies have shown that ML models can learn and even amplify these biases. This can result in unfair treatment of individuals based on their inherent characteristics or sensitive attributes such as gender, race, or age. Ensuring fairness is crucial with the increasing use of ML models in high-stakes scenarios and has gained significant attention from researchers in recent years. However, the challenge of ensuring fairness becomes much greater when the assumption of full access to sensitive attributes does not hold. The settings where the hypothesis does not hold include cases where (1) only limited or noisy demographic information is available or (2) demographic information is entirely unobserved due to privacy restrictions. This survey reviews recent research efforts to enforce fairness when sensitive attributes are missing. We propose a taxonomy of existing works and, more importantly, highlight current challenges and future research directions to stimulate research in ML fairness in the setting of missing sensitive attributes.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This submission is intended to be a survey on machine learning fairness, specifically concerning the setting where "Demographic" information is missing. In this case "Demographic" information refers to information that is considered "sensitive". For instance, this could be class information. This can obviously cause problems when considering class/group-based fairness concepts. This paper provides a background on the problem of machine learning fairness, discusses first notions of fairness, followed by approaches for fairness.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
*Strengths* * I like the way this paper categorizes the existing fairness methods. * Sections 4 and 5 is the best part of the paper, succinct and informative. *Weaknesses* * In my opinion the introduction is cluttered and off-putting. The introduction of a survey paper should explain the reason why the paper is being written. What is the missing context in the literature? What is the information you plan to present? How will you present it? This kind of introduction that you have written would be better left for a background section. * Tables are inconsistently formatted and hard to read * Figure 2 is strange. Each sub-heading should be clearly be a technique. I understand that each of these words are associated with techniques, but it is confusing * This paper is quite verbose, yet still fails to go deep enough into the details of the algorithms for it to be useful. * Section 6 is too verbose, but simultaneously lacking detail. Overall, I feel that this section fails as a survey. Perhaps it would be better to focus less on summarizing a long list of other papers, and more to explain the overarching concepts in each of the "types" of approaches you have identified, explaining the pros and cons of each with respect to the metrics that were identified in Section 5.

**Requested Changes:**
* I suggest you re-write the introduction based on my comments in above. * (throughout) “fair machine community”, "fair ML community", etc., be more consistent. * (Table 1) What does “fairly” mean, Overall, the table (spacing) looks unprofessional, please fix. * (Table 4) Looks slightly more professional, but still poorly formatted. Please make all tables look consistent. * (Eqn. 4) The equation is incorrect. * (Fig 1 and 2) Remove or revamp Fig 1 and 2. * (throughout) General proofreading is needed. Though I don't notice a huge amount of technical errors, phrasing is often awkward. * Section 6 is too verbose, but also lacks detail, please revise based on my points above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
Fairness is an important topic to discuss broader impact concerns, but since this is a survey, I don't see any immediate issues.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Reply to Reviewer muA1: We thank the reviewer for the detailed feedback and insightful suggestions. We have carefully addressed all the points raised in the revised manuscript in `red` and as outlined below. > I suggest you re-write the introduction based on my comments in above. We welcome and appreciate the reviewer’s suggestion. In the revised manuscript, we have modified the introduction to address the concerns and restructured as suggested. Specifically, we emphasized the context of the paper, the topics covered, their motivations, and how they are presented. > (throughout) “fair machine community”, "fair ML community", etc., be more consistent. We fixed the inconsistencies throughout the paper. > (Table 1) What does “fairly” mean, Overall, the table (spacing) looks unprofessional, please fix. By *fairly*, we meant the survey briefly covers fairness without demographic information. We have fixed the formatting issues with the table and clarified the confusion. > Section 6 is too verbose, but also lacks detail, please revise based on my points above. We have revised section 6 to make it more succinct. While we acknowledge that not all papers are covered in detail, and we provided enough information for most papers to help the reader grasp the core idea. Moreover, section 6 presents an overview of each method we identified under each category, along with their pros and cons. We also emphasize how each technique addresses the challenges identified in each category and which fairness metrics they can improve. Thank you again for your time and valuable feedback, which significantly helped to improve the paper. We hope the changes have addressed your concerns, and we will be happy to provide more clarifications where needed.
paper_title_zh: 关于无需人口统计信息的公平性综述
paper_abstract_zh: 机器学习（ML）模型中的偏见问题对机器学习社区构成了重大挑战。现实世界的偏见可能嵌入用于训练模型的数据中，先前的研究已经表明，ML模型可以学习和甚至放大这些偏见。这可能导致基于个体固有特征或敏感属性（如性别、种族或年龄）的不公平待遇。随着ML模型在高风险场景中的日益应用，确保公平性至关重要，近年来已引起研究人员的广泛关注。然而，当无法完全获取敏感属性的假设不成立时，确保公平性的挑战变得更大。假设不成立的情境包括以下情况：（1）仅有有限或噪声较大的人口统计信息可用，或（2）由于隐私限制，人口统计信息完全未观测到。本综述回顾了在敏感属性缺失时强制实施公平性的最新研究努力。我们提出了现有工作的分类法，更重要的是，突出了当前挑战和未来研究方向，以激发在缺失敏感属性情境下ML公平性的研究。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本投稿旨在对机器学习公平性进行综述，特别是针对“人口统计”信息缺失的情境。在此情况下，“人口统计”信息指的是被视为“敏感”的信息。例如，这可能是类别信息。显然，这在考虑基于类别/群体的公平性概念时会引起问题。本文提供了机器学习公平性问题的背景，讨论了公平性的初步概念，随后介绍了实现公平性的方法。

**优点与缺点：**
**优点**
* 我喜欢本文对现有公平性方法的分类方式。
* 第4节和第5节是本文的最佳部分，简洁且信息丰富。

**缺点**
*在我看来，引言部分杂乱且令人反感。综述文章的引言应解释撰写该文的原因。文献中缺失的背景是什么？你计划呈现哪些信息？你将如何呈现这些信息？你所写的这种引言更适合放在背景部分。
* 表格格式不一致，难以阅读。
* 图2很奇怪。每个小标题应清晰地表示一种技术。我理解这些词都与技术相关，但这样很令人困惑。
* 本文过于冗长，却仍未深入到算法细节，使其实用性不足。
* 第6节过于冗长，同时缺乏细节。总体而言，我认为这一节作为综述是失败的。或许应少关注总结大量其他论文，而更多地解释你所识别的每种“类型”方法中的总体概念，并解释每种方法在相对于第5节中确定的指标方面的优缺点。

**请求的修改：**
* 基于上述评论，我建议你重写引言。
* （全文）“公平机器学习社区”、“公平ML社区”等，请保持一致性。
* （表1）“fairly”是什么意思？总体而言，表格（间距）看起来不专业，请修正。
* （表4）看起来稍微专业一些，但格式仍然不佳。请使所有表格格式一致。
* （公式4）公式不正确。
* （图1和图2）删除或重做图1和图2。
* （全文）需要一般性校对。尽管我没有发现大量技术错误，但措辞常常显得尴尬。
* 第6节过于冗长，同时缺乏细节，请根据上述观点进行修订。

**更广泛影响关注点：**
公平性是一个重要的讨论话题，鉴于这是一篇综述，我没有看到任何直接问题。

**主张与证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳评论：**
回复评审员muA1：感谢评审员提供的详细反馈和有见地的建议。我们已仔细修订了手稿，并在`红色`中针对所有提出的问题进行了回应，具体如下。
> 基于上述评论，我建议你重写引言。我们欢迎并感谢评审员的建议。在修订稿中，我们修改了引言以解决所提问题，并按建议进行了重组。具体而言，我们强调了文章的背景、涵盖的主题、其动机以及呈现方式。

> （表1）“fairly”是什么意思？总体而言，表格（间距）看起来不专业，请修正。所谓“fairly”，我们是指综述简要涵盖了无人口统计信息的公平性。我们已修正表格格式并澄清了混淆。
> 第6节过于冗长，同时缺乏细节，请根据上述观点进行修订。我们已修订第6节使其更加简洁。我们承认并非所有论文都详细覆盖，但提供了足够信息以帮助读者掌握大多数论文的核心思想。此外，第6节概述了我们在每个类别下识别的每种方法，并附上其优缺点。我们还强调每种技术如何应对每个类别中识别的挑战，以及它们能改进哪些公平性指标。

paper_title: Big data clustering techniques based on Spark: a literature review
paper_abstract: A popular unsupervised learning method, known as clustering, is extensively used in data mining, machine learning and pattern recognition. The procedure involves grouping of single and distinct points in a group in such a way that they are either similar to each other or dissimilar to points of other clusters. Traditional clustering methods are greatly challenged by the recent massive growth of data. Therefore, several research works proposed novel designs for clustering methods that leverage the benefits of Big Data platforms, such as Apache Spark, which is designed for fast and distributed massive data processing. However, Spark-based clustering research is still in its early days. In this systematic survey, we investigate the existing Spark-based clustering methods in terms of their support to the characteristics Big Data. Moreover, we propose a new taxonomy for the Spark-based clustering methods. . To the best of our knowledge, no survey has been conducted on Spark-based clustering of Big Data. Therefore, this survey aims to present a comprehensive summary of the previous studies in the field of Big Data clustering using Apache Spark during the span of 2010-2020. This survey also highlights the new research directions in the field of clustering massive data.

Reply to Comment#3: In Section V, at the beginning of the section, we added a new heading titled “Survey Findings”. Under this heading, we answered the research questions and added pointers in each answer to more detailed discussion in the subsections of the paper as shown below: Survey Findings: The research questions (see Section IV) that we investigated in this survey are addressed as shown below: • Answer to Q1: The Spark-based clustering algorithms were divided into three main categories: k-means based methods, hierarchal-based methods and density based methods. paper_title_zh: 基于Spark的大数据聚类技术：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 一种流行的无监督学习方法，即聚类，被广泛应用于数据挖掘、机器学习和模式识别中。该过程涉及将单个且独特的点分组到一个组中，使得它们要么彼此相似，要么与其他簇的点不相似。传统的聚类方法因近年来数据的巨大增长而面临重大挑战。因此，一些研究工作提出了利用大数据平台（如Apache Spark）优势的新型聚类方法设计，Apache Spark旨在进行快速且分布式的海量数据处理。然而，基于Spark的聚类研究仍处于早期阶段。在这项系统综述中，我们从支持大数据特性的角度调查了现有的基于Spark的聚类方法。此外，我们提出了一个新的基于Spark的聚类方法分类法。据我们所知，尚未有关于大数据基于Spark的聚类的研究综述。因此，本综述旨在全面总结2010年至2020年间使用Apache Spark进行大数据聚类领域的前人研究。本综述还突出了大规模数据聚类领域的新研究方向。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）

基本报告
评论#1：例如，在第302行，“methods”和“The”之间应有空格。第525行，纠正“volumn”的拼写。
回复评论#1：我们已经修订了论文，并纠正了所有包括审稿人指出的在内的拼写和语法错误。

实验设计
评论#2：调查结果应在调查方法之后立即呈现。将第五部分标题为“Spark聚类算法”（作者声称该部分提供了对调查问题的大部分答案）并不会让读者联想到这是对调查问题的答案。
回复评论#2：我们在第五部分的开头添加了一个新的标题“调查结果”，并在该标题下详细回答了五个研究问题。每个问题的答案都包含了指向论文主体中对该问题更详细讨论的指针。

结果有效性
评论#3：所有研究结果，即对五个调查问题的答案，应放在标题为“调查结果”或简称为“结果”的部分下。答案不应像目前这样隐含。作者应逐一挑选并解答。例如，作者可以采用以下格式：
V. 调查结果
本节呈现了与调查问题相关的研究结果。
研究问题1：基于Spark的聚类方法有哪些类型？
作者将从选定的91篇论文中提供答案并回答该问题。
研究问题2：……
研究问题5
遵循此格式将使内容对读者更加清晰。
回复评论#3：在第五部分的开头，我们添加了一个新的标题“调查结果”。在该标题下，我们回答了研究问题，并在每个答案中添加了指向论文子部分中更详细讨论的指针，如下所示：
调查结果：我们在本次调查中研究的研究问题（见第四节）如下所示：
• 对Q1的答案：基于Spark的聚类算法分为三大类：基于k-means的方法、基于层次的方法和基于密度的方法。每个大类进一步细分为子类，如图3所示。对这些子类中基于Spark的聚类方法的详细讨论在下文中呈现（见子节V.A、V.B和V.C，图3和表1）。
• 对Q2的答案：我们在子节V.A、V.B和V.C中讨论了文献中提出的每种基于Spark的聚类大类下的不同方法。这些子节中的方法根据其相似性进行分组。这种方法的分组如表1所示。
• 对Q3的答案：基于Spark的聚类领域的差距主要分为两点。第一点是缺乏在聚类数据中使用AI工具和大数据平台。第二点是大多数当前聚类方法不支持大数据的多样性和速度特性。更多讨论见第六节。
• 对Q4的答案：一些现有工作采用优化技术来改进聚类结果。这些优化技术主要与k-means方法一起使用，如子节V.A.2和V.D中所讨论的。
• 对Q5的答案：不同方法的优缺点在讨论不同类型基于Spark的聚类方法的子节V.A、V.B和V.C中进行讨论。我们还在第六节中讨论了与基于Spark的聚类方法相关的发现。

对作者的建议
评论#5：
1. 第238行——作者可以删除“这些问题……论文”的陈述。正如我之前建议的，所有对调查问题的答案应出现在一个部分下。
2. 第五部分是另一篇文献综述。研究结果应是从选定的91篇论文中得出的与调查问题相关的答案，而不是另一篇文献综述。
3. 讨论部分也注意到同样的情况。作者应关注调查结果/发现的启示，而不是另一篇文献综述。
回复评论#5：
1. 已删除“这些问题……论文”的陈述。此外，我们根据审稿人的建议重新调整了论文结构。
2. 在第五部分的开头，我们添加了一个新的标题“调查结果”，在该标题下我们包含了五个研究问题的详细答案。然后，第五部分的后续子节讨论和比较了现有的基于Spark的聚类方法。
3. 我们在第五部分的末尾创建了一个名为“V.D. 聚类优化”的子节。然后，按照审稿人的建议，我们将关于聚类优化的讨论从第六节移至新的子节V.D中。

paper_title: SARS-CoV-2 and the role of fomite transmission: a systematic review
review_content:
In this manuscript, the authors have conducted an extensive comparison of many published studies attempting to assess the possibility of transmission of SARS-CoV-2 via fomites. Most of the studies reviewed involved samples from hospitals, although some studies were also from community settings. The authors report that none of the studies found infectious virus on fomites, and that viral RNA, while generally present to varying degrees, was likely of too poor quality in most instances to support infectivity anyway, based on relatively high cycle threshold (CT) values for the RNA samples.

This is a useful snapshot of where we are in the pandemic, and why thinking in the field has increasingly moved towards the view that fomite transmission is not a significant source of infection. This reviewer believes the authors are too timid in drawing that conclusion, only stating in the Abstract "Lack of positive viral cultures and variation in cycle thresholds create uncertainty about fomites as a mode of transmission." I believe a more forceful statement about the insignificance of fomite transmission is warranted.

In the second paragraph of the Introduction, the authors do not adequately characterize the content of some of the references cited.

The authors write, "it has been reported that SARS-CoV-2 can be transmitted indirectly through fomites or surfaces5." This is inaccurate; reference 5 is a review of work published up to that time, and at most, suggests the possibility that the virus can be transmitted through fomites. None of the papers reviewed in reference 5 showed indirect transmission through fomites. The authors must revise this sentence. My suggestion is to replace "reported" with "suggested", i.e., "it has been suggested that SARS-CoV-2 can be transmitted indirectly through fomites or surfaces5."

The opposite situation occurs in the very next sentence. The authors write, "However, some authors have suggested that there is a low risk of transmission of SARS-CoV-2 through fomites6,7." Reference 6 is more than a suggestion; the authors report the absence of infectious virus on surfaces in hospitals treating COVID-19 patients. My suggestion here is the reverse of my previous one, in this case, replace "suggested" with "reported" for reference 6, i.e., "However, some authors have reported6 or suggested7 that there is a low risk of transmission of SARS-CoV-2 through fomites."

In the last paragraph of the methods section, the authors write: "One reviewer (IJO) assessed the risk of bias and extracted data from the included studies, and these were independently checked by a second reviewer (EAS)." However, the reader is not given a clue as to what the authors mean by "bias" in this context. The absence of a definition and/or criteria for alleged "bias" makes this parameter meaningless in the manuscript. If the authors are to include this parameter, they must revise the manuscript to make clear what it is they are assessing as "bias", and how that assessment was made.
paper_title_zh: SARS-CoV-2及接触传播的作用：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：SARS-CoV-2 RNA已在污染物中检出，这表明病毒可能通过无生命物体传播。然而，关于此类传播的机制路径尚存在不确定性。我们的目标是识别、评估并总结来自初级研究和系统评价的证据，以评估污染物在传播中的作用。

方法：本综述是关于SARS-CoV-2传播动力学的开放证据评价的一部分。我们通过WHO Covid-19数据库、LitCovid、medRxiv和Google Scholar进行持续检索；基于五项标准评估研究质量，并持续报告重要发现。

结果：我们发现了64项研究：63项初级研究和一项系统评价（n=35）。初级研究的环境主要在医院（69.8%），包括普通病房、ICU和SARS-CoV-2隔离病房。研究设计存在差异，包括样本采集时间、卫生程序、通风设置和循环阈值。总体报告质量为低到中等。51项研究（使用RT-PCR）中SARS-CoV-2阳性检测的频率范围为0.5%至75%。循环阈值范围为20.8至44.1。17项研究报告了病毒浓度；然而，估计方法的不一致阻止了比较。11项研究（17.5%）尝试了病毒培养，但均未发现细胞病变效应。系统评价的结果显示，医疗环境是最常检测的（25/35，71.4%），但实验室报告的污染表面频率最高（20.5%，17/83）。

结论：大多数研究报告了在无生命表面检出SARS-CoV-2 RNA；然而，缺乏证据证明可恢复活病毒。阳性病毒培养的缺乏表明通过污染物传播SARS-CoV-2的风险较低。研究设计和方法的异质性阻止了跨研究的发现比较。制定标准化指南以进行和报告关于污染物传播的研究是必要的。
review_content_zh:
在这篇手稿中，作者对许多已发表的研究进行了广泛的比较，试图评估SARS-CoV-2通过接触传播的可能性。大多数被审查的研究涉及医院的样本，尽管也有一些研究来自社区环境。作者报告称，没有一项研究在接触物上发现传染性病毒，而且病毒RNA虽然普遍存在且程度不一，但基于相对较高的循环阈值（CT）值，大多数情况下RNA样本的质量可能太差，无法支持传染性。

这是对我们当前在疫情期间所处位置的有用快照，以及为何该领域的思考越来越多地倾向于认为接触传播不是感染的重要来源。本审稿人认为作者在得出这一结论时过于谨慎，仅在摘要中写道：“缺乏阳性病毒培养和循环阈值的变异使得接触传播作为一种传播方式存在不确定性。”我认为有必要对接触传播的不重要性做出更有力的声明。

在引言的第二段中，作者未能充分描述所引用的一些参考文献的内容。

作者写道：“据报道，SARS-CoV-2可以通过接触物或表面间接传播5。”这是不准确的；参考文献5是对当时已发表工作的综述，最多只是提出了病毒可能通过接触物传播的可能性。参考文献5中审查的论文中没有一篇显示通过接触物间接传播。作者必须修改这句话。我的建议是将“报道”替换为“提出”，即“有提出SARS-CoV-2可以通过接触物或表面间接传播5。”

在紧接着的下一句中，情况正好相反。作者写道：“然而，一些作者提出通过接触物传播SARS-CoV-2的风险较低6,7。”参考文献6不仅仅是提出；作者报告了在治疗COVID-19患者的医院表面未发现传染性病毒。这里的建议与之前的相反，在这种情况下，将“提出”替换为“报道”用于参考文献6，即“然而，一些作者报道6或提出7通过接触物传播SARS-CoV-2的风险较低。”

在方法部分的最后一段中，作者写道：“一位审稿人（IJO）评估了纳入研究的偏倚风险并提取了数据，这些数据由第二位审稿人（EAS）独立核对。”然而，读者并不知道作者在此背景下所指的“偏倚”是什么。缺乏对所谓“偏倚”的定义和/或标准使得这一参数在文稿中毫无意义。如果作者要包含这一参数，必须修改文稿以明确他们评估的“偏倚”是什么，以及是如何进行评估的。

reasons: In this manuscript, the authors have conducted an extensive comparison of many published studies attempting to assess the possibility of transmission of SARS-CoV-2 via fomites.
Most of the studies reviewed involved samples from hospitals, although some studies were also from community settings.

The authors report that none of the studies found infectious virus on fomites, and that viral RNA, while generally present to varying degrees, was likely of too poor quality in most instances to support infectivity anyway, based on relatively high cycle threshold (CT) values for the RNA samples.
In the second paragraph of the Introduction, the authors do not adequately characterize the content of some of the references cited.

The authors must revise this sentence. My suggestion is to replace "reported" with "suggested", i.e., "it has been suggested that SARS-CoV-2 can be transmitted indirectly through fomites or surfaces5."
However, some authors have reported6 or suggested7 that there is a low risk of transmission of SARS-CoV-2 through fomites."

paper_title: The rise and fall of machine learning methods in biomedical research
paper_abstract: In the era of explosion in biological data, machine learning techniques are becoming more popular in life sciences, including biology and medicine. This research note examines the rise and fall of the most commonly used machine learning techniques in life sciences over the past three decades.
review_content:
I should firstly point out that I was co-author on the 2011 editorial published in Bioinformatics titled, “The rise and fall of supervised machine learning techniques”1. Therefore I was momentarily surprised to be invited to review a paper with such a similar title. That editorial was only a page and a half long and only really scratched the surface of the interesting topic of the prevalence of use of machine learning in the biosciences. The author cites our 2011 paper and mentions that the current article can be considered an update of it. However, that is only mentioned in the very final paragraph of the paper. It would seem reasonable to me to make that one of the first things mentioned in the paper. Of course I am far from a neutral observer on this point.

Overall I think that the article presents sound and interesting science and should be published within F1000Research. I think it provides a timely update to the 2011 editorial and expands it with some nice extra details. The article increases the number of ML methods investigated from 5 to 10. Most notably linear regression models are included which top the league table.

I noticed an inconsistency in the data presented for ANNs in this new paper compared to the 2011 paper. Why is that? The numbers for ANN are considerably lower in this article. Is that because DNNs are split out from ANNs? Throughout the paper it says that ANNs have become known as DNNs. That is not correct. DNNs are a subtype of ANNs. So all DNNs are ANNs, but not all ANNs are DNNs. That needs correction throughout.

The following statement does not read well:
"The sharp increase usage in popularity rate of DNNs over the past few years (Figure 1C) suggests that DNNs will take the PR lead again in the coming years."
After multiple readings I would presume that PR lead means it has the highest popularity rate. DNNs would have more than 300 more mentions per million papers per year. Firstly that sentence is very confusing to understand for a reader. For the first two readings I thought you were saying that DNNs would take the lead from LRMs, which would seem unlikely. On third reading I thought you meant that the slope of DNNs would overtake LRMs, but clearly it has already done that. I think you should rethink that sentence or take it out.

Minor points:

Page 2. At he intersection -> At the intersection
Page 2. You mention that a surprising maximum of 1.2% of all paper mention one of the 10 ML techniques. Why is that surprising? Is it too low, too high? Please explain.
Page 2. NCBI database is mentioned. NCBI has a lot of databases, please specify which one.
Page 3. less used less -> used less
paper_title_zh: 机器学习方法在生物医学研究中的兴衰
paper_abstract_zh: 在生物数据爆炸的时代，机器学习技术在生命科学领域，包括生物学和医学中，正变得越来越流行。本研究简报考察了在过去三十年中，生命科学领域最常用机器学习技术的兴起与衰落。
review_content_zh:
首先，我应该指出，我是2011年发表在《生物信息学》杂志上的题为“监督式机器学习技术的兴衰”1的社论的共同作者。因此，当我受邀审阅一篇标题如此相似的论文时，我一时感到惊讶。那篇社论仅有一页半长，并且只是浅尝辄止地探讨了机器学习在生物科学中普遍应用的有趣话题。作者引用了我们2011年的论文，并提到当前文章可以被视为其更新版。然而，这一点仅在文章的最后一段提及。在我看来，将其作为文章开头提及的内容之一似乎是合理的。当然，在这点上我远非中立观察者。

总体而言，我认为该文章呈现了扎实且有趣的科学内容，应在F1000Research上发表。我认为它为2011年的社论提供了及时的更新，并补充了一些不错的额外细节。文章将研究的机器学习方法数量从5种增加到10种。最值得注意的是，线性回归模型被包括在内，并且位居榜首。

我注意到，与2011年的论文相比，这篇新论文中呈现的关于人工神经网络（ANNs）的数据存在不一致。为什么会这样？本文中ANN的数据明显较低。是因为深度神经网络（DNNs）从ANNs中分离出来了吗？文章中多次提到ANNs已被称为DNNs。这是不正确的。DNNs是ANNs的一个子类型。所以所有DNNs都是ANNs，但并非所有ANNs都是DNNs。这一点需要在全文中纠正。

以下陈述读起来不太通顺：
“过去几年DNNs使用率的急剧增加（图1C）表明，DNNs在未来几年将再次占据PR领先地位。”
经过多次阅读，我推测PR领先意味着它具有最高的流行率。DNNs的提及次数将每年每百万篇论文多出300次以上。首先，这个句子对读者来说非常难以理解。在前两次阅读中，我以为你说的是DNNs将取代线性回归模型（LRMs）的领先地位，这似乎不太可能。第三次阅读时，我以为你是指DNNs的增长斜率将超过LRMs，但显然它已经做到了。我认为你应该重新思考这个句子或将其删除。

次要问题：

第2页。At he intersection -> 在交汇处
第2页。你提到一个令人惊讶的最大值，即所有论文中有1.2%提到了这10种机器学习技术之一。为什么这令人惊讶？是太低还是太高？请解释。
第2页。提到了NCBI数据库。NCBI有很多数据库，请具体说明是哪一个。
第3页。less used less -> 使用较少
