paper_title: Framing and understanding the whole aspect of oral sex from social and health perspectives: a narrative review
paper_abstract:
Historically, oral sex is part of human sexual behaviour even though some consider it taboo, and its expression is deemed inappropriate. Human rights also stand out as technology becomes more sophisticated, leading to its practice disclosure in the 21 st century. The large-scale oral sex discussion in media encourages people to express it, and there is feedback on whether it is right or not. It all depends on each person’s values. We found this sexual behaviour occurs everywhere regardless of religion, culture and race. 
Pop culture influences this behaviour considerably. It can be seen in music, movies and television programmes that allude to oral sex. Numerous motivations underlying this behaviour include sexual pleasure for the sake of psychological well-being. It is undeniable that this behaviour is still controversial. There is a risk of it causing disease, but it reportedly provides many benefits. 
Oral sex is not a new behaviour crossing boundaries, according to our theory. It is an old behaviour that has been highlighted because of the factors that support it. This behaviour, still considered taboo, has its disadvantages, such as sexually transmitted disease and oral cancer, but also has benefits, such as preventing preeclampsia.
review_content:
Comprehensive discussion
  * Introduction - the purpose of this review is not exactly aligned with the title of the manuscript. As a reader, we expected to develop understanding about oral sex activities from the social and health perspectives. However, in the introduction we were getting more information on the definition of oral sex. Probably, it will be more suitable if the authors emphasise more on the contrary view between many perspectives about oral sex, thus point out the importance of the authors review.
  * Introduction - considering the purpose of this study, will it be more appropriate if the authors make a comparison about view or trend of oral sex, before and after the technological advancement as well as the increase penetration of pop culture? This will need a specific time period as boundaries for the literature searching as well as the discussion part.
  * Introduction - if the authors decided to write the comparison, it is also essential to write the effect of this difference in order to give a sense of urgency. For example, the authors can put how the increase of oral sex behaviours lead to higher incidence of STDs, oral cancer, etc. A paper from Kumar et al (2015) might be a start to look for further supporting evidence.1
  * Another specific part needed from this manuscript is regarding the scope. Since it is a global view, maybe we can make it more pointed for the title.
  * Method - any inclusion or exclusion criteria for the articles used in this narrative? For example, language and years of publication?
  * Results - write a statement about how the authors found their evidence; including how many papers the authors found, limitation and strength of their evidence.
  * Discussion - please provide specific time references for pop culture. Will it be different now and then, or can we generalise all time periods of any pop culture product?
  * Discussion - start with direct answer of the manuscript’s objective, followed by description of the authors finding and any relevant evidence.

Factual statements & citation
  * Introduction - Is there any supporting evidence for this claim? But currently, the trend of oral sex has increased prominently. The development of technology and media also supports this.
  * Reference from Lewis & Marston can be used to support the evidence from young adults perspectives, in regards to social narrative.2
  * Results & Discussion - Is there any supporting evidence for this claim? the difference is that technological developments accompanied by freedom of expression make this behaviour a lot of popping up in the population
  * Discussion - since the authors would like to explain the role of pop culture, it will be helpful for the reader to get a description on how pop culture is spread worldwide. Whether there was any difference due to licence, law, or any public policy, and maybe the country’s perspective about sexual content on any entertainment forms.

Language
  * The manuscript is provided with clear definition about oral sex, however it will be helpful if the authors write about what they meant about pop culture, social as well as health views in the introduction part.
  * The manuscript is written in English by using the grammar of Indonesian language. It will be easier to understand the objective and main point of this article, if this manuscript is being consulted with a formal service for academic writing.

Conclusions
  * Future direction & Conclusion - this part was enriched by the religious view, unfortunately the view was not discussed on the result & discussion section. The authors need to rearrange the structure of their paragraph, so it will be coherent and in line with the objective.
Future direction & conclusion shall be started with direct answer of the manuscript’s objective.
paper_title_zh: 从社会和健康视角构建和全面理解口交问题：叙事性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
历史上，口交是人类性行为的一部分，尽管有些人认为它是一种禁忌，其表达也被认为是不恰当的。随着技术的日益复杂，人权问题也凸显出来，导致其在21世纪的实践被披露。媒体中的大规模口交讨论鼓励人们表达这一行为，并存在关于其是否正确的反馈。这一切都取决于每个人的价值观。我们发现这种性行为无处不在，不受宗教、文化和种族的限制。

流行文化对这一行为的影响相当大。在音乐、电影和电视节目中都可以看到对口交的暗示。这种行为背后的众多动机包括为了心理福祉而追求性快感。不可否认，这种行为仍然具有争议性。它存在引发疾病的风险，但据报道也提供了许多益处。

根据我们的理论，口交并非一种跨越界限的新行为。它是一种古老的行为，由于支持它的因素而被凸显出来。这种仍被视为禁忌的行为有其缺点，如性传播疾病和口腔癌，但也有其益处，如预防先兆子痫。
review_content_zh:
全面讨论
  * 引言 - 本综述的目的与手稿标题不完全一致。作为读者，我们期望从社会和健康的角度了解口交活动。然而，在引言中，我们获得了更多关于口交定义的信息。或许，如果作者更多地强调关于口交的多种观点之间的对立，从而指出作者综述的重要性，会更加合适。
  * 引言 - 考虑到本研究的目的是否更合适，如果作者对技术进步以及流行文化渗透增加前后对口交的看法或趋势进行比较？这将需要一个特定的时间段作为文献搜索和讨论部分的界限。
  * 引言 - 如果作者决定撰写比较，也必须写出这种差异的影响，以便给人一种紧迫感。例如，作者可以说明口交行为的增加如何导致性传播疾病、口腔癌等的高发。Kumar等人（2015年）的论文可能是一个寻找进一步支持证据的起点。1
  * 手稿中需要的另一个具体部分是关于范围。既然是全球视角，或许我们可以为标题做得更具体。
  * 方法 - 用于本叙述的文章有任何纳入或排除标准吗？例如，语言和出版年份？
  * 结果 - 写一份关于作者如何找到证据的声明；包括作者找到了多少篇论文，证据的局限性和优势。
  * 讨论 - 请提供流行文化的具体时间参考。现在和那时会有不同吗，或者我们可以概括任何流行文化产品的所有时间段？
  * 讨论 - 从直接回答手稿的目标开始，接着描述作者的发现和任何相关证据。

事实陈述与引用
  * 引言 - 这一主张有任何支持证据吗？但目前，口交的趋势显著增加。技术和媒体的发展也支持了这一点。
  * 可以使用Lewis & Marston的参考文献来支持来自年轻人视角的社会叙事证据。2
  * 结果与讨论 - 这一主张有任何支持证据吗？区别在于技术发展与言论自由相伴，使这种行为在人群中大量出现
  * 讨论 - 由于作者希望解释流行文化的作用，对读者来说，了解流行文化如何在全球传播将是有帮助的。是否存在因许可、法律或任何公共政策而导致的差异，以及或许国家对任何娱乐形式中性内容的看法。

语言
  * 手稿提供了关于口交的明确定义，然而，如果作者在引言部分写明他们对流行文化、社会以及健康观点的理解，将会有所帮助。
  * 手稿是用英语撰写的，但使用了印度尼西亚语的语法。如果这份手稿咨询了正式的学术写作服务，将更容易理解本文的目标和要点。

结论
  * 未来方向与结论 - 这一部分因宗教观点而丰富，遗憾的是这一观点在结果与讨论部分未进行讨论。作者需要重新安排他们的段落结构，使其与目标一致且连贯。

paper_title: A Survey on Out-of-Distribution Detection in NLP
paper_abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is essential for the reliable and safe deployment of machine learning systems in the real world. Great progress has been made over the past years. This paper presents the first review of recent advances in OOD detection with a particular focus on natural language processing approaches. First, we provide a formal definition of OOD detection and discuss several related fields. We then categorize recent algorithms into three classes according to the data they used: (1) OOD data available, (2) OOD data unavailable + in-distribution (ID) label available, and (3) OOD data unavailable + ID label unavailable. Third, we introduce datasets, applications, and metrics. Finally, we summarize existing work and present potential future research topics.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents a survey of techniques for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in NLP. It focuses specifically on settings where a semantic shift in distribution is detected; that is, the label space (as opposed to the input space) has changed. It provides a taxonomy of settings, depending on whether OOD data or labeled in-distribution (ID) data is available, and then goes on to briefly describe methods from each leaf in the taxonomy. It closes with a discussion of differences between OOD detection for vision and NLP and sketches some future research challenges.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: As a narrative inventory of papers on OOD detection in NLP, this paper seems very thorough and up-to-date. Weaknesses: I don’t see survey papers listed among the contribution types in https://jmlr.org/tmlr/editorial-policies.html. Even if we assume that pure surveys are welcome, I don’t think this survey has sufficient value-add to be of interest to the TMLR readership. As mentioned above, the main contributions here are the inventory of papers and the taxonomy used to organize them. What’s missing is any sort of meaningful explanations of the methods themselves or an attempt to draw connections or generalizations among them. For a survey to truly add value, it should not only provide a jumping-off point through an annotated bibliography (which this survey does nicely) but it should also help the reader gain some insight into the commonalities between various methods. I did not feel like I understood any one method particularly well after reading this. The paper reads like a related work section of a larger paper - with each method getting exactly one sentence. I also found the actual NLP problems being solved to be very abstract and hard to grasp – the closest I came to clarity on this was when the various dialogue-related datasets were being described. In terms of clarity concerns: The paper on several occasions calls out the importance of complex output structures (trees or sequences) as a defining characteristic of NLP applications of OOD detection. However, this seems to run contrary to the paper’s focus on problems with semantic drift – where the label space changes as opposed to the input space. Surely this semantic drift is difficult to define when dealing with generation tasks like summarization or machine translation? I was hoping to hear more discussion of how this concept of drift even applies in such wide-open output settings, once we move beyond multi-class classification.

**Requested Changes:**
I think it’s very hard to come up with a list of requested changes for a survey paper. Were I writing something like this, I think I’d try to describe one key method from each of the major categories in depth, and then describe the others in contrast to that key method. I would also suggest that the authors lead with some concrete examples of cases where OOD detection is necessary for NLP, and not leave that to be inferred from the Data section. I will request that the authors clean up their citations. It’s very important that any citation not used as a noun in the text be completely enclosed in brackets. Also, some of the bibliography entries (the BERT one, for instance) are not formatted correctly.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
No

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Author response to Reviewer 6Y3y: We sincerely thank the reviewer for the time and effort in reviewing our paper and providing valuable feedback. We address each of the pointed weaknesses below: 1. "I don’t see survey papers listed among the contribution types": Kindly note that survey papers have been accepted by TMLR(https://jmlr.org/tmlr/papers/). 2. "I don’t think this survey has sufficient value-add to be of interest to the TMLR readership": For readers not familiar with the field of OOD detection in NLP, this survey gives a good picture and roadmap of OOD detection. Meanwhile, relevant algorithms are categorized into three distinct classes based on the data they utilized, which help readers use suitable OOD detection methods in practice. Moreover, comparisons betwen NLP and CV in OOD detection are discussed in this survey, which raise some interesting points that can be explored in future research. 3. "I did not feel like I understood any one method...with each method getting exactly one sentence": Kindly note that we have introduced the shared characteristics of sub-methods in each direction before diving into model details (For example, see the beginning paragraph of Section 3.2.1, Section 3.2.2, Section 3.2.3). 4. "more discussion of how this concept of drift even applies in such wide-open output settings, once we move beyond multi-class classification": Thanks for the suggestion. In the large language models (LLMs) era, NLP tasks can be treated as "text to text" beyond multi-class classification. In this setting, LLMs are trained to classify the next token in an output sequence [1]. LLMs may suffer even worse degradation on OOD inputs (e.g., different distribution from the training data) as the prediction is done auto-regressively over many steps. Thus, novel OOD detection approaches are encouraged to be developed for this new issue. We promise to include a new discussion on "Addressing LLMs". [1] Ren, Jie and Luo, Jiaming and Zhao, Yao and Krishna, Kundan and others. Out-of-distribution detection and selective generation for conditional language models. ICLR, 2023. | Clarification about survey papers: Hi, Thank you very much for your review. While indeed the editorial policies page is a bit vague on surveys, they are very welcome, as clarified in the TMLR FAQ: https://jmlr.org/tmlr/faq.html > Q: Does TMLR accept survey papers? > A: Yes. Authors should make sure to emphasize the contributions made by the survey. Ideally, we want survey papers that draw new, previously unreported connections between several pieces of work in an area, and/or that clearly highlight trends in the area and/or suggest currently open problems. It should also be noted that if a submission has more than 12 pages of main content, then TMLR's normal short review timeline will not be enforced. I kindly ask you (the reviewer) to keep this in mind during the rest of the process and to please update your review accordingly. For the authors: you are not expected to dedicate space to respond to the welcomeness of surveys in general. (feel free however to justify the value and contributions of your survey.) Thanks!
paper_title_zh: 自然语言处理中分布外检测综述
paper_abstract_zh: 分布外（OOD）检测对于机器学习系统在现实世界中的可靠和安全部署至关重要。近年来已取得显著进展。本文首次综述了OOD检测的最新进展，特别关注自然语言处理方法。首先，我们提供了OOD检测的正式定义，并讨论了几个相关领域。接着，我们将近期算法根据其使用的数据分为三类：（1）有可用的OOD数据，（2）无可用OOD数据但有分布内（ID）标签，以及（3）无可用OOD数据且无ID标签。第三，我们介绍了数据集、应用和评估指标。最后，我们总结了现有工作并提出了潜在的未来研究课题。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文对自然语言处理（NLP）中的分布外（OOD）检测技术进行了综述。特别关注在检测到分布的语义偏移的情况下；也就是说，标签空间（与输入空间相对）发生了变化。根据是否有OOD数据或标记的分布内（ID）数据可用，提供了设置分类法，并简要描述了分类法中每个叶节点的方法。最后，讨论了视觉和NLP中OOD检测的差异，并概述了一些未来的研究挑战。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：作为NLP中OOD检测论文的叙述性清单，本文似乎非常全面和最新。缺点：我在https://jmlr.org/tmlr/editorial-policies.html中并未看到综述论文被列为贡献类型之一。即使我们假设纯综述是受欢迎的，我也不认为这篇综述有足够的附加值来吸引TMLR的读者。如上所述，本文的主要贡献是论文清单和用于组织它们的分类法。所缺失的是对方法本身的有意义的解释，或尝试在它们之间建立联系或进行概括。要使综述真正增加价值，它不仅应通过带注释的参考书目提供一个起点（这篇综述做得很好），还应帮助读者洞察各种方法之间的共性。读完这篇综述后，我并没有觉得我对任何一个方法有特别深入的了解。本文读起来像是一篇更大论文的相关工作部分——每个方法只得到一句话的描述。我还发现所解决的NLP问题非常抽象，难以理解——我最接近清晰理解的是在描述各种与对话相关的数据集时。关于清晰度的担忧：本文多次强调复杂输出结构（树或序列）作为NLP应用中OOD检测的标志性特征。然而，这似乎与本文关注的问题（语义偏移）相矛盾——标签空间的变化与输入空间相对。在处理生成任务（如摘要或机器翻译）时，这种语义偏移确实难以定义？我希望能听到更多关于这种偏移概念如何在如此开放的输出设置中应用的讨论，一旦我们超越了多类分类。

**请求的更改：**
我认为为综述论文列出请求的更改非常困难。如果是我写这样的文章，我会尝试深入描述每个主要类别中的一个关键方法，然后将其余方法与该关键方法进行对比描述。我还建议作者首先给出一些NLP中需要OOD检测的具体案例，而不是让读者从数据部分去推断。我将要求作者清理他们的引文。任何未在文本中用作名词的引文必须完全用括号括起来。此外，一些参考文献条目（例如BERT的那个）格式不正确。

**声明和证据：**
无

**受众：**
无

**反驳意见：**
作者对评审员6Y3y的回应：我们衷心感谢评审员花时间和精力审阅我们的论文并提供宝贵的反馈。我们针对以下指出的缺点进行回应：1. "我没有看到综述论文被列在贡献类型中"：请注意，TMLR已经接受了综述论文（https://jmlr.org/tmlr/papers/）。2. "我认为这篇综述没有足够的附加值来吸引TMLR的读者"：对于不熟悉NLP中OOD检测领域的读者，这篇综述提供了OOD检测的良好图景和路线图。同时，相关算法根据其使用的数据被分为三个不同的类别，这有助于读者在实践中使用合适的OOD检测方法。此外，本文还讨论了NLP和CV在OOD检测中的比较，提出了一些有趣的可以探索的未来研究方向。3. "我没有觉得我理解了任何一个方法……每个方法只得到一句话的描述"：请注意，我们在深入模型细节之前介绍了每个方向子方法的共同特征（例如，参见第3.2.1节、第3.2.2节、第3.2.3节的开头段落）。4. "更多讨论这种偏移概念如何在如此开放的输出设置中应用，一旦我们超越了多类分类"：感谢建议。在大语言模型（LLMs）时代，NLP任务可以被视为超越多类分类的"文本到文本"。在这种设置中，LLMs被训练来分类输出序列中的下一个标记[1]。LLMs在OOD输入（例如，与训练数据不同的分布）上可能会遭受更严重的性能下降，因为预测是自回归地在多个步骤上完成的。因此，鼓励开发新的OOD检测方法来解决这一新问题。我们承诺将包括一个新的讨论"解决LLMs"。[1] Ren, Jie and Luo, Jiaming and Zhao, Yao and Krishna, Kundan and others. Out-of-distribution detection and selective generation for conditional language models. ICLR, 2023. | 关于综述论文的澄清：您好，非常感谢您的审阅。虽然编辑政策页面在综述方面确实有些模糊，但它们是非常受欢迎的，正如TMLR FAQ中所澄清的：https://jmlr.org/tmlr/faq.html > Q: TMLR接受综述论文吗？ > A: 是的。作者应确保强调综述所做的贡献。理想情况下，我们希望综述论文能够在某个领域内几项工作之间建立新的、以前未报告的联系，并/或清晰地突出该领域的趋势，并/或提出当前未解决的问题。还应注意的是，如果提交的内容超过12页的主内容，则TMLR的正常短期审阅时间表将不予执行。我恳请您（评审员）在后续过程中牢记这一点，并请相应地更新您的评审意见。对于作者：您不需要专门为综述的普遍欢迎性进行回应。（但可以自由地证明您综述的价值和贡献。）谢谢！

paper_title: A Survey of Lottery Ticket Hypothesis
paper_abstract: The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis (LTH) states that a dense neural network model contains a highly sparse subnetwork (i.e., winning tickets) that can achieve even better performance than the original model when trained in isolation. While LTH has been proved both empirically and theoretically in many works, there still are some open issues, such as efficiency and scalability, to be addressed. Also, the lack of open-source frameworks and consensual experimental setting poses a challenge to future research on LTH. For the first time, we examine previous research and studies on LTH from different perspectives. We also discuss issues in existing works and list potential directions for further exploration. This survey provides an in-depth look at the state of LTH.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper offers an overview of the most important references related to the topic of the "Lottery Ticket Hypothesis". It categorizes the existing literature in a number of categories, and mentions the contributions of the several cited works in a compact way probably accessible to experts.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
The Lottery Ticket Hypothesis is an interesting and emerging topic, so a survey paper would be appropriate and timely. I'm not an expert in this specific line of work and can't assess in a reasonable amount of time the completeness of the overview nor the correctness of what is said about existing literature. Minor: Some text gives the impression that the paper is not very rigorous and the structure can be improved, but I can't say with much confidence. E.g., Sec 2 starts saying in $f(x,\theta)$ the $x$ are "training samples" while hopefully the function also can be applied to test samples. Then a three-step procedure (pretraining, pruning, re-initialization) is presented, after which a paragraph follows which seems to suggest also several alternative approaches. The paper does not provide an introduction for non-experts. Contributions of cited works are summarized, using terminology which is not defined in the present paper. As such, if the overview would be complete and correct then it may be a nice reference for experts on this specific topic. A good survey paper provides an introduction on the relevant concepts to the reader, and discusses the advantages and disadvantages of the several lines of thinking which exist. This is not what the current paper does. For example * The text refers to Iterative Magnitude-based Pruning but does not give a hint what it is. * It is unclear what is a target subnetwork * The text refers to straight-through estimator without introducing it * The text suggests some papers try to prove some bounds, but it is unclear why kind of bounds they try to prove

**Requested Changes:**
The authors should choose their goal. * If they intend to make a good survey paper, they should explain all terms used, ideally in a way accessible to non-experts interested in getting an understanding of the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis domain. * If they intend to only provide a set of references to the most important papers as a useful tool to experts who are already familiar with this field, they should adapt the title and the claims may, e.g., "Overview of key references about the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis" would be a fitting title. If a reviewer who is expert in this line of work can confirm the adequacy of the overview of existing work, this may be a viable strategy where it is clear for potential readers what to expect. In its present form, the paper makes claims (providing a full survey) which are not supported by the content of the work.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
No concerns

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 彩票假设综述
paper_abstract_zh: 彩票假说（LTH）指出，一个稠密的神经网络模型包含一个高度稀疏的子网络（即中奖彩票），当单独训练时，该子网络能够实现比原始模型更好的性能。尽管LTH已在许多工作中得到了实证和理论上的证明，但仍存在一些待解决的问题，如效率和可扩展性。此外，缺乏开源框架和共识的实验设置对未来LTH的研究构成了挑战。我们首次从不同角度审视了以往关于LTH的研究和探讨，并讨论了现有工作中的问题，列出了进一步探索的潜在方向。本综述深入探讨了LTH的现状。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文提供了关于“彩票假说”主题最重要的参考文献的概述。它将现有文献分为若干类别，并以紧凑的方式提及了所引用作品的贡献，这种方式可能对专家来说是可理解的。

**优点与缺点：**
彩票假说是一个有趣且新兴的主题，因此一篇综述论文是恰当且及时的。我不是这一具体研究领域的专家，无法在合理时间内评估概述的完整性以及关于现有文献描述的正确性。次要问题：某些文本给人一种论文不够严谨且结构可以改进的印象，但我不能很有信心地这么说。例如，第2节开头提到在$f(x,\theta)$中，$x$是“训练样本”，而希望该函数也能应用于测试样本。然后介绍了一个三步程序（预训练、剪枝、重新初始化），之后是一段似乎也提到了几种替代方法的段落。论文没有为非专家提供引言。所引用作品的贡献被总结，使用了在本文中未定义的术语。因此，如果概述是完整且正确的，那么它可能成为该特定主题专家的一个不错的参考。一篇好的综述论文应向读者介绍相关概念，并讨论现有几种思路的优缺点。这正是当前论文所缺乏的。例如：
* 文本提到了基于幅度的迭代剪枝，但没有给出其定义的提示。
* 不清楚什么是目标子网络。
* 文本提到了直通估计器，但没有介绍它。
* 文本暗示某些论文试图证明某些界限，但不清楚它们试图证明哪种界限。

**请求的修改：**
作者应明确他们的目标。
* 如果他们打算写一篇好的综述论文，他们应解释所有使用的术语，理想情况下应以对希望了解彩票假说领域的非专家可理解的方式。
* 如果他们只想为已经熟悉该领域的专家提供一组最重要的论文参考，他们应调整标题和声明，例如，“彩票假说关键参考文献概述”将是一个合适的标题。如果一位该研究领域的专家评审员能确认现有工作概述的适当性，这可能是一个可行的策略，使潜在读者清楚预期内容。目前形式的论文提出了（提供全面综述）的声明，但内容不支持这些声明。

**更广泛的影响关切：**

无

paper_title: Water-energy-food nexus in the Great Lakes Region of Africa: Current status and prospects
paper_abstract: Water-energy-food (WEF) nexus is a concept that aims at integrating these three key economic drivers which are very crucial for the improving the livelihood of the people, general economic sustainable development and social well-being of the world population. The effective utilization and management of these key resources require in-depth planning assessment of symbiosis, competitions and concession with an essential contribution in the nexus. This paper aims at reviewing the WEF in the Great Lakes region of Africa with a focus in Kenya, Democratic Republic of Congo, Rwanda and Uganda. The status and prospects in each country has been assessed and the interconnection between the three fundamental resources together with the effects of climate change towards the security of these resources in the selected countries have been discussed. The review has found out that the selected countries are indeed WEF insecure since the impacts of climate change and poor infrastructure play a vital role in the insecurities highlighted. In the focused countries, it was realized that the existence of weak institutional and legal frameworks, political instability and poor infrastructure indeed hinders the regional attainment of the WEF nexus for sustainable economic development. This therefore calls for a dire need for the adoption of climate change adaptation and mitigation measures in the WEF nexus through an integrated and holistic approach in the Great Lakes Region of Africa.
review_content:
The paper is conducted based on the concept of the Water-Energy-Food (WEF) nexus and encourages researchers and practitioners on the benefits of using such a concept. It is not clear however to understand what is the nexus about and how it should help the Greater Lake Region of Africa (GLRA) to better analyze the interactions between water, energy, and food components. This study is based on the definition of the WEF nexus in GLRA. The analysis of existing tools to monitor WEF in entire Africa, as well as the water-energy-food-ecosystem-health (WEFBH) nexus in the Greater Horn of Africa, have been conducted. My suggestion, I wish the authors can apply new innovative tools to discover what is hidden from the WEF system.
The methodology is not clear. How many papers have the authors selected? How did they go through all the kinds of literature to get tangible results? Therefore, socio-economic and biophysical factors are known. Here, the authors elucidated the current situation and how are they connected. For instance, considering food security (i.e., availability, access, utilization, stability) is a vast topic. It is better to choose one of the four components in terms of the WEF nexus.

Herein recently published articles that can help the authors to identify the gap and problem statement:

Alert in the dynamics of water-energy-food production in African countries from a nexus perspective. Resources, Conservation & Recycling 194 (2023). 106990. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.resconrec.2023.106990

Insights on water and climate change in the greater horn of Africa: Connecting virtual water and water-energy-food-biodiversity-health nexus. Sustainability 13, 6483. https://doi:10.3390/su13116483

paper_title_zh: 非洲大湖区水-能源-食物纽带：现状与前景
paper_abstract_zh: 水-能源-食物（WEF）纽带是一个旨在整合这三个关键经济驱动因素的概念，这些因素对于改善人民生计、促进普遍经济可持续发展以及世界人口的社会福祉至关重要。有效利用和管理这些关键资源需要对共生、竞争和让步进行深入的规划评估，并在纽带中做出必要的贡献。本文旨在回顾非洲大湖地区的WEF状况，重点关注肯尼亚、刚果民主共和国、卢旺达和乌干达。评估了每个国家的现状和前景，并讨论了三种基本资源之间的相互联系以及气候变化对这些国家资源安全的影响。综述发现，所选国家确实存在WEF不安全问题，因为气候变化的影响和基础设施薄弱在所强调的不安全因素中起着关键作用。在重点国家中，意识到薄弱的制度和法律框架、政治不稳定以及基础设施落后确实阻碍了该地区实现WEF纽带以促进可持续经济发展的目标。因此，迫切需要通过在非洲大湖地区采取综合和整体的方法，在WEF纽带中采纳气候变化适应和减缓措施。
review_content_zh:
该论文基于水-能源-食物（WEF）纽带概念展开，并鼓励研究人员和从业者使用这一概念的好处。然而，关于纽带的具体内容及其如何帮助非洲大湖地区（GLRA）更好地分析水、能源和食物要素之间的相互作用，尚不明确。本研究基于GLRA中WEF纽带的定义。对整个非洲监测WEF的现有工具，以及大角非洲的水-能源-食物-生态系统-健康（WEFBH）纽带的分析已经进行。我的建议是，希望作者能应用新的创新工具来发现WEF系统中隐藏的内容。

研究方法不明确。作者选择了多少篇论文？他们是如何通过所有文献获得切实结果的？因此，社会-经济和生物物理因素是已知的。在此，作者阐明了当前状况及其相互联系。例如，考虑食品安全（即可用性、获取、利用、稳定性）是一个广泛的话题。最好选择其中一个与WEF纽带相关的组成部分。

以下是一些最近发表的文章，可以帮助作者识别研究差距和问题陈述：
1. Muhirwa F., Shen L., Elshkaki A., Chiwuikem C. J., Zhong S., Bonecke E., Hirwa H., Seka M. A., Habiyakare T., Tuyishimire A., Harerimana B., (2023). 从纽带视角看非洲国家水-能源-食物生产的动态预警. 资源、保护与回收 194 (2023). 106990. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.resconrec.2023.106990
2. Imasiku K. 和 Ntigwirumugara E., (2019). 卢旺达人口增长对能源-水-食物-土地纽带生态可持续发展的影响分析. https://doi.org/10.1002/fes3.185
3. Hirwa, H., Zhang, Q., Qiao, Y., Peng Y., Leng F., Tian C., Sayidjakhon K., Li F., Kayiranga A., Muhirwa F., Itangishish A. C., Habiyaremye G., 和 Ngamiije J., (2021). 大角非洲水与气候变化的洞察：连接虚拟水和水-能源-食物-生物多样性-健康纽带. 可持续发展 13, 6483. https://doi:10.3390/su13116483
4. Muhirwa F., Shen L., Elshkaki A., Velempini K., 和 Hirwa H. (2022). 追踪非洲水能源食物纽带研究和应用项目的属性和范围：综述. 环境科学与政策 136, 33-45. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.envsci.2022.05.012.
5. Muhirwa, F.; Shen, L.; Elshkaki, A., Kgosietsile V., Hirwa, H., Zhong S., 和 Mbandi A. M., (2021). 从1990年到2017年非洲能源、水和食物资源生产与温室气体排放脱钩：足迹视角综述. 能源 2021, 14, 6326. https://doi.org/10.3390/en14196326

paper_title: A comprehensive review of energy efficient routing protocols for query driven wireless sensor networks
paper_abstract: In this current era of communications and networking, The Internet of things plays the main role in the making of smart communication and networking. In this article, we have focused on the literature survey on wireless sensor networks which are energy efficient. Various standard protocols are reviewed along with some enhanced protocols which makes the network energy efficient. The comparison of the standard and enhanced protocols with respect to various applications in wireless sensor networks is thoroughly done in this article. The outcomes of the enhanced protocols are also briefly discussed. For easier analysis to future researchers, a comparative table which lists the enhanced protocols which are compared with standard counterparts along with the factors for energy efficiency of the protocols. This article also comments on the issues and challenges of the protocols which can be further analyzed for making the wireless sensor network more energy efficient.
review_content:
The authors conduct a comprehensive survey on energy-efficient WSN routing protocols; however, there are major flaws in the article:

The work is updated and currently focused by the many researchers around the globe. So I validated their work, but the work must be comprehensive and compared with the latest existing survey papers

There are many survey articles on WSN; authors must compare their surveys with existing surveys in terms of table and descriptions.

The authors suggest future analysis to make WSN more energy-efficient without specifying how this analysis will be conducted or the expected outcomes. Providing more clarity on the proposed future work would strengthen the context.

The section "Issues and challenges of energy-efficient protocols in WSNs" needs more explanation and justification.

The section "Issues and challenges of energy-efficient protocols in WSNs" must also proposed new trends and solutions to tackle the challenges.

Authors are encouraged to cite the latest papers from 2023.

paper_title: Mobile perceived trust mediation on the intention and adoption of FinTech innovations using mobile technology: A systematic literature review
paper_abstract: The banking and financial sectors have witnessed a significant development recently due to financial technology (FinTech), and it has become an essential part of the financial system. Many factors helped the development of this sector, including the pandemics such as Covid-19, the considerable increasing market value of the FinTech sector worldwide, and new technologies such as blockchain, artificial intelligence, big data, cloud computing and mobile technology. Moreover, changes in consumer's preferences, especially the Z-generation (digital generation). FinTech shifted the traditional business models to mobile platforms characterized by ease of access and swift transactions. Mobile technology became the main backbone for FinTech innovations and acts as a channel to deliver FinTech services that overcome all geographical and timing barriers, thus enhancing financial inclusion. Mobile perceived Trust (MPT), or the trust in using financial business models via mobile technology, is a crucial factor in the FinTech context that has mediation effects on the intention and adoption of different FinTech business models. Unfortunately, few studies have explored MPT mediations on consumers' intention to adopt FinTech innovations using mobile technology. Typically, many studies examined trust/MPT as an independent and unidirectional variable and investigated its effects on behaviour intention without predicting its mediation effects. This study aimed to develop a systematic literature review on MPT mediation in FinTech, focusing on the period from 2016 and 2021, in journals ranked Q1 and Q2, and known-based theories such as the technology acceptance model, the unified theory of acceptance and use of technology, and the mobile technology acceptance model. This study found that only four articles were published in Q1 and Q2 journals. In these articles, the MPT was used as a mediator, and its effects were measured on the intention and adoption of the behaviour.
review_content:
Today, mobile technology has become the main backbone of FinTech innovations and acts as a channel for providing FinTech services that overcome all geographical and temporal barriers, thereby enhancing financial inclusion and developing banking services to suit the preferences of the generation Z "digital native" and digital transformation process. In this sense, enhancing trust in mobile technology will be the focus of the adoption of these innovations by users. I believe the paper is well-written and clearly expresses its contribution, tools, analysis, and results. The only shortcoming is the use of Nguyen and Nguyen (2020) article repetitively. I suspect that the article collection method suffers biasness.

Regarding CSR, I would recommend adding these studies to enrich the support of its mediating effect:
  * https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34826080/
  * https://www.emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/CG-08-2020-0320/full/html
  * https://www.emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/EDI-07-2020-0213/full/html
  * https://ejournal.usm.my/aamj/article/view/91
  * https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/10.1177/0972150920917773
  * https://www.emerald.com/insight/content/doi/10.1108/JABS-07-2019-0214/full/html
I hope to see the revised version with better theoretical support on CSR.

All the best!
paper_title_zh: 移动感知信任在移动技术驱动的金融科技创新意图与采纳中的中介作用：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 银行和金融部门近年来因金融科技（FinTech）而经历了显著的发展，并已成为金融体系的重要组成部分。多种因素促进了该领域的发展，包括诸如新冠疫情等大流行病、全球FinTech部门市场价值的显著增加，以及区块链、人工智能、大数据、云计算和移动技术等新技术。此外，消费者偏好的变化，尤其是Z世代（数字一代）的变化，也起到了推动作用。FinTech将传统商业模式转变为以易于访问和快速交易为特征的移动平台。移动技术成为FinTech创新的主要支柱，并作为提供FinTech服务的渠道，克服了所有地理和时间障碍，从而增强了金融包容性。移动感知信任（MPT），即通过移动技术使用金融商业模式的信任，是FinTech背景下一个关键因素，对采用不同FinTech商业模式的意图和采纳具有中介效应。遗憾的是，很少有研究探讨MPT在消费者通过移动技术采纳FinTech创新意图中的中介作用。通常，许多研究将信任/MPT视为独立且单向的变量，并探讨其对行为意图的影响，而未预测其中介效应。本研究旨在对2016年至2021年间在Q1和Q2级别期刊上发表的、基于技术接受模型、技术接受与使用统一理论以及移动技术接受模型等知名理论的MPT在FinTech中的中介作用进行系统文献综述。研究发现，仅有四篇文章发表在Q1和Q2期刊上。在这些文章中，MPT被用作中介变量，其效应在行为意图和采纳上进行了测量。
review_content_zh:
今天，移动技术已成为金融科技创新的主要支柱，并作为提供金融科技服务的渠道，克服了所有地理和时间的障碍，从而增强了金融包容性，并发展了适合“数字原生代”Z世代和数字化转型过程的银行服务。在这个意义上，增强对移动技术的信任将是用户采纳这些创新的重点。我认为这篇文章写得很好，清晰地表达了其贡献、工具、分析和结果。唯一的不足是反复引用了Nguyen和Nguyen（2020）的文章。我怀疑文章的收集方法存在偏见。

关于企业社会责任（CSR），我建议添加以下研究以丰富其中介效应的支持：

paper_title: p53 Mutation as Plausible Predictor for Endocrine Resistance Therapy in Luminal Breast Cancer
paper_abstract: Endocrine therapy resistance in Luminal Breast Cancer is a significant issue to be tackled, but currently, no specific biomarker could be used to anticipate this event. p53 mutation is widely known as one of Breast Cancer’s most prominent genetic alterations. Its mutation could generate various effects in Estrogen Receptor and Progesterone Receptor molecular works, tangled in events leading to the aggravation of endocrine therapy resistance. Hence the possibility of p53 mutation utilization as an endocrine therapy resistance predictive biomarker is plausible. The purpose of this review is to explore the latest knowledge of p53 role in Estrogen Receptor and Progesterone Receptor molecular actions, thus aggravating the Endocrine Therapy resistance in Luminal Breast Cancer, from which we could define possibilities and limitations to utilize p53 as the predictive biomarker of endocrine therapy resistance in Luminal Breast Cancer.
review_content:
Since 2002, p53-related breast cancer research has been conducted. Regularly, p53 is evaluated for diagnostic and prognostic purposes. In contrast to other solid tumors, breast cancer has a lower incidence of p53 gene mutations. The reviewer suggests that the author also provide updates on recently studied potential biomarkers, particularly those associated with breast cancer. Given that the TP53 mutation is associated with a more aggressive disease and a lower overall survival rate, it is also crucial to identify a potential biomarker that can be tested in the early stages of the disease1.

This study also states that p53 gene mutation is one of the most common genetic alterations in breast cancer, but its incidence is only 30–35% in Luminal B BC , compared to 70% in Her-2/neu overexpression and 80% in TNBC2. This is also stated as a limitation in the study. The reviewer suggest that the study could also provide additional insight into the recent roles of p53 gene mutation applications as biomarkers in Her-2/neu overexpression and the TNBC group, in which both have higher incidence3.

It is possible for endocrine resistance to develop during the endocrine therapy or at a later time. While it is possible that the p53 gene mutation is suppressed by the presence of ER, this also means that individuals who are more susceptible to endocrine therapy have a greater chance of doing so naturally. In addition, the reviewer emphasize the importance of determining whether endocrine therapies that interact with ER, such as SERM and SERD, would also affect its suppressive effect on p53 mutation4,5.

In conclusion, p53 has the potential to become a biomarker for predicting ET resistance in the future, as its participation in the pathways involving the ER and PR molecular mechanisms is essential and cannot be ignored. The author has elaborated on the limitations of the predictability tool. The reviewer concur that additional research is necessary to determine whether p53 is effective as a prognostic biomarker for ET resistance in Luminal BC patients.
paper_title_zh: p53突变作为腔型乳腺癌内分泌耐药治疗的合理预测因子
paper_abstract_zh: 内分泌治疗耐药在Luminal型乳腺癌中是一个亟待解决的重要问题，但目前尚无特定的生物标志物可以预测这一事件。p53突变被广泛认为是乳腺癌中最显著的遗传改变之一。其突变可能在雌激素受体和孕激素受体的分子作用中产生多种效应，交织在导致内分泌治疗耐药加剧的事件中。因此，利用p53突变作为内分泌治疗耐药的预测性生物标志物的可能性是合理的。本综述的目的是探讨p53在雌激素受体和孕激素受体分子作用中的最新知识，从而加剧Luminal型乳腺癌的内分泌治疗耐药，由此我们可以定义利用p53作为Luminal型乳腺癌内分泌治疗耐药预测性生物标志物的可能性和局限性。
review_content_zh:
自2002年以来，开展了与p53相关的乳腺癌研究。定期评估p53以用于诊断和预后目的。与其他实体瘤相比，乳腺癌的p53基因突变发生率较低。审稿人建议作者还应提供最近研究的潜在生物标志物的更新，尤其是那些与乳腺癌相关的标志物。鉴于TP53突变与更具侵袭性的疾病和较低的总体生存率相关，识别一个可以在疾病早期进行检测的潜在生物标志物也至关重要1。

该研究还指出，p53基因突变是乳腺癌中最常见的遗传改变之一，但其发生率在Luminal B型乳腺癌中仅为30-35%，而在Her-2/neu过表达中为70%，在TNBC中为80%2。这也被指出是该研究的局限性。审稿人建议，该研究还可以提供关于p53基因突变作为Her-2/neu过表达和TNBC组生物标志物的近期应用的额外见解，这两者的发生率都较高3。

内分泌抵抗可能在内分泌治疗期间或之后发展。虽然p53基因突变可能被ER的存在所抑制，但这 also 意味着更易受内分泌治疗影响的个体自然具有更大的可能性。此外，审稿人强调确定与ER相互作用的内分泌疗法（如SERM和SERD）是否也会影响其对p53突变的抑制效应的重要性4,5。

总之，p53有潜力成为预测内分泌治疗抵抗的生物标志物，因为其在涉及ER和PR分子机制的通路中的参与是必不可少的，不容忽视。作者已详细阐述了预测工具的局限性。审稿人认同需要进一步研究以确定p53是否作为Luminal型乳腺癌患者内分泌治疗抵抗的有效预后生物标志物。

paper_title: The evolution and diversity of the nonsense-mediated mRNA decay pathway
paper_abstract: Nonsense-mediated mRNA decay is a eukaryotic pathway that degrades transcripts with premature termination codons (PTCs). In most eukaryotes, thousands of transcripts are degraded by NMD, including many important regulators of developmental and stress response pathways. Transcripts can be targeted to NMD by the presence of an upstream ORF or by introduction of a PTC through alternative splicing. Many factors involved in the recognition of PTCs and the destruction of NMD targets have been characterized. While some are highly conserved, others have been repeatedly lost in eukaryotic lineages. Here, I detail the factors involved in NMD, our current understanding of their interactions and how they have evolved. I outline a classification system to describe NMD pathways based on the presence/absence of key NMD factors. These types of NMD pathways exist in multiple different lineages, indicating the plasticity of the NMD pathway through recurrent losses of NMD factors during eukaryotic evolution. By classifying the NMD pathways in this way, gaps in our understanding are revealed, even within well studied organisms. Finally, I discuss the likely driving force behind the origins of the NMD pathway before the appearance of the last eukaryotic common ancestor: transposable element expansion and the consequential origin of introns.
review_content:
In this review, the author suggests a novel NMD classification system based on the evolutionary conservation of known NMD factors among different species. The author also discusses a possible driving force for the apparition of NMD. This is a well-written and structured manuscript considering NMD under an interesting evolutionary point of view. It is of broad interest for the NMD community, and it mentions several fundamental questions currently unanswered in the NMD field. Nevertheless, a few modifications of the figures and the addition of some very important references and concepts could make it easier to read and broaden the general interest of the review, as detailed in the following paragraphs.

Major comments:
 1. In Figure 1, the model of mammalian NMD indicates cleavage of the NMD target downstream of the PTC. It doesn’t indicate the distinct roles of SMG6 and SMG5/7; it would be important here to indicate the distinct involvement of SMG6 in the cleavage activity and the role of SMG5/7 in decay factors recruitment. These two routes for decay should clearly appear in Figure 1.
 2. In Figure 2, the definition of Type 1/2/3/4 NMD should already be mentioned in the figure legends (e.g. Type 1: classical SMG1 dependent NMD, Type 2: recent loss of SMG1 with conserved phosphorylation, Type 3: ancient loss of SMG1 with loss of UPF1 S/Q phosphorylation, Type 4: Heavily derived NMD).
 3. In the paragraph 'Defining NMD targets', the author cites the 2016 paper on the NMD protection effect of PTB1; an earlier study describing similar protection effect of Pub1 in yeast should also be cited (Ruiz-Echevarria and Peltz, 20001).
 4. In the same paragraph, the author focuses on Baker’s yeast DSE, stimulating NMD. The author should also mention a recent paper in yeast describing that poor translation efficiency is a major criteria for NMD targeting (Celik et al., 20172). This major result could potentially explain not yet understood deregulations observed in several other species upon NMD knockdown.
 5. It was proposed that invading RNAs of external origin, including TEs and viruses, could be a driving force for NMD apparition and evolution - this should be mentioned in the paragraph on the possible origin of NMD (Hamid and Makeyev, 20163).

Minor comments:
 1. UPF1 might have other essential functions beyond NMD, as observed for UPF3b in mammals, involved in translation termination (Neu-Yilik et al., 20174), which could explain its presence in some species without any other known NMD factors. This could be mentioned in the corresponding section.
 2. As branches of NMD exist without the need of UFP2/UPF3, it suggests that NMD could be active with only UPF1. This possibility should be discussed/mentioned when describing Type 4 species depleted of UPF2 and UPF3.
 3. In addition to ATR/ATM, the author could mention TOR or TRRAP kinases as described in (Lloyd and Davies, 20135), as possible kinase replacements for SMG1.
 4. In Figure 3, the author should add precisions on endonucleolytic cleavage and decay factor recruitment for (A), and decay factor recruitment only for the others. The different types of NMD defined in Figure 2 should be mentioned again here in Figure 3, namely: Type 1, Type 2, Type 3 and Type 4.
paper_title_zh: 无义介导mRNA降解途径的演化和多样性
paper_abstract_zh: 无义介导的mRNA降解是真核生物中降解带有提前终止密码子（PTCs）转录本的一种途径。在大多数真核生物中，数千个转录本通过NMD途径被降解，包括许多发育和应激反应途径的重要调节因子。转录本可以通过上游开放阅读框的存在或通过可变剪接引入PTC而被靶向NMD。许多参与识别PTC和破坏NMD靶标的因子已被表征。虽然一些因子高度保守，但其他因子在真核生物谱系中反复丢失。本文详细介绍了参与NMD的因子、我们目前对其相互作用的了解以及它们的进化过程。我概述了一个基于关键NMD因子存在/缺失的NMD途径分类系统。这些类型的NMD途径存在于多个不同的谱系中，表明NMD途径在真核生物进化过程中通过NMD因子的反复丢失具有可塑性。通过这种方式对NMD途径进行分类，揭示了我们对NMD途径理解的不足，即使在研究较为深入的生物中也存在。最后，我讨论了在最后一个真核生物共同祖先出现之前NMD途径起源的潜在驱动力：转座元件的扩张及其随后内含子的起源。
review_content_zh:
在这篇综述中，作者提出了一种基于已知NMD因子在不同物种中的进化保守性的新型NMD分类系统。作者还讨论了NMD出现的可能驱动力。这是一篇写得很好且结构严谨的手稿，从有趣的进化角度考虑了NMD。它对NMD领域具有广泛的兴趣，并提到了目前NMD领域中尚未回答的几个基本问题。然而，对图表的一些修改以及添加一些非常重要的参考文献和概念，可以使阅读更加容易，并扩大综述的普遍兴趣，具体如下所述。

主要意见：
1. 在图1中，哺乳动物NMD模型指示在PTC下游切割NMD靶标。它没有指出SMG6和SMG5/7的不同角色；在这里指出SMG6在切割活性中的不同参与以及SMG5/7在衰变因子招募中的作用是很重要的。这两种衰变途径应该在图1中清晰显示。
2. 在图2中，Type 1/2/3/4 NMD的定义应该在图例中已经提及（例如，Type 1：经典的SMG1依赖性NMD，Type 2：近期SMG1的丢失但保留磷酸化，Type 3：古老SMG1的丢失且UPF1 S/Q磷酸化丢失，Type 4：高度衍生的NMD）。
3. 在“定义NMD靶标”段落中，作者引用了2016年关于PTB1的NMD保护效应的论文；还应引用一项早期研究，描述了酵母中Pub1的类似保护效应（Ruiz-Echevarria和Peltz，20001）。
4. 在同一段落中，作者聚焦于刺激NMD的Baker酵母DSE。作者还应提及一篇最近的酵母论文，描述低翻译效率是NMD靶向的主要标准（Celik等，20172）。这一重要结果可能解释了在NMD敲低后，在其他几种物种中观察到的尚未理解的失调现象。
5. 有人提出，外源入侵RNA，包括转座元件和病毒，可能是NMD出现和进化的驱动力——这应该在关于NMD可能起源的段落中提及（Hamid和Makeyev，20163）。

次要意见：
1. UPF1可能具有除NMD之外的其他基本功能，如哺乳动物中的UPF3b，参与翻译终止（Neu-Yilik等，20174），这可能解释了其在一些没有其他已知NMD因子的物种中的存在。这可以在相应部分提及。
2. 由于存在不需要UFP2/UPF3的NMD分支，这表明NMD可能仅靠UPF1就能活跃。在描述缺乏UPF2和UPF3的Type 4物种时，应讨论/提及这种可能性。
3. 除了ATR/ATM，作者可以提及如（Lloyd和Davies，20135）中描述的TOR或TRRAP激酶，作为SMG1的可能激酶替代物。
4. 在图3中，作者应添加关于（A）的内切核酸酶切割和衰变因子招募的精确信息，以及其他仅衰变因子招募的信息。图2中定义的不同类型NMD应在此图3中再次提及，即：Type 1、Type 2、Type 3和Type 4。

paper_title: Imaging the delayed complications of childhood Kawasaki disease
paper_abstract: This review will discuss the long-term complications of Kawasaki disease with a particular focus on imaging surveillance of the coronary arteries in adolescence and adult life. The relative advantages and disadvantages of each modality will be illustrated with practical examples, demonstrating that, in many cases, a multimodality imaging strategy may be required.
review_content:
Andrew et al. have submitted "Imaging the delayed complications of childhood Kawasaki disease". The aim of this paper is to discuss imaging modalities used in Kawasaki disease patients during adolescence and adult life. First of all we would like to appraise the enormous effort in performing this hands-on review. Knowledge on cardiovascular imaging in adults and young adults with a history of Kawasaki disease is of great importance.

Minor comments:

Overall
The authors may consider giving a bit more in-depth background information on the risks that come hand-in-hand with developing CAA after Kawasaki disease (mostly in patients with persistent giant aneurysms). Moreover, it would be nice to add some information on size-dependent long-term risk of having a small, medium and giant CAA. Also, few references are used throughout the article. Although the article discusses very useful expert opinions, it would be nice to add some references with supporting data (from this or other research groups) as well.

1. Abstract
We would strongly recommend using the term "imaging modalities" instead of "imaging surveillance". As imaging surveillance might suggest a hands-on flowchart of the desired imaging over time during follow-up. While the strength of this review lies more in depicting the potential of visualizing pathology with specific imaging modalities.

2. Introduction
“Coronary arterial complications, both in acute or chronic phase of the illness, result in high morbidity and mortality.” This sentence might give the impression that Kawasaki disease has a high morbidity and mortality. Please consider rephrasing this sentence and add absolute numbers and references with the risk of developing persistent CAA and consequent complications (such as thrombosis, myocardial infarction etc.).

3. Introduction section "echocardiography"
The authors mention "perivascular echogenicity or "brightness"" as important imaging features on echocardiography. Despite that early reports considered this as an early sign in KD 1, recent papers showed this to be a non-specific finding that can also be found in children without KD 2,3. Do the authors consider perivascular brightness an important hallmark in the (young) adult population, or is it as questionable as it is during early childhood?

“Echocardiography is always the initial tool in the assessment of the patient with Kawasaki disease. Young children generally have excellent echocardiographic windows with the proximal sections of the coronary arteries being fully visualized.” Add references indicating that we don’t miss proximal CAA. The authors might also consider discussing whether (or how often) distal CAA may be missed by echocardiography?

“Valvular involvement in Kawasaki disease is reported but is rarely a prominent feature. Nonetheless the presence of severe mitral regurgitation should raise the question of underlying myocardial ischemia and secondary papillary muscle dysfunction.” Please add references.

4. CMR
“Nonetheless, qualitative perfusion imaging in Kawasaki Disease can be problematic” A typo: Kawasaki Disease not Kawasaki disease. In the last few paragraphs many statements are made without references, please add references.

5. Cardiac CT
The authors mention something very important for the transition to adult care, namely "staging" new referrals by performing a CT. Would the authors, based on their expert opinion, advise pediatricians/pediatric cardiologists prior to referring a young adult to adult care, to perform a CT?

“Cardiac CT is a useful and reasonable method for ‘staging’ new referrals to the adult Kawasaki clinic. In our clinic it is a baseline test to establish the presence and extent of aneurysmal disease and stenosis and may act as a gatekeeper to subsequent coronary angiography.” When do authors recommend using cardiac CT in the pediatric population?

Please consider discussing radiation exposure as a disadvantage of CT as well.

Several statements are made without references, for example:
“The major advantages of cardiac CT are its rapidity, spatial resolution, and sensitivity for calcium. Modern scanners can complete acquisition of the target anatomy in a few seconds (or less) making CT very suitable for the restless or claustrophobic. Spatial resolution is in the region of 0.5 mm for most scanners which is adequate for the depiction of aneurysms, thrombus and normal or ecstatic coronary segments.”

4. Figure 12
This figure is of great value, knowing the scope of this article is more towards the value of imaging modalities and not so much surveillance. Could you still elaborate on how often you recommend to perform level 3 imaging? In children we tend to refrain from invasive coronary artery angiography and solely use it when intervention is needed. Therefore we perform follow-up mainly with level 1&2 in KD patients (with coronary artery involvement).
paper_title_zh: 儿童川崎病延迟并发症的影像学表现
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述将讨论川崎病的长期并发症，特别关注青少年和成年期冠状动脉的影像学监测。每种影像学检查方法的相对优缺点将通过实际案例进行说明，展示在许多情况下可能需要采用多模态影像学策略。
review_content_zh:
Andrew等人提交了《儿童川崎病延迟并发症的影像学检查》。本文旨在讨论在青少年和成年川崎病患者中使用的影像学检查方法。首先，我们想对作者在撰写这篇实践性综述中所付出的巨大努力表示赞赏。了解有川崎病病史的成年人和年轻成年人心血管影像学知识非常重要。

次要意见：

总体
作者可以考虑更深入地介绍川崎病后发展为冠状动脉瘤（CAA）的风险（尤其是持续性巨大动脉瘤患者）。此外，增加一些关于小型、中型和巨大CAA的尺寸依赖性长期风险的信息会更好。文章中引用的参考文献较少。尽管文章讨论了非常有用的专家意见，但最好还是添加一些支持数据（来自本研究或其他研究组）的参考文献。

1. 摘要
我们强烈建议使用“影像学检查方法”而不是“影像学监测”。因为影像学监测可能暗示在随访期间随时间推移所需影像的实操流程图，而本综述的优势更多地在于描绘特定影像学检查方法在可视化病理学方面的潜力。

2. 引言
“无论是在疾病的急性期还是慢性期，冠状动脉并发症都会导致高发病率和死亡率。”这句话可能会让人误以为川崎病具有高发病率和死亡率。请考虑重新措辞，并添加绝对数值和参考文献，说明发展为持续性CAA及其后续并发症（如血栓形成、心肌梗死等）的风险。

3. 引言部分“超声心动图”
作者提到“血管周围回声增强或‘亮度’”是超声心动图上的重要影像特征。尽管早期报告认为这是川崎病（KD）的早期征象1，但近期研究表明这一发现不具有特异性，在无KD的儿童中也可出现2,3。作者是否认为血管周围亮度在（年轻）成人群体中是一个重要标志，还是与幼儿期一样值得怀疑？

“超声心动图始终是评估川崎病患者的初始工具。年幼儿童通常具有极佳的超声心动图窗口，冠状动脉近端部分可完全可视化。”请添加参考文献，表明我们不会遗漏近端CAA。作者是否也考虑讨论远端CAA是否（或多久）可能被超声心动图遗漏？

“川崎病中的瓣膜受累已有报道，但很少成为突出特征。尽管如此，严重二尖瓣反流的存在应引起对潜在心肌缺血和继发性乳头肌功能障碍的质疑。”请添加参考文献。

4. CMR
“尽管如此，川崎病中的定性灌注成像可能存在问题”存在笔误：应为“川崎病”而非“川崎病”。在最后几段中，许多陈述没有参考文献，请添加参考文献。

5. 心脏CT
作者提到了一个对过渡到成人护理非常重要的问题，即通过CT对新的转诊进行“分期”。基于他们的专家意见，作者是否建议儿科医生/儿科心脏病专家在将年轻成人转诊到成人护理之前进行CT检查？

“心脏CT是‘分期’新转诊到成人川崎病诊所的有用且合理的方法。在我们诊所，它是基线测试，用于确定动脉瘤性疾病和狭窄的存在和程度，并可能作为后续冠状动脉造影的把关者。”作者建议在儿科人群中何时使用心脏CT？

请考虑讨论CT的辐射暴露作为其缺点。

有几处陈述没有参考文献，例如：
“心脏CT的主要优势是其快速性、空间分辨率和对钙的敏感性。现代扫描仪可以在几秒钟（或更短时间）内完成目标解剖结构的采集，使CT非常适合不安静或幽闭恐惧症患者。大多数扫描仪的空间分辨率在0.5毫米左右，足以描绘动脉瘤、血栓和正常或扩张的冠状动脉段。”

4. 图12
这张图非常有价值，鉴于本文的重点更多地在于影像学检查方法的价值，而非监测。您能否详细说明您建议多久进行一次三级影像学检查？在儿童中，我们倾向于避免侵入性冠状动脉造影，仅在需要干预时使用。因此，我们主要使用一级和二级影像学检查对川崎病（伴冠状动脉受累）患者进行随访。

paper_title: A Unified Survey on Anomaly, Novelty, Open-Set, and Out of-Distribution Detection: Solutions and Future Challenges
paper_abstract: Machine learning models often encounter samples that are diverged from the training distribution. Failure to recognize an out-of-distribution (OOD) sample, and consequently assign that sample to an in-class label, significantly compromises the reliability of a model. The problem has gained significant attention due to its importance for safety deploying models in open-world settings. Detecting OOD samples is challenging due to the intractability of modeling all possible unknown distributions. To date, several research domains tackle the problem of detecting unfamiliar samples, including anomaly detection, novelty detection, one-class learning, open set recognition, and out-of-distribution detection. Despite having similar and shared concepts, out-of-distribution, open-set, and anomaly detection have been investigated independently. Accordingly, these research avenues have not crosspollinated, creating research barriers. While some surveys intend to provide an overview of these approaches, they seem to only focus on a specific domain without examining the relationship between different domains. This survey aims to provide a cross-domain and comprehensive review of numerous eminent works in respective areas while identifying their commonalities. Researchers can benefit from the overview of research advances in different fields and develop future methodology synergistically. Furthermore, to the best of our knowledge, while there are surveys in anomaly detection or one-class learning, there is no comprehensive or up-to-date survey on out-of-distribution detection, which this survey covers extensively. Finally, having a unified cross-domain perspective, this study discusses and sheds light on future lines of research, intending to bring these fields closer together.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper aims to comprehensively review relevant works in out-of-distribution, open-set, and anomaly detection. The paper highlights an essential concern with other survey papers in the field, i.e., the existing survey papers only focus on a specific domain without examining the relationship between different domains. This paper provides a cross-domain and comprehensive review of the literature across these areas and at the same time identifies common ideas.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths** - Survey paper is clearly written and easy to follow. The exposition is clear and situated nicely and is improved from its last version. Methods are described both mathematically and visually. This survey paper can help newcomers reduce their barriers to entry. - Table 1 and Figure 2 are illustrative and nice additions to the latest version. I have some minor comments, please read below. - Explanation for each method covered in the paper is clear. To the best of my knowledge, the survey does a good job of covering relevant papers with diverse ideas in each field. - Authors have also made some efforts to include relatively old approaches. **Weaknesses** - Figure 2 can be improved a bit (see comments below). - While authors have included Section 2 to discuss the taxonomy, relation between different approaches is still left a bit unclear - Section 3 looks a bit out of the place. - Typos. Section 3.4 title.

**Requested Changes:**
- (Critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) The paper discusses different methods in different subsections for each of the survey topics. While Section 2 is added for taxonomy, currently, it seems that the discussion of each method is fairly disjoint without a clear connection between different methods. I encourage authors to provide summary unifying ideas across similar methods and more broadly across different areas. - (Critical to securing your recommendation for acceptance) Several things in Figure 2 are unclear. The phrase 'Unfamiliar Data Detection Approaches' looks unfamiliar to me, so it is a bit hard to parse the remaining hierarchy. It is also clear why 'Pre-trained Feature Adaptation ' is branched separately from the discriminative branch.

**Rebuttal Comments:**
The new version has been uploaded.: The authors kindly ask you to check out the new version. For the first concern, please refer to our last response. For the last concern, the authors agree with the reviewer and changed "Unfamiliar Data Detection" to "The Taxonomy Of the Explained Methods". This especially makes the paper clear for inexperienced and newcomers in the field. Also, please note that methods that are based on pre-trained feature adaptation are not trained from scratch and somehow employ adaptation techniques that might be discriminative, generative, or even a hybrid of both. As reviewer "pimz" also pointed out, separating pre-trained adaptation methods from others is fair since they have privileged access to out-of-domain knowledge. Finally, the authors hope that they have solved all your concerns. | Requested Changes:: Thank You for your comments. As you mentioned, section 2 tries to give readers a unified perspective on the relationships of different tasks as the main message of this paper. Afterward, we reviewed the critical/baselines methods of anomaly detection, open set recognition, and novelty detection. We have explained each technique/method and clarified how these methods are connected to others. (For examples, see the explanation of "Redefining the Adversarially Learned One-Class Classifier Training Paradigm (Old-is-Gold) Zaheer et al. (2020):" paper. We carefully discussed how this method is related to the ALLOC method.) We agree with the reviewer that summarizing those papers with respect to the core ideas is also very beneficial, but in this way, we have to ignore the details of the methods (due to limited space). On the other side, the main difference between these methods is their evaluation setting. We thoroughly discuss that in section 7. We are also modifying Fig 2 to make it more clear. We will upload a new version of the paper very soon.
paper_title_zh: 统一调查：异常、新奇、开放集及分布外检测——解决方案与未来挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 机器学习模型经常遇到偏离训练分布的样本。未能识别出分布外（OOD）样本，并因此将该样本分配到类内标签，会显著降低模型的可靠性。由于在开放世界环境中安全部署模型的重要性，这一问题已引起广泛关注。由于建模所有可能的未知分布的不可处理性，检测OOD样本具有挑战性。迄今为止，多个研究领域都在解决检测不熟悉样本的问题，包括异常检测、新颖性检测、单类学习、开放集识别和分布外检测。尽管分布外、开放集和异常检测具有相似和共享的概念，但它们一直是独立研究的。因此，这些研究途径未能相互借鉴，形成了研究壁垒。虽然一些综述旨在提供这些方法的概述，但它们似乎只关注特定领域，而未考察不同领域之间的关系。本综述旨在提供跨领域且全面的回顾，涵盖各领域内的众多杰出工作，同时识别它们的共同点。研究人员可以从不同领域的研究进展概览中受益，并协同开发未来的方法。此外，据我们所知，尽管存在关于异常检测或单类学习的综述，但尚未有全面或最新的关于分布外检测的综述，而本综述对此进行了广泛覆盖。最后，通过统一的跨领域视角，本研究讨论并揭示了未来的研究方向，旨在使这些领域更加紧密地结合在一起。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文旨在全面回顾与分布外检测、开放集检测和异常检测相关的工作。文章指出了该领域其他综述论文的一个关键问题，即现有综述论文仅关注特定领域，未考察不同领域之间的关系。本文提供了跨领域的全面文献综述，并识别了这些领域的共同思想。

**优点与缺点：**
**优点** - 综述论文写作清晰，易于理解。论述明确，结构合理，较上一版本有所改进。方法描述兼具数学和视觉呈现。该综述论文有助于新人降低入门门槛。- 表格1和图2是最新版本的亮点，具有说明性。我有一些小建议，请见下文。- 论文中涵盖的每种方法的解释都很清晰。据我所知，该综述很好地覆盖了各领域中具有不同思想的相关论文。- 作者还努力纳入了一些相对较老的方法。
**缺点** - 图2可以稍作改进（见下文评论）。- 虽然作者添加了第2节讨论分类法，但不同方法之间的关系仍显得有些不明确。- 第3节看起来有些不协调。- 第3.4节标题有错别字。

**请求的修改：**
- （对获得接受推荐至关重要）论文在不同小节中讨论了每个综述主题的不同方法。虽然添加了第2节进行分类，但目前看来，每种方法的讨论较为分散，缺乏不同方法之间的清晰联系。我鼓励作者提供总结性观点，统一相似方法，并在更广泛的领域中进行概括。- （对获得接受推荐至关重要）图2中有几处不明确。短语“不熟悉数据检测方法”对我来说显得陌生，因此难以理解剩余的层级结构。也不清楚为何“预训练特征适应”从判别分支中单独分出。

**反驳意见：**
新版本已上传：作者恳请您查看新版本。关于第一个问题，请参考我们上次的回应。关于最后一个问题，作者同意评审意见，并将“不熟悉数据检测”改为“所解释方法的分类法”。这尤其有助于使该领域的新人和不熟悉者更清晰地理解论文。此外，请注意，基于预训练特征适应的方法并非从头开始训练，而是某种程度上采用了可能是判别性、生成性或两者混合的适应技术。正如评审“pimz”所指出的，将预训练适应方法与其他方法分开是合理的，因为它们具有访问域外知识的特权。最后，作者希望已解决您的所有疑虑。| 请求的修改：感谢您的评论。如您所述，第2节试图为读者提供一个关于不同任务关系的统一视角，作为本文的主要信息。随后，我们回顾了异常检测、开放集识别和新奇检测的关键/基准方法。我们解释了每种技术/方法，并澄清了这些方法如何与其他方法相关联。（例如，参见对“重新定义对抗性学习单类分类器训练范式（Old-is-Gold）Zaheer等人（2020）”论文的解释。我们仔细讨论了该方法与ALLOC方法的关系。）我们同意评审意见，认为根据核心思想总结这些论文也非常有益，但这样我们必须忽略方法细节（由于篇幅有限）。另一方面，这些方法的主要区别在于其评估设置。我们在第7节中对此进行了详细讨论。我们也在修改图2，使其更加清晰。我们将很快上传论文的新版本。

paper_title: COVID-19 associated spontaneous barotrauma: a literature review
paper_abstract:
Reports of spontaneous pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum as a complication of coronavirus disease (COVID-19) have been increasing. COVID-19 causes inflammatory disease mainly affecting the respiratory system. Severity varies from asymptomatic pulmonary findings on imaging to acute respiratory distress syndrome along with pleural effusions, consolidations and spontaneous pneumomediastinum and pneumothorax. 
 
The aim of this paper was to review the literature to explore the association between pneumomediastinum/pneumothorax and COVID-19 respiratory disease, both in patients on ventilators and without ventilators, on a spontaneous basis. To this end, we conducted a comprehensive online literature search using PubMed for articles published with the key words of ‘spontaneous pneumothorax’, ‘pneumomediastinum’ and ‘COVID-19’. Further references were obtained through cross-referencing the bibliographies cited in each publication. 
We found that  spontaneous barotrauma is one of the complications associated with COVID-19 infection and has been observed in patients with and without mechanical ventilation. The process of pneumomediastinum and pneumothorax development is not well understood, especially in patients without underlying lung disease or on mechanical ventilation. We identified various factors that predispose to barotrauma. First, the direct infection of the Type I and Type II pneumocytes by the virus. Second, the pressure gradient between the alveoli and the pulmonary interstitium. Finally, barotrauma can occur secondary to the severe inflammatory response from the COVID-19-related cytokine storm. These conditions are all associated with severe alveolar damage and rupture of the alveolar wall that can produce pneumomediastinum and pneumothorax, both in mechanically ventilated patients and non-ventilated patients. 
COVID-19 is associated complications result in prolonged mechanical ventilation and length of stay, as well as overall increase in morbidity and mortality. Spontaneous pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum are two serious complications. Education regarding the adjustment of ventilation settlings in the ventilator-dependent COVID-19 patient may perhaps offset the iatrogenic component of barotrauma seen in some such patients.
review_content:
Rehmani and co-authors reviewed the topic of COVID-19 associated spontaneous barotrauma. They provide a summary of the literature on a relevant problem that is increasingly seen in COVID-19 patients. They discuss the common pattern of radiological manifestations seen in these patients. They also mention the common putative mechanisms underlying barotrauma in both mechanically ventilated and spontaneous breathing. The impact on patient outcomes such as increased mortality and morbidity with associated barotrauma has been reported.

However, the review can be further enhanced if the authors discuss the implications of peripherally located lesions and the Macklin Effect seen in COVID-19. They can further discuss the association of the above factors and the development of pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum.

In the Introduction section, the authors provide a succinct introduction about the COVID-19 pandemic, the common presentations, and the varied clinical severity of the patients. They also provide the search strategy used in the selection of articles with keywords, such as “spontaneous pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum” with cross-referencing the bibliographies. However, the keyword “Barotrauma” has not been considered in the search terms. Though the likelihood of the additional article using “Barotrauma” is low, nevertheless authors may attempt a search strategy with some modification.

The authors present the common findings seen on imaging – chest X-ray and CT scan. They mention that CT alone is not recommended for screening or diagnosis of COVID-19, which is an important point as most scientific societies do not recommend using CT scans for the purpose of screening COVID-19. RT-PCR remains the gold standard for diagnosing the infection. It will be useful if the authors provide some details about the timing of HRCT during the course of illness and the prognostic utility of findings seen on the CT chest. Also, the subtle findings which may predict the development of pneumothorax or barotrauma on HRCT in these patients will help readers to identify high-risk patients.

In the following section, the authors provide a description of pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum with extensive subcutaneous emphysema in a patient of COVID-19 on mechanical ventilation. They further discuss the known risk factors of the development of pneumothorax on mechanical ventilation and spontaneous breathing. However, the author's statement: “Tension Pneumothorax accounts for approximately 30-97% of all pneumothoraxes in patients with MV” needs to be referenced.

The authors discuss the cases of barotrauma and multiple reports published in the literature. The cases provide some perspective about the development of pneumothorax and pneumomediastinum and the evolution of lesions in both mechanically and non-mechanically ventilated patient subgroups. An interesting observation was the development of giant bulla in some cases. The authors further cite the studies by McGuinness et al., Chung et al., Housman et al., Protti et al., Udi et al. and provide common patterns of findings of pneumothoraxes, pneumomediastinum, and subcutaneous emphysema. The absence of pneumothorax with substantial pneumomediastinum has also been mentioned. It will be useful for the readers if the authors provide details of the mechanism underlying such unique patterns in the article.

The authors conclude by stating the common cause of iatrogenic barotrauma related to mechanical ventilation with proposed mechanisms in both mechanically and non-mechanically ventilated patients.

The article attempts to provide a literature review of a common complication – barotrauma seen frequently in COVID-19 patients. It is well written with some putative mechanisms underlying the barotrauma. However, it is a narrative review and not a systematic review. The authors do not mention the number of articles retrieved with the search strategy. It’s unclear why only one database was searched and not others. Though the objective was to study the mechanisms underlying the barotrauma, no particular mechanism is yet proven and most remain speculative.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19相关自发性气压伤：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
关于新型冠状病毒肺炎（COVID-19）并发症自发性气胸和纵隔气肿的报道逐渐增多。COVID-19主要引起影响呼吸系统的炎症性疾病，其严重程度从影像学上的无症状肺部表现到急性呼吸窘迫综合征，伴随胸腔积液、实变以及自发性纵隔气肿和气胸。

本文旨在通过文献回顾，探讨纵隔气肿/气胸与COVID-19呼吸系统疾病之间的关联，包括在机械通气和无机械通气患者中的自发性表现。为此，我们使用PubMed进行了全面的在线文献检索，关键词包括“自发性气胸”、“纵隔气肿”和“COVID-19”。通过交叉引用每篇出版物中引用的参考文献，进一步获取了相关资料。

我们发现，自发性气压伤是COVID-19感染的并发症之一，在有无机械通气的患者中均有观察到。纵隔气肿和气胸的发展过程尚不明确，特别是在无基础肺疾病或接受机械通气的患者中。我们识别了多种易导致气压伤的因素：首先是病毒直接感染I型和II型肺泡细胞；其次是肺泡与肺间质的压力梯度；最后，气压伤可能继发于COVID-19相关细胞因子风暴引起的严重炎症反应。这些条件均与严重的肺泡损伤和肺泡壁破裂相关，可能导致纵隔气肿和气胸，无论在机械通气患者还是非通气患者中。

COVID-19相关并发症会导致机械通气时间延长和住院时间增加，以及总体发病率和死亡率的上升。自发性气胸和纵隔气肿是两种严重的并发症。对依赖机械通气的COVID-19患者进行通气设置调整的教育，可能在一定程度上抵消部分患者中出现的医源性气压伤。
review_content_zh:
Rehmani及其合著者回顾了与COVID-19相关的自发性气压伤这一主题。他们总结了在COVID-19患者中日益常见的相关问题的文献。他们讨论了这些患者中常见的放射学表现模式。还提到了机械通气和自主呼吸患者气压伤的常见假定机制。已报道气压伤对患者预后的影响，如增加死亡率和发病率。

然而，如果作者讨论COVID-19中周围病变和Macklin效应的影响，该综述可以进一步得到提升。他们可以进一步讨论上述因素与气胸和纵隔气肿发展的关联。

在引言部分，作者简要介绍了COVID-19大流行、常见表现以及患者不同的临床严重程度。他们还提供了用于选择文章的搜索策略，包括关键词如“自发性气胸和纵隔气肿”，并交叉引用了参考文献。然而，关键词“气压伤”并未包含在搜索词中。尽管使用“气压伤”的额外文章可能性较低，但作者仍可尝试进行一些修改的搜索策略。

作者展示了影像学上的常见发现——胸部X光和CT扫描。他们提到，CT单独不推荐用于COVID-19的筛查或诊断，这是一个重要观点，因为大多数科学协会不推荐使用CT扫描进行COVID-19筛查。RT-PCR仍然是诊断感染的黄金标准。如果作者提供一些关于高分辨率CT（HRCT）在病程中的时间选择以及胸部CT发现的预后价值的细节，将是有益的。此外，HRCT上可能预测气胸或气压伤发展的细微发现将帮助读者识别高风险患者。

在接下来的部分，作者描述了一例COVID-19机械通气患者出现的气胸、纵隔气肿及广泛皮下气肿。他们进一步讨论了机械通气和自主呼吸患者气胸发展的已知风险因素。然而，作者的陈述：“张力性气胸约占机械通气患者所有气胸的30-97%”需要引用参考文献。

作者讨论了文献中发表的气压伤案例和多份报告。这些案例提供了一些关于气胸和纵隔气肿发展以及机械和非机械通气患者亚组病变演变的视角。一个有趣的观察是某些病例中巨大肺大疱的发展。作者进一步引用了 McGuinness 等人、Chung 等人、Housman 等人、Protti 等人、Udi 等人的研究，并提供了气胸、纵隔气肿和皮下气肿的常见发现模式。还提到了无气胸但纵隔气肿显著的情况。如果作者在文章中提供此类独特模式背后的机制细节，对读者将是有益的。

作者总结时指出，与机械通气相关的医源性气压伤的常见原因，并提出了机械和非机械通气患者的假定机制。

该文章试图对COVID-19患者中常见的并发症——气压伤进行文献综述。文章写得很好，包含了一些气压伤的假定机制。然而，这是一篇叙述性综述，而非系统性综述。作者未提及使用搜索策略检索到的文章数量。不清楚为何只搜索了一个数据库而非其他数据库。尽管目标是研究气压伤背后的机制，但尚未证明任何特定机制，大多数仍属推测性。

reasons: They provide a summary of the literature on a relevant problem that is increasingly seen in COVID-19 patients.

The authors further cite the studies by McGuinness et al., Chung et al., Housman et al., Protti et al., Udi et al. and provide common patterns of findings of pneumothoraxes, pneumomediastinum, and subcutaneous emphysema.
However, it is a narrative review and not a systematic review.
It will be useful for the readers if the authors provide details of the mechanism underlying such unique patterns in the article.
However, it is a narrative review and not a systematic review.

However, it is a narrative review and not a systematic review. The authors do not mention the number of articles retrieved with the search strategy. It’s unclear why only one database was searched and not others.

paper_title: ERCP-induced perforation: review and revisit after half a century
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) is an invasive procedure. We aimed to investigate ERCP-induced perforations at our institution and conduct a comprehensive review of literature on ERCP-induced perforations (EIP) since the introduction of this procedure as a therapeutic intervention. 
  
  
    Methods 
    This was a case-control study, in which charts of all patients diagnosed with ERCP-induced duodenal perforation were reviewed and compared to a control group without perforation. Patient’s sociodemographic and clinical data, including ERCP procedure-related data, were gathered. 
  
  
    Results 
    A total of 996 ERCP procedures were performed; only 13 patients proved to have EIP. Obstructive jaundice was the most common indication for ERCP. The main predisposing factor was difficult cannulation (P = 0.003). In total, five patients required surgical treatment; the majority of them had type I perforation, whereas type IV was the most common in patients who were treated conservatively. The overall mortality rate was 15%, the surgical group had a slightly higher mortality rate. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    Fifty years after the introduction of ERCP for therapy, it remains an invasive procedure that carries significant morbidity and mortality, even in skilled hands or at high- volume units. Conservative management of perforation yields favorable outcomes in selected patients.
review_content:
Good written review manuscript. It might be better if you can described the criteria of endoscopist who performed the ERCP procedures (if possible).
Please add the information whether the ERCP-induced perforation cases were occurred in the first or the second procedure of ERCP?
Were there any information about the duration of each ERCP procedures which associated with perforation?
paper_title_zh: ERCP引发的穿孔：半个世纪后的回顾与再探
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
内镜逆行胆胰管造影（ERCP）是一种侵入性手术。我们旨在调查我院ERCP引发的穿孔情况，并对自该手术作为治疗干预手段引入以来关于ERCP引发穿孔（EIP）的文献进行综合回顾。

方法
这是一项病例对照研究，回顾了所有诊断为ERCP引发十二指肠穿孔的患者的病历，并与无穿孔的对照组进行比较。收集了患者的社会人口学和临床数据，包括与ERCP手术相关的数据。

结果
共进行了996例ERCP手术；仅13例患者证实存在EIP。阻塞性黄疸是ERCP最常见的指征。主要诱因是困难插管（P = 0.003）。共有5例患者需要手术治疗；其中大多数为I型穿孔，而IV型穿孔在接受保守治疗的患者中最常见。总体死亡率为15%，手术组的死亡率略高。

结论
在ERCP用于治疗五十年后，它仍然是一种侵入性手术，即使在技术娴熟的操作者或高容量单位中，也伴随着显著的发病率和死亡率。对选定的患者进行穿孔的保守治疗可获得良好预后。
review_content_zh:
优秀的书面评审稿件。如果能描述执行ERCP手术的内镜医师的标准（如果可能的话）可能会更好。
请添加信息，说明ERCP引起的穿孔病例是在第一次还是第二次ERCP手术中发生的？
是否有关于与穿孔相关的每次ERCP手术持续时间的任何信息？

paper_title: Herbarium specimens can reveal impacts of climate change on plant phenology; a review of methods and applications
paper_abstract: Studies in plant phenology have provided some of the best evidence for large-scale responses to recent climate change. Over the last decade, more than thirty studies have used herbarium specimens to analyze changes in flowering phenology over time, although studies from tropical environments are thus far generally lacking. In this review, we summarize the approaches and applications used to date. Reproductive plant phenology has primarily been analyzed using two summary statistics, the mean flowering day of year and first-flowering day of year, but mean flowering day has proven to be a more robust statistic. Two types of regression models have been applied to test for associations between flowering, temperature and time: flowering day regressed on year and flowering day regressed on temperature. Most studies analyzed the effect of temperature by averaging temperatures from three months prior to the date of flowering. On average, published studies have used 55 herbarium specimens per species to characterize changes in phenology over time, but in many cases fewer specimens were used. Geospatial grid data are increasingly being used for determining average temperatures at herbarium specimen collection locations, allowing testing for finer scale correspondence between phenology and climate. Multiple studies have shown that inferences from herbarium specimen data are comparable to findings from systematically collected field observations. Understanding phenological responses to climate change is a crucial step towards recognizing implications for higher trophic levels and large-scale ecosystem processes. As herbaria are increasingly being digitized worldwide, more data are becoming available for future studies. As temperatures continue to rise globally, herbarium specimens are expected to become an increasingly important resource for analyzing plant responses to climate change.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) “… Willis. had an article in TREE that outlined how herbarium specimens could be used in climate change, now that millions of specimens are available on-line.” This reference was included on lines 198-201 and summarized as part of our conclusions. “… Pearse had an article in Nature Ecology and Evolution describing a new statistical technique for combining peak flowering dates from herbarium specimens with first flowering observations in the field. This reference was included on lines 165-170 and in our conclusion. “… Daru. had an article in New Phytologist about the biases of herbarium specimens.” This reference was included on lines 102-105. “The article describes the use of monthly average temperature data to compare to with flowering times. However, many researchers in the field prefer to use growing degree data. That said, a review article by Basler demonstrated that both types of analysis yield almost identical results.” We found it interesting that growing degree data from field studies and monthly averages produce similar results. We agree with Everill et al. (2014) that models using growing degree days are more difficult to interpret for studies using herbarium specimens and that GGD are overall correlated with temperature averages (Archetti et al. 2013). Since we found no study that had used GGD in analyses of herbarium specimen data, we did not include the reference above. “In the article, the authors suggest that mean flowering date is better than first flowering date because first flowering date is more variable. However, the reason that first flowering dates are problematic is that they are affected by many sampling issues, especially changing population size over time.” Revised on line 157-159 “A key concluding point is that the herbarium specimens could be used for other phenological characters, such as leaf out times. The authors seem to be unaware of the two 2014 papers that do exactly that by Zohner and Renner in Ecology Letters and by Everill and others Am J Bot.” These references were included on lines 413-416 Finally, a key point made by the Willis paper which needs to be emphasized is that this field is ready to undergo a huge expansion now that millions of herbarium specimens are becoming available on-line. Concluding remarks revised on lines 65-66, 198-201 and 401-403.
paper_title_zh: 《植物标本揭示气候变化对植物物候的影响：方法与应用综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 植物物候学的研究为近年来气候变化的大规模响应提供了最佳证据之一。在过去十年中，已有超过三十项研究利用植物标本馆的标本分析了开花物候随时间的变化，尽管迄今为止热带环境的研究普遍缺乏。在本综述中，我们总结了迄今为止所采用的方法和应用。植物的生殖物候主要通过对两个汇总统计量进行分析，即年度平均开花日和年度首次开花日，但年度平均开花日已被证明是一个更稳健的统计量。已应用两种类型的回归模型来检验开花、温度和时间之间的关联：开花日对年份的回归和开花日对温度的回归。大多数研究通过平均开花前三个月的温度来分析温度的影响。平均而言，已发表的研究使用了每个物种55个植物标本馆标本以表征物候随时间的变化，但在许多情况下使用的标本较少。地理空间网格数据越来越多地被用于确定植物标本馆标本采集地点的平均温度，从而允许检验物候与气候之间更精细尺度的对应关系。多项研究表明，基于植物标本馆标本数据的推断与系统收集的野外观察结果相当。理解物候对气候变化的响应是认识对更高营养级和大规模生态系统过程影响的关键步骤。随着全球植物标本馆的数字化程度不断提高，更多数据将可用于未来的研究。随着全球温度持续上升，植物标本馆标本预计将成为分析植物对气候变化响应的日益重要的资源。
review_content_zh: 审稿人2（匿名）“…Willis在TREE上发表了一篇文章，概述了如何利用在线可查的数百万份植物标本进行气候变化研究。”这一参考文献被包含在第198-201行，并作为我们结论的一部分进行了总结。“…Pearse在《自然-生态与进化》上发表了一篇文章，描述了一种新的统计技术，用于将植物标本中的盛花期与野外的首次开花观察结合起来。”这一参考文献被包含在第165-170行及我们的结论中。“…Daru在《新植物学家》上发表了一篇文章，探讨了植物标本的偏差。”这一参考文献被包含在第102-105行。“文章描述了使用月平均温度数据与开花时间进行比较。然而，该领域的许多研究者更倾向于使用生长度日数据。尽管如此，Basler的一篇综述文章表明，这两种分析类型得出的结果几乎相同。”我们发现，来自田间研究的生长度日数据与月平均数据产生相似结果这一现象很有趣。我们同意Everill等人（2014）的观点，即使用生长度日的模型在研究植物标本时更难解释，且生长度日总体上与温度平均值相关（Archetti等人2013）。由于我们未找到使用生长度日分析植物标本数据的研究，因此未包含上述参考文献。“在文章中，作者建议使用平均开花日期比首次开花日期更好，因为首次开花日期更具变异性。然而，首次开花日期之所以有问题，是因为它们受到许多采样问题的影响，尤其是随时间变化的人口规模。”已修订在第157-159行“一个关键的结论点是，植物标本可以用于其他物候特征，如叶展开时间。作者似乎未注意到Zohner和Renner在《生态学快报》以及Everill等人在《美国植物学杂志》上发表的两篇2014年的论文，正是这样做的。”这些参考文献被包含在第413-416行。最后，Willis论文中提出的一个关键点需要强调，即随着数百万份植物标本在线可查，这一领域正准备经历巨大的扩展。结论性评论已修订在第65-66行、198-201行和401-403行。

… Pearse had an article in Nature Ecology and Evolution describing a new statistical technique for combining peak flowering dates from herbarium specimens with first flowering observations in the field.
… Daru. had an article in New Phytologist about the biases of herbarium specimens.
That said, a review article by Basler demonstrated that both types of analysis yield almost identical results.

Finally, a key point made by the Willis paper which needs to be emphasized is that this field is ready to undergo a huge expansion now that millions of herbarium specimens are becoming available on-line.

paper_title: Energy metabolism and sources of oxidative stress in wooden breast - a review
paper_abstract: Modern broilers show dramatic growth over a short interval and contribute directly to the success of the poultry meat industry. The growth performance of commercial broilers is a result of genetic selection for "performance traits", such as body size, meat yield, and feed conversion rate. However, due to the rapid growth rate of modern commercial broilers, several growth-related conditions have arisen, increasing economic losses and consumer concerns. Among the most economically consequential is the muscle disorder called wooden breast. Together with associated myopathies such as white striping and spaghetti meat, wooden breast is causing losses of $200 million a year in the U.S. alone and occurs worldwide. No causative factors are known for wooden breast to date. Wooden breast can affect over 80% of broilers in a flock, yet no methods of amelioration are currently available. Overall, the evidence suggests that wooden breast is a genetic, age-dependent condition associated with fast growth rate. The primary features of wooden breast are muscle degeneration and fibrosis, high levels of oxidative stress, hypoxia, and altered energy metabolism. Recent work has also implicated reduced pectoral vessel density in the pathogenesis of wooden breast. This review examines the history of myopathies in commercial broilers and the relationship of myopathies to metabolism and oxidative performance. This review summarizes the foundational knowledge of wooden breast and provides a platform for further investigation of wooden breast.
review_content:

paper_title_zh: 木胸病能量代谢与氧化应激来源综述
paper_abstract_zh: 现代肉鸡在短时间内表现出显著的生长速度，直接促进了家禽肉品行业的成功。商业肉鸡的生长性能是通过对“性能性状”的遗传选择而实现的，这些性状包括体型、肉产量和饲料转化率。然而，由于现代商业肉鸡的快速生长率，出现了一些与生长相关的状况，增加了经济损失和消费者担忧。其中最具经济影响的是被称为木质胸肉的肌肉疾病。与相关的肌病如白条纹和意大利面条肉一起，木质胸肉仅在美国每年就造成2亿美元的损失，并且在全球范围内发生。迄今为止，木质胸肉的致病因素尚不清楚。木质胸肉可以影响一个鸡群中超过80%的肉鸡，但目前尚无改善方法。总体而言，证据表明木质胸肉是一种与快速生长率相关的遗传性、年龄依赖性疾病。木质胸肉的主要特征包括肌肉退化和纤维化、高水平的氧化应激、低氧和能量代谢改变。近期研究还表明，胸肌血管密度降低在木质胸肉的发病机制中起作用。本综述考察了商业肉鸡肌病的历史及其与代谢和氧化性能的关系。本综述总结了木质胸肉的基础知识，并为进一步研究木质胸肉提供了平台。
