paper_title: Variables and instruments to evaluate mental health in competitive swimmers: a narrative review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Mental health issues are becoming increasingly prevalent among elite athletes, and during the Tokyo 2020 Olympic Games, this issue became a pressing concern. In particular, several athletes complained about their mental health in relation to the highly demanding demands of their sport. High-performance swimming exposes athletes to a variety of stressors due to the physical, technical and mental demands of the sport. The study has carried out a narrative review of the main variables related to mental health, their dimensions and evaluations in competitive swimmers. 
  
  
    Methods 
    Clearly planned and ordered potential studies were identified using combined search methods. The search was carried out in different bibliographic databases (Dialnet, Web of Science and Scopus) between 1990 and 2023. Google Scholar was used to manually search the reference lists of the retrieved studies to identify potentially eligible studies that were not included in the electronic searches. The studies were examined from three different perspectives. Firstly, the methodology, sample, swimming categories and their relationship with mental health were analysed. Secondly, the variables related to mental health symptoms and disorders. Finally, the main mental health analysis tools and the conclusions of the studies. 
  
  
    Results 
    The concept of mental health in competitive swimmers needs to be clarified in the scientific literature, as different variables have been analysed and multiple instruments have been used with small samples of swimmers, without any intervention and prevention protocol. In addition, the bodies and institutions involved should work in an interdisciplinary and collaborative manner, establishing specific programmes to ensure effective prevention and care. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    Studies are needed to fill this gap and it is necessary to work under the same consensus and in collaboration with specified technical teams. In order to monitor, evaluate and provide services through detection tests and support to swimmers in their training and competitions.
review_content:
The narrative review submitted is quite interesting, well-prepared, and useful for coaches and researchers interested in improving the mental health of their swimmers. I have some comments and suggestions in order to improve the meaning and readability of the manuscript.
  * Please use the impersonal form when writing through the manuscript.
  * Introduction, first paragraph, line 3, please write (WHO) after World Health Organization.
  * Methods, authors should describe what type of review they are conducting, in this case, a narrative review. I suggest using the following reference to justify the methodology used: Grant, M. J., & Booth, A. (2009). A typology of reviews: an analysis of 14 review types and associated methodologies. Health Information and Libraries Journal, 26, 91-1081.
  * Method, please add the date when the search was made.
  * Figure 1, should consider only 3 phases according to PRISMA 2020 guidelines, please modify it accordingly.
  * Table 1 should be presented by pooling the studies that used the same methodology, then this would clarify the visual inspection of every study.
  * The discussion could be enriched using an infographic that summarizes the main factors and variables under analysis.
paper_title_zh: 竞技游泳运动员心理健康评估的变量与工具：叙事性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
心理健康问题在精英运动员中日益普遍，特别是在2020年东京奥运会期间，这一问题变得尤为紧迫。特别是，一些运动员抱怨他们的心理健康与体育高度要求的压力有关。由于游泳运动的身体、技术和心理需求，高性能游泳使运动员面临各种压力源。本研究对竞技游泳运动员心理健康的主要变量、其维度和评估进行了叙事性综述。

方法
通过结合搜索方法，明确规划和排序潜在研究。搜索在不同的文献数据库（Dialnet、Web of Science和Scopus）中进行，时间范围为1990年至2023年。使用Google Scholar手动搜索检索到的研究的参考文献列表，以识别电子搜索中未包含的潜在合格研究。研究从三个不同角度进行考察。首先，分析方法论、样本、游泳类别及其与心理健康的关系。其次，分析与心理健康症状和疾病相关的变量。最后，主要心理健康分析工具和研究的结论。

结果
竞技游泳运动员的心理健康概念需要在科学文献中加以澄清，因为已经分析了不同的变量，并且使用了多种工具对小型游泳运动员样本进行研究，而没有进行任何干预和预防协议。此外，相关机构和组织应以跨学科和协作的方式开展工作，制定具体项目以确保有效的预防和关怀。

结论
需要研究来填补这一空白，并且有必要在相同共识下与指定的技术团队合作。以便通过检测测试和支持游泳运动员的训练和比赛来进行监测、评估和提供服务。
review_content_zh:
提交的叙述性综述非常有趣，准备充分，对于有兴趣改善游泳运动员心理健康的教练和研究人员非常有用。我有一些评论和建议，以提升文稿的意义和可读性。
  * 请在撰写文稿时使用非人称形式。
  * 引言部分，第一段，第三行，请在“World Health Organization”后写上（WHO）。
  * 方法部分，作者应描述他们正在进行的综述类型，在本例中为叙述性综述。我建议使用以下参考文献来证明所使用的方法论：Grant, M. J., & Booth, A. (2009). A typology of reviews: an analysis of 14 review types and associated methodologies. Health Information and Libraries Journal, 26, 91-1081。
  * 方法部分，请添加搜索的日期。
  * 图1应根据PRISMA 2020指南仅考虑3个阶段，请相应修改。
  * 表1应通过汇总使用相同方法的研究来呈现，这样将有助于清晰直观地检查每项研究。
  * 讨论部分可以通过使用总结主要因素和分析变量的信息图表来丰富内容。

paper_title: University Dropout: A Systematic Review of the Main Determinant Factors (2020-2024)
paper_abstract:
Introduction 
     This research is a systematic review aimed at synthesizing scientific evidence on the causes of university dropout, focusing on the subcategories of vocational guidance, academic performance, socioeconomic status, and institutional aspects between 2020 and June 2024. 
   
   
     Methods 
     Only articles addressing university dropout were considered, analyzing dimensions such as vocational guidance, academic performance, socioeconomic status, and institutional aspects. Articles published in indexed scientific journals with double-blind, double-blind peer, or open reviews between 2020 and June 2024 were included. The main databases used were Scopus, Web of Science, and Google Scholar. To assess the risk of bias in qualitative studies, the criteria from the article “Validity criteria for qualitative research: three epistemological strands for the same purpose” were used. For quantitative studies, the criteria from the article “Evaluating survey research in articles published in Library Science journals” were followed. For mixed-method studies, both sets of criteria were combined. 
   
   
     Results 
     A total of 23 studies were included: 15 quantitative (65.22%), 3 qualitative (13.04%), and 5 mixed-method (21.74%). All studies (100%) addressed the subcategories of socioeconomic status and institutional aspects. Regarding the academic performance subcategory, 86% of the studies addressed it, while the vocational guidance subcategory was covered by 73.91% of the studies. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     Vocational guidance, academic performance, socioeconomic status, and institutional aspects are crucial for reducing university dropout. Providing adequate professional guidance, academic support, financial assistance, and strong institutional support is fundamental to improving student retention and academic success.
review_content:
The rationale and objectives are clearly stated. This systematic review focuses on understanding the causes of university dropout, with an emphasis on vocational guidance, academic performance, socioeconomic status, and institutional factors during the period from 2020 to June 2024.

The review also provides sufficient details on the methods and analysis, enabling replication by other researchers. The inclusion criteria are clearly specified (studies published between 2020 and 2024, standardized methodological approaches), as well as the databases used (Scopus, Web of Science, Google Scholar) and the search strategy (using specific descriptors such as "university dropout" and related terms). Additionally, the study selection process is detailed, including independent review by two authors and manual data extraction to ensure accuracy. An interesting aspect is that, to assess the risk of bias in qualitative studies, the validity criteria for qualitative research proposed by experts (Aráoz Cutipa & Pinto Tapia, 2021) were used. For quantitative studies, the criteria proposed in the research “Assessment of Survey-Based Research in Articles Published in Library Science Journals” (Salvador-Oliván et al., 2021) were followed, evaluating survey design and data analysis. For mixed-method studies, both approaches were combined. All these steps ensure that the study can be effectively replicated.

Statistical analysis was not conducted in this systematic review because, being based on the PRISMA protocol, its main focus was the collection, evaluation, and synthesis of existing studies, rather than a meta-analysis, which would require direct statistical analysis. The applied PRISMA protocol focused on ensuring transparency and comprehensiveness in the literature review through rigorous study selection, risk of bias assessment, and qualitative synthesis of findings, providing essential information for preventing university dropout.

The conclusions are clearly supported by the review's findings. The research demonstrated, through the analysis of 23 studies, that vocational guidance, academic performance, socioeconomic status, and institutional factors are critical determinants in university dropout. These conclusions reflect a coherent synthesis of the findings, highlighting the need to implement specific interventions in these areas. It is recommended that educational institutions strengthen these aspects, providing adequate vocational guidance and financial support to significantly reduce student dropout and improve academic retention.
paper_title_zh: 大学辍学：主要决定因素的系统性综述（2020-2024）
paper_abstract_zh:
引言
本研究是一项系统综述，旨在综合2020年至2024年6月间关于大学辍学原因的科学证据，重点关注职业指导、学术表现、社会经济地位和制度方面的子类别。

方法
仅考虑涉及大学辍学的文章，分析职业指导、学术表现、社会经济地位和制度方面等维度。纳入2020年至2024年6月间在索引科学期刊上发表的、经过双盲、双盲同行或开放评审的文章。主要使用的数据库包括Scopus、Web of Science和Google Scholar。为评估定性研究的偏倚风险，采用了文章《定性研究的有效性标准：同一目的的三种认识论线索》中的标准。对于定量研究，遵循了文章《评估图书馆学期刊发表文章中的调查研究》中的标准。对于混合方法研究，结合了这两套标准。

结果
共纳入23项研究：15项定量研究（65.22%）、3项定性研究（13.04%）和5项混合方法研究（21.74%）。所有研究（100%）均涉及社会经济地位和制度方面的子类别。关于学术表现子类别，86%的研究有所涉及，而职业指导子类别则由73.91%的研究覆盖。

结论
职业指导、学术表现、社会经济地位和制度方面对于减少大学辍学至关重要。提供适当的职业指导、学术支持、经济援助和强有力的制度支持是提高学生保留率和学术成功的基础。
review_content_zh:
研究理据和目标表述清晰。本系统综述旨在理解大学生辍学的原因，重点探讨2020年至2024年6月期间的职业教育指导、学术表现、社会经济状况及制度因素。

综述还提供了关于方法和分析的充足细节，使其他研究者能够复制研究。纳入标准明确（2020年至2024年间发表的研究，标准化的方法学 approach），使用的数据库（Scopus、Web of Science、Google Scholar）和搜索策略（使用“大学辍学”等特定描述符及相关术语）亦详细说明。此外，研究选择过程详尽，包括两位作者的独立审查和手工数据提取以确保准确性。一个有趣方面是，为评估定性研究的偏倚风险，采用了专家（Aráoz Cutipa & Pinto Tapia，2021）提出的定性研究有效性标准。对于定量研究，遵循了“图书馆学期刊中基于调查的研究文章评估”（Salvador-Oliván等，2021）中提出的标准，评估调查设计和数据分析。对于混合方法研究，则结合了两种方法。所有这些步骤确保研究可有效复制。

本系统综述未进行统计分析，因为基于PRISMA协议，其主要焦点在于收集、评估和综合现有研究，而非需直接统计分析的元分析。所应用的PRISMA协议着重通过严格的研究选择、偏倚风险评估和定性综合研究结果，确保文献综述的透明性和全面性，为预防大学辍学提供必要信息。

结论明确得到综述发现的支持。研究通过分析23项研究，证实职业教育指导、学术表现、社会经济状况及制度因素是大学辍学的关键决定因素。这些结论反映了发现的一致性综合，强调在这些领域实施具体干预的必要性。建议教育机构加强这些方面，提供适当的职业教育指导和财务支持，以显著降低学生辍学率并提高学术留存率。

paper_title: Descriptive analysis of dental X-ray images using various practical methods: A review
paper_abstract: In dentistry, practitioners interpret various dental X-ray imaging modalities to identify tooth-related problems, abnormalities, or teeth structure changes. Another aspect of dental imaging is that it can be helpful in the field of biometrics. Human dental image analysis is a challenging and time-consuming process due to the unspecified and uneven structures of various teeth, and hence the manual investigation of dental abnormalities is at par excellence. However, automation in the domain of dental image segmentation and examination is essentially the need of the hour in order to ensure error-free diagnosis and better treatment planning. In this article, we have provided a comprehensive survey of dental image segmentation and analysis by investigating more than 130 research works conducted through various dental imaging modalities, such as various modes of X-ray, CT (Computed Tomography), CBCT (Cone Beam Computed Tomography), etc. Overall state-ofthe-art research works have been classified into three major categories, i.e., image processing, machine learning, and deep learning approaches, and their respective advantages and limitations are identified and discussed. The survey presents extensive details of the state-of-the-art methods, including image modalities, pre-processing applied for image enhancement, performance measures, and datasets utilized.
review_content: Reviewer 1: Comment 1: Is it the first of it kind survey on dental X-ray imaging? If not, compare the current survey with existing surveys and highlight how it is different or enhances the existing surveys. Response. Thank you for your suggestion. We have added two paragraphs in the revised manuscript for comparison. (as given in Section 1. Introduction on the second page in the manuscript ) “In the existing surveys (Rad et al., 2013; Schwendicke et al., 2019), various techniques and methods have been discussed for DXRI. In (Rad et al. 2013), Segmentation techniques are divided into three classes: pixel-based, edge-based, and region-based and further classified into thresholding, clustering boundary-based, region-based, or watershed approaches. However, there is no discussion on enhancement techniques, image databases used, and modalities used for DXRI. Furthermore, after (Rad et al., 2013) survey, a large number of approaches have been introduced by researchers. Next, a review of dental image diagnosis using convolution neural network is presented by (Schwendicke et al., 2019), focusing on diagnostic accuracy studies that pitted a CNN against a reference test, primarily on routine imagery data. It has been observed that in the previous surveys, a thorough investigation of traditional image processing, machine learning, and deep learning approaches is missing.” “Being an emerging and promising research domain, dental X-ray imaging requires a comprehensive and detailed survey of dental image segmentation and analysis to diagnose and treat various dental diseases. In this study, we have made the following contributions that are missing in the previous surveys: Firstly, we have imparted various studies from 2004 to 2020 covering more than 130 articles and is almost double than previous surveys given by Rad et al. (2013) and Schwendicke et al. (2019). Secondly, we have presented X-ray pre-processing techniques, traditional image analysis approaches, machine learning, and deep learning advancements in DXRI. Third, specific image modality (such as periapical, panoramic, bitewing and CBCT, etc.) based methods are categorized. At last, performance metrics and dataset descriptions are investigated up to a great extent.” Comment 2: Some of the recent works on application of DN/CNN on several domains such as the following can be discussed when discussing about ML algorithms. "Deep learning and medical image processing for coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic: A survey, A novel PCA–whale optimization-based deep neural network model for classification of tomato plant diseases using GPU, Hand gesture classification using a novel CNN-crow search algorithm". Response. Thank you for your suggestion. As per suggestion, recent works on the application of DN/CNN have been discussed in the revised manuscript on Page 2, Paragraph 1. Comment 3: A good survey should present a detailed section on challenges faced by the existing methodologies and also give directions to the researchers who want to carry out the research in that domain. I suggest that the authors can add a section, "challenges and future directions". Response. Thank you for the constructive comment. As suggested by the reviewer, a new section with the name "challenges and future directions", is added in the revised manuscript as "Section 2.4". Comment 4: A good survey paper should have eye catching images. Check this paper for reference "Deep learning and medical image processing for coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic: A survey." Response. As suggested by the reviewer, Figure 2, Figure 4, Figure 5, Figure 6, Figure 7, and Figure 8 are updated and redrawn in the revised manuscript. Reviewer 2 (Kadiyala Ramana): Comments for the author Please check grammar to submit the final paper. Response. Thank you for appreciating our work. As suggested by the reviewer, the manuscript is thoroughly checked and corrected in terms of English grammar. Reviewer 3: Comments for the author The authors have chosen a very important topic. The paper is very interesting and timely. I suggest the authors incorporate these changes to further improve the quality of the paper.
paper_title_zh: 使用多种实用方法对牙科X射线图像进行描述性分析：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 在牙科领域，从业者通过解读各种牙科X射线成像方式来识别与牙齿相关的问题、异常或牙齿结构变化。牙科成像的另一面在于它对生物识别领域也有所帮助。由于各种牙齿的不确定和不均匀结构，人类牙科图像分析是一个具有挑战性且耗时的过程，因此手动检查牙科异常堪称卓越。然而，在牙科图像分割和检查领域的自动化本质上是目前确保无误差诊断和更优治疗规划的需求。在本文中，我们通过调查超过130项通过不同牙科成像方式（如各种X射线模式、CT（计算机断层扫描）、CBCT（锥形束计算机断层扫描）等）进行的研究工作，提供了牙科图像分割和分析的全面综述。总体上的前沿研究工作被分为三大类，即图像处理、机器学习和深度学习方法，并识别和讨论了它们各自的优点和局限性。该综述展示了前沿方法的广泛细节，包括图像模态、用于图像增强的预处理、性能指标以及所使用的数据集。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1：评论1：这是关于牙科X射线成像的首个此类调查吗？如果不是，请将当前调查与现有调查进行比较，并突出其与现有调查的不同之处或对现有调查的增强。回复：感谢您的建议。我们在修订稿中添加了两段进行比较。（如稿件第2页第1节“引言”中所述）“在现有调查中（Rad等人，2013年；Schwendicke等人，2019年），讨论了DXRI的各种技术和方法。在（Rad等人，2013年）中，分割技术分为三类：基于像素的、基于边缘的和基于区域的，并进一步分类为阈值法、聚类法、基于边界的方法、基于区域的方法或分水岭方法。然而，没有讨论增强技术、使用的图像数据库以及DXRI使用的模态。此外，在（Rad等人，2013年）调查之后，研究人员引入了大量方法。接下来，（Schwendicke等人，2019年）对使用卷积神经网络的牙科图像诊断进行了综述，重点研究了将CNN与参考测试进行对比的诊断准确性研究，主要针对常规图像数据。观察到在之前的调查中，缺乏对传统图像处理、机器学习和深度学习方法进行全面调查。”“作为一个新兴且有前景的研究领域，牙科X射线成像需要对牙科图像分割和分析进行综合详细的调查，以诊断和治疗各种牙科疾病。在本研究中，我们填补了之前调查中缺失的以下贡献：首先，我们涵盖了从2004年到2020年的各种研究，涉及超过130篇文章，几乎是Rad等人（2013年）和Schwendicke等人（2019年）之前调查的两倍。其次，我们介绍了X射线预处理技术、传统图像分析方法、机器学习和深度学习在DXRI中的进展。第三，基于特定图像模态（如根尖片、全景片、咬翼片和CBCT等）的方法进行了分类。最后，对性能指标和数据集描述进行了大量调查。”评论2：在讨论机器学习算法时，可以讨论一些近期在以下领域应用DN/CNN的工作，如“深度学习和医学图像处理在冠状病毒（COVID-19）大流行中的应用：综述，一种基于PCA-鲸鱼优化的新型深度神经网络模型用于GPU辅助的番茄植物病害分类，使用新型CNN-群搜索算法的手势分类”。回复：感谢您的建议。根据建议，修订稿第2页第1段中讨论了近期DN/CNN应用的工作。评论3：一篇好的综述应该详细介绍现有方法面临的挑战，并为希望在该领域进行研究的研究人员提供方向。我建议作者可以添加一个“挑战与未来方向”的章节。回复：感谢建设性的评论。根据审稿人的建议，修订稿中添加了一个名为“挑战与未来方向”的新章节，作为“第2.4节”。评论4：一篇好的综述论文应该有吸引人的图片。参考这篇论文“深度学习和医学图像处理在冠状病毒（COVID-19）大流行中的应用：综述”。回复：根据审稿人的建议，修订稿中更新并重绘了图2、图4、图5、图6、图7和图8。

paper_title: Dual mechanisms governing reward-driven perceptual learning
paper_abstract: In this review, we explore how reward signals shape perceptual learning in animals and humans. Perceptual learning is the well-established phenomenon by which extensive practice elicits selective improvement in one’s perceptual discrimination of basic visual features, such as oriented lines or moving stimuli. While perceptual learning has long been thought to rely on ‘top-down’ processes, such as attention and decision-making, a wave of recent findings suggests that these higher-level processes are, in fact, not necessary.  Rather, these recent findings indicate that reward signals alone, in the absence of the contribution of higher-level cognitive processes, are sufficient to drive the benefits of perceptual learning. Here, we will review the literature tying reward signals to perceptual learning. Based on these findings, we propose dual underlying mechanisms that give rise to perceptual learning: one mechanism that operates ‘automatically’ and is tied directly to reward signals, and another mechanism that involves more ‘top-down’, goal-directed computations.
review_content:
This is a very well-written review aimed to provide mechanistic explanations for different variants of perceptual learning (PL). I enjoyed reading the manuscript and am inclined to follow the logic of the authors although a bit more data confirming the conjectures made by the authors would be desirable. The authors first review a number of papers from their laboratory that showed evidence for task-irrelevant perceptual learning. As opposed to more traditional forms of task-relevant PL, task-irrelevant PL occurs in the absence of attention and is supposed to be driven by external or internal rewards. Based on their data, the authors suggest the existence of two mechanisms giving rise to perceptual learning: an automatic reward-driven and a top-down goal-directed one. The studies listed in the review also suggest an interesting and common mechanism shared between conditioning and task-irrelevant perceptual learning.

I only have a number of suggestions that the authors may take into account to improve the manuscript.
 1. The authors attempt to dichotomize mechanisms underlying task-relevant vs task irrelevant PL. Are these two parallel systems? Is it possible that only one mechanism exists which can be 'adjusted' based on task constraints? In other words, have they considered only one basic principle, whereby goal-directed PL is simply a variant of task-irrelevant PL? For example, one could argue that rewards are the driving force for perceptual learning dependent plasticity and that additional higher cognitive signals such as selective attention strengthen (or override) the reward-driven changes?
 2. Given the fact that the authors promote two different mechanisms, it would be interesting if they can speculate about the neuronal pathways involved.
 3. What should be done next? Are additional experimental demonstrations for task-irrelevant perceptual learning required? At this moment a rather limited set of stimulus parameters have been used in task-irrelevant PL paradigms. Does one need additional tests, for example by using other stimulus features, other sensory modalities? What about comparative experiments including other species? What about causal experiments trying to identify structures driving PL-dependent plasticity?
paper_title_zh: 奖励驱动感知学习的双重机制
paper_abstract_zh: 在本综述中，我们探讨了奖励信号如何塑造动物和人类的感知学习。感知学习是一种 well-established 现象，通过大量练习可以引发个体对基本视觉特征（如定向线条或运动刺激）的感知辨别能力的选择性提升。虽然长期以来感知学习被认为依赖于“自上而下”的过程，如注意力和决策，但最近的一系列发现表明，这些更高级的过程实际上并非必要。相反，这些新发现指出，仅凭奖励信号，在没有更高级认知过程参与的情况下，足以驱动感知学习的益处。在此，我们将回顾将奖励信号与感知学习联系起来的文献。基于这些发现，我们提出了两种潜在的机制，共同导致感知学习的发生：一种机制“自动”运作，直接与奖励信号相关联；另一种机制涉及更多“自上而下”、目标导向的计算。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇写得非常好的综述，旨在为不同变体的感知学习（PL）提供机制解释。我很享受阅读这篇手稿，并且倾向于跟随作者的逻辑，尽管更希望有更多数据来证实作者提出的猜想。作者首先回顾了他们实验室发表的多篇论文，这些论文展示了任务无关感知学习的证据。与更传统的任务相关PL形式不同，任务无关PL在没有注意的情况下发生，被认为是由外部或内部奖励驱动的。基于他们的数据，作者提出了两种导致感知学习的机制：一种自动的奖励驱动机制和一种自上而下的目标导向机制。综述中列出的研究还表明，条件作用和任务无关感知学习之间存在一个有趣且共同的机制。

我只有一些建议供作者参考以改进手稿。
1. 作者试图将任务相关和任务无关PL的潜在机制二分。这两个系统是平行的吗？是否存在一种机制，可以根据任务约束进行“调整”？换句话说，他们是否只考虑了一个基本原理，即目标导向PL只是任务无关PL的一个变体？例如，有人可能会认为奖励是驱动感知学习依赖性可塑性的动力，而额外的更高认知信号如选择性注意会加强（或覆盖）奖励驱动的变化？
2. 鉴于作者提出了两种不同的机制，如果他们能推测涉及到的神经通路将很有趣。
3. 接下来应该做什么？是否需要更多关于任务无关感知学习的实验演示？目前，在任务无关PL范式中使用的刺激参数相当有限。是否需要额外的测试，例如使用其他刺激特征、其他感官模态？包括其他物种的比较实验如何？试图识别驱动PL依赖性可塑性的结构的因果实验如何？

paper_title: A Survey on Causal Discovery Methods for I.I.D. and Time Series Data
paper_abstract: The ability to understand causality from data is one of the major milestones of human-level intelligence. Causal Discovery (CD) algorithms can identify the cause-effect relationships among the variables of a system from related observational data with certain assumptions. Over the years, several methods have been developed primarily based on the statistical properties of data to uncover the underlying causal mechanism. In this study, we present an extensive discussion on the methods designed to perform causal discovery from both independent and identically distributed (I.I.D.) data and time series data. For this purpose, we first introduce the common terminologies used in causal discovery literature and then provide a comprehensive discussion of the algorithms designed to identify causal relations in different settings. We further discuss some of the benchmark datasets available for evaluating the algorithmic performance, off-the-shelf tools or software packages to perform causal discovery readily, and the common metrics used to evaluate these methods. We also evaluate some widely used causal discovery algorithms on multiple benchmark datasets and compare their performances. Finally, we conclude by discussing the research challenges and the applications of causal discovery algorithms in multiple areas of interest.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey paper focuses on reviewing causal discovery methods for temporal and non-temporal data. Overall, this paper well presents the basic concepts, terminologies, and assumptions for causal discoveries, and provides a good collection of existing methods with details for both i.i.d. and time series data. The authors also list some benchmark datasets and did comparison studies for i.i.d data. However, this paper is trying to put everything which unfortunately loses the main focus and leads to a few notable weaknesses that the authors may consider addressing.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
*Strengths* 1. this paper well presents the basic concepts, terminologies, and assumptions for causal discoveries; 2. the authors provide a good collection of existing methods with details for both i.i.d. and time series data; 3. the authors also list a few notable benchmark datasets and did some comparison studies for i.i.d data. *Weaknesses* 1. As a survey paper, the authors use 7 pages to talk about assumptions and methods for temporal causal discovery, which is very unbalanced compared to the overall (a total of 45 pages). I highly recommend the authors either focus on causal discovery for i.i.d. data, or for temporal data, but definitely not both. 2. As for the part of "causal discovery for i.i.d. data": a. What is the difference between this survey and existing works? To name a few: - Glymour, Clark, Kun Zhang, and Peter Spirtes. "Review of causal discovery methods based on graphical models." Frontiers in genetics 10 (2019): 524. - Nogueira, Ana Rita, et al. "Methods and tools for causal discovery and causal inference." Wiley interdisciplinary reviews: data mining and knowledge discovery 12.2 (2022): e1449. - Spirtes, Peter, and Kun Zhang. "Causal discovery and inference: concepts and recent methodological advances." Applied informatics. Vol. 3. No. 1. SpringerOpen, 2016. b. Why did the authors separate the score-based and the optimization-based methods? They should all belong to the score-based as the optimization-based methods are also constructing a score. c. Please be careful to use "causal discovery" v.s. "learning DAG". These two are different concepts and as a survey, it is important to clarify them. 3. As for the part of "causal discovery for temporal data", many things remain unclear: a. What are rigorous definitions of properties on page 28? b. What are evaluation metrics here? c. Why there is no comparison study for causal discovery methods using temporal data? d. What are the challenges here? Overall, this paper is trying to put everything which unfortunately loses the main focus and leads to a few notable weaknesses that the authors may consider addressing.

**Requested Changes:**
Please consider addressing *Weaknesses* above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
The authors may alert audiences in Section 9.2 Applications, that applying causal discovery methods without validating assumption may lead to biased results.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Addressing the requested changes: We are highly thankful for such valuable suggestions and comments. We really appreciate these comments as we believe they are really essential to improve the overall quality of the survey. We have addressed the requested changes and comments below: #Requested Change: “As a survey paper, the authors use 7 pages to talk about assumptions and methods for temporal causal discovery, which is very unbalanced compared to the overall (a total of 45 pages). I highly recommend the authors either focus on causal discovery for i.i.d. data, or for temporal data, but definitely not both.” +Reply: We really appreciate your recommendation, and understand your concern. However, the imbalance that seems for the temporal causal discovery methods is due to the reason that compared to the existing algorithms for the I.I.D. data, the amount of algorithms available for time series causal discovery are very few. In fact, the field of temporal causal discovery is a growing area of research compared to the well established area of I.I.D. causal discovery. We have tried to discuss a comprehensive list of the available time series causal discovery methods. Our purpose for this survey is to expose readers to the existing research in causal discovery as well as providing an overview of the entire field covering approaches for both I.I.D. and time series data. Often in daily settings we come across some real-world data that are time series. Hence, we feel it’s essential to present the temporal approaches too for a greater usability of the survey. Moreover, the terminologies presented in Section 2 of our survey are some common terminologies related to causal discovery for both I.I.D. and time series data. We further added benchmark analyses for time series causal discovery methods. We have also discussed future research directions, challenges, applications, metrics, tools, etc. that are common to both I.I.D. and time series methods. #Requested Clarifications/Changes: “As for the part of "causal discovery" for i.i.d. data": a. What is the difference between this survey and existing works? To name a few: Glymour, Clark, Kun Zhang, and Peter Spirtes. "Review of causal discovery methods based on graphical models." Frontiers in genetics 10 (2019): 524. Nogueira, Ana Rita, et al. "Methods and tools for causal discovery and causal inference." Wiley interdisciplinary reviews: data mining and knowledge discovery 12.2 (2022): e1449. Sprites, Peter, and Kun Zhang. "Causal discovery and inference: concepts and recent methodological advances." Applied informatics. Vol. 3. No. 1. SpringerOpen, 2016. +Reply: (a) The difference between this survey and the existing works are as follows: The survey by Glymour et.al. only talks about traditional constraint-based, score-based and FCM-based approaches and does not mention the recent advances in the field of causal discovery methods. It does not cover a lot of the recently developed methods as well as it does not explicitly talk about approaches that employ gradient optimization or prior knowledge. Our survey on the other hand tries to discuss as many as possible latest studies in the field, and also we point out about the growing body of literature that handles prior knowledge, employs gradient optimization, tackles latent variables, etc. Also, we have tried to benchmark and compare the performance of several approaches that they have not done. In the survey by Nogueira, Ana Rita, et al., they have not mentioned in detail about the way each method works as well as listed a few papers in the field of causal discovery. Also, they have not discussed the tools that are available to perform causal discovery easily. We believe such an analysis should be a part of any causal discovery survey to provide the readers with almost everything they need to start any causal analysis. The study by Sprites, Peter, and Kun Zhang differs from us in that they have not discussed and compared the methods well, and also did not perform an extensive experimental comparison study among the approaches. Overall, we differ from the existing surveys on multiple grounds as mentioned above, among which discussing most of the significant existing works as well as the latest methods in case of both i.i.d. and time series data, highlighting approaches that leverage prior knowledge, benchmarking of the approaches, discussion of the challenges, applications, tools, etc. are some of the important ones.
paper_title_zh: 对独立同分布和时间序列数据的因果发现方法综述
paper_abstract_zh: 从数据中理解因果关系是人类水平智能的主要里程碑之一。因果发现（Causal Discovery，CD）算法可以在一定假设下，从相关的观测数据中识别系统变量之间的因果关系。多年来，已经发展出多种主要基于数据统计性质的方法来揭示潜在的因果机制。在本研究中，我们对设计用于从独立同分布（I.I.D.）数据和时间序列数据中进行因果发现的方法进行了广泛的讨论。为此，我们首先介绍了因果发现文献中常用的术语，然后对在不同设置中识别因果关系的算法进行了全面的讨论。我们进一步讨论了一些用于评估算法性能的基准数据集、现成的工具或软件包以便进行因果发现，以及用于评估这些方法的常见指标。我们还对多个基准数据集上一些广泛使用的因果发现算法进行了评估，并比较了它们的性能。最后，我们通过讨论研究挑战和因果发现算法在多个感兴趣领域的应用来总结全文。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这篇综述论文重点回顾了针对时态和非时态数据的因果发现方法。总体而言，该论文很好地呈现了因果发现的基本概念、术语和假设，并提供了对独立同分布（i.i.d.）和时间序列数据的现有方法的良好汇总，详细介绍了这些方法。作者还列出了一些基准数据集，并对独立同分布数据进行了比较研究。然而，这篇论文试图涵盖所有内容，不幸的是，这导致主要焦点不明确，并带来了一些显著的弱点，作者可能需要考虑解决这些问题。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点** 1. 该论文很好地呈现了因果发现的基本概念、术语和假设；2. 作者提供了对独立同分布和时间序列数据的现有方法的良好汇总，详细介绍了这些方法；3. 作者还列出了一些显著的基准数据集，并对独立同分布数据进行了比较研究。
**缺点** 1. 作为一篇综述论文，作者用7页篇幅讨论了时态因果发现的假设和方法，这与全文（共45页）相比显得非常不平衡。我强烈建议作者要么专注于独立同分布数据的因果发现，要么专注于时态数据的因果发现，但绝对不要两者兼顾。2. 关于“独立同分布数据的因果发现”部分：a. 这篇综述与现有工作的区别是什么？举几个例子：- Glymour, Clark, Kun Zhang, and Peter Spirtes. "基于图模型的因果发现方法综述." 遗传学前沿 10 (2019): 524. - Nogueira, Ana Rita, et al. "因果发现和因果推断的方法和工具." Wiley跨学科评论：数据挖掘和知识发现 12.2 (2022): e1449. - Spirtes, Peter, and Kun Zhang. "因果发现和推断：概念及近期方法学进展." 应用信息学. 第3卷. 第1期. SpringerOpen, 2016. b. 为什么作者要将基于评分的方法和基于优化的方法分开？它们都应该属于基于评分的方法，因为基于优化的方法也在构建评分。c. 请注意区分使用“因果发现”和“学习DAG”。这两个是不同的概念，作为一篇综述，澄清它们非常重要。3. 关于“时态数据的因果发现”部分，许多问题仍不清楚：a. 第28页上的属性严格定义是什么？b. 这里的评估指标是什么？c. 为什么没有对使用时态数据的因果发现方法进行比较研究？d. 这里的挑战是什么？总体而言，这篇论文试图涵盖所有内容，不幸的是，这导致主要焦点不明确，并带来了一些显著的弱点，作者可能需要考虑解决这些问题。

**请求的更改：**
请考虑解决上述**缺点**。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
作者可能在第9.2节“应用”中提醒读者，在没有验证假设的情况下应用因果发现方法可能导致偏倚结果。

**主张和证据：**
无

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
针对请求的更改：我们非常感谢这些宝贵的建议和评论。我们非常重视这些评论，因为我们相信它们对于提高综述的整体质量至关重要。我们已根据以下请求的更改和评论进行了调整：
#请求的更改：“作为一篇综述论文，作者用7页篇幅讨论了时态因果发现的假设和方法，这与全文（共45页）相比显得非常不平衡。我强烈建议作者要么专注于独立同分布数据的因果发现，要么专注于时态数据的因果发现，但绝对不要两者兼顾。”
+回复：我们非常感谢您的建议，并理解您的关切。然而，时态因果发现方法看似不平衡的原因在于，与现有的独立同分布数据算法相比，可用于时间序列因果发现的算法数量非常少。事实上，与已建立的独立同分布因果发现领域相比，时态因果发现领域是一个正在增长的研究领域。我们试图讨论现有的时间序列因果发现方法的全面列表。我们这篇综述的目的是让读者了解现有的因果发现研究，并提供涵盖独立同分布和时间序列数据方法的整个领域的概述。在日常生活中，我们经常会遇到一些现实世界的数据是时间序列数据。因此，我们认为呈现时态方法对于提高综述的实用性也是必要的。此外，我们综述第2节中呈现的术语是一些与独立同分布和时间序列数据因果发现相关的常见术语。我们还进一步增加了对时间序列因果发现方法的基准分析。我们还讨论了未来研究方向、挑战、应用、指标、工具等，这些内容对独立同分布和时间序列方法都是共同的。
#请求的澄清/更改：“关于‘独立同分布数据的因果发现’部分：a. 这篇综述与现有工作的区别是什么？举几个例子：Glymour, Clark, Kun Zhang, and Peter Spirtes. "基于图模型的因果发现方法综述." 遗传学前沿 10 (2019): 524. Nogueira, Ana Rita, et al. "因果发现和因果推断的方法和工具." Wiley跨学科评论：数据挖掘和知识发现 12.2 (2022): e1449. Sprites, Peter, and Kun Zhang. "因果发现和推断：概念及近期方法学进展." 应用信息学. 第3卷. 第1期. SpringerOpen, 2016.”
+回复：（a）这篇综述与现有工作的区别如下：Glymour等人的综述仅讨论了传统的基于约束、基于评分和基于FCM的方法，并未提及因果发现方法领域的最新进展。它没有涵盖许多最近开发的方法，也没有明确讨论采用梯度优化或先验知识的方法。而我们的综述则试图讨论尽可能多的最新研究，并指出越来越多的文献处理先验知识、采用梯度优化、处理潜在变量等。此外，我们还尝试了对他们未做的一些方法进行了基准和性能比较。在Nogueira, Ana Rita等人的综述中，他们没有详细说明每种方法的工作方式，也没有列出该领域的一些论文。此外，他们没有讨论可用于轻松进行因果发现的工具。我们认为这种分析应该是任何因果发现综述的一部分，以便为读者提供他们开始任何因果分析所需的一切。Sprites, Peter和Kun Zhang的研究与我们不同之处在于，他们没有很好地讨论和比较方法，也没有在方法之间进行广泛的实验比较研究。总体而言，我们在多个方面与现有综述不同，如上所述，其中讨论大多数重要现有工作以及独立同分布和时间序列数据的最新方法、突出利用先验知识的方法、方法的基准测试、挑战、应用、工具等的讨论是一些重要的方面。

paper_title: Unveiling the fibrotic puzzle of endometriosis: An overlooked concern calling for prompt action
paper_abstract: Endometriosis is a benign, estrogen-dependent, persistent chronic inflammatory heterogeneous condition that features fibrotic adhesions caused by periodic bleeding. The characteristic ectopic lesions are marked by a widely spread dense fibrotic interstitium comprising of fibroblasts, myofibroblasts, collagen fibers, extracellular proteins, inflammatory cells, and active angiogenesis. Fibrosis is now recognized as a critical component of endometriosis because of which current treatments, such as hormonal therapy and surgical excision of lesions are largely ineffective with severe side effects, high recurrence rates, and significant morbidity. The symptoms include dysmenorrhea (cyclic or noncyclic), dyspareunia, abdominal discomfort, and infertility. The significant lack of knowledge regarding the underlying root causes, etiology, and complex pathogenesis of this debilitating condition, hinders early diagnosis and implement effective therapeutic approaches with minimal side effects presenting substantial hurdles in endometriosis management. Emerging research offer a close relationship between endometriosis and fibrosis, which is believed to be tightly linked to pain, a primary contributor to the deterioration of the patient’s quality of life. However, the underlying pathophysiological cellular and molecular signaling pathways behind endometriosis-associated fibrosis are poorly addressed. The available experimental disease models have tremendous challenges in reproducing the human characteristics of the disease limiting the treatment effectiveness. Future translational research on the topic has been hindered by the lack of an adequate fibrotic model of endometriosis emphasizing the necessity of etiological exploration. This review article focuses on recent developments in the field and highlight the necessity for novel fibrotic models for early diagnosis, a better understanding the disease’s etiology and develop effective anti-fibrotic treatments. By addressing these knowledge gaps, we want to open fresh avenues for a thorough investigation and extended research in the field of endometriosis.
review_content:
Overall Rating: Average
Reviewer Opinion: Major Revision

The manuscript effectively emphasizes the significance of understanding endometriosis-related fibrosis and the limitations of current treatments. It underscores the need for better models and addresses the challenges in understanding the disease's pathogenesis. However, the presentation would benefit from a more structured approach and a clearer focus on specific research gaps and proposed solutions. Adding details on how the review addresses these gaps and improves therapeutic strategies would enhance its impact. While the review offers valuable insights into fibrotic models and treatments, greater clarity on its specific contributions is needed.
  * Abstract: The abstract effectively outlines the importance of fibrosis research in endometriosis. Restructuring for clarity and adding specific research gaps and proposed solutions would strengthen overall outlook.
  * Introduction:
      + Link to Fibrosis: The introduction does not clearly connect endometriosis issues to fibrosis. Adding specifics on how the review addresses this would improve its rationale.
      + Redundancy: The introduction repeats information on endometriosis mechanisms and diagnostic challenges. Reducing repetition would improve clarity.
  * Literature Review:
      + Fibrotic Endometriosis Overview: The discussion on animal model limitations could be more focused. Highlighting specific shortcomings, especially in fibrosis and EMT representation, would provide clearer insights. There is a mouse model for endometriosis and fibrosis (PMID: 30626716).
      + Endometriotic Models: While the challenges of developing accurate models are discussed, more specific examples would be beneficial. Consider adding key limitations of rodent models and clarifying how estrogen-induced EMT impacts translation to human disease.
      + EMT and MMPs in Endometriosis: The discussion on MMPs and EMT lacks detailed mechanisms and direct evidence. Emphasizing experimental findings and strengthening the link between MMPs, EMT, and disease progression would improve this section.
  * Discussion: While acknowledging the importance of translating research into clinical care, the section lacks concrete examples of how this might occur or what specific therapeutic advancements are expected.
  * Conclusion: The call for longitudinal studies is important, but the section does not address the obstacles in conducting these studies.

paper_title_zh: 揭示子宫内膜异位症的纤维化之谜：一个被忽视的亟待关注的问题
paper_abstract_zh: 子宫内膜异位症是一种良性的、雌激素依赖的、持续性的慢性炎症性异质性疾病，其特征是由周期性出血引起的纤维性粘连。典型的异位病灶以广泛分布的致密纤维性间质为标志，包括成纤维细胞、肌成纤维细胞、胶原纤维、细胞外蛋白、炎症细胞和活跃的新血管生成。纤维化现在被认为是子宫内膜异位症的关键组成部分，因此，当前的治疗方法，如激素治疗和病灶手术切除，大多效果不佳，且伴有严重的副作用、高复发率和显著的发病率。症状包括痛经（周期性或非周期性）、性交痛、腹部不适和不孕。对于这一致残性疾病的根本原因、病因和复杂发病机制的显著知识缺乏，阻碍了早期诊断和实施具有最小副作用的有效治疗方法的实现，给子宫内膜异位症的管理带来了重大障碍。新兴研究显示子宫内膜异位症与纤维化之间有密切关系，这被认为与疼痛密切相关，而疼痛是导致患者生活质量下降的主要因素。然而，子宫内膜异位症相关纤维化背后的病理生理细胞和分子信号通路尚未得到充分探讨。现有的实验疾病模型在再现疾病的人类特征方面面临巨大挑战，限制了治疗效果。关于这一主题的未来转化研究因缺乏适当的子宫内膜异位症纤维化模型而受阻，强调了病因探索的必要性。本文综述了该领域的最新进展，并强调了新型纤维化模型对于早期诊断、更好地理解疾病病因和开发有效抗纤维化治疗的必要性。通过填补这些知识空白，我们希望为子宫内膜异位症领域的深入调查和扩展研究开辟新的途径。
review_content_zh:
总体评分：平均
审稿人意见：重大修订

该手稿有效地强调了理解子宫内膜异位症相关纤维化的重要性以及当前治疗方法的局限性。它突出了对更好模型的需求，并探讨了理解疾病发病机制中的挑战。然而，论文的呈现将受益于更结构化的方法，以及对特定研究空白和拟议解决方案的更清晰聚焦。增加关于该综述如何解决这些空白并改进治疗策略的细节，将提升其影响力。尽管该综述对纤维化模型和治疗提供了宝贵的见解，但需要更清晰地说明其具体贡献。
* 摘要：摘要有效地概述了纤维化研究在内膜异位症中的重要性。为清晰起见进行重组，并添加特定研究空白和拟议解决方案，将增强整体展望。
* 引言：
  + 与纤维化的联系：引言没有清楚地将内膜异位症问题与纤维化联系起来。添加关于该综述如何解决这一问题的具体内容，将改善其合理性。
  + 冗余：引言重复了关于内膜异位症机制和诊断挑战的信息。减少重复将提高清晰度。
* 文献综述：
  + 纤维化内膜异位症概述：对动物模型局限性的讨论可以更加聚焦。突出具体不足，特别是在纤维化和EMT表现方面，将提供更清晰的见解。存在一个关于内膜异位症和纤维化的小鼠模型（PMID: 30626716）。
  + 内膜异位症模型：虽然讨论了开发准确模型的挑战，但更多具体示例将有益。考虑添加啮齿动物模型的关键局限性，并澄清雌激素诱导的EMT如何影响向人类疾病的转化。
  + 内膜异位症中的EMT和MMPs：对MMPs和EMT的讨论缺乏详细机制和直接证据。强调实验发现，并加强MMPs、EMT与疾病进展之间的联系，将改善这一部分。
* 讨论：虽然承认将研究转化为临床护理的重要性，但该部分缺乏具体示例，说明这可能如何发生或预期哪些具体治疗进展。
* 结论：呼吁进行纵向研究很重要，但该部分未提及进行这些研究的障碍。

paper_title: Current state of knowledge on Wolbachia infection among Coleoptera: a systematic review
paper_abstract: Background. Despite great progress in studies on Wolbachia infection in insects, the knowledge about its relations with beetle species, populations and individuals, and the effects of bacteria on these hosts is still unsatisfactory. In this review we summarize the current state of knowledge about Wolbachia occurrence and interactions with Coleopteran hosts. Methods. An intensive search of the available literature resulted in the selection of 86 publications that describe the relevant details about Wolbachia presence among beetles. These publications were then examined with respect to the distribution and taxonomy of infected hosts and diversity of Wolbachia found in beetles. Sequences of Wolbachia genes (16S rDNA, ftsZ) were used for the phylogenetic analyses. Results. The collected publications revealed that Wolbachia has been confirmed in 204 beetle species and that the estimated average prevalence of this bacteria across beetle species is 38.3% and varies greatly across families and genera (0-88% infected members) and is much lower (c. 13%) in geographic studies. The majority of the examined and infected beetles were from Europe and East Asia. The most intensively studied have been two groups of herbivorous beetles: Curculionidae and Chrysomelidae. Coleoptera harbor Wolbachia belonging to three supergroups: F found in only 3 species, and A and B found in similar numbers of beetles (including some doubly infected); however the latter two were most prevalent in different families. 59% of species with precise data were found to be totally infected. Single infections were found in 69% of species and others were doubly-or multiply-infected. Wolbachia caused numerous effects on its beetle hosts, including selective sweep with host mtDNA (found in 3% of species), cytoplasmic incompatibility (detected in c. 6% of beetles) and other effects related to reproduction or development (like male-killing, possible parthenogenesis or haplodiploidy induction, and egg development). Phylogenetic reconstructions for Wolbachia genes rejected cospeciation between these bacteria and Coleoptera, with minor exceptions found in some Hydraenidae, Curculionidae and Chrysomelidae. This would put statements such as ‘most richly infected genus’ in perspective. Although in the rebuttal you claim these numbers are in the paper, I can’t find them anywhere. If you disagree with my view that this would be helpful, please explain. paper_title_zh: 关于鞘翅目昆虫中 Wolbachia 感染的现有知识现状：系统评价
paper_abstract_zh: 背景。尽管昆虫Wolbachia感染的研究取得了巨大进展，但关于其与甲虫物种、种群和个体的关系，以及细菌对这些宿主的影响的知识仍然不足。在这篇综述中，我们总结了关于Wolbachia在甲虫宿主中发生和与宿主相互作用的现有知识。方法。对现有文献的深入研究筛选出了86篇出版物，这些出版物描述了关于甲虫中Wolbachia存在的相关细节。然后，从感染宿主的分布和分类以及甲虫中发现的Wolbachia多样性方面对这些出版物进行了考察。使用Wolbachia基因序列（16S rDNA、ftsZ）进行了系统发育分析。结果。收集到的出版物显示，Wolbachia已在204种甲虫物种中得到证实，估计这种细菌在甲虫物种中的平均患病率为38.3%，在科和属之间差异很大（感染成员0-88%），而在地理研究中则要低得多（约13%）。大多数被检查和感染的甲虫来自欧洲和东亚。研究最为深入的是两组食草甲虫：金龟子科和叶甲科。鞘翅目宿主携带属于三个超组的Wolbachia：仅在3个物种中发现F组，A和B组在甲虫中的数量相似（包括一些双重感染）；然而后两者在不同科中更为普遍。精确数据物种中有59%被发现是完全感染的。69%的物种发现为单一感染，其他物种为双重或多次感染。Wolbachia对其甲虫宿主产生了多种影响，包括与宿主mtDNA的连锁选择（在3%的物种中发现）、细胞质不亲和性（在大约6%的甲虫中发现）以及与繁殖或发育相关的其他影响（如雄性致死、可能的无性生殖或单倍二倍体诱导，以及卵发育）。Wolbachia基因的系统发育重建拒绝了这些细菌与鞘翅目的共生，尽管在一些 Hydraenidae、金龟子科和叶甲科中发现了少数例外。相反，Wolbachia的横向传播
review_content_zh:
**审稿人1的建议**

L106–107 ‘[…] 甲虫（鞘翅目），是地球上物种最丰富和多样化的一类生物 […]’ – 这句话不合逻辑。我在第一次审稿中已经提到过这一点。> 在这句话中，我们旨在强调甲虫的数量和多样性，为了避免任何误解，我们已经再次修改了这句话。

L144 我对在NCBI的Genbank上搜索发现许多额外的沃尔巴克氏体-甲虫关联感到困惑（见上文）。> 这只是NCBI搜索工具显示任意两个词之间关联方式的简单效果——在甲虫属和沃尔巴克氏体的情况下，它也会显示许多与沃尔巴克氏体相关的论文，这些论文只是提到了一些关于甲虫的研究，但并没有提供关于甲虫中沃尔巴克氏体的相关数据（请参见我上面的例子）。

paper_title: Exploring Sample Size Determination in Educational Research: A Comprehensive Review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     By conducting an in-depth study of the publications, a review was conducted with the goal of evaluating the sample size in educational research. The sample size, represented by the letter “n,” is a key factor in this research because it specifies the number of participants who represent the target population. Although various studies have been published in the literature defining the processes for calculating sample sizes, there is still much uncertainty. It is vital to understand that there is no single all-encompassing method for determining sample sizes for different study designs. Instead, different study designs call for different approaches to determine sample numbers. 
   
   
     Methods 
     Information was retrieved from the databases in accordance with updated PRISMA recommendations. The keywords used for the retrieval of the relevant articles from two databases (Google Scholar and PubMed). The articles were selected by thorough scrutiny and application of inclusion and exclusion criteria. 
   
   
     Results 
     Seven articles were selected and the comparison was made among the studies in the relation to methods, objective, and outcome from the enrolled studies. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     The evaluation of the seven studies as a whole concluded that the sample size for testing any novel approach essentially required 24.24 participants in each group. The median sample size for the simulation-based educational research was 30. Further research is required to determine the proper sample size based on a single universal formula for all types of designs.
review_content:
The objective of this systematic review lacks clarity and direction. The selection of articles appears arbitrary, and the conclusions drawn from this limited article are questionable and not scientifically robust. Specifically, in conclusion, the authors assert that the sample size for certain studies needs to be 24. In contrast, other studies require 30, without providing a solid rationale or statistical justification for these numbers. Such conclusions lack precision and do not adhere to the rigorous standards expected in systematic reviews.
Furthermore, the methodology used to arrive at these conclusions is not adequately explained, leading to concerns about the validity and reliability of the findings. The review fails to offer new insights or meaningful contributions to the existing body of knowledge. A systematic review needs to be comprehensive, methodologically sound, and transparent in its approach. Unfortunately, this manuscript falls short of these criteria.
I recommend that this manuscript be not indexed. The authors may consider revisiting their methodology and providing a more rigorous analysis in future submissions.
paper_title_zh: 探索教育研究中样本量确定的综合综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
通过对出版物进行深入研究，进行了一项综述，旨在评估教育研究中的样本量。样本量，用字母“n”表示，是这项研究的关键因素，因为它指定了代表目标人群的参与者数量。尽管文献中已经发表了各种定义样本量计算过程的研究，但仍然存在许多不确定性。重要的是要理解，对于不同的研究设计，没有一种单一的、全面的方法来确定样本量。相反，不同的研究设计需要不同的方法来确定样本数量。

方法
根据更新的PRISMA建议，从数据库中检索信息。使用关键词从两个数据库（Google Scholar和PubMed）检索相关文章。通过仔细审查和应用纳入和排除标准来选择文章。

结果
选择了七篇文章，并对入选研究的方法、目标和结果进行了比较。

结论
对这七项研究的整体评估得出结论，测试任何新方法所需的样本量在每个组中本质上需要24.24名参与者。基于模拟的教育研究中位样本量为30。需要进一步研究，以根据适用于所有类型设计的单一通用公式确定适当的样本量。
review_content_zh:
本系统综述的目标缺乏清晰性和方向性。文章的选择显得随意，且从这些有限的文章中得出的结论值得质疑，缺乏科学严谨性。具体而言，在结论中，作者断言某些研究的样本量需要为24，而其他研究则需要30，并未为此提供坚实的理论基础或统计学依据。这样的结论缺乏精确性，不符合系统综述所期望的严格标准。

此外，用于得出这些结论的方法论未得到充分解释，导致对研究结果的效度和信度产生疑虑。该综述未能提供新的见解或有意义的知识贡献。系统综述需要全面、方法严谨且透明。遗憾的是，该手稿未能达到这些标准。

我建议不索引该手稿。作者可以考虑重新审视其方法论，并在未来的投稿中提供更为严谨的分析。

paper_title: Measurement of sedentary behaviour in population health surveys: a review and recommendations
paper_abstract: The purpose of this review was to determine the most valid and reliable questions for targeting key modes of sedentary behaviour (SB) in a broad range of national and international health surveillance surveys. This was done by reviewing the SB modules currently used in population health surveys, as well as examining SB questionnaires that have performed well in psychometric testing. Methods: Health surveillance surveys were identified via scoping review and contact with experts in the field. Previous systematic reviews provided psychometric information on pediatric questionnaires. A comprehensive search of four bibliographic databases was used to identify studies reporting psychometric information for adult questionnaires. Only surveys/studies published/used in English or French were included. Results: The review identified a total of 16 pediatric and 18 adult national/international surveys assessing SB, few of which have undergone psychometric testing. Fourteen pediatric and 34 adult questionnaires with psychometric information were included. While reliability was generally good to excellent for questions targeting key modes of SB, validity was poor to moderate, and reported much less frequently. The most valid and reliable questions targeting specific modes of SB were combined to create a single questionnaire targeting key modes of SB. Discussion: Our results highlight the importance of including SB questions in survey modules that are adaptable, able to assess various modes of SB, and that exhibit adequate reliability and validity. Future research could investigate the psychometric properties of the module we have proposed in this paper, as well as other questionnaires currently used in national and international population health surveys.
review_content: Reviewer 1: We thank this reviewer for their thorough evaluation of this manuscript and recognition of its importance. We believe his/her commentary and suggestions have further strengthened our manuscript and we are hopeful that we have adequately addressed them all. Comment 1: Line 67 provide citations. Response 1: We thank the reviewer for identifying this important omission. The two references have now been added to page 4, line 70. Comment 2: "Figure 1 provides results of the search strategy used to identify 35 papers that examined the validity"...this is not very clear. Do you mean Figure 1 provides results of the search strategy used to identify [37?] papers that examined the validity? Response 2: Figure 1 and the text have now been clarified to provide clarification on the number of papers. In total 40 papers were included that covered 34 unique tools/questionnaires. Multiple papers reported on the same questionnaire, the figure and table have been fixed accordingly. Comment 3: In addition, figure 1 can be used to breakdown the number of included papers undergone psychometric testing in a pediatric population, and in the adult population. Response 3: Figure 1 is meant to provide an overview of the screening process used to identify the adult papers. In our methodology we describe that pediatric papers were identified using two previously published systematic reviews in pediatric populations. We have tried to clarify this throughout the text. Comment 4: For figure 1, it is recommended to provide reasons for excluding articles at full-text screening and the number of articles that are excluded for each reason. Please see "Item 17: Study selection Given numbers of studies screened, assessed for eligibility, and included in the review, with reasons for exclusions at each stage, ideally with a flow diagram". Since this study is not a systematic review, this is not a serious issue, I just wanted to mention it. Response 4: We have amended Figure 1 to include the reasons and number of articles excluded under each reason. Comment 5: In Supplemental_Table_2 Line 184, the reliability and validity of individual questionnaires (n=34 or 37?) has been summarized in Supplemental table 2. Also, I found it to be a bit confusing to know which papers have been discussed in the previous systematic reviews [16,17] and which ones you are investigating in this study. It would be great if you could clarify. Response 5: We thank the reviewer for this observation. We believe the reviewer is referring to Supplemental Table 3 which provides an overview of the validity/reliability of individual questionnaires. The review incorporated the 14 questionnaires from the previous systematic reviews (we did not identify any other pediatric questionnaires) and 34 questionnaires in adult populations. There were 40 papers in total reporting on these questionnaires as in some cases more than 1 paper reported on the psychometric testing of the same tool. We have added the N's to Supplemental table 3. Line 190 discusses that all 14 questionnaires were from the previous reviews. Comment 6: Supplemental table 3 is not referenced anywhere in the manuscript. Response 6: Apologies this was an error on our part and thank the reviewer for catching it. We have now referred to Supplemental table 3 on page 9, line 190. Comment 7: In order to conduct a comprehensive search it is very important to include mesh terms in the search. It is impossible to come up with a comprehensive list of search terms. Mesh searching will assist with retrieving all potential articles relevant to a topic. For example, as a Subjective measurement term, one might use self-rated instead of self report. By searching for "Self Report"[Mesh], you can reduce the risk of missing that specific article. I strongly suggest adding the following mesh terms: "reproducibility of results"/ OR validation studies as topic/ Validation Studies/ Response 7: We agree with the reviewer that the absence of Mesh terms is a limitation of our search strategy. We acknowledge that our search strategy was not comprehensive in nature. We have now acknowledged this as the main limitation of our review; see page 16, lines 354-354 for this addition. However, given the relatively new recognition of sedentary behaviour as an independent movement descriptor, it is likely that Mesh Terms would not have appropriately captured this topic. There is a mesh heading for “sedentary lifestyle” but it does not describe SB, it describes physical inactivity (https://meshb.nlm.nih.gov/record/ui?ui=D057185). Comment 8: Mesh searching becomes even more important if you limit the search to tw field. "The Text Word (TW) index is an alias for all of the fields in a database which contain text words and which are appropriate for a subject search. The Text word index in Ovid MEDLINE (R) includes Title (TI) and Abstract (AB)". (from http://ospguides.ovid.com/OSPguides/medline.htm#TW ) basically tw exclude searching the author's keywords field and mesh field. Response 8: We once again acknowledge that our search strategy was not comprehensive. This is a limitation of our review. Comment 9: One of the main limitations of this study is the lack of a comprehensive search. I think it would be great to mention this in the article to increase transparency. Response 9: Please see above comment. Comment 10: Line 123) I do not think searching ‘EBM Reviews - Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews’ would have been useful as the authors were aiming to find original research articles rather than systematic review articles. Response 10: We searched the Cochrane Database to ensure that we were not missing any previous reviews to have looked at the validity/reliability of questionnaires in adults. Comment 11: As mentioned before one of the main limitations of this study is the lack of a comprehensive search. I think it would be great to mention this in the article to increase transparency. Response 11: We agree with the reviewer. We have now acknowledged this as the main limitation of our review, see page 16, lines 352-354 for this addition.
paper_title_zh: "人群健康调查中久坐行为测量的综述与建议"
paper_abstract_zh: 本综述的目的是确定在广泛的国家和国际健康监测调查中，针对久坐行为（SB）关键模式的最为有效和可靠的问题。通过回顾目前人口健康调查中使用的SB模块，以及检查在心理测量测试中表现良好的SB问卷来实现这一目标。方法：通过范围综述和与领域专家的联系，识别健康监测调查。之前的系统综述提供了关于儿科问卷的心理测量信息。对四个文献数据库的全面搜索用于识别报告成人问卷心理测量信息的研究。仅包括以英语或法语发表/使用的调查/研究。结果：综述共识别出16项儿科和18项成人国家/国际评估SB的调查，其中少数经过了心理测量测试。包括14项儿科和34项具有心理测量信息的成人问卷。尽管针对SB关键模式的问题可靠性普遍良好至优秀，但有效性较差至中等，且报告频率较低。将针对特定SB模式的最有效和可靠的问题结合起来，创建了一个针对SB关键模式的单一问卷。讨论：我们的结果强调了在调查模块中包含SB问题的重要性，这些模块应具有适应性，能够评估各种SB模式，并表现出足够的可靠性和有效性。未来的研究可以调查本文提出的模块的心理测量特性，以及其他目前在国家及国际人口健康调查中使用的问卷。
review_content_zh:

paper_title: Role of extracellular matrix in breast cancer development: a brief update
paper_abstract: Evidence is increasing on the crucial role of the extracellular matrix (ECM) in breast cancer progression, invasion and metastasis with almost all mortality cases owing to metastasis. The epithelial-mesenchymal transition is the first signal of metastasis involving different transcription factors such as Snail, TWIST, and ZEB1. ECM remodeling is a major event promoting cancer invasion and metastasis; where matrix metalloproteinases (MMPs) such as MMP-2, -9, -11, and -14 play vital roles degrading the matrix proteins for cancer spread. The β-D mannuronic acid (MMP inhibitor) has anti-metastatic properties through inhibition of MMP-2, and -9 and could be a potential therapeutic agent. Besides the MMPs, the enzymes such as LOXL2, LOXL4, procollagen lysyl hydroxylase-2, and heparanase also regulate breast cancer progression. The important ECM proteins like integrins (b1-, b5-, and b6- integrins), ECM1 protein, and Hic-5 protein are also actively involved in breast cancer development. The stromal cells such as tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAFs), and adipocytes also contribute in tumor development through different processes. The TAMs become proangiogenic through secretion of VEGF-A and building vessel network for nourishment and invasion of the tumor mass. The latest developments of ECM involvement in breast cancer progression has been discussed in this review and this study will help researchers in designing future work on breast cancer pathogenesis and developing therapy targeted to the ECM components.
review_content:
The review by Jena and Janjanam provides some updates on progress in our understanding of the complex interactions between breast cancer cells and surrounding extracellular matrix (ECM) during tumor progression and metastasis. The review also mentions the growing appreciation of the interplay of stromal cells such as tumor-associated macrophages and fibroblasts on this process. While I applaud the efforts to synthesize some recent findings in this review, each subtopic within the review would warrant a deeper dive into the literature and what this means for developing new therapies. The recent discovery of the interstitium as a fluid compartment, as opposed to a rigid ECM barrier, that facilitates metastasis within lymph nodes and blood vessels1 would warrant mention in a future review on this topic. There is also evidence emerging that ECM can form a barrier to cytotoxic immune cell recruitment. What might this mean for therapies targeting matrix metalloproteinases or cancer-associated fibroblasts that alter the ECM? How can the altered ECM improve responses to chemotherapy or immunotherapy in breast cancer?

Overall, the topic is very interesting and timely, but the review needs to be more focused to achieve significant depth, and to truly guide thinking about new therapeutic strategies for metastatic breast cancer.
paper_title_zh: 细胞外基质在乳腺癌发展中的作用：简要更新
paper_abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，细胞外基质（ECM）在乳腺癌进展、侵袭和转移中起着至关重要的作用，几乎所有死亡病例均归因于转移。上皮-间质转化是转移的第一个信号，涉及不同的转录因子，如Snail、TWIST和ZEB1。ECM重塑是促进癌症侵袭和转移的主要事件，其中基质金属蛋白酶（MMPs），如MMP-2、-9、-11和-14，在降解基质蛋白以促进癌症扩散中发挥关键作用。β-D甘露糖酸（MMP抑制剂）通过抑制MMP-2和-9具有抗转移特性，可能成为潜在的治疗剂。除了MMPs，LOXL2、LOXL4、前胶原赖氨酸羟化酶-2和乙酰肝素酶等酶也调控乳腺癌进展。重要的ECM蛋白，如整合素（b1-、b5-和b6-整合素）、ECM1蛋白和Hic-5蛋白，也积极参与乳腺癌的发展。肿瘤相关巨噬细胞（TAMs）、癌症相关成纤维细胞（CAFs）和脂肪细胞等基质细胞也通过不同过程促进肿瘤发展。TAMs通过分泌VEGF-A并构建血管网络，为肿瘤团块的滋养和侵袭提供支持。本综述讨论了ECM在乳腺癌进展中的最新研究进展，这项研究将帮助研究人员设计未来的乳腺癌发病机制研究以及开发针对ECM成分的靶向治疗。
review_content_zh:
杰纳和贾贾南姆的综述提供了一些关于我们在理解乳腺癌细胞与周围细胞外基质（ECM）在肿瘤进展和转移过程中复杂相互作用方面的进展更新。该综述还提到了对基质细胞（如肿瘤相关巨噬细胞和成纤维细胞）在此过程中相互作用的日益重视。尽管我赞赏这篇综述中综合一些近期发现的努力，但综述中的每个子主题都值得更深入地探讨文献及其对开发新疗法的意义。最近发现间质作为液态腔室，而非刚性的ECM屏障，有助于在淋巴结和血管内促进转移1，这一发现应在未来关于该主题的综述中提及。还有证据表明，ECM可以形成阻碍细胞毒性免疫细胞招募的屏障。这对针对改变ECM的基质金属蛋白酶或癌症相关成纤维细胞的疗法可能意味着什么？改变的ECM如何能提高乳腺癌对化疗或免疫疗法的响应？

总体而言，这一主题非常有趣且及时，但综述需要更加聚焦以实现显著的深度，并真正指导对转移性乳腺癌新治疗策略的思考。

paper_title: Implications of circadian rhythm and stress in addiction vulnerability
paper_abstract: In the face of chronic stress, some individuals can maintain normal function while others go on to develop mental illness. Addiction, affecting one in every twelve people in America, is a substance use disorder long associated with stressful life events and disruptions in the sleep/wake cycle. The circadian and stress response systems have evolved to afford adaptability to environmental changes and allow for maintenance of functional stability, or homeostasis. This mini-review will discuss how circadian rhythms and stress individually affect drug response, affect each other, and how their interactions may regulate reward-related behavior. In particular, we will focus on the interactions between the circadian clock and the regulation of glucocorticoids by the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis. Determining how these two systems act on dopaminergic reward circuitry may not only reveal the basis for vulnerability to addiction, but may also illuminate potential therapeutic targets for future investigation.
review_content: This is a well written and timely summary of interactions between the circadian system and the stress response system set in the framework of drug addiction/reward. The article provides an accurate summary of the current literature and a helpful introduction of these biological systems to readers who are unfamiliar with the field. The figures are clear, well-described, and aid the reader in understanding the molecular mechanisms described in the text. In addition, the evolution/environmental interaction perspective in the introduction provides an excellent framework for the following discussion of how interactions between the circadian and stress systems can go awry. This mini-review is a useful reference to researchers studying basic neuroscience questions on these systems and how these systems are disrupted in psychiatric disorders. The review highlights the importance of recognizing the potential interactions between these systems in both normal and pathological conditions.
paper_title_zh: 昼夜节律与压力在成瘾易感性中的影响

paper_title: Advancing the activity cliff concept
paper_abstract: The activity cliff concept has experienced increasing interest in medicinal chemistry and chemoinformatics. Activity cliffs have originally been defined as pairs of structurally similar compounds that are active against the same target but have a large difference in potency. Activity cliffs are relevant for structure-activity relationship (SAR) analysis and compound optimization because small chemical modifications can be deduced from cliffs that result in large-magnitude changes in potency. In addition to studying activity cliffs on the basis of individual compounds series, they can be systematically identified through mining of compound activity data. This commentary aims to provide a concise yet detailed picture of our current understanding of activity cliffs. It is also meant to introduce the further refined activity cliff concept to a general audience in drug development.
review_content:
Ye Hu, Dagmar Stumpfe, and Jürgen Bajorath elaborate in their commentary entitled 'Advancing the activity cliff concept' on the application of an abstract chemoinformatics-based analysis of differentiated structure-activity relationships within given compound sets. Given the high level of complexity and the expert computational chemistry knowledge often required to comprehend and to apply those latest developments in the field of chemoinformatics, I consider this commentary as extremely helpful in bridging exactly that obvious gap between the practitioners of bioactive compound data mining on the one hand, and the laboratory-based practitioners of medicinal chemistry on the other hand, respectively.

Within the context of today’s practice of medicinal chemistry, the sound and conclusive interpretation of structure-activity data is one of the most relevant, though challenging assignments in any small molecule lead finding and optimization campaign. In the course of those projects, involved teams are permanently required to make high-impact decisions on e.g. further prosecution of specific chemotypes based on systems that are, from an experimental point of view, notoriously under determined. Hence, it is of great value to account for all publicly available information on the compound-centric aspects in a given drug discovery project in order to make the most educated decision, specifically on the 'tractability' of a given chemotype.

More specifically, compound classes that after a certain chemical elaboration fail to exhibit a differentiated activity profile, i.e. do not show activity cliffs, should not be prosecuted any further since all too often those 'flat SAR' or 'rolling-hill' analogues were repeatedly identified as cul-de-sac series in many lead finding campaigns. In that context, the authors provide very helpful guidelines for the medicinal chemistry community on how to access the concept of activity cliffs by sharing expert insights they have gained over many systematic studies on practical aspects such as choosing the right potency difference and molecular similarity criteria to reliably define activity cliff patterns. Different molecular similarity metrics are introduced and comparatively ranked on their applicability and interpretability within a potential medicinal chemistry project. We all might have heard about Tanimoto, MACCS and ECFP4 fingerprints; but I assume that not too many of us are acquainted to the MMP (matched molecular pair) concept and utilize that concept pro-actively in pursued lead finding and optimization campaigns.

The group around Jürgen Bajorath actively de-mystifies those similarity concepts for us by providing quantitative measures on the inter-relation, thereby sharing their experience on the practicability of all those computational-based approaches. And for a medicinal chemist it is inspiring to see how e.g. scaffold-based cliffs unfold in a comprehensible way. I find it especially useful that the authors share their preferred definitions and settings in terms of applied similarity criteria, potency difference criteria, as well as activity measurements, thus highlighting scope and limitations of the underlying methodology. The more interested reader who wants to get really deeply involved into algorithmic details or further applications of the activity cliff concept is referred to the most recent and relevant research references.

Within the framework of a baseline study on 35000 bioactive compounds acting at 129 targets in the ChEMBL database, the overall occurrence of activity cliffs is analysed underlining the finding that activity cliffs occur quite frequently and contain valuable intrinsic SAR information that is not applied systematically. It becomes apparent that activity cliff-dependent optimization pathways seem to have a cliff-associated SAR advantage over other optimization strategies. Based on those findings, I can only support the claim that is made by the authors, notably to establish much closer links between chemoinformatics and practising medicinal chemists for a better and earlier integration of existing activity cliff information into pursued projects.

Despite the multiple and rather different ways towards activity cliffs, the concept as such becomes a tangible and intuitive asset that should be applied more frequently in the today’s pre-clinical discovery arena.

I see especially the attempt of reaching highest user-friendliness for a putative end-user that renders this commentary as very helpful to get the medicinal chemistry community alerted for this useful but still under-appreciated concept. The group around Jürgen Bajorath undoubtedly qualifies as an advocate in that sense, and the community of practising medicinal chemists should start to move in their direction accordingly.
paper_title_zh: 推进活性悬崖概念
paper_abstract_zh: 活性悬崖概念在药物化学和化学信息学中引起了越来越多的关注。活性悬崖最初被定义为结构相似但针对同一靶标活性差异显著的化合物对。活性悬崖对于构效关系（SAR）分析和化合物优化具有重要意义，因为从悬崖中可以推断出小的化学修饰，这些修饰会导致活性发生大幅度的变化。除了基于单个化合物系列研究活性悬崖外，还可以通过挖掘化合物活性数据系统地识别它们。本评论旨在提供一个简洁而详细的当前对活性悬崖理解的全貌。同时，也旨在向药物开发领域的普通受众介绍进一步细化的活性悬崖概念。
review_content_zh:
叶胡、达格玛·施图姆费和于尔根·巴约拉特在他们题为《推进活性悬崖概念》的评论中，详细阐述了在给定化合物集中应用基于抽象化学信息学的差异化结构-活性关系分析。鉴于化学信息学领域的最新发展往往需要高水平的复杂性和专业的计算化学知识才能理解和应用，我认为这篇评论在弥合生物活性化合物数据挖掘实践者与实验室为基础的药物化学实践者之间的明显差距方面极为有帮助。

在当今药物化学实践背景下，对结构-活性数据的准确和结论性解释是任何小分子先导发现和优化项目中最为相关且具挑战性的任务之一。在这些项目的进行过程中，参与团队需要不断基于实验角度通常难以确定的系统，对例如特定化学型的进一步研究做出重大决策。因此，为了做出最明智的决策，特别是在给定化学型的“可处理性”方面，考虑所有公开可用的关于特定药物发现项目中以化合物为中心的信息具有极大价值。

更具体地说，经过一定化学处理后未能表现出差异化活性谱的化合物类别，即不显示活性悬崖的化合物，不应再进一步研究，因为那些“平坦SAR”或“滚动山丘”类似物在许多先导发现项目中反复被识别为死胡同系列。在此背景下，作者为药物化学界提供了非常有帮助的指导方针，通过分享他们在许多系统研究中获得的专家见解，指导如何访问活性悬崖概念，例如选择合适的效力差异和分子相似性标准来可靠地定义活性悬崖模式。介绍了不同的分子相似性度量，并比较了它们在潜在药物化学项目中的适用性和可解释性。我们可能都听说过Tanimoto、MACCS和ECFP4指纹；但我假设我们中很少有人熟悉MMP（匹配分子对）概念，并在先导发现和优化项目中主动利用这一概念。

于尔根·巴约拉特团队通过提供相似性概念之间相互关系的定量度量，积极为我们揭开这些相似性概念的神秘面纱，分享他们在所有这些基于计算的方法的实用性方面的经验。对于药物化学家来说，看到例如基于支架的悬崖以易于理解的方式展开是令人鼓舞的。我发现作者分享他们偏好的应用相似性标准、效力差异标准以及活性测量方面的定义和设置尤其有用，从而突出了底层方法的范围和局限性。对算法细节或活性悬崖概念进一步应用感兴趣的读者可以参考最新和最相关的研究参考文献。

在针对ChEMBL数据库中作用于129个靶点的35000个生物活性化合物的基线研究中，分析了活性悬崖的整体出现情况，强调活性悬崖相当频繁出现，并包含未被系统应用的宝贵内在SAR信息。显然，依赖活性悬崖的优化路径似乎比其他优化策略具有与悬崖相关的SAR优势。基于这些发现，我完全支持作者提出的观点，即建立化学信息学与实践药物化学家之间更紧密的联系，以便更好地将现有的活性悬崖信息更早地整合到进行的项目中。

尽管通往活性悬崖的途径多种多样且各不相同，但这一概念本身成为了一个切实可行且直观的资产，应在当今的临床前发现领域更频繁地应用。

我特别看到这篇评论在追求最高用户友好性方面的努力，使其对药物化学界来说非常有帮助，以引起对这一有用但仍然被低估的概念的关注。于尔根·巴约拉特团队无疑在这方面堪称倡导者，实践药物化学家群体应相应地开始向他们的方向迈进。

And for a medicinal chemist it is inspiring to see how e.g. scaffold-based cliffs unfold in a comprehensible way.

paper_title: Influence of deep learning image reconstruction algorithm for reducing radiation dose and image noise compared to iterative reconstruction and filtered back projection for head and chest computed tomography examinations: a systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background 
    The most recent advances in Computed Tomography (CT) image reconstruction technology are Deep learning image reconstruction (DLIR) algorithms. Due to drawbacks in Iterative reconstruction (IR) techniques such as negative image texture and nonlinear spatial resolutions, DLIRs are gradually replacing them. However, the potential use of DLIR in Head and Chest CT has to be examined further. Hence, the purpose of the study is to review the influence of DLIR on Radiation dose (RD), Image noise (IN), and outcomes of the studies compared with IR and FBP in Head and Chest CT examinations. 
  
  
    Methods 
    We performed a detailed search in PubMed, Scopus, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, and Embase to find the articles reported using DLIR for Head and Chest CT examinations between 2017 to 2023. Data were retrieved from the short-listed studies using Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-analysis (PRISMA) guidelines. 
  
  
    Results 
    Out of 196 articles searched, 15 articles were included. A total of 1292 sample size was included. 14 articles were rated as high and 1 article as moderate quality. All studies compared DLIR to IR techniques. 5 studies compared DLIR with IR and FBP. The review showed that DLIR improved IQ, and reduced RD and IN for CT Head and Chest examinations. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    DLIR algorithm have demonstrated a noted enhancement in IQ with reduced IN for CT Head and Chest examinations at lower dose compared with IR and FBP. DLIR showed potential for enhancing patient care by reducing radiation risks and increasing diagnostic accuracy.
review_content:
Major comments:
The article provides an insightful and comprehensive review of the influence of Deep Learning Image Reconstruction (DLIR) on radiation dose, image noise, and outcomes in head and chest CT examinations compared to traditional Iterative (IR) and Filtered Back Projection (FBP) techniques. The methodology section is meticulously detailed, following PRISMA guidelines. The results section offers a clear summary of the inclusion and exclusion criteria, key outcomes related to DLIR's influence on radiation dose reduction, image noise reduction, and enhancement of image quality in CT head and chest examinations. The inclusion of quality assessment scores adds validation to the review's findings. The discussion and conclusion effectively explain the results, offering potential applications of DLIR in clinical settings.

Minor suggestions:
Please proofread for grammatical errors. Additionally, consider including points related to the smaller sample size of pediatric CT cases to provide a more comprehensive overview.

Suggestions to editor:
Overall, it is an excellent review article that represents a valuable contribution to the field of CT image reconstruction technology, providing insights into the impact of Deep Learning Image Reconstruction technology on dose reduction and improvement of image quality.
paper_title_zh: 深度学习图像重建算法在降低头部和胸部计算机断层扫描检查辐射剂量和图像噪声方面的作用：与迭代重建和滤波反投影的比较——系统综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
最新的计算机断层扫描（CT）图像重建技术进展是深度学习图像重建（DLIR）算法。由于迭代重建（IR）技术存在诸如负图像纹理和非线性空间分辨率等缺点，DLIR逐渐取代了它们。然而，DLIR在头部和胸部CT中的潜在应用需要进一步研究。因此，本研究的目的是回顾DLIR对辐射剂量（RD）、图像噪声（IN）的影响，并与IR和FBP在头部和胸部CT检查中的研究结果进行比较。

方法
我们在PubMed、Scopus、Web of Science、Cochrane Library和Embase进行了详细检索，以找到2017年至2023年间使用DLIR进行头部和胸部CT检查的报道文章。数据根据系统评价和荟萃分析优先报告条目（PRISMA）指南从筛选出的研究中提取。

结果
在检索的196篇文章中，纳入了15篇文章。总样本量为1292。14篇文章被评为高质量，1篇文章被评为中等质量。所有研究都将DLIR与IR技术进行了比较。5项研究比较了DLIR与IR和FBP。综述显示，DLIR提高了图像质量（IQ），并降低了头部和胸部CT检查的辐射剂量和图像噪声。

结论
与IR和FBP相比，DLIR算法在较低剂量下显著提高了头部和胸部CT检查的图像质量，并降低了图像噪声。DLIR显示出通过减少辐射风险和提高诊断准确性来增强患者护理的潜力。
review_content_zh:
主要评论：
本文对深度学习图像重建（DLIR）在头部和胸部CT检查中对辐射剂量、图像噪声和结果的影响进行了深入且全面的综述，并与传统的迭代（IR）和滤波反投影（FBP）技术进行了比较。方法部分详尽细致，遵循了PRISMA指南。结果部分清晰地总结了纳入和排除标准，以及与DLIR在降低辐射剂量、减少图像噪声和提高CT头部和胸部检查图像质量相关的主要结果。纳入质量评估分数为综述的发现提供了验证。讨论和结论部分有效地解释了结果，并提出了DLIR在临床环境中的潜在应用。

请校对语法错误。此外，考虑包括与儿科CT病例较小样本量相关的观点，以提供更全面的概述。
