paper_title: Unleashing the Power of Data Tsunami: A Comprehensive Survey on Data Assessment and Selection for Instruction Tuning of Language Models
paper_abstract: Instruction tuning plays a critical role in aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preference. Despite the vast amount of open instruction datasets, naively training a LLM on all existing instructions may not be optimal and practical. To pinpoint the most beneficial datapoints, data assessment and selection methods have been proposed in the fields of natural language processing (NLP) and deep learning. However, under the context of instruction tuning, there still exists a gap in knowledge on what kind of data evaluation metrics can be employed and how they can be integrated into the selection mechanism. To bridge this gap, we present a comprehensive review on existing literature of data assessment and selection especially for instruction tuning of LLMs. We systematically categorize all applicable methods into quality-based, diversity-based, and importance-based ones where a unified, fine-grained taxonomy is structured. For each category, representative methods are elaborated to describe the landscape of relevant research. In addition, comparison between latest methods is conducted on their officially reported results to provide in-depth discussions on their limitations. Finally, we summarize the open challenges and propose the promosing avenues for future studies. All related contents are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/status/instruction_tuning_data_survey-B307.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The survey examined data assessment and selection method for instruction tuning of LLMs. It presents a taxonomy based on three aspects: quality, diversity, importance. Within each aspect, further categorization of method is given and representative method are summarized and discussed. The performance of some representative method are summarized and discussed per aspect. Finally, the survey points out issues of existing methods and provide future directions.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strength: 1. The survey provide good collection of LLM data selection method that focus on three aspects: quality, diversity and importance. The survey nicely summarized representative methods of hand-crafted and model-based methods that is easy to understand and refer to for LLM community. 2. The provided suggestions on future directions are insightful. Weakness: 1. This draft contains a lot of typos and unfinished sentences. 2. see requested changes.

**Requested Changes:**
1. Related surveys are collected in the survey, but a compare and contrast is lacking. 2. Figure 1 is not vector graph, small texts are hard to read. 3. The mathematical formulation in Preliminaries Instruction Dataset Preparation is not clear to me. 1. instruction and input are used interchangeably while considered as two parts in first sentence. Also, what is x? is x the same as I? and what is the relationship between p and x? 2. The equation 2 is also confusing, the input of sampling mechanism \pi takes input b and a single data point that is a result of argmax. Author should correct the formulation. Also \S_{b}^{\*} ‘s meaning is unclear. The terminology is not unified across the survey. datapoint and instruction datapoint are also used interchangeably. 4. Eq (6): the indicators should not be sharing parameters in general? 5. Eq (8): I don’t understand why small \tilde{S}(x_i) here corresponds to “easy”, it should be the opposite since the perplexity would need to be small, no? (correct me if I am wrong) 6. The sentence below equation 10 “where yi(j) ∈ R^{N_{vocab}} denotes the one-hot vector of the vocabulary size N_vocab,” . The wording here is confusing. 7. Quality-based, diversity-based and importance-based method are discussed, but author did not elaborate the definition of those quantities. Also I think some high level rationale should be provided regarding what these three aspects are and why use them to build the taxonomy. I understand these concepts overlap practically, but some discussion of the usage of these concepts within the scope of the survey is appreciated. A general formulation of methods in each of these aspects would be beneficial if possible. This might help in resolve the possible confusion of the concept for example in Ch 4, diversity seems to refer to lexical and semantic richness, but why bias, fairness aspects of diversity are not discussed in the survey is not clear. 8. Data selection and assessment targeting bias, fairness finetuning is completely missing in this survey, I wonder the authors opinion on these. 9. I suggest author to recheck their literature summary across the draft, some summaries are wordy but fail to convey main idea of surveyed work. Take an example of Jiang et al. (2023b) referred in 5.2 the paragraph below equation 42, I have a hard time understanding the calibration process despite it taking a whole paragraph. 10. How are table 1, 2, 3 constructed? How do authors pick methods to be summarized to the tables? 11. Again, the draft should be checked thoroughly by the authors, as the current version contains a lot of typos, unfinished sentences, or empty references.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
LLMs are known to have bias/fairness issues, author may consider adding discussion on how these are handled by data assessment and selection work currently.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 释放数据海啸的力量：面向语言模型指令调优的数据评估与选择综合综述
paper_abstract_zh: 指令调优在使大型语言模型（LLMs）与人类偏好对齐方面发挥着关键作用。尽管存在大量开放的指令数据集，但盲目地将LLM训练在所有现有指令上可能并非最优且不切实际。为了精确定位最有益的数据点，自然语言处理（NLP）和深度学习领域已提出了数据评估和选择方法。然而，在指令调优的背景下，关于可以采用何种数据评估指标以及如何将这些指标整合到选择机制中，仍存在知识空白。为填补这一空白，我们对现有关于LLMs指令调优的数据评估和选择文献进行了全面综述。我们系统地將所有适用方法分为基于质量、基于多样性和基于重要性三类，并构建了一个统一的、细粒度的分类体系。对于每一类，我们详细阐述了代表性方法，以描述相关研究的全貌。此外，我们根据最新方法的官方报告结果进行了比较，以深入讨论其局限性。最后，我们总结了开放性挑战，并提出了未来研究的潜在方向。所有相关内容可在https://anonymous.4open.science/status/instruction_tuning_data_survey-B307获取。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
该调查研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）指令调优的数据评估和选择方法。它基于三个方面提出了一个分类法：质量、多样性和重要性。在每个方面内，进一步对方法进行分类，并总结和讨论了代表性方法。每个方面的某些代表性方法的性能也被总结和讨论。最后，该调查指出了现有方法的问题，并提供了未来方向。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：1. 该调查提供了良好的LLM数据选择方法集合，重点关注三个方面：质量、多样性和重要性。该调查很好地总结了手工和基于模型的代表性方法，便于LLM社区理解和参考。2. 提供的未来方向建议具有洞察力。
缺点：1. 该草稿包含大量错别字和未完成的句子。2. 见所请求的更改。

**请求的更改：**
1. 调查中收集了相关调查，但缺乏比较和对比。2. 图1不是矢量图，小文本难以阅读。3. “预备知识：指令数据集准备”中的数学公式对我来说不清楚。1. 指令和输入在第一句中被视为两部分，但使用时互相替换。此外，x是什么？x与I相同吗？p与x之间的关系是什么？2. 方程2也很混乱，采样机制π的输入是b和一个由argmax产生的单一数据点。作者应更正公式。此外，\S_{b}^{\*}的含义不清楚。调查中的术语不统一。数据点和指令数据点也互相替换使用。4. Eq (6)：指标通常不应共享参数？5. Eq (8)：我不明白为什么这里的小\tilde{S}(x_i)对应“容易”，这应该是相反的，因为困惑度需要小，不是吗？（如果错了请纠正我）6. 方程10下面的句子“其中yi(j) ∈ R^{N_{vocab}}表示词汇大小N_vocab的单热向量”，这里的措辞令人困惑。7. 讨论了基于质量、多样性和重要性的方法，但作者未详细阐述这些量的定义。此外，我认为应提供一些高级理由，说明为什么使用这三个方面来构建分类法。我理解这些概念在实践中有所重叠，但在调查范围内对这些概念的使用进行一些讨论是受欢迎的。如果可能的话，每个方面的方法的通用公式将是有益的。这可能会帮助解决例如在第4章中概念的混淆，多样性似乎指的是词汇和语义丰富性，但为什么调查中没有讨论多样性的偏见、公平性方面不清楚。8. 该调查完全缺失了针对偏见、公平性微调的数据选择和评估，我想知道作者对这些的看法。9. 我建议作者重新检查草稿中的文献总结，一些总结冗长但未能传达所调查工作的主要思想。以5.2中提到的Jiang等人（2023b）为例，尽管用了一整段，我还是很难理解校准过程。10. 表1、2、3是如何构建的？作者如何选择要总结到表中的方法？11. 再次强调，作者应彻底检查草稿，因为当前版本包含大量错别字、未完成的句子或空参考文献。

paper_title: Emerging pneumococcal serotypes in Iraq: scope for improved vaccine development
paper_abstract: Pneumococcal disease is a global public health concern as it affects the young, aged and the immunocompromised. The development of pneumococcal vaccines and their incorporation in the immunization programs has helped to reduce the global burden of disease. However, serotype replacement and the emergence of non-vaccine serotypes as well as the persistence of a few vaccine serotypes underscores the need for development of new and effective vaccines against such pneumococcal serotypes. In the Middle East, places of religious mass gatherings are a hotspot for disease transmission in addition to the global risk factors. Therefore, the periodic surveillance of pneumococcal serotypes circulating in the region to determine the effectiveness of existing prevention strategies and develop improved vaccines is warranted. Currently, there is a lack of serotype prevalence data for Iraq due to inadequate surveillance in the region. Thus, this review aims to determine the pneumococcal serotypes circulating in Iraq which may help in the development and introduction of improved pneumococcal vaccines in the country.
review_content:
This review aims to summarize the emerging pneumococcal serotypes in Iraq and the middle eastern region to determine the effectiveness of the vaccines and help policy makers in Iraq to make informed decisions regarding introduction of improved vaccines. I believe this review is important and timely not just for the eastern Mediterranean region, but also has global relevance since it is a place of mass religious gatherings and pneumococcus is widely known for its horizontal gene transfer and global spread of resistant clones. In my opinion the authors can summarize the data and present it in a way that makes it easily comprehensible for readers rather than simply presenting the data on serotype prevalence. Below are my specific comments.
 1. Most of the data presented in this review is drawn from systematic reviews. Since the inferences drawn in the review rely on these systematic reviews, it is important to assess the QC of these reviews such as clinical heterogeneity, statistical heterogeneity as well as models used for meta analysis. In some cases, the authors refer to systematic reviews from very few geographical regions of a country - e.g. Iran. How reliable are these studies? The reliability of the data presented is heavily dependent on the QC of these meta analyses. Therefore the authors need to ensure that they only present data from robust systematic reviews.
 2. Section on pneumococcal serotypes - I suggest that the authors tabulate the pneumococcal serotypes associated with colonization vs. invasive disease along with the supporting references.
 3. Many times the authors list some serotypes as frequently associated with carriage and IPD. This does not make sense.
    For e.g. page 6, under data from Iran, 19F is classified into both IPD and carrier populations.
    Similarly, serotype 23F is listed under both carriage and IPD.
 4. For the data on countries from EMR region, age-wise stratification of serotype prevalence and correlation with antibiotic resistance profile is needed.
 5. The authors need to refrain from claiming that they can draw inference for Iraq from neighboring countries since although regions are located geographically closer, serotype replacement and capsule switching are regulated by selection pressure unique to the population. Even in this review there are unique serotypes associated with Iraq such as NVT 33C that is not found elsewhere in the region.
paper_title_zh: 伊拉克新兴肺炎球菌血清型：改进疫苗开发的范围
paper_abstract_zh: 肺炎球菌疾病是全球公共卫生关注的问题，因为它影响年轻人、老年人和免疫功能低下者。肺炎球菌疫苗的研发及其纳入免疫接种计划已帮助减轻了全球疾病负担。然而，血清型替换、非疫苗血清型的出现以及少数疫苗血清型的持续存在，凸显了开发针对这些肺炎球菌血清型的新型有效疫苗的必要性。在中东地区，宗教大规模集会场所除了全球风险因素外，也是疾病传播的热点。因此，定期监测该地区流行的肺炎球菌血清型，以确定现有预防策略的有效性并开发改进的疫苗是必要的。目前，由于该地区监测不足，伊拉克缺乏血清型流行数据。因此，本综述旨在确定伊拉克流行的肺炎球菌血清型，这可能有助于该国改进肺炎球菌疫苗的研发和引入。
review_content_zh:
本综述旨在总结伊拉克和中东地区新兴的肺炎球菌血清型，以确定疫苗的有效性，并帮助伊拉克的政策制定者就引入改进疫苗做出明智决策。我认为这篇综述不仅对东地中海地区具有重要意义和时效性，而且具有全球相关性，因为该地区是大规模宗教集会的场所，而肺炎球菌以其水平基因转移和耐药克隆的全球传播而广为人知。在我看来，作者可以总结数据并以一种易于读者理解的方式呈现，而不仅仅是展示血清型流行数据。以下是我的具体意见：
1. 本综述中呈现的大部分数据来自系统综述。由于综述中的推断依赖于这些系统综述，因此评估这些综述的质量控制（如临床异质性、统计异质性和用于荟萃分析的模型）非常重要。在某些情况下，作者引用的系统综述来自一个国家非常少数的地理区域——例如伊朗。这些研究的可靠性如何？所呈现数据的可靠性在很大程度上取决于这些荟萃分析的质量控制。因此，作者需要确保他们仅呈现来自稳健系统综述的数据。
2. 关于肺炎球菌血清型的部分——我建议作者将肺炎球菌血清型与定植和侵袭性疾病相关联的数据进行表格化，并提供支持性参考文献。
3. 多次作者将某些血清型列为与携带和侵袭性肺炎球菌病（IPD）频繁相关。这没有道理。
   例如，第6页，在来自伊朗的数据下，19F被归类为IPD和携带者群体。
   同样，23F血清型也被列在携带和IPD之下。
4. 对于来自东地中海地区（EMR）国家的数据，需要按年龄分层血清型流行情况，并与抗生素耐药谱进行相关性分析。
5. 作者需要避免声称他们可以从邻国为伊拉克得出推断，因为尽管这些地区地理位置相近，但血清型替换和荚膜转换受特定人群选择压力的调控。即使在这篇综述中，也有与伊拉克独特相关的血清型，如在该地区其他地方未发现的NVT 33C。

paper_title: Tourette Syndrome research highlights 2014
paper_abstract: About 200 journal articles reported research on Tourette syndrome and other tic disorders in 2014. Here we briefly summarize a few of the reports that seemed most important or interesting, ranging from animal models to human studies. Readers can comment on our choices or provide their own favorites using the tools on the online article.
review_content:
The authors report on highlights of the growing medical and scientific literature on Tourette Syndrome in 2014. The aim was not to conduct a systematic review, but instead to discuss noteworthy articles of interest. Topics ranged from animal models and neuroimaging to behavioral treatment.

Strengths of this manuscript were 1) cogent and thoughtful summary/discussion of the articles, 2) an informal and readable style, and 3) interesting content. There were several weaknesses, which if addressed, would strengthen the manuscript.

Methods: it would be helpful to know the approximate denominator of articles reviewed, and what proportion were selected.

Results: it would be helpful to know how/why topic areas were chosen. Weight seemed to lean strongly toward neuroimaging, which may reflect the authors’ primary interests and expertise. Organization of topic areas could be improved; as it stands, the reader is moved from neuroscience (animal models, imaging) to behavior therapy, premonitory urges, and longitudinal course, and then back to neuroscience (genetics). It might read more easily to start with basics (neuroscience, genetics, neuroimaging) through phenomenology (course, urges, role of stress) to treatment.

The manuscript could be improved with the inclusion of pharmacotherapy updates; although the Discussion summarized that the “broad spectrum of articles” covered “animal models, neuroimaging, and pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatment,” the only treatments discussed were behavior therapy, exercise and biofeedback.

Suggested pharmacotherapy additions include:

Gilbert, D. et al.: “A D1 receptor antagonist, ecopipam, for treatment of tics in Tourette Syndrome” Clin Neuropharmacol 2014; 37 (1) 26-30

Malaty, I.A. and Akbar U: Updates in Medical and Surgical Therapies for Tourette Syndrome; 2014; Curr Neurol Neurosci Rep 14: 458; this is a review with an annotated bibliography.

Work to look for in 2015: Bachmann, CJ et al.: Trends in Psychopharmacological Treatment of Tic Disorders in Children and Adolescents in Germany; Eur Child Adolesc Psychiatry 2015; 24 (2); 199-207

Lastly, there appeared to be a relative lack of articles on aspects of psychiatric comorbidity. Of particular interest is the recently published study from the Tourette Syndrome Association International Consortium for Genetics:

Hirschtritt, M. et al.: Lifetime Prevalence, Age of Risk, and Genetic Relationships of Comorbid Psychiatric Disorders in Tourette Syndrome; JAMA Psychiatry doi:10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2014.2650
paper_title_zh: 2014年图雷特综合症研究亮点
paper_abstract_zh: 2014年，约有200篇期刊文章报道了关于图雷特综合症和其他抽动障碍的研究。在此，我们简要总结了几篇看似最重要或最有趣的报告，内容涵盖从动物模型到人类研究的各个方面。读者可以通过在线文章的工具对我们的选择进行评论或提供他们自己的偏好。
review_content_zh:
作者报告了2014年关于图雷特综合症日益增长的医学和科学文献的亮点。其目的并非进行系统性综述，而是讨论值得关注的有兴趣的文章。主题范围从动物模型和神经影像到行为治疗。

该手稿的优点包括：1）对文章进行清晰且深思熟虑的总结/讨论，2）非正式且易读的写作风格，3）内容有趣。存在一些不足之处，若加以改进，将增强手稿的力度。

方法：了解所综述文章的大致基数以及选取比例将有所帮助。

结果：了解主题领域的选择方式及原因将有所帮助。权重似乎强烈偏向神经影像，这可能反映了作者的主要兴趣和专长。主题领域的组织可以改进；目前，读者从神经科学（动物模型、影像）转向行为治疗、预兆性冲动和纵向病程，然后又回到神经科学（遗传学）。若从基础（神经科学、遗传学、神经影像）开始，经过现象学（病程、冲动、压力的作用）到治疗，可能会更易读。

手稿可以通过包含药物治疗更新来改进；尽管讨论中总结“广泛的文章”涵盖了“动物模型、神经影像以及药物和非药物治疗”，但所讨论的唯一治疗方法是行为治疗、运动和生物反馈。

建议增加的药物治疗内容包括：

Gilbert, D. 等人：“D1受体拮抗剂，ecopipam，治疗图雷特综合症中的抽动” Clin Neuropharmacol 2014; 37 (1) 26-30

Malaty, I.A. 和 Akbar U：图雷特综合症的医学和外科治疗更新；2014；Curr Neurol Neurosci Rep 14: 458；这是一篇带有注释书目的综述。

2015年值得关注的工作：Bachmann, CJ 等人：德国儿童和青少年抽动障碍精神药物治疗的趋势；Eur Child Adolesc Psychiatry 2015; 24 (2); 199-207

最后，似乎相对缺乏关于精神共病方面的文章。特别值得关注的是最近由图雷特综合症协会国际遗传联盟发表的研究：

Hirschtritt, M. 等人：图雷特综合症中共病精神障碍的终身患病率、风险年龄和遗传关系；JAMA Psychiatry doi:10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2014.2650

reasons: Suggested pharmacotherapy additions include:
Strengths of this manuscript were 1) cogent and thoughtful summary/discussion of the articles, 2) an informal and readable style, and 3) interesting content.

The manuscript could be improved with the inclusion of pharmacotherapy updates; although the Discussion summarized that the “broad spectrum of articles” covered “animal models, neuroimaging, and pharmacological and non-pharmacological treatment,” the only treatments discussed were behavior therapy, exercise and biofeedback.

paper_title: A review of creatine supplementation in age-related diseases: more than a supplement for athletes
paper_abstract: Creatine is an endogenous compound synthesized from arginine, glycine and methionine. This dietary supplement can be acquired from food sources such as meat and fish, along with athlete supplement powders. Since the majority of creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, dietary creatine supplementation has traditionally been important for athletes and bodybuilders to increase the power, strength, and mass of the skeletal muscle. However, new uses for creatine have emerged suggesting that it may be important in preventing or delaying the onset of neurodegenerative diseases associated with aging. On average, 30% of muscle mass is lost by age 80, while muscular weakness remains a vital cause for loss of independence in the elderly population. In light of these new roles of creatine, the dietary supplement’s usage has been studied to determine its efficacy in treating congestive heart failure, gyrate atrophy, insulin insensitivity, cancer, and high cholesterol. In relation to the brain, creatine has been shown to have antioxidant properties, reduce mental fatigue, protect the brain from neurotoxicity, and improve facets/components of neurological disorders like depression and bipolar disorder. The combination of these benefits has made creatine a leading candidate in the fight against age-related diseases, such as Parkinson’s disease, Huntington’s disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, long-term memory impairments associated with the progression of Alzheimer’s disease, and stroke. In this review, we explore the normal mechanisms by which creatine is produced and its necessary physiology, while paying special attention to the importance of creatine supplementation in improving diseases and disorders associated with brain aging and outlining the clinical trials involving creatine to treat these diseases.
review_content:
This is an excellent review of the literature on creatine. I think that it would benefit from more discussion on possible side effects or toxicology. There are a number of review articles that discuss both the benefits and potential toxicology that could be included.

Overall the article is well written and a comprehensive review of the literature. It is interesting that such diverse effects are being seen in a wide range of degenerative diseases.
paper_title_zh: 《肌酸补充在年龄相关疾病中的综述：不仅仅是运动员的补充剂》
paper_abstract_zh: 肌酸是一种由精氨酸、甘氨酸和蛋氨酸合成的内源性化合物。这种膳食补充剂可以通过食物来源如肉类和鱼类以及运动员补充粉获得。由于大部分肌酸储存在骨骼肌中，膳食肌酸补充剂传统上对运动员和健美者来说非常重要，可以增加骨骼肌的力量、强度和质量。然而，肌酸的新用途已经出现，表明它可能在预防或延缓与衰老相关的神经退行性疾病的发作中起重要作用。平均而言，到80岁时，肌肉质量会减少30%，而肌肉无力仍然是老年人丧失独立性的重要原因。鉴于肌酸的这些新作用，已经研究了该膳食补充剂的用途，以确定其在治疗充血性心力衰竭、回旋状萎缩、胰岛素不敏感、癌症和高胆固醇中的有效性。在与大脑相关的研究中，肌酸已被证明具有抗氧化特性，减少精神疲劳，保护大脑免受神经毒性，并改善抑郁症和双相情感障碍等神经疾病的各个方面/组成部分。这些益处的结合使肌酸成为对抗与年龄相关疾病（如帕金森病、亨廷顿病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、与阿尔茨海默病进展相关的长期记忆障碍和中风）的领先候选药物。在这篇综述中，我们探讨了肌酸产生的正常机制及其必要的生理学，同时特别关注肌酸补充剂在改善与大脑衰老相关的疾病和障碍中的重要性，并概述了涉及肌酸治疗这些疾病的临床试验。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于肌酸的文献的优秀综述。我认为如果增加对可能副作用或毒理学的讨论将会更有益。有许多综述文章讨论了肌酸的好处和潜在毒理学，这些可以纳入其中。

总体而言，该文章写得很好，是对文献的全面综述。值得注意的是，在多种退行性疾病中观察到了如此多样的效果。

reasons: Overall the article is well written and a comprehensive review of the literature.
I think that it would benefit from more discussion on possible side effects or toxicology.
There are a number of review articles that discuss both the benefits and potential toxicology that could be included.
Overall the article is well written and a comprehensive review of the literature.

paper_title: Provisional Tic Disorder: What to tell parents when their child first starts ticcing
paper_abstract: The child with recent onset of tics is a common patient in a pediatrics or child neurology practice. If the child’s first tic was less than a year in the past, the diagnosis is usually Provisional Tic Disorder (PTD). Published reviews by experts reveal substantial consensus on prognosis in this situation: the tics will almost always disappear in a few months, having remained mild while they lasted. Surprisingly, however, the sparse existing data may not support these opinions. PTD may have just as much importance for science as for clinical care. It provides an opportunity to prospectively observe the spontaneous remission of tics. Such prospective studies may aid identification of genes or biomarkers specifically associated with remission rather than onset of tics. A better understanding of tic remission may also suggest novel treatment strategies for Tourette syndrome, or may lead to secondary prevention of tic disorders. This review summarizes the limited existing data on the epidemiology, phenomenology, and outcome of PTD, highlights areas in which prospective study is sorely needed, and proposes that tic disorders may completely remit much less often than is generally believed.
review_content:
The authors must be congratulated for this thoughtful and exhaustive review on a difficult topic. I hope that their ongoing initiative (www.NewTics.info) will provide answers to many of the questions raised in the manuscript.

My comments are few and as follows :
  * The definition of tics varies but a reasonable argument has been made that they are not « abnormal » movements of vocalisations but rather normal or physiologic but occuring in an inappropriate context and/or in an inappropriate fashion. As a net result, one can of course speak of abnormal motor or vocal manifestations but as a movement disorder neurologist, I think it is important to stress that the semiology of tics does not give us clear diagnostic clues , as opposed to dystonia of parkinsonina tremor, for instance. Also, it is worth mentioning that tics can be (temporarily) suppressed, which is not the case in the vast majority of movement disorders. Finally, like it or not, « stereotyped » has been removed from DSM-5.
  * I sympathize with the idea that early intervention, especially using behavioral therapies such as CBIT, may alter disease course, maybe through cerebral plasticity. However, there are no data to support this at present, even in confirmed TS cases. Moreover, CBIT (as opposed to ERP) depends on sensing premonitory urges, which are rarely present before the age of 10, and most PTD cases are likely to fall into this category. Finally, I believe that for patients with PTD, motivation and thus adherence for these kind of treatments will be low, except for severe cases. Thus, the therapeutic angle appears slightly artificial to me.
  * Rather, and this is the main question raised in the manuscript and by parents of children with PTD, is the issue of individual prognosis, and especially conversion of of PTD into TS. The problem, at least in France, is that tics are considered benign, and TS almost malignant. In other words, the terminology we use is paramount. My personal concern is not so much whether one or several tics will persist for more than a year but how damaging they are. This brings us to the talmudic discussion on the utility of DSM criteria and even more on what Tourette syndrome means or not (the authors point out quite rightly that in current clinical pratice, we are usually light years away from the Marquise de Dampierre). If I had a wish, I would get rid of the term « Tourette syndrome » and switch to tic spectrum disorder (or something like that), although I concede this may be a mushy term. However, I don’t expect to see this happen in my lifetime.
paper_title_zh: 临时性抽动障碍：当孩子首次出现抽动时，应告知家长什么
paper_abstract_zh: 近期出现抽动症状的儿童是儿科或儿童神经科常见的患者。如果孩子的首次抽动症状出现在一年以内，通常诊断为暂时性抽动障碍（PTD）。专家发表的综述显示，对于这种情况的预后存在较大共识：抽动症状几乎总会在几个月内消失，且在持续期间保持轻微。然而，令人惊讶的是，稀少 existing 数据可能并不支持这些观点。PTD 对科学和临床护理可能具有同等重要性。它提供了一个前瞻性观察抽动自发缓解的机会。此类前瞻性研究可能有助于识别与抽动缓解而非发作特异性相关的基因或生物标志物。更好地理解抽动缓解也可能为图雷特综合征提出新的治疗策略，或可能导致抽动障碍的二级预防。本综述总结了关于PTD的流行病学、现象学和结局的有限现有数据，强调了迫切需要前瞻性研究的领域，并提出了抽动障碍可能远不如普遍认为的那样经常完全缓解的观点。
review_content_zh:
作者们必须为这篇关于一个难题的深思熟虑且详尽的综述而受到祝贺。我希望他们正在进行的项目（www.NewTics.info）能够为手稿中提出的许多问题提供答案。

我的评论很少，如下：
* 抽动症的定义各不相同，但有合理的论据表明，它们并非“异常”的运动或发声，而是正常或生理性的，但出现在不适当的情境和/或以不适当的方式发生。因此，当然可以称之为异常的运动或发声表现，但作为一名运动障碍神经病学家，我认为强调抽动症的症状学并未给我们提供明确的诊断线索是很重要的，这与例如肌张力障碍或帕金森震颤不同。此外，值得一提的是，抽动症可以（暂时）抑制，这在绝大多数运动障碍中是不存在的。最后，无论是否喜欢，“刻板”一词已从DSM-5中删除。
* 我赞同早期干预，尤其是使用行为疗法如CBIT，可能会改变疾病进程，可能通过大脑可塑性。然而，目前尚无数据支持这一点，即使在确诊的TS病例中也是如此。此外，CBIT（与ERP相对）依赖于感知前驱冲动，而这些冲动在10岁之前很少出现，大多数PTD病例可能属于这一类。最后，我相信对于PTD患者来说，除了严重病例外，动机和对这类治疗的依从性将会很低。因此，治疗角度在我看来略显人为。
* 相反，正如手稿和PTD儿童家长所提出的主要问题，是个体预后问题，尤其是PTD转化为TS的问题。至少在法国，问题是抽动症被认为是良性的，而TS几乎是恶性的。换句话说，我们使用的术语至关重要。我个人的关注点不在于一个或多个抽动是否会持续超过一年，而在于它们的损害程度。这使我们陷入了关于DSM标准实用性的犹太法典式讨论，甚至更多关于图雷特综合征意味着什么的讨论（作者非常正确地指出，在当前的临床实践中，我们通常与Marquise de Dampierre相去甚远）。如果我能有一个愿望，我会去掉“图雷特综合征”这个术语，转而使用抽动谱系障碍（或类似术语），尽管我承认这可能是一个模糊的术语。然而，我不期望在我的有生之年看到这一变化。

reasons: The authors must be congratulated for this thoughtful and exhaustive review on a difficult topic.

but as a movement disorder neurologist, I think it is important to stress that the semiology of tics does not give us clear diagnostic clues , as opposed to dystonia of parkinsonina tremor, for instance.

The definition of tics varies but a reasonable argument has been made that they are not « abnormal » movements of vocalisations but rather normal or physiologic but occuring in an inappropriate context and/or in an inappropriate fashion.

If I had a wish, I would get rid of the term « Tourette syndrome » and switch to tic spectrum disorder (or something like that), although I concede this may be a mushy term. However, I don’t expect to see this happen in my lifetime.

paper_title: One step further in biomechanical models in palaeontology: A nonlinear finite element analysis review Jordi Marcé-Nogué
paper_abstract: Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is no longer a new technique in the fields of palaeontology, anthropology, and evolutionary biology. It is nowadays a well-established technique within the virtual functional-morphology toolkit. However, almost all the works published in these fields have only applied the most basic FEA tools i.e., linear materials in static structural problems. Linear and static approximations are commonly used because they are computationally less expensive, and the error associated with these assumptions can be accepted. Nonetheless, nonlinearities are natural to be used in biomechanical models especially when modelling soft tissues, establish contacts between separated bones or the inclusion of buckling results. The aim of this review is to, firstly, highlight the usefulness of non-linearities and secondly, showcase these FEA tool to researchers that work in functional morphology and biomechanics, as non-linearities can improve their FEA models by widening the possible applications and topics that currently are not used in palaeontology and anthropology.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Emily Rayfield) Basic reporting This is a useful review and one that I would like to see published. Following the first review, my main concern was that the author make it clear that they are showcasing the overlooked potential and importance of non-linear FE models rather than appearing to advocate without bias for their use. In this revised version, I am happy to see that the author has modified the text to make the review closer to the former rather than the latter. This is particularly clear in the Abstract and at the end of the Introduction. As it stands, I am content that this revised manuscript serves the purpose of outlining the usefulness of non-linear models. There are still a few queries and adjustments I would like the author to make before publication - outlined below. I thank the reviewer for being supportive. I addressed most of the changes she proposed or clarified them. Line 32 - when you say "mathematical nonlinearities are natural in physical models and the assumption of nonlinearilty...[etc]" by 'physical models', do you mean organisms and biological systems? When I see the word 'models' I think of mathematical/computational constructs, but I think you mean something different here? "Model" means the law of the physics that we are using to model the behaviour of a body, so to avoid the misunderstanding I used "physical laws" instead of physical models Line 38 onwwards - if palaeontologists are unaware of non-linear models, then they cannot ignore something they are not aware of. I suggest instead of ignore, phrase this as something like: "...most palaeontologists do not have a deep understanding of how FEA problems are defined and solved, and many are not aware of the potential of non-linear modelling." Change accepted Line 41 onwards: "Including non-linearities in palaeoanthropological models can improve the results obtained in skulls when modelling skulls by considering sutures, thus making the behaviour of the model closer to reality." If you want to convince palaeo/anthro people to use non-linear models, you need to add a reference to show how this is indeed the case (maybe from the human/medical literature?). I included a reference Line 103 onwards: "In most of the biological models modelling bone structures, shells have been the prefered option." Preferred on what basis? Accurate geometry or performance? I can see how this will work for a thin later of cortex and underlying cancellous bone, but surely shells are not preferred when dealing with thick cortical bone for example? This sentence needs clarifying why shells are preferred and whether this is the case for all bony structures. The preference of shells is on front of plates. I clarified it in the text 4.2 Non-linearities in Geometry: Buckling - this section should refer to Figure 4 I presume (not figure 3). 4.3 Non-linearities in contacts - likewise in this section should refer to Figure 5. Both solved 5.1 Non-linear soft tissues - it would be great at the end of this section to include some references of biomedical models that have succesfully included non-linear materials - to guide the reader to further recommended reading. Most of the references the reviewer is asking are in the previous section 4.1 Regarding buckling - the modified figure is helpful. And I understand how buckling may be important for the slender long bones of some birds and pterosaurs. Arthropod cuticle could be another good model strucutre. However I'm still not convinced that buckling is an important selective criterion for the thick long bones of high body mass dinosaurs and proboscideans. Are buckling injuries recorded in the human and veterinary literature? I need some more evidence before dinosaurs and mammals are used as exemplars. You can find what is called as "buckle fracture" in humans https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_fracture. They result from trabecular compression due to an axial loading force along the long axis of the bone, so what we understand as buckling. There is also some literature in other bones https://link-springer-com.sabidi.urv.cat/article/10.1007/s10439-009-9751-9 and I included it in the main text. In structural mechanics, buckling is very important in columns under compression, and it is the most important criterion to design these columns. The column will fail under buckling much before cracking for yield or fracture of the material properties. If the force applied against the column is very high, the only way to avoid buckling is modifying the connections/joints (difficult but not impossible), the material properties (difficult because it is bone), or the cross-section. So, my point here is that the cross section (and the other parameters) of heavy animals should be designed under this criterion. In fact, citing Currey and Alexander (1985) "If tubes are very thin-walled in relation to their diameter, they are liable to fail by local buckling" and also, they say "That is, they were more than sufficiently thick-walled for local buckling not to be a possible mode of failure". So, my point here is that buckling may be a criterion in the design of this bones (by increasing the thickness) to avoid buckling, because much before fracture or much before yield, buckling appears in these bones. I know form literature that Alexander and Currey raised this problem in birds, and I really do not know why the question is not raised in heavy animals. Probably because there is no evidence of fracture in the fossil record, but it does not mean that buckling could be important in understanding the design of their bones. In fact in the article from Currey (2003) “How Well Are Bones Designed to Resist Fracture?” buckling is discussed. Moreover, scratching a little bit I found in Currey (2003) information of preventing buckling in horse metacarpals. I think that this example can fix your doubts and I included in the text. Currey JD, Alexander RMN. 1985. The thickness of the walls of tubular bones. Journal of Zoology 206:453–468. DOI: 10.1111/j.1469-7998.1985.tb03551.x. Currey JD. 2003. How Well Are Bones Designed to Resist Fracture? Journal of Bone and Mineral Research 18:591–598. DOI: 10.1359/jbmr.2003.18.4.591. Additional comments Line 80: kind should be kinds : Solved Finally - the review ends abruptly. It would benefit from a short conclusion paragraph. I suggest the author add this to summarise their ideas and suggestions. (I should have suggested this in the first review - it was an oversight on my part). I included a paragraph at the end by writing some new text and moving some text from the introduction.
paper_title_zh: 古生物学中生物力学模型再进一步：非线性有限元分析综述  Jordi Marcé-Nogué
paper_abstract_zh: 有限元分析（FEA）在古生物学、人类学和进化生物学领域已不再是一项新技术。如今，它已成为虚拟功能形态学工具包中的一项成熟技术。然而，在这些领域发表的大部分研究仅使用了最基本的FEA工具，即线性材料在静态结构问题中的应用。线性静态近似之所以普遍使用，是因为它们在计算上成本较低，且这些假设相关的误差是可以接受的。尽管如此，非线性在生物力学模型中是自然应用的，尤其是在模拟软组织、建立分离骨骼间的接触或包含屈曲结果时。本综述的目的是，首先强调非线性的实用性，其次向功能形态学和生物力学领域的研究者展示这些FEA工具，因为非线性可以通过拓宽当前在古生物学和人类学中未应用的潜在应用和主题，来改进他们的FEA模型。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（Emily Rayfield）基本报告

这是一篇有用的综述，我希望看到它被发表。继第一次审稿后，我主要的担忧是作者需要明确他们是在展示非线性有限元模型被忽视的潜力和重要性，而不是无偏见地倡导其使用。在这份修订版中，我很高兴看到作者修改了文本，使综述更接近前者而非后者。这在摘要和引言的结尾部分尤为明显。就目前情况来看，我满意这份修订稿达到了概述非线性模型有用性的目的。在发表之前，我仍希望作者对以下几点进行修改和澄清——具体如下。感谢审稿人的支持。我对她提出的大部分修改建议进行了处理或澄清。

第32行——当你说“数学非线性在物理模型中是自然的，非线性的假设……[等等]”时，你所说的“物理模型”是指生物体和生物系统吗？当我看到“模型”这个词时，我会想到数学/计算构造，但我想你在这里指的是别的意思？“模型”指的是我们用来模拟物体行为的物理定律，为了避免误解，我用“物理定律”代替了“物理模型”。

从第38行开始——如果古生物学家不知道非线性模型，那么他们无法忽视他们不知道的东西。我建议不要用“忽视”，而是改用类似的说法：“……大多数古生物学家对有限元分析问题的定义和解决方法没有深入了解，许多人也不知道非线性建模的潜力。”接受修改。

从第41行开始：“在古人类学模型中包含非线性可以提高模拟颅骨时获得的结果，通过考虑骨缝，从而使模型的行为更接近现实。”如果你想说服古人类学/人类学领域的人使用非线性模型，你需要添加一个参考文献来证明这一点（可能来自人类/医学文献？）。已添加参考文献。

从第103行开始：“在大多数模拟骨结构的生物模型中，壳体是首选选项。”基于什么标准是首选？准确的几何形状还是性能？我能理解这对于薄层皮质骨和下方的松质骨是可行的，但在处理厚皮质骨时，壳体肯定不是首选吗？这句话需要澄清为什么壳体是首选以及这是否适用于所有骨结构。壳体的偏好是在板面前。我在文本中进行了澄清。

4.2 几何非线性：屈曲——这一节应该指的是图4（不是图3）。已解决。

4.3 接触非线性——同样，这一节应该指的是图5。已解决。

5.1 非线性软组织——在这一节的结尾，最好能包括一些成功包含非线性材料的生物医学模型的参考文献，以引导读者进一步阅读。审稿人要求的大部分参考文献在之前的4.1节中已有。

关于屈曲——修改后的图很有帮助。我理解屈曲对于一些鸟类和翼龙细长的长骨可能很重要。节肢动物的表皮可能是另一个好的模型结构。然而，我仍然不相信屈曲是高体重恐龙和长鼻类动物厚长骨的重要选择性标准。人类和兽医文献中有记录屈曲损伤吗？我需要更多证据才能将恐龙和哺乳动物作为例证。你可以在人类中找到所谓的“屈曲骨折”（https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Torus_fracture）。它们是由于沿骨长轴的轴向载荷力导致的松质骨压缩而引起的，即我们理解的屈曲。其他骨骼也有一些文献（https://link-springer-com.sabidi.urv.cat/article/10.1007/s10439-009-9751-9），我将其纳入了正文。

在结构力学中，屈曲在受压柱中非常重要，是设计这些柱子的最重要标准。柱子在屈曲失效之前，远不会因材料属性的裂缝或屈服而失效。如果施加的力非常大，避免屈曲的唯一方法是修改连接/接点（困难但并非不可能）、材料属性（困难，因为它是骨）或横截面。所以，我的观点是，重型动物的横截面（和其他参数）应根据这一标准进行设计。事实上，引用Currey和Alexander（1985）的话：“如果管壁相对于其直径非常薄，它们容易因局部屈曲而失效”，他们还说道：“也就是说，它们的壁厚足以使局部屈曲不成为一种可能的失效模式”。因此，我的观点是，屈曲可能是设计这些骨骼（通过增加厚度）以避免屈曲的一个标准，因为在骨折或屈服之前，屈曲会出现在这些骨骼中。我从文献中知道，Alexander和Currey在鸟类中提出了这个问题，我真的不知道为什么在重型动物中没有提出这个问题。可能是因为化石记录中没有骨折的证据，但这并不意味着屈曲在理解其骨骼设计上不重要。事实上，在Currey（2003）的文章《骨骼设计抵抗骨折的能力如何？》中讨论了屈曲。此外，稍作挖掘，我在Currey（2003）中找到了关于防止马掌骨屈曲的信息。我认为这个例子可以解决你的疑问，我将其纳入了文本。

Currey JD, Alexander RMN. 1985. The thickness of the walls of tubular bones. Journal of Zoology 206:453–468. DOI: 10.1111/j.1469-7998.1985.tb03551.x.
Currey JD. 2003. How Well Are Bones Designed to Resist Fracture? Journal of Bone and Mineral Research 18:591–598. DOI: 10.1359/jbmr.2003.18.4.591.

附加评论

第80行：kind应改为kinds。已解决。

最后——综述突然结束。增加一个简短的结论段落会更有益。我建议作者添加这一段来总结他们的想法和建议。（我应该在前一次审稿中提出这一点——这是我的疏忽）。我在结尾添加了一个段落，通过写入一些新文本并从引言中移动了一些文本。

reasons: If you want to convince palaeo/anthro people to use non-linear models, you need to add a reference to show how this is indeed the case (maybe from the human/medical literature?).

5.1 Non-linear soft tissues - it would be great at the end of this section to include some references of biomedical models that have succesfully included non-linear materials - to guide the reader to further recommended reading.
Are buckling injuries recorded in the human and veterinary literature?
I need some more evidence before dinosaurs and mammals are used as exemplars.
So, my point here is that the cross section (and the other parameters) of heavy animals should be designed under this criterion.
I really do not know why the question is not raised in heavy animals.
4.2 Non-linearities in Geometry: Buckling - this section should refer to Figure 4 I presume (not figure 3). 4.3 Non-linearities in contacts - likewise in this section should refer to Figure 5.
Line 80: kind should be kinds
4.2 Non-linearities in Geometry: Buckling - this section should refer to Figure 4 I presume (not figure 3).
4.3 Non-linearities in contacts - likewise in this section should refer to Figure 5.
Finally - the review ends abruptly.
It would benefit from a short conclusion paragraph.
I suggest the author add this to summarise their ideas and suggestions.

paper_title: Factors influencing the higher incidence of tuberculosis among migrants and ethnic minorities in the UK
paper_abstract: Migrants and ethnic minorities in the UK have higher rates of tuberculosis (TB) compared with the general population. Historically, much of the disparity in incidence between UK-born and migrant populations has been attributed to differential pathogen exposure, due to migration from high-incidence regions and the transnational connections maintained with TB endemic countries of birth or ethnic origin. However, focusing solely on exposure fails to address the relatively high rates of progression to active disease observed in some populations of latently infected individuals. A range of factors that disproportionately affect migrants and ethnic minorities, including genetic susceptibility, vitamin D deficiency and co-morbidities such as diabetes mellitus and HIV, also increase vulnerability to infection with Mycobacterium tuberculosis (M.tb) or reactivation of latent infection. Furthermore, ethnic socio-economic disparities and the experience of migration itself may contribute to differences in TB incidence, as well as cultural and structural barriers to accessing healthcare. In this review, we discuss both biological and anthropological influences relating to risk of pathogen exposure, vulnerability to infection or development of active disease, and access to treatment for migrant and ethnic minorities in the UK.
review_content:
This is an important review and good addition to the literature in that it combines both the biomedical and the social determinants of TB risk amongst populations that experience a disproportionate burden of disease in the UK. Great concluding section in particular. "Given the complex association between ethnicity and socio-economic status, it is hard to disentangle the extent to which socio-economic disadvantage influences TB incidence in migrant and ethnic minority populations" - I suggest this needs to be more explicit from the start and particularly as you risk, perhaps (my reading of it) conflating the migrant and ethnic-minority experience thus contributing to an idea that non-white = non British.

I note the reference to Nancy Krieger's work on the embodiment of risk across a life course. Considering TB through this ecosocial perspective allows an analysis of the interplay between the biomedical and the social. I wonder whether the article would flow better and provide a more critical reading if situated within this framework and, in particular, framing the literature from a 'distal' or macro (social determinants) perspective down to more proximal factors might provide a better reading. In terms of considerations of factors that contribute to risk I think that placing discussions of genetic susceptability at the start somewhat undermines the well founded concerns highlighted in the social determinants section - that our understanding of TB and research investment heavily focuses on the biomedical rather than the social.

The section about genetic susceptibility is perhaps a little uncritical and positions the association between ethnicity and TB risk at a genetic level as taken for granted. For a critical reading of Cummins research in relation to race and racism, for example, chapters 1 and 2 (the rise and fall of race) in Discovering TB by Christian McMillen.

I also note you use the term 'colored' to describe participants - I realise this is in the title of that study. As this term has racist origins I would suggest either adding [sic!] after it or altering the term to more accurately describe the population the research was conducted amongst (the former is probably easiest!).

A few other points:
- 'Hindu-Asians are more frequently vegetarian' - than who?
- 'Globalisation and capital flows' are drivers of migration - the reference is a report on migration and cities...is there a better reference?
- 2015 PHE data provided - can this be updated?
- The section on health-seeking states "The disease has been variously erroneously attributed to climate conditions...." - Please can you delete 'erroneously': You previously discuss vitamin D and migration - both related to 'climate conditions' as possible risk factors for TB (I realise this is not necessarily what the participants were getting at in their interviews but still think best to remove it) My other reason for removing it is that it undermines what is ''truth' as experienced by patients.
- 'Non-compliance' - I tend to use adherance as per NICE guidelines https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg76
- "Farmer criticises anthropological investigations for conflating structural violence with cultural difference" - The report the 'snowy white peaks of the NHS' and the McPherson report in the wake of the Stephen Lawrence inquiry talked about institutional racism within the NHS and I wonder whether this would be useful to mention as you talk about cultural barriers in relation to language, knowledge of health systems etc but, although you mention 'racial' barriers it is within the context of talking about migrants, rather than British-born BAME communities whose challenges in accessing care you don't specifically address.
paper_title_zh: 影响英国移民和少数民族结核病高发率的因素
paper_abstract_zh: 在英国，移民和少数民族的结核病（TB）发病率高于普通人群。历史上，英国出生人群与移民人群之间发病率差异的很大一部分被归因于病原体暴露的不同，这是由于从高发病率地区迁移以及与出生地或族裔起源的结核病流行国家保持跨国联系所致。然而，仅仅关注暴露并不能解释在某些潜伏感染人群中观察到的相对较高的活动性疾病进展率。一系列不成比例地影响移民和少数民族的因素，包括遗传易感性、维生素D缺乏以及糖尿病和HIV等共病，也增加了对结核分枝杆菌（M.tb）感染的易感性或潜伏感染的再激活风险。此外，种族社会经济差异和迁移本身的经历也可能导致结核病发病率的差异，以及文化和结构性障碍影响医疗保健的获取。在这篇综述中，我们讨论了与英国移民和少数民族病原体暴露风险、感染易感性或活动性疾病发展以及治疗获取相关的生物学和人类学影响。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇重要的综述，对文献的重要补充，因为它结合了在英国疾病负担不成比例的人群中结核病风险的生物医学和社会决定因素。特别是结论部分非常出色。“鉴于种族和社会经济状况之间的复杂关联，很难区分社会经济劣势对移民和少数族裔群体结核病发病率的影响程度”——我认为这一点需要从一开始就更加明确，尤其是你可能在（我的理解）将移民和少数族裔的经历混为一谈，从而助长了一种非白人即非英国人的观念。

我注意到引用了南希·克里格关于风险在生命历程中体现的研究。通过这种生态社会视角来考虑结核病，可以分析生物医学和社会之间的相互作用。我想如果将文章置于这一框架内，可能会使文章更加流畅，并提供更具批判性的阅读，特别是从“远端”或宏观（社会决定因素）视角到更近端因素的文献框架，可能会提供更好的阅读体验。在考虑风险因素的讨论中，我认为将遗传易感性的讨论放在开头，某种程度上削弱了社会决定因素部分所强调的合理关切——即我们对结核病的理解和研究投资过于集中在生物医学而非社会方面。

关于遗传易感性的部分可能有些不够批判性，将种族与结核病风险之间的关联定位在遗传层面视为理所当然。例如，对于库明斯关于种族和种族主义研究的批判性阅读，可以参考克里斯蒂安·麦克米伦在《发现结核病》一书中第一章和第二章（种族的兴衰）。

我还注意到你使用“colored”一词来描述参与者——我意识到这是那项研究的标题中的用词。由于这个词有种族主义的起源，我建议在后面加上[sic!]或者在描述研究人群时改用更准确的术语（前者可能更容易操作）。

其他几点：
- “印度裔亚洲人更常素食”——比谁更常？
- “全球化和资本流动”是移民的驱动力——引用的是关于移民和城市的报告……是否有更好的参考文献？
- 提供的2015年PHE数据——能否更新？
- 健康寻求部分提到“该疾病曾被 variously erroneously 归因于气候条件……”——请删除“erroneously”：你之前讨论了维生素D和移民——这两者都与“气候条件”相关，可能是结核病的风险因素（我意识到这并不一定是参与者访谈中的意思，但仍然认为最好删除）我删除的另一原因是，它削弱了患者所经历的“真相”。
- “不遵从”——我倾向于使用NICE指南中的“依从” https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg76
- “法默批评人类学研究将结构暴力与文化差异混为一谈”——“NHS的雪白高峰”报告和斯蒂芬·劳伦斯调查后的麦克弗森报告谈到了NHS内的制度种族主义，我想知道在讨论与文化相关的语言、健康系统知识等障碍时，提及这一点是否有用，尽管你提到了“种族”障碍，但这是在谈论移民的背景下，而不是英国出生的BAME社区，你并没有具体讨论他们在获取护理方面的挑战。

paper_title: A review of microscopic analysis of blood cells for disease detection with AI perspective
paper_abstract: Background Any contamination in the human body can prompt changes in blood cell morphology and various parameters of cells. The minuscule images of blood cells are examined for recognizing the contamination inside the body with an expectation of maladies and variations from the norm. Appropriate segmentation of these cells makes the detection of a disease progressively exact and vigorous. Microscopic blood cell analysis is a critical activity in the pathological analysis. It highlights the investigation of appropriate malady after exact location followed by an order of abnormalities, which assumes an essential job in the analysis of various disorders, treatment arranging, and assessment of results of treatment.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Comments: 1. In figure two, please do not use the word agranulocytes, this is not a good way to discriminate white blood cells, please follow the WHO classification, book published 2017. Fixed: Agraulocytes term is changed in figure 2. 2. For staining such as Romanowsky stain: please also prefer already in this paragraph that laboratories are used to their respective homebrew technics and therefor, as peripheral blood differential is aphenotypical method, technicians and doctors but also machine learning tools may have problems to translate their experience for other laboratories. Please also mention that normally machines are doing cell counting of peripheral blood and any unknown result by flagging will start the process of preparing peripheral blood smears. Please also refer to the aspect that (line 146) that there may be several technics to take the pictures not only "segmentation. Fixed: Paragraph is revised and citations are added 4. Figure 3 is only an idea what is going on, however one should really try to paint the lymphocytes and the monocytes a little bit more according to reality, as showing here they look much too similar. The sentence line 160 is quite funny, please delete the sentence "it is found to be…" as AML is already killing patients several days after diagnoses, the authors see problems in future areas of interest to devide white and red blood cells on smears, for sure this is a problem, however the reviewer does not see the problem to devide those, but to approach those in different ways with respect to machine learning. paper_title_zh: 基于人工智能视角的血细胞显微分析在疾病检测中的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 背景 人体内的任何污染都可能导致血细胞形态和各种细胞参数的变化。通过检查血细胞的微小图像，可以识别体内的污染，从而预期疾病和异常情况。对这些细胞的适当分割使得疾病的检测更加精确和稳健。显微镜血细胞分析在病理分析中是一项关键操作。它强调在精确定位后进行适当疾病的调查，随后对异常进行分类，这在各种疾病的诊断、治疗计划制定和治疗效果评估中扮演着重要角色。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2的意见：

1. 在图二中，请不要使用“无颗粒细胞”一词，这不是区分白细胞的良好方式，请遵循2017年出版的WHO分类。已修正：图2中已更改无颗粒细胞术语。

2. 对于如罗曼诺夫斯基染色的方法：也请在段落中明确指出，实验室习惯使用各自的内部技术，因此，由于外周血差异计数是一种表型方法，技术人员和医生以及机器学习工具可能难以将他们的经验转化为其他实验室。已修正：在“血涂片染色”部分添加了描述。

paper_title: Energy metabolism and sources of oxidative stress in wooden breast - a review
paper_abstract: Modern broilers show dramatic growth over a short interval and contribute directly to the success of the poultry meat industry. The growth performance of commercial broilers is a result of genetic selection for "performance traits", such as body size, meat yield, and feed conversion rate. However, due to the rapid growth rate of modern commercial broilers, several growth-related conditions have arisen, increasing economic losses and consumer concerns. Among the most economically consequential is the muscle disorder called wooden breast. Together with associated myopathies such as white striping and spaghetti meat, wooden breast is causing losses of $200 million a year in the U.S. alone and occurs worldwide. No causative factors are known for wooden breast to date. Wooden breast can affect over 80% of broilers in a flock, yet no methods of amelioration are currently available. Overall, the evidence suggests that wooden breast is a genetic, age-dependent condition associated with fast growth rate. The primary features of wooden breast are muscle degeneration and fibrosis, high levels of oxidative stress, hypoxia, and altered energy metabolism. Recent work has also implicated reduced pectoral vessel density in the pathogenesis of wooden breast. This review examines the history of myopathies in commercial broilers and the relationship of myopathies to metabolism and oxidative performance. This review summarizes the foundational knowledge of wooden breast and provides a platform for further investigation of wooden breast.
review_content:
The review is lacking in the following aspects:
 1. The effects of the disease on meat quality of commercial broiler.
 2. The effects of some disease control programs (e. g. against coccidiosis).
 3. The impact on productive efficiency and profitability.
 4. The protective effects of some antioxidants administered with the diet; biochemical signatures potentially useful for diagnosis.
paper_title_zh: 木胸病能量代谢与氧化应激来源综述
paper_abstract_zh: 现代肉鸡在短时间内表现出显著的生长速度，直接促进了家禽肉品行业的成功。商业肉鸡的生长性能是通过对“性能性状”的遗传选择结果，如体型、肉产量和饲料转化率。然而，由于现代商业肉鸡的快速生长率，出现了几种与生长相关的状况，增加了经济损失和消费者担忧。其中最具经济后果的是被称为木质胸肉的肌肉疾病。与相关的肌病如白条纹和意大利面条肉一起，木质胸肉仅在美国每年就造成2亿美元的损失，并且在全球范围内发生。迄今为止，木质胸肉的致病因素尚不清楚。木质胸肉可以影响一个鸡群中超过80%的肉鸡，但目前尚无改善方法。总体而言，证据表明木质胸肉是一种与快速生长率相关的遗传性、年龄依赖性状况。木质胸肉的主要特征是肌肉退化和纤维化、高水平的氧化应激、缺氧和能量代谢改变。近期研究还表明，胸肌血管密度降低在木质胸肉的发病机制中起作用。本文综述了商业肉鸡肌病的历史以及肌病与代谢和氧化性能的关系。本文总结了木质胸肉的基础知识，并为进一步研究木质胸肉提供了平台。

paper_title: The impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on self-harm and suicidal behaviour: update of living systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused considerable morbidity, mortality and disruption to people’s lives around the world. There are concerns that rates of suicide and suicidal behaviour may rise during and in its aftermath. Our living systematic review synthesises findings from emerging literature on incidence and prevalence of suicidal behaviour as well as suicide prevention efforts in relation to COVID-19, with this iteration synthesising relevant evidence up to 19 th October 2020. 
 Method:  Automated daily searches feed into a web-based database with screening and data extraction functionalities. Eligibility criteria include incidence/prevalence of suicidal behaviour, exposure-outcome relationships and effects of interventions in relation to the COVID-19 pandemic. Outcomes of interest are suicide, self-harm or attempted suicide and suicidal thoughts. No restrictions are placed on language or study type, except for single-person case reports. We exclude one-off cross-sectional studies without either pre-pandemic measures or comparisons of COVID-19 positive vs. unaffected individuals. 
 Results: Searches identified 6,226 articles. Seventy-eight articles met our inclusion criteria. We identified a further 64 relevant cross-sectional studies that did not meet our revised inclusion criteria. Thirty-four articles were not peer-reviewed (e.g. research letters, pre-prints). All articles were based on observational studies. 
There was no consistent evidence of a rise in suicide but many studies noted adverse economic effects were evolving. There was evidence of a rise in community distress, fall in hospital presentation for suicidal behaviour and early evidence of an increased frequency of suicidal thoughts in those who had become infected with COVID-19. 
 Conclusions:   Research evidence of the impact of COVID-19 on suicidal behaviour is accumulating rapidly. This living review provides a regular synthesis of the most up-to-date research evidence to guide public health and clinical policy to mitigate the impact of COVID-19 on suicide risk as the longer term impacts of the pandemic on suicide risk are researched.
review_content:
This manuscript is a great scientific contribution. The main strength of the manuscript (that it builds on a remarkable effort -- their living systematic review) goes hand in hand with the most important limitation (the period included in the particular iteration that is under consideration for publication). I would like to thank the authors for such a great addition to science (the living systematic review) and express my admiration. Next, I expand on these observations.

The introduction is right on target and reads well. A reference to recent increases in gun purchases in the US (e.g., https://www.businessinsider.com/gun-sales-boom-2020-background-checks-hit-record-highs-2021-1). Methods are sound. Results are concise and informative. The tables are particularly interesting and we congratulate the authors on the table including modelling studies as it conveys the most important information easily. The discussion also reads well and adjusts well to the findings.

There is, however, a major limitation to this study that authors may want to address: the limited period of time included. This iteration of the review stopped including papers by July 7th, roughly 4 months after the pandemic hit Western countries for the first time. Notably, this review would have been of great interest if published over the summer. Several research reports (and important grey literature) have become public in the meantime, some adding to the evidence reviewed here without notably changing the overarching results but enhancing their reliability (and probably creating the necessary ground for a quantitative summary or a meta-analysis) and, more importantly, some creating groundbreaking evidence that may change the conclusion of this review (such as the Nature Comms paper by Tanaka and Okamoto using data from Japan to show an initial dip and subsequent increase in suicide rates in Japan).

See some key recent key additions to the literature as an example:

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-020-01042-z1

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.11.13.20231571v12

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.10.06.20207530v53

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.10.21.20187419v14

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.10.20.20215343v15

The impact of this profound and sound review is somewhat limited by the period included: readers should resort to the authors’ ongoing live review.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19大流行对自伤和自杀行为的影响：实时系统综述更新
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：COVID-19大流行已在全球范围内造成显著的发病率和死亡率，并对人们的生活造成了严重干扰。有担忧认为，在疫情期间及其后续影响中，自杀和自杀行为的比率可能会上升。我们的实时系统综述综合了关于COVID-19相关自杀行为的发生率和流行率以及自杀预防努力的最新文献，本次迭代综合了截至2020年10月19日的相关证据。

方法：自动每日搜索结果输入一个具有筛选和数据提取功能的基于网络的数据库。纳入标准包括与COVID-19大流行相关的自杀行为的发生率/流行率、暴露-结局关系和干预效果。感兴趣的结果包括自杀、自残或自杀未遂以及自杀念头。除单人案例报告外，不对语言或研究类型设限。我们排除了既无大流行前测量也无COVID-19阳性与未受影响个体比较的单一横断面研究。

结果：搜索识别出6,226篇文章。78篇文章符合我们的纳入标准。我们进一步识别出64项相关横断面研究，但不符合我们修订后的纳入标准。34篇文章未经同行评审（如研究简报、预印本）。所有文章均基于观察性研究。

没有一致证据表明自杀率上升，但许多研究指出不利的经济影响正在演变。有证据显示社区痛苦增加，因自杀行为而就诊医院的人数下降，以及早期证据表明感染COVID-19的人群中自杀念头的频率增加。

结论：关于COVID-19对自杀行为影响的研究证据正在迅速积累。这一实时综述提供了最新研究证据的定期综合，以指导公共卫生和临床政策，减轻COVID-19对自杀风险的长期影响，同时对此进行深入研究。
review_content_zh:
这篇手稿是对科学的重要贡献。手稿的主要优势（即建立在卓越努力之上——他们的动态系统综述）与最重要的局限性（即考虑发表的特定迭代中包含的时间段）相辅相成。我要感谢作者为科学（动态系统综述）做出的这一伟大贡献，并表达我的钦佩之情。接下来，我将进一步展开这些观察。

引言切中要害，读起来流畅。可以引用美国近期枪支购买增加的资料（例如，https://www.businessinsider.com/gun-sales-boom-2020-background-checks-hit-record-highs-2021-1）。方法可靠。结果简洁且信息丰富。表格尤其有趣，我们祝贺作者在表格中包含建模研究，因为它轻松传达了最重要的信息。讨论部分也读起来顺畅，且很好地调整以符合研究结果。

然而，这项研究存在一个主要局限性，作者可能需要解决：包含的时间段有限。这次综述在7月7日停止纳入论文，大约是西方国家首次受到疫情影响后的4个月。值得注意的是，如果这篇综述在夏季发表，将引起极大兴趣。在此期间，已有几项研究报告（以及重要的灰色文献）公布，其中一些增加了此处综述的证据，而未显著改变总体结果，但增强了其可靠性（并可能为定量总结或元分析奠定了必要基础），更重要的是，一些研究提供了突破性证据，可能会改变这篇综述的结论（例如，Tanaka和Okamoto在《自然通讯》上发表的论文，使用日本的数据显示日本自杀率最初下降随后增加）。

以下是一些近期关键文献的示例：

https://www.nature.com/articles/s41562-020-01042-z1

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.11.13.20231571v12

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.10.06.20207530v53

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.10.21.20187419v14

https://www.medrxiv.org/content/10.1101/2020.10.20.20215343v15

由于包含的时间段限制，这篇深刻且可靠的综述的影响力有所局限：读者应参考作者持续进行的动态综述。

paper_title: From the past to the present, optical coherence tomography in glaucoma: a practical guide to a common disease
paper_abstract: Glaucoma comprises a group of disorders of the optic nerve that cause degenerative optic neuropathy, characterised by failure of neuroretinal rim tissue in the optic nerve head, retinal nerve fibre layer, and retinal ganglion cells. Glaucoma imposes a serious epidemiological threat, with an steady increase in the global number of cases. In the current ophthalmological practice, glaucoma is diagnosed via a series of examinations, including routine funduscopic examination, ocular tonometry, gonioscopy, measurement of the visual field, and assessment using the optical coherence tomography (OCT) technique. Nowadays, the OCT technique helps in systematising the diagnostic pathway and is a basic diagnostic tool for detection of early glaucomatous eye changes. It is also vital in assessing progression and monitoring treatment results of patients. The aim of this review was to present the OCT technique as a main tool in diagnosing and monitoring glaucoma.
review_content:
The authors conducted a comprehensive analysis of the incidence, etiology and risk factors involved in the development of glaucoma disease. In this review they assessed all the diagnosis methods current available in the clinic to detect early sign of glaucoma. Specifically, they focused on the latest imaging technology, the optical coherence tomography (OCT). Overall, the review is well-written and informative.
To be more factual, I would suggest to add a citation in the introduction when referring to the RGCs receiving impulses that travel to the brain. And an additionally citation in the pRNFL area when referring to normal, borderline or abnormal values assigned to the RNFL thickness.
paper_title_zh: 从过去到现在，光学相干断层扫描在青光眼中的应用：常见疾病的实用指南
paper_abstract_zh: 青光眼是一组导致退行性视神经病变的视神经疾病，其特征在于视神经头部、视网膜神经纤维层和视网膜神经节细胞的神经视网膜边缘组织功能衰竭。青光眼构成了严重的流行病学威胁，全球病例数量持续增加。在当前的眼科实践中，青光眼的诊断通过一系列检查进行，包括常规眼底镜检查、眼压测量、前房角镜检查、视野测量以及使用光学相干断层扫描（OCT）技术的评估。如今，OCT技术在系统化诊断路径中起到辅助作用，是检测早期青光眼眼变化的基本诊断工具。它在对病情进展的评估和患者治疗结果的监测中也至关重要。本综述的目的是将OCT技术作为诊断和监测青光眼的主要工具进行介绍。
review_content_zh:
作者对青光眼疾病的发病率、病因及风险因素进行了全面分析。在这篇综述中，他们评估了目前临床上用于检测青光眼早期征象的所有诊断方法。特别是，他们重点关注了最新的成像技术——光学相干断层扫描（OCT）。总体而言，这篇综述文笔流畅，信息丰富。
为了更加严谨，我建议在引言中提到视网膜神经节细胞（RGCs）接收传递到大脑的冲动时添加一个引用。此外，在提到视网膜神经纤维层（pRNFL）厚度被赋予正常、临界或异常值时也应添加一个引用。
