paper_title: Enter the Matrix: Fibroblast-immune cell interactions shape extracellular matrix deposition in health and disease.
paper_abstract: Fibroblasts, non-hematopoietic cells of mesenchymal origin, are tissue architects which regulate the topography of tissues, dictate tissue resident cell types, and drive fibrotic disease. Fibroblasts regulate the composition of the extracellular matrix (ECM), a 3-dimensional network of macromolecules that comprise the acellular milieu of tissues. Fibroblasts can directly and indirectly regulate immune responses by secreting ECM and ECM-bound molecules to shape tissue structure and influence organ function. In this review, we will highlight recent studies which elucidate the mechanisms by which fibroblast-derived ECM factors (e.g., collagens, fibrillar proteins) regulate ECM architecture and subsequent immune responses, with a focus on macrophages. As examples of fibroblast-derived ECM proteins, we examine Collagen Triple Helix Repeat Containing 1 (CTHRC1) and Transforming Growth Factor-β-inducible protein (TGFBI), also known as BIGH3. We address the need for investigation into how diverse fibroblast populations coordinate immune responses by modulating ECM, including the fibroblast-ECM-immune axis and the precise molecular mediators and pathways which regulate these processes. Finally, we will outline how novel research identifying key regulators of ECM deposition is critical for therapeutic development for fibrotic diseases and cancer.
review_content:
In the current review, Altieri et al. revisit the literature to highlight the ECM signals that mediate the fibroblast-macrophage interactions in the context of wound healing, fibrosis and cancer. They additionally summarize the current knowledge on the matrisome proteins CTHRC1 and TGFBI (BIGH3), and discuss their impact on ECM accumulation in fibrotic and malignant tissues. Overall, the manuscript is well-written and the authors comprehensively present the diverse nature of ECM signals (mechanical cues mediated by core matrisome proteins such as collagens, and biochemical signals mediated by matrisome-associated proteins, such as secreted factors (e.g. CSF1) and ECM regulators (MMP9)). Nonetheless, some major concerns need to be remarked:

1) The review’s title and abstract predispose the reader for a collection of studies that focus on the fibroblast-ECM-macrophage axis in fibrosis and cancer. Nevertheless, the manuscript's content does not align with its title, since the sender and/or receiver cell of the ECM signal is undefined in most of the references included. For example, in Figure 1 the authors schematically claim that fibroblast-secreted MMP9 promotes the accumulation of macrophages in the tissues. The respective studies by Shubayev et al., Gong et al., and Tan et al. indeed support the macrophage-recruiting role of MMP9, but they do not define the fibroblast as the cellular source of the enzyme. In the paper by Tan et al. in particular, the authors describe the tubular epithelial cells (TEC) as the major MMP9 producer. Consequently, Figure 1 should be modified accordingly to avoid misinterpretations.
Additional ambiguity is detected regarding CTHRC1 and TGFBI. In the abstract, these molecules are defined as ‘fibroblast-derived ECM proteins’, whereas in the main text they are described as ‘immune-derived co-factor candidates’. Moreover, it does not become clear to the reader how the discussion on these proteins serves the purpose of the manuscript, given that no crosstalk between fibroblasts and macrophages through CTHRC1/TGFBI is reported.
Overall, we recommend a cautious reconstruction of the text across the manuscript in a way that the references will reliably reflect the scope of the review.

2) Since fibroblast-macrophage interactions in fibrosis are in the spotlight of the review, the authors should consider dedicating a section to discuss the emerging topic of scar-associated macrophages (SAMacs) and how their communication with pro-fibrotic fibroblasts affects the disease course across tissues. This addition will be of particular relevance to the review’s main focus, as various ligands that have been described to mediate the crosstalk of the two fibrotic cell types constitute ECM-associated components (SPP1, IL-1β, PDGF), and are currently trending as potential antifibrotic therapeutic targets 1–6.

3) Fibroblasts orchestrate ECM deposition in steady state and disease: In addition to the pathological consequences of aberrant fibroblast activation upon injury, it is worth mentioning the reviews by Koliaraki et al. (JEM, 2020 and Nature Immunology, 2020) 7,8 to also discuss the immunomodulatory effects of CAFs and ECM in the context of cancer.
paper_title_zh: 进入矩阵：成纤维细胞-免疫细胞相互作用塑造健康与疾病中的细胞外基质沉积
paper_abstract_zh: 成纤维细胞是起源于间充质的非造血细胞，作为组织建筑师，它们调控组织的地形结构，决定组织驻留细胞类型，并驱动纤维化疾病的发生。成纤维细胞调节细胞外基质（ECM）的组成，ECM是由大分子构成的三维网络，形成了组织的非细胞环境。成纤维细胞通过分泌ECM及ECM结合分子，直接和间接地调控免疫反应，塑造组织结构并影响器官功能。在这篇综述中，我们将重点介绍近期研究，阐明成纤维细胞来源的ECM因子（如胶原蛋白、纤维蛋白）如何调节ECM架构及后续免疫反应的机制，重点关注巨噬细胞。作为成纤维细胞来源的ECM蛋白的例子，我们探讨了含有三螺旋重复序列的胶原蛋白1（CTHRC1）和转化生长因子-β诱导蛋白（TGFBI），也称为BIGH3。我们提出了对多种成纤维细胞群体如何通过调节ECM协调免疫反应的研究需求，包括成纤维细胞-ECM-免疫轴以及精确的分子介质和调控这些过程的途径。最后，我们将概述识别ECM沉积关键调节因子的新研究对于纤维化疾病和癌症治疗开发的重要性。
review_content_zh:
在本次综述中，Altieri等人重新审视了文献，以突出在伤口愈合、纤维化和癌症背景下介导成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞相互作用的细胞外基质（ECM）信号。他们还总结了目前对基质蛋白CTHRC1和TGFBI（BIGH3）的认识，并讨论了它们在纤维化和恶性组织中ECM积累的影响。总体而言，该手稿写作质量高，作者全面呈现了ECM信号的多样性（由核心基质蛋白如胶原蛋白介导的机械信号，以及由基质相关蛋白如分泌因子（例如CSF1）和ECM调节因子（MMP9）介导的生化信号）。然而，一些主要问题需要指出：

1）综述的标题和摘要使读者预期该研究聚焦于纤维化和癌症中的成纤维细胞-ECM-巨噬细胞轴。然而，手稿内容与其标题不符，因为大多数参考文献中ECM信号的发送者和/或接收细胞未明确定义。例如，在图1中，作者图示性地声称成纤维细胞分泌的MMP9促进了巨噬细胞在组织中的积累。Shubayev等人、Gong等人和Tan等人的相关研究确实支持MMP9的巨噬细胞招募作用，但它们并未将成纤维细胞定义为该酶的细胞来源。特别是在Tan等人的论文中，作者描述肾小管上皮细胞（TEC）是主要的MMP9生产者。因此，图1应相应修改，以避免误解。
关于CTHRC1和TGFBI也存在进一步的模糊性。在摘要中，这些分子被定义为“成纤维细胞衍生的ECM蛋白”，而在正文中它们被描述为“免疫衍生的共因子候选物”。此外，对于读者而言，讨论这些蛋白如何服务于手稿的目的并不清晰，因为未报告通过CTHRC1/TGFBI在成纤维细胞和巨噬细胞之间的交叉对话。
总体而言，我们建议谨慎重构手稿中的文本，以确保参考文献可靠地反映综述的范围。

2）由于成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞在纤维化中的相互作用是综述的重点，作者应考虑专门用一个部分讨论新兴话题——瘢痕相关巨噬细胞（SAMacs）以及它们与促纤维化成纤维细胞的通讯如何影响不同组织的疾病进程。这一补充将与综述的主要焦点特别相关，因为已描述为介导这两种纤维化细胞类型交叉对话的多种配体构成ECM相关成分（SPP1、IL-1β、PDGF），并且目前作为潜在的抗纤维化治疗靶点而备受关注1-6。

3）成纤维细胞在稳态和疾病中协调ECM沉积：除了损伤后成纤维细胞异常激活的病理后果外，还值得提及Koliaraki等人（JEM，2020和Nature Immunology，2020）7,8的综述，以讨论CAF和ECM在癌症背景下的免疫调节效应。

reasons: Overall, we recommend a cautious reconstruction of the text across the manuscript in a way that the references will reliably reflect the scope of the review.
In the abstract, these molecules are defined as ‘fibroblast-derived ECM proteins’, whereas in the main text they are described as ‘immune-derived co-factor candidates’.

In addition to the pathological consequences of aberrant fibroblast activation upon injury, it is worth mentioning the reviews by Koliaraki et al. (JEM, 2020 and Nature Immunology, 2020) 7,8 to also discuss the immunomodulatory effects of CAFs and ECM in the context of cancer.

paper_title: Epidemiological behavior of childhood obesity: A continental point of view
paper_abstract: Weight excess during the childhood has been one of the most critical public health problems worldwide in the past few decades. It is considered a significant predictor of adulthood obesity, increased cardiometabolic diseases, and premature mortality. Since the Industrial Revolution, childhood obesity has risen due to sedentary lifestyles and poor eating habits, contributing to the development of obesogenic environments around children in different parts of the world. In this regard, Oceania is positioned as the continent with the highest prevalence globally; however, these results did not consider Australia and New Zealand’s data, probably due to the significant differences in population sizes. America has the second highest percentage of children under five who are overweight. Curiously, Asia’s obesity rates are more significant in higher socioeconomic statuses and urban areas than in children aged 2-4 years. Likewise, Africa displays similar epidemiologic behaviour. Qatar and Kuwait are the countries with the highest obesity prevalence on the continent. Moreover, Europe exhibits a notable South-North gradient, which establishes a higher prevalence of obesity in Mediterranean countries than the Nordic ones. In this regard, various prevention and interventional programs have been developed to combat this silent epidemic, focusing their efforts on nutritional education, improving children’s and parents’ lifestyles, and fighting the influence of the media on their behaviour, and decisions. Therefore, the objective of this review was to describe the epidemiological behaviour of childhood obesity from a continental perspective.
review_content: Congratulations on your article. I consider that they have made a great effort and great job compiling all the data related to the current state of obesity and overweight. Despite this, the data included is not completely up to date and should be updated, since in recent years the trend has been increasing. In any case, the article is correct, written in simple and easy to understand language. In addition, numerous data are included that allow the reader to get an idea of the global problem such as overweight and obesity.
paper_title_zh: 儿童肥胖的流行病学行为：大陆视角
paper_abstract_zh: 儿童期体重超标在过去几十年中已成为全球最严重的公共卫生问题之一。它被认为是成年肥胖、心血管代谢疾病增加和过早死亡的重要预测因素。自工业革命以来，由于久坐不动的生活方式和不良饮食习惯，儿童肥胖症有所上升，导致世界各地儿童周围形成了致胖环境。在这方面，大洋洲被认为是全球儿童肥胖症患病率最高的地区；然而，这些结果并未考虑澳大利亚和新西兰的数据，可能是因为人口规模的显著差异。美洲在五岁以下超重儿童的比例中位居第二。有趣的是，亚洲的肥胖率在高社会经济地位和城市地区比2-4岁儿童中更为显著。同样，非洲也表现出类似的流行病学行为。卡塔尔和科威特是非洲大陆上肥胖症患病率最高的国家。此外，欧洲呈现出明显的南-北梯度，地中海国家的肥胖症患病率高于北欧国家。为此，已开发出多种预防和干预项目来对抗这一无声的流行病，重点放在营养教育、改善儿童及其家长的生活方式，以及对抗媒体对其行为和决策的影响。因此，本综述的目的是从大陆视角描述儿童肥胖症的流行病学行为。
review_content_zh: 祝贺您的文章。我认为他们在汇编与当前肥胖和超重状况相关的所有数据方面付出了巨大努力，并做得非常出色。尽管如此，所包含的数据并非完全最新，应进行更新，因为近年来这一趋势一直在上升。无论如何，文章是正确的，语言简洁易懂。此外，文中还包含了大量数据，使读者能够了解超重和肥胖这一全球性问题的概况。

reasons: Despite this, the data included is not completely up to date and should be updated, since in recent years the trend has been increasing.
In any case, the article is correct, written in simple and easy to understand language.

paper_title: Considerations related to vaping as a possible gateway into cigarette smoking: an analytical review
paper_abstract:
Background: Compared to cigarette smoking, e-cigarette use is likely to present a reduced risk of smoking-related disease (SRD). However, several studies have shown that vaping predicts smoking initiation and might provide a gateway into smoking for those who otherwise would never have smoked. This paper considers various aspects of the gateway issue in youths. 
 Methods: Here, we reviewed studies (N=15) of the gateway effect examining how extensively they accounted for confounders associated with smoking initiation in youths. We estimated how omitting a confounder, or misclassifying it, might bias the association between vaping and smoking initiation. We assessed how smoking prevalence might be affected by any true gateway effect, and examined trends in youth smoking and e-cigarette use from national surveys. 
 Results:  The list of smoking predictors adjusted for in studies reporting a significant gateway effect is not comprehensive, rarely considering internalising/externalising disorders, outcome expectancies, school performance, anxiety, parental smoking and peer attitudes. Furthermore, no study adjusted for residual confounding from inaccurately measured predictors. Better adjustment may substantially reduce the estimated gateway effect. Calculations showed that as any true gateway effects increase, there are much smaller increases in smoking prevalence, and that gateway effects increase only if initiating vaping is more frequent than initiating smoking. These effects on prevalence also depend on the relative odds of quitting vs. initiation. Data from five surveys in US/UK youths all show that, regardless of sex and age, smoking prevalence in 2014–2016 declined faster than predicted by the preceding trend, suggesting the absence of a substantial gateway effect. We also present arguments suggesting that even with some true gateway effect, introducing e-cigarettes likely reduces SRD risk. 
 Conclusions: A true gateway effect in youths has not yet been demonstrated. Even if it were, e-cigarette introduction may well have had a beneficial population health impact.
review_content:
This is an interesting and valuable contribution to the field on the hotly debated topic of whether or not e-cigarettes function as a gateway into subsequent combustible cigarette use. Of particular value here is the analysis of the impact of residual confounding on creating spurious associations in observational studies. However, there are a number of issues in the other analyses I would recommend addressing.
 1. Abstract: This is currently rather data free. I would suggest including some illustrative results here.
 2. Results: Particularly in relation to Tables 5-7, I wonder if it would be possible to condense results somewhat (or to move some of these results into supplementary files). It seems that it is not strictly necessary to include all modelled effects, especially since not all are discussed. This makes this section at times difficult to follow. A better way to structure the Tables might be to link these explicitly to the 5 conclusions presented on pages 9 and 10.
 3. Terminology: I am not sure that the term “gateway-out” is helpful. At the very least, it would not represent the only way to construe this concept insofar as it could be argued that in a hypothetical scenario the opposite to the “gateway-in” might be the avoidance of uptake of smoking in the first place (another “gateway-out” not related to smoking cessation where adolescents who would have smoked try an e-cigarette and never start smoking). It might therefore be helpful to clarify the difference between those gateway effects away from smoking
 4. Change in smoking trends: I am not entirely convinced by this analysis for a number of reasons. First, very little information is provided about the actual analysis undertaken. I would expect to see fitting parameters for various functions to model trends in smoking prevalence in the period prior to 2014. Are these assumed to be linear, logarithmic, polynomial etc.? More detail is required here. A more appropriate way to analyse the data would be to conduct segmented regression or timeseries analysis. Second, based on the current analysis, the problem (somewhat acknowledged on top of page 11) is that it might still be the case that e-cigarettes functioned as a “gateway in” since we do not know what smoking prevalence would have been in the absence of e-cigarettes (and may have been even lower). I don’t think this is likely but this issue should be acknowledged more explicitly, perhaps making it clear that such arguments would require “special pleading”, i.e. one would need to postulate additional environmental changes which could explain a continued decrease in smoking prevalence even in the presence of a gateway effect.
 5. Second paragraph on page 11 does not seem to add anything (it’s not clear how these cognitive measures in PATH relate to actual behaviour and so it’s quite weak evidence). Suggest dropping this.
 6. Table 9: The counterpart to A3 is not presented, i.e. dual use which results in reduction of combustible cigarettes. If there is a commensurate reduction in cigarette consumption associated with an increase in e-cigarette use (if dual users reduce cigarette consumption sufficiently) there may be beneficial health effects (so perhaps this effect should be added). In fact, perhaps a more nuanced discussion of dual use is needed on page 12, given that it may have both positive and negative effects and encompasses such a wide range of behavioural patterns. Please note that the statement on page 11 “The adverse effect for smokers switching to vaping instead of quitting smoking (A2) is not ideal but would still confer some benefits, given what is known regarding the reduced harm and toxicity of e-cigarettes" is logically inconsistent. If a smoker intending to quit starts using e-cigarettes instead of quitting, there is no benefit (as e-cigarette use even if less harmful than smoking does not confer any benefit over stopping completely).
 7. The discussion on end of page 11 and top of page 12 feels rather qualitative. Either provide more quantitative analysis of modelled impact on health effects or move this to the discussion. You don’t really provide any primary data to support your conclusion ”Finally, introducing e-cigarettes should lead to a reduced risk of SRD.” This is rather speculative at this stage without more rigorous modelling as was done e.g. in the NASEM report.
paper_title_zh: 关于电子烟作为可能进入香烟吸烟的途径的考量：一项分析性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：与吸烟相比，使用电子烟可能降低吸烟相关疾病（SRD）的风险。然而，多项研究表明，吸电子烟预示着吸烟的开始，并可能为那些本来永远不会吸烟的人提供进入吸烟的途径。本文探讨了青少年中这一“入门”问题的多个方面。

方法：在此，我们回顾了15项研究，这些研究探讨了“入门效应”，并检查了它们在多大程度上考虑了与青少年吸烟开始相关的混杂因素。我们估计了遗漏或错误分类一个混杂因素可能会如何偏置吸电子烟与吸烟开始之间的关联。我们评估了任何真正的“入门效应”可能会如何影响吸烟流行率，并从全国性调查中检查了青少年吸烟和电子烟使用的趋势。

结果：报告显著“入门效应”的研究中调整的吸烟预测因素列表并不全面，很少考虑内化/外化障碍、结果预期、学校表现、焦虑、父母吸烟和同伴态度。此外，没有研究调整了因预测因素测量不准确而导致的残余混杂。更好的调整可能会大幅降低估计的“入门效应”。计算显示，随着任何真正的“入门效应”增加，吸烟流行率的增加要小得多，并且只有当开始吸电子烟比开始吸烟更频繁时，“入门效应”才会增加。这些对流行率的影响还取决于戒烟与开始的相对几率。来自美国/英国青少年五项调查的数据均显示，无论性别和年龄，2014-2016年的吸烟流行率下降速度比先前趋势预测的要快，这表明不存在显著的“入门效应”。我们还提出了论据，表明即使存在一些真正的“入门效应”，引入电子烟也可能降低SRD风险。

结论：青少年中真正的“入门效应”尚未得到证实。即使存在，电子烟的引入也可能对人群健康产生了有益影响。
review_content_zh:
这是对电子烟是否作为后续可燃香烟使用的“入门”这一热议话题的有趣且有价值的贡献。特别有价值的是对残余混杂因素在观察性研究中产生虚假关联影响的分析。然而，在其他分析中存在一些问题，我建议予以解决。

1. 摘要：目前这部分内容较为缺乏数据。我建议在此处包含一些说明性结果。

2. 结果：特别是与表5-7相关的内容，我想知道是否有可能对结果进行一定程度的精简（或将部分结果移至补充文件中）。似乎并非严格必要包含所有模型效应，尤其是并非所有效应都被讨论。这使得这部分内容有时难以理解。更好的表格结构方式可能是将这些结果与第9页和第10页呈现的5个结论明确关联。

3. 术语：我不确定“入门-退出”这一术语是否有帮助。至少，它并非唯一构建这一概念的方式，因为可以认为在假设情景中，“入门-进入”的对立面可能是首先避免吸烟的起始（另一种与戒烟无关的“入门-退出”，即那些本会吸烟的青少年尝试电子烟后从未开始吸烟）。因此，澄清那些远离吸烟的入门效应可能有所帮助。

4. 吸烟趋势的变化：由于多种原因，我对这一分析并不完全信服。首先，关于实际进行的分析提供了非常少的信息。我期望看到在2014年之前对吸烟流行趋势进行建模的各种函数的拟合参数。这些参数是假设为线性的、对数的、多项式的等吗？这里需要更多细节。更合适的分析方法可能是进行分段回归或时间序列分析。其次，基于当前分析，问题（在第11页顶部有所承认）在于，电子烟可能仍然发挥了“入门-进入”的作用，因为我们不知道在没有电子烟的情况下吸烟流行率会是什么（可能会更低）。我认为这不太可能，但这一问题应更明确地承认，或许应明确指出此类论点需要“特殊辩解”，即需要假设额外的环境变化，这些变化可以解释即使在存在入门效应的情况下吸烟流行率的持续下降。

5. 第11页第二段似乎没有增加任何内容（不清楚这些在PATH中的认知测量如何与实际行为相关，因此证据相当薄弱）。建议删除。

6. 表9：A3的对等部分未呈现，即双重使用导致可燃香烟减少。如果与电子烟使用增加相关联的香烟消费有相应减少（如果双重使用者充分减少香烟消费），可能会产生有益的健康效应（因此或许应添加这一效应）。实际上，鉴于双重使用可能具有正面和负面效应，并涵盖广泛的行为模式，第12页可能需要对双重使用进行更细致的讨论。请注意，第11页的声明“吸烟者转而使用电子烟而非戒烟的负面效应（A2）并不理想，但鉴于已知电子烟的减害和低毒性，仍会带来一些益处”在逻辑上是不一致的。如果意图戒烟的吸烟者转而使用电子烟而非戒烟，则没有任何益处（因为即使电子烟的危害小于吸烟，也不及完全停止带来的益处）。

7. 第11页末和第12页顶部的讨论感觉较为定性。要么提供更多关于模型对健康效应影响的定量分析，要么将其移至讨论部分。你们并未真正提供任何原始数据来支持结论“最后，引入电子烟应导致SRD风险降低”。在缺乏如NASEM报告中所进行的更严格建模的情况下，这一结论目前较为推测性。

reasons: I am not entirely convinced by this analysis for a number of reasons.

I don’t think this is likely but this issue should be acknowledged more explicitly, perhaps making it clear that such arguments would require “special pleading”, i.e. one would need to postulate additional environmental changes which could explain a continued decrease in smoking prevalence even in the presence of a gateway effect.
The discussion on end of page 11 and top of page 12 feels rather qualitative.
Particularly in relation to Tables 5-7, I wonder if it would be possible to condense results somewhat (or to move some of these results into supplementary files).
I am not sure that the term “gateway-out” is helpful.
Results: Particularly in relation to Tables 5-7, I wonder if it would be possible to condense results somewhat (or to move some of these results into supplementary files).
It seems that it is not strictly necessary to include all modelled effects, especially since not all are discussed.
A better way to structure the Tables might be to link these explicitly to the 5 conclusions presented on pages 9 and 10.
Table 9: The counterpart to A3 is not presented, i.e. dual use which results in reduction of combustible cigarettes.
In fact, perhaps a more nuanced discussion of dual use is needed on page 12, given that it may have both positive and negative effects and encompasses such a wide range of behavioural patterns.
The discussion on end of page 11 and top of page 12 feels rather qualitative.
Either provide more quantitative analysis of modelled impact on health effects or move this to the discussion.
Suggest dropping this.

paper_title: Peripheral-physiological and neural correlates of flow experience while playing video games: A comprehensive review
paper_abstract: The flow state is defined by intense involvement in an activity with high degrees of concentration and focused attention, and accompanied by a sense of pleasure. Video games are effective tools for inducing flow, and keeping players in this state is considered to be one of the central goals of game design. Many studies have focused on the underlying physiological and neural mechanisms of flow. Results are inconsistent when describing a unified mechanism underling this mental state. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the physiological and neural correlates of flow and offers an explanation of the relationship between the reported physiological and the neural markers of flow experience. Despite the heterogeneous results, it seems possible to establish associations between reported markers and cognitive and experiential aspects of flow, particularly regarding arousal, attention control, reward processing, automaticity, and selfreferential processing.
review_content: Reviewer 2 Basic reporting I have appreciated the effort of the authors to write a comprehensive review about the physiological and neural correlates of flow experience (while playing videogames). Authors stated that this is the first review include the studies about physiological and also neural correlates of the flow experience. This is maybe true but I have several questions and problem about about the concept and the purpose of this review. In my opinion neither the studies of the physiological nor the neural correlates of the the flow experience have not discussed in deep way. In my general opinion, this review is still not ready to publication because of several weaknesses and I can not see what this review add to the field. I suggest major revision or re-submission to the editors for this work. The manuscript is now restructured and all studies are explained and discussed with more details. Experimental design 1. The selection method for the review is poorly reported. Authors should provide detailed description about the combination of the keywords, how many article were find, the inclusion and exclusion criterias to final selection of the articles have not reported in the review. I suggest the author to report their review selection method in details. We agree with the reviewer that we should provide detailed description of the selection procedure using other databases like Web of Science and PubMed. Information regarding method used for collecting studies and inclusion and exclusion criteria has now been given (as we used Web of Science and PubMed databases) in lines 173-184. According to the discipline specific standards of the PeerJ journals, our review manuscript is not a systematic or meta- analysis but the scoping review or literature review. Reports of systematic reviews must include a PRISMA flow diagram and complete PRISMA checklist. However, for scoping reviews it is mentioned just to have a Survey Methodology section in which it should be explained how to ensure comprehensive and unbiased coverage of the literature. Validity of the findings 2. The authors reported several studies on the field without applying their deep critical opinions about the results and suggestions for future research. Authors suggested poor conclusions to summarize the studies about the physiological correlates of the flow experiences e.g. ”results are inconsistent…” OK, all the experts on the field can agree with this. What is major problem to find specific patterns for the underlying physiological and neural mechanisms of the flow experience based on the current literature? What are the author’s suggestions for future research to improve the field? I think some book chapters discussed the problem in more detailed and comprehensive way and this knowledge should be integrated into this paper also (Tozman & Peifer et al. 2016; Keller et al. 2016). It was interesting to read the studies about the neural correlates of the flow experience. I have no knowledge any other review artcile on this field. On other hand, the results was not discussed in good details and I would like read more about the different approaches and studies on this field. In addition, I don’t understand the concept and purpose of the review. If the authors aimed to review the physiological and neural correlates of the flow experience in one article I would appreciate some discussions about the connection between two fields. What we can learn to understand more about flow if we scope together the psysiological and neural correlates of the flow experience? What are the future directions in flow research to understand the connections between the neural correlates and the specific peripheral-physiological patterns of the flow experience?? In the discussion, we categorized observed results into physiological and cognitive subfunctions involved during the experience of flow and we discussed them in detail. We stated that some of the inconsistencies especially in peripheral-physiological research can be traced back to the imprecise measures used for identifying physiological arousal (lines 693-730) and mental effort (741-750) and we suggested using more reliable measures such as pre-ejection period of cardiovascular activity for arousal and blood glucose and pupil dilation for mental effort assessment. Further, we discussed the task dependency as a probable cause of inconsistency of the results in lines 859-891. We argued that a unified underlying neurophysiological mechanism cannot be related to the flow experience, as this experience highly depend on the experimental design utilized for the study. Despite inconsistencies in the result, we believe that one could still establish associations between flow and the five cognitive and physiological subfunctions which we summarized in the discussion including positive valence and heightened arousal, Joyous state of focused attention, synchronization of attentional and reward networks, automaticity, and loss of self-awareness. Finally in lines 863-896, we suggest using objective measures along with self-reported surveys to better define the internal moments of flow and thus more precise identification of physiological and neural correlates of flow experience. As we mentioned in the manuscript lines 162-175, this manuscript integrates physiological and cognitive mechanisms underlying flow experience. Particularly some subfunctions reported in the literature like effortless attention cannot be discussed just from the physiological or neural perspective. In the discussion for instance at “Joyous state of focused attention”, we integrated results from both sides to explain effortless but high degree of attention experienced during flow. Comments for the Author 3. I suggest to re-think the concept of the review. Maybe it would be enough if the authors just focus on the neural correlates of the flow experience with some critical review on the existing studies and add some suggestions how the research should be developed. This would really increase the validity of this paper and may fill some gaps on our field. If still the authors want to keep the peripheral-physiological part of the paper I suggest that make deep discussion about the question why the existing results are inconsistent. As we mentioned on comment 2, this manuscript integrates physiological and cognitive mechanisms underlying flow experience. Some subfunctions reported in the literature like effortless attention cannot be discussed just from the physiological or neural perspective and it is better to consider both perspectives together. In the discussion for instance of “Joyous state of focused attention”, we integrated results from both sides to explain effortless but high degree of attention experienced during flow. Some minor comments 4. However most of the flow studies was made on computer gaming there are several studies was made on other tasks e.g. De Manzano 2010, Peifer 2014. Based on the title of the paper the authors focused on studies on computer gaming and flow. This problems relates to confusion about the review selection method and also the concept of the article. There are several studies like De Manzano 2010, Peifer 2014 which propose an initial theoretical background for underlying mechanisms of flow and several researches explore their theories in the gaming context. We think it is good to mention those theories and then discuss corresponding observed results in the gaming context. 5. Authors only introduce an eight dimension model of flow. I suggest to introduce the nine dimension model by Csikszentmihalyi 1990 that was also used in FFS-2 scale (Jackson & Eklund, 2002) and add autotelic experience (enjoyment) as a dimension. Athuors metioned that in several context in the text ejoyment is an important factor for computer gaimg in connection with flow. We agree with the reviewer. The ninth dimension of flow (autotelic experience) is added to the manuscript lines 49-53.
paper_title_zh: 《玩电子游戏时心流体验的外周生理与神经相关因素：全面综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 心流状态定义为在高度集中和专注的活动中深度投入，并伴随愉悦感。视频游戏是引发心流的有效工具，保持玩家处于此状态被认为是游戏设计的核心目标之一。许多研究聚焦于心流背后的生理和神经机制。在描述这一心理状态的统一机制时，结果并不一致。本文对心流的生理和神经相关因素进行了全面综述，并解释了所报告的生理和神经标记与心流体验之间的关系。尽管结果多样，但似乎可以建立所报告的标记与心流的认知和体验方面之间的关联，特别是关于唤醒、注意力控制、奖励处理、自动化和自我参照处理。
review_content_zh:
### Reviewer 2 基本报告

我赞赏作者撰写一篇关于游戏过程中流畅体验的生理和神经相关性的综合性综述的努力。作者声称这是第一篇包含关于流畅体验的生理和神经相关性研究的综述。这可能属实，但我对这篇综述的概念和目的有几个疑问和问题。在我看来，无论是关于流畅体验的生理还是神经相关性的研究，都没有进行深入的讨论。总的来说，我认为这篇综述由于存在多个弱点，尚未准备好发表，并且我看不出这篇综述对领域有何贡献。我建议进行重大修订或重新提交给编辑。手稿现已重新结构化，所有研究都进行了更详细的解释和讨论。

### 实验设计

1. 综述的选取方法报告得很差。作者应提供关于关键词组合的详细描述，找到多少篇文章，以及最终选取文章的纳入和排除标准在综述中未报告。我建议作者详细报告他们的综述选取方法。我们同意评审者的意见，认为我们应该提供使用其他数据库（如Web of Science和PubMed）的选取过程详细描述。关于收集研究的方法以及纳入和排除标准的信息现已给出（正如我们使用了Web of Science和PubMed数据库），见第173-184行。根据PeerJ期刊的学科特定标准，我们的综述手稿不是系统综述或元分析，而是范围综述或文献综述。系统综述的报告必须包括PRISMA流程图和完整的PRISMA清单。然而，对于范围综述，只需在调查方法部分说明如何确保对文献的全面和无偏覆盖。

### 研究发现的效度

2. 作者报告了该领域的几项研究，但没有对其结果和未来研究的建议提出深入的批判性意见。作者对总结关于流畅体验生理相关性的研究提出了薄弱的结论，例如“结果不一致”……好吧，所有该领域的专家都可以同意这一点。基于当前文献，找出流畅体验的潜在生理和神经机制的具体模式的主要问题是什么？作者对未来研究有何建议以改进该领域？我认为一些书籍章节更详细和全面地讨论了这个问题，这些知识也应整合到这篇论文中（Tozman & Peifer et al. 2016; Keller et al. 2016）。阅读关于流畅体验神经相关性的研究很有趣。我不知道该领域还有其他综述文章。另一方面，结果讨论得不够详细，我希望了解更多关于该领域的不同方法和研究。此外，我不理解这篇综述的概念和目的。如果作者旨在在一篇文章中综述流畅体验的生理和神经相关性，我会欣赏一些关于这两个领域之间联系的讨论。如果我们一起考察流畅体验的生理和神经相关性，我们能学到什么以更好地理解流畅体验？未来在流畅研究中理解神经相关性和流畅体验特定外周生理模式之间联系的方向是什么？在讨论中，我们将观察到的结果分类为流畅体验过程中涉及的生理和认知子功能，并进行了详细讨论。我们指出，特别是在外周生理研究中的某些不一致性可以追溯到用于识别生理唤醒（第693-730行）和心理努力（第741-750行）的不精确测量方法，并建议使用更可靠的测量方法，如心血管活动的预射血期用于唤醒评估，以及血糖和瞳孔扩张用于心理努力评估。此外，我们在第859-891行讨论了任务依赖性作为结果不一致的可能原因。我们认为，统一的潜在神经生理机制不能与流畅体验相关联，因为这种体验高度依赖于研究中使用的实验设计。尽管结果存在不一致性，我们相信仍可以建立流畅体验与我们在讨论中总结的五个认知和生理子功能之间的关联，包括积极效价和高唤醒、愉悦的专注状态、注意和奖励网络的同步、自动化以及自我意识的丧失。最后，在第863-896行，我们建议使用客观测量方法结合自我报告调查，以更好地定义流畅的内部时刻，从而更精确地识别流畅体验的生理和神经相关性。正如我们在手稿第162-175行中所提到的，这篇手稿整合了流畅体验的生理和认知机制。特别是文献中报告的一些子功能，如无努力注意力，不能仅从生理或神经角度讨论。例如，在“愉悦的专注状态”的讨论中，我们整合了双方的结果来解释流畅体验中无努力但高度专注的状态。

### 对作者的建议

3. 我建议重新思考综述的概念。也许如果作者只关注流畅体验的神经相关性，并对现有研究进行一些批判性综述，并添加一些关于如何发展研究的建议，就足够了。这 действительно повысит достоверность этой статьи и может заполнить некоторые пробелы в нашей области.如果作者仍想保留论文的外周生理部分，我建议深入讨论为什么现有结果不一致。正如我们在评论2中所提到的，这篇手稿整合了流畅体验的生理和认知机制。文献中报告的一些子功能，如无努力注意力，不能仅从生理或神经角度讨论，而最好同时考虑两个角度。例如，在“愉悦的专注状态”的讨论中，我们整合了双方的结果来解释流畅体验中无努力但高度专注的状态。

### 一些次要评论

4. 然而，大多数流畅研究是在电脑游戏上进行的，但也有几项研究是在其他任务上进行的，例如De Manzano 2010, Peifer 2014。根据论文标题，作者专注于电脑游戏和流畅的研究。这个问题与综述选取方法的混淆以及文章的概念有关。有几项研究，如De Manzano 2010, Peifer 2014，提出了流畅潜在机制的初步理论背景，并且一些研究者在游戏环境中探索了他们的理论。我们认为提到这些理论，然后讨论在游戏环境中相应的观察结果是有益的。

5. 作者只介绍了一个八维度流畅模型。我建议介绍Csikszentmihalyi 1990年的九维度模型，该模型也被用于FFS-2量表（Jackson & Eklund, 2002），并添加自体验（享受）作为一个维度。作者在文本的几个上下文中提到，享受是电脑游戏与流畅相关的重要因子。我们同意评审者的意见。流畅的第九个维度（自体验）已添加到手稿的第49-53行。

paper_title: Efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of rurioctocog alfa pegol for prophylactic treatment in previously treated patients with severe hemophilia A: a systematic review and meta-analysis of clinical trials
paper_abstract:
Background: Patients with severe hemophilia often present with painful joint and soft tissue bleeding which may restrict them from their daily activities. The current standard of care still relies on a regular prophylactic factor VIII (FVIII), which has a high daily treatment burden. Recently, rurioctocog alfa pegol, a third-generation recombinant FVIII with a modification in its polyethylene glycol (PEG) component, has been developed. Several trials have studied this synthetic drug as bleeding prophylaxis in severe hemophilia A. This study aims to evaluate the efficacy, safety, and immunogenicity of rurioctocog alfa pegol for previously treated patients with severe hemophilia A. 
 Methods : This study was conducted in conformity with the PRISMA guidelines. Data were retrieved from PubMed, Scopus, Cochrane Library, Wiley Online Library, and CINAHL (via EBSCOhost). Study qualities were assessed using the Methodological Index for Non-Randomized Studies (MINORS) and Modified Jadad scales. 
 Results: Four studies involving 517 previously treated severe hemophilia A patients were included in this study. The pooled mean of total annualized bleeding rate (ABR) and hemostatic efficacy was 2.59 (95% CI = 2.04–3.14) and 92% (95% CI = 85%–97%), respectively. Only 30 (2.3%) non-serious and one (1.4%) serious adverse events were considered related to rurioctocog alfa pegol treatment. At the end of the studies, no development of FVIII inhibitory antibodies was observed. None of the developed binding antibodies to FVIII, PEG-FVIII, or PEG was correlated to the treatment efficacy and safety. 
 Conclusions: Despite the limited availability of direct comparison studies, our analyses indicate that rurioctocog alfa pegol could serve as a safe and effective alternative for bleeding prophylaxis in previously treated hemophilia A patients. Moreover, it appears to have low immunogenicity, which further increases the safety profile of the drug in such clinical conditions.
review_content:
This paper is clearly written and well organized. This paper presented the meta analysis of the efficacy, safety and immunogenicity of newly developed drug for severe hemophilia A, rurioctocog alfa pegol. The figures and tables are also clear and helpful.

However, there are some parts that need clarifying:
  * In the result part (section: safety outcomes) the author stated: "A total of 1,299 non-serious adverse events (non-SAEs) occurred during the four studies.5,7,9,15 However, only 30 (2.3%) of them were considered related to rurioctocog alfa pegol treatment. Whilst, a total of 70 serious adverse events (SAEs) were observed in the four studies and only one (1.4%) of them – as reported by Klamroth et al.15 – were considered related to treatment" - I think it would be nicer, if author gives more explanation or examples about what kind of serious adverse that related to rurioctocog alfa pegol treatment.
  * In the discussion part, the author stated, "Regarding the zero-bleeding prevalence (Figure 4A), a difference was observed among studies that employed different dose regimens. Different dose regimens were considered because pharmacokinetic profiles, targets of FVIII level, and age group varied among patients." - I think it would be better if the authors explain more about the dose regimens and pharmacokinetic in the introduction or discussion part.
I added a reference from Stidl et aI. (2018)1, because the article explained about the safety and potential adverse effects that related to rurioctocog alfa pegol. This reference could help enrich the discussion of article, especially in the part of safety and adverse effects from the drug.

Overall, this article is interesting and gives valuable information.
paper_title_zh: "鲁瑞奥克托格阿尔法聚乙二醇预防性治疗既往治疗的重度血友病A患者的疗效、安全性和免疫原性：临床试验的系统回顾与荟萃分析"
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：重度血友病患者常表现为疼痛性关节和软组织出血，这可能限制他们的日常活动。目前的标准治疗方法仍然依赖于定期预防性使用凝血因子VIII（FVIII），这带来了较高的每日治疗负担。最近，一种第三代重组FVIII——rurioctocog alfa pegol，其聚乙二醇（PEG）成分经过改良，已被开发出来。多项试验研究了这种合成药物作为重度血友病A出血预防的疗效。本研究旨在评估rurioctocog alfa pegol对既往治疗过的重度血友病A患者的疗效、安全性和免疫原性。

方法：本研究遵循PRISMA指南进行。数据从PubMed、Scopus、Cochrane Library、Wiley Online Library和CINAHL（通过EBSCOhost）检索。研究质量使用非随机研究方法学指数（MINORS）和改良Jadad量表进行评估。

结果：本研究纳入了四项涉及517名既往治疗过的重度血友病A患者的研究。总年化出血率（ABR）的合并均值和止血效能为2.59（95% CI = 2.04–3.14）和92%（95% CI = 85%–97%）。仅有30例（2.3%）非严重和1例（1.4%）严重不良事件被认为与rurioctocog alfa pegol治疗相关。在研究结束时，未观察到FVIII抑制性抗体的产生。所发展的针对FVIII、PEG-FVIII或PEG的结合抗体均与治疗效果和安全性无相关性。

结论：尽管直接比较研究有限，但我们的分析表明，rurioctocog alfa pegol可以作为既往治疗过的血友病A患者出血预防的安全有效替代方案。此外，它似乎具有低免疫原性，这进一步提高了该药物在这种临床条件下的安全性。
review_content_zh:
本文撰写清晰，组织有序。该论文对新型药物rurioctocog alfa pegol在严重血友病A中的疗效、安全性和免疫原性进行了荟萃分析。图表也清晰且有帮助。

然而，有些部分需要澄清：
* 在结果部分（安全结果部分），作者指出：“在四项研究中，共发生1,299起非严重不良事件（非SAEs）。然而，其中仅有30起（2.3%）被认为与rurioctocog alfa pegol治疗相关。同时，在四项研究中观察到70起严重不良事件（SAEs），其中仅有1起（1.4%）——如Klamroth等人所报告的——被认为与治疗相关。”我认为，如果作者能提供更多关于与rurioctocog alfa pegol治疗相关的严重不良事件的解释或例子，会更好。
* 在讨论部分，作者指出：“关于零出血发生率（图4A），在采用不同剂量方案的研究中观察到差异。考虑不同剂量方案是因为患者的药代动力学特征、FVIII水平目标和年龄组存在差异。”我认为，如果作者在引言或讨论部分对剂量方案和药代动力学进行更多解释，会更好。
我添加了Stidl等人（2018）的参考文献，因为该文章解释了与rurioctocog alfa pegol相关的安全性和潜在不良反应。这一参考文献可以帮助丰富文章的讨论，特别是在药物安全性和不良反应部分。

总体而言，本文内容有趣且提供了有价值的信息。

paper_title: Associative memory cells and their working principle in the brain
paper_abstract: The acquisition, integration and storage of exogenous associated signals are termed as associative learning and memory. The consequences and processes of associative thinking and logical reasoning based on these stored exogenous signals can be memorized as endogenous signals, which are essential for decision making, intention, and planning. Associative memory cells recruited in these primary and secondary associative memories are presumably the foundation for the brain to fulfill cognition events and emotional reactions in life, though the plasticity of synaptic connectivity and neuronal activity has been believed to be involved in learning and memory. Current reports indicate that associative memory cells are recruited by their mutual synapse innervations among co-activated brain regions to fulfill the integration, storage and retrieval of associated signals. The activation of these associative memory cells initiates information recall in the mind, and the successful activation of their downstream neurons endorses memory presentations through behaviors and emotion reactions. In this review, we aim to draw a comprehensive diagram for associative memory cells, working principle and modulation, as well as propose their roles in cognition, emotion and behaviors.
review_content:
In the present review, Wang and Cui have summarized their previous works about associative memory cells and made a hypothesis of how it works. Specifically, they named the cells that process exogenous associated signals as associative memory cells which could be classified as primary (located in sensory cortices) and secondary (located in cognition-, emotion-related brain areas). The authors also discussed the molecular changes and plasticity of the associative memory cells and raised an interesting hypothesis about working principles of these cells. Overall, this review is compelling, well-written, and timely needed for the field. However, there are some points that are not clear:
 1. The authors raised several interesting questions in the manuscript. But it would be helpful for the authors to provide a perspective section to elucidate how these questions should be addressed at the end of the manuscript.
 2. Figure 1 and the related paragraph. The authors’ claim that mutual innervation is the major pattern of primary and secondary associative memory cells connection. This model is quite simple and easy to understand. However, are there any other patterns exist in the associative memory cells? For example, the neocortex is hypothesized to function as cortical column. Does the column model fit in the associative memory cells connection as well?

paper_title_zh: 脑中的联想记忆细胞及其工作原理
paper_abstract_zh: 外源性关联信号的获取、整合和存储被称为关联学习和记忆。基于这些存储的外源性信号进行的关联思维和逻辑推理的过程及其结果可以被记忆为内源性信号，这对于决策、意图和计划至关重要。参与这些初级和次级关联记忆的关联记忆细胞被认为是大脑完成生活中认知事件和情绪反应的基础，尽管突触连接的可塑性和神经元活动被认为参与了学习和记忆过程。当前的研究报告指出，关联记忆细胞通过共同激活的大脑区域之间的相互突触支配而被招募，以完成关联信号的整合、存储和检索。这些关联记忆细胞的激活启动了心智中的信息回忆，而其下游神经元的成功激活则通过行为和情绪反应支持记忆呈现。在本综述中，我们旨在绘制关联记忆细胞的综合图示，阐述其工作原理和调控机制，并提出它们在认知、情绪和行为中的角色。
review_content_zh:
在本次综述中，王和崔总结了他们之前关于联想记忆细胞的研究工作，并提出了一种关于其工作机制的假设。具体而言，他们将处理外源性关联信号的细胞命名为联想记忆细胞，这些细胞可分为初级（位于感觉皮层）和次级（位于与认知、情感相关的脑区）。作者还讨论了联想记忆细胞的分子变化和可塑性，并提出了一种关于这些细胞工作原理的有趣假设。总体而言，这篇综述引人入胜，文笔流畅，且对该领域具有及时的需求。然而，仍有一些不明确之处：
1. 作者在文稿中提出了几个有趣的问题。但若能在文稿末尾提供一个展望部分，阐明如何解决这些问题，将更有助于读者理解。
2. 图1及相关段落。作者声称相互神经支配是初级和次级联想记忆细胞连接的主要模式。这一模型相当简单易懂。然而，联想记忆细胞中是否存在其他连接模式？例如，新皮层被假设为以皮层柱形式发挥作用。柱模型是否也适用于联想记忆细胞的连接？
3. 作者描述了联想记忆细胞的功能可塑性。这些细胞是否也表现出形态学变化？例如，在记忆获取或存储过程中，树突棘密度或形状有何变化？
4. 第3页，关于分子机制，该过程中存在许多分子变化。为何作者特别指出非编码RNA的microRNA，这一点尚不明确。
5. 第6页，作者指出前额皮质和运动皮层的单个神经元接受来自桶状皮层的突触神经支配……这对运动皮层可能是成立的。据我们所知，前额皮质并不直接接受来自桶状皮层的神经支配。
第6页，参考文献26与前额皮质无关。

paper_title: Bibliometric assessment and key messages of sporotrichosis research (1945-2018)
paper_abstract:
Background: Sporotrichosis has recently emerged as an important mycosis worldwide, with diverse transmission and epidemiologic profiles. For instance, in Brazil most cases are related to zoonotic transmission from naturally infected cats, and the majority of cases in China are due to external injury with environmental materials. Publications on sporotrichosis and on its etiologic agent may guide the direction of the research in this field. It can also define priorities for future studies. 
 Methods: In this study, we evaluated the trends of global research in Sporothrix and sporotrichosis, based on publications records retrieved from Scopus and Web of Science databases for the period of 1945 to 2018. The overall productivity in the field, its geographical and temporal distribution, research themes, co-authorship networks, funding sources, and if audience and research findings are addressed in the abstracts. 
 Results: A total of 4,007 unique publications involving 99 countries were retrieved, most of them published after 2000. Authors based on institutions from the United States of America and Brazil accounted for 57.4% of the publications. Brazil was the leading country in terms of research collaboration and networking, with co-authorship with 45 countries. The thematic mapping revealed a temporal shift from clinical to applied research. Despite the large number of countries publishing in this field, most of funded studies came from Brazil, Mexico, China, South Africa, or the United States of America. The analysis of content identified few specific public health recommendations for prevention, case-management, or research. Moreover, most papers do not have a clearly defined intended audience. 
 Conclusion: As the research in this field is emerging in several countries, with the generation of a large amount of data, it is necessary that scientists strengthen efforts to translate the research results into practice to curb this neglected infection.
review_content:
The manuscript "Bibliometric assessment and implications for practice of sporotrichosis research (1945-2018)" from Albuquerque and colleagues shows how research on sporotrichosis has been conducted in the mentioned time range. The authors raised relevant data to conclude where and how this research has been done. Besides usual typos, parts of the text, as well as some figures should be remade (comments below).

Introduction
When citing reference #15, the authors should highlight that the cited bibliometric analyses were about tuberculosis. Otherwise, the reader may think that those analyses were already made for sporotrichosis and that would decrease the impact of the current work.
End of third paragraph: “impact” is more appropriate than “impacts”.

Methods
Is citation #19 correctly referenced? Isn’t the publishing year supposed to be included at least?

Results
What is reference 23? Is it a preprint? Is it the same work as this manuscript published somewhere else?
Table 3: Why does the Rank of all publications, after going from 1 – 10, go to 22, 24, 23, 21, and 26? Isn’t that supposed to be the top 15 journals?
Figure 4: From A to D, most of what is written is way too small. Even when zooming in, some words are difficult to read. I recommend the authors to at least increase the resolution, but also try to rearrange the panels in order to make it easier for the reader. Even 4c and 4D have distinct resolution, even though the text is supposed to be identical among them.
Fig. 4 Legend: “(b) The heat map shows the most frequent terms in the period analyzed”. Please specify the period.
Fig 5A: I am not sure if this figure is adding information or even helping the understanding of the text. The authors should consider to change the format, or even take it out of the manuscript.
Fig 6: It seems that, besides the research networks, this figure is also about the distribution of scientific institutions in Brazil. Merging the current figure with a map would make it easier to visualize.
Table 7: Consider to keep it as supplementary information.

Discussion
In “…This fact, together with the increase in the average degree and size of the giant component…”. Please clarify what is the giant component.
In “…It is interesting to note that just recently, sporotrichosis has spread to the Northeast and Center-Western regions of the country…”. For the sake of being consistent with the nomenclature used in Results, please change Center-Western to Midwest.
In “…In our analysis, publications co-authored by Brazilians researchers have more tentative and minimal…”, change to Brazilian researchers.
I agree with the other reviewer that conclusions regarding implications in practice cannot be taken based on the method used.
paper_title_zh: "孢子丝菌病研究的文献计量评估及关键信息（1945-2018）"
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：孢子丝菌病近年来在全球范围内成为重要的真菌病，具有多样的传播和流行病学特征。例如，在巴西，大多数病例与自然感染的猫的动物源性传播有关，而在中国，大多数病例是由于与环境材料的体外损伤有关。关于孢子丝菌病及其病原体的出版物可以指导该领域的研究方向，并确定未来研究的优先事项。

方法：在本研究中，我们基于从Scopus和Web of Science数据库中检索到的1945年至2018年的出版物记录，评估了全球对Sporothrix和孢子丝菌病的研究趋势。分析了该领域的总体产出、地理和时间分布、研究主题、合著网络、资金来源，以及摘要中是否提及受众和研究发现。

结果：共检索到涉及99个国家的4,007篇独特出版物，其中大多数发表于2000年之后。来自美国和巴西的机构作者占出版物的57.4%。巴西在研究合作和网络方面领先，与45个国家有合著关系。主题映射显示，研究主题从临床研究转向应用研究。尽管有许多国家在该领域发表文章，但大多数受资助的研究来自巴西、墨西哥、中国、南非或美国。内容分析发现，针对预防、病例管理或研究的具体公共卫生建议较少。此外，大多数论文没有明确界定的目标受众。

结论：随着该领域研究在多个国家的兴起，并产生了大量数据，科学家们有必要加强努力，将研究结果转化为实践，以遏制这种被忽视的感染。

paper_title: ERCP-induced perforation: review and revisit after half a century
paper_abstract:
Background 
    Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) is an invasive procedure. We aimed to investigate ERCP-induced perforations at our institution and conduct a comprehensive review of literature on ERCP-induced perforations (EIP) since the introduction of this procedure as a therapeutic intervention. 
  
  
    Methods 
    This was a case-control study, in which charts of all patients diagnosed with ERCP-induced duodenal perforation were reviewed and compared to a control group without perforation. Patient’s sociodemographic and clinical data, including ERCP procedure-related data, were gathered. 
  
  
    Results 
    A total of 996 ERCP procedures were performed; only 13 patients proved to have EIP. Obstructive jaundice was the most common indication for ERCP. The main predisposing factor was difficult cannulation (P = 0.003). In total, five patients required surgical treatment; the majority of them had type I perforation, whereas type IV was the most common in patients who were treated conservatively. The overall mortality rate was 15%, the surgical group had a slightly higher mortality rate. 
  
  
    Conclusions 
    Fifty years after the introduction of ERCP for therapy, it remains an invasive procedure that carries significant morbidity and mortality, even in skilled hands or at high- volume units. Conservative management of perforation yields favorable outcomes in selected patients.
review_content:
I have read the review which I think had been given a lot of effort during preparation. However, I have some criticisms and comments.

"Did the patients with EIP have adjacent diverticula, intradiverticular papilla , or were the patients’ papilla morphology assessed and classified? This is important because this anomaly may cause difficult cannulation and inadvertent injury to papilla resulting in perforation? This data may be added if available.

1) Haraldsson, E. et al. (2019 [Ref - 1]). DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gie.2019.07.014

2)Tari, E. et al. (2024 [Ref - 2]). DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-57758-9"


EIP is a complication due to mechanical maneuvers and interventional techniques during ERCP, so being hypertensive or diabetic should not be considered as a risk factor for perforation but rather be regarded as an important risk factor in the post-procedure period of patient care, should there be a perforation during ERCP. I believe the manuscript should be corrected in this aspect, if the authors agree.

The precut papillotomy rate was reported as 85% for the EIP and this rate is quite high, why do the operators prefer this much high rate of precut papillotomy? Do the operators prefer other options such as double guide cannulation, trans-pancreatic sphincterotomy, etc., before commencing to a more hazardous technique such as a free-hand precut papillotomy? Is the rate of precut papillotomy significantly lower in the non-EIP patients when compared to EIP patients? If so, precut papillotomy utilization should be regarded as the most important risk factor for EIP, concerning your manuscript. This may be added to the manuscript, if this makes sense for the authors too.

I suggest that the methodology for statistical analysis should be reviewed by either an independent or the attendant statistician of the journal.

I have read this submission. I believe that I have an appropriate level of expertise to confirm that it is of an acceptable scientific standard, however, I have a number of small changes to the article, or specific, sometimes more significant revisions.
paper_title_zh: ERCP诱导的穿孔：半个世纪后的回顾与再探
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
内镜逆行胆胰管造影（ERCP）是一种侵入性手术。我们旨在调查我院ERCP引发的穿孔情况，并对自该手术作为治疗干预手段引入以来关于ERCP引发穿孔（EIP）的文献进行综合回顾。

方法
这是一项病例对照研究，回顾了所有诊断为ERCP引发十二指肠穿孔的患者的病历，并与无穿孔的对照组进行比较。收集了患者的社经背景和临床数据，包括与ERCP手术相关的数据。

结果
共进行了996例ERCP手术；仅13例患者证实患有EIP。阻塞性黄疸是ERCP最常见的指征。主要诱因是困难插管（P = 0.003）。共有5例患者需要手术治疗；其中大多数患有I型穿孔，而IV型穿孔在接受保守治疗的患者中最常见。总体死亡率为15%，手术组的死亡率略高。

结论
ERCP作为治疗手段引入50年后，仍是一种侵入性手术，即使在技术娴熟或高容量单位中，也伴随着显著的发病率和死亡率。对选定的患者进行穿孔的保守治疗可获得良好效果。
review_content_zh:
我已经阅读了这篇评论，我认为在准备过程中投入了大量精力。然而，我有一些批评和建议。

“患有EIP的患者是否伴有邻近憩室、憩室内乳头，或者患者的乳头形态是否被评估和分类？这一点很重要，因为这种异常可能导致插管困难，并无意中损伤乳头，从而引起穿孔？如果有的话，可以添加这些数据。

1) Haraldsson, E.等人（2019年[参考文献-1]）。DOI: https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gie.2019.07.014

2) Tari, E.等人（2024年[参考文献-2]）。DOI: https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-57758-9”

EIP是由于ERCP过程中机械操作和介入技术引起的并发症，因此高血压或糖尿病不应被视为穿孔的风险因素，而应被视为在术后患者护理期间的重要风险因素，如果在ERCP过程中发生穿孔。我相信如果作者同意，手稿在这方面应该进行修正。

据报道，EIP的预切乳头切开术率为85%，这个比例相当高，为什么操作者更喜欢如此高的预切乳头切开术率？在开始更危险的技术（如自由手预切乳头切开术）之前，操作者是否更喜欢其他选项，如双导丝插管、经胰腺括约肌切开术等？与非EIP患者相比，EIP患者的预切乳头切开术率是否显著较低？如果是这样，考虑到你们的手稿，预切乳头切开术的使用应被视为EIP最重要的风险因素。如果这对作者也有意义的话，可以将其添加到手稿中。

我建议由独立统计学家或期刊的常驻统计学家重新审查统计分析的方法。

paper_title: An analysis on the entity annotations in biological corpora
paper_abstract: Collection of documents annotated with semantic entities and relationships are crucial resources to support development and evaluation of text mining solutions for the biomedical domain. Here I present an overview of 36 corpora and show an analysis on the semantic annotations they contain. Annotations for entity types were classified into six semantic groups and an overview on the semantic entities which can be found in each corpus is shown. Results show that while some semantic entities, such as genes, proteins and chemicals are consistently annotated in many collections, corpora available for diseases, variations and mutations are still few, in spite of their importance in the biological domain.
review_content:
The article shows a review of 36 publicly annotated corpora in the biological domain. The analysis is performed taking into account different features such as type of text (abstracts, full text publications, etc.), types of entities, types of relationships (if any), number of documents, if automatic or manual annotation, if annotations are related to other resources (such as ontolologies), etc.It is an interesting and useful work that can help researchers to find a corpus to perform evaluations of their machine learning methods. As the author describes in the introduction sections, annotated corpora are valuable resources that allow to train and test algorithms and also to compare state-of-the art works each other.I think that the paper is a good contribution to the journal. Below I give several suggestions in order to improve the article as well as some data to correct a couple of mistakes.

  * In the Introduction section, it would be beneficial to introduce to the reader the “inter-annotator agreement” as well as the main ways to calculate it.
  * Before introducing the annotation schema it is necessary to give a definition of “Schema” (is it a conceptual schema? What are the elements a schema should contain)
  * In the paragraph about DDI corpus, some remarks should be included: in the first version of the corpus used in the DDIExtraction 2011 task the drugs were automatically annotated by Metamap tool1 but in the new version (used in DDI Extraction 2013 shared tasks), every annotation was manually revised by two pharmacists)
  * At the end of this section, I would like to see something about the precision experts have annotating entities and relationships. This would also help to know what is the limit systems are able to manage recognizing entities and relations.
  * In section “Corpora and semantic types” it is a good idea to give the number of citations from Google Scholar, although the most recent corpora have almost no citations. The DDI corpus has 0 citations because the reference is from October 2013; Segura-Bedmar et al. (2011)1is another reference that the author could include in the article corresponding to the first version of the corpus.
  * Concerning the figures of DDI corpus, it consists of 792 texts selected from the DrugBank database (DDI-DrugBank dataset) and other 233 Medline abstracts (DDI-MedLine dataset) on the subject of DDIs. The corpus was manually annotated with a total of 18,502 pharmacological substances and 5028 DDIs, including both pharmacokinetic (PK) as well as pharmacodynamic (PD) interactions.
  * Concerning drugs, there are two corpora that do not appear in the article: (a) PK Corpus and PF DDI Corpus2 with approx. 600 abstracts about clinical pharmacokinetics and pharmacogenetics, in-vitro and in-vivo drug-drug interactions. (b) PK DDI corpus3 consisting of 64 FDA drug labels with annotations for drugs with their precipitant or object roles in drug-drug interaction.
  * Instead of having a paragraph for each corpus, I suggest including a tabular representation of corpora and characteristics. For instance, with a column for each feature (document type, annotation tool, categories of entities, number of mentions, format, availability, etc.). This representation would help to compare different corpora.
  * I also suggest mentioning that linguistic phenomena such as co-reference resolution are also required in annotation task, especially in the detection of entities. For instance, how are words such as “drug”, “disease”, “medication” and others annotated in these corpora?
  * Some typos: In the section: List of biological corpora - Drug-Drug Interaction:

    “...has been extensively used for both training and evaluation for NER and relatiosnhip extarction tasks.”
paper_title_zh: 生物语料库中实体注释的分析
paper_abstract_zh: 带有语义实体和关系的文档集合是支持生物医学领域文本挖掘解决方案开发和评估的关键资源。本文概述了36个语料库，并展示了对其包含的语义注释的分析。实体类型的注释被分为六个语义组，并展示了每个语料库中可以找到的语义实体的概览。结果显示，尽管某些语义实体（如基因、蛋白质和化学物质）在许多集合中一致地被注释，但可用于疾病、变异和突变的语料库仍然较少，尽管它们在生物领域的重要性。
review_content_zh:
文章展示了生物领域中36个公开标注语料库的综述。分析考虑了不同特征，如文本类型（摘要、全文出版物等）、实体类型、关系类型（如果有的话）、文档数量、是否自动或手动标注、标注是否与其他资源相关（如本体）等。这是一项有趣且有用的研究，可以帮助研究人员找到用于评估其机器学习方法语料库。正如作者在引言部分所描述的，标注语料库是宝贵的资源，可以用于训练和测试算法，以及比较当前最先进的工作。我认为这篇文章是对期刊的良好贡献。以下是我为改进文章提出的一些建议，以及一些用于纠正几处错误的数据。

  * 在引言部分，向读者介绍“标注者间一致性”以及计算它的主要方法将是有益的。
  * 在介绍标注模式之前，有必要给出“模式”的定义（它是一个概念模式吗？模式应包含哪些元素？）
  * 在关于DDI语料库的段落中，应包括一些备注：在DDIExtraction 2011任务中使用的语料库第一版中，药物是通过Metamap工具自动标注的，但在新版本（用于DDI Extraction 2013共享任务）中，每个标注都由两位药剂师手动审查。
  * 在本节末尾，我希望看到一些关于专家标注实体和关系的精度的内容。这也有助于了解系统在识别实体和关系方面的极限。
  * 在“语料库和语义类型”部分，给出Google Scholar的引用数量是个好主意，尽管最新的语料库几乎没有引用。DDI语料库的引用为0，因为参考文献来自2013年10月；Segura-Bedmar等人（2011）的参考文献是作者可以在文章中包含的，对应于语料库的第一版。
  * 关于DDI语料库的数据，它由从DrugBank数据库中选出的792篇文本（DDI-DrugBank数据集）和另外233篇Medline摘要（DDI-MedLine数据集）组成，主题为药物相互作用。该语料库经过手动标注，共有18,502种药理物质和5028个DDIs，包括药代动力学（PK）和药效学（PD）相互作用。
  * 关于药物，有两个语料库未在文章中出现：（a）PK语料库和PF DDI语料库，包含约600篇关于临床药代动力学和药物遗传学、体外和体内药物相互作用的摘要。（b）PK DDI语料库，由64个FDA药物标签组成，标注了药物在药物相互作用中的促发或对象角色。
  * 我建议用一个表格来表示语料库及其特征，而不是为每个语料库单独写一段。例如，每列代表一个特征（文档类型、标注工具、实体类别、提及数量、格式、可用性等）。这种表示方式有助于比较不同的语料库。
  * 我还建议提到，如共指消解等语言现象在标注任务中也是必需的，尤其是在实体检测中。例如，在这些语料库中，“药物”、“疾病”、“药物”等词是如何标注的？
  * 一些错别字：在“生物语料库列表 - 药物-药物相互作用”部分：

    “...已被广泛用于NER和关系提取任务的训练和评估。”

paper_title: On permutation-invariant neural networks: A survey
paper_abstract: Conventional machine learning algorithms have traditionally been designed under the assumption that input data follows a vector-based format, with an emphasis on vector-centric paradigms. However, as the demand for tasks involving set-based inputs has grown, there has been a paradigm shift in the research community towards addressing these challenges. In recent years, the emergence of neural network architectures such as Deep Sets and Transformers has presented a significant advancement in the treatment of set-based data. These architectures are specifically engineered to naturally accommodate sets as input, enabling more effective representation and processing of set structures. Consequently, there has been a surge of research endeavors dedicated to exploring and harnessing the capabilities of these architectures for various tasks involving the approximation of set functions. This comprehensive survey aims to provide an overview of the diverse problem settings and ongoing research efforts pertaining to neural networks that approximate set functions. By delving into the intricacies of these approaches and elucidating the associated challenges, the survey aims to equip readers with a comprehensive understanding of the field. Through this comprehensive perspective, we hope that researchers can gain valuable insights into the potential applications, inherent limitations, and future directions of set-based neural networks. Indeed, from this survey we gain two insights: i) Deep Sets and its variants can be generalized by differences in the aggregation function, and ii) the behavior of Deep Sets is sensitive to the choice of the aggregation function. From these observations, we show that Deep Sets, one of the well-known permutation-invariant neural networks, can be generalized in the sense of a quasi-arithmetic mean.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This work discusses several neural network-based set functions and their applications. In addition to these, the authors provide some theoretical perspectives of such neural network-based set functions and datasets for set-related tasks.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths * Research on set-taking neural networks is an interesting topic in machine learning. Weaknesses * This work fails to provide insights for neural network-based set functions and their approximations. Each section is not connected to the other sections and some recent papers are missing. * I think that the equivariant property of set-taking neural networks is more important than the invariant property. The Deep Sets and Set Transformer papers discussed this topic more thoroughly. This survey paper also needs to discuss it. * In Section 1, the authors mention that graph data belongs to set data structures. I do not agree with this. Graphs are a generalization of set structures. Moreover, graph structures cannot be expressed by Definition 2.1. * I feel like the sentence `Popular conventional neural network architectures like VGG (Simonyan & Zisserman, 2014) and ResNet (He et al., 2016) do not inherently possess the permutation-invariant property` is somewhat outdated in 2024. I agree that VGG and ResNet are remarkable architectures, but there should be more popular neural networks in 2024. * In Section 1, the part `The following outlines the organization of this paper` seems redundant. It is okay to be removed. * The authors should provide appropriate descriptions on Definitions 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, and 2.4. They are enumerated without any texts. * Could you provide any references for this sentence `Finally, the output of the network should be invariant to repeated elements, as the presence of duplicate elements should not impact the resulting function approximation`? * The title of Section 3 should be `Model architectures for approximating set functions`. * In Section 3.2, Poin tNet should be PointNet. * How can Set Transformer be expressed by Equation (3)? It requires more precise expressions. * In Section 3.4, the authors did not cite the paper of Deep Sets++ and Set Transformer++. * I cannot find the proper description of Figure 2. Basically, I think that Figure 2 is redundant in this paper. * In Figure 3, some taxonomy is not accurate. For example, a hypergraph is a generalization of a graph. `Set to hypergraph` should include `Set to graph`. In addition, why are some topics overlapped? The authors should describe it more carefully. * The section title of Section 4.5 should be `Neural processes`. * I think that the author can detail more thorough future directions of the set-taking neural networks in Section 7. * Many figures are borrowed from the previous work; I think that it is generally allowed in a survey paper. However, I believe that they should be redrawn by emphasizing the authors' message on why they are explained in this paper.

**Requested Changes:**
Please see the text box above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
I do not have any concerns on broader impacts.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response from the authors.: Let us thank you for your constructive review, which has helped us to improve the manuscript. > Connections between sections and lack of recent studies To improve clarity, we have summarized the contributions and the corresponding sections at the end of Section 1. In addition, we have added several recent studies (e.g., the additional Subsection 3.9 of Perceiver (Jaegle at el, 2021) and its variants). > Equivariant property We have added a new section 2.2, which describes the equivariant property. > Graph data doesn't belong to set data We have removed the mentioned description. > Several neural network architectures are outdated in 2024. We added more recent architectures: ResNeXt (Xie et al., 2017), EfficientNet (Tan & Le, 2019) and ResNest (Zhang et al., 2022b) > In Section 1, the part The following outlines the organization of this paper seems redundant We removed this sentence. > Appropriate descriptions on Definitions 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, and 2.4. We have added appropriate explanations before and after the definitions. > Description without reference We removed this sentence. > The title of Section 3 We have corrected the title of section 3 as you indicated . > Typo in Section 3.2 We fixed typo. > Set Transformer and Eq.(3) We have added an additional description of the representation by Eq. (3) of Set Transformer. > Missing citation of Deep Sets++ and Set Transformer++ We added the citation of Deep Sets++ and Set Transformer++. > Figure 2 is redundant We removed this figure. > Modification of Figure 3 We have corrected the hierarchical relationship between set to graph and hypergraph as you mentioned. We have also fixed the confusing overlap. > Section title of Section 4.5 We modified the title of Section 4.5 > Future directions of the set-taking neural networks in Section 7 We have add possible future directions in Section 7. > Messages for the borrowed figures. We have added descriptions of why we borrowed these figures.
paper_title_zh: 关于置换不变神经网络：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 传统的机器学习算法通常在假设输入数据遵循基于向量的格式下进行设计，强调以向量为中心的范式。然而，随着涉及基于集合的输入任务需求的增长，研究社区中出现了一种范式转变，以应对这些挑战。近年来，诸如深度集合（Deep Sets）和变换器（Transformers）等神经网络架构的出现，在处理基于集合的数据方面取得了显著进展。这些架构专门设计以自然地适应集合作为输入，从而更有效地表示和处理集合结构。因此，涌现了大量研究工作，致力于探索和利用这些架构在涉及近似集合函数的各种任务中的能力。这篇综合性综述旨在概述与近似集合函数的神经网络相关的多样化问题设置和正在进行的研究努力。通过深入探讨这些方法的复杂性并阐明相关挑战，综述旨在为读者提供对该领域的全面理解。通过这一全面视角，我们希望研究人员能够获得关于基于集合的神经网络的潜在应用、固有局限性和未来方向的有价值见解。确实，从这篇综述中我们获得了两个洞见：i）深度集合及其变体可以通过聚合函数的差异进行泛化；ii）深度集合的行为对聚合函数的选择敏感。基于这些观察，我们展示了深度集合，这一著名的置换不变神经网络，可以在准算术平均值的意义上进行泛化。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文讨论了基于神经网络的几种集合函数及其应用。除此之外，作者还提供了一些基于神经网络的集合函数的理论视角以及用于集合相关任务的数据库。

**优点与缺点：**
优点：
* 集合输入神经网络的 research 是机器学习中的一个有趣话题。

缺点：
* 本文未能提供基于神经网络的集合函数及其近似的洞见。每个部分与其他部分缺乏联系，且遗漏了一些近期论文。
* 我认为集合输入神经网络的等变性质比不变性质更重要。Deep Sets 和 Set Transformer 论文对此话题进行了更深入的讨论。这篇综述论文也需要讨论这一点。
* 在第1节中，作者提到图数据属于集合数据结构。我不同意这一点。图是集合结构的一种泛化。此外，图结构不能用定义2.1来表达。
* 我觉得句子“像VGG（Simonyan & Zisserman, 2014）和ResNet（He et al., 2016）这样流行的传统神经网络架构并不天生具备置换不变性”在2024年有些过时。我同意VGG和ResNet是显著的架构，但2024年应该有更流行的神经网络。
* 在第1节中，“以下概述了本文的组织结构”这一部分似乎冗余。可以删除。
* 作者应对定义2.1、2.2、2.3和2.4提供适当的描述。它们被列举出来，但没有附带任何文字。
* 句子“最后，网络的输出应对重复元素保持不变，因为重复元素的存在不应影响函数近似的最终结果”是否有参考文献？
* 第3节的标题应为“用于近似集合函数的模型架构”。
* 在第3.2节中，Poin tNet应为PointNet。
* Set Transformer如何用方程（3）表达？需要更精确的表达。
* 在第3.4节中，作者未引用Deep Sets++和Set Transformer++的论文。
* 我找不到对图2的适当描述。基本上，我认为图2在这篇论文中是冗余的。
* 在图3中，一些分类不准确。例如，超图是图的一种泛化。“集合到超图”应包括“集合到图”。此外，为什么有些话题重叠？作者应更仔细地描述这一点。
* 第4.5节的标题应为“神经过程”。
* 我认为作者可以在第7节中更详细地阐述集合输入神经网络的未来方向。
* 许多图表借鉴了之前的工作；我认为这在综述论文中通常是允许的。然而，我相信它们应该被重新绘制，以强调作者在本文中解释它们的原因。

**请求的更改：**
请参见上述文本框。

**更广泛影响方面的担忧：**
我没有关于更广泛影响的任何担忧。

**主张与证据：**
无

**受众：**

paper_title: Tourette syndrome research highlights from 2021
paper_abstract: We summarize selected research reports from 2021 relevant to Tourette syndrome that the authors consider most important or interesting. The authors welcome article suggestions and thoughtful feedback from readers.
review_content:
Thank you for the opportunity to review this comprehensive review of the 2021 literature covering Tourette syndrome (TS) and related disorders. The authors did a wonderful job presenting a thorough, detailed, yet succinct summary of an enormous number of new, important articles in the field. I appreciated that they showed the growth of research in TS over the last forty years, and are open to creative ways to make sure they have access to the likely even larger 2022 literature base. They covered a range of topics, broken down in effective sections, including Phenomenology and Natural History, Pathophysiology, Electrophysiology, Treatment, each with its own appropriate subsections. The authors presented the brief summaries of the literature clearly, and without bias.

I only have a few comments/recommended adjustments that I would suggest the authors consider following up on.
  * Under Epidemiology, starting "The controversial topic of cognitive..." - it would help if the authors add a sentence clarifying why that phenomena is not considered OCD/intrusive thoughts.
  * Under Comorbidity, starting "A very interesting study..." - I would recommend either eliminating that or expanding on it, as the findings are quite provocative, and given the sample size was so small, I worry about it being given more attention than warranted without further studies to validate (and/or without commenting on co-occurring conditions that may also influence moral reasoning).
  * Under Premonitory Urge and Tic Suppression, starting "Another study, by He..." - I would make that a new paragraph
  * Under Environmental Risk Factors, starting "This year brought," I would recommend condensing the paragraph to make it more in line with the other summaries, particularly related to citations 46 and 47. Given that they were small studies, particularly 47, I would recommend not listing all the findings/differences (particularly as I wonder about multiple comparisons in that study..). Related, I would soften the sentence saying "meaning that almost none of these patients' presentations even slightly resembled TS to these clinicians" as it sounds more subjective/intense than the rest of the paper. And I would soften the language in the paragraph starting "One concern..." as again, it read as more subjective/opinion-driven than the rest of the manuscript.
  * In the paragraph starting, "Sturm and colleagues..." I believe the heading above it is incorrect.
  * Under Tic Assessment, starting "Many studies have focused..." it would help to clarify the last sentence starting, "Interesting vocal tics..." Without more context, it is difficult to understand why vocal tics not predicting TS diagnosis might challenge the validity of diagnostic TS criteria vs challenge the validity of the SVM (support vector machine)?
  * Under Treatment Psychological interventions, starting "Several research groups..." - it would help to spell out what the acronym BIP means
  * In the figure depicting the increase in TS related literature over time, it looks like the legend is flipped
  * In Conclusions, I wonder if the authors mean to say "Additionally" rather than "On the other hand."
paper_title_zh: 2021年图雷特综合征研究亮点
paper_abstract_zh: 我们总结了2021年与图雷特综合症相关的研究报告，这些报告是作者认为最重要或最有趣的。作者欢迎读者提出文章建议和深思熟虑的反馈。
review_content_zh:
感谢有机会审阅这篇涵盖2021年图雷特综合症（TS）及相关疾病的全面文献综述。作者们出色地呈现了对该领域大量新发表的重要文章的详尽、细致且简洁的总结。我赞赏他们展示了过去四十年TS研究的增长，并且对获取可能更大的2022年文献库持开放态度。他们涵盖了多个主题，有效划分为各个部分，包括现象学和自然史、病理生理学、电生理学、治疗，每个部分都有其适当的子章节。作者们清晰地、无偏见地呈现了文献的简要总结。

我只有几点评论/建议调整，建议作者们考虑跟进：
* 在流行病学部分，从“关于认知的争议性话题……”开始——如果作者能添加一句澄清为何该现象不被视为强迫症/侵入性思维，将会有所帮助。
* 在共病部分，从“一项非常有趣的研究……”开始——我建议要么删除这部分，要么加以扩展，因为该发现颇具挑衅性，鉴于样本量很小，我担心在没有进一步研究验证的情况下（以及/或者没有评论可能也影响道德推理的共存条件），它会受到不应有的更多关注。

paper_title: Assessing toxicological risk of nanoplastics contaminants in food and feed from ingestion pathway to human diseases
paper_abstract: The extensive use of plastic without an effective management system is linked to significant environmental pollution issues. The fragmentation of various types of plastic waste leads to the formation of microplastics (MPs) and nanoplastics (NPs). NPs, measuring less than 0.1 μm pose a latent danger to the human food chain caused by the ability to traverse biological membranes than MPs, potentially leading to various chronic diseases. The widespread distribution of NPs across diverse environmental matrices and their subsequent infiltration into food and feed chains precipitates various emerging health concerns. NPs contaminate food production systems and leach from plastic packaging, infiltrating organisms at various trophic levels. Seafood, processed foods, and drinking water serve as vectors for absorption and accumulation in human tissues. The pervasive contamination pathway poses substantial risks to human health through multiple exposure routes, primarily ingestion. It can lead to cytotoxicity, inflammation, genotoxicity, and apoptosis. This review summarizes the implications of NPs exposure that triggers various diseases such as inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), kidney dysfunction, liver disease, heart problems, brain disorders, reproductive issues, and cancer. Currently, no established method exists to treat NPs that humans may have already ingested. Hence, it is urgent to mitigate the harmful effects of NPs through the development and implementation of innovative, efficient, and sustainable environmental decontamination strategies. This discussion highlights several advanced remediation techniques that can effectively reduce the toxicity of NPs in environmental systems, thus mitigating their associated risks.

paper_title_zh: 评估食品和饲料中纳米塑料污染物通过摄入途径对人类疾病的毒理学风险
paper_abstract_zh: 塑料的广泛使用缺乏有效的管理系统，与严重的环境污染问题密切相关。各种类型塑料废物的碎片化导致微塑料（MPs）和纳米塑料（NPs）的形成。尺寸小于0.1微米的NPs因其能够穿越生物膜，相较于MPs对人类食物链构成潜在危险，可能导致各种慢性疾病。NPs在多种环境基质中的广泛分布及其随后对食品和饲料链的渗透，引发了诸多新兴健康问题。NPs污染食品生产系统，并从塑料包装中渗出，侵入不同营养级的生物体。海产品、加工食品和饮用水作为载体，促进其在人体组织的吸收和积累。这种普遍的污染途径通过多种暴露途径，尤其是摄入，对人类健康构成重大风险，可能导致细胞毒性、炎症、基因毒性和细胞凋亡。本文综述了NPs暴露引发的各类疾病影响，如炎症性肠病（IBD）、肾脏功能障碍、肝脏疾病、心脏问题、脑部疾病、生殖问题和癌症。目前，尚无确立的方法治疗人类可能已摄入的NPs。因此，迫切需要通过开发和实施创新、高效和可持续的环境净化策略，减轻NPs的有害影响。本文讨论了若干先进修复技术，这些技术能有效降低环境系统中NPs的毒性，从而减轻其相关风险。
