paper_title: A Survey of Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
paper_abstract: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) is a variant of reinforcement learning (RL) that learns from human feedback instead of relying on an engineered reward function. Building on prior work on the related setting of preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL), it stands at the intersection of artificial intelligence and human-computer interaction. This positioning offers a promising avenue to enhance the performance and adaptability of intelligent systems while also improving the alignment of their objectives with human values. The training of large language models (LLMs) has impressively demonstrated this potential in recent years, where RLHF played a decisive role in directing the model's capabilities toward human objectives. This article provides a comprehensive overview of the fundamentals of RLHF, exploring the intricate dynamics between RL agents and human input. While recent focus has been on RLHF for LLMs, our survey adopts a broader perspective, examining the diverse applications and wide-ranging impact of the technique. We delve into the core principles that underpin RLHF, shedding light on the symbiotic relationship between algorithms and human feedback, and discuss the main research trends in the field. By synthesizing the current landscape of RLHF research, this article aims to provide researchers as well as practitioners with a comprehensive understanding of this rapidly growing field of research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The authors present a new survey on reinforcement learning from human feedback, focusing on a general frame of view across each of the steps in the RL process. The “novelty” in this area is to give the newest possible map of papers for new entrants in the field.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
This paper is clearly a useful document, especially once into the central portions of the paper (sections 3 to 5), but there is some thematic confusion and balance challenges that are to be expected as a subfield goes through such substantial shifts in interest. My primary concern with the paper is trying to reconcile how most of the readers in the paper will show up due to an interest in the application of RLHF to language models, but the inclusion of language-modeling related content seems largely an afterthought. Throughout, most of the figures and references either miss core recent works in that area of don’t indicate what is different about this blossoming area of research. To be clear, as a reviewer I don’t think this is my decision to make, but given I’ll be giving a positive score either way, I think some discourse on the matter is important. There are plenty of sentences that aren’t really true for RLHF on LMs, but it’s not easy to fix: - “Learning the agent’s objective from human feedback circumvents reward engineering challenges and fosters robust training” —> the only way to get a reasonable reward - Anything “human-in-the-loop” doesn’t apply because it’s a contrived offline bandits approach - reward model “should be learning in an interactive, online, …” There are also other sources of confusion similar to this: - Limiting the scope to papers within 5 years, which leads to selective inclusion or not of core papers outside of that window. The seminal papers of the field, which is pretty recent, should really be included. - There could potentially be more forward pointers in the text. Like my language model comment, in section 5.2.7 I was really wondering when DPO would be mentioned (and if), which I also wondered during the intro. There were other examples where I was confused reading it, only to find it later, which forward links could avoid. I focus on this because a lot of the content in the paper is great. There are plenty of sections that I starred as well done, such as feedback types and the origins of the Bradley Terry model. So, I think this is a good paper, but should revisit some of the framing and organization.

**Requested Changes:**
1. I mentioned incomplete coverage of core papers in the flourishing of RLHF, here’s a list of papers I grabbed from a blog post from early 2023 that should be considered (coverage was pretty good in checking this): - GopherCite: [**Teaching language models to support answers with verified quotes**](https://www.deepmind.com/publications/gophercite-teaching-language-models-to-support-answers-with-verified-quotes) (Menick et al. 2022): Train a LM with RLHF to return answers with specific citations. - [**Dynamic Planning in Open-Ended Dialogue using Reinforcement Learning**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.02294) (Cohen at al. 2022): Using RL to enhance the conversational skill of an open-ended dialogue agent. - [**Llama 2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09288) (Touvron et al. 2023): Impactful open-access model with substantial RLHF details. - The first paper to do KL penalties for sequences https://arxiv.org/abs/1611.02796 (section 5.2.1 addition) 2. All of the content on previous surveys should probably be moved to the end or the appendix 3. It is probably worth adding a diagram that works for how the RLHF used for language models can work (offline labels, no state feedback) 4. There can be citations added to the paper that support arguments, but they probably are more niche. A section that I felt like could use populating was 5.1.6 (and nearby). 1. Toward pluralistic alignment https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05070 2. Social choice for AI alignment https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.10271v1 3. The History and Risks of Reinforcement Learning and Human Feedback, https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.13595 5. I found the active learning and query-learning framing to be a bit forced, as I have never seen it before in the literature, which makes the entry costs to the paper a bit higher. I don’t really know how to fix this. 6. In section 3.2.3 in discussing improvements, the concept of revisions and critiques should be included (e.g. constitutional AI and https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.07896) 7. I thought it was weird that section 4.2.2 had no mention of dataset size per domain, which is likely a crucial detail. 8. Section 5 seemed to have a bit higher variance than the core sections preceding it (e.g. 3 and 4). Some feedback: 1. 5.1.X is likely to vary a lot by domain. This links with my language model comment, but it just didn’t seem as clear how to use it as some of the other sections. 2. 5.2 seemed a little tangential, not sure how necessary it is in fullness 3. 5.2 is missing references to a bunch of recent reward model ensembling and averaging papers: https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09244 https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.12187 4. 5.3 and the later evaluation section can include recent work on evaluating reward models (and generative reward models): https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13787 https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.05470 https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16155 (consistency eval is small) 5. 5.5.1 the analysis of reward model pretraining is not accurate with the method described in the paper. It was additional pretraining, which is really more of fine-tuning of a language model. 6. 5.5.2 should probably mention RLAIF and recent distillation of preferences work. And Meta Llama 2’s margin RM loss 9. Section 6 should mention best of n sampling and rejection sampling 10. Nits: 1. 5.1.6 has a broken bibtex ref 2. 4.2.1 particularly was a bit long and could use some of the paragraph breakdowns you did 3. Section 6 has a clear typo in the intro to the section 4. 3.2.2 has a author note that was supposed to be deleted

**Claims And Evidence:**

paper_title_zh: 人类反馈强化学习综述
paper_abstract_zh: 基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是强化学习（RL）的一种变体，它从人类反馈中学习，而不是依赖于工程化的奖励函数。在前期关于基于偏好的强化学习（PbRL）相关设置的研究基础上，RLHF位于人工智能与人机交互的交叉点。这种定位为提升智能系统的性能和适应性提供了有前景的途径，同时也改善了系统目标与人类价值观的一致性。近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）的训练令人印象深刻地展示了这一潜力，其中RLHF在引导模型能力向人类目标方向发展上发挥了决定性作用。本文全面概述了RLHF的基础知识，探讨了强化学习代理与人类输入之间的复杂动态关系。尽管近期的研究重点集中在LLMs的RLHF上，但我们的综述采取了更广阔的视角，考察了该技术的多样化应用和广泛影响。我们深入探讨了支撑RLHF的核心原则，揭示了算法与人类反馈之间的共生关系，并讨论了该领域的主要研究趋势。通过综合当前RLHF研究的现状，本文旨在为研究人员和从业者提供一个对这一快速发展的研究领域的全面理解。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
作者们呈现了一篇关于从人类反馈中强化学习的新综述，重点关注强化学习过程中每一步的普遍框架。该领域的“新颖性”在于为该领域的新进入者提供最新的论文地图。

**优点和缺点：**
这篇论文显然是一份有用的文档，尤其是进入论文的核心部分（第3至第5节）时，但存在一些主题上的混淆和平衡上的挑战，这是在子领域经历如此重大兴趣转变时可以预料的。我对论文的主要担忧是，试图调和大多数读者因对将RLHF应用于语言模型的兴趣而阅读该论文，但与语言建模相关的内容似乎很大程度上是事后添加的。通读全文，大多数图表和参考文献要么遗漏了该领域的核心近期工作，要么没有指出这一蓬勃发展研究领域的独特之处。明确地说，作为审稿人，我认为这不是我该做的决定，但鉴于无论如何我都会给出正面评价，我认为对此进行一些讨论是很重要的。有许多句子对于语言模型上的RLHF并不真正成立，但并不容易修正：
- “从人类反馈中学习代理的目标规避了奖励工程挑战，促进了稳健训练”——>获得合理奖励的唯一方式
- 任何“人在回路”的内容都不适用，因为这是一种人为的离线赌博方法
- 奖励模型“应该在交互式、在线、……”中进行学习

还有其他类似的混淆来源：
- 将范围限制在5年内的论文，导致选择性地包含或不包含该窗口之外的核心论文。该领域的开创性论文，尽管时间较近，但确实应该被包括在内。
- 文本中可以有更多的前瞻性指针。就像我的语言模型评论一样，在第5.2.7节中，我真的很想知道DPO何时会被提及（以及是否会提及），我在引言中也有同样的疑问。还有其他例子，我在阅读时感到困惑，后来才找到，如果有前瞻性链接就可以避免这种情况。我之所以关注这一点，是因为论文中的许多内容都很好。有许多节段我认为做得很好，例如反馈类型和Bradley Terry模型的起源。所以，我认为这是一篇好论文，但应该重新审视一些框架和组织。

**请求的更改：**
1. 我提到了对RLHF蓬勃发展中的核心论文的不完整覆盖，这里是从2023年初的一篇博客文章中抓取的应考虑的论文列表（在检查时覆盖得相当好）：
   - GopherCite: [**教会语言模型用验证过的引言支持答案**](https://www.deepmind.com/publications/gophercite-teaching-language-models-to-support-answers-with-verified-quotes) (Menick等人，2022)：用RLHF训练一个LM以返回带有特定引言的答案。
   - [**使用强化学习在开放式对话中进行动态规划**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2208.02294) (Cohen等人，2022)：使用RL增强开放式对话代理的对话技巧。
   - [**Llama 2**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.09288) (Touvron等人，2023)：具有实质性RLHF细节的有影响力的开放获取模型。
   - 第一篇对序列进行KL惩罚的论文 https://arxiv.org/abs/1611.02796（第5.2.1节的补充）

2. 所有关于先前综述的内容可能应该移至文末或附录。

3. 添加一个适用于语言模型中RLHF如何工作的图表可能是有价值的（离线标签，无状态反馈）。

4. 可以添加支持论点的引用，但它们可能更小众。我觉得可以充实的一个节段是5.1.6（及其附近）。
   1. 朝着多元对齐 https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.05070
   2. 人工智能对齐的社会选择 https://arxiv.org/abs/2404.10271v1
   3. 强化学习和人类反馈的历史与风险 https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.13595

5. 我发现主动学习和查询学习框架有点牵强，因为我从未在文献中见过，这使得论文的入门成本有点高。我不太知道如何解决这个问题。

6. 在第3.2.3节讨论改进时，应包括修订和批评的概念（例如宪法AI和https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.07896）。

7. 我觉得第4.2.2节没有提到每个领域的数据集大小有点奇怪，这很可能是一个关键细节。

8. 第5节似乎比前面的核心节段（如3和4）有更高的变异性。一些反馈：
   1. 5.1.X很可能因领域而异。这与我的语言模型评论相联系，但就是感觉不如其他节段那么清晰。
   2. 5.2似乎有点偏离主题，不确定是否需要完整地包含。
   3. 5.2遗漏了大量关于奖励模型集成和平均的近期论文：https://arxiv.org/abs/2312.09244 https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.12187
   4. 5.3和后面的评估节段可以包括关于评估奖励模型（及生成奖励模型）的近期工作：https://arxiv.org/abs/2403.13787 https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.05470 https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16155（一致性评估较小）
   5. 5.5.1对奖励模型预训练的分析与论文中描述的方法不符。它是额外的预训练，实际上更像是语言模型的微调。
   6. 5.5.2可能应该提到RLAIF和最近的偏好蒸馏工作。以及Meta Llama 2的边际RM损失。

9. 第6节应提到最佳n采样和拒绝采样。

10. 细节：
    1. 5.1.6有一个损坏的bibtex引用。
    2. 4.2.1特别长，可以用你做的一些段落分解。
    3. 第6节在节段引言中有明显的错别字。
    4. 3.2.2有一个本应删除的作者注释。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

There can be citations added to the paper that support arguments, but they probably are more niche.
Section 5.5.2 should probably mention RLAIF and recent distillation of preferences work.

This paper is clearly a useful document, especially once into the central portions of the paper (sections 3 to 5), but there is some thematic confusion and balance challenges that are to be expected as a subfield goes through such substantial shifts in interest.
I found the active learning and query-learning framing to be a bit forced, as I have never seen it before in the literature, which makes the entry costs to the paper a bit higher.
It is probably worth adding a diagram that works for how the RLHF used for language models can work (offline labels, no state feedback)
In section 3.2.3 in discussing improvements, the concept of revisions and critiques should be included (e.g. constitutional AI and https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.07896)
4.2.1 particularly was a bit long and could use some of the paragraph breakdowns you did

paper_title: Rice (Oryza) hemoglobins
paper_abstract: Hemoglobins (Hbs) corresponding to non-symbiotic (nsHb) and truncated (tHb) Hbs have been identified in rice ( Oryza ). This review discusses the major findings from the current studies on rice Hbs. At the molecular level, a family of the nshb genes, consisting of hb1 , hb2 , hb3 , hb4 and hb5 , and a single copy of the thb gene exist in Oryza sativa var. indica and O . sativa var. japonica, Hb transcripts coexist in rice organs and Hb polypeptides exist in rice embryonic and vegetative organs and in the cytoplasm of differentiating cells. At the structural level, the crystal structure of rice Hb1 has been elucidated, and the structures of the other rice Hbs have been modeled. Kinetic analysis indicated that rice Hb1 and 2, and possibly rice Hb3 and 4, exhibit a very high affinity for O 2 , whereas rice Hb5 and tHb possibly exhibit a low to moderate affinity for O 2 . Based on the accumulated information on the properties of rice Hbs and data from the analysis of other plant and non-plant Hbs, it is likely that Hbs play a variety of roles in rice organs, including O 2 -transport, O 2 -sensing, NO-scavenging and redox-signaling. From an evolutionary perspective, an outline for the evolution of rice Hbs is available. Rice nshb and thb genes vertically evolved through different lineages, rice nsHbs evolved into clade I and clade II lineages and rice nshb s and thb s evolved under the effect of neutral selection. This review also reveals lacunae in our ability to completely understand rice Hbs. Primary lacunae are the absence of experimental information about the precise functions of rice Hbs, the properties of modeled rice Hbs and the cis -elements and trans -acting factors that regulate the expression of rice hb genes, and the partial understanding of the evolution of rice Hbs.
review_content:
The manuscript “Rice (Oryza) hemoglobins” by Arredondo-Peter, Moran and Sarath reviews the current status of research on the group of proteins found within rice plants belonging to the hemoglobin (Hb) superfamily. There is growing interest in Hbs, particularly non-mammalian Hbs, owing to their potential role as mediators of reactive nitrogen molecules, such as nitric oxide. Such a review is welcome, as rice is an important cultivar and adaptation to stress during growth plays an important role in the survival of the plant. The review covers a wide range of relevant topics, such as phylogenetic aspects, cellular localization, and chemical properties.

Within this review, the literature on rice Hbs is covered thoroughly, as witnessed by the extensive bibliography that accompanies the manuscript. However, closer inspection of that bibliography reveals an underlying issue with this manuscript. Although over 150 citations are given, a minority of those papers reference research performed specifically on rice plant or rice Hbs. This is not meant as a slight against the authors, rather as an observation that current research on rice Hbs is still in its infancy and extensive literature on the topic simply does not exist. With that in mind we would suggest altering this manuscript to acknowledge this shortage of experimental evidence in the following ways.
  * By far the majority of experimental evidence exists of Hb1, yet throughout the manuscript Hb1 is treated more-or-less equally to Hb2-Hb5. The authors should focus on Hb1 in presenting the available evidence, then in a separate section (perhaps “correlations to other Hb genes”) the authors could examine homology models and hypothetical behavior without the danger of having conjecture misinterpreted by the reader as published fact.
  * tHb belongs to a separate class of Hbs than the other Hbs in rice (Hb1 through Hb5), and throughout the manuscript it is often treated as an afterthought. As an addendum to the above comment we would also suggest a separate section be reserved for tHb. Though little experiment information may be available for this protein, a short stand-alone section would be more informative than a series of trailing paragraphs.
  * Great care must be taken by the authors when postulating biophysical characteristics of rice Hbs using only homology models based upon a single crystal structure. Simple variations in structure can carry significant changes in heme iron coordination, reactivity and binding affinity. If such conjecture is used in this manuscript it must be plainly stated with the caveat that this is not published fact, or experimental evidence.

Additional specific comments
 1. To orient the reader it would be helpful to include a two-panel figure containing (a) the amino acid sequence alignment of Hbs 1 through 5 using Hb1 as the anchor, and (b) the alignment of tHb using Arabidopsis thaliana GLB3 as the anchor. In both panels, the differences between each Hb and Hb1 (a) or tHb and GLB3 (b) could be emphasized (e.g., with color). The secondary structure of Hb1 (a) and GLB3 (b) could be indicated as well. In the text the % sequence identity for the relevant pairs should be mentioned. In addition, are the japonica and indica sequences identical? Whether one or the other cultivar is used should be clearly indicated throughout the review (for example, in Figure 2).
 2. Apoprotein folding pathways are discussed on page 7. An additional statement as to the biological relevance of the folding pathway and information about association with the heme (when, where) would be interesting.
 3. In general, it is not possible to predict the thermodynamic or chemical properties of a heme protein based on its primary structure. The case of Parasponia andersonii and Trema tomentosa hemoglobins provides one illustration of the difficulty within the plant world. Predictions can be inaccurate even when a three-dimensional structure is available. This shortcoming of sequence analyses and modeling could be emphasized with a discussion of specific examples and used to advocate the need for additional hemoglobin research.
 4. Reaction with nitric oxide is a likely function of many hemoglobins. According to the work of Gardner and colleagues, the NO dioxygenase reaction begins with the binding of dioxygen followed by combination with NO to produce nitrate. In this mechanism, binding of NO to the iron is not necessary. In this regard, the statement on page 3 (bottom left) should be clarified. Likewise, the Hb/NO cycle as proposed by Igamberdiev and Hill involves oxyHb. In contrast, the description on page 9 suggests that one turnover occurs with oxyHb, followed by formation of Hb-NO.
 5. Speculations regarding the formation of homodimeric or heterodimeric structures should also be qualified, since the concentration of the hemoglobins (sub micromolar) appears to be much lower than the projected Kd (mM).
 6. In the "Postulated functions” section, a proposal is made that Hb5 and tHb are O2 transporters. Could the authors elaborate on this function? (Transport to what and for what purpose, and is it consistent with the cellular concentrations?)
 7. Ligand binding is central to the function of hemoglobins. The “kinetic” section provides little such information while the second paragraph of the “Postulated functions” section offers numbers. It would be useful to consolidate the kinetic data with a table containing the measured equilibrium and rate constants for Hb1 and Hb2 (CO, NO, O2), as published in various primary references (for example, reference 97), and for Hb relatives mentioned in the text.
paper_title_zh: 水稻（Oryza）血红蛋白
paper_abstract_zh: 在水稻（Oryza）中已鉴定出对应于非共生血红蛋白（nsHb）和截短血红蛋白（tHb）的血红蛋白（Hbs）。本文综述了当前对水稻血红蛋白研究的主要发现。在分子水平上，水稻品种Oryza sativa var. indica和O. sativa var. japonica中存在一个由hb1、hb2、hb3、hb4和hb5组成的nshb基因家族以及一个单拷贝的thb基因。Hb转录本共存于水稻器官中，Hb多肽存在于水稻胚胎和营养器官以及分化细胞的细胞质中。在结构水平上，已阐明了水稻Hb1的晶体结构，其他水稻Hbs的结构也已建模。动力学分析表明，水稻Hb1和Hb2，以及可能的水稻Hb3和Hb4，对O2具有非常高的亲和力，而水稻Hb5和tHb可能对O2具有低到中等的亲和力。基于积累的水稻Hbs属性信息以及其他植物和非植物Hbs的分析数据，Hbs在水稻器官中可能扮演多种角色，包括O2运输、O2感应、NO清除和氧化还原信号传导。从进化角度来看，已有水稻Hbs进化的概要。水稻nshb和thb基因通过不同谱系垂直进化，水稻nsHbs进化为谱系I和谱系II，水稻nshb和thb在自然选择的影响下进化。本文还揭示了我们对水稻Hbs完全理解的不足之处。主要不足包括缺乏关于水稻Hbs确切功能的实验信息、建模水稻Hbs的属性以及调控水稻hb基因表达的顺式元件和反式作用因子，以及对水稻Hbs进化的部分理解。
review_content_zh:
**《水稻（Oryza）血红蛋白》评论内容翻译**

Arredondo-Peter、Moran和Sarath撰写的《水稻（Oryza）血红蛋白》手稿综述了目前对水稻植物中属于血红蛋白（Hb）超家族的蛋白质组的研究现状。由于血红蛋白，特别是非哺乳动物血红蛋白，在作为反应性氮分子（如一氧化氮）的介体方面具有潜在作用，因此人们对血红蛋白的兴趣日益浓厚。这样的综述是受欢迎的，因为水稻是一个重要的栽培品种，生长过程中的应激适应在植物的生存中起着重要作用。该综述涵盖了广泛的相关主题，如系统发育方面、细胞定位和化学性质。

在这篇综述中，关于水稻血红蛋白的文献被全面覆盖，这一点从伴随手稿的广泛参考文献中可以看出。然而，仔细检查这些参考文献会发现该手稿存在一个潜在问题。尽管引用了超过150篇文献，但其中只有少数论文涉及专门针对水稻植物或水稻血红蛋白的研究。这并非意在贬低作者，而是指出当前对水稻血红蛋白的研究仍处于起步阶段，关于这一主题的广泛文献 simply does not exist。基于此，我们建议以以下方式修改手稿，以承认实验证据的不足：
1. 绝大多数实验证据存在于Hb1，然而在整个手稿中，Hb1被或多或少地与Hb2-Hb5平等对待。作者应在呈现现有证据时聚焦于Hb1，然后在单独的章节（或许是“与其他血红蛋白基因的相关性”）中，作者可以探讨同源模型和假设行为，而不用担心读者的误解将推测当作已发表的事实。
2. tHb属于与水稻中其他血红蛋白（Hb1至Hb5）不同类别的血红蛋白，且在整个手稿中常被视为附带提及。作为对上述评论的补充，我们也建议为tHb保留一个单独的章节。尽管关于这种蛋白质的实验信息可能较少，但一个简短的独立章节会比一系列尾随段落更具信息性。
3. 当仅基于单一晶体结构使用同源模型推测水稻血红蛋白的生物物理特性时，作者必须非常谨慎。结构的简单变异可能会带来血红素铁配位、反应性和结合亲和力的显著变化。如果手稿中使用了此类推测，必须明确说明，并附带警告这不是已发表的事实或实验证据。

**具体补充评论**
1. 为了引导读者，建议包含一个双面板图，其中包含（a）使用Hb1作为锚点的Hb1至Hb5的氨基酸序列比对，和（b）使用拟南芥GLB3作为锚点的tHb的比对。在两个面板中，可以强调每个Hb与Hb1（a）或tHb与GLB3（b）之间的差异（例如，用颜色标注）。Hb1（a）和GLB3（b）的二级结构也可以标出。在文本中应提及相关对的序列同一性百分比。此外， japonica和indica序列是否相同？在整个综述中应明确指出使用了哪一个栽培品种（例如，在图2中）。
2. 第7页讨论了脱辅蛋白折叠途径。关于折叠途径的生物相关性以及与血红素结合的信息（何时、何地）的额外声明将是有趣的。
3. 通常，不可能仅基于初级结构预测血红素蛋白的热力学或化学性质。Parasponia andersonii和Trema tomentosa血红蛋白的情况提供了植物界内这一困难的例证。即使有三维结构可用，预测也可能不准确。可以通过讨论具体例子来强调序列分析和建模的这种不足，并以此倡导需要更多的血红蛋白研究。
4. 与一氧化氮的反应是许多血红蛋白的可能功能。根据Gardner及其同事的工作，NO双加氧酶反应始于二氧的结合，随后与NO结合生成硝酸盐。在这一机制中，NO与铁的结合不是必需的。在这方面，第3页（左下角）的声明应予澄清。同样，Igamberdiev和Hill提出的Hb/NO循环涉及氧合Hb。相比之下，第9页的描述建议一次周转发生在氧合Hb之后，随后形成Hb-NO。
5. 关于形成同二聚体或异二聚体结构的推测也应予以限定，因为血红蛋白的浓度（亚微摩尔）似乎远低于预期的Kd（毫摩尔）。
6. 在“推测功能”部分，提出了Hb5和tHb是O2转运蛋白的假设。作者能否详细阐述这一功能？（转运到什么以及为了什么目的，且是否与细胞浓度一致？）
7. 配体结合是血红蛋白功能的核心。“动力学”部分提供了很少的此类信息，而“推测功能”部分的第二段提供了数据。将动力学数据整合到一个表格中将是有用的，该表格包含Hb1和Hb2（CO、NO、O2）的测量平衡和速率常数，如 various primary references（例如，参考文献97）中所发表，以及文中提到的血红蛋白相关蛋白的数据。

reasons: The review covers a wide range of relevant topics, such as phylogenetic aspects, cellular localization, and chemical properties.
Within this review, the literature on rice Hbs is covered thoroughly, as witnessed by the extensive bibliography that accompanies the manuscript.
However, closer inspection of that bibliography reveals an underlying issue with this manuscript.
Although over 150 citations are given, a minority of those papers reference research performed specifically on rice plant or rice Hbs.
This is not meant as a slight against the authors, rather as an observation that current research on rice Hbs is still in its infancy and extensive literature on the topic simply does not exist.
If such conjecture is used in this manuscript it must be plainly stated with the caveat that this is not published fact, or experimental evidence.
In this regard, the statement on page 3 (bottom left) should be clarified.

To orient the reader it would be helpful to include a two-panel figure containing (a) the amino acid sequence alignment of Hbs 1 through 5 using Hb1 as the anchor, and (b) the alignment of tHb using Arabidopsis thaliana GLB3 as the anchor

paper_title: An integrative review on physical restraint in adult critical care unit
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Physical restraints (PRs) are frequently used in adult critical care units to protect staff and prevent self-harm, despite the fact that they represent significant safety risks. Restraint complications may have an impact on the patient’s long- and short-term outcomes. This integrative review aimed to meticulously evaluate existing evidence pertaining to physical restraint practices in adult critical care settings. The review was specifically geared towards examining the prevalence of PR, identifying influential factors, elucidating the role of nurses in PR implementation, exploring nurses’ experiences in caring for patients under restraint, and scrutinizing the complications associated with PR application 
   
   
     Method 
     This integrative review included the studies published between January 2009 and December 2019 and the literature search was conducted in July 2020. The databases searched included EBSCOhost, Ovid, ProQuest, PubMed, Wiley Online Library, SCOPUS, and ScienceDirect. The keywords included in the search were restraint, critical care, intensive care, ICU, mechanical ventilation, intubation, nursing, and experience. A checklist based on the CASP checklist and the JBI Critical Appraisal Tool was used to assess the methodological quality. 
   
   
     Results 
     The findings were evaluated and summarized into seven key topics after twenty-one publications were found to be evaluated. i) High prevalence of PR application in adult critical care unit; ii) determinants of PR applications; iii) types of PR in adult critical care units; iv) decision maker of PR; v) moral and ethical dilemma in PR application; vi) awareness and guidelines for PR applications; vii) common complications and use of sedation, analgesics, antipsychotic drugs in PR application. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     The number of days PR is used is related to the risk of an adverse event. In order to standardize nursing practice, ICU nurses require greater training on the ideas of PR use. Evidence-based recommendations will assist critical care nurses in making the best judgments possible concerning the use of PR.
review_content:
Thank you for asking me to review this paper. Restraint with in Critical Care and in fact most clinical settings is common depending on how you define 'restraint'. In the review there is a large discussion around staffing that is not alluded to in the conclusion. The conclusion, nor the review has made any comment on the fact that tube dislodgement occurs in people who are physically restrained.

The discussion is very good at high lighting alternative interventions to manage delirium which would then reduce the need for the se of restraints.

Standardising nursing practice guidance will not change things unless a more fundamental approach is taken to ensure that the environment within critical care is appropriate, patient identification improves and staffing levels are tackled.
paper_title_zh: 成人重症监护病房物理约束的综合回顾
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
物理约束（PRs）在成人重症监护单元中频繁使用，以保护工作人员并防止自我伤害，尽管它们存在显著的安全风险。约束并发症可能对患者的长期和短期结局产生影响。本综合性回顾旨在细致评估现有关于成人重症监护环境中物理约束实践的证据。该回顾特别针对检查PR的流行率、识别影响因素、阐明护士在PR实施中的作用、探讨护士在照顾受约束患者中的经验，以及审查与PR应用相关的并发症。

方法
本综合性回顾包括2009年1月至2019年12月间发表的研究，文献检索于2020年7月进行。检索的数据库包括EBSCOhost、Ovid、ProQuest、PubMed、Wiley Online Library、SCOPUS和ScienceDirect。检索关键词包括约束、重症监护、加强护理、ICU、机械通气、插管、护理和经验。使用基于CASP清单和JBI关键评估工具的清单来评估方法学质量。

结果
在评估了21篇出版物后，发现结果被评估并总结为七个关键主题：i）成人重症监护单元中PR应用的高流行率；ii）PR应用的决定因素；iii）成人重症监护单元中PR的类型；iv）PR的决策者；v）PR应用中的道德和伦理困境；vi）PR应用的意识和指南；vii）PR应用中的常见并发症及镇静剂、镇痛剂、抗精神病药物的使用。

结论
PR使用的天数与不良事件的风险相关。为了标准化护理实践，ICU护士需要接受更多关于PR使用理念的训练。基于证据的建议将帮助重症监护护士在PR使用方面做出最佳判断。
review_content_zh:
感谢您邀请我审阅这篇论文。在重症监护以及事实上大多数临床环境中，约束是常见的，这取决于您如何定义“约束”。在综述中，有大量关于人员配备的讨论，这在结论中并未提及。结论和综述都未对被物理约束的患者中发生的管路移位现象进行任何评论。

讨论在突出替代干预措施以管理谵妄方面做得很好，这将减少对约束使用的需求。

除非采取更根本的方法来确保重症监护环境适宜、患者识别得到改善以及人员配备水平得到解决，否则标准化护理实践指南将不会改变现状。

paper_title: A review of recent advances in the diagnosis of cardiac amyloidosis, treatment of its cardiac complications, and disease-modifying therapies
paper_abstract: Cardiac amyloidosis (CA), a significant condition resulting in infiltrative cardiomyopathy and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (HFpEF), is caused by extracellular deposition of amyloid fibrils in the heart. Even though this has been known for an extended period, its prevalence in elderly patients with heart failure is increasingly being recognized. Recent advances in diagnosis with non-invasive methods like technetium pyrophosphate-labeled cardiac scintigraphy (i.e., Tc-PYP scan) and treatment options with tafamidis have played a pivotal role in awareness of the burden of this disease. Management of cardiac complications like heart failure, atrial arrhythmias, conduction block, ventricular arrhythmias, coronary artery disease, and aortic stenosis is now more critical than ever. We aim to review and outline the recent advances in diagnoses of CA. We also review management strategies for cardiac complications of CA with a brief summary of disease-modifying therapies.
review_content:
An excellent report in reviewing the key aspects of cardiac amyloidosis focusing on recent advances and current literature. All statements appear to be factual, and the language is appropriate.

It has detailed recommendations of recent advances in management with adequate and appropriate citations and the conclusions are made in accordance with the current literature.
paper_title_zh: 心脏淀粉样变诊断的最新进展、其心脏并发症的治疗及疾病修饰疗法的综述
paper_abstract_zh: 心脏淀粉样变性（CA）是一种导致浸润性心肌病和射血分数保留的心力衰竭（HFpEF）的重要疾病，由心脏内细胞外淀粉样纤维沉积引起。尽管这一现象已被认识多年，但在老年心力衰竭患者中的患病率正逐渐被重视。近年来，通过非侵入性方法如锝焦磷酸盐标记的心脏闪烁扫描（即Tc-PYP扫描）在诊断上的进步，以及使用tafamidis的治疗方案，对提高对该病负担的认识起到了关键作用。管理心脏并发症如心力衰竭、房性心律失常、传导阻滞、室性心律失常、冠状动脉疾病和主动脉瓣狭窄如今比以往任何时候都更为重要。我们旨在回顾并概述CA诊断的最新进展。同时，我们也回顾了CA心脏并发症的管理策略，并对疾病修饰疗法进行了简要总结。
review_content_zh:
一份优秀的报告，回顾了心脏淀粉样变的关键方面，重点关注近期进展和当前文献。所有陈述均属实，语言恰当。

该报告详细介绍了管理方面的最新进展，并附有充分且恰当的引用，结论与当前文献相符。

reasons: An excellent report in reviewing the key aspects of cardiac amyloidosis focusing on recent advances and current literature.
It has detailed recommendations of recent advances in management with adequate and appropriate citations and the conclusions are made in accordance with the current literature.
All statements appear to be factual, and the language is appropriate.

paper_title: A systematic approach to mapping longitudinal data usage: Reflections on tracking Millennium Cohort Study activity
paper_abstract:
Background: The Millennium Cohort Study is the youngest of the UK’s four national birth cohort studies, but the only study (to our knowledge) where a systematic approach to exploring data usage has been undertaken. 
 Methods: In this paper we: (i) explore previous exercises and provide justification for our approach; (ii) share headline findings of our research, (iii) outline the challenges of intersecting systematic review methods with survey design methods; and (iv) discuss the implications for future survey design as well as for future exercises tracking survey data usage. All of the results were obtained through undertaking systematic searches across 30 databases which generated over 4000 results. We then searched these records, first on title and abstract and then on the full text and extracted data on studies that fell within our specific areas of interest. 
 Results: A total of 481 studies were identified as using MCS data in novel analyses. Among these studies, measures that have been collected across sweeps—diet, BMI, SDQ and screen time—are all comparatively well used. Data that were collected from the child’s own reports (e.g. friendships and feelings) have seldom been utilised in comparison to data collected through parental reports and using validated tools (e.g. SDQ). Imposing thresholds on data was found to be problematic in some cases, for example for BMI, where a number of different thresholds for overweight and obesity were in use. The use of different thresholds can lead to substantial differences in the results obtained. 
 Conclusions: Longitudinal consistency in measures is key to identifying change over time, and the review helped map the degree of consistency in measures, and their utility. The findings shaped decisions around inclusion of variables in MCS7 (age 17 years), as well as the way in which existing data were deposited.
review_content:
This paper systematically examined all published literature (481 papers) that analyzed the Millennium Cohort Study (MCS) across 10 pre-selected domains. The MCS is the youngest birth cohort in the UK and will continue across the life course as others have done successfully, such as the 1958 cohort. The authors did a really nice job highlighting important ethical considerations, including the collection of data but researchers not using it. While the authors list four aims of the paper, it feels more that the paper is about identifying how the MCS papers intersect with these 10 areas. The paper is structured more like a research article, with methods and results, rather than specifically exploring the other three areas. For example, the authors mention that aim four is to “discuss the implications for future survey design”, which should be part of the discussion rather than a separate aim. There are a few other weaknesses of the paper that should be addressed.

A challenge is understanding how the 10 priority areas were chosen. While it’s understandable that all topics cannot be explored due to the sheer volume of variables at each sweep, it’s not completely clear how these 10 areas were selected. By consensus of the authors? Through discussion with experts? Policy priorities? For example, another topic could be about inequalities with a focus on poverty as the MCS over-sampled disadvantaged children. Page 10 states “ten priority areas which were selected in conjunction with the study management team”. This information should have been included in the methods rather than the discussion. Furthermore, a study limitation was that other important areas were not included, which would have helped to identify gaps in the literature.

In addition, page 6 describes the information extracted from the studies and it would have been useful to have a table of summary statistics with these data mapped across the 10 areas. For example, the SDQ, which was used across the largest number of studies, could have been completed by multiple informants and it would have been interesting to know how many studies took advantage of this aspect. On a related note, data have been collected from partners (primarily fathers), older siblings, and teachers. Due to the ethical issues raised previously about making sure that data are used, it’s important to understand how and whether researchers are using these multiple sources of information.

Another limitation is the lack of quantitative data presented in the paper, particularly when describing the results of the review. The discussion of the specific measures in the results is too general and does not provide enough of the specifics that were extracted from each study. I would have preferred that specific information about each measure, such as issues related to cut-off of BMI, be included in the body of the results rather than the section titled, “Specific issues around granularity and data usage”. The authors have raised an important point about differences in cut-offs and what that means for interpretation and implications of results. The authors mention that IOTF-generated thresholds were constructed and included in the dataset, which sounds like a good recommendation to encourage consistency across studies.

The paper would benefit from summary statistics, such as:
  * The authors make the statement: “Contrary to our expectations, we saw little evidence of granularity being ‘lost’ in this way, although this is likely a reflection of these data being underutilised.” It is challenging to understand how this was determined – through a quantitative analysis or were there specific criteria?
  * Similarly, it would be helpful if the authors could quantify utilization: “Unusually, data collected from children themselves (at age 7 years) were not well utilised,…”
Additional information that would have been useful to quantify:
  * How many studies included children who were singletons versus multiple births. A challenge of many analyses is using twins or triplets and they were often excluded. It raises the question as to whether they should be surveyed at all?
  * How many studies included data on fathers, older siblings, and teachers?
  * How many studies included information on the neighborhood context? A study on obesity could have looked at neighborhood quality and obesity.
  * How many looked at outcomes outside the ‘health’ arena in these 10 areas? Such as social, educational, or behavioral exposures or outcomes?

Here are comments specific to each section:
Abstract
 1. Is “novel” analyses necessary? Is this signifying unique analyses, meaning without duplication?
Methods
 1. Page 3, First sentence: “through an explicit” Is this supposed to be “thorough and explicit”?
 2. Page 5, “albeit with the caveats outlined in the conclusion”. This phrase is not clear – please summarize the caveats mentioned in the conclusion.
 3. Page 5, what % of the reviewers matched at different points in the selection process? Since papers were only screened if they had variables related to the topics in Table 1, it seems even more important to provide justification on how these topics were chosen. Another approach could have been to review all studies relating to the MCS (additional 258 in Figure 1) and organize the studies around themes to identify what topics have been examined versus gaps.
Results
 1. Page 6, “The total number of unique MCS studies identified was 481.” However, why is 481 not identifiable in Figure 1?
Discussion
 1. In Figure 1, it is not clear how many articles were discarded if the variable of interest was not the focus of the paper. It seems that this could be quantified.
 2. Another area to discuss is the ability of the MCS to be used in cross-cohort comparisons – how do the variables compare across UK cohorts or across cohorts from other countries? Data will be utilized by more researchers if they can be compared across multiple domains.
paper_title_zh: 系统化方法绘制纵向数据使用图：对追踪千年队列研究活动的反思
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：千年队列研究是英国四大全国出生队列研究中最年轻的一项，但据我们所知，这是唯一一项系统探讨数据使用情况的研究。
方法：在本文中，我们：(i) 探讨了以往的实践并为我们方法提供依据；(ii) 分享了我们研究的主要发现；(iii) 概述了系统综述方法与调查设计方法交叉的挑战；以及(iv) 讨论了对未来调查设计以及追踪调查数据使用情况的未来实践的启示。所有结果均通过在30个数据库中进行系统检索获得，生成了超过4000条结果。我们随后对这些记录进行了检索，首先根据标题和摘要，然后根据全文，并提取了属于我们特定兴趣领域的研究数据。
结果：共有481项研究被识别为在创新分析中使用了MCS数据。在这些研究中，跨多个阶段收集的测量指标——饮食、BMI、SDQ和屏幕时间——都得到了相对较好的利用。与通过父母报告和使用验证工具（例如SDQ）收集的数据相比，从孩子自身报告（例如友谊和感受）中收集的数据很少被利用。在某些情况下，对数据施加阈值被发现存在问题，例如对于BMI，存在多种不同的超重和肥胖阈值。使用不同的阈值可能导致获得的结果存在显著差异。
结论：测量指标的纵向一致性是识别随时间变化的关键，本次综述帮助绘制了测量指标一致性的程度及其效用。这些发现影响了关于MCS7（17岁）中变量纳入的决策，以及现有数据的存储方式。
review_content_zh:
**以下是对review_content的中文翻译：**

本文系统地审查了所有已发表的文献（共481篇），这些文献分析了千年队列研究（MCS）在10个预先选定的领域。MCS是英国最年轻的出生队列，并将继续贯穿整个生命周期，正如1958年队列研究成功所做的那样。作者在强调重要的伦理考量方面做得非常好，包括数据的收集但研究人员未使用的情况。尽管作者列出了本文的四个目标，但感觉本文更多的是在识别MCS论文与这10个领域的交叉点。本文的结构更像是一篇研究文章，包含方法和结果，而不是专门探讨其他三个领域。例如，作者提到第四个目标是“讨论对未来调查设计的启示”，这应该是讨论部分的内容，而不是一个单独的目标。本文还有一些其他弱点需要解决。

一个挑战是理解这10个优先领域是如何选择的。虽然由于每次调查的变量数量庞大，无法探索所有主题是可以理解的，但这10个领域是如何选定的并不完全清楚。是通过作者共识？与专家讨论？还是政策优先？例如，另一个主题可以是关于不平等，重点关注贫困，因为MCS对弱势儿童进行了过采样。第10页提到“与研究报告管理团队共同选定的10个优先领域”。这些信息应该包含在方法部分而不是讨论部分。此外，研究的局限性在于未包括其他重要领域，这有助于识别文献中的空白。

此外，第6页描述了从研究中提取的信息，如果有一个汇总统计表，将这些数据映射到10个领域会很有用。例如，SDQ在最多的研究中使用，可以由多个信息提供者完成，了解有多少研究利用了这一方面会很有趣。相关地，数据已从伴侣（主要是父亲）、年长的兄弟姐妹和教师处收集。由于之前提到的确保数据使用的伦理问题，了解研究人员如何以及是否使用这些多源信息非常重要。

另一个局限性是本文缺乏定量数据的呈现，特别是在描述审查结果时。结果中对具体措施的讨论过于笼统，没有提供从每项研究中提取的具体细节。我更希望关于每个措施的具体信息，例如与BMI截止点相关的问题，能包含在结果主体中，而不是在标题为“关于粒度和数据使用的具体问题”的部分。作者提出了一个重要观点，即截止点的差异对结果解释和启示的影响。作者提到IOTF生成的阈值被构建并包含在数据集中，这听起来是一个鼓励研究间一致性的好建议。

本文将受益于汇总统计，例如：
* 作者声明：“与我们的预期相反，我们几乎没有看到粒度以这种方式‘丢失’的证据，尽管这可能是这些数据未被充分利用的反映。”难以理解这是如何确定的——通过定量分析还是有具体标准？
* 同样，如果作者能量化利用率会很有帮助：“不同寻常的是，从儿童自身（7岁时）收集的数据未被充分利用，……”
其他有用的量化信息包括：
* 有多少研究包括了单胎和双胎或多胎儿童。许多分析的挑战在于使用双胎或三胎，他们通常被排除。这引发了是否应该对他们进行调查的问题。
* 有多少研究包括了关于父亲、年长兄弟姐妹和教师的数据？
* 有多少研究包括了关于邻里环境的信息？例如，一项关于肥胖的研究可以考察邻里质量和肥胖。
* 有多少研究在这些10个领域之外考察了“健康”领域之外的结局？例如社会、教育或行为暴露或结局？

以下是针对各部分的具体评论：
**摘要**
1. “新颖”分析是否必要？这是否意味着独特的分析，即没有重复？
**方法**
1. 第3页，第一句：“通过明确的”这是否应该是“彻底且明确的”？
2. 第5页，“尽管结论中概述了注意事项”。这句话不清楚——请总结结论中提到的注意事项。
3. 第5页，在不同选择阶段的评审者匹配百分比是多少？由于只有当论文包含与表1中主题相关的变量时才会进行筛选，似乎更有必要提供这些主题选择依据的说明。另一种方法可能是审查所有与MCS相关的研究（图1中额外的258项），并围绕主题组织研究，以识别已考察的主题与空白。
**结果**
1. 第6页，“识别出的独特MCS研究总数为481项。”然而，为什么图1中无法识别出481项？
**讨论**
1. 在图1中，不清楚如果感兴趣的变量不是论文的重点，有多少文章被丢弃。这似乎是可以量化的。
2. 另一个要讨论的领域是MCS用于跨队列比较的能力——这些变量在英国队列间或与其他国家的队列比较如何？如果数据可以在多个领域进行比较，将有更多研究人员使用这些数据。

In Figure 1, it is not clear how many articles were discarded if the variable of interest was not the focus of the paper. It seems that this could be quantified.

In addition, page 6 describes the information extracted from the studies and it would have been useful to have a table of summary statistics with these data mapped across the 10 areas.

paper_title: Making science public: a review of journalists’ use of Open Access research
paper_abstract: Science journalists are uniquely positioned to increase the societal impact of open research outputs by contextualizing and communicating findings in ways that highlight their relevance and implications for non-specialist audiences. Yet, it is unclear to what degree journalists use open research outputs, such as open access publications or preprints, in their reporting; what factors motivate or constrain this use; and how the recent surge in openly available research seen during the COVID-19 pandemic has affected this. This article examines these questions through a review of relevant literature published from 2018 onwards—particularly literature relating to the COVID-19 pandemic—as well as seminal articles outside the search dates. We find that research that explicitly examines journalists’ engagement with open access publications or preprints is scarce, with existing literature mostly addressing the topic tangentially or as a secondary concern, rather than a primary focus. Still, the limited body of evidence points to several factors that may hamper journalists’ use of these outputs and thus warrant further exploration. These include an overreliance on traditional criteria for evaluating scientific quality; concerns about the trustworthiness of open research outputs; and challenges using and verifying the findings. We also find that, while the COVID-19 pandemic encouraged journalists to explore open research outputs such as preprints, the extent to which these explorations will become established journalistic practices remains unclear. Furthermore, we note that current research is overwhelmingly authored and focused on the Global North, and the United States specifically. We conclude with recommendations for future research that attend to issues of equity and diversity, and more explicitly examine the intersections of open access and science journalism.
review_content:
This is a timely and relevant article, especially since open science is an essential discussion in the scholarly community. The UNESCO Open Science recommendations highlight the importance of the accessibility of science to the broader public. As mentioned in the article, it is, however, not always possible for the general public to understand highly specialized scientific articles, and science journalism can be really beneficial in bringing complex knowledge in a simpler form to people. In this regard, the accessibility of scholarly articles to journalists is an important consideration and enabler as well. So, how open access is enabling better science journalism needs to be understood. However, as a scholar who studies open science from a different perspective, my knowledge of science journalism and related literature is not adequate to evaluate the quality of the literature review provided here. Also, I assume that this article is a review of literature addressing science journalism and open science, not "a review of a review of...".

This article presents a review of literature that mainly addresses the questions of open access rather than the broader concept of open science. Open science is a much broader concept where open access is an element. So unless the literature addresses the use of other elements, such as open data, code, etc., by the science journalists, in a more accurate sense, this article tracks mostly the use of open-access research by journalists. Using open science and open access interchangeably does not help the cause of open science as a broad concept.

Since 'Altmetrics' is becoming increasingly popular in assessing the impact of research, especially on society, reporting any study by journalists' impact on the altmetric scores will be an interesting observation.

The method and value of science is deeply rooted in the peer-review process. As indicated by the cold fusion reporting through preprint and the recent controversy of widespread coverage of the LK-99 as the potential superconductor (not mentioned in the present article), indicates the problematic nature of covering preprint by SJs. Also, how the newer trend of peer-reviewed preprints are used by the SJs and how these newer model of publications can be used to remove confusion regarding the quality of preprints could be an exciting addition to this article.
paper_title_zh: 《让科学公开：记者使用开放获取研究的综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 科学记者在将开放研究成果的社会影响最大化方面具有独特的优势，他们通过将研究发现置于相关背景中并进行传播，突出其对非专业受众的相关性和影响。然而，目前尚不清楚记者在报道中多大程度上使用了开放研究成果，如开放获取出版物或预印本；哪些因素促进了或限制了这种使用；以及COVID-19大流行期间公开可获取研究激增对此产生了何种影响。本文通过回顾2018年及以后发表的相关文献——尤其是与COVID-19大流行相关的文献——以及搜索日期之外的经典文章，探讨了这些问题。我们发现，明确研究记者与开放获取出版物或预印本互动的文献较为稀缺，现有文献大多只是间接或作为次要问题而非主要焦点来探讨这一话题。尽管如此，有限的证据指向了几个可能阻碍记者使用这些成果的因素，值得进一步探究。这些因素包括过度依赖传统科学质量评估标准；对开放研究成果可信度的担忧；以及使用和验证研究发现的挑战。我们还发现，尽管COVID-19大流行促使记者探索开放研究成果如预印本，但这种探索在多大程度上将成为确立的 journalistic practices 仍不清楚。此外，我们注意到当前研究绝大多数由全球北方国家，尤其是美国的作者撰写并聚焦于此。我们以对未来研究的建议作为结论，这些建议关注公平和多样性问题，并更明确地探讨开放获取与科学新闻业的交叉点。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇及时且相关的文章，尤其是在开放科学成为学术社区重要讨论议题的背景下。联合国教科文组织关于开放科学的建议强调了科学对更广泛公众可及性的重要性。正如文章中所提到的，然而，普通公众并不总是能够理解高度专业化的科学文章，而科学新闻业在以更简化的形式向人们传递复杂知识方面可以发挥极大作用。在这方面，学术文章对记者的可及性是一个重要的考虑因素和促进因素。因此，需要理解开放获取如何促进更好的科学新闻业。然而，作为一名从不同角度研究开放科学的学者，我对科学新闻业及相关文献的了解不足以评估此处提供的文献综述的质量。同时，我假设这篇文章是对科学新闻业和开放科学文献的综述，而不是“对综述的综述”。

本文呈现的文献综述主要探讨了开放获取的问题，而非更广泛的开放科学概念。开放科学是一个更为广泛的概念，其中开放获取只是其一个要素。因此，除非文献涉及科学记者对其他要素（如开放数据、代码等）的使用，更准确地说，本文主要追踪了记者对开放获取研究的利用。将开放科学与开放获取互换使用，并不有助于推动作为广泛概念的开放科学。

由于“替代计量学”（Altmetrics）在评估研究影响，尤其是对社会的影响方面越来越受欢迎，报道记者对任何研究的报道对替代计量分数的影响将是一个有趣的观察。

科学的方法和价值深深植根于同行评审过程。正如通过预印本报道的冷聚变和最近广泛报道的LK-99作为潜在超导体的争议（本文未提及）所表明的，科学记者（SJs）报道预印本存在问题的性质。此外，科学记者如何利用新兴的同行评审预印本趋势，以及这些新型出版物如何用于消除关于预印本质量的混淆，可能是本文的一个令人兴奋的补充。

paper_title: Modifiable factors associated with weight regain after bariatric surgery: a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background:  Although bariatric surgery is the most effective treatment for severe obesity, weight regain may still occur. While non-modifiable factors associated with weight regain have been explored, modifiable factors responsible for weight regain are understudied. This scoping review aimed to identify modifiable behaviors associated with weight regain after bariatric surgery. 
 Methods:  A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Google Scholar, Cochrane, National Collaborating Centre for Methods and Tools (NCCMT) and Practice-based Evidence in Nutrition (PEN) which included articles published between January 1990 and February 2 2017, for studies examining “weight regain” after bariatric surgery. A total of 293 citations were retrieved. Eligible articles must have examined modifiable factors and addressed weight regain, or a long-term post-operative phase in which weight regain may occur. After removing duplicates, 22 studies were included for thematic analysis. 
 Results:  Key modifiable factors associated with weight regain were identified and categorized under the following themes: poor dietary adherence (e.g. excessive calorie, carbohydrate, and alcohol intake), maladaptive eating behaviors (e.g. grazing, binging), lack of on-going follow-up with the bariatric team and insufficient physical activity. 
 Conclusions:  Health professionals and self-monitoring tools for patients who have undergone bariatric surgery may benefit from these findings to direct their education and interventions to target behavior change.
review_content:
Thank you very much for the opportunity to review this manuscript. The authors conducted a scoping review of the literature from 1990 to 2017 identify the modifiable factors associated with weight regain following bariatric surgery. I commend the authors on exploring this important topic as the issue of weight regain after bariatric surgery is gaining increased importance with over 215,000 primary bariatric procedures performed per year in USA 1.

To help situate this manuscript in the current literature, I would suggest for the authors to define two distinct patient populations following bariatric surgery: (1) individuals who were initially successful in losing weight and have regained some or all of weight previously lost, and (2) individuals who have failed to lose the appropriate percentage of weight post-op. These two patient populations are different and respond differently to additional weight loss interventions. Defining these would help the readers understand which patients this review is focused on (i.e. # 1).

I would encourage the authors to better define weight regain in this manuscript. At present, it is unclear what cut-off is being used to define weight regain (i.e. gaining 5% of maximum weight lost vs regaining all of the weight previously lost). A recent study in JAMA suggested reporting weight regain as percentage of maximum weight lost as this parameter appeared to perform better for association with most clinical outcomes than the alternatives examined [2].

In addition, I would encourage the authors to write a paragraph in the introduction section of the manuscript discussing obesity as a chronic disease, which, as other chronic diseases, will require multiple interventions over the person's lifetime to treat. The Obesity Medicine Association defined obesity as "a chronic, relapsing, multifactorial, neurobehavioral disease, wherein an increase in body fat promotes adipose tissue dysfunction and abnormal fat mass physical forces, resulting in adverse metabolic, biomechanical, and psychosocial health consequences." Framing your discussion around this contemporary definition of obesity would help the readers understand why lifestyle, pharmacotherapy and surgery are all important treatments for patients with obesity.

Lastly, I would like to make a couple of suggestions for minor revisions to the manuscript:
 1. Introduction: The authors note that "Bariatric surgery has been established as a promising treatment option for severe obesity "; however, I would argue that bariatric surgery is a proven treatment for severe obesity with over 20 years of outcomes data. I suggest revising the wording.
 2. Introduction: The authors report that "Studies have estimated an average of 56% of patients regain weight within two years of their surgery, and about one in four fail to achieve the average expected weight loss and begin to regain weight from their lowest post-operative weight, following the first post-operative year." This statement needs to be clarified in the context of my prior comments about the definition of weight regain. In the current form, it makes it seem that most of the patients regain weight after surgery, suggesting that surgery is not effective. This is false and can contribute to the biases among the health care providers that surgery is not effective. In a recent study from Kothari and colleagues, reported on 10 year follow-up post bariatric surgery on > 70% of patients 3. They reported a 56% EWL at 10 years post gastric bypass - confirming durability of the results after this operation.
 3. In the discussion section, please consider discussing why patients should be educated about abstinence from alcohol after malabsorptive bariatric operations (in addition to possible weight regain) and changes in alcohol metabolism post gastric bypass.
 4. Discussion: Given the finding of frequency of follow-up being associated with weight loss outcomes, please consider discussing how the health care system and health care providers can address the need for ongoing follow-up of bariatric surgery patients in a resource constrained environment of a publicly funded Canadian health care system? Why should be following these patients? How long and how often?
paper_title_zh: 与减重手术后体重反弹相关的可修改因素：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：尽管减重手术是治疗严重肥胖最有效的方法，但体重反弹仍可能发生。虽然已探讨了与体重反弹相关的不可改变因素，但对导致体重反弹的可改变因素的研究较少。本范围综述旨在识别与减重手术后体重反弹相关的可改变行为。

方法：在Medline、Google Scholar、Cochrane、国家协作中心方法与工具（NCCMT）和基于实践的营养证据（PEN）中进行了系统检索，包括1990年1月至2017年2月2日发表的关于减重手术后“体重反弹”的研究文章。共检索到293篇引文。符合条件的研究必须探讨了可改变因素并涉及体重反弹，或术后长期阶段可能发生体重反弹的情况。去除重复项后，纳入22项研究进行主题分析。

结果：识别并归类了与体重反弹相关的关键可改变因素，包括以下主题：饮食依从性差（如过量摄入卡路里、碳水化合物和酒精）、适应不良的进食行为（如零星进食、暴饮暴食）、缺乏与减重团队的持续随访以及身体活动不足。

结论：健康专业人士和接受减重手术患者的自我监测工具可能从这些发现中受益，以指导其教育和干预措施，针对行为改变进行靶向治疗。
review_content_zh:
非常感谢有机会审阅这篇稿件。作者对1990年至2017年的文献进行了范围综述，以识别与减重手术后体重反弹相关的可修改因素。我赞赏作者探讨这一重要话题，因为在美国每年进行的超过215,000例初级减重手术中，术后体重反弹的问题正日益受到重视[1]。

为了帮助将这篇稿件置于当前文献中，我建议作者定义减重手术后两个不同的患者群体：（1）最初成功减重但已部分或全部反弹至先前减重水平的个体，以及（2）术后未能减掉适当比例体重的个体。这两类患者群体不同，对额外减重干预的反应也不同。定义这些群体将帮助读者理解本综述关注的是哪类患者（即第1类）。

我鼓励作者在这篇稿件中更好地定义体重反弹。目前，尚不清楚用于定义体重反弹的临界值是什么（即增加最大减重量的5%与完全反弹至先前减重水平）。《美国医学会杂志》上的一项近期研究建议报告体重反弹为最大减重量的百分比，因为这一参数在与其他考察的替代指标相比时，似乎在关联大多数临床结局方面表现更好[2]。

此外，我鼓励作者在稿件的引言部分撰写一段讨论，将肥胖视为一种慢性疾病，正如其他慢性疾病一样，需要通过个人一生中的多次干预来治疗。肥胖医学协会将肥胖定义为“一种慢性、复发性、多因素、神经行为性疾病，其中体脂的增加促进了脂肪组织功能障碍和异常脂肪质量物理力，导致不良的代谢、生物力学和心理社会健康后果。”围绕这一当代肥胖定义展开讨论，将帮助读者理解为什么生活方式、药物治疗和手术都是肥胖患者的重要治疗方法。

最后，我想对稿件提出一些小的修改建议：
1. 引言：作者指出“减重手术已被确立为治疗严重肥胖的有前景的治疗选择”；然而，我认为减重手术是经过20多年结局数据证明的严重肥胖治疗方法。我建议修改措辞。
2. 引言：作者报告“研究表明，平均有56%的患者在术后两年内体重反弹，大约四分之一的患者未能达到平均预期减重，并从术后最低体重开始反弹，这一现象发生在术后第一年后。”这一陈述需要在我先前关于体重反弹定义的评论背景下进行澄清。目前的表述让人觉得大多数患者在术后体重反弹，暗示手术无效。这是错误的，可能会加剧医疗保健提供者认为手术无效的偏见。在Kothari及其同事的一项近期研究中，报告了超过70%的患者在减重手术后10年的随访结果[3]。他们报告在胃旁路术后10年有56%的EWL（多余体重减轻），证实了该手术结果的持久性。
3. 在讨论部分，请考虑讨论为什么应教育患者在吸收不良性减重手术后戒酒（除了可能的体重反弹）以及胃旁路术后酒精代谢的变化。
4. 讨论：鉴于随访频率与减重结局相关的发现，请考虑讨论在资源受限的加拿大公共资助医疗保健系统中，医疗保健系统和医疗保健提供者如何满足减重手术患者持续随访的需求？为什么应该对这些患者进行随访？随访多长时间以及多频繁？

paper_title: Graph Reinforcement Learning for Combinatorial Optimization: A Survey and Unifying Perspective
paper_abstract: Graphs are a natural representation for systems based on relations between connected entities. Combinatorial optimization problems, which arise when considering an objective function related to a process of interest on discrete structures, are often challenging due to the rapid growth of the solution space. The trial-and-error paradigm of Reinforcement Learning has recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional methods, such as exact algorithms and (meta)heuristics, for discovering better decision-making strategies in a variety of disciplines including chemistry, computer science, and statistics. Despite the fact that they arose in markedly different fields, these techniques share significant commonalities. Therefore, we set out to synthesize this work in a unifying perspective that we term Graph Reinforcement Learning, interpreting it as a constructive decision-making method for graph problems. After covering the relevant technical background, we review works along the dividing line of whether the goal is to optimize graph structure given a process of interest, or to optimize the outcome of the process itself under fixed graph structure. Finally, we discuss the common challenges facing the field and open research questions. In contrast with other surveys, the present work focuses on non-canonical graph problems for which performant algorithms are typically not known and Reinforcement Learning is able to provide efficient and effective solutions.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This submission does indeed deliver what its title promises. I am not in a position to (1) check that the provided summaries of papers are accurate or (2) that important work has not been missed. So I am prepared to trust the authors on both these counts; there are certainly many relevant papers discussed. Evidently many people are interested in applying RL methods to combinatorial optimisation (CO) problems, so this survey will be of some help to such people. However, summarising a bunch of relevant papers (although necessary) is not a sufficient reason for publication of a survey paper: we also need an insightful analysis of the state-of-the-art. The following statement lays out the authors' approach to their survey. "With a few exceptions, even though work on such benchmark problems is important for pushing the limitations of ML-based methods, currently they cannot directly compete with well-established, highly optimized heuristic and exact solvers. This article is therefore complementary to other surveys (Mazyavkina et al., 2021; Wang & Tang, 2021) and perspectives (Bengio et al., 2021; Cappart et al., 2021) on RL for combinatorial optimization, both in terms of proposing a unifying paradigm and its focus on non-canonical problems." So the current version is deliberately "internal": with a focus on comparing different RL methods, rather than also comparing RL to non-RL methods. For sure, non-RL methods are mentioned, but the reader does not go away from this paper with a good understanding of the competing merits of RL and non-RL for CO.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
And unfortunately, the 4 cited surveys do not provide such an unerstanding. Mazyavkina et al make poor choices of non-RL to compare to. I doubt that the Concord TSP solver would have trouble exactly solving the 100 node problems they consider. Wang & Tang do a better job and use better comparators, but I suspect that the times they report for exact solvers (for eg TSP) is the time these solvers take to terminate and provide a certificate of optimality rather than how long it takes them to merely find an optimal solution (a much quicker task). The other two papers do not do comparisons. Also all these papers are 3 years old. So the current paper is a missed opportunity to fill a gap (I'm not aware of a recent paper properly comparing RL to non-RL methods for CO). We sometimes get vague comments which might lead one to believe that RL is the preferred option: "The novelty of casting problems as MDPs and using RL is often deemed a sufficient contribution, especially as this methodology can already yield gains in evaluation metrics compared to classic techniques." and "The trial-and-error paradigm of Reinforcement Learning has recently emerged as a promising alternative to traditional methods, such as exact algorithms and (meta)heuristics," If there are positive results for RL compared to some sensible non-RL method, we should be pointed to the papers which provide those results. The authors are not guilty of explicitly over-selling RL for CO, for example, they state: (1) ".. the application of RL to graph combinatorial optimization problems is still a nascent area of investigation", (2) "CD-UCT was shown to substantially outperform RL-BIC even with orders of magnitude fewer score function evaluations, and also to compare favorably to Greedy Search." Comparing "favourably" (which usually means similar performance) to greedy search is nothing to get excited about. and (3) "Considering the current popularity of RL, one might also ask if their application in this problem space is an instance of Maslow's hammer (Maslow, 1966)". The problem is a lack of comparison to non-RL methods. EXACT METHODS Brute force search is indeed an exact method but no one uses it, so why even mention it? "Typically, exact methods only work well for small to medium-sized problem instances." This is misleading. From Concorde page: "Concorde's TSP solver has been used to obtain the optimal solutions to all 110 of the TSPLIB instances; the largest having 85,900 cities." I found it odd that the connection between dynamic programming (an exact method) and RL/MDPs was not explored. STYLE OF WRITING The content is at time very elementary, with basic definition of graphs and what an adjacency matrix is. Do we really need an explanation of search trees? and greedy search? I'm neutral about this: I suspect most readers won't need it, but it's not a problem, since people can just skip over it. MINOR POINTS Using R for the reward function (and expected reward) and R_t to denote the actual reward at time t is not great notation. (Murphy (PML Book2) uses r_t to denote the actual reward at time t, which is clearer. "One important distinction is that between model-based algorithms (which assume knowledge of the MDP)" This is wrong and is contradicted by later text which correctly states that the model is learned not assumed. On a similar point: "Recall the fact that, in the case of model-based methods, we have access to the transition function P and reward function R." should be something like: "Recall the fact that, in the case of model-based methods, we have access to the (possibly estimated) transition function P and (possibly estimated) reward function R." p27: less environment interactions -> fewer environment interactions

**Requested Changes:**
As explained above, without a proper comparison of RL and non-RL methods provided somewhere, the current RL-specific survey is too narrow. The authors should either find an existing paper or they will be obliged to do it themselves. I understand it is hard work to do empirical comparisons, but I think it is necessary. It would also be preferable (but not critical) to connect any empirical findings to an understanding of why a particular RL algorithm (or RL methods in general) perform (comparatively) well. I don't think Section 5 went into this deeply enough.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to Reviewer YnH3: We thank the reviewer for taking the time to consider our paper. Please find below our responses to the points that were raised. > […] the current paper is a missed opportunity to fill a gap (I'm not aware of a recent paper properly comparing RL to non-RL methods for CO). […] If there are positive results for RL compared to some sensible non-RL method, we should be pointed to the papers which provide those results. […] As explained above, without a proper comparison of RL and non-RL methods provided somewhere, the current RL-specific survey is too narrow. The authors should either find an existing paper or they will be obliged to do it themselves. I understand it is hard work to do empirical comparisons, but I think it is necessary. We agree that there is a gap in the literature regarding empirical comparisons of RL versus non-RL methods for CO problems. This point was also raised by Reviewer KJw5. The focus of our article is the proposal of a unifying paradigm and a critical survey of the existing literature. In the previous version of the paper, we failed to underline the fact that the superiority of RL vs non-RL solutions for certain problems has been proven in the literature through several experimental studies. Empirical comparisons are typically carried out within the evaluations of the papers themselves so as to argue for the adoption of RL as a methodology. Some examples worth mentioning (which we have underlined in the revised version of the article) are: - *Attacking GNNs via rewiring*: Dai et al. 2018 and Ma et al. 2021 show superior performance over random rewiring and (in some settings) a genetic algorithm. - *Network design*: Yang et al. 2023b outperform hill climbing, simulated annealing, greedy search, and an evolutionary algorithm. - *Network games*: Darvariu et al. 2021b outperform simulated annealing, a distributed search algorithm, the standard game-theoretic best-response technique, and heuristics based on local node properties (targeting high-degree nodes and lower-cost nodes). - *Spreading processes*: Meirom et al. 2021 outperform heuristics based on local node properties (degree, discounted-degree, and eigenvector centralities) and the LIR algorithm for influence maximization. - *Search and navigation*: for knowledge base completion, Shen et al. 2018 outperform several widely used methods that learn vector representations of entities and relations (TransE, TransR, DistMult, ComplEx, ConvE). **Changes made**: we have added examples of problems for which RL can do better than non-RL to the Introduction, as these were missing entirely. We have also added a discussion in the newly formed Section 6 about problems for which a RL solution is preferrable and those for which it is not, in order to provide a balanced view of the landscape in this area. This section also points to the gap in the literature regarding comparisons of RL and non-RL approaches beyond the scope of each individual paper. > We sometimes get vague comments which might lead one to believe that RL is the preferred option […] As the reviewer themselves acknowledges, “many people are interested in applying RL methods to CO problems, so this survey will be of some help to such people.” We think that the interest in applying RL to CO problems is not only related to the recent rise in popularity of RL, but it is motivated by promising results for problems for which we typically have had to settle for heuristics and metaheuristics, as in the cases listed above. Indeed, superior combinatorial optimization algorithms may emerge in the future, but we would argue that this survey provides a picture of the state-of-the-art for the considered problems. In our opinion, our work goes well beyond “summarizing a bunch of relevant papers”. We had attempted to make the previous version of the work rather balanced, as recognized by the reviewer, who states “the authors are not guilty of explicitly over-selling RL for CO”. In the new version, we have expanded the discussion about the type of problems for which RL is the best solution and those for which the application of RL does not lead to better performance when compared to existing methods. **Changes made**: we have modified the vague statements (e.g., in Sections 1 and 5.1.3) that may be read as suggesting that RL is a superior means of approaching CO problems in general. As mentioned above, we have also added a discussion in Section 6.2 about problems in which a RL solution is not preferrable in order to provide a balanced view of the landscape in this area.
paper_title_zh: 图强化学习在组合优化中的应用：综述与统一视角
paper_abstract_zh: 图是表示基于连接实体之间关系的系统的自然形式。组合优化问题在考虑与离散结构上感兴趣的过程相关的目标函数时出现，通常由于解空间迅速增长而具有挑战性。近年来，强化学习的试错范式作为一种有前景的替代方法，出现在传统方法（如精确算法和（元）启发式方法）之外，用于在化学、计算机科学和统计学等多个学科中发现更好的决策策略。尽管这些技术起源于明显不同的领域，但它们之间存在显著的共性。因此，我们着手从统一的角度综合这项工作，我们称之为图强化学习，将其解释为图问题的建设性决策方法。在涵盖相关技术背景之后，我们回顾了沿着以下分界线的工作：目标是优化给定感兴趣过程的图结构，还是优化在固定图结构下过程本身的结局。最后，我们讨论了该领域面临的共同挑战和开放的研究问题。与其他综述不同，当前工作专注于非典型图问题，对于这些问题，通常没有已知的高效算法，而强化学习能够提供高效且有效的解决方案。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这篇投稿确实如其标题所承诺的那样。我无法（1）检查所提供的论文摘要是否准确，也无法（2）确认是否有重要工作被遗漏。因此，我准备在这两点上信任作者；文中确实讨论了许多相关论文。显然，许多人对将强化学习（RL）方法应用于组合优化（CO）问题感兴趣，因此这篇综述对这些人会有所帮助。然而，总结一堆相关论文（尽管是必要的）并不足以成为发表综述论文的理由：我们还需要对当前技术水平进行有洞察力的分析。以下声明阐述了作者进行综述的方法。“除少数例外，尽管在基准问题上的工作对于推动基于ML的方法的局限性很重要，但目前它们无法直接与成熟且高度优化的启发式和精确求解器竞争。因此，本文是对其他关于RL在组合优化中的综述（Mazyavkina等人，2021年；Wang & Tang，2021年）和观点（Bengio等人，2021年；Cappart等人，2021年）的补充，既提出了一个统一范式，又聚焦于非典型问题。”因此，当前版本是故意“内部的”：专注于比较不同的RL方法，而不是同时比较RL和非RL方法。当然，提到了非RL方法，但读者在读完这篇文章后，并不能很好地理解RL和非RL在CO中的竞争优劣势。

**优点和缺点：**
不幸的是，所引用的4篇综述并未提供这样的理解。Mazyavkina等人选择了较差的非RL方法进行比较。我怀疑Concord TSP求解器在精确解决他们考虑的100节点问题上不会有困难。Wang & Tang做得更好，使用了更好的比较对象，但我怀疑他们报告的精确求解器（例如TSP）的时间是这些求解器终止并提供最优性证明的时间，而不是它们仅仅找到最优解所需的时间（这是一个更快的过程）。其他两篇论文没有进行比较。此外，这些论文都是3年前的。因此，当前论文错失了一个填补空白的机会（据我所知，没有一篇近期论文正确比较了RL和非RL方法在CO中的应用）。 我们有时会收到一些模糊的评论，可能会让人认为强化学习（RL）是首选方案：“将问题表述为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）并使用强化学习通常被认为是一种足够的贡献，尤其是这种方法在评估指标上已经能够比传统技术带来提升。”以及“强化学习的试错范式最近作为一种有前景的替代方案出现，取代了传统方法，如精确算法和（元）启发式算法。”如果与某种合理的非RL方法相比，RL有积极结果，我们应该被指向提供这些结果的论文。作者并没有明确过度推销RL在组合优化（CO）中的应用，例如，他们指出：（1）“将RL应用于图组合优化问题仍然是一个新兴的研究领域”，（2）“CD-UCT被证明即使在评分函数评估次数少几个数量级的情况下，也显著优于RL-BIC，并且与贪婪搜索相比也表现良好。”与贪婪搜索“表现良好”（通常意味着性能相似）没有什么值得兴奋的，（3）“考虑到RL当前的流行程度，人们可能还会问，它们在这一问题空间的应用是否是马斯洛锤（Maslow, 1966）的一个实例”。问题在于缺乏与非RL方法的比较。精确方法暴力搜索确实是一种精确方法，但没有人使用它，那为什么还要提到它呢？“通常，精确方法只适用于中小规模的问题实例。”这是误导性的。从Concorde页面：“Concorde的TSP求解器已被用于获得所有110个TSPLIB实例的最优解；最大的实例包含85,900个城市。”我发现动态规划（一种精确方法）与RL/MDP之间的联系没有被探讨，这很奇怪。写作风格内容有时非常基础，包括图的基本定义和邻接矩阵是什么。我们真的需要解释搜索树和贪婪搜索吗？对此我持中立态度：我怀疑大多数读者不需要这些，但这不是问题，因为人们可以跳过这些内容。次要问题使用R表示奖励函数（及期望奖励），使用R_t表示时间t时的实际奖励，这种符号表示并不理想。（Murphy在《PML Book2》中使用r_t表示时间t时的实际奖励，这更清晰。）“一个重要的区别是模型-based算法（假设已知MDP）”这是错误的，并且与后文相矛盾，后文正确地指出模型是学习的而非假设已知的。类似地：“回想一下，在模型-based方法的情况下，我们可以访问转移函数P和奖励函数R。”应该改为：“回想一下，在模型-based方法的情况下，我们可以访问（可能是估计的）转移函数P和（可能是估计的）奖励函数R。”第27页：less environment interactions -> fewer environment interactions **请求的修改：**
如上所述，如果没有在某处提供对RL和非RL方法的适当比较，当前的RL特定综述过于狭隘。作者要么找到一篇现有的论文，要么将不得不自己进行这项工作。我理解进行实证比较是艰苦的工作，但我认为这是必要的。如果能将任何实证发现与理解特定RL算法（或RL方法总体）表现（相对）良好的原因联系起来，那将是更好的（但不是关键的）。我认为第5节对此探讨得不够深入。

是的

是的

回复评审员YnH3：感谢评审员花时间考虑我们的论文。请见下方我们对所提问题的回应。> […] 当前的论文错失了填补一个空白的机会（我不清楚是否有近期论文对RL和非RL方法在CO问题上进行了适当比较）。[…] 如果有关于RL相对于某些合理的非RL方法的积极结果，我们应该被指向提供这些结果的论文。[…] 如上所述，如果没有在某处提供对RL和非RL方法的适当比较，当前的RL特定综述过于狭隘。作者要么找到一篇现有的论文，要么将不得不自己进行这项工作。我理解进行实证比较是艰苦的工作，但我认为这是必要的。我们同意在文献中确实存在关于RL与非RL方法在CO问题上实证比较的空白。这一点也被评审员KJw5提出。我们文章的重点是提出一个统一范式并对现有文献进行批判性综述。在论文的前一版本中，我们未能强调一个事实，即在某些问题上，RL相对于非RL解决方案的优越性已在文献中通过多项实验研究得到证明。实证比较通常在论文本身的评估中进行，以论证采用RL作为方法论的合理性。一些值得提及的例子（我们在修订版中已强调）包括：- *通过重新布线攻击GNNs*：Dai等人2018年和Ma等人2021年展示了相对于随机重新布线和（在某些设置中）遗传算法的优越性能。- *网络设计*：Yang等人2023b优于爬山算法、模拟退火、贪婪搜索和进化算法。- *网络博弈*：Darvariu等人2021b优于模拟退火、分布式搜索算法、标准博弈论最佳响应技术和基于局部节点属性（针对高度节点和低成本节点）的启发式方法。- *传播过程*：Meirom等人2021年优于基于局部节点属性（度、折扣度和特征向量中心性）的启发式方法和用于影响力最大化的LIR算法。- *搜索与导航*：对于知识库补全，Shen等人。 2018年，该方法在实体和关系的向量表示学习方面超越了多种广泛使用的方法（如TransE、TransR、DistMult、ComplEx、ConvE）。**所做的更改**：我们在引言中添加了强化学习（RL）比非强化学习方法表现更好的问题示例，因为这些内容之前完全缺失。我们还新增加了第6节，讨论了哪些问题更适合采用强化学习解决方案，以及哪些问题不适合，以便为该领域的现状提供一个平衡的视角。该节还指出了文献中关于比较强化学习与非强化学习方法的研究空白，超出了每篇论文的范畴。> 我们有时会收到一些模糊的评论，可能会让人误以为强化学习是首选方案[…]正如评审者自己所承认的，“许多人对将强化学习方法应用于组合优化（CO）问题感兴趣，因此这份综述对这些人会有所帮助。”我们认为，将强化学习应用于组合优化问题的兴趣不仅与强化学习近期的流行有关，还受到其在一些问题上取得的有前景结果的推动，这些问题通常我们只能依赖启发式和元启发式方法，如上述案例所示。确实，未来可能会出现更优的组合优化算法，但我们认为这份综述为所考虑问题提供了当前技术水平的全景。在我们看来，我们的工作远不止“总结一堆相关论文”。我们曾试图使前一个版本的工作保持平衡，正如评审者所认可的，“作者并没有明显地过度推销强化学习在组合优化中的应用”。在新版本中，我们扩展了关于哪些问题最适合强化学习解决方案以及哪些问题应用强化学习并未比现有方法表现更好的讨论。**所做的更改**：我们修改了可能被解读为强化学习是解决组合优化问题的普遍优越方法的模糊表述（例如，在第1节和5.1.3节）。如上所述，我们还在第6.2节中添加了关于不适合采用强化学习解决方案的问题的讨论，以便为该领域的现状提供一个平衡的视角。

paper_title: Exploring Sample Size Determination in Educational Research: A Comprehensive Review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     By conducting an in-depth study of the publications, a review was conducted with the goal of evaluating the sample size in educational research. The sample size, represented by the letter “n,” is a key factor in this research because it specifies the number of participants who represent the target population. Although various studies have been published in the literature defining the processes for calculating sample sizes, there is still much uncertainty. It is vital to understand that there is no single all-encompassing method for determining sample sizes for different study designs. Instead, different study designs call for different approaches to determine sample numbers. 
   
   
     Methods 
     Information was retrieved from the databases in accordance with updated PRISMA recommendations. The keywords used for the retrieval of the relevant articles from two databases (Google Scholar and PubMed). The articles were selected by thorough scrutiny and application of inclusion and exclusion criteria. 
   
   
     Results 
     Seven articles were selected and the comparison was made among the studies in the relation to methods, objective, and outcome from the enrolled studies. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     The evaluation of the seven studies as a whole concluded that the sample size for testing any novel approach essentially required 24.24 participants in each group. The median sample size for the simulation-based educational research was 30. Further research is required to determine the proper sample size based on a single universal formula for all types of designs.
