paper_title: Know Your Self-supervised Learning: A Survey on Image-based Generative and Discriminative Training
paper_abstract: Although supervised learning has been highly successful in improving the state-of-the-art in the domain of image-based computer vision in the past, the margin of improvement has diminished significantly in recent years, indicating that a plateau is in sight. Meanwhile, the use of self-supervised learning (SSL) for the purpose of natural language processing (NLP) has seen tremendous successes during the past couple of years, with this new learning paradigm yielding powerful language models. Inspired by the excellent results obtained in the field of NLP, self-supervised methods that rely on clustering, contrastive learning, distillation, and information-maximization, which all fall under the banner of discriminative SSL, have experienced a swift uptake in the area of computer vision. Shortly afterwards, generative SSL frameworks that are mostly based on masked image modeling, complemented and surpassed the results obtained with discriminative SSL. Consequently, within a span of three years, over $100$ unique general-purpose frameworks for generative and discriminative SSL, with a focus on imaging, were proposed. In this survey, we review a plethora of research efforts conducted on image-oriented SSL, providing a historic view and paying attention to best practices as well as useful software packages. While doing so, we discuss pretext tasks for image-based SSL, as well as techniques that are commonly used in image-based SSL. Lastly, to aid researchers who aim at contributing to image-focused SSL, we outline a number of promising research directions.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This survey paper reviews a number of general-purpose frameworks for image-based self-supervised learning (SSL) that fall into the category of discriminative training. This includes clustering, contrastive learning, distillation, and information-maximization. 50+ SSL techniques are covered.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
## Strengths - The important concepts related to SSL are nicely illustrated in Figure 3, with description in Section 3. - It is good to see the one sentence summary of each of the 50+ SSL techniques. ## Weaknesses - The topic of discriminative SSL is a bit outdated, due to the fast research pace nowadays. We may use Table 8 as an evidence (the authors summarize the publication information as well as implementation details for the SSL frameworks covered in this survey), the number of papers in 2022 is significantly smaller than 2020 and 2021. In Figure 1, though SSL is shown an increasingly popular topic for the all areas according to Google Trends does not necessarily mean a similar trend for SSL in computer vision, not to mention the discriminative model family in SSL in computer vision. For the information of authors, the community seems more interested in generative SSL paradigm like MAE & BEIT, and vision-language pre-training for general and transferable visual representation learning. - There are not much new insights and discoveries in this survey, including the future directions section. Though I appreciate the hard work to compile the list and provide the summary, I am afraid that the survey would encourage much more interests in discriminative SSL. The current form of this survey can fit the format of a GitHub readme to maintain the update-to-date papers on this topic. - Some related papers on discriminative SSL are missing. One simple way to add more related papers is to check out the leaderboard "Self-Supervised Image Classification on ImageNet" on the paper-with-code website: https://paperswithcode.com/sota/self-supervised-image-classification-on As a survey paper, please at lease add all the methods from this leaderboard, which is crowdsourced by the most related community.

**Requested Changes:**
My major concern is how to attract more attention for this survey (in another word, the topic of discriminative SSL), based on the up-to-date literature and the community interests. Some suggestions: - Try to make more concrete connections with the current community interests, such as (1) generative methods for representation learning & content creation, (2) the possible integration with vision-language pre-training, which is arguably the most empirically effective in visual representation learning for recognition problems. - Think about why discriminative SSL is not so popular. One reason could be the evaluation metrics. Sticking with the so-called standard metric on "linear probing on ImageNet-1K" does not really present the full power of discriminative SSL methods. Other tasks in computer vision that are aligned with the pre-training objectives could be better downstream evaluation scenarios.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
Probably add broad discussions with other related topics, and their shared and unique impact concerns, such as compute cost.

**Claims And Evidence:**
No

**Audience:**
No

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Author response to euRx: We would like to thank the reviewer for evaluating our manuscript with great effort and sharing our enthusiasm for SSL. We are pleased to hear that the reviewer found the work on discriminative SSL informative, which was our primary objective: engaging interested readers who are inexperienced with discriminative SSL. However, as pointed out by the reviewer _(as well as reviewers xZKh and UR1h)_, our focus on discriminative training and the absence of generative frameworks resulted in a major shortcoming for readers, which we will rectify in the revised manuscript. In what follows, we will address the reviewer's concerns. **Generative SSL:** The decision to exclude generative SSL frameworks was a deliberate one on our part, and it was also reflected in the manuscript's title. However, given the reviewer's comment, we understand the relevance of generative SSL to the survey, and we will introduce generative methods as a subsection in Section 5 in a similar fashion to other self-supervision techniques (e.g., contrastive). **Shortcomings of discriminative SSL and evaluation metrics:** We agree with the reviewer that judging SSL frameworks solely based on a single benchmark (linear evaluation on ImageNet) is not fair. However, it has been the only common evaluation method for vision SSL frameworks (including generative frameworks). Our goal in using it was to report to readers the frameworks' performance on a common dataset (ImageNet) using a common evaluation method (linear probing). That being said, we share the reviewer's concern in discussing the limitations of discriminative SSL and evaluation methods. We will expand upon those topics and include a number of benchmarks for downstream transfer evaluations. **Missing frameworks:** Prompted by the reviewer's comment, we analyzed the link shared by the reviewer and found the majority of missing frameworks to be generative, which we initially did not include in the manuscript. In line with our comment above, in the revised manuscript, we will also cover those generative frameworks. **Proposed changes:** In summary, we propose making the following adjustments: - Introduce generative self-supervised learning (SSL) as a new subsection within Section 4, covering the latest advancements in the field, and update the title of the paper accordingly. - Increase the depth of content by discussing the limitations and shortcomings of discriminative SSL frameworks. - Expand Section 5 by discussing the current limitations of the evaluation methods (e.g., linear and KNN) and datasets (e.g., ImageNet) used in SSL research. In addition to the above changes, we will make the following major additions: - _(cf. feedback of M91J)_ Create a detailed table describing the datasets used for downstream transfer evaluations in SSL frameworks and describe loss functions of SSL frameworks using the notation introduced in Section 3. With the proposed changes, we hope to address the concerns raised by the reviewer regarding the manuscript's limitations. We are eager to receive feedback from the reviewer and will work diligently to incorporate any necessary revisions as soon as possible, with the aim of submitting the revised version by the first week of April.
paper_title_zh: 了解你的自监督学习：基于图像的生成式与判别式训练综述
paper_abstract_zh: 尽管在过去，监督学习在基于图像的计算机视觉领域提升现有技术水平方面取得了巨大成功，但近年来改进的幅度已显著减小，表明即将达到一个平稳期。与此同时，自监督学习（SSL）在自然语言处理（NLP）领域的应用在过去几年中取得了巨大成功，这一新的学习范式产生了强大的语言模型。受NLP领域取得的卓越成果的启发，依赖于聚类、对比学习、蒸馏和信息最大化的自监督方法，这些方法均属于判别性SSL，在计算机视觉领域迅速得到应用。不久之后，主要以掩码图像建模为基础的生成性SSL框架，补充并超越了判别性SSL所取得的结果。因此，在短短三年内，提出了超过100种独特的通用框架，专注于图像的生成性和判别性SSL。在这篇综述中，我们回顾了大量针对图像导向的SSL所进行的研究工作，提供了一个历史视角，并关注最佳实践以及有用的软件包。在此过程中，我们讨论了基于图像的SSL的预训练任务，以及图像SSL中常用的技术。最后，为了帮助那些致力于图像聚焦SSL的研究人员，我们概述了一些有前景的研究方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
这篇综述论文回顾了多种基于图像的自监督学习（SSL）通用框架，这些框架属于判别性训练类别。这包括聚类、对比学习、蒸馏和信息最大化。涵盖了50多种SSL技术。

**优点和缺点：**
## 优点
- 图3中很好地展示了与SSL相关的重要概念，并在第3节中进行了描述。
- 每种50多种SSL技术的一句总结是很有帮助的。

## 缺点
- 判别性SSL的主题略显过时，由于当前研究进展迅速。我们可以用表8作为证据（作者总结了所涵盖SSL框架的出版信息及实现细节），2022年的论文数量显著少于2020年和2021年。在图1中，尽管根据Google Trends显示SSL在所有领域都是一个日益热门的话题，但这并不一定意味着计算机视觉中的SSL也有类似的趋势，更不用说计算机视觉中SSL的判别模型家族了。对于作者的信息，社区似乎对生成式SSL范式（如MAE & BEIT）以及用于通用和可转移视觉表示学习的视觉-语言预训练更感兴趣。
- 这篇综述中并没有太多新的见解和发现，包括未来方向部分。尽管我赞赏为汇编列表和提供总结所付出的努力，但恐怕这篇综述会鼓励更多对判别性SSL的兴趣。当前形式的综述可以适合GitHub readme的格式，以维护该主题的最新论文。
- 缺少一些与判别性SSL相关的论文。一个简单的方法是查看paper-with-code网站上的“Self-Supervised Image Classification on ImageNet”排行榜：https://paperswithcode.com/sota/self-supervised-image-classification-on。作为一篇综述论文，请至少添加该排行榜上的所有方法，这是由最相关的社区众包的。

**请求的更改：**
我主要关心的是如何基于最新的文献和社区兴趣吸引更多对这篇综述（换句话说，判别性SSL主题）的关注。一些建议：
- 尝试与当前社区兴趣建立更具体的联系，例如（1）用于表示学习和内容创作的生成方法，（2）可能与视觉-语言预训练的整合，这在视觉表示学习中对识别问题无疑是经验上最有效的。
- 思考为什么判别性SSL不那么受欢迎。一个原因可能是评估指标。坚持使用所谓的标准指标“ImageNet-1K上的线性探测”并不能真正展现判别性SSL方法的全貌。计算机视觉中与预训练目标一致的其他任务可能是更好的下游评估场景。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
可能需要与其他相关主题进行广泛讨论，以及它们共同的和独特的影响关切，例如计算成本。

**主张和证据：**
无

**受众：**
无

**反驳评论：**
作者对euRx的回应：我们感谢审稿人付出巨大努力评估我们的手稿，并分享我们对SSL的热情。我们很高兴听到审稿人认为判别性SSL的工作信息丰富，这是我们主要目标：吸引对判别性SSL不熟悉的感兴趣读者。然而，正如审稿人（以及审稿人xZKh和UR1h）所指出的，我们专注于判别性训练而忽略了生成框架，这对读者来说是一个主要缺陷，我们将在修订稿中纠正。以下是我们对审稿人关切的回应。

**生成式SSL：** 排除生成式SSL框架是我们有意为之的决定，这也反映在论文标题中。然而，鉴于审稿人的评论，我们理解生成式SSL对综述的相关性，我们将在第5节中以类似其他自监督技术（例如，对比学习）的方式引入生成方法作为一个子节。

**判别性SSL的缺点和评估指标：** 我们同意审稿人的观点，仅基于单一基准（ImageNet上的线性评估）来判断SSL框架是不公平的。然而，它一直是视觉SSL框架（包括生成框架）的唯一常见评估方法。我们使用它的目标是向读者报告框架在常见数据集（ImageNet）上使用常见评估方法（线性探测）的性能。话虽如此，我们与审稿人一样关心讨论判别性SSL和评估方法的局限性。我们将扩展这些主题，并包括一些用于下游迁移评估的基准。

**缺失框架：** 受审稿人评论的启发，我们分析了审稿人分享的链接，发现大多数缺失框架是生成式的，我们最初没有包括在稿件中。根据我们上面的评论，在修订稿中，我们也将涵盖这些生成框架。

**拟议的更改：** 总的来说，我们建议进行以下调整：
- 在第4节中引入生成式自监督学习（SSL）作为一个新的子节，涵盖该领域的最新进展，并相应更新论文标题。
- 通过讨论判别性SSL框架的局限性和缺点，增加内容的深度。
- 通过讨论当前SSL研究中使用的评估方法（例如，线性和高斯混合模型）和数据集（例如，ImageNet）的局限性，扩展第5节。

除了上述更改外，我们还将进行以下主要添加：
- （参见M91J的反馈）创建一个详细表格，描述SSL框架中用于下游迁移评估的数据集，并使用第3节中引入的符号描述SSL框架的损失函数。

通过拟议的更改，我们希望解决审稿人提出的关于手稿局限性的关切。我们渴望收到审稿人的反馈，并将努力尽快纳入任何必要的修订，目标是在4月的第一周提交修订版。

paper_title: Does who I am and what I feel determine what I see (or say)? A meta-analytic systematic review exploring the influence of real and perceived bodily state on spatial perception of the external environment
paper_abstract: Background. Bodily state is theorised to play a role in perceptual scaling of the environment, whereby low bodily capacity shifts visuospatial perception, with distances appearing farther and hills steeper, and the opposite seen for high bodily capacity. This may play a protective role, whereby perceptual scaling discourages engaging with the environment when capacity is low.
review_content: Reviewer 3 Basic reporting Thank you for the opportunity to review this comprehensive and far-reaching meta-analysis, which investigates the influence of bodily state on spatial perception, under the theoretical banner of the Economy of Action Hypothesis. The authors have undertaken a large amount of work, presenting their findings extremely clearly, in a structured and thoughtful way. The categories for analysis were well defined and each aspect discussed in depth, with good use of interim summaries to unpack the broader context. Many steps were taken to ensure the robustness of the review, including pre-registration via the Open Science Framework, well defined search criteria, the inclusion of a Risk of Bias Assessment and a robust method of extracting data, including in the event of extraction from graphical forms.

paper_title: Smartphone applications are used for self-management, telerehabilitation, evaluation and data collection in low back pain healthcare: a scoping review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Smartphone use has grown in providing healthcare for patients with low back pain (LBP), but the literature lacks an analysis of the use of smartphone apps. This scoping review aimed to identify current areas of smartphone apps use for managing LBP. We also aimed to evaluate the current status of the effectiveness or scientific validity of such use and determine perspectives for their potential development. 
   
   
     Methods 
     We searched PubMed, PEDro and Embase for articles published in English up to May 3rd, 2021 that investigated smartphone use for LBP healthcare and their purpose. All types of study design were accepted. Studies concerning telemedicine or telerehabilitation but without use of a smartphone were not included. The same search strategy was performed by two researchers independently and a third researcher validated the synthesis of the included studies. 
   
   
     Results 
     We included 43 articles: randomised controlled trials (RCTs) (n=12), study protocols (n=6), reliability/validity studies (n=6), systematic reviews (n=7), cohort studies (n=4), qualitative studies (n=6), and case series (n=1). The purposes of the smartphone app were for 1) evaluation, 2) telerehabilitation, 3) self-management, and 4) data collection. Self-management was the most-studied use, showing promising results derived from moderate- to good-quality RCTs for patients with chronic LBP and patients after spinal surgery. Promising results exist regarding evaluation and data collection use and contradictory results regarding measurement use. 
   
   
     Conclusions 
     This scoping review revealed a notable interest in the scientific literatures regarding the use of smartphone apps for LBP patients. The identified purposes point to current scientific status and perspectives for further studies including RCTs and systematic reviews targeting specific usage.
review_content:
This scoping review is well written. It's an interesting work that takes stock of a current topic.

My minor remarks are the following:

Abstract:
  * Background - There is a gap between the first (too general) and second sentences.
  * Conclusions - You can't state the growing literature as you didn't really study this aspect (quantitative assessment of studies through the years).

Introduction:
  * First paragraph: Are "Navigation, video communication, gaming, and social media" the most common use of mobile phones?
  * Third paragraph: You should make a difference between LBP and chronic LBP which is in some conditions the major target of biopsychosocial management.
  * Fourth paragraph, first sentence: Does the "purpose" include overtreating?
  * You could also raise the topic of the cost and accessibility of the apps compared to usual (face-to-face) treatment.

Methods
  * Could you justify why you included studies from January 1st, 2005?

Results:
  * Use of smartphone apps for evaluation: Give a few words about PainMAP.
  * When you talk about spine surgery, specify that you are talking of "spine surgery" for low back pain.

Discussion:
  * First paragraph: To explain why the classification could be controversial, you could specify that the use of apps is multiple.
  * It's not clear why you use both the words "efficacy" and "effectiveness".
  * Second paragraph: As stated above, you can't really state about the growing literature as you didn't really study that point.
  * When you are talking of efficacy or effectiveness, specify systematically on what outcomes.
  * I don't really understand the problem of hygiene raised by the use of apps to measure RoM.
  * Last paragraph before the limits part, what about data security?

Limitations:
  * I'm not sure that the compulsive behavior is a limitation as it is not really in the scope of your review.

Conclusions:
  * Same remark about "growing literature".
paper_title_zh: 智能手机应用程序在腰背痛健康管理中的自我管理、远程康复、评估和数据收集应用：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
智能手机在为腰背痛（LBP）患者提供医疗保健方面的应用日益增长，但文献中缺乏对智能手机应用程序使用的分析。本范围综述旨在确定当前智能手机应用程序在管理LBP方面的应用领域。我们还旨在评估此类应用的有效性或科学有效性的当前状态，并确定其潜在发展的前景。

方法
我们在PubMed、PEDro和Embase数据库中搜索了截至2021年5月3日发表的英文文章，这些文章研究了智能手机在LBP医疗保健中的应用及其目的。接受所有类型的研究设计。涉及远程医疗或远程康复但不使用智能手机的研究不包括在内。两名研究人员独立进行相同的搜索策略，第三名研究人员验证了所包含研究的综合结果。

结果
我们纳入了43篇文章：随机对照试验（RCTs）（n=12）、研究方案（n=6）、可靠性/有效性研究（n=6）、系统综述（n=7）、队列研究（n=4）、定性研究（n=6）和病例系列（n=1）。智能手机应用程序的用途包括1）评估、2）远程康复、3）自我管理和4）数据收集。自我管理是最常研究的用途，从中等到高质量RCTs中获得的结果显示，对于慢性LBP患者和脊柱手术后患者具有 promising results。关于评估和数据收集用途存在 promising results，而关于测量用途的结果则存在矛盾。

结论
本范围综述揭示了科学文献中对智能手机应用程序用于LBP患者的显著兴趣。确定的用途指向当前科学状态和进一步研究的视角，包括针对特定用途的RCTs和系统综述。
review_content_zh:
这篇范围综述写得很好。这是一项有趣的工作，对当前话题进行了梳理。

我的几点小意见如下：

摘要：
  * 背景 - 第一句（过于笼统）和第二句之间存在差距。
  * 结论 - 你不能声称文献在增长，因为你并没有真正研究这一方面（通过年份对研究的定量评估）。

引言：
  * 第一段：难道“导航、视频通信、游戏和社交媒体”是手机最普遍的用途吗？
  * 第三段：你应该区分LBP和慢性LBP，在某些情况下，慢性LBP是生物心理社会管理的首要目标。
  * 第四段，第一句：这个“目的”包括过度治疗吗？
  * 你还可以提出应用程序的成本和可及性与常规（面对面）治疗相比的话题。

方法：
  * 你能解释为什么你纳入了从2005年1月1日以来的研究吗？

结果：
  * 使用智能手机应用程序进行评估：简单介绍一下PainMAP。
  * 当你谈到脊柱手术时，请明确指出你是在谈论“脊柱手术”治疗下背痛。

讨论：
  * 第一段：为了解释为什么分类可能存在争议，你可以指出应用程序的用途是多样的。
  * 你同时使用“效力”和“效果”这两个词的原因不清楚。
  * 第二段：如上所述，你不能真正断言文献在增长，因为你并没有真正研究这一点。
  * 当你谈到效力或效果时，系统地指明是基于哪些结果。
  * 我不太明白使用应用程序测量RoM所提出的卫生问题。
  * 在限制部分之前的最后一段，数据安全问题如何？

限制：
  * 我不确定强迫行为是一个限制，因为它并不在你综述的范围内。

结论：
  * 同样关于“文献增长”的评论。

paper_title: COVID-19 vaccinations and their side effects: a scoping systematic review
paper_abstract:
Introduction: The COVID-19 virus has impacted people worldwide, causing significant changes in their lifestyles. Since the emergence of the epidemic, attempts have begun to prepare a vaccine that can eliminate the virus and restore balance to life in the entire world. Over the past two years, countries and specialized companies have competed to obtain a license from the World Health Organization for the vaccines that were discovered. After the appearance of vaccines in the health community, comparisons and fears of their side effects began, but people don’t get an answer to the question of which is the best vaccine. 
   
     Methods: IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, the New England Journal of Medicine, Google Scholar, and PubMed databases were searched for literature on the COVID-19 vaccine and its side effects. we surveyed the literature on the COVID-19 vaccine’s side effects and the sorts of side effects observed after vaccination. Depending on data from the literature, we compared these vaccines in terms of side effects, then we analyzed the gaps and obstacles of previous studies and made proposals to process these gaps in future studies. 
   
     Results: Overall, 17 studies were included in this scoping systematic review as they fulfilled the criteria specified, the majority of which were cross-sectional and retrospective cross-sectional studies. Most of the side effects were mild, self-limiting, and common. Thus, they usually resolve within 1–3 days after vaccination. Factors associated with higher side effects included advanced age, allergic conditions, those taking other medications (particularly immunosuppressive ones), those with a history of type II diabetes, heart disease, hypertension, COVID-19 infection, and female sex. Our meta‐analyses also found that mRNA vaccines looked to be more effective, while inactivated vaccinations had fewer side effects. 
   
     Conclusion: This review shows that the COVID-19 vaccine is safe to administer and induces protection.
review_content:
This manuscript performs a scoping systematic review to explore the COVID-19 vaccinations and their side effects, this topic is very interesting and has important guiding significance for evaluating the effectiveness of vaccines. Although this paper did a good job, the current version needs to be further improved by a minor revision.

Title:
The title is concise and summarizes the content of the article.


Abstract:
The abstract is concise and effectively outlines the research's objectives, which include evaluating the COVID-19 vaccinations and their side effects. However, several minor points need to be revised:
 1. Results need to provide figures to support the findings instead of something like a conclusion.
 2. Conclusion should give a summary of adverse reactions of the vaccine.

Introduction:
The introduction provides adequate context for understanding the research problem and the primary hypotheses. Also, some minor points need to be revised:
 1. Paragraph 1 should summarize the severity of the impact of COVID-19, including the number of cases and deaths.
 2. Paragraph 4 should provide the recent figures regarding the vaccine doses, this data is available on the WHO website.
 3. It should be highlighted that the duration of application of COVID-19 vaccines is short, and adverse effects are inconsistent due to different types of vaccines.

Background:
This part is well-written, particularly the method used in this study, giving an adequate description. Here just needs a very minor revision:
 1. “A brief overview of the vaccine” should be removed.
 2. Check "from 2019 to 2022 to select eligible research publications."

Results:
The results are also adequate. Factors associated with side effects of COVID-19 vaccines can provide a summary in Table or Figure.


Discussion:
The discussion also gives a full comparison with other studies. But some minor points should be addressed:
 1. In the discussion, can the authors explain the causes of adverse reactions of different vaccines from the mechanism level?
 2. Some new research results have been published recently, and the discussion needs to be supplemented and fully compared.
paper_title_zh: COVID-19疫苗接种及其副作用：一项范围系统性综述
paper_abstract_zh:
引言：新冠病毒已对全球人民产生了影响，导致其生活方式发生了显著变化。自疫情爆发以来，人们开始尝试制备一种能够消除病毒并恢复全球生活平衡的疫苗。在过去两年中，各国和专业公司竞相获得世界卫生组织对所发现疫苗的许可。疫苗在卫生社区出现后，人们开始对其进行比较并担忧其副作用，但关于哪种疫苗最佳的问题仍未得到解答。

方法：通过IEEE Xplore、ScienceDirect、新英格兰医学杂志、Google Scholar和PubMed数据库检索了有关COVID-19疫苗及其副作用的相关文献。我们调查了关于COVID-19疫苗副作用的文献以及接种疫苗后观察到的副作用类型。根据文献数据，我们比较了这些疫苗的副作用，然后分析了先前研究的差距和障碍，并提出了在未来研究中处理这些差距的建议。

结果：总体而言，共有17项研究符合指定标准，被纳入本次范围系统性综述，其中大多数为横断面研究和回顾性横断面研究。大多数副作用为轻度、自限性和常见，通常在接种疫苗后1-3天内自行缓解。与较高副作用相关的因素包括高龄、过敏状况、正在服用其他药物（尤其是免疫抑制剂）者、有II型糖尿病、心脏病、高血压、COVID-19感染史以及女性。我们的荟萃分析还发现，mRNA疫苗似乎更有效，而灭活疫苗的副作用较少。

结论：本次综述表明，COVID-19疫苗是安全的，并能诱导保护作用。
review_content_zh:
该手稿进行了一项范围性系统综述，以探讨COVID-19疫苗接种及其副作用，这一主题非常有趣，对于评估疫苗的有效性具有重要的指导意义。尽管这篇文章做得不错，但当前版本需要通过小修进一步改进。

标题：
标题简洁，概括了文章的内容。

摘要：
摘要简洁，有效概述了研究的目标，包括评估COVID-19疫苗接种及其副作用。然而，有几个小点需要修订：
1. 结果部分需要提供数据以支持发现，而不是类似结论的内容。
2. 结论部分应总结疫苗的不良反应。

引言：
引言为理解研究问题和主要假设提供了充分的背景。同时，一些小点需要修订：
1. 第一段应总结COVID-19影响的严重性，包括病例数和死亡数。
2. 第四段应提供关于疫苗剂量的最新数据，这些数据可在WHO网站上找到。
3. 应强调COVID-19疫苗应用时间较短，且由于疫苗类型不同，不良反应不一致。

背景：
这部分写得很好，尤其是本研究使用的方法，给出了充分的描述。这里只需要非常小的修订：
1. 应删除“疫苗的简要概述”。
2. 检查“从2019年至2022年选择符合条件的研究出版物”。

结果：
结果部分也是充分的。与COVID-19疫苗副作用相关的因素可以在表格或图表中总结。

讨论：
讨论部分也与其他研究进行了全面的比较。但一些小点需要解决：
1. 在讨论中，作者能否从机制层面解释不同疫苗不良反应的原因？
2. 最近有一些新的研究成果发表，讨论部分需要补充并进行全面比较。

paper_title: Translational regulation of cell invasion through extracellular matrix—an emerging role for ribosomes
paper_abstract: Many developmental and physiological processes require cells to invade and migrate through extracellular matrix barriers. This specialized cellular behavior is also misregulated in many diseases, such as immune disorders and cancer. Cell invasive activity is driven by pro-invasive transcriptional networks that activate the expression of genes encoding numerous different proteins that expand and regulate the cytoskeleton, endomembrane system, cell adhesion, signaling pathways, and metabolic networks. While detailed mechanistic studies have uncovered crucial insights into pro-invasive transcriptional networks and the distinct cell biological attributes of invasive cells, less is known about how invasive cells modulate mRNA translation to meet the robust, dynamic, and unique protein production needs of cell invasion. In this review we outline known modes of translation regulation promoting cell invasion and focus on recent studies revealing elegant mechanisms that expand ribosome biogenesis within invasive cells to meet the increased protein production requirements to invade and migrate through extracellular matrix barriers.
review_content:
This is a nice review of a complex and somewhat understudied subject: how cell invasion is regulated by modifying protein translation. Much is known about how genes are up or down regulated in cell invasion and cancer, but much less is clear concerning the protein consequences of this regulation.
Overall, the review does a great job of making a complicated subject with a multitude of molecular players accessible to non-specialists of ribosome biology and protein translation machinery. There is one small thing that I found confusing: the section “Ribosomal protein misexpression can drive or inhibit cell invasion in cancer cells” seems contradictory with the previous parts, where ribosome enrichment was linked invariably with an increase in invasion presumably by increasing the production of proteins necessary for the increased activity and growth that cancer cells display. Would it be correct to say that ribosome decrease only drives cancer via activities that aren’t directly connected to protein translation? Perhaps this can be stated as such, because as it is, this section puts some doubt on what was up until then a strong message that ribosomes and ribosomal function are upregulated for invasion.
A few “cosmetic” comments:
1. In Figure 1, it would be nice to have EPA defined next to its first appearance, so next to the 80S blob between steps 5 and 6.
2. Also in Figure 1, a bracket and label for “48S initiation complex” and “80S complex” would be nice (as done for “43S PIC”).
3. I think the “the” can be removed from this sentence on page 8: RiboPuromycylation analysis, an immunofluorescence method to visualize translation sites at the sub-cellular resolution (Bastide et al., 2018)…
4. In this sentence on page 8, wouldn’t it be better to say “revealed” instead of “discovered”: Recent advances in ribosome tagging and subcellular biochemical analysis have discovered enrichment of ribosomes and translation at several locations within invasive cells where localized translation mediates important functions (Figure 3).
paper_title_zh: 细胞侵袭通过细胞外基质的翻译调控——核糖体的新兴作用
paper_abstract_zh: 许多发育和生理过程需要细胞侵入并迁移通过细胞外基质屏障。这种特殊的细胞行为在许多疾病中也会失调，例如免疫疾病和癌症。细胞的侵入活性由促侵入转录网络驱动，这些网络激活编码多种不同蛋白质的基因表达，这些蛋白质扩展并调节细胞骨架、内膜系统、细胞粘附、信号通路和代谢网络。尽管详细的机制研究已经揭示了促侵入转录网络以及侵入细胞独特细胞生物学属性的重要见解，但对于侵入细胞如何调节mRNA翻译以满足细胞侵入过程中强健、动态和独特的蛋白质生产需求，了解较少。在这篇综述中，我们概述了已知促进细胞侵入的翻译调控模式，并重点介绍了最近揭示的优雅机制，这些机制在侵入细胞内扩展核糖体生物生成，以满足侵入和迁移通过细胞外基质屏障时增加的蛋白质生产需求。
review_content_zh:
这是一篇关于一个复杂且相对研究不足的主题的精彩综述：如何通过修饰蛋白质翻译来调控细胞侵袭。关于细胞侵袭和癌症中基因的上调或下调，已有大量研究，但关于这种调控对蛋白质后果的影响则远不够清晰。

总体而言，这篇综述在将一个涉及众多分子参与者的复杂主题变得对核糖体生物学和蛋白质翻译机制的非专业人士易于理解方面做得非常出色。有一点我觉得有些困惑：在“核糖体蛋白的异常表达可以驱动或抑制癌细胞侵袭”这一节中，似乎与之前的部分存在矛盾，之前的部分将核糖体富集与侵袭增加联系起来，推测是通过增加癌细胞所表现出的增强活性和生长所需的蛋白质生产。是否可以正确地说，核糖体减少仅通过那些不直接与蛋白质翻译相关的活动来驱动癌症？或许可以这样表述，因为目前的表述使这一节对之前关于核糖体和核糖体功能上调以促进侵袭的强烈信息产生了些许怀疑。

一些“形式”上的建议：
1. 在图1中，最好在EPA首次出现时旁边定义它，即在步骤5和6之间的80S团块旁边。
2. 同样在图1中，为“48S起始复合物”和“80S复合物”加上括号和标签会更好（如同为“43S PIC”所做的那样）。
3. 我认为在第8页的这句话中可以去掉“the”：RiboPuromycylation分析，一种用于在亚细胞分辨率下可视化翻译位点的免疫荧光方法（Bastide等，2018）…
4. 在第8页的这句话中，用“revealed”代替“discovered”是否会更好：最近的核糖体标记和亚细胞生化分析进展发现了核糖体和翻译在侵袭细胞内多个位置的富集，这些位置的局部翻译介导了重要功能（图3）。

paper_title: Pathophysiology of risk factors for post operative complications
paper_abstract:
Postoperative complications lead to an increase in morbidity and mortality, increase in hospital length of stay and costs for health care. Understanding the pathophysiology of various risk factors causing post-operative complications, helps in better understanding of the subject and perioperative patient assessment. 
The risk factors selected for the purpose of the study include modifiable risk factors and includes results from various single centre and multi-centre cohort studies, and systematic reviews and data from various meta-analysis by various authors on different subjects. 
The importance of optimizing the modifiable risk factors like hypoalbuminemia, anemia, obesity and smoking can be understood from the above study. It is important to remember that morbidity is multifactorial and taking into account only a single risk factor will not improve the outcomes. This signifies the importance of multidisciplinary approach when treating the patient.
review_content:
This article while it does talk about some of the pathophysiology and modifiable risk factors it appears very superficial. It glances over some key words and does not provide depth to these factors. It has some superficial merit but it lacks detailed discussion of its key topics.

The methods section needs some expansion. How were these studies selected still seems nebulous to me. How did they get to the 21 total studies? How many studies came up when these key words were searched and how was this narrowed to 21 studies? There should also be some exclusion criteria for studies that did not meet their criteria of what information the authors are looking for?

In the discussion the section Age the term frailty is used but without context and not defined here. It would be good to know how frailty was measured, this is important and speaks to the author glancing over key wording and details.

The discussion on anemia is a stretch. The claim that " An elderly patient is unable to compensate for loss of hemoglobin due to inability to increase cardiac output." Is partly true yes there is less reserve but to claim that an elderly patient has no ability to increase cardiac output is categorically false.
The ideas need to be defined and expanded upon it reads as a flight of ideas. There are only minor details that are incorrect the overall idea of the paper is sound however it needs some major fleshing out of the ideas presented.
paper_title_zh: 术后并发症风险因素的病理生理学
paper_abstract_zh:
术后并发症导致发病率、死亡率增加，住院时间延长和医疗成本上升。了解导致术后并发症的各种风险因素的病理生理学，有助于更好地理解该主题和围术期患者评估。

本研究选择的风险因素包括可改变的风险因素，并包括来自各种单中心和多中心队列研究、系统综述以及不同作者针对不同主题的元分析数据。

从上述研究中可以理解优化可改变风险因素（如低蛋白血症、贫血、肥胖和吸烟）的重要性。重要的是要记住，发病率是多因素的，仅考虑单一风险因素不会改善结果。这表明在治疗患者时采取多学科方法的重要性。
review_content_zh:
这篇文章虽然讨论了一些病理生理学和可修改的风险因素，但显得非常肤浅。它只是简单提及了一些关键词，并未对这些因素进行深入探讨。文章有一定的表面价值，但缺乏对其关键主题的详细讨论。

方法部分需要扩展。这些研究是如何被选定的，对我来说仍然显得模糊不清。他们是如何得出总共21项研究的？在搜索这些关键词时出现了多少项研究，又是如何缩小到21项的？还应该有一些排除标准，用于剔除不符合作者所寻找信息标准的研究。

在讨论部分的“年龄”一节中，使用了“脆弱性”这一术语，但未提供上下文且未在此定义。了解脆弱性是如何测量的将很有帮助，这一点很重要，也说明了作者对关键词和细节的草率处理。

关于贫血的讨论有些牵强。文章声称“老年患者由于无法增加心输出量，无法补偿血红蛋白的损失。”这一说法部分正确，确实储备较少，但断言老年患者完全无法增加心输出量是绝对错误的。

这些观点需要被定义并加以扩展，目前的读起来像是思想的跳跃。虽然只有一些细节错误，但文章的整体思路是合理的，然而需要对提出的观点进行更多的充实。

paper_title: Inflatable penile prosthesis in the radical prostatectomy patient: a review
paper_abstract: In the population of patients with prostate cancer, survivorship has come to the forefront of continuity-of-care. In addition to urinary control, erectile function is a significant issue after radical pelvic surgery. Penile prosthesis surgery remains an excellent option for restoring erectile function to those for whom more conservative measures have failed. This review article outlines the anatomical, surgical and post-operative consideration involved in the placement of a penile prosthesis in this special patient population.
review_content:
The authors provide a review manuscript highlighting the role of a specific surgical modality in the realm of prostate cancer survivorship. They initially start by providing a concise review of ED after RP.

Under "Surgical Considerations," they begin to discuss specific steps of the penile implantation surgical process. I felt they provided a good review on the separate domains of penile implant surgery. However, I would avoid specific surgeon bias specific steps such as the first sentence under "Technique of corporal measurement," where the author's state, "After corporotomy, PDS 2-0 stay sutures..." This is NOT a surgical techniques manuscript, it is a review of the topic at hand.
paper_title_zh: 根治性前列腺切除术后患者使用可膨胀阴茎假体的综述

paper_title: Transfection types, methods, and strategies: A technical review
paper_abstract: Transfection is a modern and powerful method used to insert foreign nucleic acids into eukaryotic cells. The ability to modify host cells' genetic content enables the broad application of this process in studying normal cellular processes, disease molecular mechanism, and gene therapeutic effect. In this review, we summarized and compared the findings from various reported literature on the characteristics, strengths, and limitations of various transfection methods, type of transfected nucleic acids, transfection controls, and approaches to assess transfection efficiency. With the vast choices of approaches available, we hope that this review will help researchers, especially those new to the field, in their decision making over the transfection protocol or strategy appropriate for their experimental aims.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting The manuscript by Chong et al provides an overview of the transfection protocols used in modern laboratory practice. Transfection is a routine method utilised in a wide variety of cross-disciplinary studies, thus this topic is of broad interest and within the scope of the journal. Most of the literature available on this topic is focused on specific products or methods, while an unbiased summary of the field is needed. To my knowledge, such a summary has not been done recently, thus the review by Chong et al is relevant and up to date. The review cites recent publications representing a wide range of opinions in the field. The references are selected based on a stringent and unbiased criteria, the sources are adequately cited. The introduction clearly defines the purpose of the article and its target audience, the conclusions are logical. The review is definitely thorough and comprehensive, the wealth of information is carefully summarized, the text is overall logical and coherent, though some points might be improved. I would recommend this article for publication after a revision. The authors would like to thank reviewer 1 for the constructive feedback and comments. The following steps could be taken to strengthen the article: Major English language revision. Grammar mistakes are frequent and the word choice is often imprecise, making the message hard to understand. Some examples include lines 47,60,79,88,325,587. The article had been carefully revised for improvement in grammar and readability. Paying attention to basic concepts and terminology. According to the introduction, the review is aimed at the wide variety of readers, including those new to the field of transfection. To fulfill this, aim the review should accurately introduce the terminology and explain the underlying principles of the methods described before making any technical comparisons. Unfortunately, this is now missing. The article could be useful for the readers who already have some experience in the field, but is largely unsuitable for those unfamiliar with transfection principles. We have revised the articles and included more detailed introduction to the terminologies and described in greater detail the underlying principles of the methods described to suit those who are new to the field, some of these include: • Classification and explanation about transient and stable transfection: Introduction paragraph 2 & 3 • Types of transfection vector / vehicle: Introduction paragraph 4 • Meaning of viral, non-viral and physical/chemical transfection: Under section 1 (Transfection approaches) • Types of nucleic acids that can be transfected (Section 2, including different definitions of DNA/RNA and small oligonucleotides) • Transfection control, justification of its need and examples (Section 3) The part “Common and special oligonucleotides (small ribonucleic acids, RNA)” is largely unclear. It would be useful to briefly introduce the readers to the structure of the small RNAs described (e.g. whether they are single-stranded or double stranded) and the molecular mechanisms of their activity in cells before making the comparison of their efficiency. “Common mimics/inhibitors” should be defined more clearly, possibly with some examples. • We agree that the part “common and special oligonucleotides” is unclear and would be difficult for the readers to understand. Therefore, we have inserted some illustrations on the chemical structure of the oligonucleotides and used points forms to describe the contents in the corresponding table to ease reading and understanding. • We also define the terms “mimics”, “inhibitors/antagonists”, “agomir/antagomir” and “locked nucleic acid” (See section 2.3: small ribonucleic acids) Minor remarks: Figure 1 is not very informative and can be either omitted or expanded (e.g. some examples of each transfection type could be added); We agreed that Figure 1 is not very informative and have deleted the Figure. The content of the tables sometimes duplicates the text in the main body of the article (e.g. Table 1 and line 194). Please, paraphrase; We have paraphrase the content on both main text and Table 1 to minimize duplication between them. In general, the tables are now very hard to read. Making the text in the tables more concise (e.g. by using bullet points instead of the plain text) would be much appreciated; Content in Tables 1 and 3 had been revised in points forms while Table 2 remained unchanged (was prepared in point form). The descriptions of chemical structures (e.g. the part about LNAs, agomir/antagomir, etc.) are hard to understand and may require illustrations; Thank you for the suggestion and we have added the corresponding chemical structures to describe the oligonucleotides (See Table 1). Experimental design: No comment Validity of the findings: No comment
paper_title_zh: 转染类型、方法与策略：技术综述
paper_abstract_zh: 转染是一种现代且强大的方法，用于将外源核酸插入真核细胞中。修改宿主细胞遗传内容的能力使得这一过程在研究正常细胞过程、疾病分子机制以及基因治疗效果方面具有广泛的应用。在本综述中，我们总结并比较了来自各种已报道文献的研究结果，涉及不同转染方法的特性、优势及局限性，转染核酸的类型，转染控制，以及评估转染效率的方法。鉴于可供选择的方法众多，我们希望本综述能帮助研究人员，尤其是那些刚进入该领域的研究人员，在决定适合其实验目标的转染方案或策略时做出明智选择。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）基本报告

Chong等人的手稿概述了现代实验室实践中使用的转染协议。转染是一种在多种跨学科研究中常规使用的方法，因此这一主题具有广泛的兴趣，并且属于期刊的范畴。关于这一主题的大部分现有文献都集中在特定的产品或方法上，而需要一个无偏见的领域总结。据我所知，这样的总结最近尚未进行，因此Chong等人的综述是相关且最新的。该综述引用了代表该领域广泛意见的近期出版物。参考文献是基于严格且无偏见的标准选择的，来源得到了充分的引用。引言清晰地定义了文章的目的和目标受众，结论是合理的。该综述无疑是全面且详尽的，丰富的信息被仔细总结，文本总体上逻辑连贯，尽管某些点可能需要改进。我建议在修订后发表这篇文章。

作者感谢审稿人1的建设性反馈和评论。可以采取以下步骤来加强文章：

1. 主要的英语语言修订。语法错误频繁，用词常常不准确，使得信息难以理解。一些例子包括第47、60、79、88、325、587行。文章已仔细修订以改进语法和可读性。

2. 关注基本概念和术语。根据引言，该综述面向广泛的读者，包括那些刚接触转染领域的新手。为了实现这一目标，综述应在进行任何技术比较之前，准确介绍术语并解释所描述方法的原理。不幸的是，这一点目前缺失。该文章可能对已有一定领域经验的读者有用，但对于不熟悉转染原理的人来说 largely unsuitable。我们已修订文章，并包含了对术语的更详细介绍，并更详细地描述了所描述方法的原理，以适应那些刚接触该领域的读者，包括：
   - 转瞬和稳定转染的分类和解释：引言第2、3段
   - 转染载体/工具的类型：引言第4段
   - 病毒、非病毒和物理/化学转染的含义：第1节（转染方法）
   - 可转染的核酸类型（第2节，包括DNA/RNA和小寡核苷酸的不同定义）
   - 转染控制、其必要性的理由和示例（第3节）

“常见和特殊寡核苷酸（小核糖核酸，RNA）”部分 largely unclear。在比较其效率之前，简要介绍所描述小RNA的结构（例如它们是单链还是双链）及其在细胞中的分子机制会很有用。“常见模拟物/抑制剂”应更清晰地定义，可能需要一些示例。
   - 我们同意“常见和特殊寡核苷酸”部分不清楚，读者难以理解。因此，我们插入了一些关于寡核苷酸化学结构的插图，并使用要点形式描述了相应表格的内容，以方便阅读和理解。
   - 我们还定义了“模拟物”、“抑制剂/拮抗剂”、“agomir/antagomir”和“锁核酸”（见第2.3节：小核糖核酸）

次要意见：
   - 图1信息量不大，可以删除或扩展（例如，可以添加每种转染类型的一些示例）；我们同意图1信息量不大，已删除该图。
   - 表格的内容有时与文章正文重复（例如，表1和第194行）。请改写；我们已改写了正文和表1的内容，以尽量减少它们之间的重复。
   - 总的来说，现在的表格很难阅读。使表格中的文本更简洁（例如，使用项目符号而不是纯文本）将非常受欢迎；表1和表3的内容已修订为要点形式，而表2保持不变（已用要点形式准备）。

发现的合理性：无评论

paper_title: Tale of Two Cities: narrative review of oxygen
paper_abstract: The human brain contributes 2% of the body weight yet receives 15% of cardiac output and demands a constant supply of oxygen (O 2 ) and nutrients to meet its metabolic needs. Cerebral autoregulation is responsible for maintaining a constant cerebral blood flow that provides the supply of oxygen and maintains the energy storage capacity. We selected oxygen administration-related studies published between 1975–2021 that included meta-analysis, original research, commentaries, editorial, and review articles. In the present narrative review, several important aspects of the oxygen effects on brain tissues and cerebral autoregulation are discussed, as well the role of exogenous O 2 administration in patients with chronic ischemic cerebrovascular disease: We aimed to revisit the utility of O 2 administration in pathophysiological situations whether or not being advantageous. Indeed, a compelling clinical and experimental body of evidence questions the utility of routine oxygen administration in acute and post-recovery brain ischemia, as evident by studies in neurophysiology imaging. While O 2 is still part of common clinical practice, it remains unclear whether its routine use is safe.
review_content:
The manuscript submitted by Gullapalli et al. is a narrative review composed by a team of anesthesiologists, intensivists and neurobiologist, intended for broad audience. It is not an experts review per se, yet the authors organized the different paragraphs accessing several key reference works based on their own experience. A very interesting and novel perspective, is the graphical content, which adds an original aspect to the original approach. The authors started the review emphasizing a general cover on the topic and they search from PubMed of English language abstracts, using adequate searching terms, from 1975 to October 2021.

They extracted the essence of several good articles about the use of oxygen in various pathophysiological conditions as well as during anaesthesia, emphasizing the contradictory effects of its application, which justifies the title of the paper "Tale of Two Cities". The use of oxygen has been questioned indeed on the beneficial effects in different clinical scenarios as well as in controlled preclinical studies. The authors, even if briefly, address a clinical novel evaluation of the long-term vascular reactivity and cerebral autoregulation after stroke, while exposing patients to administration of oxygen.

Is the narrative review too general, too long, or even dispersive? On a general knowledge standpoint and trying to offer a scholastic resource for non-experts it is not; it still offers some expert view points on critical topics, like neuroapoptosis and cellular mechanisms of injury as well as neuroimaging and coupling. It does build a case for what it is known and moving in a hypothetical model testing the safety of clinical practice.

I had the chance to read Dr Pancaro notes about the manuscript and his peer-review of the paper is in line with my own assessment: I agree with the assessment that it is an interesting reading with only few minor changes to be completed. I congratulate the authors for a simple yet unique presentation, and the nice artworks.
paper_title_zh: 《双城记：氧气叙事综述》
paper_abstract_zh: 人脑仅占体重的2%，却接受15%的心输出量，并需要持续供应氧气（O₂）和营养以满足其代谢需求。脑部自动调节负责维持恒定的脑血流量，以提供氧气供应并保持能量储存能力。我们选取了1975年至2021年间发表的与氧气治疗相关的研究，包括荟萃分析、原创研究、评论、社论和综述文章。在本次叙述性综述中，讨论了氧气对脑组织和脑部自动调节的几个重要影响，以及外源性O₂治疗在慢性缺血性脑血管疾病患者中的作用：我们旨在重新审视在病理生理情况下O₂治疗的实用性，无论其是否具有优势。事实上，大量临床和实验证据对急性及恢复期脑缺血中常规氧气治疗的实用性提出了质疑，这一点在神经生理学影像研究中尤为明显。尽管O₂仍是常见临床实践的一部分，但其常规使用的安全性仍不明确。
review_content_zh:
Gullapalli等人提交的手稿是由麻醉师、重症监护专家和神经生物学家组成的团队撰写的一篇叙述性综述，旨在面向广大读者。它并非严格意义上的专家综述，但作者们根据自身经验，整理了不同段落，参考了若干关键文献。一个非常有趣且新颖的视角是其图形内容，为原始方法增添了独特方面。作者们从强调该主题的总体概述开始，并从PubMed检索了1975年至2021年10月的英文摘要，使用了恰当的搜索术语。

他们提炼了多篇关于在多种病理生理条件下以及麻醉期间使用氧气的优秀文章的精华，强调了其应用的矛盾效应，这正符合论文标题“双城记”的寓意。确实，在不同临床场景以及受控的预临床研究中，氧气的益处受到了质疑。作者们虽简短但涉及了临床新评估，即卒中后长期血管反应性和脑自动调节，同时让患者接受氧气治疗。

这篇叙述性综述是否过于泛泛、冗长或甚至散乱？从一般知识角度出发，并试图为非专家提供学术资源来看，并非如此；它仍就关键话题提供了一些专家观点，如神经凋亡、损伤的细胞机制以及神经影像学和耦合。它确实构建了一个已知案例，并朝着假设模型迈进，测试临床实践的安全性。

我有幸阅读了Pancaro博士关于该手稿的笔记，他的同行评审与我的评估一致：我同意这是一篇有趣的读物，只需完成少量微小修改。我祝贺作者们呈现了简洁而独特的展示以及精美的插图。

paper_title: Diverse mechanisms and treatment strategies to confront fatigue in multiple sclerosis: A systematic review
paper_abstract:
Background: Firm conclusions about the applicability of treatment methods other than pharmacotherapy in treating fatigue in multiple sclerosis (MS) remain elusive. Our objective is to synthesize and review the epidemiological literature systematically and find an effective therapeutic plan for fatigue. The effect of individual treatment and combined treatment strategies are studied. 
 Methods: An electronic database search included EBSCO, PubMed, SCIENCE DIRECT and Scopus from January 1, 2013, to September 30, 2018. Search terms used are “Fatigue AND Multiple sclerosis AND therapy”. The articles included in the study are open access, published in last five years, not restricted to region and language. The search included randomized controlled trials (RCTs), observational studies, and systematic reviews. 
 Results: We included 13 systematic reviews, 10 RCTs and 7 observational studies. A Cochrane review on 3206 patients showed exercise therapy to have a positive effect on fatigue in RRMS patients. The EPOC trial showed switching interferon therapy or glatiramer to fingolimod showed improved fatigue levels. The FACETS trial showed incorporating behavioral therapy to ongoing recommended therapy is beneficial. Few observational studies demonstrated that fatigue is influenced by pain, mood problems, and depression. 
 Conclusions: The diverse pathology of fatigue related to MS is important in understanding and quantifying the role of each causal factor. Evidence reveals a positive effect on fatigue levels of RRMS patients with regular CBT and exercise-based combination therapy. Progressive forms of the disease have the worst prognosis. Individually aerobic exercises, behavioral therapy and pharmacotherapy have positive effects. A modified amalgamation of the same is a better hope for MS patients.
review_content:
This article aims at providing a systematic review of literature on the treatment of fatigue in multiple sclerosis. This is an important topic, as management of MS-related fatigue is a difficult subject and the results achieved in clinical practice are often frustrating to clinicians and patients alike. Unfortunately, the review falls short of its goal, providing only a superficial summary of the identified literature and a discussion based on a handful of selected anecdotes. The review would benefit from a more systematic approach to the topic.

Major comments:
The systematic review only included open access articles. This is potentially a significant limitation. How may otherwise eligible articles were excluded on these grounds?
The information summarised in the Introduction is selective and only remotely related to this article. The referencing style in the Introduction is suboptimal, with only limited number of indirect references cited. The summary given in the Introduction, paragraph 5 is unnecessary. Most of this information is not immediately relevant to this manuscript and the section is not appropriately referenced. Similarly, the information shown in paragraph 6 is patchy and poorly referenced.
The authors cite the old phenotypic classification of MS. Instead, the 2013 revisions of the classification of MS phenotypes (Lublin et al., Neurology 2014[Ref-1]) should be used.

During screening, the authors have excluded a large number of identified articles. This does not impact negatively on the quality of the systematic review but it highlights that the search terms employed were very broad.

The Results are hard to follow. The effect of different interventions on physical performance and fatigue are presented intermittently. In fact, the most of the section on the results of meta-analyses focuses on the effects of treatments on physical performance, with only a very brief mention of the reported effect on fatigue. The references of the individual results are scattered and often given without the appropriate context (for instance “6-month study in 2016, ECTRIMS showed no increase in mortality.” The summary of the safety issues mentioned for some of the presented interventions is not balanced. The authors erroneously state that there is no evidence of therapeutic effect in SPMS, whereas siponimod has in fact shown effect on slowing progression of disability in a phase 3 trial (EXPAND).
There is some duplication of the reported results, as some of the clinical trials were also included in the meta-analyses. This is unavoidable, but the amount of overlap between the meta-analyses and the trials reported individually in this review should be reported.
An improvement in 20-40% of patients treated with amantadine is referenced – it is unclear which domain and in what test this improvement involves. Similarly, it is unclear what is meant by the statement ‘The two most effective drugs in treatment are natalizumab and alemtuzumab…”. Does this relate to their effect on relapses/disability/MRI or fatigue?
The results of the individual randomised controlled trials should be summarised not only with p values but, most importantly, with the measures of effect size (both point and interval estimates).
The authors mention an issue of the efficacy of interventions in the context of the duration of the symptoms. This should be expanded upon and provided with more supporting evidence if this theme is to be retained within the article.

The manuscript would benefit from a stylistic review (a few examples – Introduction, paragraph 2, lines 6-7; Introduction, paragraph 3, lines 12-16; Introduction, paragraph 5, last line; Introduction, paragraph 5, lines 10-12; Methods, Inclusion/Exclusion criteria, lines 9-11; Figure 2 etc.). The authors should also use terminology more accurately – e.g. ’widespread MS investigation’, ‘disease burden’, ‘experimental studies’. The formulation “MS is affecting 2,000,000 people worldwide and 400,000 people in the United States per year” implies that the cited information represents incidence, whereas the numbers given are keeping with MS prevalence.
The Discussion is not systematically structured and would benefit from more thorough, systematic evaluation of the mentioned topics. These include the present anecdotes related to the link between depression and fatigue, use of melatonin, TMS and plasticity. An in-depth discussion of the summarised literature, including critical appraisal of the presented studies and meta-analyses, is needed.

The opening statement of the Discussion provides a perspective on relevant measurable outcomes in the tests of MS-related fatigue. This discussion should be linked to the results presented and the magnitude of the impact of the studied interventions on FSS should be evaluated.

The authors have phrased the conclusion in the fashion of an original study (“Our study has found a significant positive effect…”). However, it should be remembered that this article is a systematic review of literature, in which no novel results were generated. The Conclusion section should use the language of a review. In this context, references to ‘significant’ findings are not appropriate.

The following proposed conclusions are not supported by the results of the reported trials, including the following:
  * The suggestion that CBT and exercise-based therapies are not associated with better control of fatigue due to a more aggressive nature of PPMS and SPMS relative to RRMS
  * The proposed need for combination therapy for MS, which is also being implied as an accessible option (please note that combination immunotherapy is not approved for use in MS)
The sentence containing “…should focus on improving the quality of life of progressive forms of MS” objectifies patients and should be rephrased.

Minor comments:
Table 1: should provide explanation of the AMSTAR items in a footnote.
Table 2: Minor inconsistencies are present (such as n-acetyl carnitine vs. L-carnitine; the format of presenting control groups)
paper_title_zh: 《应对多发性硬化症疲劳的多样化机制和治疗策略：系统综述》
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：关于在治疗多发性硬化症（MS）疲劳方面，除药物治疗外的其他治疗方法的适用性，尚无明确结论。我们的目标是系统综合和回顾流行病学文献，并寻找一种有效的疲劳治疗计划。研究了个体治疗和联合治疗策略的效果。

方法：电子数据库搜索包括EBSCO、PubMed、SCIENCE DIRECT和Scopus，时间范围为2013年1月1日至2018年9月30日。使用的搜索词为“Fatigue AND Multiple sclerosis AND therapy”。纳入研究的文章为开放获取，发表于过去五年内，不限地区和语言。搜索包括随机对照试验（RCTs）、观察性研究和系统综述。

结果：我们纳入了13篇系统综述、10项RCTs和7项观察性研究。一项针对3206名患者的Cochrane综述显示，运动疗法对缓解RRMS患者的疲劳有积极效果。EPOC试验表明，将干扰素疗法或格拉替雷转换为芬戈莫德可改善疲劳水平。FACETS试验显示，将行为疗法纳入持续推荐疗法中是有益的。少数观察性研究显示，疲劳受疼痛、情绪问题和抑郁的影响。

结论：理解并量化每个致病因素在MS相关疲劳的多样化病理学中的角色至关重要。证据显示，定期认知行为疗法（CBT）和基于运动的联合疗法对RRMS患者的疲劳水平有积极效果。疾病进展形式预后最差。单独的有氧运动、行为疗法和药物治疗均有积极效果。对相同疗法的改良结合为MS患者提供了更好的希望。
review_content_zh:
**文章内容翻译：**

本文旨在对多发性硬化症（MS）疲劳治疗的相关文献进行系统性综述。这是一个重要议题，因为MS相关疲劳的管理是一个难题，临床实践中取得的结果往往令临床医生和患者都感到沮丧。不幸的是，这篇综述未能达到其目标，仅提供了对所识别文献的浅显总结，并基于少数选定的轶事进行讨论。该综述若能采用更系统的方法来处理这一主题，将大为受益。

**主要评论：**

1. 系统性综述仅包括了开放获取的文章。这可能是一个显著的局限性。有多少本应符合条件的文章因这一标准而被排除？
2. 引言中总结的信息具有选择性，且与本文关联性较弱。引言中的引用风格不理想，仅引用了有限数量的间接参考文献。引言第5段给出的总结是不必要的，大部分信息与本文不直接相关，且该部分引用不当。同样，第6段展示的信息零散且引用不当。
3. 作者引用了旧的MS表型分类。相反，应使用2013年修订的MS表型分类（Lublin等，Neurology 2014[Ref-1]）。

在筛选过程中，作者排除了一大批已识别的文章。这并未对系统性综述的质量产生负面影响，但凸显了所使用的搜索术语过于宽泛。

**结果部分难以理解。**不同干预措施对体能表现和疲劳的影响呈现不连贯。事实上，关于元分析结果的绝大部分内容集中在治疗对体能表现的影响上，仅简要提及了对疲劳的报道效果。个别结果的参考文献分散，且常在不适当的背景下给出（例如“2016年为期6个月的研究，ECTRIMS显示无死亡率增加。”）。对某些呈现干预措施的安全性问题总结不平衡。作者错误地指出在SPMS中没有治疗效力的证据，而实际上siponimod在3期试验（EXPAND）中已显示出对减缓残疾进展的效果。

**存在一些结果的重复报告，**因为某些临床试验也被纳入了元分析中。这是不可避免的，但应报告元分析与本文单独报告的试验之间的重叠程度。

**引用了20-40%接受金刚烷胺治疗的患者有所改善，**但不清除这一改善涉及哪个领域及何种测试。同样，不清楚“治疗中最有效的两种药物是natalizumab和alemtuzumab…”这一说法的含义。这是指它们对复发/残疾/MRI或疲劳的影响吗？

**个别随机对照试验的结果不仅应以p值总结，**更重要的是应以效应量测量（包括点估计和区间估计）进行总结。

**作者提到了干预措施效力与症状持续时间相关的问题。**如果要在文章中保留这一主题，应进一步展开并提供更多支持证据。

**文稿将从文体审查中受益（一些例子——引言第2段，第6-7行；引言第3段，第12-16行；引言第5段，最后一行；引言第5段，第10-12行；方法，纳入/排除标准，第9-11行；图2等）。**作者还应更准确地使用术语——例如“广泛MS调查”、“疾病负担”、“实验研究”。措辞“MS每年影响全球200万人和美国的40万人”暗示所引用的信息代表发病率，而给出的数字实际上与MS的患病率相符。

**讨论部分结构不系统，**若能对提及的主题进行更全面、系统的评估将大为受益。这些包括当前与抑郁和疲劳之间联系的轶事、褪黑素的使用、TMS和可塑性等。需要对总结的文献进行深入讨论，包括对所呈现研究和元分析的批判性评价。

**讨论的开头陈述提供了关于MS相关疲劳测试中相关可测量结果的观点。**这一讨论应与呈现的结果相联系，并评估所研究干预措施对FSS影响的程度。

**作者以原始研究的风格措辞了结论（“我们的研究发现显著的积极效果…”）。**然而，应记住，本文是对文献的系统性综述，其中未产生新的结果。结论部分应使用综述的语言。在这种情况下，提及“显著”发现是不恰当的。

**以下提出的结论未得到报告试验结果的支持，包括：**
- 建议CBT和基于锻炼的疗法由于PPMS和SPMS相对于RRMS的更激进性质，与更好地控制疲劳无关
- 提出的MS联合治疗需求，这也被暗示为一种可及的选项（请注意，联合免疫疗法尚未批准用于MS）

**包含“…应关注改善进行性MS形式的生活质量”的句子将患者客观化，应重新措辞。**

**次要评论：**

- 表1：应在脚注中提供AMSTAR项目的解释。
- 表2：存在一些小的不一致（例如n-乙酰肉碱与L-肉碱；呈现对照组的格式）。

reasons: The systematic review only included open access articles.
This is potentially a significant limitation.
How may otherwise eligible articles were excluded on these grounds?
The authors cite the old phenotypic classification of MS.
Instead, the 2013 revisions of the classification of MS phenotypes (Lublin et al., Neurology 2014[Ref-1]) should be used.
Unfortunately, the review falls short of its goal, providing only a superficial summary of the identified literature and a discussion based on a handful of selected anecdotes.
The authors erroneously state that there is no evidence of therapeutic effect in SPMS, whereas siponimod has in fact shown effect on slowing progression of disability in a phase 3 trial (EXPAND).
The results of the individual randomised controlled trials should be summarised not only with p values but, most importantly, with the measures of effect size (both point and interval estimates).
There is some duplication of the reported results, as some of the clinical trials were also included in the meta-analyses.
The sentence containing “…should focus on improving the quality of life of progressive forms of MS” objectifies patients and should be rephrased.
In this context, references to ‘significant’ findings are not appropriate.
The review would benefit from a more systematic approach to the topic.
The effect of different interventions on physical performance and fatigue are presented intermittently.
In fact, the most of the section on the results of meta-analyses focuses on the effects of treatments on physical performance, with only a very brief mention of the reported effect on fatigue.
There is some duplication of the reported results, as some of the clinical trials were also included in the meta-analyses.
This is unavoidable, but the amount of overlap between the meta-analyses and the trials reported individually in this review should be reported.
The Discussion is not systematically structured and would benefit from more thorough, systematic evaluation of the mentioned topics.
This discussion should be linked to the results presented and the magnitude of the impact of the studied interventions on FSS should be evaluated.
The Conclusion section should use the language of a review.
In this context, references to ‘significant’ findings are not appropriate.

paper_title: Humanistic burden and economic impact of chronic kidney disease: a systematic literature review
paper_abstract:
Background: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is increasing in prevalence worldwide. Progression of CKD to end-stage renal disease (ESRD) can result in the requirement for renal replacement therapy, which incurs considerable healthcare costs and imposes restrictions on patients’ daily living. This systematic review was conducted to inform understanding of the humanistic and economic burden of CKD by collecting quality of life (QoL), symptom burden, and cost and resource use data, with a focus on the impact of disease progression. 
 Methods: Embase, MEDLINE, the Cochrane Library, and conference proceedings were searched in May 2017 according to predefined inclusion criteria. Data were extracted for full publications reporting either QoL or symptom burden (published 2007–2017; reporting data from ≥ 100 patients) or costs and resource use (published 2012–2017). Relevant QoL studies were those that used the 6-dimension or 8-, 12-, or 36-item Short-Form Health Surveys, 5-dimension EuroQol questionnaire, Healthy Days/Health-Related Quality of Life questionnaire, or Kidney Disease Quality of Life Questionnaire. 
 Results: Data were extracted from 95 studies reporting QoL data, 47 studies reporting cost and resource use data, and eight studies reporting descriptions of symptoms; 12 studies (seven QoL; five costs/resource use) reported data for patients with and without CKD, and 15 studies (seven QoL; eight costs/resource use) reported data by disease stage. Patients with CKD, including those with ESRD, had worse QoL than those with normal kidney function, and incurred higher healthcare costs. Disease progression was associated with cost increases, particularly for later stages and in patients receiving dialysis. Increasing CKD severity was also associated with reductions in QoL, although not all studies identified showed a consistent decrease with increasing disease stage. 
 Conclusions: The presence of CKD and CKD progression are associated with reductions in patients’ QoL and increased economic impact. This may be mitigated by interventions that slow progression.
review_content:
Freeman et al. started an ambitious project by reporting meta-analyses on both the quality of life (QoL) and the cost of treatment of patients with chronic kidney disease (CKD)
The overall conclusion confirms existing knowledge that progressing CKD is associated with a reduction in QoL and increasing costs.

I have several concerns:
 1. To describe and analyse the QoL over all stages of kidney disease is a major undertaking. So is meta-analyzing the costs. The authors do not clearly describe why they decided to perform two meta-analyses and report it in one manuscript. In their manuscript, the authors in essence describe two meta-analyses. In clinical practice, and in governing healthcare, it is important to know the effects of a disease and its treatment on both QoL and costs. I miss a clear rationale for why both topics are presented combined in this manuscript. The manuscript reads like a manuscript on QoL and a second on costs. The authors do not make a clear connection between the two.
    I would invite the authors to better connect the two topics or consider writing two separate manuscripts, one focusing on QoL and one focusing on costs.
 2. The cut off date used for both analyses was May 2017. Both QoL of kidney patients and costs of kidney care are topics of major interest in recent years. Many studies have been published since. For a manuscript to be published in 2020, an update of the search is essential
 3. The literature was screened by a single independent reviewer. Reviewing by two reviewers is the accepted norm in meta-analyses.
 4. The authors do not provide a table stating the risks of bias in the studies analyzed (Prisma checklist item 12)
 5. In table 2 the authors provide an overview of the literature reported in both meta-analyses. In the first column the text is rotated 90 degrees, making this column illegible (on my laptop). In the current lay-out I can not read which studies are reviewed!
 6. It is difficult to summarize studies with different ways of staging CKD, using different measurement tools. The authors mainly describe the results of individual studies, both in the figures and in the text of the manuscript. Prisma guidelines suggest providing a summary and a synthesis of results (Prisma items 13,14). Not all studies selected use the standard KDIGO staging of CKD and not all use the same measures of QoL and costs. I would suggest a synthesis of results from those studies that do use the standard KDIGO classification of CKD and do use the same measures of QoL and costs.
paper_title_zh: 慢性肾脏病的人本负担与经济影响：系统文献综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：慢性肾脏病（CKD）在全球范围内的患病率正在增加。CKD进展至终末期肾病（ESRD）可能导致需要肾脏替代治疗，这不仅带来显著的健康保健成本，还对患者的日常生活造成限制。本系统评价旨在通过收集生活质量（QoL）、症状负担以及成本和资源使用数据，了解CKD的人文学和经济负担，重点关注疾病进展的影响。

方法：根据预定义的纳入标准，于2017年5月检索Embase、MEDLINE、Cochrane图书馆和会议论文。提取全文出版物中报告QoL或症状负担（发表于2007-2017年；报告数据来自≥100名患者）或成本和资源使用（发表于2012-2017年）的数据。相关的QoL研究是那些使用6维度或8、12、36项简短健康调查表、5维度EuroQol问卷、健康天数/健康相关生活质量问卷或肾脏病生活质量问卷的研究。

结果：从95项报告QoL数据的研究、47项报告成本和资源使用数据的研究以及8项报告症状描述的研究中提取数据；12项研究（7项QoL；5项成本/资源使用）报告了有和无CKD患者的数据，15项研究（7项QoL；8项成本/资源使用）按疾病阶段报告了数据。CKD患者，包括ESRD患者，其QoL比肾功能正常者差，且医疗保健成本更高。疾病进展与成本增加相关，尤其是在后期阶段和接受透析的患者中。CKD严重程度的增加也与QoL的降低相关，尽管并非所有研究都显示随着疾病阶段的增加QoL持续下降。

结论：CKD的存在和进展与患者QoL的降低和经济影响的增加相关。通过减缓进展的干预措施可能减轻这一影响。
review_content_zh:
Freeman等人启动了一项雄心勃勃的项目，报告了关于慢性肾脏病（CKD）患者的生活质量（QoL）和治疗成本的元分析。总体结论证实了现有知识，即CKD的进展与QoL的降低和成本的增加相关。

我有几个担忧：
1. 描述和分析所有肾脏病阶段的生活质量是一项重大任务。对成本进行元分析也是如此。作者没有清楚地描述他们为何决定进行两项元分析并在一篇手稿中报告。在手稿中，作者实际上描述了两项元分析。在临床实践和医疗管理中，了解疾病及其治疗对QoL和成本的影响都很重要。我缺少一个明确的理由，解释为何这两项主题在这篇手稿中合并呈现。手稿读起来像是一篇关于QoL的手稿和另一篇关于成本的手稿。作者没有明确地将两者联系起来。
   我建议作者更好地连接这两个主题，或者考虑撰写两篇独立的手稿，一篇专注于QoL，另一篇专注于成本。
2. 两次分析使用的截止日期均为2017年5月。近年来，肾脏病患者的生活质量和肾脏护理成本都是备受关注的主题。自那时以来已发表了许多研究。对于2020年发表的手稿，更新搜索是必要的。
3. 文献由单一独立评审员筛选。双评审员评审是元分析中的公认规范。
4. 作者没有提供一张表格来陈述所分析研究的偏倚风险（Prisma清单第12项）。
5. 在表2中，作者提供了两次元分析中报告的文献概览。第一列的文字旋转了90度，使得这一列无法阅读（在我的笔记本电脑上）。在当前的布局中，我无法阅读哪些研究被评审！
6. 概括使用不同CKD分期方式和不同测量工具的研究是困难的。作者主要描述了各个研究的结果，无论是在图表中还是在手稿的文本中。Prisma指南建议提供结果的总结和综合（Prisma项目13、14）。并非所有选定的研究都使用标准的KDIGO CKD分期，也并非所有研究都使用相同的QoL和成本测量方法。我建议综合那些使用标准KDIGO CKD分类和相同QoL及成本测量方法的研究结果。

paper_title: Tapping into the plasticity of plant architecture for increased stress resilience
paper_abstract: Plant architecture develops post-embryonically and emerges from a dialogue between the developmental signals and environmental cues. Length and branching of the vegetative and reproductive tissues were the focus of improvement of plant performance from the early days of plant breeding. Current breeding priorities are changing, as we need to prioritize plant productivity under increasingly challenging environmental conditions. While it has been widely recognized that plant architecture changes in response to the environment, its contribution to plant productivity in the changing climate remains to be fully explored. This review will summarize prior discoveries of genetic control of plant architecture traits and their effect on plant performance under environmental stress. We review new tools in phenotyping that will guide future discoveries of genes contributing to plant architecture, its plasticity, and its contributions to stress resilience. Subsequently, we provide a perspective into how integrating the study of new species, modern phenotyping techniques, and modeling can lead to discovering new genetic targets underlying the plasticity of plant architecture and stress resilience. Altogether, this review provides a new perspective on the plasticity of plant architecture and how it can be harnessed for increased performance under environmental stress.
review_content:
Reviewer comments
The review paper is well-written and easy to understand. The authors have done an excellent job of explaining the fundamentals of plant architecture and its plasticity under various stress conditions. The detailed explanation of the root, shoot, and leaf systems is particularly commendable, providing a comprehensive understanding of how plants adapt to their environment. Additionally, the authors have effectively discussed the genetic components that regulate plant architecture, supplementing their explanations with a self-explanatory figure, which enhances the clarity and accessibility of the content. Furthermore, the paper adeptly addresses the challenges and future directions in an easily understandable manner, which is essential for the readers. By outlining the obstacles and potential paths forward, the authors have not only provided a valuable summary of the current state of research but have also offered a roadmap for future investigations in this critical area of study. This forward-looking approach adds significant value to the paper, making it a relevant and insightful resource for both researchers and practitioners in the field of plant biology and agriculture.
Comment: Page 5, second paragraph; Nutrient deficiency, drought, and salt stress, strigolactones promote the elongation of main root growth while inhibiting the formation of lateral roots, mainly through inhibiting polar auxin transport.
This line needs to be edited. “Under nutrient deficiency, drought…...”
Comment: Page 5, third paragraph; “The wider use of integrated phenotypes will not only diversity the possible strategies of environmental resilience…”
Does the author mean to diversify? Please edit the line as needed.
Comment: Page 5, last paragraph; “High levels of auxin trigger new lateral organ initiation whereas cytokinin field that surrounds each auxin maximum creates an inhibitory field that prevents the formation of new lateral organs, which strength decreases with the distance.”
This sentence is complex to understand. Please check the structure of the sentence and make it simpler. Please split the sentence into two to make it simpler and more understandable.
Comment: Page 6, second paragraph; “While high plants might produce increased yield due to increased access to light, this requires additional mechanical...”
Here does the author refer to taller plants by mentioning high plants? I suggest using the term tall or taller plants instead of high plants if you are referring to height.
Comment: Page 6. The author has mentioned the term strigolactone multiple times. I suggest adding a brief line about this term in the paper.
Comment: Page 6. I suggest the author explain the term Goldilocks ratio for a better understanding to a layman.
Comment: Page 7. “Plants that are native to arid areas typically develop smaller or narrower leaves compared to their relatives from wetter regions.” I suggest the authors add literature on why the leaves are narrower in arid natives.
Comment: The author has provided a comprehensive explanation of plant architecture; however, there appears to be limited mention of plasticity and how it changes under different stress conditions. I suggest that the authors incorporate references to additional studies highlighting the plasticity of various crops in response to diverse stressors. Acknowledging and integrating a wider range of research in this area can enhance the depth of the discussion and contribute to a more comprehensive understanding of crop resilience.
paper_title_zh: 利用植物构型的可塑性提高抗逆性
paper_abstract_zh: 植物构型在胚胎后发育，并源于发育信号与环境线索的对话。从植物育种的早期开始，营养组织和生殖组织的长度及分支一直是提高植物性能的重点。当前的育种优先事项正在改变，因为我们需要在日益严峻的环境条件下优先考虑植物生产力。虽然人们普遍认识到植物构型会响应环境变化，但其对气候变化下植物生产力的贡献仍有待全面探索。本文将总结先前关于植物构型性状的遗传控制及其在环境压力下对植物性能影响的发现。我们回顾了表型分析的新工具，这些工具将指导未来发现有助于植物构型、其可塑性及其对压力抗性的基因。随后，我们提供了一个视角，探讨如何通过整合新物种研究、现代表型分析技术和建模，来发现植物构型可塑性和压力抗性背后的新遗传靶点。总体而言，本文为植物构型可塑性及其在环境压力下提高性能的利用提供了新视角。
review_content_zh:
审稿人评论
该综述文章写得很好，易于理解。作者在解释植物结构的基本原理及其在各种应激条件下的可塑性方面做得非常出色。对根、茎和叶系统的详细解释尤其值得称赞，提供了植物如何适应环境的全面理解。此外，作者还有效地讨论了调节植物结构的遗传成分，并用一个自解释的图补充了他们的解释，这增强了内容的清晰度和可访问性。此外，文章以易于理解的方式熟练地解决了挑战和未来方向，这对读者至关重要。通过概述障碍和潜在的路径，作者不仅提供了当前研究状态的有价值总结，还为这一关键研究领域的未来调查提供了路线图。这种前瞻性方法为文章增添了显著价值，使其成为植物生物学和农业领域研究人员和从业者的相关且有洞察力的资源。

作者是否意味着多样化？请根据需要编辑该行。

这个句子复杂难懂。请检查句子结构，使其更简单。请将句子分成两句，使其更简单易懂。
