I found this paper to be a well-written, thorough, and highly informative review of deep-learning approaches to emergent language.
- It might be good to include a few figures or boxes illustrating some notable or canonical examples of deep-learning-based emergent language research.
This would be helpful particularly to readers who are less familiar with the topic.
- There are a number of sentence with missing words, or other similar errors, throughout the paper.
- Although it is helpful to have an explicit framework for organizing the paper, the framework did not seem to fit the material in some sections.
For example, organizing the paper around different applications was a bit confusing, given that 'intermediate applications' (more like basic research on emergent language) aren't applications at all.

Similarly, the section on 'Rederiving human language' is treated as one research area among many, but it seems that it would be better described as the overarching goal of basic research in emergent language, while the following subsections (metrics, theoretical models, tools) are means for achieving that goal.
I think it may make more sense not to impose the same structure on each of the sections, given the very different nature of basic research and applications.

paper_title: Merging cranial histology and 3D-computational biomechanics: a review of the feeding ecology of a Late Triassic temnospondyl amphibian
paper_abstract: Finite Element Analysis is a useful method for understanding form and function. However, modelling of fossil taxa invariably involves assumptions as a result of preservation-induced loss of information in the fossil record. To test the validity of such assumptions a different analysis is needed. In the current study a new concept of using bone microstructure as a prediction of stress distribution in the skull during feeding is presented and a correlation between bone microstructure and computional biomechanics (FEA) results is done. The bony framework is a product of biological optimisation; bone structure is created to meet local mechanical conditions. Thus, bone microstructure can be used to predict local stress and these results can be used to check the predictions of the Finite Element models. To test this scenario, the early tetrapod group of Temnospondyli is an excellent case-study.
review_content: Reviewer 2 (Anonymous) 1. The introductions section is very long (11 manuscript pages). I have made some suggestions of background information that could be cut/reduced, for example information not directly relevant to this study (why 12 citations on sauropods and marine reptiles demonstrating they have no extant analogues?) and other sections (introducing FEA and overview of general factors impacting bone strength) what can be shortened. Introduction is now a lot of shorter and we believe much more focused. 2. On the other hand, some very relevant findings from previous studies involving sensitivity analyses in FE studies of other fossil taxa and/or validation studies on FE models of crocodilian skulls (similar in both shape and ecological niche to temnospondyls) are not mentioned at all. Similarly, although correlating FE results with histology is novel, doing so with cranial sutures is not (Line 137) – see extensive work by Rayfield, Moazen Reed and others in fossil and living reptiles and fossil tetrapods. Yes, thank you for this comment. After the long discussion we have decided to focus in this paper on this what is really novel and correlate only FEA with the bone histology. Sutures morphology and FEA modeling seems to be very extensive topic and maybe it is worth to publish this as a separate paper with proper discussion. The attempt to make a simplification here did not work, and if we want to discuss this topic better we will miss the focus. However, thank you very much for your help. 3. It is unclear to me (see comments Line 304) why an aquatic predator cannot be an ambush predator using a lateral strike, as this occurs in some extant aquatic predators. Yes, you are right. The revised opinion is now in manuscript. “The histological results confirm the presence of direct lateral and bilateral biting, but not exclude other combinations, except of unilateral biting, and may reinforcing the idea that lateral strike was also performed under an ambush strategy and not only as active swimming.” 4. I have made suggestions (see “Validity”) on one figure that can be modified slightly and one figure that could be added that would clarify results. Accepted and changed. 5. The English language needs to be improved throughout the manuscript to ensure your international audience can understand your text. I suggest having an English speaking colleague review your manuscript. I have made some corrections and highlighted difficult text (any highlighted text without additional comments are areas where the language is unclear) throughout the annotated PDF. Thank you, accepted and changed. 6. One of the issues with this manuscript is a lack of clear questions that will be addressed or hypotheses that will be tested (stating how results from FEA and bone microstructure would support or reject those hypotheses). You must add such a section at the end of your introduction. Added: “In the current study a new concept of using bone microstructure as a prediction of stress distribution in the skull during feeding is presented and a correlation between bone microstructure and computional biomechanics (FEA) results is done. Merging these sources will test first the predictions generated by FEA and help to evaluate the influence of methodological assumptions and simplifications onto the final interpretation and second give the new insights into the feeding ecology of Temnospondyli. “ 7. I realize that the detailed methods for the model have been published elsewhere but basic information needs to be repeated here – see annotated PDF line 371. This is especially true if – as you suggest – you have made changes to your model since its 2017 publication. Any such changes need to be detailed in full to allow the study to be replicated. All necessary information are provided in new manuscript. 8. Your text (Lines 529 – 531) suggests the lateral strike loading regime is not the same as a unilateral bite. If not, please explain (early on when you discuss results from your 2017 paper) what a lateral strike load regime actually involves and how it differs from unilateral biting. We have added the description of all four scenarios (unilateral, bilateral, lateral and skull raisingsystem). We hope that now the differences are easier to understand. 9. One thing that would help tremendously in understanding the Discussion section “Bone histology vs computational biomechanics – how does bone structure correlate with Finite Element Analysis?” would be if you could overlay bone boundaries onto the screenshots of FE models showing von Mises stress (Figure 8). Readers could compare these with the labelled maps of the skull shown in Figure 2 to understand within which bones different stresses are occurring under different loading conditions. See new figures, we followed reviewer comment. 10. Also – why not have contour plots of compressive vs. tensile stress to see whether your predictions on stress type based on sutural morphology corresponds with FEA predictions? Von Mises stress plots do not add information beyond stress magnitudes, whereas suture shape should correlate with the type of stress (tension, compression) being experience. We have deleted the suture information to make our paper more focused on the real novel method. 11. Be careful with the language you use in the final section of the discussion (new interpretation of mode of life) – although you have evidence to support your suggestions, they are still speculation. Some of the wording you use makes these ideas sound conclusive. Yes, agree.
paper_title_zh: 融合颅骨组织学与三维计算生物力学：晚三叠世切椎类两栖动物摄食生态学综述
paper_abstract_zh: 有限元分析是理解形态和功能的有用方法。然而，由于化石记录中保存导致的的信息丢失，化石类群的建模不可避免地涉及假设。为了测试这些假设的有效性，需要一种不同的分析方法。在当前研究中，提出了一种新概念，即使用骨微结构来预测进食过程中颅骨的应力分布，并进行了骨微结构与计算生物力学（有限元分析）结果之间的相关性研究。骨骼框架是生物优化的产物；骨结构是为了满足局部力学条件而形成的。因此，骨微结构可以用来预测局部应力，而这些结果可以用来检验有限元模型的预测。为了测试这一情景，早期四足动物类群的三叠纪类是一个极佳的案例研究。
review_content_zh:
审稿人2（匿名）

1. 引言部分过长（11页手稿）。我对一些背景信息提出了删减/缩减的建议，例如与本研究不直接相关的信息（为何引用12篇关于蜥脚类和海洋爬行动物的文献来证明它们没有现存类比物？）以及其他部分（介绍有限元分析（FEA）和概述影响骨骼强度的普遍因素）可以进行简化。引言现在大幅缩短，我们认为更加聚焦。

2. 另一方面，一些与本研究非常相关的前期研究成果，涉及其他化石类群的有限元研究中的敏感性分析以及鳄鱼头骨有限元模型的验证研究（在形状和生态位上与坚头类相似），完全没有提及。同样，尽管将有限元结果与组织学相关联是新颖的，但与颅缝相关联并非如此（第137行）——参见Rayfield、Moazen Reed等人在化石和现生爬行动物以及化石四足动物中的大量工作。是的，感谢您的评论。经过长时间讨论，我们决定在本论文中仅聚焦真正新颖的部分，即仅将有限元分析（FEA）与骨骼组织学相关联。颅缝形态和有限元建模似乎是一个极为广泛的话题，或许值得作为单独的论文发表并进行充分讨论。在此进行简化的尝试并未成功，如果我们想更好地讨论这一话题，将会偏离焦点。然而，非常感谢您的帮助。

3. 我不清楚（见第304行的评论）为何水生捕食者不能采用侧击的方式进行伏击捕食，因为这种现象在一些现生水生捕食者中确实存在。是的，您是对的。修订后的观点现已写入手稿。“组织学结果证实了直接侧向和双侧咬合的存在，但不排除其他组合，除了单侧咬合，这可能强化了侧击也作为伏击策略而非仅作为主动游泳的观点。”

4. 我对一幅图提出了稍作修改的建议，并建议增加一幅图以澄清结果（见“有效性”部分）。已接受并修改。

5. 全文英语水平需要提高，以确保国际读者能够理解您的文本。建议请一位英语母语的同事审阅您的手稿。我已进行了一些修正，并在注释PDF中高亮了难懂的文本（任何未附加评论的高亮文本均为语言不清的区域）。感谢，已接受并修改。

6. 本手稿的一个问题是缺乏明确的研究问题或待检验的假设（说明有限元分析和骨骼微结构的结果如何支持或反驳这些假设）。您必须在引言末尾添加此类内容。已添加：“在当前研究中，提出了一个新的概念，即使用骨骼微结构作为预测颅骨在进食过程中应力分布的方法，并进行了骨骼微结构与计算生物力学（有限元分析）结果的相关性研究。整合这些数据首先将检验有限元分析生成的预测，并帮助评估方法学假设和简化对最终解释的影响，其次将提供对坚头类进食生态学的新见解。”

7. 我意识到模型的详细方法已在其他地方发表，但基本信息需要在此重复——见注释PDF第371行。特别是如果您——如所建议的——自2017年发表以来对模型进行了修改，任何此类更改都需要详细说明，以便研究能够被复制。新手稿中提供了所有必要信息。

8. 您的文本（第529-531行）暗示侧击加载模式与单侧咬合不同。如果不同，请解释（在讨论2017年论文结果的早期部分）侧击加载模式实际涉及的内容及其与单侧咬合的区别。我们已添加了所有四种情景（单侧、双侧、侧向和颅骨提升系统）的描述。我们希望现在更容易理解这些区别。

9. 为了更好地理解“骨骼组织学 vs 计算生物力学——骨骼结构如何与有限元分析相关联？”这一讨论部分，如果能在显示冯·米塞斯应力的有限元模型截图上叠加骨骼边界（图8），将非常有帮助。读者可以将其与图2中标记的颅骨图进行比较，以了解在不同加载条件下不同骨骼中发生的应力情况。见新图，我们遵循了审稿人的建议。

10. 此外——为何不提供压缩与拉伸应力的等高线图，以查看您基于颅缝形态对应力类型的预测是否与有限元分析预测相符？冯·米塞斯应力图仅提供了应力大小的信息，而颅缝形状应与所经历的应力类型（张力、压缩）相关。我们已删除颅缝信息，以使论文更加聚焦于真正新颖的方法。

11. 在讨论的最后一部分（生活方式的新解释）中，请注意您的用词——尽管您有证据支持您的建议，但它们仍然是推测性的。您使用的一些措辞使这些想法听起来是结论性的。是的，同意。

paper_title: Linked within-host and between-host models and data for infectious diseases: A systematic review
paper_abstract: The observed dynamics of infectious diseases are driven by processes across multiple scales. Here we focus on two: within-host, that is how an infection progresses inside a single individual (for instance viral and immune dynamics), and between-host, that is how the infection is transmitted between multiple individuals of a host population. The dynamics of each of these may be influenced by the other, particularly across evolutionary time. Thus understanding each of these scales, and the links between them, is necessary for a holistic understanding of the spread of infectious diseases. One approach to combining these scales is through mathematical modeling. We conducted a systematic review of the published literature on multi-scale mathematical models of disease transmission (as defined by combining within-host and between-host scales) to determine the extent to which mathematical models are being used to understand across-scale transmission, and the extent to which these models are being confronted with data.
review_content: Reviewer 3 (Anonymous) Basic reporting In general, I really appreciate the theoretical and applied motivation for this study. I also feel that the study is timely and holds potential for applied applications of the questions raised in the paper. The paper is overall well written, thoughtfully constructed, and addresses important questions. I think the paper would benefit enormously from only a few very minor modifications. The paper is well written, thoughtfully constructed, addresses an important question, and yields interesting and timely results. I provide a few comments and suggestions, I hope that they will prove constructive. Experimental design Lines 76-77: I appreciate the rigorous approach taken in the systematic review. I can’t help but wonder if your review would be expanded if the following search terms were included: cross-scale models, nested models (e.g., Gilcrest was an early proponent of these models and he uses the term nested models), in-host, among-host. We thank the reviewer for this suggestion. We have widened our search terms in several ways to look for: (within-host* OR in-host-model* OR among-host-model* ) AND (between-host* OR nested-model* OR cross-scale-model*) AND (pathogen* OR parasite* ) AND (transmi*) We feel this encompasses all suggested additional terms by both this reviewer and other reviewers. We note that this search accesses the “title,” “abstract,” “author keywords,” and “keywords plus.” If the search terms are not found in these locations, the papers will not be returned from the search. In addition, I am assuming that the studies covered in the previous reviews on this topic that you mentioned were also included in your study (i.e., even if they did not appear in your Web of Science search)? For example, Hite and Cressler 2018 and Greenspoon et al., 2018, Smith and Mideo 2016 are a few examples that I do not see included in your reference list (i.e., in any of the main text or online supplementary information). I understand that this may seem like harping on a few studies not being included and I do not mean to do that. It’s just that a large portion of the current manuscript is devoted to describing the search terms. Given this emphasis, I just wonder if more studies would be included in the search terms were expanded. The reviewer is correct that papers mentioned did not appear in our references. Originally, our systematic review only extended to Nov 30, 2017, and thus the two papers from 2018 would not have been included. Our original search did not return Smith and Mideo (2016). In this revision, we have updated our search terms (as requested by reviewers) as well as extended our search through Dec 31, 2018. This returns the Hite and Cressler (2018) paper but not the Greenspoon et al (2018) paper nor the Smith and Mideo (2016) paper. We have evaluated these latter two papers, despite not meeting our search criteria, and find that neither meet our requirements for inclusion. As noted above the search terms need to appear in the title, abstract or keywords, which is not the case for the Greenspoon et al (2018) and Smith and Mideo (2016) so it is not surprising they were not returned. Furthermore, as neither of these papers ultimately met our criteria for inclusion, we feel our chosen search terms return the relevant papers. To be clear, the additional papers (Smith and Mideo 2016; Greenspoon et al, 2018) suggested by the reviewer but not returned by our search were not included in our discussion of the survey methodology (including Figure 1), but are included in all our data figures. In other words, 195 papers were listed as returned but 197 are included in our evaluation. Validity of the findings In this manuscript, the authors conduct a systematic review of the literature to examine the current state of cross-scale models that integrate data into the theoretical analyses. They provide a detailed overview of the specific types of models, host-parasite systems, linking mechanisms, and sub-fields addressing these questions. Their review illustrates that despite repeated calls for data-theory integration, few studies currently meet these demands. This study reports valid findings that appear quite timely and useful across multiple fields. Comments for the Author Lines 54-55: Are there references supporting the relationship between vial load and transmission? I know these relationships are quite difficult to obtain empirically and while this relationship is often assumed, I was not aware that there are many empirical studies that explicitly quantify this relationship. If so, providing those references would be quite useful. If not, maybe revise the sentence? We thank the reviewer for these comments. We intended this as suggested: that the relationship between viral load and transmission is often assumed. In other words, regardless of the empirical support, there is an assumption of a relationship between viral load and transmission. We are unaware of much empirical work supporting this but do provide a reference related to dengue (Nguyen, 2013).
paper_title_zh: 宿主内和宿主间传染病模型及数据的关联：系统综述
paper_abstract_zh: 传染病观察到的动态由多个尺度上的过程驱动。本文重点关注两个尺度：宿主体内，即感染在单个个体内部如何进展（例如病毒和免疫动态），以及宿主间，即感染如何在宿主种群的多名个体之间传播。每个尺度的动态都可能受到另一个尺度的影响，尤其是在进化时间尺度上。因此，理解每个尺度及其之间的联系，对于全面理解传染病的传播是必要的。将这两个尺度结合的一种方法是借助数学建模。我们对已发表的多尺度疾病传播数学模型文献（定义为结合宿主体内和宿主间尺度）进行了系统综述，以确定数学模型在理解跨尺度传播方面的应用程度，以及这些模型与数据相符的程度。
review_content_zh:
### 审稿人3（匿名）的基本报告

总的来说，我非常欣赏这项研究的理论和应用动机。我也认为这项研究时机恰当，对论文中提出的问题具有潜在的应用价值。总的来说，论文写得很好，构思周密，解决了重要问题。我认为，只需进行一些非常微小的修改，论文将受益匪浅。论文写作精良，构思严谨，探讨了重要问题，并得出了有趣且及时的结果。我提供了一些评论和建议，希望它们能有所帮助。

### 实验设计

第76-77行：我赞赏在系统综述中所采用的严谨方法。我不禁想知道，如果包括以下搜索术语，您的综述是否会扩展：跨尺度模型、嵌套模型（例如，Gilcrest是这些模型的早期支持者，他使用术语“嵌套模型”）、宿主体内、宿主间。我们感谢审稿人提出的建议。我们已经通过多种方式扩展了搜索术语，以查找：（宿主体内* OR 宿主体内模型* OR 宿主间模型*）AND（宿主间* OR 嵌套模型* OR 跨尺度模型*）AND（病原体* OR 寄生虫*）AND（传播*）。我们认为这涵盖了这位审稿人和其他审稿人建议的所有额外术语。我们注意到，这次搜索涉及“标题”、“摘要”、“作者关键词”和“关键词加”。如果这些位置找不到搜索术语，搜索将不会返回这些论文。此外，我假设您提到的关于这一主题的先前综述中所涵盖的研究也包括在您的研究中（即，即使它们没有出现在您的Web of Science搜索中）？例如，Hite和Cressler 2018年以及Greenspoon等人2018年、Smith和Mideo 2016年的研究，我在您的参考文献列表中（无论是在正文还是在线补充信息中）都没有看到这些研究。我理解这似乎是在纠结于少数未被包括的研究，我并非有意如此。只是手稿的大部分内容都用于描述搜索术语。鉴于这种强调，我只是想知道如果扩展搜索术语，是否会有更多研究被包括在内。

审稿人是对的，提到的论文没有出现在我们的参考文献中。最初，我们的系统综述只延伸到2017年11月30日，因此2018年的两篇论文不会被包括在内。我们的原始搜索没有返回Smith和Mideo（2016）的论文。在这篇修订稿中，我们更新了搜索术语（如审稿人所要求的），并将搜索扩展到2018年12月31日。这返回了Hite和Cressler（2018）的论文，但没有返回Greenspoon等人（2018）的论文和Smith和Mideo（2016）的论文。我们评估了这两篇 latter 论文，尽管它们不符合我们的搜索标准，发现它们都不符合我们的纳入要求。如上所述，搜索术语需要出现在标题、摘要或关键词中，而Greenspoon等人（2018）和Smith和Mideo（2016）的论文并非如此，因此它们没有被返回并不奇怪。此外，由于这两篇论文最终都不符合我们的纳入标准，我们认为我们选择的搜索术语返回了相关论文。需要明确的是，审稿人建议的额外论文（Smith和Mideo 2016年；Greenspoon等人2018年）虽然没有通过我们的搜索返回，但并未包括在我们对调查方法论的讨论中（包括图1），但包括在我们所有的数据图表中。换句话说，列出的论文为195篇，但评估中包括了197篇。

### 研究结果的有效性

在这篇手稿中，作者对文献进行了系统综述，以考察当前跨尺度模型将数据整合到理论分析中的现状。他们详细概述了特定类型的模型、宿主-寄生虫系统、链接机制以及解决这些问题的子领域。他们的综述表明，尽管一再呼吁数据与理论的整合，但目前很少有研究满足这些要求。这项研究报告了有效的发现，这些发现似乎非常及时，并在多个领域中有用。

### 对作者的评论

第54-55行：是否有参考文献支持病毒载量与传播之间的关系？我知道这些关系很难通过实证获得，尽管这种关系通常被假设，但我不清楚是否有许多实证研究明确量化了这种关系。如果有，提供这些参考文献将非常有用。如果没有，也许可以修改这句话？

我们感谢审稿人的这些评论。我们原本的意图是建议：病毒载量与传播之间的关系通常是被假设的。换句话说，无论实证支持如何，都存在病毒载量与传播之间关系的假设。我们不太了解支持这一点的实证工作，但确实提供了一个与登革热相关的参考文献（Nguyen，2013）。

paper_title: Big data clustering techniques based on Spark: a literature review
paper_abstract: A popular unsupervised learning method, known as clustering, is extensively used in data mining, machine learning and pattern recognition. The procedure involves grouping of single and distinct points in a group in such a way that they are either similar to each other or dissimilar to points of other clusters. Traditional clustering methods are greatly challenged by the recent massive growth of data. Therefore, several research works proposed novel designs for clustering methods that leverage the benefits of Big Data platforms, such as Apache Spark, which is designed for fast and distributed massive data processing. However, Spark-based clustering research is still in its early days. In this systematic survey, we investigate the existing Spark-based clustering methods in terms of their support to the characteristics Big Data. Moreover, we propose a new taxonomy for the Spark-based clustering methods. . To the best of our knowledge, no survey has been conducted on Spark-based clustering of Big Data. Therefore, this survey aims to present a comprehensive summary of the previous studies in the field of Big Data clustering using Apache Spark during the span of 2010-2020. This survey also highlights the new research directions in the field of clustering massive data.
review_content: Reviewer 1 (Anonymous) Basic reporting No comment. Experimental design No comment. Validity of the findings No comment. Comments for the Author This survey studies the previous literature and the existing applications on big data clustering techniques based on Spark, and the authors outline a commonly used pipeline in clustering methods based on Spark in a systematic way and focus on discussing by giving a comprehensive review and 93 direct researchers to the strong and weak points of the current Spark-based clustering methods. After that, they discuss the different Spark clustering algorithms. Finally, they present the discussion on the clustering big data using Spark and future direction. However, the topic is quite old. This paper fails to represent a high-quality survey with in-depth analysis, comparison, and discussion. The specific comments are shown as follows. Comment#1. As a survey paper, I don’t see many tables to make comparisons and no timeline to represent the evolution of big data clustering methods, which makes this paper quiet weak. Reply to Comment#1: We have added the following three tables to incorporate the reviewer’s comment: • Table 1: compares the Spark-based clustering method in terms of which Big Data characteristic (volume, variety and velocity) the method supports. Additionally, Table 1 compares the proposed clustering methods in terms of the type of data used (real and/or synthetic). • Table 2: shows the data sources of the Spark-based clustering papers discussed in the paper. Ta • Table 3: shows which of the papers used in this survey were published in each of the last 6 years and the count of published papers. Table 1 is added just before section VI, while Table 2 and 3 were added after Section VII. These tables were cited and discussed in Section VI. Comment#2. To review the data clustering based on Spark is a large topic, I recommend the authors to pick a distinguished perspective to study this topic, instead of attempting to review multiple aspects of it. Reply to Comment#2: We thank the reviewer for the suggestion, however we would like to point out that the area of clustering is a very old topic. However, the designing clustering methods to leverage the Big data platform is relatively new. As can be seen from Table 3, the Spark-based clustering methods were published in the last 4 years. That indicates that there is still a lot of potential for research and enhancement in cluster methods that leverage Big Data Platforms as we discussed in Section VI. Comment#3. As we step into the AI era, I also recommend the authors could add some machine learning-based works to make this survey more consistent with the technique changes. Reply to Comment#3: We agree with the reviewer that AI started to have big influence in the field of computing in general. We modified Section VI to discuss this the methods that utilized AI tools in clustering data while leveraging the benefits of Big Data platforms such as Spark. Comment#4. It would be better to give new insight into the challenges and future research direction. Reply to Comment#4: We have re-written Section VI to emphasize the future research directions. These modifications, particularly, highlight three new directions: • utilize AI tools in clustering data while leveraging the benefits of Big Data platforms such as Spark. • clustering methods to support the characteristics of variety and velocity of Big data. Additionally, support new aspects of clustering such as concept drift, scalability, integration, fault-tolerance, consistency, timeliness, load balancing, privacy, and incompleteness, etc. • Clustering methods to utilize Spark as it is an efficient Big Data platform. Comment#5. The figures in this paper are not clear enough. The text in the figures are blurred. Reply to Comment#5: We have improved all figures and their text. ______________________________________
paper_title_zh: 基于Spark的大数据聚类技术：文献综述
paper_abstract_zh: 一种流行的无监督学习方法，即聚类，被广泛应用于数据挖掘、机器学习和模式识别中。该过程涉及将单个且独特的点分组到一个组中，使得它们要么彼此相似，要么与其他簇的点不相似。传统的聚类方法因近年来数据的巨大增长而面临巨大挑战。因此，一些研究工作提出了利用大数据平台（如Apache Spark）优势的新型聚类方法设计，Apache Spark专为快速和分布式大规模数据处理而设计。然而，基于Spark的聚类研究仍处于早期阶段。在这项系统综述中，我们从支持大数据特性的角度调查了现有的基于Spark的聚类方法。此外，我们提出了一个新的基于Spark的聚类方法分类法。据我们所知，尚未有关于大数据基于Spark的聚类的研究综述。因此，本综述旨在全面总结2010年至2020年间使用Apache Spark进行大数据聚类领域的前人研究。本综述还突出了大规模数据聚类领域的新研究方向。
review_content_zh:
审稿人1（匿名）

基本报告
无评论。

实验设计
无评论。

结果的有效性
无评论。

对作者的评论
这项调查研究了基于Spark的大数据聚类技术的前期文献和现有应用，作者系统地概述了基于Spark的聚类方法中常用的管道，并通过全面的综述和93位直接研究人员讨论了当前基于Spark的聚类方法的优缺点。之后，他们讨论了不同的Spark聚类算法。最后，他们呈现了使用Spark进行大数据聚类的讨论和未来方向。然而，这个主题相当陈旧。本文未能代表一个具有深度分析、比较和讨论的高质量综述。具体评论如下：

评论#1：作为一篇综述文章，我没有看到很多用于比较的表格，也没有时间线来展示大数据聚类方法的演变，这使得这篇文章显得很弱。

对评论#1的回复：我们已根据审稿人的意见添加了以下三个表格：
• 表1：比较了基于Spark的聚类方法在支持大数据特性（体积、多样性和速度）方面的表现。此外，表1还比较了所提出的聚类方法在所用数据类型（真实和/或合成）方面的差异。
• 表2：展示了本文讨论的基于Spark的聚类论文的数据来源。
• 表3：展示了本综述中使用的论文在过去6年中的发表情况及发表论文的数量。表1添加在第六节之前，而表2和表3添加在第七节之后。这些表格在第六节中被引用和讨论。

评论#2：基于Spark的数据聚类是一个大课题，我建议作者选择一个独特的视角来研究这个课题，而不是试图综述其多个方面。

对评论#2的回复：我们感谢审稿人的建议，但我们要指出，聚类领域是一个非常古老的话题。然而，设计利用大数据平台的聚类方法是相对较新的。从表3可以看出，基于Spark的聚类方法是在过去4年中发表的。这表明在利用大数据平台的聚类方法中仍有很多研究和提升的潜力，正如我们在第六节中所讨论的。

评论#3：在我们步入AI时代之际，我也建议作者可以添加一些基于机器学习的工作，使这篇综述更符合技术变化。

对评论#3的回复：我们同意审稿人的观点，AI开始在计算领域产生重大影响。我们修改了第六节，讨论了在聚类数据时利用AI工具并发挥大数据平台（如Spark）优势的方法。

评论#4：最好能对挑战和未来研究方向给出新的见解。

对评论#4的回复：我们重写了第六节，强调未来研究方向。这些修改特别突出了三个新方向：
• 在聚类数据时利用AI工具并发挥大数据平台（如Spark）的优势。
• 聚类方法支持大数据的多样性和速度特性。此外，支持聚类的新方面，如概念漂移、可扩展性、集成、容错、一致性、及时性、负载平衡、隐私和不完整性等。
• 利用Spark作为高效大数据平台的聚类方法。

评论#5：本文中的图表不够清晰，图表中的文字模糊。

对评论#5的回复：我们已改进了所有图表及其文字。

paper_title: The emergence of a modern paradigm for urban health
paper_abstract: The importance of urban health in achieving global and planetary health goals is increasingly recognized. Cities offer important opportunities to improve health while also presenting significant challenges. As our understanding of and evidence for the importance of determinants of health beyond health care have grown, the need for urban health policies and actions that transcend disciplinary and sectoral boundaries and involve multiple stakeholders in urban decision-making has become clearer. Current urban health practice builds on decades of conceptual and operational work. This paper traces the evolution of the urban health paradigm through research, policy and practice in recent decades. We suggest that, despite the proven utility of urban health as a paradigm and its conceptual and practical evolution for effective urban health governance, significant challenges remain, especially related to implementing the systems approaches needed to improve health amidst the complexity of urban dynamics.
review_content:
While the paper does a fairly comprehensive treatment outlining the history of the urban health paradigm, it relies heavily on authoritative global health agency practice, positions, and frameworks.

My review concerns two areas:

1) Authors conclude the following: While some of the insights from 75 years of evolving understanding of urban health and wellbeing have been incorporated into the Sustainable Development Goals, it is far from clear that the global agenda has taken sufficient account of lessons learned.

However, this statement lacks a thorough discussion of what lessons were learned in the past 75 years -- other than the evolving frameworks. What is the evidence base?

This may be too broad but perhaps illustrative examples would be useful.

2) Related to above, what do authors opine are the major global pressures of our time? How do these new global pressures inform this new urban health paradigm? The authors do not seem to clearly articulate what the emerging health paradigm is. There is limited discussion and treatment of both classic and contemporary theoretical frameworks that exist in the social sciences that may advance this thinking. Section 5 highlights Vlahov and Galea. However, in the spirit of transdisciplinary approaches to solving the major urban health challenges of our time -- shift from communicable to NCDs, emergence of novel viral pandemics, crisis management/adaption in the face of climate change, rising inequality/health inequity in established/older cities in more affluent countries, gentrification -- there is no consideration of some of the critical frameworks from other disciplines that can help advance our thinking on how to inform a new health paradigm. There is much insight that can be learned from the fields of social epidemiology (in public health with emphasis on the social determinants of health) and urban planning/development theory (Lewis, Mumford).
paper_title_zh: 现代城市健康范式的兴起
paper_abstract_zh: 城市健康在实现全球和行星健康目标中的重要性日益得到认可。城市提供了改善健康的重要机会，同时也带来了显著挑战。随着我们对医疗保健之外的健康决定因素的理解和证据的增加，跨学科和部门界限并涉及多个城市决策利益相关者的城市健康政策和行动的需求变得更加明确。当前的城市健康实践建立在数十年的概念和操作性工作之上。本文追溯了近年来通过研究、政策和实践的城市健康范式的演变。我们认为，尽管城市健康作为一个范式已被证明具有实用价值，并在概念和实践上为有效的城市健康治理不断演变，但仍存在重大挑战，尤其是与在复杂的城市动态中实施改善健康所需的系统方法相关的问题。
review_content_zh:
尽管该论文对城市健康范式的历史进行了相当全面的概述，但它严重依赖于权威全球卫生机构的实践、立场和框架。

我的评论涉及两个领域：

1) 作者得出以下结论：尽管过去75年对城市健康和福祉的演变理解中的一些洞见已被纳入可持续发展目标，但全球议程是否充分吸取了所汲取的教训，这一点远不清楚。

然而，这一声明缺乏对过去75年所汲取教训的深入讨论——除了演变中的框架之外。证据基础是什么？

这可能范围太广，但或许举例说明会很有用。

2) 与上述相关，作者认为我们时代的主要全球压力是什么？这些新的全球压力如何影响新的城市健康范式？作者似乎没有明确阐述新兴的健康范式是什么。对于存在于社会科学中可能推进这一思考的经典和当代理论框架，讨论和处理都有限。第5节突出了Vlahov和Galea。然而，在跨学科方法解决我们时代的主要城市健康挑战的精神下——从传染病到非传染性疾病的转变、新型病毒大流行的出现、面对气候变化的危机管理/适应、富裕国家中已建立/较老城市的不平等/健康不公现象上升、绅士化——没有考虑到其他学科中一些关键框架，这些框架可以帮助我们推进如何构建新健康范式的思考。从社会流行病学（公共卫生中强调社会决定因素）和城市规划/发展理论（Lewis, Mumford）领域可以学到许多洞见。

paper_title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Large Models: A Comprehensive Survey
paper_abstract: Large models represent a groundbreaking advancement in multiple application fields, enabling remarkable achievements across various tasks. However, their unprecedented scale comes with significant computational costs. These models, often consisting of billions of parameters, require vast amounts of computational resources for execution. Especially, the expansive scale and computational demands pose considerable challenges when customizing them for particular downstream tasks, particularly over the hardware platforms constrained by computational capabilities. Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) provides a practical solution by efficiently adjusting the large models over the various downstream tasks. In particular, PEFT refers to the process of adjusting the parameters of a pre-trained large model to adapt it to a specific task or domain while minimizing the number of additional parameters introduced or computational resources required. This approach is particularly important when dealing with large-scale language models with high parameter counts, as fine-tuning these models from scratch can be computationally expensive and resource-intensive, posing considerable challenges in the supporting system platform design. In this survey, we present comprehensive studies of various PEFT algorithms, examining their performance and computational overhead. Moreover, we provide an overview of applications developed using different PEFT algorithms and discuss common techniques employed to mitigate PEFT computation costs. In addition to providing an extensive survey from an algorithmic standpoint, we also examine various real-world system designs to investigate the implementation costs associated with different PEFT approaches. This survey serves as a valuable resource for researchers aiming to understand both the PEFT algorithm and its system implementation, offering detailed insights into recent advancements and practical applications.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The paper provides a comprehensive overview of Parameter Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) algorithms for adapting large pre-trained models to specific downstream tasks while minimizing the number of additional parameters and computational resources required. The key contributions of the paper are: 1. It examines the performance and computational overhead of various PEFT algorithms. This helps understand the trade-offs between fine-tuning efficiency and model performance. 2. It provides an overview of applications developed using different PEFT algorithms. This illustrates the practical utility and versatility of PEFT techniques across domains. 3. It discusses common techniques employed to mitigate the computational costs of PEFT. 4. Beyond just the algorithms, it also examines real-world training and serving system designs to investigate the implementation costs of different PEFT approaches, which are crucial for practical deployment.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
Strengths: The paper provides a comprehensive review of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) algorithms, covering additive, selective, reparameterized, and hybrid approaches. Additionally, the authors discuss efficient optimization techniques for deploying PEFT models, as well as some existing system examples. Overall, this survey serves as a valuable resource for understanding and utilizing PEFT techniques in the era of large pre-trained models. Weakness: 1. Lack of clarity on KV-cache management: In the efficient PEFT design section, it is unclear how to specifically conduct KV-cache management for PEFT tasks. Providing more detailed guidance on this aspect would enhance the practicality of this part. 2. Limited coverage of recent works: The PEFT serving system parts could be improved by including other recent works, such as dLora (OSDI 2024). This would ensure that the survey remains up-to-date and comprehensive. 3. Absence of benchmarks: The survey lacks related benchmarks regarding both algorithm and system optimization. Including such benchmarks would provide a more thorough evaluation of the PEFT techniques and systems, allowing readers to better understand their performance and trade-offs.

**Requested Changes:**
To strengthen the work: 1. Comprehensive benchmarking: To provide a more thorough evaluation, I recommend adding benchmarks for different key algorithms (e.g., various forms of PEFT methods) using diverse metrics. Additionally, benchmarking different training and serving systems for PEFT workloads and comparing their metrics would be beneficial. A more detailed discussion of existing evaluation practices would also enhance the work. 2. Correction in Section 6.4: I noticed that S-Lora and Punica are actually Lora serving frameworks, whereas the section title is "Parallel PEFT Training Frameworks". I suggest that the authors correct this inconsistency to ensure clarity and accuracy. 3. Abstraction of challenges and design principles: In the PEFT system parts, I recommend that the authors abstract the challenges and key design principles for PEFT workloads instead of simply listing related works and their methods. This would provide a more insightful and structured discussion, allowing readers to better understand the underlying complexities and design considerations for PEFT systems.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes
paper_title_zh: 大型模型的参数高效微调：综述
paper_abstract_zh: 大型模型在多个应用领域代表了突破性的进步，使各种任务取得了显著成就。然而，其前所未有的规模带来了显著的计算成本。这些通常包含数十亿参数的模型，需要大量的计算资源来执行。特别是，其庞大的规模和计算需求在为特定下游任务进行定制时带来了相当大的挑战，尤其是在受计算能力限制的硬件平台上。参数高效微调（PEFT）通过高效调整大型模型以适应各种下游任务，提供了一种实用解决方案。具体而言，PEFT指的是调整预训练大型模型的参数以适应特定任务或领域，同时最小化引入的额外参数数量或所需的计算资源。这种方法在处理高参数量的大型语言模型时尤为重要，因为从头开始微调这些模型可能会非常昂贵且资源密集，对支持系统平台设计构成相当大的挑战。在本综述中，我们全面研究了各种PEFT算法，考察了它们的性能和计算开销。此外，我们概述了使用不同PEFT算法开发的应用，并讨论了常用的减轻PEFT计算成本的技术。除了从算法角度提供广泛的综述外，我们还考察了各种现实世界的系统设计，以研究不同PEFT方法的实施成本。本综述为旨在理解PEFT算法及其系统实现的研究人员提供了宝贵资源，提供了对最新进展和实际应用的详细见解。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
本文全面概述了参数高效微调（PEFT）算法，旨在将大型预训练模型适应特定下游任务，同时最小化所需的额外参数和计算资源。论文的主要贡献包括：1. 检查了各种PEFT算法的性能和计算开销，帮助理解微调效率和模型性能之间的权衡。2. 提供了使用不同PEFT算法开发的应用概述，展示了PEFT技术在各个领域的实用性和多样性。3. 讨论了用于减轻PEFT计算成本的常见技术。4. 除了算法本身，还考察了实际训练和服务系统设计，以研究不同PEFT方法的实施成本，这对实际部署至关重要。

**优点和缺点：**
优点：本文全面回顾了参数高效微调（PEFT）算法，涵盖了附加、选择、重参数化和混合方法。此外，作者还讨论了部署PEFT模型的优化技术以及一些现有系统示例。总体而言，这项调查是理解和使用大型预训练模型时代PEFT技术的宝贵资源。缺点：1. KV-cache管理的清晰度不足：在高效PEFT设计部分，不清楚如何具体进行PEFT任务的KV-cache管理。提供更多关于这一方面的详细指导将增强这部分的实际应用性。2. 对近期工作的覆盖有限：PEFT服务系统部分可以通过包括其他近期工作（如dLora，OSDI 2024）来改进，以确保调查保持最新和全面。3. 缺乏基准测试：调查缺乏关于算法和系统优化的相关基准。包括这些基准将提供对PEFT技术和系统的更全面评估，使读者更好地理解其性能和权衡。

**请求的更改：**
为加强工作：1. 全面基准测试：为提供更彻底的评估，我建议添加不同关键算法（如各种形式的PEFT方法）的基准，使用多样化指标。此外，对PEFT工作负载的不同训练和服务系统进行基准测试并比较其指标也将有益。更详细地讨论现有评估实践也将增强工作。2. 修正第6.4节：我注意到S-Lora和Punica实际上是Lora服务框架，而该节标题为“并行PEFT训练框架”。我建议作者修正这一不一致，以确保清晰和准确。3. 挑战和设计原则的抽象：在PEFT系统部分，我建议作者抽象出PEFT工作负载的挑战和关键设计原则，而不是简单地列出相关工作及其方法。这将提供更有洞察力和结构化的讨论，使读者更好地理解PEFT系统的底层复杂性和设计考虑。

**声明和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

paper_title: The predictive value of PRDM2 in solid tumor: a systematic review and meta-analysis
paper_abstract: Background. Many studies have reported the presence of Positive Regulatory/Su(var)3-9,Enhancer-of-zeste and Trithorax Domain 2 (PRDM2) downregulation in cancer. However, its potential as a diagnostic biomarker is still unclear. Hence, a systematic review and metaanalysis were conducted to address this issue.

Experimental design The study is well thought through and critical of itself. I applaud the authors meticulous and tedious work. I'm in favor of publication as it insights need for more experimental studies on PRDM2 down regulation in solid tumors. Validity of the findings The authors should explain in the results how the 3870 records were excluded and they should make conclusions once there is sufficient data available otherwise it appears to be phrased as if authors doubt their own conclusions in their present study. paper_title: Leisure-Based Interventions in Adults with Schizophrenia: A Scoping Review
paper_abstract:
Background 
     Schizophrenia is a severe mental illness characterized by psychosis, apathy, social withdrawal, and cognitive impairment, which results in impaired functioning in work, school, parenting, self-care, independent living, interpersonal relationships, and leisure time. 
   
   
     Method 
     A systematic search was conducted using Arksey and O’Malley’s framework with studies published on leisure-based intervention from January 1990 to December 2023. 
   
   
     Results 
     The review included 11 articles in the study. In total two studies were pilot interventional study, one randomized controlled study, one case-control, one retrospective study, three were cross sectional, one was cross sectional longitudinal study and two were qualitative in nature. Studies used different types of leisure activities like cooking group, discussions, board games, arts and craft, painting, beading, sewing, clay work, paper craft, etc were used as an intervention. Qualitative studies found that individuals with schizophrenia spent less time in social and leisure activities and more time relaxing and doing nothing. 
   
   
     Conclusion 
     The study highlights the need to conduct further research on leisure-based interventions using various study designs like randomized controlled trials and mixed methods to understand its effectiveness among individuals with schizophrenia.
review_content:
The study by Nishad et al. aims to explore the existing literature related to the leisure-based interventions for adults with schizophrenia by identifying the range of study designs. The results of the present study highlight the need to conduct further research on leisure-based interventions using rigorous study designs like randomized controlled trials and mixed methods to understand its effectiveness among individuals with schizophrenia.
The study topic is timely and interesting. However, according to the comments provided below, some important issues should be addressed.
  * Abstract
 1. The aims of the study are missing.
 2. In the results section, listing the methodology of all the studies included in the review might be removed.
 3. In the results section, are reported only the findings of qualitative studies. Please report also the quantitative results.
  * Introduction
 1. Citations after the sentences “Approximately 24 million individuals worldwide, or 1 in 300, are affected by schizophrenia” and “In adulthood, the corresponding rate is 1 in 222” are missing. Please add them.
 2. The sentence “One of the main mental health disorders contributing to the global disease burden is schizophrenia, that also affects social functioning” does not appear fluid within the paragraph and it could be changed with “Schizophrenia is one of the main mental health disorders contributing to the global disease burden, affecting different functioning domains, among which social functioning”.
 3. Does “systematic activities carried out by beginners or hobbyists with skills and expertise that could lead to a career itself” and “occasionally short-term tasks completed as part of work obligations” correspond respectively to serious- and project-based leisure activities? Please specify.
 4. The sentence “One aspect of a meaningful life that provides those with mental illness with many benefits is leisure, which includes identity, belonging to themselves, involvement, lowering boredom, and a method of managing their stress” does not appear fluid within the paragraph. Please change it, linking the sentence with the previous one.
 5. The authors states that “negative symptoms of psychosis may make it difficult for a person to participate in leisure activities”. The concept could be further discussed, more references are needed and also the impact of cognitive deficit on participating in leisure activity should be examined.
 6. The aim of the study should be modified. Instead of prioritizing the identification of the range of study designs, the focus should be placed on the findings of the included studies, highlighting the impact and utilization of leisure-based interventions in adults with schizophrenia.
  * Methods
 1. (Major concern) I have some concerns regarding the search string. By using "schizophrenia AND psychosis," there is a risk, albeit minimal, of excluding studies on patients with schizophrenia that do not include the term psychosis. Additionally, parentheses were not used, which might have resulted in missing some works that could have been included.
  * Results
 1. I recommend reorganizing the presentation of the results because the current format might be unclear. For instance, it is not evident why the sections "Leisure activities and association with various factors in individuals with schizophrenia", "Time use and schizophrenia", and "Clinical and functional outcome" are separated, as they appear to summarize similar results.
 2. When listing the locations where the studies were conducted, the authors sometimes use the city and other times the country. This leads to inconsistencies, such as separating the study conducted in the USA from the one conducted in Philadelphia. In my opinion, it would be better to choose a single classification criterion to ensure consistency.
  * Discussion:
 1. The discussion section needs to be completely rewritten. The authors merely restate the results of individual studies instead of organizing the discussion around the following suggested points:
  * Discuss the finding that patients with schizophrenia spend little time engaging in leisure activities and that the activities they do engage in are usually passive.
  * Discuss the fact that the included studies in the review show that engaging in leisure activities benefits patients with schizophrenia. Specifically, address how these activities impact cognitive, clinical, functional, and quality of life dimensions.
  * Discuss the studies that utilized leisure-based interventions for patients with schizophrenia. Summarize the findings of these studies, and examine any differences in outcomes based on sample size, study design, and type of intervention as reported in the included studies.
 1. The conclusions should include a consideration of how promising and important leisure-based interventions can be, if the authors believe they are. This addition would highlight the potential value and significance of these interventions in the treatment and support of patients with schizophrenia.
  * Other
The manuscript would benefit from a review by a native English speaker due to the presence of small but frequent grammatical and spelling errors. Improving the language quality would enhance the clarity and readability of the paper.
paper_title_zh: 基于休闲的干预措施在成年精神分裂症患者中的应用：一项范围综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景
精神分裂症是一种严重的精神疾病，其特征包括精神病性症状、冷漠、社交退缩和认知障碍，导致在工作、学习、育儿、自我照顾、独立生活、人际关系和休闲时间等方面的功能受损。

方法
采用Arksey和O'Malley的框架进行了系统检索，纳入了1990年1月至2023年12月发表的基于休闲活动的干预研究。

结果
该综述共纳入了11篇文章。其中，两项为试点干预研究，一项为随机对照研究，一项为病例对照研究，一项为回顾性研究，三项为横断面研究，一项为横断面纵向研究，两项为质性研究。研究采用了不同类型的休闲活动作为干预手段，如烹饪小组、讨论、棋盘游戏、艺术和手工、绘画、串珠、缝纫、陶艺、纸艺等。质性研究发现，精神分裂症患者在社会和休闲活动上花费的时间较少，而更多时间用于放松和无所事事。

结论
该研究强调了需要通过随机对照试验和混合方法等多种研究设计，进一步研究基于休闲活动的干预措施，以了解其在精神分裂症患者中的有效性。
review_content_zh:
Nishad等人的研究旨在通过识别研究设计的范围，探讨与成人精神分裂症患者休闲干预相关的现有文献。当前研究的结果强调了使用严格的研究设计（如随机对照试验和混合方法）进一步研究休闲干预的必要性，以了解其在精神分裂症患者中的有效性。

研究主题及时且有趣。然而，根据以下提供的评论，一些重要问题应予以解决。

* 摘要
1. 研究目标缺失。
2. 在结果部分，列出综述中包含的所有研究的方法论可能应删除。
3. 结果部分仅报告了定性研究的发现。请同时报告定量结果。

* 引言
1. 句子“全球约有2400万人，即每300人中就有1人受精神分裂症影响”和“在成年期，相应的比例为1/222”后缺少引用。请添加。
2. 句子“精神分裂症是导致全球疾病负担的主要精神健康障碍之一，也影响社会功能”在段落中显得不流畅，可以改为“精神分裂症是导致全球疾病负担的主要精神健康障碍之一，影响不同的功能领域，其中之一是社会功能”。
3. “由初学者或具有技能和专长的爱好者进行的系统性活动，可能导致其本身成为职业”和“偶尔作为工作义务完成的短期任务”是否分别对应于严肃型和项目型休闲活动？请明确。
4. 句子“休闲是充实生活的一个方面，为精神疾病患者带来许多益处，包括身份认同、自我归属、参与、降低无聊感以及管理压力的方法”在段落中显得不流畅。请修改，将该句与前一句连接。
5. 作者指出“精神病的阴性症状可能使一个人难以参与休闲活动”。这一概念需要进一步讨论，需要更多参考文献，并应考察认知缺陷对参与休闲活动的影响。
6. 研究目标应修改。不应优先识别研究设计的范围，而应重点关注所包含研究的发现，突出休闲干预在成人精神分裂症患者中的影响和利用。

* 方法
1. （主要关注点）我对搜索字符串有些担忧。使用“精神分裂症 AND 精神病”可能会排除未包含“精神病”一词的精神分裂症患者研究，尽管风险很小。此外，未使用括号，可能导致遗漏一些本应包含的作品。

* 结果
1. 我建议重新组织结果展示，因为当前格式可能不清楚。例如，不清楚为何将“精神分裂症患者的休闲活动与各种因素的相关性”、“时间利用与精神分裂症”和“临床和功能结果”分开，因为它们似乎总结了相似的结果。
2. 列出研究地点时，作者有时使用城市，有时使用国家。这导致不一致，如将美国进行的研究与费城进行的研究分开。我认为最好选择单一分类标准以确保一致性。

* 讨论
1. 讨论部分需要完全重写。作者只是重述了单个研究的结果，而不是围绕以下建议点组织讨论：
* 讨论精神分裂症患者很少花时间参与休闲活动，且参与的活动通常是被动的事实。
* 讨论综述中包含的研究表明参与休闲活动对精神分裂症患者有益。具体说明这些活动如何影响认知、临床、功能和生活质量维度。
* 讨论使用休闲干预的精神分裂症患者研究。总结这些研究的发现，并考察基于样本量、研究设计和干预类型的不同结果。

1. 结论应包括对休闲干预的前景和重要性的考虑，如果作者认为它们有前景和重要的话。这一补充将突出这些干预在治疗和支持精神分裂症患者中的潜在价值和意义。

* 其他
由于存在小而频繁的语法和拼写错误，手稿将受益于母语为英语者的审阅。提高语言质量将增强论文的清晰度和可读性。

paper_title: A Survey on Data Selection for Language Models
paper_abstract: A major factor in the recent success of large language models is the use of enormous and ever-growing text datasets for unsupervised pre-training. However, naively training a model on all available data may not be optimal (or feasible), as the quality of available text data can vary. Filtering out data can also decrease the carbon footprint and financial costs of training models by reducing the amount of training required. Data selection methods aim to determine which candidate data points to include in the training dataset and how to appropriately sample from the selected data points. The promise of improved data selection methods has caused the volume of research in the area to rapidly expand. However, because deep learning is mostly driven by empirical evidence and experimentation on large-scale data is expensive, few organizations have the resources for extensive data selection research. Consequently, knowledge of effective data selection practices has become concentrated within a few organizations, many of which do not openly share their findings and methodologies. To narrow this gap in knowledge, we present a comprehensive review of existing literature on data selection methods and related research areas, providing a taxonomy of existing approaches. By describing the current landscape of research, this work aims to accelerate progress in data selection by establishing an entry point for new and established researchers. Additionally, throughout this review we draw attention to noticeable holes in the literature and conclude the paper by proposing promising avenues for future research.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
The authors present an in-depth review on the current state of data selection in natural language processing (NLP). I very much enjoyed reading this outstandingly up-to-date and comprehensive overview of the state of the art in data centric language modeling. Given the importance of this topic I'm convinced that the value of contributions that aim at comprehensive surveys in this field are hard to underestimate. This holds true for all subcommunities of the ML field, but in NLP the topic deserves special attention: due to the vast amount of data and the fact that we currently do not really understand the complexity of commonly used training data sets (in contrast to, say, computer vision or tabular data sets), the research summarized in this manuscript is more heterogeneous and difficult to structure than data cleaning/selection methods in other fields. As demonstrated by the number of references cited, structuing the complexity of this field is a very valuable contribution. When reading the manuscript I just had minor remarks that I'll list below.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
## Strengths * impressive breadth of literature review * great summaries of cited content; I felt the level of detail was just right for this purpose * the structure of the manuscript was clear and easy to follow * the illustrations were great and helped to guide the reader ## Weaknesses * the focus of the survey was very fine grained; except for the high level structure given by the model development cycle of LLMs, it felt like there is not much structure between the leaves of the taxonomy of methods studied and the high level structure of the model development. Maybe it would help readers to try and have some more mid-level structure? I'm not sure whether that's possible and how the best solution would look like - but maybe there are commonalities between methods that could help to reduce the complexity? Or there could be, for each section/model development step some sort of ranking, of which methods are most popular or successful in terms of quantitative metrics? * related to the above point, I think the authors did a great job at objectively summarizing the field with a neutral tone and view. But I guess for many readers it would be helpful to have bit of guidance or insight into what works and what did not show concistent empirical improvements? In some paragraphs the authors mention that methods did not really get traction or are not really used anymore, but maybe an overview of those methods that did survive would be helpful? * I believe active learning is probably relevant as well and has been applied to NLP problems, too [Zhang et al., "A Survey of Active Learning for Natural Language Processing", EMNLP, 2022](https://aclanthology.org/2022.emnlp-main.414.pdf) - some references probably mention literature in that field, so sorry if I just missed that, but it seems that could maybe fit in section 9.

**Requested Changes:**
In order to guide readers a bit better through the amount of information provided in the survey it would be great if the authors could add a bit of mid-level structure (taxonomy or illustrations/rankings of methods) as mentioned above.

**Broader Impact Concerns:**
The authors do discuss societial impact of data set quality on LLMs, including concerns such as fairness and how it could be enforced via data set curation, as well as concerns on data protection.

**Claims And Evidence:**
Yes

**Audience:**
Yes

**Rebuttal Comments:**
Response to TCqY: Thank you for the high praise! We appreciate the feedback and are glad that you enjoyed reading our work and found it to be comprehensive and outstanding. We agree that data selection, and data-centric research in general, are crucial right now in NLP and we hope this survey can be a starting point for many new works in the field. We address the requested change and weaknesses below. **- Requested change and Weaknesses 1 + 2 (Mid-level structure and current best methods):** Thank you for the feedback, we did our best to stay very neutral when discussing the vast landscape of methods, but understand that it will likely be quite useful for the community to have a set of best practices. We had previously included some mid-level information that compares methods, but this information is spread out across the individual sections for each method. For example, in section 3.4 (paragraph "Comparison to data quality filters.") we discuss how methods for quality filtering have essentially spun-off from methods of domain-specific selection. Additionally, in Section 3 we discuss reasons why the filters are generally used in this particular order, including efficiency and the amount of data they remove. To create more mid-level structure we emphasize these connections and reiterate them in a new section (3.9) to bring these connections to attention. Furthermore, to clarify the methods which have been demonstrated to work best, the new section of the manuscript contains the current best practices and aims to bring additional mid-level structure by discussing the connections between methods. Please see section 3.9 in the revised manuscript for the updated section. **- Weakness 3 (Active Learning)** Thank you for bringing this to our attention, we agree that active learning is a related topic and important to cover within the related topics section. Please see the new paragraph on active learning in section 9 of the revised manuscript (highlighted in red).
paper_title_zh: 语言模型数据选择综述
paper_abstract_zh: 近期大型语言模型成功的主要因素之一是使用庞大且不断增长的文本数据集进行无监督预训练。然而，盲目地在所有可用数据上训练模型可能并非最优（或可行），因为可用文本数据的质量参差不齐。通过筛选数据，还可以通过减少所需训练量来降低训练模型的碳足迹和财务成本。数据选择方法旨在确定哪些候选数据点应包含在训练数据集中，以及如何从选定的数据点中进行适当抽样。改进数据选择方法的潜力使得该领域的研究量迅速扩大。然而，由于深度学习主要依赖于实证证据，且在大规模数据上的实验成本高昂，因此很少有组织拥有进行广泛数据选择研究的资源。结果，有效数据选择实践的知识集中在少数组织手中，其中许多组织并不公开分享其发现和方法。为缩小这一知识差距，我们对现有关于数据选择方法及相关研究领域的文献进行了全面综述，提供了一个现有方法的分类体系。通过描述当前研究现状，本文旨在通过为新兴和资深研究者建立一个切入点，以加速数据选择领域的进展。此外，在本次综述中，我们指出了文献中的明显空白，并在文末提出了未来研究的潜在方向。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
作者对自然语言处理（NLP）中数据选择的当前状态进行了深入综述。我非常享受阅读这篇极为及时且全面的关于数据驱动语言建模现状的综述。鉴于这一主题的重要性，我相信旨在对该领域进行全面综述的贡献价值难以低估。这对于机器学习（ML）领域的所有子社区都适用，但在NLP中，这一主题尤其值得特别关注：由于数据量庞大，且我们目前并未真正理解常用训练数据集的复杂性（与计算机视觉或表格数据集相比），本文总结的研究比其他领域的数据清洗/选择方法更为异质且难以结构化。正如所引用的参考文献数量所示，对这一领域的复杂性进行结构化是一项非常有价值的贡献。在阅读手稿时，我只有一些小的意见，将在下面列出。

**优点和缺点：**
## 优点
* 文献综述范围广泛，令人印象深刻
* 对引用内容的总结出色；我觉得细节程度对于这一目的来说恰到好处
* 手稿结构清晰，易于跟随
* 插图精美，有助于引导读者

## 缺点
* 综述的重点非常细致；除了由大型语言模型（LLM）开发周期给出的高级结构外，感觉在所研究方法的分类法叶子节点和模型开发的高级结构之间没有太多结构。也许尝试增加一些中级结构会对读者有所帮助？我不确定这是否可能以及最佳解决方案是什么——但也许方法之间有一些共性可以帮助减少复杂性？或者，对于每个部分/模型开发步骤，可以有一些关于哪些方法在定量指标上最受欢迎或最成功的排序？
* 与上述观点相关，我认为作者在以中立语气和视角客观总结该领域方面做得很好。但我想对于许多读者来说，如果能有一些关于哪些方法有效、哪些方法未显示出一致的经验改进的指导或见解会很有帮助。在一些段落中，作者提到某些方法并未真正获得关注或不再被广泛使用，但也许对那些幸存的方法进行概述会更有帮助？
* 我认为主动学习也可能相关，并且也已应用于NLP问题[Zhang等人，"自然语言处理中的主动学习综述"，EMNLP，2022](https://aclanthology.org/2022.emnlp-main.414.pdf)——一些参考文献可能提到了该领域的文献，所以抱歉如果我刚好错过了，但似乎这也许可以放在第9节中。

**请求的更改：**
为了更好地引导读者通过综述中提供的大量信息，如果作者能增加一些中级结构（分类法或方法的插图/排序），如上所述，将会非常不错。

**更广泛的影响关切：**
作者确实讨论了数据集质量对LLM的社会影响，包括公平性及其如何通过数据集策展来强制执行的问题，以及数据保护的关切。

**主张和证据：**
是

**受众：**
是

**反驳意见：**
对TCqY的回应：感谢您的高度赞扬！我们感谢您的反馈，并很高兴您喜欢阅读我们的工作，并认为它全面且出色。我们同意数据选择以及一般的数据驱动研究目前在NLP中至关重要，我们希望这篇综述能成为该领域许多新工作的起点。我们在下面 address 请求的更改和缺点。
**- 请求的更改和缺点1 + 2（中级结构及当前最佳方法）：** 感谢您的反馈，我们在讨论方法广泛景观时尽力保持非常中立，但理解对于社区来说，拥有一套最佳实践可能非常有用。我们之前包含了一些比较方法的中级信息，但这些信息分散在每个方法的各个部分中。例如，在第3.4节（段落“与数据质量过滤器的比较。”）中，我们讨论了质量过滤方法是如何从领域特定选择方法中衍生出来的。此外，在第3节中，我们讨论了为什么通常按此顺序使用过滤器的原因，包括效率和它们移除的数据量。为了创建更多的中级结构，我们强调这些联系，并在新部分（3.9）中重申它们，以引起对这些联系的注意。此外，为了澄清哪些方法已被证明最有效，手稿的新部分包含了当前最佳实践，并旨在通过讨论方法之间的联系来增加中级结构。请参阅修订手稿中的第3.9节以获取更新部分。
**- 缺点3（主动学习）** 感谢您提请我们注意这一点，我们同意主动学习是一个相关主题，并在相关主题部分中加以涵盖。请参阅修订手稿第9节中关于主动学习的新段落（以红色突出显示）。

paper_title: A Comprehensive Survey on Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning: Definitions, Progress and Challenges
paper_abstract: Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning (ICRL) is the task of inferring the implicit constraints followed by expert agents from their demonstration data. As an emerging research topic, ICRL has received considerable attention in recent years. This article presents a categorical survey of the latest advances in ICRL. It serves as a comprehensive reference for machine learning researchers and practitioners, as well as starters seeking to comprehend the definitions, advancements, and important challenges in ICRL. We begin by formally defining the problem and outlining the algorithmic framework that facilitates constraint inference across various scenarios. These include deterministic or stochastic environments, environments with limited demonstrations, and multiple agents. For each context, we illustrate the critical challenges and introduce a series of fundamental methods to tackle these issues. This survey encompasses discrete, virtual, and realistic environments for evaluating ICRL agents. We also delve into the most pertinent applications of ICRL, such as autonomous driving, robot control, and sports analytics. To stimulate continuing research, we conclude the survey with a discussion of key unresolved questions in ICRL that can effectively foster a bridge between theoretical understanding and practical industrial applications.
review_content:
**Summary Of Contributions:**
This paper presents to the best of my knowledge the first survey in the area of constraint inference. The authors discuss recent developments in constraint inference in reinforcement leaning but also in control tasks.The authors provide motivation for the research area and they follow to discuss most of the recent advances. They also discuss some open problems as a possible direction for future research.

**Strengths And Weaknesses:**
**Strengths**: The paper is well structured. The authors try to present some key details about the setup and implementation of each paper in an organized way. To the best of my knowledge most of the relevant research work has been included. I have included a few additional papers later in my review that the authors might want to consider. The authors also try to shed some light on the possible future directions that might be of interest. **Weaknesses**: * Surveys that also benchmark different methods tend to be even more valuable in my view, although I understand that this is a significantly more involved task. I think that regarding the future direction the authors should try and elaborate a bit more on the "challenges part" and possible future research avenues. For example, the case of inferring dynamic constraints (like moving obstacles) could be discussed. Also for example, constraint inference could be potentially utilized in aligning LLMs so that they respect constraints. * The authors also do not mention anything about the complexity of the methods. In many cases such arguments were not done in the original papers and so it is hard to tabulate complexities for different methods, but I think that some comments can be added regarding that. Some additional references that you might want to consider are listed at the end. In the section "Inverse Constrained Learning from Offline Dataset" I believe that except for Qual et al. constraint inference from offline data has been studied in [1]. Here are some typos/rewordings/minor fixes for your convenience. In (32) and (41) the integration is over $a$ but a does not appear in the integral. In (50) three different datasets appear. What is the relationship of $\mathcal{D}$ with the others? "By utilizing the posterior distribution over constraint sets at previous..." I think this sentence can be rewritten to be a bit more clear In (52) the subscripts in the expectations appear to be in bold for some reason Also it would be nice to start a section with text and not with Figures. This happens in section1 and 2.4. In (5) maybe include $\forall i \in [1,N]$ as in (6) In (11) it is not clear which is the original problem of this dual. I assume it is (5) "task of inferring the implicit constraints followed by expert agents" maybe a different word than followed is more appropriate Sometimes when referring to a single person "and inherent to experts’ own experience" it should be expert's. This happens a few times in the paper. "Discounted factor" should be Discount factor The term nominal is used a few times in the paper but it is not clearly defined somewhere. where $\omega_m\sim q(\omega)$ Specifically, there is a . missing at the end of the sentence. "constraints function $c(s,a). i.e. \pi^{\epsilon}\mathbb{E} =$ ..." avoid starting a sentence with i.e. "Within each partition ι, CBN-IRL learns" in multiple sections in the paper the letter i appears without the dot on top. I think it would be clearer if you used just i. If it is done because you want to use i only for the index of a constraint then it is fine. "proposed to learn single reward function" --> to learn a single "here f is implemented by a multi-layer" $f$ or $f_{\omega}$? I would avoid having equations between text, especially when they affect the spacing between lines. In those case just use write them as an equation. See for example below (56). Also when writing an optimization problem use a different line for the constraint (the s.t. part) "., locating outside the support of" -->located In (59) there is both $\pi$ and $\pi(\theta)$ appearing. Is this a typo? In (61) and a few other places there is no gap between the $argmax$ and the expectation "for extracting expert constraints from their demonstration data" maybe rephrase to constraint from expert demonstration data? " independent of environmental interaction." --> interactions sometimes a colon is used to introduce an equation bit sometimes it is missing. (for example (53) and (54)). Also there is no need for a colon to introduce definition 6.1 In (18) maybe just use $|C|$ for the size of the set "Striving for reliable constraint inference, the policy represent" maybe you meant representation? "domains, 2) soft constraints" instead of , maybe use and "In the continuous environment, constructing"--> environments In definition 5.1 is should be $s_T$ "but the soft constraints requires a threshold"--> require "by expert demonstration is a trivial "--> demonstrations "Lagrange method or Interior Points Method."--> Interior Point Methods "The parameters of the constraint models $\omega$ is given by:"--> are in page 4 when the cost $c$ is discussed I think it would be clearer if it was written as $c(s,a)$ as it is a function. That appleid for example in table 2 and above eq. (2) In (19) the partition should be $Z_c$ or $Z_{c_{\omega}}$? "in RL to learn model-free controller without"--> a model-free... " While studying these topics are not our primary focus, we"--> is not **References**: [1] D. Papadimitriou et al. "Bayesian Constraint Inference from User Demonstrations Based on Margin-Respecting Preference Models", ICRA 2024 [2] C. Basich et al. "Learning Constraints on Autonomous Behavior from Proactive Feedback", IROS 2023 [3]. J. Jang et al. "Inverse Constraint Learning and Generalization by Transferable Reward Decomposition", RA-L [4] K. Kim et al. "Learning Shared Safety Constraints from Multi-task Demonstrations" NIPS 2023 [5] F. Palafox et al. "Learning Hyperplanes for Multi-Agent Collision Avoidance in Space" [6] Q. Wei et al. "Isoperimetric Constraint Inference for Discrete-Time Nonlinear Systems Based on Inverse Optimal Control", TCYB [7] F. Ding et al, "X-MEN: Guaranteed XOR-Maximum Entropy Constrained Inverse Reinforcement Learning", UAI 2022 [8] B. Peng et al. "Positive-Unlabeled Constraint Learning (PUCL) for Inferring Nonlinear Continuous Constraints Functions from Expert Demonstrations", arxiv [9] B. Yue et al. "Provably Efficient Exploration in Inverse Constrained Reinforcement Learning", arxiv

**Requested Changes:**
It would be great if the authors could address the weaknesses listed above. Regarding the third bullet point, there is no need for trying to derive computational complexities, but some discussion or table with some comments would be a good addition to the paper.

Yes

paper_title_zh: 反向约束强化学习的全面综述：定义、进展与挑战
paper_abstract_zh: 逆约束强化学习（ICRL）是从专家代理的演示数据中推断出其遵循的隐式约束的任务。作为一个新兴的研究课题，ICRL近年来受到了广泛关注。本文对ICRL的最新进展进行了分类综述，为机器学习研究人员和实践者以及希望理解ICRL的定义、进展和重要挑战的初学者提供了全面的参考。我们首先正式定义了问题，并概述了促进在各种场景中进行约束推断的算法框架。这些场景包括确定性或随机环境、有限演示的环境以及多代理环境。针对每种情境，我们阐述了关键挑战，并介绍了一系列解决这些问题的基本方法。本综述涵盖了用于评估ICRL代理的离散、虚拟和现实环境。我们还深入探讨了ICRL的最相关应用，如自动驾驶、机器人控制和体育分析。为了激发持续研究，我们在综述的最后讨论了ICRL中尚未解决的关键问题，这些问题可以有效促进理论理解与实际工业应用之间的桥梁。
review_content_zh:
**贡献总结：**
据我所知，本文是约束推理领域内的第一篇综述文章。作者讨论了强化学习和控制任务中约束推理的最新进展。作者为该研究领域提供了动机，并讨论了大多数最近的进展。他们还讨论了一些开放性问题，作为未来研究的可能方向。

**优点和缺点：**
**优点**：本文结构良好。作者试图以一种有条理的方式呈现每篇论文的设置和实施的关键细节。据我所知，大部分相关的研究工作都已包括在内。我在后面的评论中增加了一些额外的论文，作者可能需要考虑。作者还试图揭示一些可能感兴趣的未来的研究方向。
**缺点**：
* 在我看来，那些也对不同方法进行基准测试的综述更有价值，尽管我理解这是一个更为复杂的任务。我认为在未来的研究方向上，作者应该更多地阐述“挑战部分”和可能的未来研究途径。例如，可以讨论动态约束（如移动障碍物）的推理问题。此外，约束推理可以潜在地用于对大型语言模型（LLM）进行对齐，使其尊重约束。
* 作者也没有提及方法的复杂性。在许多情况下，原始论文中没有进行此类论证，因此很难为不同方法列出复杂性，但我认为可以添加一些相关评论。一些您可能需要考虑的额外参考文献列在文末。
在“从离线数据集进行逆约束学习”部分，我相信除了Qual等人之外，从离线数据中进行约束推理已在[1]中研究过。以下是一些方便您参考的错别字/重写/小修正。

paper_title: Measuring the outcome and impact of research capacity strengthening initiatives: A review of indicators used or described in the published and grey literature
paper_abstract:
Background: Development partners and research councils are increasingly investing in research capacity strengthening initiatives in low- and middle-income countries to support sustainable research systems. However, there are few reported evaluations of research capacity strengthening initiatives and no agreed evaluation metrics. 
 Methods: To advance progress towards a standardised set of outcome and impact indicators, this paper presents a structured review of research capacity strengthening indicators described in the published and grey literature. 
 Results: We identified a total of 668 indicators of which 40% measured output, 59.5% outcome and 0.5% impact. Only 1% of outcome and impact indicators met all four quality criteria applied. A majority (63%) of reported outcome indicators clustered in four focal areas, including: research management and support (97/400), the attainment and application of new research skills and knowledge (62/400), research collaboration (53/400), and knowledge transfer (39/400). 
 Conclusions: Whilst this review identified few examples of quality research capacity strengthening indicators, it has identified priority focal areas in which outcome and impact indicators could be developed as well as a small set of ‘candidate’ indicators that could form the basis of development efforts.
review_content:
Summary: This paper provides a review and analysis of the quality and suitability of M&E metrics for funding that is allocated to strengthen research capacity in LMIC's. Published and grey literature has been reviewed to identify indicators used to measure the outputs, outcomes and impacts of relevant programmes and the findings have been assessed in terms of content and quality. The authors conclude that the outcome indicators identified were of low quality and impact indicators are almost always missing from RCS MEL frameworks and recommend further work to develop appropriate indicators to measure the outcomes and impacts of research capacity strengthening programmes/activities. Through the review of existing outcome indicators the authors have identified four focal areas against which indicators could be developed.

Methods:
  * The search strategy and study selection is clearly described and links to source data are available. Data extraction and analysis methods are also clearly described.
Major:
  * No major points to address. This work is by a leading team in the field of RCS research and makes a useful contribution to the literature in providing a thorough review of indicators used to monitor and evaluate work funded to strengthen research capacity.
Minor:
  * Though the article is not focused on health research, health is specifically referred to in a few places throughout the article e.g. line 4 (and corresponding references) of the introduction, Research Funding example indicators in Table 2, RMS example indicators in Table 3, numbers 5 and 6 of the 6 outcome indicators meeting all four quality criteria refer to TDR, and the impact indicators are all acknowledged as being specific to health and wellbeing. It would be interesting to understand which other research disciplines featured in the literature reviewed, and the spread of results across disciplines in order that analysis and findings could indicate if there is variety between and/or within disciplines in approaches to MEL for RCS and what can be learnt from this.
  * No background, references or justification is given for the pre-determined 'quality' criteria.
  * The authors note in 'Limitations' that project documents were not available in the public domain and documents not in English were excluded. Further reflection on to what extent Log Frames, ToC's and other MEL docs for programmes that have RCS as a primary or secondary outcome would be in the public domain could be helpful e.g. is it common for delivery partners of RCS programmes to make their MEL docs publicly available? If not, are these indicators representative of those currently/recently being used by actors in the RCS programme delivery space or do they represent a subset that is more likely to have publicly available data?
paper_title_zh: 衡量研究能力提升举措的成果和影响：对已发表和灰色文献中使用的或描述的指标综述
paper_abstract_zh:
背景：发展伙伴和研究委员会越来越多地投资于低收入和中收入国家的研究能力建设倡议，以支持可持续的研究系统。然而，关于研究能力建设倡议的评估报告较少，且没有统一的评估指标。

方法：为了推进制定一套标准化的成果和影响指标，本文对已发表文献和灰色文献中描述的研究能力建设指标进行了结构化综述。

结果：我们共识别出668个指标，其中40%衡量产出，59.5%衡量成果，0.5%衡量影响。仅有1%的成果和影响指标符合所有四个应用的质量标准。大多数（63%）报告的成果指标集中在四个重点领域，包括：研究管理和支持（97/400）、新研究技能和知识的获取与应用（62/400）、研究合作（53/400）以及知识转移（39/400）。

结论：尽管本次综述发现的优质研究能力建设指标较少，但它已识别出可以开发成果和影响指标的重点领域，以及一小部分可作为发展基础的“候选”指标。
review_content_zh:
摘要：本文对用于加强低收入和中等收入国家（LMIC）研究能力的资助的监测与评估（M&E）指标的质量和适用性进行了回顾和分析。通过审查已发表和灰色文献，识别了用于衡量相关项目产出、成果和影响的指标，并对这些发现的内容和质量进行了评估。作者得出结论，所识别的成果指标质量较低，影响指标几乎总是从研究能力加强（RCS）的监测、评估和学习（MEL）框架中缺失，并建议进一步工作以开发适当的指标来衡量研究能力加强项目和活动的成果和影响。通过对现有成果指标的回顾，作者确定了四个可以开发指标的重点领域。

方法：
  * 搜索策略和研究选择描述清晰，并提供与源数据的链接。数据提取和分析方法也描述清晰。
主要点：
  * 无需解决的主要问题。这项工作由RCS研究领域的领先团队完成，通过对用于监测和评估资助加强研究能力工作的指标进行全面回顾，为文献做出了有益的贡献。
次要点：
  * 尽管文章未专注于健康研究，但在文章的几个地方明确提到了健康，例如引言第4行（及相应参考文献）、表2中的研究资助示例指标、表3中的RMS示例指标、符合所有四个质量标准的6个成果指标中的第5和第6项提到TDR，且所有影响指标均被认可为特定于健康和福祉。了解文献回顾中涉及的其他研究领域以及跨学科结果的分布将很有趣，以便分析和发现可以表明在RCS的MEL方法上是否存在学科间和/或学科内的差异，以及可以从中学习到什么。
  * 未提供预先确定的“质量”标准的背景、参考文献或理由。
  * 作者在“局限性”中指出，项目文件未在公共领域提供，且非英文文件被排除。进一步反思程序中将RCS作为主要或次要成果的日志框架、理论变革（ToC）和其他MEL文件在公共领域的程度可能会有所帮助，例如，RCS项目的交付合作伙伴是否通常会将其MEL文件公开？如果不是，这些指标是否代表了RCS项目交付领域的当前/近期使用的指标，还是它们代表了一个更可能有公开数据的子集？
